10.1002/aepp.70078.title: Correction to “The Role of Intrinsic Motivation and Continuous Enhancement on the Intention to Implement Animal Welfare Practices in Dairy Farming”
10.1002/aepp.70078.title_zh: 更正：“内在动机与持续改进在奶牛养殖中实施动物福利实践意愿中的作用

10.1002/aepp.70079.abstract: Prior research analyzes the economic effects of Voluntary Sustainability Standards (VSS)—such as Fairtrade, Organic, and GlobalGAP—but little is known about the stability of these effects over time. Using a nationally representative farm survey of Peru (2015–2019), this study analyzes whether VSS certification is associated with reduced inter‐annual price and yield volatility. Applying pooled OLS, matching, and internal instruments, we find that certification is associated with 27% lower price volatility and 17% lower yield volatility, particularly benefiting family farms, translating into an 81% reduction in their net farm revenue volatility. The results highlight VSS' potential to enhance revenue stability.
10.1002/aepp.70079.abstract_zh: 已有研究分析了自愿性可持续标准（VSS）——如公平贸易、有机认证和全球良好农业规范——的经济效应，但关于这些效应随时间稳定性的认知仍十分有限。本研究利用秘鲁全国代表性农户调查数据（2015-2019年），分析VSS认证是否与降低的年际价格波动和产量波动相关。通过混合OLS回归、匹配法和内部工具变量法，我们发现认证与价格波动降低27%、产量波动降低17%显著相关，其中家庭农场受益尤为突出，其净农场收入波动降幅达81%。研究结果凸显了VSS在增强收入稳定性方面的潜力。
10.1002/aepp.70079.title: Certified and Stable? Price and Yield Volatility Under Voluntary Sustainability Standards in Peru
10.1002/aepp.70079.title_zh: 认证与稳定？秘鲁自愿性可持续标准下的价格与产量波动

10.1002/aepp.70080.abstract: Index insurance, while heralded as a potential solution to alleviate poverty and food insecurity among agricultural households, has its own set of challenges, notably basis risk. Basis risk is the discrepancy between the insurance payout and losses incurred, posing a significant deterrent to the adoption of index insurance. This study investigates the effect of basis risk training on the uptake of rainfall index insurance among rural farmers in Senegal, employing an educational simulation game as a pedagogical tool. Our results suggest that a lack of transparency and a misunderstanding of basis risk contribute to low participation and a lack of trust in index insurance.
10.1002/aepp.70080.abstract_zh: 指数保险虽被誉为缓解农业家庭贫困与粮食安全的潜在解决方案，但其自身存在一系列挑战，尤其是基差风险。基差风险是指保险赔付与实际损失之间的差异，这成为阻碍指数保险推广的重要因素。本研究通过教育模拟游戏作为教学工具，探讨基差风险培训对塞内加尔农村农民购买降雨指数保险的影响。结果表明，透明度不足以及对基差风险的误解，是导致参与率低且对指数保险缺乏信任的原因。
10.1002/aepp.70080.title: Why Didn't I Get a Payout? Understanding Farmer Choices, Index Insurance, and Basis Risk
10.1002/aepp.70080.title_zh: 为什么我没有获得赔付？理解农户选择、指数保险与基差风险

10.1002/aepp.70081.abstract: Increased frequency of extreme weather events, particularly droughts, threatens grassland farming by destabilizing yields and farms' economic viability. We examine, theoretically and through numerical simulations, how sown plant diversity (natural insurance) influences the attractiveness of indemnity and drought index insurance (formal insurance) in grassland systems across Europe. Our analysis shows that higher sown diversity reduces farmers' willingness to pay for indemnity insurance, suggesting adverse selection. In contrast, drought index insurance remains equally attractive regardless of diversity. These effects hold across different insurance designs and risk preferences. Our findings offer valuable insights for farmers, insurers, and policymakers aiming to build resilient, sustainable agricultural systems.
10.1002/aepp.70081.abstract_zh: 极端天气事件（尤其是干旱）频率的增加，通过破坏产量和农场的经济可行性，威胁着草地农业。我们通过理论分析和数值模拟，研究了欧洲草地系统中播种植物多样性（自然保险）如何影响赔偿保险和干旱指数保险（正式保险）的吸引力。分析表明，较高的播种多样性降低了农民对赔偿保险的支付意愿，这表明存在逆向选择。相比之下，无论多样性如何，干旱指数保险的吸引力保持不变。这些效应在不同的保险设计和风险偏好下均成立。我们的研究结果为农民、保险公司和政策制定者提供了宝贵见解，旨在构建具有韧性和可持续性的农业系统。
10.1002/aepp.70081.title: Coping With Production Risk: Effects of Sown Plant Diversity on the Attractiveness of Crop Insurance in Grasslands
10.1002/aepp.70081.title_zh: 应对生产风险：播种植物多样性对草地作物保险吸引力的影响

10.1002/aepp.70082.abstract: Eggs are an inexpensive and sustainable source of proteins, but volatility in the U.S. egg prices has intensified in recent years, raising concerns over food affordability and market stability. This study examines the drivers of U.S. egg price dynamics over 2004–2025 using a two‐stage framework that combines LASSO‐based variable selection with an ARIMAX forecasting model. The results reveal strong price persistence, together with significant impacts of energy, feed costs and seasonal demand. The influence of avian influenza is strongly time‐dependent, with limited effects in full‐sample averages but significant impacts during high‐intensity outbreak periods, particularly in the mid‐2010s and after 2022. Out‐of‐sample forecasts indicate that the LASSO‐ARIMAX model reduces forecast errors by more than 60% relative to a univariate ARIMA benchmark. These findings suggest that stabilizing key input costs, strengthening timely epidemiological surveillance, and proactively managing predictable seasonal demand pressures are more effective than relying on any single explanatory factor.
10.1002/aepp.70082.abstract_zh: 鸡蛋是一种廉价且可持续的蛋白质来源，但近年来美国鸡蛋价格波动加剧，引发了对食品可负担性和市场稳定性的担忧。本研究采用两阶段框架，结合基于LASSO的变量选择与ARIMAX预测模型，考察了2004-2025年间美国鸡蛋价格动态的驱动因素。结果显示，价格具有强持续性，同时能源、饲料成本和季节性需求的影响显著。禽流感的影响具有强烈的时间依赖性：在全样本平均值中影响有限，但在高强度疫情暴发期（尤其是2010年代中期及2022年后）影响显著。样本外预测表明，相较于单变量ARIMA基准模型，LASSO-ARIMAX模型将预测误差降低了60%以上。这些发现表明，稳定关键投入成本、加强及时流行病学监测以及主动管理可预测的季节性需求压力，比依赖任何单一解释因素更为有效。
10.1002/aepp.70082.title: Understanding Egg Price Volatility and Policy Implications in the U.S. With Machine Learning
10.1002/aepp.70082.title_zh: 美国鸡蛋价格波动理解与机器学习政策启示

10.1002/aepp.70083.abstract: We provide a comprehensive review of the U.S. Renewable Fuel Standard (RFS), synthesizing nearly two decades of program evolution, market outcomes, and economic analysis. The RFS mandates minimum volumes of renewable fuel blending through a nested structure based on life‐cycle greenhouse gas reductions, enforced via tradeable Renewable Identification Numbers (RINs). Actual implementation diverged substantially from statutory targets, reaching only 20 billion gallons in 2022 versus the intended 36 billion, primarily due to failure to scale cellulosic biofuel production. RIN prices exhibit extraordinary volatility but follow rational economic fundamentals. Total inflation‐adjusted compliance costs are estimated to be $252.1 billion over 2011 through 2025.
10.1002/aepp.70083.abstract_zh: 本文全面回顾了美国可再生燃料标准（RFS），综合梳理了近二十年的政策演变、市场结果及经济分析。RFS通过基于生命周期温室气体减排量的嵌套结构，强制规定最低可再生燃料掺混量，并借助可交易的可再生识别码（RINs）执行。实际执行情况与法定目标存在显著偏差，2022年仅达到200亿加仑，远低于预期的360亿加仑，主要原因是纤维素生物燃料生产未能实现规模化。RIN价格表现出异常波动性，但遵循理性的经济基本面。经通胀调整后，2011年至2025年间的总合规成本估计为2521亿美元。
10.1002/aepp.70083.title: The Biofuels Blueprint: Understanding the U.S. Renewable Fuel Standard
10.1002/aepp.70083.title_zh: 生物燃料蓝图：理解美国可再生燃料标准

10.1002/aepp.70084.abstract: This study examines how rising food prices affected household welfare in The Gambia using nationally representative data from the 2015/16 Integrated Household Survey (IHS‐3). The analysis reflects household consumption behavior and market conditions prevailing during that period and provides a structural benchmark for understanding vulnerability in an import‐dependent economy. Using data from 5443 households, we estimate price and expenditure elasticities for four key food groups—cereals, animal products, roots and tubers, and fruits and vegetables through a censored Quadratic Almost Ideal Demand System (QUAIDS) model that accounts for zero consumption and nonlinear expenditure effects. Results reveal substantial heterogeneity across income groups and geographic locations. Poor urban households are most vulnerable to food price increases due to greater market dependence and limited substitution options, while rural households are particularly sensitive to cereal price shocks. Compensating variation estimates indicate that poor urban households require significantly higher income compensation to maintain welfare following price increases. Although structural conditions have evolved since 2015, the findings provide baseline evidence on household demand responses and distributional impacts of food price shocks in The Gambia.
10.1002/aepp.70084.abstract_zh: 本研究利用冈比亚2015/16年度综合住户调查（IHS-3）的全国代表性数据，考察粮食价格上涨对家庭福利的影响。分析反映了该时期家庭消费行为与市场状况，为理解进口依赖型经济体的脆弱性提供了结构性基准。基于5443户家庭数据，我们通过考虑零消费和非线性支出效应的删失二次近乎理想需求系统（QUAIDS）模型，估算了四大关键食品类别（谷物、动物产品、块根块茎类、果蔬）的价格弹性与支出弹性。结果显示，不同收入群体和地理区域存在显著异质性。城市贫困家庭因市场依赖度更高且替代选择有限，对粮食价格上涨最为脆弱；而农村家庭对谷物价格冲击尤为敏感。补偿变分估计表明，价格上涨后，城市贫困家庭需获得显著更高的收入补偿才能维持原有福利水平。尽管2015年以来结构性条件已发生变化，但本研究为冈比亚家庭需求响应及粮食价格冲击的分配效应提供了基线证据。
10.1002/aepp.70084.title: Assessing Household Welfare in Response to Rising Food Prices in The Gambia
10.1002/aepp.70084.title_zh: 评估冈比亚食品价格上涨对家庭福利的影响

10.1002/aepp.70085.abstract: We unpack the impact of expansions in ethanol production—as measured by proximity to newly constructed ethanol plants and capacity expansions—on farmland values using land transaction data from Kansas in combination with modern causal inference techniques. We first show that Two‐Way Fixed Effects (TWFE) estimation with data aggregated to the county and township level leads to an average land value effect ranging from 4% to 9% for parcels located within 50 km of an ethanol plant. However, using a modern difference‐in‐difference estimator, we find no evidence of a statistically significant effect on farmland values. Furthermore, our analysis reveals no indication that land value proximity premiums rose following the 2005 Energy Policy Act. We find evidence that the average treatment effect detected by conventional TWFE is largely driven by land transactions in the proximity of ethanol plants that were established prior to the 2005 Energy Policy Act. Proximity to ethanol plants established after the 2005 Energy Policy Act has a smaller and less robust effect on land values.
10.1002/aepp.70085.abstract_zh: 我们利用堪萨斯州的土地交易数据，结合现代因果推断技术，揭示了乙醇产量扩张（以新建乙醇工厂及产能扩张的邻近程度衡量）对农田价值的影响。首先，将数据汇总至县和乡镇层面后，采用双向固定效应（TWFE）估计发现，位于乙醇工厂50公里范围内的地块，其土地价值平均影响幅度在4%至9%之间。然而，使用现代双重差分估计器后，我们未发现乙醇工厂对农田价值具有统计上显著影响的证据。此外，分析表明，2005年《能源政策法案》实施后，土地价值并未因邻近乙醇工厂而出现溢价上升的迹象。我们找到证据表明，传统TWFE方法检测到的平均处理效应主要源于2005年《能源政策法案》之前已建立的乙醇工厂周边土地交易。而2005年《能源政策法案》之后建立的乙醇工厂，其邻近性对土地价值的影响较小且稳健性较弱。
10.1002/aepp.70085.title: Unpacking the Farmland Capitalization Effect of Ethanol Establishment
10.1002/aepp.70085.title_zh: 乙醇设施对农地资本化效应的解析

10.1002/aepp.70086.abstract: Presenting pesticide dosages in range formats (e.g., 10–40 g) is presumed to offer farmers flexibility to adjust dosage application based on pest or disease pressure, and thereby facilitating precise use. However, this conventional practice may unintentionally encourage pesticide overuse. Based on a lab‐in‐the‐field experiment, this study finds that approximately 65% of farmers disregard the minimum dosage when exposed to range‐based labels, anchoring instead on the upper bound. A nudge‐based label design, featuring reference points and brief explanatory cues, can significantly reduce pesticide use without restricting farmers' autonomy. These findings reveal both the hidden risks and promising potential of label‐based interventions, suggesting that thoughtfully designed labels can serve as a low‐cost, scalable policy tool for mitigating excessive chemical use problem in agriculture.
10.1002/aepp.70086.abstract_zh: 以范围形式呈现农药剂量（如10–40克）被认为能为农户提供灵活性，使其根据病虫害压力调整施药量，从而促进精准用药。然而，这一常规做法可能无意中助长农药过度使用。基于一项田间实验室实验，本研究发现约65%的农户在面对范围标签时会忽略最低剂量，反而以上限为锚定标准。一种基于助推设计的标签方案，通过设置参考点并辅以简要解释性提示，能在不限制农户自主权的前提下显著减少农药使用量。这些发现揭示了标签干预措施既存在潜在风险，也蕴含巨大潜力，表明精心设计的标签可作为低成本、可推广的政策工具，用于缓解农业中化学品过度使用问题。
10.1002/aepp.70086.title: The Label Trap: Unintended Consequences of Pesticide Labeling and the Power of Nudges
10.1002/aepp.70086.title_zh: 标签陷阱：农药标签的意外后果与助推的力量

10.1002/aepp.70087.abstract: The United States spends billions annually on crop insurance premium subsidies, yet the prevailing distance‐based guarantee design unintentionally rewards risk‐taking by linking subsidies to yield variability. We consider a simple redesign: define guarantees in terms of probability so that coverage reflects a consistent likelihood of indemnity. Using US data, this probability‐based approach would reallocate about $3.3 billion in annual subsidies from high‐risk to low‐risk production, reducing regional disparities by two‐thirds without changing total subsidies. Because most publicly subsidized crop insurance programs around the world share this structure, adopting probability‐based guarantees could help realign agricultural production toward more resilient and sustainable regions and practices.
10.1002/aepp.70087.abstract_zh: 美国每年在农作物保险保费补贴上投入数十亿美元，然而现行基于距离的保障设计因将补贴与产量波动挂钩，无意中激励了风险承担行为。我们提出一种简单的重新设计方案：以概率定义保障，使保险覆盖范围反映一致的赔付可能性。基于美国数据的测算表明，这种概率导向方法每年可将约33亿美元补贴从高风险生产重新分配至低风险生产，在不改变补贴总额的情况下将区域差异减少三分之二。由于全球大多数公共补贴农作物保险计划均采用类似结构，采纳概率型保障有助于引导农业生产向更具韧性和可持续性的区域及实践模式转型。
10.1002/aepp.70087.title: Crop Insurance Design and On‐Farm Risk Adaptation
10.1002/aepp.70087.title_zh: 农作物保险设计与农场风险适应

10.1002/aepp.70088.abstract: Providing nutritious meals in institutional settings with financial constraints, such as military dining facilities, is challenging. The US Department of War (DoW) and US Department of Agriculture (USDA) collaborated to modernize the Basic Daily Food Allowance (BDFA) using an optimization model that incorporates service members' consumption patterns and nutritional standards. The model estimated optimal diets for four demographic groups, producing costs similar to the 2019 BDFA but with greater food variety. This first application of the USDA Food Plan to military purchase data demonstrates a flexible approach for improving cost estimates in military and other institutional food programs.
10.1002/aepp.70088.abstract_zh: 在资金受限的机构环境（如军队餐饮设施）中提供营养餐食颇具挑战。美国战争部与美国农业部合作，通过引入优化模型对基本每日食品津贴进行现代化改革，该模型整合了军人的消费模式与营养标准。模型为四个不同人口群体估算出最优膳食方案，其成本与2019年基本每日食品津贴相当，但食物种类更为丰富。此次将美国农业部食品计划首次应用于军购数据，展示了提升军队及其他机构食品项目成本估算灵活性的可行路径。
10.1002/aepp.70088.title: The Cost of a Nutritious Diet in Cafeterias: Evidence From US Military Dining Facilities
10.1002/aepp.70088.title_zh: 食堂营养膳食的成本：来自美国军队餐饮设施的证据

10.1002/aepp.70089.abstract: This paper presents an economic analysis of US agricultural policy, building on a modified version of Gardner's efficient redistribution. We argue that agricultural policy is motivated as an attempt to implement an efficient redistribution scheme that redistributes income toward farmers who, as a group, have been adversely affected by agricultural productivity growth. We show how this approach helps explain why subsidies are more common in agriculture than in other sectors of the economy. We explore how our analysis provides new and useful insights into the design and implementation of US agricultural policy.
10.1002/aepp.70089.abstract_zh: 本文基于加德纳有效再分配理论的修正版本，对美国农业政策进行了经济分析。我们认为，农业政策的动机在于试图实施一种有效的再分配方案，将收入重新分配给那些因农业生产率增长而受到不利影响的农民群体。我们展示了这一方法如何有助于解释为何补贴在农业领域比在经济其他部门更为普遍。我们探讨了我们的分析如何为美国农业政策的设计与实施提供新颖且有益的见解。
10.1002/aepp.70089.title: On the Economics of US Agricultural Policy
10.1002/aepp.70089.title_zh: 美国农业政策的经济学分析

10.1002/aepp.70090.abstract: This study examines the main drivers influencing the adoption of two types of precision farming technologies in the viticultural sector: Decision Support Systems (DSSs) and Variable Rate Technologies (VRTs). We apply a partial proportional odds model and find that socio‐demographic characteristics are not significant determinants of adoption, whereas farm structural features and a general positive attitude toward technology significantly increase the likelihood of uptake. Environmental concern plays a role only with respect to the intention to adopt, but not in explaining actual adoption behavior. Moreover, farmers' perceptions of the usefulness of digital technologies and the difficulties associated with their use emerge as key factors shaping adoption intentions among non‐adopters. These results suggest that targeted training initiatives and strengthened advisory services could play a crucial role in fostering the diffusion of precision farming technologies in viticulture.
10.1002/aepp.70090.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了影响葡萄种植业采纳两类精准农业技术的主要驱动因素：决策支持系统（DSSs）与变量施肥技术（VRTs）。通过应用部分比例优势模型，本研究发现社会人口特征并非技术采纳的显著决定因素，而农场结构特征及对技术的普遍积极态度则显著提升了采纳概率。环境关注仅在采纳意愿层面发挥作用，但无法解释实际采纳行为。此外，农户对数字技术实用性的认知及使用困难程度，成为影响非采纳者采纳意愿的关键因素。这些结果表明，针对性的培训计划与强化咨询服务可在促进葡萄种植业精准农业技术推广中发挥关键作用。
10.1002/aepp.70090.title: Drivers of Precision Agriculture Adoption in Italian Viticulture
10.1002/aepp.70090.title_zh: 意大利葡萄栽培中精准农业采纳的驱动因素

10.1002/aepp.70091.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This paper investigates how lenders' costs of funds affect agricultural loan interest rates. We use a matched sample of US farm‐loan data and lender‐specific cost of funds, and a farm fixed effects design, to estimate pass‐through, conditioning on borrower characteristics. We find modest average pass‐through of funding costs to farm loan interest rates, with meaningful differences across lender types and local market conditions. Our findings suggest that borrower characteristics and common macroeconomic trends remain central to agricultural loan pricing, but lender business models and local credit market structure also shape how changes in funding costs affect farm borrowing costs.</jats:p>
10.1002/aepp.70091.abstract_zh: 本文研究了贷款机构的资金成本如何影响农业贷款利率。我们利用美国农场贷款数据与贷款机构特定资金成本的匹配样本，并采用农场固定效应模型，在控制借款人特征的情况下估计传导效应。研究发现，资金成本向农场贷款利率的平均传导程度较为温和，且在不同贷款机构类型和当地市场条件下存在显著差异。我们的结果表明，借款人特征和共同宏观经济趋势仍是农业贷款定价的核心因素，但贷款机构的商业模式和当地信贷市场结构同样影响着资金成本变化对农场借贷成本的作用路径。
10.1002/aepp.70091.title: How Lender Cost of Funds and Market Structure Shape Agricultural Interest Rates
10.1002/aepp.70091.title_zh: 贷款资金成本与市场结构如何塑造农业贷款利率

10.1002/aepp.70093.abstract: Countries are accelerating actions to reduce food loss and waste to ensure global food security and sustainable development. Cooperatives are considered important channels for promoting the use of agricultural technologies and improving farmers' skills, which are regarded as key factors in reducing harvest losses. However, owing to data limitations, few systematic assessments of the effects of cooperative membership on food losses exist. On the basis of survey data from 703 maize growers in three major maize production areas in China, propensity score matching (PSM) and endogenous switching regression (ESR) were used in this study to evaluate the effects of cooperative membership on the maize harvest losses of households. The results revealed that membership significantly reduced maize harvest losses by 68%, saving farmers an average of 238.05 kg per ha, which is worth $91.92 per ha. Membership also contributed to minor pest attacks and better working attitudes during the harvest stage. Cooperative membership is critically important for China's food security, resource conservation, and environmental protection. If the average maize harvest loss reaches the level of loss observed among member households, then it is possible to meet the food consumption needs of 13.61 million people, saving 0.74 million ha of land and 0.29 million tons of fertilizer used for maize production and reducing carbon emissions by 4.04 million tons and the water footprint by 6.43 billion m 3 .
10.1002/aepp.70093.abstract_zh: 各国正加速行动减少粮食损失与浪费，以保障全球粮食安全与可持续发展。合作社被视为推广农业技术、提升农户技能的重要渠道，而这两者被认为是降低收获损失的关键因素。然而，受数据限制，关于合作社成员身份对粮食损失影响的系统性评估仍较为匮乏。本研究基于中国三大玉米主产区703户玉米种植户的调查数据，采用倾向得分匹配（PSM）与内生转换回归（ESR）方法，评估合作社成员身份对农户玉米收获损失的影响。结果表明：成员身份显著降低了68%的玉米收获损失，平均每公顷为农户节省238.05公斤，折合每公顷91.92美元。此外，成员身份还有助于减少收获阶段的虫害侵袭，并改善农户的工作态度。合作社成员身份对中国粮食安全、资源节约与环境保护具有关键意义。若玉米平均收获损失降至成员农户的水平，则可满足1360万人的粮食消费需求，节省74万公顷土地及29万吨玉米生产用化肥，减少404万吨碳排放，并降低64.3亿立方米的水足迹。
10.1002/aepp.70093.title: Impact of Cooperative Membership on Maize Harvest Losses in China
10.1002/aepp.70093.title_zh: 合作社成员身份对中国玉米收获损失的影响

10.1002/aepp.70094.abstract: Professional service for digital technology like agricultural drones lowers transaction costs and scope thresholds for smallholders. Meanwhile, perceptual adoption barriers remain underexplored. We conduct a two‐stage choice experiment with a randomized video‐based information treatment among 384 Chinese crop farmers to measure its effect on farmers' willingness to pay (WTP) for agricultural drone services (ADS). While video‐based information significantly reduces farmers' WTP for contracts relative to oral agreements, it increases WTP for overall drone services among farmers who are younger, higher‐income, cultivate larger‐scale farms near tractor roads, have limited access to digital dissemination, and show lower risk preferences. By incorporating perceived uncertainty and risk management into the information‐adoption framework, we provide insights for policy support of digital agriculture service markets.
10.1002/aepp.70094.abstract_zh: 农业无人机等数字技术的专业服务降低了小农户的交易成本和规模门槛。然而，感知层面的采用障碍仍未得到充分研究。我们针对384名中国种植农户开展了一项两阶段选择实验，并采用随机视频信息干预措施，以衡量其对农户农业无人机服务支付意愿的影响。研究发现，与口头协议相比，视频信息显著降低了农户对合同的支付意愿，但提高了年轻、高收入、在机耕道附近经营较大规模农场、数字传播渠道有限且风险偏好较低的农户对整体无人机服务的支付意愿。通过将感知不确定性和风险管理纳入信息采纳分析框架，我们为数字农业服务市场的政策支持提供了启示。
10.1002/aepp.70094.title: How Video‐Based Information Affects Farmers' Willingness to Pay for Drone Services
10.1002/aepp.70094.title_zh: 视频信息如何影响农民对无人机服务支付意愿

10.1002/aepp.70095.abstract: This study investigates consumer food responses to Hurricanes Helene and Milton, which affected a swath of the Southeastern U.S. in 2024. Using representative consumer survey data from six affected states, we analyze 10 distinct food responses classified into ex ante and ex post responses, and examine their associations with food insufficiency and diet quality. We find that ex ante food stockpiling is associated with a lower likelihood of food insufficiency and a higher diet quality score. Conversely, the ex post drop in food spending due to income loss is associated with a higher likelihood of food insufficiency and a lower diet quality score. We also examine heterogeneity in food responses across sociodemographic groups. Our results suggest that targeted support for families with children and low‐income households warrant consideration.
10.1002/aepp.70095.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了2024年影响美国东南部地区的飓风海伦和米尔顿对消费者食品应对行为的影响。基于来自六个受灾州的代表性消费者调查数据，我们将10种不同的食品应对行为分为事前应对和事后应对两类，并分析了它们与食品不足和膳食质量之间的关联。研究发现，事前囤积食品与较低的食品不足发生率和较高的膳食质量评分相关。相反，因收入损失导致的事后食品支出下降则与较高的食品不足发生率和较低的膳食质量评分相关。我们还考察了不同社会人口群体在食品应对行为上的异质性。研究结果表明，针对有子女家庭和低收入家庭的有针对性支持值得考虑。
10.1002/aepp.70095.title: Extreme Weather Events and Consumer Food Responses
10.1002/aepp.70095.title_zh: 极端天气事件与消费者食品反应

10.1002/aepp.70096.abstract: Smallholder farmers in developing countries face the twin challenges of improving productivity and managing agricultural risks. One emerging response is outsourcing production tasks to specialized service providers. Using plot‐level data from rice farms in Jiangsu Province, China, and an endogenous treatment‐regression model, this study examines the effects of outsourcing on yields and production risks. Results show that outsourcing increases rice yields by nearly 3%, reduces yield volatility, and lowers the probability of crop failure. These benefits arise from greater access to mechanized services, the substitution of machinery for labor, and more efficient use of inputs. However, outcomes vary by type: machinery‐intensive outsourcing reduces risk, whereas labor‐intensive outsourcing can exacerbate it in weak service markets. Gains are greatest on larger and more fertile plots, underscoring the importance of policies that support mechanization and competitive service markets.
10.1002/aepp.70096.abstract_zh: 发展中国家的农户面临提升生产力和管理农业风险的双重挑战。一种新兴应对策略是将生产任务外包给专业化服务提供商。本研究利用中国江苏省水稻种植的地块层面数据，采用内生处理回归模型，考察了外包对产量和生产风险的影响。结果表明，外包使水稻产量提升近3%，降低了产量波动性，并减少了作物歉收的概率。这些效益源于机械化服务的更易获取、机械对劳动力的替代以及投入要素的更高效利用。然而，不同外包类型的效果存在差异：机械密集型外包降低了风险，而劳动密集型外包在薄弱服务市场中可能加剧风险。在面积更大、土壤更肥沃的地块上，外包效益最为显著，这凸显了支持机械化和竞争性服务市场的政策重要性。
10.1002/aepp.70096.title: Outsourcing Agricultural Services and Risk Reduction in Smallholder Rice Farming: Evidence From China and Global Implications
10.1002/aepp.70096.title_zh: 农业服务外包与小农户水稻种植中的风险降低：来自中国的证据及全球启示

10.1002/aepp.70097.abstract: ABSTRACT To increase farmer adoption of green practices, the EU Common Agricultural Policy includes both mandatory (conditionality) and voluntary instruments (eco‐schemes–ECS– and more demanding, multi‐annual agri‐environment‐climate measures –AECM–). Building on the experiment of Barreiro‐Hurle et al. (2023), which focused on eco‐schemes, this paper analyses farmers' stated willingness to voluntarily adopt AECM. Using a framed experiment with 600 farmers in Spain, Germany, and Poland, we compared two policy interventions—higher mandatory environmental requirements and an equivalent reduction in income linked to CAP direct payments—and varied their intensity. Higher mandatory environmental requirements and an equivalent income reduction reduce the willingness to voluntarily adopt AECM. We also find a positive conditional association between the intensity of ECS adoption and the willingness to adopt AECM, suggesting potential spillover effects. We further show that behavioral factors, particularly perceived fairness of compensation, environmental concern, confidence in the environmental program, and CAP entitlement, explain substantially more variation in willingness to adopt AECM than standard structural and socio‐demographic characteristics (farm and farmer features). These results have implications for the upcoming envisaged CAP green architecture.
10.1002/aepp.70097.abstract_zh: 摘要 为提升农民对绿色实践的采纳率，欧盟共同农业政策同时包含强制性（条件性）与自愿性工具（生态计划——ECS——以及要求更高、多年期的农业环境气候措施——AECM）。本文基于Barreiro‐Hurle等人（2023）聚焦生态计划的实验研究，进一步分析农民自愿采纳AECM的陈述意愿。通过对西班牙、德国和波兰600名农民开展框架实验，我们比较了两种政策干预——提高强制性环境要求与等额削减CAP直接支付相关的收入——并调整其强度。结果表明，更高的强制性环境要求与等额收入削减均会降低农民自愿采纳AECM的意愿。同时，我们发现ECS采纳强度与AECM采纳意愿之间存在正向条件关联，暗示潜在溢出效应。进一步分析显示，行为因素（尤其是补偿公平感知、环境关切、对环保项目的信心及CAP权益认知）对AECM采纳意愿的解释力显著高于标准的结构性与社会人口特征（农场与农民属性）。这些发现对即将实施的CAP绿色架构具有政策启示。
10.1002/aepp.70097.title:
What Really Drives Agri‐Environment‐Climate Measures' Adoption? Mandatory Requirements, Behavioral Traits, and Structural Factors in the
                    CAP
                    Green Architecture
10.1002/aepp.70097.title_zh: 真正驱动农业-环境-气候措施采纳的因素是什么？CAP绿色架构中的强制性要求、行为特征与结构性因素

10.1002/aepp.70098.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Growing demand for healthier beverages is driving innovation in the wine sector, with dealcoholized wine emerging as a promising alternative. However, little is known about the contextual conditions under which consumers would choose dealcoholized wine, particularly in countries with strong wine traditions. To fill this gap, this work examines how situational factors and information treatments influence consumers' willingness to switch from traditional to dealcoholized wine in Italy and Croatia, two countries with different wine consumption traditions. Using a vignette‐based experiment administered to 1600 wine consumers, this study analyses how consumption context and product information affect the likelihood of choosing dealcoholized wine over conventional alternatives. The results show that, although conventional wine remains the preferred option under standard conditions, the likelihood of switching to dealcoholized wine increases when a driving constraint is introduced. Informational treatments significantly affect choices in Italy, whereas Croatian consumers appear to respond more to functional constraints than to calorie or health messages. The findings have implications for producers and policymakers seeking to promote dealcoholized wines.</jats:p>
10.1002/aepp.70098.abstract_zh: 对更健康饮料的需求增长正推动葡萄酒行业创新，无醇葡萄酒正成为一种有前景的替代选择。然而，关于消费者在何种情境条件下会选择无醇葡萄酒，尤其是在具有深厚葡萄酒传统的国家，目前仍知之甚少。为填补这一空白，本研究考察了情境因素和信息处理如何影响意大利和克罗地亚（两个具有不同葡萄酒消费传统的国家）消费者从传统葡萄酒转向无醇葡萄酒的意愿。通过对1600名葡萄酒消费者进行基于情境实验的分析，本研究探讨了消费情境和产品信息如何影响选择无醇葡萄酒而非传统替代品的可能性。结果表明，尽管传统葡萄酒在标准条件下仍是首选，但当引入驾驶限制条件时，转向无醇葡萄酒的可能性增加。信息处理显著影响意大利消费者的选择，而克罗地亚消费者似乎对功能性限制的反应强于对卡路里或健康信息的反应。这些发现对寻求推广无醇葡萄酒的生产商和政策制定者具有启示意义。
10.1002/aepp.70098.title: Promoting Healthier Drinking: Evidence From a Vignette Experiment on Contextual and Informational Drivers of Dealcoholized Wine Choices
10.1002/aepp.70098.title_zh: 促进健康饮酒：情境与信息因素对无醇葡萄酒选择影响的场景实验证据

10.1002/aepp.70099.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This study examines the ecosystem benefits of expanding hemp cultivation by assessing its impact on crop diversity. Using scenario‐based simulations and fixed‐effect panel regressions with county‐level data in Kentucky, we find that increased hemp acreage tends to enhance crop diversity, improving water quality and bird diversity. While agricultural policies aimed at small‐scale farmers align with improving farm profitability, broader ecological benefits may remain limited unless they reach a sufficient scale. Our findings suggest that hemp‐induced crop diversification can generate measurable non‐market economic benefits through improvements in water quality and bird diversity, highlighting the need for practical and proactive policy measures that promote smallholder participation.</jats:p>
10.1002/aepp.70099.abstract_zh: 本研究通过评估工业大麻种植对作物多样性的影响，探讨其带来的生态系统效益。基于肯塔基州县级数据的场景模拟与固定效应面板回归分析发现，工业大麻种植面积的增加倾向于提升作物多样性，进而改善水质与鸟类多样性。尽管面向小规模农户的农业政策与提升农场盈利能力的目标相契合，但若未达到足够规模，其更广泛的生态效益可能仍十分有限。研究结果表明，工业大麻引致的作物多样化可通过水质改善与鸟类多样性提升产生可量化的非市场经济效益，这凸显了制定切实可行且积极主动的政策措施以促进小农户参与的必要性。
10.1002/aepp.70099.title: Hemp Cultivation and Crop Diversification: Implications for Ecosystem Services in Kentucky
10.1002/aepp.70099.title_zh: 大麻种植与作物多样化：对肯塔基州生态系统服务的影响

10.1002/aepp.70100.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This article examines whether Latin American countries are keeping pace with global trends in trade agreement depth or falling behind. Using 681 agreements (1970–2019), we develop the Depth Index of Trade Agreements (DITA) to weight provisions endogenously through factor analysis based on co‐occurrence patterns. Results show that the Pacific Alliance and Central America lag one decade behind North American standards, whereas South America and the Caribbean lag by two to three decades. Partner selection is critical: countries negotiating extensively with developed partners tend to incorporate similar provisions into South–South agreements, suggesting North–South spillover effects. These findings suggest that regional lag reflects policy choices rather than inherent constraints.</jats:p>
10.1002/aepp.70100.abstract_zh: 本文考察拉丁美洲国家在全球贸易协定深度趋势中是同步跟进还是落后。基于681项协定（1970-2019年），我们通过因子分析依据条款共现模式内生性加权，构建了贸易协定深度指数（DITA）。结果显示，太平洋联盟和中美洲落后于北美标准约十年，而南美洲和加勒比地区则落后二至三十年。合作伙伴选择至关重要：与发达国家进行广泛谈判的国家，倾向于将类似条款纳入南南协定中，这表明存在南北溢出效应。这些发现表明，区域滞后反映的是政策选择而非固有约束。
10.1002/aepp.70100.title: Keeping Pace or Falling Behind? The Depth of Latin American Trade Agreements
10.1002/aepp.70100.title_zh: 保持同步还是落后？拉丁美洲贸易协定的深度

10.1002/aepp.70101.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>How food prices affect diet quality is an important question to design policies that can improve the nutrition and health of all Americans. This study investigates the association between food‐at‐home diet quality and aggregate food prices to understand if price movements compromise nutrition, and where price‐based policies could be an effective tool to improve population health. Using detailed household purchase data from 2015 to 2018, our findings suggest three insights. First, consumers make substitutions that largely preserve their given level of diet quality, though that level remains poor relative to recommendations for health. Second, we find minimal evidence of heterogeneous responsiveness to prices by diet quality or sociodemographic characteristics. Third, we find evidence that the substitutions consumers make in their protein choices when prices rise increase the healthfulness of their food baskets. Taken together, our study suggests that encouraging healthier diets probably requires more than pricing policies but that price‐based policies targeted at protein may be more effective than other food groups. That we fail to find evidence of differential responsiveness of diet quality to prices suggests that universal (untargeted) policies can be recommended to improve diets across the population.</jats:p>
                  <jats:p>
                    <jats:bold>JEL Classification:</jats:bold>
                    D12, I12, Q18
                  </jats:p>
10.1002/aepp.70101.abstract_zh: 食品价格如何影响膳食质量，是设计改善全体美国人营养与健康政策的关键问题。本研究探究家庭食品膳食质量与总体食品价格之间的关联，以理解价格波动是否损害营养状况，以及基于价格的政策能否成为改善人口健康的有效工具。利用2015年至2018年的详细家庭购买数据，我们的发现揭示了三个要点。首先，消费者进行的替代行为大体上维持了其既有的膳食质量水平，尽管该水平相对于健康建议而言仍然较差。其次，我们几乎没有发现膳食质量或社会人口特征对价格存在异质性响应程度的证据。第三，我们发现证据表明，当价格上涨时，消费者在蛋白质选择上进行的替代行为提高了其食品篮子的健康程度。综合来看，我们的研究表明，鼓励更健康的膳食可能不仅需要定价政策，但针对蛋白质的基于价格的政策可能比其他食品类别更有效。我们未能发现膳食质量对价格存在差异化响应程度的证据，这表明可以推荐普遍性（非针对性）政策来改善全体人口的膳食。
10.1002/aepp.70101.title: What Happens to Diet Quality When Food Prices Rise? Revealed Preference From National Household Scanner Data, 2015–2018
10.1002/aepp.70101.title_zh: 食品价格上涨时膳食质量如何变化？基于2015–2018年全国家庭扫描数据的显示性偏好分析

10.1002/aepp.70102.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>China's accession to the World Trade Organization in 2001 reshaped global trade, reducing U.S. demand for Mexican manufactured goods and weakening Mexico's manufacturing employment. This study estimates how this trade‐induced decline affected migration and employment decisions among rural Mexicans. Using individual‐level panel data from the Mexican National Rural Household Survey (ENHRUM) and a long‐difference framework, we instrument manufacturing employment with regional exposure to Chinese import competition. Results show that a 10‐percentage‐point decline in manufacturing employment increased the probability of U.S. migration by 24 percentage points and U.S. nonagricultural employment by 17 points, with no significant effects on agricultural employment.</jats:p>
10.1002/aepp.70102.abstract_zh: 2001年中国加入世界贸易组织重塑了全球贸易格局，导致美国对墨西哥制成品的需求下降，进而削弱了墨西哥制造业的就业水平。本研究旨在估算这一贸易冲击引发的制造业就业萎缩对墨西哥农村人口迁移及就业决策的影响。基于墨西哥国家农村家庭调查（ENHRUM）的个体层面面板数据，采用长期差分框架，以各地区对中国进口竞争的暴露度作为制造业就业的工具变量。结果表明：制造业就业率每下降10个百分点，农村人口迁移至美国的概率增加24个百分点，在美国从事非农就业的概率上升17个百分点，而对农业就业未产生显著影响。
10.1002/aepp.70102.title: Chinese Trade Competition and Rural Mexican Migration
10.1002/aepp.70102.title_zh: 中国贸易竞争与墨西哥农村移民

10.1002/aepp.70103.abstract: ABSTRACT Large ad hoc assistance programs have returned to U.S. farm policy since 2017, operating alongside a more developed safety net built around federally subsidized crop insurance, Title I commodity programs, and standing disaster assistance. This paper reviews the renewed use of ad hoc assistance, documents its recent scale using USDA data, and examines its implications for producers and policy design. Repeated ad hoc programs may create expectations of future support while leaving uncertainty about timing, eligibility, and payment formulas. They also raise questions about crop insurance incentives, targeting, transparency, taxpayer exposure, and coordination across safety‐net tools.
10.1002/aepp.70103.abstract_zh: 摘要 自2017年以来，美国农业政策中重新出现了大规模临时援助计划，这些计划与围绕联邦补贴作物保险、第一标题商品计划及常设灾害援助构建的更为完善的安全网并行运作。本文回顾了临时援助的重新启用情况，利用美国农业部数据记录了其近期规模，并探讨了其对生产者及政策设计的影响。反复实施的临时计划可能形成对未来支持的预期，同时却在时间安排、资格认定及支付公式方面留下不确定性。此外，这些计划还引发了关于作物保险激励、目标定位、透明度、纳税人风险敞口以及安全网工具间协调性的问题。
10.1002/aepp.70103.title: Temporary Programs, Lasting Questions: Ad Hoc Assistance in the U.S. Farm Safety Net
10.1002/aepp.70103.title_zh: 临时项目，持久问题：美国农业安全网中的临时援助

10.1002/aepp.70104.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Some rural counties remain dependent on agricultural or manufacturing jobs, but an increasing proportion have diversified economics. Rural counties also differ in their abilities to commute to an urban market characterized by higher wages and labor productivity. National changes in immigration and trade policies have had heterogeneous effects on rural labor markets, with counties dependent on agriculture or food processing facing rising input costs and shrinking international output markets. Increased commuting will help some rural communities adapt, while more remote counties will face outmigration, population loss, and reduced capacity to sustain public services.</jats:p>
10.1002/aepp.70104.abstract_zh: 摘要：部分农村县仍依赖农业或制造业就业，但越来越多的农村县已实现经济多元化。不同农村县在通勤至工资水平与劳动生产率更高的城市市场的能力方面也存在差异。国家移民与贸易政策的变化对农村劳动力市场产生了异质性影响，依赖农业或食品加工业的县面临投入成本上升与国际产出市场萎缩的双重压力。通勤便利性的提升将有助于部分农村社区适应变化，而更为偏远的县则将面临人口外迁、规模缩减以及公共服务维持能力下降的困境。
10.1002/aepp.70104.title: Rural Labor Supply and Economic Opportunities: Commuting, Migration, Tariffs, and Immigration
10.1002/aepp.70104.title_zh: 农村劳动力供给与经济机会：通勤、迁移、关税与移民

10.1002/aepp.70105.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We examine the impact of US–China trade policy announcements on corn and soybean markets. Using time‐series models, our results show that prospective tariff announcements significantly increased implied volatility (IV), especially during the 2018–2019 trade war. Our results show that corn and soybean markets responded to both countries' announcements. We observe the strongest volatility impacts at the 90% and 95% strikes. Our results indicate that higher IV raised hedging costs for producers, further constricting farm margins– a 7.5% rise in IV increased soybean option premiums by approximately 3.75%. These findings highlight the financial burden imposed by trade policy uncertainty beyond its impact on commodity prices.</jats:p>
10.1002/aepp.70105.abstract_zh: 摘要：本文研究了美中贸易政策公告对玉米和大豆市场的影响。基于时间序列模型，我们的结果表明，预期关税公告显著提高了隐含波动率（IV），尤其是在2018–2019年贸易战期间。研究显示，玉米和大豆市场对两国的公告均有反应。我们在90%和95%执行价处观察到最强的波动率影响。结果指出，更高的隐含波动率提高了生产者的对冲成本，进一步压缩了农场利润——隐含波动率每上升7.5%，大豆期权溢价约增加3.75%。这些发现凸显了贸易政策不确定性在影响商品价格之外所带来的财务负担。
10.1002/aepp.70105.title: The Cost of Uncertainty: US–China Tariff Effects on Agricultural Commodity Markets
10.1002/aepp.70105.title_zh: 不确定性的代价：美中关税对农产品市场的影响

10.1002/aepp.70106.abstract: ABSTRACT Since 2014, the number of schools offering universal free meals to all enrolled children without requiring annual meal applications has increased meaningfully. Using USDA's Purchase to Plate Crosswalk, a difference‐in‐differences framework, and a nationwide consumer panel, the effect of universal‐free‐meal exposure on the diet quality of food‐at‐home purchases is assessed in terms of the Healthy Eating Index (HEI). Consistent with earlier findings, households exposed to universal free meals reduce grocery spending by over 6%. There is no deleterious overall effect of universal‐free‐meal exposure on the diet quality of food‐at‐home purchases as measured by the HEI.
10.1002/aepp.70106.abstract_zh: 摘要 自2014年以来，无需年度餐食申请即可向所有在校儿童提供免费餐食的学校数量显著增加。本研究利用美国农业部的"从采购到餐盘"数据转换工具、双重差分框架以及全国消费者面板数据，以健康饮食指数（HEI）为衡量标准，评估了普及免费餐食政策对家庭食品购买中居家饮食质量的影响。与早期研究结果一致，受普及免费餐食政策影响的家庭，其食品杂货支出减少了6%以上。以HEI为衡量指标，普及免费餐食政策对居家食品购买的整体饮食质量并未产生不利影响。
10.1002/aepp.70106.title: Do Universal Free School Meals Improve the Dietary Quality of Food‐At‐Home Purchases?
10.1002/aepp.70106.title_zh: 全民免费校餐能否改善家庭食品购买的膳食质量？

10.1002/aepp.70107.abstract: ABSTRACT Gene editing (GE) is gaining momentum worldwide, but limited data on UK farmers' preferences hinders our understanding of its potential impact amid deregulation debates. Based on a survey of 200 English arable farmers, we employ a Latent Class Analysis and Multinomial Logit regressions to investigate current preferences for GE crops. The analysis reveals a high willingness of adoption, outlines three preference profiles, including eager, wary, and hesitant adopters, and identify factors influencing such preferences. Results spot a possible substitution effect among GE crops and agricultural insurance, and suggest farmers may adopt GE in response to growing public demand for sustainable practices.
10.1002/aepp.70107.abstract_zh: 摘要 基因编辑技术在全球范围内发展迅速，但关于英国农民偏好的数据有限，这阻碍了我们在放松管制辩论中理解其潜在影响。基于对200名英格兰耕地农民的调查，我们采用潜在类别分析和多项逻辑回归模型，研究当前对基因编辑作物的偏好。分析显示农民采用意愿较高，勾勒出三种偏好类型，包括积极采纳者、谨慎采纳者和犹豫采纳者，并识别出影响这些偏好的因素。结果揭示了基因编辑作物与农业保险之间可能存在的替代效应，并表明农民可能因公众对可持续实践日益增长的需求而采纳基因编辑技术。
10.1002/aepp.70107.title: Farmers' Preferences for Gene Editing Crops and Influencing Factors
10.1002/aepp.70107.title_zh: 农民对基因编辑作物的偏好及其影响因素

10.1002/aepp.70108.abstract: ABSTRACT This paper examines the relationship between participation in the EU Rural Development Program and the economic performance of Italian olive farms using a finite‐mixture model with inverse‐probability‐weighted regression adjustment. Based on 2010–2022 FADN panel data, it estimates heterogeneous treatment effects while correcting for selection bias. Results suggest that RDP participation is associated with higher net income, by about EUR 280/ha on average. Two farm clusters emerge, also reflecting different typologies of rural development program measure packages: family‐run farms in disadvantaged areas are often associated with agro‐climatic environmental commitments and related packages and gain about €265/ha. By contrast, more profitable and labor‐intensive farms are more frequently linked to less adopted measures and benefit only marginally. A Monte Carlo simulation assesses the estimator's performance under a controlled data‐generating process. The study highlights the need to account for structural heterogeneity in policy evaluation and supports data‐driven rural development strategies.
10.1002/aepp.70108.abstract_zh: 本文采用有限混合模型与逆概率加权回归调整方法，探究欧盟农村发展计划参与对意大利橄榄农场经济绩效的影响。基于2010-2022年FADN面板数据，在纠正选择偏差的同时估计异质性处理效应。结果表明，参与农村发展计划与净收入提升相关，平均每公顷约增加280欧元。研究识别出两类农场集群，分别对应不同的农村发展计划措施组合类型：位于欠发达地区的家庭经营农场通常与农业气候环境承诺及相关措施包相关联，每公顷增收约265欧元；而利润更高、劳动密集型的农场则更多与采用率较低的措施相关，仅获得边际收益。通过蒙特卡洛模拟在受控数据生成过程中评估了估计量的表现。本研究强调政策评估中需考虑结构性异质性，并为数据驱动的农村发展战略提供支撑。
10.1002/aepp.70108.title:
Differentiated Impacts of
                    EU
                    Rural Development Measures: A Finite Mixture Evaluation of Italian Olive Farms
10.1002/aepp.70108.title_zh: 欧盟农村发展措施的差异化影响：意大利橄榄农场的有限混合评估

10.1002/aepp.70109.abstract: ABSTRACT We conducted two framed field economic experiments with citrus farmers in Florida, United States and soybean farmers in Argentina to investigate their willingness to coordinate pest and weed management efforts. Despite the contrast between these two agricultural contexts, we find striking behavioral commonalities. In both countries, farmers display aversion to strategic uncertainty, rely heavily on beliefs about their neighbors' actions when deciding whether to participate, and systematically underestimate the probability of successful coordination even when opportunity costs are low. These common findings across such different settings suggest that the underlying mechanisms are not context‐specific but instead reflect more general features of decision‐making under strategic interdependence, lending support to the external validity of our findings. The results highlight key psychological and economic barriers to cooperation and offer policy‐relevant insights for designing interventions to enhance participation in voluntary area‐wide pest management programs. While voluntary coordination can enhance pest management effectiveness and be pareto‐optimal, the success of the collective action depends on overcoming farmers' reluctance to participate. The evidence that farmers systematically underestimate the probability of successful coordination even when opportunity costs are low highlights a key behavioral barrier that can lead to coordination failures. Interventions that mitigate strategic uncertainty and build trust among participants—such as targeted subsidies or technical assistance—could encourage participation among farmers who would otherwise be unwilling to engage in coordinated efforts. Beyond the immediate application to pest and weed resistance management, our findings contribute to a broader understanding of cooperative behavior among farmers in the presence of strategic uncertainty.
10.1002/aepp.70109.abstract_zh: 摘要 我们与美国佛罗里达州柑橘种植户及阿根廷大豆种植户合作开展了两项框架田野经济实验，旨在探究农户参与病虫害与杂草协同治理的意愿。尽管两国农业情境存在显著差异，但研究发现惊人的行为共性：两国农户均表现出对战略不确定性的规避倾向，其参与决策高度依赖对邻居行为的信念，且即便机会成本较低时仍系统性低估协同成功的概率。这些跨情境的共性发现表明，潜在机制并非情境特异性，而是反映了战略依存条件下决策的普遍特征，从而支持了研究结论的外部有效性。研究结果揭示了阻碍合作的关键心理与经济壁垒，为设计提升自愿性区域病虫害协同治理项目参与度的干预措施提供了政策启示。尽管自愿协同能提升病虫害治理效率并实现帕累托最优，但集体行动的成功取决于能否克服农户的参与惰性。农户在机会成本较低时仍系统性低估协同成功概率的证据，凸显了导致协同失灵的关键行为障碍。通过定向补贴或技术援助等缓解战略不确定性、建立参与者信任的干预措施，可促使原本不愿参与协同行动的农户加入。除直接应用于病虫害抗性治理外，本研究还为理解战略不确定性下农户合作行为提供了更广泛的理论视角。
10.1002/aepp.70109.title: Voluntary Collective Action to Address Growing Agricultural Challenges in Two Countries: Experimental Insights and Commonalities
10.1002/aepp.70109.title_zh: 两国应对日益严峻农业挑战的自愿集体行动：实验洞见与共性

10.1002/aepp.70110.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Federally subsidized crop insurance is a cornerstone of U.S. farm risk management, yet policies with the greatest share of participation only trigger indemnities after losses exceed 15%. Supplemental insurance was introduced to cover part of this deductible, but participation remains largely unchanged. Using 1,005,245 sub‐county aggregated insurance observations and applying novel calibration and simulation methods, we show that low participation in supplemental coverage limits risk reduction potential. While basic insurance provides a foundation, adding supplemental policies meaningfully improves downside risk reduction and income transfer. Although these gains involve higher premiums, a benefit‐per‐premium analysis still favors broader use. These results reflect potential program impacts conditional on adoption, recognizing that actual participation depends on farmer preferences, risk perceptions, and institutional constraints.</jats:p>
10.1002/aepp.70110.abstract_zh: 联邦补贴作物保险是美国农业风险管理的基石，但参与率最高的保单仅在损失超过15%后才触发赔付。补充保险旨在覆盖部分免赔额，但参与率基本未变。利用1,005,245个次县级汇总保险观测数据，并应用新型校准与模拟方法，我们发现补充保险的低参与率限制了风险降低潜力。虽然基础保险提供了保障基础，但增加补充保单能显著改善下行风险降低和收入转移效果。尽管这些收益伴随更高保费，但每单位保费收益分析仍支持更广泛使用。这些结果反映了在采用条件下的潜在项目影响，同时认识到实际参与取决于农户偏好、风险感知和制度约束。
10.1002/aepp.70110.title: Low Participation and Risk Reduction Potential of Supplemental Crop Insurance in the United States
10.1002/aepp.70110.title_zh: 美国补充性农作物保险的低参与率与风险降低潜力

10.1002/aepp.70111.abstract: ABSTRACT Biosecurity trade restrictions are commonly framed as preventive measures, yet in many settings they function primarily as policies of delay: they impose immediate market costs while only postponing the arrival of biological risks. This paper evaluates that intertemporal tradeoff using the 2024–2025 US suspension of live cattle imports from Mexico in response to the northward spread of New World Screwworm (NWS). We estimate a vector autoregression (VAR) using monthly data from 2004 to 2025 to characterize pre‐ban dynamics in feeder cattle prices, Mexican import volumes, fed cattle prices, and feed costs, and construct counterfactual forecasts for prices and trade flows absent the border closures. Translating these costs into a simple break‐even framework shows that under an annual endemic‐loss assumption of $10 billion, each additional month of border closure would need to delay endemic NWS establishment by approximately 4 months to be welfare improving.
10.1002/aepp.70111.abstract_zh: 摘要 生物安全贸易限制通常被视为预防性措施，但在许多情境下，它们主要发挥延迟政策的作用：这些限制在施加即时市场成本的同时，仅能推迟生物风险的到来。本文利用2024-2025年美国因新世界螺旋蝇（NWS）向北蔓延而暂停从墨西哥进口活牛的案例，评估了这一跨期权衡。我们基于2004年至2025年的月度数据，估计了一个向量自回归（VAR）模型，以刻画禁运前架子牛价格、墨西哥进口量、育肥牛价格及饲料成本之间的动态关系，并构建了无边境关闭情形下价格与贸易流的反事实预测。将这些成本转化为简单的盈亏平衡框架后显示，在每年10亿美元的地方性损失假设下，边境关闭每延长一个月，需将NWS地方性建立推迟约4个月，才能实现福利改善。
10.1002/aepp.70111.title: Delaying the Inevitable? U.S. Screwworm Closures and Feeder Cattle Market Dynamics
10.1002/aepp.70111.title_zh: 推迟不可避免之事？美国螺旋蝇检疫封锁与架子牛市场动态

10.1002/aepp.70112.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Using an enhanced Computable General Equilibrium (CGE) model (GTAP‐BIO), this study assesses how the expansion in demand for Electric Vehicles (EVs) and the reduction in exports of agricultural products induced by trade disputes negatively affect US agriculture. It then evaluates the extent to which producing Sustainable Aviation Fuels (SAFs) from corn and soybeans could mitigate these effects. Results show that EV expansion reduces gasoline demand, suppresses corn production, lowers farm incomes, and generates idled capacity, including increases in uncultivated cropland. Export tariffs further amplify these effects. Expansion in SAF produced from corn and soybean could partially limit these consequences.</jats:p>
10.1002/aepp.70112.abstract_zh: 摘要：本研究采用增强型可计算一般均衡（CGE）模型（GTAP-BIO），评估电动汽车（EV）需求扩张及贸易争端导致的农产品出口减少对美国农业的负面影响，并进一步分析利用玉米和大豆生产可持续航空燃料（SAFs）在多大程度上能够缓解这些影响。结果表明，电动汽车扩张降低了汽油需求，抑制了玉米生产，减少了农业收入，并导致产能闲置，包括未耕种农田面积的增加。出口关税进一步放大了这些效应。扩大以玉米和大豆为原料的可持续航空燃料生产可在一定程度上限制上述后果。
10.1002/aepp.70112.title: U.S. Agriculture, Biofuel Markets, and Trade: Challenges and Opportunities
10.1002/aepp.70112.title_zh: 美国农业、生物燃料市场与贸易：挑战与机遇

10.1002/aepp.70113.abstract: Sustainable agricultural practices such as cover cropping can improve soil health, water quality, and carbon sequestration, yet U.S. adoption remains limited due to economic and operational barriers. We evaluate market and economic impacts of integrating perennial groundcover into U.S. corn and soybean production under six yield and cost scenarios. Results show that impacts depend on whether yields are maintained and costs remain stable. Under the most optimistic scenario, long‐term outcomes remain close to or slightly above baseline levels. In contrast, scenarios involving yield losses or sustained cost increases generate negative economic outcomes, highlighting the importance of agronomic performance and cost control.
10.1002/aepp.70113.abstract_zh: 覆盖种植等可持续农业实践能够改善土壤健康、水质和碳封存，但由于经济和操作障碍，美国对其采用仍然有限。我们评估了在六种产量和成本情景下，将多年生地被植物整合到美国玉米和大豆生产中的市场和经济效益。结果表明，影响取决于产量是否得以维持以及成本是否保持稳定。在最乐观的情景下，长期结果仍接近或略高于基准水平。相比之下，涉及产量损失或成本持续增加的情景则产生负面经济结果，凸显了农艺表现和成本控制的重要性。
10.1002/aepp.70113.title: Integrating Perennial Groundcover in Corn and Soybean Acres: Impacts on U.S. Agriculture
10.1002/aepp.70113.title_zh: 将多年生地被植物整合到玉米和大豆农田：对美国农业的影响

10.1002/aepp.70114.abstract: ABSTRACT This study analyzed post‐COVID‐19 trends in food prices in Brazil and projected changes through 2026. Time series from the 2017/2018 Household Budget Survey, the National System of Consumer Price Indexes, and the Continuous National Household Sample Survey were analyzed using Seasonal Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (SARIMA) models. Between 2018 and 2024, prices of ultra‐processed food products (UPFP) decreased by 16%, while unprocessed or minimally processed foods and culinary ingredients increased, narrowing the price gap. The nominal prices of food groups rose more than nominal household income between 2018 and 2024, particularly for unprocessed or minimally processed foods and culinary ingredients. Projections indicate that UPFP will remain the cheapest group by 2026, reinforcing barriers to healthy diets and supporting tax policies.
10.1002/aepp.70114.abstract_zh: 摘要 本研究分析了巴西在新冠疫情后的食品价格趋势，并预测了截至2026年的变化。研究利用2017/2018年家庭预算调查、国家消费者价格指数体系以及连续全国住户抽样调查的时间序列数据，采用季节性自回归积分滑动平均模型（SARIMA）进行分析。2018年至2024年间，超加工食品（UPFP）价格下降了16%，而未加工或 minimally 加工食品及烹饪原料的价格则有所上涨，从而缩小了价格差距。2018年至2024年间，各类食品的名义价格涨幅超过了名义家庭收入，尤其是未加工或 minimally 加工食品及烹饪原料。预测显示，到2026年，超加工食品仍将是最便宜的类别，这加剧了健康饮食的障碍，并为税收政策提供了支持依据。
10.1002/aepp.70114.title: Food Price Trends and Projections in Brazil (2018–2026): Implications for Access to Adequate and Healthy Food
10.1002/aepp.70114.title_zh: 巴西食品价格趋势与预测（2018-2026年）：对获取充足健康食品的影响

10.1002/aepp.70115.abstract: This study examines how rural households in Ethiopia adjust their livestock market participation in response to moisture conditions. Using contemporaneous and lagged measures of hydrological stress, the analysis distinguishes between sheep and goat markets to capture species‐specific responses. The results show that adjustment is driven primarily by lagged moisture conditions, although some contemporaneous effects are also evident. Favorable past moisture significantly increases participation in sheep markets, while responses in goat markets are smaller and less consistent. Transaction volumes respond only weakly, indicating that hydrological stress affects primarily the extensive margin of market participation. Responses also vary across agroecological zones. The findings suggest that livestock adjustment to hydrological stress is gradual and species‐specific, reflecting ecological dynamics and differences in resilience across livestock species.
10.1002/aepp.70115.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了埃塞俄比亚农村家庭如何根据水分条件调整其牲畜市场参与行为。通过使用同期和滞后的水文压力指标，分析区分了绵羊市场和山羊市场，以捕捉不同物种的特定反应。结果表明，调整主要由滞后的水分条件驱动，尽管部分同期效应也较为明显。过去有利的水分条件显著增加了绵羊市场的参与度，而山羊市场的反应较小且一致性较低。交易量反应较弱，表明水文压力主要影响市场参与的广延边际。不同农业生态区的反应也存在差异。研究结果表明，牲畜对水文压力的调整是渐进且具有物种特异性的，反映了生态动态及不同牲畜物种在韧性上的差异。
10.1002/aepp.70115.title: Slow to Respond: Lagged Adjustments to Moisture Conditions in Small Ruminant Markets
10.1002/aepp.70115.title_zh: 反应迟缓：小型反刍动物市场对水分条件的滞后调整

10.1002/aepp.70117.abstract: This study investigates the decline in Bureau of Land Management (BLM) grazing allotments, authorized Animal Unit Months, across eight Intermountain states (Arizona, Colorado, Idaho, Montana, Nevada, New Mexico, Utah, Wyoming) from 1980 to 2022, examining the role of drought and structural change. Using outlier detection and structural break tests, we identify a concentrated regime shift in the early 2000s, with seven of eight states experiencing a statistically significant break between 2000 and 2003. Post‐break allotments declined by 11% regionally, ranging from 8% in New Mexico to 27% in Colorado. Outlier analysis reveals substantial heterogeneity in the nature of shocks, with Idaho and Utah experiencing permanent level shifts, Colorado a temporary change, and Wyoming multiple shocks of all types. To quantify drought impacts, we estimate a fixed effects model with a lagged dependent variable and a state‐specific structural break dummy. Results show that a one‐unit decrease in the Palmer Drought Severity Index (PDSI) reduces allotments by 0.5% immediately and by 3.6% in the long run under sustained drought. The break dummy is negative and highly significant, indicating a permanent 6.5% reduction in allotments following the early 2000s drought that is not explained by drought or market variables alone. This suggests that factors beyond drought have reduced grazing capacity. A sustained severe drought (three‐unit PDSI decrease) would permanently remove approximately 893,000 Animal Unit Months (AUMs) annually from the region, equivalent to 149,000–179,000 cow‐calf pairs and representing between $9 million and $27 million in lost forage value at private lease rates. These findings support reforms to drought relief programs to account for lagged and permanent effects, flexible permitting mechanisms for temporary drought, and long‐term adjustment assistance for permanent reductions. State‐specific heterogeneity in drought impacts implies that, while BLM already administers grazing at state and district levels, further differentiation of drought relief and permit flexibility based on state‐level vulnerabilities may improve effectiveness.
10.1002/aepp.70117.abstract_zh: 本研究调查了1980年至2022年间美国土地管理局（BLM）在八个山地州（亚利桑那州、科罗拉多州、爱达荷州、蒙大拿州、内华达州、新墨西哥州、犹他州、怀俄明州）放牧配额（授权动物单位月）的下降趋势，并考察了干旱与结构性变化的作用。通过异常值检测与结构性断点检验，我们识别出21世纪初存在集中的制度变迁：八个州中有七个在2000年至2003年间出现统计显著的断点。断点后区域放牧配额平均下降11%，各州降幅从新墨西哥州的8%到科罗拉多州的27%不等。异常值分析揭示了冲击性质的显著异质性：爱达荷州与犹他州经历永久性水平位移，科罗拉多州为暂时性变化，而怀俄明州则遭遇多种类型的多重冲击。为量化干旱影响，我们构建了包含滞后因变量与州特定结构性断点虚拟变量的固定效应模型。结果显示：帕尔默干旱指数（PDSI）每下降1个单位，放牧配额在短期内立即减少0.5%，在持续干旱条件下长期累计减少3.6%。断点虚拟变量为负且高度显著，表明21世纪初干旱后放牧配额永久性减少6.5%，这一降幅无法仅由干旱或市场变量解释，暗示干旱以外的因素削弱了放牧承载力。持续严重干旱（PDSI下降3个单位）将导致该区域每年永久性减少约89.3万动物单位月（AUMs），相当于14.9万至17.9万对母牛-牛犊组合，按私人租赁费率计算，牧草价值损失达900万至2700万美元。这些发现支持对干旱救济计划进行改革，以纳入滞后与永久性效应、建立临时干旱的灵活许可机制，并为永久性减少提供长期调整援助。干旱影响的州际异质性表明，尽管BLM已在州与地区层面实施放牧管理，但基于州级脆弱性进一步差异化干旱救济与许可灵活性，可能提升政策有效性。
10.1002/aepp.70117.title: Drought, Structural Breaks, and the Economics of Public Land Grazing: Evidence From the Intermountain West
10.1002/aepp.70117.title_zh: 干旱、结构性突变与公共土地放牧经济学：来自美国西部山间地区的证据

10.1002/aepp.70118.abstract: Using the agent‐based model SWISSland, we simulate farm‐level responses and interactions under two institutional shocks: tariff reductions and direct payment reductions. Using a framework we developed, we assess resilience capacities, resilience attributes, and the provision of private and public goods, following the shock. Results indicate that valley farms are vulnerable to tariff reductions and mountain farms to direct payment reductions. Payment cuts cause minor changes in private and public goods provision, while tariff reductions reduce provision levels. It shows that different shocks require different resilience attributes, underscoring the need for ex‐ante resilience assessments to develop targeted measures strengthening farm resilience.
10.1002/aepp.70118.abstract_zh: 基于主体模型SWISSland，我们模拟了两种制度冲击下的农场层面响应与互动：关税削减与直接支付削减。运用我们开发的框架，评估冲击后的韧性能力、韧性属性以及私人与公共产品的供给。结果表明，山谷农场易受关税削减影响，而山地农场则对直接支付削减更为敏感。支付削减对私人与公共产品供给的影响较小，而关税削减则降低了供给水平。这表明不同冲击需要不同的韧性属性，凸显了开展事前韧性评估以制定针对性措施、增强农场韧性的必要性。
10.1002/aepp.70118.title: Ex‐Ante Assessment of Farm Resilience to Institutional Shocks: A Modeling Approach
10.1002/aepp.70118.title_zh: 制度冲击下农场韧性的事前评估：一种建模方法

10.1002/aepp.70119.abstract: The USDA's Conservation Reserve Program (CRP) delivers environmental benefits to society by enrolling cropland and grasslands to reestablish or safeguard long‐term vegetative cover. In recent years, the CRP has dramatically increased grassland enrollment while cropland enrollment has been in steady decline. This paper uses descriptive analysis, multivariate regression analysis, and a spatial comparison of participant incentives to assess the relationship between these two CRP signup types. We argue that while these two programs do not compete administratively under current trends, these enrollment patterns could tighten competition between the programs in future periods if total enrollment approaches a shared cap.
10.1002/aepp.70119.abstract_zh: 美国农业部保护储备计划（CRP）通过将农田和草地纳入计划以重建或保护长期植被覆盖，为社会带来环境效益。近年来，CRP的草地纳入面积大幅增加，而农田纳入面积持续下降。本文采用描述性分析、多元回归分析以及参与者激励的空间比较，评估这两种CRP签约类型之间的关系。我们认为，尽管在当前趋势下这两个计划在行政管理上并不存在竞争，但如果总纳入面积接近共同上限，这些纳入模式可能会在未来阶段加剧计划间的竞争。
10.1002/aepp.70119.title: Complementary or Competitive? Emerging Interactions Between Restoration and Protection in the Conservation Reserve Program
10.1002/aepp.70119.title_zh: 互补还是竞争？保护储备计划中恢复与保护之间的新兴互动

10.1002/aepp.70120.abstract: The One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA) strengthens the agricultural risk coverage (ARC) and price loss coverage (PLC) programs by aligning program parameters more closely with recent market dynamics and allows for an expansion in program acres. This study projects the increases in ARC‐County and PLC payments for corn, soybeans, and wheat under OBBBA, compared with those under the 2018 Farm Bill. Total projected program payments would increase by $4.65 billion for crop year 2025 and $1.30–$2.13 billion for crop year 2026 (depending on the relative enrollment rates), with high regional heterogeneity. JEL Classification: Q14, Q18
10.1002/aepp.70120.abstract_zh: 《一项宏大美丽法案》（OBBBA）通过使项目参数更贴近近期市场动态，强化了农业风险覆盖（ARC）和价格损失覆盖（PLC）项目，并允许扩大项目面积。本研究预测了在OBBBA下，相较于2018年农业法案，玉米、大豆和小麦的ARC-县及PLC支付额的增长情况。预计2025作物年项目总支付额将增加46.5亿美元，2026作物年将增加13亿至21.3亿美元（具体取决于相对参保率），且存在显著的区域异质性。JEL分类：Q14, Q18
10.1002/aepp.70120.title: Expanded Farm Safety Net Payments Under the One Big Beautiful Bill Act
10.1002/aepp.70120.title_zh: 《大美丽法案》下扩大农业安全网支付

10.1002/aepp.70122.abstract: The California dairy industry has experienced considerable consolidation over the past 30 years. During this period, there has also been substantial technological innovation, implementation of the state's Low Carbon Fuel Standard program, and rapid adoption of anaerobic digesters. This apparent correlation has fueled concerns that anaerobic digesters are causing consolidation. We test for a causal relationship between digesters and consolidation using synthetic differences‐in‐differences. Our findings dispute the theory that digesters are causing consolidation.
10.1002/aepp.70122.abstract_zh: 加州乳制品行业在过去30年间经历了显著的整合。在此期间，该行业还出现了大量技术创新、州低碳燃料标准项目的实施，以及厌氧消化器的迅速普及。这种表面上的相关性引发了担忧，认为厌氧消化器正在导致行业整合。我们采用合成双重差分法检验了消化器与整合之间的因果关系。我们的研究结果反驳了消化器导致整合的理论。
10.1002/aepp.70122.title: The Cow or the Credit: Causal Relationship Between California Dairy Herd Consolidation and Anaerobic Digesters
10.1002/aepp.70122.title_zh: 奶牛还是信贷：加州奶牛群整合与厌氧消化器之间的因果关系

10.1002/ajae.70072.abstract: Irrigation is widely recognized as a key driver of agricultural productivity and rural economic development, yet credible evidence on its impacts, mechanisms, and long‐term economic returns remains limited due to endogenous irrigation investments. Leveraging the timing of government irrigation investments and longitudinal household survey data spanning 15 years, we investigate how irrigation affects agricultural productivity. We find that irrigation investment increased the share of irrigated farmland by 11.0 percentage points, which in turn raised per‐area output by 14.9%, net agricultural income by 15.6%, agricultural total factor productivity by 13.7%, and per‐labor output by 36.2%. These effects are driven by four key mechanisms: increased use of high‐productivity inputs, expanded cultivation area, labor reallocation from farm work to off‐farm work, and mitigation of drought damage. The induced land expansion and labor reallocation explain the substantially larger increase in per‐labor output. A cost‐effectiveness analysis suggests a high return to irrigation investment, with approximately half of the return stemming from labor reallocation that increased off‐farm income. These results provide strong evidence that irrigation investment plays an important role in improving agricultural productivity and accelerating rural transformation, with benefits extending beyond the farm by influencing labor markets.
10.1002/ajae.70072.abstract_zh: 灌溉被广泛认为是农业生产力与农村经济发展的关键驱动力，然而由于灌溉投资的内生性问题，关于其影响、机制及长期经济回报的可靠证据仍然有限。利用政府灌溉投资的时机以及跨越15年的纵向农户调查数据，我们研究了灌溉如何影响农业生产力。研究发现，灌溉投资使灌溉农田比例提高了11.0个百分点，进而使单位面积产出增加14.9%，农业净收入增加15.6%，农业全要素生产率提高13.7%，人均产出增加36.2%。这些效应由四个关键机制驱动：高生产率投入品使用增加、种植面积扩大、劳动力从农业向非农就业重新配置，以及干旱损害缓解。土地扩张和劳动力重新配置共同解释了人均产出更大幅度的增长。成本效益分析表明，灌溉投资回报率较高，其中约一半的回报来自劳动力重新配置所增加的非农收入。这些结果有力证明，灌溉投资在提升农业生产力和加速农村转型中发挥重要作用，其效益通过影响劳动力市场而延伸至农业领域之外。
10.1002/ajae.70072.title: Irrigation investments and agricultural productivity in Northern China
10.1002/ajae.70072.title_zh: 中国北方灌溉投资与农业生产力

10.1002/ajae.70076.abstract: This paper derives a firm‐level threshold, the Herfindahl Neutral Point, from the standard concentration index used in merger review. At this threshold, a marginal expansion leaves the index unchanged. Firms below the threshold reduce concentration when they expand; firms above it increase concentration. We derive exact formulas for discrete capacity additions and define bridging amounts that measure how far each firm sits from the threshold. Applying this framework to monthly federally inspected hog slaughter data from 2004 to 2024, we show that the sharp rise in concentration in 2016 is driven by acquisitions at firms that were near the threshold and then crossed it, while the subsequent partial decline reflects sustained growth among mid‐tier packers operating below it. The 2015 acquisition of Cargill's pork business illustrates how bridging amounts organize merger analysis within a standard concentration screen. Reallocating the $34.7 million in federal capacity grants awarded to hog‐sector processors under a targeting rule based on this threshold lowers the 2024 national hog packing Herfindahl–Hirschman Index by about 147 points relative to the pre‐award baseline. The framework requires only market shares and the baseline concentration index.
10.1002/ajae.70076.abstract_zh: 本文从并购审查中使用的标准集中度指数出发，推导出一个企业层面的阈值——赫芬达尔中性点。在该阈值处，边际扩张不会改变指数值。低于该阈值的企业扩张时会降低集中度；高于该阈值的企业扩张则会提高集中度。我们推导出离散产能增加的确切公式，并定义了衡量每个企业距离该阈值远近的“桥梁量”。将该分析框架应用于2004年至2024年联邦月度生猪屠宰数据，我们发现2016年集中度的急剧上升是由接近阈值并随后跨越该阈值的企业收购所驱动，而随后的部分下降则反映了在该阈值以下运营的中型加工企业的持续增长。2015年嘉吉猪肉业务的收购案例展示了“桥梁量”如何在标准集中度筛查框架内组织并购分析。基于该阈值的目标规则，将联邦向生猪行业加工商提供的3470万美元产能拨款重新分配，可使2024年全国生猪屠宰赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数相较于拨款前基线降低约147点。该框架仅需市场份额和基线集中度指数。
10.1002/ajae.70076.title: The Herfindahl neutral point: A firm‐level threshold for managing market concentration with evidence from US hog packing
10.1002/ajae.70076.title_zh: 赫芬达尔中性点：基于美国生猪加工企业数据的市场集中度管理阈值

10.1002/ajae.70077.abstract: Preferential trade agreements (PTAs) contain various non‐tariff provisions, yet identifying their trade effects remains challenging because these commitments are high‐dimensional and strongly correlated within agreements. We estimated a theory‐consistent structural gravity model with domestic flows for 26 agricultural subsectors over 1988–2017 and employed a plug‐in Elastic Net‐penalized PPML approach to isolate the provisions that systematically shape agricultural trade. The procedure identifies 13 provisions that are particularly important for agricultural trade, spanning trade facilitation, SPS/TBT disciplines, and rules on competition and subsidies. After accounting for the impact of preferential tariff rates, a generic PTA indicator is still estimated to increase trade by 20%. This effect is absorbed once the identified provision bundle is included, demonstrating that trade patterns under PTAs are primarily shaped by specific non‐tariff commitments. The results point to clear channels: facilitation and transparency provisions are trade‐promoting, whereas stronger reliance on international standards is associated with lower trade, consistent with compliance‐cost mechanisms.
10.1002/ajae.70077.abstract_zh: 优惠贸易协定（PTAs）包含多种非关税条款，但由于这些承诺具有高维特征且在同一协定内高度相关，识别其贸易效应仍具挑战性。我们基于1988-2017年26个农业子部门数据，采用包含国内贸易流的理论一致性结构引力模型，并运用插件式弹性网络惩罚泊松伪最大似然估计法，筛选出系统性影响农产品贸易的条款。该程序识别出13项对农产品贸易尤为重要的条款，涵盖贸易便利化、卫生与植物卫生措施/技术性贸易壁垒（SPS/TBT）纪律以及竞争与补贴规则。在控制优惠关税税率影响后，通用PTA指标仍显示贸易增长20%。当纳入已识别的条款组合后，该效应被完全吸收，表明PTA下的贸易模式主要由特定非关税承诺塑造。研究结果揭示了明确的作用渠道：便利化与透明度条款促进贸易，而对国际标准的更强依赖则与贸易下降相关，这与合规成本机制相一致。
10.1002/ajae.70077.title: Preferential trading in agriculture: New insights from a structural gravity analysis and machine learning
10.1002/ajae.70077.title_zh: 农业优惠贸易：基于结构引力分析与机器学习的新见解

10.1002/ajae.70078.abstract: Common‐pool resources—such as collectively‐owned grasslands—are often overused and depleted until effective conservation strategies are put into place. We conducted a lab‐in‐the‐field experiment to examine the performance of different management strategies on the sustainability of common‐pool grassland management in China. We designed three experimental interventions—reward, punishment, and communication—to evaluate how to cost‐effectively promote grassland conservation. Results reveal that the communication treatment is as effective as the reward and punishment treatments in promoting grassland conservation. However, unlike the reward treatment, communication does not require external funding or create income inequality among herders, and unlike the punishment treatment, it avoids undesirable impacts such as reducing herders' net payoffs. A mechanism analysis suggests that our communication treatment shifts herders' focus from exploitation to conservation. Our results indicate that incorporating communication interventions into grassland management strategies could improve their overall performance.
10.1002/ajae.70078.abstract_zh: 公共池资源——例如集体所有的草原——往往因过度使用而枯竭，直至有效的保护策略得以实施。我们开展了一项实地实验室实验，考察不同管理策略对中国公共池草原管理可持续性的影响。我们设计了三种实验干预措施——奖励、惩罚和沟通——以评估如何以成本有效的方式促进草原保护。结果表明，沟通干预在促进草原保护方面与奖励和惩罚干预同样有效。然而，与奖励干预不同，沟通干预无需外部资金支持，也不会在牧民之间造成收入不平等；与惩罚干预不同，它避免了降低牧民净收益等不良影响。机制分析表明，我们的沟通干预将牧民的关注点从开发利用转向保护。研究结果表明，将沟通干预纳入草原管理策略可提升其整体绩效。
10.1002/ajae.70078.title: Performance of reward, punishment, and communication in common‐pool resource management: Evidence from grassland conservation in China
10.1002/ajae.70078.title_zh: 奖励、惩罚与沟通在公共池塘资源管理中的绩效：来自中国草原保护的证据

10.1002/ajae.70079.abstract: Individual Fishing Quotas (IFQs) have the potential to lead to higher ex‐vessel prices by reducing market gluts and improving product quality. While IFQs have been introduced in a number of fisheries in recent decades, few causal studies investigate their price effects. Using synthetic control methods on US reef‐fish fisheries, we show that IFQs significantly increase prices for red snapper, red grouper, gag grouper, yellowedge grouper, scamp grouper, and tilefish. We also find significant positive price spillovers to adjacent, untreated fisheries. A primary challenge to unbiased estimation using synthetic control is treatment spillover, which can contaminate both never‐treated units in the donor pool and to‐be‐treated units in a staggered implementation. When control (donor) units are subject to these spillovers, this can lead to either attenuation or divergence of the causal estimate, depending on the empirical setting. To address this estimation challenge, we propose a framework relying on economic theory (market arbitrage and product substitution) and empirical analysis (e.g., market integration or demand estimation) to inform both donor selection and the timing of the treatment start date. As a result, our proposed structure improves the accuracy of synthetic control estimates, as shown by a small Monte Carlo experiment. Furthermore, by pre‐identifying contaminated units, our framework allows for the direct measurement of the spillover effects themselves.
10.1002/ajae.70079.abstract_zh: 个人捕捞配额（IFQs）可能通过减少市场过剩和改善产品质量来提高离岸价格。尽管近几十年来多个渔业已引入IFQs，但关于其价格效应的因果研究仍较为匮乏。通过在美国礁石鱼类渔业中应用合成控制方法，我们发现IFQs显著提高了红鲷鱼、红石斑鱼、黑斑石斑鱼、黄边石斑鱼、斑纹石斑鱼和方头鱼的价格。同时，我们还发现IFQs对邻近未受政策影响的渔业产生了显著的正向价格溢出效应。使用合成控制方法进行无偏估计的主要挑战在于处理溢出效应——这种效应可能污染供体池中从未受处理的单元，以及在分阶段实施中即将受处理的单元。当控制（供体）单元受到这些溢出效应影响时，因果估计可能产生衰减或发散，具体取决于实证环境。为应对这一估计挑战，我们提出一个基于经济理论（市场套利与产品替代）和实证分析（如市场整合或需求估计）的框架，以指导供体选择和处理起始时间的确定。通过小型蒙特卡洛实验验证，我们提出的结构显著提升了合成控制估计的准确性。此外，通过预先识别受污染的单元，该框架还能直接测量溢出效应本身。
10.1002/ajae.70079.title: An economic approach to mitigating spillover bias in synthetic control methods: An application to the price effects of fishing quotas
10.1002/ajae.70079.title_zh: 减轻合成控制法中溢出偏差的经济学方法：以捕捞配额价格效应为例

10.1002/ajae.70080.abstract: Dark sky conservation is increasingly popular, requiring facility upgrades and community cooperation. This study assesses its economic benefits at Great Sand Dunes National Park and Preserve, a Gold Tier International Dark Sky Park. Through on‐site surveys, we collected data on visitor behaviors, expenditures, and night sky perceptions. We introduced a continuum of contingent night sky brightness levels based on visitors' home locations and measured changes in visitation. Our Travel Cost‐Contingent Behavior analysis shows that each unit increase in nightlight decreases visitation by 0.05 days over 5 years. Using a weighted Latent Class Negative Binomial (LCNB) model, we estimate consumer welfare losses under escalating nightlight pollution scenarios. If the park's night skies matched an average rural, suburban, or urban area, visitors' consumer surplus would fall by about 3%, 23–24%, and 42–44%, respectively. These results underscore the substantial economic value of preserving dark skies.
10.1002/ajae.70080.abstract_zh: 暗夜保护日益受到重视，这需要设施升级和社区协作。本研究评估了大沙丘国家公园与保护区（国际金级暗夜公园）暗夜保护的经济效益。通过实地问卷调查，我们收集了游客行为、消费支出及夜空感知数据。基于游客居住地的光污染水平，我们构建了连续性的条件夜间天空亮度梯度，并测量了游客量的变化。旅行成本-条件行为分析显示，夜间灯光每增加一个单位，五年内游客量将减少0.05天。采用加权潜类负二项模型，我们估算了夜间灯光污染加剧情景下的消费者福利损失。若公园夜空亮度分别达到普通乡村、郊区或城市水平，游客消费者剩余将分别下降约3%、23-24%和42-44%。这些结果凸显了保护暗夜天空的巨大经济价值。
10.1002/ajae.70080.title: Contingent behavior modeling for dark skies valuation at Great Sand Dunes National Park
10.1002/ajae.70080.title_zh: 大沙丘国家公园暗夜天空评估中的条件行为建模

10.1002/ajae.70081.abstract: This paper examines how a natural disaster, the Dust Bowl, shapes occupational choices in farm households across generations. Using full‐count US census data, I find that young adult sons shift away from self‐employed farming toward wage farm work and nonagricultural sectors after the Dust Bowl. Younger children with affected farming parents are more likely to leave agriculture and earn higher income. Migration and schooling serve as mechanisms, and New Deal relief spending mitigates the Dust Bowl's effects. Overall, the Dust Bowl accelerated occupational reallocation among younger children of farmers and contributed to US mid‐20th century structural change.
10.1002/ajae.70081.abstract_zh: 本文考察了自然灾害“沙尘暴”如何跨代塑造农户家庭的职业选择。利用美国人口普查全量数据，我发现沙尘暴后，年轻成年儿子从自营农业转向雇佣农业劳动和非农部门。受影响的农民家庭中，年幼子女更可能离开农业并获得更高收入。迁移与教育是作用机制，而新政救济支出缓解了沙尘暴的影响。总体而言，沙尘暴加速了农民年轻子女的职业再配置，并推动了美国20世纪中期的结构性变革。
10.1002/ajae.70081.title:
Natural disaster and intergenerational occupational choice in agriculture: Evidence from the
                    US
                    Dust Bowl
10.1002/ajae.70081.title_zh: 自然灾害与农业代际职业选择：来自美国沙尘暴的证据

10.1002/ajae.70082.abstract: Voluntary agricultural land retirement programs are widely recognized for their environmental benefits, yet their economic effects, particularly on labor markets and land tenure, remain less understood. This paper examines the short‐ and long‐term impacts of the first large‐scale US land retirement initiative, the historical Conservation Reserve Program, introduced under the 1956 Set‐Aside Act. Between 1957 and 1960, the program enrolled more than 30 million acres under 3‐, 5‐, or 10‐year contracts, which then expired gradually through 1970. Using a newly digitized Conservation Reserve Program enrollment database linked to agricultural census data from the 1950s through the 1970s, we find that counties with medium and high enrollment intensity experienced statistically significant declines in tenant‐cultivated land relative to low‐enrollment counties during the program's active years. In medium‐enrollment counties, tenant‐operated land declined by roughly 0.6 percentage points, while high‐enrollment counties experienced declines of approximately 1.6 percentage points nationally. The proportion of tenant farm operators also fell in both medium‐ and high‐enrollment counties. These effects were larger and more persistent in the South, especially in counties with higher shares of nonwhite farm operators and sharecropping.
10.1002/ajae.70082.abstract_zh: 自愿性农业土地休耕项目因其环境效益而广受认可，但其经济影响——特别是对劳动力市场和土地保有权的影响——仍鲜为人知。本文考察了美国首个大规模土地休耕计划——1956年《预留法案》下设立的历史性保护储备计划——的短期与长期影响。1957年至1960年间，该计划以3年、5年或10年合同形式纳入了超过3000万英亩土地，这些合同随后于1970年前逐步到期。通过将新数字化的保护储备计划登记数据库与20世纪50年代至70年代的农业普查数据相关联，我们发现：在项目活跃期，中等和高强度登记县相对于低登记县，租佃耕地面积出现了统计上显著的下降。在全国范围内，中等登记县的租佃经营土地面积下降约0.6个百分点，而高登记县则下降约1.6个百分点。中等和高登记县的租佃农场经营者比例也同步下降。这些效应在南方地区更为显著且持久，尤其在非白人农场经营者及分成制佃农比例较高的县份表现突出。
10.1002/ajae.70082.title: Consequences of land retirement policies on agricultural labor and land tenure: Evidence from the historical Conservation Reserve Program in the United States
10.1002/ajae.70082.title_zh: 土地休耕政策对农业劳动力和土地保有权的影响：来自美国历史性保护储备计划的证据

10.1002/ajae.70083.abstract: To evaluate the role played by startup companies in the innovation ecosystem of US agriculture, we compile a unique dataset of 6024 new entrants founded 1987–2019 that details their financing lifecycles, annual economic performance, and patenting activities. One‐third of the firms in the sample have observable signs of contributing to innovation, including patenting and external financing such as grants and venture capital, thus characterizing them as startups. Such startups and their financing have grown substantially over the period studied. We use discrete‐time survival analysis to test factors related to firms receiving venture financing as well as to firms achieving successful financial exits. We find those firms that file for patents have higher likelihood of receiving financing than those that do not. Patent filings also increase the relative probability of a successful financial exit, which takes place primarily through mergers and acquisitions. In about a third of such exits, startups are acquired by corporate incumbents in agriculture well positioned to scale up and commercialize those startups' innovations for US agriculture. Importantly, a substantial portion of firms in the sample are still too young to have attained venture financing let alone a financial exit.
10.1002/ajae.70083.abstract_zh: 为评估初创企业在美国农业创新生态系统中的作用，我们构建了一个包含1987-2019年间成立的6024家新企业的独特数据集，详细记录了其融资生命周期、年度经济绩效及专利活动。样本中三分之一的公司展现出可观测的创新贡献迹象，包括专利申请及获得赠款、风险投资等外部融资，从而被界定为初创企业。此类初创企业及其融资规模在研究期间显著增长。我们采用离散时间生存分析法，检验影响企业获得风险融资及实现成功财务退出的因素。研究发现，提交专利申请的企业获得融资的可能性高于未申请企业。专利申请同时提高了企业成功实现财务退出的相对概率，此类退出主要通过并购完成。在约三分之一的退出案例中，初创企业被农业领域具备规模化推广及商业化能力的现有企业收购，从而将其创新成果应用于美国农业。值得注意的是，样本中相当比例的企业仍处于发展初期，尚未获得风险融资，更遑论实现财务退出。
10.1002/ajae.70083.title: The role of venture‐financed startups in innovation for US agriculture
10.1002/ajae.70083.title_zh: 风险投资支持的初创企业在美国农业创新中的作用

10.1002/ajae.70084.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We introduce a fully nonparametric estimator to estimate willingness to pay (WTP) using contingent valuation (CV) data. Traditional methods such as the probit model are used because of their roots in utility theory as well as their ease to implement. However, they are limited by their reliance on strict parametric assumptions, such as linearity and the requirement that the researcher pre‐select important covariates. While these methods are widely used, they may fail to capture complex relationships, particularly in situations involving nonlinearity or interactions among variables. This paper introduces Bayesian Additive Regression Trees (BART) as a flexible, nonparametric way to estimate WTP from CV studies. Using a simulation study, we demonstrate that BART is competitive with traditional models under strict data‐generating assumptions. When the underlying data‐generating process is more complex, BART outperforms traditional models and even other machine‐learning models. Moreover, BART automatically incorporates individual heterogeneity into estimation, making it more informative than traditional nonparametric estimators. We illustrate the breadth of the model's benefits with an empirical application estimating WTP to develop an Invasive Species Rapid Response Fund in the Hawaiian Islands. We find WTP distributional differences along the margins of gender, age, and income. We also construct willingness to pay curves out of Monte Carlo Markov Chain (MCMC) draws and calculate posterior means and credible intervals using empirical cumulative distribution functions (CDFs). We find these WTP to be lower than those from the probit. Future natural extensions of BART make this method a compelling alternative for estimating WTP in CV experiments.</jats:p>
10.1002/ajae.70084.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种完全非参数估计方法，利用条件价值评估（CV）数据来估计支付意愿（WTP）。传统方法如probit模型因其植根于效用理论且易于实施而被广泛使用。然而，这些方法受限于严格的参数假设，例如线性关系以及研究者需预先选择重要协变量的要求。尽管这些方法应用广泛，但在涉及非线性或变量间交互作用的复杂情境中，可能无法捕捉真实关系。本文引入贝叶斯加性回归树（BART）作为一种灵活的非参数方法，用于从CV研究中估计WTP。通过模拟研究，我们证明在严格的数据生成假设下，BART与传统模型表现相当。当底层数据生成过程更为复杂时，BART优于传统模型甚至其他机器学习模型。此外，BART自动将个体异质性纳入估计，使其比传统非参数估计器更具信息量。我们通过一项实证应用展示了该模型的广泛优势，该应用估计了夏威夷群岛建立入侵物种快速响应基金的支付意愿。研究发现，WTP在性别、年龄和收入边际上存在分布差异。我们还利用马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）抽样构建了支付意愿曲线，并通过经验累积分布函数（CDFs）计算后验均值和可信区间。结果显示，这些WTP估计值低于probit模型的结果。BART未来的自然扩展使其成为CV实验中估计WTP的有力替代方法。
10.1002/ajae.70084.title: Not just a random forest: Using Bayesian additive regression trees to estimate willingness to pay to protect critical habitat
10.1002/ajae.70084.title_zh: 不仅仅是随机森林：使用贝叶斯加性回归树估计保护关键栖息地的支付意愿

10.1002/ajae.70085.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This paper examines the causal effects of a school feeding program on maternal empowerment and household consumption in rural China. Exploiting the staggered implementation of the Student Nutrition Improvement Program, we find that the program significantly reduces maternal time spent on housework, improves maternal labor market performance, and enhances maternal decision‐making power within nuclear households. The augmented bargaining power translates into shifts in household consumption toward female‐prioritized goods, including more nutritious foods, clothing, and housework‐related appliances. However, these positive effects on maternal empowerment are diminished in multigenerational families, where grandparents can assist with childcare responsibilities.</jats:p>
