10.1002/ajae.70085.abstract_zh: 本文考察了学校供餐计划对中国农村地区女性赋权及家庭消费的因果效应。利用学生营养改善计划的分阶段实施，我们发现该计划显著减少了母亲的家务劳动时间，改善了母亲在劳动力市场的表现，并增强了母亲在核心家庭中的决策权。这种议价能力的提升促使家庭消费转向女性优先商品，包括更营养的食品、衣物及家务相关电器。然而，在多代同堂的家庭中，由于祖父母可协助承担育儿责任，这些对女性赋权的积极影响有所减弱。
10.1002/ajae.70085.title: School feeding, maternal empowerment, and household consumption
10.1002/ajae.70085.title_zh: 学校供餐、女性赋权与家庭消费

10.1002/ajae.70086.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Lifting smallholder farmers out of poverty depends largely on boosting their agricultural operating incomes, a persistent challenge despite numerous efforts. This study evaluates the impact of China's “E‐Commerce into the Countryside” (ECC) program—the first and largest e‐commerce initiative in the developing world—on both the level and distribution of smallholders' farm earnings. Employing a quasi‐experimental design, we find that the ECC program significantly increases household per capita agricultural operating income. We show that this gain is driven by expanded market access through online sales, which facilitate income growth via three primary mechanisms: operational scale expansion, higher output prices, and a shift toward high‐value‐added crops. However, these benefits are unevenly distributed. The program also widens the income gap among smallholders, a disparity largely attributable to pre‐existing differences in human, productive, and digital capital. Our findings highlight that e‐commerce policies, while potent for income generation, require complementary measures to mitigate disparities that arise from heterogeneous initial endowments.</jats:p>
10.1002/ajae.70086.abstract_zh: 摘要：使小农户摆脱贫困在很大程度上取决于提高其农业经营收入，尽管付出了诸多努力，这仍是一项长期挑战。本研究评估了中国"电子商务进农村"（ECC）计划——发展中国家首个也是规模最大的电子商务举措——对小农户农业收入水平及分布的影响。采用准实验设计，我们发现ECC计划显著提高了家庭人均农业经营收入。研究表明，这一增长源于通过在线销售扩大市场准入，并通过三种主要机制促进收入增长：经营规模扩大、产出价格提高以及向高附加值作物转型。然而，这些收益的分配并不均衡。该计划还扩大了小农户之间的收入差距，这种差距在很大程度上可归因于人力资本、生产资本和数字资本的既有差异。我们的研究结果表明，电子商务政策虽能有效促进收入增长，但需要配套措施来缓解因初始禀赋异质性而产生的差距。
10.1002/ajae.70086.title: When e‐commerce meets smallholders: Boosting incomes and widening gaps in rural China's anti‐poverty policy
10.1002/ajae.70086.title_zh: 电子商务遇上小农户：中国农村扶贫政策中的收入提升与差距扩大

10.1002/jae.70057.abstract: Double/debiased machine learning (DML) uses for estimating an average treatment effect (ATE) a double‐robust score function that relies on the prediction of nuisance functions, such as the propensity score, which is the probability of treatment assignment given covariates. Estimators relying on double‐robust score functions are highly sensitive to errors in propensity score predictions. Machine learning algorithms have been found to produce models that often overestimate or underestimate these probabilities. Several calibration approaches have been proposed to improve probabilistic forecasts of machine learners. This paper explores their integration into the DML framework, showing via simulations that using calibrated propensity scores significantly reduces the root mean squared error of ATE estimates in finite samples while preserving DML's asymptotic properties.
10.1002/jae.70057.abstract_zh: 双重/去偏机器学习（DML）利用双稳健得分函数来估计平均处理效应（ATE），该函数依赖于对干扰函数的预测，例如倾向得分——即在给定协变量条件下接受处理的概率。依赖双稳健得分函数的估计量对倾向得分预测中的误差高度敏感。研究发现，机器学习算法生成的模型往往高估或低估这些概率。已有多种校准方法被提出以改进机器学习模型的概率预测。本文探讨了将这些方法整合到DML框架中的可行性，并通过模拟实验证明：在校准倾向得分后，有限样本中ATE估计的均方根误差显著降低，同时DML的渐近性质得以保持。
10.1002/jae.70057.title: Improving the Finite Sample Estimation of Average Treatment Effects Using Double/Debiased Machine Learning With Propensity Score Calibration
10.1002/jae.70057.title_zh: 使用倾向得分校准的双重/去偏机器学习改进平均处理效应的有限样本估计

10.1002/jae.70058.abstract: This paper revisits the empirical analysis of Nakamura and Steinsson (2014). I reconstructed and extended the original dataset to cover the period 1966–2019, harmonizing two major sources of data: the Defense Contract Action Data System (DCADS) and USAspending.gov. I discuss how to aggregate these contract‐level data to better capture spending more directly tied to domestic stimulus. Estimated multipliers are slightly lower in narrow replications but increase when incorporating later fiscal episodes. I also assess the validity and stability of cross‐sectional estimates. While some heterogeneity exists, dispersion in state‐level responses remains within reasonable boundaries, especially when accounting for dynamic persistence.
10.1002/jae.70058.abstract_zh: 本文重新审视了Nakamura与Steinsson（2014）的实证分析。我重构并扩展了原始数据集，将研究时段覆盖至1966-2019年，整合了两大主要数据来源：国防合同行动数据系统（DCADS）与USAspending.gov。我探讨了如何聚合这些合同级数据，以更精准地捕捉与国内刺激直接相关的支出。在狭义复制中，估计乘数略低，但纳入后期财政事件后有所上升。我还评估了横截面估计的有效性与稳定性。尽管存在一定异质性，但各州层面响应的离散程度仍处于合理范围内，尤其是在考虑动态持续性之后。
10.1002/jae.70058.title: Reassessing the Cross‐Sectional Fiscal Multiplier: Evidence From U.S. Defense Procurement, 1966–2019
10.1002/jae.70058.title_zh: 重新评估横截面财政乘数：来自美国国防采购的证据（1966–2019）

10.1002/jae.70059.abstract: A common VAR approach is to identify responses to TFP news shocks by maximizing the variance share of TFP over a long horizon. We find that these TFP max share estimators tend to be biased in large samples when applied to data generated from DSGE models with shock processes that match TFP moments in the data, especially in the presence of TFP measurement error. We propose an alternative max share news estimator that reduces this bias and the RMSE of the impulse response estimates, even when there is sizable measurement error in the news variable. When applying this estimator to U.S. data, we find that news shocks are slower to diffuse to TFP and have a smaller effect on real activity than implied by the TFP max share estimator.
10.1002/jae.70059.abstract_zh: 常见的VAR方法是通过最大化全要素生产率（TFP）在长期内的方差份额来识别对TFP新闻冲击的响应。我们发现，当将这种TFP最大份额估计量应用于由DSGE模型生成的数据时（该模型的冲击过程与数据中的TFP矩相匹配），尤其是在存在TFP测量误差的情况下，这些估计量在大样本中往往存在偏误。我们提出了一种替代性的最大份额新闻估计量，该估计量能够减少这种偏误以及脉冲响应估计的均方根误差（RMSE），即使新闻变量存在显著的测量误差。当将此估计量应用于美国数据时，我们发现新闻冲击对TFP的扩散速度比TFP最大份额估计量所隐含的更慢，且对实际经济活动的影响更小。
10.1002/jae.70059.title: Estimating Macroeconomic News and Surprise Shocks
10.1002/jae.70059.title_zh: 估算宏观经济新闻与意外冲击

10.1002/jae.70061.abstract: This paper studies estimation of causal effects in a panel data setting. We introduce a new estimator, the Triply Robust Panel (TROP) estimator, that combines a flexible model for the potential outcomes based on a low‐rank factor structure on top of a two‐way‐fixed effect specification, with unit weights intended to upweight units similar to the treated units and time weights intended to upweight time periods close to the treated time periods. We study the performance of the estimator in a set of simulations designed to closely match several commonly studied real data sets. We find that there is substantial variation in the performance of the estimators across the settings considered. The proposed estimator outperforms Two‐Way‐Fixed‐Effect (TWFE) or Difference‐In‐Differences (DID), Synthetic Control (SC), Matrix Completion (MC) and Synthetic‐Difference‐In‐Differences (SDID) estimators. We investigate what features of the data generating process lead to this superior performance and assess the relative importance of the three components of the proposed estimator. We have two recommendations. Our preferred strategy is that researchers use simulations closely matched to the data they are interested in, along the lines discussed in this paper, to investigate which estimators work well in their particular setting. A simpler approach is to use more robust estimators such as SDID or the new TROP estimator, which we find to substantially outperform TWFE/DID estimators in many empirically relevant settings.
10.1002/jae.70061.abstract_zh: 本文研究面板数据设定下的因果效应估计问题。我们提出一种新的估计量——三重稳健面板（TROP）估计量，该估计量结合了基于低秩因子结构的灵活潜在结果模型（该模型建立在双向固定效应规范之上），并引入旨在提升与处理单元相似性的单元权重，以及旨在强化接近处理时间段的时期权重。我们通过一系列与多个常用真实数据集高度匹配的模拟实验，评估该估计量的表现。研究发现，不同设定下各估计量的表现存在显著差异。所提出的估计量优于双向固定效应（TWFE）或双重差分（DID）、合成控制（SC）、矩阵补全（MC）及合成双重差分（SDID）估计量。我们进一步探究数据生成过程中哪些特征导致了这种优越表现，并评估该估计量三个组成部分的相对重要性。我们提出两项建议：首选策略是研究者应按照本文讨论的思路，针对其关注的数据进行高度匹配的模拟实验，以确定在特定设定下表现良好的估计量；更简便的方法是采用SDID或新型TROP估计量等更具稳健性的估计量，我们发现这些估计量在许多实证相关设定中显著优于TWFE/DID估计量。
10.1002/jae.70061.title: Triply Robust Panel Estimators

10.1002/jae.70063.abstract: The external validity of regression discontinuity designs is crucial for informing policy but is rarely examined in applied work. To advance empirical practice, we propose a joint inference procedure for the treatment effect and its local external validity, captured by the treatment effect derivative (TED), within a robust bias correction framework. We further introduce a locally linear treatment effects assumption, which extends the scope of the TED and enables identification and the construction of a uniform confidence band for extrapolated effects. These methods apply to most empirical studies. Empirical illustrations demonstrate their practical usefulness.
10.1002/jae.70063.abstract_zh: 断点回归设计的外部有效性对于政策制定至关重要，但在应用研究中却鲜少被检验。为推进实证实践，我们提出了一种在稳健偏差校正框架内，对处理效应及其局部外部有效性（由处理效应导数TED衡量）进行联合推断的方法。我们进一步引入局部线性处理效应假设，该假设扩展了TED的适用范围，并能够识别外推效应并构建其一致置信带。这些方法适用于大多数实证研究。实证案例展示了其实际应用价值。
10.1002/jae.70063.title: Joint Inference for the Regression Discontinuity Effect and Its External Validity
10.1002/jae.70063.title_zh: 断点回归效应及其外部有效性的联合推断

10.1002/jae.70064.abstract: I provide a precision‐sampler‐based replication of the multivariate unobserved component stochastic volatility outlier‐adjusted model of Stock and Watson (2016) applied to inflation in the United States and the Euro Area (EA). I find a substantial post‐2020 increase in trend inflation for both the United States and the EA, and estimate end‐2024 trend inflation at 2.3 and 2.0 percent, respectively.
10.1002/jae.70064.abstract_zh: 本文基于Stock与Watson（2016）提出的多变量不可观测成分随机波动异常值调整模型，采用精确采样器方法进行复制，并将其应用于美国和欧元区的通胀分析。研究发现，2020年后美国和欧元区的趋势通胀均出现显著上升，预计2024年底的趋势通胀率分别为2.3%和2.0%。
10.1002/jae.70064.title: Multivariate Trend Inflation in the United States and the Euro Area
10.1002/jae.70064.title_zh: 美国和欧元区的多元趋势通胀

10.1002/jae.70065.abstract: We examine how parental income and family structure during childhood and adolescence affect adult income, emphasizing the timing of these effects. Using an ordered multinomial probability model with functional covariates, we find that these familial influences are strongest in middle childhood and adolescence. We also uncover a complementary relationship in the effects of income and family structure trajectories during key developmental periods. By flexibly controlling for personal and family characteristics using nonparametric methods, our approach effectively handles high‐dimensional covariates. The results advance the understanding of intergenerational income mobility and highlight the long‐term importance of early‐life familial conditions for adult economic success.
10.1002/jae.70065.abstract_zh: 本文考察了童年及青少年时期的父母收入与家庭结构如何影响成年后的收入水平，并重点分析了这些影响的时间节点。通过采用含函数协变量的有序多项概率模型，本研究发现这些家庭因素在童年中期及青少年时期的影响最为显著。同时，研究揭示了关键发育阶段中收入与家庭结构轨迹的互补效应。借助非参数方法灵活控制个人及家庭特征，本模型有效处理了高维协变量问题。研究结果深化了对代际收入流动性的理解，并凸显了早期家庭环境对成年后经济成就的长期重要性。
10.1002/jae.70065.title: The Effects of Parental Income and Family Structure on Intergenerational Mobility: A Trajectories‐Based Approach
10.1002/jae.70065.title_zh: 父母收入与家庭结构对代际流动的影响：基于轨迹的方法

10.1002/jae.70066.abstract: This paper introduces a novel method to adaptively design randomized experiments. For randomized experiments with a pilot stage, or multistage experiments, Hahn et al. (2011) propose an adaptive experimental design that adjusts the next stage's propensity score based on data from the previous stages. This paper discusses how the discretization of covariates affects the precision of the estimation of the average treatment effect (ATE) through the estimated propensity score for the next stage. Also, this paper proposes an algorithm using the bootstrap technique to find the optimal level of discretization of covariates. Monte Carlo simulations and an application with actual data show that the suggested method performs well.
10.1002/jae.70066.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种自适应设计随机实验的新方法。针对包含预实验阶段或多阶段随机实验，Hahn等人（2011）提出了一种自适应实验设计，该设计基于前一阶段的数据调整下一阶段的倾向得分。本文探讨了协变量离散化如何通过下一阶段估计的倾向得分影响平均处理效应（ATE）估计的精度。同时，本文提出了一种基于自助法（bootstrap）技术的算法，用于确定协变量的最优离散化水平。蒙特卡洛模拟及实际数据应用表明，所建议的方法表现良好。
10.1002/jae.70066.title: Optimal Covariate Discretization in Adaptive Randomized Experiments
10.1002/jae.70066.title_zh: 自适应随机实验中的最优协变量离散化

10.1002/jae.70067.abstract: This paper studies heterogeneous mixed‐frequency panel data models, focusing on linear specifications that allow heterogeneity in both aggregation weights and slope coefficients. To address potential correlations between the heterogeneity and the covariates, we first show that, under additional normalization conditions, the mean‐group estimator delivers consistent and asymptotically normal slope estimates but biased weights estimators. As an alternative, we propose a correlated random effects estimator using a generalized Mundlak specification. We further discuss the implementation of these two estimators when covariates are observed at substantially higher sampling frequencies. Monte Carlo simulations are conducted to assess their finite‐sample properties. As an empirical illustration, we revisit the impact of temperature fluctuations on economic growth using the proposed framework.
10.1002/jae.70067.abstract_zh: 本文研究异质性混频面板数据模型，重点关注允许聚合权重和斜率系数均存在异质性的线性设定。为应对异质性与协变量之间的潜在相关性，我们首先证明：在额外标准化条件下，均值组估计量能够获得一致且渐近正态的斜率估计，但权重估计量存在偏误。作为替代方案，我们提出采用广义Mundlak设定的相关随机效应估计量。进一步讨论了当协变量以显著更高采样频率被观测时，这两种估计量的实施方法。通过蒙特卡洛模拟评估其有限样本性质。作为实证例证，我们运用该框架重新考察了气温波动对经济增长的影响。
10.1002/jae.70067.title: Estimation of Heterogeneous Panel Data Models With Mixed Sampling Frequencies
10.1002/jae.70067.title_zh: 混合采样频率下异质性面板数据模型的估计

10.1002/jae.70068.abstract: We introduce an overidentification test of two alternative assumptions to identify the average treatment effect on the treated in a two‐period panel data setting: unconfoundedness and common trends. Under unconfoundedness, treatment assignment and post‐treatment outcomes are independent, conditional on control variables and pre‐treatment outcomes, which motivates including the pre‐treatment outcomes in the set of controls. Under common trends, the trend and the treatment assignment are independent, conditional on control variables, motivating a Difference‐in‐Differences (DiD) approach. Given the non‐nested nature of these assumptions and their often ambiguous plausibility in empirical settings, we propose a joint test using a doubly robust statistic that can be combined with machine learning to control for observed confounders in a data‐driven manner. We discuss causal models satisfying either common trends, unconfoundedness, or both assumptions. Applying the proposed method to publicly available datasets, we find that the test rejects the null hypothesis in two out of four cases.
10.1002/jae.70068.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种过度识别检验方法，用于评估两期面板数据中识别处理组平均处理效应的两种替代假设：无混杂性与共同趋势。在无混杂性假设下，处理分配与处理后结果在控制变量和处理前结果条件下相互独立，这促使将处理前结果纳入控制变量集。在共同趋势假设下，趋势与处理分配在控制变量条件下相互独立，这推动了双重差分法的应用。鉴于这两种假设的非嵌套性质及其在实证情境中常存的模糊合理性，我们提出一种联合检验方法，采用双重稳健统计量，可结合机器学习以数据驱动方式控制观测混杂因素。我们讨论了满足共同趋势、无混杂性或两者兼具的因果模型。将所提方法应用于公开数据集后，发现检验在四个案例中有两个拒绝了原假设。
10.1002/jae.70068.title: A Joint Test of Unconfoundedness and Common Trends
10.1002/jae.70068.title_zh: 无混淆性与共同趋势的联合检验

10.1002/jae.70069.abstract: ABSTRACT Peer influence on effort devoted to some activity is often studied when effort is unobserved, and the researcher instead observes an outcome that combines effort with other shocks. For instance, in education, achievement measures such as GPA reflect both effort and idiosyncratic GPA shocks. We propose an alternative approach that circumvents this approximation. Our framework distinguishes unobserved shocks to GPA that do not affect effort from preference shocks that do affect effort levels. We show that peer effects estimates obtained using our approach can differ significantly from classical estimates (where effort is approximated) if the network includes isolated students. Applying our approach to data on high school students in the United States, we find that peer effect estimates relying on GPA as a proxy for effort are 40% lower than those obtained using our approach.
10.1002/jae.70069.abstract_zh: 摘要 当努力程度不可观测，而研究者仅能观察到结合了努力与其他冲击的最终结果时，关于同伴效应对某项活动投入程度的影响研究往往面临挑战。例如在教育领域，GPA等学业成就指标既反映努力程度，也包含个体特有的GPA冲击。本文提出一种规避此类近似处理的新方法。我们的分析框架将不影响努力程度的不可观测GPA冲击与确实影响努力水平的偏好冲击进行区分。研究表明，当社交网络中存在孤立学生时，采用本方法获得的同伴效应估计值可能与经典方法（将努力程度近似处理）存在显著差异。通过将本方法应用于美国高中生数据，我们发现，以GPA作为努力程度代理变量的同伴效应估计值，比采用本方法获得的估计值低40%。
10.1002/jae.70069.title: Identifying Peer Effects in Networks with Unobserved Effort and Isolated Students
10.1002/jae.70069.title_zh: 识别未观测努力与孤立学生网络中的同伴效应

10.1002/jae.70070.abstract: Instrumental variables are a popular tool to infer causal effects under unobserved confounding, but choosing suitable instruments is challenging in practice. We propose gIVBMA, a Bayesian model averaging procedure that addresses this challenge by averaging across different sets of instrumental variables and covariates in a structural equation model. This allows for data‐driven selection of valid and relevant instruments and provides additional robustness against invalid instruments. Our approach extends previous work through a scale‐invariant prior structure and accommodates non‐Gaussian outcomes and treatments, offering greater flexibility than existing methods. The computational strategy uses conditional Bayes factors to update models separately for the outcome and treatments. We prove that this model selection procedure is consistent. In simulation experiments, gIVBMA outperforms current state‐of‐the‐art methods. We demonstrate its usefulness in two empirical applications: the effects of malaria and institutions on income per capita and the returns to schooling. A software implementation of gIVBMA is available in Julia.
10.1002/jae.70070.abstract_zh: 工具变量是在存在未观测混杂因素时推断因果效应的常用方法，但在实践中选择合适的工具变量颇具挑战性。我们提出gIVBMA方法，这是一种通过结构方程模型中对不同工具变量集和协变量集进行平均化的贝叶斯模型平均程序。该方法能够基于数据驱动选择有效且相关的工具变量，并增强对无效工具变量的稳健性。我们的方法通过尺度不变先验结构扩展了先前研究，并兼容非高斯结果变量和处理变量，比现有方法具有更高灵活性。计算策略采用条件贝叶斯因子分别更新结果方程和处理方程的模型。我们证明该模型选择程序具有一致性。模拟实验表明，gIVBMA优于当前最先进方法。我们在两个实证应用中验证其实用价值：疟疾与制度对人均收入的影响，以及教育回报率。gIVBMA的软件实现已发布于Julia平台。
10.1002/jae.70070.title: Bayesian Model Averaging in Causal Instrumental Variable Models
10.1002/jae.70070.title_zh: 因果工具变量模型中的贝叶斯模型平均

10.1002/jae.70071.abstract: We propose a unified framework for interpreting and comparing a broad class of synthetic control (SC) methods. Our framework is built on an analysis of a mean‐squared prediction error (MSPE) bound for the counterfactual predicted by a generic SC method, without imposing a specific outcome model. Using this framework, we develop a generalized SC method that provides a more comprehensive regularization of the MSPE bound than several existing SC methods. Through simulation studies and placebo analyses, we demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach in predicting the counterfactual.
10.1002/jae.70071.abstract_zh: 本文提出一个统一框架，用于解释和比较广泛类别的合成控制（SC）方法。该框架基于对通用SC方法预测的反事实均方预测误差（MSPE）边界的分析，且无需设定特定结果模型。利用此框架，我们开发了一种广义合成控制方法，相较于现有多种SC方法，该方法对MSPE边界实现了更全面的正则化。通过模拟研究与安慰剂分析，我们验证了所提方法在反事实预测中的有效性。
10.1002/jae.70071.title: Regularization of Synthetic Controls for Policy Evaluation
10.1002/jae.70071.title_zh: 政策评估中合成控制法的正则化

10.1002/jae.70072.abstract: We build on Modestino et al., who analysed “opportunistic upskilling” during the 2007 recession in the US, by extending their approach to European labour markets following recent economic shocks. Using a comprehensive dataset of online job postings (2019–2023) and an instrumental variable approach leveraging Ukrainian refugee inflows, we find that increases in labour supply have a significant positive effect on both education and experience requirements. Our findings reinforce the idea that employers opportunistically upskill labour demand in different but challenging macroeconomic contexts. The identification of such patterns, however, depends on the presence of a plausibly exogenous shock to labour markets.
10.1002/jae.70072.abstract_zh: 我们基于Modestino等人对2007年美国经济衰退期间“机会性技能提升”的研究，将其方法拓展至近期经济冲击后的欧洲劳动力市场。利用2019-2023年在线招聘信息的综合数据集，并采用以乌克兰难民流入为工具变量的方法，我们发现劳动力供给增加对教育及经验要求均产生显著正向影响。研究结果进一步印证了雇主在不同但严峻的宏观经济背景下会机会性地提升劳动力需求技能水平的观点。然而，此类模式的识别依赖于劳动力市场是否存在合理外生冲击。
10.1002/jae.70072.title: Opportunistic Upskilling in European Labour Markets—Evidence From a Wide Replication
10.1002/jae.70072.title_zh: 欧洲劳动力市场中的机会性技能提升——基于广泛复制的证据

10.1002/jae.70073.abstract: ABSTRACT We estimate the first time‐varying, county‐level index of housing supply elasticities across the United States, using a structural vector autoregression model with sign restrictions to identify the effect of a positive demand shock. This index reveals four features of the supply curve in different local housing markets. First, supply elasticities are low, on average, generating faster price growth than housing unit growth for most of the country. Second, there is significant variation in elasticities across counties, both urban and rural. Third, elasticities have declined in more counties than they have risen over time, particularly in large urban markets. Fourth, these new estimates predict housing quantity growth better than previous models in the literature.
10.1002/jae.70073.abstract_zh: 摘要 我们利用带有符号约束的结构向量自回归模型识别正向需求冲击效应，首次估算了美国各县级住房供给弹性的时变指数。该指数揭示了不同地方住房市场供给曲线的四个特征：第一，平均而言供给弹性较低，导致全国大部分地区房价增速快于住房单元增速；第二，城乡各县之间的弹性存在显著差异；第三，随时间推移，弹性下降的县数量多于上升的县，尤其是在大型城市市场；第四，相较于文献中的既有模型，这些新估计值能更准确地预测住房数量增长。
10.1002/jae.70073.title: Housing Supply Elasticities: A Structural Vector Autoregression Approach
10.1002/jae.70073.title_zh: 住房供给弹性：结构向量自回归方法

10.1002/jae.70074.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We analyse fiscal policy in resource‐rich economies using a novel Bayesian regime‐switching panel model. The identified regimes capture pro‐ or countercyclical fiscal behaviour by allowing regime‐specific shifts in the average fiscal stance, while the switches between the regimes have the interpretation of changes in fiscal policy. Applying the model to a panel of sixteen oil‐producing economies, we show that fiscal policy has alternated between a procyclical and countercyclical regime multiple times over the sample. Furthermore, we find that fiscal policy is more volatile in the procyclical regime and that the probability of being in the procyclical regime is higher for OPEC countries than for non‐OPEC countries. We also show that following either an increase or decrease in oil revenues, the growth in government expenditures is mostly increasing, suggesting an upward bias in expenditures in oil‐producing countries. These are new findings in the literature.</jats:p>
10.1002/jae.70074.abstract_zh: 摘要：我们采用一种新颖的贝叶斯体制转换面板模型，分析了资源丰富经济体的财政政策。通过允许平均财政立场发生体制特定转变，识别出的体制捕捉了顺周期或逆周期的财政行为，而体制间的转换则被解释为财政政策的变化。将该模型应用于由16个石油生产经济体组成的面板数据，我们发现在样本期内，财政政策多次在顺周期与逆周期体制之间交替。此外，我们发现顺周期体制下的财政政策波动性更大，且石油输出国组织（OPEC）国家处于顺周期体制的概率高于非OPEC国家。我们还表明，无论石油收入增加还是减少，政府支出的增长大多呈上升趋势，这暗示石油生产国存在支出向上偏倚。这些是文献中的新发现。
10.1002/jae.70074.title: Fiscal Policy Regimes in Resource‐Rich Economies
10.1002/jae.70074.title_zh: 资源丰富经济体的财政政策体制

10.1002/jae.70075.abstract: ABSTRACT Lévy processes are widely used in financial modeling due to their ability to capture discontinuities and heavy tails, which are common in high‐frequency asset return data. However, parameter estimation remains a challenge when associated likelihoods are unavailable or costly to compute. We propose a fast and accurate method for Lévy parameter estimation using the neural Bayes estimation (NBE) framework—a simulation‐based, likelihood‐free approach that leverages permutation‐invariant neural networks to approximate Bayes estimators. We contribute new theoretical results, showing that NBE results in consistent estimators whose risk converges to that of the Bayes estimator under mild conditions. Moreover, through extensive simulations across several Lévy models, we show that NBE outperforms traditional methods in both accuracy and runtime, while also enabling two complementary approaches to uncertainty quantification. We illustrate our approach on a challenging high‐frequency cryptocurrency return dataset, where the method captures evolving parameter dynamics and delivers reliable and interpretable inference at a fraction of the computational cost of traditional methods. We investigate nearly a decade of high‐frequency Bitcoin returns, requiring less than one minute to estimate parameters under the proposed approach.
10.1002/jae.70075.abstract_zh: 摘要 莱维过程因其能够捕捉高频资产收益数据中常见的间断性和厚尾特征，在金融建模中得到广泛应用。然而，当相关似然函数不可用或计算成本高昂时，参数估计仍面临挑战。我们提出了一种基于神经贝叶斯估计（NBE）框架的快速精确莱维参数估计方法——这是一种基于模拟的无似然方法，利用置换不变神经网络来近似贝叶斯估计量。我们贡献了新的理论成果，证明在温和条件下，NBE可得到一致估计量，其风险收敛至贝叶斯估计量的风险水平。此外，通过针对多个莱维模型的大量模拟实验，我们表明NBE在精度和运行时间上均优于传统方法，同时还能实现两种互补的不确定性量化方法。我们以具有挑战性的高频加密货币收益数据集为例进行方法验证，该方法能够捕捉动态变化的参数特征，并以传统方法计算成本的一小部分提供可靠且可解释的推断。我们研究了近十年高频比特币收益数据，在提出的方法下，参数估计耗时不足一分钟。
10.1002/jae.70075.title: Fast Likelihood‐Free Parameter Estimation for Lévy Processes
10.1002/jae.70075.title_zh: 莱维过程的快速无似然参数估计

10.1002/jae.70076.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This study proposes specification tests for interference structure in causal inference with spillovers. We focus on experimental settings in which the treatment assignment mechanism is known. To test whether a given exposure mapping adequately summarizes the true interference structure, we develop conditional randomization tests by utilizing the hierarchical relationship between the null and alternative exposure mappings. When there are multiple candidate exposure mappings of interest, we propose a sequential specification testing procedure that controls the false discovery rate. Through extensive simulation exercises, we demonstrate that our tests have desirable size properties and satisfactory power. To illustrate the proposed methods, we revisit two existing social network experiments: One on farmers' insurance adoption and another on anti‐conflict education programs.</jats:p>
10.1002/jae.70076.abstract_zh: 本研究针对存在溢出效应的因果推断中的干扰结构，提出了设定检验方法。我们聚焦于处理分配机制已知的实验场景。为检验给定的暴露映射是否充分概括了真实的干扰结构，我们利用零假设与备择假设暴露映射之间的层级关系，开发了条件随机化检验。当存在多个感兴趣的候选暴露映射时，我们提出了一种序贯设定检验程序，该程序能够控制错误发现率。通过大量模拟实验，我们证明所提出的检验具有理想的尺度性质与令人满意的检验功效。为说明所提方法的应用，我们重新审视了两项现有社交网络实验：一项关于农民保险采纳行为，另一项关于反冲突教育项目。
10.1002/jae.70076.title: Conditional Randomization Tests for the Specification of Interference Structure
10.1002/jae.70076.title_zh: 干扰结构设定的条件随机化检验

10.1002/jae.70077.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This paper proposes a simple smooth specification test for the propensity score in the spirit of Neyman (1937). We derive a particular restriction on the propensity score and construct the specification test based on it. Using the density‐weighting method, we transform the original specification testing problem into a test of the joint significance of the generalized Fourier coefficients. We propose a novel projection method to eliminate the parameter estimation effect arising from estimating unknown nuisance parameters. The proposed test is shown to follow a standard  distribution under the null hypothesis and to possess nontrivial asymptotic power against local alternatives that converge to the null at the parametric rate , where  is the sample size. To enhance the practical applicability of the procedure, we further introduce a data‐driven selection method for determining the testing order, enabling automatic selection based on the observed data. Compared to existing methods, our test does not suffer from the “curse of dimensionality” faced by Shaikh et al. (2009); at the same time, our test is both asymptotically pivotal and more computationally efficient than that of Sant'Anna and Song (2019). Extensive simulations demonstrate that the proposed test yields satisfactory empirical size and power. Compared with previous tests, our test exhibits comparable overall performance and delivers clear improvements in some cases, especially for high‐frequency alternatives. Two empirical applications further illustrate the practical applicability of our proposal, examining propensity score specifications in the Soviet 156 Program and the US Job Corps Program.</jats:p>
10.1002/jae.70077.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种基于Neyman（1937）思想的倾向得分平滑设定检验方法。我们推导出倾向得分的一个特定约束条件，并据此构建设定检验。通过密度加权方法，将原始设定检验问题转化为广义傅里叶系数联合显著性检验。我们提出一种新颖的投影方法，以消除未知冗余参数估计带来的参数估计效应。所提出的检验在原假设下服从标准分布，并对以参数速率收敛于原假设的局部备择假设具有非平凡渐近功效（其中为样本量）。为增强方法的实际应用性，我们进一步引入数据驱动的检验阶数选择方法，实现基于观测数据的自动选择。与现有方法相比，本检验不存在Shaikh等（2009）面临的"维度灾难"问题；同时，本检验既具有渐近枢轴性质，又比Sant'Anna和Song（2019）的方法计算效率更高。大量模拟表明，所提检验具有令人满意的经验水平和功效。与以往检验相比，本检验在整体表现上相当，并在某些情形下（尤其是高频备择假设）展现出明显改进。两项实证应用（苏联156工程和美国职业训练团项目）进一步验证了本方法的实际适用性。
10.1002/jae.70077.title: A Smooth Specification Test for the Propensity Score
10.1002/jae.70077.title_zh: 倾向得分的平滑设定检验

10.1002/jae.70078.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>How do labor market institutions shape the transmission of government spending shocks and macroeconomic volatility? We develop a theoretical model in which labor market institutions affect fiscal transmission through their effect on wage rigidity, job separation, and matching frictions. We estimate an interacted panel vector autoregressive model for 16 OECD economies and study how macroeconomic responses to government spending shocks vary with institutional labor market characteristics. In line with our theoretical predictions, we show that institutions that stabilize employment and wages tend to reduce output volatility and attenuate the response of output and employment to government spending shocks.</jats:p>
10.1002/jae.70078.abstract_zh: 劳动力市场制度如何影响政府支出冲击的传导机制及宏观经济波动？我们构建了一个理论模型，其中劳动力市场制度通过影响工资刚性、岗位分离和匹配摩擦来作用于财政传导机制。基于16个OECD经济体的交互面板向量自回归模型估计，我们研究了宏观经济对政府支出冲击的反应如何随劳动力市场制度特征而变化。与理论预测一致，我们发现稳定就业和工资的制度倾向于降低产出波动，并削弱产出和就业对政府支出冲击的反应。
10.1002/jae.70078.title: Labor Market Institutions, Fiscal Multipliers, and Macroeconomic Volatility
10.1002/jae.70078.title_zh: 劳动力市场制度、财政乘数与宏观经济波动

10.1002/jae.70079.abstract: ABSTRACT This paper explores the existence of network externalities in link formation games of incomplete information. It extends the structural estimation method in Leung (2015) to games where links are undirected and proposals are only partially observed. We provide an econometric characterization of the proposed two‐step estimator and document its performance through a simulation exercise. When the estimation method is applied to data on risk‐sharing arrangements in a Tanzanian village, results indicate that indirect connections matter.
10.1002/jae.70079.abstract_zh: 摘要 本文探讨了不完全信息链接形成博弈中网络外部性的存在性。我们将Leung（2015）的结构估计方法扩展至链接无向且提议仅部分可观测的博弈场景。我们提出了所设计的两步估计量的计量经济学特征，并通过模拟实验验证其性能。将该估计方法应用于坦桑尼亚某村庄风险分担安排的数据后，结果表明间接连接具有显著影响。
10.1002/jae.70079.title: Estimating Network Externalities in Undirected Link Formation Games
10.1002/jae.70079.title_zh: 无向链接形成博弈中的网络外部性估计

10.1002/jae.70080.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>While existing work shows COVID‐19 stay‐at‐home (SAH) policies decreased mobility on average, we lack evidence regarding heterogeneity in policy effectiveness across US counties. To uncover potential heterogeneity, we implement a novel two‐stage approach. First, we employ recent advances in synthetic control estimation and inference to obtain and bound both time‐average and county‐specific treatment effects. Next, we use a local linear forest to explain observed heterogeneity using county‐level predictors. This procedure reveals substantial variation in policy effectiveness and identifies predictors of policy effectiveness which can be used to target future SAH policies.</jats:p>
10.1002/jae.70080.abstract_zh:
<jats:title>摘要</jats:title>
<jats:p>现有研究表明，新冠疫情居家令政策平均降低了人口流动性，但关于该政策在美国各县间有效性的异质性证据尚不充分。为揭示潜在异质性，我们采用了一种新颖的两阶段方法。首先，利用合成控制估计与推断的最新进展，获取并界定了时间平均效应及县级特定处理效应的边界。其次，通过局部线性森林模型，运用县级预测变量解释观测到的异质性。该流程揭示了政策有效性的显著差异，并识别出可用于未来居家令政策精准施策的预测变量。</jats:p>
10.1002/jae.70080.title: Deniers and Compliers: Unpacking the Heterogeneous Effectiveness of U.S. Stay‐at‐Home Mandates During the COVID‐19 Pandemic
10.1002/jae.70080.title_zh: 否认者与遵从者：解析美国COVID-19疫情期间居家令的异质性效果

10.1002/jae.70081.abstract: ABSTRACT We propose a method to identify the anticipated components of macroeconomic shocks in a structural VAR. We include empirical forecasts about each time series in the VAR. This introduces enough linear restrictions to identify every structural shock and to further decompose each one into “news” and “surprise” shocks. We estimate a VAR on U.S. time series using forecast data from the SPF, CBO, Federal Reserve, and asset prices. Unanticipated fiscal stimulus and monetary policy shocks have typical effects that match existing evidence. In our news‐surprise decomposition, we find that news drives around one quarter of U.S. business cycle volatility. News explains a larger share of the variance due to fiscal shocks than for monetary policy shocks. Finally, we use the news structure of the shocks to estimate counterfactual policy rules, and compare the ability of fiscal and monetary policy to moderate output and inflation. We find that coordinated fiscal and monetary policy are substantially more effective than either individually.
10.1002/jae.70081.abstract_zh: 摘要 本文提出一种在结构向量自回归（VAR）中识别宏观经济冲击预期成分的方法。我们将各时间序列的经验预测纳入VAR模型，由此引入足够的线性约束，从而识别所有结构性冲击，并进一步将每个冲击分解为“新闻”冲击与“意外”冲击。我们利用美国国会预算办公室（CBO）、美联储、资产价格及专业预测者调查（SPF）的预测数据，对美国时间序列进行VAR估计。研究发现，未预期的财政刺激与货币政策冲击的典型效应与既有证据一致。在新闻-意外分解中，新闻冲击解释了美国经济周期波动约四分之一的方差。相较于货币政策冲击，新闻冲击对财政冲击方差的解释份额更大。最后，我们利用冲击的新闻结构估计反事实政策规则，并比较财政政策与货币政策在平抑产出与通胀方面的效力。结果表明，财政与货币政策的协调配合比单一政策显著更有效。
10.1002/jae.70081.title: Identifying News Shocks From Forecasts
10.1002/jae.70081.title_zh: 从预测中识别新闻冲击

10.1002/jae.70082.abstract: We estimate the causal effects of macroprudential policies on the entire distribution of GDP growth for advanced European economies using a narrative‐identification strategy in a quantile‐regression framework. While macroprudential policy has near‐zero effects on the center of the GDP‐growth distribution, tighter policy brings benefits by reducing the variance of future growth, significantly boosting the left tail while simultaneously reducing the right. Assessing a range of channels through which these effects materialize, we find that macroprudential policy particularly operates through ‘credit‐at‐risk’: it reduces the right tail of future credit growth, dampening booms, in turn reducing the likelihood of extreme GDP‐growth outturns.
10.1002/jae.70082.abstract_zh: 我们采用叙事识别策略，在分位数回归框架下，估算了宏观审慎政策对欧洲发达经济体GDP增长整体分布的因果效应。尽管宏观审慎政策对GDP增长分布的中心几乎无影响，但收紧政策通过降低未来增长的方差带来益处，显著提升左尾的同时削减右尾。通过评估这些效应得以显现的多种渠道，我们发现宏观审慎政策尤其通过“风险信贷”发挥作用：它减少了未来信贷增长的右尾，抑制了繁荣，进而降低了极端GDP增长结果的可能性。
10.1002/jae.70082.title: The Transmission of Macroprudential Policy in the Tails: Evidence From a Narrative Approach
10.1002/jae.70082.title_zh: 宏观审慎政策在尾部风险中的传导：基于叙事方法的证据

10.1002/jae.70083.abstract: We introduce EA‐MD‐QD, a new publicly available dataset comprising 1136 macroeconomic time series for the euro area (EA) and its ten largest member countries observed at monthly or quarterly frequency. Since January 2024, EA‐MD‐QD has been updated monthly and continuously revised, providing a valuable resource for policy analysis in the EA. Using EA‐MD‐QD, we study country‐specific impulse responses to an EA‐wide monetary policy shock. Results reveal moderate yet significant cross‐country heterogeneity, with differences between so‐called core countries, such as France and Germany, and peripheral countries, such as Italy and Spain, in their price and interest rate responses, together with meaningful differences in real activity, while stock price responses are relatively homogeneous. Evidence points to homeownership and saving behavior as potential drivers of the observed cross‐country differences.
10.1002/jae.70083.abstract_zh: 我们推出EA-MD-QD，这是一个新的公开数据集，包含欧元区及其十个最大成员国的1136个月度或季度宏观经济时间序列。自2024年1月起，EA-MD-QD每月更新并持续修订，为欧元区政策分析提供了宝贵资源。利用EA-MD-QD，我们研究了各国对欧元区整体货币政策冲击的特定脉冲响应。结果显示，各国之间存在适度但显著的异质性：法国和德国等所谓核心国家与意大利和西班牙等外围国家在价格和利率响应上存在差异，实际经济活动方面也有显著不同，而股票价格响应则相对同质。证据表明，住房拥有率和储蓄行为是观察到的跨国差异的潜在驱动因素。
10.1002/jae.70083.title: Large Datasets for the Euro Area and Its Member Countries and the Dynamic Effects of the Common Monetary Policy
10.1002/jae.70083.title_zh: 欧元区及其成员国的大数据集与共同货币政策的动态效应

10.1002/jae.70084.abstract: Despite its conceptual appeal, the autoregressive inverse‐Wishart (AIW) multivariate stochastic volatility model has been hindered by inefficient sampling methods. The existing samplers for the latent covariance matrix severely suffer from the curse of dimensionality and only work when the dimension is very low. In this paper, we introduce a new proposal for the latent covariance matrix in the AIW model, which demonstrates far better scalability. We introduce different extensions to the basic AIW model that capture various stylized volatility features. We further fit the AIW model into a factor structure and provide an a posteriori identification procedure without introducing order dependence. When evaluated using real datasets ranging from 10 assets to 1000 assets, the new AIW‐based models, whether the standalone versions or the factor versions, are especially suited for multivariate volatility modeling in a wide range of dimensions.
10.1002/jae.70084.abstract_zh: 尽管自回归逆威沙特（AIW）多元随机波动模型在概念上具有吸引力，但其低效的采样方法一直制约其应用。现有针对潜在协方差矩阵的采样器严重受困于维度灾难，仅能在极低维度下运行。本文为AIW模型中的潜在协方差矩阵提出了一种新方案，该方案展现出显著更优的可扩展性。我们引入基础AIW模型的不同扩展形式，以捕捉各类典型波动特征。进一步将AIW模型嵌入因子结构，并设计了一种无需引入顺序依赖的后验识别程序。基于10至1000个资产规模的真实数据集评估表明，无论是独立版本还是因子版本的新型AIW模型，均特别适用于广泛维度下的多元波动率建模。
10.1002/jae.70084.title: The Autoregressive Inverse‐Wishart Multivariate Stochastic Volatility Model and Its Factor Extension
10.1002/jae.70084.title_zh: 自回归逆威沙特多元随机波动模型及其因子扩展

10.1007/978-3-540-29807-6_2745.title: DP46 Net Energy Expenditure and Energy Demand in the UK
10.1007/978-3-540-29807-6_2745.title_zh: DP46 英国净能源支出与能源需求

10.1007/bf00373063.abstract: The principal argument of the paper is that in an incomplete information setting, where the private sector lacks information of government objectives and has to learn about the policy rule by direct observation and estimation, simple ‘sub-optimal’ rules may outperform the more complicated rule which is optimal under complete information. This result is demonstrated by simulations using an overlapping contract rational expectations model. The paper thus provides some formal reasoning to support arguments for simplicity associated with credibility and the need for the private sector to be able to monitor policy. This is a preview of subscription content, log in via an institution to check access.
10.1007/bf00373063.abstract_zh: 本文的核心论点是，在信息不完全的环境下，当私人部门缺乏对政府目标的了解，必须通过直接观察和估计来学习政策规则时，简单的“次优”规则可能优于在完全信息条件下最优的复杂规则。这一结论通过使用重叠合同理性预期模型的模拟得以验证。因此，本文为支持与可信度相关的简单性论点，以及私人部门需具备监督政策能力的主张，提供了形式化的理论依据。此为订阅内容预览，请通过机构登录以确认访问权限。
10.1007/bf00373063.title: DP515 Should Rules be Simple?

10.1007/bf01000910.abstract: This paper explains this phenomenon in terms of a `peso problem' of credibility created by the response of a member government to the incentives it faces within the ERM.A country within the ERM that attempts to restrain inflation and avoid economic distortions faces strong pressure from its domestic manufacturing lobby. In the event that trading conditions for manufacturers worsen drastically, they will apply intense pressure not only for subsidy protection but also for a devaluation. When times are good, however, the pressure will be relaxed. This creates an asymmetry in the government's policy reaction: devaluation and subsidy in bad times, and no parity change or subsidy in good times. The result is an average expectation of devaluation in excess of what normally occurs which leads to overvaluation in normal times.
10.1007/bf01000910.abstract_zh: 本文从“比索问题”的视角解释这一现象，该问题源于成员国政府在欧洲汇率机制（ERM）内所面临的激励所引发的可信度危机。在ERM中，试图抑制通胀并避免经济扭曲的成员国，会面临来自国内制造业游说集团的强大压力。当制造业贸易条件急剧恶化时，这些集团不仅会强烈要求补贴保护，还会施压要求货币贬值。然而，在经济形势良好时，这种压力会有所缓解。这导致政府政策反应出现不对称性：经济低迷时期采取贬值和补贴措施，而经济繁荣时期则维持汇率不变且不提供补贴。其结果是，市场对贬值的平均预期高于实际发生频率，从而在正常时期造成汇率高估。

10.1007/s00148-026-01169-9.abstract: This study develops a common framework to compare the magnitude of national level losses that the COVID-19 pandemic inflicted across three critical dimensions — loss of life, loss of income, and loss of learning — and then explores the global distribution of such losses. To help inform public discussions, the well-being consequences of excess mortality are expressed in years of life lost, while those of income losses and school closures are expressed in additional person-years spent in poverty, either currently or in the future (due to lower growth). While 2020–2021 witnessed a global drop in life expectancy and the largest one-year increase in global poverty in many decades, widespread school closures may cause almost twice as large an increase in future poverty. The estimates of well-being loss for the average global citizen include a loss of 8 days of life, an additional two and half weeks spent in poverty in 2020 and 2021 (17 days), and the possibility of an additional month of life in poverty in the future due to school closures (31 days). The distribution of pandemic costs was highly unequal globally. While aggregating total losses requires the valuation of a year of life lost vis-à-vis an additional year spent in poverty, high-income countries experienced the lowest well-being losses for a wide range of valuations. Aggregate losses were much higher among lower-income countries, especially countries in the Latin America region who suffered the largest mortality costs as well as large losses in learning and sharp increases in poverty.
10.1007/s00148-026-01169-9.abstract_zh: 本研究构建了一个统一框架，用以比较新冠疫情在国家层面造成的三重关键维度损失——生命损失、收入损失与学习损失——并进一步探讨此类损失的全球分布格局。为助力公共讨论，超额死亡带来的福祉影响以生命损失年数衡量，而收入损失与学校关闭的后果则通过当前或未来（因增长放缓）新增的贫困人年数呈现。尽管2020-2021年间全球预期寿命下降，且全球贫困人口出现数十年来最大单年增幅，但大规模学校关闭可能使未来贫困人口增幅达到前者的近两倍。全球普通公民的福祉损失估算包括：生命损失8天、2020-2021年额外贫困时间两周半（17天），以及因学校关闭可能导致的未来额外贫困时间一个月（31天）。疫情成本的全球分布极不均衡。尽管汇总总损失需对生命损失年与新增贫困年进行价值权衡，但在广泛的价值评估区间内，高收入国家的福祉损失始终最低。中低收入国家的总损失显著更高，尤以拉丁美洲地区为甚——该地区不仅承受了最高的死亡率成本，还面临严重的学习损失与贫困率急剧攀升。
10.1007/s00148-026-01169-9.title: Lives, livelihoods, and learning: A global perspective on the well-being impacts of the COVID-19 pandemic
10.1007/s00148-026-01169-9.title_zh: 生命、生计与学习：新冠疫情对福祉影响的全球视角

10.1007/s00148-026-01172-0.abstract: Using the 2003 ban of female genital cutting in Benin as a natural experiment, I estimate the effect of the ban on women’s human capital accumulation. The ban decreases the likelihood of a woman undergoing genital cutting despite inconsistent enforcement. Banning female genital cutting has a counter-intuitive effect on women’s education. A difference-in-differences estimation indicates that the ban decreases women’s years of education, the probability of completing primary school, and the probability of starting secondary school. I show that the decrease in educational outcomes is accompanied by an increase in marriage and increased spousal match quality. The negative effect on women’s education dissipates following the implementation of free primary education in Benin.
10.1007/s00148-026-01172-0.abstract_zh: 以2003年贝宁禁止女性割礼作为自然实验，本文评估了该禁令对女性人力资本积累的影响。尽管执法力度不一，该禁令仍降低了女性接受割礼的可能性。禁止女性割礼对女性教育产生了反直觉效应。双重差分估计表明，该禁令减少了女性受教育年限、完成小学教育的概率以及进入中学的概率。本文发现，教育成果的下降伴随着婚姻缔结率的上升和配偶匹配质量的提升。随着贝宁免费初等教育的实施，该禁令对女性教育的负面效应逐渐消失。
10.1007/s00148-026-01172-0.title: Education, marriage, and banning female genital cutting: evidence from Benin
10.1007/s00148-026-01172-0.title_zh: 教育、婚姻与禁止女性割礼：来自贝宁的证据

10.1007/s00148-026-01173-z.title: From sons to daughters: international marriage migration and sex imbalances at birth
10.1007/s00148-026-01173-z.title_zh: 从儿子到女儿：国际婚姻迁移与出生性别失衡

10.1007/s00148-026-01174-y.abstract: Following the 2022 US Supreme Court decision Dobbs v Jackson, many states adopted early-term abortion (ETA) bans that prohibit abortions before the age of viability and often before sex determination is technologically feasible. We analyze the effect of ETA bans on the sex ratio at birth among first-generation Chinese, Korean, and Indian (CKI) immigrants using difference-in-differences and triple differences methodologies. While our estimates across higher parity children sometimes indicate a decrease in the sex ratio at birth, they are also generally small and statistically insignificant, which is consistent with continued access to sex selection under ETA bans. In contrast, we find that ETA bans are associated with a large and statistically significant increase in the sex ratio at birth among first-parity children to immigrant CKI women. As elevated sex ratios have not been previously documented on first-parity children, this may indicate that ETA bans shift sex-selective behavior to earlier parities by placing additional emphasis on having a boy now, before any further restrictions on abortions occur. Our estimates suggest that ETA bans caused 139 missing, first-born girls in 2023 alone.
10.1007/s00148-026-01174-y.abstract_zh: 2022年美国最高法院对多布斯诉杰克逊案作出裁决后，许多州通过了早期堕胎禁令，禁止在胎儿存活期之前（且通常在技术无法确定胎儿性别之前）实施堕胎。我们采用双重差分法和三重差分法，分析了早期堕胎禁令对第一代华裔、韩裔和印度裔移民出生性别比的影响。尽管对较高胎次子女的估算有时显示出生性别比下降，但这些结果普遍较小且统计上不显著，这与早期堕胎禁令下仍可继续实施性别选择的情况一致。相反，我们发现早期堕胎禁令与移民华裔、韩裔和印度裔女性第一胎子女的出生性别比大幅且统计上显著上升相关。由于此前未发现第一胎子女存在性别比偏高现象，这可能表明早期堕胎禁令通过强调在进一步堕胎限制实施前优先生育男孩，将性别选择行为提前至更早胎次。我们的估算显示，仅2023年，早期堕胎禁令就导致139名第一胎女婴缺失。
10.1007/s00148-026-01174-y.title: Early-term abortion bans and sex selection after Dobbs v Jackson
10.1007/s00148-026-01174-y.title_zh: 多布斯诉杰克逊案后的早期堕胎禁令与性别选择

10.1007/s00148-026-01175-x.abstract: This paper explores the relationship between geographic mortality differentials and human capital investment patterns in the Malthusian setup of 19th-century Armenia. We examine how variations in altitude are associated with mortality rates, human capital accumulation, and fertility decisions. Using detailed historical census and parish records, we document that higher-altitude areas tend to have lower population density, lower respiratory disease mortality, and lower overall mortality. Our empirical analysis also shows that individuals in these environments tend to display better numeracy skills and lower fertility rates. These findings align with the Ben-Porath hypothesis, suggesting that longer life horizons encourage shifting from child quantity to quality. Furthermore, these patterns are not driven by income differences or increased female autonomy arising from pastoral agriculture.
10.1007/s00148-026-01175-x.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了19世纪亚美尼亚马尔萨斯式环境下，地理死亡率差异与人力资本投资模式之间的关系。我们研究了海拔变化如何与死亡率、人力资本积累及生育决策相关联。利用详细的历史人口普查和教区记录，我们发现高海拔地区往往具有较低的人口密度、较低的呼吸系统疾病死亡率以及较低的总体死亡率。实证分析还表明，这些环境中的个体通常表现出更好的计算能力和较低的生育率。这些发现与Ben-Porath假说一致，表明更长的生命预期鼓励从子女数量向质量的转变。此外，这些模式并非由收入差异或牧业农业带来的女性自主权增强所驱动。
10.1007/s00148-026-01175-x.title: Geographic mortality differentials and the quality-quantity trade-off
10.1007/s00148-026-01175-x.title_zh: 地理死亡率差异与质量-数量权衡

10.1007/s00148-026-01176-w.abstract: Voluntary turnover imposes substantial costs on organizations, yet we know little about whether workers’ fundamental orientations toward work shape their mobility decisions. In this paper, we distinguish between job, career, and calling orientations, defined as the long-term beliefs about the role of work in one’s life. Using original survey data from the Dutch LISS panel, we show that work orientations are strong predictors of quit intentions and on-the-job search, even after controlling for socio-demographic characteristics, personality traits, job characteristics, and job satisfaction. Career-oriented individuals exhibit significantly higher quit intentions and search activity, particularly when perceived promotion opportunities are limited. Calling-oriented individuals report substantially lower quit intentions and on-the-job search. By contrast, having a job orientation is not systematically associated with turnover-related outcomes. The associations between work orientations and actual job quits one and two years later are weaker, suggesting that work orientations primarily shape turnover intentions and preparatory search behavior, while actual working conditions more strongly influence mobility. Overall, our findings identify work orientations as a novel and quantitatively important determinant of turnover-related behavior and highlight the role of workers’ underlying motivations in shaping mobility beyond standard economic predictors.
10.1007/s00148-026-01176-w.abstract_zh: 自愿离职给组织带来巨大成本，然而我们对工作者对工作的基本取向是否影响其流动决策知之甚少。本文区分了工作取向、职业取向和使命取向，这些取向被定义为关于工作在生活中角色的长期信念。利用荷兰LISS面板的原始调查数据，我们发现即使在控制社会人口特征、人格特质、工作特征和工作满意度后，工作取向仍是离职意向和在职求职的强预测因子。职业取向个体表现出显著更高的离职意向和求职活动，尤其在感知晋升机会有限时。使命取向个体报告的离职意向和在职求职显著较低。相比之下，工作取向与离职相关结果并无系统性关联。工作取向与一年及两年后实际离职的关联较弱，表明工作取向主要塑造离职意向和预备性求职行为，而实际工作条件对流动性的影响更强。总体而言，我们的研究将工作取向识别为离职相关行为的新颖且数量上重要的决定因素，并强调工作者潜在动机在标准经济预测因子之外对流动性塑造的作用。
10.1007/s00148-026-01176-w.title: Work orientations and turnover

10.1007/s00148-026-01177-9.title: Fertility, labor market participation, and macroeconomic dynamics
10.1007/s00148-026-01177-9.title_zh: 生育率、劳动力市场参与和宏观经济动态

10.1007/s00148-026-01178-8.abstract: This paper examines whether adverse childhood economic shocks affect fertility in adulthood. Using Finnish administrative data and plant closures during the 1991–93 recession as exogenous parental job loss, I estimate long-run effects on children’s fertility. Paternal job loss reduces sons’ probability of parenthood by age 43 by 1.7 percentage points, while maternal job loss is positively associated with sons’ fertility and accelerates daughters’ childbearing without affecting completed fertility. Paternal displacement persistently lowers sons’ education, employment, and earnings; mediation analysis suggests that these socioeconomic scarring effects explain about half of the fertility decline. The remaining effect appears to operate through non-pecuniary mechanisms, such as family stress. Maternal job loss does not affect children’s socioeconomic outcomes, pointing to non-pecuniary channels, including changes in parent–child relationships. Overall, the findings indicate that economic shocks in adolescence have lasting intergenerational consequences for demographic behavior.
10.1007/s00148-026-01178-8.abstract_zh: 本文考察了童年时期的经济冲击是否会影响成年后的生育决策。利用芬兰行政数据以及1991-1993年经济衰退期间企业倒闭作为外生性父母失业事件，本文估算了其对子女生育率的长期影响。父亲失业使儿子在43岁前成为父母的概率降低1.7个百分点，而母亲失业则与儿子生育率呈正相关，并加速女儿的生育进程，但未影响其最终生育数量。父亲失业持续降低儿子的教育水平、就业率和收入；中介分析表明，这些社会经济创伤效应解释了约一半的生育率下降。剩余效应似乎通过非金钱机制（如家庭压力）发挥作用。母亲失业不影响子女的社会经济状况，这表明其影响渠道为非金钱机制，包括亲子关系的变化。总体而言，研究结果表明，青少年时期的经济冲击对人口行为具有持久的代际影响。
10.1007/s00148-026-01178-8.title: Childhood shocks and fertility: evidence from parental job loss
10.1007/s00148-026-01178-8.title_zh: 童年冲击与生育率：来自父母失业的证据

10.1007/s00148-026-01179-7.abstract: Abstract While international knowledge transfer drives structural transformation, the diffusion of tacit knowledge—the complex skills and procedures essential for sophisticated production—remains constrained by the need for face-to-face interaction. This paper identifies outbound business travel as a distinct channel for overcoming this friction. Exploiting a panel of 113 countries (1995–2020) and a System GMM framework to address endogeneity, I document a robust positive association between business travel and economic complexity. I show that this relationship is conditional on domestic political institutions: the returns to travel are amplified in inclusive, open political environments but vanish in highly centralized systems. Furthermore, I find evidence of diminishing marginal returns, suggesting that the benefits of travel moderate as connectivity channels saturate. I conclude that inclusive institutions function as a critical “absorptive filter” mechanism, enabling the tacit knowledge acquired abroad to translate effectively into national productive capabilities.
10.1007/s00148-026-01179-7.abstract_zh: 摘要：尽管国际知识转移推动着结构性转型，但隐性知识——复杂生产所需的关键技能与流程——的传播仍受限于面对面互动的需求。本文指出，出境商务差旅是克服这一摩擦的独特渠道。基于113个国家1995-2020年的面板数据，并采用系统GMM框架处理内生性问题，本文证实商务差旅与经济复杂度之间存在稳健的正向关联。研究表明，这一关系受国内政治制度调节：在包容开放的政治环境中，差旅的回报效应被放大，但在高度集权体制下则完全消失。此外，本文发现边际回报递减的证据，表明随着连通渠道趋于饱和，差旅收益将逐步减弱。结论指出，包容性制度作为关键的"吸收过滤"机制，能够使海外获取的隐性知识有效转化为国家生产能力。
10.1007/s00148-026-01179-7.title: Business travel, institutions, and economic complexity
10.1007/s00148-026-01179-7.title_zh: 商务旅行、制度与经济复杂性

10.1007/s00148-026-01180-0.abstract: This paper examines the causal impact of cannabidiol (CBD) product availability on workplace injuries, exploiting Italy’s unintended liberalization of low-THC cannabis as a natural experiment. We use a staggered difference-in-differences approach, leveraging variation in the timing of CBD retailer entries across provinces. We find that CBD availability leads to a reduction in workplace injury rates by 2.5%, with larger effects among young and prime-age workers. Robustness checks confirm these findings, and placebo tests rule out confounding trends. These effects are stronger in provinces with higher pre-existing use of pharmaceuticals commonly prescribed for stress, anxiety, sleep disorders, and chronic therapies. We interpret this pattern as suggestive of a substitution-based channel in which CBD products may represent an additional source of pain and stress management.
10.1007/s00148-026-01180-0.abstract_zh: 本文利用意大利低THC大麻意外合法化作为自然实验，考察大麻二酚（CBD）产品可及性对工伤的因果影响。我们采用交错双重差分法，利用各省CBD零售商进入时间的差异。研究发现，CBD可及性使工伤率降低2.5%，其中对青年和壮年劳动者的影响更为显著。稳健性检验证实了上述结论，安慰剂检验排除了混杂趋势的影响。在那些此前常用于缓解压力、焦虑、睡眠障碍及慢性治疗的药物使用率较高的省份，这种效应更为突出。我们将这一模式解读为替代效应渠道的佐证，即CBD产品可能成为疼痛与压力管理的额外来源。
10.1007/s00148-026-01180-0.title: CBD at work: the impact of cannabidiol access on workplace health
10.1007/s00148-026-01180-0.title_zh: 工作中的CBD：大麻二酚获取对职场健康的影响

10.1007/s00148-026-01181-z.abstract: Using data from the German Socio-Economic Panel, we provide a comprehensive investigation of the relationship between workplace co-determination in the form of works councils and income satisfaction. Controlling for a wide range of individual, job-related, and firm-level characteristics in OLS and fixed effects specifications, we observe that employees working in establishments with a works council report significantly higher income satisfaction compared to their counterparts in non-co-determined firms. Rank in the income distribution, perceived fairness of the wage, and working conditions emerge as quantitatively relevant factors in explaining the positive correlation.
10.1007/s00148-026-01181-z.abstract_zh: 基于德国社会经济面板数据，本文全面考察了以企业职工委员会为形式的职场共同决策与收入满意度之间的关系。在控制个体、岗位及企业层面广泛特征变量的OLS与固定效应模型中，我们发现：相较于非共同决策企业，设有职工委员会企业的员工报告的收入满意度显著更高。收入分配位次、工资公平感知及工作条件是解释这一正向关联的关键量化因素。
10.1007/s00148-026-01181-z.title: Councils of contentment: works councils and income perceptions
10.1007/s00148-026-01181-z.title_zh: 满足的委员会：企业职工委员会与收入感知

10.1007/s00148-026-01182-y.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This paper contributes to the understanding of alcohol consumption in adulthood by investigating the impact of a specific life event: the transition to an empty nest, when adult children move out of the parental home. Our findings using English data show a significant increase in alcohol consumption in an empty nest, characterised by more regular drinking patterns and a moderate increase in daily intake. The most affected groups include couples, high-income individuals, those actively employed, and respondents aged 45–60. We also provide evidence on the mechanisms underlying this relationship, supporting a key role of relaxation and changes in time use.</jats:p>
10.1007/s00148-026-01182-y.abstract_zh: 本文通过研究特定生活事件——成年子女搬离父母家后的“空巢”过渡期——对成年期饮酒行为的影响，深化了对该问题的理解。基于英国数据的分析表明，空巢期饮酒量显著增加，表现为饮酒频率更趋规律，且日均摄入量适度上升。受影响最显著的群体包括夫妻、高收入者、在职人员及45-60岁受访者。本研究还揭示了这一关联的内在机制，证实放松需求与时间利用变化在其中发挥关键作用。
10.1007/s00148-026-01182-y.title: Alcohol consumption in an empty nest

10.1007/s00148-026-01183-x.title: The Foster-Greer-Thorbecke approach applied to the measurement of population aging
10.1007/s00148-026-01183-x.title_zh: 福斯特-格里尔-索尔贝克方法在人口老龄化测量中的应用

10.1007/s00148-026-01184-w.abstract: This paper examines whether traditional gender norms are associated with well-being penalties for the rising share of women who are more educated than their husbands (hypogamy). Using panel data from the Japanese Panel Survey of Consumers (JPSC) covering the period of 1993 to 2020, the results show that women in hypogamous marriages report lower life satisfaction than other married women. The negative association is less pronounced for more recent marriage cohorts, as well as for women with less traditional norms. Moreover, the association shows stronger negative well-being implications for hypogamous women whose intra-household role is not in line with norm-based expectations.
10.1007/s00148-026-01184-w.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了传统性别规范是否与日益增多的“妻强夫弱”（即妻子受教育程度高于丈夫）婚姻中女性的幸福感损失相关。基于1993年至2020年日本消费者面板调查（JPSC）的面板数据，结果显示，处于“妻强夫弱”婚姻中的女性报告的生活满意度低于其他已婚女性。这种负向关联在较晚近的婚姻队列中以及传统观念较弱的女性中不那么显著。此外，对于家庭内部角色不符合规范预期的“妻强夫弱”女性，这种关联表现出更强的负面幸福感影响。
10.1007/s00148-026-01184-w.title: Higher education, lower satisfaction: hypogamy and traditional norms in Japan
10.1007/s00148-026-01184-w.title_zh: 高等教育，更低满意度：日本的低嫁婚与传统规范

10.1007/s00148-026-01185-9.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Recent literature provides evidence of inter-generational correlation regarding gender-stereotypical behavior in the labor market. There are two potential explanations for this pattern: selection and causality. Relying on identification through second moments, we reveal a striking result among female adolescents in Germany and Australia. The apparent positive correlation between mothers and daughters is entirely driven by selection, suggesting that sticky gender norms are responsible for persistent gender segregation in the labor market. Most surprisingly, we find that causality operates in the opposite direction, suggesting that the mother holding a non-stereotypical job may have an ambiguous effect on the daughter’s occupational choice. Our findings have important implications for policymakers and identify new directions for future research. We highlight the need to investigate the mechanisms of transmission further to design policies that are successful at closing the remaining gaps. Our findings also suggest that policies designed to foster balanced gender compositions may fall short of achieving the desired inter-generational spillovers unless fundamental shifts in underlying gender norms occur.</jats:p>
10.1007/s00148-026-01185-9.abstract_zh:
<jats:title>摘要</jats:title>
<jats:p>近期文献提供了劳动力市场中性别刻板行为代际相关性的证据。这一现象存在两种可能的解释：选择效应与因果效应。基于二阶矩识别方法，我们在德国和澳大利亚的青春期女性中揭示了一个惊人结果：母女之间看似正向的相关性完全由选择效应驱动，表明僵化的性别规范是导致劳动力市场持续性别隔离的根源。最令人意外的是，我们发现因果效应呈反向作用，这意味着母亲从事非刻板职业可能对女儿的职业选择产生模糊影响。这一发现对政策制定者具有重要启示，并为未来研究指明了新方向。我们强调需进一步探究传递机制，以设计能有效弥合现存差距的政策。研究结果同时表明，除非根本性的性别规范发生转变，否则旨在促进性别平衡构成的政策可能难以实现预期的代际溢出效应。</jats:p>
10.1007/s00148-026-01185-9.title: Daughters like mothers? New evidence of inter-generational transmission of labor market stereotypical behavior
10.1007/s00148-026-01185-9.title_zh: 女儿像母亲？劳动力市场刻板行为代际传递的新证据

10.1007/s00148-026-01186-8.abstract: Exploiting cohort and spatial variation in exposure to India’s Universal Immunization Program (UIP), I estimate the program’s effects on child mortality and educational attainment. The results show that UIP exposure reduced infant mortality by 0.4 percentage points and under-five mortality by 0.5 percentage points. While the program clearly improved child survival, its effects on educational outcomes were mixed, reflecting changes in the composition of surviving children. UIP exposure reduced primary school completion but increased secondary school completion. The negative effect at lower levels of schooling may reflect lower average health among marginal surviving children or a quantity–quality trade-off arising from unanticipated improvements in child survival. In contrast, the positive effect on secondary schooling may reflect improved health and human capital among children further from the margin of survival.
10.1007/s00148-026-01186-8.abstract_zh: 利用印度全民免疫计划（UIP）覆盖率的队列与空间差异，本文评估了该计划对儿童死亡率及教育成就的影响。结果显示，UIP覆盖使婴儿死亡率降低0.4个百分点，五岁以下儿童死亡率降低0.5个百分点。尽管该计划显著改善了儿童存活率，但对教育成果的影响呈现分化特征，这反映了存活儿童群体构成的变化。UIP覆盖降低了小学完成率，但提高了中学完成率。较低教育阶段的负面效应可能源于边际存活儿童的平均健康水平下降，或儿童存活率意外提升引发的数量-质量权衡。相比之下，中学教育阶段的正面效应则可能反映了远离存活临界点的儿童健康水平与人力资本的改善。
10.1007/s00148-026-01186-8.title: The effects of childhood immunization programs on health and education: micro-evidence from India
10.1007/s00148-026-01186-8.title_zh: 儿童免疫计划对健康和教育的影响：来自印度的微观证据

10.1007/s00148-026-01187-7.abstract: The U.S. Department of Health and Human Services has urged a coordinated “public health approach” to combatting bullying in schools, in part due to concerns that bullying victimization causes teens to turn to risky behaviors as a coping mechanism. This study provides new evidence on the effect of anti-bullying laws (ABLs) on youth risky health behaviors. Using data from the Youth Risk Behavior Surveys and a generalized difference-in-differences approach, we find little evidence that ABL adoption leads to statistically significant or economically meaningful reductions in binge drinking, tobacco use, marijuana use, risky sex, or body weight for the average teenager. However, for some historically marginalized youth—particularly those who identify as lesbian, gay, bisexual, or questioning—we find some evidence of ABL-induced improvements in behavioral health, especially with respect to binge drinking. This finding is consistent with disproportionate ABL health gains for queer youth.
10.1007/s00148-026-01187-7.abstract_zh: 美国卫生与公众服务部呼吁采取协调一致的“公共卫生方法”来应对校园欺凌问题，部分原因是担心遭受欺凌会导致青少年将高风险行为作为应对机制。本研究为反欺凌法对青少年高风险健康行为的影响提供了新证据。基于青少年风险行为调查数据及广义双重差分法，我们发现几乎没有证据表明反欺凌法的实施会导致普通青少年在暴饮、吸烟、大麻使用、危险性行为或体重方面出现统计显著或经济意义上的显著减少。然而，对于部分历史上处于边缘地位的青少年——尤其是那些自认为女同性恋、男同性恋、双性恋或性取向不确定的青少年——我们发现一些证据表明反欺凌法改善了其行为健康，特别是在暴饮方面。这一发现与反欺凌法对性少数青少年健康收益不成比例的现象一致。
10.1007/s00148-026-01187-7.title: Anti-bullying laws and youth risky health behaviors
10.1007/s00148-026-01187-7.title_zh: 反欺凌法律与青少年危险健康行为

10.1007/s00148-026-01188-6.abstract: We investigate the impact of gender composition on team performance in a real-world setting using a large-scale survey conducted within Chinese firms. We study the performance of two-person interviewer teams, with gender composition randomly assigned, tasked with complex survey data collection. Our analysis shows that two-female teams outperform both mixed-gender and two-male teams in interview completion and refusal-based questionnaire quality. Specifically, assignment to an all-female team increases the likelihood of completing an interview by 2.4%, and reduces refusals to answer key questions by 5%. This performance difference is likely driven by improved task coordination and a more favorable communication environment in all-female teams. This leads to increased effort input and ultimately enhances team effectiveness.
10.1007/s00148-026-01188-6.abstract_zh: 我们利用在中国企业内部开展的大规模调查，在真实情境中探究性别构成对团队绩效的影响。研究对象为随机分配性别组合的两人访谈员团队，其任务为完成复杂的调查数据采集工作。分析表明，全女性团队在访谈完成率和基于拒答的问卷质量方面均优于混合性别团队及全男性团队。具体而言，被分配至全女性团队可使访谈完成概率提升2.4%，并将关键问题拒答率降低5%。这一绩效差异很可能源于全女性团队中任务协调的改善与更有利的沟通环境，进而促使团队成员投入更多努力，最终提升团队效能。
10.1007/s00148-026-01188-6.title: “Girls with girls”: gender composition and team performance in survey data collection
10.1007/s00148-026-01188-6.title_zh: 女孩与女孩”：性别构成与调查数据采集中的团队绩效

10.1007/s00148-026-01189-5.abstract: Age at first birth has increased over time, which is likely to create many benefits in the labour market. Applying a number of alternative estimation approaches to administrative data from Austria, we estimate small to moderate effects of delaying motherhood on earnings, employment, and attachment to pre-birth firms in the medium run. However, even the largest of these effects are small relative to the average age effects, implying that delay leads to only small changes in child penalties. Much of the career return to later first birth comes from delaying the child penalty rather than changing how careers respond to children.
10.1007/s00148-026-01189-5.abstract_zh: 初育年龄随时间推移而上升，这很可能在劳动力市场中带来诸多益处。通过运用多种替代性估计方法对奥地利行政数据进行分析，我们发现在中期内，推迟生育对女性收入、就业状况及与产前企业的依附关系仅产生较小至中等程度的影响。然而，即便这些影响中最为显著的效应，相较于平均年龄效应而言仍显微弱，这意味着推迟生育仅能小幅改变育儿惩罚。推迟初育带来的职业回报，主要源于育儿惩罚的延迟而非职业发展对育儿行为反应的改变。
10.1007/s00148-026-01189-5.title: Motherhood timing and the child penalty
10.1007/s00148-026-01189-5.title_zh: 母亲生育时机与子女惩罚

10.1007/s00148-026-01190-y.abstract: Children who start school at a younger age are more likely to receive pharmacological treatment for attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD). This pattern is widely attributed to peer-comparison biases, but the relative importance of different underlying mechanisms remains debated. We use administrative data from England to study how school starting age affects ADHD prescription rates from ages 5 to 15. Exploiting a sharp school-entry cutoff and comparing children born just before and after September 1, we estimate both age- and grade-specific effects of early school entry. We find that early starters are 40–50% more likely to be treated for ADHD by age 15. This long-term gap is entirely driven by first-time prescriptions among children aged 5 to 8. Using a novel decomposition strategy, we isolate the roles of relative age, absolute age, the length of school exposure, and age at school entry. We find that relative age is the primary long-term driver, aligning with previous evidence on peer-comparison bias, while absolute age and the length of school exposure have only short-lived effects. Our findings suggest that early starters are more likely to receive marginal diagnoses due to their relative immaturity, and we recommend refining diagnostic guidelines and classroom grouping practices to reduce diagnostic gaps.
10.1007/s00148-026-01190-y.abstract_zh: 入学年龄较小的儿童更可能因注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）接受药物治疗。这一现象被广泛归因于同伴比较偏差，但不同潜在机制的重要性仍存争议。我们利用英格兰行政数据，研究入学年龄如何影响5至15岁儿童的ADHD处方率。通过利用严格的入学年龄截止日期，并比较9月1日前后的出生儿童，我们估算了早期入学对年龄和年级的特定影响。研究发现，早期入学儿童在15岁时接受ADHD治疗的可能性高出40%-50%。这一长期差距完全由5至8岁儿童的首次处方驱动。采用新的分解策略，我们分离了相对年龄、绝对年龄、在校时长及入学年龄的作用。结果表明，相对年龄是主要的长期驱动因素，与先前关于同伴比较偏差的证据一致，而绝对年龄和在校时长仅产生短期效应。我们的发现表明，早期入学儿童因相对不成熟更易获得边缘性诊断，并建议完善诊断指南和课堂分组实践以减少诊断差距。
10.1007/s00148-026-01190-y.title: Why are the youngest in class more often prescribed pharmacological treatment for ADHD?
10.1007/s00148-026-01190-y.title_zh: 为何班级中最年幼的学生更常被开具ADHD药物治疗？

10.1007/s00182-025-00954-2.title: Bertrand competition with one-sided cost uncertainty
10.1007/s00182-025-00954-2.title_zh: 单边成本不确定下的伯特兰竞争

10.1007/s00182-026-00984-4.title: A note on the Diversity Owen value
10.1007/s00182-026-00984-4.title_zh: 关于多样性Owen值的一个注记

10.1007/s00182-026-00992-4.title: Deadline credibility and trade efficiency
10.1007/s00182-026-00992-4.title_zh: 截止日期可信度与贸易效率

10.1007/s00182-026-00995-1.abstract: We conducted an online Dictator Game experiment ( N = 1195) to test three hypotheses about the role of monetary incentives in prosocial behavior. First, we examined whether real incentives of £1 reduce the dispersion of responses compared to hypothetical ones. Surprisingly, we found the opposite: hypothetical responses were less dispersed, with choices clustering around the egalitarian split. This pattern held in a replication ( N = 308) with higher stakes (£5), offering no support for the first hypothesis. Second, we tested whether real incentives—by involving actual monetary consequences—lead to more selfish decisions, as they are expected to reduce socially desirable responses. With £1 stakes, no significant differences emerged across conditions. However, when the stake was increased to £5, participants became more selfish under real incentives, supporting the second hypothesis only when the amount at stake is substantial. Third, we explored whether probabilistic payments trigger differential behavior. At low stakes, probabilistic incentives resembled real ones. But with higher stakes, real and probabilistic outcomes diverged, suggesting participants respond to expected value only when it is meaningful. Finally, in a separate study ( N = 299), we found that many participants facing standard hypothetical-payment instructions still expected real payments. Only explicit phrasing stating that “unfortunately, the money is not real” alleviated this confusion. This result underscores the importance of precise wording in experimental design and potentially explains why hypothetical treatments do not yield dramatically different results compared to real-money treatments.
10.1007/s00182-026-00995-1.abstract_zh: 我们开展了一项在线独裁者博弈实验（样本量N=1195），以检验关于货币激励在亲社会行为中作用的三个假设。首先，我们考察了与假设性激励相比，1英镑的真实激励是否会降低反应离散度。令人意外的是，我们发现了相反的结果：假设性情境下的反应离散度更低，选择集中在平等主义分配方案附近。这一模式在更高赌注（5英镑）的重复实验（样本量N=308）中得以保持，因此第一个假设未获支持。其次，我们检验了真实激励——通过涉及实际货币后果——是否会导致更自私的决策，因为预期这会减少社会期望性反应。在1英镑赌注下，各条件之间未出现显著差异。然而，当赌注增至5英镑时，参与者在真实激励下变得更加自私，这仅在赌注金额较大时支持了第二个假设。第三，我们探讨了概率性支付是否会引发差异化行为。在低赌注下，概率性激励与真实激励相似。但在高赌注下，真实与概率性结果出现分化，表明参与者仅在有意义的预期价值下才会做出反应。最后，在另一项独立研究（样本量N=299）中，我们发现许多面对标准假设性支付说明的参与者仍预期会获得真实支付。只有明确表述“遗憾的是，这笔钱并非真实”才能缓解这种混淆。这一结果凸显了实验设计中措辞精确的重要性，并可能解释为何假设性处理与真实货币处理相比不会产生显著不同的结果。
10.1007/s00182-026-00995-1.title: Paying £1(£5) or nothing in dictator games: unexpected differences
10.1007/s00182-026-00995-1.title_zh: 独裁者游戏中支付1英镑（5英镑）与不支付：意料之外的差异

10.1007/s00182-026-00996-0.abstract: Processes of bargaining are studied in which the players reach interim agreements that serve as status quo points for further bargaining. This is modeled in Nash’s setup of bargaining problems, where the solution is a time parameterized path of interim agreements rather than a single point. We characterize path solutions for linear problems that satisfy the axioms of restarting and covariance , and show that if a Pareto efficient agreement is not reached immediately, then it is never reached in finite time. Adding the axioms of individual rationality , relevance , and monotonicity , we characterize the family of continuous Raiffa solutions and show that these solutions converge to a Pareto efficient agreement but never reach it in finite time. Finally, if a deadline is added to the bargaining problem, and the speed of bargaining is proportionally inverse to the deadline, then a Pareto efficient agreement is reached exactly at the deadline.
10.1007/s00182-026-00996-0.abstract_zh: 本文研究了谈判过程中各方达成临时协议的过程，这些临时协议作为进一步谈判的现状点。该过程在纳什谈判问题框架下建模，其解是一条以时间为参数的临时协议路径，而非单一协议点。我们刻画了满足重启公理和协方差公理的线性问题的路径解，并证明若帕累托有效协议未立即达成，则有限时间内永远无法达成。通过引入个体理性、相关性和单调性公理，我们刻画了连续Raiffa解族，并证明这些解收敛于帕累托有效协议，但有限时间内无法达成。最后，若在谈判问题中加入截止期限，且谈判速度与截止期限成反比，则帕累托有效协议恰好在截止期限时达成。
10.1007/s00182-026-00996-0.title: Interim agreements

10.1007/s00182-026-00997-z.abstract: Dilmé (Internat J Game Theory 53:673 2024) shows that an assessment is Kreps-Wilson (1982) consistent if and only if it is the limit of a particularly simple kind of sequence of strictly mixed strategies—which Dilmé calls a “power sequence”—and its associated sequence of Bayes-rule induced beliefs. We use Farkas’ lemma to provide a brief and simple proof of Dilmé’s result.
10.1007/s00182-026-00997-z.abstract_zh: 迪尔梅（《国际博弈论杂志》第53卷，第673页，2024年）证明，一个评估是克雷普斯-威尔逊（1982）一致的，当且仅当它是某种特别简单的严格混合策略序列——迪尔梅称之为“幂序列”——及其关联的贝叶斯规则诱导信念序列的极限。我们利用法卡斯引理，为迪尔梅的这一结果提供了一个简洁而简单的证明。
10.1007/s00182-026-00997-z.title: A simple proof of the sufficiency of Dilmé’s power-sequence test for Kreps-Wilson consistency
10.1007/s00182-026-00997-z.title_zh: 迪尔梅权力序列检验对克雷普斯-威尔逊一致性的充分性的一个简单证明

10.1007/s00182-026-00998-y.title: Language Constraints in Multi-Sender Communication Games
10.1007/s00182-026-00998-y.title_zh: 多发送者通信博弈中的语言约束

10.1007/s00182-026-01000-5.title: A stable and strategy-proof controlled school choice mechanism with integrated and flexible rules
10.1007/s00182-026-01000-5.title_zh: 集成灵活规则的稳定且防策略的可控学校选择机制

10.1007/s00182-026-01002-3.abstract: This paper presents an evolutionary model of patriotism. The state interacts with a population of citizens who may differ in their levels of patriotism, reflecting how much they care about the state. Citizens’ patriotism is subject to evolutionary pressure in the long run. Under complete information, if the state’s payoff function exhibits strategic complementarity, patriotism can emerge through evolution. In the presence of incomplete information, however, patriotism fails to thrive. Despite this, if citizens can costlessly disclose their levels of patriotism to the state in a truthful but potentially imprecise manner, full information revelation can be achieved under certain monotonicity conditions—one of which can be derived from the supermodularity of the interaction between the state and citizens—thus allowing patriotism to evolve in a manner similar to the complete information case.
10.1007/s00182-026-01002-3.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个关于爱国主义的演化模型。国家与一群公民互动，这些公民的爱国主义程度可能不同，反映了他们对国家的关心程度。公民的爱国主义在长期中受到演化压力的影响。在完全信息条件下，如果国家的收益函数表现出策略互补性，爱国主义可以通过演化过程产生。然而，在不完全信息条件下，爱国主义无法蓬勃发展。尽管如此，如果公民能够以真实但可能不精确的方式，无成本地向国家披露其爱国主义程度，则在某些单调性条件下——其中一种条件可源于国家与公民之间互动的超模性——可以实现完全信息揭示，从而使爱国主义得以在类似于完全信息的情形下演化。
10.1007/s00182-026-01002-3.title: The evolution of patriotism

10.1007/s00182-026-01003-2.abstract: We introduce Multiplicative Modular Nim (MuM), a variant of Nim in which the traditional nim-sum is replaced by heap-size multiplication modulo m. We establish a complete theory for this game, beginning with a direct, Bouton-style analysis for prime moduli. Our central result is an analogue of the Sprague-Grundy theorem, where we define a game-theoretic value, the mumber, for each position via a multiplicative mex recursion. We prove that these mumbers are equivalent to the heap-product modulo m, and show that multiplicative composition of MuM positions is governed by modular multiplication, in contrast to classical Nim where composition is governed by XOR (nim-sum). For composite moduli, we show that MuM decomposes via the Chinese Remainder Theorem into independent subgames corresponding to its prime-power factors. We extend the game to finite fields \documentclass[12pt]{minimal} \usepackage{amsmath} \usepackage{wasysym} \usepackage{amsfonts} \usepackage{amssymb} \usepackage{amsbsy} \usepackage{mathrsfs} \usepackage{upgreek} \setlength{\oddsidemargin}{-69pt} \begin{document}$$\mathbb {F}(p^n)$$\end{document}, motivated by the pedagogical need to make the algebra of the AES S-box more accessible. We demonstrate that a sound game in this domain requires an integer heap model with synonym-move exclusion to resolve the many-to-one mapping from integer heaps to field elements. To our knowledge, this is the first systematic analysis of a multiplicative modular variant of Nim and its extension into a complete, non-additive combinatorial game algebra.
10.1007/s00182-026-01003-2.abstract_zh: 我们引入乘法模尼姆游戏（MuM），这是尼姆游戏的一个变体，其中传统的尼姆和被堆大小模m的乘法所取代。我们为该游戏建立了完整的理论，首先对素数模数进行了直接的、类似布顿风格的分析。我们的核心结果是斯普拉格-格伦迪定理的类比，其中我们通过乘法mex递归为每个局面定义了一个博弈论值——mumber。我们证明这些mumber等价于堆乘积模m，并表明MuM局面的乘法组合由模乘法支配，这与经典尼姆中由异或（尼姆和）支配的组合形成对比。对于合数模数，我们证明MuM可通过中国剩余定理分解为对应于其素数幂因子的独立子游戏。受使AES S盒的代数更易于理解的教学需求驱动，我们将该游戏扩展到有限域\documentclass[12pt]{minimal} \usepackage{amsmath} \usepackage{wasysym} \usepackage{amsfonts} \usepackage{amssymb} \usepackage{amsbsy} \usepackage{mathrsfs} \usepackage{upgreek} \setlength{\oddsidemargin}{-69pt} \begin{document}$$\mathbb {F}(p^n)$$\end{document}。我们证明，在该域中构建合理的游戏需要采用整数堆模型并排除同义词移动，以解决从整数堆到域元素的多对一映射问题。据我们所知，这是首次对尼姆的乘法模变体及其扩展为完整非加性组合博弈代数进行的系统分析。
10.1007/s00182-026-01003-2.title: Multiplicative Modular Nim (MuM)

10.1007/s00182-026-01004-1.abstract: In cooperative games with transferable utility (TU-games), a player’s contribution may vary depending on the coalition they join, reflecting different levels of synergy with other members. In this paper, we introduce a family of axioms referred to as sub-game order preservation axioms , which formalize the intuition that a player’s payoff should increase with the degree of synergy they exhibit within a coalition. We propose four distinct axioms, each of which captures a different interpretation of what constitutes synergy in the context of TU-games. We demonstrate that one of these variants is incompatible with the classical Efficiency axiom, thereby giving rise to an impossibility result. The remaining three axioms, when combined with Efficiency, lead to unique characterizations of three well-known solution concepts: the Shapley value, the Center of the imputation set (CIS), and the Equal allocation of non-separable contributions (ENSC) value, respectively.
10.1007/s00182-026-01004-1.abstract_zh: 在具有可转移效用的合作博弈（TU博弈）中，参与者的贡献可能因其加入的联盟不同而有所变化，这反映了与其他成员之间不同程度的协同效应。本文引入了一组公理，称为子博弈序保持公理，这些公理形式化了参与者的收益应随其在联盟中展现的协同程度增加而提高的直觉。我们提出了四个不同的公理，每个公理都捕捉了TU博弈背景下协同概念的不同解释。我们证明，其中一个变体与经典的效率公理不相容，从而产生了一个不可能性结果。其余三个公理在与效率公理结合时，分别导致了对三个著名解概念的独特刻画：沙普利值、分配集中心（CIS）以及不可分离贡献的均等分配（ENSC）值。
10.1007/s00182-026-01004-1.title: Sub-game order preservation and values for TU-games
10.1007/s00182-026-01004-1.title_zh: 子博弈序保持与TU博弈的值

10.1007/s00182-026-01005-0.abstract: In this paper, we develop a dynamic model of moral preferences in repeated public goods games on networks. We incorporate informational nudges and derive conditions for convergence of behavior and optimal targeting of policies. Importantly, the long-term impact of moral nudges on preferences and behavior depends on how preferences evolve. When preferences include a component of persistent intrinsic morality, the effect of a moral nudge dissipates over time. Conversely, if social preferences continuously evolve, influenced by recent periods and present experiences, the potential for long-lasting effects of behavioral interventions becomes more promising. We also discuss heterogeneous adaptation, which improves the model’s predictive power for laboratory public-goods experiments. With the framework constructed in this paper, outcomes in experimental, field and natural experiments can be evaluated to further understand what drives individual decision making.
10.1007/s00182-026-01005-0.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个网络重复公共品博弈中的道德偏好动态模型。我们引入信息助推，推导出行为收敛与政策最优靶向的条件。重要的是，道德助推对偏好与行为的长期影响取决于偏好的演化方式。当偏好包含持久内在道德成分时，道德助推的效果会随时间消散。相反，若社会偏好持续演化，受近期阶段与当前经验影响，行为干预产生持久效应的可能性将更为乐观。我们还讨论了异质性适应问题，这提升了模型对实验室公共品实验的预测能力。借助本文构建的分析框架，可评估实验、实地实验与自然实验的结果，从而进一步理解个体决策的驱动因素。
10.1007/s00182-026-01005-0.title: Long-term morality effects of behavioral interventions in networks
10.1007/s00182-026-01005-0.title_zh: 网络中行为干预的长期道德效应

10.1007/s00199-026-01714-3.abstract: In a coordination game with multiple Pareto ordered equilibria and population uncertainty, we show that group size helps select a unique equilibrium, for reasons reminiscent of the global games literature. A critical mass phenomenon emerges at equilibrium. Group size has an emboldening effect on participants.
10.1007/s00199-026-01714-3.abstract_zh: 在具有多个帕累托排序均衡和人口不确定性的协调博弈中，我们证明群体规模有助于选择唯一均衡，其原因与全球博弈文献中的观点相似。均衡中出现了一个关键多数现象。群体规模对参与者具有鼓舞效应。

10.1007/s00199-026-01715-2.abstract: We formulate three sets of axioms to measure inequality of opportunity. First, the basic axioms that any relative measure should satisfy. Second, axioms that capture the ex ante perspective, focusing on inequality between individuals with different circumstances. Third, axioms that capture the ex post perspective, focusing on inequality among individuals with the same responsibility characteristics. Based on these axioms, we characterize the ex ante and ex post classes of inequality of opportunity measures. We also discuss how well existing measures in the literature adhere to the axioms.
10.1007/s00199-026-01715-2.abstract_zh: 我们构建了三组公理来度量机会不平等。第一组是任何相对度量方法均应满足的基本公理。第二组公理捕捉事前视角，聚焦于不同环境禀赋个体之间的不平等。第三组公理捕捉事后视角，聚焦于具有相同责任特征个体之间的不平等。基于这些公理，我们刻画了事前与事后两类机会不平等度量方法。同时，本文还探讨了现有文献中的度量方法对这些公理的遵循程度。
10.1007/s00199-026-01715-2.title: An axiomatic approach to the measurement of inequality of opportunity
10.1007/s00199-026-01715-2.title_zh: 机会不平等测度的公理化方法

10.1007/s00199-026-01716-1.abstract: This paper develops a dynamic game-theoretic framework to analyze security competition between two states that can invest in a technology to eliminate their rival.
