Extending the canonical one-shot game, our model incorporates a negotiation (settlement) stage and assumes effective diplomacy, which rules out payoff-dominated equilibria. We fully characterize equilibrium behavior across all discount factors and compare outcomes under high and low elimination costs. The dynamic structure reveals why, even with optimal coordination, long-lasting disarmed peace is rare. By combining the dynamics of military escalation with the constraints of effective diplomacy, the model rationalizes historical cycles of peace, arms races, and conflict. Our approach identifies strategic mechanisms that restrict the sustainability of disarmament and clarifies the conditions under which arms races or conflict become inevitable, offering a deeper understanding of the recurrent nature of international conflict under repeated interaction.
10.1007/s00199-026-01716-1.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个动态博弈理论框架，用于分析两个国家在投资消除对手技术时的安全竞争。在经典单次博弈的基础上，我们的模型引入了谈判（和解）阶段，并假设有效外交排除了收益占优均衡。我们全面刻画了所有折现因子下的均衡行为，并比较了高消除成本与低消除成本下的结果。动态结构揭示了为何即使在最优协调下，持久的非武装和平也极为罕见。通过将军事升级的动态过程与有效外交的约束相结合，该模型合理化了和平、军备竞赛与冲突的历史循环。我们的方法识别出限制裁军可持续性的战略机制，并阐明了军备竞赛或冲突不可避免的条件，从而在重复互动背景下为理解国际冲突的反复性提供了更深刻的洞见。
10.1007/s00199-026-01716-1.title: The elusive quest for disarmed peace: contest games and international relations
10.1007/s00199-026-01716-1.title_zh: 寻求解除武装和平的艰难探索：竞争博弈与国际关系

10.1007/s00199-026-01717-0.abstract: We study an agency model with two independent projects each of which is owned by a principal. Under exclusive agency, each principal uses a different agent, whereas under common agency, all principals use the same agent. A project’s outcome depends on the agent’s hidden effort. We show that, even in the absence of physical linkages between the projects, a principal benefits from providing information on her project outcome to the other principal under common agency (rather than benefiting from receiving the information ), whereas no such benefits arise under exclusive agency. That is, under common agency, an information sharing principal can take advantage of the other principal’s using the shared information. As a result, sharing information becomes each principal’s dominant strategy, provided that the other principal uses the shared information in a Pareto-optimal way. We show that using a common agent is optimal when information can be shared.
10.1007/s00199-026-01717-0.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个包含两个独立项目的委托代理模型，每个项目由一位委托人所有。在独家代理模式下，每位委托人雇佣不同的代理人；而在共同代理模式下，所有委托人雇佣同一代理人。项目的产出取决于代理人的隐性努力。研究表明，即使项目之间不存在物理关联，在共同代理模式下，委托人通过向另一位委托人提供自身项目结果的信息（而非接收信息）能够获益，而这种收益在独家代理模式下并不存在。也就是说，在共同代理模式下，共享信息的委托人可以利用另一位委托人对共享信息的使用。因此，只要另一位委托人以帕累托最优方式使用共享信息，信息共享将成为每位委托人的占优策略。我们证明，当信息可以共享时，使用共同代理人是最优选择。
10.1007/s00199-026-01717-0.title: Information alliance in common agency
10.1007/s00199-026-01717-0.title_zh: 共同代理中的信息联盟

10.1007/s00199-026-01718-z.title: How do sectoral compositions affect the impact of FTAs on global tariff liberalization?
10.1007/s00199-026-01718-z.title_zh: 部门构成如何影响自由贸易协定对全球关税自由化的作用？

10.1007/s00199-026-01719-y.title: A Multivariate distribution with Pareto tails and Pareto maxima
10.1007/s00199-026-01719-y.title_zh: 具有帕累托尾部和帕累托最大值的多元分布

10.1007/s00199-026-01720-5.abstract: We build a model of policymaking under the threat of unrest. A policymaker chooses how much effort to spend on a public good; effort is unobservable and the outcome conditional on effort is uncertain. A group of citizens protest if the outcome falls short of a reference point; the reference point is determined endogenously by expectations about the outcome and by the intensity of emotions. We show that the effects of stronger emotional reactions on policymaker’s effort and the probability of protest are nonmonotonic and depend on the group’s ability to inflict damage. Equilibrium may require the policymaker to randomize between providing some effort or no effort at all, in order to temper citizens’ expectations, in which case strong emotional reactions are counterproductive. Optimal emotional reactions are fine-tuned to minimize the probability of protest.
10.1007/s00199-026-01720-5.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个在骚乱威胁下的政策制定模型。政策制定者需决定投入多少精力用于公共品供给；其努力程度不可观测，且努力所对应的结果具有不确定性。当公共品供给结果低于某个参照点时，公民群体便会发起抗议；该参照点由对结果的预期及情绪强度内生决定。研究表明，情绪反应的增强对政策制定者努力程度及抗议概率的影响呈非单调性，且取决于群体造成损害的能力。均衡状态下，政策制定者可能需要在"付出一定努力"与"完全不努力"之间进行随机化选择，以调节公民预期——此时强烈的情绪反应反而适得其反。最优情绪反应需精准调校，以最小化抗议发生的概率。
10.1007/s00199-026-01720-5.title: Why Do People Protest? A Theory of Emotions, Public Policy, and Political Unrest
10.1007/s00199-026-01720-5.title_zh: 人们为何抗议？情绪、公共政策与政治动荡的理论

10.1007/s00199-026-01722-3.abstract: We study the effect of prudence on optimal prevention in two periods with Kreps and Porteus (1978) and Selden (1978) (KPS) preferences. We use consumption smoothing as the benchmark and consider risk-averse decision-makers. In this framework, prudence has a positive effect on prevention, generalizing findings of Menegatti (2009). We extend this result to risk lovers and comparative risk aversion. When saving is endogenized, the preference over the timing of uncertainty resolution becomes irrelevant for prevention, and only the curvature of marginal utility matters. This result allows us to identify a class of decision-makers who are prudent in the KPS model but whose prevention effort coincides with that of a risk-neutral agent. Our findings highlight that the structure of intertemporal preferences critically shapes the link between prudence and prevention.
10.1007/s00199-026-01722-3.abstract_zh: 本文研究在Kreps与Porteus（1978）及Selden（1978）（KPS）偏好框架下，审慎性对两期最优预防行为的影响。以消费平滑为基准，我们考察风险厌恶型决策者。在此框架中，审慎性对预防行为具有正向促进作用，从而推广了Menegatti（2009）的研究结论。我们将该结论拓展至风险偏好型决策者及比较风险厌恶情形。当储蓄内生化时，不确定性解决的时间偏好对预防行为不再具有影响，仅边际效用曲率发挥作用。这一发现使我们能够识别出KPS模型中具有审慎性、但其预防努力水平与风险中性主体一致的决策者群体。研究结果凸显跨期偏好结构对审慎性与预防行为关联性的关键塑造作用。
10.1007/s00199-026-01722-3.title: Disentangling risk and time for optimal prevention
10.1007/s00199-026-01722-3.title_zh: 分离风险与时间以实现最优预防

10.1007/s00199-026-01723-2.abstract: We introduce a new, powerful, and easy-to-use solution concept called simple forward induction which is implied by strategic stability in generic finite multi-sender signaling games. We apply this concept to infinite monotonic signaling games and show that a unique simple forward induction outcome exists and is non-distorted by asymmetric information. We also show that, in this class of games, the non-distorted outcome is the limit of stable outcomes of finite games. Hence, in this sense, we characterize stable outcomes in this class of games. The definition of our solution concept can be easily extended to arbitrary extensive-form games.
10.1007/s00199-026-01723-2.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新颖、强大且易于使用的解概念，称为简单前向归纳法，该概念在一般有限多发送者信号博弈中由策略稳定性所蕴含。我们将这一概念应用于无限单调信号博弈，并证明存在唯一的简单前向归纳结果，且该结果不受信息不对称的扭曲。我们还证明，在此类博弈中，非扭曲结果是有限博弈稳定结果的极限。因此，在此意义上，我们刻画了此类博弈中的稳定结果。我们的解概念定义可轻松推广至任意扩展式博弈。
10.1007/s00199-026-01723-2.title: Simple forward induction in monotonic multi-sender signaling games
10.1007/s00199-026-01723-2.title_zh: 单调多发送者信号博弈中的简单前向归纳

10.1007/s00199-026-01724-1.abstract: Berge equilibrium offers an alternative to Nash equilibrium in game theory, emphasizing cooperative stability rather than individual optimization. Despite recent interest, a systematic study of Berge equilibria in finite normal form games is still lacking, with fundamental questions like existence remaining open. This paper characterizes Berge equilibria through a polynomial system of equations, enabling computational algebra and algebraic geometry methods to analyze them. Algorithms based on Gröbner bases determine the existence and computation of Berge equilibria. Furthermore, we show that the set of games admitting completely mixed Berge equilibria is contained within a determinantal variety, whose dimension we explicitly bound from above.
10.1007/s00199-026-01724-1.abstract_zh: 伯格均衡为博弈论中的纳什均衡提供了一种替代方案，强调合作稳定性而非个体最优化。尽管近期研究兴趣渐增，但有限正规型博弈中伯格均衡的系统性研究仍显不足，诸如存在性等基本问题尚未解决。本文通过多项式方程组刻画伯格均衡，从而能够运用计算代数和代数几何方法对其进行分析。基于格罗布纳基的算法可判定伯格均衡的存在性并实现其计算。此外，我们证明存在完全混合伯格均衡的博弈集合包含于某一行列式簇中，并给出了该簇维数的显式上界。
10.1007/s00199-026-01724-1.title: Berge equilibria – an algebraic approach
10.1007/s00199-026-01724-1.title_zh: 伯格均衡——一种代数方法

10.1007/s00199-026-01725-0.title: Optimal sender ordering in sequential persuasion
10.1007/s00199-026-01725-0.title_zh: 序列说服中的最优发送者排序

10.1007/s00199-026-01726-z.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    This paper develops a tractable model of wishful thinking that captures both the benefits and costs of optimistic biased beliefs and the behaviors they induce. Building on Bratcha and Brown (2012) and Caplin and Leahy (2019), we propose a two-stage framework in which a decision maker selects actions and belief structures under uncertainty, balancing subjective utility against the cost of departing from prior beliefs. The cost is formalized using a
                    <jats:inline-formula>
                      <jats:alternatives>
                        <jats:tex-math>$$\phi $$</jats:tex-math>
                        <mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
                          <mml:mi>ϕ</mml:mi>
                        </mml:math>
                      </jats:alternatives>
                    </jats:inline-formula>
                    -divergence–based belief distortion function, encompassing measures such as Kullback–Leibler, reverse Kullback-Leibler, and Pearson
                    <jats:inline-formula>
                      <jats:alternatives>
                        <jats:tex-math>$$\chi ^2$$</jats:tex-math>
                        <mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
                          <mml:msup>
                            <mml:mi>χ</mml:mi>
                            <mml:mn>2</mml:mn>
                          </mml:msup>
                        </mml:math>
                      </jats:alternatives>
                    </jats:inline-formula>
                    distances. Our contributions are threefold: (i) we characterize optimal beliefs, showing they twist prior probabilities toward high-utility states across a broad class of divergences; (ii) we link WT behavior to risk-seeking actions via convex risk measures; and (iii) we introduce cognitive censoring and cognitive emergence, capturing extreme beliefs. Methodologically, the model provides new insights into how optimistic beliefs reshape decision-making, extending the theoretical foundations of WT and opening avenues for future research.
                  </jats:p>
10.1007/s00199-026-01726-z.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个易于处理的愿望思维模型，同时捕捉了乐观偏差信念及其所引发行为的收益与成本。在Bratcha与Brown（2012）以及Caplin与Leahy（2019）的研究基础上，我们提出了一个两阶段框架：决策者在不确定性下选择行动与信念结构，在主观效用与偏离先验信念的成本之间进行权衡。该成本通过基于ϕ-散度的信念扭曲函数形式化，涵盖Kullback-Leibler散度、逆Kullback-Leibler散度以及Pearson χ²距离等度量。我们的贡献有三方面：（i）刻画了最优信念的特征，表明在广泛的散度类别中，最优信念会将先验概率向高效用状态扭曲；（ii）通过凸风险度量将愿望思维行为与风险寻求行动联系起来；（iii）引入认知审查与认知涌现概念，捕捉极端信念。在方法论上，该模型为乐观信念如何重塑决策提供了新见解，拓展了愿望思维的理论基础，并为未来研究开辟了方向。
10.1007/s00199-026-01726-z.title: Wishful thinking is risky thinking
10.1007/s00199-026-01726-z.title_zh: 一厢情愿是冒险的思维

10.1007/s00199-026-01727-y.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    We derive conditions for individual choices and
                    <jats:inline-formula>
                      <jats:alternatives>
                        <jats:tex-math>$$ \epsilon $$</jats:tex-math>
                        <mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
                          <mml:mi>ϵ</mml:mi>
                        </mml:math>
                      </jats:alternatives>
                    </jats:inline-formula>
                    -equilibrium prices to be inferred from a finite set of market data in the following sense: Although potential observations are infinite, inference can be attained and known to have been attained after a finite number of observations. While we first examine the case of observations on an individual’s demand at different prices and incomes, our primary focus is on equilibrium, where only profiles of individual endowments and associated equilibrium prices are observable. Our main result is that finite inference is possible in the equilibrium setting if one wants to infer either individual choices or the
                    <jats:inline-formula>
                      <jats:alternatives>
                        <jats:tex-math>$$ \epsilon $$</jats:tex-math>
                        <mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
                          <mml:mi>ϵ</mml:mi>
                        </mml:math>
                      </jats:alternatives>
                    </jats:inline-formula>
                    -equilibrium correspondence.
                  </jats:p>
10.1007/s00199-026-01727-y.abstract_zh: 我们推导了从有限市场数据推断个体选择与ε-均衡价格的条件，其含义如下：尽管潜在观测数据是无限的，但推断可以在有限次观测后实现，且可被确知已实现。我们首先考察不同价格与收入下个体需求的观测情形，但主要关注均衡状态——此时仅能观测到个体禀赋分布及其对应的均衡价格。主要结论是：若需推断个体选择或ε-均衡对应关系，则在均衡设定下有限推断是可行的。
10.1007/s00199-026-01727-y.title: Exact inference from finite market data
10.1007/s00199-026-01727-y.title_zh: 有限市场数据的精确推断

10.1007/s00199-026-01728-x.title: Silence speaks volumes: dynamic cheap talk over a static issue
10.1007/s00199-026-01728-x.title_zh: 沉默胜千言：静态议题上的动态廉价交谈

10.1007/s00199-026-01729-w.title: Dynamic complementarities and multiple equilibria in open economies with collateral constraints
10.1007/s00199-026-01729-w.title_zh: 抵押约束下开放经济体的动态互补性与多重均衡

10.1007/s00199-026-01732-1.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We analyze competition in service markets with unit demand prone to adverse selection, such as secured lending and car insurance markets. Incumbent firms learn their customers’ types over time and can price discriminate accordingly. We prove existence of a unique set of mixed strategy equilibria where firms randomize prices over a bounded continuous support. Incumbents earn positive rents. Increased competition through firm entry does not benefit customers if firms know portfolio compositions of competitors. If firms only possess information regarding the aggregate industry client composition, horizontal mergers may reduce industry rents, a finding with implications for competition policy in information-intensive industries.</jats:p>
10.1007/s00199-026-01732-1.abstract_zh: 摘要：本文分析了存在逆向选择风险的单元需求服务市场中的竞争问题，例如担保贷款和汽车保险市场。在位企业会随时间推移了解客户类型，并据此实施价格歧视。我们证明存在一组唯一的混合策略均衡，其中企业在有界连续支撑集上随机定价。在位企业可获得正租金。若企业知晓竞争对手的资产组合构成，则通过企业进入加剧竞争并不会使客户受益。若企业仅掌握行业整体客户构成的汇总信息，横向并购可能降低行业租金——这一发现对信息密集型行业的竞争政策具有启示意义。
10.1007/s00199-026-01732-1.title: Competition on service markets with unit demand and learning
10.1007/s00199-026-01732-1.title_zh: 单位需求与学习效应下的服务市场竞争

10.1007/s00199-026-01733-0.title: Credit and inventories in illiquid housing markets
10.1007/s00199-026-01733-0.title_zh: 流动性不足的住房市场中的信贷与库存

10.1007/s00199-026-01734-z.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    In many expert–decision maker settings, information is richer than the language used to convey it. Motivated by this communication friction, we study Bayesian persuasion when the sender is constrained to use
                    <jats:italic>k</jats:italic>
                    messages. We show that the sender’s value is given by a
                    <jats:italic>k</jats:italic>
                    -point analogue of concavification, which we call
                    <jats:italic>k</jats:italic>
                    -concavification. An optimal information structure can be chosen with affinely independent posterior support, allowing the problem to be reduced to a lower-dimensional persuasion problem and then solved by standard concavification. We derive a tight bound on the value of communication capacity that applies to general persuasion games: the gain from a
                    <jats:inline-formula>
                      <jats:alternatives>
                        <jats:tex-math>$$(k+1)$$</jats:tex-math>
                        <mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
                          <mml:mrow>
                            <mml:mo>(</mml:mo>
                            <mml:mi>k</mml:mi>
                            <mml:mo>+</mml:mo>
                            <mml:mn>1</mml:mn>
                            <mml:mo>)</mml:mo>
                          </mml:mrow>
                        </mml:math>
                      </jats:alternatives>
                    </jats:inline-formula>
                    <jats:sup>st</jats:sup>
                    message is at most
                    <jats:inline-formula>
                      <jats:alternatives>
                        <jats:tex-math>$$2/(k-1)$$</jats:tex-math>
                        <mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
                          <mml:mrow>
                            <mml:mn>2</mml:mn>
                            <mml:mo>/</mml:mo>
                            <mml:mo>(</mml:mo>
                            <mml:mi>k</mml:mi>
                            <mml:mo>-</mml:mo>
                            <mml:mn>1</mml:mn>
                            <mml:mo>)</mml:mo>
                          </mml:mrow>
                        </mml:math>
                      </jats:alternatives>
                    </jats:inline-formula>
                    times the value attainable with
                    <jats:italic>k</jats:italic>
                    messages. Finally, we solve a class of belief-threshold games in which the receiver chooses between a safe default and several risky actions, the sender gets zero from the default and the same positive payoff from any risky action, and a risky action is taken only when the corresponding posterior probability exceeds a threshold. We characterize the optimal coarse information structure, derive comparative statics in the prior and the threshold, and extend the analysis to heterogeneous thresholds and heterogeneous sender values across risky actions.
                  </jats:p>
10.1007/s00199-026-01734-z.abstract_zh: 在许多专家与决策者互动的场景中，信息本身比用于传递信息的语言更为丰富。受这种沟通摩擦的启发，我们研究了当发送者被限制只能使用k条信息时的贝叶斯说服问题。我们证明，发送者的价值由k点版本的凹化（称为k-凹化）给出。通过选择仿射独立的后验支撑，可以构建最优信息结构，从而将问题简化为低维说服问题，并通过标准凹化方法求解。我们推导出适用于一般说服博弈的沟通能力价值的紧界：从第(k+1)条信息中获得的增益最多为使用k条信息时可实现价值的2/(k-1)倍。最后，我们求解了一类信念阈值博弈：接收者在安全默认选项与多个风险行动之间进行选择，发送者从默认选项中获得零收益，从任何风险行动中获得相同的正收益，且仅当相应的后验概率超过阈值时才采取风险行动。我们刻画了最优粗糙信息结构，推导了关于先验和阈值的比较静态分析，并将分析扩展到风险行动具有异质性阈值和异质性发送者价值的情形。
10.1007/s00199-026-01734-z.title: Persuasion with Coarse Communication

10.1007/s00199-026-01735-y.abstract: We study the symmetric volunteer’s dilemma with binary actions and cost sharing, where the volunteering cost is split equally among volunteers. In the one-shot game, all pure-strategy Nash equilibria involve a single volunteer, while Pareto optimality allows any non-zero number. In the infinitely repeated game, all Pareto optima can be sustained in a subgame-perfect Nash equilibrium based on a grim-trigger strategy: trivially under undiscounted payoffs, and provided the discount factor exceeds a threshold under discounted payoffs. This threshold is non-monotonic in the number of volunteers; it is zero with one volunteer, highest with two, and decreases with both more volunteers beyond two and more players. Thus, the scope for tacit cooperation is universal with one volunteer, minimal with two, then improving as more join in, all the way to universal again only in the limit with more and more players and volunteers. Considering efficiency, scope for cooperation and equity/focality as criteria, the grand coalition of volunteers emerges as the best cooperation scenario.
10.1007/s00199-026-01735-y.abstract_zh: 我们研究了具有二元行动和成本分担的对称志愿者困境，其中志愿者成本由所有志愿者平均分担。在一次性博弈中，所有纯策略纳什均衡都只涉及一名志愿者，而帕累托最优则允许任意非零数量的志愿者。在无限重复博弈中，所有帕累托最优状态都可以通过基于冷酷触发策略的子博弈完美纳什均衡得以维持：在无折现收益下显然成立，而在有折现收益下，需满足折现因子超过某一阈值。该阈值随志愿者数量呈非单调变化：当只有一名志愿者时为零，两名志愿者时最高，随后随着志愿者数量超过两人以及玩家数量增加而下降。因此，隐性合作的范围在只有一名志愿者时具有普遍性，在两名志愿者时最小，随着更多人加入而改善，直到在玩家和志愿者数量趋于极限时再次达到普遍性。综合考虑效率、合作范围以及公平性/焦点性等标准，志愿者的大联盟成为最佳合作情景。
10.1007/s00199-026-01735-y.title: On the repeated volunteer’s dilemma with equal cost sharing
10.1007/s00199-026-01735-y.title_zh: 关于成本均摊下的重复志愿者困境

10.1007/s00199-026-01736-x.title: Costly Bayesian optimism
10.1007/s00199-026-01736-x.title_zh: 昂贵的贝叶斯乐观主义

10.1007/s00199-026-01737-w.title: Bayesian Coalitional Rationality in Games: An Informational Foundation
10.1007/s00199-026-01737-w.title_zh: 博弈中的贝叶斯联盟理性：一个信息基础

10.1007/s00199-026-01739-8.abstract: This paper proposes a non-cooperative game of network formation in which creating access to the network – for oneself and others – is a public good. Link formation therefore reflects a trade-off between the social value of links and their private cost. The paper characterizes the architecture of strict Nash networks. Strict Nash equilibria are either flat or hierarchical. Flat equilibria consist of a wheel (i.e., a directed cycle) that may or may not encompass all agents. Hierarchical equilibria are trees in which some agents act as intermediaries between otherwise disconnected groups. When the cost of link formation is sufficiently low, the exhaustive wheel is the unique equilibrium architecture and best-response dynamics converge to it with probability one. For intermediate costs, multiple equilibrium architectures coexist and can be Pareto-ranked: the exhaustive wheels dominate the non-exhaustive ones and the empty network, and trees dominate the empty network.
10.1007/s00199-026-01739-8.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种网络形成的非合作博弈模型，在该模型中，为自己及他人创建网络接入具有公共品属性。因此，链接形成反映了链接的社会价值与其私人成本之间的权衡。本文刻画了严格纳什网络的架构特征。严格纳什均衡要么是扁平结构，要么是层级结构。扁平均衡由轮状结构（即有向环）构成，该结构可能包含所有参与者，也可能不包含。层级均衡则呈现树状结构，其中部分参与者充当原本互不相连群体之间的中介。当链接形成成本足够低时，全覆盖轮状结构是唯一的均衡架构，且最优反应动态以概率1收敛于此结构。在中等成本条件下，多种均衡架构并存且可进行帕累托排序：全覆盖轮状结构优于非全覆盖轮状结构及空网络，而树状结构优于空网络。
10.1007/s00199-026-01739-8.title: Endogenous network formation with diffusion incentives
10.1007/s00199-026-01739-8.title_zh: 具有扩散激励的内生网络形成

10.1007/s00355-026-01655-9.abstract: We provide the first asymptotic analysis of the Boston Mechanism under equilibrium play in random markets. We provide two results. First, while 63% of students receive their first preference under truthful reporting–outperforming any other known mechanism in the literature–this rate converges to zero in any Nash equilibrium of the corresponding preference revelation game as the market size grows. Second, we show there exists a Nash equilibrium where the average student receives a dramatically inferior assignment: in markets with 1,000 students, the average placement shifts from the 7th choice (under truthfulness) to the 145th choice, representing a change from logarithmic to nearly linear average rank.
10.1007/s00355-026-01655-9.abstract_zh: 我们首次对随机市场中均衡行为下的波士顿机制进行了渐近分析。我们提供了两项结果。第一，尽管在真实报告下，63%的学生能获得其首选偏好——这一比例超越了文献中任何其他已知机制——但在相应的偏好揭示博弈中，随着市场规模扩大，这一比例在任何纳什均衡下都趋近于零。第二，我们证明存在一个纳什均衡，其中平均学生获得的分配结果显著恶化：在拥有1000名学生的市场中，平均分配位置从第7选择（在真实报告下）移至第145选择，这标志着平均排名从对数级转变为近乎线性级。

10.1007/s00355-026-01663-9.title: Formation of teams in contests: tradeoffs between inter- and intra-team inequalities
10.1007/s00355-026-01663-9.title_zh: 竞赛中团队的形成：团队间与团队内不平等之间的权衡

10.1007/s00355-026-01665-7.title: Do grades have absolute meaning? An experiment on majority judgment
10.1007/s00355-026-01665-7.title_zh: 成绩具有绝对意义吗？多数判断实验

10.1007/s00355-026-01666-6.abstract: We study the problem of aggregating individual preferences into a collective ranking without ties (a linear order) over a finite set of alternatives. We introduce a framework that constructs such rankings from supermajority rules, defined by a threshold parameter $$\alpha \in \left[ 1/2,1\right) $$ . For each $$\alpha $$ , we consider the binary relation of defeats from pairwise comparisons and apply two closure operations—the transitive closure and the Suzumura-consistent closure—to eliminate cycles. We then study the sets of linear orders that respect these relations; that is, linear orders that preserve all strict defeats while extending them to a complete ranking. To avoid the arbitrariness of fixing a single $$\alpha $$ , we take the intersection across all $$\alpha $$ . This yields two sets of linear orders: the T-order set (from the transitive closure) and the S-order set (from the Suzumura-consistent closure), both always nonempty, the former is a subset of the latter, and jointly capturing the full spectrum of supermajority rules. We show that this perspective unifies prominent methods: the Schulze method coincides with the T-order set, the Split Cycle method with the S-order set, and every outcome of the Ranked Pairs method lies within the S-order set. Moreover, every linear order in the S-order set satisfies the extended Condorcet criterion and the strong Pareto principle. Our results thus place these methods within a common supermajority-based framework and clarify their relationships.
10.1007/s00355-026-01666-6.abstract_zh: 本文研究如何将个体偏好聚合为有限备选方案集合上的无并列集体排序（线性序）。我们提出一个基于超多数规则构建此类排序的框架，该规则由阈值参数 $$\alpha \in \left[ 1/2,1\right) $$ 定义。对于每个 $$\alpha $$，我们考虑两两比较中产生的击败二元关系，并应用两种闭包运算——传递闭包和铃村一致闭包——以消除循环。随后，我们研究尊重这些关系的线性序集合；即，在保留所有严格击败关系的同时将其扩展为完整排序的线性序。为避免固定单一 $$\alpha $$ 的任意性，我们取所有 $$\alpha $$ 的交集。由此得到两组线性序：T-序集（来自传递闭包）和S-序集（来自铃村一致闭包），两者均非空，前者为后者的子集，且共同涵盖超多数规则的完整谱系。我们证明，这一视角统一了多种主流方法：Schulze方法等同于T-序集，Split Cycle方法等同于S-序集，而Ranked Pairs方法的每个结果均属于S-序集。此外，S-序集中的每个线性序均满足扩展的孔多塞准则与强帕累托原则。因此，我们的研究将这些方法置于统一的超多数规则框架下，并厘清了它们之间的关联。
10.1007/s00355-026-01666-6.title: Respecting linear orders for supermajority rules
10.1007/s00355-026-01666-6.title_zh: 尊重超多数规则下的线性顺序

10.1007/s00355-026-01667-5.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We use laboratory experiments to analyze decentralized decision-making in one-sided matching markets. We find that subjects tend to make decisions in line with most theoretical models, as their offering and accepting decisions are mainly guided by the objective of improving upon the status quo. In consequence, markets move towards satisfying blocking pairs making the number of remaining blocking pairs diminish and the aggregate payoffs increase over time. Overall, the theoretical solutions of absorbing sets and stable matchings to the roommate problem are supported by the experimental results. However, not all matchings in an absorbing set have the same power of attraction in the experimental laboratory. The theoretical property of P-stability refines absorbing sets as predictors of final outcomes.</jats:p>
10.1007/s00355-026-01667-5.abstract_zh:
<jats:title>摘要</jats:title>
<jats:p>我们通过实验室实验分析单边匹配市场中的分散决策。研究发现，受试者的决策行为与多数理论模型一致，其出价与接受决策主要受改善现状目标的引导。因此，市场会朝着满足阻塞对的方向演进，使得剩余阻塞对数量随时间递减，总收益逐步提升。总体而言，室友问题中吸收集与稳定匹配的理论解得到了实验结果的支撑。然而，在实验室环境中，吸收集内的不同匹配并不具有同等的吸引力。理论上的P稳定性性质能够进一步精炼吸收集作为最终结果的预测指标。</jats:p>
10.1007/s00355-026-01667-5.title: Experimental results on the roommate problem

10.1007/s00355-026-01668-4.title: On the ordinal Bayesian incentive compatibility of vote share and veto share rules
10.1007/s00355-026-01668-4.title_zh: 关于投票份额与否决份额规则的序数贝叶斯激励相容性

10.1007/s00355-026-01670-w.abstract: In the spatial model of voting, the yolk and LP (linear programming) yolk are important solution concepts for predicting outcomes for a committee of voters. McKelvey and Tovey showed that the LP yolk provides a lower bound approximation for the size of the yolk and there has been considerable debate on whether the LP yolk is a good approximation of the yolk. The problem was partially resolved for arbitrarily large committees (as the number of voters goes to infinity) but remains open when there are few voters, which is standard for most committees. In this paper, we show that for an odd number of voters in a two-dimensional space, the yolk radius is at most twice the size of the LP yolk radius and we show that this bound is tight—there exists a family of instances where the LP yolk radius will differ from the yolk radius by a factor arbitrarily close to 2. We also show that (1) even in this setting, the LP yolk center can be arbitrarily far away from the yolk center (relative to the radius of the yolk) and (2) for all other settings (an even number of voters or in dimension k \ge 3), the LP yolk can be arbitrarily small relative to the yolk. Thus, in general, the LP yolk can be an arbitrarily poor approximation of the yolk.
10.1007/s00355-026-01670-w.abstract_zh: 在空间投票模型中，蛋黄（yolk）与线性规划蛋黄（LP yolk）是预测委员会投票结果的重要解概念。McKelvey与Tovey证明线性规划蛋黄为蛋黄规模提供了下界近似，但关于线性规划蛋黄能否有效近似蛋黄的问题一直存在激烈争论。该问题在委员会规模趋于无穷大时已得到部分解决，但在标准委员会常见的少量投票者情形下仍悬而未决。本文证明：在二维空间中奇数投票者情形下，蛋黄半径至多为线性规划蛋黄半径的两倍，且该上界是紧的——存在实例族使得线性规划蛋黄半径与蛋黄半径的比值可任意趋近于2。我们同时证明：（1）即便在此设定下，线性规划蛋黄中心与蛋黄中心的距离（相对于蛋黄半径）可任意大；（2）在其他所有设定中（偶数投票者或维度k≥3），线性规划蛋黄相对于蛋黄可任意小。因此，一般而言，线性规划蛋黄对蛋黄的近似效果可能极差。
10.1007/s00355-026-01670-w.title: On the approximability of the yolk by the LP yolk in the spatial model of voting
10.1007/s00355-026-01670-w.title_zh: 空间投票模型中蛋黄由线性规划蛋黄逼近的可近似性

10.1007/s00355-026-01671-9.abstract: Tournaments are well studied objects in economic theory. Copeland (1951 A reasonable social welfare function. Tech. rep., Mimeo, University of Michigan USA")) provides an intuitive way to select alternatives from a tournament, the Copeland set . As a tournament solution, the Copeland set possesses many desirable properties and has been widely studied. Rubinstein (1980 Ranking the participants in a tournament. SIAM J Appl Math 38:108–111")) axiomatizes a method to rank alternatives from a tournament which is based on their Copeland scores . This paper analyzes the Copeland set from a revealed preference perspective. A choice procedure where a decision maker has a fixed underlying tournament and selects the Copeland set from every menu is behaviorally characterized.
10.1007/s00355-026-01671-9.abstract_zh: 锦标赛是经济理论中研究较为深入的对象。Copeland（1951，《一种合理的社会福利函数》，技术报告，密歇根大学，美国）提出了一种从锦标赛中筛选备选方案的直观方法，即Copeland集。作为一种锦标赛解概念，Copeland集具备诸多理想性质，并得到了广泛研究。Rubinstein（1980，《锦标赛参与者排序方法》，《SIAM应用数学杂志》第38卷，第108–111页）基于Copeland得分公理化了锦标赛备选方案的排序方法。本文从显示偏好视角分析Copeland集。研究对一种选择程序进行了行为特征刻画：在该程序中，决策者拥有固定的潜在锦标赛结构，并从每个备选菜单中选取Copeland集。
10.1007/s00355-026-01671-9.title: Copeland choice rules

10.1007/s00355-026-01672-8.title: On verifiable cheap talk and social welfare
10.1007/s00355-026-01672-8.title_zh: 关于可验证廉价谈话与社会福利

10.1007/s10058-025-00386-0.abstract: How can we assess the diversity of a group of decision makers? Identifying decision makers with their preferences, we address this question by applying the multi-attribute approach developed by Nehring and Puppe (2002) to sets of preferences. Specifically, we provide a repertoire of alternative models to measure the diversity of sets of preferences. The proposed models are purely ordinal and are characterized in terms of the different properties that a preference order need to satisfy in order to contribute to the diversity of a given set of preference orderings.
10.1007/s10058-025-00386-0.abstract_zh: 如何评估一组决策者的多样性？通过将决策者与其偏好相对应，我们运用Nehring和Puppe（2002）发展的多属性方法来解决这一问题，并将其应用于偏好集合。具体而言，我们提供了一系列替代模型来衡量偏好集合的多样性。所提出的模型纯属序数性质，并通过偏好序需满足的不同属性来刻画，这些属性决定了偏好序对给定偏好序集合多样性的贡献。

10.1007/s10058-026-00398-4.abstract: A variation of a cheap talk game is considered in which the preferences of a special interest group conflict with those of a policymaker if she is benevolent; however, she may be corrupt. The interest group, which knows the state of the world, sends a message to the policymaker and may also exert costly lobbying effort for its preferred policy to be adopted. We show that expected welfare, which is the same in all PBE, is decreasing in the probability that the policymaker is corrupt. Surprisingly, it decreases faster when this probability is above one-half, suggesting that corrupt behavior will be tolerated only up to a certain level.
10.1007/s10058-026-00398-4.abstract_zh: 本文考虑了一种廉价交谈博弈的变体，其中特殊利益集团的偏好与政策制定者（若其廉洁）的偏好相冲突；然而，该政策制定者可能腐败。利益集团知晓世界状态，向政策制定者发送信息，并可能为其偏好的政策被采纳而付出代价高昂的游说努力。我们表明，在所有完美贝叶斯均衡（PBE）中相同的预期福利，随政策制定者腐败概率的增加而递减。令人惊讶的是，当这一概率超过二分之一时，福利下降得更快，这表明腐败行为仅在达到一定水平之前才会被容忍。

10.1007/s10058-026-00399-3.abstract: Cooperative game theory has proposed different notions of powerful players. For example, big-boss games (Muto et al. 1988) and clan games (Potters et al. 1989) are particular cases of veto games (Bahel 2016). The present paper extends these veto games by assuming that there is a given subset of powerful (or essential) players, but only a few (as opposed to all) essential players are required for a coalition to have a positive group value. The resulting games, which are called r -essential games, encompass convex games (Shapley 1971) and veto games. We show that r -essential games have a nonempty core. We give a recursive description of the core. Moreover, it is shown that the core and the bargaining set are equivalent for r -essential games. An application to networks is provided.
10.1007/s10058-026-00399-3.abstract_zh: 合作博弈理论提出了不同形式的强参与者概念。例如，大老板博弈（Muto等，1988）和宗族博弈（Potters等，1989）是否决博弈（Bahel，2016）的特例。本文通过假设存在一个给定的强（或关键）参与者子集，但联盟只需少数（而非全部）关键参与者即可产生正群体价值，从而扩展了这些否决博弈。由此产生的博弈被称为r-关键博弈，它涵盖了凸博弈（Shapley，1971）和否决博弈。我们证明r-关键博弈具有非空核，并给出了核的递归描述。此外，研究表明对于r-关键博弈，核与议价集是等价的。本文还提供了在网络中的应用。
10.1007/s10058-026-00399-3.title: Essentiality of degree r in cooperative games with transferable utility
10.1007/s10058-026-00399-3.title_zh: 可转移效用合作博弈中程度r的必要性

10.1007/s10058-026-00400-z.title: Tournament auctions with a strong limit bidder
10.1007/s10058-026-00400-z.title_zh: 强限制竞标者参与的锦标赛拍卖

10.1007/s10058-026-00401-y.abstract: In multi-winner elections, the goal is to select a pre-given size committee of members from a given set of candidates. We define the concept of T-power of a majority-group of voters (Total majority-power or Total tyranny-power) as the ability of the group to guarantee, under a given voting rule, that all the committee members belong to its favorite candidates, regardless of the preferences of the other voters. In this case, we say also that such a voting rule is exposed to T-power. This situation can be considered extreme and worrying in democracy. In this paper, we examine the T-power under classes of multi-winner scoring rules. We focus on some common rules, and it turns out that BLOC rule ( k - k -Approval) is totally exposed to T-power, that is, any majority-group of any size has T-power under this rule. On the other hand, CCR, k -Plurality and k -Inverse-Plurality rules are almost notexposed to it, that is, no majority of any size has T-power. These last rules may provide some protection for minority groups in the sense of preventing T-power.
10.1007/s10058-026-00401-y.abstract_zh: 在多赢家选举中，目标是从给定候选人集合中选出预先设定规模的委员会成员。我们定义多数选民群体的T-权力（总多数权力或总暴政权力）为：在给定投票规则下，该群体能够确保所有委员会成员均来自其偏好的候选人，而无论其他选民的偏好如何。在此情况下，我们也称该投票规则暴露于T-权力之下。这种情形在民主制度中可被视为极端且令人担忧。本文研究了多赢家计分规则类别下的T-权力。我们聚焦于若干常见规则，发现BLOC规则（k-k-批准制）完全暴露于T-权力，即任何规模的多数群体在此规则下均拥有T-权力。另一方面，CCR、k-复数制与k-逆复数制规则几乎不暴露于T-权力，即任何规模的多数群体均不拥有T-权力。这些规则在防止T-权力意义上可能为少数群体提供一定保护。
10.1007/s10058-026-00401-y.title: The T-power of a majority under multi-winner scoring rules
10.1007/s10058-026-00401-y.title_zh: 多数在多胜者计分规则下的T权力

                      </jats:alternatives>
                    </jats:inline-formula>
                    ,
                    <jats:inline-formula>
                      <jats:alternatives>
                        <jats:tex-math>$$\varvec{m}$$</jats:tex-math>
                        <mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
                          <mml:mrow>
                            <mml:mi>m</mml:mi>
                          </mml:mrow>
                        </mml:math>
                      </jats:alternatives>
                    </jats:inline-formula>
                    ,
                    <jats:inline-formula>
                      <jats:alternatives>
                        <jats:tex-math>$$\varvec{k}$$</jats:tex-math>
                        <mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
                          <mml:mrow>
                            <mml:mi>k</mml:mi>
                          </mml:mrow>
                        </mml:math>
                      </jats:alternatives>
                    </jats:inline-formula>
                    are the number of voters, the number of candidates and the committee size, respectively); we show that a simple tweak improves the time complexity to
                    <jats:inline-formula>
                      <jats:alternatives>
                        <jats:tex-math>$$\varvec{O(nmk)}$$</jats:tex-math>
                        <mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
                          <mml:mrow>
                            <mml:mi>O</mml:mi>
                            <mml:mo>(</mml:mo>
                            <mml:mi>n</mml:mi>
                            <mml:mi>m</mml:mi>
                            <mml:mi>k</mml:mi>
                            <mml:mo>)</mml:mo>
                          </mml:mrow>
                        </mml:math>
                      </jats:alternatives>
                    </jats:inline-formula>
                    . We then improve this bound even further by reducing our problem to the
                    <jats:inline-formula>
                      <jats:alternatives>
                        <jats:tex-math>$$\varvec{k}$$</jats:tex-math>
                        <mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
                          <mml:mrow>
                            <mml:mi>k</mml:mi>
                          </mml:mrow>
                        </mml:math>
                      </jats:alternatives>
                    </jats:inline-formula>
                    -link path problem for complete DAGs with Monge-concave weights, obtaining an
                    <jats:inline-formula>
                      <jats:alternatives>
                        <jats:tex-math>$$\varvec{O(n}^{\varvec{1 + o(1)}}\varvec{m})$$</jats:tex-math>
                        <mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
                          <mml:mrow>
                            <mml:msup>
                              <mml:mrow>
                                <mml:mi>O</mml:mi>
                                <mml:mo>(</mml:mo>
                                <mml:mi>n</mml:mi>
                              </mml:mrow>
                              <mml:mrow>
                                <mml:mn>1</mml:mn>
                                <mml:mo>+</mml:mo>
                                <mml:mi>o</mml:mi>
                                <mml:mo>(</mml:mo>
                                <mml:mn>1</mml:mn>
                                <mml:mo>)</mml:mo>
                              </mml:mrow>
                            </mml:msup>
                            <mml:mrow>
                              <mml:mrow>
                                <mml:mi>m</mml:mi>
                              </mml:mrow>
                              <mml:mo>)</mml:mo>
                            </mml:mrow>
                          </mml:mrow>
                        </mml:math>
                      </jats:alternatives>
                    </jats:inline-formula>
                    algorithm for arbitrary misrepresentation functions and a nearly linear algorithm for the Borda misrepresentation function. For trees, we point out an issue with the algorithm proposed by Clearwater et al. (2015), and develop an
                    <jats:inline-formula>
                      <jats:alternatives>
                        <jats:tex-math>$$\varvec{O(nmk)}$$</jats:tex-math>
                        <mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
                          <mml:mrow>
                            <mml:mi>O</mml:mi>
                            <mml:mo>(</mml:mo>
                            <mml:mi>n</mml:mi>
                            <mml:mi>m</mml:mi>
                            <mml:mi>k</mml:mi>
                            <mml:mo>)</mml:mo>
                          </mml:mrow>
                        </mml:math>
                      </jats:alternatives>
                    </jats:inline-formula>
                    algorithm for this case as well. For grids, we formulate a conjecture about the structure of optimal solutions, and describe a polynomial-time algorithm that finds a winning committee if this conjecture is true; we also explain how to convert this algorithm into a bicriterial approximation algorithm whose correctness does not depend on the conjecture.
                  </jats:p>
10.1007/s10058-026-00402-x.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在选民偏好满足直线单交叉性，或更一般地，满足中位数图（这类图包括树和网格等）上的单交叉性时，在Chamberlin–Courant投票规则下确定获胜委员会的复杂性。对于直线情形，Skowron等人（2015）描述了一个O(n²mk)算法（其中n、m、k分别表示选民数、候选人数和委员会规模）；我们证明一个简单的改进可将时间复杂度提升至O(nmk)。随后，我们通过将问题归约为具有Monge-凹权重的完全有向无环图的k-链路路径问题，进一步改进了这一界，从而对任意失真函数获得了O(n^{1+o(1)}m)算法，并对Borda失真函数获得了近乎线性的算法。对于树形结构，我们指出了Clearwater等人（2015）提出的算法中存在的问题，并针对该情形同样开发了一个O(nmk)算法。对于网格结构，我们提出了一个关于最优解结构的猜想，并描述了一个在该猜想成立时能找出获胜委员会的多项式时间算法；同时，我们解释了如何将该算法转化为一个正确性不依赖于该猜想的双准则近似算法。
10.1007/s10058-026-00402-x.title: Proportional representation under single-crossing preferences revisited
10.1007/s10058-026-00402-x.title_zh: 单交叉偏好下的比例代表制再探讨

10.1007/s10640-026-01080-7.abstract: We study the impact of a policy mix, consisting of an emissions tax and an R&D subsidy on both abatement technology improvement (R&D) and technology adoption. In an upstream industry with market power (monopoly or duopoly) an improved abatement technology is developed for polluting downstream firms that are subject to the aforementioned policy mix. These firms can adopt the new technology, which has different value for each firm, leading to product differentiation. First, we study the optimal policy, which includes output subsidies. Next, we examine second-best policy mixes, such as emission taxes and R&D expenditure subsidies, for different market forms. We identify novel aspects of these policy mixes. For instance, in a monopoly, the optimal second-best policy must account for the intra-marginal benefits of adopting firms. In a duopoly, the policy mix must also address strategic under- or overinvestment by upstream technology developers.
10.1007/s10640-026-01080-7.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一种政策组合的影响，该组合包括排放税和研发补贴，旨在促进减排技术的改进（研发）及其采纳。在一个具有市场力量（垄断或双头垄断）的上游行业中，为受上述政策组合约束的污染型下游企业开发了改进的减排技术。这些企业可以采纳新技术，而该技术对每家企业具有不同的价值，从而导致产品差异化。首先，我们研究了包含产出补贴的最优政策。接着，我们考察了不同市场形态下的次优政策组合，如排放税和研发支出补贴。我们识别出这些政策组合的新颖方面。例如，在垄断情况下，最优次优政策必须考虑采纳企业的边际内收益。在双头垄断情况下，政策组合还必须应对上游技术开发者的策略性投资不足或过度投资问题。

10.1007/s10640-026-01085-2.abstract: We examine the timing of timber harvesting, when neighboring forest stands interact through windthrow risk. Positive adjacency externality stems from the sheltering effect of tall trees whereas negative externality stems from a windthrow-prone border created by clear felling or wind damage. We model wind damages as catastrophic, which call for immediate salvage harvest and regeneration. We augment previous optimal rotation results by extending the analysis to a dynamic harvest policy, where harvest age depends on the age of the neighboring stand. We examine both an efficient equilibrium and an inefficient noncooperative Markov perfect equilibrium. In the efficient equilibrium, where the externality is internalized, harvest is delayed when the neighboring stand is mature. This delay provides shelter by postponing harvest-created border risks. In the noncooperative equilibrium, the shelter is not provided, yet the harvest age adapts to increased risk-levels due to the border effect. We numerically test the magnitude of the border effect under various model assumptions and find that pricing the carbon externality makes the harvest policy more responsive to the adjacency externality.
10.1007/s10640-026-01085-2.abstract_zh: 本文研究了相邻林分因风倒风险相互作用时，木材采伐时机的选择问题。正向邻接外部性源于高大树木的庇护效应，而负向外部性则源于皆伐或风灾造成的易风倒边界。我们将风灾建模为灾难性事件，要求立即进行救伐和更新。通过将分析扩展至动态采伐政策（其中采伐林龄取决于相邻林分的林龄），我们完善了以往的最优轮伐期研究。我们同时考察了有效均衡和低效的非合作马尔可夫完美均衡。在外部性内部化的有效均衡中，当相邻林分成熟时，采伐会被推迟。这种延迟通过推迟采伐造成的边界风险来提供庇护。在非合作均衡中，庇护效应缺失，但采伐林龄会因边界效应导致的风险水平上升而调整。我们通过数值模拟检验了不同模型假设下边界效应的规模，发现对碳外部性定价会使采伐政策对邻接外部性更加敏感。
10.1007/s10640-026-01085-2.title: Adjacency Externality and the Timing of Timber Harvesting – The Case of Windthrow Risk
10.1007/s10640-026-01085-2.title_zh: 邻接外部性与木材采伐时机——以风倒风险为例

10.1007/s10640-026-01086-1.title: Harnessing Social Information to Improve Public Support for Pigouvian Taxes
10.1007/s10640-026-01086-1.title_zh: 利用社会信息提升公众对庇古税的支持

10.1007/s10640-026-01088-z.abstract: Residential energy use is a major contributor to total energy consumption and CO 2 emissions, and energy costs can take up high shares of household spending. In this context, we make three contributions to the literature. First, using a discrete choice experiment with 1,389 prospective homebuyers in Sweden, we investigate how homebuyers account for energy efficiency of buildings compared to other attributes when looking for a new home. Second, we elicit forecasts from a sample of 252 realtors whom we ask to predict homebuyers’ preferences, allowing us to shed light on the role these important mediators play regarding energy efficiency in the housing market. Third, we estimate how providing prior information on homebuyers’ choices affects realtors’ forecasting accuracy. For homebuyers, we find that energy efficiency ranks low overall. Realtors’ forecasting accuracy is lower for the energy efficiency attribute. Providing realtors with more prior information has sizeable positive effects on forecasting accuracy, and information also affects self-reported difficulty of and confidence in the forecasts.
10.1007/s10640-026-01088-z.abstract_zh: 住宅能源使用是总能源消耗和二氧化碳排放的主要来源，能源成本在家庭支出中占据较高比例。在此背景下，我们为相关文献做出三项贡献。首先，通过对瑞典1389名潜在购房者进行离散选择实验，我们研究了购房者在寻找新住房时如何权衡建筑能效与其他属性。其次，我们收集了252名房地产经纪人的预测样本，要求他们预测购房者的偏好，从而揭示这些重要中介在住房市场能效方面所扮演的角色。第三，我们评估了向房地产经纪人提供购房者选择的先验信息对其预测准确性的影响。研究发现，购房者对能效属性的整体重视程度较低。房地产经纪人对能效属性的预测准确性也较低。向房地产经纪人提供更多先验信息能显著提升预测准确性，同时信息还会影响其自我报告的预测难度和信心水平。
10.1007/s10640-026-01088-z.title: Realtor Forecasting Accuracy on Homebuyer Preferences for Energy Efficiency
10.1007/s10640-026-01088-z.title_zh: 房地产经纪人关于购房者能效偏好预测的准确性

10.1007/s10640-026-01089-y.abstract: This paper argues that military buildups lead to a significant rise in greenhouse gas emissions and can disrupt the green transition. Identifying military spending shocks, I use local projections to show that a percentage point rise in the military spending share leads to a 0.9–2% rise in total emissions, as well as a 1% rise in emission intensity, depending on the economy’s overall emission intensity. Using a dynamic production network model calibrated for the US, I find that a permanent shock of the same size would increase total emissions by between 0.25% and 1.38%, and emission intensity by between 0.12% and 1.06%. The empirical analysis tentatively suggests that green patenting may be reduced by 10–25% following such a shock, and the model suggests that investment in renewables could be crowded out by defence spending under certain circumstances, hindering the energy transition. I show in a directed technical change model that crowding out green innovation could result in the growth rate - not just the level - of emissions becoming higher. These effects can significantly raise climate damages. Depending on the social cost of carbon and the composition of a military spending shock, I estimate that permanently doubling the military spending share in the US in 2017 (equal to 3.3% of GDP) would have led to climate damages equivalent to between 0.05–1.81% of US GDP per year.
10.1007/s10640-026-01089-y.abstract_zh: 本文认为，军事扩张会导致温室气体排放显著增加，并可能阻碍绿色转型。通过识别军事支出冲击，我采用局部投影法证明：军事支出占比每上升1个百分点，总排放量将增加0.9%-2%，排放强度将上升1%（具体幅度取决于经济体的整体排放强度）。基于为美国校准的动态生产网络模型，我发现同等规模的永久性冲击将使总排放量增加0.25%-1.38%，排放强度提高0.12%-1.06%。实证分析初步表明，此类冲击后绿色专利数量可能减少10%-25%；模型则显示，特定条件下国防支出可能挤出可再生能源投资，阻碍能源转型。在定向技术变革模型中，我证明挤出绿色创新可能导致排放增长率（而非仅排放水平）上升。这些效应将显著加剧气候损害。根据碳的社会成本及军事支出冲击的构成，我估算：若2017年美国军事支出占比（相当于GDP的3.3%）永久性翻倍，由此导致的气候损害将相当于美国GDP的0.05%-1.81%/年。
10.1007/s10640-026-01089-y.title: The Green Peace Dividend: The Effects of Militarisation on Emissions and the Green Transition
10.1007/s10640-026-01089-y.title_zh: 绿色和平红利：军事化对排放与绿色转型的影响

10.1007/s10640-026-01090-5.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    In March 2020, Luxembourg became the first country to make public transport free. We use this unique setting to evaluate the policy’s impact on transport emissions using a synthetic difference-in-differences framework. We use spatial emissions data to construct a panel of NUTS 2 regions in the EU from 2016 to 2022. We estimate an average reduction of 5.9% in road transport CO
                    <jats:sub>2</jats:sub>
                    and overall road transport GHG emissions, with larger effects for NO
                    <jats:sub>x</jats:sub>
                    . These findings are robust against confounding shifts in working from home and commuting patterns, vehicle fleet electrification, and the localized effects of the COVID-19 pandemic. Complementary event-study evidence from automatic traffic counters and air quality stations through 2023 corroborates our findings and suggests larger effects on weekends.
                  </jats:p>
10.1007/s10640-026-01090-5.abstract_zh: 2020年3月，卢森堡成为首个实现公共交通免费化的国家。我们利用这一独特政策场景，采用合成双重差分框架评估该政策对交通排放的影响。通过使用空间排放数据，我们构建了2016至2022年欧盟NUTS 2区域的面板数据。研究发现，该政策使道路交通二氧化碳及整体道路交通温室气体排放平均降低5.9%，对氮氧化物的减排效果更为显著。这些结论在控制居家办公与通勤模式变化、车辆电动化进程以及新冠疫情局部影响等混杂因素后依然稳健。基于2023年自动交通计数器与空气质量监测站的补充事件研究证据进一步佐证了我们的发现，并表明该政策在周末的减排效应更为显著。
10.1007/s10640-026-01090-5.title: Zero Fare, Cleaner Air? The Causal Effect of Luxembourg’s Free Public Transportation Policy on Transport Emissions
10.1007/s10640-026-01090-5.title_zh: 零票价，更清洁的空气？卢森堡免费公共交通政策对交通排放的因果效应

10.1007/s10640-026-01091-4.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Using BoardEx (2000–2017), we create a dynamic network connecting firms and board directors in the United States. We use the Environmental Protection Agency’s Toxics Release Inventory to measure environmental performance at the director and firm-level. We first examine how candidates’ environmental performance and networks affect their probability to be appointed to the board. We find that firms are likely to appoint influential directors with good environmental records and similar characteristics. We then show that directors’ past environmental records affect their current firm’s chemical releases. We address endogeneity concerns related to directors’ appointments and firms’ environmental performance by modeling directors’ network formation.</jats:p>
10.1007/s10640-026-01091-4.abstract_zh:
<jats:title>摘要</jats:title>
<jats:p>本文利用BoardEx数据库（2000–2017年），构建了一个连接美国企业与董事会成员的动态网络。我们采用美国环境保护署的有毒物质排放清单，从董事与企业两个层面衡量环境绩效。首先，我们考察候选人的环境绩效及其社会网络如何影响其被任命为董事会成员的概率。研究发现，企业倾向于任命具有良好环境记录且特征相似的影响力董事。其次，我们证明董事过往的环境记录会对其当前任职企业的化学品排放量产生影响。通过构建董事网络形成模型，我们解决了董事任命与企业环境绩效相关的内生性问题。</jats:p>
10.1007/s10640-026-01091-4.title: Director Appointments, Boardroom Networks, and Firm Environmental Performance
10.1007/s10640-026-01091-4.title_zh: 董事任命、董事会网络与企业环境绩效

10.1007/s10640-026-01092-3.abstract: The transition to carbon-neutral residential heating poses extraordinary policy challenges to societies in Europe and beyond. In this paper, we study the electoral consequences of an amendment to the German Building Energy Act (GEG) aimed at phasing-out fossil-based heating systems. We use granular building stock data to approximate heterogeneity in household compliance costs and apply difference-in-differences and triple difference models to estimate its impacts on vote shares at the municipal level. For the state elections in Bavaria and Hesse, we find relative gains for the far-right (+2.4 pp) and conservative opposition parties (+6.5 pp) and losses for the incumbent federal government parties (−2.9 pp) in the baseline specification of our model. For the latter two, the effects are more pronounced in rural municipalities. These findings highlight the importance of holistic climate policy approaches that account for salient and heterogeneous costs to mitigate political backlash.
10.1007/s10640-026-01092-3.abstract_zh: 向碳中和住宅供暖的转型对欧洲及其他地区的社会构成了特殊的政策挑战。本文研究了德国《建筑能源法》（GEG）修正案（旨在逐步淘汰化石燃料供暖系统）的选举后果。我们利用精细的建筑存量数据来近似衡量家庭合规成本的异质性，并采用双重差分和三重差分模型，估算该修正案在市级层面对政党得票率的影响。在巴伐利亚和黑森州的州选举中，我们的基准模型结果显示，极右翼政党得票率相对上升2.4个百分点，保守派反对党得票率上升6.5个百分点，而联邦执政党得票率下降2.9个百分点。对于后两者而言，这种效应在农村地区更为显著。这些发现凸显了采取整体性气候政策方法的重要性，该方法需考虑显著且异质性的成本，以减轻政治反弹。
10.1007/s10640-026-01092-3.title: The Electoral Impact of Housing Climate Policy: Evidence from Germany
10.1007/s10640-026-01092-3.title_zh: 住房气候政策的选举影响：来自德国的证据

10.1007/s10640-026-01093-2.abstract: We present a simple model showing how income inequality and the income elasticity of demand jointly shape the tax progressivity of indirect taxes, with rising inequality increasing the regressivity of taxes on necessities. We test the model’s predictions by analyzing the Swedish carbon tax on transport fuel. We find that the tax becomes increasingly regressive over time, closely tracking rising income inequality. We also show that the relative incidence shifts from regressive to progressive when using annual expenditure rather than annual income as the welfare measure, as expenditure is more evenly distributed. A cross-country analysis of gasoline taxes in high-income nations further supports our findings, establishing a strong correlation between higher inequality and greater regressivity. Our model helps policymakers identify when complementary redistributive measures such as lump-sum transfers may become necessary.
10.1007/s10640-026-01093-2.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个简约模型，揭示收入不平等与需求收入弹性如何共同塑造间接税的累进性：不平等加剧会提高必需品税的累退性。通过分析瑞典交通燃料碳税，我们验证了模型预测：该税种的累退性随时间推移持续增强，与收入不平等加剧趋势高度吻合。研究还表明，当采用年度支出（而非年度收入）作为福利衡量指标时，相对税负分布从累退转为累进——因为支出分布更为均衡。对高收入国家汽油税的跨国分析进一步支持了我们的发现：不平等程度越高，累退性越强。该模型有助于政策制定者识别何时需要配套实施一次性转移支付等再分配措施。
10.1007/s10640-026-01093-2.title: Tax Progressivity of Carbon and Gasoline Taxes: The Role of Income Inequality
10.1007/s10640-026-01093-2.title_zh: 碳税与汽油税的累进性：收入不平等的作用

10.1007/s10640-026-01094-1.abstract: This study examines an under-explored implication of population ageing: its relationship with environmental outcomes at the country level and environmental attitudes at the individual level. The analysis introduces a novel classification of environmental outcomes, distinguishing between action-requiring and nature-concerning dimensions based on the degree of civic engagement necessary for their realisation. Using panel data from a broad set of countries over the period 1995–2018, population ageing is shown to be associated with improvements in environmental outcomes that require limited civic engagement, while no systematic relationship is observed for outcomes that rely on active public participation. Complementary evidence from individual-level survey data for 2005–2016 indicates that ageing societies exhibit lower levels of environmental engagement, without a corresponding decline in underlying environmental concern. The findings contribute to the literature on demographic change and environmental performance by highlighting the role of civic engagement as a mediating mechanism and suggest that ageing societies may face specific challenges in sustaining participatory forms of environmental action.
10.1007/s10640-026-01094-1.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了人口老龄化一个尚未充分挖掘的影响：其在国家层面与环境结果、个体层面与环境态度之间的关系。分析引入了一种新的环境结果分类方法，根据实现这些结果所需的公民参与程度，将其区分为“需要行动型”和“关注自然型”两个维度。利用1995–2018年间多个国家的面板数据，研究发现人口老龄化与那些需要有限公民参与的环境结果的改善相关，而对于依赖公众积极参与的环境结果，则未观察到系统性关联。基于2005–2016年个体层面调查数据的补充证据表明，老龄化社会中的环境参与水平较低，但潜在的环境关注并未相应下降。这些发现通过强调公民参与作为中介机制的作用，为人口变化与环境绩效的相关文献做出了贡献，并表明老龄化社会在维持参与式环境行动方面可能面临特定挑战。
10.1007/s10640-026-01094-1.title: Population Ageing and the Environment: A Comparative Study of Nature-Concerning and Action-Requiring Outcomes
10.1007/s10640-026-01094-1.title_zh: 人口老龄化与环境：自然关注型与行动需求型结果的比较研究

10.1007/s10640-026-01095-0.abstract: In regions with low soil fertility, smallholder farmers often clear forest to sustain agricultural yields. This pattern becomes more problematic where forest regrowth is slow, contributing to local forest loss and global environmental challenges such as climate change and biodiversity decline. This paper presents findings from a framed field experiment that examines how different types of monetary incentives affect forest-clearing decisions in northern Namibia, a semi-arid region with negligible forest regrowth. We implemented a common-pool resource game with 518 smallholder farmers across 25 villages, in which a forest stock declines dynamically based on participants’ clearing decisions, without immediate regrowth. The game spans three periods: a baseline without incentives, an intervention period where participants receive either individual rewards, collective rewards, an individual fee, or no incentives (control group), and a post-incentive phase. This setup allows us to assess both the immediate effects of incentives and their persistence after incentive removal. All incentive types reduce clearing compared to the baseline, but not significantly more than in the control condition, where clearing also declined – an unexpected trend likely linked to features of the dynamic game design. Incentive effects largely dissipate after removal, with no strong evidence of lasting motivational crowding-in or crowding-out. Overall, our results suggest that moderate payments may be insufficient to sustain cooperation in persistent resource dilemmas. More broadly, they highlight the importance of multifaceted analysis including control conditions and careful experimental framing in field-laboratory studies, coupled with caution in generalizing findings to other settings or policy applications.
10.1007/s10640-026-01095-0.abstract_zh: 在土壤肥力较低的地区，小农户常通过砍伐森林来维持农业产量。当森林再生缓慢时，这种模式会加剧问题，导致局部森林损失及气候变化、生物多样性下降等全球性环境挑战。本文基于一项框架田野实验，探讨不同货币激励类型如何影响纳米比亚北部（一个森林再生几乎为零的半干旱地区）的森林砍伐决策。我们针对25个村庄的518名小农户开展了一项公共池资源博弈实验：森林存量根据参与者的砍伐决策动态下降，且无即时再生。实验分为三个阶段：无激励基线期、干预期（参与者分别获得个人奖励、集体奖励、个人费用或零激励（对照组））以及激励后阶段。该设计使我们能够评估激励的即时效应及其在激励取消后的持续性。所有激励类型均比基线期减少了砍伐行为，但并未显著优于对照组——对照组砍伐量同样下降，这一意外趋势可能与动态博弈设计特征相关。激励效应在取消后基本消失，未发现持久的动机挤入或挤出效应。总体而言，我们的结果表明，适度支付可能不足以在持续性资源困境中维持合作。更广泛地看，本研究凸显了在田野实验室研究中纳入控制条件、谨慎设计实验框架并进行多维度分析的重要性，同时需警惕将结论推广至其他情境或政策应用。
10.1007/s10640-026-01095-0.title: Introducing and Terminating Monetary Incentives in Non-Regenerating Forests: Insights from a Framed Field Experiment
10.1007/s10640-026-01095-0.title_zh: 非再生森林中货币激励的引入与终止：来自框架田野实验的启示

10.1007/s10640-026-01096-z.abstract: This paper examines which country should undertake forest restoration when production and deforestation jointly degrade environmental absorption capacity. We develop a two-country dynamic game in which a forest owner derives revenues from deforestation while a non-owner benefits from production; both generate emissions, but only deforestation directly reduces carbon sink efficiency. Restoration is costly and subject to inertia. Consistent with international governance frameworks, the restoring country commits to a predetermined restoration path, while the non-restorer may either commit or retain strategic flexibility. Under homogeneous strategies, long-run environmental outcomes are independent of which country restores. Under heterogeneous strategies, however, the allocation of restoration responsibility becomes crucial: assigning restoration to the producer may aggravate environmental degradation and lead to history-dependent, potentially irreversible dynamics, whereas assigning it to the deforester mitigates opportunistic behavior and promotes more stable outcomes. A novel finding is that history-dependency is both control-specific and parameter-dependent: the deforester’s deforestation and restoration controls exhibit strong Skiba behavior robustly across parametric regimes, while the producer’s emissions exhibit weak Skiba behavior when economically dominant but become more sensitive to initial conditions when the deforester dominates. These results reflect an asymmetry in transmission channels and suggest that robust environmental protection requires aligning restoration responsibilities with forest ownership.
10.1007/s10640-026-01096-z.abstract_zh: 本文探讨当生产与毁林共同削弱环境吸收能力时，应由哪个国家承担森林恢复责任。我们构建了一个两国动态博弈模型：森林所有者通过毁林获取收益，而非所有者则从生产中获益；两者均产生排放，但只有毁林行为直接降低碳汇效率。森林恢复成本高昂且存在惯性。遵循国际治理框架，恢复国承诺执行既定恢复路径，而非恢复国可选择承诺或保留战略灵活性。在策略同质化情形下，长期环境结果与恢复责任归属无关。然而在策略异质化情形下，恢复责任的分配变得至关重要：将恢复责任分配给生产国可能加剧环境退化，并引发依赖历史路径且可能不可逆的动态过程；而将其分配给毁林国则可抑制机会主义行为，促进更稳定的结果。一项新发现表明：历史路径依赖性既具有控制特异性又具有参数依赖性——毁林国的毁林与恢复控制在不同参数区间均表现出显著的Skiba行为，而生产国的排放控制在经济主导时呈现弱Skiba行为，但在毁林国主导时对初始条件更为敏感。这些结果反映了传导渠道的非对称性，并表明稳健的环境保护需要将恢复责任与森林所有权相匹配。
10.1007/s10640-026-01096-z.title: Restoration Responsibility in a Dynamic Game of Deforestation, Production, and Pollution Accumulation
10.1007/s10640-026-01096-z.title_zh: 毁林、生产与污染累积动态博弈中的恢复责任

10.1007/s10640-026-01097-y.abstract: This study investigates how target-based performance evaluation affects the spatial allocation of environmental enforcement. Using China’s ambient air quality monitoring network as a quasi-experimental setting, we combine high-frequency firm-level emissions data and a difference-in-differences design. We document a 12.6% reduction in nitrogen oxide (NOx) emissions among polluting firms located near newly established monitoring stations, relative to more distant firms. This disparity reveals a strategic reallocation of enforcement effort by local governments to improve visible air quality metrics tied to career incentives, rather than to achieve broad pollution abatement. While such selective enforcement helps jurisdictions meet top-down performance targets, it creates a “monitoring-proximity paradox,” whereby regulatory effort becomes spatially concentrated.
10.1007/s10640-026-01097-y.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了基于目标的绩效评估如何影响环境执法的空间配置。以中国环境空气质量监测网络为准自然实验场景，我们结合高频企业级排放数据与双重差分模型展开分析。研究发现，相较于距离较远的企业，新建监测站点周边污染企业的氮氧化物排放量下降了12.6%。这一差异揭示了地方政府为改善与职业晋升激励挂钩的显性空气质量指标，而非实现广泛污染减排所采取的策略性执法资源再配置行为。尽管这种选择性执法有助于辖区完成自上而下的绩效目标，却形成了"监测邻近悖论"——即监管力度呈现空间集聚特征。
10.1007/s10640-026-01097-y.title: Strategic Enforcement Distortion Under Target-Based Environmental Governance: Spatial Heterogeneity in Pollution Mitigation and Policy Implications
10.1007/s10640-026-01097-y.title_zh: 目标导向环境治理下的策略性执法扭曲：污染减排的空间异质性与政策启示

10.1007/s10640-026-01099-w.abstract: This study evaluates the impact of the Pilot Free Trade Zones (PFTZs) on the carbon emissions of enterprises located within the zones. By manually identifying PFTZs’ boundaries and employing a spatial regression discontinuity (SRD) design, we find that the establishment of the PFTZs significantly reduces the carbon emission intensity of enterprises within the zones. This conclusion remains valid across a series of robustness tests. Mechanism analysis reveals that the PFTZs drives emission reductions by intensifying market competition, stimulating green technology innovation, and alleviating financing constraints. Furthermore, heterogeneity analyses indicate that these effects are more pronounced in heavily polluting industries, technology-intensive enterprises, non-state-owned enterprises, and areas with a larger scale of construction. This study provides a vital theoretical basis for China’s green and high-quality development strategies in the current context of carbon reduction.
10.1007/s10640-026-01099-w.abstract_zh: 本研究评估了自由贸易试验区（PFTZs）对区内企业碳排放的影响。通过手动识别自贸区边界并采用空间断点回归（SRD）设计，我们发现自贸区的设立显著降低了区内企业的碳排放强度。该结论在一系列稳健性检验中依然成立。机制分析表明，自贸区通过加剧市场竞争、激发绿色技术创新以及缓解融资约束来推动减排。此外，异质性分析显示，这些效应在重污染行业、技术密集型企业、非国有企业以及建设规模较大的区域更为显著。本研究为当前碳减排背景下中国绿色高质量发展战略提供了重要的理论依据。
10.1007/s10640-026-01099-w.title: The Establishment of Pilot Free Trade Zones and Carbon Emissions
10.1007/s10640-026-01099-w.title_zh: 自贸试验区设立与碳排放

10.1007/s10640-026-01100-6.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We estimate the impact of catastrophic wildfires on suicide. Leveraging an eight-year panel of county-by-month restricted-use mortality data for California, we find that catastrophic wildfires that destroy at least 2% of a county’s housing stock cause a 47% increase in the suicide rate (roughly nine excess suicides) in the six-month aftermath of an event. Exploring sources of heterogeneity, effects are largely driven by men. Mechanisms are explored and suggest that suicide results from the loss of property and direct loss of life, rather than smoke exposure. These findings suggest that wildfires may be deadlier and more expensive than previously thought.</jats:p>
10.1007/s10640-026-01100-6.abstract_zh: 我们估算了灾难性野火对自杀率的影响。利用加州按县-月划分的八年限制使用死亡率面板数据，我们发现，在事件发生后的六个月内，摧毁一个县至少2%住房存量的灾难性野火会导致自杀率上升47%（约增加9例自杀）。在异质性来源的探索中，影响主要由男性驱动。机制分析表明，自杀源于财产损失和直接生命损失，而非烟雾暴露。这些发现表明，野火可能比先前认为的更具致命性和更高成本。
10.1007/s10640-026-01100-6.title: Catastrophic Wildfires & Suicide

10.1007/s10640-026-01101-5.abstract: We study whether the net zero transition (NZT) affects loan pricing in the energy and utilities sectors of the loan market. We find that firms with higher levels of overall NZT disclosure experience a lower cost of debt in the loan market, controlling for loan-specific and firm financial characteristics. This effect is economically and statistically significant in Europe, but not in North America or emerging markets, and becomes more pronounced after the 2015 Paris Agreement. We also identify relevant NZT actions contributing to such a relation. Firms disclosing clear emission reduction targets aligned with the Paris Agreement enjoy lower loan spreads. Additionally, environmental R&D expenditure and improved energy efficiency policies are associated with lower loan spreads. Moreover, effective governance actions, such as environmental management training and ESG-linked executive compensation, help mitigate climate risks and lower loan spreads.
10.1007/s10640-026-01101-5.abstract_zh: 本文研究净零转型是否影响贷款市场中能源与公用事业部门的贷款定价。在控制贷款特定特征与企业财务特征后，我们发现净零转型整体披露水平较高的企业在贷款市场中的债务成本较低。这一效应在欧洲具有经济和统计显著性，但在北美或新兴市场并不显著，且在2015年《巴黎协定》后更为突出。我们还识别出促成该关系的相关净零转型行动：披露与《巴黎协定》一致的明确减排目标的企业享有较低的贷款利差；此外，环境研发支出与能源效率政策的改善也与较低的贷款利差相关。同时，有效的治理行动（如环境管理培训及与ESG挂钩的高管薪酬）有助于缓解气候风险并降低贷款利差。
10.1007/s10640-026-01101-5.title: Corporate Net Zero Transition and Financing Cost: Evidence of Impact from the Global Energy and Utilities Sectors
10.1007/s10640-026-01101-5.title_zh: 企业净零转型与融资成本：来自全球能源与公用事业部门的冲击证据

10.1007/s10640-026-01102-4.abstract: We present a valuation framework for measuring the non-market net operating surplus associated with threatened wild species preservation for monetary ecosystem accounting . We use the Simulated Exchange Value ( SEV ) method, which estimates the maximum benefit that could be internalized in a hypothetical market using the demand simulated from a choice experiment, a given market supply, and an assumed market structure. The choice experiment estimates willingness to pay (WTP), in addition to current tax-funded costs, for achieving different stock levels of wild species across threat categories defined by the International Union for Conservation of Nature Red List. We apply this framework to the valuation of threatened waterbird species preservation in the coastal wetlands of the southwestern Iberian Peninsula. The results show that WTP increases as the number of threatened species decreases, with the critically endangered species generating the highest WTP and no statistically significant differences between vulnerable and endangered species. Based on our preferred model, we estimate a SEV of the net operating surplus of €2,850 per hectare per year for the current stock levels of threatened waterbird species. The equivalent variation estimated for the same stock level is €4,108 per hectare per year.
10.1007/s10640-026-01102-4.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种估值框架，用于衡量与受威胁野生物种保护相关的非市场净经营盈余，以服务于货币化生态系统核算。我们采用模拟交换价值（SEV）方法，该方法通过选择实验模拟的需求、给定的市场供给以及假定的市场结构，估算在假设市场中可内部化的最大收益。该选择实验估算了除当前税收资助成本之外，为实现国际自然保护联盟（IUCN）红色名录所定义的不同威胁类别野生物种存量水平而支付的意愿（WTP）。我们将此框架应用于伊比利亚半岛西南部沿海湿地受威胁水鸟物种保护的估值。结果显示，随着受威胁物种数量的减少，WTP增加，其中极危物种产生的WTP最高，而易危物种与濒危物种之间无统计学显著差异。基于我们的优选模型，我们估算出当前受威胁水鸟物种存量水平的净经营盈余SEV为每公顷每年2850欧元。同一存量水平下估算的等价变差为每公顷每年4108欧元。
10.1007/s10640-026-01102-4.title: Integrating Threatened Biodiversity in Monetary Ecosystem Accounting: Choice Experiments and Simulated Exchange Values
10.1007/s10640-026-01102-4.title_zh: 将受威胁生物多样性纳入货币化生态系统核算：选择实验与模拟交换价值

10.1007/s10640-026-01103-3.abstract: The consensus view among economists is that carbon prices, in order to be efficient, must be the same across the globe. But when there are inefficiencies in the allocation of capital so that countries are subject to different discount rates, we show that efficient carbon prices must be different across countries. This is a consequence of Hotelling’s familiar argument on the price of a non-renewable resource: it must grow at the rate of the next best use of marginal funds, which is equal to the country’s discount rate. If different countries discount at different rates, their carbon prices ought to grow at different rates as well. If they grow at different rates, they can’t be the same all of the time, as first-best carbon prices are. The computational climate policy literature has so far avoided this conclusion by altering time preferences in a country-specific way through time-varying Negishi weights. We show that the use of such weights causes inefficient policy prescriptions and, furthermore, has the particularly undesirable consequence of incorrectly discounting future consumption more in countries with high growth rates. The existence of inefficiencies in the savings process—causing differences in discount rates—is well-known and should be acknowledged head on in climate policy analysis. Doing so results in global mitigation policy with carbon price paths for different countries growing (efficiently) at different rates.
10.1007/s10640-026-01103-3.abstract_zh: 经济学家普遍认为，碳价格若要实现效率最优，必须在全球范围内保持一致。然而，当资本配置存在效率损失，导致各国面临不同的贴现率时，我们证明有效的碳价格必须因国而异。这一结论源于霍特林关于不可再生资源价格的经典论证：碳价格必须以边际资金次优用途的增长率上升，而该增长率等于该国的贴现率。若不同国家的贴现率存在差异，其碳价格也应以不同速率增长。由于增长速率不同，碳价格便无法像最优状态那样始终保持一致。现有气候政策计算文献通过引入随时间变化的尼格希权重来调整各国的时间偏好，从而回避了这一结论。我们证明，使用此类权重会导致政策建议缺乏效率，并产生尤为不良的后果——在高增长国家中，未来消费被错误地以更高贴现率折现。储蓄过程中的效率损失（导致贴现率差异）是公认现象，气候政策分析应直面这一问题。如此制定的全球减排政策，将使不同国家的碳价格路径以（有效的）不同速率增长。
10.1007/s10640-026-01103-3.title: On Differentiated Carbon Prices and Discount Rates
10.1007/s10640-026-01103-3.title_zh: 差异化碳价格与贴现率研究

10.1007/s10640-026-01105-1.abstract: This paper analyzes the taxation of emissions in the presence of two institutional frictions common in developing countries. First, credit markets are underdeveloped in terms of both access to credit and borrowing conditions. Second, limited state capacity restricts the operation of the tax system. The analysis shows that the second-best emissions tax reflects both marginal environmental damages, as in the Pigouvian principle, and the effectiveness of taxation in reducing pollution. Credit market frictions hinder the adoption of clean technologies and increase emissions, which would, in isolation, call for a higher Pigouvian tax. However, these frictions may also reduce the responsiveness of emissions to taxation by limiting firms’ ability to adopt cleaner technologies, thereby lowering the optimal second-best tax. To capture these mechanisms, the paper distinguishes between two types of distortions: collateral-based, productivity-independent differences in access to credit, and cash-flow–based borrowing constraints. The optimal tax responds differently to each type of distortion.
10.1007/s10640-026-01105-1.abstract_zh: 本文分析了发展中国家普遍存在的两种制度性摩擦对排放征税的影响。其一，信贷市场在信贷获取渠道与借贷条件方面均存在欠发达特征；其二，有限的国家能力制约了税收体系的运行效能。研究表明，次优排放税既需遵循庇古原则反映边际环境损害，又需体现税收在减少污染方面的有效性。信贷市场摩擦会阻碍清洁技术采用并增加排放量，单就这一效应而言，本应要求更高的庇古税。然而，这些摩擦通过限制企业采用清洁技术的能力，可能同时削弱排放对税收的响应弹性，从而降低最优次优税率。为捕捉上述机制，本文区分了两种不同类型的扭曲：基于抵押品且与生产率无关的信贷获取差异，以及基于现金流约束的借贷限制。最优税率对这两种扭曲的响应方式存在显著差异。
10.1007/s10640-026-01105-1.title: Revisiting Pigouvian Taxes Under Credit Constraints and State Capacity Limitations
10.1007/s10640-026-01105-1.title_zh: 信贷约束与国家能力限制下的庇古税再探讨

10.1007/s10797-026-09947-7.abstract: This study investigates how increased female representation in executive positions within local governments affects municipal expenditures. We leverage a 2014 reform in Italy that mandated 40% gender quotas in the executive councils of municipalities with more than 3000 residents. To isolate the impact of gender quotas from other policies active at the same population cutoff, we employ a difference-in-discontinuities approach. We document that the policy effectively increases female representation in local governments, bringing younger, less politically experienced female politicians into executive councils. We find that increased female representation shifts resources away from culture and toward education, with spending shares rising by 25% for preschool and decreasing by 47% for culture. This indicates that including more women in executive roles can influence the allocation of municipal resources, even if it does not alter total spending levels.
10.1007/s10797-026-09947-7.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨地方政府行政职位中女性代表比例提升对市政支出的影响。我们利用意大利2014年实施的一项改革，该改革规定居民超过3000人的市镇行政委员会中女性配额须达到40%。为将性别配额的影响与同一人口阈值下其他政策的作用区分开来，我们采用断点回归差分法。研究证实，该政策有效提升了地方政府中的女性代表比例，使更年轻、政治经验较少的女性政治家进入行政委员会。我们发现，女性代表比例的提高促使资源从文化领域转向教育领域，学前教育支出份额上升25%，而文化支出份额下降47%。这表明，即使不改变总支出水平，增加女性在行政职务中的参与也能影响市政资源的分配格局。
10.1007/s10797-026-09947-7.title: Gender quotas in municipal executives: reallocating public spending in Italy
10.1007/s10797-026-09947-7.title_zh: 市政行政中的性别配额：意大利公共支出的重新分配

10.1007/s10797-026-09954-8.abstract: This paper examines how the Kansas tax experiment, which eliminated state income taxes on pass-through entities between 2012 and 2017, affected firms’ debt payment behavior, a key indicator of liquidity constraint. Using establishment-level data from the National Establishment Time Series (NETS) and exploiting the geographic discontinuity in the Kansas City metropolitan area, we estimate the causal effect of the reform using a spatially anchored difference-in-differences framework. The results show that eliminating pass-through income led to a measurable, but temporary, improvement in the timeliness of debt payments. The average duration of delayed payments was reduced by one-third in the baseline model. The effects were heterogeneous and significant in small and non-publicly listed establishments.
10.1007/s10797-026-09954-8.abstract_zh: 本文考察了2012年至2017年间堪萨斯州税收实验（该实验取消了穿透实体州所得税）对企业债务支付行为（流动性约束的关键指标）的影响。利用国家企业时间序列数据库（NETS）中的企业层面数据，并借助堪萨斯城都市区的地理断点特征，我们采用空间锚定双重差分框架估计了该改革的因果效应。结果表明，取消穿透实体所得税显著但暂时地改善了债务支付的及时性。在基准模型中，延迟支付的平均时长减少了三分之一。该效应在小型及非上市企业中呈现异质性且更为显著。
