10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113121.abstract: Researchers often include unit-specific (e.g., state-specific) trends in difference-in-differences (DiD) specifications. Under standard DiD assumptions, these specifications still yield consistent estimates of dynamic treatment effects (i.e., separate effects for each post-treatment time period) but the pooled post-treatment coefficient is not consistent for the average treatment effect. This single coefficient is a weighted average of the dynamic coefficients, but some weights are often negative. This occurs even without a staggered rollout of treatment. Instead of estimating a pooled coefficient, researchers can estimate the average treatment effect as the mean of the dynamic effects. Previous article in issue Next article in issue
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113121.abstract_zh: 研究者常在双重差分（DiD）设定中纳入单位特定（如州特定）趋势。在标准DiD假设下，这些设定仍能得出动态处理效应（即每个处理后期对应的独立效应）的一致估计，但合并处理后期系数并非平均处理效应的一致估计量。该单一系数是动态系数的加权平均值，但部分权重常为负值——即便在非交错式处理推行情况下亦如此。研究者可通过计算动态效应均值来估计平均处理效应，而非采用合并系数。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113121.title: Difference-in-differences with unit-specific trends: Bias in post-treatment estimates and a simple alternative
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113121.title_zh: 单位特定趋势下的双重差分法：处理后估计的偏差及一个简单替代方案

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113123.abstract: Rainfall fluctuations significantly reduce welfare for poor rural households in low- and middle-income countries dependent on rainfed agriculture for consumption, and the effects of these shocks can be borne disproportionately by vulnerable household members, particularly children and girls. We present new evidence around the effects of rainfall fluctuations on child anthropometric status in Papua New Guinea, an understudied context characterized by some of the highest stunting rates in the world. We show that negative fluctuations in rainfall within the first 12 months of life lead to a reduction in height-for-age and weight-for-age (though not stunting), but this effect is observed only for girls.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113123.abstract_zh: 降雨波动显著降低了依赖雨养农业维持生计的低收入与中等收入国家贫困农村家庭的福利水平，且此类冲击的影响可能不成比例地由弱势家庭成员（尤其是儿童和女童）承担。我们提供了关于巴布亚新几内亚降雨波动对儿童人体测量学指标影响的新证据——该地区是全球发育迟缓率最高的地区之一，但相关研究尚不充分。研究表明，出生后12个月内降雨量的负向波动会导致年龄别身高和年龄别体重下降（但未达到发育迟缓标准），然而这一效应仅出现在女童群体中。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113123.title: The gendered effects of rainfall shocks on stunting: Evidence from Papua New Guinea
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113123.title_zh: 降雨冲击对发育迟缓的性别差异效应：来自巴布亚新几内亚的证据

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113124.abstract: This note studies a pure fertility-timing reform in a three-period OLG model. Holding completed fertility fixed, shifting births from middle age to youth raises the balanced-growth factor if N > 1 , lowers it if N < 1 , and leaves it unchanged if N = 1 . The same positive balanced-growth root λ determines cohort growth, the cohort ratio, and the steady-state PAYG support ratio λ 2 + λ . Thus the long-run support-ratio effect, and under an exogenous wage the pension-benefit effect, are positive in growing populations and negative in shrinking ones.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113124.abstract_zh: 本文在三期OLG模型中研究了一项纯粹的生育时机改革。在保持终身生育率不变的前提下，将生育行为从中年阶段提前至青年阶段，若N>1则会提高平衡增长因子，若N<1则会降低该因子，若N=1则保持不变。相同的正平衡增长根λ决定了队列增长、队列比率以及稳态现收现付制抚养比λ²+λ。因此，长期抚养比效应以及在外生工资条件下的养老金待遇效应，在人口增长型社会中为正，在人口收缩型社会中为负。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113124.title: Birth timing, stable population growth, and pay-as-you-go pensions
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113124.title_zh: 生育时机、稳定人口增长与现收现付养老金

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113125.abstract: Does proximity to the natal family protect women against intimate partner violence (IPV)? Leveraging Uzbekistan as a natural laboratory and an original list experiment among 835 married women, we find that women near their parents show a list-experiment prevalence estimate of 9.4% and no detectable reporting gap, whereas those far from their parents report only 8.5% in direct surveys, against a list-experiment estimate of 36.2%. Standard surveys do not merely undercount these victims — they invert the ranking of risk, making the most vulnerable women appear the safest. A parallel attitude experiment supports neither preference falsification nor cultural selection.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113125.abstract_zh: 靠近原生家庭能否保护女性免受亲密伴侣暴力（IPV）侵害？以乌兹别克斯坦为自然实验场，通过对835名已婚女性开展原始列表实验，我们发现：与父母同住的女性在列表实验中遭受暴力的估计比例为9.4%，且未发现可检测的报告偏差；而远离父母的女性在直接调查中仅报告8.5%的暴力发生率，但列表实验估计值却高达36.2%。传统调查不仅低估了这些受害者的数量——更彻底颠倒了风险排序，使最脆弱的女性反而显得最安全。平行态度实验的结果既不支持偏好伪装假说，也不支持文化选择假说。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113125.title: Under the wing: The effect of parental proximity on intimate partner violence and underreporting
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113125.title_zh: 庇护之下：父母邻近性对亲密伴侣暴力及其低报率的影响

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113126.title: The effect of master’s level social worker licensing reform in Illinois
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113126.title_zh: 伊利诺伊州硕士级社会工作者执照改革的影响

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113127.abstract: We examine the impact of short-term temperature changes on voting behavior in the Brazilian presidential elections from 2010 to 2018, focusing on the candidacy of Marina Silva, a prominent pro-environment politician. Using data on municipality level voting and daily wet bulb temperature, we find that an increase in temperature on election day increases votes for Marina Silva. We argue that this effect is driven by the salience of climate change issues, which influences last-minute voting decisions. Our analysis also shows that temperature variations in the days preceding the election have a limited impact on voting outcomes, highlighting the transient nature of climate salience effects.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113127.abstract_zh: 本文考察了2010年至2018年巴西总统选举期间短期气温变化对投票行为的影响，重点关注著名环保政治家玛丽娜·席尔瓦的竞选活动。利用市级投票数据与每日湿球温度数据，我们发现选举日气温升高会增加玛丽娜·席尔瓦的得票数。我们认为这一效应源于气候变化议题的显著性，这种显著性影响了选民在最后一刻的投票决策。分析还表明，选举前几天的气温变化对投票结果影响有限，凸显了气候显著性效应的短暂性特征。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113127.title: Voting in the heat of the moment: Climate change salience and electoral behavior
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113127.title_zh: 气候变化紧迫性下的投票：气候突显性与选举行为

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113128.title: How default risk shapes social choice
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113128.title_zh: 违约风险如何塑造社会选择

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113129.abstract: We study compatibility design in repeated procurement. A winning supplier can make a cost-reducing investment that carries over, while compatibility determines how much of the cost reduction is usable by the alternative supplier. Greater compatibility strengthens the alternative supplier but lowers the future value of winning and can weaken investment incentives. We show that when investment is sustainable, optimal compatibility is the lower of the unconstrained buyer-surplus optimum and the investment-sustaining ceiling. Except when zero compatibility is always optimal, buyer-optimal compatibility first rises and then falls with supplier patience.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113129.abstract_zh: 我们研究重复采购中的兼容性设计。获胜供应商可以进行具有延续性的成本削减投资，而兼容性决定了替代供应商能够利用多少成本削减成果。更高的兼容性会增强替代供应商的实力，但会降低未来获胜的价值，并可能削弱投资激励。研究表明，当投资具有可持续性时，最优兼容性取无约束买方剩余最优值与投资可持续上限两者中的较低值。除非零兼容性始终为最优方案，否则买方最优兼容性会随供应商耐心程度先升后降。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113129.title: Compatibility and investment incentives in dynamic procurement
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113129.title_zh: 动态采购中的兼容性与投资激励

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113130.abstract: This study examines how politically driven trade-threat signals affect global equity markets. Using a Large Language Model (LLM), we construct a measure of trade-threat intensity from U.S. president Donald J. Trump’s posts on Truth Social and identify extreme threat events based on the upper tail of the score distribution. We find that these events are associated with significantly negative abnormal returns in global equity markets, concentrated within a short window around the event date. The effect exhibits substantial regional heterogeneity, with weaker responses in the Americas and stronger reactions in European, Asian, and Pacific markets. Our findings suggest that LLM-based measures of political communication capture economically meaningful signals associated with short-horizon movements in asset prices, highlighting the role of real-time political rhetoric in shaping global financial market dynamics.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113130.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了政治驱动的贸易威胁信号如何影响全球股票市场。通过运用大语言模型（LLM），我们基于美国前总统唐纳德·J·特朗普在Truth Social平台上的帖子构建了贸易威胁强度指标，并根据得分分布的上尾部分识别出极端威胁事件。研究发现，这些事件与全球股票市场显著为负的异常收益率相关，且该效应集中在事件日期前后的短窗口期内。该影响表现出显著的区域异质性：美洲市场反应较弱，而欧洲、亚洲及太平洋市场反应更为强烈。我们的研究结果表明，基于大语言模型的政治沟通指标能够捕捉与资产价格短期波动相关的经济意义信号，凸显了实时政治言论在塑造全球金融市场动态中的作用。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113130.title: Large Language Model, trade threats and stock markets
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113130.title_zh: 大语言模型、贸易威胁与股票市场

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113131.abstract: Empirical evidence shows that environmental, social, and governance (ESG) quality interacts with financial performance at the individual asset level: high-ESG firms outperform during crises and corporate social responsibility lowers systematic beta. Models with separable ESG preferences generate a greenium but no such interaction. We develop a capital asset pricing model (CAPM) with supermodular preferences over each asset’s return and ESG score. The equilibrium features an asset-specific denominator that compresses expected returns for high-ESG assets and generates a negative beta-ESG interaction, implying lower effective market sensitivity for green firms. We show that portfolio-level complementarity cannot produce this interaction, which yields a sharp test distinguishing our mechanism in the data. The model offers one rationalization of the beta-ESG interaction. We illustrate its quantitative content with four empirical studies.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113131.abstract_zh: 实证证据表明，环境、社会和治理（ESG）质量在个体资产层面与财务绩效相互作用：高ESG企业在危机期间表现更优，且企业社会责任降低了系统性贝塔值。具有可分离ESG偏好的模型虽能产生绿色溢价，却无法解释这种相互作用。我们构建了一个资本资产定价模型（CAPM），其中包含对每项资产回报率与ESG评分的超模偏好。均衡状态下，模型呈现资产特定的分母，压缩了高ESG资产的预期回报，并产生负向的贝塔-ESG交互效应，意味着绿色企业的有效市场敏感度较低。我们证明，投资组合层面的互补性无法产生这种交互作用，这为在数据中区分我们的机制提供了一个明确的检验标准。该模型为贝塔-ESG交互效应提供了一种合理化解释。我们通过四项实证研究展示了其定量内容。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113131.title: Doing good and doing well: A CAPM with complementary ESG and financial returns
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113131.title_zh: 行善与盈利：兼具ESG与财务回报互补性的CAPM模型

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113132.title: Investor Fear, Behavioural Contagion, and the Global Dollar Cycle: Evidence From BRICS Currency Markets
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113132.title_zh: 投资者恐惧、行为传染与全球美元周期：来自金砖国家货币市场的证据

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113133.title: Which demand elasticity should a monopoly use?
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113133.title_zh: 垄断应使用哪种需求弹性？

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113140.title: Estimating exact efficiency in multi-weight spatial autoregressive stochastic frontier models
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113140.title_zh: 多权重空间自回归随机前沿模型中精确效率的估计

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113141.abstract: We propose a robust bandwidth rule for the classical CUSUM and QS tests for shifts in the mean of a time series: the AR(1) coefficient entering Andrews’ (1991) data-driven HAC bandwidth is truncated at a fixed threshold $\rho {0} < 1$, with $\rho {0}$ selected by a simulation-based procedure that controls empirical size against a user-specified persistence robustness target. The truncated bandwidth is shown to be free from the asymptotic power reversal problem under the diverging-alternatives framework of Juhl and Xiao (2009). Monte Carlo evidence indicates that the CUSUM and QS tests implemented with this bandwidth deliver good size control and monotonic power across a range of break designs and persistence levels.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113141.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种针对时间序列均值突变检测中经典CUSUM和QS检验的稳健带宽规则：将Andrews（1991）数据驱动的HAC带宽中涉及的AR(1)系数截断在固定阈值$\rho {0} < 1$处，其中$\rho {0}$通过基于模拟的程序选择，该程序控制经验大小以针对用户指定的持久性稳健性目标。所提出的截断带宽被证明在Juhl和Xiao（2009）的发散备择框架下避免了渐近功效反转问题。蒙特卡洛证据表明，采用此带宽实施的CUSUM和QS检验在多种断点设计和持久性水平下均能提供良好的大小控制和单调功效。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113141.title: Improved Andrews’ formula for testing changing mean
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113141.title_zh: 改进的Andrews变均值检验公式

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113144.abstract: A representative chooses policy on behalf of a group with heterogeneous preferences. Group members differ in voice (their salience to the representative). The representative maximizes perceived welfare based on a voice-weighted signal. The resulting policy distortion is proportional to the covariance between voice and preferences. When agents choose voice effort endogenously, equilibrium voice is U-shaped (quadratic in distance between preferences and policy). The equilibrium distortion is approximately one-third of a standard deviation times the skewness coefficient. It is non-zero only when the preference distribution is skewed. Combining the voice-weighted signal with a random sample can reduce the expected welfare loss. Previous article in issue Next article in issue
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113144.abstract_zh: 一位代表代表一个偏好异质性的群体制定政策。群体成员在话语权（即其对代表的重要性）上存在差异。代表基于话语权加权的信号最大化感知福利。由此产生的政策扭曲与话语权和偏好之间的协方差成正比。当代理人内生地选择话语努力时，均衡话语呈U形（即偏好与政策距离的二次函数）。均衡扭曲约为标准差的三分之一乘以偏度系数。只有当偏好分布呈偏态时，该扭曲才非零。将话语权加权信号与随机样本相结合，可以减少预期福利损失。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113144.title: Voice and distortion: When representatives misread the room
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113144.title_zh: 声音与扭曲：当代表们误判局势时

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113145.abstract: Recent literature proposed variants of estimators of conditional error variances that are robust to the presence of many regressors. One of the proposals produces unbiased estimates, which, however, are sensitive to regression parameter values. We propose its modification based on cross-fitting and averaging over random sample splits, which preserves the unbiasedness but eliminates that sensitivity. Then, we extend the cross-fitting machinery to unbiased estimation of pairwise variance products and to testing for many restrictions. We verify properties of associated estimators and tests in a simulation setup with many covariates.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113145.abstract_zh: 近期文献提出了多种条件误差方差的估计量变体，这些估计量对大量回归变量的存在具有稳健性。其中一种方法可产生无偏估计，但其结果对回归参数值较为敏感。我们提出基于交叉拟合与随机样本分割平均的改进方案，该方法在保持无偏性的同时消除了参数敏感性。进一步地，我们将交叉拟合机制扩展至成对方差乘积的无偏估计及多重约束检验。通过包含大量协变量的模拟实验，我们验证了相关估计量与检验方法的性质。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113145.title: Parameter-invariant unbiased estimation of individual variances and their pairwise products
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113145.title_zh: 个体方差及其两两乘积的参数不变无偏估计

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113146.title: The reset premium: Option value under asymmetric price commitment
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113146.title_zh: 重置溢价：非对称价格承诺下的期权价值

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113148.abstract: This study examines the effect of managerial responses assisted by generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) on stock price crash risk. Using question–response data from investor-relations platforms operated by Chinese stock exchanges, we employ large language models (LLMs) to measure the degree of GenAI assistance in managerial responses. We find that stronger GenAI-assisted textual features predict higher future stock price crash risk. We further show that greater response–question mismatch and more negative investor sentiment serve as two potential mechanisms, and that the effect is more pronounced among firms with more frequent investor interactions.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113148.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了生成式人工智能（GenAI）辅助的管理层回复对股价崩盘风险的影响。基于中国证券交易所投资者关系平台的问答数据，我们运用大语言模型（LLMs）测度管理层回复中GenAI辅助程度。研究发现，GenAI辅助文本特征越显著，未来股价崩盘风险越高。进一步分析表明，回复与问题匹配度降低及投资者负面情绪加剧是两条潜在作用机制，且该效应在投资者互动更频繁的企业中更为显著。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113148.title: Generative AI-assisted investor communication and stock price crash risk
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113148.title_zh: 生成式AI辅助投资者沟通与股价崩盘风险

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113149.abstract: Extreme weather events generate systematic forecast errors in credit risk models. Using proprietary loan-level data covering approximately 250,000 corporate loans over 2012–2023, we find that exposure to extreme weather significantly predicts realized default rates after conditioning on model-implied probabilities. Effects are stronger for early-year exposures and reflect persistent regional vulnerability rather than transitory fluctuations. These results suggest that omitted climate risk factors contribute to systematic model miscalibration, robust across specifications. More broadly, when relevant weather events are excluded, forecast errors may become systematic rather than idiosyncratic, with implications for model design and the efficient allocation of credit.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113149.abstract_zh: 极端天气事件会导致信用风险模型产生系统性预测误差。基于2012至2023年间约25万笔企业贷款的专有贷款级数据，本研究发现，在控制模型隐含概率后，极端天气暴露度能显著预测实际违约率。该效应在年初暴露中更为显著，且反映的是持续的区域脆弱性而非暂时性波动。这些结果表明，遗漏的气候风险因素会导致模型系统性校准偏差，且该结论在多种设定下保持稳健。更广泛而言，当相关天气事件被排除时，预测误差可能从特质性转为系统性，这对模型设计及信贷资源的有效配置具有重要启示。

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113150.abstract: We show that Weitzman (2009)’s dismal theorem resurfaces naturally within a dynamic asset pricing framework with temperature-related disaster risk. If the climate disaster loss distribution is sufficiently fat-tailed, the risk-adjusted expected loss term diverges. Under unit elasticity of intertemporal substitution (EIS), this causes the social cost of carbon (SCC) to explode and the underlying optimization problem to have no finite solution so that the dynamic general equilibrium analogue of the dismal theorem applies. We show that, if the risk of climate tipping increases with temperature, the fat tail becomes endogenous and the dismal result is more likely to be activated at higher temperatures.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113150.abstract_zh: 我们证明，Weitzman（2009）的“ dismal theorem”在包含温度相关灾难风险的动态资产定价框架中会自然重现。若气候灾难损失分布具有足够厚的尾部，风险调整后的预期损失项将发散。在跨期替代弹性（EIS）为单位值时，这会导致碳的社会成本（SCC）激增，且底层优化问题无有限解，从而使得动态一般均衡版本的“ dismal theorem”成立。我们进一步表明，若气候临界点风险随温度升高而增加，厚尾特征将变为内生性，且该“ dismal”结果更可能在高温条件下被激活。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113150.title: The dismal theorem in a general equilibrium climate-economy model
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113150.title_zh: 一般均衡气候-经济模型中的悲观定理

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113151.abstract: Systemic importance has two dimensions, a bank’s contribution to system-wide tail risk ($\Delta$CoVaR) and its exposure to it (marginal expected shortfall, MES). Using daily $\Delta$CoVaR and MES for 24 publicly traded Global Systemically Important Banks over 2012–2025, we show the two rankings move on different clocks. Contribution rankings reorder at the same rate in calm times, the pandemic, and after. Exposure rankings survive the pandemic but re-anchor sharply at the 2022–2023 interest-rate regime change, as euro-area banks fall and US and Japanese banks rise. Shocks rotate which banks contribute to systemic risk; only regime changes move which are exposed.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113151.abstract_zh: 系统重要性具有两个维度：银行对系统性尾部风险的贡献度（$\Delta$CoVaR）及其风险暴露程度（边际预期损失，MES）。基于2012-2025年间24家上市全球系统重要性银行的日度$\Delta$CoVaR与MES数据，我们发现两种排名遵循不同的时间节奏。贡献度排名在平稳时期、疫情期间及疫情后均以相同速率重新排序；而风险暴露排名虽经受住疫情冲击，却在2022-2023年利率制度转换时发生剧烈锚定调整——欧元区银行排名下降，美日银行排名上升。冲击会改变哪些银行构成系统性风险贡献者，唯有制度变迁才能改变哪些银行面临风险暴露。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113151.title: The two clocks of systemic importance
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113151.title_zh: 系统重要性的两个时钟

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113152.title: The Capital-Access Premium and the Won: Korean Stablecoin Premia as a Leading Indicator of Exchange-Rate Pressure
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113152.title_zh: 资本获取溢价与韩元：韩国稳定币溢价作为汇率压力的先行指标

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113153.title: Geopolitics and the Strait of Hormuz: Evidence from Middle East Stock Markets
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113153.title_zh: 地缘政治与霍尔木兹海峡：来自中东股票市场的证据

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113154.title: The tragedy of the horizon: A contracting account
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113154.title_zh: 地平线的悲剧：一份契约解释

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113155.abstract: We document a growing link between university R&D expenditures and patenting activity in surrounding metropolitan statistical areas (MSAs) since 1980: the patents-per-capita gap between MSAs with and without a research university has doubled, and the elasticity of patents with respect to university R&D has tripled. We present several pieces of evidence showing that this trend reflects growing spillovers from universities: it is robust to MSA and university characteristics; local invention tracks the content of nearby university research; and the link is stronger where universities do more basic research. Thus, universities may increasingly shape the geography of innovation.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113155.abstract_zh: 我们记录了自1980年以来，大学研发支出与周边大都市统计区（MSA）专利活动之间日益增强的联系：拥有研究型大学的MSA与没有研究型大学的MSA之间的人均专利差距扩大了一倍，且专利对大学研发的弹性增长了两倍。我们提供了多项证据表明，这一趋势反映了大学溢出效应的增强：该联系对MSA和大学特征具有稳健性；本地发明活动与邻近大学的研究内容相吻合；且在大学从事更多基础研究的地区，这种联系更为显著。因此，大学可能日益塑造着创新的地理格局。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113155.title: The growing importance of universities for patenting and innovation
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113155.title_zh: 大学在专利与创新中日益增长的重要性

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113156.title: Endogenous networks with constrained public goods
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113156.title_zh: 约束公共品的内生网络

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113157.title: Effects of oil price uncertainty on the stock returns of oil and gas companies
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113157.title_zh: 油价不确定性对油气公司股票收益的影响

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113158.abstract: Non-financial risks affect asset prices individually, yet they are typically studied in isolation. Using 49 Fama–French industry portfolios over 1990–2026, we show that pairwise compound channels among geopolitical risk, climate policy uncertainty, and financial stress carry significant pricing power beyond individual exposures. Climate policy uncertainty emerges as the nexus variable: its interaction with financial conditions is the most consistent channel, surviving all standard error methods, sub-sample splits, and predetermined (lagged) financial conditions, with an effect roughly four times larger for carbon-intensive industries. A Wald test confirms the joint significance of the interactions while individual risks lack joint significance.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113158.abstract_zh: 非金融风险虽各自影响资产价格，但通常被孤立研究。基于1990-2026年49个Fama-French行业投资组合，我们发现地缘政治风险、气候政策不确定性与金融压力之间的两两复合渠道，其定价能力显著超越单一风险暴露。气候政策不确定性作为枢纽变量：其与金融状况的交互作用是最稳健的渠道，在所有标准误方法、子样本分割及预设（滞后）金融状况下均保持显著，且对碳密集型行业的影响约为其他行业的四倍。Wald检验证实交互项具有联合显著性，而单一风险则缺乏联合显著性。

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113159.abstract: We study how high short-term interest rates affect depositor withdrawals and bank fragility. In a global games model, depositors choose between bank deposits and money market funds, while bank holds short-term and long-term assets. Higher rates raise the payoff from withdrawing and reduce long-term asset recovery values. The model delivers a critical interest rate threshold above which runs occur, conditional on bank balance-sheet fundamentals. Lower switching cost, weaker long-term asset returns, larger fire-sale loss, and larger long-term asset share lower the threshold and expand the run region.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113159.abstract_zh: 本文研究短期高利率如何影响储户提款行为及银行脆弱性。在一个全局博弈模型中，储户在银行存款与货币市场基金之间进行选择，而银行持有短期与长期资产。利率上升既提高了提款的收益，又降低了长期资产回收价值。该模型推导出一个关键利率阈值：当利率超过该阈值时，基于银行资产负债表基本面状况，挤兑现象将发生。较低的转换成本、较弱的长期资产回报、较大的折价抛售损失以及较高的长期资产占比，均会降低该阈值并扩大挤兑区域。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113159.title: Interest rates and bank runs

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113160.title: Low-Cost AI and the Value of Compute Scarcity: Evidence from the DeepSeek Shock
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113160.title_zh: 低成本人工智能与算力稀缺性的价值：来自DeepSeek冲击的证据

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113162.abstract: We study maximum resale prices across heterogeneous local markets that share a common target retail price. A sufficiently small retailer margin can make the ceiling bind across markets, allowing common terms to implement this price. Two-part tariffs instead require the marginal wholesale price to align the retailer’s unconstrained optimal price exactly with the target. If the ceiling already binds, changes in market structure require no contractual recalibration. Apple’s use of list prices as de facto maximum resale prices, combined with discounts from those prices for independent resellers, illustrates a setting in which the mechanism may be relevant.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113162.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在共享统一目标零售价格的异质性地方市场中，最高转售价格的表现。当零售商利润率足够低时，价格上限可能在各市场间产生约束效应，使得统一条款能够实现该目标价格。相比之下，两部收费制要求边际批发价格精确匹配零售商无约束最优价格与目标价格。若价格上限已产生约束，市场结构变化无需重新调整合同条款。苹果公司将标价作为事实上的最高转售价格，同时为独立经销商提供折扣的做法，揭示了该机制可能适用的场景。

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113163.abstract: In the context of school choice, Ergin (2002) shows that Pareto efficiency and group strategy-proofness are equivalent properties for the student-optimal stable mechanism. We show that this equivalence holds at each preference profile and for every stable mechanism, providing a simple test for coalitional manipulability.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113163.abstract_zh: 在学校选择的背景下，Ergin（2002）指出，对于学生最优稳定机制而言，帕累托效率与群体策略防伪性是等价的。我们证明，这种等价性在每个偏好分布下以及对于每一种稳定机制均成立，从而为联盟可操纵性提供了一种简单的检验方法。

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113165.title: Corporate Earnings Announcements and Stock Market Bubbles
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113165.title_zh: 企业盈利公告与股市泡沫

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113166.abstract: We propose target-driven Bayesian stacking for a fixed six-model ensemble of GARCH and stochastic-volatility forecasts with realised- and VIX-based extensions. Two rolling stacking rules target either log predictive density or QLIKE. In S&P 500, the objective changes the preferred information channel: LPD stacking remains centred on GARCH-RV, whereas QLIKE stacking shifts towards GARCH-VIX. Across 56 rolling windows, the QLIKE stack improves certainty-equivalent returns by roughly one to one-and-a-half percentage points per year, depending on the investor’s risk aversion. In the 30 windows where the QLIKE stack assigns material weight to implied volatility models, the gain exceeds two percentage points per year with a 90% win rate. However, LPD stacking delivers tighter 5% Value-at-Risk calibration. Previous article in issue Next article in issue
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113166.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种目标驱动的贝叶斯堆叠方法，用于一个由GARCH和随机波动率预测构成的固定六模型集成，并加入了基于已实现波动率和VIX的扩展。两种滚动堆叠规则分别以对数预测密度或QLIKE为目标。在标普500指数中，目标函数改变了偏好的信息渠道：LPD堆叠仍以GARCH-RV为中心，而QLIKE堆叠则转向GARCH-VIX。在56个滚动窗口中，根据投资者的风险厌恶程度，QLIKE堆叠每年可将确定性等价收益提高约1至1.5个百分点。在QLIKE堆叠赋予隐含波动率模型显著权重的30个窗口中，年化收益提升超过2个百分点，且胜率达90%。然而，LPD堆叠在5%风险价值校准方面表现更优。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113166.title: Target-driven Bayesian stacking of realized and implied volatility forecasts
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113166.title_zh: 目标驱动的已实现波动率与隐含波动率预测的贝叶斯堆叠

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113168.title: Efficiency bounds for incomplete information social interaction models with network structures
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113168.title_zh: 网络结构下不完全信息社会互动模型的效率边界

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113170.abstract: We study the robustness of Nash equilibria in the preference revelation game induced by the student-optimal stable mechanism when small application fees are introduced. Assuming lexicographic preferences over outcomes, we show that introducing application fees reduces the set of Nash equilibria, to the detriment of student welfare. We provide a sufficient condition on the distribution of application fees that eliminates any Pareto improvement in which a student strictly benefits from being assigned to a given school. When all application fees are strictly positive for all applications, every Nash equilibrium induces a stable assignment.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113170.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在引入小额申请费的情况下，由学生最优稳定机制引发的偏好揭示博弈中纳什均衡的稳健性。假设对结果具有字典序偏好，我们表明引入申请费会减少纳什均衡的集合，从而损害学生福利。我们提供了申请费分布的一个充分条件，该条件消除了任何帕累托改进，其中学生因被分配到特定学校而严格受益。当所有申请费对所有申请均为严格正数时，每个纳什均衡都会产生一个稳定分配。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113170.title: Application fees and the robustness of Nash equilibria in school choice
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113170.title_zh: 申请费与学校选择中纳什均衡的稳健性

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113171.abstract: Does central bank independence shape the inflationary impact of geopolitical risk? Using a panel of 29 countries over 1990–2023, we show that geopolitical risk significantly increases inflation, but that this effect depends on the degree of central bank independence. Higher institutional credibility substantially attenuates, and in some case offsets, the inflationary impact of geopolitical shocks. This moderating effect is stronger for geopolitical threats than for realized actions and is considerably more pronounced in advanced than in emerging economies. These findings highlight the importance of credible monetary institutions in enhancing resilience to geopolitical inflation.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113171.abstract_zh: 中央银行独立性是否影响地缘政治风险的通胀效应？基于1990-2023年29个国家的面板数据，我们发现地缘政治风险显著推高通胀水平，但该效应取决于中央银行的独立程度。更高的制度可信度能显著削弱——在某些情况下甚至抵消——地缘政治冲击的通胀影响。相较于已发生的实际行动，这种调节效应对地缘政治威胁更为显著，且在发达经济体中的表现远强于新兴经济体。这些发现凸显了可信货币制度在增强抵御地缘政治通胀韧性方面的重要作用。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113171.title: Geopolitical risk and inflation: Does central bank independence matter?
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113171.title_zh: 地缘政治风险与通货膨胀：央行独立性是否重要？

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113172.abstract: We consider tests for normality, residual autocorrelation, and autoregressive conditional heteroskedasticity for a time series regression, which includes various zero-one dummy variables for individual observations. The sizes of these tests are distorted as the residuals associated with the dummies are equal to zero. We propose a simple solution which amounts to dismissing the observations with these zero-valued residuals, that is, treat these observations as missing. With simulations we show that the resulting tests have the proper size.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113172.abstract_zh: 我们考虑时间序列回归中的正态性检验、残差自相关检验以及自回归条件异方差检验，该回归包含针对个体观测值的各种0-1虚拟变量。由于与虚拟变量相关的残差为零，这些检验的显著性水平存在扭曲。我们提出一个简单解决方案，即剔除这些残差为零的观测值，将其视为缺失值处理。通过模拟研究，我们证明修正后的检验具有恰当的显著性水平。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113172.title: Diagnostic testing a time series regression with zero-one dummies
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113172.title_zh: 零一虚拟变量时间序列回归的诊断检验

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113174.abstract: Reduced-form bequest motives are routinely assumed to exhibit decreasing absolute risk aversion (DARA). I show this is consistent with an underlying altruistic primitive: when descendant risk is unrealised at the bequest choice date, DARA of the warm-glow preference is inherited from the descendant’s continuation value under both multiplicative and additive risk, without parametric restriction. Yet the two canonical specifications differ in what is preserved beyond DARA. Multiplicative risk yields a shifter-weight decomposition and preserves CRRA form; additive income risk—the relevant case for dynastic precautionary savings—preserves DARA but not functional form. • Warm-glow bequest motives inherit DARA from the descendant’s continuation value. • Holds under additive and multiplicative risk without parametric restriction. • Differences across calibrated studies need not reflect altruism strength. • Multiplicative risk preserves CRRA functional form; additive income risk does not. • Under additive risk, functional form is not disciplined by the altruistic primitive.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113174.abstract_zh: 简化形式的遗赠动机通常被假定表现出递减绝对风险厌恶（DARA）。我证明这与潜在的利他主义原始设定相一致：当后代风险在遗赠选择日期尚未实现时，暖光偏好的DARA特性是从后代的延续价值中继承而来的，无论是在乘法风险还是加法风险下，均无需参数限制。然而，两种典型设定在DARA之外所保留的特性上存在差异。乘法风险产生了一种移位权重分解，并保留了CRRA形式；加法收入风险——与王朝预防性储蓄相关的情形——保留了DARA但未保留函数形式。• 暖光遗赠动机从后代的延续价值中继承DARA。• 在加法和乘法风险下均成立，无需参数限制。• 校准研究间的差异未必反映利他主义强度。• 乘法风险保留CRRA函数形式；加法收入风险则不保留。• 在加法风险下，函数形式不受利他主义原始设定的约束。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113174.title: Warm-glow bequests and descendant risk

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113175.abstract: In this paper, we examine whether the relationship between non-bank financial intermediation (NBFI) and economic growth varies across the economic cycle. While existing studies focus on the average effects of broad measures of NBFI, the effects of the narrow measure of NBFI differing during periods of economic stress is less clear. Using a panel of 26 jurisdictions participating in the Financial Stability Board's NBFI exercise between 2006 and 2024, we find that larger narrow NBFI sectors are associated with higher real GDP growth. However, we find limited evidence that this relationship varies systematically between expansionary and recessionary periods.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113175.abstract_zh: 本文考察了非银行金融中介（NBFI）与经济增长之间的关系是否随经济周期变化。现有研究侧重于广义NBFI指标的平均效应，而狭义NBFI指标在经济压力时期的影响尚不明确。利用2006年至2024年间参与金融稳定理事会NBFI监测的26个司法管辖区的面板数据，我们发现，狭义NBFI部门规模越大，实际GDP增长率越高。然而，我们发现的证据有限，表明这种关系在扩张期与衰退期之间存在系统性差异。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113175.title: Narrow Non-Bank Financial Intermediation and Economic Growth: Does the Economic Cycle Matter?
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113175.title_zh: 狭义的影子银行中介与经济增长：经济周期是否重要？

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113177.abstract: This paper asks what can be learned from observed merger pairings when acquirers and targets meet in a two-sided market with transferable utility. A compact assignment-game model implies revealed-preference inequalities: observed matches must generate at least as much total surplus as feasible counterfactual matches in the same local market. I take these inequalities to Refinitiv M&A data for U.S. same-industry transactions during 2010–2024. The final estimation sample contains 1025 completed acquirer-target pairs and 36,881 financially feasible counterfactual pairs constructed within industry-quarter cells. A benchmark linear surplus specification based on differences in profitability, leverage, sales growth, and liquidity has weak identifying content. Across 60 optimization runs, the same maximum score is obtained, but the coefficient vectors attaining it differ substantially in sign and magnitude. The result is not a general impossibility claim about revealed-preference methods. It shows that observed matches and standard financial differences alone provide limited discipline on merger surplus when transfers, outside options, and richer pair-specific synergies are unobserved.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113177.abstract_zh: 本文探讨在具有可转移效用的双边市场中，当收购方与目标方相遇时，从观察到的并购配对中能获得何种信息。一个紧凑的指派博弈模型揭示了显示性偏好不等式：观察到的配对必须至少产生与同一局部市场中可行的反事实配对相等的总剩余。我将这些不等式应用于2010-2024年美国同行业交易的Refinitiv并购数据。最终估计样本包含1025个已完成的收购方-目标方配对，以及在行业-季度单元内构建的36881个财务上可行的反事实配对。基于盈利能力、杠杆率、销售增长率和流动性差异的基准线性剩余设定，其识别能力较弱。在60次优化运行中，虽获得相同的最大得分，但达到该得分的系数向量在符号和大小上存在显著差异。这一结果并非对显示性偏好方法的普遍不可行性论断。它表明，当转移支付、外部选择以及更丰富的配对特定协同效应未被观测到时，仅凭观察到的配对和标准财务差异对并购剩余的约束作用有限。
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113177.title: Learning from observed matches in two-sided markets
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113177.title_zh: 从双边市场中的观测匹配中学习

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113178.title: Limited awareness and message feasibility in cheap talk

10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101772.abstract: In 1900, thousands of people in England were poisoned by arsenic. The source was beer contaminated by tainted sugar. This paper examines how the poisoning affected birth rates in the affected areas, using an event study difference-in-difference design. The results show that the arsenic-in-beer epidemic caused a 10% drop in births in 1901, but the effect was short-lived. After about 28 weeks, birth rates returned to pre-epidemic levels. Evidence from the timing of the effect and a range of alternative mechanisms is most consistent with the epidemic reducing conceptions or early pregnancies, rather than operating through economic disruption or later gestational harm.
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101772.abstract_zh: 1900年，英格兰数千人因砷中毒而受害，其源头为被污染糖所掺杂的啤酒。本文采用事件研究双重差分设计，探讨了此次中毒事件对受影响地区出生率的影响。结果显示，1901年啤酒砷中毒疫情导致出生率下降10%，但此效应短暂，约28周后，出生率恢复至疫情前水平。基于效应时间点及一系列替代机制的证据，最符合的解释是疫情减少了受孕或早期妊娠，而非通过经济干扰或妊娠后期伤害发挥作用。
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101772.title: Arsenic and fertility: Evidence from the 1900 English beer-poisoning epidemic
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101772.title_zh: 砷与生育力：来自1900年英国啤酒中毒流行病的证据

10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101773.abstract: This paper examines how acute pollution exposure in historical London (1892–1919) affected child health. I proxy acute, extreme pollution exposure using daily data on fog events, which reflect meteorological conditions where pollution emitted in the city was not dispersed across space leading to a sharp spike in pollution. I also use rich individual-level data on child health drawn from the Queen Charlotte Hospital, a maternity hospital, and the Foundling Hospital, an orphanage. I find no effect of pollution exposure at birth on birth or growth outcomes or on upper respiratory morbidity. However, exposure on the day of birth had persistent effects on health, increasing mortality risk in childhood and adolescence from respiratory diseases and raising incidence, prevalence and sickness duration of influenza and measles. There was no persistent effect of in utero and postnatal pollution exposures. These mixed results show that extreme pollution at birth had lasting impacts on specific, but also limited, dimensions of child health.
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101773.abstract_zh: 本文研究了历史时期伦敦（1892-1919年）急性污染暴露对儿童健康的影响。我利用每日雾天事件数据作为急性极端污染暴露的代理变量——这些雾天反映了城市排放的污染物因无法扩散而导致污染浓度急剧飙升的气象条件。同时，我采用来自夏洛特女王医院（一家妇产医院）和弃婴医院（一家孤儿院）的丰富个体层面儿童健康数据。研究发现，出生时的污染暴露对出生结局、生长发育指标或上呼吸道疾病发病率无显著影响。然而，出生当日的污染暴露对健康产生了持续性影响：它增加了儿童期及青少年期因呼吸系统疾病导致的死亡风险，并提高了流感与麻疹的发病率、患病率及病程持续时间。宫内暴露和产后暴露则未发现持续性影响。这些混合结果表明，出生时的极端污染暴露对儿童健康的特定维度（但范围有限）产生了持久影响。
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101773.title: Born in Smog: Immediate and persistent health consequences of acute air pollution exposure in historical London, 1892–1919
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101773.title_zh: 雾霾中诞生：1892-1919年伦敦历史急性空气污染暴露的即时与持续健康后果

10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101774.abstract: The Panic of 1825 was a significant crisis in British financial history. We document how this crisis spread from London banks to England’s real economy. England’s correspondent banking network propagated trouble in sovereign debt markets to small banks outside of London and ultimately to non-financial firms. Using exogenous variation in district-level exposure to the crisis, we show that bank failures led to a substantial number of bankruptcies among non-financial firms. We discuss two potential mechanisms by which the financial system affected the real economy: a fall in aggregate demand and a credit supply shock.
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101774.abstract_zh: 1825年恐慌是英国金融史上一次重大危机。本文记录了这场危机如何从伦敦银行蔓延至英格兰实体经济。英格兰的代理银行网络将主权债务市场的困境传导至伦敦以外的小型银行，并最终波及非金融企业。利用各地区危机暴露程度的外生差异，我们证明银行倒闭导致非金融企业破产数量大幅增加。本文探讨了金融体系影响实体经济的两种潜在机制：总需求下降与信贷供给冲击。
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101774.title: Country banks and the Panic of 1825

10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101775.abstract: I examine the effect of a woman-friendly occupation on employment by exploring a unique historical setting -- the postmaster occupation during the early twentieth-century United States. Unlike many occupations that established practices to prevent married women from entering, postmasters were open to married women and offered flexible work arrangements and equal pay. With a novel dataset on postmaster appointments and census linking, I show that postmasters attracted qualified women who were not gainfully employed previously. However, the postmaster occupation offered women few benefits beyond the appointed term. Taking advantage of the fact that postmasters were presidential appointees and were rarely re-appointed after the party of the president changed, I compare the 1940 outcomes of women appointed just before and after the 1933 presidential transition in a regression discontinuity (RD) design. The RD estimates suggest that women experienced a 26.7 percentage points reduction in gainful employment after finishing their postmaster term. The negative employment effect is unique to women and does not apply to men appointed under the same circumstances. In addition, I show that women postmasters were not more likely to be employed than their women neighbors who had never been postmasters, despite their work experience. The lack of benefits for women's future employment is in part explained by state-level discrimination against married women working and the severity of the Great Depression.
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101775.abstract_zh: 本文通过考察20世纪初美国邮政局长这一独特的历史职业背景，探究了女性友好型职业对就业的影响。与许多通过制度性规定阻止已婚女性进入的职业不同，邮政局长职位对已婚女性开放，并提供灵活的工作安排与同工同酬。基于邮政局长任命记录与人口普查关联数据构建的新数据集，本研究发现：邮政局长职位吸引了此前未从事有酬工作的合格女性。然而，该职业除任期内的权益外，几乎未为女性提供长期职业发展优势。利用邮政局长由总统任命、且总统所属政党更迭后极少获得连任的制度特征，本文采用断点回归设计（RD），比较了1933年总统权力交接前后被任命的女性在1940年的就业状况。断点回归估计表明，女性在结束邮政局长任期后，有酬就业率下降26.7个百分点。这一负面就业效应仅存在于女性群体，在相同条件下任命的男性并未出现类似现象。此外，研究显示，尽管拥有工作经验，女性邮政局长与其从未担任该职位的女性邻居相比，就业概率并未更高。女性未来就业缺乏职业红利的部分原因，可归因于各州对已婚女性就业的歧视政策以及大萧条时期的严重经济冲击。
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101775.title: The effect of a woman-friendly occupation on employment: U.S. postmasters before World War II
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101775.title_zh: 女性友好职业对就业的影响：二战前美国邮政局长

10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101776.abstract: How reliable is historical microdata? Understanding historical labor force participation is crucial for assessing long-term trends in economic development and intergenerational mobility. Most existing historical studies are, however, limited to men, and little is known about how reliable quantitative historical sources are when studying labor market outcomes for women. This paper documents that the measurement of women’s economic activity in the 1910 Norwegian population census had a high level of consistency. There is extensive discussion of measurement issues in historical census reports, micro data can reproduce historical census tables with a high degree of accuracy, and other contemporary reports such as industrial censuses and tax statistics confirm the results found in the census. In addition, a double-enumeration feature of the Norwegian census is leveraged to assess consistency between enumerators, finding no indication that precision in the occupational classification of women is any lower than for men. Some potential sources of downward bias are found in the historical census microdata set provided by IPUMS. Based on the results in this paper, historical census data appears well suited to study economic activity using modern econometric methods, for women as well as men. A slight upward revision of the 39% female labor force participation in Norway in 1910 might be in order.
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101776.abstract_zh: 历史微观数据的可靠性如何？理解历史劳动力参与率对于评估经济发展和代际流动的长期趋势至关重要。然而，现有的大多数历史研究仅限于男性，关于定量历史资料在研究女性劳动力市场结果时的可靠性知之甚少。本文记录了1910年挪威人口普查中女性经济活动测量的高度一致性。历史普查报告中对测量问题有广泛讨论，微观数据能够高度准确地重现历史普查表格，而其他当代报告如工业普查和税收统计也证实了普查中的结果。此外，利用挪威普查的双重登记特性来评估普查员之间的一致性，未发现女性职业分类的精确度低于男性的迹象。在IPUMS提供的历史普查微观数据集中发现了一些潜在的下行偏差来源。基于本文的结果，历史普查数据似乎非常适合使用现代计量经济学方法研究经济活动，无论是对女性还是男性。对1910年挪威39%的女性劳动力参与率进行轻微上调可能是合适的。

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105415.abstract: Transactions such as kidney sales or surrogacy often evoke repugnance among unaffected observers (spectators). We examine whether individuals directly involved in these transactions (stakeholders) are more accepting. In our lab experiment featuring a transaction with severe consequences and limited agency for the vulnerable party, spectators and vulnerable stakeholders largely deem it repugnant, whereas advantaged stakeholders (who have the right to make offers) are less likely to prohibit it. Spectators and vulnerable stakeholders differentiate between mild and severe outcomes, while advantaged stakeholders are accepting in both cases. All groups are more prohibitive when agency is lacking. Overall, spectators mostly align with the vulnerable, while advantaged stakeholders view the transactions more favorably.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105415.abstract_zh: 诸如肾脏买卖或代孕等交易，往往会在未受影响的旁观者（旁观者）中引发反感。我们考察了直接参与这些交易的个人（利益相关者）是否更为接受。在我们的实验室实验中，涉及后果严重且弱势方代理权有限的交易，旁观者和弱势利益相关者大多认为其令人反感，而优势利益相关者（拥有提出要约权利的一方）则较少倾向于禁止。旁观者和弱势利益相关者会区分轻微与严重后果，而优势利益相关者在两种情况下均持接受态度。当缺乏代理权时，所有群体都更倾向于禁止。总体而言，旁观者主要与弱势方立场一致，而优势利益相关者则对交易持更为积极的态度。

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105418.abstract: Variations in the low- and high-frequency components of temperature may have distinct impacts on economic outcomes. Parametric and non-parametric estimates from three panels of data all find significant heterogeneity in the relative importance of the two components, but there is clear evidence in each panel of a common, slowly evolving low-frequency factor that is highly correlated with the low-frequency factor of economic activity. In regressions that quantify the output effects of the components, we find that one-way clustered standard errors often lead to size distortions, and that an additive fixed effect specification does not adequately control for common time effects. Using bootstrap inference to assess estimates from our preferred interactive fixed effect specification, we only find a marginally significant effect of the high-frequency component on growth in the U.S. panel. However, the effect of the low-frequency component is significant in the European and International panels, suggesting that the increase in the low-frequency temperature component over the post-1980 period is associated with a reduction in economic growth of approximately 1.3 percentage points. The findings are corroborated by time series estimation using data at the unit and national levels.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105418.abstract_zh: 温度的低频与高频成分变化可能对经济产出产生不同影响。基于三组面板数据的参数与非参数估计均发现，这两种成分的相对重要性存在显著异质性，但每组数据中均清晰显示出一个共同的、缓慢演变低频因子，该因子与经济活动的低频因子高度相关。在量化各成分对产出影响的回归分析中，我们发现单向聚类标准误常导致规模失真，且加性固定效应模型未能充分控制共同时间效应。采用自助法推断评估我们偏好的交互固定效应模型估计结果时，仅在美国面板中发现高频成分对增长的边际显著效应。然而，在欧洲和国际面板中，低频成分的影响显著，表明1980年后低频温度成分的上升与经济增长率约1.3个百分点的下降相关联。这些发现通过使用单位和国家层面数据的时间序列估计得到了进一步证实。

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105422.abstract: In this paper, we investigate whether, and to what extent, UK newspapers exhibited image-based bias in their portrayal of politicians during the 2016 Brexit referendum. We use computer vision and machine learning techniques to first, identify the faces of politicians and assess the emotional content conveyed through their expressions and second, to measure the contextual sentiment of the overall image, including elements such as background, objects, and color. Our findings reveal that tabloid newspapers displayed significant partisan bias. Specifically, pro-leave tabloids were more likely to depict pro-leave politicians with positive facial expressions and in more favorable visual contexts, while pro-remain politicians were portrayed more negatively. This bias was especially pronounced in front-page images and those featuring key political figures, while no comparable patterns were found in broadsheets. However, the visual bias diminished immediately after the referendum vote. Our scalable framework not only provides a systematic way to detect visual bias in political imagery but also underscores the growing need for media accountability and visual literacy as images play an increasingly powerful role in shaping political communication.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105422.abstract_zh: 本文探究了2016年英国脱欧公投期间，英国报纸在描绘政治人物时是否存在以及多大程度上存在基于图像的偏见。我们运用计算机视觉与机器学习技术，首先识别政治人物的面部并评估其表情所传达的情感内容，其次衡量整体图像的语境情感，包括背景、物体和色彩等元素。研究结果显示，小报呈现出显著的党派偏见。具体而言，支持脱欧的小报更倾向于以积极的面部表情和更有利的视觉语境描绘支持脱欧的政治人物，而支持留欧的政治人物则被更负面地呈现。这种偏见在头版图像及关键政治人物特写中尤为突出，而大报中未发现类似模式。然而，视觉偏见在公投投票结束后立即减弱。我们提出的可扩展框架不仅为检测政治图像中的视觉偏见提供了系统性方法，也凸显了随着图像在塑造政治传播中日益增强的作用，媒体问责与视觉素养的需求正不断增长。

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105425.abstract: We model the interaction between shareholder trading and voting on firm policies that create externalities for which investors have heterogenous preferences, and we test the model’s equilibrium predictions in the laboratory. The model suggests, and laboratory results confirm, that low policy costs favor policy adoption while intermediate costs lead to a lower policy adoption rate under dispersed preferences than under polarized preferences. Observed share prices are higher than equilibrium predictions when the policy is adopted and are close to the fundamental value of the firm had the policy not been adopted. We conclude that the adoption of costly policies with externalities may be less burdensome to shareholders than predicted.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105425.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个模型，用以分析股东交易与投票在制定具有外部性的公司政策时的相互作用，其中投资者对这些外部性存在异质性偏好，并通过实验室实验检验了模型的均衡预测。模型表明（且实验结果证实）：低政策成本有利于政策采纳，而在中等成本条件下，分散偏好下的政策采纳率低于极化偏好。当政策被采纳时，观察到的股价高于均衡预测值，且接近未采纳政策时公司的基本面价值。我们得出结论：具有外部性的高成本政策对股东的负担可能低于理论预测。

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105427.abstract: New importers increase their conditional survival rate and import share over time. However, a model of multi-input firms with an import entry cost and stochastic import costs cannot replicate these dynamics. I show that an extended model can be reconciled with the data. I calibrate both models and use them to identify the effects of trade shocks. The simulations show that a decrease in import prices with the new importer dynamics generates lower productivity gains, but these gains are more widespread across firms.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105427.abstract_zh: 新进口商的存活率和进口份额随时间推移而提高。然而，一个包含进口进入成本和随机进口成本的多投入企业模型无法复现这些动态特征。本文证明，扩展后的模型能够与数据相吻合。我对两个模型进行了校准，并利用它们识别贸易冲击的影响。模拟结果表明，在新进口商动态特征下，进口价格下降带来的生产率提升幅度较小，但这些提升在企业间的分布更为广泛。

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105432.abstract: Fossil fuels have shaped the European economy since the industrial revolution. We use new long-run panel data to analyse the effect of both, coal and oil on economic growth between 1900 and 2015, exploiting variation at the level of European NUTS2 and NUTS3 regions. We show that the reversal of fortune of coal regions resulted from the second energy transition. Specifically, an “oil invasion” in the early 1960s turned regional coal abundance from a blessing into a curse. Human capital accumulation contributed to this reversal of fortune and fully explains the negative effects until today. Moreover, we find substantial heterogeneity between former coal regions that is in line with Glaeser’s “reinvention hypothesis”: regions with a higher skill-level adjusted much better to the decline of coal. In particular, we show that coal regions with a higher urban density before 1800 were much more resilient than others.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105432.abstract_zh: 自工业革命以来，化石燃料深刻塑造了欧洲经济。我们利用新的长期面板数据，以欧洲NUTS2和NUTS3区域为分析单元，考察了1900年至2015年间煤炭与石油对经济增长的影响。研究表明，煤炭产区的命运逆转源于第二次能源转型。具体而言，20世纪60年代初期的"石油入侵"使区域煤炭禀赋从福音转变为诅咒。人力资本积累促成了这一命运逆转，并完全解释了直至今日的负面效应。此外，我们发现前煤炭产区之间存在显著异质性，这与格莱泽的"再造假说"一致：技能水平较高的区域对煤炭产业衰退的适应能力显著更强。特别值得注意的是，1800年前城市密度较高的煤炭产区展现出远超其他地区的经济韧性。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105432.title: Fickle fossils: Economic growth, coal, and the European oil invasion, 1900–2015
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105432.title_zh: 易变化石：经济增长、煤炭与欧洲石油入侵，1900–2015

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105435.abstract: Climate policy uncertainty (CPU) shocks can induce capital reallocation from carbon-intensive sectors to low-emitting sectors. We first show, using a DSGE model with financial frictions and various climate policy tools, that CPU shocks (i) lower the market value of the “dirty” sector relative to the “green” sector and (ii) reduce real investment in the “dirty” sector relative to the “green” sector. The financial channel plays a key role for this reallocation. Second, we document that these results align with firm-level evidence from the US. We find that empirical CPU shocks (i) cause financial markets to revalue firms in carbon-intensive sectors relative to firms in low-emitting sectors, and (ii) lead to substantial investment reallocation, particularly from manufacturing towards services. 10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105435.abstract_zh: 气候政策不确定性（CPU）冲击可引发资本从碳密集型部门向低排放部门重新配置。我们首先通过构建包含金融摩擦与多种气候政策工具的DSGE模型证明，CPU冲击会（i）降低"高碳"部门相对于"绿色"部门的市值，并（ii）减少"高碳"部门相对于"绿色"部门的实际投资。金融渠道在这一重新配置过程中发挥关键作用。其次，我们证实这些结论与美国企业层面的证据相吻合。实证研究发现，CPU冲击（i）导致金融市场对碳密集型行业企业的估值相对低于低排放行业企业，并（ii）引发显著的投资重新配置，尤其是从制造业向服务业的转移。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105435.title: Capital reallocation under climate policy uncertainty
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105435.title_zh: 气候政策不确定性下的资本再配置

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105436.abstract: Auctions with endogenous rationing have been introduced to stimulate competition. Such (procurement) auctions reduce the volume put out to tender when competition is low. This paper finds a strong negative effect of endogenous rationing on participation when bid-preparation is costly, counteracting the aim to stimulate competition. For multiple auctioneer's objectives mentioned in directives, we derive optimal mechanisms, which differ due to different evaluation of the tradeoff between participation and bid-preparation costs. Thus, the auctioneer needs to decide on an objective. However, reducing bid-preparation costs improves the optimal values of multiple objective functions.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105436.abstract_zh: 内生配给拍卖被引入以刺激竞争。此类（采购）拍卖在竞争不足时会减少招标数量。本文发现，当投标准备成本较高时，内生配给对参与率产生显著的负向效应，这与刺激竞争的目标相悖。针对指令中提及的多种拍卖方目标，我们推导出最优机制，这些机制因对参与率与投标准备成本之间权衡的不同评估而存在差异。因此，拍卖方需要确定一个目标。然而，降低投标准备成本能够改善多个目标函数的最优值。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105436.title: A small volume reduction that melts down the market: Auctions with endogenous rationing
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105436.title_zh: 小规模减量引发市场崩盘：内生配给的拍卖

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105437.abstract: This paper proposes an equilibrium theory of nominal exchange rates, which offers a new perspective on various issues in open economy macroeconomics. The nominal exchange rate and portfolio choices are jointly determined in equilibrium, thus providing a new approach to overcoming the indeterminacy results in Kareken and Wallace (1981). The distinctive features of this theory are that the nominal exchange rate is determined in international financial markets, that the risk premium and UIP deviations are fully endogenous equilibrium objects and that the real exchange rate inherits its properties from the nominal exchange rate. In terms of policy, this novel theory implies that a country with an exchange rate peg and free asset mobility faces a tetralemma and not a trilemma, because it loses not only monetary policy independence but also fiscal policy independence.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105437.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种名义汇率的均衡理论，为开放经济宏观经济学中的诸多问题提供了新视角。名义汇率与资产组合选择在均衡中共同决定，从而为克服卡雷肯与华莱士（1981）中的不确定性结果提供了新途径。该理论的独特之处在于，名义汇率在国际金融市场上确定，风险溢价与未覆盖利率平价偏离均为完全内生的均衡对象，且实际汇率继承了名义汇率的属性。在政策层面，这一新颖理论意味着，实行汇率挂钩且资产自由流动的国家面临的是“四难困境”而非“三难困境”，因为它不仅丧失了货币政策独立性，也丧失了财政政策独立性。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105437.title: An equilibrium theory of nominal exchange rates

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105438.abstract: This paper quantifies the effects of energy price shocks in the euro area and examines the role of ECB monetary policy during the energy crisis. Using a Bayesian VAR identified with sign and narrative restrictions, local projections, and counterfactuals, I show that energy shocks induce persistent and broad-based inflationary pressures while reducing real activity. The pass-through to inflation is state-dependent: it is sizeable and persistent only when inflation is already elevated and when the shock originates from gas and electricity prices. A counterfactual exercise shows that an earlier and more forceful monetary policy tightening would have reduced inflation only at the cost of a sizeable output loss.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105438.abstract_zh: 本文量化了欧元区能源价格冲击的影响，并考察了欧洲央行在能源危机期间的货币政策作用。通过采用基于符号约束与叙事约束识别的贝叶斯向量自回归模型、局部投影法及反事实分析，研究表明能源冲击在抑制实际经济活动的同时，引发了持续且广泛的通胀压力。通胀传导呈现状态依赖性：仅当通胀水平已处于高位且冲击源自天然气与电力价格时，传导效应才显著且持久。反事实模拟显示，若更早实施更强力的货币政策紧缩，虽能降低通胀，但需以显著产出损失为代价。
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105438.title: Energy prices, inflation, and the ECB’s monetary policy during the 2021-22 energy crisis
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105438.title_zh: 能源价格、通胀与2021-22年能源危机期间欧洲央行的货币政策

10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105439.abstract: We estimate the slope of the Phillips curve in the euro area, allowing for nonlinearities—or kinks—in the relationship between labor market slack and inflation. We exploit cross-country variation in labor market conditions in the period 2001–2024, absorbing aggregate shocks and endogenous monetary policy reactions with time fixed effects. We find that, while the Phillips curve is usually quite flat, it becomes at least three times steeper when the labor market is sufficiently tight. This kink is more pronounced in the euro area than in the United States, potentially due to more rigid labor markets. Our estimates suggest, however, that despite this nonlinearity, most of the post-pandemic inflation surge is attributable to factors other than labor market tightness.
10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105439.abstract_zh: 我们估计了欧元区菲利普斯曲线的斜率，并允许劳动力市场松弛与通胀之间的关系存在非线性——即拐点。我们利用2001-2024年期间各国劳动力市场状况的跨国差异，通过时间固定效应吸收了总体冲击和内生性货币政策反应。研究发现，尽管菲利普斯曲线通常较为平坦，但当劳动力市场足够紧张时，其斜率至少会陡峭三倍。这一拐点在欧元区比美国更为显著，可能源于欧元区更为僵化的劳动力市场。然而，我们的估计表明，尽管存在这种非线性特征，疫情后通胀飙升的主要原因并非劳动力市场紧张，而是其他因素。

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103097.abstract: • A comparative MSF study of food policy agenda-setting shaped in a policy network. • Framing food environment issues beyond health increased their agenda status. • Food strategies were more likely with consistent views on the role of municipality. • Perceived paternalism fueled political caution in zoning policy agenda-setting. • Being in a policy network helped place and keep food policies on the agenda. Little is known about the processes through which local food environment policies gain a place on municipal policy agendas. This study examines why some municipalities within the Dutch City Deal: Healthy and Sustainable Food Environment succeed in placing food strategies and food environmental zoning policies on the agenda. Guided by Kingdon’s Multiple Streams Framework (MSF) and informed by interviews with 14 policymakers and policy documents from ten municipalities, we conducted a qualitative comparative case study focusing on agenda-setting windows related to food strategies and zoning policies across ten Dutch municipalities. Six municipalities adopted local food strategies, framing obesity, health inequalities, unsustainable food systems, and economic concerns as public policy problems linked to the food environment. Agenda-setting was enabled by committed politicians, alignment with broader health or sustainability agendas, and consistent views on the government’s role. Four municipalities without local food strategies lacked clear framing or leadership and viewed food policy as politically sensitive. Framing fast-food dominance as a threat to health, liveability, and local businesses enabled zoning policy agenda-setting in four municipalities, while legal uncertainty and paternalism concerns constrained it elsewhere. Successful agenda-setting of municipal food policies depended on strategic framing, linking food environments to broader societal goals and local priorities. Institutionalising ambitions in formal visions and structures reduced reliance on individual policy entrepreneurs. Trans-local policy networks such as the City Deal can strengthen local capacity, learning, and political commitment. Limited municipal resources, concerns about paternalism, and limited guidance for zoning policies constrained agenda-setting.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103097.abstract_zh: • 一项基于政策网络的食物政策议程设置的比较MSF研究。 • 将食物环境问题框定超越健康范畴，提升了其议程地位。 • 对市政府角色看法一致时，更可能制定食物战略。 • 感知到的家长式作风加剧了分区政策议程设置中的政治谨慎。 • 身处政策网络有助于将食物政策纳入并保持在议程上。 关于地方食物环境政策如何在市政政策议程上获得一席之地的过程，目前知之甚少。本研究探讨了荷兰“城市协议：健康与可持续食物环境”中，为何一些市政当局能成功将食物战略和食物环境分区政策纳入议程。以金登的多源流框架（MSF）为指导，结合对14位政策制定者的访谈及十个市政当局的政策文件，我们开展了一项定性比较案例研究，聚焦于十个荷兰市政当局中与食物战略和分区政策相关的议程设置窗口。六个市政当局采纳了地方食物战略，将肥胖、健康不平等、不可持续的食物系统及经济关切框定为与食物环境相关的公共政策问题。议程设置得益于有承诺的政治家、与更广泛的健康或可持续议程的契合，以及对政府角色的一致看法。四个未制定地方食物战略的市政当局缺乏明确的框定或领导力，并将食物政策视为政治敏感议题。将快餐主导地位框定为对健康、宜居性和地方商业的威胁，促进了四个市政当局的分区政策议程设置，而在其他地方，法律不确定性和家长式作风的担忧则制约了此进程。市政食物政策的成功议程设置依赖于战略框定，将食物环境与更广泛的社会目标和地方优先事项联系起来。在正式愿景和结构中制度化雄心，减少了对个体政策企业家的依赖。诸如城市协议等跨地方政策网络可以增强地方能力、学习及政治承诺。有限的市政资源、对家长式作风的担忧以及分区政策指导不足，制约了议程设置。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103097.title: Agenda-setting in local food environment policy: A comparative Multiple Streams Analysis of the City Deal network in the Netherlands
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103097.title_zh: 地方食品环境政策中的议程设置：荷兰城市协议网络的比较多源流分析

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103100.abstract: We investigate how exposure to extreme temperature affects smallholder commercialization. We examine a range of outcomes that indicate the degree of commercialization, including market participation, sales quantity, commercialization index, and sales revenue, which serves as an indicator of monetary benefit. Recognizing the non-separability between production and commercialization, we also examine how extreme temperature directly affects agricultural production. To address these questions, we develop a simple and straightforward theoretical framework that links temperature events to production and market dynamics. From this framework, we derive a set of hypotheses which we proceed to test empirically. Our empirical strategy leverages a comprehensive three-wave panel dataset, which we integrate with earth observation data on temperature extremes. We find that extreme temperatures lead to production losses. We also observe significant declines in market participation among smallholder farmers which could be explained by production shortfalls. This reduction is evident at both the extensive margin (likelihood of participating in markets) and the intensive margin (sales quantity). Furthermore, we observe that when farmers face extreme temperatures, the proportion of harvested crops they sell and the resulting revenue from these also decrease. Causal mediation analysis further confirms that production losses due to extreme temperatures explains the reduction in market outcomes. Overall, these findings highlight the broader economic burden that extreme weather events continue to impose on smallholder households.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103100.abstract_zh: 我们研究了极端温度暴露如何影响小农户的商业化程度。我们考察了一系列反映商业化程度的指标，包括市场参与、销售量、商业化指数以及作为货币收益指标的销售收入。鉴于生产与商业化之间的不可分割性，我们还探讨了极端温度如何直接影响农业生产。为解答这些问题，我们构建了一个简洁明了的理论框架，将温度事件与生产和市场动态联系起来。基于此框架，我们推导出一系列假设，并随后进行实证检验。我们的实证策略利用了一个包含三轮调查的面板数据集，并将其与关于极端温度的地球观测数据相结合。我们发现极端温度导致生产损失。同时，我们观察到小农户的市场参与显著下降，这可由生产短缺来解释。这种减少在广度边际（参与市场的可能性）和强度边际（销售量）上均有所体现。此外，我们还发现，当农户面临极端温度时，其收获作物中出售的比例以及由此产生的收入也相应减少。因果中介分析进一步证实，极端温度导致的生产损失解释了市场结果的下降。总体而言，这些发现凸显了极端天气事件对小农户家庭持续施加的更广泛经济负担。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103100.title: Extreme heat and markets: Theoretical and empirical evidence from Nigeria
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103100.title_zh: 极端高温与市场：来自尼日利亚的理论与实证证据

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103101.abstract: • A representative sample of Italian consumers participated in a Choice Experiment. • Green-Score is more effective than organic at increasing WTP for sustainable food. • The effectiveness of labels varies widely across different food product categories. • Salience nudges increase consumer preference for the Green-Score label. • PDO certification remains the most influential for culturally significant products. The Green-Score label aims to complement established certifications by providing a standardized and easily interpretable assessment of products’ environmental performance. This study examines (i) the relative influence of Green-Score, organic, and Protected Designation of Origin (PDO) certifications on consumers’ willingness to pay (WTP); (ii) how label effectiveness varies across food categories; and (iii) the impact of a salience nudge on consumer choices. A Discrete Choice Experiment was conducted with a nationally representative sample of 1,102 Italian consumers, using a between-subjects design to evaluate the nudge. Results show that PDO labels, leveraging strong institutional credibility and symbolic value, consistently generate the highest marginal WTP (€7.61), especially for culturally and traditionally significant products. Green-Score A+ labels, valued for their diagnosticity and cross-product comparability, achieve an average marginal WTP of €6.25, slightly above organic certification (€4.59), with variation across product categories and treatment conditions. The salience nudge enhances the perceived value of Green-Score, particularly in contexts where environmental performance is salient, and can reduce the marginal contribution of overlapping labels such as organic certification. These findings demonstrate that the effectiveness of sustainability labels depends on both the balance between credibility and diagnosticity and the product-specific context, offering actionable insights for policymakers and stakeholders seeking to design targeted and effective environmental labelling strategies in food markets.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103101.abstract_zh: • 一项以意大利消费者代表性样本为对象的选择实验。 • 在提升可持续食品支付意愿方面，Green-Score比有机认证更有效。 • 标签的有效性在不同食品产品类别间差异显著。 • 显著性助推增加了消费者对Green-Score标签的偏好。 • 对于具有文化意义的产品，PDO认证仍最具影响力。Green-Score标签旨在通过提供标准化且易于理解的产品环境绩效评估，补充现有认证体系。本研究考察了：(i) Green-Score、有机认证和原产地保护认证（PDO）对消费者支付意愿（WTP）的相对影响；(ii) 标签有效性在不同食品类别间的差异；以及(iii) 显著性助推对消费者选择的影响。研究采用离散选择实验，以1,102名意大利消费者的全国代表性样本为对象，并通过受试者间设计评估助推效果。结果表明，PDO标签凭借强大的制度公信力和象征价值，持续产生最高的边际支付意愿（€7.61），尤其对具有文化和传统意义的产品效果显著。Green-Score A+标签因其诊断性和跨产品可比性而受到重视，平均边际支付意愿为€6.25，略高于有机认证（€4.59），且在不同产品类别和处理条件下存在差异。显著性助推增强了Green-Score的感知价值，尤其在环境绩效显著的情境中，并可能降低有机认证等重叠标签的边际贡献。这些发现表明，可持续标签的有效性既取决于公信力与诊断性之间的平衡，也取决于产品特定情境，为政策制定者和利益相关者设计食品市场中针对性且有效的环境标签策略提供了可操作的见解。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103101.title: Consumer preferences for sustainability labels: A comparative analysis of the green-score and other established labels
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103101.title_zh: 消费者对可持续性标签的偏好：绿色评分与其他成熟标签的比较分析

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103102.title_zh: 英国食品标准局关于重组食源性风险监管方式的提案：分析与评述

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103103.title: The impact of post-harvest training interventions on adoption and production behavior: evidence from black pepper farmers in Sri Lanka
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103103.title_zh: 采后培训干预对采用与生产行为的影响：来自斯里兰卡黑胡椒农户的证据

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103104.abstract: National nutrition regulations can shape diets in two distinct ways: directly, through domestic policy mechanisms, and indirectly, by mediating trade flows. This study assesses how trans fat (TF) intake is affected by both pathways. When countries act alone – by banning or limiting TF – their rules often differ in timing, stringency, and enforcement. The resulting regulatory heterogeneity can create loopholes that allow unhealthy products to move across borders. This study estimates the causal effects of TF regulations on its intake nationally by constructing a food-item-level panel dataset for 161 countries (2010–2022, validated with established benchmarks), and applying a staggered difference-in-differences approach combined with mediation analysis. The findings show that strict, enforceable regulations, such as those in the United States and European Union, significantly reduce TF intake and imports, acting as effective filters against TF-rich foods. In contrast, countries with weaker regulations experience rising TF imports and, eventually, increased intake, effectively placing them at risk of becoming “dietary risk havens.” Even modest rules work better when backed by strong monitoring. These results are robust to alternative specifications such as controlling for importer-specific foreign regulatory exposure. The causal evidence demonstrates that unilateral action delivers meaningful health gains, but fragmented regulatory approaches create opportunities for “regulatory dumping.” This study underscores the need for global cooperation – through harmonized standards or trade-linked enforcement – to prevent cross-border displacement of dietary risks. Beyond TF, the findings offer timely insights for emerging national and global mandates on other nutrients, such as salt, sugar, and saturated fats.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103104.abstract_zh: 国家营养法规可通过两种不同途径塑造膳食结构：一是直接通过国内政策机制，二是间接通过调节贸易流动。本研究评估反式脂肪（TF）摄入如何受到这两条路径的影响。当各国单独行动——通过禁止或限制反式脂肪时——其法规在时间、严格程度和执行力度上往往存在差异。由此产生的监管异质性可能造成漏洞，使不健康产品得以跨境流动。本研究通过构建涵盖161个国家（2010—2022年，并经既有基准验证）的食品项目层面面板数据集，并采用交错双重差分法结合中介分析，估计反式脂肪法规对其摄入量的因果效应。研究结果表明，严格且可执行的法规（如美国和欧盟的法规）能显著降低反式脂肪摄入量和进口量，有效充当反式脂肪高含量食品的过滤机制。相比之下，法规较弱的国家反式脂肪进口量持续上升，最终摄入量也随之增加，实际上使其面临成为“膳食风险避风港”的风险。即使力度适中的法规，在有强有力监测支撑时也能发挥更好的效果。这些结果在替代设定下依然稳健，例如控制进口国特定的外国监管暴露。因果证据表明，单边行动能带来实质性的健康收益，但碎片化的监管方式为“监管倾销”创造了机会。本研究强调全球合作的必要性——通过统一标准或贸易关联执法——以防止膳食风险的跨境转移。除反式脂肪外，研究结果还为盐、糖和饱和脂肪等其他营养素的新兴国内及全球监管要求提供了及时启示。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103104.title: Regulatory heterogeneity, trade mediation and nutrient intake: The case of Trans fat
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103104.title_zh: 监管异质性、贸易中介与营养素摄入：以反式脂肪为例

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103105.abstract: • Food policies promote plant-based protein; intake remains far below recommendations. • Supermarkets offer a promising setting to increase plant-based protein consumption. • Studies tested interventions in online and physical retail environments. • Legume sales increased with placement and recipe-based in-store interventions. The protein transition is a crucial element of the transition to sustainable food systems, and both EU and national policies aim to foster the consumption of plant-based proteins. Supermarkets as the primary source of food products in many countries represent a promising environment for translating these policy objectives into practice. With three studies from Denmark, including a representative online survey (n = 838 participants) followed by randomised controlled trials in a real online supermarket in two rounds over 6 weeks (n = 9,093 transactions Round 1; n = 8,706 transactions Round 2) and field experiments in physical brick-and-mortar stores (9 test stores, 13 control stores, 21 days of observation), this research investigates the potential of leveraging behavioural interventions to foster legume purchases in online and offline retail settings. The randomised controlled trials in the online supermarket showed that placement interventions in the vegetable section were effective in increasing sales of legumes by 57%, while placement interventions in the meat section were not effective, suggesting that the strategies known to work for highly processed plant-based meat substitutes cannot be translated to legumes. The field experiments in brick-and-mortar supermarkets confirmed that the vegetable section is a promising intervention point. The multi-layered intervention tested (bundling placement combined with a recipe inspiration poster) significantly increased legume purchases to a similar degree as in the other study. This paper concludes that retailers play a pivotal role in the protein transition; however, their commercial interests may impede the implementation of ambitious in-store interventions promoting legumes, highlighting the need for innovative policy approaches.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103105.abstract_zh: • 食品政策倡导植物蛋白，但摄入量仍远低于建议水平。• 超市为增加植物蛋白消费提供了有前景的环境。• 研究测试了在线及实体零售环境中的干预措施。• 通过摆放位置和食谱式店内干预，豆类销售额有所增加。蛋白质转型是向可持续食品体系过渡的关键要素，欧盟及各国政策均旨在促进植物蛋白的消费。作为许多国家食品的主要来源，超市是将这些政策目标付诸实践的有前景环境。本研究基于丹麦的三项研究，包括一项代表性在线调查（n=838名参与者），随后在真实在线超市进行了两轮为期6周的随机对照试验（第一轮n=9,093笔交易；第二轮n=8,706笔交易），并在实体实体店进行了现场实验（9家测试门店，13家对照门店，观察21天），探讨了利用行为干预在线上和线下零售环境中促进豆类购买的潜力。在线超市的随机对照试验显示，蔬菜区的摆放干预有效使豆类销售额增加了57%，而肉类区的摆放干预则无效，这表明适用于高度加工的植物基肉类替代品的策略不能直接应用于豆类。实体超市的现场实验证实，蔬菜区是一个有前景的干预点。测试的多层次干预（捆绑摆放结合食谱灵感海报）显著增加了豆类购买，其效果与其他研究相似。本文得出结论，零售商在蛋白质转型中扮演关键角色；然而，其商业利益可能阻碍实施促进豆类的雄心勃勃的店内干预措施，这凸显了创新政策方法的必要性。

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103108.abstract: Despite growing enthusiasm about the potential of digital innovations to transform agrifood systems, adoption among smallholder farmers in Africa remains low and heterogeneous. While the proliferation of digital tools targeting smallholder farmers is encouraging, the vast majority remain at pilot stages, facing barriers such as limited awareness among farmer, digital illiteracy, usability challenges, and low trust among farmers. This paper evaluates alternative digital literacy interventions designed to address these demand-side barriers and enhance smallholder farmers’ knowledge, utilization, trust, and uptake of two Egyptian mobile apps offering marketing, advisory, and input delivery services. Following a Training of Trainers (TOT) model, we designed and implemented a randomized controlled trial to test three variants of digital literacy training: standard classroom-based digital literacy training (T1), digital training complemented (preceded) by a video-based play (T2), digital training complemented (preceded) by a live community play (T3), and a control group (C). We find that the different variants of digital training led to statistically significant increases in uptake and utilization of digital tools. Specifically, the standard digital training alone increased uptake by 20 percentage points and utilization by 18 percentage points. The interventions also improved farmers’ trust in digital tools by 8–13 percentage points. Surprisingly, for some outcomes, the digital literacy training alone outperformed the combined approaches that incorporated edutainment nudges. We explore possible explanations, including group size effects and social influence dynamics during the plays. We also document heterogeneity in the impact of these interventions across farmers’ gender and age. Our findings offer insights into designing cost-effective, scalable interventions that build digital capabilities and trust among smallholder farmers, while cautioning against assuming edutainment always strengthens adoption outcomes.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103108.abstract_zh: 尽管数字创新在改造农业食品系统方面的潜力日益受到关注，但非洲小农户的采纳率仍然较低且存在异质性。尽管针对小农户的数字工具数量激增令人鼓舞，但绝大多数仍处于试点阶段，面临诸如农民认知有限、数字素养不足、可用性挑战以及农民信任度低等障碍。本文评估了旨在解决这些需求侧障碍并提升小农户对两款埃及移动应用的知识、使用、信任及采纳情况的替代性数字素养干预措施，这两款应用提供营销、咨询和投入品配送服务。遵循培训培训者（TOT）模式，我们设计并实施了一项随机对照试验，测试三种数字素养培训变体：标准课堂式数字素养培训（T1）、辅以（前置）视频剧情的数字培训（T2）、辅以（前置）现场社区剧情的数字培训（T3），以及对照组（C）。我们发现，不同变体的数字培训均显著提高了数字工具的采纳和使用率。具体而言，仅标准数字培训就将采纳率提高了20个百分点，使用率提高了18个百分点。干预措施还将农民对数字工具的信任度提高了8至13个百分点。令人意外的是，在某些结果上，仅数字素养培训的表现优于结合了寓教于乐助推手段的综合方法。我们探讨了可能的解释，包括群体规模效应和剧情表演期间的社会影响动态。我们还记录了这些干预措施在农民性别和年龄上的影响异质性。我们的发现为设计具有成本效益、可扩展的干预措施提供了见解，这些措施能够建立小农户的数字能力和信任，同时提醒人们不要假设寓教于乐总能增强采纳结果。

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103114.abstract: Food policy often struggles to reach diverse population groups, and well-intentioned interventions can sometimes exacerbate inequalities along socio-demographic groups. This systematic data review examines whether default nudges in food choices have consistent effects across different socio-demographic groups, or whether their impact varies depending on factors such as education level, age, and gender. After selecting eligible studies, authors from 12 studies shared their primary data and were subsequently included in the Default Nudge Research & Data Sharing Consortium (Table A2). These primary data enabled us to analyze 40 interaction effects examining whether age, gender, and education moderate the effectiveness of defaults relative to active choice conditions. Results show no consistent and rarely any interaction effects, suggesting defaults influence food decisions similarly across socio-demographic groups. A possible exception is that harmful defaults may be more effective among less educated individuals. These findings highlight default nudges as a broadly equitable behavioral tool in food policy design.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103114.abstract_zh: 食品政策往往难以覆盖多样化的人群，而意图良好的干预措施有时可能会加剧不同社会人口群体之间的不平等。本系统数据综述旨在探讨食品选择中的默认助推是否在不同社会人口群体间具有一致的效果，还是其影响会因教育水平、年龄和性别等因素而异。在筛选出符合条件的研究后，来自12项研究的作者分享了他们的原始数据，并随后被纳入默认助推研究与数据共享联盟（表A2）。这些原始数据使我们能够分析40个交互效应，以检验年龄、性别和教育是否调节默认选项相对于主动选择条件的有效性。结果显示，交互效应并不一致且极少出现，表明默认选项对社会人口群体的食品决策影响相似。一个可能的例外是，有害默认选项可能在教育程度较低的个体中更为有效。这些发现凸显了默认助推作为食品政策设计中一种广泛公平的行为工具。

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103134.abstract: The Integrated Phase Classification (IPC) is the global standard for analyzing and classifying food insecurity, including famine. While media attention tends to focus on IPC famine analyses, the IPC conducts most of its analyses in non-famine contexts, providing critical assessments of sub-national food insecurity. These analyses guide considerable humanitarian intervention and investment. We argue that IPC analyses are most valuable and effective when users understand the processes, data, and methodological safeguards that underlie and inform IPC findings. We present and discuss seven essential characteristics to clarify IPC operations and interpretation including its analysis framework, consensus-based processes, reporting output interpretation, and famine classification protocols. These seven characteristics are key to the IPC’s capacity to monitor dynamic, overlapping and chronic circumstances of food insecurity. We discuss the strengths and limitations of these characteristics, and we work through implications for interpreting and applying IPC outputs. While our primary objective is to clarify IPC processes, we conclude with a section that is more normative, discussing the IPC’s role and significance in the current global humanitarian system. At a time of significant strain on the humanitarian system and in the face of a loss of practitioner expertise at all levels, a more complete understanding of the IPC’s processes will enhance its utility in an increasingly constrained humanitarian landscape.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103134.abstract_zh: 综合阶段分类（IPC）是全球分析粮食不安全（包括饥荒）的标准。尽管媒体关注往往聚焦于IPC饥荒分析，但IPC在非饥荒情境下进行了大部分分析，提供了对次国家级粮食不安全状况的关键评估。这些分析指导了大量人道主义干预和投资。我们认为，当用户理解支撑并告知IPC发现的过程、数据和方法论保障时，IPC分析最具价值和有效性。我们提出并讨论了七个关键特征，以阐明IPC的操作和解读，包括其分析框架、基于共识的过程、报告输出的解读以及饥荒分类协议。这七个特征对于IPC监测动态、重叠及慢性粮食不安全状况的能力至关重要。我们讨论了这些特征的优势与局限，并探讨了其对解读和应用IPC输出的启示。虽然我们的主要目标是澄清IPC过程，但我们在结尾部分转向更具规范性的讨论，探讨IPC在当前全球人道主义体系中的角色和意义。在人道主义体系面临重大压力、各级从业者专业知识流失之际，更全面地理解IPC过程将增强其在日益受限的人道主义环境中的实用性。
