10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103136.abstract: This paper investigates how the agricultural cycle influences protest behavior in Kenya from 2000 to 2019. Using satellite data to identify the crop cycle and local harvest periods at the lowest available administrative level (wards) and geocoded protest records, we find that protest activity does not decline during the harvest period but increases with a temporal lag. A dynamic difference-in-differences specification shows that protest activity gradually rises in the two to three months following harvest, peaking around the onset of the subsequent agricultural cycle. These patterns are consistent with theories of opportunity costs and seasonal scarcity. While the opportunity costs of protest participation are highest during harvest periods, they decline thereafter and coincide with the lean season, when household food stocks become exhausted. These findings are robust across empirical specifications and contribute to a deeper understanding of the temporal dynamics of unrest in agrarian settings. They also highlight the importance of timing in the design of rural development and conflict prevention policies.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103136.abstract_zh: 本文研究了2000年至2019年间农业周期如何影响肯尼亚的抗议行为。利用卫星数据识别最低行政层级（选区）的作物周期与当地收获期，并结合地理编码的抗议记录，我们发现抗议活动在收获期间并未减少，反而在时间滞后效应下有所增加。动态双重差分模型显示，抗议活动在收获后两至三个月内逐渐上升，并在后续农业周期开始时达到峰值。这些模式与机会成本及季节性稀缺理论相吻合：尽管收获期参与抗议的机会成本最高，但此后机会成本下降，恰逢家庭粮食储备耗尽的淡季。上述发现在不同实证设定中均保持稳健，有助于深化对农业社会动荡时间动态的理解，同时凸显了农村发展与冲突预防政策设计中时机选择的重要性。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103136.title: Predictable patterns of protest: The impact of agricultural cycles on social unrest in Kenya
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103136.title_zh: 可预测的抗议模式：农业周期对肯尼亚社会动荡的影响

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103137.abstract: The ways in which governments legitimize and promote plant-rich eating remain underexplored, particularly in contexts where animal-based foods retain strong cultural and political significance. Focusing primarily on nutritional governance, this study examines the institutional mechanisms through which plant foods and plant-rich practices have been framed as objects of public intervention in Portugal since the inception of the National Program for the Promotion of Healthy Eating in 2012. Adopting a qualitative, discourse-oriented, and semiotically informed approach, the study conceptualizes public intervention as a dispositif that actively shapes meanings and norms around food. Findings show that the legitimization of plant-rich eating relies on strategically cautious discourse emphasizing health, sustainability, and heritage, while avoiding explicit advocacy of vegetarianism. The Mediterranean diet emerges as the primary legitimizing model, enabling plant foods without challenging the centrality of meat and fish. Risk prevention and responsibilization further structure these discourses, framing citizens as self-monitoring consumers. Ultimately, plant-rich eating is cautiously legitimized yet continually negotiated, absorbed into broader narratives of health, sustainability, and national identity. As the first European country to legally require the availability of vegetarian meals in public canteens, Portugal offers insights for other national contexts, particularly regarding discursive strategies, risk-based governance, the symbolic status of animal and plant products, and the role of institutional environments in normalizing plant-rich eating. These findings also resonate with developments elsewhere while highlighting context-specific dynamics.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103137.abstract_zh: 政府如何合法化并推广植物性饮食仍是一个研究不足的领域，尤其是在动物性食品仍具有深厚文化及政治意义的背景下。本研究聚焦营养治理，考察自2012年葡萄牙启动《促进健康饮食国家计划》以来，植物性食品及植物性饮食实践被构建为公共干预对象的制度机制。采用定性、话语导向及符号学分析路径，本研究将公共干预概念化为一个积极塑造食品意义与规范的"装置"。研究发现，植物性饮食的合法化依赖于策略性谨慎话语，强调健康、可持续性与传统遗产，同时避免明确倡导素食主义。地中海饮食模式成为主要的合法化模型，既推广植物性食品又不挑战肉类与鱼类的主导地位。风险预防与责任化进一步构建了这些话语，将公民塑造为自我监控的消费者。最终，植物性饮食虽被谨慎合法化，却持续处于协商状态，被吸纳进健康、可持续性与国家认同的宏大叙事中。作为首个通过法律要求公共食堂提供素食的欧洲国家，葡萄牙为其他国家的实践提供了启示，尤其在话语策略、风险治理、动植物产品的象征地位以及制度环境对植物性饮食常态化的作用方面。这些发现亦与其他地区的发展相呼应，同时凸显了特定情境的动态特征。
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103137.title: Framing plant-rich eating: an analysis of nutritional public policies in Portugal
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103137.title_zh: 构建植物性饮食框架：葡萄牙营养公共政策分析

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103138.abstract: Technology adoption is an important farm management decision and is frequently made using information that is unavailable to the researcher. Aside from their own experiences, producers often rely on extension services to inform their adoption decisions. Here, we propose a novel instrumental variable (IV) approach to identify the effect that a new technology, genetically modified (GM) corn, has on farm yield using instruments constructed from extension information. The proposed approach allows us to explore the degree to which endogeneity bias is present in the GM adoption effect on farm productivity. Candidate instruments are constructed from variety trial data to resemble information acquired by producers from university extension variety trial reports and are spatially merged with on-farm production data. We find that failure to account for the endogeneity of the adoption decision does indeed result in an upward bias in the estimated productivity gains. After correcting for this bias through our IV approach, GM corn results in large on-farm yield gains of 19.6 bushels per acre. We demonstrate that variety trial data can be used to estimate the on-farm impact of new technology, and this approach is general enough to be applied to additional contexts (i.e., technologies, crops, and/or locations).
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103138.abstract_zh: 技术采纳是农场管理中的一项重要决策，且通常基于研究者无法获取的信息进行。除自身经验外，生产者常依赖推广服务来指导其采纳决策。本文提出一种新的工具变量（IV）方法，利用推广信息构建的工具变量，识别转基因玉米这一新技术对农场产量的影响。该方法使我们能够探究转基因采纳效应中内生性偏差对农场生产率影响的程度。候选工具变量基于品种试验数据构建，以模拟生产者从大学推广品种试验报告中获取的信息，并与农场生产数据进行空间匹配。研究发现，若未考虑采纳决策的内生性，确实会导致估计的生产率提升出现向上偏差。通过IV方法纠正这一偏差后，转基因玉米使农场产量实现每英亩19.6蒲式耳的大幅提升。我们证明，品种试验数据可用于估算新技术对农场的影响，且该方法具有足够普适性，可应用于其他情境（如不同技术、作物或地区）。

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103141.abstract: Sustainable public procurement (SPP) is increasingly recognized as a policy tool to improve the environmental performance of food systems, yet there is limited empirical evidence on how procurement strategies influence environmental outcomes. This study assesses the environmental implications of municipal food procurement in a rural Swedish region using life cycle assessment (LCA). Procurement data from Östersund Municipality were used to construct baseline and alternative scenarios that reflect policy targets and objectives, including increased sourcing of organic and local foods, substitution of beef with game or legumes, and reductions in plate waste. Environmental impacts were evaluated using the Impact World + method across multiple indicators, including climate change, eutrophication, biodiversity, toxicity, and resource use. The results show that procurement strategies have differing effects across impact categories. Measures targeting food composition and consumption, such as reducing beef consumption and plate waste, lead to consistent reductions across several indicators, whereas strategies focused on sourcing and production methods, such as organic and local, yield more mixed outcomes, with improvements in some categories but increases in others. Substituting minced beef with local game and reducing food waste result in the largest overall reductions, while increasing organic procurement leads to relatively small changes across most indicators. These findings highlight the importance of multi-indicator assessments and show that focusing on a single indicator, or target, risks overlooking trade-offs. The study provides empirical evidence supporting more targeted, evidence-based procurement strategies and highlights the need for improved life cycle inventory data.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103141.abstract_zh: 可持续公共采购（SPP）日益被视为改善食品系统环境绩效的政策工具，然而关于采购策略如何影响环境结果的实证证据仍然有限。本研究采用生命周期评估（LCA）方法，评估瑞典某农村地区市政食品采购的环境影响。基于厄斯特松德市采购数据，构建了反映政策目标与指标的基准情景与替代情景，包括增加有机食品和本地食品采购、以野味或豆类替代牛肉、以及减少餐盘浪费。采用Impact World+方法，从气候变化、富营养化、生物多样性、毒性和资源利用等多个指标评估环境影响。结果表明，不同采购策略在各影响类别中产生差异化效果。针对食品构成与消费的措施（如减少牛肉消费和餐盘浪费）在多个指标上实现持续减排，而聚焦于采购与生产方式（如有机和本地化）的策略则呈现混合结果——部分指标改善，另一些指标恶化。以本地野味替代碎牛肉和减少食物浪费带来最大整体减排，而增加有机采购在多数指标上仅产生较小变化。这些发现凸显了多指标评估的重要性，并表明仅关注单一指标或目标可能忽视权衡取舍。本研究为制定更具针对性和循证性的采购策略提供了实证支持，并强调改进生命周期清单数据的必要性。

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103143.abstract: Integrated staple food markets are essential for food security in sub-Saharan Africa, where national production is often sufficient but spatial disparities limit access for households in deficit regions. This study examines price connectedness in maize and yam markets across ten major regions in Ghana and assesses how transmission patterns respond to domestic and global shocks. Using monthly wholesale prices from January 2006 to December 2024, we employ a dynamic Quantile Vector Autoregression framework to estimate spillovers across the full distribution of price movements. The results show strong integration in maize markets, with total dynamic connectedness averaging 92 %. Major assembly and transit markets, including Kumasi, Techiman and Bolgatanga, consistently transmit price shocks, while coastal consumption markets such as Accra and Takoradi receive them. Yam markets exhibit weaker and more variable integration, with an average connectedness of 87 % and a more dispersed structure of price leadership across regions. For both commodities, connectedness strengthened during the 2008 food price hikes, whereas connectedness during the COVID-19 period was uneven and volatile. In contrast, political regime changes in 2009 and 2017 do not generate substantial shifts in market connectedness, highlighting the dominant role of structural supply chains and trader coordination over short-term political events. The findings identify regional markets where households face greater exposure to price volatility and highlight the importance of spatially targeted investments in transport, storage and market coordination alongside measures to manage shock transmission and reduce vulnerability to price volatility and unequal food access.
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103143.abstract_zh: 一体化主食市场对于撒哈拉以南非洲的粮食安全至关重要，该地区国家层面的产量往往充足，但空间差异限制了缺粮区域家庭的获取能力。本研究考察了加纳十个主要地区玉米和山药市场的价格关联性，并评估了传导模式如何响应国内及全球冲击。利用2006年1月至2024年12月的月度批发价格数据，我们采用动态分位数向量自回归框架，估计价格变动全分布上的溢出效应。结果显示，玉米市场整合程度较高，总动态关联度平均为92%。主要集散和转运市场，包括库马西、特奇曼和博尔加坦加，持续传导价格冲击，而阿克拉和塔科拉迪等沿海消费市场则接收这些冲击。山药市场表现出较弱且波动较大的整合特征，平均关联度为87%，且区域间价格领导结构更为分散。就两种商品而言，关联度在2008年食品价格飙升期间有所增强，而在COVID-19期间则呈现不均衡且波动的态势。相比之下，2009年和2017年的政治政权更迭并未引发市场关联度的显著变化，凸显了结构性供应链和交易商协调相对于短期政治事件的支配作用。研究结果识别了家庭面临更大价格波动风险的区域市场，并强调了在交通、仓储和市场协调方面进行空间定向投资的重要性，同时需采取措施管理冲击传导，以降低价格波动脆弱性和粮食获取不平等。

10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103145.abstract: There is a need to assess the benefits of government policy to improve the welfare of food animals. We present a holistic, animal-centred welfare assessment method using an expert panel of independent animal welfare scientists linked to a survey of food shoppers’ willingness to pay (WTP) to improve welfare levels, using a 0–100 animal welfare scale. We apply this method to six food animal types in the UK and 15 different topical policy scenarios. We find that several current production systems have welfare scores below 50 but that some of the policy initiatives analysed could increase welfare scores substantially if implemented. We provide valuation tables of people’s WTP to increase welfare scores for each of the six animal types. Marginal WTP was found to diminish as welfare scores increased. WTP values are fully transferable across any policies affecting the animals involved and are not tied to specific production practices or contexts. The UK government has been using the method to evaluate a range of policy options to improve welfare. The method can be applied in other countries. The method enables government policy makers to better make the case for policies to improve the welfare of food animals and its application should lead to an increased likelihood of such policies being implemented. The outputs can also be used to inform consumers regarding the animal welfare provenance of the food they purchase. Previous article in issue Next article in issue
10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103145.abstract_zh: 有必要评估政府政策在改善食用动物福利方面的效益。我们提出了一种整体性、以动物为中心的福利评估方法，该方法采用由独立动物福利科学家组成的专家小组，并结合对食品购物者支付意愿的调查，以0-100的动物福利量表衡量福利水平的改善。我们将此方法应用于英国的六类食用动物及15种不同的热点政策情景。研究发现，当前若干生产系统的福利评分低于50分，但若实施所分析的某些政策举措，福利评分可能大幅提升。我们提供了针对六类动物中每一类，人们为提升福利评分而愿意支付的估值表。研究发现，边际支付意愿随福利评分提高而递减。这些支付意愿值可完全转移至任何影响相关动物的政策，且不依赖于特定的生产实践或背景。英国政府已采用该方法评估一系列旨在改善福利的政策选项。该方法也可应用于其他国家。该方法使政府政策制定者能够更有力地论证改善食用动物福利政策的合理性，其应用应能提高此类政策得以实施的可能性。研究结果还可用于告知消费者其所购食品的动物福利来源。

10.1016/j.geb.2026.07.001.abstract: Large-scale infrastructure investments are often carried out in settings where their eventual usefulness or importance is difficult to predict. This paper studies optimal incentives for investment when the agent undertaking the investment has superior information on two dimensions: the cost of investment and the likelihood it is useful or beneficial to the principal. Usefulness eventually becomes public, but punishments are limited as the regulator aims at ensuring the agent earns non-negative profits in each period. We characterize the optimal incentive scheme and show it involves either: (i) investments by the agent even though he knows they are useless and rents to only cost-efficient types, or (ii) rents to all types. The possibility that rent is left to all types contrasts with the usual prediction in static (and also dynamic) mechanism design and arises even though the agent’s preferences are stable over time.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.07.001.abstract_zh: 大规模基础设施投资往往在其实用性或重要性难以预测的环境中进行。本文研究了当承担投资的代理人在两个维度上拥有信息优势时的最优激励问题：投资成本以及投资对委托人而言有用或有益的可能性。实用性最终会公开，但由于监管者旨在确保代理人每期获得非负利润，惩罚措施受到限制。我们刻画了最优激励方案，并表明其涉及以下两种情况之一：（i）代理人即使知道投资无用仍进行投资，且仅向成本效率高的类型支付租金；或（ii）向所有类型支付租金。向所有类型留下租金的可能性与静态（以及动态）机制设计中的通常预测形成对比，并且即使在代理人偏好随时间保持稳定的情况下也会出现。

10.1016/j.geb.2026.07.001.title_zh: 当成本和需求均为私人信息时的投资监管

10.1016/j.geb.2026.07.003.abstract: We study the diffusion of a true and a false message (misinformation) when agents are biased and able to verify messages. As a recipient of a false message who verifies it becomes informed of the truth, a higher prevalence of misinformation can increase the prevalence of the truth. We uncover conditions such that this happens and discuss policy implications. Specifically, a planner aiming to maximize the prevalence of the truth should allow misinformation to circulate if: non-verified messages may be ignored, transmission of information is relatively low, and the planner's budget to induce verification is neither too low nor too high. Homophily increases the spread of misinformation, but also facilitates diffusion of truth, and leads to similar results on the effect of verification.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.07.003.abstract_zh: 我们研究了当个体存在偏见且能够验证信息时，真实信息与虚假信息（错误信息）的传播机制。当接收虚假信息的个体通过验证获知真相时，错误信息的更高流行度反而可能提升真相的普及程度。我们揭示了此类现象发生的条件，并探讨其政策启示。具体而言，若规划者旨在最大化真相普及度，则应在以下情形允许错误信息传播：未经验证的信息可能被忽略、信息传播效率相对较低、且规划者用于诱导验证的预算既不过低也不过高。同质性虽会加剧错误信息的扩散，但同时也促进真相的传播，并对验证效果产生类似影响。

10.1016/j.geb.2026.07.007.abstract: We extend Kuhn's Theorem to games of the extensive form with unawareness. We prove that if a game of the extensive form with unawareness has perfect recall, then for each mixed strategy there is an equivalent behavior strategy. We show that the converse does not hold under unawareness without restricting the evolution of the player's awareness to constant awareness along paths of play. Both directions of Kuhn's Theorem for games of the extensive form with unawareness require a condition complementary to perfect recall that rules out falsely believing in some events when the player is unaware of the actual past events.
10.1016/j.geb.2026.07.007.abstract_zh: 我们将库恩定理扩展至具有未知性的扩展式博弈。我们证明，若具有未知性的扩展式博弈满足完美回忆条件，则每个混合策略均存在等价的行为策略。研究表明，在不限制玩家沿博弈路径的认知状态保持恒定的情况下，未知性条件下该定理的逆命题不成立。库恩定理在具有未知性的扩展式博弈中的双向成立，均需在完美回忆条件之外补充一个约束条件：当玩家对实际历史事件缺乏认知时，需排除其对某些事件的错误信念。

10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103309.abstract: In the aftermath of the Russian invasion in Ukraine and rising gas prices, the ’gas price brake’, a subsidy scheme for retail consumers and firms, was implemented in Germany. We employ a difference-in-differences approach and analyze data on offered gas contracts from two countries with comparable gas markets, where one country (Germany) has implemented the gas price brake and the other (Austria) has not. We find that the gas price brake led to an increase in total annual gas costs in Germany. This increase is entirely attributable to incumbents increasing counterfactual gas prices by up to 90%. Non-incumbents do not ’milk‘ the brake.

10.1016/j.jce.2026.07.003.abstract: We present global microeconometric evidence on the impact of climate advocacy on hydrocarbon production. We construct two panel data sets by first linking climate activist campaigns to several thousand oil fields, which together account for 72% of global production. Second, we use textual analysis of over 140 million words from 1832 annual reports to compute a measure of activism-induced uncertainty for the corporations that control these oil fields. We find robust evidence that climate activism directly reduced not only oil field productivity but also increased company-level uncertainty. By utilising the ownership links between corporations and their oil fields, we also uncover an indirect mechanism in which the initial activism-induced company uncertainty leads to further productivity losses at the field level. Our findings demonstrate the presence of two pathways through which climate advocacy impacts hydrocarbon extraction.
10.1016/j.jce.2026.07.003.abstract_zh: 我们提供了关于气候倡导对碳氢化合物生产影响的全球微观计量经济学证据。我们首先将气候活动家的运动与数千个油田联系起来，这些油田合计占全球产量的72%，据此构建了两个面板数据集。其次，我们通过对1832份年度报告中超过1.4亿词进行文本分析，计算了控制这些油田的企业所面临的活动引发的确定性指标。我们发现强有力的证据表明，气候倡导不仅直接降低了油田生产率，还增加了企业层面的不确定性。通过利用企业与其油田之间的所有权联系，我们还揭示了一种间接机制，即最初由活动引发的企业不确定性导致油田层面的进一步生产率损失。我们的研究结果表明，气候倡导通过两条途径影响碳氢化合物的开采。

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2006.01.008.abstract: this Paper we argue that the political incentives that resource endowments generate are the key to understanding whether or not they are a curse. We show: (1) politicians tend to over-extract natural resources relative to the efficient extraction path because they discount the future too much; (2) resource booms improve the efficiency of the extraction path; (3) resource booms, however, by raising the value of being in power and by providing politicians with more resources which they can use to influence the outcome of elections, increase resource misallocation in the rest of the economy and (4) the overall impact of resource booms on the economy depends critically on institutions, since these determine the extent to which political incentives map into policy outcomes. Countries with good institutions tend to benefit from resource booms since these institutions mitigate the perverse political incentives that such booms create. Countries with bad institutions suffer a resource curse.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2006.01.008.abstract_zh: 本文认为，资源禀赋所产生的政治激励是理解其是否成为“诅咒”的关键。我们论证：（1）政治家倾向于过度开采自然资源，偏离有效开采路径，因为他们对未来过度折现；（2）资源繁荣会改善开采路径的效率；（3）然而，资源繁荣通过提升执政价值，并为政治家提供更多可用于影响选举结果的资源，加剧了经济其他领域的资源错配；（4）资源繁荣对经济的总体影响关键取决于制度，因为制度决定了政治激励转化为政策结果的程度。制度良好的国家往往能从资源繁荣中受益，因为这些制度缓解了繁荣所引发的扭曲性政治激励。制度不良的国家则会遭受资源诅咒。
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2006.01.008.title: Political Foundations of the Resource Curse

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2025.103629.abstract: We estimate a Choo and Siow (2006b) model using census data to quantify the relative roles of changes in population structure and changes in marital surplus, i.e., the value of marriage. We find that the increase in the supply of educated people explains half of the decline, partly due to a mismatch between highly-educated women and less-educated men. The deterioration of female-to-male ratio, known as marriage squeeze, explains an additional 13% for men. The decrease in surplus accounts for the remainder.

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103840.abstract: This paper investigates the impact of trade liberalization on structural transformation, using quasi-experimental tariff reductions from Brazil's 1990s reforms. Building on recent cross-regional macroeconomic literature, we extend the traditional shift-share framework to estimate both local and spatial spillover effects on sectoral employment shares, providing insights on aggregate outcomes. Regions more exposed to tariff cuts saw declines in manufacturing employment, increases in the primary sector, and reductions in non-tradables. Spillover effects—mediated through migration or proximity—partially offset local deindustrialization in manufacturing but amplified declines in non-tradables. These effects persisted for over twenty years and proved robust to alternative explanations, including competing structural transformation hypotheses and other economic shocks during the period of analysis. Overall, our findings support theories highlighting comparative advantage as a potential driver of trade-induced structural transformation.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103840.abstract_zh: 本文利用巴西1990年代改革中准实验性的关税削减，研究了贸易自由化对结构转型的影响。基于近期跨区域宏观经济文献，我们扩展了传统的转移-份额框架，以估计关税削减对部门就业份额的本地效应和空间溢出效应，从而揭示总体经济结果。关税削减暴露程度更高的地区经历了制造业就业下降、初级部门扩张以及非贸易部门收缩。通过移民或地理邻近性传导的溢出效应，部分抵消了制造业的本地去工业化，但加剧了非贸易部门的收缩。这些效应持续了二十多年，并在替代性解释（包括分析期间的其他经济冲击及竞争性结构转型假说）下依然稳健。总体而言，我们的研究结果支持了强调比较优势作为贸易驱动型结构转型潜在驱动力的理论。

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103852.abstract: We conduct a randomized controlled trial across Kenyan courts to tackle a major source of court delays: adjournments, i.e., postponements of cases to later dates without reaching a resolution. Partnering with the Kenyan Judiciary, we introduce a simple, cost-effective one-page document that outlines the main reasons for adjournments in each court. We test this intervention in two experimental arms: one where the information is shared with judges, and the other where it is shared with both judges and court user committees. Our intervention successfully prevents approximately 20,000 adjournments nationwide, with each adjournment previously delaying cases by an average of 3 months. The acceleration of court proceedings leads to a notable increase in the demand for and utilization of the legal system, increasing the filing of cases as well as citizen trust in the justice system. Our findings demonstrate that tackling the underlying reasons for court delays can substantially enhance both the perceived and actual performance of judicial systems, fostering greater usage and trust in legal institutions. 10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103852.abstract_zh: 我们在肯尼亚各级法院开展了一项随机对照试验，旨在解决导致法院案件积压的主要根源——休庭（即案件未达成裁决而延期审理）。通过与肯尼亚司法机构合作，我们引入了一份简单且成本低廉的单页文件，该文件概述了各法院休庭的主要原因。我们在两个实验组中测试了这一干预措施：一组仅向法官提供信息，另一组则同时向法官和法院用户委员会提供信息。我们的干预措施成功在全国范围内避免了约2万次休庭，而此前每次休庭平均导致案件延迟3个月。诉讼程序的加速显著提升了法律系统的需求与利用率，案件立案数量增加，公民对司法系统的信任度也随之提高。研究结果表明，解决法院延迟的根本原因能够显著提升司法系统的实际效能与公众感知，从而促进法律机构的更广泛使用与信任。

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103859.abstract: Despite decades of reform, early marriage and dowry remain pervasive in rural India. I examine whether women's political representation shifts these practices. I develop a model in which households choose daughters' marriage timing and dowry, facing social penalties for non-marriage. Female leaders, by expanding women's economic opportunities, increase the value of daughters and delay marriage. When social penalties are high, delays raise dowry. I test this using exogenous variation from India's 1992 constitutional amendment, which reserved one-third of village council (pradhan) seats for women. Data from a representative rural survey shows that female pradhans delay marriage by 1.22 years and increase dowry by 68%. A 29% rise in female labor force participation partly explains the delay. Dowry increases are concentrated in patriarchal states, where penalties for non-marriage are most severe. The findings highlight both the potential and the limits of political empowerment in transforming marital norms under binding social constraints.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103859.abstract_zh: 尽管历经数十年改革，童婚与嫁妆在印度农村地区依然普遍存在。本文考察女性政治代表权是否改变了这些习俗。我构建了一个模型，其中家庭在面临未婚的社会惩罚时，会选择女儿的结婚时机与嫁妆。女性领导人通过拓宽女性的经济机会，提升了女儿的价值并推迟了婚龄。当社会惩罚较高时，推迟婚龄会增加嫁妆。我利用印度1992年宪法修正案产生的外生变异进行检验，该修正案将村务委员会（pradhan）席位的三分之一保留给女性。来自代表性农村调查的数据显示，女性pradhan使婚龄推迟了1.22年，并使嫁妆增加了68%。女性劳动力参与率上升29%部分解释了这一推迟现象。嫁妆的增加集中在父权制邦，这些地区对未婚的社会惩罚最为严重。研究结果凸显了在刚性社会约束下，政治赋权在转变婚姻规范方面的潜力与局限。

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103861.abstract: We study the effects of immigration during the Age of Mass Migration (1855–1920) on Brazil’s agricultural development in 1920. Instrumenting for a municipality’s immigrant share using the interaction of aggregate immigrant inflows and the expansion of Brazil’s railway network, we find that a greater share of European immigrants in a municipality led to an increase in farm values. The bulk of the effect was the product of more intense cultivation of land. We also find that it is unlikely that immigration slowed Brazil’s structural transformation. Our results imply that immigration into an emerging agricultural economy can contribute substantially to agricultural development.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103861.abstract_zh: 我们研究了大规模移民时期（1855-1920年）移民对巴西1920年农业发展的影响。利用总移民流入与巴西铁路网络扩张的交互作用作为市政区移民比例的工具变量，我们发现，市政区中欧洲移民比例的增加导致了农场价值的提升。这一效应主要源于土地更密集的耕作。同时，我们也不认为移民减缓了巴西的结构转型。我们的研究结果表明，移民进入一个新兴农业经济体，能显著促进其农业发展。

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103868.abstract: Standard intergenerational measures have been shown to understate the long-run persistence of socioeconomic advantages in developed countries. We study theoretically and empirically whether this pattern extends to less developed settings, using Indonesia as a case study. Using the Indonesian Family Life Survey (IFLS) and Census data, we study multigenerational correlations in education across three generations. Contrary to previous findings, we observe greater multigenerational mobility than parent-child correlations alone would suggest. We develop a theoretical framework to highlight two key factors influencing multigenerational dynamics in developing countries: (1) financial and credit constraints, and (2) cultural norms related to marital sorting. To confirm their relevance, we exploit regional variations in exposure to the 1997-98 Asian financial crisis and in marital customs.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103868.abstract_zh: 标准代际衡量指标已被证明会低估发达国家社会经济优势的长期持续性。我们以印度尼西亚为案例，从理论和实证层面研究这一模式是否同样适用于欠发达地区。通过运用印度尼西亚家庭生活调查（IFLS）及人口普查数据，我们考察了横跨三代人的教育代际相关性。与既有研究发现相反，我们观察到三代人之间的代际流动性高于仅基于亲子两代关联性所呈现的水平。我们构建了一个理论框架，揭示影响发展中国家代际动态的两个关键因素：（1）金融与信贷约束；（2）与婚配选择相关的文化规范。为验证其相关性，我们利用各地区在1997-98年亚洲金融危机中的暴露程度差异以及婚俗差异进行实证分析。

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103869.abstract: Accurate estimates of food and nutrient elasticities are important inputs for the design of efficient policies targeting the poor. In this paper we estimate the expenditure elasticity of food and calories using exogenous variation in budget from two unconditional cash transfer programs in rural Kenya, combined with detailed data on food expenditure, nutrition and prices. We find an elasticity of food expenditure of 0.86 and of calories of 0.66. Although these estimates are higher than those reported in many previous studies — plausibly because our study focuses on extremely poor households — they are significantly lower than those obtained using a non-experimental analysis in our context.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103869.abstract_zh: 准确估计食物和营养弹性是设计针对贫困人口的有效政策的重要依据。本文利用肯尼亚农村地区两项无条件现金转移项目带来的预算外生变化，结合详细的食品支出、营养和价格数据，估算了食品和卡路里的支出弹性。研究发现，食品支出弹性为0.86，卡路里弹性为0.66。尽管这些估计值高于许多先前研究报告的结果——可能因为本研究聚焦于极端贫困家庭——但它们显著低于在本研究情境下通过非实验分析所得出的数值。

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103877.abstract: This paper studies the effects of the Green Revolution, one of the largest development projects in the late 20th-Century, on individualism. We use a difference-in-differences approach to investigate how rapid technological and organizational changes in traditional agriculture reshaped cultural norms in Indonesia, where Green Revolution rollout was largely driven by centralized government interventions. Regions with greater exposure to Green Revolution policies experienced significant and persistent increases in individualism (as measured by a higher prevalence of infrequent names) decades after the end of the program. Results are not driven by pre-trends and hold across a battery of robustness checks. We further document suggestive, correlational evidence of a persistent fall in community funding for public goods, a key measure of collective action. Our findings suggest that technical change can lead to rapid and persistent changes in culture.
10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103877.abstract_zh: 本文研究20世纪末最大规模发展项目之一——绿色革命对个人主义的影响。我们采用双重差分法，探究传统农业中快速的技术与组织变革如何重塑印度尼西亚的文化规范。在该国，绿色革命的推广主要由中央政府干预驱动。研究显示，在项目结束数十年后，受绿色革命政策影响较大的地区，其个人主义（以罕见名字出现频率升高为衡量指标）显著且持续增强。该结果不受事前趋势影响，并通过了一系列稳健性检验。我们进一步发现具有提示性的相关证据：作为集体行动关键指标的公共品社区资金投入持续下降。研究结果表明，技术变革能够引发文化快速且持久的变迁。

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103880.abstract: We study how the Trans-Regional Jurisdiction reform (TRJ) affects corporate investment. The reform moves administrative lawsuits to courts outside the defendant government's home jurisdiction, which limits local government influence over the courts. We use a stacked difference-in-differences design that draws on the staggered rollout of the reform across cities. We find that the reform raises corporate investment by about 28.7 percent of the sample mean. Complementary evidence shows that the reform improves court outcomes for firms, has stronger effects where pre-reform trust in local institutions is higher, and is associated with lower institutional transaction costs and financing constraints. The effect is larger for firms with more irreversible investment, lower state ownership, and better access to finance. The reform also leads firms to acquire more land and take on more risk, although part of the higher investment appears as overinvestment. These results show how a focused judicial reform can change firm behavior where legal institutions are weak.

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103882.abstract: Which countries drive global inequality? Which states drive US inequality? We characterize the class of inequality measures that can answer these questions, permitting both an additive decomposition by subgroup and a multiplicative decomposition into within- and between-group components. Its central measure is simply the expected ratio of incomes between two randomly selected individuals. We show that global inequality fell since 1990, driven by declining disparities between countries. Inequality is primarily driven by large middle-income countries (India, China) and poor countries (Democratic Republic of Congo, Ethiopia). In the US, rising inequality is explained by widening gaps within states, while between-state inequality remains limited.

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107635.abstract: The paper evaluates the impact of the reform of the judicial map on the functioning of Italian civil justice. Implemented between 2013 and 2014, the reform abolished all branch offices and merged several small first-instance courts, substantially increasing the size of judicial districts and the scale at which civil justice services are provided. According to our findings, the reform led to a reduction in the demand for justice, plausibly due to higher access costs associated with increased distances to the courts. This decline was particularly pronounced in case types characterized by greater claimant discretion and lower expected stakes. On the supply side, the reform increased the number of cases resolved and reduced their average duration. These improvements were more pronounced in initially less efficient courts and in more complex case types, which benefited the most from the increased scale and specialization.

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107660.abstract: We study spatial variation in the responses of single mothers to a welfare reform in Australia which reduced the generosity of parenting support payments and increased the taper rates. We estimate the reform’s effect on earned income, using a large administrative dataset and applying regression discontinuity models separately to 87 distinct local labour markets. We can link the local reform effects to local unemployment rates and local wages. In sharp contrast to its objectives, the reform reduced labour earnings for single mothers; the effects were most pronounced in disadvantaged areas with weak labour market conditions. We also find that the reform did not induce migration, despite these costs of staying in place. Welfare reform imposed an extra cost on those living in more disadvantaged areas, and single mothers who cannot relocate bear a disproportionate burden.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107660.abstract_zh: 我们研究了澳大利亚一项福利改革对单亲母亲反应的地区差异，该改革降低了育儿支持金的慷慨程度并提高了边际扣减率。我们利用大型行政数据集，分别对87个不同的地方劳动力市场应用断点回归模型，估计了该改革对劳动收入的影响。我们能够将地方改革效应与地方失业率及地方工资水平联系起来。与改革目标截然相反，该改革减少了单亲母亲的劳动收入；其影响在劳动力市场条件疲弱的弱势地区最为显著。我们还发现，尽管留在原地存在这些代价，改革并未促使人口迁移。福利改革对居住在更弱势地区的人群施加了额外成本，而无法迁移的单亲母亲承担了不成比例的负担。

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107664.abstract: We study the early-life determinants of children’s perseverance and its predictive power for educational attainment and labour market outcomes across the life course. Using teacher-assessed perseverance from the 1970 British Cohort Study we document that cognitive skills, gender, early health, and parental influences (particularly maternal biological factors and paternal education) are the strongest predictors of perseverance at age 10. Perseverance and cognitive skills exhibit distinct yet complementary effects on later outcomes. Perseverance shows strong associations with academic self-perception, internal locus of control, and interpersonal workplace skills such as teamwork, while cognitive skills dominate in technical and numerical domains. We assess the credibility of these associations, by combining Augmented Inverse Propensity Weighting with the framework of Cinelli and Hazlett (2020), quantifying how strong unobserved confounding would need to be to overturn our findings. This analysis reveals that perseverance’s associations with contemporaneous academic performance and locus of control beliefs show strong to moderate robustness. In contrast, associations with educational attainment and labour market outcomes are more fragile. Subgroup analysis reveals that perseverance functions as a compensatory mechanism in the face of childhood adversity, and it reinforces effort beliefs and labour market outcomes for males. Our findings would imply that policies promoting perseverance yield credible benefits for academic engagement and psychological well-being, but long-term economic gains requires interventions addressing educational access, financial barriers and labour market inequality.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107664.abstract_zh: 我们研究了儿童早期坚持性的决定因素及其在生命历程中对教育成就和劳动力市场结果的预测力。利用1970年英国队列研究中教师评估的坚持性，我们记录了认知技能、性别、早期健康以及父母影响（尤其是母亲生物学因素和父亲教育程度）是10岁时坚持性的最强预测因子。坚持性与认知技能在后续结果上表现出独特且互补的效应。坚持性与学术自我认知、内在控制点以及人际工作场所技能（如团队合作）密切相关，而认知技能在技术和数值领域占主导地位。我们通过将增强逆概率加权与Cinelli和Hazlett（2020）的框架相结合，评估了这些关联的可信度，量化了未观测混杂因素需要多强才能推翻我们的发现。分析显示，坚持性与同期学业表现和控制点信念的关联表现出强至中等的稳健性。相比之下，与教育成就和劳动力市场结果的关联则较为脆弱。亚组分析揭示，坚持性在面对童年逆境时起到补偿机制的作用，并强化了男性的努力信念和劳动力市场结果。我们的发现意味着，促进坚持性的政策对学术参与和心理健康产生可信的益处，但长期经济收益需要干预措施来解决教育机会、财务障碍和劳动力市场不平等问题。

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107671.abstract: The metaphor of "pain of paying" has shaped behavioral economics for decades, yet direct evidence that spending money elicits literal pain remains elusive. Building on Camerer et al.'s (2005) neuroeconomic framework, we present converging evidence from two studies demonstrating that payment decisions activate affective pain-processing circuits. In a correlational pilot study, we use fMRI during incentive-compatible purchase decisions to show that activity in the anterior insula—a key region in affective pain processing—correlates parametrically with price magnitude. Critically, we find that paying with money activates affective but not somatosensory pain networks in the brain, whereas paying with electric shocks activates both. In the main study, we establish causality through a novel reverse-placebo paradigm in which participants believed they had taken pain-modulating drugs. Only affective pain enhancing placebos influenced valuation: participants given affective pain “enhancers” exhibited higher willingness to pay than those given affective “relievers,” though neither condition differed significantly from the untreated control. These findings provide the first causal evidence that the pain of paying constitutes a genuine affective experience that shapes economic valuation. We discuss implications for models of consumer choice, mental accounting, and behavioral policy interventions aimed at improving financial decision-making.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107671.abstract_zh: 支付的痛苦”这一隐喻塑造了行为经济学数十年，然而，关于花钱会引发真实疼痛的直接证据仍然难以捉摸。基于Camerer等人（2005年）的神经经济学框架，我们通过两项研究提供了汇聚的证据，表明支付决策会激活情感性疼痛处理回路。在一项相关性预实验中，我们使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）在激励相容的购买决策中显示，前脑岛——情感性疼痛处理的关键区域——的活动与价格幅度呈参数性相关。关键的是，我们发现用金钱支付激活的是大脑中的情感性而非躯体感觉性疼痛网络，而用电击支付则同时激活两者。在主要研究中，我们通过一种新颖的反向安慰剂范式确立了因果关系，在该范式中，参与者相信他们服用了调节疼痛的药物。只有情感性疼痛增强安慰剂影响了估值：接受情感性疼痛“增强剂”的参与者比接受情感性“缓解剂”的参与者表现出更高的支付意愿，尽管这两种情况与未治疗对照组相比均无显著差异。这些发现首次提供了因果证据，表明支付的痛苦构成了一种真实的情感体验，能够塑造经济估值。我们讨论了这些发现对消费者选择模型、心理账户以及旨在改善财务决策的行为政策干预的启示。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107671.title: The affective cost of spending: neuroeconomic and experimental evidence on the pain of paying
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107671.title_zh: 消费的情感成本：关于支付痛苦的神经经济学与实验证据

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107672.abstract: Despite increasingly stringent regulations, there has been a concerning stagnation in reducing workplace fatalities. Can place-based policy targeting help? By coupling machine learning techniques with comprehensive data from Italy, we develop a place-based approach to workplace fatalities. Harnessing accurate machine forecasts, we construct a granular risk map and compare it to the allocation of on-site work inspections and public subsidies for occupational safety, uncovering limited overlap. Counterfactual estimates reveal that current public policies are effective only in areas flagged as high-risk by ex-ante machine predictions. A back-of-the-envelope exercise based on these estimates suggests that machine-learning-based targeting could prevent approximately 70 workplace fatalities per year, equivalent to around 6% of annual deaths, generating substantial social benefits. AI-powered territorial targeting can reduce the incidence and economic burden of this chronic issue while lowering the costs of policy implementation.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107672.abstract_zh: 尽管监管日益严格，工作场所死亡率的降低却出现了令人担忧的停滞。基于地方的政策定向能否有所帮助？通过将机器学习技术与意大利的全面数据相结合，我们开发了一种针对工作场所死亡的地方性方法。利用准确的机器预测，我们构建了一个精细的风险地图，并将其与现场工作检查及职业安全公共补贴的分配进行比较，发现两者重叠有限。反事实估计显示，当前公共政策仅在前瞻性机器预测标记为高风险的区域有效。基于这些估计的粗略计算表明，机器学习驱动的定向策略每年可预防约70起工作场所死亡，约占年死亡人数的6%，产生显著的社会效益。人工智能驱动的地域定向能够减少这一长期问题的发生率与经济负担，同时降低政策实施成本。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107672.title: ‘Dead man working’: A Place-based approach to occupational safety and health
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107672.title_zh: 亡者工作”：基于场所的职业安全与健康研究

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107673.abstract: Promoting green (usually more costly) product consumption is one essential element in building a sustainable society. In times of high inflation, not only budget constraints but also the fear that prices will continue to rise might limit the effectiveness of exerted efforts to promote sustainable behaviors. To test this suggestion, we conducted a Germany-wide survey with almost 1200 respondents, followed by a framed field experiment to confirm causality. Our proxy for green consumption is organic food purchases. Survey respondents’ stated organic purchasing behavior is positively correlated with concerns about climate change but negatively correlated with concerns about inflation. The latter result is driven by individuals with a below-median environmental attitude. In the framed field experiment, we use the priming method to manipulate the saliency of inflation concerns. Whereas sizably relaxing the budget constraint has no impact on the share of organic products in participants’ baskets, the priming significantly decreases the share of organic products for individuals with below-median environmental attitude. Using the same inflation priming in a subsequent survey experiment with around 1800 respondents, we find that high inflationary environments affect both the perception of organic being luxury products and the social norm of buying organic. Both effects are more pronounced for individuals with below-median environmental attitude and, hence, they are the likely mechanisms driving the negative effects on organic product consumption.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107673.abstract_zh: 推广绿色（通常成本更高）产品消费是构建可持续社会的基本要素之一。在高通胀时期，不仅预算约束，而且对价格持续上涨的担忧，都可能限制促进可持续行为所付出努力的有效性。为验证这一观点，我们在德国开展了一项覆盖近1200名受访者的全国性调查，并随后进行了一项框架性实地实验以确认因果关系。我们以有机食品购买作为绿色消费的代理指标。调查受访者所报告的有机购买行为与对气候变化的担忧呈正相关，但与对通胀的担忧呈负相关。后者结果主要由环境态度低于中位数的个体驱动。在框架性实地实验中，我们采用启动方法操纵通胀担忧的显著性。尽管大幅放宽预算约束对参与者购物篮中有机产品的比例没有影响，但启动显著降低了环境态度低于中位数个体中有机产品的比例。在随后一项涉及约1800名受访者的调查实验中，使用相同的通胀启动，我们发现高通胀环境既影响有机产品被视为奢侈品的认知，也影响购买有机产品的社会规范。这两种效应在环境态度低于中位数的个体中更为显著，因此，它们可能是驱动有机产品消费负面效应的潜在机制。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107673.title: Inflation concerns and green product consumption: Evidence from a nationwide survey and a framed field experiment
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107673.title_zh: 通胀担忧与绿色产品消费：基于全国性调查和框架田野实验的证据

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107674.title: Peer institution networks, test-optional admission policies, and STEM major completions
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107674.title_zh: 同行院校网络、可选考试录取政策与STEM专业完成率

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107675.abstract: This paper provides evidence of costly perseverance in the field. In a setting where consultants select and pursue projects autonomously, I show that perseverance, conditional on consistency of interest, is associated with fewer successfully completed projects as well as lower sales and commissions. Using rich firm data on individual job activity, I shed light on the task-specific behavioral mechanisms. Overall, perseverant consultants start fewer projects. In fast markets, the lower number of projects started is the main channel of costly perseverance; in slower markets, costs primarily arise from pursuing projects in a more isolated and uninformed way, as shown by an inefficient allocation of effort between stakeholders. The survey questions driving costly perseverance point to the consultants’ failure to incorporate negative signals and opportunity costs into their effort allocation. Using heterogeneity within and between consultants’ task assignment, I show that perseverance is more costly in exploration tasks as opposed to well-defined tasks characterized by mere exploitation.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107675.abstract_zh: 本文提供了关于“昂贵坚持”在实地环境中的证据。在一个顾问自主选择并追求项目的环境中，我表明，在兴趣一致性条件下，坚持与成功完成项目数量减少以及销售额和佣金降低相关。利用关于个体工作活动的丰富企业数据，我揭示了任务特定行为机制。总体而言，坚持的顾问启动的项目较少。在快速市场中，启动项目数量减少是昂贵坚持的主要渠道；在较慢市场中，成本主要源于以更孤立且信息不足的方式追求项目，这体现在利益相关者之间努力分配的低效上。驱动昂贵坚持的调查问题指向顾问未能将负面信号和机会成本纳入其努力分配中。利用顾问任务分配内部及之间的异质性，我表明，坚持在探索性任务中比在仅需利用的明确任务中成本更高。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107675.title: Running against windmills: Costly perseverance in long- and short-term goal pursuit
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107675.title_zh: 逆风而行：长期与短期目标追求中的高成本坚持

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107676.abstract: This study examines the causal effect of P M 2.5 air pollution exposure on premature mortality in Southern European cities from 2010 to 2018. We leverage local variations in precipitation and wind speed as a source of random variation in P M 2.5 exposure. Using the Two-Sample Two-Stage Least Squares (TS2SLS) estimator to reconcile monitoring station-level and city-level data, our findings reveal a statistically significant increase in premature mortality caused by P M 2.5 . According to our preferred specification, a 1% increase in P M 2.5 causes a 0.82% rise in the under-65 mortality rate and a 0.93% rise in the infant mortality rate. The results are robust to alternative specifications. The most affected populations are those residing in urban areas (relative to suburban areas) and those living in cities located in richer regions (as opposed to poorer ones). We also examine the role of additional pollutants, finding further evidence for the importance of particulate matter.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107676.abstract_zh: 本研究考察了2010年至2018年南欧城市PM2.5空气污染暴露对过早死亡率的因果效应。我们利用降水和风速的局部变化作为PM2.5暴露的随机变异来源。通过采用两样本两阶段最小二乘估计量（TS2SLS）协调监测站点级与城市级数据，研究结果表明PM2.5暴露显著增加了过早死亡率。根据我们的首选模型设定，PM2.5浓度每增加1%，会导致65岁以下死亡率上升0.82%，婴儿死亡率上升0.93%。该结果在替代模型设定下依然稳健。受影响最严重的人群包括城市地区（相对于郊区）居民，以及位于较富裕地区（相对于较贫困地区）城市的居民。我们还考察了其他污染物的作用，进一步证实了颗粒物的重要性。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107676.title: Poisoned air, shortened lives: PM2.5 exposure and premature mortality in Southern European cities
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107676.title_zh: 毒化空气，缩短寿命：PM2.5暴露与南欧城市过早死亡

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107677.abstract: We study whether competition between groups that yields no material rewards fosters within-group cooperation. In a laboratory experiment, pairs of subjects played an indefinitely repeated Prisoner’s Dilemma either in isolation or in a tournament against another pair, where winning conferred no monetary payoff. The competitive environment increased cooperation, and the effect strengthened over time as subjects gained experience. Exploiting the binary action space of the repeated game, we estimate participants’ strategies and find that the tournament reallocates play away from strategies that start with defection toward strategies that start with cooperation. This reallocation results in a shift from Always Defect to the least risky cooperative strategy, Grim. We complement the experiment with a simple tournament-based model that shows how non-monetary competition can shift equilibrium selection toward cooperative strategies.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107677.abstract_zh: 我们研究的是，不产生物质回报的群体间竞争是否能够促进群体内部的合作。在一项实验室实验中，成对的参与者要么在隔离环境中，要么在与另一对进行锦标赛式对抗中，参与无限重复的囚徒困境游戏，其中获胜并不带来金钱收益。竞争环境增强了合作，且随着参与者积累经验，这一效应随时间增强。利用重复博弈的二元行动空间，我们估计了参与者的策略，并发现锦标赛将游戏行为从以背叛开始的策略重新分配至以合作开始的策略。这种重新分配导致从“始终背叛”转向风险最低的合作策略——“冷酷策略”。我们通过一个简单的基于锦标赛的模型补充实验，该模型展示了非金钱竞争如何将均衡选择转向合作策略。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107677.title: Unity through rivalry: How competition mitigates social dilemmas
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107677.title_zh: 竞争中的团结：竞争如何缓解社会困境

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107678.abstract: We study how localized gasoline price shocks affect household consumption by linking high-frequency bank transaction data with station-level fuel prices. A 1% increase in local gasoline prices reduces monthly household spending by approximately 0.13%, even after controlling for national fuel price movements. We identify two mechanisms. First, spending declines are larger among fuel-dependent, low-liquidity households, consistent with a budget-constraint channel. Second, highly visible local price spikes reduce spending even among non-car households, consistent with a price-salience channel. We further show that localized gasoline price shocks amplify consumption inequality: low-income households with high fuel exposure experience the largest reductions, particularly in discretionary spending. Our findings show that localized energy price fluctuations shape household consumption through both financial constraints and behavioral responses to salient price signals.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107678.abstract_zh: 我们通过将高频银行交易数据与加油站级别的燃油价格相关联，研究局部汽油价格冲击如何影响家庭消费。即使控制了全国燃油价格变动，当地汽油价格每上涨1%，每月家庭支出约减少0.13%。我们识别出两种机制。首先，在依赖燃油且流动性低的家庭中，支出下降幅度更大，这与预算约束渠道一致。其次，高度可见的局部价格飙升甚至减少了无车家庭的支出，这与价格显著性渠道相符。我们进一步表明，局部汽油价格冲击加剧了消费不平等：燃油暴露度高的低收入家庭经历最大幅度的支出削减，尤其是在可自由支配支出方面。我们的研究结果显示，局部能源价格波动通过财务约束和对显著价格信号的行为反应，共同塑造家庭消费。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107678.title: Fueling the mind: How local gasoline prices shape household consumption
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107678.title_zh: 燃油心智：地方汽油价格如何影响家庭消费

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107679.abstract: We examine whether preventive health care uptake varies with cultural background related to patience and risk-taking. We combine individual-level survey data on preventive care use from 27 European countries with country-level preference measures from the Global Preferences Survey. To reduce confounding from institutional and economic correlates of culture, we focus on second-generation immigrants, who were born and currently reside in the same country – and thus face the same health care system and broad economic environment – but differ in inherited cultural background through their parents’ countries of origin. We find that respondents from more patient cultural backgrounds are more likely to use preventive services, while those from more risk-tolerant backgrounds are less likely to do so. These patterns appear across multiple preventive care outcomes.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107679.abstract_zh: 本文考察预防性医疗服务的利用是否因与耐心和风险偏好相关的文化背景而异。我们将来自27个欧洲国家的个体层面预防性护理使用调查数据，与全球偏好调查中的国家层面偏好指标相结合。为减少文化与制度、经济因素之间的混杂效应，我们聚焦于第二代移民——他们出生并居住在同一国家，因此面临相同的医疗体系与宏观经济环境，但通过父母的原籍国继承了不同的文化背景。研究发现，来自更具耐心文化背景的受访者更倾向于使用预防性服务，而来自更具风险容忍背景的受访者则较少使用。这一模式在多种预防性护理结果中均得到体现。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107679.title: Cultural origins of preventive health care utilization
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107679.title_zh: 预防性医疗保健利用的文化起源

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107680.title_zh: 对抗性谈判中的承诺与威胁：来自辩诉交易实验的启示

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107681.title: Optimism, complementarity and welfare
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107681.title_zh: 乐观主义、互补性与福利

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107683.title: On migration gravity with status quo bias and job search frictions
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107683.title_zh: 带有现状偏好和工作搜寻摩擦的移民引力模型

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107685.abstract: We study the effect of communication on beliefs, behavior, and efficiency in the context of trust games with a punishment option, which have the structure of hold-up problems. We apply a novel behavioral motivation, frustration-dependent anger, that links unmet payoff expectations with the willingness to forgo material payoffs to punish others, and we conjecture that communication works through this mechanism to raise expectations about the likelihood of belief-dependent costly punishment and to increase trust, cooperation, and efficiency. Promises drive the effect of communication on beliefs and broken promises lead to costly punishment. In an experiment we allow communication in the form of a single pre-play message. We measure beliefs and our design permits the observation of promises and deception. The results are consistent with the theory.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107685.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在具有惩罚选项的信任博弈中，沟通对信念、行为及效率的影响，这类博弈具有敲竹杠问题的结构。我们引入了一种新颖的行为动机——基于挫败感的愤怒，该动机将未实现的收益预期与牺牲物质收益惩罚他人的意愿联系起来，并推测沟通通过这一机制发挥作用，提升对信念依赖性高成本惩罚可能性的预期，从而增强信任、合作与效率。承诺驱动了沟通对信念的影响，而违背承诺则导致高成本惩罚。在实验中，我们允许以单一事前信息的形式进行沟通，测量了信念，并通过实验设计观察了承诺与欺骗行为。实验结果与理论预测一致。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107685.title: Promises and Punishment

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107686.title: Governance, reputation, crises and recovery: An experiment
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107686.title_zh: 治理、声誉、危机与复苏：一项实验研究

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107687.abstract: We analyze the effects of income interdependence between two players on risk sharing without commitment in an infinitely repeated game. In theory, the likelihood that an informal risk-sharing agreement is self-enforcing decreases with income correlation due to a higher probability of both players being in the same income state in future periods. We test this prediction in a laboratory setting, using treatments with negative, zero, and positive income correlation. Contrary to expectations, we find the least engagement in risk-sharing activities in the zero-correlation treatment. This surprising result suggests that when incomes are positively correlated, experiencing similar financial outcomes fosters a social bond that enhances the success of informal risk-sharing mechanisms.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107687.abstract_zh: 我们分析了无限重复博弈中，两位参与者之间的收入相互依赖对无承诺风险分担的影响。理论上，由于未来时期两位参与者处于相同收入状态的概率更高，非正式风险分担协议自我执行的可能性会随着收入相关性的增加而降低。我们在实验室环境中检验了这一预测，采用了负相关、零相关和正相关三种收入相关性处理。与预期相反，我们发现零相关处理中风险分担活动的参与度最低。这一令人惊讶的结果表明，当收入呈正相关时，经历相似的财务结果会促进社会纽带，从而增强非正式风险分担机制的成功率。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107687.title: Income interdependence and informal risk sharing under the shadow of the future
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107687.title_zh: 未来阴影下的收入相互依赖与非正式风险分担

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107688.abstract: We propose a novel game, the Dictatorial Public Goods Game , to study the interplay between collective resource generation and centralized provision of public goods. After making choices in a standard Voluntary Contribution Mechanism (VCM), one player is selected from the group to administrate the contributions: either provide the public good or expropriate the collected resources for personal gain. We find that adding this centralized mechanism reduces efficiency compared to the standard VCM. Although higher contributions increase the material incentive to expropriate, they lead to more provision. Thus, pro-social choices in the contribution and in the provision stages act as complements, reflecting the generation of social capital in the group. Administrators tend to provide more when the statutory default is expropriation rather than provision. This counter status-quo effect is in line with the standard provision-maintenance gap in the literature, but is not explained by the theoretical arguments typically invoked to explain such framing effects.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107688.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新颖的博弈——独裁性公共品博弈，用以研究集体资源生成与公共品集中供给之间的相互作用。在标准自愿贡献机制（VCM）中做出选择后，从群体中选出一名玩家来管理贡献：要么提供公共品，要么将收集的资源据为己有。我们发现，与标准VCM相比，加入这一集中机制会降低效率。尽管更高的贡献增加了侵占的物质激励，但它们反而导致了更多的供给。因此，贡献阶段和供给阶段的亲社会行为互为补充，反映了群体中社会资本的生成。当法定默认设置为侵占而非供给时，管理者倾向于提供更多。这种反现状效应与文献中标准的供给-维护缺口一致，但无法用通常用于解释此类框架效应的理论论点来解释。

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107691.abstract: Some researchers argue that preferences for wealth accumulation contribute to the long-run stagnation of the Japanese economy. One theoretical implication of such preferences, particularly the assumption that the marginal utility of accumulated wealth has a strictly positive lower bound while that of consumption does not, is a widening of wealth inequality. We experimentally test this theoretical prediction by inducing preferences for wealth accumulation in the laboratory. We find partial support for the prediction: wealth inequality widens when initial inequality is large, but not when it is small. This occurs because high-wealth participants tend to overconsume more than low-wealth participants, partly offsetting the effect of induced preferences for wealth accumulation on inequality dynamics. Providing relative wealth-ranking information has only a limited impact on the widening of wealth inequality.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107691.abstract_zh: 一些研究者认为，对财富积累的偏好是导致日本经济长期停滞的原因之一。此类偏好的一个理论含义——特别是假设累积财富的边际效用存在严格正下限而消费的边际效用不存在这一假设——会导致财富不平等扩大。我们通过实验室实验诱导被试产生财富积累偏好，对该理论预测进行检验。结果发现该预测得到部分支持：当初始不平等程度较高时，财富不平等会扩大；但当初始不平等程度较低时则不会。这是因为高财富参与者比低财富参与者更倾向于过度消费，这在一定程度上抵消了诱导的财富积累偏好对不平等动态的影响。提供相对财富排名信息对财富不平等扩大的影响有限。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107691.title: Preferences for wealth accumulation and wealth inequality: Experimental evidence
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107691.title_zh: 财富积累偏好与财富不平等：实验证据

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107696.abstract: This paper proposes a model of tax compliance and fiscal capacity grounded in universalization reasoning. Citizens partially internalize the consequences of concealment by imagining a world in which everyone acted similarly, linking their compliance decisions to the perceived effectiveness of public spending. A selfish elite chooses between public goods and private rents, taking compliance as given. In equilibrium, citizens' moral internalization expands the feasible tax base and induces elites to allocate resources toward provision rather than appropriation. When the value of public spending is uncertain, morality enables credible reform: high-value elites can signal their type through provision, prompting citizens to increase compliance and raising fiscal capacity within the same period. The analysis thus identifies a moral channel through which states may escape low-capacity traps even under weak institutions.
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107696.abstract_zh: 本文提出一个基于普遍化推理的税收遵从与财政能力模型。公民通过想象一个所有人行为相似的世界，部分内化隐瞒行为的后果，从而将自身的税收遵从决策与公共支出的感知有效性联系起来。自私的精英阶层在给定税收遵从水平的情况下，在公共品与私人租金之间进行选择。在均衡状态下，公民的道德内化扩大了可行的税基，并促使精英阶层将资源分配给公共品供给而非私人侵占。当公共支出的价值不确定时，道德因素能够促成可信的改革：高价值精英可以通过提供公共品来传递自身类型信号，促使公民提高税收遵从度，并在同一时期内提升财政能力。因此，本文分析揭示了一条道德渠道——即便在制度薄弱的情况下，国家也可能通过该渠道摆脱低财政能力陷阱。
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107696.title: Universalization and the origins of fiscal capacity
10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107696.title_zh: 财政能力的普遍化与起源

10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107699.abstract: This paper asks whether authors’ ability to manipulate AI referees necessarily undermines peer review, or whether it can sometimes improve it. We model a journal in which authors privately know quality, referees choose between costly manual review and cheap AI delegation, and editors may investigate suspicious recommendations. Hidden prompts can force AI to recommend acceptance, but prompt detection is imperfect. With the baseline referee incentives and sequentially rational, non-committed investigation, manual-only review is unsustainable once AI is available, and there is no robust pure-strategy AI-only equilibrium with manipulation. Most notably, under the welfare criterion studied here, prompt injection can be welfare improving on an open set of primitives: in certain monitoring equilibria, manipulation makes positive AI reports more suspicious or more exposed to audit, induces editor investigation, and helps sustain manual review where prompt-free standard inspection would fail. Stronger prompt detection is, therefore, not unconditionally better; within the focal equilibrium menu, it can eliminate a monitoring regime without replacing it with a higher-welfare one. 10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107699.abstract_zh: 本文探讨作者操纵AI审稿人的能力是否必然损害同行评审，抑或有时能改进评审机制。我们构建了一个期刊模型：作者私下知晓论文质量，审稿人可在高成本人工评审与低成本AI委托之间选择，编辑则可能对可疑推荐展开调查。隐藏提示可强制AI推荐接收，但提示检测并不完美。在基准审稿人激励与序贯理性、非承诺调查条件下，一旦AI可用，纯人工评审便不可持续，且不存在稳健的纯策略AI均衡（含操纵行为）。尤为值得注意的是，在所研究的福利标准下，提示注入可在开集参数上改善福利：在某些监控均衡中，操纵行为使正面AI报告更可疑或更易受审计，促使编辑展开调查，并在无提示的标准审查失效时维持人工评审。因此，更强的提示检测并非无条件更优；在焦点均衡集合内，它可能消除一种监控机制，却未代之以更高福利的机制。

10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.105949.abstract: In this paper we consider the simulation-based Bayesian analysis of stochastic volatility in mean (SVM) models. Extending the highly efficient Markov chain Monte Carlo mixture sampler for the SV model proposed in Kim et al. (1998) and Omori et al. (2007), we develop an accurate approximation of the logarithm of the non-central chi-squared distribution as a mixture of thirty normal distributions . Under this mixture representation, we sample the parameters and latent volatilities in one block. We also detail a correction of the small approximation error by using additional Metropolis–Hastings steps. The proposed method is extended to the SVM model with leverage. The methodology and models are applied to excess holding yields and S&P500 returns in empirical studies, and the SVM models are shown to outperform other volatility models based on marginal likelihoods.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.105949.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了基于模拟的贝叶斯分析在随机波动率均值（SVM）模型中的应用。通过扩展Kim等人（1998）及Omori等人（2007）提出的针对SV模型的高效马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛混合抽样方法，我们开发了一种精确近似非中心卡方分布对数的方法，将其表示为三十个正态分布的混合形式。在此混合表示下，我们实现了参数与潜在波动率的联合分块抽样。同时，我们详细阐述了通过附加Metropolis-Hastings步骤来修正微小近似误差的方法，并将所提方法扩展至包含杠杆效应的SVM模型。在实证研究中，我们将该方法与模型应用于超额持有收益率及标普500指数收益率，结果表明基于边际似然比较，SVM模型优于其他波动率模型。

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106276.abstract: The stochastic block model (SBM) has been widely used to analyze network data. Various goodness-of-fit tests have been proposed to assess the adequacy of model structures. To the best of our knowledge, however, none of the existing approaches are applicable for sparse networks in which the connection probability of any two communities is of order log(n)/n, and the number of communities is divergent. To fill this gap, we propose a novel goodness-of-fit test for the stochastic block model. The key idea is to construct statistics by sampling the maximum entry-deviations of the adjacency matrix that the negative impacts of network sparsity are alleviated by the sampling process. We demonstrate theoretically that the proposed test statistic converges to the Type-I extreme value distribution under the null hypothesis regardless of the network structure. Accordingly, it can be applied to both dense and sparse networks. In addition, we obtain the asymptotic power against alternatives. Moreover, we introduce a bootstrap-corrected test statistic to improve the finite sample performance, recommend an augmented test statistic to increase the power, and extend the proposed test to the degree-corrected SBM. Simulation studies and two empirical examples with both dense and sparse networks indicate that the proposed method performs well.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106276.abstract_zh: 随机块模型（SBM）已被广泛用于分析网络数据。为评估模型结构的充分性，已有多种拟合优度检验方法被提出。然而，据我们所知，现有方法均不适用于连接概率为log(n)/n量级且社区数量发散的稀疏网络。为填补这一空白，我们提出了一种针对随机块模型的新型拟合优度检验方法。其核心思想是通过采样邻接矩阵的最大条目偏差来构造统计量，从而通过采样过程减轻网络稀疏性的负面影响。我们从理论上证明，在原假设下，所提出的检验统计量收敛于第一类极值分布，且与网络结构无关。因此，该方法可同时适用于稠密和稀疏网络。此外，我们获得了备择假设下的渐近功效。进一步地，我们引入了一种基于自助法的修正统计量以提升有限样本性能，推荐了一种增强统计量以增加检验功效，并将所提检验扩展至度修正的SBM。模拟研究及两个涵盖稠密与稀疏网络的实证案例表明，所提方法表现良好。

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106297.abstract: This paper studies the introduction of causal conditional heteroskedasticity in noncausal autoregressive (AR) models. We demonstrate that, in this framework, large shocks to the innovation process driving the GARCH error term of a noncausal AR model result in heightened volatility immediately before and after a bubble crash. The non-coincidence of the σ -fields generated by past observations and past values of the GARCH process makes statistical inference nonstandard. In particular, the full quasi-maximum likelihood estimator (QMLE) is generally inconsistent. We investigate the asymptotic properties of three-step weighted least squares estimators of the AR coefficient and the QMLE of the volatility parameters. Our findings are illustrated by Monte Carlo experiments and an empirical application to financial data.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106297.abstract_zh: 本文研究在非因果自回归（AR）模型中引入因果条件异方差性的方法。我们证明，在该框架下，驱动非因果AR模型GARCH误差项的创新过程中的大幅冲击，会导致泡沫崩溃前后波动性显著加剧。由于过去观测值生成的σ域与GARCH过程过去值生成的σ域不重合，统计推断变得非标准。具体而言，完全拟极大似然估计量（QMLE）通常不一致。我们研究了AR系数的三步加权最小二乘估计量以及波动率参数的QMLE的渐近性质。通过蒙特卡洛实验和对金融数据的实证应用，本文验证了上述发现。
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106297.title: Noncausal AR processes driven by causal GARCH volatility
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106297.title_zh: 因果GARCH波动驱动的非因果AR过程

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106298.abstract: Empirical regression discontinuity (RD) studies often include covariates in their specifications to increase the precision of their estimates. In this paper, we propose a novel class of estimators that use such covariate information more efficiently than existing methods and can accommodate many covariates. Our estimators are simple to implement and involve running a standard RD analysis after subtracting a function of the covariates from the original outcome variable. We characterize the function of the covariates that minimizes the asymptotic variance of these estimators. We also show that the conventional RD framework gives rise to a special robustness property which implies that the optimal adjustment function can be estimated flexibly via modern machine learning techniques without affecting the first-order properties of the final RD estimator. We demonstrate our methods' scope for efficiency improvements by reanalyzing data from a large number of recently published empirical studies.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106298.abstract_zh: 实证回归不连续性（RD）研究中通常会在设定中包含协变量，以提高估计的精确度。本文提出了一类新型估计量，相较于现有方法能更高效地利用协变量信息，并可容纳大量协变量。我们的估计量易于实施，只需在从原始结果变量中减去协变量的函数后，进行标准RD分析即可。我们刻画了能使这些估计量渐近方差最小化的协变量函数。同时证明，传统RD框架具有特殊的稳健性特征，这意味着最优调整函数可通过现代机器学习技术灵活估计，而不会影响最终RD估计量的一阶性质。通过重新分析近期大量已发表实证研究的数据，我们展示了该方法在效率提升方面的潜力。

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106302.abstract: This paper presents an inference method for the local average treatment effect (LATE) in the presence of high-dimensional covariates, regardless of the strength of identification. We propose an orthogonalized Anderson-Rubin test statistic that maintains uniformly valid asymptotic size. We provide an easy-to-implement algorithm for inferring the high-dimensional LATE by inverting our test statistic and employing the double/debiased machine learning method. Simulation results show that our test achieves better size control under both weak identification and high dimensionality, outperforming conventional alternatives. Applying the proposed method to railroad and population data to study the effect of railroad access on urban population growth, we observe wider confidence intervals than those obtained using conventional methods.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106302.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种在高维协变量存在下，无论识别强度如何，对局部平均处理效应（LATE）进行推断的方法。我们构建了一个正交化的安德森-鲁宾检验统计量，该统计量能保持均匀有效的渐近规模。通过反转该检验统计量并采用双重/去偏机器学习方法，我们提供了一种易于实现的算法来推断高维LATE。模拟结果表明，在弱识别和高维性条件下，我们的检验在规模控制方面优于传统替代方法。将所提方法应用于铁路与人口数据以研究铁路通达对城市人口增长的影响时，我们观察到比传统方法更宽的置信区间。

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106304.abstract: In many scenarios, such as the evaluation of place-based policies, potential outcomes are not only dependent upon the unit's own treatment but also its neighbors' treatment. Despite this,"difference-in-differences"(DID) type estimators typically ignore such interference among neighbors. I show in this paper that the canonical DID estimators generally fail to identify interesting causal effects in the presence of neighborhood interference. To incorporate interference structure into DID estimation, I propose doubly robust estimators for the direct average treatment effect on the treated as well as the average spillover effects under a modified parallel trends assumption. I later relax common restrictions in the literature, such as immediate neighborhood interference and correctly specified spillover functions. Moreover, robust inference is discussed based on the asymptotic distribution of the proposed estimators.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106304.abstract_zh: 在许多场景中，例如基于地点的政策评估，潜在结果不仅取决于个体自身的处理状态，还取决于其邻居的处理状态。然而，典型的“双重差分”（DID）类估计量通常忽略了这种邻居间的相互干扰。本文表明，在存在邻居干扰的情况下，经典DID估计量通常无法识别有意义的因果效应。为了将干扰结构纳入DID估计，本文在修正的平行趋势假设下，提出了针对处理组的直接平均处理效应以及平均溢出效应的双重稳健估计量。随后，本文放宽了文献中的常见限制条件，例如直接邻居干扰和正确设定的溢出函数。此外，基于所提估计量的渐近分布，本文讨论了稳健推断方法。

10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106307.abstract: This paper investigates estimation and inference for average treatment effects in completely randomized experiments when researchers observe potentially many covariates. Within Neyman's (1923) design-based framework, allowing the number of covariates to grow more slowly than the sample size, we demonstrate that a cross-fitted regression adjustment estimator--adapted from Aronow and Middleton (2013)--exhibits more favorable asymptotic properties than existing alternatives, such as Lin's (2013) regression adjustment estimator and the bias-corrected estimator of Lei and Ding (2021). For inference, we derive the first- and second-order terms in the stochastic expansions of regression-adjusted estimators, analyze the higher-order behavior of existing inference procedures, and introduce a modified version of the HC3 standard error. The proposed methods extend naturally to stratified experiments with large strata. Simulation studies show that the cross-fitted estimator, in combination with the modified HC3, provides accurate point estimates and reliable size control across a wide range of data-generating processes.
10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106307.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在完全随机化实验中，当研究者观察到可能众多协变量时，平均处理效应的估计与推断问题。在Neyman（1923）的设计框架内，允许协变量数量以慢于样本量的速度增长，我们证明了一种交叉拟合回归调整估计量——改编自Aronow和Middleton（2013）——相较于现有替代方法，如Lin（2013）的回归调整估计量和Lei与Ding（2021）的偏差校正估计量，展现出更优的渐近性质。在推断方面，我们推导了回归调整估计量随机展开中的一阶和二阶项，分析了现有推断程序的高阶行为，并引入了修正版HC3标准误。所提方法自然扩展至具有大层数的分层实验。模拟研究表明，交叉拟合估计量结合修正HC3，在广泛的数据生成过程中提供了精确的点估计和可靠的规模控制。

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105373.abstract: We investigate the sources of heterogeneity in producer and consumer price inflation rates at both industry and aggregate levels. To this end, we develop a dynamic general equilibrium model with a production network, which enables us to disentangle the effects of producer price stickiness and consumer price stickiness in the transmission of sectoral shocks—a distinction often overlooked in theoretical models. We demonstrate that sectoral cost-push shocks and network connectivity are key determinants of the relative volatility between producer and consumer price inflation in the U.S. Furthermore, we quantify how these shocks propagate through cascading adjustments in producer prices, ultimately influencing the aggregate consumer price.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105373.abstract_zh: 我们探究了行业及总体层面上生产者与消费者价格通胀率异质性的来源。为此，我们构建了一个包含生产网络的动态一般均衡模型，该模型使我们能够区分生产者价格粘性与消费者价格粘性在部门冲击传导中的作用——这一区别在理论模型中常被忽视。我们证明，部门成本推动冲击和网络连通性是决定美国生产者与消费者价格通胀相对波动性的关键因素。此外，我们量化了这些冲击如何通过生产者价格的级联调整进行传播，最终影响总体消费者价格。

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105384.abstract: We describe a quantum variational algorithm for securities transactions settlement optimization, based on a novel mathematical formalization of the problem that includes the most relevant constraints considered in the pan-European securities settlement platform TARGET2-Securities. The proposed algorithm is designed for Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum devices, specifically targeting IBM's superconducting qubit machines. We adopt non-linear activation functions to encode inequality constraints in the objective function of the problem, and design customized noise mitigation techniques to alleviate the effect of readout errors. We consider batches of up to 40 trades obtained from real transactional data to benchmark our algorithm on quantum hardware against classical and quantum-inspired solvers.

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105390.abstract: This paper proposes the first methodology for assessing local determinacy in incomplete-markets models. My simple determinacy criterion yields theoretical results and can be verified numerically. It merely requires calculating aggregate marginal propensities to consume (MPC) and aggregate elasticities of asset demand. I find that the policy rules ensuring determinacy can be quite different in incomplete as opposed to complete-markets models. My methodology can thus avoid the current (flawed) practice of referring to complete markets results to assess determinacy in incomplete markets models. The main findings are: If bonds are nominal, the economy is always determinate for a constant nominal interest rate or for price level targeting if prices are sufficiently rigid. The model is indeterminate if fiscal policy is too expansionary, requiring a monetary policy response to reestablish determinacy. If bonds are real, whether or not the Taylor principle induces determinacy depends non-linearly on MPCs, the degree of price rigidities and whether interest rates respond to output. I also find the determinacy properties of active and passive fiscal rules (Leeper, 1991) to be different in incomplete and complete markets models. I explain the shortcomings in Kaplan et al. (2023), which are the reason for their different and thus invalid findings.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105390.abstract_zh: 本文提出了在不完全市场模型中评估局部确定性的首个方法论。这一简洁的确定性准则既能推导出理论结果，也可通过数值方法验证，仅需计算总边际消费倾向（MPC）与总资产需求弹性。研究发现，相较于完全市场模型，不完全市场模型中确保确定性的政策规则可能存在显著差异。因此，本方法论可避免当前（存在缺陷的）将完全市场结论套用于不完全市场模型确定性评估的实践。主要发现如下：若债券为名义债券，在名义利率恒定或价格水平目标制下（当价格具有充分刚性时），经济始终具有确定性；若财政政策过度扩张，模型将出现不确定性，此时需通过货币政策响应重建确定性。若债券为实际债券，泰勒原理能否引发确定性取决于MPC、价格刚性程度及利率是否对产出做出反应的非线性关系。此外，本文发现主动与被动财政规则（Leeper, 1991）在完全市场与不完全市场模型中的确定性特征存在差异，并阐释了Kaplan等（2023）研究中的缺陷——正是这些缺陷导致其结论存在差异且无效。

10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105393.abstract: In this paper, we assess how the stability of financial networks is affected by interconnectedness considering its tiniest variation: the edge. We compute the impact of edges as the percentage difference in the systemic risk (SR) of the whole network caused by the inclusion of that edge. We apply this framework to a thorough Brazilian dataset to compute the impact of bank-firm edges. After observing that (i) edges are heterogeneous regarding their impact on the SR, and (ii) the fraction of edges whose impact on the SR is non-positive increases with the level of the initial shock, we use machine learning techniques to try to predict two variables: the criticality of the edges (defining as critical an edge whose impact on SR is significantly greater than that of the others) and the sign of the edge impact. The level of accuracy obtained in these prediction exercises was very high. These results have important implications for the development macroprudential policies aimed at financial stability. Our framework allows to identify, based on features related to the origin and destination nodes of the edge (i.e., the lending bank and the borrowing firm), whether an additional loan will have a significant and positive impact on the SR.
10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105393.abstract_zh: 本文评估了金融网络稳定性如何受互联性影响，重点关注其最细微的变化：边。我们通过计算某条边加入后对整个网络系统性风险（SR）造成的百分比差异，来衡量该边的影响。我们将这一框架应用于详尽的巴西数据集，以计算银行-企业边的影响。在观察到以下两点后：（i）各边对系统性风险的影响具有异质性；（ii）对系统性风险影响为非正值的边所占比例随初始冲击水平上升而增加，我们运用机器学习技术尝试预测两个变量：边的关键性（将系统性风险影响显著高于其他边的边定义为关键边）以及边影响的符号。这些预测练习的准确度非常高。上述结果对旨在维护金融稳定的宏观审慎政策制定具有重要启示。我们的框架能够基于边起点与终点节点（即贷款银行与借款企业）的相关特征，识别新增贷款是否会对系统性风险产生显著正向影响。

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103314.abstract: In this paper, we study the effects of gasoline content regulations on consumers’ product choices in China. Our empirical design leverages a unique market structure and policy-induced changes in gasoline standards. Using detailed station-level data, we compare sales volumes of gas stations located near city borders before and after one side’s government implements stricter gasoline standards, which raise both the price and quality of gasoline. We find that the relative market share of stations located on the side implementing stricter standards increases, and we recover consumers’ underlying preference for higher fuel quality. Based on the estimated demand, the marginal willingness to pay (MWTP) for the upgrade from China III to China IV gasoline standards is approximately 5.2% of the retail price. Our simulation shows that government subsidies for the upgraded gasoline product create unintended behavioral distortions, which diminish the overall environmental benefits and welfare gains.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103314.abstract_zh: 本文研究了汽油含量监管对中国消费者产品选择的影响。我们的实证设计利用了独特的市场结构和政策引发的汽油标准变化。利用详细的加油站层面数据，我们比较了城市边界两侧加油站在一侧政府实施更严格汽油标准前后的销售量，该标准同时提高了汽油的价格和质量。我们发现，实施更严格标准一侧的加油站的相对市场份额有所增加，并据此恢复了消费者对更高燃油质量的潜在偏好。基于估计的需求，从中国III到中国IV汽油标准升级的边际支付意愿（MWTP）约为零售价格的5.2%。我们的模拟显示，政府对升级汽油产品的补贴造成了非预期的行为扭曲，削弱了整体环境效益和福利收益。

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103325.abstract: This paper analyzes the causal effect of exposure to uncensored environmental reporting on individuals’ environmental preferences and pro-environmental behavior. We exploit a natural experiment occurring in the German Democratic Republic, where geographic characteristics determined access to Western TV. Western media provided information on environmental pollution, a topic censored in East German state media. Using individual-level data from the German Socio-Economic Panel, we find a positive and persistent effect of Western TV exposure on environmental concerns and participation in environmental organizations. Complementing these findings, the analysis of county-level data reveals additional changes in pro-environmental behavior. Specifically, we show that Western TV induced GDR citizens to submit complaint letters on environmental issues to local authorities. Furthermore, regions with Western TV access exhibited stronger electoral support for the Green Party in the first two federal elections of reunified Germany. These results highlight the influential role of mass media in shaping both environmental preferences and corresponding behavior.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103325.abstract_zh: 本文分析了接触未经审查的环境报道对个人环境偏好及亲环境行为的因果效应。我们利用德意志民主共和国发生的一项自然实验，其中地理特征决定了西德电视的接入情况。西方媒体提供了关于环境污染的信息，而这一话题在东德国家媒体中受到审查。利用德国社会经济面板数据的个体层面数据，我们发现西德电视接触对环境关注及参与环保组织具有积极且持久的影响。为补充这些发现，县级数据的分析揭示了亲环境行为的额外变化。具体而言，我们表明西德电视促使东德公民向地方当局提交关于环境问题的投诉信。此外，在统一后德国的前两次联邦选举中，能够接入西德电视的地区表现出对绿党更强的选举支持。这些结果凸显了大众媒体在塑造环境偏好及相应行为方面的关键作用。

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103387.abstract: Food production and consumption account for a third of global greenhouse gas emissions (Crippa et al., 2021) and, therefore, offer a large mitigation potential. Policies such as carbon taxation and carbon labelling can contribute to correcting such externalities by encouraging consumers to substitute away from carbon intensive food products. We employ data from a survey-based, randomized experiment simulating an online supermarket, administered to a representative sample of the UK population. Using a structural demand system based on the Exact Affine Stone Index model with censoring, we estimate the greenhouse gas emission reductions and welfare effects associated with a range of demand-side policy scenarios, combining carbon labelling and carbon taxation. Our results show that the application of carbon labels leads to a 5.60% decrease in the carbon content of the average food basket. A £60 tax per tonne of CO 2 e on the most carbon intensive products would yield a 9.89% reduction in the carbon footprint, while also decreasing consumer welfare by £78.71 per person per year. Respectively, these policies would yield a decrease in emissions corresponding to about 2.7% and 4.7% of the GHG emissions of the UK. Combining carbon taxation and carbon labelling allows to reach the same CO 2 e emissions reduction as the carbon tax, with only a £27.86 tax rate per tonne of CO 2 e, thereby reducing welfare losses to £33.52 per person per year. These findings imply that carbon taxation and carbon labelling can be complementary policies to abate greenhouse gas emissions, while limiting the negative impacts on welfare.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103387.abstract_zh: 食品生产与消费占全球温室气体排放的三分之一（Crippa等，2021），因此具有巨大的减排潜力。碳税和碳标签等政策可通过鼓励消费者减少对碳密集型食品的替代，有助于纠正此类外部性。我们利用一项基于调查的随机实验数据，模拟在线超市，并对英国人口代表性样本进行调查。基于精确仿射斯通指数模型并考虑审查机制的结构性需求系统，我们估算了结合碳标签与碳税的一系列需求侧政策情景下的温室气体减排量及福利效应。结果显示，应用碳标签可使平均食品篮的碳含量降低5.60%。对碳密集型产品征收每吨二氧化碳当量60英镑的税收，将使碳足迹减少9.89%，同时消费者福利每年每人下降78.71英镑。相应地，这些政策将分别使排放量减少约英国温室气体排放的2.7%和4.7%。将碳税与碳标签相结合，可在仅征收每吨二氧化碳当量27.86英镑税率的情况下实现与单独碳税相同的二氧化碳当量减排效果，从而将福利损失降至每年每人33.52英镑。这些发现表明，碳税与碳标签可作为互补政策，在减少温室气体排放的同时，限制对福利的负面影响。

10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103389.abstract: Policymakers frequently implement environmental policies that are less ambitious than what voters would prefer. We document this gap using findings from previous research as well as evidence from climate policy in Austria's transport sector. To account for this pattern, we develop a model in which political parties compete with electoral platforms that involve multiple policy dimensions. When voters place greater weight on a primary issue -such as fiscal policy - than on environmental policy, we show that parties may refrain from proposing environmental reforms, even when these reforms enjoy broad public support. This dynamic arises once the primary issue becomes sufficiently salient to voters. We then examine potential ways to overcome this policy inertia, including the use of direct democratic instruments (e.g., referendums) and the delegation of environmental policy decisions from national to regional governments.
10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103389.abstract_zh: 政策制定者经常实施的环境政策力度低于选民期望的水平。我们利用既有研究成果以及奥地利交通部门气候政策的实证证据，揭示了这一差距。为解释这一现象，我们构建了一个模型，其中政党在涉及多个政策维度的选举纲领中展开竞争。当选民对财政政策等首要议题的重视程度超过环境政策时，研究表明即使环境改革获得广泛公众支持，政党也可能放弃提出相关改革方案。这种动态机制在首要议题对选民具有足够显著重要性时便会显现。随后我们探讨了克服这种政策惯性的潜在路径，包括运用直接民主工具（如公投）以及将环境政策决策权从国家政府下放至地区政府。
