10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108202.abstract: European mountain areas have been historically shaped by traditional pastoral practices, creating culturally, ecologically, and visually valuable traditional landscapes. Over the past decades, these landscapes have faced profound transformations due to the decline of pastoralism and the rapid development of tourism. This paper applies a modified DPSIR framework, referred to as the DRSIR model, to present driving forces, local reactions, landscape state changes, impacts, and responses related to transformations of pastoral landscape in European mountain regions. The aim of this paper is to present a conceptual synthesis of these transformations based on a literature review and structured using the DRSIR framework. The conceptual synthesis enabled the identification of three landscape transformation models: Co-presence, Sequence, and Abandonment. These models reflect varying degrees of interaction between pastoralism and tourism. Co-presence allows for sustainable coexistence or cooperation between traditional pastoralism and tourism which allows the preservation of traditional landscape features. Sequence models illustrate transitions where one function succeeds or suppresses the other, and abandonment reflects the decline of pastoral practices and tourism, often leading to afforestation and loss of landscape and cultural values. The essay highlights landscape consequences of these trajectories. Management responses, guided by legal protection, agri-environmental policies, and sustainable tourism initiatives, can either prevent abandonment or mitigate negative impacts, shaping future landscape scenarios. The DRSIR framework provides a comprehensive lens for understanding these dynamics, supporting spatial planning and landscape management by enabling the identification of dominant relationships between tourism and pastoralism in different mountain regions. Maintaining the evolutionary continuity of traditional landscapes while integrating pastoralism and tourism functions emerges as a key strategy for preserving European mountain landscapes.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108202.abstract_zh: 欧洲山区历史上深受传统牧业实践的影响，形成了具有文化、生态和视觉价值的传统景观。近几十年来，由于牧业衰退和旅游业快速发展，这些景观经历了深刻变革。本文采用改进的DPSIR框架（即DRSIR模型），系统呈现了欧洲山区牧场景观转型相关的驱动力、地方响应、景观状态变化、影响及应对措施。研究旨在基于文献综述，运用DRSIR框架对这些转型进行概念性综合。该概念综合识别出三种景观转型模式：共存模式、序列模式与废弃模式。这些模式反映了牧业与旅游业之间不同程度的互动关系。共存模式允许传统牧业与旅游业实现可持续共存或合作，从而保留传统景观特征；序列模式呈现一种功能取代或抑制另一种功能的过渡过程；废弃模式则反映牧业与旅游业的双重衰退，常导致森林扩张及景观与文化价值的丧失。本文重点阐述了这些发展轨迹的景观后果。在法律保护、农业环境政策及可持续旅游倡议指导下的管理应对措施，既能防止景观废弃，也能减轻负面影响，从而塑造未来景观格局。DRSIR框架为理解这些动态机制提供了全面视角，通过识别不同山区牧业与旅游业之间的主导关系，支持空间规划与景观管理。在整合牧业与旅游功能的同时，维持传统景观的演化连续性，成为保护欧洲山区景观的关键策略。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108202.title: Balancing pastoral heritage and tourism – A DRSIR perspective on landscape transformation in European mountains
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108202.title_zh: 平衡牧区遗产与旅游业——基于DRSIR视角的欧洲山地景观转型研究

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108203.title: Socioeconomic and policy-triggered land use/land cover change in the Alwero Watershed, Gambela Region, Ethiopia
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108203.title_zh: 埃塞俄比亚甘贝拉地区阿尔韦罗流域社会经济与政策驱动的土地利用/土地覆盖变化

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108204.abstract: Dryland afforestation is increasingly deployed as a Nature-based Solution (NbS) for climate mitigation and ecosystem restoration, yet its long-term effectiveness remains uncertain because carbon gains may be offset by biophysical trade-offs and water limitations. Existing assessments rarely integrate carbon sequestration, surface albedo, and climate vulnerability, limiting understanding of how these processes interact to determine restoration outcomes. Here we present the first integrated assessment of large-scale afforestation in the South Aral Sea – a region whose near-complete desiccation may have shifted the area from a carbon sink toward a source of emissions. We evaluate the current carbon pool, surface albedo effects, and climate vulnerability to assess both the potential and inherent limits of dryland afforestation as an NbS. By combining field surveys of saxaul (Haloxylon) shrublands, analysis of land cover change, and six decades of regional climate data, we estimate that the vegetated parts of the South Aral Sea (approximately 1.6 million hectares) store 20.4 million tonnes of carbon (74.7 million tonnes CO₂-equivalent) in soil and vegetation, with a mean carbon density of 12.7 Mg C ha⁻¹ . Albedo analysis reveals strongly context-dependent climate trade-offs: vegetation establishment increases surface reflectivity on former water bodies but decreases it on highly reflective salt pans. Over the past six decades, regional temperatures have increased by approximately 0.5°C per decade (more than twice the global average) while drought intensity has increased markedly since the 1990s. Temperature-adjusted drought indices (SPEI-12) indicate substantially stronger drying trends (R² = 0.55) than precipitation-only indices (SPI-12; R² = 0.03), demonstrating that rising temperatures amplify water stress beyond precipitation changes alone and may constrain the vegetation density that can be sustained over time. Our findings show that afforestation can contribute meaningfully to carbon storage and landscape stabilisation in severely degraded drylands, but its long-term viability as an NbS depends on adaptive management that respects water-limited carrying capacity, incorporates drought-resilient species, and optimises planting density. The integrated framework presented here offers empirical guidance for designing climate-resilient NbS in drylands worldwide, where nearly one-fifth of Earth's land surface faces accelerating degradation by the end of this century.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108204.abstract_zh: 旱地造林作为基于自然的解决方案（NbS）在气候缓解和生态系统恢复中的应用日益广泛，但其长期有效性仍不确定，因为碳收益可能被生物物理权衡和水资源限制所抵消。现有评估很少整合碳固存、地表反照率和气候脆弱性，限制了对这些过程如何相互作用以决定恢复结果的理解。本研究首次对南咸海地区大规模造林进行综合评估——该地区近乎完全干涸可能已使其从碳汇转变为碳排放源。我们评估了当前碳库、地表反照率效应和气候脆弱性，以探究旱地造林作为NbS的潜力与固有局限。通过结合梭梭灌木林实地调查、土地覆被变化分析及六十年区域气候数据，我们估算南咸海植被覆盖区域（约160万公顷）在土壤和植被中储存了2040万吨碳（7470万吨二氧化碳当量），平均碳密度为12.7 Mg C ha⁻¹。反照率分析揭示了强烈依赖情境的气候权衡：植被建立增加了原水体区域的地表反射率，但降低了高反射盐滩的反射率。过去六十年间，区域气温以每十年约0.5°C的速度上升（超过全球平均水平两倍），而自1990年代以来干旱强度显著加剧。经温度调整的干旱指数（SPEI-12）显示比仅基于降水的指数（SPI-12；R²=0.03）更强的干燥趋势（R²=0.55），表明升温加剧了超出降水变化本身的水分胁迫，并可能限制可持续维持的植被密度。研究结果表明，造林可为严重退化旱地的碳储存和景观稳定做出实质性贡献，但其作为NbS的长期可行性取决于尊重水资源承载能力、采用耐旱物种并优化种植密度的适应性管理。本研究所提出的综合框架为全球旱地设计气候适应性NbS提供了经验指导——到本世纪末，全球近五分之一陆地表面正面临加速退化。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108204.title: Greening drylands: The potential and limits of afforestation as a nature-based solution in the Aralkum Desert
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108204.title_zh: 绿化干旱区：咸海沙漠中基于自然的造林方案的潜力与局限

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108205.title: The gendered effects of agricultural practices on land degradation and restoration in two contrasting agro-ecological zones of Cameroon
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108205.title_zh: 喀麦隆两个对比农业生态区中农业实践对土地退化和恢复的性别化影响

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108206.abstract: Local communities are widely blamed for the increasing deforestation in Malawi, primarily due to agricultural expansion and the increased use of biomass energy. Yet, there is limited evidence to understand systemic trade-offs that communities face in their land-use decisions. This study examines the drivers of deforestation in Southern Malawi, focusing on community perceptions and the resource Nexus outcomes related to deforestation. We conducted 25 focus group discussions, 22 key informant interviews, and 271 household interviews across Chikwawa, Blantyre, Mwanza, Mulanje, and Thyolo districts. We also conducted seven expert interviews, facilitated five participatory workshops, and employed ethnographic techniques to gather the lived experiences of community members. The study reveals that (1) socio-economic needs for food, energy and income create a vicious cycle of cropland expansion at the direct expense of forest conservation. (2) Community perceptions identify biomass energy production (index=0.0788) as the main driver of deforestation, followed by cropland expansion (0.0769) and energy poverty (0.0746). (3) The dominance of negative ecological outcomes, followed by economic and political outcomes. The socio-cultural dimension reports the least negative outcomes. Nonetheless, positive outcomes are highest in the socio-cultural dimension, followed by the economic and political dimensions. The least positive outcomes are reported in the ecological dimension. The study empirically shows how community perceptions reshape the Resource Nexus and offers geographically specific policy recommendations. It treats deforestation as both socioeconomic and ecological problem, calling for integrated policies that address livelihood needs and structural drivers in Southern Malawi and similar areas in Sub-Saharan Africa.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108206.abstract_zh: 当地社区被广泛指责为马拉维森林砍伐加剧的主要原因，这主要源于农业扩张和生物质能源使用的增加。然而，关于社区在土地利用决策中面临的系统性权衡，现有证据十分有限。本研究聚焦马拉维南部森林砍伐的驱动因素，重点关注社区认知及与森林砍伐相关的资源纽带结果。我们在奇夸瓦、布兰太尔、姆万扎、穆兰杰和蒂约洛地区开展了25场焦点小组讨论、22次关键知情人访谈和271户家庭访谈。此外，我们还进行了7次专家访谈、组织了5场参与式研讨会，并运用民族志方法收集社区成员的生活经验。研究表明：（1）对食物、能源和收入的社会经济需求形成了耕地扩张的恶性循环，直接牺牲了森林保护；（2）社区认知将生物质能源生产（指数=0.0788）视为森林砍伐的首要驱动因素，其次是耕地扩张（0.0769）和能源贫困（0.0746）；（3）负面生态结果占主导地位，其次是经济和政治结果，而社会文化维度报告的负面结果最少。尽管如此，正面结果在社会文化维度最高，其次是经济和政治维度，生态维度报告的正面结果最少。本研究实证展示了社区认知如何重塑资源纽带，并提出了具有地理针对性的政策建议。它将森林砍伐视为社会经济与生态的双重问题，呼吁采取综合政策应对马拉维南部及撒哈拉以南非洲类似地区的生计需求和结构性驱动因素。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108206.title: Food, fuel, or forest? Interrogating the resource nexus dilemma behind deforestation through community-lived experiences in southern Malawi
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108206.title_zh: 食物、燃料还是森林？通过马拉维南部社区生活经验审视森林砍伐背后的资源关联困境

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108207.abstract: Land rights, important dimensions of land tenure, are crucial for smallholder farmers’ land tenure security and climate change adaptation. However, there are knowledge gaps on the nexus between land rights and climate adaptation in Ghana, particularly from a gendered perspective. This study draws on land right frameworks to explore the nexus between gender, land rights and climate change adaptation among men and women smallholder farmers in rural Ghana. Data were collected through a randomized survey administered to 510 smallholder farmers from four purposively selected communities in the Adansi Asokwa District, and analyzed using descriptive and inferential statistics. The results showed that compared to women, more men own more farmlands (averagely 6.8 vs. 5.4 acres for women), have formal land title deeds, and exercise more land rights, particularly exclusion and alienation rights, enhancing their tenure security. Besides frequency of pest invasion, there is no significant differences in men’s and women’s climate change perceptions and experiences. Farmers used multiple climate adaptation strategies, including planting improved crop varieties, changing planting season, climate information services and agrochemical application. We found a significant difference between men’s and women’s adoption of crop diversification, crop-livestock integration and seed storage. Unlike men’s adaptation strategies, those of women are influenced by the number of rights they exercise and farmland size. Also, perceptions about the raining season and temperature intensity as well as marital status, locality, years of farming experience, access to non-farm livelihood activities and credit significantly influence farmers’ climate change adaptation. Gender differentiated policies and incentives for farmers are needed to enhance tenure security and climate change adaptation.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108207.abstract_zh: 土地权利作为土地制度的重要维度，对小农户的土地权属保障和气候变化适应能力至关重要。然而，关于加纳土地权利与气候适应之间关系的研究仍存在知识空白，尤其是从性别视角切入的分析。本研究基于土地权利理论框架，探讨加纳农村地区男女小农户在性别、土地权利与气候变化适应之间的关联机制。通过对阿丹西阿索夸地区四个定向选取社区的510名小农户进行随机问卷调查，并运用描述性统计与推断性统计分析数据。结果表明：相较于女性，男性拥有更多农田（平均6.8英亩 vs 女性5.4英亩）、持有正式土地所有权证书，并享有更多土地权利（特别是排他权和转让权），从而增强了其土地权属保障。除虫害侵袭频率外，男女农户在气候变化认知与经历方面无显著差异。农户采用多种气候适应策略，包括种植改良作物品种、调整种植季节、利用气候信息服务及施用农用化学品。研究发现，男女农户在作物多样化、种养结合及种子储存方面的采纳行为存在显著差异。与男性适应策略不同，女性农户的适应行为受其行使权利数量及农田面积的影响。此外，对雨季和气温强度的认知、婚姻状况、居住地、务农年限、非农生计活动参与及信贷获取等因素显著影响农户的气候变化适应能力。需制定性别差异化的农户政策与激励措施，以增强土地权属保障和气候变化适应能力。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108207.title: Gender, land rights and climate change adaptation in Ghana: Implications for land tenure, agriculture and rural development
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108207.title_zh: 加纳的性别、土地权利与气候变化适应：对土地权属、农业和农村发展的影响

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108208.abstract: Forests are central to rural livelihoods in Zambia’s Miombo landscapes, providing energy, food, materials, and income. Yet forest-use restrictions may affect households differently depending on market access, enforcement, and livelihood opportunities. This study examines how restricted and non-restricted forest management regimes shape household livelihood strategies in Copperbelt, Eastern, and North-Western provinces. Using survey data from 1115 households, cluster analysis identified forest livelihood strategies, while multinomial logit models estimated adjusted probabilities of strategy membership and associated household drivers. Four strategies were identified: Low-Monetisation Unprocessed Forest Products Dependents, Unprocessed Forest Products Subsistence Diversifiers, Charcoal-Oriented Mixed households, and Charcoal-Cash Specialists. Regime effects varied strongly by province. In Eastern Province, restricted landscapes increased Low-Monetisation dependence by 43.76 %age points and reduced Charcoal-Cash specialisation by 29.94 points. In North-Western Province, restrictions increased Low-Monetisation dependence by 35.11 points but reduced Charcoal-Oriented Mixed strategies by 31.40 points. In the Copperbelt, the pattern differed: restricted landscapes increased Charcoal-Cash specialisation by 9.80 points and Charcoal-Oriented Mixed strategies by 14.26 points, while reducing subsistence diversification by 26.03 points. Household education, gender, livestock ownership, landholding, residence duration, road access, and regime interactions also shaped strategy membership. The findings show that forest-use restrictions do not produce uniform livelihood outcomes. Instead, they operate as context-dependent filters, reinforcing subsistence dependence in some settings while coexisting with charcoal commercialisation in market-integrated landscapes. Effective governance requires spatially differentiated policy mixes combining conservation, enforcement, energy alternatives, tenure clarity, and livelihood support.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108208.abstract_zh: 森林是赞比亚米奥博林地农村生计的核心，提供能源、食物、材料和收入。然而，森林使用限制可能因市场准入、执法力度和生计机会的不同而对家庭产生差异化影响。本研究考察了限制性与非限制性森林管理制度如何塑造铜带省、东部省和西北省的家庭生计策略。基于1115户家庭的调查数据，聚类分析识别出森林生计策略，而多项逻辑模型则估计了策略归属的调整后概率及其相关家庭驱动因素。研究识别出四种策略：低货币化未加工林产品依赖型、未加工林产品生计多样化型、木炭导向混合型以及木炭现金专业化型。制度效应因省份而异。在东部省，限制性景观使低货币化依赖型策略增加43.76个百分点，同时使木炭现金专业化型策略减少29.94个百分点。在西北省，限制性景观使低货币化依赖型策略增加35.11个百分点，但使木炭导向混合型策略减少31.40个百分点。在铜带省，模式有所不同：限制性景观使木炭现金专业化型策略增加9.80个百分点，木炭导向混合型策略增加14.26个百分点，同时使生计多样化型策略减少26.03个百分点。家庭受教育程度、性别、牲畜拥有量、土地持有量、居住时长、道路通达性及制度交互作用也影响策略归属。研究结果表明，森林使用限制并未产生统一的生计结果，而是作为情境依赖的过滤器，在某些环境中强化生计依赖，同时在市场整合的景观中与木炭商业化共存。有效的治理需要结合保护、执法、能源替代、权属明确和生计支持的空间差异化政策组合。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108208.title: Forest livelihood strategies under contrasting management regimes: Evidence from the Copperbelt, Eastern and North-Western Provinces of Zambia
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108208.title_zh: 不同管理机制下的森林生计策略：来自赞比亚铜带省、东部省和西北省的证据

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108209.title: Public green spaces for urban sustainability: A quantitative socio-ecological analysis of impacts in Marrakech, Morocco
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108209.title_zh: 城市可持续性的公共绿地：摩洛哥马拉喀什影响的定量社会生态分析

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108210.abstract: This study analyses the creation of La Réunion National Park (2002–2007) as a strategic and competitive political process embedded within a formal conservation planning framework. Drawing on Evolutionary Governance Theory (EGT), it shows how boundary delineation functioned as a governance instrument that reconfigured power relations between the French state and the Regional Council within a post-colonial, multi-level European outermost context marked by socio-environmental vulnerability and claims for regional autonomy. Combining GIS-based spatial analysis, archival research, and semi-structured interviews, the study traces the co-evolution of actors, institutions, discourses, knowledge, and material instruments throughout the park’s spatial planning process. Results, structured along five EGT analytical axes, indicate that boundary delineation constituted a strategic governance process rather than a purely technical exercise. Environmental planning emerged as a political arena in which power relations between the French state and the Regional Council were renegotiated. Scientific expertise and digital tools played a central role in legitimising decisions. Simultaneously, they contributed to filtering and hierarchising competing territorial claims. Participatory processes were formally inclusive but tightly managed, enabling consultation without substantially altering predefined outcomes and resulting in limited boundary changes. Finally, despite stated autonomy-oriented objectives, environmental planning contributed to the production of new social and spatial inequalities, highlighting the ambivalent role of conservation policies in island governance: ensuring both protection and external territorial control. More broadly, the study demonstrates how conservation planning operates as a governance instrument that shapes and reveals land values and power distribution. These findings suggest that boundary delineation should be explicitly treated as a political and governance instrument, requiring greater transparency, stronger accountability, and more substantive inclusion of local actors to avoid reinforcing existing power asymmetries in spatial planning.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108210.abstract_zh: 本研究分析了留尼汪国家公园（2002–2007年）的创建过程，将其视为嵌入正式保护规划框架中的战略性与竞争性政治进程。基于演化治理理论（EGT），研究揭示了边界划定如何作为一种治理工具，在面临社会-环境脆弱性与区域自治诉求的后殖民、多层级欧洲最外围地区，重构法国国家与地区议会之间的权力关系。通过结合地理信息系统空间分析、档案研究与半结构化访谈，本研究追溯了公园空间规划过程中行动者、制度、话语、知识与物质工具的协同演化。依据EGT五大分析维度呈现的结果表明，边界划定构成了一种战略性治理过程，而非纯粹的技术性操作。环境规划成为法国国家与地区议会重新协商权力关系的政治场域。科学专业知识与数字工具在决策合法化中发挥核心作用，同时亦对相互竞争的领土诉求进行筛选与等级化。参与过程形式上具有包容性，但受到严格管控，允许协商却未实质性改变预设结果，仅导致有限的边界调整。最终，尽管以自治为导向的目标被明确表述，环境规划却催生了新的社会与空间不平等，凸显了保护政策在岛屿治理中的矛盾角色：既确保保护，又强化外部领土控制。更广泛而言，本研究揭示了保护规划如何作为塑造并反映土地价值与权力分配的治理工具。这些发现表明，边界划定应被明确视为政治与治理工具，需要更高的透明度、更强的问责机制以及更实质性的地方行动者参与，以避免在空间规划中强化既有的权力不对称。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108210.title: What boundary delineation reveals about island evolutionary governance: Multi-level power brokerage in Réunion National Park
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108210.title_zh: 边界划定揭示的岛屿演化治理：留尼汪国家公园的多层级权力中介

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108211.abstract: Although the U.S. alcohol industry is a major economic sector, alcohol consumption has long been associated with a wide range of detrimental health, social, and economic outcomes. Simultaneously, increasing land use conflicts and climate change-induced yield reductions are contributing to food insecurity. The purpose of this study is to evaluate a potential approach to addressing both the negative externalities of the alcohol industry and the growing problem of food insecurity by reconsidering agricultural land allocation – specifically, shifting land currently used for alcohol crops towards human food. For this land-use re-allocation, this study develops a new method by determining alcohol-related crop land area, caloric yield, and quantifies human feeding capacity for four scenarios: (i) lives saved by mitigating alcohol-related harms by elimination of alcohol consumption and (ii) additional lives that could be supported through increased caloric availability from food crops grown on the same land for hops, grapes, barley and corn for two scenarios: (iia) ingesting food directly rather than alcohol conversion and (iib) replanting with higher yield food crops. Eliminating U.S. alcohol could prevent an estimated 178,000 deaths/year. These life savings, however, were small compared to the implications for food security. Results showed repurposing (scenario iib) America’s alcohol-dedicated cropland to potato cultivation yields the greatest potential human feeding capacity – an estimated 641.65 million people annually, exceeding the baseline of eating alcohol crops directly by over 50%. Only 2.1% of American alcohol-related crops would need to be converted to eliminate global hunger-related mortality entirely. By making small land use changes to eliminate alcohol consumption in favor of food production, public health policy could eliminate human starvation globally and save millions of lives annually.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108211.abstract_zh: 尽管美国酒精产业是一个重要的经济部门，但酒精消费长期以来与一系列有害的健康、社会和经济后果相关联。同时，日益加剧的土地利用冲突和气候变化引起的产量减少正导致粮食不安全问题。本研究旨在评估一种潜在方法，通过重新考虑农业土地分配——具体而言，将目前用于酒精作物的土地转向人类食物生产——来同时应对酒精产业的负面外部性和日益严重的粮食不安全问题。为此，本研究开发了一种新方法，通过确定与酒精相关的作物土地面积、卡路里产量，并量化四种情景下的人类供养能力：(i) 通过消除酒精消费减轻酒精相关危害而挽救的生命，以及(ii) 通过在同一土地上种植用于啤酒花、葡萄、大麦和玉米的粮食作物增加卡路里供应所能额外支持的生命，分为两种情景：(iia) 直接食用食物而非将其转化为酒精，以及(iib) 重新种植高产粮食作物。消除美国的酒精消费预计每年可防止约178,000人死亡。然而，与对粮食安全的影响相比，这些生命节省相对较小。结果显示，将美国专门用于酒精作物的农田重新用于马铃薯种植（情景iib）能产生最大的人类供养潜力——估计每年可供养6.4165亿人，比直接食用酒精作物的基线情景高出超过50%。仅需将美国与酒精相关作物的2.1%转化为粮食生产，即可完全消除全球与饥饿相关的死亡。通过微小的土地利用调整，以消除酒精消费并转向粮食生产，公共卫生政策可以在全球范围内消除人类饥饿，并每年挽救数百万人的生命。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108211.title: Land use for alcohol production and its implications for food security and public health: A case study of the United States
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108211.title_zh: 酒精生产的土地利用及其对粮食安全和公共健康的影响：以美国为例

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108212.title: Transportation and environmental burdens in affordable housing: Evidence from federal housing programs in the Washington metropolitan area
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108212.title_zh: 经济适用房中的交通与环境负担：来自华盛顿大都市区联邦住房项目的证据

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108213.title: Balancing cultivated land benchmark prices using a method integrating rank adjustment and spatial association
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108213.title_zh: 整合秩调整与空间关联的耕地基准价格平衡方法

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108214.abstract: Agricultural expansion in Ghana continues to drive deforestation, posing a major challenge to balancing food production with forest carbon conservation. While Sustainable Agricultural Intensification (SAI) is widely promoted, its ecological and land use planning implications remain underexplored in policy contexts. This study investigates the trade-offs between agricultural intensification and forest carbon conservation, aiming to identify land use configurations that optimise both productivity and environmental sustainability within Ghana’s national planning framework. Using a 31-year FAOSTAT dataset, a socio-ecological systems approach integrating Random Forest and polynomial regression models was applied to capture non-linear dynamics. A multi-objective optimisation framework was used to derive Pareto-optimal land use allocations under empirical constraints, reflecting real-world policy and adoption limitations. Findings reveal that land use composition – particularly the cropland-pasture balance – has a stronger influence on forest carbon stocks than intensification alone. Low adoption rates of irrigation and organic farming limit their national impact. The optimal land use mix (58.85% cropland, 41.15% pasture, 1% organic, 3.01% irrigated) achieves 92% of a composite objective prioritising productivity (70%) and carbon conservation (30%). These results underscore the need for spatially differentiated land use policies that incorporate zoning, targeted incentives, and coordinated landscape governance. The study shows that the ecological impacts of intensification depend on its scale, type, and socio-ecological context. For policymakers, this highlights the need to move beyond uniform SAI approaches toward spatially targeted strategies that integrate land-use zoning, practice-specific incentives, and coordinated landscape management to balance agricultural productivity with forest conservation.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108214.abstract_zh: 加纳农业扩张持续加剧森林砍伐，对平衡粮食生产与森林碳汇保护构成重大挑战。尽管可持续农业集约化（SAI）被广泛推广，但其生态影响及土地利用规划意义在政策语境中仍未得到充分探讨。本研究探究农业集约化与森林碳汇保护之间的权衡关系，旨在识别在国家规划框架内同时优化生产力与环境可持续性的土地利用配置方案。基于31年FAOSTAT数据集，采用整合随机森林与多项式回归模型的社会-生态系统方法捕捉非线性动态，并运用多目标优化框架在经验约束条件下推导帕累托最优土地利用分配方案，以反映现实政策与采纳限制。研究发现：土地利用构成（尤其是农田-牧场比例）对森林碳储量的影响强于集约化本身；灌溉与有机农业的低采纳率限制了其国家层面影响；最优土地利用组合（58.85%农田、41.15%牧场、1%有机农业、3.01%灌溉面积）可实现优先考虑生产力（70%）与碳汇保护（30%）的复合目标值的92%。这些结果凸显了制定空间差异化土地利用政策的必要性，需整合分区规划、定向激励与协调性景观治理。研究表明，集约化的生态影响取决于其规模、类型及社会-生态背景。对政策制定者而言，这要求超越统一的SAI方法，转向整合土地利用分区、实践导向激励与协调性景观管理的空间靶向策略，以平衡农业生产与森林保护。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108214.title: Productivity-carbon trade-offs in Ghana: Quantifying the roles of irrigation and organic farming in land-use optimisation
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108214.title_zh: 加纳生产力-碳权衡：量化灌溉与有机农业在土地利用优化中的作用

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108215.title_zh: 城市扩张的政治生态学：加纳库马西生态敏感区的权力、治理与土地利用转型

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108216.title: The political ecology of urban green space transformation in Greater Tamale, Ghana: Conditions, drivers, and power relations
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108216.title_zh: 加纳大塔马利地区城市绿地转型的政治生态学：条件、驱动因素与权力关系

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108217.title: From abandoned farmland to afforestation: Legal and spatial perspectives on land consolidation in Serbia
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108217.title_zh: 从废弃农田到造林：塞尔维亚土地整治的法律与空间视角

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108218.abstract: Urban flooding poses escalating risks under climate change, requiring planning approaches that integrate technological precision with human and ecological values. This study introduces a Human-Centred Artificial Intelligence (HCAI) framework for adaptive and regenerative flood-resilient urban design. Unlike conventional AI approaches focused on optimisation, HCAI embeds ethical, participatory, and context-sensitive principles into land-use governance. The paper develops a four-pillar analytical framework – technical integration, institutional arrangements, stakeholder engagement, and land-use innovation – operationalised through a document-based comparative analysis of nine cities representing diverse flood typologies, governance regimes, and documented AI/digital flood-resilience activity. Documentary evidence suggests that AI tools such as Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Graph Neural Networks are reported to support flood-risk prediction and response coordination in flood-risk applications, while their planning relevance depends on inclusive decision-making and regenerative land-use strategies. Cities with stronger institutional embedding of AI-enabled or digital tools within adaptive regulatory systems and participatory platforms (e.g., Rotterdam, Copenhagen, Bangkok) show clearer planning-policy pathways, whereas those relying on fragmented or project-based deployments (e.g., Venice, Sydney) show limited continuity. Findings suggest that technical capability alone is insufficient: planning relevance depends on governance maturity, ethical safeguards, civic legitimacy, and linkage to spatial planning instruments. By coupling algorithmic intelligence with participatory and regulatory innovation, the study advances a policy-oriented framework for embedding HCAI into spatial governance and identifying conditions that may support a shift from defensive flood control toward regenerative, socially just urbanism. The framework guides AI institutionalisation within land-use systems and contributes to debates on equitable, data-driven climate adaptation.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108218.abstract_zh: 气候变化背景下，城市洪涝风险持续加剧，亟需融合技术精度与人文生态价值的规划路径。本研究提出以人为中心的人工智能（HCAI）框架，用于适应性、再生性防洪韧性城市设计。与侧重优化的传统AI方法不同，HCAI将伦理、参与性和情境敏感性原则嵌入土地利用治理体系。本文构建了包含技术整合、制度安排、利益相关方参与和土地利用创新四大支柱的分析框架，通过对九个代表不同洪涝类型、治理体制及AI/数字防洪韧性实践案例的城市进行文献比较分析加以验证。文献证据表明，机器学习、深度学习、图神经网络等AI工具在洪涝风险应用中可支持风险预测与响应协调，但其规划相关性取决于包容性决策与再生性土地利用策略。在适应性监管体系与参与式平台中实现AI或数字工具制度化嵌入的城市（如鹿特丹、哥本哈根、曼谷），展现出更清晰的规划政策路径；而依赖碎片化或项目式部署的城市（如威尼斯、悉尼）则呈现有限连续性。研究结果表明，单纯技术能力不足：规划相关性取决于治理成熟度、伦理保障、公民合法性及与空间规划工具的衔接。通过将算法智能与参与式及监管创新相结合，本研究提出了将HCAI嵌入空间治理的政策导向框架，并识别出可能推动从防御性洪涝控制向再生性、社会公正城市主义转型的条件。该框架为土地利用系统中的AI制度化提供指引，并推动关于公平、数据驱动气候适应的学术讨论。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108218.title: Revolutionizing flood resilience: Human-centred AI for adaptive and regenerative urban design
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108218.title_zh: 变革洪水韧性：面向适应性与再生性城市设计的以人为本人工智能

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108219.abstract: Brazil established its National Policy of Payment for Environmental Services (PES) to promote the maintenance, recovery, and enhancement of ecosystems. Yet the diversity, spatial distribution, and effectiveness of existing initiatives remain poorly understood. This study provides the first nationwide synthesis of all PES programs implemented in Brazil since 2000, based on a systematic scoping review of 80 peer-reviewed papers documenting 138 distinct programs. We apply an analytical framework with 11 dimensions to classify and compare programs by ecosystem type, service category, funding source, objectives, and governance mechanisms. Results show initiatives concentrate in the Atlantic Forest (49.3%) and Cerrado (23.2%) biomes, largely targeting regulation services (93.2%) via forest conservation (65.2%) and restoration (61.6%) actions. Watershed (73.9%) and Forest & Carbon (14.8%) programs predominate; 59.4% of initiatives are in Southeast and 17.4% in North. Most programs rely on public funding (94%), while private and market-based mechanisms remain rare. Despite frequent social objectives (65%) and non-monetary benefits (35%), fiscal dependence and regional imbalance constrain scalability and policy sustainability. By comparing Brazil’s experience with international trends in PES governance, we identify structural challenges to design more adaptive, inclusive, and financially diversified mechanisms that strengthen ecosystem protection and social equity across biomes. Explicitly contrasting Brazil with Latin – American benchmarks, we show that – unlike Costa Rica’s centralized national PES and Mexico’s federally coordinated watershed schemes – Brazil’s policy has fostered a decentralized mosaic of municipal and state programs, closely linked to Forest Code compliance and frequent mixed (cash and in-kind) payments, outlining a distinct regional governance model.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108219.abstract_zh: 巴西建立了国家生态系统服务付费政策，旨在促进生态系统的维护、恢复与增强。然而，现有举措的多样性、空间分布及有效性仍缺乏充分认知。本研究基于对80篇同行评审论文的系统性范围综述（涵盖138个独立项目），首次对2000年以来巴西实施的所有生态系统服务付费项目进行全国性综合梳理。我们运用包含11个维度的分析框架，从生态系统类型、服务类别、资金来源、目标及治理机制等方面对项目进行分类比较。结果显示：项目集中于大西洋森林（49.3%）和塞拉多（23.2%）生物群落，主要通过森林保护（65.2%）和恢复（61.6%）行动瞄准调节服务（93.2%）；流域项目（73.9%）与森林碳汇项目（14.8%）占主导地位；59.4%的举措分布在东南部，17.4%在北部。多数项目依赖公共资金（94%），私营和市场机制仍属罕见。尽管频繁设定社会目标（65%）并提供非货币收益（35%），财政依赖性与区域失衡制约了可扩展性与政策可持续性。通过将巴西经验与国际生态系统服务付费治理趋势对比，我们识别出设计更具适应性、包容性和财务多元化机制的结构性挑战，以强化跨生物群落的生态保护与社会公平。与拉美基准国家的明确对比表明：不同于哥斯达黎加的中央集权式国家生态系统服务付费和墨西哥的联邦协调流域计划，巴西政策催生了分散化的市州级项目拼图，这些项目与《森林法》合规要求紧密关联，并频繁采用混合支付（现金与实物）模式，勾勒出独特的区域治理范式。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108219.title: Payment for environmental services in Brazil: A systematic scoping review of policy design, governance, and territorial patterns
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108219.title_zh: 巴西环境服务付费：政策设计、治理与地域格局的系统性范围综述

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108220.abstract: This study quantifies the tax revenue effects of residential land development in Germany. Whereas existing research and policy debates have concentrated on the fiscal returns of commercial land expansion, the tax revenue effects of residential development remain largely unexplored. We estimate the impacts of increases in living space and settlement area on municipal tax revenues using spatial instrumental variable regressions and a nationwide cross-sectional dataset covering all German municipalities. Accounting for spatial spillovers and potential endogeneity, we document a significant positive effect of residential living space expansion on municipal income tax revenues, with substantial heterogeneity between urban and rural municipalities and across regions with differing economic performance. A corresponding analysis of broader settlement area expansion indicates similarly positive effects on total municipal tax revenues. Multiple robustness checks support the validity of these findings. Finally, we outline a simple framework for approximating the fiscal payback period of residential land development by relating estimated revenue effects to average municipal development costs.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108220.abstract_zh: 本研究量化了德国住宅用地开发对税收收入的影响。现有研究及政策讨论主要聚焦于商业用地扩张的财政回报，而住宅开发对税收收入的影响在很大程度上仍未被探索。我们利用空间工具变量回归方法，结合覆盖全德所有市镇的全国截面数据集，估算了居住空间与定居面积增加对市镇税收收入的影响。在考虑空间溢出效应与潜在内生性问题后，研究发现住宅居住空间扩张对市镇所得税收入具有显著正向效应，且该效应在城乡市镇及经济绩效不同地区间存在显著异质性。对更广泛定居面积扩张的对应分析表明，其对市镇总税收收入同样具有正向影响。多项稳健性检验支持了这些结论的有效性。最后，我们通过将估计的收入效应与市镇平均开发成本相关联，构建了一个用于近似估算住宅用地开发财政回收期的简易框架。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108220.title: Building homes for tax revenues? Spatial evidence on the fiscal effects of residential land development
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108220.title_zh: 为税收而建房？住宅用地开发的财政效应空间证据

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108222.abstract: Accurately reconstructing historical cropland distribution is essential for quantifying the environmental impacts of agricultural land-use change and understanding human–environment interactions. Existing statistical inference methods provide long temporal coverage but suffer from limited spatial accuracy, while remote sensing–based approaches offer high spatial resolution but are constrained in historical depth and often exhibit area biases. To overcome these limitations, this study developed an integrated reconstruction framework and produced a yearly cropland spatial distribution dataset for China from 1850 to 2020 at a 5 km resolution. Multi-source data, including historical archives, statistical yearbooks, and national land surveys, were synthesized to construct a temporally continuous and internally consistent provincial cropland area time series through phased identification, correction, and interpolation. A dynamically weighted joint probability index was then established by combining remote sensing–derived spatial probabilities with physical suitability–based potential probabilities, enabling consistent spatial allocation of cropland before and after the remote sensing era. Results indicate that China’s cropland area experienced a “fluctuating increase–rapid expansion–continuous decline” trajectory, peaking around 1980. Cropland distribution shifted northward toward Northeast China since the early 20th century and toward Northwest China after the 1950s, while several southern and eastern provinces exhibited net cropland loss by 2020. Compared with existing datasets, the reconstructed product shows higher consistency with national land surveys and more accurately captures key spatial evolution processes. This dataset provides robust support for long-term cropland change assessment and environmental impact studies in China.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108222.abstract_zh: 精确重建历史耕地分布对于量化农业土地利用变化的环境影响以及理解人类-环境相互作用至关重要。现有统计推断方法虽能覆盖较长时间跨度，但空间精度有限；而基于遥感的方法虽具有高空间分辨率，却在历史深度上受限且常存在面积偏差。为克服这些局限，本研究构建了一个集成重建框架，并生成了中国1850—2020年逐年、5公里分辨率的耕地空间分布数据集。通过整合历史档案、统计年鉴和全国土地调查等多源数据，采用分阶段识别、校正与插值方法，构建了时间连续且内部一致的省级耕地面积时间序列。进一步结合遥感衍生的空间概率与基于物理适宜性的潜在概率，建立了动态加权联合概率指数，实现了遥感时代前后耕地的空间一致性分配。结果表明，中国耕地面积经历了“波动增长—快速扩张—持续减少”的轨迹，约在1980年达到峰值。自20世纪初以来，耕地分布向东北地区北移，1950年代后向西北地区扩展，而多个南方和东部省份在2020年出现耕地净减少。与现有数据集相比，重建产品与全国土地调查的一致性更高，并能更准确地捕捉关键空间演变过程。该数据集为中国长期耕地变化评估及环境影响研究提供了有力支撑。

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108226.abstract: Assessing land use and land cover dynamics in protected areas (PA) is fundamental to understanding how different conservation strategies influence outcomes across distinct territorial contexts. The present study provided one of the most comprehensive longitudinal assessments of the PAs under the Brazilian System of Nature Conservation Units, through geospatial statistical analysis of land use and cover variations between 1985 and 2022, drawing on an ad hoc Natural Cover Dynamics Index (NCDI). The results revealed persistent conversion of natural areas within Brazilian PAs, including strictly protected categories, with agricultural expansion emerging as the main driver of natural cover loss. Findings also indicated differences in conservation performance among PA categories, reinforcing broader theoretical and political debates around forest transition theory and land sparing versus land sharing strategies. Beyond providing large-scale empirical evidence on conservation outcomes in Brazil, the analytical framework developed in this study contributes to policy-oriented assessments aimed at improving strategic conservation planning and the effectiveness of protected area system. 10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108226.abstract_zh: 评估保护区（PA）的土地利用与土地覆盖动态变化，对于理解不同保护策略如何在特定地域背景下影响保护成效至关重要。本研究基于1985年至2022年间土地利用与覆盖变化的时空统计分析，并借助特设的自然覆盖动态指数（NCDI），对巴西国家自然保护单位体系下的保护区进行了最为全面的纵向评估之一。结果显示，巴西保护区内（包括严格保护类别）的自然区域持续被转化，农业扩张成为自然覆盖丧失的主要驱动因素。研究还发现不同保护区类别在保护绩效上存在差异，这进一步强化了围绕森林转型理论以及土地节约与土地共享策略的广泛理论与政策辩论。除为巴西保护成效提供大规模实证证据外，本研究构建的分析框架还有助于开展面向政策导向的评估，旨在优化战略性保护规划并提升保护区体系的有效性。

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108235.abstract: The lack of urban planning in Latin America’s medium-sized cities, especially in the Caribbean, has resulted in uncontrolled expansion with severe implications in the context of climate emergencies. This expansion manifests through two intertwined processes: “urban sprawl,” understood as outward, land‑consuming (often low‑density) growth, and “informal settlements,” referring to residential areas developed outside formal planning, regulatory, or tenure frameworks. Although analytically distinct, both dynamics frequently overlap in intermediate Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC), where peripheral growth is predominantly driven by informal urbanisation. These cities/urban peripheries are highly vulnerable and urgently need to integrate the climate dimension into their urban development strategies. This paper analyses the scientific and grey literature published between 2014 and 2024 on urban sprawl in medium-sized cities to identify the extent to which literature incorporates the challenges of climate change. Artificial intelligence techniques were applied when searching and reviewing academic and technical sources. The results show that scientific literature is oriented towards explanation and modelling (Geographic Information Systems (GIS), simulation, artificial intelligence), while the grey literature emphasises implementation and monitoring. Both converge in the use of GIS and complement each other: the scientific production provides diagnosis and analysis; the technical, action and applicability. This division of roles, however, creates a functional asynchrony: peer-reviewed scientific production typically operates on medium- to long-term research and publication timelines, whereas technical documentation responds to shorter decision windows and implementation deadlines. This temporal misalignment, in turn, highlights the need to reinforce implementation-oriented instruments for climate adaptation (especially in highly exposed Caribbean intermediate cities) so that rapid decision-making can more effectively draw upon and operationalise scientific evidence.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108235.abstract_zh: 拉丁美洲中等城市，尤其是加勒比地区，因缺乏城市规划导致无序扩张，在气候紧急背景下产生严重后果。这种扩张通过两个相互交织的过程显现：“城市蔓延”——即向外、消耗土地（通常为低密度）的增长，以及“非正规住区”——指在正式规划、监管或产权框架之外开发的居住区。尽管分析上有所区分，但这两种动态在拉丁美洲和加勒比（LAC）的中等城市中频繁重叠，其边缘增长主要由非正规城市化驱动。这些城市/城市边缘区高度脆弱，亟需将气候维度纳入城市发展战略。本文分析了2014年至2024年间关于中等城市城市蔓延的科学文献与灰色文献，以识别文献在多大程度上纳入了气候变化挑战。在检索和审阅学术与技术资料时应用了人工智能技术。结果表明，科学文献侧重于解释与建模（地理信息系统（GIS）、模拟、人工智能），而灰色文献强调实施与监测。两者在GIS应用上趋于一致且相互补充：科学产出提供诊断与分析，技术产出提供行动与可操作性。然而，这种角色分工造成了功能上的异步性：同行评审的科学产出通常遵循中长期研究与发表周期，而技术文档则响应较短的决策窗口与实施期限。这种时间错位进而凸显了加强面向气候适应的实施导向工具（尤其在高度暴露的加勒比中等城市）的必要性，以便快速决策能更有效地借鉴并运用科学证据。
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108235.title: Urban expansion, informality and climate change in intermediate cities in Latin America and the Caribbean: Challenges and opportunities
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108235.title_zh: 拉丁美洲和加勒比地区中等城市的城市扩张、非正规性与气候变化：挑战与机遇

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108236.abstract: Land governance in African countries often unfolds at the intersection of formal state institutions and informal traditional authority structures. In many communities, unelected traditional leaders and chiefs continue to wield substantial influence over land allocation and local dispute resolution, operating alongside elected officials. These patterns raise critical questions about how perceived government performance influences who governs key resources, such as land. Does a well-performing state crowd out the influence of traditional authorities, or does it create an environment where formal and informal actors collaborate for better outcomes? Our study investigates these issues, focusing on the role of chiefs in land distribution as a key outcome. We use the Afrobarometer dataset from 2021 to 2023 for 31 African countries in which traditional authorities govern rural and local communities. We conducted moderated mediation analyses using absorbed regression (AREG), logit, and wild-cluster linear regressions, accounting for country and broad regional-level fixed effects. We find that perceived government performance is positively associated with land governance. Traditional authority positively mediates the link between government performance and land governance. Furthermore, while disinformation attenuates the mediation effect, perceived responsiveness of traditional leaders amplifies this effect. Lastly, perceived institutional trust positively strengthens the traditional authority-land governance nexus. We ground our approach in an institutionalist perspective that views governance in Africa as the product of ongoing interactions between formal state structures and informal societal institutions. We further discuss the theoretical and practical findings, as well as major limitations and avenues for future research.
10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108236.abstract_zh: 非洲国家的土地治理往往发生在正式国家制度与非正式传统权力结构的交汇处。在许多社区，未经选举的传统领袖和酋长继续在土地分配和地方争端解决方面发挥重大影响力，与民选官员并行运作。这些现象引发了关于政府绩效感知如何影响关键资源（如土地）治理主体的关键问题。一个表现良好的国家是否会削弱传统权威的影响力，还是创造一个正式与非正式行为者协作以取得更好成果的环境？本研究聚焦于酋长在土地分配中的作用这一关键结果，探讨上述问题。我们使用2021至2023年间31个非洲国家的Afrobarometer数据集，这些国家的传统权威治理着农村和地方社区。我们采用吸收回归（AREG）、logit和wild-cluster线性回归进行有调节的中介分析，并纳入国家和广泛区域层面的固定效应。研究发现，政府绩效感知与土地治理呈正相关。传统权威在政府绩效与土地治理之间起正向中介作用。此外，虚假信息削弱了中介效应，而传统领袖的回应性感知则增强了这一效应。最后，制度信任感知正向强化了传统权威与土地治理之间的关联。我们的研究基于制度主义视角，将非洲治理视为正式国家结构与非正式社会制度之间持续互动的产物。我们进一步讨论了理论与实践发现、主要局限性及未来研究方向。

10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108238.abstract: Contemporary land use policy rests on a foundational and insufficiently examined premise that the exogenous operating environment of cities will remain within historically derived parameters adequate for extrapolative planning. This paper terms that premise the stability premise and argues that its structural dissolution constitutes not a series of correctable policy failures but a fundamental reconfiguration in the conditions under which urban governance operates. The concept of Volatile Urbanismis introduced to theorise that transformation: defined as the structural condition produced when disruptions to urban operating systems arrive with a velocity, simultaneity, and cross-systemic compounding that systematically exceeds the adaptive capacity of the institutions governing those cities. Three constitutive properties are identified and theorised: (i) transmission without proximity, (ii) compounding rather than sequential disruption, and (iii) institutional lag as the primary vulnerability mechanism, with implications for urban finance, infrastructure insurance, public health systems, and municipal fiscal governance. The framework is distinguished from the cognate concepts of fragility, vulnerability, and resilience, including its most sophisticated reformulations through transformative and evolutionary resilience theory, against which it offers a theoretically bounded contribution focused on the velocity-institution mismatch as a distinct governance failure mode. Specific implications are developed for zoning and land classification, infrastructure investment appraisal, development planning, and urban finance. The paper argues that land use policy is both the domain in which the stability premise is most durably encoded and the most consequential site for its reformulation. The framework arrives at a moment when the 2026 Strait of Hormuz closure, the 2023–2024 Red Sea shipping crisis, and the compound urban consequences of the COVID-19 pandemic have made the theoretical inadequacy of existing frameworks empirically evident. 10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108238.abstract_zh: 当代土地利用政策建立在一个基础性但未经充分检验的前提之上，即城市的外生运行环境将维持在历史参数范围内，足以支撑外推式规划。本文将这一前提称为“稳定性前提”，并认为其结构性瓦解并非一系列可纠正的政策失误，而是城市治理运行条件发生的根本性重构。本文引入“波动城市主义”概念来理论化这一转变：将其定义为当城市运行系统受到的冲击以某种速度、同时性及跨系统复合效应系统性超出治理这些城市的制度适应能力时所产生的结构性状态。本文识别并理论化了三个构成性属性：（i）无需邻近即可传播，（ii）复合而非序列性冲击，以及（iii）制度滞后作为主要脆弱性机制，并探讨其对城市财政、基础设施保险、公共卫生系统及市政财政治理的影响。该框架与脆弱性、易损性和韧性等相近概念相区分，包括通过变革性韧性理论和演化韧性理论进行的最为复杂的重新表述，并在此基础上提供了一个理论边界明确的贡献，聚焦于速度-制度错配作为一种独特的治理失效模式。本文进一步探讨了该框架对区划与土地分类、基础设施投资评估、发展规划及城市财政的具体影响。本文认为，土地利用政策既是稳定性前提被最持久编码的领域，也是对其进行重构的最关键场域。该框架提出的时机恰逢2026年霍尔木兹海峡关闭、2023-2024年红海航运危机以及COVID-19大流行带来的复合城市后果，使得现有框架的理论不足在经验上变得显而易见。

10.1016/j.mathsocsci.2026.102551.abstract: This study proposes a general framework for aggregation problems, in which agents’ signals given in an infinite sequence are aggregated. Notably, no restriction is imposed on the set of signals; hence, this framework is applicable to any type of attributes, including preferences, ballots, pieces of information, or judgments. The result can include the empty set that corresponds to the silence of the aggregation rule. Our main focus is to analyze the process by which the structure of the family of decisive coalitions forms a filter or an ultrafilter. In our framework, a coalition is regarded as decisive if a signal is socially approved as long as every agent in the coalition picks the signal up unanimously. First, we show that the family of decisive coalitions forms a filter under a certain axiom representing a stability condition. Next, in the case where the set of signals is finite, we provide axiomatic characterizations of the class of agreement-based rules associated with filters or ultrafilters: a signal is approved if and only if it is a unanimous agreement of some coalition in a specified filter or ultrafilter. Our axiomatic results demonstrate the robustness and stability of such rules.
10.1016/j.mathsocsci.2026.102551.abstract_zh: 本研究提出一个通用的聚合问题框架，其中代理人在无限序列中给出的信号被聚合。值得注意的是，对信号集合未施加任何限制；因此，该框架适用于任何类型的属性，包括偏好、选票、信息片段或判断。结果可以包括空集，这对应于聚合规则的沉默。我们的主要焦点是分析决定性联盟家族的结构如何形成滤子或超滤子的过程。在我们的框架中，如果一个信号只要联盟中的每个代理一致选择该信号，该信号就被社会认可，则该联盟被视为决定性的。首先，我们证明在代表稳定性条件的特定公理下，决定性联盟家族形成一个滤子。其次，在信号集合有限的情况下，我们提供了与滤子或超滤子相关联的基于一致同意的规则类的公理化特征：一个信号被认可当且仅当它是指定滤子或超滤子中某个联盟的一致同意。我们的公理化结果展示了此类规则的稳健性和稳定性。
10.1016/j.mathsocsci.2026.102551.title: Filters in abstract aggregation with infinite sequences of signals
10.1016/j.mathsocsci.2026.102551.title_zh: 无限信号序列下抽象聚合中的滤波器

10.1016/j.mathsocsci.2026.102552.abstract: We compare two procedures for the iterated removal of strictly dominated strategies. In the nested procedure, a strategy of a player is removed only if it is dominated by an unremoved strategy. The universal procedure is more comprehensive for it allows the removal of strategies that are dominated by previously removed ones. Outside the class of finite games, the two procedures may lead to different outcomes in that the universal one is always order independent while the other is not. We provide necessary and sufficient conditions for the equivalence of the two procedures. The conditions we give are based on completely bounded subsets of strategy profiles, which are variations of the bounded mechanisms from the literature on full implementation. The two elimination procedures are also shown to be equivalent in quasisupermodular games as well as in games with compact strategy spaces and upper semicontinuous payoff functions. Finally, we give an example of a game in which the nested procedure is order independent but not equivalent to the universal one, thus showing that order independence is not sufficient to guarantee the equivalence of the two elimination procedures.
10.1016/j.mathsocsci.2026.102552.abstract_zh: 我们比较了两种严格占优策略迭代剔除的程序。在嵌套程序中，只有当某个玩家的策略被一个未被剔除的策略所支配时，该策略才会被移除。通用程序则更为全面，因为它允许移除那些被先前已剔除策略所支配的策略。在有限博弈类之外，这两种程序可能导致不同的结果，即通用程序总是顺序无关的，而嵌套程序则不然。我们提供了这两种程序等价性的必要且充分条件。所给出的条件基于策略组合的完全有界子集，这些是完整实施文献中受限机制的变体。此外，我们还证明了这两种剔除程序在拟超模博弈以及具有紧策略空间和上半连续支付函数的博弈中是等价的。最后，我们给出了一个博弈示例，其中嵌套程序是顺序无关的，但与通用程序不等价，从而表明顺序无关性并不足以保证这两种剔除程序的等价性。

10.1016/j.mathsocsci.2026.102552.title_zh: 无限博弈中严格占优策略的嵌套剔除

10.1016/j.mathsocsci.2026.102553.abstract: We prove that a two-cycle equilibrium in a general equilibrium model with infinitely-lived agents (GEILA) constitutes an equilibrium in an overlapping generations (OLG) model. Conversely, an equilibrium in an OLG model that satisfies additional conditions is part of an equilibrium in a GEILA model. Our framework, which includes three assets (physical capital, a Lucas tree, and fiat money), encompasses both exchange and production economies. As an application, we demonstrate that equilibrium indeterminacy and rational asset price bubbles can arise not only in OLG models but also in GEILA models.
10.1016/j.mathsocsci.2026.102553.abstract_zh: 我们证明，在具有无限期存活主体的—般均衡模型（GEILA）中，一个两周期均衡构成了世代交叠（OLG）模型中的一个均衡。反之，满足附加条件的OLG模型中的均衡，也是GEILA模型均衡的一部分。我们的框架包含三种资产（实物资本、卢卡斯树和无息货币），涵盖了交换经济与生产经济。作为应用，我们证明均衡不确定性与理性资产价格泡沫不仅可能出现在OLG模型中，也可能出现在GEILA模型中。

10.1016/j.mathsocsci.2026.102554.abstract: This paper develops an evolutionary game model to analyze how economic incentives and social interactions influence household recycling behavior. Citizens are modeled as three types: non-recyclers, partial recyclers, and full recyclers, whose strategies evolve through imitation under bounded rationality. Individual payoffs depend on consumption benefits, a waste disposal tax on untreated waste, recycling costs and social interaction effects capturing similarity bias, moral motivation, and proselytism by environmentally responsible agents. The evolutionary dynamics are described by replicator dynamics, allowing us to characterize the existence and stability of multiple equilibria. Analytical results show that different population configurations may emerge, depending on the policy and social parameters. Numerical simulations further explore how variations in key parameters affect equilibrium selection and the basins of attraction of alternative outcomes. The results indicate that higher waste taxes and stronger social pressure increase the likelihood of convergence toward full recycling, whereas higher proselytism costs or stronger similarity bias can hinder the diffusion of pro-environmental behavior. These findings highlight the joint role of fiscal instruments and social dynamics in promoting sustainable waste management.
10.1016/j.mathsocsci.2026.102554.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个演化博弈模型，分析经济激励与社会互动如何影响家庭回收行为。居民被划分为三类：非回收者、部分回收者和完全回收者，其策略在有限理性条件下通过模仿行为演化。个体收益取决于消费效用、对未处理垃圾征收的垃圾处置税、回收成本，以及反映相似性偏好、道德动机和环境责任者传教行为的社会互动效应。演化动态由复制者动力学描述，从而刻画多重均衡的存在性与稳定性。分析结果表明，根据政策与社会参数的不同，可能出现不同的人口配置。数值模拟进一步探讨了关键参数变化如何影响均衡选择及不同结果的吸引域。研究结果显示，更高的垃圾税和更强的社会压力会提高向完全回收状态收敛的可能性，而更高的传教成本或更强的相似性偏好则可能阻碍亲环境行为的扩散。这些发现凸显了财政工具与社会动态在促进可持续废弃物管理中的联合作用。

10.1016/j.pirs.2024.100023.abstract: This paper studies the impact of government agency reforms, designed to enhance local government effectiveness, on the innovation performance of city-regions in China. We examine the adoption of these reforms between 2009 and 2016 as an exogenous shock to regional institutions. Our analysis identifies a positive and significant relationship between improvements in institutional quality and the innovation performance of Chinese city-regions, particularly pronounced in regions with medium to high levels of innovation. The results are robust to a series of checks including placebo and endogeneity tests and potential confounding policies. This research highlights the critical role of government institutions in driving innovation across China, bringing to the fore important regional variations in the adoption of government agency reforms that are defining the country’s innovation landscape.
10.1016/j.pirs.2024.100023.abstract_zh: 本文研究旨在提升地方政府效能的政府机构改革对中国城市区域创新绩效的影响。我们将2009年至2016年间这些改革的实施视为区域制度的外生冲击。分析表明，制度质量提升与中国城市区域创新绩效之间存在显著正向关系，这一效应在中等至高创新水平的区域尤为突出。通过安慰剂检验、内生性检验及潜在混杂政策控制等一系列稳健性检验，该结果依然成立。本研究揭示了政府机构在驱动中国创新中的关键作用，并凸显了政府机构改革采纳过程中塑造国家创新格局的重要区域差异。

10.1016/j.red.2026.101352.abstract: This paper presents a new dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE)framework based on recursive quantile preferences (quantile certainty equivalent),in which household downside risk attitudes are a model primitive. In this economy,infinitely lived households maximize the discounted value of the stream offuture τ-quantile utilities for τ ∈ (0, 1) with standard consumption and disutility oflabor. The quantile parameter τ captures the households’ downside risk attitude,independent of the elasticity of intertemporal substitution. Representative firmsare price takers, and prices are determined endogenously. We establish centralproperties of the model, including: (i) existence and uniqueness of a fixed pointfor household value functions, (ii) envelope condition, and the quantile Euler equation.We define the quantile recursive competitive equilibrium and establish itsexistence and uniqueness. We also provide an algorithm and numerically computethe quantile DSGE procedure. Lastly, we employ nonlinear impulse responsefunctions and present empirical results for the varying one-time technology shockimpulse response functions for augmented MaCurdy and KPR utility functions.We find significant heterogeneity in downside risk attitudes with the potentialfor countercyclical labor responses for a shallow shock in an otherwise frictionlessenvironment. Rates of dissipation of the shock also vary with the configuration.
10.1016/j.red.2026.101352.abstract_zh: 本文提出一个基于递归分位数偏好（分位数确定性等价）的新型动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）框架，其中家庭的下行风险态度构成模型的基本要素。在该经济体中，无限期存续的家庭以标准消费和劳动负效用为条件，最大化未来τ分位数效用流（τ∈(0,1)）的折现值。分位数参数τ捕捉家庭的下行风险态度，且独立于跨期替代弹性。代表性企业为价格接受者，价格由内生决定。我们建立了模型的核心性质，包括：（i）家庭价值函数不动点的存在性与唯一性，（ii）包络条件，以及分位数欧拉方程。我们定义了分位数递归竞争均衡，并证明其存在性与唯一性。同时提供算法并对分位数DSGE程序进行数值计算。最后，我们采用非线性脉冲响应函数，针对增强型MaCurdy和KPR效用函数，呈现一次性技术冲击脉冲响应函数的实证结果。研究发现，在无摩擦环境中，浅层冲击下下行风险态度存在显著异质性，并可能引发反周期劳动响应。冲击的消散速率亦随参数配置而变化。

10.1016/j.worlddev.2026.107478.abstract: We investigate the extent to which asylum policies that aim to deter individuals from migrating irregularly in fact do so. We specifically consider effects of Germany’s 2023 asylum policy adjustments, which include accelerated asylum decision processes, the prospect of asylum processing outside of Europe, the introduction of a payment card to replace cash benefits, and an extended waiting period for native-level benefits. To estimate the effects of these policy measures on irregular migration intent, we implement a conjoint experiment with 989 men aged 18–40 in four cities in Senegal, a country where irregular migration to Europe is highly salient. Offshoring the asylum process substantially lowers irregular migration intentions, and extending the waiting time for native-level benefits only has a small effect on intent. Neither reducing asylum processing times nor replacing cash benefits with a payment card alters intentions. Our study does not resolve political and normative questions concerning these policies.
10.1016/j.worlddev.2026.107478.abstract_zh: 本文研究了旨在阻止个人非正规移民的庇护政策在多大程度上实际发挥了作用。我们特别关注德国2023年庇护政策调整的影响，包括加速庇护决策流程、将庇护处理程序转移至欧洲以外地区、引入支付卡替代现金福利，以及延长获得与本国居民同等福利的等待期。为评估这些政策对非正规移民意愿的影响，我们在塞内加尔四个城市对989名18至40岁男性实施了一项联合实验——该国非正规移民至欧洲的现象尤为突出。研究发现，将庇护程序外包至欧洲以外地区显著降低了非正规移民意愿，而延长获得与本国居民同等福利的等待期仅对意愿产生微弱影响。缩短庇护处理时间或用支付卡替代现金福利均未改变移民意愿。本研究未就这些政策涉及的政治与规范性问题作出定论。

10.1016/j.worlddev.2026.107493.abstract: As global change accelerates, Payments for Ecosystem Services (PES) programs have become increasingly important tools for addressing the interconnected challenges of land degradation, biodiversity loss, water scarcity, and climate change. PES programs provide incentives to individuals or communities, conditional on people adopting sustainable natural resource management practices to support or increase ecosystem service provisioning. Although conditionality is considered a “PES-defining feature,” little is known about how conditionality is perceived by community members and how such perceptions influence their participation in and experience with PES programs. To address this gap, we conducted an extensive qualitative study of Watershared, a Bolivian PES program, to investigate (1) how community members perceive conditionality in PES and its two components—monitoring and sanction, and (2) how removing conditionality influences PES participants’ perceptions of the program and relationship with the implementing organization. We found that Watershared participants perceived monitoring as more than just a compliance check mechanism; they saw it as a form of technical support and relationship building, which strengthens their relational values toward both nature and the program itself. Participants were generally unconcerned about sanctioning, with many viewing sanctioning as unnecessary or unenforceable, despite the implementing organization having imposed sanctions previously. Watershared participants with unconditional contracts generally noticed the removal of conditionality, with some interpreting it as a lack of care and reciprocity from the implementing organization. These results highlight how relational values were developed and supported through the two components of conditionality in PES. These results suggest that the role of conditionality in PES may be less about surveillance and penalty to ensure conservation, but more about serving as an avenue to activate and strengthen community members’ relational values toward nature and the PES-implementing organization, which may, in turn, improve program effectiveness and future participation. In the face of intensifying global environmental change, such relational values tied to conditionality in PES, as identified in this research, are critical for fostering and sustaining cooperation, trust, and long-term commitment to conservation.
10.1016/j.worlddev.2026.107493.abstract_zh: 随着全球变化加速，生态系统服务付费（PES）项目已成为应对土地退化、生物多样性丧失、水资源短缺和气候变化等相互关联挑战的重要工具。PES项目向个人或社区提供激励，条件是他们采取可持续自然资源管理实践，以支持或增加生态系统服务供给。尽管条件性被视为“PES的定义性特征”，但关于社区成员如何感知条件性，以及这种感知如何影响他们参与PES项目并形成相关体验，目前知之甚少。为填补这一空白，我们对玻利维亚的Watershared PES项目进行了广泛的定性研究，旨在探究：（1）社区成员如何感知PES中的条件性及其两个组成部分——监测与制裁；（2）取消条件性如何影响PES参与者对项目的看法及其与实施组织的关系。我们发现，Watershared参与者将监测视为不仅仅是合规检查机制，更将其视为一种技术支持和关系建设形式，这强化了他们对自然和项目本身的关联价值。参与者普遍不关心制裁，许多人认为制裁不必要或无法执行，尽管实施组织此前曾施加过制裁。拥有无条件合同的Watershared参与者通常注意到条件性的取消，其中一些人将其解读为实施组织缺乏关怀和互惠。这些结果凸显了关联价值如何通过PES条件性的两个组成部分得以发展和支持。这些结果表明，PES中条件性的作用可能不在于通过监督和惩罚来确保保护，而更多是作为激活和加强社区成员对自然及PES实施组织的关联价值的途径，这进而可能提升项目有效性和未来参与度。面对日益加剧的全球环境变化，本研究所识别的与PES条件性相关的关联价值，对于培养和维持合作、信任以及对保护的长期承诺至关重要。

10.1016/j.worlddev.2026.107496.abstract: This paper examines politicians’ attitudes and beliefs about the press, their potential role in shaping aid policy and how these views differ from the public’s. We address these questions using survey data from 107 UK MPs and 2047 members of the UK public. We find a positive association between MPs’ beliefs that the news media influence public opinion, reflect public opinion, and are central to a political career—and a belief that the news media should influence aid policy. This suggests that politicians’ attitudes and beliefs about the media can play a role in shaping aid policy. We also find that MPs are significantly more likely to think that the media influences public attitudes towards aid spending than the public. This suggests that politicians could potentially be overweighing news coverage when making decisions about aid spending. Overall, these findings help fill an important gap in our understanding of what happens ‘upstream’ of aid allocations and add further nuance to our understanding of the media’s political effects.
10.1016/j.worlddev.2026.107496.abstract_zh: 本文考察了政治家对新闻媒体的态度与信念、这些态度在塑造援助政策中的潜在作用，以及它们与公众观点的差异。我们利用来自107位英国议员和2047位英国公众的调查数据来探讨这些问题。研究发现，议员们认为新闻媒体影响公众舆论、反映公众舆论，并且对政治生涯至关重要——这些信念与认为新闻媒体应影响援助政策的信念之间存在正相关关系。这表明，政治家对媒体的态度和信念可能在塑造援助政策中发挥作用。我们还发现，议员们比公众更倾向于认为媒体影响公众对援助支出的态度。这暗示政治家在做出援助支出决策时可能过度重视新闻报道。总体而言，这些发现填补了我们对援助分配“上游”过程理解的重要空白，并为我们理解媒体的政治效应增添了更多细微之处。

10.1016/j.worlddev.2026.107497.abstract: Mobile money platforms are ubiquitous in many emerging economies. Hailed for raising financial inclusion and economic wellbeing, governments have now turned to mobile payments as a source of tax revenue. Transaction levies are often regressive, unpopular, and can encourage a return to cash. We present experimental evidence that they may also harm tax morale, a core component of the social contract between citizen and state. We present results from a survey experiment in Ghana, in which priming a controversial mobile transaction levy significantly lowers support for the state’s right to collect taxes and willingness to comply with tax laws. We combine this with focus group discussions and analyse effect heterogeneity to examine two pre-registered explanations: transaction taxes cost citizens more than they expect to gain (reciprocity) and provoke particular backlash from non-government voters (partisanship). Our findings suggest that taxing mobile money can undermine efforts to expand fiscal capacity, while raising important mechanistic and policy questions for future research.
10.1016/j.worlddev.2026.107497.abstract_zh: 移动货币平台在许多新兴经济体中无处不在。因其提升金融包容性和经济福祉而备受赞誉，各国政府现已转向移动支付作为税收来源。交易税往往具有累退性，不受欢迎，并可能促使人们回归现金使用。我们提供的实验证据表明，这类税收还可能损害税收道德，而税收道德是公民与国家之间社会契约的核心组成部分。我们展示了在加纳进行的一项调查实验结果，其中，引入一项有争议的移动交易税显著降低了公众对国家征税权的支持度以及遵守税法的意愿。我们将此与焦点小组讨论相结合，并分析效应异质性，以检验两项预先注册的解释：交易税给公民带来的成本超过其预期收益（互惠性），以及引发非政府选民特别强烈的反弹（党派性）。我们的研究结果表明，对移动货币征税可能削弱扩大财政能力的努力，同时为未来研究提出了重要的机制性和政策性问题。
10.1016/j.worlddev.2026.107497.title: Mobile money and the social contract: Experimental evidence from Ghana
10.1016/j.worlddev.2026.107497.title_zh: 移动货币与社会契约：来自加纳的实验证据

10.1016/j.worlddev.2026.107498.abstract: Governments around the world need internal discipline to ensure the implementation of policies and delivery of governance outputs, and this need is more severe in authoritarian systems that govern top-down and without bottom-up electoral pressures. Conventional wisdom suggests that autocrats rely on punishment to discipline subordinates who fail to obey orders, but we argue that public disclosure of such malfeasance can also be effective, even when unaccompanied by punishment. In the case of internal misinformation—the tampering of government data and statistics by local agents to distort central authorities’ decisions—we find that the Chinese government successfully adopted public disclosure to combat the manipulation of local GDP numbers by lower-level governments. Our evidence indicates that publicly disclosing a prior act of falsification reduced future manipulation and did so at various levels of local governments, even as officials implicated by the disclosure faced no career setbacks. Hinting at downstream impacts, such disclosure also improved confidence among economic actors, evidenced by increased business activity in localities involved in public disclosures.
10.1016/j.worlddev.2026.107498.abstract_zh: 世界各国的政府都需要内部纪律以确保政策执行和治理成果的交付，而在那些自上而下治理、缺乏自下而上选举压力的威权体制中，这种需求更为迫切。传统观点认为，威权者依赖惩罚来约束不服从命令的下属，但我们主张，公开披露此类不当行为同样有效，即便没有伴随惩罚。以内部虚假信息为例——即地方代理人为扭曲中央决策而篡改政府数据和统计——我们发现中国政府成功采用了公开披露的方式来打击下级政府对地方GDP数据的操纵。我们的证据表明，公开披露先前的造假行为减少了未来的操纵，且这一效果在各级地方政府中均有所体现，即使被披露涉及的官员并未遭遇职业挫折。此外，此类披露还产生了下游影响，提升了经济参与者的信心，表现为涉及公开披露地区的商业活动增加。
10.1016/j.worlddev.2026.107498.title: Enforcing discipline in China: Countering internal misinformation with public disclosure
10.1016/j.worlddev.2026.107498.title_zh: 中国纪律执行：以公开披露应对内部虚假信息

10.1016/j.worlddev.2026.107499.title: Full-day school programs and higher education: Evidence from Peru
10.1016/j.worlddev.2026.107499.title_zh: 全日制学校项目与高等教育：来自秘鲁的证据

10.1016/j.worlddev.2026.107500.abstract: Insurance payouts, remittances, and government cash transfers all share one feature: they inject cash into local markets. While these interventions typically aim to improve the welfare of recipients, they can also affect the economic welfare of non-recipients. Yet our understanding of such economic spillover effects remains limited. Empirical studies report mixed findings, ranging from welfare-increasing to welfare-decreasing spillover effects, while the theoretical literature discussing potential mechanisms remains fragmented and lacks an integrated framework. This study develops a structured conceptual synthesis that integrates dispersed theoretical and empirical insights on the spillover effects of cash injections. We first develop a unified theoretical framework identifying the key mechanisms and moderating factors shaping spillovers, and then review the empirical literature through its lens. The framework highlights that spillover effects emerge through changes in local prices, wages, and resource sharing within social networks. We further show that the magnitude and direction of these effects depend on the interaction between cash-injection-specific parameters and the local environment, including its local economic structure and the constraints that recipient and non-recipient households face. By integrating insights across studies on cash transfers, remittances, and insurance programs, the paper provides a conceptual foundation for understanding spillover patterns of cash injections more broadly. Our analysis generates policy-relevant insights and highlights several important gaps in the current literature.
10.1016/j.worlddev.2026.107500.abstract_zh: 保险赔付、汇款和政府现金转移支付有一个共同特征：它们都向当地市场注入现金。尽管这些干预措施通常旨在改善受助者的福利，但也可能影响非受助者的经济福利。然而，我们对这种经济溢出效应的理解仍然有限。实证研究报告了从福利增加到福利减少的混合结果，而讨论潜在机制的理论文献仍然零散，缺乏一个整合框架。本研究构建了一个结构化的概念综合，整合了关于现金注入溢出效应的分散理论和实证见解。我们首先开发了一个统一的理论框架，识别形成溢出效应的关键机制和调节因素，然后通过该框架审视实证文献。该框架强调，溢出效应通过当地价格、工资以及社会网络内资源共享的变化而产生。我们进一步表明，这些效应的规模和方向取决于现金注入特定参数与当地环境（包括其经济结构以及受助和非受助家庭面临的约束）之间的相互作用。通过整合关于现金转移、汇款和保险项目的研究见解，本文为更广泛地理解现金注入的溢出模式提供了概念基础。我们的分析产生了政策相关的见解，并指出了当前文献中的几个重要空白。
10.1016/j.worlddev.2026.107500.title: When cash enters local markets: local economic spillover effects of cash transfers, remittances, and insurance
10.1016/j.worlddev.2026.107500.title_zh: 现金进入本地市场：现金转移、汇款与保险的本地经济溢出效应

10.1016/j.worlddev.2026.107501.title: Negotiating land, producing authority: hybrid rangeland governance on the pastoral Qinghai-Gansu Border, China
10.1016/j.worlddev.2026.107501.title_zh: 协商土地，生产权威：中国青海-甘肃牧区边境的混合牧场治理

10.1016/j.worlddev.2026.107503.abstract: Property taxes, the primary source of local revenue for municipal governments, are essential for improving urban service provision and resident welfare. Yet this tax is widely unpopular and often politically contentiuous. This study's descriptive findings reveal that property owners are not currently motivated to pay their property taxes by the promise of collective benefits, but rather by the desire to secure their property rights. Thus, this study asks: What dimensions of property tax design do property owners prioritize? How do they negotiate trade-offs? And can policy design establish credible commitment? I address these questions using an experimental conjoint survey with over 2,000 property owners in 34 urban municipalities in Mexico. I find that property owners are largely indifferent to the progressivity of property tax increases yet strongly prioritize policies that enhance accountability in how government administers, spends, and enforces taxes. Specifically, the presence of active oversight strategies in the use of funds increases the support for a policy by 11 percentage points, an effect greater than that of policies that offer more direct benefits. Individuals with high perceptions of government corruption disproportionately favor tax policies that incorporate active transparency strategies even if this implies a higher fiscal burden. Overall, this study demonstrates that public support for property taxation is not entirely inelastic and that adopting accountability measures that signal how funds are spent can make property owners more accepting of tax increases. This study contributes to literature on the fiscal contract by demonstrating how policy designs that enhance accountability can help establish credible commitment.
10.1016/j.worlddev.2026.107503.abstract_zh: 财产税作为市政政府地方收入的主要来源，对于改善城市服务供给和居民福祉至关重要。然而，这一税种普遍不受欢迎，且常引发政治争议。本研究的描述性发现表明，业主目前并非因集体利益的承诺而缴纳财产税，而是出于保障自身产权的愿望。因此，本研究提出以下问题：业主优先关注财产税设计的哪些维度？他们如何权衡取舍？政策设计能否建立可信承诺？我通过在墨西哥34个城市市政区对超过2000名业主进行的实验性联合分析调查来解答这些问题。研究发现，业主对财产税增加的累进性基本不敏感，但强烈优先考虑增强政府在税收管理、支出和执行方面问责性的政策。具体而言，资金使用中积极监督策略的存在使政策支持率提高11个百分点，这一效果大于提供更直接利益的政策。对政府腐败感知较高的个体，即使这意味着更高的财政负担，也尤为倾向于支持包含积极透明策略的税收政策。总体而言，本研究证明公众对财产税的支持并非完全缺乏弹性，采取能表明资金使用方式的问责措施可使业主更易接受税收增加。本研究通过展示增强问责性的政策设计如何帮助建立可信承诺，为财政契约文献做出贡献。
10.1016/j.worlddev.2026.107503.title: Can policy design build trust in local taxation? Experimental evidence of property taxation in Mexican municipalities

10.1016/j.worlddev.2026.107510.abstract: This systematic review examines English-language publications documenting primary-level community programming for preventing and countering violent extremism (P/CVE) undertaken by development civil society and non-government organisations (CSO/NGOs). The objective is to identify and critically analyse the strengths, problems, gaps, and opportunities in incorporating P/CVE into international and community development work. This focus is necessary because primary-level interventions target broad community resilience, unlike secondary and tertiary interventions, which focus on at-risk or radicalised individuals. Given that development CSOs working on P/CVE programs operate independently from government-led counterterrorism efforts, this review provides insights specific to non-securitised, community-level, development-driven approaches. Source inclusion parameters were set to require empirical studies on primary-level P/CVE programs run by development CSOs. Studies of secondary and tertiary interventions, government-led programs, and initiatives by educational or religious institutions were excluded to maintain the focus on non-state, community-level, development-driven approaches. There was no restriction on location, publication date, or publication type, with both peer-reviewed and grey-literature publications included. As the P/CVE field is relatively new, it was expected that the search would mostly find publications from the 2010s and 2020s, which proved to be the case, with the earliest publication being from 2008. Records were identified using Google Scholar, Google, JSTOR Security Studies, 3ie, ALNAP, OECD iLibrary, and institutional websites, with a final search occurring on 31 January 2024. Bias was assessed by recording authors’ affiliation with the evaluand (although internal evaluations were not excluded on that basis). Extracted data was analysed using grounded theory to inductively determine themes. The systematic review incorporates 129 studies reported in 137 papers: 64% qualitative, 32% mixed-methods, and 4% quantitative. Of these, 53% were industry and evaluation reports, 31% articles, 10% books/chapters, and 6% theses. Limitations include the heterogeneity of included studies and limited evaluation rigour, which constrain reliable conclusions of program effectiveness in many papers. Grounded analysis identified three overarching thematic groupings: interconnections, power and relations, and impact. Common findings across papers highlighted the opportunities for P/CVE programming to enhance the work already being conducted by development CSOs, although papers cautioned that this needs to be carefully designed, implemented, and assessed with consideration of context, objectives, appropriate terminology, local agency, sustainability, marginalised groups, and potential for perverse outcomes. The need for consistent, long-term, untied funding of development CSOs’ P/CVE programs was frequently raised, as was the importance of prioritising local participation in all aspects of programming. Many papers noted the value of effective coordination and collaboration horizontally between communities and CSOs as well as vertically between global and local authorities and academia. Evidence of effectiveness was heterogeneous, with some studies measuring impact and others measuring satisfaction. This likely underlies a particular problem with monitoring and evaluation in this nascent field rather than necessarily representing problematic programming. Key issues with monitoring and evaluation typically include unclear and infeasible theories of change, poor monitoring practices, and limited ability to conduct rigorous evaluation due to insufficient funding and capacity. The most promising practices centred on the evaluation of changes in knowledge, attitudes, social cohesion, and wellbeing. Rather than trying to evaluate the impact of a development program on a reduction in violent extremism, these evaluations demonstrated how P/CVE programs influenced the conditions that facilitate violent extremism and sought to enhance presumed protective factors. While the mechanisms that link these outcomes to P/CVE certainly require further investigation, there is evidence emerging that these preventative programs can strengthen individual and community resilience.
10.1016/j.worlddev.2026.107510.abstract_zh: 本系统综述梳理了以英文发表的、由发展型民间社会组织与非政府组织（CSO/NGO）实施的、旨在预防和应对暴力极端主义（P/CVE）的初级社区项目文献。研究目标在于识别并批判性分析将P/CVE纳入国际与社区发展工作的优势、问题、空白与机遇。之所以聚焦初级干预，是因为其针对的是广泛的社区韧性，而二级和三级干预则聚焦于高风险或已激进化个体。鉴于从事P/CVE项目的发展型CSO独立于政府主导的反恐行动，本综述提供了针对非安全化、社区层面、发展驱动型方法的独特见解。文献纳入标准要求必须包含发展型CSO实施的初级P/CVE项目的实证研究。为保持对非国家、社区层面、发展驱动型方法的聚焦，排除了二级和三级干预、政府主导项目以及教育或宗教机构倡议的研究。研究未对地点、发表年份或发表类型设限，同行评审文献与灰色文献均纳入分析。由于P/CVE领域相对新兴，预期搜索结果主要来自2010年代和2020年代——事实确如此，最早文献发表于2008年。通过Google Scholar、Google、JSTOR Security Studies、3ie、ALNAP、OECD iLibrary及机构网站检索记录，最终检索日期为2024年1月31日。通过记录作者与被评估对象的隶属关系评估偏倚（但内部评估未因此被排除）。采用扎根理论对提取数据进行归纳性主题分析。本系统综述纳入129项研究（报告于137篇论文中）：64%为定性研究，32%为混合方法研究，4%为定量研究。其中53%为行业与评估报告，31%为期刊文章，10%为书籍/章节，6%为学位论文。局限性包括纳入研究的异质性及评估严谨性不足，这导致许多论文中关于项目有效性的可靠结论受限。扎根分析识别出三大主题群：相互关联性、权力与关系、影响。论文中的共同发现凸显了P/CVE项目增强发展型CSO现有工作的机遇，但论文也警示需结合情境、目标、恰当术语、地方能动性、可持续性、边缘群体及潜在负面后果进行审慎设计、实施与评估。发展型CSO的P/CVE项目需要持续、长期、无附加条件的资金支持这一诉求被频繁提及，同时强调在项目各环节优先保障地方参与的重要性。许多论文指出，社区与CSO之间的横向协调合作，以及全球与地方当局及学术界之间的纵向协作具有重要价值。有效性证据呈现异质性：部分研究测量影响，部分则测量满意度。这很可能反映了这一新兴领域监测评估中的特定问题，而非必然代表项目设计缺陷。监测评估的关键问题通常包括：变革理论不清晰且不可行、监测实践薄弱、因资金与能力不足导致严格评估受限。最具前景的实践聚焦于知识、态度、社会凝聚力与福祉变化的评估。这些评估并非试图衡量发展项目对减少暴力极端主义的影响，而是展示P/CVE项目如何影响助长暴力极端主义的条件，并致力于增强假定的保护性因素。尽管将这些结果与P/CVE关联的机制仍需进一步探究，但已有证据表明，这些预防性项目能够增强个体与社区的韧性。

10.1016/j.worlddev.2026.107510.title_zh: 预防暴力极端主义的发展路径：实证证据的系统综述

10.1016/j.worlddev.2026.107511.abstract: We examine how shocks to migration opportunities affect schooling outcomes in origin communities. We focus on the migration between Mexico and the United States, and exploit the expansion of the Secure Communities program in the US—a federal data-sharing program that substantially increased the risk of deportation for illegal migrants—as an exogenous shock to the attractiveness of illegal migration. Our results suggest that the Secure Communities program increased attendance, enrollment, and educational attainment in municipalities that had stronger migration-network links with counties in the US that adopted the program early-on relative to municipalities that had ties with US counties that introduced the policy somewhat later. These results are consistent with the interpretation that the Secure Communities program raised the returns to education for prospective migrants by making low-skill migration to the US less attractive.
10.1016/j.worlddev.2026.107511.abstract_zh: 我们研究了移民机会的冲击如何影响原籍社区的教育成果。本文聚焦于墨西哥与美国之间的移民流动，并利用美国“安全社区”计划的扩展——一项大幅增加非法移民遣返风险的联邦数据共享计划——作为非法移民吸引力的外生冲击。研究结果表明，相较于那些与美国较晚实施该政策的县有移民网络联系的市镇，与美国早期实施该政策的县有更强移民网络联系的市镇，其出勤率、入学率和教育成就均有所提高。这些结果与以下解释一致：“安全社区”计划通过降低低技能移民赴美的吸引力，提高了潜在移民的教育回报率。
