10.1016/s0047-2727(98)00027-9.abstract: this paper, we examine a new survey of 6,010 United States households and estimate a model for the allocation of total net worth among different assets. The paper has three main aims. The first is to investigate the extent to which a conventional portfolio choice model can explain the differences in portfolio composition among households. Our survey data show that most households hold only a subset of the available assets. Hence we analyze a model in which investors choose to hold incomplete portfolios. We show that the empirical specification of the joint discrete and continuous choice that characterizes household portfolio behaviour is a switching regressions model with endogenous switching. The second aim is to examine the impact of taxes on portfolio composition. The survey contains a great deal of information on taxable incomes and deductions which enable us to calculate rather precisely the marginal tax rate facing each household. The third aim is to estimate wealth elasticities of demand for a range of assets and liabilities. We test the frequently made assumption of constant relative risk aversion.
10.1016/s0047-2727(98)00027-9.abstract_zh: 本文基于一项针对6,010个美国家庭的新调查数据，构建了一个用于分析总净资产在不同资产间配置的模型。本研究主要包含三个目标：第一，探究传统投资组合选择模型在多大程度上能够解释家庭间资产组合构成的差异。调查数据显示，大多数家庭仅持有部分可用资产，因此我们构建了一个投资者选择持有非完整投资组合的模型。研究表明，刻画家庭投资组合行为的联合离散-连续选择实证模型，本质上是具有内生转换机制的转换回归模型。第二，分析税收对资产组合构成的影响。该调查包含大量应税收入与扣除项信息，使我们能够精确计算每个家庭的边际税率。第三，估算一系列资产与负债的需求财富弹性，并对常相对风险厌恶这一常见假设进行检验。
10.1016/s0047-2727(98)00027-9.title: DP43 Wealth and Portfolio Composition: Theory and Evidence
10.1016/s0047-2727(98)00027-9.title_zh: DP43 财富与投资组合构成：理论与实证

10.1016/s0166-0462(01)00080-1.abstract: This paper analyzes the problem of price discrimination in a market where consumers have heterogeneous preferences over both a horizontal parameter (brand) and a vertical one (quality). A model with two firms competing over locations and non-linear contracts is analyzed. Discriminatory contracts are first characterized at each location. It is then shown that locations have a big impact on the firms' discriminatory ability and that equilibrium locations are non-monotonic in consumer types; however firms never locate too far away from the first and third quartiles.
10.1016/s0166-0462(01)00080-1.abstract_zh: 本文分析了消费者在水平参数（品牌）和垂直参数（质量）上均存在异质性偏好的市场中的价格歧视问题。研究构建了一个包含两家企业在区位与非线性合约上竞争的理论模型。首先刻画了各区位下的歧视性合约特征，进而证明区位对企业歧视能力具有显著影响，且均衡区位随消费者类型呈非单调变化；然而，企业从未将区位设定得远离第一与第三四分位数。
10.1016/s0166-0462(01)00080-1.title: Location Choice and Price Discrimination in a Duopoly
10.1016/s0166-0462(01)00080-1.title_zh: 双寡头市场中的选址决策与价格歧视

10.1016/s1062-9769(97)90073-9.abstract: This paper uses the immigration sample of the German Socioeconomic Panel to analyse the earnings and unemployment assimilation of ethnic Germans who entered West Germany within the last ten years. The empirical analysis suggests that there is no earnings differential between immigrants from Eastern Europe and comparable East Germans at the time of immigration. With longer time of residence the earnings of former East Europeans rise faster than those of East Germans, however. Migrants from Poland and the former USSR have higher unemployment risks than those from East Germany or Romania. Ethnic networks are shown to be very useful for a successful integration into the labour market.
10.1016/s1062-9769(97)90073-9.abstract_zh: 本文利用德国社会经济面板数据中的移民样本，分析了过去十年内进入西德的德裔移民的收入与失业同化情况。实证分析表明，在移民初期，东欧移民与可比的东德人之间不存在收入差异。然而，随着居住时间延长，前东欧移民的收入增长速度快于东德人。来自波兰和前苏联的移民面临比东德或罗马尼亚移民更高的失业风险。研究表明，族群网络对成功融入劳动力市场具有重要作用。
10.1016/s1062-9769(97)90073-9.title: Unemployment and Wages of Ethnic Germans
10.1016/s1062-9769(97)90073-9.title_zh: 族裔德国人的失业与工资

10.1016/s1351-4210(02)80102-0.abstract: This paper studies the factors determining plant size and interplant output allocation within the boundaries of a multiplant firm under conditions of demand uncertainty. It shows that asymmetric information between headquarters and individual plants is one factor determining plant size and output allocation: since the existence of excess capacity creates ?high powered? incentives for individual plants, capacity levels in a second-best setting exceed the corresponding benchmark in a first-best world if capacity prices are low. The presence of ?agency costs? in the case of fully-utilized capacity reverses this result for high-capacity prices. Also, in a recession output is not necessarily assigned to the plant with the lowest production costs.
10.1016/s1351-4210(02)80102-0.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在需求不确定条件下，决定多工厂企业边界内工厂规模及厂际产出分配的因素。研究表明，总部与各工厂之间的信息不对称是决定工厂规模与产出分配的关键因素之一：由于过剩产能的存在为单个工厂提供了“强激励”，当产能价格较低时，次优环境下的产能水平会超过最优基准下的对应水平。而在产能充分利用的情况下，“代理成本”的存在则会在高产能价格时逆转这一结果。此外，在经济衰退期，产出并不必然分配给生产成本最低的工厂。
10.1016/s1351-4210(02)80102-0.title: Excess Capacity as an Incentive Device
10.1016/s1351-4210(02)80102-0.title_zh: 过剩产能作为激励手段

10.1017/eec.2025.10037.abstract: We investigate whether time pressure exacerbates or mitigates bubbles in laboratory experiments. We find that under high time pressure price volatility is lower and market prices are closer to their fundamental value. This is due to participants using simpler adaptive forecasting strategies, instead of the self-reinforcing extrapolative expectations that they use under low time pressure, and which are conducive to the emergence of bubbles. In addition, by substantially increasing the number of decision periods in our experiment, we find that in the long run prices tend to converge to their fundamental value, also in the absence of time pressure.
10.1017/eec.2025.10037.abstract_zh: 我们通过实验室实验探究时间压力是加剧还是缓解泡沫现象。研究发现，在高时间压力下，价格波动性更低，市场价格更接近其基础价值。这是因为参与者采用了更简单的适应性预测策略，而非低时间压力下使用的自我强化外推预期——后者正是导致泡沫产生的因素。此外，通过大幅增加实验中的决策周期数，我们发现长期来看，即使没有时间压力，价格也趋于收敛至基础价值。
10.1017/eec.2025.10037.title: Time pressure reduces financial bubbles: evidence from a forecasting experiment
10.1017/eec.2025.10037.title_zh: 时间压力减少金融泡沫：来自预测实验的证据

10.1017/eec.2025.10038.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have the potential to profoundly transform and enrich experimental economic research. We propose a new software framework, “alter_ego”, which makes it easy to design experiments between LLMs and to integrate LLMs into oTree-based experiments with human subjects. Our toolkit is freely available at github.com/mrpg/ego . To illustrate, we run differently framed prisoner’s dilemmas with interacting machines as well as with human-machine interaction. Framing effects in machine-only treatments are strong and similar to those expected from previous human-only experiments, yet less pronounced and qualitatively different if machines interact with human participants.
10.1017/eec.2025.10038.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）具有深刻变革和丰富实验经济学研究的潜力。我们提出了一种新的软件框架"alter_ego"，该框架能够便捷地设计LLMs之间的实验，并将其整合到基于oTree平台、涉及人类被试的实验中。我们的工具包可在github.com/mrpg/ego免费获取。为进行说明，我们通过机器间交互以及人机交互的方式，运行了不同框架设定的囚徒困境实验。在纯机器处理组中，框架效应显著且与以往纯人类实验的预期结果相似；但当机器与人类被试交互时，框架效应则较弱且存在质性差异。
10.1017/eec.2025.10038.title: Integrating machine behavior into human subject experiments: a user-friendly toolkit and an application to framed prisoner’s dilemmas
10.1017/eec.2025.10038.title_zh: 将机器行为融入人类被试实验：一个用户友好型工具包及其在框架囚徒困境中的应用

10.1017/eec.2025.10039.abstract: Agents frequently engage with multiple principals simultaneously – for example, when borrowing from several banks or peers. In such settings, principals typically possess less information about the agent’s ability or intentions (e.g., to repay a loan) and must rely on trust. This paper presents experimental evidence from trust games framed in a credit market context to examine the role of reciprocity in interactions involving multiple principals (lenders) and a single agent (borrower). Agents were asked to decide whether to act trustworthily and repay, or to default and act selfishly, after receiving the same credit amount from either one or multiple principals. The results show that reciprocity declines when the number of trusting principals increases. A key mechanism appears to be the reduced marginal harm that an agent’s default imposes on each individual principal. Additionally, agents seem less sensitive to the negative consequences of their actions when multiple principals are affected. These findings suggest that interactions involving multiple principals are behaviorally riskier than bilateral ones. The results have implications for the design of incentive structures in multi-principal-agent environments, such as crowdlending platforms.
10.1017/eec.2025.10039.abstract_zh: 代理人经常同时与多个委托人互动——例如，向多家银行或同伴借款时。在此类情境中，委托人通常对代理人的能力或意图（如偿还贷款）掌握较少信息，因而必须依赖信任。本文通过在信贷市场背景下设计的信任博弈实验，考察了涉及多个委托人（贷款人）与单一代理人（借款人）的互动中互惠性的作用。代理人从单个或多个委托人处获得相同信贷额度后，需决定是履行可信赖行为（偿还贷款）还是违约（采取自私行为）。结果表明，当信任代理人的委托人数量增加时，互惠性会下降。其关键机制似乎是代理人违约对每个委托人造成的边际损害降低。此外，当多个委托人受到影响时，代理人对其行为的负面后果似乎更不敏感。这些发现表明，涉及多个委托人的互动在行为层面比双边互动更具风险性。研究结果对多委托人-代理人环境（如众贷平台）中的激励机制设计具有启示意义。
10.1017/eec.2025.10039.title: Reciprocity in multiple principals – one agent interactions: experimental evidence
10.1017/eec.2025.10039.title_zh: 多委托人-单一代理人互动中的互惠性：实验证据

10.1017/eec.2026.10040.abstract: The prevalence of false and misleading news has become an issue of great concern in recent years. Academic researchers, policymakers, and social media firms all continue to seek effective solutions to reduce the sharing of misinformation. In this paper, we evaluate the effectiveness of two policies in particular: competition among media firms and fact-checking of published news articles by independent organizations. We first develop a theoretical model that predicts the effect of each policy and then conduct a behavioral experiment to test those predictions. Our experimental findings indicate that media competition is most effective at nipping misinformation in the bud because media firms spend significantly more resources on improving the accuracy of their news when readers obtain news from multiple sources. We also find that fact-checking improves the overall quality of news available to viewers; however, it does not incentivize firms to improve the accuracy of their own news articles. Last, our results from an interaction treatment suggest that under competition, fact-checking adversely affects firms’ investment in news accuracy.
10.1017/eec.2026.10040.abstract_zh: 近年来，虚假与误导性新闻的泛滥已成为备受关注的社会问题。学术界、政策制定者及社交媒体平台持续探索减少虚假信息传播的有效方案。本文重点评估两项政策的实施效果：媒体企业间的竞争机制，以及独立机构对已发布新闻文章的事实核查机制。我们首先构建理论模型预测各项政策的影响效应，继而通过行为实验验证这些预测。实验结果表明，媒体竞争在遏制虚假信息萌芽阶段最为有效——当读者通过多渠道获取新闻时，媒体企业会显著增加资源投入以提升新闻准确性。研究同时发现，事实核查虽能改善受众可获取新闻的整体质量，但并未激励企业提升自身新闻的准确性。最后，交互处理组的实验结果显示，在竞争环境下，事实核查反而对企业的新闻准确性投资产生负面影响。
10.1017/eec.2026.10040.title: Reducing misinformation on social media: an experimental evaluation of two policy interventions
10.1017/eec.2026.10040.title_zh: 减少社交媒体上的错误信息：两项政策干预的实验评估

10.1017/eec.2026.10041.abstract: We develop and validate a survey instrument to elicit six key economic preferences in children: undefined time preferences, risk preferences, altruism, positive reciprocity, negative reciprocity, and trust. The survey was administered to a sample of 339 nine-year-old children, for whom we also collected behavioral data through incentivized choice experiments targeting the same preferences. Our econometric analysis allows us to identify a set of 14 survey items that best predict children’s experimental behavior. For each preference, we also compare the predictive power of this 14-item validated survey to a shorter 9-item self-evaluation version. Our results demonstrate that these surveys provide a simple and reliable tool for measuring individual preferences in children – enabling researchers to account for heterogeneity when designing and evaluating policies targeting younger populations.
10.1017/eec.2026.10041.abstract_zh: 我们开发并验证了一套调查工具，用于测量儿童六种关键经济偏好：未定义的时间偏好、风险偏好、利他主义、正向互惠、负向互惠以及信任。该调查对339名九岁儿童样本实施，同时我们通过针对相同偏好的激励性选择实验收集了行为数据。计量经济学分析使我们能够识别出14个最能预测儿童实验行为的调查项目。针对每种偏好，我们还比较了包含14个项目的验证版调查与更简短的9项自我评估版本的预测能力。结果表明，这些调查为测量儿童个体偏好提供了简单可靠的工具——使研究人员在设计和评估针对年轻群体的政策时能够考虑异质性。
10.1017/eec.2026.10041.title: Eliciting time, risk, and social preferences in children: a validated survey
10.1017/eec.2026.10041.title_zh: 儿童时间、风险与社会偏好的引出：一项经过验证的调查

10.1017/eec.2026.10043.abstract: In a $k$ -replica Edgeworth box economy, we compare outcomes of laboratory markets in which human traders have different visualizations available on their screens. Novel visualizations include a heat map that shows at a glance the value of all feasible portfolios (i.e., final allocations); a geometric display of the order book; and order entry via point-and-click on the heat map. Efficiency metrics focus on allocations, prices and profitability. Compared to the traditional text-oriented trader screen for the continuous double auction, we find that the novel features generally increase all three efficiency metrics.
10.1017/eec.2026.10043.abstract_zh: 在一个$k$重复埃奇沃思盒经济中，我们比较了人类交易者在屏幕上拥有不同可视化选项的实验室市场结果。新颖的可视化功能包括：热力图，可一目了然地显示所有可行投资组合（即最终配置）的价值；订单簿的几何展示；以及通过点击热力图进行订单输入。效率指标侧重于配置、价格和盈利能力。与传统的面向文本的连续双向拍卖交易屏幕相比，我们发现新颖功能通常能提升所有三项效率指标。
10.1017/eec.2026.10043.title: Market visualizations

10.1017/eec.2026.10045.abstract: A zero price effect is a discontinuous change in demand when price is reduced to zero from a level arbitrarily close to it. It has been proposed that social norms play a role in zero price effects on consumption. We first conducted a norm-elicitation experiment to measure how people perceive the social appropriateness of consumption under zero versus minimal prices. We then ran a natural field experiment in the same contexts to observe actual taking behavior. Results show that the social appropriateness of consuming high quantities is significantly lower when goods are offered for free than when they are sold at 1 cent. Zero pricing increases the proportion of individuals who consume something, but reduces the average amount taken by those who consume positive amounts. Overall, the evidence suggests that high consumption of free goods is prevented by its social inappropriateness, potentially helping to explain the inconsistent evidence on the direction of zero price effects in previous studies.
10.1017/eec.2026.10045.abstract_zh: 零价格效应是指当价格从任意接近零的水平降至零时，需求发生的不连续变化。已有研究提出，社会规范在零价格对消费的影响中发挥作用。我们首先开展了一项规范诱导实验，以衡量人们在零价格与最低价格条件下对消费社会适当性的认知。随后，我们在相同情境下进行了一项自然田野实验，以观察实际获取行为。结果表明，当商品免费提供时，大量消费的社会适当性显著低于以1美分出售的情况。零价格增加了消费某种物品的个体比例，但降低了消费正数量个体的平均获取量。总体而言，证据表明免费商品的高消费因其社会不适当性而受到抑制，这或许有助于解释以往研究中关于零价格效应方向的不一致证据。
10.1017/eec.2026.10045.title: The role of social norms in zero price effects
10.1017/eec.2026.10045.title_zh: 社会规范在零价格效应中的作用

10.1017/eec.2026.10047.abstract: In various organizational settings, a team member is given the authority to make an investment decision that influences the value of the jointly produced surplus. We experimentally investigate the effect of asymmetric status, investment decisions, and the outcome of these decisions on bargaining behavior and outcomes. Agents’ initial contributions to the surplus are determined by their relative performances in a real-effort task. Three treatments vary in how the final surplus value is determined. We observe that when low-contributors take a risk, they are punished (rewarded) for failure (success), whereas high-contributors receive a fixed share independent of the outcome. Analysis of bargaining process variables, subjects’ communication during bargaining, and third parties’ normative judgments provides further insights into the possible mechanism behind this observation.
10.1017/eec.2026.10047.abstract_zh: 在各种组织环境中，团队成员被赋予投资决策权，该决策会影响共同产出剩余的价值。我们通过实验研究了非对称地位、投资决策及其结果对议价行为与结果的影响。代理人对于剩余的初始贡献取决于他们在真实努力任务中的相对表现。三种实验处理通过最终剩余价值的确定方式加以区分。我们观察到，当低贡献者承担风险时，其失败（成功）会受到惩罚（奖励），而高贡献者无论结果如何都能获得固定份额。对议价过程变量、被试在议价过程中的沟通内容以及第三方规范性判断的分析，进一步揭示了这一现象背后可能的作用机制。
10.1017/eec.2026.10047.title: Earned entitlements and risky investments in bargaining: an experiment
10.1017/eec.2026.10047.title_zh: 议价中的应得权利与风险投资：一项实验研究

10.1017/eec.2026.10048.abstract: We present and conduct a novel experiment on a multi-period beauty contest game. Leveraging the multi-period feature, we investigate how participants revise their forecasts in periods when new information—such as shocks or announcements—arrives and how they form their expectations in the absence of new information. We make two key contributions. First, we develop a new method based on forecast revisions to evaluate whether participants behave in a forward-looking manner. The experimental results show that participants do react to anticipated shocks: namely, the announcements of future shocks. Second, we identify a new strategic environment effect during periods without new information; only when the game exhibits strategic complementarity do participants use extrapolation and expect continuously rising prices. This finding suggests that expectation formation is endogenous to the economic environment; and policy design should thus take this endogeneity into account.
10.1017/eec.2026.10048.abstract_zh: 我们设计并开展了一项关于多期选美比赛博弈的新实验。利用多期特征，我们研究了参与者在信息更新时期（如冲击或公告发布时）如何修正其预测，以及在缺乏新信息时如何形成预期。本研究有两项核心贡献：第一，我们基于预测修正开发了一种新方法，用以评估参与者是否具有前瞻性行为。实验结果表明，参与者确实会对预期冲击（即未来冲击的公告）做出反应；第二，我们发现在无新信息时期存在一种新的战略环境效应——只有当博弈呈现战略互补性时，参与者才会采用外推法并预期价格持续上涨。这一发现表明，预期形成内生于经济环境，因此政策设计应考虑这种内生性。
10.1017/eec.2026.10048.title: An experiment on a multi-period beauty contest game
10.1017/eec.2026.10048.title_zh: 多期选美竞赛博弈实验研究

10.1017/eec.2026.10049.abstract: This study investigates how in-game virtual currencies influence consumer spending behaviour. In an incentivized randomized controlled trial with 753 UK participants, we estimate the willingness-to-pay (WTP) for loot boxes represented as risky and ambiguous lotteries. We test the effects of virtual currencies, money illusion, and cognitive-demanding (non-intuitive) exchange rates, three practices commonly used to sell loot boxes. Our results show that WTP is significantly higher when transactions are conducted in virtual currencies with a 1:1 exchange rate compared to British pounds, contributing to the debate on the neutrality of virtual currencies and experimental currency units. Moreover, participants in our study are affected by money illusion distortions, regardless of the exchange rate’s intuitiveness. However, we find no evidence that non-intuitive exchange rates affect participants’ WTP compared to intuitive exchange rates of comparable size. These findings highlight the behavioural distortions induced by common monetization practices in games and provide empirical support for the European Commission’s call for stricter regulation of virtual currencies in digital environments.
10.1017/eec.2026.10049.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了游戏内虚拟货币如何影响消费者支出行为。通过一项包含753名英国参与者的激励性随机对照试验，我们估算了以风险性和模糊性彩票形式呈现的“战利品箱”的支付意愿（WTP）。我们检验了虚拟货币、货币幻觉以及认知负荷（非直观）汇率这三种常用于销售战利品箱的实践效应。结果显示，当交易以1:1汇率的虚拟货币进行时，支付意愿显著高于以英镑计价的情况，这为虚拟货币与实验货币单位的中立性争论提供了新证据。此外，无论汇率是否直观，参与者均受到货币幻觉扭曲的影响。然而，与规模相近的直观汇率相比，我们未发现非直观汇率对参与者支付意愿产生影响的证据。这些发现揭示了游戏中常见货币化实践所引发的行为扭曲，并为欧盟委员会呼吁在数字环境中加强虚拟货币监管提供了实证支持。
10.1017/eec.2026.10049.title: Virtual currencies in online gaming increase the willingness to pay for loot boxes: an experimental analysis
10.1017/eec.2026.10049.title_zh: 网络游戏中的虚拟货币增加对开箱付费意愿：一项实验分析

10.1017/eec.2026.10050.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We build an experiment to uncover the bandit-like nature of consumer behavior usually masked by the product and time aggregation of consumption data. Subjects make repeated choices between musical styles (either all familiar or unfamiliar), and post-choice satisfaction is observed. We estimate Bayesian bandit models of learning taste by consuming with satiation. Our best model features decreasing random exploration, with openness being associated with higher exploration. Early exploration is more intensive in the unfamiliar treatment and persists throughout the experiment in both treatments. Overall, subjects make choices that deviate from their best prediction 61.5% of the time in the unfamiliar treatment versus 44.7% in the familiar treatment. Our model offers a rational interpretation of random utility in discrete consumer choices which does not rest on perception and/or decision errors.</jats:p>
10.1017/eec.2026.10050.abstract_zh: 我们设计了一项实验，以揭示通常被消费数据的产品和时间聚合所掩盖的消费者行为的“类赌博机”本质。受试者在不同音乐风格（全部熟悉或全部不熟悉）之间进行重复选择，并记录选择后的满意度。我们通过消费中的满足感来估计学习品味的贝叶斯赌博机模型。最优模型呈现递减的随机探索特征，其中开放性程度与更高探索水平相关。在不熟悉处理组中，早期探索更为密集，且该探索行为在两个处理组中均贯穿实验全程。总体而言，受试者在61.5%的决策中（不熟悉处理组）偏离其最优预测，而熟悉处理组该比例为44.7%。我们的模型为离散消费者选择中的随机效用提供了理性解释，该解释不依赖于感知和/或决策误差。
10.1017/eec.2026.10050.title: Learning by consuming in the lab

10.1017/eec.2026.10051.abstract: Groups often agree that change is needed, but differing preferences and information may still lead to difficulty coordinating on a particular alternative. In a laboratory experiment, we study coordination and information aggregation in a divided-majority voting game with public information and conflicting preferences. Voters observe private signals and a public signal about whether alternative upper A $A$ A or upper B $B$ B is socially optimal. Unless sufficiently many voters agree, an inferior default upper C $C$ C occurs. When the public signal is more accurate than the private signal and voters have common preferences, most voters coordinate on the public signal. However, when public-signal accuracy is reduced or preferences conflict, voters follow the public signal less frequently. While reduced public-signal accuracy substantially increases the frequency of coordination failure, conflicting preferences between subgroups do not. These results highlight the importance of accurate public information in achieving collective action.
10.1017/eec.2026.10051.abstract_zh: 群体通常认同变革的必要性，但不同的偏好和信息仍可能导致难以就某一特定替代方案达成协调。通过一项实验室实验，我们研究了在存在公共信息和偏好冲突的分裂多数投票博弈中的协调与信息聚合问题。投票者观察私人信号以及关于替代方案A或B何者更优的公共信号。除非有足够多的投票者达成一致，否则将出现较差的默认方案C。当公共信号比私人信号更准确且投票者具有共同偏好时，多数投票者会依据公共信号进行协调。然而，当公共信号准确性降低或偏好存在冲突时，投票者遵循公共信号的频率会下降。尽管公共信号准确性降低会显著增加协调失败的发生频率，但子群体间的偏好冲突并不会产生同样影响。这些结果凸显了准确公共信息在实现集体行动中的重要性。
10.1017/eec.2026.10051.title: Public information and coordination with a divided majority
10.1017/eec.2026.10051.title_zh: 公共信息与分裂多数下的协调

10.1017/eec.2026.10052.abstract: We experimentally investigate preferences for clumping-versus-separating information in the gain and the loss domains, and also preferences for timing. Our design is motivated by the idea that information preferences may depend on reference points. Subjects participate in two monetary lotteries and choose how to receive the outcome information. For half of the subjects, the lotteries are framed as two gain lotteries; for the other half, as two loss lotteries. Based on Thaler (1985) one can expect that people want to learn the outcomes of the gain lotteries separately and the outcomes of the loss lotteries clumped together (cf. hedonic editing hypothesis). On the other hand, a different reference dependent model by Koszegi and Rabin (2009) relies on expectations-based reference points, and predicts that subjects should prefer clumped information irrespective of the frame. The results of our experiment show a preference for separating information about gains, and no preference for clumping or separating information about losses. Regarding timing, we find a weak overall preference for receiving information sooner. These findings provide new insights into information preferences. We conclude by discussing policy implications, as well as our additional contributions to related literature.
10.1017/eec.2026.10052.abstract_zh: 我们通过实验研究了人们在收益域和损失域中对信息聚合与分离的偏好，以及对信息获取时机的偏好。实验设计基于信息偏好可能依赖于参照点的理论假设。受试者参与两项货币抽奖，并选择如何接收结果信息。其中一半受试者的抽奖被设定为两项收益抽奖，另一半则为两项损失抽奖。根据Thaler（1985）的理论，人们可能倾向于分别了解收益抽奖的结果，而将损失抽奖的结果合并了解（参见享乐编辑假说）。另一方面，Koszegi和Rabin（2009）提出的基于期望参照点的不同参照依赖模型则预测，无论抽奖框架如何，受试者都应偏好信息聚合。实验结果显示，受试者偏好将收益信息分离呈现，而对损失信息则未表现出聚合或分离的明确偏好。在时机方面，我们发现受试者整体上微弱偏好尽早获取信息。这些发现为信息偏好研究提供了新见解。最后，我们讨论了政策含义及对相关文献的额外贡献。
10.1017/eec.2026.10052.title: Information preferences, reference points and hedonic editing: experimental evidence
10.1017/eec.2026.10052.title_zh: 信息偏好、参考点与享乐编辑：实验证据

10.1017/eec.2026.10053.abstract_zh: 我们设计并实施了一项真实努力实验，以联合估计努力和货币领域中的现时偏向与理性程度。与先前研究（例如Augenblick和Rabin, 2019; Fedyk, 2024）不同，我们并未假设这些参数在不同领域间相同。我们解释并通过实证表明，假设货币与努力领域的理性程度相同会如何导致关键参数估计的偏误。在我们的在线实验中，参与者当天完成的任务比未来某天少14%（预测为10%），由此估计出努力领域的现时偏向（βₑ）为0.70–0.79，理性程度（β̂ₑ）为0.80–0.88。在货币领域，总体现时偏向（βₘ）接近于零，但存在显著的异质性，表现出现时偏向和未来偏向的参与者数量大致相当。在个体层面，约四分之三的参与者能够正确预测自身在两个领域中的偏向方向，尽管未能完全预测其幅度。
10.1017/eec.2026.10053.title: Estimating present bias and sophistication over effort and money
10.1017/eec.2026.10053.title_zh: 估计努力和金钱上的现时偏向与成熟度

10.1017/eec.2026.10055.abstract: Motivated by the problem of organizational design, we study coordination in the network minimum game: a version of the minimum-effort game where players are connected by a directed network. We show experimentally that acyclic networks such as hierarchies are most conducive to successful coordination. Introducing a single link to complete a network cycle may drastically inhibit coordination. Furthermore, acyclic networks enable resilient coordination: initial coordination failure is often overcome (exacerbated) after repeated play in acyclic (cyclic) networks.
10.1017/eec.2026.10055.abstract_zh: 受组织设计问题的启发，我们研究了网络最小博弈中的协调问题：该博弈是最小努力博弈的一个变体，其中参与者通过有向网络相互连接。实验结果表明，层级结构等无环网络最有利于实现成功协调。引入单一链接以形成网络环可能会严重抑制协调。此外，无环网络能够实现具有韧性的协调：在无环（有环）网络中，初始协调失败往往会在重复博弈后被克服（加剧）。
10.1017/eec.2026.10055.title: Coordination in the network minimum game
10.1017/eec.2026.10055.title_zh: 网络最小博弈中的协调

10.1017/s0022050725101034.abstract: We provide empirical evidence that central banks can mitigate economic crises more efficiently when they extend eligibility for their discount facility to any safe asset or solvent agent. Nineteenth-century France serves as a case study to circumvent endogeneity. Following 1863, an agricultural pandemic increased defaults outside agriculture. We exploit specificities of the discount window to create exogenous variation in central bank access. Regressions show that while the demand shock brought about by the pandemic led to an increase in defaults outside agriculture by 20 percent, this effect was significantly reduced whenever a branch office of the central bank was present.
10.1017/s0022050725101034.abstract_zh: 我们提供了实证证据，表明当央行将贴现窗口的合格范围扩展至任何安全资产或偿付能力充足的机构时，其缓解经济危机的效率更高。以19世纪的法国作为案例研究，以规避内生性问题。1863年后，一场农业疫情导致农业以外的违约率上升。我们利用贴现窗口的特殊性，构建了央行准入的外生性变化。回归分析显示，尽管疫情引发的需求冲击使农业以外的违约率上升了20%，但每当央行设有分支机构时，这一影响便显著减弱。
10.1017/s0022050725101034.title: Eligibility to the Central Bank in Times of Crises: Evidence from France, 1863–1890
10.1017/s0022050725101034.title_zh: 危机时期中央银行的准入资格：来自法国（1863–1890年）的证据

10.1017/s0022050725101046.abstract: Using linked Census Tree records and archival sources, I explore the roles of race and gender in migrant selection and sorting during the exodus of single young women and men from U.S. Southern farms from 1900–1940. Female migration rates, influenced by changes in farm men’s marriageability, rose during the farm crisis of 1920–1940 and exceeded men’s by 1940. On- and off-farm discrimination by race and gender drove differences in migrant characteristics: out-of-South Black female migrants, but not within-South, were positively selected on education and family resources, while White women were positively selected across both destinations.
10.1017/s0022050725101046.abstract_zh: 利用关联的人口普查树记录与档案资料，本文探究了1900-1940年间美国南部农场单身青年男女外迁过程中，种族与性别在移民选择与分类中的作用。受农场男性婚姻适龄性变化影响，女性迁移率在1920-1940年农业危机期间上升，并于1940年超过男性。种族与性别在农场内外遭遇的歧视导致移民特征差异：迁出南部的黑人女性移民（而非南部内部迁移者）在教育程度与家庭资源方面呈现正向选择，而白人女性在两个迁移目的地均呈现正向选择。
10.1017/s0022050725101046.title: Gender and Racial Differences in Migration Behavior: Evidence from the Farm Exodus within and out of the U.S. South, 1900–1940
10.1017/s0022050725101046.title_zh: 迁移行为中的性别与种族差异：来自1900–1940年美国南部农业人口外迁的证据

10.1017/s0022050725101058.abstract: Using a new database of European academics, we build a network of universities that is based on professors’ mobility. We describe how the network was altered following the Protestant Reformation. We focus on fragmentation and on universities’ centrality. Dyadic regressions confirm that geography and vernacular languages were important for mobility, but did not substitute for religion. We compare simulated networks with and without religious identity. Most universities lose centrality in the simulated religious network compared to the non-religious one. As publications per university are correlated with centrality, the loss of connectedness of many universities after the Reformation contributed to their scientific decline.
10.1017/s0022050725101058.abstract_zh: 基于欧洲学者新数据库，我们构建了以教授流动为基础的大学网络，并描述了宗教改革后该网络的变化。研究聚焦于网络碎片化与大学中心性。二元回归分析证实，地理因素与地方语言对学者流动具有重要影响，但并未取代宗教的作用。通过对比含宗教身份与不含宗教身份的模拟网络，发现多数大学在含宗教身份的模拟网络中中心性低于不含宗教身份的网络。由于大学论文发表数量与中心性相关，宗教改革后众多大学连通性的下降导致了其科学地位的衰落。
10.1017/s0022050725101058.title: Winners and Losers from the Protestant Reformation: An Analysis of the Network of European Universities
10.1017/s0022050725101058.title_zh: 宗教改革的赢家与输家：欧洲大学网络分析

10.1017/s002205072510106x.abstract: Between 1910 and 1940, U.S. high school graduation rates rose five-fold, driving twentieth-century economic growth. I explore how the Great Depression’s surge in youth unemployment influenced this trend, emphasizing gender and socioeconomic disparities. Using linked census data and newly digitized city-level unemployment rates, I find that youth unemployment significantly increased high school and post-secondary completion among higher-income boys, while effects on girls and lower-income youths were negligible. These results underscore the role of household resources in leveraging educational opportunities, as financial constraints limited disadvantaged groups from benefiting from reduced opportunity costs.
10.1017/s002205072510106x.abstract_zh: 1910年至1940年间，美国高中毕业率增长了五倍，推动了20世纪的经济增长。本文探讨了大萧条期间青年失业率激增如何影响这一趋势，重点关注性别和社会经济差异。通过使用关联人口普查数据和新数字化的城市级失业率数据，我发现青年失业显著提高了高收入男孩的高中和高等教育完成率，而对女孩和低收入青年的影响微乎其微。这些结果凸显了家庭资源在利用教育机会中的作用，因为经济限制使弱势群体难以从机会成本降低中获益。
10.1017/s002205072510106x.title: Crises and Educational Attainment

10.1017/s0022050725101095.abstract: To what extent do strike threats prompt firms to adopt capital-intensive methods to deter strikes or labor-intensive strategies to maintain flexibility during work stoppages? We introduce a theoretical model that demonstrates how threats of industrial action influence capital investments through relative factor prices and the power dynamics between workers and employers. Using newly digitized data from 3,141 industrial conflicts and collective agreements in Norway during the interwar period, our findings indicate that strikes generally drive firms toward less capital-intensive technologies. This trend is particularly pronounced in conflicts resolved at the branch or national level, where strike threats may appear more exogenous to firms.
10.1017/s0022050725101095.abstract_zh: 罢工威胁在多大程度上促使企业采用资本密集型方法以遏制罢工，或采取劳动密集型策略以在停工期间保持灵活性？我们引入了一个理论模型，展示了工业行动威胁如何通过相对要素价格以及工人与雇主之间的权力动态影响资本投资。利用一战期间挪威3,141起工业冲突和集体协议的新数字化数据，我们的研究结果表明，罢工通常促使企业转向资本密集度较低的技术。这一趋势在分支或国家层面解决的冲突中尤为显著，因为在这些情况下，罢工威胁对企业而言可能显得更具外生性。
10.1017/s0022050725101095.title: Strikes and Machines: Investments in the Norwegian Inter-War-Period
10.1017/s0022050725101095.title_zh: 罢工与机器：挪威两次世界大战期间的投资

10.1017/s0022050725101113.abstract: With 70 million dead, World War II remains the most devastating conflict in history. Among the survivors, millions were displaced, returned maimed from the battlefield, or endured years of captivity. We examine the effects of such war exposures on labor market careers, showing that they often become apparent only at certain life stages. While war injuries reduced employment in old age, former prisoners of war prolonged their time in the workforce before retiring. Many displaced workers, especially women, never returned to employment. These responses align with standard life-cycle theory and thus likely hold relevance for other conflicts.
10.1017/s0022050725101113.abstract_zh: 第二次世界大战造成7000万人死亡，仍是历史上最具破坏性的冲突。幸存者中，数百万人流离失所、从战场伤残归来或经历多年囚禁。我们考察了此类战争经历对劳动力市场职业生涯的影响，发现其影响往往仅在特定人生阶段显现。尽管战争创伤降低了老年期的就业率，但前战俘在退休前延长了工作时间。许多流离失所的劳动者——尤其是女性——再未重返工作岗位。这些反应符合标准生命周期理论，因此可能对其他冲突具有参考意义。
10.1017/s0022050725101113.title: Exposure to World War II and Its Labor Market Consequences over the Life Cycle
10.1017/s0022050725101113.title_zh: 二战经历及其对生命周期劳动力市场的影响

10.1017/s0022050725101149.title: JEH volume 86 issue 2 Cover and Front matter
10.1017/s0022050725101149.title_zh: JEH 第86卷第2期封面及前页

10.1017/s0022050725101150.title: JEH volume 86 issue 2 Cover and Back matter
10.1017/s0022050725101150.title_zh: JEH 第86卷第2期封面与封底

10.1017/s002205072610134x.abstract: American economic historians generally believe that U.S. modern economic growth began before 1840, was broadly based, and the acceleration was gradual. These claims are treated as conjectures rather than solid conclusions because the census did not publish good economic data before 1840. But the earlier period was not a “statistical dark age,” as sometimes asserted. After 1817, systematic statistics on postal activity were available at the local level at high frequencies. These data shed light on the timing and sources of the onset of modern economic growth, the patterns of regional development, and the spread of a culture of communication.
10.1017/s002205072610134x.abstract_zh: 美国经济史学家普遍认为，美国现代经济增长始于1840年之前，基础广泛且增速平缓。这些论断被视为推测而非确凿结论，因为1840年之前的人口普查并未发布可靠的经济数据。但早期阶段并非如某些观点所称的"统计黑暗时代"。1817年后，地方层面可获得高频次、系统性的邮政活动统计数据。这些数据揭示了现代经济增长的起始时间与驱动因素、区域发展模式以及通信文化的传播特征。
10.1017/s002205072610134x.title: Shining Light on a Statistical Dark Age: Postal Activity in Antebellum America

10.1017/s0022050726101454.abstract: <jats:p>European fascist regimes have attached great importance to nationalistic families and designed policies to perpetuate them. Most offered policy packages with interest-free loans repayable through childbirth, along with allowances and tax deductions for large families. Using a difference-in-difference approach and Nazi Germany as a case study, we show that these policies may have counterproductive effects due to negative selection mechanisms in the marriage market. The excessive pressure to marry exerted on singles results in lower quality, ultimately less fertile, and more fragile unions. This finding is important as the main European far-right parties today propose reinstating these policy packages.</jats:p>
10.1017/s0022050726101454.abstract_zh: 欧洲法西斯政权高度重视民族主义家庭，并制定了旨在延续这些家庭的政策。多数政权提供了一揽子政策，包括通过生育偿还的无息贷款，以及对大家庭的补贴和税收减免。本文以纳粹德国为案例，采用双重差分法研究发现，由于婚姻市场中的负向选择机制，这些政策可能产生适得其反的效果。对单身者施加的过度婚姻压力导致婚姻质量下降，最终形成生育率更低、关系更脆弱的结合。这一发现具有重要意义，因为当今欧洲主要极右翼政党正提议重新推行此类政策组合。

10.1017/s0022050726101521.abstract: Using data on interbank relationships and note holdings in Pennsylvania, I estimate the probability that a bank will redeem the notes of other banks by the distance separating them. If two banks were separated by 50 miles, there was a 40 percent probability that a bank would hold the notes of another at a given time. At 200 miles, the estimated probability is virtually zero. My analysis of notes discounted by a small-town, Connecticut banknote broker reveals that distant notes were offered by travelers and traders who moved along the era’s principal waterways.
10.1017/s0022050726101521.abstract_zh: 基于宾夕法尼亚州银行间关系与票据持有数据，本文估算了银行赎回其他银行票据的概率与地理距离的关联。若两家银行相距50英里，特定时点一家银行持有另一家银行票据的概率为40%；当距离增至200英里时，该概率几乎为零。通过对康涅狄格州小镇票据经纪人折价票据的分析发现，远距离票据主要由沿当时主要水路流动的旅行者与商人提供。

10.1017/s0022050726101533.abstract: <jats:p>How much did France pay for its colonial empire? Did colonies benefit from large transfers from French taxpayers and private investors, or were they, on the contrary, drained of their capital? This paper uses novel budgetary, private investment, and loan data to compute monetary flows between France and the colonies between 1833 and 1962. Public expenditure spent by France on the empire represented only 1.3 percent of its GDP, of which four-fifths was for the military. Trade balance deficits of French colonies were not counterbalanced by large public or private capital transfers from France to the colonies, but by military expenditure from the metropole. Overall, large sums of money were flowing from the colonies to the metropole, a “drain” representing a couple of percentage points of colonial GDP, making French colonies comparable to British India in the twentieth century.</jats:p>
10.1017/s0022050726101533.abstract_zh: 法国为其殖民帝国付出了多少代价？殖民地是否从法国纳税人和私人投资者那里获得了大量转移支付，还是相反，其资本被抽走？本文利用新的预算、私人投资和贷款数据，计算了1833年至1962年间法国与殖民地之间的货币流动。法国在帝国上的公共支出仅占其GDP的1.3%，其中五分之四用于军事。法国殖民地的贸易逆差并未被法国向殖民地的大量公共或私人资本转移所抵消，而是由宗主国的军事支出弥补。总体而言，大量资金从殖民地流向宗主国，这种“抽血”相当于殖民地GDP的几个百分点，使得法国殖民地在20世纪与英属印度具有可比性。

10.1057/be.2016.5.abstract: This paper shows how previous fluctuations in births affect the educational system, relative earnings and unemployment rates in the labour market, the number and composition of households, patterns of housing consumption, pressures in health services and personal social services, and finally contribution rates in the state retirement pension system. It also shows how members of large generations may suffer in educational opportunities, in their lifetime earnings prospects and possibly in the pensions that they receive.
10.1057/be.2016.5.abstract_zh: 本文展示了出生人数的历史波动如何影响教育体系、劳动力市场中的相对收入与失业率、家庭数量与构成、住房消费模式、医疗服务及个人社会服务的压力，以及国家退休养老金体系的缴费率。同时，本文揭示了大规模世代成员可能在教育机会、终身收入前景乃至所获养老金方面遭受的不利影响。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2532888.abstract: This paper examines the nonlinear impact of environmental regulations in export destinations on the export quality of Chinese manufacturing goods using the CEPII-BACI database (2001–2021). This study reveals that environmental regulations in destination countries have an inverted U-shaped effect on the quality of Chinese manufacturing exports through the combined effects of the innovation effects, crowding-out effects, and constraint effects. In addition, the scale of imported intermediate products and foreign direct investments into China have a moderating role on the inverted U-shaped relationship, shifting the inflection point of the curve to the left and flattening it. This study deepens the understanding of the spillover effects of cross-border environmental policies and their effects on export quality.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2532888.abstract_zh: 本文利用CEPII-BACI数据库（2001-2021年），考察了出口目的地环境规制对中国制造业出口质量的非线性影响。研究发现，目的地国家的环境规制通过创新效应、挤出效应和约束效应的共同作用，对中国制造业出口质量产生倒U型影响。此外，进口中间品规模与外商对华直接投资对上述倒U型关系具有调节作用，使曲线拐点左移且曲线趋于平缓。本研究深化了对跨境环境政策溢出效应及其对出口质量影响的理解。
10.1080/00036846.2025.2532888.title: Does environmental regulation of export destinations affect export quality? Evidence from an emerging economy
10.1080/00036846.2025.2532888.title_zh: 出口目的地的环境规制是否影响出口质量？来自新兴经济体的证据

10.1080/00036846.2025.2534731.abstract: Using data from Chinese listed companies, this study examines the overall impact of the smart city policy (SCP) on corporate environmental, social, and governance (ESG) performance, focusing on the distinct effects across the E, S, and G dimensions. Using a multiperiod difference-in-differences (DID) approach, we analyse 24647 firm-year observations from 2009 to 2021, leveraging the three-stage SCP rollout as a quasi-natural experiment. The results indicate that the SCP improves corporate ESG scores by approximately 0.04, with significant enhancements in governance performance. Mechanism analysis also reveals that the SCP fosters ESG improvements through increased R&D investments and market attention, while executive environmental awareness has limited effects. Policy impacts also vary by ownership and industry, with state-owned enterprises, industrial firms, and companies in low-pollution and high-technology sectors obtaining the greatest benefits. Robustness checks, including alternative models and PSM-DID estimations, confirm these findings. Moreover, interaction analysis indicates that the SCP and other sustainability-focused policies (e.g. green credit and resource city policies) act as substitutes rather than complements due to policy priority and resource constraints for companies. Our findings underscore the importance of a coordinated policy design to maximize the collective effectiveness of policies in promoting sustainable corporate practices.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2534731.abstract_zh: 基于中国上市公司数据，本研究考察了智慧城市政策（SCP）对企业环境、社会和治理（ESG）绩效的整体影响，重点关注其在E、S、G三个维度上的差异化效应。采用多期双重差分（DID）方法，我们分析了2009年至2021年间24647个公司-年度观测值，将三阶段SCP推广作为准自然实验。结果表明，SCP使企业ESG得分提升约0.04，其中治理绩效的改善尤为显著。机制分析进一步揭示，SCP通过增加研发投入和市场关注度促进ESG改善，而高管环境意识的影响有限。政策效应因所有权性质和行业类型而异，国有企业、工业企业以及低污染和高科技行业的企业获益最大。包括替代模型和倾向得分匹配双重差分（PSM-DID）估计在内的稳健性检验证实了上述发现。此外，交互效应分析表明，由于政策优先级和企业资源约束，SCP与其他可持续发展导向政策（如绿色信贷政策和资源型城市政策）呈现替代而非互补关系。本研究结果强调了协调政策设计对于最大化政策组合在促进企业可持续实践方面整体效能的重要性。
10.1080/00036846.2025.2534731.title: Better city, better life: smart city policy and corporate ESG performance
10.1080/00036846.2025.2534731.title_zh: 智慧城市，美好生活：智慧城市政策与企业ESG表现

10.1080/00036846.2025.2534734.abstract: This paper examines how support from entrepreneurs’ insiders affects financial constraints for entrepreneurs using a survey of 2,644 new firms in Japan. The major findings of this paper are as follows. First, bank referrals from their insiders alleviate entrepreneurs’ financial constraints, whereas there is no evidence that the provision of initial funds from such insiders alleviates the constraints. Second, the effect of such referrals can be more pronounced for financially constrained entrepreneurs. Third, the referrals are effective in alleviating entrepreneurs’ financial constraints even if they do not receive initial funds from their insiders.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2534734.abstract_zh: 本文利用日本2644家新创企业的调查数据，考察企业家内部人支持如何影响其融资约束。主要发现如下：第一，内部人提供的银行推荐能够缓解企业家的融资约束，但尚无证据表明内部人提供的初始资金能缓解此类约束；第二，对于面临融资约束的企业家而言，此类推荐的效果更为显著；第三，即便企业家未从内部人处获得初始资金，内部人推荐仍能有效缓解其融资约束。
10.1080/00036846.2025.2534734.title: How do insiders affect start-up financing?
10.1080/00036846.2025.2534734.title_zh: 内部人士如何影响初创企业融资？

10.1080/00036846.2025.2535542.abstract: While improving agricultural technical efficiency and alleviating energy poverty are vital components of sustainable development, existing research on the relationship between the two remains limited. This study aims to elucidate the effects and mechanisms of energy poverty on agricultural technical efficiency. The sample comprises small-scale farmers from the China Family Panel Studies, spanning from 2012 to 2018. Utilizing the two-stage least squares method to correct for the endogenous bias of energy poverty, our findings indicate that energy poverty reduces agricultural productivity by 11.7% to 47.8%, depending on the measurement method used. With a structural equation modelling approach, we find that the relationship between energy poverty and agricultural productivity is partially mediated by non-agricultural employment and land transfer, which contribute 3.72% to 30.86% to the total impact of energy poverty. Non-agricultural employment and land transfer hinder the improvement of agricultural technical efficiency in the process of alleviating energy poverty. The results and findings of this study yield significant policy implications for energy poverty alleviation and the enhancement of agricultural technical efficiency, which can be generalized to other developing countries.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2535542.abstract_zh: 提升农业技术效率与缓解能源贫困是可持续发展的重要组成部分，然而现有关于二者关系的研究仍较为有限。本研究旨在阐明能源贫困对农业技术效率的影响及其作用机制。研究样本来自中国家庭追踪调查（2012-2018年）中的小规模农户。通过采用两阶段最小二乘法校正能源贫困的内生性偏误，研究发现：根据测量方法的不同，能源贫困使农业生产率降低11.7%至47.8%。基于结构方程模型的分析表明，非农就业与土地流转在能源贫困与农业生产率的关系中发挥部分中介作用，二者对能源贫困总效应的贡献度介于3.72%至30.86%之间。在缓解能源贫困的过程中，非农就业与土地流转反而抑制了农业技术效率的提升。本研究的结论对发展中国家制定能源贫困缓解与农业技术效率提升政策具有重要启示意义。
10.1080/00036846.2025.2535542.title: Does energy poverty affect agricultural technical efficiency? Evidence from small-scale farmers in China
10.1080/00036846.2025.2535542.title_zh: 能源贫困是否影响农业技术效率？来自中国小规模农户的证据

10.1080/00036846.2025.2535545.abstract: This study examines the debt service ratio (DSR) as a predictor of household financial distress in South Korea, with a particular focus on identifying the threshold at which delinquency risk rises sharply. Leveraging household-level microdata and a multilevel Bayesian threshold regression model, we estimate the tipping point in the DSR – default relationship while accounting for household heterogeneity. Our findings indicate that the critical DSR threshold falls below current regulatory benchmarks, suggesting that many households may experience financial strain at lower debt levels than anticipated by policymakers. Notably, we find substantial variation by employment type: temporary and self-employed workers exhibit significantly higher vulnerability, even at moderate DSRs. These results highlight the limitations of uniform regulatory caps and support the need for differentiated, evidence-based lending standards. By offering the first data-driven estimate of DSR thresholds in Korea, this study advances the academic understanding of household credit risk and informs ongoing macroprudential policy development. KEYWORDS: Debt service ratio Delinquency financial stability multilevel bayesian model JEL CLASSIFICATION: G51 C11 D14 G21
10.1080/00036846.2025.2535545.abstract_zh: 本研究以韩国为对象，考察偿债比率（DSR）作为家庭财务困境预测指标的有效性，重点识别违约风险急剧上升的阈值。通过运用家庭层面微观数据与多层贝叶斯阈值回归模型，我们在考虑家庭异质性的基础上，估算了DSR与违约关系中的临界点。研究结果表明，关键DSR阈值低于现行监管基准，这意味着许多家庭在债务水平低于政策制定者预期时便可能面临财务压力。值得注意的是，不同就业类型之间存在显著差异：临时工与自雇劳动者即使在中等DSR水平下也表现出明显更高的脆弱性。这些结果揭示了统一监管上限的局限性，并支持制定差异化、基于证据的贷款标准。通过首次提供韩国DSR阈值的数据驱动估计，本研究深化了对家庭信用风险的学术理解，并为当前宏观审慎政策的发展提供参考。关键词：偿债比率；违约；金融稳定；多层贝叶斯模型 JEL分类：G51；C11；D14；G21
10.1080/00036846.2025.2535545.title: DSR and Household debt delinquency: evidence from South Korea
10.1080/00036846.2025.2535545.title_zh: DSR与家庭债务违约：来自韩国的证据

10.1080/00036846.2025.2535546.abstract: BRICS nations – Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa – stand at a critical crossroads. These countries, while achieving impressive economic growth and urbanization over the past few decades, now face escalating environmental challenges. This study dives deep into the interplay between educational development, digital transformation, and environmental sustainability in BRICS nations from 1990 to 2022. The analysis employs dynamic panel data techniques, including Two-Step System Generalized Method of Moments (GMM), AMG, CCEMG, Fixed Effects models, and also Granger causality to capture the relationships between educational components and environmental outcomes effectively. The GMM outcomes reveal a double-edged sword: economic growth (EG) drives environmental degradation, whereas digital transformation (DT) emerges as a powerful counterforce, significantly mitigating emissions. The first model highlights primary education’s (SEP) vital role in fostering sustainable practices, showing a significant positive effect on reducing carbon emissions (CE). The second model underscores the impact of secondary education (SES), with increased investment proving pivotal in advancing environmental sustainability. The third model brings tertiary education (SET) into the spotlight, emphasizing its crucial contribution to enhancing environmental outcomes. The robustness of these findings is reinforced through rigorous-fixed effects panel regression analysis, consistently affirming the interconnectedness of education, digital transformation, and urbanization in tackling environmental challenges.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2535546.abstract_zh: 金砖国家——巴西、俄罗斯、印度、中国和南非——正站在关键的十字路口。这些国家在过去几十年实现了令人瞩目的经济增长和城市化进程，但如今面临着日益严峻的环境挑战。本研究深入探讨了1990年至2022年间金砖国家教育发展、数字化转型与环境可持续性之间的相互作用。分析采用动态面板数据技术，包括两步系统广义矩估计法（GMM）、AMG、CCEMG、固定效应模型，以及格兰杰因果检验，以有效捕捉教育要素与环境结果之间的关系。GMM结果显示了一柄双刃剑：经济增长（EG）加剧了环境退化，而数字化转型（DT）则成为强大的反制力量，显著减少了排放。第一个模型凸显了初等教育（SEP）在促进可持续实践中的关键作用，表明其对减少碳排放（CE）具有显著的积极影响。第二个模型强调了中等教育（SES）的影响，增加投入被证明是推进环境可持续性的关键。第三个模型将高等教育（SET）置于聚光灯下，强调其在改善环境结果方面的重要贡献。通过严格的固定效应面板回归分析，这些发现得到了进一步强化，一致证实了教育、数字化转型和城市化在应对环境挑战中的相互关联性。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2536751.abstract: The Consumer Price Index (CPI) aims to measure inflation. The CPI, published monthly by the US and measured by the price index of ‘All items’, is the sum of the products of component price indices and their relative weights. We analysed the CPI and its component price indices between 2012 and 2023. Based on the correlations between the CPI and its 358 component price indices, the CPI well represented the trends of most component price indices throughout the period. The time series regression coefficients of component indices did not necessarily match the relative weights. If measuring volatility with rolling standard deviations of raw values with 19 or more months time windows, the CPI was less volatile than the core CPI. The CPI is a good measure of relative price changes in most of the goods or services. However, some goods and services have prices fluctuating in patterns very different from that of the CPI. Policy implications include initiatives that focus on the management of macroeconomic risks, early policy responses using the leading indicators of inflation, policies to manage inflation propagation over time or across price indices, and strategies to refine inflation-linked payments.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2536751.abstract_zh: 消费者价格指数（CPI）旨在衡量通货膨胀。美国每月发布的CPI以“所有项目”价格指数衡量，是各成分价格指数与其相对权重乘积的总和。我们分析了2012年至2023年间的CPI及其成分价格指数。基于CPI与其358个成分价格指数之间的相关性，CPI在整个时期内较好地代表了大多数成分价格指数的趋势。成分指数的时间序列回归系数未必与其相对权重匹配。若采用19个月及以上时间窗口的原始值滚动标准差衡量波动性，CPI的波动性低于核心CPI。CPI是衡量大多数商品或服务相对价格变化的良好指标。然而，部分商品和服务的价格波动模式与CPI存在显著差异。政策启示包括：聚焦宏观经济风险管理的举措、利用通胀领先指标进行早期政策响应、管理通胀随时间或跨价格指数传导的政策，以及优化通胀挂钩支付策略。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2538817.abstract: In this study, we investigate the optimal investment-consumption-insurance decisions faced by a wage earner operating within an inflationary environment, utilizing a continuous finite time framework. We posit that the wage earner’s preference is described by the Cobb-Douglas utility function, which incorporates a parameter that reflects the elasticity of substitution between consumption and leisure. Additionally, we assume that the financial market comprises three distinct financial assets: a risk-free bond, an index bond and a stock. To obtain closed-form solutions for optimal strategies and value function, we utilize the martingale method in conjunction with duality theory. Finally, the impact of several model parameters on optimal strategies is explored through numerical simulation utilizing predefined parameters.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2538817.abstract_zh: 本研究在连续有限时间框架下，探讨通胀环境中工薪阶层面临的最优投资-消费-保险决策问题。假设工薪阶层的偏好由柯布-道格拉斯效用函数描述，该函数包含反映消费与闲暇替代弹性的参数。同时，假定金融市场包含三种不同金融资产：无风险债券、指数债券和股票。为获得最优策略与价值函数的闭式解，我们采用鞅方法与对偶理论相结合的分析框架。最后，通过预设参数的数值模拟，探讨了若干模型参数对最优策略的影响。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2545013.abstract: This study investigates the relationship between firms’ dividend payments and their designation as financially insolvent. We aim to identify a forward-looking indicator that can help predict potential insolvency. Using data from firms listed on the Korea Composite Stock Price Index (KOSPI) and the Korea Securities Dealers Automated Quotations (KOSDAQ) markets between 2005 and 2023, we find that dividend payments are negatively associated with financial insolvency designations. This suggests that firms at risk of insolvency tend to conserve liquidity by postponing or withholding dividend payments prior to being officially designated as insolvent. These findings offer practical insights for investors seeking to protect capital and enhance their understanding of financial sustainability. Moreover, this study underscores the potential of dividend policy as a proactive indicator of financial distress, providing valuable implications for market participants and regulators seeking to promote financial stability.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2545013.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了企业股利支付与其被认定为财务破产之间的关系，旨在识别有助于预测潜在破产的前瞻性指标。基于2005年至2023年间韩国综合股价指数（KOSPI）和韩国证券交易商自动报价系统（KOSDAQ）市场上市公司的数据，我们发现股利支付与财务破产认定呈负相关。这表明，面临破产风险的企业倾向于在正式被认定为破产前，通过推迟或暂停股利支付来保留流动性。这些发现为寻求保护资本并增强对财务可持续性理解的投资者提供了实践启示。此外，本研究强调了股利政策作为财务困境前瞻性指标的潜力，为致力于促进金融稳定的市场参与者和监管机构提供了重要参考。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2546119.abstract: This study examines the impact of state ownership reduction on firms’ Environmental, Social, and Governance performance and investigates how regional development influences this relationship. Using panel data from Chinese publicly traded firms between 2012 and 2024, we employ a fixed-effect design combined with robust econometric techniques, including propensity score matching (PSM), Heckman two-stage estimation, and the generalized method of moments (GMM), to address endogeneity concerns. Our empirical results show that reductions in state ownership are significantly associated with a decline in firms’ ESG performance; however, the effect size appears relatively modest, and the findings should be interpreted as robust correlations rather than definitive causal effects. The analysis also suggests that higher levels of regional development help mitigate this negative association by enhancing local institutional conditions. This study contributes important insights for policymakers by highlighting how privatization and subnational development can jointly influence corporate sustainability practices in emerging markets.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2546119.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了国有股权减持对企业环境、社会与治理绩效的影响，并考察了区域发展水平如何调节这一关系。基于2012至2024年中国上市公司的面板数据，我们采用固定效应模型，并结合倾向得分匹配、赫克曼两阶段估计及广义矩估计等稳健计量方法以处理内生性问题。实证结果表明，国有股权减持与企业ESG绩效下降显著相关，但效应规模相对有限，研究结论应被解读为稳健的相关关系而非确凿的因果效应。进一步分析显示，较高的区域发展水平通过改善地方制度环境有助于缓解这种负向关联。本研究为政策制定者提供了重要启示，揭示了私有化进程与地方发展如何共同影响新兴市场企业的可持续发展实践。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2547103.abstract: In the context of the rapid growth in earnings and internet penetration in China, this study investigates the impact of internet use on earnings. Using a panel data from China Family Panel Study 2010, 2014, 2016, 2018, 2020, 2022，this study finds that internet use promotes earnings growth in China. The benefits of internet use are more pronounced for those born after 1970, the high-educated, and the rural residents. Further investigations reveal three underlying mechanisms, including promoting non-agricultural employment, facilitating multiple jobholding and improving social capital.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2547103.abstract_zh: 在中国收入与互联网普及率快速增长的背景下，本研究探讨了互联网使用对收入的影响。基于中国家庭追踪调查2010、2014、2016、2018、2020、2022年的面板数据，本研究发现互联网使用促进了中国居民的收入增长。对于1970年后出生群体、高学历人群及农村居民而言，互联网使用的收益更为显著。进一步研究揭示了三种潜在机制：促进非农就业、推动多重职业参与以及提升社会资本。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2547105.abstract: This study contributes to understanding the link between the housing market and airport location proximity, whilst examining the entirety of the house price distribution. The research investigates this association across four key urban areas within New Zealand proximal to an international airport – Auckland, Wellington, Christchurch, and Queenstown. Applying hedonic and quantile regression, the analysis reveals that proximity to airports on house prices has a heterogeneous pricing effect. Results show that distance comprises a positive pricing effect within Auckland and Christchurch, whereas in Wellington and Queenstown the pricing effect is negative. The quantile regression findings further revealed differences between lower and higher priced properties value, given distance and proximity to airports within each city region. The Christchurch region reveals contrasting findings, showing there to be a higher positive pricing effect for higher-priced housing, which gradually decreases when moving down the quantiles. It is argued that this higher positive pricing for higher priced properties is due to particularities in the housing market close to Christchurch Airport.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2547105.abstract_zh: 本研究有助于理解住房市场与机场区位邻近性之间的关系，同时考察了房价分布的完整区间。研究调查了新西兰四个靠近国际机场的主要城市区域——奥克兰、惠灵顿、基督城和皇后镇——中这一关联性。通过应用特征价格模型和分位数回归，分析揭示了机场邻近性对房价存在异质性的定价效应。结果显示，在奥克兰和基督城，距离对房价具有正向定价效应，而在惠灵顿和皇后镇，定价效应则为负向。分位数回归结果进一步揭示了各城市区域内，低价值与高价值房产在距离和机场邻近性方面的差异。基督城地区呈现出对比性发现：高价位住房的正向定价效应更强，且随着分位数下移而逐渐减弱。本文认为，高价位房产更强的正向定价效应源于基督城机场附近住房市场的特殊性。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2547107.abstract: This article investigates the impacts of monetary policy, macro- and micro-prudential supervision, and their coordination on mitigating systemic risk in China at both macro and micro levels. At the macro level, we employ the TVP-SV-SVAR model to capture the time-varying impacts of these policies on financial-real sector risk spillover. The results show that expansionary monetary policy and micro-prudential supervision increase the risk spillover, while macro-prudential supervision has the opposite effect. At the micro level, we use bank-level panel data to evaluate the individual and interactive effects of these policies on banks’ systemic risk-taking. The findings reveal that expansionary monetary policy increases banks’ systemic risk through the risk-taking channel, whereas both macro- and micro-prudential supervision reduce banks’ risk-taking. Most notably, the results highlight the significance of policy coordination. Macro-prudential supervision can mitigate the negative effects of expansionary monetary policy, while micro-prudential tools require strategic integration with macro-prudential supervision to reduce macro-level risk spillover.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2547107.abstract_zh: 本文从宏观与微观两个层面，考察了货币政策、宏观审慎监管、微观审慎监管及其协调配合对中国系统性风险的缓释效应。在宏观层面，我们采用TVP-SV-SVAR模型捕捉上述政策对金融-实体经济风险溢出的时变影响。结果表明，扩张性货币政策与微观审慎监管加剧了风险溢出，而宏观审慎监管则产生相反效果。在微观层面，我们利用银行层面面板数据评估了这些政策对银行系统性风险承担行为的独立效应与交互效应。研究发现，扩张性货币政策通过风险承担渠道增加了银行的系统性风险，而宏观与微观审慎监管均降低了银行的风险承担。尤为重要的是，研究结果凸显了政策协调的重要性：宏观审慎监管能够缓解扩张性货币政策的负面效应，而微观审慎工具需与宏观审慎监管进行战略整合，方能降低宏观层面的风险溢出。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2547109.abstract: Previous climate risk assessments using models such as DICE or IAMs often exhibit instability, which poses challenges for accurate calculations. This paper refines these methodologies to assess the climate risk exposure of Chinese banks, taking into account both physical and transition risks. We empirically examine the impact of climate risk on bank performance and find that most Chinese listed banks are exposed to significant climate risks, with some banks’ exposures surpassing their market value. By comparing banks located in the upper and lower reaches of the Yangtze River, we observe that climate risk exposures typically show distinct geographic patterns. Using a time and individual fixed effects model, we demonstrate that higher climate risk negatively affects bank performance by degrading credit quality and increasing market risk-weighted assets. This impact is especially pronounced for commercial banks with small assets, low equity ratios, low ESG performance or low share capital. Our findings provide valuable insights for improving business strategies in response to climate change.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2547109.abstract_zh: 以往使用DICE或IAMs等模型进行的气候风险评估往往表现出不稳定性，这给精确计算带来了挑战。本文改进了这些方法，综合考虑物理风险和转型风险，评估了中国银行的气候风险敞口。我们通过实证检验气候风险对银行绩效的影响，发现大多数中国上市银行面临显著的气候风险，部分银行的风险敞口甚至超过其市值。通过比较长江上下游地区银行的差异，我们观察到气候风险敞口通常呈现明显的地理分布特征。采用时间和个体固定效应模型，我们证明较高的气候风险会通过降低信贷质量和增加市场风险加权资产，对银行绩效产生负面影响。这种影响在资产规模小、权益比率低、ESG表现差或股本规模小的商业银行中尤为显著。我们的研究结果为应对气候变化而改进商业策略提供了有价值的见解。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2547110.abstract: Traditional passive fund performance evaluation relies on tracking error metrics, which have a short-term orientation. As such, these metrics may not appropriately quantify the long-term performance of passive funds, which is of particular interest to buy-and-hold investors. This study considers the potential shortcomings of current passive investment evaluation practices by comparing the performance of a sample of United States equity exchange traded funds (ETFs) based on short-run (tracking error) and long-run (cointegration-based) tracking metrics over the period 1 January 2013 to 25 September 2024. The cointegration approach employed accommodates structural breaks. Our findings reveal significant disparities in rankings, highlighting the importance of aligning performance evaluation with investment horizons. We also introduce a novel metric, ‘Overall Tracking Performance’, which integrates both short- and long-run measures. Finally, we demonstrate that top-performing funds maintain consistent tracking performance over successive periods, irrespective of the measure of tracking performance. These results offer meaningful insights for both investors and fund managers seeking a more comprehensive approach to passive fund performance evaluation.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2547110.abstract_zh: 传统被动型基金绩效评估依赖跟踪误差指标，这类指标具有短期导向性。对于长期持有型投资者尤为关注的被动型基金长期绩效，这些指标可能无法进行恰当量化。本研究通过对比2013年1月1日至2024年9月25日期间美国股票交易所交易基金（ETF）样本基于短期（跟踪误差）与长期（协整）跟踪指标的绩效表现，探讨当前被动投资评估实践存在的潜在缺陷。所采用的协整方法能够适应结构性突变。研究结果揭示排名存在显著差异，凸显了绩效评估与投资期限相匹配的重要性。我们同时引入"综合跟踪绩效"这一新型指标，该指标整合了短期与长期度量维度。最后证明，无论采用何种跟踪绩效度量方式，表现最优的基金均能在连续期间保持稳定的跟踪绩效。这些发现为寻求更全面被动型基金绩效评估方法的投资者与基金管理人提供了重要启示。
10.1080/00036846.2025.2547110.title: Evaluating passive fund performance: short-term versus long-term metrics
10.1080/00036846.2025.2547110.title_zh: 被动基金绩效评估：短期与长期指标的比较

10.1080/00036846.2025.2547111.abstract: We study how the rapid adoption of FinTech payment technology, Zelle, affects crime in the United States. We collect a novel dataset of Zelle’s banking partners using an internet archive tool-the Wayback Machine. Our baseline OLS model shows a higher Zelle penetration is associated with a lower robbery rate and motor vehicle theft rate at the county level. To address the reverse causality issue, we exploit the fact that Zelle was launched by the seven largest U.S. banks in 2017. The difference-in-difference analysis shows that counties with large exposure to the seven largest U.S. banks before 2017 experienced a large decline in the robbery rate and motor vehicle theft rate. The negative effect on the robbery rate was more pronounced in counties with lower education levels and fewer law employees. Our findings shed light on the evolution of the social impact of FinTech adoption.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2547111.abstract_zh: 本文研究了金融科技支付技术Zelle的快速普及对美国犯罪率的影响。我们利用互联网存档工具Wayback Machine收集了Zelle银行合作伙伴的新数据集。基准OLS模型显示，Zelle渗透率较高的县，其抢劫率和机动车盗窃率较低。为解决反向因果问题，我们利用Zelle于2017年由美国七大银行联合推出这一事实。双重差分分析表明，在2017年前对七大银行敞口较大的县，抢劫率和机动车盗窃率显著下降。抢劫率的下降效应在教育水平较低及执法人员较少的县更为明显。本研究揭示了金融科技应用社会影响的演变规律。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2547113.abstract: Building upon the static analysis conducted via structural equation modelling (SEM), this study employs Belousov-Zhabotinskii reaction model in complex system theory to construct three-dimensional Logistic dynamic equation, simulates the collaborative support pathways between formal finance and informal finance for enterprise innovation under policy incentives. 519 science and technology-based SMEs listed on Growth Enterprise Market in China are taken as samples. The results of simulation reveal that the level of formal financial support and enterprise innovation performance improve with enhancing of policy incentive. The scale and growth rate of formal finance significantly surpass those of informal finance. Formal and informal finance consistently exhibit an incomplete substitution relationship which becomes more pronounced as policy incentives intensify. The regional disparities in the effects of policy stimulation are notable: Eastern and central regions benefit from substantial policy support, where a marked positive relationship exists between corporate innovation and formal financial support. The external policy environment in the western and northeastern regions needs to be optimized, where enterprises innovation remains sluggish. The marginal contribution of this study lies in simulating the nonlinear dynamic evolutionary pathways of financial support for enterprise innovation under different policy incentive intensities, from the perspective of complex system theory. KEYWORDS: Science and technology-based small and medium-sized enterprises financial synergistic support policy incentive complex system theory Belousov-Zhabotinskii reaction model JEL CLASSIFICATION: C15 G30 O17 O38
10.1080/00036846.2025.2547113.abstract_zh: 在结构方程模型（SEM）静态分析的基础上，本研究运用复杂系统理论中的别洛乌索夫-扎博京斯基反应模型，构建三维Logistic动态方程，模拟政策激励下正规金融与非正规金融对企业创新的协同支持路径。以中国创业板上市的519家科技型中小企业为样本。模拟结果显示：正规金融支持水平与企业创新绩效随政策激励增强而提升；正规金融的规模与增长速度显著优于非正规金融；正规金融与非正规金融始终呈现不完全替代关系，且该关系随政策激励强化而更加显著。政策激励效果存在显著区域差异：东部和中部地区受益于强有力的政策支持，企业创新与正规金融支持之间存在显著正向关系；西部和东北地区的外部政策环境有待优化，企业创新仍显滞后。本研究的边际贡献在于：从复杂系统理论视角，模拟不同政策激励强度下金融支持企业创新的非线性动态演化路径。关键词：科技型中小企业；金融协同支持；政策激励；复杂系统理论；别洛乌索夫-扎博京斯基反应模型 JEL分类号：C15 G30 O17 O38

10.1080/00036846.2025.2547115.abstract: This paper investigates the safe haven properties of China’s green stocks under geopolitical risks and oil market volatility. Leveraging an integrated analytical framework – including the Transformer-DCC-GARCH, SVAR, and TVP-VAR models – we examine the dynamic relationships among green stocks, geopolitical risks, and oil prices. The results show that green stocks exhibit a significant negative correlation with oil prices during periods of heightened geopolitical risks, such as the global oil price collapse, COVID-19 pandemic, and Russia-Ukraine conflict, indicating their short-term dynamic safe haven properties. Moreover, green stocks help stabilize oil price fluctuations by promoting energy transition, thereby indirectly mitigating the adverse impact of geopolitical risks and exhibiting long-term structural safe haven properties. These safe haven properties are time-varying and more pronounced during periods of heightened global risk. Further analysis demonstrates that incorporating green stocks into energy investment portfolios through a geopolitical risk-based strategy improves both return and risk-adjusted performance, confirming their practical hedging value. Overall, the findings suggest that while green stocks play a vital role in stabilizing energy markets, their hedging effectiveness is contingent on evolving risk environments. Strengthening regulatory support and expanding green financial instruments are essential to fully realize their safe haven properties.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2547115.abstract_zh: 本文探究中国绿色股票在地缘政治风险与石油市场波动下的避险属性。通过整合Transformer-DCC-GARCH、SVAR与TVP-VAR模型构建分析框架，我们考察了绿色股票、地缘政治风险与石油价格之间的动态关系。研究结果表明：在全球油价暴跌、新冠疫情及俄乌冲突等地缘政治风险加剧时期，绿色股票与石油价格呈现显著负相关，表明其具有短期动态避险属性。此外，绿色股票通过推动能源转型有助于稳定油价波动，从而间接缓解地缘政治风险的不利影响，展现出长期结构性避险属性。这些避险属性具有时变性，在全球风险加剧时期更为显著。进一步分析表明，基于地缘政治风险策略将绿色股票纳入能源投资组合，能够同时提升收益与风险调整后绩效，证实了其实际对冲价值。总体而言，研究结果表明绿色股票在稳定能源市场方面发挥重要作用，但其对冲效果取决于风险环境的演变。为充分实现其避险属性，需加强监管支持并拓展绿色金融工具。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2547116.abstract: To preserve a competitive edge and protect proprietary information, companies may strategically design their ESG disclosures in line with product market competition (PMC). This study aims to examine how the moderating role of PMC influences the relationship between sustainable practices and ‘firm financial performance’ (FFP). Using regression techniques on a sample of 2801 firms from G-20 countries over a study period covering from 2011 to 2023, findings show that firms’ sustainable practices positively impact FFP. PMC effectively acts as a disciplinary mechanism for firm’s performance and aligns with the deterrence hypothesis. Due to competitive pressure, sustainable practices increase firm performance. Although in all cases, PMC does not portray moderating effect to establish relationship between sustainable practices and firm value, the individual parameters, such as environmental and social practices, are enhancing FFP under high PMC levels. While in low competition, environmental practices detriment FFP due to competitive disadvantages. Further, in developed countries, PMC is ineffective, whereas it effectively works for developing countries. Using alternative competition measures, sensitivity analysis, and propensity score matching, the present study provides robust empirical evidence to validate the moderating role of PMC in shaping ESG-FFP dynamics. Managers may leverage PMC strategically; investors and policymakers ought to keep on surveillance for greenwashing.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2547116.abstract_zh: 为保持竞争优势并保护专有信息，企业可能根据产品市场竞争（PMC）策略性地设计其ESG披露。本研究旨在探讨PMC的调节作用如何影响可持续实践与企业财务绩效（FFP）之间的关系。基于2011至2023年间G20国家2801家企业的样本数据，采用回归分析发现：企业可持续实践对FFP具有正向影响。PMC有效发挥企业绩效的惩戒机制作用，与威慑假说一致。在竞争压力下，可持续实践提升了企业绩效。尽管在所有情形中PMC均未表现出调节可持续实践与企业价值关系的效应，但在高PMC水平下，环境与社会实践等单项指标均能提升FFP；而在低竞争环境下，环境实践因竞争劣势反而损害FFP。此外，PMC在发达国家中调节效应不显著，但在发展中国家表现有效。通过采用替代竞争指标、敏感性分析和倾向得分匹配，本研究为PMC在ESG-FFP动态关系中的调节作用提供了稳健的实证证据。管理者可策略性运用PMC；投资者与政策制定者需持续警惕漂绿行为。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2547117.abstract: This study explores the impact of artificial intelligence (AI) adoption on the quality of environmental, social, and governance (ESG) disclosures, emphasizing the moderating roles of internal (corporate governance quality) and external (regional institutional development) factors in Chinese firms listed on the Shanghai and Shenzhen Stock Exchanges. Drawing on data from the Wind, Bloomberg, and CSMAR databases, as well as firms’ annual reports, the analysis spans 14,945 firm-year observations from 2015 to 2023. Methodologically, the study employs principal component analysis (PCA), fixed effects modelling, one-year lagged regression, and three-stage least squares (3SLS) estimation to ensure robust findings. The results reveal that both governance quality and regional institutional strength significantly enhance the positive effect of AI adoption on ESG disclosure. Firms situated in regions with stronger institutional frameworks and higher governance standards report more transparent and detailed ESG information. Among the sample, companies listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange demonstrate the most substantial improvements. The findings suggest that policymakers should strengthen institutional support and promote AI integration, while corporate leaders should enhance governance practices to maximize AI’s potential in ESG reporting. This research offers new insights into the role of digital transformation in advancing ESG transparency within emerging markets like China. KEYWORDS: Artificial intelligence (AI) ESG disclosure institutional quality corporate governance (CG) regional development China JEL CLASSIFICATION: M14 M41 M40 M15
10.1080/00036846.2025.2547117.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了人工智能（AI）应用对环境、社会和治理（ESG）信息披露质量的影响，重点分析了内部因素（公司治理质量）与外部因素（区域制度发展）在中国沪深两市上市公司中的调节作用。基于Wind、彭博、CSMAR数据库及企业年报数据，研究涵盖2015年至2023年间14,945个公司-年度观测值。在方法上，本研究采用主成分分析（PCA）、固定效应模型、滞后一期回归及三阶段最小二乘法（3SLS）估计，以确保结果的稳健性。结果表明，治理质量与区域制度强度均显著增强了AI应用对ESG信息披露的正向效应。位于制度框架更完善、治理标准更高地区的企业，其ESG信息披露更为透明且详尽。在样本中，深圳证券交易所上市公司的改善最为显著。研究建议，政策制定者应强化制度支持并推动AI整合，而企业领导者则应优化治理实践，以最大化AI在ESG报告中的潜力。本研究为理解数字化转型在新兴市场（如中国）中推动ESG透明度提升的作用提供了新见解。关键词：人工智能（AI） ESG信息披露 制度质量 公司治理（CG） 区域发展 中国 JEL分类：M14 M41 M40 M15

10.1080/00036846.2025.2547118.abstract: This study examines the impact of the ‘integration of informatization and industrialization’ (III) pilot policy on corporate ESG (environmental, social, and governance) performance. Utilizing unbalanced panel data from Chinese listed companies spanning 2010–2022, we construct a multi-period difference-in-differences (DID) model for empirical analysis. The results demonstrate that the III pilot policy significantly enhances corporate ESG performance, with findings remaining robust across a series of rigorous tests. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that the policy’s positive effects are more pronounced in eastern and central China compared with western regions. The policy also consistently improves ESG performance across corporate life cycles – growth, maturity, and decline stages – although the magnitude varies. Notably, heavily polluting and technology-intensive industries exhibit stronger ESG improvements under the policy. Additional mechanism analyses indicate that green technology innovation capabilities, labour productivity levels, and government support collectively form a positive feedback loop in mediating the policy’s impact on ESG outcomes. Our research provides novel policy-level evidence for advancing corporate ESG practices.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2547118.abstract_zh: 本研究考察了“两化融合”（III）试点政策对企业ESG（环境、社会和治理）绩效的影响。基于2010—2022年中国上市公司非平衡面板数据，构建多期双重差分（DID）模型进行实证分析。结果表明，III试点政策显著提升了企业ESG绩效，该结论在一系列严格检验中保持稳健。异质性分析显示，相较于西部地区，该政策在东部和中部地区的积极效应更为显著。政策在企业生命周期各阶段（成长期、成熟期和衰退期）均能持续改善ESG绩效，但影响幅度存在差异。值得注意的是，重污染行业和技术密集型行业在政策作用下表现出更强的ESG改善效果。进一步机制分析表明，绿色技术创新能力、劳动生产率水平和政府支持共同构成正向反馈循环，中介了政策对ESG结果的影响。本研究为推进企业ESG实践提供了新的政策层面证据。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2548037.abstract: This study uses a multilevel analysis to examine how banking system stability influences the relationship between bank concentration and borrower discouragement. The analysis uses 26 rounds of the Survey on the Access to Finance of Enterprises for 11 Eurozone countries between 2010 and 2022. We find that banking system stability reduces or even reverses the negative effect of bank concentration on borrower discouragement for small and medium-sized enterprises. Specifically, increased bank concentration reduces borrower discouragement when banking system stability, measured using the Z-score, is above certain thresholds: 20.6 for term loans and 21.97 for credit lines. These thresholds correspond to the 90th–95th percentiles of banking system stability in the data, meaning that only about 5–10% of firms operate in banking systems sufficiently stable for concentration to reduce discouragement. Micro firms benefit the most from bank concentration in stable banking systems but suffer the most in unstable ones. Additionally, increased bank concentration discourages credit line borrowers more than term loan borrowers in unstable systems, with the opposite effect in stable systems. Overall, maintaining banking system stability is essential for realizing the potential benefits of bank concentration, especially for small firms.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2548037.abstract_zh: 本研究采用多层次分析，探讨银行体系稳定性如何影响银行集中度与借款者受挫感之间的关系。分析基于2010年至2022年间欧元区11国企业融资调查的26轮数据。研究发现，银行体系稳定性能够削弱甚至逆转银行集中度对中小企业借款者受挫感的负面效应。具体而言，当以Z-score衡量的银行体系稳定性超过特定阈值时（定期贷款为20.6，信用额度为21.97），银行集中度的提高会降低借款者受挫感。这些阈值对应数据中银行体系稳定性的第90至第95百分位，意味着仅有约5%至10%的企业处于稳定性足以使集中度缓解受挫感的银行体系中。微型企业在稳定银行体系中从集中度获益最大，但在不稳定体系中受损也最严重。此外，在不稳定体系中，银行集中度提高对信用额度借款者的抑制作用强于定期贷款借款者，而在稳定体系中则呈现相反效应。总体而言，维持银行体系稳定性对于实现银行集中度的潜在效益至关重要，尤其对小型企业而言。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2548409.abstract: Pilot free trade zones (FTZs) constitute crucial reform measures for deepening institutional opening up. However, their microeconomic effects remain debated, and their influence on total factor productivity (TFP) needs further exploration. Using Chinese A-share listed companies as a sample, this study employs a difference-in-differences (DID) model to evaluate the productivity effects of FTZs and to identify the underlying mechanisms. The results indicate that pilot FTZs have a negative effect on enterprise productivity, which is seen primarily in eastern China, private enterprises, and high-tech industries. However, pilot FTZs in first-tier cities can mitigate this negative impact. Regarding the mechanisms, FTZs exacerbate market monopoly power, encourage enterprises to increase their investment scale, and exert a crowding-out effect on innovation. Hence, the mass implementation of institutional opening up via pilot FTZs should not be rushed. Instead, pilot reforms should prioritize developed first-tier cities, and they should balance high levels of openness with innovation-driven growth strategies. These findings offer a foundation for refining FTZ policies and advancing high-quality enterprise development.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2548409.abstract_zh: 自由贸易试验区（FTZs）是深化制度型开放的关键改革举措，但其微观经济效应仍存争议，对全要素生产率（TFP）的影响有待深入探究。本研究以中国A股上市公司为样本，采用双重差分（DID）模型评估自贸试验区的生产率效应，并识别其作用机制。结果表明，自贸试验区对企业生产率存在负向影响，这一效应主要集中于东部地区、民营企业和高科技行业。然而，一线城市的自贸试验区能够缓解这种负面冲击。从机制来看，自贸试验区加剧了市场垄断势力，促使企业扩大投资规模，并对创新产生挤出效应。因此，不宜急于通过自贸试验区大规模推行制度型开放，而应优先在发达的一线城市开展试点改革，并平衡高水平开放与创新驱动增长战略。这些发现为完善自贸试验区政策、推动企业高质量发展提供了依据。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2548413.abstract: Workers Pension Insurance accounts for more than 90% of China’s basic social pension income and expenditure. This scheme is a partially funded design that is pronounced sensitivity to demographic shifts. Persistently low fertility and accelerated population ageing jeopardize the system’s long-term solvency, rendering an actuarial evaluation imperative. Drawing on data from the United Nations’ World Population Prospects 2024 and official Chinese statistical sources, we calibrate an actuarial model to project the system’s sustainability. Our simulations indicate that, absent of a delayed-retirement reform, the pension system is projected to record its first annual cash-flow shortfall in 2033 and to exhaust its cumulative reserves by 2042. Under a phased retirement-age increase, the first cash-flow deficit and reserve depletion are deferred to 2049 and 2058, respectively. By 2100, the system is still expected to accumulate an unfunded deficit of approximately CNY 1715 trillion. Consequently, while the delayed retirement policy may provide temporary relief for pension payment pressures, it fails to resolve the underlying long-term viability of the pension system.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2548413.abstract_zh: 职工养老保险占中国基本社会养老保险收支的90%以上。该制度采用部分积累制设计，对人口结构变化高度敏感。持续的低生育率和加速的人口老龄化正危及该体系的长期偿付能力，因此进行精算评估势在必行。基于联合国《世界人口展望2024》及中国官方统计数据，我们校准了一个精算模型以预测该体系的可持续性。模拟结果显示，若不实施延迟退休改革，养老金体系预计将在2033年首次出现年度现金流缺口，并于2042年耗尽累计储备。若采取渐进式延迟退休年龄方案，首次现金流赤字和储备耗尽将分别推迟至2049年和2058年。到2100年，该体系预计仍将积累约1715万亿元人民币的无资金准备赤字。因此，延迟退休政策虽能暂时缓解养老金支付压力，但无法从根本上解决养老金体系的长期可持续性问题。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2549094.abstract: Corporate transparency is essential for effective governance, as it mitigates information asymmetry between internal and external stakeholders. Blockchain’s decentralized, immutable, and traceable features offer a novel solution for improving operational transparency. Drawing upon agency theory, this study investigates how and to what extent blockchain innovation affects corporate transparency. Based on data from firms listed on the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock exchanges (A-share market) during the period 2017–2023, the results show that blockchain innovation significantly enhances corporate transparency. Additionally, we further explore the impact mechanisms of external supervision on the relationship between blockchain innovation and corporate transparency. The results find that both media supervision and institutional investors amplify the positive effect of blockchain innovation on corporate transparency. This study contributes to interdisciplinary research at the intersection of information technology and corporate governance by demonstrating how blockchain technology can enhance corporate transparency.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2549094.abstract_zh: 企业透明度对于有效治理至关重要，因为它能缓解内外部利益相关者之间的信息不对称。区块链的去中心化、不可篡改和可追溯特性为提升运营透明度提供了全新解决方案。基于委托代理理论，本研究探讨了区块链创新如何以及在多大程度上影响企业透明度。基于2017-2023年沪深两市A股上市公司数据，结果表明区块链创新显著提升了企业透明度。此外，我们进一步探究了外部监督对区块链创新与企业透明度关系的调节机制。研究发现，媒体监督和机构投资者均能强化区块链创新对企业透明度的正向促进作用。本研究通过论证区块链技术如何提升企业透明度，为信息技术与公司治理交叉领域的跨学科研究做出了贡献。

10.1080/00036846.2025.2549529.abstract: Essentially, debt financing aims to enhance corporate performance through effective debt management, underscoring the trade-offs between associated costs and benefits. Using data from Chinese listed firms during 2010–2022, this study defines debt utilization efficiency using a DuPont analysis and demonstrates that in corporate settings, it is significantly improved by environmental, social, and governance (ESG) performance. This conclusion remains unchanged after a battery of robustness tests. Mediation analysis shows that attention from external analysts partially mediates the relationship between ESG performance and debt utilization efficiency. We further find that intense industry competition positively moderates the relationship between ESG performance and debt utilization efficiency, while high environmental uncertainty negatively moderates this relationship. Our study thus expands the literature on debt financing and highlights the role of ESG in financial sustainability.
10.1080/00036846.2025.2549529.abstract_zh: 债务融资的本质在于通过有效的债务管理提升企业绩效，这凸显了相关成本与收益之间的权衡关系。本研究基于2010-2022年中国上市公司数据，运用杜邦分析法界定债务利用效率，并证明在企业情境下，环境、社会与治理（ESG）表现能显著提升该效率。经过一系列稳健性检验后，该结论依然成立。中介效应分析表明，外部分析师关注度在ESG表现与债务利用效率之间起部分中介作用。进一步研究发现，行业竞争强度正向调节ESG表现与债务利用效率的关系，而环境不确定性则负向调节该关系。本研究拓展了债务融资领域的文献，并凸显了ESG在财务可持续性中的重要作用。
