10.1080/00036846.2026.2699942.abstract_zh: 加速发展新质生产力已成为各国应对全球竞争、增强可持续发展能力的重要战略选择。基于此，本研究利用2009—2022年280个城市的面板数据，以国家级新区为典型代表，严谨考察了区位导向型政策是否有助于推动新质生产力发展，并通过多维敏感性分析验证了研究结果的稳健性。实证结果表明，新区的设立显著提升了新质生产力水平，其作用机制在于政府主导的科技投入与区域市场化水平发挥了正向调节效应。进一步机制检验证实，该政策通过驱动第三产业集聚、同时抑制传统制造业集聚的路径加速了新质生产力发展。深入分析发现，政策效应存在显著的结构性差异：从空间布局看，单城发展模式的效果优于双城协同模式；从行政层级看，政策在行政级别较高的城市中影响更为显著。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699942.title: The role of location-oriented policy in promoting the development of new quality productivity in regions
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699942.title_zh: 区位导向政策在促进区域新质生产力发展中的作用

10.1080/00036846.2026.2699943.abstract: In the minimum wage literature, much of the focus has been on the effects of minimum wage changes on employment, wages, earnings of labour market participants, and income. However, through its influence on parents’ income, time allocation, and capacity for health investment, a change in minimum wage can also affect child health. In this study, I examine the effect of the minimum wage introduced by the 1966 Fair Labor Standards Act on child health. The study uses intergenerational survey data from US households in the Panel Study of Income Dynamics (PSID) and employs a difference-in-differences research design. The results show that the introduction of a minimum wage increases the likelihood of a healthy childhood. The effect is not homogeneous across states; it is stronger in states without prior minimum wage policies, where the Act represented a larger shock. The results further reveal significant gender heterogeneity, indicating that the health improvement effect of the minimum wage policy is substantially stronger for girls than for boys. The findings are robust to a range of additional validation exercises, including event-study specifications, spillover analyses, and placebo tests.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699943.abstract_zh: 在最低工资文献中，研究重点多集中于最低工资变动对就业、工资、劳动力市场参与者收入及总体收入的影响。然而，最低工资变动通过影响父母的收入、时间分配及健康投资能力，也可能对儿童健康产生作用。本研究考察了1966年《公平劳动标准法》引入的最低工资制度对儿童健康的影响。研究采用美国收入动态追踪调查（PSID）中的跨代际家庭数据，并运用双重差分研究设计。结果表明，最低工资的引入提高了儿童拥有健康童年的可能性。该效应在各州间并非同质：在未实施过最低工资政策的州（该法案带来的冲击更大）中，效应更为显著。结果进一步揭示了显著的性别异质性，表明最低工资政策对女孩的健康改善效应明显强于男孩。上述发现在一系列额外验证测试中保持稳健，包括事件研究设定、溢出效应分析及安慰剂检验。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699943.title: Minimum wage and child health: Evidence from the 1966 Fair Labor Standards Act
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699943.title_zh: 最低工资与儿童健康：来自1966年《公平劳动标准法》的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2699944.abstract: This study examines the moderating effect of the minimum wage on the relationship between industrial robots and labour mobility in China. Using provincial-industrial panel data from 2006–2019, combining China’s industrial database and IFR robot data, we analyse patterns of labour mobility at both regional and industry levels. To ensure the robustness of the results, we discuss potential collinearity between robot penetration and the minimum wage, as well as the persistence of the relation of the baseline results. Our findings reveal that the minimum wage negatively moderates the positive effect of robots on regional labour mobility while amplifying their impact on inter-industry labour reallocation. Heterogeneity analysis shows these effects are stronger in regions with lower education levels and higher employment rates. Although the minimum wage exhibits no significant lagged effects on regional labour mobility, it demonstrates persistent effects on industrial labour mobility. Long-term analysis further indicates that the minimum wage amplifies robots’ negative influence on regional labour flows while enhancing industrial labour reallocation. These findings suggest the need for coordinated policies that consider both automation trends and regional labour market characteristics when setting the minimum wage.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699944.abstract_zh: 本研究考察了最低工资对中国工业机器人影响劳动力流动的调节效应。基于2006-2019年省级-行业面板数据，结合中国工业数据库与国际机器人联合会（IFR）机器人数据，我们从区域和行业两个层面分析了劳动力流动模式。为确保结果稳健性，我们探讨了机器人渗透率与最低工资之间可能存在的多重共线性问题，以及基准结果关系的持续性。研究发现：最低工资对机器人促进区域劳动力流动的正向效应具有负向调节作用，同时强化了机器人对跨行业劳动力再配置的影响。异质性分析表明，在受教育水平较低、就业率较高的地区，上述调节效应更为显著。尽管最低工资对区域劳动力流动未呈现显著滞后效应，但其对行业间劳动力流动具有持续影响。长期分析进一步显示，最低工资会放大机器人对区域劳动力流动的抑制作用，同时增强行业间劳动力再配置效应。这些发现表明，在制定最低工资标准时，需要统筹考虑自动化发展趋势与区域劳动力市场特征，实施协调性政策。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699944.title: Beyond substitution: the moderating effect of the minimum wage on robot-labour dynamics in China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699944.title_zh: 超越替代：最低工资对中国机器人-劳动力动态关系的调节效应

10.1080/00036846.2026.2699945.abstract: Supplier concentration can enhance resource integration efficiency, but it may also increase dependency risks. Therefore, concerning inventory management, which supply chain structure is more advantageous: diversification or centralization? We utilize data from publicly listed firms in China from 2010 to 2024 to empirically examine the impact of supplier concentration on firms’ lean inventory and its potential mechanisms. The results indicate that supplier concentration generally has a positive effect on firms in promoting lean inventory, thereby supporting the theoretical assumptions dominated by transaction cost economics and embeddedness theory. In addition, from the perspectives of information flow, production flow, and capital flow, we verify that supplier concentration promotes lean inventory in firms by reducing coordination costs, alleviating financing constraints, and enhancing total factor productivity. Focusing on the resource dependence theory, we find that corporate strategy, R&D innovation, and regional marketization of firms amplify the positive effect of supplier concentration on lean inventory. Finally, analysis of segmented inventory type data indicates that supplier concentration significantly drives lean practices in raw materials and work-in-progress inventory, while its impact on lean practices related to finished goods inventory is limited.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699945.abstract_zh: 供应商集中度能够提升资源整合效率，但也可能增加依赖风险。因此，在库存管理方面，供应链结构究竟是多元化还是集中化更具优势？我们利用2010至2024年中国上市公司数据，实证检验供应商集中度对企业精益库存的影响及其潜在机制。结果表明，供应商集中度总体上对企业推进精益库存具有正向效应，从而支持了以交易成本经济学和嵌入性理论为主导的理论假设。此外，从信息流、生产流和资金流视角出发，我们验证了供应商集中度通过降低协调成本、缓解融资约束以及提升全要素生产率来促进企业精益库存。基于资源依赖理论，我们发现企业战略、研发创新及区域市场化程度会放大供应商集中度对精益库存的正向效应。最后，对细分库存类型数据的分析表明，供应商集中度显著推动了原材料和在制品库存的精益实践，但对产成品库存精益实践的影响有限。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699945.title: Concentrating or dispersing? The impact of supplier concentration on lean inventory
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699945.title_zh: 集中还是分散？供应商集中度对精益库存的影响

10.1080/00036846.2026.2699948.abstract: We use causal forests to examine how public utility broadband providers are associated with broadband adoption and local market structure across 194 counties in Tennessee and Iowa, 38 of which have a public utility broadband provider. Public provider presence is associated with an average 6% point higher broadband adoption share, lower private-carrier market shares, and lower measured market concentration, though the latter partly reflects the mechanical effect of an additional provider on the concentration index. The estimated adoption difference is largest in lower-income and urban counties and in counties where public providers have greater geographic reach and offer lower prices. Given the cross-sectional design, limited number of treated counties, and the observable income imbalance between treated and untreated counties, we interpret these results as a transparent, explicitly associational account of structured heterogeneity in broadband outcomes rather than as causal estimates; sensitivity analyses indicate that the income heterogeneity patterns are not driven solely by the observable selection margin.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699948.abstract_zh: 我们采用因果森林方法，考察公共事业宽带提供商如何与田纳西州和爱荷华州194个县的宽带普及率及本地市场结构相关联，其中38个县拥有公共事业宽带提供商。公共提供商的存在与宽带普及率平均高出6个百分点、私营运营商市场份额降低以及市场集中度下降相关——尽管后者部分反映了新增提供商对集中度指数的机械性影响。宽带普及率差异在低收入县、城市县以及公共提供商地理覆盖范围更广、定价更低的县中最为显著。鉴于本研究采用横截面设计、受处理县数量有限，且受处理县与未受处理县之间存在可观测的收入不平衡，我们将这些结果解读为对宽带结果中结构化异质性的透明、明确关联性描述，而非因果估计；敏感性分析表明，收入异质性模式并非仅由可观测的选择性边界驱动。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699948.title: Making connections: access and market competition with public broadband
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699948.title_zh: 建立连接：公共宽带接入与市场竞争

10.1080/00036846.2026.2701281.abstract: Amid the growing urgency of climate change and the global pursuit of net-zero emissions, green fiscal policy (GFP) has become an important instrument for sustainable development. This study examines the effect of GFP on urban carbon emission mitigation (UCEM), with particular attention to its mechanisms and heterogeneous impacts. Using panel data for 274 Chinese prefecture-level cities from 2002 to 2022, it employs the Comprehensive Demonstration of Fiscal Policy for Energy Conservation and Emission Reduction as a quasi-natural experiment and applies a difference-in-differences approach. The results show that GFP significantly promotes UCEM, with stronger effects in cities characterized by higher pollution levels. Mechanism analysis indicates that green innovation and lower total energy consumption serve as positive channels, whereas government environmental attention plays a negative mediating role. In addition, entrepreneurial activity strengthens the effect of GFP, while fiscal pressure weakens it. These findings support phased GFP expansion, stricter enforcement in high-pollution cities, stronger incentives in low-pollution areas, improved transparency and supervision, innovation-led efficiency and clean-energy substitution, plus flexible financing to sustain decarbonization.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2701281.abstract_zh: 在气候变化日益紧迫和全球追求净零排放的背景下，绿色财政政策已成为促进可持续发展的重要工具。本研究考察了绿色财政政策对城市碳减排的影响，重点关注其作用机制与异质性效应。基于2002至2022年中国274个地级市的面板数据，本文以节能减排财政政策综合示范作为准自然实验，采用双重差分方法进行分析。结果表明，绿色财政政策显著促进了城市碳减排，且在污染程度较高的城市中效果更为明显。机制分析显示，绿色创新与降低总能源消费是正向传导渠道，而政府环境关注则发挥负向中介作用。此外，创业活动强化了绿色财政政策的效应，而财政压力则削弱了该效应。这些发现支持分阶段推广绿色财政政策、在高污染城市加强执行力度、在低污染地区强化激励措施、提升透明度与监管水平、以创新驱动效率提升和清洁能源替代，以及通过灵活融资维持脱碳进程。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2701281.title: Steering cities towards net-zero: unravelling the causal impact of green fiscal policy on urban decarbonization in China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2701281.title_zh: 引导城市迈向净零排放：揭示绿色财政政策对中国城市脱碳的因果影响

10.1080/00036846.2026.2701282.abstract: Against the backdrop of deepening global climate governance and China’s advancing dual carbon goals, climate risk disclosure has gradually emerged as an important institutional arrangement for firms to respond to climate change and accelerate green transformation. Using a sample of China’s A-share listed firms from 2016 to 2024, this study systematically investigates how climate risk disclosure affects corporate green innovation and explores its underlying mechanisms. The empirical results show that climate risk disclosure exerts a significant positive effect on corporate green innovation. Mechanism analyses confirm the existence of internal resource reallocation channels. Specifically, climate risk disclosure increases firms’ R&D investment and crowds out speculative financial asset holdings. Furthermore, heterogeneity analyses demonstrate that the facilitating effect is more pronounced for firms with severe natural disaster exposure, weaker regional environmental regulation, lower traditional core business risk, higher institutional ownership and less severe financial constraints. These findings enrich the literature on the relationship between climate risk disclosure and corporate green innovation while providing targeted policy and managerial implications for policymakers and firm executives to advance environmental sustainability.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2701282.abstract_zh: 在全球气候治理持续深化与中国"双碳"目标稳步推进的背景下，气候风险披露逐渐成为企业应对气候变化、加速绿色转型的重要制度安排。本研究以2016-2024年中国A股上市公司为样本，系统考察气候风险披露对企业绿色创新的影响及其作用机制。实证结果表明，气候风险披露对企业绿色创新具有显著正向影响。机制分析证实了内部资源再配置渠道的存在：气候风险披露既增加了企业研发投入，又挤出了投机性金融资产持有。进一步异质性分析显示，在自然灾害暴露程度较高、地区环境规制较弱、传统核心业务风险较低、机构投资者持股比例较高以及融资约束程度较轻的企业中，气候风险披露的促进效应更为显著。这些发现丰富了气候风险披露与企业绿色创新关系的文献体系，同时为政策制定者与企业高管推进环境可持续发展提供了针对性的政策启示与管理建议。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2701282.title: Does climate risk disclosure promote corporate green innovation? The role of internal resource reallocation
10.1080/00036846.2026.2701282.title_zh: 气候风险披露是否促进企业绿色创新？内部资源再配置的作用

10.1080/00036846.2026.2701284.abstract: While digital innovation (DI) is viewed as a key driver of industrial decarbonization, its environmental impact remains contested. The growing energy demand may induce Jevons-type rebound effects, challenging the sustainability of digital transition. Moving beyond linear and static perspectives, this study integrates dynamic capability theory with the technique-composition-scale framework to examine the nonlinear relationship between DI and carbon emissions (CE). Using panel data from Chinese A-share listed manufacturing firms from 2014 to 2021, the results reveal a robust U-shaped relationship: DI reduces CE in the early stage but increases it after further expansion. This pattern is more pronounced among younger firms and firms in low-energy-intensity sectors. External environmental regulation intensity steepens the curve by accelerating stage transitions, whereas corporate green investment scale acts as an internal buffer, flattening the curve and marginally shifting the turning point rightward. These findings provide stage-adaptive implications for balancing digital transformation with carbon reduction.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2701284.abstract_zh: 尽管数字创新被视为工业脱碳的关键驱动力，但其环境影响仍存在争议。日益增长的能源需求可能引发杰文斯型反弹效应，对数字转型的可持续性构成挑战。本研究突破线性与静态视角，将动态能力理论与技术-构成-规模框架相结合，考察数字创新与碳排放之间的非线性关系。基于2014-2021年中国A股制造业上市公司面板数据，结果揭示出稳健的U型关系：数字创新在初期阶段降低碳排放，但进一步扩张后反而增加碳排放。这一模式在年轻企业及低能源强度行业的企业中更为显著。外部环境规制强度通过加速阶段转换使曲线更陡峭，而企业绿色投资规模作为内部缓冲机制则使曲线趋于平缓，并将拐点轻微右移。这些发现为平衡数字化转型与碳减排提供了阶段适应性启示。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2701284.title: Digital enabler or carbon culprit? The U-shaped trajectory of digital innovation on carbon emissions
10.1080/00036846.2026.2701284.title_zh: 数字赋能还是碳排元凶？数字创新对碳排放的U型轨迹

10.1080/00036846.2026.2701296.abstract: In the context of the digital economy reshaping new forms of employment while social security coverage for flexibly employed workers remains inadequate,this study, set against the backdrop of digital economy reshaping employment and insufficient social security for flexibly employed workers, uses CFPS microdata to systematically analyze the impact and mechanisms of digital technology use on pension insurance participation. Empirically, digital technology use significantly promotes participation, a finding robust to various sensitivity tests. Mechanistically, it facilitates participation by raising income, job satisfaction, and trust in social security. Interestingly, the contribution base plays a negative moderating role. Heterogeneity reveals that the positive effect is stronger among middle-aged and older workers, agricultural hukou holders, less-educated, and married groups. Policy recommendations include a targeted digital expansion strategy, optimized contribution parameters accommodating flexible work, and a long-term promotion mechanism centered on improving job quality and institutional trust, so as to sustainably increase pension insurance participation.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2701296.abstract_zh: 在数字经济重塑就业形态而灵活就业者社保覆盖不足的背景下，本研究利用CFPS微观数据，系统分析了数字技术使用对养老保险参与的影响及其作用机制。实证结果表明，数字技术使用显著促进了养老保险参与，该结论在多种敏感性检验中保持稳健。机制分析显示，数字技术使用通过提高收入水平、工作满意度及社保制度信任度促进参与。值得注意的是，缴费基数在其中发挥负向调节作用。异质性分析表明，该促进效应在中老年群体、农业户籍者、低学历群体及已婚群体中更为显著。政策建议包括：实施精准化数字推广策略、优化适应灵活就业的缴费参数设计、构建以提升工作质量与制度信任为核心的长期促进机制，从而持续提高养老保险参与率。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2701296.title: How does digital technology use affect the participation of flexibly employed workers in pension insurance? Evidence from China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2701296.title_zh: 数字技术使用如何影响灵活就业人员参与养老保险？——来自中国的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2701302.abstract: We exploit China’s 2007 policy promoting the import of key equipment and technology as an exogenous shock and examine its effects on firms’ total factor productivity (TFP). Drawing on a merged dataset combining the Chinese Annual Survey of Industrial Firms and patent filings for the 2003–2009 period, we implement a difference-in-differences strategy to quantify the policy’s impact. We find that the policy led to a statistically and economically significant 1.11% increase in treated firms’ TFP relative to untreated firms during the sample period, and this result remains highly robust across a wide range of empirical checks. A mechanism analysis reveals that the policy primarily relaxes firms’ financial constraints and strengthen their capacity for innovation, especially technological innovation. These mechanistic channels contribute to an observed improvement in productivity. Moreover, the heterogeneity analysis indicates that the productivity effects of the policy are greater among medium and large-sized firms, state-owned and foreign firms, non-superstar firms and firms in financially underdeveloped regions.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2701302.abstract_zh: 本文以中国2007年促进关键设备与技术进口的政策作为外生冲击，考察其对企业全要素生产率（TFP）的影响。基于2003-2009年中国工业企业年度调查与专利数据的合并数据集，我们采用双重差分策略量化该政策的影响。研究发现，在样本期内，该政策使受处理企业的全要素生产率相较于未受处理企业显著提升1.11%，这一结果在经济意义和统计意义上均显著，并在多种稳健性检验中保持高度稳健。机制分析表明，该政策主要通过缓解企业融资约束、增强企业创新能力（尤其是技术创新能力）发挥作用，这些机制渠道最终促进了生产率的提升。异质性分析进一步显示，该政策对中型和大型企业、国有及外资企业、非明星企业以及金融欠发达地区企业的生产率提升效应更为显著。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2701302.title: Key equipment and technology imports and firm productivity
10.1080/00036846.2026.2701302.title_zh: 关键设备与技术进口与企业生产率

10.1080/00036846.2026.2701324.abstract: The enhancement of carbon productivity necessitates the deployment of cleaner technologies, the establishment of robust policy frameworks, and the optimization of production factor allocation. This study examines the effect of energy misallocation on total factor carbon productivity (TFCP) using stochastic frontier analysis across 73 countries. Employing panel data from 1991 to 2023, we construct country-level relative misallocation indices for energy, capital, and labour, based on deviations between observed and theoretically efficient factor input shares. Our methodology involves fixed-effects models and several robustness checks, including dynamic panel analysis and policy-heterogeneity tests. The results reveal a strong negative correlation between energy misallocation and TFCP, whereas the impacts of capital and labour misallocation are comparatively weaker and less consistent. Energy over-allocation imposes a greater productivity cost than under-allocation, indicating that excessive energy consumption significantly impedes carbon-adjusted efficiency. This deleterious effect intensifies in later periods, coinciding with increases in economic scale, energy demand, and carbon constraints. Nevertheless, policy-heterogeneity tests, utilizing Environmental Policy Stringency indicators, demonstrate that environmental policies, particularly market-based instruments, partially attenuate this effect by strengthening price signals and incentivizing structural adjustments. These findings highlight energy allocation efficiency as a critical mechanism through which low-carbon transition policies can advance carbon productivity. KEYWORDS: Energy misallocation total factor carbon productivity resource distortion environmental regulation climate policy JEL CLASSIFICATION: Q43 Q54 O47 D24
10.1080/00036846.2026.2701324.abstract_zh: 提升碳生产率需要部署清洁技术、建立稳健的政策框架并优化生产要素配置。本研究运用随机前沿分析法，考察了73个国家能源错配对全要素碳生产率（TFCP）的影响。基于1991至2023年的面板数据，我们根据实际要素投入份额与理论有效份额的偏离程度，构建了国家层面的能源、资本和劳动力相对错配指数。研究方法包括固定效应模型及多项稳健性检验，如动态面板分析和政策异质性检验。结果表明，能源错配与全要素碳生产率呈显著负相关，而资本和劳动力错配的影响则相对较弱且一致性较差。能源过度配置比配置不足造成的生产率损失更大，表明能源过度消耗显著阻碍了碳调整效率。这种负面效应在后期阶段加剧，与经济规模、能源需求和碳约束的增加同步。然而，利用环境政策严格度指标进行的政策异质性检验表明，环境政策（尤其是市场型工具）通过强化价格信号和激励结构调整，部分缓解了这一效应。这些发现揭示了能源配置效率是低碳转型政策提升碳生产率的关键机制。关键词：能源错配 全要素碳生产率 资源扭曲 环境规制 气候政策 JEL分类：Q43 Q54 O47 D24
10.1080/00036846.2026.2701324.title: Factor distortions and carbon efficiency: the case of energy misallocation
10.1080/00036846.2026.2701324.title_zh: 要素扭曲与碳效率：能源错配的案例研究

10.1080/00036846.2026.2701325.abstract: This study aims to investigate whether and how industrial internet platform (IIP) adoption translates digital connectivity into measurable green productivity gains at the firm level. Utilizing a comprehensive sample of listed companies in China’s renewable energy sector spanning from 2008 to 2024, we specify a staggered difference-in-differences (DID) model to empirically test the relationship between IIP access and corporate green total factor productivity (GTFP). Our findings demonstrate that IIP adoption significantly enhances GTFP, remaining robust across multiple sensitivity tests. Mechanism analyses reveal that this enhancement is driven primarily by data network effects and digital-first innovation strategies. Furthermore, cross-sectional analyses indicate that the positive impact is more pronounced in firms characterized by lower labour intensity, higher market competition, and lower asset specificity. Based on these findings, we suggest that management should strategically integrate IIP into their internal operations. IIP providers should develop and embed real-time carbon monitoring tools to lower technical barriers for adoption. Policymakers should shift from generic subsidies to targeted interventions, offering specific fiscal incentives to alleviate the high transition costs faced by firms with rigid asset structures.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2701325.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探究工业互联网平台（IIP）的采用是否以及如何将数字互联转化为企业层面可测度的绿色生产力提升。基于2008至2024年中国可再生能源行业上市公司的综合样本，我们构建了交错双重差分（DID）模型，实证检验IIP接入与企业绿色全要素生产率（GTFP）之间的关系。研究结果表明，IIP采用显著提升了GTFP，该结论在多项敏感性检验中保持稳健。机制分析揭示，这一提升主要源于数据网络效应与数字优先创新战略。进一步异质性分析显示，在劳动密集度较低、市场竞争程度较高及资产专用性较低的企业中，IIP的积极影响更为显著。基于上述发现，我们建议管理层应将IIP战略性地融入内部运营；IIP提供商应开发并嵌入实时碳监测工具以降低采用技术门槛；政策制定者应从普惠式补贴转向精准干预，通过提供针对性财政激励措施，缓解资产结构僵化企业面临的高额转型成本。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2701325.title: Industrial internet and green total factor productivity: evidence from a quasi-natural experiment in China’s renewable energy industry
10.1080/00036846.2026.2701325.title_zh: 工业互联网与绿色全要素生产率：来自中国可再生能源行业准自然实验的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2702112.abstract: This paper takes the establishment of China’s data trading platforms as a quasi-natural experiment, and examines their impacts on corporate information disclosure quality based on the data of listed companies from 2012 to 2025. The empirical results show that the launch of data trading platforms significantly improves the quality of corporate information disclosure, which verifies the positive effect of data on corporate information disclosure. Such platforms exert influences mainly through three channels: encouraging firms to accumulate high-quality data, improving their capabilities for information disclosure, and strengthening their willingness to disclose information. Further analysis indicates that the improvement in information disclosure quality can effectively reduce abnormal audit fees and alleviate corporate financing constraints. This paper provides a data-oriented theoretical perspective for research on information disclosure quality, and offers practical implications for the construction of data trading platforms and the optimization of corporate information disclosure.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2702112.abstract_zh: 本文以中国数据交易平台的设立为准自然实验，基于2012至2025年上市公司数据，考察其对信息披露质量的影响。实证结果表明，数据交易平台的启动显著提升了企业信息披露质量，验证了数据对企业信息披露的积极效应。此类平台主要通过三条渠道发挥作用：鼓励企业积累高质量数据、提升信息披露能力、强化信息披露意愿。进一步分析显示，信息披露质量的提升能够有效降低异常审计费用，并缓解企业融资约束。本文为信息披露质量研究提供了数据导向的理论视角，并对数据交易平台建设及企业信息披露优化具有实践启示。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2702112.title: Data trading platforms and corporate information disclosure quality: evidence from China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2702112.title_zh: 数据交易平台与企业信息披露质量：来自中国的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2702114.abstract: This study explores the high- and low-volatility spillover effects and portfolio allocation from a frequency-domain perspective across the stock, bond, forex, gold, and oil markets. Specifically, we decompose realized volatility into high- and low-volatility regimes and analyse volatility spillovers from both short- and long-term components using the TVP-VAR frequency connectedness approach. In addition, we employ four portfolio strategies to evaluate cumulative returns and hedging effectiveness. This results reveal significant differences in spillover effects between high- and low-volatility networks: short-term spillovers dominate in high-volatility networks, whereas long-term spillovers are the main contributors in low-volatility networks. Furthermore, the portfolio constructed using the minimum connectedness approach (MCoP) exhibits the highest cumulative returns, whereas the minimum variance portfolio (MVP) and risk parity portfolio (RPP) achieve stronger hedging effectiveness. Overall, this study highlights the importance of jointly considering volatility intensity and time-frequency characteristics when assessing cross-market risk transmission and designing portfolio strategies.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2702114.abstract_zh: 本研究从频域视角探讨了股票、债券、外汇、黄金及石油市场间的高、低波动溢出效应与资产配置策略。具体而言，我们将已实现波动率分解为高波动与低波动状态，并采用TVP-VAR频域关联方法，从短期与长期成分两个维度分析波动溢出效应。此外，我们运用四种投资组合策略评估累计收益与对冲有效性。研究结果显示，高波动与低波动网络中的溢出效应存在显著差异：高波动网络中短期溢出占主导地位，而低波动网络中长期溢出为主要贡献因素。进一步发现，基于最小关联法构建的投资组合（MCoP）具有最高的累计收益，而最小方差组合（MVP）与风险平价组合（RPP）则展现出更强的对冲有效性。总体而言，本研究强调了在评估跨市场风险传导与设计投资组合策略时，需同时考虑波动强度与时间-频率特征的重要性。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2702114.title: Financial market high-low volatility spillover and portfolio allocation: a time frequency analysis
10.1080/00036846.2026.2702114.title_zh: 金融市场高低波动溢出与投资组合配置：时频分析

10.1080/00036846.2026.2703152.abstract: Credit constraints can limit land consolidation in developing economies, even when land rental markets are formally available. This paper studies China’s land management right mortgage lending pilot programme, which allows rural households to pledge land management rights—rather than land ownership—as collateral. Using household panel data from China’s National Fixed Observation Points from 2009 to 2019 and a difference-in-differences design, we find that the programme increases land renting-out by rural households. The effect is larger after the 2019 revision of the Rural Land Contract Law, which codified the use of land management rights as collateral and reduced legal uncertainty. The programme also changes the allocation of rented-out land: land is increasingly transferred to larger and more capitalized agricultural operators rather than to ordinary smallholders. Evidence on formal bank credit and village-level land rents is consistent with a collateral-value mechanism. The reform improves access to credit for households with greater scale potential and raises rental returns, strengthening incentives to supply land to the rental market. These findings show that legally secured land collateralization can facilitate land reallocation, but may also shift market power towards better-capitalized operators.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2703152.abstract_zh: 信贷约束可能限制发展中国家的土地整合，即使土地租赁市场在形式上已存在。本文研究了中国土地经营权抵押贷款试点项目，该项目允许农村家庭以土地经营权（而非土地所有权）作为抵押品。利用2009年至2019年中国全国固定观察点的家庭面板数据，并结合双重差分设计，我们发现该项目增加了农村家庭的土地转出行为。在2019年《农村土地承包法》修订后，这一效应更为显著，该修订将土地经营权作为抵押品的使用纳入法律框架，并降低了法律不确定性。该项目还改变了转出土地的分配格局：土地越来越多地流向规模更大、资本化程度更高的农业经营者，而非普通小农户。关于正规银行贷款和村级土地租金的证据与抵押品价值机制相一致。该改革为具有更大规模潜力的家庭改善了信贷获取渠道，并提高了租金回报，从而增强了向租赁市场供应土地的激励。这些发现表明，法律保障的土地抵押化能够促进土地再配置，但也可能将市场力量向资本化程度更高的经营者转移。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2703152.title: How does the rural land management right mortgage loan programme affect rural household land renting-out? Evidence from China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2703152.title_zh: 农村土地经营权抵押贷款项目如何影响农户土地转出？——来自中国的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2703153.abstract: Can broadband infrastructure serve as a catalyst for breaking intergenerational income links and promoting social mobility? This paper tries to answer this question by empirically examining the effects of broadband infrastructure on intergenerational income mobility in China. We exploit a quasi-natural experiment provided by the Broadband China Strategy (BCS) and employ a staggered difference-in-differences methodology to draw causal insights, revealing a 0.058 decrease in intergenerational income elasticity in pilot cities compared to non-pilot cities. The effect is particularly pronounced for males, cohorts born in the 1980 s, those whose fathers have rural hukou or lower levels of education, and residents in peri-urban areas surrounding major cities. Mechanism analyses suggest that the increase in intergenerational income mobility is primarily due to reshaping employment opportunities in favour of disadvantaged groups. These findings hold important implications not only for China but also for other developing countries undergoing digitalization.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2703153.abstract_zh: 宽带基础设施能否成为打破代际收入关联、促进社会流动的催化剂？本文通过实证检验宽带基础设施对中国代际收入流动性的影响来回答这一问题。我们利用"宽带中国"战略提供的准自然实验，采用交错双重差分法进行因果推断，发现试点城市的代际收入弹性较非试点城市下降了0.058。这一效应在男性、20世纪80年代出生群体、父亲为农村户籍或低学历者、以及大城市周边近郊居民中尤为显著。机制分析表明，代际收入流动性的提升主要源于就业机会向弱势群体的重新配置。这些发现不仅对中国具有重要启示，对正处于数字化转型进程中的其他发展中国家同样具有借鉴意义。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2703153.title: Breaking the links: broadband infrastructure and intergenerational income mobility
10.1080/00036846.2026.2703153.title_zh: 打破连接：宽带基础设施与代际收入流动性

10.1080/00036846.2026.2703828.abstract: The carbon emissions trading mechanism increases production costs for regulated firms, which undoubtedly encourages enterprises to participate in technology research and development (R&D). However, it is unclear whether the carbon price will lead to misallocation of firms’ innovation resources. When R&D labour and capital are misallocated, increased R&D spending does not necessarily translate into innovation gains. Therefore, focusing on China’s carbon emissions trading mechanism, we systematically examine whether the carbon price affects firms’ innovation resource allocation and further evaluate social welfare after correcting for such misallocation. The analysis indicates that the carbon price exerts an inverted U-shaped effect on both R&D capital and labour misallocation; beyond a certain threshold, the carbon price helps reduce R&D resource misallocation. Further analysis indicates that correcting these misallocations significantly enhances both the quantity and quality of innovation output. These findings expand the research on carbon price mechanisms, highlight the importance of innovation resource allocation efficiency in climate governance, and provide evidence for designing carbon price policies that balance emission reduction targets with innovation efficiency.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2703828.abstract_zh: 碳排放交易机制提高了受监管企业的生产成本，这无疑会激励企业参与技术研发。然而，碳价是否会导致企业创新资源的错配尚不明确。当研发劳动力和资本出现错配时，研发支出的增加并不必然转化为创新收益。因此，本文聚焦中国碳排放交易机制，系统考察碳价是否影响企业创新资源配置，并进一步评估纠正此类错配后的社会福利效应。分析表明，碳价对研发资本和劳动力错配均呈现倒U型影响；当碳价超过特定阈值后，有助于减少研发资源错配。进一步分析显示，纠正这些错配能显著提升创新产出的数量与质量。这些发现拓展了碳价机制的研究范畴，凸显了创新资源配置效率在气候治理中的重要性，并为设计兼顾减排目标与创新效率的碳价政策提供了实证依据。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2703828.title: Carbon price and the misallocation of enterprise innovation resources
10.1080/00036846.2026.2703828.title_zh: 碳价格与企业创新资源的错配

10.1080/00036846.2026.2703829.abstract: This article analyses the notion of Ecological Rationality in the context of decision making under uncertainty. It suggests that constructivist approaches, namely constructivist rationality, are not adapted to solve problems faced in the real ecological environments, which imply large world problems and intractability. The complexity of the decision problems imply search and information costs and thus heuristics, as exhibited by human decision makers might be optimal. It is suggested that inverse S-shaped probability weighting as exhibited by most decision makers might be optimal when facing real world environments. It is shown that the maximum entropy approach can be used to model such kind of behaviour as an approximation to the inverse S-shaped probability weighting. It is argued that this approach is ecologically rational and that such a heuristic can be used to treat financial and econometric decision problems and be a calibrated to decision-makers ambiguity aversion.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2703829.abstract_zh: 本文分析了不确定性决策背景下“生态理性”的概念。研究指出，建构主义方法（即建构理性）并不适用于解决真实生态环境中的问题，这类问题涉及“大世界”困境与不可解性。决策问题的复杂性意味着搜索成本与信息成本的存在，因此人类决策者所展现的启发式策略可能具有最优性。研究表明，多数决策者表现出的反S形概率权重在真实环境决策中可能具有最优性。本文论证了最大熵方法可作为反S形概率权重的近似模型来模拟此类行为，并指出该路径具有生态理性特征，可应用于金融与计量经济决策问题，同时能校准决策者的模糊厌恶倾向。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2703829.title: Ecological rationality and the maximum entropy heuristic
10.1080/00036846.2026.2703829.title_zh: 生态理性与最大熵启发式

10.1080/00036846.2026.2703832.abstract: Online sales have been deepening the integration of digital and real economies and driving enterprise development in recent years, but their impact on the expansion of enterprises’ innovation boundaries remains underexplored. Based on constructing a heterogeneous innovation theory model, this paper conducts empirical tests using two-way fixed‑effects models, combined with unbalanced panel data of A-share listed enterprises from 2015 to 2024. The results showed that online sales significantly expand enterprises’ innovation boundaries and help increase the number of patents. From mechanism perspectives, online sales encourage companies’ substantive technological innovation, resulting in technological breakthroughs through broadening market information channels, promoting knowledge and technology spillovers and altering enterprises’ innovation strategies. Heterogeneity analyses revealed that the effect of online sales is more pronounced for enterprises with a higher degree of digital transformation, larger scale and low market share. This study provides new empirical evidence for exploring how online sales can be leveraged to empower enterprise innovation and the innovation incentives of digital-real integration
10.1080/00036846.2026.2703832.abstract_zh: 近年来，线上销售持续深化数字经济与实体经济的融合，并驱动企业发展，但其对企业创新边界拓展的影响尚未得到充分探究。本文在构建异质性创新理论模型的基础上，采用双向固定效应模型，结合2015—2024年A股上市企业非平衡面板数据进行实证检验。结果表明，线上销售显著拓展了企业的创新边界，并有助于增加专利数量。从机制视角来看，线上销售通过拓宽市场信息渠道、促进知识和技术溢出以及改变企业创新策略，鼓励企业开展实质性技术创新，从而实现技术突破。异质性分析显示，对于数字化转型程度较高、规模较大且市场份额较低的企业，线上销售的影响更为显著。本研究为探索如何利用线上销售赋能企业创新以及数字融合的创新激励提供了新的经验证据。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2703832.title: Online sales and the expansion of enterprises’ innovation boundaries: on the innovation incentive of digital-real integration
10.1080/00036846.2026.2703832.title_zh: 线上销售与企业创新边界扩张：数字实体融合的创新激励研究

10.1080/00036846.2026.2703834.abstract: Prior studies have not fully examined the factors associated with the global CO 2 transfer network driven by information and communication technology (ICT) investments (GCNI). We employ a multi-regional input-output model, complex network analysis, and an exponential random graph model to explore the evolution and formation mechanisms of the GCNI between 2000 and 2020 from the perspective of foreign direct investment (FDI) motivations. The results indicate that the GCNI has become increasingly interconnected. CO 2 transfer relationships exhibit significant reciprocity and triadic closure characteristics. Larger and more open markets are more likely to receive CO 2 transfer relationships, while similar markets are more likely to establish such relationships. Vertical factors associated with receiving CO 2 transfer relationships evolve from abundant natural resources to low-cost labour, and eventually to highly skilled labour. Regions with stricter environmental regulations and higher corporate tax rates are more likely to initiate these relationships. Our findings suggest that FDI motivation-related factors are closely associated with the geographical pattern of ICT investment-driven emission transfers. These associations may be informative for investment-related emission disclosure, carbon accounting, and discussions of carbon responsibilities and sustainable ICT development in the digital era.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2703834.abstract_zh: 以往研究尚未充分探讨与信息和通信技术（ICT）投资驱动的全球二氧化碳转移网络（GCNI）相关的因素。我们采用多区域投入产出模型、复杂网络分析和指数随机图模型，从外国直接投资（FDI）动机的视角，探究2000年至2020年间GCNI的演化与形成机制。结果表明，GCNI的互联性日益增强。二氧化碳转移关系呈现出显著的互惠性和三元闭合特征。市场规模更大、开放程度更高的经济体更易成为二氧化碳转移关系的接收方，而相似的市场之间则更倾向于建立此类关系。与接收二氧化碳转移关系相关的垂直因素，从丰富的自然资源逐步演变为低成本劳动力，最终转向高技能劳动力。环境规制更严格、企业税率更高的地区更可能发起此类关系。我们的发现表明，与FDI动机相关的因素与ICT投资驱动的排放转移地理格局密切相关。这些关联可能为投资相关的排放披露、碳核算，以及数字时代碳责任与可持续ICT发展的讨论提供参考信息。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2703834.title:
Formation mechanism evolution of CO
                    <sub>2</sub>
                    emissions outsourcing within the global ICT multinational investment network
10.1080/00036846.2026.2703834.title_zh: 全球ICT跨国投资网络中CO₂排放外包的形成机制演化

10.1080/00036846.2026.2703835.abstract: Exploiting the establishment of public data platforms in China as a quasi-natural experiment, this paper systematically examines the impact of public data on the integration of manufacturing and service industries (MSI). We find that public data openness significantly promotes MSI. Mechanism analysis identifies two transmission channels through which public data openness promotes MSI. These channels are enterprise digital-intelligent transformation and high-skilled labour matching. We further find that the local market and institutional environment moderates this effect. The promotional impact is stronger in cities whose market and institutional environments are weaker. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that among various categories of public data, data pertaining to government services, market regulation, and fiscal and financial affairs exhibits a more pronounced promotional effect. The promotional effect is stronger in cities with more developed digital infrastructure and in non-resource-based cities. This study offers key policy implications for deepening public data openness and empowering regional industrial structure upgrading within the context of the digital economy.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2703835.abstract_zh: 本文以中国公共数据平台设立为准自然实验，系统考察了公共数据对制造业与服务业融合（MSI）的影响。研究发现，公共数据开放显著促进了制造业与服务业融合。机制分析揭示了公共数据开放促进产业融合的两条传导渠道：企业数智化转型与高技能劳动力匹配。进一步研究表明，本地市场与制度环境对该效应具有调节作用——在市场与制度环境较弱的城市，其促进效应更为显著。异质性分析显示，在各类公共数据中，政务服务、市场监管及财政金融类数据的促进效应尤为突出；数字基础设施更完善的城市及非资源型城市中，该促进效应更强。本研究为数字经济背景下深化公共数据开放、赋能区域产业结构升级提供了重要政策启示。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2703835.title: Data element sharing and manufacturing-service integration: evidence from China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2703835.title_zh: 数据要素共享与制造服务融合：来自中国的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2704614.abstract: Topology data analysis (TDA) explores the topological structure features of data from the geometric topology perspective. This study constructs investment portfolios by integrating asset clustering based on topological structure features and price prediction. First, we employ the Principal Component Analysis to reduce the dimensionality of nine topological features, and utilize the K-Medoids algorithm to cluster multiple assets based on the extracted principal components. Then, portfolios based on historical prices and predicted prices are constructed, respectively, with the latter effectively integrates the advantages of TDA and the predictive information. Based on closing prices of Chinese stock market, the performance of five TDA-based strategies are analysed and compared with five industry classification strategies. The results show that portfolios incorporating topological features outperform those based on industry classification, and portfolios integrating predicted prices further outperform those based on historical data. Specifically, the strategy combining TDA with volatility, and the strategy combining TDA with both predicted prices and Sharpe ratio, are particularly outstanding. This study verifies the core value of topological features in investment decision-making, providing a practical approach for portfolio construction. KEYWORDS: Portfolio strategy topology data analysis price prediction asset clustering JEL CLASSIFICATION: G11 G17
10.1080/00036846.2026.2704614.abstract_zh: 拓扑数据分析（TDA）从几何拓扑视角探索数据的拓扑结构特征。本研究通过整合基于拓扑结构特征的资产聚类与价格预测来构建投资组合。首先，我们采用主成分分析对九个拓扑特征进行降维，并利用K-Medoids算法基于提取的主成分对多个资产进行聚类。随后，分别基于历史价格和预测价格构建投资组合，后者有效融合了TDA的优势与预测信息。基于中国股市收盘价，我们分析了五种TDA策略的表现，并与五种行业分类策略进行比较。结果表明，纳入拓扑特征的投资组合优于基于行业分类的投资组合，而整合预测价格的投资组合进一步优于基于历史数据的投资组合。具体而言，结合TDA与波动率的策略，以及结合TDA与预测价格及夏普比率的策略表现尤为突出。本研究验证了拓扑特征在投资决策中的核心价值，为投资组合构建提供了一种实用方法。关键词：投资组合策略；拓扑数据分析；价格预测；资产聚类 JEL分类：G11 G17
10.1080/00036846.2026.2704614.title: Topological structure features enhanced portfolios: integration of asset clustering and price prediction
10.1080/00036846.2026.2704614.title_zh: 拓扑结构特征增强的投资组合：资产聚类与价格预测的整合

10.1080/00036846.2026.2704615.abstract: This paper investigates the impact of Data Exchange Platform (DEP) establishment on the green innovation of heavily polluting enterprises, with a focus on spatial spillover effects. Using panel data on Chinese listed firms from 2014 to 2023, we employ a hybrid framework that combines machine learning techniques, causal econometric models with instrumental variables, and spatial econometric and regression methods. The results indicate that DEP significantly promotes green innovation in host cities. The main empirically verified mechanism lies in restraining greenwashing through enhanced data transparency. However, at the spatial level, DEP shows a significant negative spatial spillover effect under the baseline spatial weight matrix, indicating a possible resource siphon effect that concentrates data and innovation resources in platform-hosting locations. Marked regional heterogeneity is observed: local effects dominate in the Beijing–Tianjin–Hebei and Pearl River Delta regions, while the Yangtze River Delta exhibits positive spillovers due to stronger regional integration. Firm-level analyses further reveal that DEP effects are strongest for firms in highly concentrated markets, small and medium-sized enterprises, and mature firms. Overall, the findings highlight data as a core production factor in green innovation and emphasize the need for spatially coordinated data governance to mitigate siphon effects and promote regional collaborative innovation. KEYWORDS: Data exchange platform green innovation spatial spillover effect XGBoost-SHAP model Geographical Gaussian Process Regression (GGPR) JEL CLASSIFICATION: Q55 R11
10.1080/00036846.2026.2704615.abstract_zh: 本文研究了数据交易平台（DEP）的建立对重污染企业绿色创新的影响，重点关注空间溢出效应。基于2014至2023年中国上市公司面板数据，我们采用融合机器学习技术、工具变量因果计量模型以及空间计量与回归方法的混合框架。结果表明，DEP显著促进了所在城市的绿色创新。实证验证的主要机制在于通过增强数据透明度抑制漂绿行为。然而，在空间层面，基准空间权重矩阵下DEP呈现显著的负向空间溢出效应，表明可能存在资源虹吸效应，即数据和创新资源向平台所在地集中。区域异质性显著：京津冀和珠三角地区以本地效应为主，而长三角地区因更强的区域一体化表现出正向溢出效应。企业层面分析进一步揭示，DEP效应在高度集中市场中的企业、中小企业以及成熟企业中最为显著。总体而言，研究结果凸显了数据作为绿色创新核心生产要素的作用，并强调需实施空间协调的数据治理以缓解虹吸效应，促进区域协同创新。关键词：数据交易平台 绿色创新 空间溢出效应 XGBoost-SHAP模型 地理高斯过程回归（GGPR） JEL分类：Q55 R11
10.1080/00036846.2026.2704615.title: Does data exchange platform boost green innovation?—Empirical evidence from heavily polluting enterprises with the integration of machine learning and econometric methods
10.1080/00036846.2026.2704615.title_zh: 数据交换平台是否促进了绿色创新？——基于机器学习与计量方法整合的高污染企业实证证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2704617.abstract: This study quantifies the impact of water scarcity on Peru’s long-term growth potential using a Computable General Equilibrium model that explicitly represents water as a production factor in selected activities and incorporates mobility constraints on its allocation across sectors. The model is calibrated on a Social Accounting Matrix of the economy that has been specifically extended to capture water-related features. Simulations are conducted based on climate change-induced reductions in water availability projected for 2050 in the Pacific coastal region, the country’s economic core and the area most exposed to water stress. The results highlight the economic and welfare costs associated with increased water scarcity, as well as its differentiated impacts across sectors. They also confirm that the degree of substitutability between water and other production factors, as well as the degree of water mobility across sectors, jointly determine the capacity of the economy to adapt to water scarcity.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2704617.abstract_zh: 本研究利用可计算一般均衡模型，量化了水资源短缺对秘鲁长期增长潜力的影响。该模型将水明确列为特定生产活动中的生产要素，并纳入了跨部门水资源配置的流动性约束。模型基于经特别扩展以捕捉水资源相关特征的社会核算矩阵进行校准。模拟基于气候变化导致的2050年太平洋沿海地区（该国经济核心区域及水资源压力最严重地区）可用水量减少的预测情景展开。研究结果凸显了水资源短缺加剧所带来的经济与福利成本，及其对各部门的差异化影响。同时证实，水与其他生产要素之间的替代程度，以及水在各部门间的流动性程度，共同决定了经济适应水资源短缺的能力。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2704617.title: Effects of water scarcity on Peru’s long-term growth potential: a general equilibrium model-based quantitative assessment
10.1080/00036846.2026.2704617.title_zh: 水资源短缺对秘鲁长期增长潜力的影响：基于一般均衡模型的量化评估

10.1080/00036846.2026.2704622.abstract: This study extends the behavioral theory of the firm by reconceptualizing performance feedback as a multidimensional construct that captures performance relative to aspiration levels and performance relative to underlying potential. We define four feedback categories: legitimated success (performance above both aspiration levels and underlying potential), fragile success (performance above aspiration levels but below underlying potential), potential-confirming failure (performance below aspiration levels but above underlying potential), and structural failure (performance below both aspiration levels and underlying potential). Using panel data on 213 team-seasons from the Korea Baseball Organization (2001–2025), we examine how each feedback type influences risk-taking decisions in the form of top leadership changes and workforce reconfiguration. Our analyses show that structural failure is associated with a higher likelihood of replacing the top leader, whereas legitimated success corresponds to greater leadership stability. In addition, potential-confirming failure triggers significant workforce reconfiguration, whereas both types of success entail minimal workforce changes. These findings highlight the importance of incorporating underlying potential into performance feedback evaluation. By jointly considering performance relative to aspiration levels and underlying potential, this study advances a more precise account of how firms interpret performance outcomes and, consequently, when they pursue strategic change versus reinforce the status quo.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2704622.abstract_zh: 本研究通过将绩效反馈重新概念化为一个多维构念，同时捕捉绩效相对于期望水平及绩效相对于潜在能力，从而拓展了企业行为理论。我们定义了四种反馈类型：合法化成功（绩效高于期望水平且高于潜在能力）、脆弱成功（绩效高于期望水平但低于潜在能力）、潜力确认型失败（绩效低于期望水平但高于潜在能力）以及结构性失败（绩效低于期望水平且低于潜在能力）。基于韩国棒球组织2001-2025年间213个团队赛季的面板数据，我们考察了每种反馈类型如何通过最高领导层变动和劳动力重组这两种形式影响风险承担决策。分析表明，结构性失败与最高领导者更替概率升高相关，而合法化成功则对应更高的领导层稳定性。此外，潜力确认型失败会引发显著的劳动力重组，而两种成功类型均仅带来微小的劳动力变动。这些发现凸显了将潜在能力纳入绩效反馈评估的重要性。通过联合考虑绩效相对于期望水平及潜在能力，本研究更精确地阐释了企业如何解读绩效结果，并据此决定何时追求战略变革、何时维持现状。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2704622.title: Revisiting performance feedback: aspiration levels, underlying potential, and risk-taking behavior
10.1080/00036846.2026.2704622.title_zh: 重新审视绩效反馈：期望水平、潜在能力与风险承担行为

10.1080/00036846.2026.2704626.abstract: Accelerated depreciation policies allow firms to front-load depreciation allowances, generating a substantial intertemporal tax shield that reduces the cost of capital. Leveraging China’s 2014 accelerated depreciation policy for fixed assets as a quasi-natural experiment, this study employs a Difference-in-Differences (DID) method to examine its impact on corporate artificial intelligence (AI) adoption. Our results indicate that the tax incentive serves as a ‘stepping stone’, significantly promoting the uptake of AI technologies in pilot firms. This positive outcome primarily operates through two taxpayer-side mechanisms: alleviating financing constraints and upgrading human capital structures. Shifting the focus from taxpayers to tax administration, moderation analysis distinguishes between administrative services and administrative enforcement by revealing that policy effectiveness is strengthened by streamlined services rather than stringent enforcement. Heterogeneity analysis further demonstrates that the AI-promoting effect is more pronounced for large-scale or recession-stage firms, as well as those in low-uncertainty environments. Finally, we bridge the gap between tax incentives and market stability by showing that the tax incentive suppresses stock price crash risk, revealing its crucial role in fortifying firm resilience and mitigating financial risks. This study provides empirical evidence on how targeted tax incentives catalyse corporate AI adoption, offering policy implications for facilitating high-quality economic development.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2704626.abstract_zh: 加速折旧政策允许企业提前计提折旧，形成跨期税盾，从而降低资本成本。本研究以中国2014年固定资产加速折旧政策为准自然实验，采用双重差分法（DID）考察该政策对企业人工智能（AI）采纳的影响。结果表明，税收激励作为"垫脚石"，显著促进了试点企业AI技术的应用。这一积极效应主要通过两条纳税人侧机制实现：缓解融资约束与优化人力资本结构。将视角从纳税人转向税收征管后，调节效应分析区分了行政服务与行政执法的不同作用，揭示政策有效性通过简化服务流程而非严格执法得以强化。异质性分析进一步表明，大规模企业、衰退期企业以及低不确定性环境中的企业，其AI促进效应更为显著。最后，本研究通过揭示税收激励抑制股价崩盘风险，弥合了税收激励与市场稳定性之间的研究缺口，凸显其在增强企业韧性与防范金融风险中的关键作用。本研究为定向税收激励如何催化企业AI采纳提供了经验证据，对推动经济高质量发展具有政策启示意义。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2704626.title: Stepping stone or stumbling block: the impact of tax incentives on corporate artificial intelligence adoption
10.1080/00036846.2026.2704626.title_zh: 垫脚石还是绊脚石：税收激励对企业人工智能采纳的影响

10.1080/00036846.2026.2704627.abstract: Green mergers and acquisitions (M&A) represent a pivotal strategy for corporate sustainable transition. Using data from Chinese A-share listed companies (2010–2024), this study examines how executives’ environmental backgrounds shape green M&A decisions and outcomes. The results show that executives’ environmental backgrounds significantly drive companies’ green M&A activities, and the promoting effect is more significant when the executives hold greater power. Heterogeneity analysis shows that the impact of executives’ environmental backgrounds on green M&A varies contingent on firm characteristics and financing constraints. The promoting effect is more pronounced for state-owned enterprises and enterprises with a high proportion of institutional ownership, yet no significant difference is observed between heavily polluting and non-heavily polluting firms. However, the impact is statistically insignificant for enterprises facing tight external financing constraints, regardless of whether the financing channel is debt financing or equity financing. Further analysis indicates that green M&A generates short-term market reactions, boosting cumulative abnormal returns. Furthermore, this study finds that the executives’ environmental backgrounds can significantly improve enterprises’ environmental and economic performance following green M&A activities. Overall, these findings illuminate the internal governance mechanisms driving corporate green transformation.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2704627.abstract_zh: 绿色并购是企业可持续转型的关键战略。基于2010-2024年中国A股上市公司数据，本文考察高管环保背景如何影响绿色并购决策与成效。研究发现：高管环保背景显著推动企业绿色并购活动，且当高管权力较大时，这种促进作用更为显著。异质性分析表明，高管环保背景对绿色并购的影响因企业特征与融资约束而异：国有企业及机构持股比例较高企业的促进作用更显著，但重污染与非重污染企业间未呈现显著差异；然而，当企业面临较强外部融资约束时（无论融资渠道为债务融资还是股权融资），该影响在统计上不显著。进一步分析显示，绿色并购能产生短期市场反应，提升累计异常收益率。此外，本文发现高管环保背景可显著改善企业绿色并购后的环境绩效与经济绩效。总体而言，这些发现揭示了驱动企业绿色转型的内部治理机制。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2704627.title: Leading green paths: the impact of executives’ environmental backgrounds on corporate green mergers and acquisitions
10.1080/00036846.2026.2704627.title_zh: 引领绿色路径：高管环境背景对企业绿色并购的影响

10.1080/00036846.2026.2705969.abstract: This paper develops an information design model to analyze how underwriters strategically disclose firm-specific information prior to equity issuance. The model predicts the existence of discriminatory disclosure: for high-quality firms, the disclosed offering price is positively correlated with firm fundamentals, whereas for low-quality firms, this correlation breaks down. Empirical evidence from China’s stock market under a market-oriented registration system supports this theoretical prediction, based on a proprietary dataset of IPO valuations sourced exclusively from underwriters’ internal pricing reports.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2705969.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个信息设计模型，分析承销商在股权发行前如何策略性地披露企业特定信息。模型预测存在歧视性披露现象：对于高质量企业，披露的发行价格与企业基本面呈正相关；而对于低质量企业，这种相关性则不复存在。基于中国股票市场在市场化注册制下的实证证据，利用独家来源的承销商内部定价报告中的IPO估值数据集，验证了这一理论预测。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2705969.title: Information design and strategic disclosure in IPO underwriting
10.1080/00036846.2026.2705969.title_zh: IPO承销中的信息设计与策略性披露

10.1080/00036846.2026.2705973.abstract: This article examines how parental co-residence in the destination city is related to migrants’ labour supply. Using the 2018 China Migrants Dynamic Survey, the results show that parental co-residence is positively associated with migrants’ weekly working hours, and this relationship is mainly driven by relatively younger co-residing parents. To interpret the mechanism, the paper develops and estimates a structural time-allocation framework in which parents can substitute for household tasks but may also generate coordination costs within multigenerational households. The structural estimates suggest that parental assistance releases time for market work, while co-residence frictions partly offset these gains. Policy simulations further suggest that reducing household task burdens through market and community services may generate more stable labour-supply gains than relying only on family-based support. By linking empirical evidence with a structural time-allocation framework, this article contributes to the literature by showing that family support in migrant households is valuable but not costless, because parental co-residence simultaneously relaxes household task burdens and creates co-residence frictions.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2705973.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了父母在迁入地共同居住与流动人口劳动供给之间的关系。基于2018年中国流动人口动态监测调查数据，研究发现父母共同居住与流动人口每周工作时间呈正相关，且这一关系主要由相对年轻的同住父母驱动。为解释其作用机制，本文构建并估计了一个结构性时间分配框架，在该框架中，父母可替代部分家务劳动，但也可能引发多代同住家庭中的协调成本。结构性估计结果表明，父母提供的帮助释放了用于市场劳动的时间，但同住摩擦在一定程度上抵消了这些收益。政策模拟进一步显示，通过市场与社区服务减轻家务负担，可能比单纯依赖家庭支持带来更稳定的劳动供给增益。通过将实证证据与结构性时间分配框架相结合，本文揭示了流动家庭中的家庭支持虽具价值但并非无成本，因为父母共同居住既缓解了家务负担，也产生了同住摩擦。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2705973.title: Help comes with friction: parental Co-residence and labour supply in migrant households
10.1080/00036846.2026.2705973.title_zh: 帮助伴随摩擦：流动家庭中的父母同住与劳动供给

10.1080/00036846.2026.2706688.abstract: Monetary policy shapes macroeconomic conditions and may influence renewable energy development, a key element of the transition to low-carbon growth. Using cross-country panel data covering the period from 2000 to 2021, this study investigates how the policy rate affects the development of renewable energy. Building on a standard transmission framework, the analysis considers firms’ investment behaviour and links Monetary policy to energy efficiency, credit conditions, and technological innovation. An empirical analysis is conducted using panel data methods, complemented by robustness checks to validate the results. The findings suggest that increases in the policy rate are associated with a decline in renewable energy development across countries. In terms of mechanisms, energy efficiency and credit conditions serve as key channels through which Monetary policy affects renewable energy, particularly in capital-intensive sectors. Although monetary tightening stimulates technological innovation, such technological innovation is largely concentrated in basic research and does not translate into applied technologies. The heterogeneity analysis further shows that the effects differ by income group and OECD membership status. The findings contribute cross-national empirical evidence and provide policy insights into how Monetary policy can be better designed to support the advancement of renewable energy.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2706688.abstract_zh: 货币政策塑造宏观经济环境，并可能影响可再生能源发展——这是向低碳增长转型的关键要素。本研究利用2000年至2021年的跨国面板数据，探讨政策利率如何影响可再生能源发展。基于标准传导框架，分析考虑了企业的投资行为，并将货币政策与能源效率、信贷条件和技术创新联系起来。采用面板数据方法进行实证分析，并通过稳健性检验验证结果。研究发现，政策利率上升与各国可再生能源发展水平下降相关。在机制方面，能源效率和信贷条件是货币政策影响可再生能源的关键渠道，尤其是在资本密集型行业。尽管货币紧缩刺激了技术创新，但这种创新主要集中在基础研究领域，并未转化为应用技术。异质性分析进一步表明，这种影响因收入群体和OECD成员国身份而异。本研究提供了跨国实证证据，并为如何优化货币政策设计以支持可再生能源发展提供了政策启示。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2706688.title: Monetary policy and renewable energy development: a cross-country perspective
10.1080/00036846.2026.2706688.title_zh: 货币政策与可再生能源发展：跨国视角

10.1080/00036846.2026.2706689.abstract: This study asks whether and how risk connectedness between green bonds and G8 financial markets varies across market states, time, and investment horizons. Using daily data from 2015 to 2025, we apply a TVP-QVAR connectedness framework and wavelet-based analyses to measure quantile-dependent and time-frequency spillovers before and after COVID-19. We find that connectedness is strongest at extreme quantiles, green bonds are mostly net risk receivers but temporarily become transmitters during the pandemic, and European equity markets are key systemic transmitters. Medium-frequency co-movements dominate, whereas long-run coherence weakens after COVID-19. The results show that the diversification and safe-haven roles of green bonds are conditional on market states and horizons.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2706689.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨绿色债券与八国集团金融市场之间的风险关联性是否以及如何随市场状态、时间及投资期限而变化。基于2015至2025年的日度数据，我们采用TVP-QVAR关联性框架与小波分析方法，测度新冠疫情前后分位数依赖型及时频域风险溢出效应。研究发现：极端分位数下的关联性最强；绿色债券主要充当净风险接收方，但在疫情期间暂时转为风险传递方；欧洲股票市场是关键的系统性风险传递方。中频协同波动占据主导地位，而长期协动性在新冠疫情后有所减弱。结果表明，绿色债券的分散化与避险功能具有市场状态与投资期限的条件依赖性。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2706689.title: Multi-scale quantile connectedness effects between green bonds and G8 countries’ financial markets
10.1080/00036846.2026.2706689.title_zh: 绿色债券与G8国家金融市场间的多尺度分位数关联效应

10.1080/00036846.2026.2706690.abstract: As populations age, a growing number of people need help with everyday activities. Long-term care can be provided by professional caregivers; however, the associated costs can lead to horizontal inequity, i.e. unequal access to care for individuals with similar needs. This paper examines income-related horizontal inequity in home care use in France, and the effects on horizontal inequity of the three funding systems involved: national health insurance, government allowances, and income tax deductions. Results reveal income-related inequities that favour wealthier individuals. Furthermore, while all three systems (including national health insurance) lead to horizontal inequity, we find that half of this inequity comes from home care provided by professionals funded directly by income tax deductions.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2706690.abstract_zh: 随着人口老龄化，越来越多的人需要在日常生活中获得帮助。长期护理可由专业护理人员提供，但相关成本可能导致横向不公平，即需求相似的个体在获取护理服务方面存在不平等。本文研究了法国家庭护理使用中与收入相关的横向不公平现象，并分析了三种相关资助体系——国家医疗保险、政府补贴和所得税减免——对横向不公平的影响。结果显示存在有利于富裕人群的收入相关不公平现象。此外，尽管这三种体系（包括国家医疗保险）均导致横向不公平，但我们发现其中一半的不公平源于由所得税减免直接资助的专业家庭护理服务。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2706690.title: Why care about who pays for care? Horizontal inequity in home care use for older adults
10.1080/00036846.2026.2706690.title_zh: 为何关心谁为照护买单？老年人居家照护使用的横向不公平

10.1080/00036846.2026.2706691.abstract: This study examines how enhanced local autonomy affects ecological quality by analysing China’s County Power Expansion reform, which granted unprecedented fiscal and administrative powers to county governments. Using a comprehensive ecological index that captures multiple environmental dimensions, we find that the reform is associated with a decline of 0.64 index points in local ecological quality. This deterioration is associated with a stronger prioritization of economic development, reflected in increased growth-oriented expenditure and business attraction, while environmental protection expenditure did not increase significantly. The negative ecological effects are amplified in counties facing stronger economic pressures but mitigated where environmental performance metrics are included in official evaluations. These findings reveal important trade-offs in decentralized environmental governance and highlight how institutional incentives can shape local governments’ environmental decisions.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2706691.abstract_zh: 本研究通过分析中国“扩权强县”改革（该改革赋予县级政府前所未有的财政与行政权力），探讨地方自主权增强对生态质量的影响。基于涵盖多维度环境指标的综合生态指数，我们发现该改革导致地方生态质量下降0.64个指数点。这种生态退化与地方政府更侧重经济发展优先相关，具体表现为增长导向型支出和招商引资力度增强，而环境保护支出未显著增加。在面临更强经济压力的县域，负面生态效应被放大；但在将环境绩效指标纳入官员考核体系的地区，该效应得到缓解。这些发现揭示了环境分权治理中的重要权衡，并凸显制度激励如何塑造地方政府的环境决策行为。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2706691.title: Does local empowerment come at an ecological cost? Evidence from China’s county power expansion reform
10.1080/00036846.2026.2706691.title_zh: 地方赋权是否以生态成本为代价？来自中国县域扩权改革的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2706692.abstract: This paper examines whether climate risk is associated with excess executive perquisites (perks) among Chinese listed firms over the period 2014–2022. Using a city-level climate risk index based on disaster-related fatalities and economic losses, we find that firms exposed to greater climate risk tend to exhibit higher excess executive perks. This positive association is weaker for firms with greater media coverage and stronger digital technology application. The results remain robust to a range of additional analyses, including alternative climate-risk and perk measures, propensity score matching, first-difference specifications, confounder tests, and Fama – MacBeth regressions. Overall, the paper contributes to the literature on the governance consequences of climate risk by showing that climate-related pressure is associated with greater implicit executive consumption and that stronger external scrutiny and governance-related discipline may mitigate this relation.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2706692.abstract_zh: 本文考察了2014至2022年间中国上市公司面临的气候风险是否与高管超额在职消费（津贴）存在关联。基于城市层面以灾害相关死亡人数和经济损失衡量的气候风险指数，我们发现：面临较高气候风险的企业往往表现出更高水平的高管超额津贴。这一正向关联在媒体关注度更高、数字技术应用更强的企业中有所减弱。通过一系列附加分析（包括替代性气候风险与津贴指标、倾向得分匹配、一阶差分模型、混杂因素检验及Fama-MacBeth回归），该结果仍保持稳健。总体而言，本文通过揭示气候相关压力与高管隐性消费增加之间的关联，并证明更强外部监督与治理约束可缓解此关系，为气候风险治理后果的相关文献提供了新见解。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2706692.title: Climate risk and excess executive perquisites: the moderating role of media and digitalization
10.1080/00036846.2026.2706692.title_zh: 气候风险与高管超额津贴：媒体与数字化的调节作用

10.1080/00036846.2026.2706694.abstract: Whether cultural heritage protection can preserve historical and cultural resources while expanding county-level consumption market activity is important for understanding the economic effects of cultural policy. Using county-level panel data from China for 2000–2019, this paper exploits the staggered designation of National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units and applies a staggered difference-in-differences approach. The results show that heritage protection significantly increases county-level retail-based consumption activity, and the finding remains robust across multiple checks. Mechanism analysis shows that local fiscal expenditure, infrastructure investment, fixed-asset investment, service-sector expansion, tourist flows, service-sector employment, and land-value capitalization change in directions consistent with the theoretical predictions. These results suggest that heritage protection may expand county-level consumption market activity through supply-side improvements and demand-side expansion, including tourist spending and broader local market responses. Heterogeneity analysis indicates that the effect is mainly concentrated in counties in central and western China, non-core administrative counties, and smaller counties. This paper provides evidence on the local market effects of cultural heritage protection and offers policy implications for activating cultural resources in less developed areas.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2706694.abstract_zh: 文化遗产保护能否在保存历史文化资源的同时扩大县域消费市场活力，对于理解文化政策的经济效应具有重要意义。本文利用2000-2019年中国县域面板数据，基于全国重点文物保护单位的分批认定政策，采用交错双重差分法进行实证分析。研究结果表明，文化遗产保护显著提升了县域零售消费活力，该结论在多项稳健性检验中依然成立。机制分析显示，地方财政支出、基础设施投资、固定资产投资、服务业扩张、旅游客流、服务业就业及土地价值资本化等指标的变化方向均与理论预期一致。这些发现表明，文化遗产保护可能通过供给侧改善与需求侧扩张（包括旅游消费及更广泛的地方市场响应）来扩大县域消费市场活力。异质性分析显示，该效应主要集中在中西部地区、非核心行政县及规模较小的县域。本文为文化遗产保护的本地市场效应提供了实证证据，并为激活欠发达地区文化资源提供了政策启示。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2706694.title: Can heritage protection promote local consumption? Evidence from National Key Cultural Relics protection Units in China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2706694.title_zh: 遗产保护能否促进本地消费？来自中国全国重点文物保护单位的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2706696.abstract: This study investigates how monetary policy uncertainty shapes corporate investment efficiency based on an unbalanced panel of 5,090 Chinese A-share listed firms over the period 2011–2024. The findings indicate that heightened monetary policy uncertainty leads to a significant deterioration in investment efficiency. This relationship remains stable after adopting alternative measures, introducing lagged terms, removing observations from the COVID-19 period, and applying instrumental-variable estimation. Mechanism analysis shows that tighter financing constraints and lower R&D expenditure constitute two important channels underlying this effect. The negative influence is particularly evident among capital-intensive and technology-intensive firms, state-owned enterprises, and firms characterized by CEO duality. Moreover, an upgraded human capital structure enhances firms’ capacity to absorb policy-related shocks and weakens the adverse effect of monetary policy uncertainty. These findings advance the understanding of firm-level responses to macroeconomic policy uncertainty and offer practical insights into policy communication, innovation financing, human capital allocation, and corporate investment management.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2706696.abstract_zh: 本研究基于2011–2024年间5090家中国A股上市公司的非平衡面板数据，考察货币政策不确定性如何影响企业投资效率。结果表明，货币政策不确定性加剧会显著降低企业投资效率。在采用替代性指标、引入滞后项、剔除新冠疫情时期观测值以及运用工具变量估计后，该关系依然稳健。机制分析显示，融资约束趋紧与研发支出下降是这一效应的两个重要传导渠道。这种负面影响在资本密集型与技术密集型企业、国有企业以及董事长兼任总经理的企业中尤为显著。此外，人力资本结构升级能够增强企业吸收政策冲击的能力，从而削弱货币政策不确定性的不利影响。这些发现深化了对企业应对宏观经济政策不确定性的理解，并为政策沟通、创新融资、人力资本配置及企业投资管理提供了实践启示。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2706696.title: Research on the impact mechanism of monetary policy shocks and the synergy of human capital structure on corporate investment
10.1080/00036846.2026.2706696.title_zh: 货币政策冲击与人力资本结构协同对企业投资的影响机制研究

10.1080/00036846.2026.2706697.abstract: This paper investigates how Information and Communication Technologies (ICT) relate to school efficiency, drawing on data from the OECD PISA 2022 survey for 5,360 schools across 21 EU countries. We estimate school-level efficiency scores using a robust nonparametric order-m model under a meta-frontier framework, distinguishing between local (within-country) and global (cross-country) benchmarks. We also run a robust conditional efficiency model in which exogenous variables are indicators of ICT availability and use, showing how ICT is associated with an increase in average efficiency. We also employ a multilevel random forest model to explore which ICT-related variables best explain efficiency scores. Findings highlight that cognitively engaging digital activities such as student-led research, data analysis, and the use of digital learning games are positively associated with efficiency, especially when used in moderation (i.e. avoiding its excessive use).
10.1080/00036846.2026.2706697.abstract_zh: 本文利用OECD PISA 2022调查中21个欧盟国家5360所学校的数据，探究信息通信技术（ICT）与学校效率之间的关系。我们采用元前沿框架下的稳健非参数order-m模型估算学校层面的效率得分，区分了本地（国家内部）与全球（跨国）基准。同时，我们运行了稳健的条件效率模型，将ICT可用性与使用指标作为外生变量，揭示ICT如何与平均效率提升相关联。此外，我们运用多层随机森林模型，探索哪些ICT相关变量最能解释效率得分差异。研究结果表明：以学生主导研究、数据分析及数字学习游戏为代表的认知参与型数字活动与效率呈正相关，尤其在适度使用（即避免过度使用）时效果更为显著。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2706697.title: How does ICT relate to school efficiency in Europe? Evidence from OECD PISA 2022
10.1080/00036846.2026.2706697.title_zh: ICT如何影响欧洲学校效率？基于OECD PISA 2022的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2707337.abstract: This paper evaluates the impact of the Three Supplies and Two Platforms (TSTP) programme, a large-scale computer-assisted learning (CAL) initiative in China, on the cognitive skills of lower secondary students. We draw on nationally representative panel data from the China Education Panel Survey (CEPS) and implement a difference-in-differences (DID) strategy to identify causal effects. The results indicate that TSTP increases students’ cognitive test scores by 0.177 standard deviations. We provide suggestive evidence that these gains may operate through changes in teachers’ instructional tools and practices, improvements in students’ learning experiences and learning-related skills, and increased parental engagement. The effects are heterogeneous, with larger impacts observed among disadvantaged students, particularly those with lower baseline achievement and those attending rural schools. In addition, the programme reduces the rural–urban cognitive achievement gap by 0.079 standard deviations. Overall, the findings suggest that large-scale CAL interventions can enhance cognitive outcomes and contribute to reducing educational inequality in developing country contexts.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2707337.abstract_zh: 本文评估了中国大规模计算机辅助学习（CAL）项目——“三通两平台”（TSTP）对初中生认知技能的影响。我们利用中国教育追踪调查（CEPS）中具有全国代表性的面板数据，采用双重差分（DID）策略识别因果效应。结果表明，TSTP使学生的认知测试成绩提高了0.177个标准差。我们提供的初步证据表明，这些成效可能通过教师教学工具与实践的改变、学生学习体验及学习相关技能的提升，以及家长参与度的增强来实现。效应存在异质性，在弱势学生群体中影响更为显著，尤其是基线成绩较低的学生和农村学校学生。此外，该项目使城乡认知成绩差距缩小了0.079个标准差。总体而言，研究结果表明，大规模CAL干预能够提升认知成果，并有助于减少发展中国家背景下的教育不平等。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2707337.title: The impact of computer-assisted learning on students’ cognitive skills: evidence from the “Three Supplies and Two Platforms” programme in China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2707337.title_zh: 计算机辅助学习对学生认知技能的影响：来自中国“三个课堂”项目的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2707338.abstract: Firms navigating the transition towards sustainable manufacturing face a critical strategic question: Can voluntary environmental regulation (VER) reconcile the tension between environmental compliance and market performance? Using Chinese A-share data from 2008 to 2024, this study treats the Green Factory Certification (GFC) Program as a quasi-natural experiment to examine the impact of VER on corporate market value. The results show that GFC significantly increases corporate market value. Mechanism analysis indicates that the policy mainly boosts market value through two paths: promoting green innovation and attracting green investors. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that policy benefits are more pronounced in labour-intensive, non-state-owned, non-heavy-polluting enterprises and in regions characterized by stringent environmental regulation and higher levels of economic development.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2707338.abstract_zh: 在向可持续制造转型的过程中，企业面临一个关键的战略问题：自愿性环境规制能否调和环境合规与市场绩效之间的张力？本研究利用2008至2024年中国A股数据，将绿色工厂认证计划视为准自然实验，考察自愿性环境规制对企业市场价值的影响。结果表明，绿色工厂认证显著提升了企业市场价值。机制分析显示，该政策主要通过两条路径提升市场价值：促进绿色创新和吸引绿色投资者。异质性分析表明，政策收益在劳动密集型、非国有、非重污染企业以及环境规制严格、经济发展水平较高的地区更为显著。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2707338.title: From policy to valuation: how voluntary environmental regulation drives corporate value
10.1080/00036846.2026.2707338.title_zh: 从政策到估值：自愿性环境规制如何驱动企业价值

10.1080/00036846.2026.2707339.abstract: Given the background of global ecological civilization construction, understanding the impact of environmental policies on corporate green innovation is of great significance. Based on a constructed theoretical model, this study employs a Double Machine Learning (DML) model to examine the impact of the new Environmental Protection Law on green technology innovation in resource-based enterprises, using sample data from Chinese resource-based listed companies from 2008 to 2024. The findings of this study include: (1) The new Law has a positive impact on green technology innovation in resource-based enterprises. This conclusion remains robust after tests, including those addressing endogeneity. (2) The local government environmental attention and the corporate environmental information disclosure constitute the mechanisms through which the new Law affects green technology innovation in resource-based enterprises. (3) The positive impact of the new Law on green technology innovation in resource-based enterprises is more pronounced when the chairman or executives of the enterprise hold Communist Party membership or possess a digital professional background, or when the enterprise is located in a key environmental protection city or an economically developed eastern region of China.
