10.1111/1467-8489.70124.abstract: Contracts and ownership structures play a critical role in fostering innovation in the bioeconomy. However, identifying which designs best promote bioresource circularity and collaboration remains challenging, as existing studies use diverse frameworks and are often limited to specific contexts or regions. Therefore, we conducted a review to clarify the types of contracts and ownership structures within bio‐based value chains and evaluate their roles in fostering innovation. To this end, we followed PRISMA‐P guidelines when collecting studies and organised them based on methodologies to facilitate the synthesis. Using a framework of the ownership distribution along the value chain between primary producer and biorefinery, we categorise three main categories of ownership structures: vertical integration, individual ownership and joint ownership. Some literature argues that primary producers prefer low‐risk attributes and therefore shift much of the responsibility onto biorefineries. While such structures can encourage participation, they hinder innovation by concentrating power within the biorefinery. Joint ownership structures, such as cooperatives, emerge as promising alternatives, offering a more balanced and collaborative approach to sharing risks, costs and profits. Our findings highlight the need for future research to explore joint ownership structures and apply different methods to support substantial advancement.
10.1111/1467-8489.70124.abstract_zh: 合同与所有权结构在推动生物经济创新中发挥着关键作用。然而，由于现有研究采用不同分析框架且多局限于特定情境或区域，目前仍难以确定何种设计最能促进生物资源循环利用与协作。为此，我们开展系统性综述，旨在厘清生物基价值链中的合同与所有权结构类型，并评估其在促进创新中的作用。本研究遵循PRISMA-P指南进行文献收集，并按方法论分类以促进综合比较。基于初级生产者与生物精炼厂之间价值链所有权分布的分析框架，我们将所有权结构归纳为三类：纵向一体化、个体所有权与联合所有权。部分文献认为初级生产者偏好低风险属性，因此将大部分责任转移至生物精炼厂。此类结构虽能鼓励参与，但通过将权力集中于生物精炼厂而阻碍创新。合作社等联合所有权结构作为更具前景的替代方案，提供了更均衡、协作的风险、成本与利润分担方式。研究结论表明，未来需深入探索联合所有权结构，并采用多元方法推动实质性进展。
10.1111/1467-8489.70124.title: Contracts and Ownership Structures in the Bioeconomy: A Review of Their Design and Role in Innovation
10.1111/1467-8489.70124.title_zh: 生物经济中的合同与所有权结构：其设计与创新作用综述

10.1111/1467-8489.70125.abstract: Australia's National Electricity Market (NEM) was established in the late 1990s. The market is an energy only gross pool with zonal (state‐based) pricing. Over the past 15 years, the system has undergone a profound transformation as large coal‐fired power stations have retired and substantial volumes of large‐scale and embedded behind the meter variable renewables have been installed. In this context, Australian governments commissioned a review into the NEM by an expert panel (the ‘NEM Review’). This article provides a summary of the key findings of the Panel across three key timeframes: the short‐term market (spot market) is largely fit for purpose but ‘hidden participants’ are impeding efficient outcomes and there are increasing risks to be managed as the system becomes more weather dependant; the medium‐term derivative market, used to manage risk, requires urgent attention to ensure liquidity and price transparency facilitate efficient management of spot price risk; and a new long‐term integrated market mechanism designed to overcome the ‘tenor gap’ should be introduced to facilitate long‐term investment.
10.1111/1467-8489.70125.abstract_zh: 澳大利亚国家电力市场（NEM）成立于20世纪90年代末。该市场是一个仅含能源的集中式现货市场，采用区域（州级）定价机制。过去15年间，随着大型燃煤电厂退役以及大规模集中式与分布式表后可变可再生能源的并网，该电力系统经历了深刻变革。在此背景下，澳大利亚政府委托专家小组对NEM进行审查（即"NEM审查"）。本文总结了该小组在三个关键时间维度的主要发现：短期市场（现货市场）基本满足运行需求，但"隐性参与者"阻碍了效率提升，且随着系统对天气依赖性增强，需管理的风险日益增加；用于风险管理的衍生品中期市场亟需关注，以确保流动性和价格透明度能够有效管理现货价格风险；应引入旨在克服"期限缺口"的新型长期一体化市场机制，以促进长期投资。
10.1111/1467-8489.70125.title_zh: 改革国家电力市场（NEM）的建议

10.1111/1467-8489.70126.abstract: We apply a household production framework to analyse how changes in cooking skills, waste‐abatement costs and wage rates influence the food waste behaviour of five consumer profiles in Finland. We find that achieving a given reduction in food waste through skill‐enhancing interventions induces larger behavioural adjustments than equivalent reductions in waste‐abatement costs. Higher wage rates, however, counteract efforts to decrease household food waste. Lowering abatement costs at the food preparation stage yields a greater overall reduction in waste than targeting the consumption stage. Our findings indicate that uniform, skill‐based interventions are unlikely to be sustainable without complementary structural support tailored to specific consumer groups. Accordingly, policy measures should combine skill development with targeted reductions in the costs of preventing food waste.
10.1111/1467-8489.70126.abstract_zh: 我们运用家庭生产框架，分析烹饪技能变化、减废成本及工资率如何影响芬兰五类消费者群体的食物浪费行为。研究发现，通过技能提升干预实现特定程度的食物浪费减少，比同等程度的减废成本降低更能引发显著的行为调整。然而，更高的工资率会抵消减少家庭食物浪费的努力。相较于针对消费阶段，降低食物准备阶段的减废成本能带来更显著的总体浪费减少。研究结果表明，若缺乏针对特定消费者群体的结构性配套支持，单一化的技能干预措施难以持续。因此，政策制定应将技能培养与定向降低食物浪费预防成本相结合。
10.1111/1467-8489.70126.title: The Feasibility of Household Food Waste Reduction in Finland: Insights From Five Consumer Profiles
10.1111/1467-8489.70126.title_zh: 芬兰家庭食物垃圾减量的可行性：基于五种消费者画像的洞见

10.1111/1467-8489.70127.abstract: Productivity growth is essential for securing the long‐term profitability and competitiveness of pasture‐based dairy systems, particularly amid volatile input and output prices and increasing environmental constraints. This paper measures productivity growth using a total factor productivity index (TFPI) tailored to the seasonal, pasture‐based nature of New Zealand dairy farming. We apply a proper‐index approach to enable meaningful comparisons across time and farms. The TFPI is decomposed into key components: technological progress, scale and input‐mix efficiency, technical efficiency, production environment and statistical noise. To account for climate‐related variability, we integrate pasture growth indices as proxies for pasture availability supporting milksolids (fat + protein) production. Between 2012/2013 and 2023/2024, productivity growth plateaued, with the TFPI declining by 1.33% (−0.09% per annum). While technological progress increased by 6.9%, this was offset by declines in scale‐and‐mix efficiency (−4.2%), technical efficiency (−0.63%) and production environment favourability (−1.68%). Moreover, technological progress has stagnated since 2015/2016, suggesting that recent innovations have not translated into measurable productivity gains. These findings underscore the need for a multifaceted response to reverse productivity decline and secure competitiveness: accelerating innovation, strengthening technology adoption and building environmental resilience.
10.1111/1467-8489.70127.abstract_zh: 生产率增长对于确保放牧型奶牛养殖系统的长期盈利能力和竞争力至关重要，尤其是在投入品和产出品价格波动加剧以及环境约束日益严格的背景下。本文采用针对新西兰奶牛养殖季节性、放牧型特点的全要素生产率指数（TFPI）来测算生产率增长。我们运用恰当指数方法，以实现跨时间和跨农场的有效比较。TFPI被分解为关键组成部分：技术进步、规模与投入组合效率、技术效率、生产环境以及统计噪声。为考虑气候相关变异性，我们整合了牧草生长指数作为牧草可用性的代理变量，以支持乳固体（脂肪+蛋白质）生产。在2012/2013至2023/2024年间，生产率增长趋于停滞，TFPI下降1.33%（年均下降0.09%）。尽管技术进步增长了6.9%，但被规模与组合效率下降（-4.2%）、技术效率下降（-0.63%）以及生产环境有利性下降（-1.68%）所抵消。此外，自2015/2016年以来技术进步已停滞，表明近期创新并未转化为可衡量的生产率提升。这些发现凸显了需要采取多维度应对措施以扭转生产率下降并确保竞争力：加速创新、强化技术采纳以及构建环境韧性。
10.1111/1467-8489.70127.title: Climate and Feeding Strategies: An Analysis of Productivity Growth in New Zealand Dairy
10.1111/1467-8489.70127.title_zh: 气候与饲养策略：新西兰奶牛业生产率增长分析

10.1111/1467-8489.70128.abstract: ABSTRACT This paper examines the influence of gender on the adoption of Climate‐Smart Agriculture (CSA) practices in West Africa. An exogenous switching treatment effect regression model with the Oaxaca–Blinder decomposition method is used in the study. Data were collected from the 2018/2019 Harmonized Household Living Conditions Survey across five West African countries. The results indicate that if female plot managers had the same characteristics as their male counterparts, their likelihood of adopting CSA practices would increase, yet it would still be lower than that of men. The decomposition analysis shows a significant gender gap favouring men in Burkina Faso and Senegal, unlike in Ivory Coast and Togo. These gender differences are mainly due to structural factors such as household size, education, access to credit, commercialisation, income, livestock ownership, family labour, pesticide use, soil fertility and the availability of agricultural extension agents and cooperatives. To effectively address gender disparities in CSA adoption, policies could focus on improving these structural conditions rather than solely on ensuring equal access to production resources. This approach would enhance policy effectiveness and empower women to better utilise their agricultural resources.
10.1111/1467-8489.70128.abstract_zh: 本文考察了性别对西非气候智慧型农业（CSA）实践采纳的影响。研究采用外生转换处理效应回归模型与奥克萨卡-布林德分解方法，数据来源于2018/2019年五个西非国家的统一家庭生活条件调查。结果表明，若女性地块管理者具备与男性相同的特征，其采纳CSA实践的可能性将有所提升，但仍低于男性。分解分析显示，布基纳法索和塞内加尔存在显著偏向男性的性别差距，而科特迪瓦和多哥则未出现此类差异。这些性别差异主要源于结构性因素，包括家庭规模、教育水平、信贷获取、商业化程度、收入、牲畜所有权、家庭劳动力、农药使用、土壤肥力以及农业推广人员和合作社的可及性。为有效解决CSA采纳中的性别差异，政策应侧重于改善这些结构性条件，而非仅关注生产资源的平等获取。这一方法将提升政策有效性，并增强女性利用农业资源的能力。
10.1111/1467-8489.70128.title: Gender and Adoption of Climate‐Smart Agricultural Practices in Developing Countries: Evidence From West African Countries
10.1111/1467-8489.70128.title_zh: 发展中国家性别与气候智慧型农业实践采纳：来自西非国家的证据

10.1111/1467-8489.70129.abstract: Fuel subsidies in resource‐rich economies distort consumption and undermine fiscal efficiency. This study exploits Kuwait's 2016 gasoline (petrol) price reform—which raised prices by up to 83% after nearly two decades of price stability—to estimate short‐run price elasticity and analyse consumer behavioural responses under entrenched subsidies. Using high‐frequency, station‐level daily gasoline sales data and traffic data combined with Regression Discontinuity in Time (RDiT) designs, the study causally identifies the reform's impact on gasoline demand. Mechanism analyses evaluate substitution across octane grades, driving behaviour, public transport use and extensive‐margin responses such as vehicle ownership or efficiency. Contrary to the literature documenting limited price responsiveness in subsidy‐heavy rentier states, the reform produced a sharp and immediate drop in fuel consumption, with a short‐run price elasticity of approximately −0.45. The dominant response was intra‐product substitution, as consumers persistently shifted from octane 95 to 91. Driving reductions were modest; public transit use and extensive‐margin adjustments were negligible. High‐octane (98) users showed near‐zero responsiveness. By raising prices, the reform likely reduced the estimated KD 7 million (US$24 million) in pre‐reform waste as drivers switched to suitable, cheaper fuel. The reform also reduced deadweight loss by over KD 55 million (US$179 million) annually, with total welfare gains—accounting for externalities—reaching up to KD 97 million (US$312 million) annually. This study shows price reforms in rentier states can yield substantial efficiency and welfare gains, but require complementary policies to address informational frictions and limited substitution options.
10.1111/1467-8489.70129.abstract_zh: 资源丰富经济体的燃料补贴扭曲了消费并削弱了财政效率。本研究利用科威特2016年汽油价格改革——在近二十年价格稳定后，汽油价格最高上涨83%——来估计短期价格弹性，并分析在根深蒂固的补贴制度下消费者的行为反应。通过使用高频、加油站层面的日度汽油销售数据和交通数据，结合时间断点回归设计，本研究因果识别了改革对汽油需求的影响。机制分析评估了辛烷值等级间的替代、驾驶行为、公共交通使用以及车辆拥有率或效率等广延边际反应。与记录补贴密集型食利国家价格反应有限的文献相反，改革导致了燃料消费的急剧和即时下降，短期价格弹性约为-0.45。主要反应是产品内替代，消费者持续从95辛烷值转向91辛烷值。驾驶减少幅度较小；公共交通使用和广延边际调整可忽略不计。高辛烷值（98）用户表现出近乎零的反应。通过提高价格，改革可能减少了改革前估计的700万科威特第纳尔（2400万美元）的浪费，因为驾驶者转向了合适且更便宜的燃料。改革还每年减少了超过5500万科威特第纳尔（1.79亿美元）的无谓损失，考虑外部性后的总福利收益每年高达9700万科威特第纳尔（3.12亿美元）。本研究表明，食利国家的价格改革可以产生显著的效率和福利收益，但需要补充政策来解决信息摩擦和有限的替代选择。
10.1111/1467-8489.70129.title: How Drivers in a Rentier State Respond to Fuel Price Shocks: High‐Frequency Evidence From Kuwait's Subsidy Reform
10.1111/1467-8489.70129.title_zh: 租金国家司机如何应对燃油价格冲击：科威特补贴改革的高频证据

10.1111/1467-8489.70130.abstract: ABSTRACT Conservation on working agricultural lands is increasingly recognised as a critical strategy for enhancing the resilience of food systems in the face of climate change. Despite the growing funding worldwide for climate‐smart agriculture and forestry (CSAF) practices, we lack a comprehensive assessment of their economic impacts. Focusing on the impacts of CSAF practices on agricultural productivity and resilience in the United States, we estimate the effects of payments under the Environmental Quality Incentives Program (EQIP) for CSAF on county‐level yields, land rent and measures of production losses for corn, soybean and winter wheat. We also account for the potential confounding effects of land retirement through the Conservation Reserve Program (CRP). Our findings suggest that EQIP payments for CSAF practices are associated with reductions in county‐level corn production losses. In contrast, payments for non‐CSAF practices may increase loss measures. These findings highlight the importance of targeted conservation investments in improving agricultural resilience.
10.1111/1467-8489.70130.abstract_zh: 摘要 在应对气候变化的背景下，农业用地上的保护措施日益被视为增强粮食系统韧性的关键策略。尽管全球对气候智慧型农业与林业（CSAF）实践的资助不断增加，但对其经济影响的全面评估仍显不足。本研究聚焦美国CSAF实践对农业生产力和韧性的影响，通过估算环境质量激励计划（EQIP）中CSAF相关补贴对县级玉米、大豆和冬小麦的产量、地租及生产损失指标的作用，同时考虑保护储备计划（CRP）中土地休耕可能带来的混杂效应。研究结果表明，针对CSAF实践的EQIP补贴与县级玉米生产损失减少存在关联；相反，非CSAF实践的补贴可能加剧损失指标。这些发现凸显了定向保护投资在提升农业韧性方面的重要性。
10.1111/1467-8489.70130.title:
Economic Impacts of Climate‐Smart Agriculture and Forestry Practices: Evidence From the
                    USDA
                    Environmental Quality Incentives Program
10.1111/1467-8489.70130.title_zh: 气候智慧型农业与林业实践的经济影响：来自美国农业部环境质量激励计划的证据

10.1111/1467-8489.70131.abstract: Australia's natural environment has been devastated by decades of land clearing, habitat destruction, invasive species and climate change—and the economics discipline has largely looked the other way. In November 2025, the Australian Parliament passed landmark amendments to the Environmental Protection and Biodiversity Conservation (EPBC) Act. These reforms are a game‐changer—but they are just a start. Restoration at scale must follow, properly funded and integrated with climate policy; anything less is a betrayal of future generations. Rebuilding natural capital is not a discretionary amenity. For this and every subsequent generation of Australians, it is a matter of survival.
10.1111/1467-8489.70131.abstract_zh: 澳大利亚的自然环境因数十年的土地开垦、栖息地破坏、入侵物种和气候变化而遭受重创——而经济学学科在很大程度上对此视而不见。2025年11月，澳大利亚议会通过了《环境保护与生物多样性保护法》（EPBC Act）具有里程碑意义的修正案。这些改革是颠覆性的变革——但这仅仅是开始。必须随之开展大规模生态修复，并确保资金充足且与气候政策相整合；任何不足都是对子孙后代的背叛。重建自然资本并非可选择的便利设施。对于这一代及未来每一代澳大利亚人而言，这关乎生存。
10.1111/1467-8489.70131.title: Environmental Reforms to Secure Intergenerational Justice: An Edited Extract from the Address to the 2026 AARES Conference, Adelaide
10.1111/1467-8489.70131.title_zh: 确保代际公平的环境改革：2026年AARES阿德莱德会议致辞节选

10.1111/1467-8489.70132.abstract: ABSTRACT This paper examines the short‐ and long‐run effects of the 2015 Nepal Earthquake on paddy production using a difference‐in‐differences framework and district‐level panel data spanning 2010–2019. We document a 10.95% decline in paddy production and a 6.94% decline in yield in earthquake‐affected districts in the short run, with effects fully dissipating over the long run. Decomposing production losses into intensive and extensive margins reveals that the intensive margin explains the majority of losses. Heterogeneity analysis shows that production losses scale with seismic intensity while yield losses operate as a common behavioural shock uniformly across affected districts. Household survey evidence confirms two reinforcing channels: a contraction in agricultural labour supply during the critical planting season and a reallocation of household resources toward reconstruction of damaged dwellings.
10.1111/1467-8489.70132.abstract_zh: 本文采用双重差分框架及2010–2019年区级面板数据，考察2015年尼泊尔地震对水稻生产的短期与长期影响。研究发现，地震受灾地区的水稻产量在短期内下降10.95%，单产下降6.94%，但长期来看这些影响完全消散。将产量损失分解为集约边际与广延边际后发现，集约边际解释了大部分损失。异质性分析表明，产量损失随地震烈度递增，而单产损失则表现为受灾地区普遍存在的共同行为冲击。家户调查证据证实了两种相互强化的传导渠道：关键播种季节农业劳动力供给的收缩，以及家户资源向受损房屋重建的重新配置。
10.1111/1467-8489.70132.title: Agriculture and Natural Disasters: Evidence From the 2015 Nepal Earthquake
10.1111/1467-8489.70132.title_zh: 农业与自然灾害：来自2015年尼泊尔地震的证据

10.1111/1467-8489.70133.abstract: Alongside the 2024–2025 review of the National Electricity Market, Australian energy companies faced the most significant reforms to climate disclosures in corporate history. Specifically, the Australian Sustainability Reporting Standard for Climate‐related Disclosures (AASB S2) was announced in September 2024, after which all entities falling within the purview of the National Greenhouse and Energy Reporting Act—effectively every major electricity generator and retailer—were required to identify and disclose climate‐related risks and opportunities. This includes Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions and scenario analysis of their exposure to climate disruptions. Whilst some energy companies had already voluntarily disclosed some elements of this information, these new requirements required more consistent, comparable and forward‐looking reporting. We examine the early stages of measures taken by the energy sector to comply with AASB S2. Drawing on a 12‐month collaboration with the Australian Energy Council, our case study highlights the need for greater attention to robust methodologies for calculating Scope 3 emissions and stress testing climate scenarios, including the policy assumptions that underpin them. Importantly, this research highlights the risks inherent to any national standard that is more closely aligned to policy aspirations than to climate science, given that such discrepancies may pose risks to the resilience of the National Electricity Market. This study also contributes to stakeholder theory by illustrating the need for greater attention to how sector‐level collaboration among competitors can support improved corporate disclosures, especially in relation to climate governance.
10.1111/1467-8489.70133.abstract_zh: 在2024-2025年国家电力市场审查期间，澳大利亚能源企业面临企业史上最重大的气候信息披露改革。具体而言，2024年9月发布的《澳大利亚气候相关披露可持续性报告准则》（AASB S2）要求所有受《国家温室与能源报告法》管辖的实体——实际上涵盖所有主要电力生产商和零售商——必须识别并披露气候相关风险与机遇，包括范围1、2、3排放及其对气候干扰暴露度的情景分析。尽管部分能源企业此前已自愿披露部分信息，但新规要求更一致、可比且具有前瞻性的报告。本研究考察了能源行业为遵守AASB S2所采取措施的早期阶段。基于与澳大利亚能源委员会为期12个月的合作，我们的案例研究强调需更加关注范围3排放计算的稳健方法论及气候情景压力测试（包括其政策假设）。重要的是，本研究揭示了任何更贴近政策愿景而非气候科学的国家标准所固有的风险——此类偏差可能危及国家电力市场的韧性。此外，本研究通过阐明竞争者之间的行业层面协作如何支持企业信息披露改进（尤其在气候治理领域），为利益相关者理论作出贡献。
10.1111/1467-8489.70133.title: Inside the Black Box: Advancing Climate Disclosure in Australia's Energy Sector to Support a Resilient National Electricity Market
10.1111/1467-8489.70133.title_zh: 黑箱之内：推进澳大利亚能源行业气候披露以支持韧性国家电力市场

10.1111/1467-8489.70135.abstract: Poverty alleviation relocation is an important component of China's anti‐poverty strategy and has reshaped relocated households' living conditions and social integration. Using the Poverty Alleviation Relocation Programme (PARP) as a quasi‐natural experiment, this study examines the impact of relocation on households' social status based on four‐wave panel data from 1351 households. The results show that relocation significantly improves subjective social status, whereas its effect on objective social status is insignificant. The positive effect is more pronounced among young adults aged 18–44, elderly individuals aged 60 and above, households with lower educational attainment, and those resettled in rural areas. Mechanism analysis suggests that social network expansion and improved life satisfaction are important channels through which relocation enhances perceived social standing. The findings also reveal a significant increase in conspicuous consumption after relocation, suggesting stronger aspirations for upward mobility among relocated households. By extending the analysis from material welfare to the social dimensions of relocation, this study provides new evidence on the social consequences of poverty alleviation relocation and offers implications for subsequent support policies.
10.1111/1467-8489.70135.abstract_zh: 易地扶贫搬迁是中国反贫困战略的重要组成部分，重塑了搬迁家庭的生活条件与社会融合。本研究以易地扶贫搬迁项目作为准自然实验，基于1351户家庭的四轮面板数据，考察了搬迁对家庭社会地位的影响。结果表明，搬迁显著提升了主观社会地位，而对客观社会地位的影响则不显著。这一积极效应在18至44岁的青年群体、60岁及以上的老年群体、受教育程度较低的家庭以及迁入农村地区的家庭中更为明显。机制分析表明，社交网络扩展和生活满意度提升是搬迁增强感知社会地位的重要渠道。研究结果还显示，搬迁后炫耀性消费显著增加，表明搬迁家庭具有更强的向上流动意愿。通过将分析从物质福利延伸至搬迁的社会维度，本研究为易地扶贫搬迁的社会后果提供了新的证据，并对后续支持政策具有启示意义。
10.1111/1467-8489.70135.title: Where the Heart Finds Peace, There Is My Home: Changes in Social Status in the Poverty Alleviation Relocation Programme
10.1111/1467-8489.70135.title_zh: 心安之处即是家：易地扶贫搬迁中的社会地位变迁

10.1111/1467-8489.70136.abstract: Rapid growth in digital finance has expanded credit access for rural smallholders, yet financial capability has not kept pace with access. Where fee structures are opaque and search is costly, this gap raises the risk of expensive borrowing in digital financial services. This paper assesses whether a video‐based financial knowledge intervention affects stated willingness to pay for digital credit. Using contingent valuation with a payment card approach, we measure willingness to pay before and after information provision among 694 smallholder households in Meru County, Kenya. Our results show that the video intervention reduced the monthly interest rate that smallholders are willing to pay by 1.4 percentage points. This finding suggests that the intervention increased sensitivity to borrowing costs and reduced stated tolerance for higher‐priced digital credit. It also provides policy‐relevant evidence that brief, targeted video prompts can complement consumer‐protection measures by shifting stated credit choices toward lower interest‐rate categories.
10.1111/1467-8489.70136.abstract_zh: 数字金融的快速发展扩大了农村小农户的信贷获取渠道，但金融能力并未跟上信贷可及性的提升。在费用结构不透明且搜寻成本高昂的情况下，这一差距加剧了数字金融服务中高成本借贷的风险。本文评估了基于视频的金融知识干预是否会影响农户对数字信贷的陈述意愿支付价格。我们采用支付卡法的条件价值评估法，对肯尼亚梅鲁县694户小农户在信息干预前后的支付意愿进行测度。研究结果显示，视频干预使小农户愿意支付的月利率降低了1.4个百分点。这一发现表明，该干预措施提高了农户对借贷成本的敏感度，并降低了其对高息数字信贷的陈述容忍度。同时，该研究提供了具有政策参考价值的证据：简短且有针对性的视频提示能够通过引导陈述信贷选择向低利率类别转移，从而补充消费者保护措施。
10.1111/1467-8489.70136.title: Financial Literacy Intervention and the Willingness to Pay for Digital Credits: A Scalable Video‐Based Approach in Kenya
10.1111/1467-8489.70136.title_zh: 金融素养干预与数字信贷支付意愿：肯尼亚一项可扩展的视频干预方法

10.1111/1467-8489.70138.abstract: ABSTRACT This special issue examines the economics of greenhouse gas (GHG) mitigation in agriculture. The papers in the issue study agricultural mitigation from three broad perspectives: the design of mitigation incentives, the economic benefits of mitigation practices and programmes, and the adoption and behavioural responses by producers, consumers and other stakeholders. The papers span a wide range of countries, production systems and policy contexts, and collectively show that translating mitigation potential into mitigation outcomes depends critically on incentive design, measurement and the actions across producers, consumers, regulators and supply‐chain actors.
10.1111/1467-8489.70138.abstract_zh: 摘要 本期特刊探讨农业领域温室气体减排的经济学问题。所收录论文从三大视角研究农业减排：减排激励机制设计、减排实践与项目的经济效益，以及生产者、消费者及其他利益相关方的采纳行为与响应。这些研究覆盖多个国家、生产体系及政策背景，共同表明：将减排潜力转化为实际减排成效，关键取决于激励机制设计、核算方法，以及生产者、消费者、监管机构和供应链参与者的协同行动。
10.1111/1467-8489.70138.title:
Economics of
                    GHG
                    Mitigation in Agriculture: Incentive Design, Economic Benefits and Behavioural Responses
10.1111/1467-8489.70138.title_zh: 农业温室气体减排经济学：激励设计、经济效益与行为响应

10.1111/1467-8489.70141.abstract: Excessive water use in rice production is a major source of methane emissions, the dominant greenhouse gas from Vietnam's agricultural sector. Improving water‐use efficiency can enhance water security and reduce emissions, but achieving these gains requires substantial changes in farming practices and significant investment in supporting infrastructure. This study provides an economic analysis of low‐water, low‐emission (LWLE) farming techniques, such as Alternate Wetting and Drying and the System of Rice Intensification, and their associated infrastructure requirements. Using survey data from 14,312 rice‐producing households in Vietnam, we evaluate the economic performance of farmers who adopt LWLE practices and those who do not. The results show that producers adopting LWLE not only achieve higher yields than those using traditional farming techniques—and consequently higher revenues—but also incur higher costs and ultimately earn lower profits. In addition, LWLE entails considerable hidden upfront irrigation costs, posing barriers for farmers and limiting smallholder participation. We also undertake a break‐even carbon price analysis to illustrate the economic trade‐offs in reducing one tonne of CO 2 equivalent through LWLE techniques, and the results suggest that these practices could reduce farmers' vulnerability to future carbon pricing.
10.1111/1467-8489.70141.abstract_zh: 水稻生产中的过度用水是甲烷排放的主要来源，而甲烷是越南农业部门最主要的温室气体。提高用水效率既能增强水安全，又能减少排放，但实现这些效益需要大幅改变耕作方式，并对配套基础设施进行大量投资。本研究对低水低排放（LWLE）耕作技术（如交替干湿灌溉和稻作强化体系）及其相关基础设施需求进行了经济分析。利用越南14,312户水稻生产农户的调查数据，我们评估了采用LWLE实践与未采用农户的经济表现。结果表明，采用LWLE的农户不仅比传统耕作技术获得更高产量（进而获得更高收入），而且承担更高成本，最终利润更低。此外，LWLE还涉及大量隐性前期灌溉成本，这给农户带来障碍并限制了小农户的参与。我们还进行了盈亏平衡碳价分析，以说明通过LWLE技术减少一吨二氧化碳当量所涉及的经济权衡，结果表明这些实践可能降低农户对未来碳定价的脆弱性。
10.1111/1467-8489.70141.title: Economic Analysis of Infrastructure Investment and Break‐Even Carbon Prices for Low‐Water, Low‐Emission Farming Techniques in Vietnam
10.1111/1467-8489.70141.title_zh: 越南低水低排放农业技术的基础设施投资与盈亏平衡碳价格的经济分析

10.1111/1467-8489.70142.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This study examines whether household tap water access affects income‐generating work time among employed rural adults in China. While existing studies have mainly examined the effects of improved water access on employment participation, off‐farm transition and household income, this paper focuses on the intensive margin of labour supply within existing livelihood activities. Drawing on household production and time allocation theory, household tap water access is conceptualised as reducing the time cost of routine domestic production, thereby releasing time that may be reallocated to income‐generating work and other household activities. Using rural panel data from the China Family Panel Studies from 2014 to 2022, the analysis applies individual fixed‐effects models and instrumental variables fixed‐effects (IV‐FE) estimates. The fixed effects results show that household tap water access is associated with approximately one additional hour of income‐generating work per week among employed rural adults. Under the IV identifying assumptions, the IV‐FE estimates suggest a larger positive effect. Additional time‐use analysis indicates that household tap water access reduces daily housework time by about 0.29 h and modestly increases midday nap duration, while no statistically significant changes are found for television watching or leisure reading. Heterogeneity analysis suggests that the increase in work time is concentrated among agricultural workers, self‐employed individuals, prime‐age adults and individuals living in households without young children.</jats:p>
10.1111/1467-8489.70142.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了家庭自来水供应是否影响中国农村就业成年人的创收工作时间。现有研究主要关注改善水资源获取对就业参与、非农转移和家庭收入的影响，而本文聚焦于现有生计活动中劳动力供给的集约边际。基于家庭生产与时间分配理论，家庭自来水供应被概念化为降低日常家务生产的时间成本，从而释放出可能重新分配至创收工作及其他家庭活动的时间。利用2014年至2022年中国家庭追踪调查的农村面板数据，本文采用个体固定效应模型和工具变量固定效应估计。固定效应结果显示，家庭自来水供应与农村就业成年人每周约增加一小时的创收工作时间相关。在工具变量识别假设下，工具变量固定效应估计表明存在更大的正向效应。额外的时间使用分析显示，家庭自来水供应使每日家务时间减少约0.29小时，并适度增加午睡时长，而看电视或休闲阅读的时间未发现统计显著变化。异质性分析表明，工作时间的增加主要集中在农业劳动者、自雇者、壮年成年人以及无幼儿家庭中的个体。
10.1111/1467-8489.70142.title: From Tap Water Access to Income‐Generating Work Time: Evidence From Rural China
10.1111/1467-8489.70142.title_zh: 从自来水接入到创收工作时间：来自中国农村的证据

10.1111/1467-8489.70143.abstract: The agricultural sector's share of GDP in growing economies typically declines but, for a century from the early 1850s, Australia's did not. That trend is most evident for the former colony and now State of South Australia (SA). Moreover, that share for SA has been almost flat since 1980 as well, along with the agricultural sector's share of SA exports. This paper seeks to shed light on the forces behind the unusual evolution of these sectoral shares for SA both up to 1950 and since 1980. The extensive time series data compiled for this paper suggest various partial explanations. For 1850–1950, they include the huge arable land area per worker, clearly defined and enforced property rights in settled rural areas as the frontier of European settlement expanded, the absence of a need to do any processing of the main 19th century exports (copper, wool and wheat), a strong public agricultural research and extension system, and the absence of major mining booms after the copper finds in the 1840s and 1860s.
10.1111/1467-8489.70143.abstract_zh: 在经济增长过程中，农业部门占GDP的比重通常会下降，但从19世纪50年代初开始的一个世纪里，澳大利亚的这一比重并未下降。这一趋势在前殖民地、现南澳大利亚州（SA）表现得最为明显。此外，自1980年以来，南澳大利亚州农业部门占GDP的比重以及农业部门占该州出口的比重几乎保持平稳。本文旨在揭示南澳大利亚州在1950年之前及1980年之后这些部门份额异常演变的驱动因素。本文编制的大量时间序列数据提供了多种局部解释。对于1850年至1950年期间，这些因素包括：人均可耕地面积巨大；随着欧洲定居前沿的扩展，定居农村地区明确界定并有效执行的产权；19世纪主要出口产品（铜、羊毛和小麦）无需任何加工；强大的公共农业研究与推广体系；以及19世纪40年代和60年代铜矿发现后未出现重大矿业繁荣。
10.1111/1467-8489.70143.title: Forces Behind South Australia's Unusual Structural Changes Since 1840
10.1111/1467-8489.70143.title_zh: 1840年以来南澳大利亚州异常结构变化背后的驱动力

10.1111/1467-8489.70144.abstract: As a core component of human capital, education plays a pivotal role in shaping labour productivity. In remote and impoverished rural areas, limited access to post‐compulsory education creates a self‐perpetuating cycle of low education, low productivity, and entrenched poverty. Using data from China's Poverty Alleviation Through Relocation programme, this study examines the impact of relocation on children's post‐compulsory education, measured by high school enrolment. Employing a two‐way fixed effects model, we find that relocation increases the probability of high school enrolment by approximately 8.6 percentage points, with results robust to household controls and propensity score matching. Mechanism analysis provides suggestive evidence that these gains are associated with improved school accessibility, higher household income and increased educational investment. The effects are heterogeneous: educational gains are concentrated among male children and those in households with lower‐educated and older heads, are primarily driven by rural relocation, and increase with the duration since resettlement. The findings highlight both the potential and uneven distribution of human capital gains from relocation policies, providing important insights for targeted post‐relocation educational support in other developing country contexts.
10.1111/1467-8489.70144.abstract_zh: 作为人力资本的核心组成部分，教育在塑造劳动生产率方面发挥着关键作用。在偏远贫困的农村地区，义务教育后教育机会的匮乏形成了低教育水平、低生产率与根深蒂固贫困的自我循环。本研究利用中国易地扶贫搬迁项目数据，以高中入学率为衡量指标，考察搬迁对儿童义务教育后教育的影响。通过采用双向固定效应模型，我们发现搬迁使高中入学概率提升约8.6个百分点，该结果在加入家庭层面控制变量及倾向得分匹配后依然稳健。机制分析表明，这些教育收益与学校可达性改善、家庭收入提高及教育投资增加存在关联。异质性分析显示：教育收益集中于男性儿童、户主受教育程度较低及年龄较大的家庭；主要源于农村搬迁驱动；且随安置时间延长而递增。研究结果揭示了搬迁政策在人力资本积累方面的潜力与分配不均问题，为其他发展中国家制定针对性的搬迁后教育支持政策提供了重要启示。
10.1111/1467-8489.70144.title: Relocation and Educational Attainment: Evidence From China's Poverty Alleviation Programme
10.1111/1467-8489.70144.title_zh: 搬迁与教育成就：来自中国扶贫项目的证据

10.1111/1467-8489.70145.abstract: This paper examines the causal impact of agronomic technology adoption, induced by technical assistance programmes, on factor misallocation and aggregate agricultural productivity. While the literature has established the central role of land and capital market imperfections as sources of misallocation in agriculture, the potential of technological adoption to correct these inefficiencies has received limited attention. This paper directly addresses this gap by combining a calibrated equilibrium model with causal inference methods, using Chile as a case study. The results show that, among farmers whose adoption is induced by access to technical assistance programmes, factor misallocation is reduced by approximately 22 percentage points. This effect is robust across alternative efficiency measures, functional specifications and parametric assumptions, and remains stable after purging idiosyncratic productivity from agroclimatic conditions such as rainfall and soil quality. Technological adoption significantly increases participation in land rental markets and access to bank credit, thereby facilitating the reallocation of resources towards more productive farmers. In addition, the analysis identifies local spillover effects: farmers in municipalities with higher adoption rates exhibit lower misallocation. Counterfactual exercises further indicate that these effects are amplified when frictions in land markets are reduced.
10.1111/1467-8489.70145.abstract_zh: 本文考察了由技术援助项目引致的农艺技术采纳对要素错配和农业总生产率的影响。尽管已有文献确立了土地和资本市场不完善是农业错配的主要根源，但技术采纳在纠正这些效率损失方面的潜力却鲜受关注。本文通过将校准均衡模型与因果推断方法相结合，以智利为案例研究，直接填补了这一空白。结果表明，在因获得技术援助项目而采纳技术的农户中，要素错配降低了约22个百分点。这一效应在替代效率测度、函数设定和参数假设下均保持稳健，且在剔除降雨和土壤质量等农业气候条件带来的异质性生产率后依然稳定。技术采纳显著提高了农户参与土地租赁市场和获得银行信贷的机会，从而促进了资源向更具生产率的农户重新配置。此外，分析还识别出局部溢出效应：在技术采纳率较高的市镇，农户的错配程度较低。反事实分析进一步表明，当土地市场摩擦减少时，这些效应会得到放大。
10.1111/1467-8489.70145.title: Beyond Productivity: Technology Adoption and Factor Allocation in Agriculture
10.1111/1467-8489.70145.title_zh: 超越生产力：农业中的技术采纳与要素配置

10.1111/1467-8489.70146.abstract: Incorporating greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions as an undesirable output of agricultural production in a directional distance function provides a better understanding of agricultural production performance. Based on balanced panel data from 126 prefecture‐level regions in the Yangtze River Basin in China, we employed a quadratic directional output‐oriented distance function to measure agricultural production performance in terms of environmental efficiency, relative shadow price of GHG emissions and Morishima elasticities of substitution between inputs. We found an upward trend, with average environmental efficiency of 0.871 during 2000–2020. This indicates that 12.9% more agricultural added value can be achieved, along with a 12.9% reduction in GHG emissions. Agricultural production in the upstream Yangtze River Basin region showed the best performance in terms of environmental efficiency. The estimated relative shadow price of GHG emissions was 4.606 and showed a negative association with environmental efficiency. Morishima elasticities of substitution indicated a substitution relationship of labour and fertiliser to land, and a strong complementary relationship between fertiliser and labour.
10.1111/1467-8489.70146.abstract_zh: 将温室气体排放作为农业生产非期望产出纳入方向性距离函数，有助于更深入理解农业生产绩效。基于中国长江流域126个地级市2000-2020年的平衡面板数据，采用二次型方向性产出距离函数，从环境效率、温室气体排放相对影子价格及投入要素间Morishima替代弹性三个维度测度农业生产绩效。研究发现：样本期间平均环境效率为0.871且呈上升趋势，表明在实现12.9%农业增加值增长的同时可同步减少12.9%的温室气体排放；长江上游地区农业生产的环境效率表现最优；温室气体排放相对影子价格估计值为4.606，且与环境效率呈负相关关系；Morishima替代弹性显示劳动力和化肥对土地存在替代关系，而化肥与劳动力之间呈现强互补关系。
10.1111/1467-8489.70146.title: Synergies or Trade‐Offs Between Environmental and Economic Outcomes? An Analysis of Agricultural Production Performance
10.1111/1467-8489.70146.title_zh: 环境与经济成果之间的协同还是权衡？农业生产绩效分析

10.1111/1467-8489.70148.abstract: Americans across the country are plagued with harmful effects from air and water pollution, resource depletion, land degradation, biodiversity loss and climate change. Protecting the natural environment, ecosystems and humans from these effects will demand substantive changes in production methods, delivery processes and consumption patterns. Amassing resources to effect such changes will likely require both higher taxes and prices. Currently, the literature offers little in the way of estimating or identifying the factors important in determining the public's willingness to pay both higher taxes and higher prices, in principle, for environmental protection. This paper is a first attempt to fill this gap. Using data from the United States 2021 General Social Survey, we estimate a bivariate ordered probit model, enabling us to calculate average marginal effects on and average predicted probabilities of the willingness to pay both higher taxes and higher prices to protect the environment. Without considerable and widespread changes in attitudes and beliefs, results suggest that there is little chance that a majority of Americans will support higher prices, a smaller chance of a majority supporting higher taxes and a still smaller chance that a majority will support both higher taxes and higher prices for environmental protection.
10.1111/1467-8489.70148.abstract_zh: 全美各地民众正遭受空气与水污染、资源枯竭、土地退化、生物多样性丧失及气候变化带来的有害影响。保护自然环境、生态系统及人类免受这些影响，需要生产方式、配送流程和消费模式发生实质性变革。为促成此类变革而筹集资源，很可能需要提高税收和价格。目前，学术界在估算或识别决定公众原则上是否愿意为环境保护同时承担更高税收与更高价格的关键因素方面，几乎未提供任何研究。本文首次尝试填补这一空白。利用美国2021年综合社会调查数据，我们估计了双变量有序概率模型，从而能够计算公众为保护环境同时承担更高税收与更高价格的意愿的平均边际效应和平均预测概率。研究结果表明，若态度与信念未发生广泛且显著的转变，大多数美国人支持更高价格的可能性微乎其微，支持更高税收的可能性更小，而同时支持为环境保护承担更高税收与更高价格的可能性则微乎其微。
10.1111/1467-8489.70148.title: What Is the Probability That the Environmentally Conscious Are Willing to Pay Higher Taxes and Higher Prices to Protect the Environment? Recent Evidence for the United States
10.1111/1467-8489.70148.title_zh: 环保意识者愿意支付更高税收和价格以保护环境的概率是多少？——来自美国的最新证据

10.1111/1477-9552.70033.abstract: As global demand for beef increases, balancing livestock productivity with environmental sustainability has become a policy priority. In response, Uruguay implemented the Sustainable Family Production Programme (PFIS) between 2015 and 2017, providing targeted support for small and medium‐sized cattle farmers to invest in productivity‐enhancing and climate‐adaptive technologies. This study provides the first causal evaluation of a national programme designed to promote these dual objectives in the cattle sector. Using a regression discontinuity design based on a strict eligibility threshold and panel data from 2015 to 2020, we evaluate the programme's effect on five dimensions: (i) the adoption of technology and practices, (ii) engagement in producer organisations, (iii) reported cattle health problems, (iv) beef production per hectare, and (v) greenhouse gas emissions intensity. The intervention significantly increased the application of reproductive and herd management practices, specifically early weaning, controlled mating, and ovarian activity diagnosis, without generating shifts in the other measured outcomes by the 2020 horizon. These results highlight both the potential and the limitations of integrated technology transfer programmes in promoting sustainable intensification of extensive livestock systems. They also suggest the need for longer‐term evaluations to capture potential effects on productivity and emissions that may emerge as these technologies, particularly reproductive ones, influence aggregate outcomes.
10.1111/1477-9552.70033.abstract_zh: 随着全球牛肉需求增长，平衡畜牧业生产力与环境可持续性已成为政策重点。为此，乌拉圭于2015年至2017年间实施了可持续家庭生产计划（PFIS），为中小型养牛户提供针对性支持，以投资于提升生产力和气候适应性技术。本研究首次对旨在促进养牛业双重目标的国家级计划进行因果评估。基于严格资格门槛的断点回归设计及2015-2020年面板数据，我们从五个维度评估该计划的效果：（i）技术与实践采纳率；（ii）生产者组织参与度；（iii）报告牛群健康问题；（iv）每公顷牛肉产量；（v）温室气体排放强度。该干预措施显著提高了繁殖与畜群管理实践的应用率，具体表现为早期断奶、控制配种及卵巢活动诊断，但截至2020年，其他衡量指标未发生显著变化。这些结果既揭示了综合性技术推广计划在促进粗放型畜牧系统可持续集约化方面的潜力，也凸显了其局限性。同时表明，随着这些技术（尤其是繁殖技术）对总体产出产生影响，需开展更长期评估以捕捉其对生产力和排放的潜在效应。
10.1111/1477-9552.70033.title: Outcomes of a Public Program to Support Sustainable Livestock Farming: Evidence From Uruguay
10.1111/1477-9552.70033.title_zh: 乌拉圭支持可持续畜牧业公共项目的成效：来自实证的证据

10.1111/1477-9552.70041.abstract: This paper quantifies the economy‐wide consequences of two independent global stress‐tests in livestock production. The first assesses the effects of phasing out antimicrobial growth promoters (AGPs), and the second evaluates the long‐term impacts of antimicrobial resistance (AMR) progression. We use a sequential, one‐way modelling framework combining a global partial equilibrium (PE) model and a global computable general equilibrium (CGE) model to trace how scenario‐defined shocks in livestock production propagate through world agricultural markets and the wider economy. The highest‐impact AGPs phase‐out scenario results in cumulative global livestock production losses, valued at constant 2021–2023 prices, of roughly USD 53 billion over 2025–2040, with annual deviations that peak in the mid‐2020s and then decline as output converges along scenario‐defined recovery paths. In contrast, the highest‐impact AMR scenario produces persistent and compounding reductions by construction, with cumulative production losses of about USD 318 billion by 2040, while cumulative economy‐wide welfare losses in this high‐impact case reach approximately USD 1.25 trillion, concentrated mainly in upper–middle‐income countries. Results are scenario dependent by construction and represent indicative orders of magnitude rather than forecasts. The baseline implicitly reflects prevailing levels of AGPs and AMR embedded in historical production trends. The study provides a framework for quantifying the production effects of antimicrobial use (AMU) and their economy‐wide spillovers, highlighting the asymmetric timing of the economic costs of action and inaction under the imposed scenario structure.
10.1111/1477-9552.70041.abstract_zh: 本文量化了畜牧业生产中两项独立全球压力测试对整体经济的影响。第一项评估了逐步淘汰抗生素生长促进剂（AGPs）的效应，第二项评估了抗生素耐药性（AMR）持续发展的长期影响。我们采用序贯单向建模框架，结合全球局部均衡（PE）模型与全球可计算一般均衡（CGE）模型，追踪情景设定的畜牧业生产冲击如何通过世界农产品市场及更广泛的经济体系传导。在影响最大的AGPs淘汰情景下，以2021-2023年不变价格计算，2025-2040年间全球畜牧业累计产量损失约为530亿美元，年度偏离值在2020年代中期达到峰值，随后随产出沿情景设定的恢复路径收敛而下降。相比之下，影响最大的AMR情景因设定机制产生持续且叠加的减产效应，至2040年累计产量损失约达3180亿美元，而该高影响情景下的累计经济福利损失约为1.25万亿美元，主要集中于中高收入国家。研究结果本质上具有情景依赖性，仅代表指示性量级而非预测值。基准情景隐含地反映了历史生产趋势中固有的AGPs与AMR水平。本研究为量化抗生素使用（AMU）的生产效应及其经济溢出提供了分析框架，揭示了在既定情景结构下，采取行动与不采取行动所产生经济成本在时间维度上的非对称性。
10.1111/1477-9552.70041.title: Antimicrobial Use in Livestock: The Economic Cost of Action or Inaction
10.1111/1477-9552.70041.title_zh: 畜牧业中抗生素的使用：行动或不行动的经济成本

10.1111/1477-9552.70047.abstract: The Orinoquía region is one of Colombia's principal agricultural frontiers and has been shaped by long‐standing armed‐conflict dynamics that continue to influence land governance, producer incentives, and investment decisions. Efforts to promote sustainable cattle production emphasize two key practices: sustainable pasture management (including rotational grazing systems) and ecologically appropriate stocking rates. However, their adoption varies widely because of institutional, economic, and biophysical constraints. This study applies a dual binary choice framework to examine the adoption decisions associated with these two practices and to assess whether they operate sequentially or independently. Results show that tenure security, measured through formal landownership, is strongly associated with the adoption of sustainable pasture management. In contrast, access to technical assistance is negatively associated with adoption, suggesting issues of program quality, targeting, or reverse causality. Older and more experienced producers are less likely to adopt, indicating path dependence. For stocking‐rate decisions, rotational and alternating grazing systems exhibit lower probabilities of meeting sustainable thresholds, likely reflecting implementation challenges in extensive systems. Larger finishing areas also tend to be managed less sustainably, and descriptive evidence suggests that unsustainable stocking in our sample is more frequently associated with understocking than overstocking, with 239 producers (70%) below 1 animal per hectare. These findings illustrate how structural and institutional conditions, including those linked to conflict legacies, shape sustainability transitions in the Orinoquía and can inform more tailored policy interventions for frontier livestock regions.
10.1111/1477-9552.70047.abstract_zh: 奥里诺基亚地区是哥伦比亚主要的农业边疆之一，长期武装冲突动态持续影响着土地治理、生产者激励和投资决策。推动可持续畜牧业发展的努力聚焦于两项关键实践：可持续牧场管理（包括轮牧系统）和生态适宜载畜率。然而，由于制度、经济和生物物理条件的制约，这些实践的采纳程度差异显著。本研究采用二元选择框架，分析这两项实践的采纳决策，并评估其是顺序推进还是独立进行。结果表明，通过正式土地所有权衡量的产权保障与可持续牧场管理的采纳密切相关。相反，技术援助的获取与采纳呈负相关，暗示项目质量、目标定位或反向因果问题。年龄较大、经验更丰富的生产者采纳意愿较低，体现了路径依赖效应。在载畜率决策中，轮牧和交替放牧系统达到可持续阈值的概率较低，这反映了粗放型系统中的实施挑战。较大的育肥区域往往管理更不可持续，描述性证据表明，样本中不可持续载畜更常表现为载畜不足而非过度载畜，239名生产者（70%）的载畜率低于每公顷1头。这些发现揭示了结构性及制度条件（包括与冲突遗留问题相关的条件）如何塑造奥里诺基亚地区的可持续转型，并为针对边疆畜牧区域制定更精准的政策干预提供依据。
10.1111/1477-9552.70047.title: Sustainable Livestock Decisions in a Post‐Conflict Frontier: Evidence From Colombia's Orinoquía
10.1111/1477-9552.70047.title_zh: 后冲突前沿地区的可持续畜牧业决策：来自哥伦比亚奥里诺基亚地区的证据

10.1111/1477-9552.70049.abstract: To maintain the vital economic benefits of Latin America's livestock sector while minimizing its environmental footprint, producers must adopt clean and climate‐friendly ‘sustainable’ technologies including improved feed, grazing, reproductive, and herd management practices. Yet we have limited evidence on the barriers to and opportunities for the adoption of such technologies, and even less on that topic in Latin America and other developing regions where socioeconomic and geophysical conditions often differ from those in the developed countries. The product of a competitive open call by the Inter‐American Development Bank, the four articles that comprise the Special Focus aim to help fill that gap. Three examine the determinants of adoption in Mexico, Colombia, and Uruguay; and the fourth presents a quasi‐experimental impact evaluation of a program aimed at promoting adoption in Uruguay. The findings suggest that: (i) generalizing about the drivers of the adoption of sustainable livestock technologies in Latin America is ill advised: they are both technology‐ and site‐specific; (ii) land tenure matters; (iii) adopting one sustainable livestock technology does not necessarily increase the chances of adopting others; (iv) adoption does not guarantee significant impacts on targeted outcomes; and (v) two of the most common policy interventions—enhancing access to credit and providing technical extension—are correlated with adoption, at least for some technologies and subgroups.
10.1111/1477-9552.70049.abstract_zh: 为维持拉丁美洲畜牧业的重要经济效益，同时最大限度减少其环境足迹，生产者必须采用清洁且气候友好的"可持续"技术，包括改良饲料、放牧、繁殖及畜群管理实践。然而，关于此类技术采用的障碍与机遇，现有证据十分有限，而在社会经济与地理条件常异于发达国家的拉丁美洲及其他发展中地区，相关研究更为匮乏。作为美洲开发银行公开竞标成果，本专题聚焦的四篇文章旨在填补这一空白：其中三篇分别考察墨西哥、哥伦比亚和乌拉圭的技术采用决定因素，第四篇则对乌拉圭一项旨在促进技术采用的计划进行准实验影响评估。研究结果表明：（一）对拉丁美洲可持续畜牧业技术采用驱动因素进行泛化概括并不可取——这些因素既具有技术特异性又具有地域特异性；（二）土地权属至关重要；（三）采用某项可持续畜牧业技术并不必然增加采用其他技术的可能性；（四）技术采用并不能保证对目标结果产生显著影响；（五）两种最常见的政策干预措施——增强信贷可及性与提供技术推广服务——与技术采用存在相关性，至少对某些技术和子群体而言如此。
10.1111/1477-9552.70049.title: Adoption of Sustainable Livestock Innovations: Evidence from Latin America
10.1111/1477-9552.70049.title_zh: 采纳可持续畜牧业创新：来自拉丁美洲的证据

10.1111/1477-9552.70050.abstract: Changes towards more sustainable livestock production are often evaluated in terms of whether farms abandon environmentally harmful practices. Less attention has been paid to how farms reallocate production across alternative grazing systems and how the composition of production evolves over time. This paper addresses this question by modelling grazing systems as compositional outcomes and examining how financial, institutional and structural factors shape the distribution of livestock across alternative regimes. We use farm level data from the 2007 and 2022 agricultural censuses in Mexico, covering more than 860,000 cattle farms and estimate a fractional multinomial logit model. Financial and institutional support is associated with economically meaningful reductions in free grazing. However, most of this adjustment occurs through confinement rather than controlled grazing. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that small and dairy farms allocate a larger share of production to confinement systems, whereas large and beef‐dairy farms allocate relatively more to controlled grazing. The results indicate that sustainability outcomes depend on how policy instruments interact with farm scale, production orientation and land constraints.
10.1111/1477-9552.70050.abstract_zh: 向更可持续的畜牧业转型的评估通常聚焦于农场是否放弃环境有害的生产方式，而较少关注农场如何在替代放牧系统间重新配置生产，以及生产结构如何随时间演变。本文通过将放牧系统建模为组合结果，考察金融、制度和结构因素如何影响牲畜在不同生产模式间的分布，从而探讨这一问题。我们利用墨西哥2007年和2022年农业普查中超过86万个牧场的微观数据，估计了分数多项逻辑模型。研究发现，金融与制度支持与自由放牧在经济意义上的显著减少相关，但这一调整主要通过圈养而非控制放牧实现。异质性分析表明，小型牧场和奶牛场将更大比例的生产配置于圈养系统，而大型牧场及肉奶兼用牧场则相对更多采用控制放牧。结果表明，可持续性成效取决于政策工具如何与农场规模、生产导向及土地约束相互作用。
10.1111/1477-9552.70050.title: Sustainability and the Reallocation of Production Across Grazing Regimes in Livestock Systems: Evidence From Mexico
10.1111/1477-9552.70050.title_zh: 可持续性与畜牧系统中放牧模式间生产重新配置：来自墨西哥的证据

10.1111/1477-9552.70051.title: Adoption of New Practices in Latin American Agriculture: Livestock Technologies and Systems
10.1111/1477-9552.70051.title_zh: 拉丁美洲农业新实践的采纳：畜牧技术与系统

10.1111/1477-9552.70052.abstract: This paper examines the reallocation effects of a typical environmental policy aiming to internalize externalities: the straw burning ban across China. The ban prohibited the traditional farming practice of burning straw while compelling the labour‐intensive practice of straw utilization. We show that the legislation banning straw burning led to an increase in local land renting activities. Our results indicate that implementation of the ban resulted in a within‐village land redistribution, encouraging the exit of less‐productive farmers while promoting land expansion by more‐productive farmers. Consequently, village‐level aggregate agricultural output and productivity increased by 5% and 3%, respectively. A complementary policy instrument to the command‐and‐control ban—establishing biomass power plants to incentivize farmers to collect crop residues—led to a greater land redistribution in villages with a nearby biomass power plant after the ban is imposed, relative to before.
10.1111/1477-9552.70052.abstract_zh: 本文考察了一项旨在内化外部性的典型环境政策——中国秸秆禁烧令——的重新配置效应。该禁令禁止了传统的秸秆焚烧耕作方式，同时强制推行劳动密集型的秸秆利用实践。我们证明，秸秆禁烧立法导致当地土地租赁活动增加。研究结果表明，禁令的实施引发了村内土地重新分配，促使低生产率农户退出，同时推动高生产率农户扩大土地规模。由此，村级农业总产出和生产率分别提升了5%和3%。作为命令控制型禁令的补充政策工具——建立生物质发电厂以激励农户收集农作物残余物——在禁令实施后，相较于实施前，导致邻近生物质发电厂的村庄出现了更显著的土地重新分配。
10.1111/1477-9552.70052.title: Reallocation Effects of Internalizing Externalities: Evidence From China's Straw Burning Ban
10.1111/1477-9552.70052.title_zh: 内部化外部性的再配置效应：来自中国秸秆禁烧政策的证据

10.1111/1477-9552.70053.abstract: Repurposing agricultural public resources toward higher‐return incentives and investments can help transform agri‐food systems. This is important for low‐income countries, especially in sub‐Saharan Africa, where limited budgets restrict options for boosting agricultural spending. We demonstrate how, within a tight budget envelope, opportunities exist to achieve better agricultural transformation outcomes. To this end, we developed the policy optimization modelling tool, PolOpT, which combines a multicriteria decision‐making technique and a recursive‐dynamic computable general equilibrium model. We applied it with datasets for six sub‐Saharan African countries, including hundreds of estimated parameters that transmit the effect of policy measures onto agricultural productivity. The approach demonstrates that reallocating agricultural public expenditure across policy measures in these countries can potentially boost agri‐food output by several percentage points, create almost a million off‐farm jobs in rural areas, lift almost 3 million people out of poverty and allow 16 million people more to afford a healthy diet—all without extra funding.
10.1111/1477-9552.70053.abstract_zh: 将农业公共资源重新配置到更高回报的激励措施和投资领域，有助于推动农业食品体系转型。这对低收入国家尤为重要，尤其是撒哈拉以南非洲地区，这些国家有限的预算制约了农业支出增长的选择空间。我们证明，在预算约束范围内，仍存在实现更优农业转型成果的机遇。为此，我们开发了政策优化建模工具PolOpT，该工具融合了多准则决策技术与递归动态可计算一般均衡模型。我们利用六个撒哈拉以南非洲国家的数据集（包含数百个反映政策措施对农业生产率传导效应的估计参数）进行了应用分析。研究结果表明，在这些国家间重新配置农业公共支出，可在不增加额外资金的情况下，使农业食品产出提升数个百分点，在农村地区创造近百万非农就业岗位，帮助近300万人摆脱贫困，并使1600万人能够负担健康膳食。

10.1111/1477-9552.70054.abstract: How large is the potential benefit for farmers from obtaining forecasts of total rainfall in the upcoming season? This critically depends on the local farm system and the crop management actions available to farmers to respond to the forecasts issued. Studies assessing the financial value of seasonal precipitation forecasts have so far focused almost exclusively on start‐of‐season crop sowing decisions using approaches for non‐embedded risk analysis. However, crop management decisions are spread over the entire growing cycle, and considering this realistically could either increase or diminish the financial value of seasonal forecast information from a theoretical perspective. Our simulation analysis demonstrates how this research gap can be closed: we employ a state‐contingent embedded risk approach combining multi‐stage discrete stochastic programming and high‐performance computing to determine optimal crop management responses (crop choice, sowing date, tied‐ridging, relay cropping and fertilization) to seasonal precipitation forecasts throughout the full crop growth cycle. For rain‐fed agriculture in the Central Rift Valley of Ethiopia, we find seasonal forecasts to increase risk‐adjusted expected cash surplus by about 2%–3% at realistic forecast skill levels. For a typical risk‐averse subsistence farming household (0.5 ha), we calculated an increase in long‐term expected cash surplus of 58 USD PPP at 2023 prices. Intra‐seasonal crop management plays an important role in forecast response. A non‐embedded risk approach simulated not more than 35% of the forecast's economic value simulated with the embedded risk approach.
10.1111/1477-9552.70054.abstract_zh: 农民从获取未来季节总降雨量预测中获得的潜在收益有多大？这关键取决于当地农业系统以及农民根据预测可采取的作物管理措施。目前，评估季节性降水预测经济价值的研究几乎完全集中于季初作物播种决策，并采用非嵌入风险分析方法。然而，作物管理决策贯穿整个生长周期，从理论角度看，更现实地考虑这一点可能增加或减少季节性预测信息的经济价值。我们的模拟分析展示了如何填补这一研究空白：采用状态依存的嵌入风险方法，结合多阶段离散随机规划与高性能计算，确定整个作物生长周期中对季节性降水预测的最优作物管理响应（作物选择、播种日期、垄作、间作套种和施肥）。针对埃塞俄比亚中央裂谷地区的雨养农业，我们发现，在现实预测技能水平下，季节性预测可使风险调整后的预期现金盈余增加约2%–3%。对于一个典型的风险规避型自给农户（0.5公顷），我们计算出长期预期现金盈余按2023年价格计算增加了58美元购买力平价。季节内作物管理在预测响应中发挥着重要作用。非嵌入风险方法模拟的经济价值不超过嵌入风险方法模拟的预测经济价值的35%。

10.1111/1477-9552.70056.abstract: Submissions increased in 2025 to 386 original manuscripts, similar to levels preceding the Covid period. The Journal's acceptance rate increased from 11% to 13%, which contrasts with rates of less than 10% in the preceding few years. The Journal's Impact Factor increased from 3.4 to 4.2, which compares favourably with similar field journals. This is my final report as Editor‐in‐Chief, with Frederic Ang due to succeed me following publication of the final edition of the year, which will contain principally invited articles marking the centenary of the Agricultural Economics Society.

10.1111/1477-9552.70059.abstract: We develop a framework for regulated production systems where output generation and pollution abatement impose competing technological demands. Using a multi‐ware technology, we model the production set as the intersection of two input requirement frontiers, one for production and one for abatement, each reflecting distinct trade‐offs. We characterise the efficient set using gaps in efficiency distances and recover shadow prices for smooth and non‐smooth frontiers, clarifying how subdifferentials govern shadow prices at switching points. To address unobserved heterogeneity in technological orientation, we estimate a full‐information maximum likelihood model with endogenous regime‐switching. Applying the framework to Chinese livestock farms, we recover regime‐specific land costs, identify drivers of regime assignment and quantify inefficiency using multi‐ware distances. Results reveal sharp asymmetries in spatial burdens between production and abatement, and systematic switching behaviour driven by inputs and weather. Our framework offers a widely applicable, policy‐relevant tool for evaluating environmental and economic performance. JEL Classification: D24, Q12, Q52
10.1111/1477-9552.70059.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个受监管生产系统的分析框架，其中产出生成与污染减排对技术提出竞争性要求。通过采用多仓库技术，我们将生产集建模为两个投入需求前沿的交集——一个针对生产，另一个针对减排，各自反映不同的权衡关系。我们利用效率距离的缺口刻画有效集，并推导出光滑与非光滑前沿的影子价格，阐明次微分如何在切换点主导影子价格。为解决技术方向中未观测到的异质性，我们估计了一个包含内生机制切换的全信息最大似然模型。将该框架应用于中国畜牧养殖场，我们恢复了机制特定的土地成本，识别了机制分配的驱动因素，并利用多仓库距离量化了无效率。研究结果揭示了生产与减排之间空间负担的显著不对称性，以及由投入和天气驱动的系统性切换行为。我们的框架为评估环境与经济绩效提供了一个广泛适用且具有政策相关性的工具。JEL分类：D24, Q12, Q52
10.1111/1477-9552.70059.title: Efficiency, Shadow Pricing and Regime Switching in Multi‐Ware Technologies: Evidence From Regulated Livestock Farms
10.1111/1477-9552.70059.title_zh: 多仓库技术中的效率、影子定价与制度转换：来自受监管畜牧场的证据

10.1111/1477-9552.70060.abstract: The Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM), scheduled to become fully operational in 2026, is designed to complement the EU Emissions Trading System (ETS) by replacing free emission allowances and preventing carbon leakage to non‐EU regions. CBAM initially covers energy‐intensive sectors, including mineral nitrogen (N) fertiliser production. Although mineral N fertiliser production is already included in the EU ETS, it is currently exempt from carbon charges owing to full compensation through free allowances. The phase‐out of these allowances and the introduction of CBAM are expected to increase the prices of both imported and domestically produced fertilisers, indirectly affecting the EU agricultural sector. This study quantitatively assesses the impacts of the expected fertiliser price changes on the EU agricultural sector and related environmental outcomes using the Modular Applied GeNeral Equilibrium Tool (MAGNET) and the Common Agricultural Policy Regionalised Impact (CAPRI) model. The results indicate that the combined effect of phasing out free allowances and implementing CBAM will double mineral N fertiliser prices. Higher prices are projected to reduce demand, leading to a 21.4% decline in domestic production and a 37% reduction in imports. Overall mineral N fertiliser use in the EU is expected to decrease by 22%, partially replaced by manure. Consequently, EU agricultural factor income is projected to fall by 7.7%, primarily affecting high‐input regions. Meanwhile, non‐EU agricultural income is projected to rise slightly by 0.05%, driven by higher exports. EU agricultural greenhouse gas emissions are expected to decrease by 22 megatons of CO 2 ‐equivalent, with no significant increase globally.
10.1111/1477-9552.70060.abstract_zh: 碳边境调节机制（CBAM）计划于2026年全面实施，旨在通过取代免费排放配额并防止碳泄漏至非欧盟地区，对欧盟排放交易体系（ETS）形成补充。CBAM最初覆盖能源密集型行业，包括矿物氮肥生产。尽管矿物氮肥生产已被纳入欧盟ETS，但目前因通过免费配额获得全额补偿而免于碳成本。这些配额的逐步取消及CBAM的引入预计将推高进口和本土化肥价格，间接影响欧盟农业部门。本研究采用模块化应用一般均衡工具（MAGNET）与共同农业政策区域化影响模型（CAPRI），定量评估预期化肥价格变化对欧盟农业部门及相关环境结果的影响。结果表明，取消免费配额与实施CBAM的叠加效应将使矿物氮肥价格翻倍。价格上涨预计将抑制需求，导致本土产量下降21.4%，进口量减少37%。欧盟矿物氮肥总使用量预计下降22%，部分被粪肥替代。受此影响，欧盟农业要素收入预计下降7.7%，高投入地区受冲击最为显著。与此同时，非欧盟地区农业收入因出口增长预计小幅上升0.05%。欧盟农业温室气体排放预计减少2200万吨二氧化碳当量，且全球范围内未出现显著增长。
