10.1111/1477-9552.70061.abstract: In recent decades, soy expansion in Brazil has generated significant environmental, social and economic impacts. However, there is no consensus about benefits and drawbacks, calling for a more careful account of the economic and ecological diversity of the territories where this phenomenon has been unfolding. By acknowledging this diversity, we investigate the economic and ecological impacts of soy by applying a synthetic control method to longitudinal data (1990–2019) at state level. We focus on three indicators (GDP, CO 2 emissions and deforestation) and explore how these indicators vary in five states (Goiás, Paraná, Piauí, Rio Grande do Sul, Tocantins). These states differ in terms of underlying conditions and timing of soy expansion but have in common a significant contribution of soy to their GDP. From an environmental perspective, the states where soy consolidated its presence during the period considered (Goiás and Paraná) experienced a general improvement compared to their synthetic counterfactuals, especially in terms of deforestation, while a pioneer state in soy production such as Rio Grande do Sul saw a worsening in environmental indicators, especially right after the 2008 global financial crisis. This is also reflected in the impact of soy on GDP, which has been negative in this state, suggesting that it may have suffered from being a plantation economy, with soy subtracting resources from potentially more beneficial sectors. This geographical and temporal heterogeneity indicates that the economic and environmental impact of soy cannot be reduced to a single dominant trend. The outcome depends on the trade‐offs with other sectors, which is in turn linked to the level of economic development of the state when soy took off.
10.1111/1477-9552.70061.abstract_zh: 近几十年来，巴西的大豆扩张对环境、社会和经济产生了显著影响。然而，关于其利弊尚未形成共识，这要求我们更细致地考量该现象所涉及区域的经济与生态多样性。基于这一多样性，我们采用合成控制法对1990-2019年州级面板数据进行分析，探究大豆种植的经济与生态影响。研究聚焦三项指标（GDP、二氧化碳排放量及森林砍伐率），并考察这些指标在五个州（戈亚斯州、巴拉那州、皮奥伊州、南里奥格兰德州、托坎廷斯州）的差异。这些州的基础条件与大豆扩张时间节点各不相同，但共同特征是大豆对其GDP贡献显著。从环境视角看，研究期内大豆产业已巩固的州（戈亚斯州与巴拉那州）相较于合成对照组呈现整体改善，尤其在森林砍伐方面表现突出；而作为大豆生产先驱的南里奥格兰德州，其环境指标却出现恶化，尤其在2008年全球金融危机后更为明显。这一趋势同样反映在大豆对GDP的影响上——该州大豆对GDP的贡献为负值，表明其可能陷入种植园经济困境，大豆产业挤占了更具发展潜力的其他部门资源。这种地理与时间维度的异质性表明，大豆的经济与环境影响不能简化为单一主导趋势。最终结果取决于大豆与其他部门间的权衡关系，而这种权衡又与大豆产业兴起时各州的经济发展水平密切相关。
10.1111/1477-9552.70061.title: The Economic and Ecological Impact of Soy in Brazil: A Synthetic Control Method Approach
10.1111/1477-9552.70061.title_zh: 巴西大豆的经济与生态影响：基于合成控制法的研究

10.1111/1477-9552.70062.abstract: The UK grazing livestock sector is challenged by declining farm profitability and stringent environmental policy. Innovative technologies such as virtual fencing could enable a balanced economic and environmental performance of beef production. Virtual fencing is a livestock management tool relying on invisible boundaries perceived as auditory, electrical, or vibrational cues emitted by devices worn by grazing animals. This analysis compares virtual and conventional fencing from an economic and environmental perspective using a multi‐objective linear programming model. Optimal livestock management scenarios are identified for two typical UK cattle grazing systems. In intensive lowland beef finishing, virtual fencing achieves the lowest economic performance and a beef carbon emission intensity comparable to electric fencing. In an extensive upland suckler cow system, virtual fencing enables ecological conservation and reduces beef carbon emission intensity but increases labour input compared to set stocking. This ex‐ante assessment illustrates how precision grazing technologies can be simultaneously evaluated against economic and environmental objectives. The results indicate that, under current cost structures, virtual fencing is unlikely to be competitive with electric fencing in intensive lowland beef finishing systems, where it delivers similar environmental outcomes at higher cost. In contrast, in upland suckler cow systems, virtual fencing can support habitat protection and reduce beef carbon emission intensity but remains constrained by capital and labour costs. These findings suggest that virtual fencing is unlikely to be widely adopted on purely commercial grounds but could play a targeted role in the delivery of publicly subsidised conservation programmes such as the UK's Environmental Land Management schemes.
10.1111/1477-9552.70062.abstract_zh: 英国放牧畜牧业面临农场盈利能力下降和严格环境政策的双重挑战。虚拟围栏等创新技术有望实现牛肉生产的经济与环境绩效平衡。虚拟围栏是一种牲畜管理工具，依赖放牧动物佩戴设备发出的听觉、电击或振动信号所感知的隐形边界。本研究采用多目标线性规划模型，从经济与环境视角对比分析虚拟围栏与传统围栏。针对两种典型的英国牛群放牧系统，识别出最优的牲畜管理方案。在集约化低地肉牛育肥系统中，虚拟围栏的经济绩效最低，牛肉碳排放强度与电围栏相当。在粗放型高地哺乳母牛系统中，虚拟围栏虽能促进生态保护并降低牛肉碳排放强度，但相较于固定放牧增加了劳动力投入。这项事前评估展示了如何同时从经济与环境目标维度评价精准放牧技术。结果表明，在当前成本结构下，虚拟围栏在集约化低地肉牛育肥系统中难以与电围栏竞争——其以更高成本实现相似环境效益。相反，在高地哺乳母牛系统中，虚拟围栏可支持栖息地保护并降低牛肉碳排放强度，但仍受资本与劳动力成本制约。这些发现表明，虚拟围栏难以纯粹基于商业理由被广泛采用，但可在英国环境土地管理计划等公共补贴保护项目中发挥针对性作用。
10.1111/1477-9552.70062.title: An Economic and Environmental Analysis of Virtual Fencing for Precision Grazing
10.1111/1477-9552.70062.title_zh: 精准放牧虚拟围栏的经济与环境分析

10.1111/1477-9552.70063.abstract: Regional crop‐livestock integration can reduce dependence on external inputs and improve circularity, but its implementation requires coordination across heterogeneous farms and may generate uneven welfare losses due to technical, economic and behavioural factors, including social norms and peer effects. This study develops a landscape bio‐economic model that integrates heterogeneous farmer preferences, farm‐level constraints and social coordination via social norms and peer networks. Applied to a Dutch case study, the model identifies, from a social planner perspective, coordinated integration strategies that optimise feed and manure exchanges between arable and dairy farms. We show that optimising farm‐to‐farm integration can reduce total nitrogen import by up to 20% with limited losses of farmer welfare relative to the unconstrained welfare‐maximising solution. The model estimates farm‐specific willingness‐to‐accept imposed circularity targets, accounting for losses across economic and non‐economic utility attributes, including social norm conformity. Willingness‐to‐accept increases non‐linearly as nitrogen reduction targets become more stringent, with the burden initially borne mainly by sustainability‐oriented and dairy farms, while extending to arable and conventional farms only at very ambitious targets. We also find that stronger preferences for social norm conformity can ease trade‐offs between farmer welfare and circularity and are associated with greater reliance on local feed exchange and a reduced role for manure exchange, indicating that social influence is practice‐specific. These results motivate targeted and phased policy programmes combined with coordination incentives.
10.1111/1477-9552.70063.abstract_zh: 区域作物-畜牧一体化可减少对外部投入的依赖并提升循环性，但其实现需要协调异质性农场，并可能因技术、经济及行为因素（包括社会规范与同伴效应）导致福利损失不均。本研究构建了一个景观生物经济模型，该模型整合了异质性农户偏好、农场层面约束以及通过社会规范和同伴网络实现的社会协调。以荷兰案例为应用场景，该模型从社会规划者视角识别出协调一体化策略，优化种植农场与奶牛养殖场之间的饲料和粪肥交换。研究表明，相较于无约束的福利最大化方案，优化农场间一体化可使总氮输入减少高达20%，同时农户福利损失有限。模型估算了农场层面接受强制性循环目标所需的最低补偿意愿，涵盖经济与非经济效用属性（包括社会规范遵从性）的损失。随着氮减排目标趋严，最低补偿意愿呈非线性增长：初期负担主要由可持续导向型农场和奶牛养殖场承担，而种植农场和传统农场仅在极高目标下才被波及。研究还发现，对社会规范遵从性的更强偏好可缓解农户福利与循环性之间的权衡，并与本地饲料交换依赖度提升及粪肥交换作用减弱相关，表明社会影响具有实践特异性。这些结论为结合协调激励的定向分阶段政策方案提供了理论依据。
10.1111/1477-9552.70063.title: Planning Crop–Livestock Integration With Social Norms: A Bio‐Economic Model Balancing Circularity and Farmer Welfare
10.1111/1477-9552.70063.title_zh: 基于社会规范的种养结合规划：平衡循环性与农民福利的生物经济模型

10.1111/1477-9552.70064.abstract: Research on adoption of new practices, technologies and systems in agriculture has generated thousands of publications over the past 70 years, covering uptake of agricultural practices spanning more than 100 years. This paper contains selected key lessons from the results of this enormous research effort, drawn from numerous reviews of the literature and shaped by personal experience. The lessons include that trialling is not adoption, that extension is not necessarily the key to increasing adoption, that each new farming practice has its own adoption story, and that adoption is often slower than practice advocates expect, typically taking multiple decades. The identified lessons are juxtaposed with a number of flawed assumptions and misconceptions commonly held by people working in agricultural agencies. A number of methodological weaknesses are still common in existing studies, including neglect or poor representation of key variables, compromising the potential for the research to generate real understanding of adoption. This also inhibits comparison of studies and the application of meta‐analyses. Suggestions are made on ways to add value to the existing research and improve the quality of future research, including the collection and curation of good‐quality adoption data sets, the development of a searchable database of adoption studies, and the creation of best‐practice guidelines for the conduct of adoption research.
10.1111/1477-9552.70064.abstract_zh: 过去70年间，关于农业新实践、新技术和新系统采纳的研究已产出数千篇文献，涵盖跨越百余年的农业实践应用历程。本文从大量文献综述中提炼关键经验，并结合个人研究实践，呈现这项庞大研究工作的核心启示。这些经验包括：试验不等于采纳；技术推广并非提升采纳率的关键；每项新型农业实践都有其独特的采纳路径；采纳速度往往慢于实践倡导者的预期，通常需要数十年时间。本文将这些经验与农业机构从业者普遍存在的若干错误假设和认知误区进行对比分析。现有研究仍普遍存在方法论缺陷，包括关键变量的忽视或表征不足，这不仅削弱了研究对采纳机制的真实理解，也阻碍了跨研究比较与元分析的应用。本文提出提升现有研究价值、改进未来研究质量的建议，包括建立高质量采纳数据集并持续维护、开发可检索的采纳研究数据库，以及制定采纳研究最佳实践指南。
10.1111/1477-9552.70064.title: Reflections on Adoption of New Agricultural Practices
10.1111/1477-9552.70064.title_zh: 关于采纳新农业实践的思考

10.1111/1756-2171.70008.abstract: We propose a tractable model of asymmetric platform oligopoly with logit demand in which users from two distinct groups are subject to within‐group and cross‐group network effects and decide which platform to join. We characterize the equilibrium when platforms manage user access by setting participation fees for each user group. We explore the effects of platform entry, a change of incumbent platforms' quality under free entry, and the degree of compatibility. We show how the analysis can be extended to partial user participation.
10.1111/1756-2171.70008.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个可处理的非对称平台寡头模型，该模型采用对数需求函数，其中来自两个不同群体的用户受到组内和组间网络效应的影响，并决定加入哪个平台。我们刻画了平台通过为每个用户群体设定参与费来管理用户接入时的均衡状态。我们探讨了平台进入、自由进入条件下在位平台质量变化以及兼容性程度的影响。我们还展示了如何将分析扩展至部分用户参与的情形。
10.1111/1756-2171.70008.title: Asymmetric Platform Oligopoly

10.1111/1756-2171.70056.abstract: This article studies entry preemption in new industries. We first test a key prediction of dynamic entry games: Entry preemption is most relevant in intermediate‐sized markets, where firms face highest uncertainty about future entry. Using US drive‐in theater market (1945–1957) data, we find robust evidence for this non‐monotonic relationship between market size and early entry probability. We then estimate a dynamic entry game, and quantify preemption effects through counterfactual analysis. Preemptive motives increase early entry by up to 40% in mid‐size markets, raising entry costs by 5% and reducing firms' expected value by 1%.
10.1111/1756-2171.70056.abstract_zh: 本文研究新产业中的进入抢占行为。我们首先检验动态进入博弈的一个关键预测：进入抢占在中等规模市场中最为显著，因为此时企业面临最大的未来进入不确定性。利用美国汽车影院市场（1945-1957年）的数据，我们发现了市场规模与早期进入概率之间呈非单调关系的稳健证据。随后，我们估计了一个动态进入博弈模型，并通过反事实分析量化了抢占效应。在中等规模市场中，抢占动机使早期进入率最高增加40%，导致进入成本上升5%，并使企业预期价值降低1%。
10.1111/1756-2171.70056.title: Preemptive Entry and Technology Diffusion: The Market for Drive‐In Theaters
10.1111/1756-2171.70056.title_zh: 先发进入与技术扩散：汽车影院市场

10.1111/1756-2171.70057.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We study the optimal design of a monopoly platform that interacts with heterogeneous firms and consumers who face uncertainty about product values and prices. Consumers search randomly among firms recommended by the platform. The platform designs a menu of contracts tailored to different firm types and allocates consumer visits across these firms. We show that the optimal platform design creates a “superstar effect,” whereby high‐type firms capture a disproportionately large market share, and improves consumer welfare relative to the no‐design benchmark.</jats:p>
10.1111/1756-2171.70057.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个垄断平台的最优设计问题，该平台与异质性企业以及面临产品价值和价格不确定性的消费者进行互动。消费者在平台推荐的企业中进行随机搜索。平台针对不同类型的企业设计了一套定制化合同菜单，并将消费者访问量分配给这些企业。研究表明，最优平台设计会产生“超级明星效应”，即高类型企业获得不成比例的巨大市场份额，并且与无设计基准相比，该设计能够改善消费者福利。
10.1111/1756-2171.70057.title: Consumer Search, Firm Heterogeneity, and Platform Design
10.1111/1756-2171.70057.title_zh: 消费者搜索、企业异质性与平台设计

10.1111/1756-2171.70058.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This article studies price discrimination by a seller who uses data on observables that buyers can control (or manipulate) at a cost. If the seller's discriminatory prices are offered covertly, equilibrium market segmentation is always coarse, resulting in limited price discrimination. In contrast, if prices must be transparently posted, every buyer pays a personalized price in equilibrium, though this does not always reduce buyer or social welfare. The analysis sheds new light on calls for transparency in how sellers utilize consumer data to customize prices and highlights potential issues with assessing welfare using (only) observed prices, pricing conduct, and market coverage.</jats:p>
10.1111/1756-2171.70058.abstract_zh: 本文研究卖方利用买方可以控制（或操纵）的可观测数据进行价格歧视的行为。若卖方的歧视性定价以隐蔽方式提供，均衡市场分割始终较为粗糙，导致有限的价格歧视。相反，若价格必须透明公示，则均衡状态下每位买方均需支付个性化价格，但这并不总能降低买方福利或社会福利。该分析为要求卖方透明化利用消费者数据定制价格的呼声提供了新视角，并揭示了仅依据观测价格、定价行为及市场覆盖率评估福利时可能存在的问题。
10.1111/1756-2171.70058.title: Price Discrimination With Manipulable Observables
10.1111/1756-2171.70058.title_zh: 可操纵观测值下的价格歧视

10.1111/1756-2171.70059.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This article provides a full characterization of the competitive effects of horizontal mergers in the Cournot model with heterogeneous firms and constant marginal costs. We show that price effects depend only on the smaller merging firm's market share and the number of firms but are independent of the distribution of market shares among other firms. Standard concentration measures, instead, are often misleading. We also provide simple—yet general—closed‐form solutions for merger effects based on pre‐merger parameters. Moreover, we extend the model to study the combination of output and input market power and relate our results to the Merger Guidelines.</jats:p>
10.1111/1756-2171.70059.abstract_zh: 本文全面刻画了异质性企业且边际成本恒定条件下古诺模型中横向合并的竞争效应。研究表明，价格效应仅取决于规模较小合并企业的市场份额及企业数量，而与其他企业的市场份额分布无关。相比之下，标准集中度指标往往具有误导性。我们基于合并前参数，为合并效应提供了简洁而通用的闭式解。此外，我们将模型拓展至产出市场与投入市场势力的联合分析，并将研究结论与《合并指南》相关联。
10.1111/1756-2171.70059.title: The Competitive Effects of Mergers with Cournot Competition
10.1111/1756-2171.70059.title_zh: 古诺竞争下并购的竞争效应

10.1111/1756-2171.70060.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We study the market effects of sponsored search auctions for advertising space on searches for brands. In our model,  firms simultaneously choose the price of their product and the bids for the advertising auctions triggered by their own and rivals' brand keywords search. In any symmetric equilibrium, each firm wins its own keyword auction, and relative to a no‐ads benchmark, online advertising raises the winning brand's marginal cost and ultimately market prices. Only in an environment with strong initial asymmetries do we find that brand advertising might be beneficial.</jats:p>
10.1111/1756-2171.70060.abstract_zh: 我们研究了品牌搜索中赞助搜索广告拍卖的市场效应。在模型中，企业同时选择产品价格以及针对自身和竞争对手品牌关键词搜索触发的广告拍卖出价。在任何对称均衡中，每家企业都能赢得自身关键词拍卖；与无广告基准相比，在线广告提高了获胜品牌的边际成本，并最终推高了市场价格。仅在初始不对称性较强的环境中，我们才发现品牌广告可能是有益的。
10.1111/1756-2171.70060.title: Market Effects of Brand Search Advertising
10.1111/1756-2171.70060.title_zh: 品牌搜索广告的市场效应

10.1111/1756-2171.70061.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We study oligopolistic competition by firms practicing second‐degree price discrimination. In line with the literature on demand estimation, our theory allows consumers' propensity to switch brands to vary with tastes for product quality. If low‐type consumers are sufficiently more (respectively, less) prone to switch brands than are high types, (i) quality provision is inefficiently low at the bottom (respectively, high at the top) of the product line, and (ii) informational rents are positive (respectively, negative) for high types and negative (respectively, positive) for low types. Interestingly, we show that an increase in the number of competing firms may decrease welfare (by tightening incentive constraints), so much so that monopoly may be welfare superior to oligopoly. Pure‐strategy equilibria fail to exist, resulting in price‐quality dispersion across firms, whenever the propensity to switch brands is sufficiently different across consumers types.</jats:p>
10.1111/1756-2171.70061.abstract_zh: 我们研究了实施二级价格歧视的企业在寡头竞争中的行为。与需求估计文献一致，我们的理论允许消费者转换品牌的倾向随其对产品质量的偏好而变化。若低类型消费者比高类型消费者更易（或更不易）转换品牌，则：（i）产品线底端（或顶端）的质量供给将出现低效不足（或过高）；（ii）高类型消费者获得正（或负）信息租金，而低类型消费者获得负（或正）信息租金。有趣的是，我们发现竞争企业数量的增加可能降低社会福利（通过强化激励约束），以至于垄断可能比寡头更有利于社会福利。当不同消费者类型的品牌转换倾向差异足够大时，纯策略均衡将不存在，导致企业间出现价格-质量离散现象。
10.1111/1756-2171.70061.title: Nonlinear Pricing in Oligopoly: How Brand Preferences Shape Market Outcomes
10.1111/1756-2171.70061.title_zh: 寡头市场中的非线性定价：品牌偏好如何塑造市场结果

10.1111/1756-2171.70062.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We adopt a dynamic mechanism design approach to study how a revenue‐maximizing seller should sell an indivisible object when a buyer with a private value can search for an outside option with continuous‐intensity choices. We find that lowering the buyer's search cost definitely reduces the seller's revenue when the buyer's search decision is binary, as in Armstrong and Zhou (2016). In contrast, with continuous search intensity, a counterintuitive effect may arise: lowering the buyer's search cost function can, under mild conditions, actually increase the seller's revenue.</jats:p>
10.1111/1756-2171.70062.abstract_zh: 我们采用动态机制设计方法，研究当具有私人价值的买方能够通过连续强度选择搜索外部选项时，追求收益最大化的卖方应如何销售不可分割商品。研究发现，当买方搜索决策为二元选择时（如Armstrong与Zhou 2016年所述），降低买方搜索成本必然减少卖方收益。然而在连续搜索强度下，可能产生反直觉效应：在温和条件下，降低买方搜索成本函数反而可能增加卖方收益。
10.1111/1756-2171.70062.title: Buyer's Hidden Search With Continuous Intensity: The Seller‐Optimal Mechanism and a Perverse Effect
10.1111/1756-2171.70062.title_zh: 连续强度下买方的隐藏搜索：卖方最优机制与一种反常效应

10.1111/1756-2171.70063.abstract: Unobserved objective output quality complicates the analysis of firm productivity and demand because higher‐quality products entail higher costs but offer greater consumption benefits. Using a panel of firms with output quality data, we decompose quantity‐based productivity into fundamental productivity and the costs of quality, and separate the demand residual into fundamental demand and quality benefits. Fundamental demand accounts for most revenue variation, whereas quality's revenue‐enhancing benefits are largely offset by its costs. During the 2008 global financial crisis, shifts in quality diverged from changes in fundamental productivity and demand, highlighting the role of quality in assessing firm and industry performance.
10.1111/1756-2171.70063.abstract_zh: 未观测到的客观产出质量使企业生产率与需求分析复杂化，因为更高质量的产品虽带来更高成本，却提供更大的消费效用。基于包含产出质量数据的企业面板数据，我们将基于数量的生产率分解为基础生产率与质量成本，并将需求残差分离为基础需求与质量收益。基础需求解释了大部分收入变动，而质量带来的收入提升效应在很大程度上被其成本所抵消。在2008年全球金融危机期间，质量变动与基础生产率及需求变化呈现分化态势，凸显了质量在评估企业与行业绩效中的关键作用。
10.1111/1756-2171.70063.title: Output Quality, Productivity, and Demand: Evidence from the Chinese Steel Industry
10.1111/1756-2171.70063.title_zh: 产出质量、生产率与需求：来自中国钢铁行业的证据

10.1111/1756-2171.70064.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>The energy transition from coal to gas is reshaping the power sector to rely more on gas generation, which is cleaner but has more variable input costs. Using counterfactual analysis, I study the competitive effects of this transition, by considering several transition paths that differ in the types of firms involved in retiring coal plants and investing in gas plants. I show that the variable nature of the marginal cost of gas generation creates an environment in which market power could increase after the transition. However, the transition's impact on competition depends on the characteristics of the firms investing in new gas generation; the adverse impact is mitigated under a well‐planned transition that leads to a more competitive industry structure.</jats:p>
10.1111/1756-2171.70064.abstract_zh:
<jats:title>摘要</jats:title>
<jats:p>从煤炭向天然气的能源转型正重塑电力行业，使其更加依赖天然气发电——这种发电方式更清洁，但投入成本波动性更大。通过反事实分析，本文研究了这一转型的竞争效应，考虑了若干种不同的转型路径，这些路径在参与退役燃煤电厂和投资天然气电厂的企业类型上存在差异。研究表明，天然气发电边际成本的波动性特征创造了一种环境，使得转型后市场势力可能增强。然而，转型对竞争的影响取决于投资新建天然气发电企业的特征；在精心规划的转型路径下，这种不利影响会得到缓解，从而形成更具竞争性的行业结构。</jats:p>
10.1111/1756-2171.70064.title: Cleaner but Volatile Energy? The Effect of Coal Plant Retirement on Market Competition in the Wholesale Electricity Market
10.1111/1756-2171.70064.title_zh: 更清洁但更不稳定的能源？煤电厂退役对电力批发市场竞争的影响

10.1111/1756-2171.70067.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We study a two‐period learning model where a sequentially rational regulator builds a reputation for strict enforcement and self‐interested firms test the regulator's enforcement propensity through their misconduct. In the transparent setting, where misconduct and enforcement are observable between the firms, the regulator's reputation concern endogenously creates positive or negative enforcement externalities between the firms. When the reputation concern is strong, the enforcement externalities are negative and dominate the information externalities, encouraging misconduct. Otherwise, both externalities are positive and deter misconduct. Although a strong reputation always benefits the regulator in the opaque setting, it often backfires in a transparent setting.</jats:p>
10.1111/1756-2171.70067.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个两期学习模型，其中具有序贯理性特征的监管者致力于建立严格执法的声誉，而自利的企业则通过其不当行为来试探监管者的执法倾向。在透明环境下（企业间可观察到不当行为与执法行为），监管者的声誉关切会内生地在企业间产生正向或负向的执法外部性。当声誉关切较强时，执法外部性为负向且主导信息外部性，从而助长不当行为；反之，两种外部性均为正向，能够抑制不当行为。尽管在非透明环境下，强大的声誉始终有利于监管者，但在透明环境下，这种声誉往往会产生适得其反的效果。
10.1111/1756-2171.70067.title: Peer Learning, Enforcement, and Reputation

10.1111/1756-2171.70068.abstract: ABSTRACT Firms in decentralized markets often trade using quantity contracts, agreements specifying quantity prior to the point of sale. These contracts are valuable because they provide quantity assurance, as trading frictions could prevent a buyer and seller from matching in the spot market. However, quantity contracts prevent sellers from optimally allocating production across buyers after market conditions realize. Using proprietary invoice data, we estimate a model of quantity contracts in the pulp and paper industry. The average value of a quantity contract is 10% of profits, but would be 55% larger if sellers could optimally allocate production after market conditions realize.
10.1111/1756-2171.70068.abstract_zh: 摘要 在分散市场中，企业常采用数量合同进行交易，即在销售前约定具体数量的协议。此类合同因能提供数量保障而具有价值——交易摩擦可能导致买卖双方在现货市场中无法匹配。然而，数量合同会阻碍卖方在市场条件实现后，将生产在买方之间进行最优配置。我们利用专有发票数据，对纸浆与造纸行业中的数量合同模型进行了估计。数量合同的平均价值相当于利润的10%，但若卖方能在市场条件实现后实现生产的最优配置，该价值将提升55%。
10.1111/1756-2171.70068.title: Pulp Friction: The Value of Quantity Contracts in Decentralized Markets
10.1111/1756-2171.70068.title_zh: 纸浆摩擦：分散市场中数量合约的价值

10.1111/1756-2171.70069.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>In this article, we examine the importance of individual physicians in explaining the significant variation in prescription drug spending in Medicare Part D. By tracking prescribing behavior before and after physician relocations, we find that movers' prescribing converges toward the average of their new location. However, this convergence is far from complete, highlighting the importance of idiosyncratic physician‐specific factors. Overall, these physician‐specific factors explain about 60 to 70 percent of the cross‐sectional variation in prescription drug spending, suggesting that physicians are one of the most important supply‐side determinants of this variation. We investigate several potential mechanisms behind this partial convergence.</jats:p>
10.1111/1756-2171.70069.abstract_zh: 摘要：本文探讨了在医疗保险D部分处方药支出显著差异中，个体医生的重要性。通过追踪医生迁移前后的处方行为，我们发现迁移者的处方模式会逐渐趋近于新地区的平均水平。然而，这种趋同远未完全实现，凸显了医生个体特有因素的关键作用。总体而言，这些医生特有因素解释了处方药支出横截面差异的60%至70%，表明医生是导致这种差异的最重要供给侧决定因素之一。我们进一步研究了这种部分趋同背后的若干潜在机制。
10.1111/1756-2171.70069.title: What Causes Geographic Variation in Drug Prescribing? Evidence from Physician Migration
10.1111/1756-2171.70069.title_zh: 医生迁移视角下药品处方地理差异的成因分析

10.1111/1756-2171.70070.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>In the presence of adverse selection, mergers can increase welfare through a reduction in inefficient sorting. I characterize the sorting externality internalized between merging firms in a tractable discrete choice model. Mergers benefit consumers when the firms are small, willingness to pay is moderately increasing in cost, and consumer costs are skewed. Applying the model to the non‐group health insurance market, 13% of potential mergers would improve consumer surplus. In markets where the sorting distortion exceeds $5 per person, nearly one‐third of mergers improve consumer surplus, highlighting the importance of considering adverse selection in merger evaluation.</jats:p>
10.1111/1756-2171.70070.abstract_zh: 在逆向选择存在的情况下，并购可以通过减少低效分类来提高福利。我在一个易于处理的离散选择模型中刻画了并购企业之间内部化的分类外部性。当企业规模较小、支付意愿随成本适度递增且消费者成本呈偏态分布时，并购对消费者有利。将该模型应用于非团体健康保险市场，13%的潜在并购将改善消费者剩余。在分类扭曲超过每人5美元的市场中，近三分之一的并购会提升消费者剩余，这凸显了在并购评估中考虑逆向选择的重要性。
10.1111/1756-2171.70070.title: Mergers in the Presence of Adverse Selection
10.1111/1756-2171.70070.title_zh: 逆向选择下的企业并购

10.1111/1756-2171.70071.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>A coarse certification provides simple but incomplete information. Its rationale is to help consumers trade off dimensions of quality that are complex and lack salience. In imperfectly competitive markets, it may induce excess bunching at the certification requirement, crowd out quality, and facilitate price discrimination. Who will ultimately benefit from a coarse certification thus depends on the degree of market power firms can exercise as well as on consumers' sophistication in responding to such information. I use a structural econometric model of the U.S. appliance market to illustrate these insights using the ENERGY STAR certification as a case study.</jats:p>
10.1111/1756-2171.70071.abstract_zh: 粗放型认证提供简单但不完整的信息。其基本原理是帮助消费者权衡复杂且缺乏显著性的质量维度。在不完全竞争市场中，这种认证可能导致企业在认证要求处过度聚集、挤占质量提升空间，并促进价格歧视。因此，粗放型认证的最终受益者取决于企业能够行使的市场势力程度，以及消费者对此类信息的反应成熟度。本文以能源之星认证为案例，运用美国家电市场的结构计量经济学模型来阐释上述见解。
10.1111/1756-2171.70071.title: The Incidence of Coarse Certification: Evidence From the ENERGY STAR Program
10.1111/1756-2171.70071.title_zh: 粗略认证的影响：来自能源之星计划的证据

10.1111/1756-2171.70073.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This article examines the welfare consequences of a trade association in an exporting country on consumers in destination countries. We estimate a structural model of the Chilean Salmon exporting industry that endogenizes firms' pricing and export decisions. Our results show that the trade association has a positive effect on consumer utility and involves higher marginal costs of production, consistent with higher quality products. Reduced form analysis estimates price effects associated with trade association membership of 3 to 8 percent. Our counterfactual analysis reveals that eliminating the trade association would reduce consumer welfare by 1.7 billion USD in destination countries.</jats:p>
10.1111/1756-2171.70073.abstract_zh: 本文研究了出口国行业协会对目的地国家消费者的福利影响。我们构建了智利鲑鱼出口行业的结构模型，将企业的定价与出口决策内生化。研究结果表明，该行业协会对消费者效用具有正向影响，同时伴随着更高的边际生产成本，这与产品质量提升的结论一致。简化形式分析估计，行业协会成员身份带来的价格效应为3%至8%。反事实分析显示，若取消该行业协会，目的地国家的消费者福利将减少17亿美元。
10.1111/1756-2171.70073.title: Welfare Effects of Trade Associations: The Case of the Chilean Salmon Export Industry
10.1111/1756-2171.70073.title_zh: 贸易协会的福利效应：智利鲑鱼出口行业的案例

10.1111/agec.70115.abstract: In sub‐Saharan Africa, agriculture is vital; however, the systematic exclusion of persons with disabilities from farming hinders sustainable development and social equity. Although several studies have analyzed productivity differentials across various dimensions of social exclusion, empirical evidence on technology access, farming efficiency, and productivity gaps among farmers with disabilities remains limited. This study addresses this gap by evaluating disparities in crop production between farmers with and without disabilities in Ghana, with a particular focus on differences in technology endowment and production efficiency. Utilizing the meta‐stochastic frontier analysis coupled with statistical matching techniques on nationally representative farm‐level data from the 2012/13 and 2016/17 agricultural seasons, we find negligible differences in technical efficiency between the two groups (less than 0.5%). However, the productive capacity of the technology sets employed by farmers with disabilities is approximately 11%‐point lower than that of their counterparts without disability, resulting in a 9.5%‐point shortfall in crop production. This production shortfall is primarily driven by reduced per‐hectare use of critical inputs such as planting materials, labor, fertilizer, and agro‐chemicals. These findings highlight a significant disability‐associated technology access gap that reflects broader structural inequalities. Addressing these disparities is essential for promoting equitable agricultural development while harnessing the full potential of all farmers in Ghana.
10.1111/agec.70115.abstract_zh: 在撒哈拉以南非洲，农业至关重要；然而，残疾人被系统性地排斥在农业生产之外，阻碍了可持续发展与社会公平。尽管已有研究分析了社会排斥不同维度下的生产率差异，但关于残疾农民在技术获取、耕作效率及生产率差距方面的实证证据仍然有限。本研究通过评估加纳残疾与非残疾农民在作物生产中的差异，特别是技术禀赋与生产效率的差异，填补了这一空白。基于2012/13和2016/17农业季全国代表性农户层面数据，采用元随机前沿分析结合统计匹配技术，我们发现两组农民的技术效率差异微乎其微（低于0.5%）。然而，残疾农民所采用技术集的生产能力比非残疾农民低约11个百分点，导致作物产量减少9.5个百分点。这一产量缺口主要源于种植材料、劳动力、化肥及农用化学品等关键投入要素的每公顷使用量减少。这些发现揭示了与残疾相关的显著技术获取差距，反映了更广泛的结构性不平等。解决这些差距对于促进公平的农业发展、同时充分发挥加纳所有农民的潜力至关重要。
10.1111/agec.70115.title: Production Gaps Among Farmers With Disabilities Are Associated With Limited Technology
10.1111/agec.70115.title_zh: 残疾农民的生产差距与有限技术相关

10.1111/agec.70116.abstract: Price volatility in agricultural markets directly affects the financial viability of rural producers, particularly in sectors characterized by narrow profit margins and long production cycles, such as beef cattle production. Futures contracts and agricultural insurance are commonly used to mitigate this risk; however, both instruments are exposed to basis risk, which arises from the divergences between futures and spot prices. This article has two objectives: to estimate the basis risk of futures contracts for fed cattle, feeder cattle, and corn, and to assess the basis risk associated with designing a gross margin insurance product adapted to the Brazilian context. The results show that basis risk for fed cattle and corn contracts was lower in São Paulo (7.51% and 4.85%, respectively) than in Mato Grosso do Sul (11.34% and 5.79%). Using state‐level prices as a proxy for feeder cattle futures reduced basis risk in both states, although the São Paulo proxy exhibited higher relative basis risk. The basis risk of the gross margin insurance product was estimated at 31.23% in São Paulo and 32.39% in Mato Grosso do Sul. These findings indicate that incorporating regional price differentials into margin insurance valuation is an effective policy strategy to reduce basis risk, allowing insured margins to better reflect local market conditions without introducing new futures contracts.
10.1111/agec.70116.abstract_zh: 农产品市场价格波动直接影响农村生产者的财务可持续性，尤其在利润率低、生产周期长的行业（如肉牛养殖）中表现显著。期货合约和农业保险常被用于缓解此类风险，但两者均面临基差风险——即期货价格与现货价格之间的偏差。本文旨在实现两个目标：估算育肥牛、架子牛和玉米期货合约的基差风险，并评估适用于巴西背景的总利润保险产品设计中的基差风险。结果表明，圣保罗州育肥牛和玉米期货合约的基差风险（分别为7.51%和4.85%）低于南马托格罗索州（分别为11.34%和5.79%）。以州级价格作为架子牛期货的代理变量降低了两个州的基差风险，但圣保罗州的代理变量表现出更高的相对基差风险。总利润保险产品的基差风险在圣保罗州为31.23%，在南马托格罗索州为32.39%。这些发现表明，将区域价格差异纳入利润保险估值是降低基差风险的有效政策策略，可在不引入新期货合约的情况下，使保险利润更准确地反映当地市场条件。
10.1111/agec.70116.title: Assessing Basis Risk in Margin Insurance for Beef Cattle Farming in Brazil
10.1111/agec.70116.title_zh: 评估巴西肉牛养殖利润保险中的基差风险

10.1111/agec.70117.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    Cocoa production forms the backbone of West Africa's agricultural economy, sustaining smallholder farmers whose livelihoods depend on stable yields. Critical to these yields is the provision of pollination services by a few key species, notably, the minuscule
                    <jats:italic>Forcipomyia</jats:italic>
                    spp. While many studies have modeled the effects of complete pollinator collapse, the impacts of gradual declines remain little studied. In this study, we develop an integrated ecological–economic model that links pollinator abundance with cocoa yield, incorporating the global cocoa market and an economy‐wide framework for Ghana, one of the world's major cocoa producers. We examine scenarios in which declines in pollinator populations occur at regional, national, and supranational scales. Our analysis reveals that localized declines in pollinator populations detrimentally affect cocoa farmers and Ghana's national economy, with rural communities and low‐income households bearing a disproportionate share of the welfare losses. In contrast, widespread declines across West Africa trigger a “King effect” where rising global cocoa prices partially mitigate production losses, benefiting farmers while overall consumer surplus declines. These results highlight the necessity of conserving pollinator biodiversity to safeguard cocoa production and economic welfare at multiple scales.
                  </jats:p>
10.1111/agec.70117.abstract_zh: 可可生产是西非农业经济的支柱，维系着依赖稳定产量维持生计的小农户。对产量至关重要的因素是少数关键物种提供的授粉服务，尤其是微小的蠓属（*Forcipomyia* spp.）。尽管许多研究模拟了完全授粉者崩溃的影响，但逐渐减少的影响仍鲜有研究。本研究构建了一个整合生态经济模型，将授粉者丰度与可可产量联系起来，并纳入全球可可市场以及加纳（全球主要可可生产国之一）的经济整体框架。我们考察了授粉者种群在区域、国家和超国家尺度上下降的情景。分析表明，授粉者种群的局部下降对可可农户和加纳国民经济产生不利影响，农村社区和低收入家庭承担了不成比例的福利损失。相比之下，西非地区广泛授粉者下降会触发“国王效应”，即全球可可价格上涨部分抵消了产量损失，使农户受益，而整体消费者剩余下降。这些结果凸显了保护授粉者生物多样性对于在多尺度上保障可可生产和经济福利的必要性。
10.1111/agec.70117.title: Small Midges, Major Consequences: Partial Declines in Cocoa Pollination and Their Economic Impact in West Africa and Beyond
10.1111/agec.70117.title_zh: 小蠓虫，大影响：西非及以外地区可可授粉的部分衰退及其经济后果

10.1111/agec.70119.abstract: About one‐quarter of the global population, that is, approximately 1.8 billion people, with 90% in low‐ and middle‐income countries, face substantial weather‐related risks. This paper studies how weather shocks are associated with crop diversification and household food security in Nigeria, with a focus on gendered plot management. We merge historical climate data with the World Bank's Living Standards Measurement Study—Integrated Surveys on Agriculture (LSMS‐ISA) to construct rainfall anomaly (z‐score) and temperature extreme (Killing Degree Days, KDD) measures, household crop diversification, and household food security indicators. Using a Two‐Way Fixed Effects (TWFE) model, we find that both rainfall shocks and extreme temperatures are negatively associated with household dietary diversity, but the relationship is mixed for other food security outcomes. Crop diversification is positively associated with food security under high temperature exposure, but the relationship is mixed under rainfall anomalies. The gender composition of household plot managers does not show a statistically robust moderating role in the aggregate; however, gender differences emerge at certain thresholds of weather exposure. The results highlight the heterogeneity in the crop diversification—food security relationship across weather dimensions.
10.1111/agec.70119.abstract_zh: 全球约四分之一人口（约18亿人）面临重大气候相关风险，其中90%生活在低收入和中等收入国家。本文以尼日利亚为研究对象，聚焦地块管理的性别差异，探讨天气冲击与作物多样化及家庭粮食安全之间的关联。我们将历史气候数据与世界银行生活标准测量研究——农业综合调查（LSMS-ISA）相结合，构建了降雨异常（z-score）和极端温度（致死度日，KDD）指标，以及家庭作物多样化和粮食安全指标。采用双向固定效应（TWFE）模型研究发现，降雨冲击和极端温度均与家庭膳食多样性呈负相关，但与其他粮食安全指标的关系则呈现混合特征。在高温暴露条件下，作物多样化与粮食安全呈正相关，但在降雨异常情境下两者关系复杂。从总体来看，家庭地块管理者的性别构成并未表现出统计上稳健的调节作用；然而，在特定天气暴露阈值下，性别差异开始显现。研究结果揭示了作物多样化与粮食安全关系在不同天气维度上的异质性。
10.1111/agec.70119.title: Heterogeneous Effects of Weather Shocks and Crop Diversification on Household Food Security. A Gender Dimension
10.1111/agec.70119.title_zh: 天气冲击与作物多样化对家庭粮食安全的异质性影响：性别维度

10.1111/agec.70120.abstract: This study reassesses the impact of the historical BSE outbreak on EU diets, showing that consumption patterns shifted persistently even after policy actions eliminated the food safety risk. Utilizing advanced difference‐in‐differences techniques on 1980–2020 data, we demonstrate that while beef consumption exhibited a transient U‐shaped recovery relative to other meats, it declined sharply compared to plant‐based products, with average reductions of 79%, 29%, and 28% for pulses, cereals, and vegetable oils, respectively. This highlights a structural dietary change, overlooked by previous analyses focused on meat substitution. Results are robust to sensitivity analyses. Understanding the primary drivers behind the structural shift in EU consumer diets over recent decades is crucial for future research investigating the reduction in red meat consumption driven by environmental and health concerns in high‐income countries.
10.1111/agec.70120.abstract_zh: 本研究重新评估了历史上疯牛病疫情对欧盟饮食结构的影响，结果表明即使在政策行动消除食品安全风险后，消费模式仍发生了持续性转变。基于1980-2020年数据，采用先进的双重差分技术，我们发现：牛肉消费相对于其他肉类呈现短暂的U型恢复，但相较于植物性产品则显著下降——豆类、谷物和植物油的消费量平均分别减少79%、29%和28%。这揭示了以往聚焦肉类替代效应的研究所忽视的结构性饮食变迁。敏感性分析证实了结果的稳健性。理解近几十年来欧盟消费者饮食结构变迁的主要驱动力，对于未来研究高收入国家因环境和健康担忧导致红肉消费减少的课题具有关键意义。
10.1111/agec.70120.title: From Meat to Plant‐Based Products? The Enduring Impact of BSE on Beef Consumption
10.1111/agec.70120.title_zh: 从肉类到植物基产品？疯牛病对牛肉消费的持久影响

10.1111/agec.70122.abstract: Despite significant policy interventions and conservation initiatives, incentives for the conservation of biodiversity have been criticised for being ecologically ineffective and economically inefficient. This paper examines a novel approach to improve the ecological and economic performance of such incentives. Specifically, we analyse the ecological and economic effectiveness of a targeting bonus which establishes a two‐part subsidy for changes to land management when the ecological benefits of such changes vary spatially. Using a spatially explicit mathematical programming model applied to an empirical case study in the UK, we show that a targeting bonus has the potential to enhance efficiency, with the magnitude of gains depending on the strength of the spatial correlation between opportunity costs and ecological benefits, as well as the size of the budget and the definition of the targeting zone. We find that the targeting bonus offers major advantages when the most ecologically beneficial land parcels are positively correlated with highest opportunity costs for farmers; and that the additional benefits of the targeting bonus relative to a no‐bonus subsidy scheme eventually decline as the share of the bonus is increased.
10.1111/agec.70122.abstract_zh: 尽管已有显著的政策干预和保护举措，生物多样性保护激励措施仍因生态效果不佳和经济效率低下而受到批评。本文研究了一种提升此类激励措施生态与经济绩效的新方法。具体而言，我们分析了定向奖励金的生态与经济有效性——当土地管理变更的生态效益存在空间差异时，该机制通过建立两部分补贴来应对这种变化。通过将空间显式数学规划模型应用于英国实证案例研究，我们发现定向奖励金具有提升效率的潜力，其收益幅度取决于机会成本与生态效益之间的空间相关性强度、预算规模以及定向区域的界定方式。研究结果表明：当生态效益最高的地块与农民机会成本最高的地块呈正相关时，定向奖励金具有显著优势；随着奖励金占比提高，相较于无奖励金补贴方案，定向奖励金的额外收益最终会递减。
10.1111/agec.70122.title: A Targeting Bonus for More Effective Agri‐Environmental Policy
10.1111/agec.70122.title_zh: 更有效的农业环境政策的定向奖励

10.1111/agec.70123.abstract: In real estate markets featuring substantial search friction and strong seller loss aversion, external shocks that shift buyer valuations are largely reflected in liquidity fluctuations, while price adjustments tend to be rigid. This study examines market liquidity shifts following the tightening of South Korean farmland ownership regulations, utilizing the 2021 Farmland Act amendment and nationwide parcel‐level transaction data (2013−2023). We estimate the relationships between land liquidity, policy change, and key macro variables (i.e. interest rates) using a monthly county fixed‐effects model. We find that the amendment is significantly associated with a 10%−11% reduction in nationwide market liquidity, as measured by the turnover rate. This negative relationship is geographically heterogeneous, being more pronounced in rural areas while statistically insignificant in investment‐driven urban areas. Furthermore, our decomposition analysis reveals that the post‐enforcement drop in observed market liquidity is mostly associated with rising interest rates. The role of interest rates is more dominant in urbanized areas than rural ones, reflecting the higher concentration of investment‐driven buyers and substantial capital requirements for land acquisition in these regions. Our findings demonstrate that the market response to ownership regulation is strongly mediated by local market conditions, highlighting the challenges of enforcing stringent policies in areas with high investment potential.
10.1111/agec.70123.abstract_zh: 在具有显著搜索摩擦和强烈卖方损失厌恶特征的房地产市场中，改变买方估值的外部冲击主要反映在流动性波动上，而价格调整往往呈现刚性。本研究利用2021年《农地法》修正案及2013-2023年全国地块层面交易数据，考察韩国农地所有权监管收紧后的市场流动性变化。我们采用月度县级固定效应模型，估计土地流动性、政策变化与关键宏观变量（如利率）之间的关系。研究发现，该修正案与全国市场流动性（以周转率衡量）显著下降10%-11%相关。这种负向关系存在地理异质性：在农村地区更为显著，而在投资驱动的城市地区统计上不显著。此外，分解分析表明，政策实施后观察到的市场流动性下降主要与利率上升相关。利率在城市化地区的作用比农村地区更为突出，这反映了这些地区投资驱动型买家的高度集中以及土地收购所需的大量资本。我们的研究结果表明，市场对所有权监管的反应受到当地市场条件的强烈调节，凸显了在高投资潜力地区实施严格政策的挑战。
10.1111/agec.70123.title: Farmland Liquidity Under a Tightened Ownership Regime: Urban–Rural Heterogeneity in South Korea
10.1111/agec.70123.title_zh: 收紧所有权制度下的农地流动性：韩国的城乡异质性

10.1111/agec.70124.abstract: Understanding risk attitudes is critical for agricultural development, as risk is ubiquitous in the lives of smallholder farmers. Accurate elicitation of risk attitudes is essential to analyze patterns and biases in decision‐making. Ensuring comprehension and attention in risk elicitation tasks is particularly important, as inattentiveness generates noise rather than reliable results. Achieving this remains challenging, especially among smallholder farmers in the Global South, since many sophisticated risk elicitation methods require numerical skills that rural populations often lack due to limited education. To contribute to addressing this problem, we isolate the effects of illustration and gamification in risk elicitation tasks‐two elements that may increase attention and engagement, potentially producing lower inconsistencies and more reliable results. We empirically test the Wheel ‐task, an elicitation method designed to be easy to understand and engaging, to motivate participation. The task follows a wheel‐of‐fortune model, where a spin determines the payout, while participants can always choose between spinning the wheel and a safe payout. We compare the Wheel ‐task results to the well‐established Holt and Laury task (HL‐task) in its original form, as well as with probabilities illustrated using the wheel. We collected the data among smallholder coffee farmers from rural Colombia and Peru and in a pilot phase among smallholder farmers from rural Cambodia. We find low levels of comprehension across all three tasks. More specifically, we find no substantial difference in comprehension or levels of risk aversion when illustrating the probabilities in the HL‐task using a wheel. However, gamification affects levels of risk aversion, although these effects appear to be culturally dependent.
10.1111/agec.70124.abstract_zh: 理解风险态度对农业发展至关重要，因为风险在小农户生活中无处不在。准确获取风险态度对于分析决策中的模式与偏差不可或缺。确保风险诱导任务中的理解力与注意力尤为重要，因为注意力不集中会产生噪音而非可靠结果。实现这一目标仍具挑战性，尤其是在全球南方的小农户群体中——许多复杂的风险诱导方法需要数值计算能力，而农村人口因教育水平有限往往缺乏这种能力。为助力解决这一问题，我们分离了风险诱导任务中插画与游戏化两种元素的效果——这两种元素可能提升注意力与参与度，从而降低不一致性并产生更可靠的结果。我们通过实证检验了"轮盘任务"——一种旨在易于理解且具有参与感的诱导方法，以激励参与。该任务采用幸运转盘模型，通过旋转转盘决定收益，参与者始终可在旋转转盘与固定收益之间做出选择。我们将轮盘任务的结果与成熟的霍尔特-劳里任务（HL任务）原始版本及使用轮盘图示概率的版本进行比较。数据采集自哥伦比亚和秘鲁农村的小农户咖啡种植者，并在柬埔寨农村小农户中开展了试点阶段。我们发现所有三种任务的理解水平均较低。具体而言，在HL任务中使用轮盘图示概率时，理解力或风险厌恶程度未出现显著差异。然而，游戏化会影响风险厌恶水平，尽管这种影响似乎具有文化依赖性。
10.1111/agec.70124.title: Gamification as an Approach To Enhance Comprehension in Risk Elicitation: Experimental Evidence From Smallholder Farmers
10.1111/agec.70124.title_zh: 游戏化作为提升风险诱导理解的方法：来自小农户的实验证据

10.1111/agec.70125.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Studies that analyze the transmission of food prices from international to domestic markets for large sets of countries and products assume that price relationships are time‐invariant. However, studies that look in detail at individual countries and products show that countries respond to increasing international food prices with measures that increase the insulation of their domestic markets and thus weaken international‐to‐domestic price transmission. We analyze relationships between international prices and a large set of domestic prices for wheat, yellow and white maize, and rice using a smooth‐transition error correction model. This specification relaxes the assumption of time‐invariant price transmission by allowing price relationships and domestic market insulation to vary over time depending on international price levels. The results confirm that international‐to‐domestic price transmission weakens in many countries during periods of high international prices, such as 2007/08 and 2022. Our findings highlight a collective action problem: as more countries insulate, the global trading system's capacity to buffer shocks diminishes, amplifying volatility and food security risks.</jats:p>
10.1111/agec.70125.abstract_zh: 摘要：针对大量国家和产品分析国际粮食价格向国内市场传导的研究，通常假设价格关系具有时间不变性。然而，聚焦单个国家和产品的详细研究表明，各国在面对国际粮价上涨时，会采取增强国内市场隔离度的措施，从而削弱国际价格向国内价格的传导。本文采用平滑转换误差修正模型，分析国际价格与小麦、黄玉米、白玉米及大米的大量国内价格之间的关系。该模型通过允许价格关系及国内市场隔离度随国际价格水平变化，放宽了价格传导时间不变性的假设。结果证实，在国际价格高企时期（如2007/08年度及2022年），许多国家的国际-国内价格传导效应显著减弱。研究结果揭示了一个集体行动困境：随着更多国家实施市场隔离，全球贸易体系缓冲冲击的能力下降，从而加剧价格波动与粮食安全风险。
10.1111/agec.70125.title: Food Price Crises and the Insulation of Domestic Grain Markets
10.1111/agec.70125.title_zh: 粮食价格危机与国内谷物市场的隔离

10.1111/agec.70126.abstract: Land fragmentation is widely recognized as a constraint on smallholder agriculture, raising production costs, limiting mechanization, and reducing efficiency. Land consolidation programs have been introduced in many countries to address this problem, yet their economic effects depend not only on plot reconfiguration but also on institutional implementation and land market functioning. This paper examines the impacts of Vietnam's state‐led land consolidation program using six waves of household panel data (2008–2018) from two provinces where consolidation was implemented. Impacts are estimated with two‐way fixed effects and a staggered difference‐in‐differences approach that accounts for heterogeneous adoption timing. The results show that the consolidation program substantially reduced land fragmentation: the number of plots per household fell by roughly three plots, average plot size increased by about 66 percent, and the distance between plots and homesteads declined by approximately 23 percent. At the same time, administrative delays in reissuing land‐use‐right certificates temporarily reduced the share of titled and collateral‐eligible land. While households’ overall access to credit is not adversely affected, land rental markets are significantly disrupted, with both rent‐in and rent‐out declining. Such reductions in land transactions may impede efficient land reallocation and operational scale adjustment, thereby delaying investment and productivity gains from improved land structure. Overall, the findings highlight the importance of institutional implementation and complementary market functioning for realizing the benefits of land consolidation in Vietnam and other smallholder economies.
10.1111/agec.70126.abstract_zh: 土地细碎化被广泛认为是制约小农农业的瓶颈，它提高了生产成本、限制了机械化进程并降低了生产效率。许多国家推行了土地整合计划以应对这一问题，但其经济效果不仅取决于地块重组，还依赖于制度实施和土地市场运行。本文利用越南两个实施土地整合省份的六轮农户面板数据（2008-2018年），考察了该国政府主导的土地整合计划的影响。采用双向固定效应和考虑异质性采纳时点的交错双重差分法进行效应估计。结果显示：土地整合计划显著降低了土地细碎化程度——每户地块数量减少约3块，平均地块面积增加约66%，地块与宅基地距离缩短约23%。与此同时，重新颁发土地使用权证过程中的行政延迟导致有证土地和可抵押土地比例暂时下降。虽然农户整体信贷获取未受负面影响，但土地租赁市场受到显著干扰，租入和租出行为均出现减少。这种土地交易的缩减可能阻碍土地有效再配置和经营规模调整，从而延缓因土地结构改善带来的投资和生产率提升。总体而言，研究结果凸显了制度实施与配套市场功能对越南及其他小农经济体实现土地整合效益的关键作用。
10.1111/agec.70126.title: Land Consolidation, Tenure Documentation, and Land Rental Markets: Evidence from rural Vietnam
10.1111/agec.70126.title_zh: 土地整理、产权登记与土地租赁市场：来自越南农村的证据

10.1111/agec.70127.abstract: Farmers commit suicide at high rates relative to the general population in the United States and elsewhere. Prior studies on farmer suicide have generally focused on socio‐demographic characteristics of individuals and on method of suicide, but few quantitative analyses have sought to understand the possible role of economic and climatic factors as determinants of suicide among farmers. This study addresses this void. We develop an economic model to show how poor economic outcomes or adverse weather conditions can reduce current‐period utility and diminish expectations of future utility through accumulation of debt and formation of expectations of future economic and climatic conditions, with suicide resulting in extreme cases. Our empirical analysis merges CDC nonpublic vital statistics, PRISM daily weather data, and USDA NASS crop and livestock price data into a county‐year panel to estimate the relationship between weather variables, economic factors, and farmer suicides. Results based upon a Poisson regression model show that long‐term, not transitory, poor economic conditions are associated with higher rates of farmer suicide. Extreme heat is also associated with increased farmer suicide, especially in counties most reliant upon animal agriculture. Precipitation appears to play little role in U.S. farmer suicide.
10.1111/agec.70127.abstract_zh: 美国及其他地区的农民自杀率显著高于普通人群。此前关于农民自杀的研究多聚焦于个体社会人口学特征及自杀方式，但鲜有定量分析探讨经济和气候因素作为农民自杀决定因素的潜在作用。本研究填补了这一空白。我们构建了一个经济模型，论证了不良经济结果或恶劣天气如何通过债务累积及对未来经济和气候条件的预期形成，降低当期效用并削弱未来效用预期，极端情况下导致自杀。实证分析整合了美国疾病控制与预防中心非公开生命统计数据、PRISM逐日天气数据及美国农业部国家农业统计局作物与牲畜价格数据，构建县级年度面板数据，以估计气候变量、经济因素与农民自杀之间的关系。基于泊松回归模型的结果表明，长期（而非暂时性）经济状况恶化与农民自杀率上升相关。极端高温同样与农民自杀增加相关，尤其在畜牧业依赖度最高的县。降水量对美国农民自杀的影响似乎微乎其微。
10.1111/agec.70127.title: The Role of Economic and Weather Conditions in Farmer Suicide in the United States
10.1111/agec.70127.title_zh: 美国农民自杀中经济与天气条件的作用

10.1111/agec.70128.abstract: The Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) is the largest federal nutrition assistance program in the United States, yet many eligible households do not participate due to administrative burdens, stigma, and geographic access constraints. We examine whether the SNAP Online Purchasing Pilot (OPP), which allows beneficiaries to redeem benefits online, affects program participation. Using a difference‐in‐differences design with state‐level data from 2017 to 2021, we find that SNAP OPP increases program participation per capita by 13.7% (1.6 percentage points) and participation among individuals below the poverty line by 11.3% (11 percentage points). Event‐study estimates indicate effects emerge within three months and persist thereafter. Participation gains are larger in states with higher digital infrastructure (computer ownership and internet access) and greater vehicle access, indicating that online and physical access function as complements. States with higher shares of elderly residents and households with children also exhibit stronger responses. These findings suggest that enabling online benefit redemption can expand safety net access, though benefits vary systematically with local infrastructure and demographic composition.
10.1111/agec.70128.abstract_zh: 补充营养援助计划（SNAP）是美国最大的联邦营养援助项目，但由于行政负担、污名化以及地理可达性限制，许多符合条件的家庭并未参与其中。我们考察了SNAP在线购买试点项目（OPP）——该试点允许受益人通过在线方式兑换福利——是否会影响项目参与率。利用2017年至2021年的州级数据，采用双重差分法进行分析，我们发现SNAP OPP使人均项目参与率提高了13.7%（1.6个百分点），贫困线以下个体的参与率提高了11.3%（11个百分点）。事件研究估计表明，该效应在三个月内显现并持续存在。在数字基础设施（计算机拥有率和互联网接入率）更完善以及车辆可及性更高的州，参与率增幅更大，这表明在线与实体可达性具有互补作用。老年居民比例较高以及有儿童家庭比例较高的州也表现出更强的响应。这些发现表明，允许在线福利兑换能够扩大安全网的可及性，但其效益会因当地基础设施和人口结构的差异而呈现系统性变化。
10.1111/agec.70128.title: Online Benefit Redemption and SNAP Participation: Evidence From the SNAP Online Purchasing Pilot
10.1111/agec.70128.title_zh: 线上福利兑换与SNAP参与：来自SNAP线上购买试点的证据

10.1111/agec.70129.abstract: ABSTRACT This study develops a theoretical framework to examine the welfare effects of scale transition from smallholders to large farms. Taking hog farming in China as an example, this study focuses on the coexistence equilibrium with both smallholders and large farms and assesses the distributional effects on rural households (independent smallholders, employed smallholders, and quitters), urban consumers, and aggregate social welfare. The simulation findings reveal that the transition to large farms results in long‐term welfare losses for employed smallholsers, as well as rural households as a whole. This outcome is attributed to a reversed income effect, whereby the initial employment gains gradually diminish as the scale of transition progresses. Conversely, urban consumers gain substantial welfare improvements owing to lower retail pork prices, which are driven by the credit advantages and technological innovations of large farms. Additionally, aggregate social welfare improves as consumer surplus outpaces smallholder welfare losses. This research unpacks the intermediary step in the transition from smallholders to large farms and provides theoretical insights for agricultural transitions in developing economies.
10.1111/agec.70129.abstract_zh: 本研究构建了一个理论框架，用以考察从小农户向大规模农场转型的福利效应。以中国生猪养殖为例，本文聚焦于小农户与大规模农场共存均衡状态，评估其对农村家庭（独立小农户、受雇小农户及退出农户）、城市消费者以及社会总福利的分配效应。模拟结果表明，向大规模农场的转型会导致受雇小农户及农村家庭整体的长期福利损失。这一结果源于反向收入效应——随着转型规模推进，初始就业收益逐渐递减。相反，由于大规模农场的信贷优势和技术创新降低了猪肉零售价格，城市消费者获得了显著的福利改善。此外，由于消费者剩余的增长超过小农户的福利损失，社会总福利得以提升。本研究揭示了从小农户向大规模农场转型的中间环节，为发展中经济体的农业转型提供了理论洞见。
10.1111/agec.70129.title: Welfare Effects of Scale Transition From Smallholders to Large Farms: A Theoretical Framework
10.1111/agec.70129.title_zh: 小农户向大规模农场转型的福利效应：一个理论框架

10.1111/agec.70130.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Demand estimates are commonly used to inform firm strategy and public policy, yet they can obscure important variation in demand across geographic space that is relevant for local business decisions and policy interventions. Prior work documents demand heterogeneity across countries, regions, states, and between coarse urban‐rural categories, but evidence on sub‐metropolitan variation is limited. This study documents within‐metro geographic heterogeneity in market shares and willingness‐to‐pay (WTP) for retail and foodservice protein products. I use nearly six years of publicly available survey data and random parameters logit models that include municipality interactions with alternative‐specific constants and price sensitivity to estimate municipality‐specific market shares and WTP in the Phoenix metropolitan area. Demand varies substantially across adjacent municipalities. Central Phoenix residents exhibit higher retail WTP for conventional beef, pork, and chicken products, while both central Phoenix and Scottsdale‐Tempe residents show consistently higher foodservice WTP. Median WTP in these municipalities is roughly 30–50% higher than in surrounding suburbs, whereas suburban groups exhibit similar valuations to one another. These within‐metro differences are large enough to affect targeted pricing and assortment strategies and to produce uneven distributional welfare effects from local price policies (e.g., taxes). The results suggest that investment in geographically refined demand analyses could better inform policy interventions and business decisions at the local level, where those decisions are often made.</jats:p>
10.1111/agec.70130.abstract_zh: 需求估计通常用于指导企业战略和公共政策，但可能掩盖地理空间上需求的重要差异，而这些差异与地方商业决策和政策干预密切相关。已有研究记录了国家、地区、州以及城乡粗分类之间的需求异质性，但关于大都市内部子区域差异的证据有限。本研究揭示了凤凰城大都市区内零售和餐饮服务蛋白质产品市场份额及支付意愿（WTP）的地理异质性。我利用近六年的公开调查数据，并采用包含城市固定效应与替代特定常数及价格敏感度交互项的随机参数Logit模型，估算凤凰城大都市区各城市的特定市场份额和支付意愿。结果显示，相邻城市间的需求存在显著差异。凤凰城市中心居民对传统牛肉、猪肉和鸡肉产品的零售支付意愿较高，而凤凰城市中心及斯科茨代尔-坦佩居民的餐饮服务支付意愿持续偏高。这些城市的支付意愿中位数比周边郊区高出约30-50%，而郊区群体之间的估值则较为接近。这种大都市内部差异足以影响针对性的定价和产品组合策略，并导致地方价格政策（如税收）产生不均等的分配福利效应。研究结果表明，投资于地理精细化需求分析能更好地为地方层面的政策干预和商业决策提供信息，而这些决策通常正是在地方层面制定的。
10.1111/agec.70130.title: Beyond Metropolitan Averages: Food Demand Across Local Markets
10.1111/agec.70130.title_zh: 超越都市均值：地方市场的食品需求

10.1111/agec.70131.abstract: ABSTRACT This study examined the effect of the West‐to‐East Electricity Transmission Project in China on agricultural productivity. The project transmits electricity from the resource‐rich west to the consumer‐dense east. Using a Difference‐in‐Differences approach, we found that the project increased county‐level agricultural productivity by about USD 509.5 per person. This increase results from advances in agricultural technological progress and the development of the agricultural industry. Farmer adaptation to improved electricity supply also contributed, such as expanded irrigation, greater land allocation to water‐intensive crops, higher replanting indices, and larger‐scale operations. The project has also raised grain yields and farmers’ disposable incomes, while reducing the agricultural labor force. Only electricity transmission, not natural gas or oil, had a positive and significant effect on agricultural productivity. These results support compelling evidence for investing in large‐scale transregional electricity transmission infrastructure worldwide.
10.1111/agec.70131.abstract_zh: 本研究考察了中国“西电东送”工程对农业生产率的影响。该工程将电力从资源丰富的西部地区输送至人口密集的东部地区。采用双重差分法，我们发现该工程使县级农业生产率人均提高了约509.5美元。这一增长源于农业技术进步和农业产业发展。农民对电力供应改善的适应性调整也起到了促进作用，例如扩大灌溉面积、增加高耗水作物的土地配置、提高复种指数以及扩大经营规模。该工程还提高了粮食产量和农民可支配收入，同时减少了农业劳动力。只有电力传输（而非天然气或石油）对农业生产率产生了显著的正向影响。这些结果为全球范围内投资大规模跨区域电力传输基础设施提供了有力证据。
10.1111/agec.70131.title: Long‐Distance Electricity Transmission and Agricultural Productivity Growth: Evidence From China
10.1111/agec.70131.title_zh: 远距离输电与农业生产力增长：来自中国的证据

10.1111/agec.70132.abstract: ABSTRACT Viticulture is a key economic sector in Europe, but responsible for vast amounts of fungicide use. Fungus‐resistant grapevine varieties are less susceptible to fungal diseases, reducing fungicide use by up to 80%. However, their adoption remains limited, despite their economic and environmental advantages. We develop a bio‐economic simulation model with a real options investment perspective to analyze farmers’ decisions to adopt resistant varieties, accounting for different risk factors (e.g., production, market, policy). We apply the model to the case of Swiss viticulture. Results indicate that in the short‐term, adoption barriers persist for the majority of farmers, with replanting occurring only when favorable conditions are met, such as low discount rates, high disease pressure, and available price premia. Conversely, we find that in the long‐term, as vines reach replacement age, resistant varieties are favored over traditional ones. Our findings further indicate that increases in disease pressure, for example, due to climate change, are likely to accelerate the early adoption of fungus‐resistant varieties. We highlight potential avenues for improving current support for replanting in Switzerland, for example, through market access and information provision. By integrating risk and managerial flexibility into a dynamic, real options decision‐making framework, this study provides new insights for designing effective policies to promote sustainable pest management in viticulture.
10.1111/agec.70132.abstract_zh: 摘要：葡萄栽培是欧洲重要的经济部门，但也是大量杀菌剂使用的来源。抗真菌葡萄品种对真菌病害的敏感性较低，可将杀菌剂使用量减少高达80%。然而，尽管具有经济和环境优势，其采用率仍然有限。我们构建了一个结合实物期权投资视角的生物经济模拟模型，用于分析农户采纳抗性品种的决策，并考虑了不同风险因素（如生产、市场、政策）。我们将该模型应用于瑞士葡萄栽培案例。结果表明，短期内，大多数农户仍面临采用障碍，只有在满足低贴现率、高病害压力和可获得溢价等有利条件时才会进行重新种植。相反，我们发现长期来看，当葡萄藤达到更新树龄时，抗性品种比传统品种更受青睐。我们的研究进一步表明，病害压力的增加（例如因气候变化所致）可能加速抗真菌品种的早期采用。我们指出了改善瑞士当前重新种植支持政策的潜在途径，例如通过市场准入和信息提供。通过将风险和管理灵活性纳入动态的实物期权决策框架，本研究为设计促进葡萄栽培可持续病虫害管理的有效政策提供了新见解。
10.1111/agec.70132.title: Adoption Dynamics of Fungus‐Resistant Grapevine Varieties: A Real Options Approach
10.1111/agec.70132.title_zh: 抗真菌葡萄品种的采用动态：一种实物期权方法

10.1111/agec.70133.abstract: Matsuura, M., Luh, Y. H., and Islam, A. H. M. S. 2023. “Weather Shocks, Livelihood Diversification, and Household Food Security: Empirical Evidence From Rural Bangladesh. ” Agricultural Economics 54, no. 4: 455–470. In the originally published version of this article, Table 2 contained typographical errors and misaligned rows for several variables (Male, Age of HH, Household size, Schooling Year of HH, and Asset index). Furthermore, the farm size values for 2015 and 2018 were updated to their log-transformed values. These errors have been corrected, and the updated table is provided below. We apologize for this error.

10.1111/agec.70133.title: Correction to “Weather Shocks, Livelihood Diversification, and Household Food Security: Empirical Evidence From Rural Bangladesh”
10.1111/agec.70133.title_zh: 更正：“天气冲击、生计多样化与家庭粮食安全：来自孟加拉国农村地区的实证证据

10.1111/agec.70136.abstract: Farm size, as well as technical and environmental efficiency in agriculture, is key to food security and sustainable development. However, empirical evidence about how heterogeneity across farm sizes is associated with the joint production of desirable outputs and undesirable by‐products remains limited, preventing our understanding of technical and environmental efficiency. Using country‐representative survey data on rice production in China from 2014 to 2018, we estimate farm‐level technical and environmental efficiency by employing a by‐production function combined with a stochastic meta‐frontier approach, accounting for heterogeneous technology across farm sizes. Our findings reveal considerable room to improve both technical and environmental performance, and the extent of both differs markedly by farm size. Medium‐sized farms (2–6.67 ha) exhibit the highest meta‐frontier technical efficiency, whereas large farms (6.67–33.33 ha) achieve the highest meta‐frontier environmental efficiency. The estimated shadow prices indicate that the mean marginal abatement cost of nitrogen pollution is 129.233 yuan/kg. We also identify a range of farm‐scale factors, such as technical training, land consolidation, higher educational attainment, and cooperative membership, which are significantly associated with higher levels of technical and environmental efficiency in rice farming. Counterfactual simulations further indicate that combining farm‐size‐specific measures could enhance meta‐frontier technical and environmental efficiency. In particular, cooperative participation is positively associated with technical and environmental performance among smallholders, while high‐level education and technical training are more impactful at large farms. Land fragmentation is consistently associated with lower efficiency and wider technology gaps across farm sizes. Our findings underscore the importance of designing farm‐size‐specific policies and implementing integrated interventions in promoting sustainable agricultural development.
10.1111/agec.70136.abstract_zh: 农业经营规模以及技术效率与环境效率是粮食安全与可持续发展的关键。然而，关于不同规模农场在联合生产期望产出与非期望副产品方面的异质性如何影响技术效率与环境效率，现有实证证据仍然有限，这制约了我们对相关问题的理解。利用2014年至2018年中国水稻生产的全国代表性调查数据，我们采用联合生产函数结合随机元前沿方法，在考虑不同规模农场技术异质性的基础上，估算了农场层面的技术效率与环境效率。研究结果表明，技术绩效与环境绩效均有较大提升空间，且不同规模农场的提升幅度存在显著差异。中型农场（2–6.67公顷）的元前沿技术效率最高，而大型农场（6.67–33.33公顷）的元前沿环境效率最高。估算的影子价格显示，氮污染的平均边际减排成本为129.233元/千克。我们还发现一系列农场规模相关因素，如技术培训、土地整合、更高教育水平及合作社成员身份，与水稻种植中更高的技术效率与环境效率显著相关。反事实模拟进一步表明，结合针对特定规模农场的措施可提升元前沿技术效率与环境效率。具体而言，合作社参与与小农户的技术绩效和环境绩效呈正相关，而高等教育水平和技术培训对大型农场的影响更为显著。土地细碎化则始终与较低效率及更大技术差距相关，且这一关联在不同规模农场中普遍存在。研究结果强调了制定针对不同规模农场的政策并实施综合干预措施对促进农业可持续发展的重要性。
10.1111/agec.70136.title: Farm Size, Technical Efficiency, and Environmental Performance: Evidence From Rice Production in China
10.1111/agec.70136.title_zh: 农场规模、技术效率与环境绩效：来自中国水稻生产的证据

10.1111/agec.70138.abstract: This paper develops a novel production function framework that accounts for spatial spillovers in environment‐adjusted agricultural productivity and its components, namely technical change, scale efficiency change and environmental efficiency change, in a single‐stage setting, with greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions incorporated as an undesirable output. A parametric frontier model was specified to measure agricultural environmental efficiency and productivity growth, while allowing for the agricultural outputs to be functions of individuals’ and neighbors’ characteristics. The empirical application concerned the 126 prefectures in the Yangtze River Basin for the period 2000–2020. The empirical findings indicated an upward trend, with an average environment‐adjusted agricultural productivity growth rate of 0.213 during this period when spatial spillovers and agricultural undesirable output were considered, suggesting that agricultural productivity was increasing rapidly and at an accelerating pace. The downstream region experienced the highest rate of productivity improvement, followed by the midstream region, while the upstream region lagged. Technical progress emerged as the dominant driver of environment‐adjusted agricultural productivity growth in the study area.
10.1111/agec.70138.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个新颖的生产函数框架，在单阶段设定中纳入环境调整后的农业全要素生产率及其组成部分（即技术变化、规模效率变化和环境效率变化）的空间溢出效应，并将温室气体排放作为非期望产出纳入模型。通过设定参数前沿模型，在允许农业产出受个体及邻近区域特征影响的前提下，测算了农业环境效率与生产率增长。实证研究以2000—2020年长江流域126个地级市为对象。结果表明，在考虑空间溢出效应和农业非期望产出时，该时期环境调整后的农业全要素生产率呈上升趋势，平均增长率为0.213，表明农业生产力正以加速态势快速提升。下游地区生产率改善幅度最大，中游地区次之，上游地区相对滞后。技术进步是研究区域环境调整后农业全要素生产率增长的主导驱动力。
10.1111/agec.70138.title: Spatial Spillovers and Green Growth: Decoding Environment‐Adjusted Agricultural Productivity Dynamics
10.1111/agec.70138.title_zh: 空间溢出与绿色增长：解码环境调整后的农业生产力动态

10.1111/caje.70055.abstract: We study income tax competition in a structure of two adjacent two‐tier (federal‐regional) fiscal federations, where both upper‐tier and lower‐tier authorities tax income in the presence of income shifting within and between the federations. We show that when the federations are symmetric, horizontal competition leads to income‐shifting flows from rich regions (setting higher income tax rates) to poor regions (setting lower tax rates), both within and between federations. Moreover, income‐shifting facilities intensify tax competition, potentially increasing income redistribution from wealthier to poorer regions. However, in the case of asymmetric federations, the relationship between regional income tax rate and tax base and the resulting direction of inter‐regional income‐shifting flows are ambiguous due to the operation of vertical and diagonal fiscal externalities.
10.1111/caje.70055.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一个由两个相邻的两级（联邦-地区）财政联邦制构成的收入税收竞争结构，其中，在存在联邦内部及联邦之间收入转移的情况下，上级和下级政府均对收入征税。研究表明，当联邦对称时，横向竞争会导致收入从富裕地区（设定较高所得税率）向贫困地区（设定较低税率）转移，这种转移既发生在联邦内部，也发生在联邦之间。此外，收入转移机制加剧了税收竞争，可能增加从富裕地区向贫困地区的收入再分配。然而，在非对称联邦的情况下，由于纵向和对角财政外部性的作用，地区所得税率与税基之间的关系以及由此产生的地区间收入转移方向具有不确定性。
10.1111/caje.70055.title: Income distribution, taxation and shifting in a federal fiscal structure
10.1111/caje.70055.title_zh: 联邦财政结构中的收入分配、税收与转移

10.1111/caje.70057.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We study the competition and welfare effects of upstream partial ownerships (UPO) in a framework with two competing supply chains and downstream firms choosing their product positionings strategically. We find that UPO reduces downstream product differentiation and thus intensifies downstream competition. Unlike the standard results of Bertrand competition, we find that downstream prices can be strategic substitutes even when downstream firms compete in Bertrand fashion. More importantly, we show that UPO increases consumer surplus and social welfare, even when double marginalization increases downstream prices. The competition and welfare results from downstream partial ownerships (DPO) are just the opposite to those from UPO. Our findings have clear managerial and policy implications.</jats:p>
10.1111/caje.70057.abstract_zh: 摘要：本文研究了上游部分所有权（UPO）在两条竞争性供应链框架下的竞争与福利效应，其中下游企业战略性选择产品定位。研究发现，UPO会降低下游产品差异化程度，从而加剧下游竞争。与伯特兰竞争的标准结论不同，我们发现即使下游企业以伯特兰方式竞争，下游价格仍可能呈现战略替代性。更重要的是，我们证明即使双重边际化推高了下游价格，UPO仍能提升消费者剩余和社会福利。下游部分所有权（DPO）的竞争与福利效应则与UPO完全相反。本研究具有明确的管理与政策启示。
10.1111/caje.70057.title: Supply chain competition and the welfare effects of partial ownership
10.1111/caje.70057.title_zh: 供应链竞争与部分所有权的福利效应

10.1111/caje.70058.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This paper uses linked Census records from 1871 to 1901 to compute intergenerational mobility for Canadian regions and census divisions. The results reveal sharp differences in mobility over space: Ontario featured high relative and absolute mobility, Quebec low relative and absolute mobility and the Maritimes low absolute mobility. Local differences in human capital endowments and labour market inequality are correlated with division mobility patterns but do not account for regional differences, where migration and structural change toward industry and services appear important. Comparing spatial patterns of Canadian mobility in the 19th century to today shows substantial changes for Quebec districts.</jats:p>
10.1111/caje.70058.abstract_zh: 本文利用1871年至1901年的关联人口普查记录，计算了加拿大各地区及普查分区的代际流动性。结果显示，不同地区的流动性存在显著差异：安大略省具有较高的相对流动性和绝对流动性，魁北克省则表现出较低的相对流动性和绝对流动性，而滨海省份的绝对流动性较低。地方人力资本禀赋和劳动力市场不平等与分区流动性模式相关，但无法解释区域差异，其中向工业和服务业的迁移及结构转型似乎更为重要。将19世纪加拿大流动性的空间格局与当今对比，发现魁北克地区发生了显著变化。
10.1111/caje.70058.title: The geography of economic mobility in 19th‐century Canada
10.1111/caje.70058.title_zh: 19世纪加拿大经济流动性的地理分布

10.1111/caje.70059.abstract: This paper examines the significance of including a company's location of origin in its name, a practice known as using an eponymous location name. Our theory demonstrates that signalling an origin from a prestigious location is an appealing strategy for relatively weaker companies, whereas stronger companies tend to avoid it. We empirically test this theory on a sample of UK university spin‐outs from 2010 to 2021. Eponymous location names are particularly prevalent among spin‐outs from Oxbridge (i.e., Oxford and Cambridge). As predicted by our theory, eponymous location names are negatively related to measures of fundraising success after controlling for spin‐out origin.
10.1111/caje.70059.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了将公司原产地名称纳入公司名称（即使用同名地名）的重要意义。我们的理论表明，对于相对较弱的公司而言，通过名称彰显其源自知名地区是一种具有吸引力的策略，而实力较强的公司则倾向于避免这种做法。我们以2010年至2021年间英国大学衍生企业为样本，对该理论进行了实证检验。同名地名在牛津剑桥（即牛津大学和剑桥大学）的衍生企业中尤为普遍。正如理论所预测，在控制衍生企业原产地因素后，同名地名与融资成功指标呈负相关关系。
10.1111/caje.70059.title: To name your venture after Oxbridge or not, that is the question!
10.1111/caje.70059.title_zh: 以牛桥命名你的企业，是耶非耶？

10.1111/caje.70060.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>As far back as 1755, Richard Cantillon analyzed how changes in the money supply affected relative prices in the economy. In times of monetary infusion, prices of certain types of goods and services could be expected to rise, depending upon the initial distribution of the money and therefore initial spending. Cantillon emphasized the case of new money falling into the hands of wealthy agents, driving up spending on luxuries, such as artworks (as well as financial assets), and causing their relative prices to increase. We present new evidence on the “Cantillon effect” as a potential explanation for movements in the prices of Canadian and Australian paintings since the mid‐1970s. We econometrically analyze the relationship between time series of the money supply and art prices in each country. Both countries represent peripheral art markets dominated by domestic private and corporate collectors, and they should thus be more responsive to domestic rather than international economic and monetary conditions. For both markets, we distinguish and separately analyze different tiers of the market, separating the very top from a lower segment. We find that prices for top Canadian artists follow the money supply relatively well over the long term, with a similar but slightly weaker result for the top Australian segment; notably, Australian middlebrow prices move more in line with the Consumer Price Index. These results suggest that national art markets are not homogeneous and that segmenting them for analytical purposes may be useful. Specifically, we find stronger evidence of a Cantillon effect in the upper end of the market, while prices of lower‐prestige paintings move more in line with consumer goods prices.</jats:p>
10.1111/caje.70060.abstract_zh: 早在1755年，理查德·坎蒂隆就分析了货币供给变化如何影响经济中的相对价格。在货币注入时期，某些商品和服务的价格预计会上涨，具体取决于货币的初始分配及由此产生的初始支出。坎蒂隆强调，当新增货币落入富裕阶层手中时，会推高奢侈品（如艺术品及金融资产）的支出，导致其相对价格上升。我们提供了关于“坎蒂隆效应”的新证据，将其作为自20世纪70年代中期以来加拿大和澳大利亚绘画价格变动的潜在解释。我们运用计量经济学方法，分析了各国货币供给时间序列与艺术品价格之间的关系。这两个国家均属于由国内私人及企业收藏家主导的边缘艺术市场，因此它们对国内而非国际经济与货币状况的反应更为敏感。针对这两个市场，我们区分并分别分析了不同市场层级，将顶级市场与较低层级市场分开。研究发现，长期来看，加拿大顶级艺术家的价格与货币供给的走势相对吻合，澳大利亚顶级市场的结果类似但略弱；值得注意的是，澳大利亚中端市场价格与消费者价格指数的变动更为一致。这些结果表明，国家艺术市场并非同质化，按分析目的对其进行分层可能具有价值。具体而言，我们在市场高端发现了更强的坎蒂隆效应证据，而低声望画作的价格则更贴近消费品价格的变动。
10.1111/caje.70060.title: Comparative Cantillon effects in the Canadian and Australian art markets
10.1111/caje.70060.title_zh: 加拿大与澳大利亚艺术市场中的比较康替龙效应

10.1111/caje.70061.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This paper generalizes the original Brander and Taylor model of open‐access renewable resource use and trade to address three common critiques. First, I introduce heterogeneity across agents in harvesting productivity to smooth out the model's extreme specialization patterns while maintaining its Ricardian structure and tractability. Second, I move beyond the original assumption of open access by constructing a policy stringency function allowing for partial, first‐best, and endogenous resource policy. Third, by exploiting the smooth substitution possibilities generated by agent heterogeneity and the insight that policy stringency functions are likely to vary across countries, I show how the model's core predictions can be evaluated using empirical methods related to those in growth econometrics.</jats:p>
10.1111/caje.70061.abstract_zh: 本文对Brander和Taylor关于开放获取可再生资源利用与贸易的原始模型进行了推广，以回应三项常见批评。首先，我在采掘生产率方面引入主体异质性，在保持模型李嘉图结构与可处理性的同时，平滑了其极端专业化模式。其次，通过构建一个允许部分最优、第一最优及内生资源政策的政策严格度函数，我突破了原始模型对开放获取的假设。第三，利用主体异质性产生的平滑替代可能性以及政策严格度函数可能因国家而异的洞见，我展示了如何运用增长计量经济学相关的实证方法来评估模型的核心预测。
10.1111/caje.70061.title: Is free trade good for renewable resources? Brander and Taylor redux
10.1111/caje.70061.title_zh: 自由贸易对可再生资源有益吗？布兰德与泰勒再探

10.1111/caje.70062.title: Introduction to the Symposium in Honour of James A. Brander
10.1111/caje.70062.title_zh: 詹姆斯·A·布兰德纪念研讨会导言

10.1111/caje.70065.title: Considering trade policy: Then and now
10.1111/caje.70065.title_zh: 考虑贸易政策：过去与现在

10.1111/caje.70066.title: Reflections on trade policy: Then and now
10.1111/caje.70066.title_zh: 贸易政策反思：过去与现在

10.1111/caje.70067.abstract: Abstract This paper investigates the hypothesis that lower trade policy uncertainty (TPU) reduces the share of intrafirm trade in total trade. A significant change in US‐China TPU occurred in 2001 when China joined the WTO, providing a natural experiment to test this hypothesis. Using a difference‐in‐differences approach with industry‐level US data, I examine the trade effects of this change. The results indicate that the reduction in TPU between the US and China led to a significant increase in both US arm's‐length and intrafirm imports from China compared to pre‐WTO levels. Notably, the effect of TPU on arm's‐length trade is approximately twice that on intrafirm trade, with the disparity largely attributed to sunk costs. A simple model of production location and ownership choice under policy uncertainty provides a conceptual framework for understanding these findings.
10.1111/caje.70067.abstract_zh: 摘要 本文研究了贸易政策不确定性（TPU）降低会减少公司内贸易在总贸易中占比这一假说。2001年中国加入WTO使美中贸易政策不确定性发生显著变化，为检验该假说提供了自然实验。本文采用双重差分法，基于美国行业层面数据，考察了这一变化带来的贸易效应。结果表明，相较于入世前水平，美中贸易政策不确定性的降低显著增加了美国从中国的独立企业间贸易和公司内进口。值得注意的是，贸易政策不确定性对独立企业间贸易的影响约为公司内贸易的两倍，这一差异主要归因于沉没成本。一个关于政策不确定性下生产区位与所有权选择的简单模型，为理解上述发现提供了概念框架。
10.1111/caje.70067.title: Trade policy uncertainty, organization of firms, and the form of international trade
10.1111/caje.70067.title_zh: 贸易政策不确定性、企业组织与国际贸易形式

10.1111/caje.70068.abstract: Abstract China's overseas patents grew rapidly in the past two decades at the same time as China became the world's largest exporter of merchandise goods. This paper investigates the effects of overseas patents on the volume and prices of Chinese firms' exports. We consider two channels. First, patents prevent imitation and rival entry, leading to higher quantities and prices. Second, patents reduce the likelihood of litigation and can allow firms to price more aggressively if they are keeping prices high to deter potential litigation in the export market. We find evidence of both. Both channels predict a higher quantity of exports, and we find evidence of that in the data. We also compile evidence consistent with patents allowing Chinese firms to price more aggressively (lower prices).
10.1111/caje.70068.abstract_zh: 摘要 过去二十年，中国海外专利数量快速增长，与此同时，中国成为全球最大的商品出口国。本文研究海外专利对中国企业出口规模与价格的影响。我们考虑两种作用机制：其一，专利阻止模仿与竞争者进入，从而提升出口数量与价格；其二，专利降低诉讼风险，若企业为规避出口市场潜在诉讼而维持高价，则专利可使其采取更激进的定价策略。实证结果支持两种机制的存在。两种机制均预测出口数量增加，数据验证了这一结论。此外，我们发现的证据表明，专利使中国企业能够采取更激进的定价策略（即降低价格）。
10.1111/caje.70068.title: Market expansion and litigation deterrence effects of patents: Evidence from Chinese exporters
10.1111/caje.70068.title_zh: 专利的市场扩张与诉讼威慑效应：来自中国出口企业的证据

10.1111/caje.70069.abstract: In oligopoly market structures, optimal trade policies depend on the conduct of competing firms. Whether firms compete with prices or quantities as the strategic variables has a major quantitative and, sometimes, qualitative impact on the design of optimal trade policies. Conduct is not directly observable, but we develop an econometric method to infer it from data on prices, quantities, and a cost shifter such as tariffs. We apply the method to the widely used case of a constant elasticity of substitution demand and ad valorem tariffs. Using simulations, we show how policy makers could infer conduct from estimation and thereby generate domestic welfare gains from strategic trade policy when conduct is ex ante unknown. Several caveats from the literature remain important, but our method mitigates concerns over imperfect information on conduct.
10.1111/caje.70069.abstract_zh: 在寡头市场结构中，最优贸易政策取决于竞争企业的行为模式。企业是以价格还是产量作为战略变量进行竞争，对最优贸易政策的设计会产生重大的数量影响，有时甚至会产生质的影响。行为模式无法直接观测，但我们开发了一种计量经济学方法，通过价格、产量以及关税等成本变动因素的数据来推断企业行为。我们将该方法应用于广泛使用的恒定替代弹性需求与从价关税案例。通过模拟分析，我们展示了政策制定者如何通过估计推断企业行为，从而在行为模式事先未知的情况下，通过战略性贸易政策实现国内福利提升。文献中的若干重要警示仍需关注，但我们的方法缓解了对行为模式信息不完全的担忧。
10.1111/caje.70069.title: Inferring conduct to guide strategic trade policy
10.1111/caje.70069.title_zh: 推断行为以指导战略贸易政策

10.1111/caje.70070.abstract: In this article, we assess the effect of the French disability benefits program on the employment of low‐skilled youth. Using the French Labour Force Survey, we exploit the age discontinuity in the program eligibility to instrument the effect of this allowance on employment. The results show that receipt of the French disability benefits program reduces the probability of employment for low‐skilled youth with disabilities. However, the effect differs markedly by gender: it is significantly higher for women, while no effect is detectable in men.
10.1111/caje.70070.abstract_zh: 本文评估了法国残疾人福利计划对低技能青年就业的影响。利用法国劳动力调查数据，我们借助该计划资格认定中的年龄断点，将此项津贴对就业的影响作为工具变量进行分析。结果表明，领取法国残疾人福利计划津贴会降低低技能残疾青年的就业概率。然而，该影响存在显著的性别差异：对女性的影响明显更高，而对男性则未发现显著影响。
10.1111/caje.70070.title: Effects of disability benefits on the employment of low‐skilled youth: Evidence from France
10.1111/caje.70070.title_zh: 残疾津贴对低技能青年就业的影响：来自法国的证据
