10.1111/caje.70071.abstract: Most countries use export credit agencies (ECAs) to mitigate export‐related credit constraints. Only few firms benefit directly from these credit schemes. In this paper, I analyze potential spillover effects from export credit guarantees to other firms. Using firm‐level data from the Danish ECA and exploiting detailed firm‐product‐level production and purchase statistics, I derive new measures for horizontal and backward spillovers at the firm‐product and firm levels. Results show that potential suppliers upstream increase their sales of those products that are purchased by the firm(s) receiving export credit guarantees. Moreover, employment and total sales of potential suppliers increase as well. These findings speak to the transmission of large export shocks (here reflected in the issuance of export credit guarantees) to other domestic firms via customer‐supplier linkages. In contrast, I find little evidence of negative effects on domestic producers when export credit guarantees are given to their competitors.
10.1111/caje.70071.abstract_zh: 大多数国家通过出口信用机构（ECAs）来缓解与出口相关的信贷约束，但仅有少数企业能直接受益于这些信贷计划。本文分析了出口信用担保对其他企业的潜在溢出效应。基于丹麦出口信用机构的企业层面数据，并利用详细的企业-产品层面生产与采购统计，我在企业-产品和企业层面构建了横向与后向溢出的新测度指标。研究结果表明，上游潜在供应商会增加其向获得出口信用担保的企业所采购产品的销售额。此外，这些潜在供应商的就业与总销售额也同步增长。这些发现揭示了大型出口冲击（此处体现为出口信用担保的发放）如何通过客户-供应商关联传导至国内其他企业。相比之下，当出口信用担保给予竞争对手时，我并未发现对国内生产者产生负面效应的显著证据。
10.1111/caje.70071.title: Spillovers from export credit guarantees
10.1111/caje.70071.title_zh: 出口信用担保的溢出效应

10.1111/caje.70072.abstract: Abstract The global success of online search and social media stems from free access and high quality—both enabled by a business model that monetizes personal data through targeted advertising. But does this model yield socially desirable outcomes? We examine how a global monopoly platform chooses privacy protection and service quality. Under a free‐service model, it overexploits data and underprovides quality relative to a global planner. Yet, even with distortions on both margins, stronger privacy protection alone can improve global welfare—and may even boost quality. When privacy policy is set nationally, large countries often align with global interests due to a “Brussels Effect,” where platform responses to one country's policy spill over globally. This alignment reduces the need for privacy rules in trade agreements. In contrast, ad tech taxes create “beggar‐thy‐neighbour” incentives, making them a clear case for international cooperation.
10.1111/caje.70072.abstract_zh: 摘要 在线搜索与社交媒体的全球成功源于免费访问与高质量服务——这两者均得益于通过定向广告将个人数据货币化的商业模式。但这一模式能否产生符合社会期望的结果？我们研究了一家全球垄断平台在隐私保护与服务质量之间的权衡选择。在免费服务模式下，相较于全球规划者，该平台过度利用数据且服务质量不足。然而，即便在这两个维度均存在扭曲，仅加强隐私保护本身就能改善全球福利——甚至可能提升服务质量。当隐私政策由国家层面制定时，大国往往因"布鲁塞尔效应"与全球利益趋同，即平台对一国政策的反应会产生全球溢出效应。这种趋同降低了贸易协定中隐私规则的必要性。相比之下，广告技术税会催生"以邻为壑"的激励，使其成为国际合作的明确案例。
10.1111/caje.70072.title: e‐Globalization and trade agreements

10.1111/cjag.70017.abstract: With the widespread adoption of sugar‐sweetened beverage (SSB) taxes, top‐down facilitation measures—designed to influence consumer tax cognition—have limited impact, even though they are widely promoted as a means of enhancing tax effectiveness. This study introduces a bottom‐up facilitation approach that targets immediate and direct information available to consumers. We examine how these two types of facilitation measures jointly affect tax policy efficacy. Results indicate that top‐down measures, such as public health education campaigns, do not significantly reduce SSB purchases when implemented alone. However, when combined with bottom‐up measures—such as displaying the specific tax amount on product labels—the tax's effectiveness increases substantially. In addition, a difference‐in‐differences style analysis reveals that the combination of top‐down and bottom‐up facilitation measures significantly reduces consumer willingness to purchase SSBs and helps mitigate reactance observed under top‐down‐only conditions, particularly among consumers who are more likely to ignore or discount the top‐down educational information about the SSB tax. These findings provide actionable insights into how the design of public health taxation—such as SSB taxes—can be optimized to strengthen behavioral responses and enhance policy outcomes.
10.1111/cjag.70017.abstract_zh: 随着含糖饮料（SSB）税收政策的广泛实施，旨在影响消费者税收认知的“自上而下”促进措施——尽管被广泛宣传为提升税收有效性的手段——实际效果有限。本研究引入了一种针对消费者即时直接信息的“自下而上”促进方法，考察这两类促进措施如何共同影响税收政策效能。结果表明，单独实施公共卫生教育宣传等自上而下措施时，并未显著减少含糖饮料购买行为。然而，当与在产品标签上显示具体税额等自下而上措施结合使用时，税收有效性大幅提升。此外，基于双重差分法的分析显示，自上而下与自下而上促进措施的组合能显著降低消费者购买含糖饮料的意愿，并有助于缓解仅在自上而下条件下观察到的消费者逆反心理——尤其对更易忽视或低估含糖饮料税自上而下教育信息的消费者群体效果显著。这些发现为优化含糖饮料税等公共卫生税收政策设计、强化行为响应及提升政策成效提供了可操作的见解。
10.1111/cjag.70017.title: Facilitating sugar taxes with top‐down and bottom‐up information: A combined approach for improved tax efficacy
10.1111/cjag.70017.title_zh: 自上而下与自下而上信息促进糖税：提升税收效力的综合方法

10.1111/cjag.70018.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This study expands the framework for analyzing the interplay of agricultural area and crop diversity on agroecosystem services by incorporating the species‐area relationship concept from biology. We estimate panel fixed effects models that include both agricultural area and crop diversity, along with their interaction term. This approach allows us to derive a crop diversity threshold‐the point at which agricultural land no longer exerts a negative marginal effect on water quality, driven by adjustments along the intensive margin rather than the extensive margin. By replicating well‐established water quality models from the literature and conducting robustness checks, we validate this framework. Our results empirically demonstrate that crop diversity can mitigate the adverse impact of agricultural land on water quality, aligning with the goals of conservation programs. This framework provides a more comprehensive understanding of agriculture's non‐unidirectional contributions to water quality, rather than only negative impacts, which are pervasive in the literature. Moreover, the thresholds identified in this study provide valuable insights for prioritizing regions for landscape‐based, crop diversity‐driven conservation strategies and policy design.</jats:p>
10.1111/cjag.70018.abstract_zh: 本研究通过引入生物学中的物种-面积关系概念，拓展了分析农业面积与作物多样性对农业生态系统服务交互作用的框架。我们估计了包含农业面积、作物多样性及其交互项的面板固定效应模型。这一方法使我们能够推导出作物多样性阈值——即农业用地通过集约边际调整而非粗放边际调整，不再对水质产生负面边际效应的临界点。通过复现文献中成熟的水质模型并进行稳健性检验，我们验证了这一框架的有效性。实证结果表明，作物多样性能够缓解农业用地对水质的负面影响，这与保护项目的目标一致。该框架有助于更全面地理解农业对水质的非单向贡献（而非文献中普遍强调的单一负面影响）。此外，本研究识别的阈值可为优先区域划定提供依据，助力基于景观格局、以作物多样性为导向的保护策略与政策设计。
10.1111/cjag.70018.title: Interplay of crop diversity and agricultural area in agroecosystem services: Analytical and empirical study on local water quality
10.1111/cjag.70018.title_zh: 作物多样性与农业面积在农业生态系统服务中的相互作用：基于地方水质的分析与实证研究

10.1111/cjag.70019.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Conventional price indexes partially address product heterogeneity. This paper considers the variety and quality of products in each market, the combination of region and year, and constructs panel price indexes using household scanner data on non‐alcoholic beverages in urban China. By comparing our panel price indexes to a conventional one, we find that ignoring product heterogeneity could largely underestimate the cross‐market price differences for non‐alcoholic beverages. We also find that product variety increases with urban population and income per capita, but that quality decreases with urban population, suggesting that wealthier provincial urban markets tend to have higher consumer welfare.</jats:p>
10.1111/cjag.70019.abstract_zh: 传统价格指数仅部分解决了产品异质性问题。本文考虑每个市场（地区与年份的组合）中产品的多样性和质量，利用中国城市非酒精饮料的家庭扫描数据构建了面板价格指数。通过将我们的面板价格指数与传统价格指数进行比较，我们发现忽略产品异质性可能会严重低估非酒精饮料的跨市场价格差异。研究还发现，产品多样性随城市人口和人均收入增加而上升，但产品质量随城市人口增加而下降，这表明更富裕的省级城市市场往往具有更高的消费者福利。
10.1111/cjag.70019.title: Product heterogeneity, price index bias, and their link to provincial urban size: Evidence from urban China's beverage market
10.1111/cjag.70019.title_zh: 产品异质性、价格指数偏差及其与省级城市规模的关联：来自中国城市饮料市场的证据

10.1111/cjag.70020.abstract: Abstract This study utilizes nationally representative panel data on rural Chinese households to investigate the interrelationship between smallholders’ participation in land rental markets and their agricultural commercialization while also evaluating the interactive effects of these market‐oriented farming practices on agricultural land and labor productivity. We adopted a bivariate Tobit model, fixed effects models, and instrumental variable methods to address the endogeneity problems. Results reveal a mutually reinforcing relationship between farm households’ land rental area and commercialization decisions. Furthermore, renting farmland is associated with improved agricultural labor productivity and reduced land productivity. Agricultural commercialization shows a positive correlation with the productivity of both land and labor for farm households. Finally, commercialization could positively moderate the association between land renting and agricultural productivity. Policymakers should design policies and strategies to promote the development of the land rental market and the commercialization of farmers, which could improve labor and land productivity.
10.1111/cjag.70020.abstract_zh: 本研究利用具有全国代表性的中国农村家庭面板数据，探讨小农户参与土地租赁市场与其农业商业化之间的相互关系，同时评估这些市场化农业实践对农业土地和劳动生产率的交互效应。我们采用双变量Tobit模型、固定效应模型和工具变量方法来解决内生性问题。结果显示，农户土地租赁面积与商业化决策之间存在相互促进的关系。此外，租赁耕地与农业劳动生产率提高和土地生产率下降相关。农业商业化与农户土地和劳动生产率均呈正相关。最后，商业化能够正向调节土地租赁与农业生产率之间的关系。政策制定者应设计促进土地租赁市场发展和农民商业化的政策与策略，从而提升劳动和土地生产率。
10.1111/cjag.70020.title: Agricultural commercialization and productivity: Evidence from land market participation in rural China
10.1111/cjag.70020.title_zh: 农业商业化与生产率：来自中国农村土地市场参与的实证证据

10.1111/cjag.70021.abstract: In Naylor, Deaton, and Ker (2025), we discuss an appropriate econometric method for estimating the pass‐through of the Nutrition North subsidy in the presence of heterogeneous effects and endogenous sampling. Applying this method to the data set compiled by Galloway and Li (2023), who conclude that there is “large leakage” of the subsidy, we fail to find evidence that supports their conclusion. After our paper was published, Galloway and Li published both a corrigendum to their 2023 article and a comment to our paper based on that corrigendum. In their comment, Galloway and Li (2026) claim that after “minor but easily justified” changes to their original data, our econometric approach leads to either imprecise or incomplete estimates of pass‐through. In our response we show that: (i) Galloway and Li (2026) choose a classification of market structure that differs from the one recommended by federal government officials and from the classification they themselves use in their most recent work, including Galloway and Li (2025b) and Li, Daley, and Watson (2025); (ii) the classification structure consistent with the recommendations of federal government officials and their aforementioned research supports full pass‐through; (iii) Galloway and Li's (2026) removal of 75% of the original sample is not minor; and (iv) Galloway and Li's (2026) repeated emphasis on sub‐sampling, robustness, and statistical power is incomplete and thus misleading. Importantly, our response emphasizes that the correct econometric approach does not turn on whether one can selectively find a data set in which the empirical estimate of pass‐through changes.
10.1111/cjag.70021.abstract_zh: 在Naylor、Deaton与Ker（2025）的研究中，我们探讨了在存在异质性效应与内生抽样条件下，估算“营养北方”补贴传导效应的适当计量方法。将该方法应用于Galloway与Li（2023）编制的数据集（该研究得出补贴存在“大量渗漏”的结论）后，我们未能发现支持其结论的证据。论文发表后，Galloway与Li针对其2023年文章发布了勘误，并基于该勘误对我们的论文发表了评论。在评论中，Galloway与Li（2026）声称，对其原始数据进行“微小但易于论证”的调整后，我们的计量方法对传导效应的估算要么不精确，要么不完整。我们的回应表明：（i）Galloway与Li（2026）选择的市场结构分类，既不同于联邦政府官员推荐的分类标准，也不同于其自身最新研究（包括Galloway与Li（2025b）及Li、Daley与Watson（2025））所使用的分类；（ii）与联邦政府官员建议及上述研究一致的分类结构支持完全传导效应；（iii）Galloway与Li（2026）剔除75%原始样本的做法并非“微小调整”；（iv）Galloway与Li（2026）反复强调子样本分析、稳健性与统计功效的做法不完整且具有误导性。重要的是，我们的回应强调：正确的计量方法并不取决于能否选择性找到传导效应实证估计值发生变化的数据集。
10.1111/cjag.70021.title: Reply to Comment on “On the pass‐through rate of the Nutrition North Canada subsidy”
10.1111/cjag.70021.title_zh: 回复《关于加拿大北部营养补贴传导率的评论》

10.1111/cjag.70022.abstract: Naylor, Deaton and Ker provide estimates of Nutrition North Canada subsidy pass‐through using data we collected and an identification strategy we devised. They propose an alternative econometric specification based on estimating passthrough for separate monopoly and non‐monopoly sub‐samples and aggregating the coefficients using subsidy share weights. They argue that this specification is more appropriate for estimating overall subsidy pass‐through and conclude that its application to our data provides evidence for full subsidy pass‐through. We show that their conclusions are not warranted by making two distinct but related points. First, we show that conclusions based on their specification are not robust to two changes in the estimating sample. Correcting two subsidy assignment and one monopoly classification error in the original data set, or using a time period more relevant for comparing heterogeneous effects across monopoly and non‐monopoly communities, leads to estimates that either reinforce our original finding of incomplete passthrough or that are too imprecise to be informative. Second, we provide a graphical illustration and power calculation to make a more general point about the appropriateness and limitations of the type of sub‐sample analysis they propose in settings with limited sample size and statistical power.
10.1111/cjag.70022.abstract_zh: Naylor、Deaton和Ker利用我们收集的数据及我们设计的识别策略，估算了“营养北方加拿大”补贴的传导效应。他们提出了一种替代性计量模型，基于对垄断与非垄断子样本分别估算传导效应，并通过补贴份额权重对系数进行加总。他们认为该模型更适合估算整体补贴传导效应，并据此得出结论：将该模型应用于我们的数据可证明补贴完全传导。我们通过两个独立但相关的论点表明，其结论缺乏依据。第一，我们证明其模型结论对估算样本的两项调整缺乏稳健性。修正原始数据集中的两项补贴分配错误和一项垄断分类错误，或采用更适用于比较垄断与非垄断社区异质性效应的时段，所得估算结果要么强化了我们最初关于不完全传导的发现，要么因精度过低而无法提供有效信息。第二，我们通过图形说明和统计功效计算，就其在样本量有限且统计功效不足的背景下所提出的子样本分析方法的适用性与局限性，提出更一般性的观点。
10.1111/cjag.70022.title: Comment on “On the pass‐through rate of the Nutrition North Canada subsidy”
10.1111/cjag.70022.title_zh: 对“加拿大北方营养补贴传导率”一文的评论

10.1111/ecca.70053.abstract: Regular exercise offers well‐documented health benefits, and mobile applications are increasingly used to promote physical activity. In this study, we conduct a large‐scale randomized controlled trial with 20,187 users of the WeWard app in France to evaluate the effectiveness of different message framings and intervention durations on app engagement and walking behaviour. Participants were randomly assigned to receive one of three types of messages, each leveraging distinct behavioural features such as peer comparison, self‐comparison or a generic reminder, over a period of one or three weeks. Our results show that peer‐comparison messages positively influence the extensive margin of app utilization. However, despite these increases in app usage, neither type of message led to a significant increase in the number of steps walked. These findings highlight the limitations of relying on engagement metrics alone when evaluating app‐based interventions aimed at behaviour change.
10.1111/ecca.70053.abstract_zh: 规律运动对健康有明确益处，而移动应用程序正越来越多地被用于促进体育活动。本研究在法国WeWard应用的20,187名用户中开展大规模随机对照试验，评估不同信息框架和干预时长对应用参与度及步行行为的影响。参与者被随机分配接收三种类型的信息（分别利用同伴比较、自我比较或通用提醒等不同行为特征），干预周期为一周或三周。结果显示，同伴比较信息对应用使用的广延边际产生正向影响。然而，尽管应用使用频率有所提升，但各类信息均未显著增加步行步数。这些发现揭示了在评估基于应用的行为改变干预措施时，仅依赖参与度指标的局限性。
10.1111/ecca.70053.title: Step into action: how reminders shape engagement in fitness apps
10.1111/ecca.70053.title_zh: 步入行动：提醒如何塑造健身应用中的用户参与度

10.1111/ecca.70054.abstract: We examine how changes in task content over time condition occupational wage development. Using survey data from Germany, we document substantial heterogeneity in within‐occupation changes in task content. Combining this evidence with administrative data on individual employment outcomes over a 25‐year period, we find important heterogeneity in wage penalties amongst jobs that were initially routine‐task‐intensive. While occupations that remain (relatively) routine‐intensive generate substantial wage penalties, occupations with a decreasing routine intensity experience stable or even increasing wages. These findings suggest that changing task profiles of occupations is an important adaptation mechanism to technological change. They cannot be explained by composition or cohort effects.
10.1111/ecca.70054.abstract_zh: 本文考察了任务内容随时间的变化如何影响职业工资发展。利用德国调查数据，我们记录了职业内部任务内容变化的显著异质性。结合25年间个体就业结果的行政数据，我们发现初始常规任务密集型岗位的工资惩罚存在重要异质性。那些保持（相对）常规密集型的职业会产生显著的工资惩罚，而常规强度下降的职业则经历工资稳定甚至增长。这些发现表明，职业任务特征的改变是应对技术变革的重要适应机制，且无法通过构成效应或队列效应加以解释。
10.1111/ecca.70054.title: How important are within‐occupation task changes for wage growth? Evidence from administrative micro data
10.1111/ecca.70054.title_zh: 职业内任务变化对工资增长的重要性：基于行政微观数据的证据

10.1111/ecca.70055.abstract: Researchers have sought to quantify the extent of inequality that is inherited from previous generations or factors that are predetermined at birth in multiple ways, including a large body of work on intergenerational mobility and inequality of opportunity. Many of the most frequently used approaches to measuring mobility or inequality of opportunity fit within a general framework that involves, as a first step, an estimation of the extent to which inherited personal characteristics can predict current incomes. We suggest a new approach, within that broad framework, that is sensitive to differences across the entire conditional distributions of relevant population subgroups, rather than just in their means. Sensitivity to differences in higher moments of the conditional distributions allows for a comprehensive assessment of inherited inequality. We apply this approach to household income distributions in China, India, South Africa and the USA, to illustrate how the method performs in different settings. We find that inherited inequality accounts for large shares of total inequality, from 36% in the USA to 59% in China, 62% in India, and 81% in South Africa.
10.1111/ecca.70055.abstract_zh: 研究者们通过多种方式试图量化代际传承或出生前既定因素所导致的不平等程度，其中包括大量关于代际流动与机会不平等的研究。许多最常用的流动性与机会不平等测量方法均适用于一个通用框架：该框架的第一步是评估先天个人特征对当前收入的预测能力。我们在此框架内提出一种新方法，该方法关注相关人口子群体整个条件分布（而非仅均值）的差异。对条件分布高阶矩差异的敏感性，使我们能够全面评估继承性不平等。我们将该方法应用于中国、印度、南非和美国家庭收入分布数据，以展示该方法在不同情境下的表现。研究发现，继承性不平等占总不平等的比重从美国的36%到中国的59%、印度的62%以及南非的81%不等。
10.1111/ecca.70055.title:
Inherited inequality and the distribution of opportunities in the
                    <scp>USA</scp>
                    , China, India and South Africa
10.1111/ecca.70055.title_zh: 继承性不平等与美国、中国、印度和南非的机会分布

10.1111/ecca.70057.abstract: Anton Chekhov's story ‘The ninny’ meets the question: ‘What is the meaning of economic theory?’
10.1111/ecca.70057.abstract_zh: 安东·契诃夫的小说《傻瓜》与这样一个问题相遇：“经济理论的意义是什么？
10.1111/ecca.70057.title: A ninny, an idiot and an economic theorist
10.1111/ecca.70057.title_zh: 一个傻瓜、一个白痴与一位经济理论家

10.1111/ecca.70058.abstract: How individuals make trade‐offs between socially proximate or distant groups impacts upon a wide range of social, political and economic behaviours. This paper exploits Norwegian administrative register data over the 2012–2022 period to assess whether, and if so how, such ‘(moral) universalism’ develops as individuals age and go through major life events. We show that ageing is associated with increases in universalism in early adulthood and declining universalism among older individuals, but the magnitude of these changes remains very small. Similarly, major life events—such as starting higher education, first‐time parenthood, positive income shocks and retirement—are linked to at best minor and short‐lived changes in universalism. These results add important insights regarding the (in)stability of individuals' value orientations during adulthood, and raise new questions about the potential influence of broader social forces on universalism across cohorts.
10.1111/ecca.70058.abstract_zh: 个体如何在社交亲近或疏远群体之间进行权衡，会影响广泛的社会、政治和经济行为。本文利用挪威2012-2022年期间的行政登记数据，评估这种“（道德）普遍主义”是否会随年龄增长及经历重大人生事件而发生变化，以及如何变化。我们发现，年龄增长与成年早期普遍主义的上升及老年个体普遍主义的下降相关，但这些变化的幅度非常微小。同样，重大人生事件——如开始接受高等教育、首次成为父母、正向收入冲击及退休——最多仅与普遍主义的微小且短暂变化相关。这些结果为了解成年期个体价值取向的（不）稳定性提供了重要见解，并引发了关于更广泛社会力量对不同世代普遍主义潜在影响的新问题。
10.1111/ecca.70058.title: Universalism: an 11‐year longitudinal study
10.1111/ecca.70058.title_zh: 普遍主义：一项11年纵向研究

10.1111/ecca.70059.abstract: It is well‐known that the wealthier are less likely to have Left‐leaning political preferences. In addition, we consider here the role of the individual's starting position, and in particular their upward social mobility relative to their parents. In 18 waves of UK panel data, both own and parental social status are independently negatively associated with Left‐leaning voting and political preferences; given their own social status, the upwardly mobile are therefore more Left‐wing. We replicate these findings using US data, and show that in both countries, the choice of specification when controlling for the respondent's own current status is crucial and may explain some of the mixed findings on mobility and political preferences in the existing literature.
10.1111/ecca.70059.abstract_zh: 众所周知，财富水平较高者持有左翼政治偏好的可能性较低。此外，本文进一步考察了个体初始社会地位的作用，特别是其相对于父母的向上社会流动性。基于英国18轮面板数据，个人自身社会地位与父母社会地位均与左翼投票倾向及政治偏好呈独立负相关关系；在控制自身社会地位后，向上流动者反而表现出更强的左翼倾向。我们利用美国数据复现了上述发现，并表明在两国样本中，控制受访者当前自身社会地位时的模型设定选择至关重要，这或可解释现有文献中关于社会流动性与政治偏好关系的部分矛盾结论。
10.1111/ecca.70059.title: Are the upwardly mobile more Left‐wing?

10.1111/ecca.70060.abstract: This paper investigates the impact of creativity on technological advancement, long‐term economic development, and social welfare, where creativity is determined endogenously through interactions within social networks. The analysis shows that an economy remains stagnant, exhibiting neither networking nor long‐term growth, when the size of the creative class falls below a positive threshold. Once this threshold is exceeded, active networking between creative and non‐creative individuals emerges, fostering sustained technological progress and income growth. The model is calibrated and used to simulate the transition from stagnation to sustained growth. The results indicate meaningful welfare gains from such a transition, driven by the cumulative effects of technological progress facilitated by networking.
10.1111/ecca.70060.abstract_zh: 本文研究了创造力对技术进步、长期经济发展及社会福利的影响，其中创造力通过社会网络内部的互动内生决定。分析表明，当创意阶层规模低于某个正阈值时，经济将陷入停滞，既无网络互动也无长期增长。一旦超过该阈值，创意与非创意个体之间将形成活跃的网络互动，从而推动持续的技术进步与收入增长。本文对模型进行了校准，并用于模拟从停滞到持续增长的转型过程。结果表明，这种转型能带来显著的福利提升，其驱动力源于网络互动所促进的技术进步的累积效应。
10.1111/ecca.70060.title: Creative‐class dynamics, technological evolution and growth
10.1111/ecca.70060.title_zh: 创意阶层动态、技术演进与经济增长

10.1111/ecca.70061.abstract: I argue that economists' distinction between ‘pure’ and ‘applied’ economic theory is often based on papers' stylistic markers rather than their methodology or scope. I illustrate this point with a model of price competition for boundedly rational consumers, due to Piccione and Spiegler. I first present its original, ‘pure style’ version. I then offer several ‘applied style’ modifications, and speculate how audiences would react to the various versions.
10.1111/ecca.70061.abstract_zh: 我认为，经济学家对“纯”经济理论与“应用”经济理论的区分，往往基于论文的风格标记而非其方法论或范围。我以Piccione和Spiegler提出的有限理性消费者价格竞争模型为例说明这一点。首先呈现其原始的“纯风格”版本，随后提出若干“应用风格”的修改，并推测受众对不同版本的反应。
10.1111/ecca.70061.title: Applied theory makeovers

10.1111/ecca.70062.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Pathogen‐stress and terror‐management theories predict that lethal epidemics heighten parochial cooperation. We test this prediction experimentally in two nationally representative US samples surveyed before and at the onset of the COVID‐19 pandemic. We compare trust and expected trustworthiness across the two waves in monetarily incentivized trust games involving non‐Hispanic Whites, African Americans and Hispanics. We find significant ingroup favouritism in both waves. However, the aggregate ingroup premium fell by about one‐half between waves. This decline was concentrated among left‐leaning and moderate respondents. While non‐Hispanic Whites tended to reduce their ingroup bias in expected trustworthiness, the opposite was found for African Americans. Respondents more exposed to COVID‐19 displayed higher intergroup trust, altruism and expected trustworthiness than others. These results contradict the hypothesis that lethal epidemics intensify parochialism, also suggesting that the response may be diversified across groups.</jats:p>
10.1111/ecca.70062.abstract_zh:
<jats:title>摘要</jats:title>
<jats:p>病原体应激与恐怖管理理论预测，致命性流行病会加剧群体内合作。我们通过两项具有全国代表性的美国样本（分别在COVID-19疫情爆发前后进行调查）对这一预测进行了实验检验。我们比较了涉及非西班牙裔白人、非洲裔美国人和西班牙裔的货币激励信任博弈中两轮调查的信任与预期可信度。研究发现两轮调查均存在显著的群体内偏袒现象。然而，群体内溢价的总量在两轮调查间下降了约一半，这一下降主要集中在左倾和温和派受访者中。非西班牙裔白人倾向于降低其在预期可信度方面的群体内偏见，而非洲裔美国人则呈现相反趋势。相较于其他受访者，更易接触COVID-19的受访者表现出更高的群体间信任、利他主义和预期可信度。这些结果与致命性流行病会加剧群体内偏见的假设相矛盾，同时表明不同群体的反应可能存在差异。</jats:p>
10.1111/ecca.70062.title: Did the outbreak of COVID‐19 and individual exposure to it increase ingroup bias in the USA? An experimental investigation of interethnic trust
10.1111/ecca.70062.title_zh: COVID-19疫情爆发及个体暴露程度是否加剧了美国的内群体偏见？一项关于族裔间信任的实验研究

10.1111/ecca.70063.abstract: Abstract Meritocratic systems are commonly understood as those that assign tasks to individuals who can best perform them. But future performance is not known prior to assignment, and must be inferred from other traits. We consider a model in which performance depends on two attributes—ability and training—where ability is endowed and unobserved, and training is acquired and observed. The potential to acquire training depends on ability and resource access, so ability affects performance through two channels: indirectly through training, and directly through the performance function. The population consists of two groups, each with the same ability distribution, but with differential access to resources. We show that performance‐maximizing allocations are not necessarily group‐blind or monotonic in training, and can involve greater representation of groups with lower resource access than would arise if the only criteria for selection were past performance. If policies are constrained to be monotonic due to the possibility of strategic applicant behaviour, then these representation effects can be mitigated or amplified, depending on the fraction of the population that is selected.
10.1111/ecca.70063.abstract_zh: 摘要 精英体制通常被理解为将任务分配给最能胜任者的制度。但未来表现无法在分配前预知，必须通过其他特征推断。我们构建了一个模型，其中表现取决于两种属性——能力与训练——能力是先天赋予且不可观测的，训练是后天获得且可观测的。获得训练的潜力取决于能力与资源获取渠道，因此能力通过两条渠道影响表现：间接通过训练，直接通过表现函数。人口由两个群体组成，每个群体具有相同的能力分布，但资源获取渠道存在差异。研究表明，表现最大化分配未必是群体盲视的或关于训练单调的，且可能使资源获取较少的群体获得比仅以过往表现为唯一选拔标准时更高的代表性。若因策略性申请者行为的存在而需对政策施加单调性约束，则这些代表性效应可能被削弱或放大，具体取决于被选拔人口的比例。
10.1111/ecca.70063.title: Meritocracy in the face of group inequality
10.1111/ecca.70063.title_zh: 群体不平等面前的精英统治

10.1111/ecca.70064.abstract: Abstract We estimate the trade and income effects of regulatory developments concerning standard‐like non‐tariff measures (NTMs) over 2012–2017 combining structural gravity estimates and general equilibrium projections. The trade cost effects of regulatory changes vary at the country‐pair level and across sectors. Overall, NTM‐related regulatory changes over 2012–2017 increased trade costs in goods, which reduced global trade by 1.2%. The majority of this reduction corresponds to a decline in goods trade equivalent to about 40% of the actual worldwide decrease of nominal goods trade over this period. Yet the implied reduction of real income is small. We highlight significant variation of these effects at the country and sector level, and show that excluding pair‐specific trade frictions and third‐country effects introduces omitted variable bias. Our findings imply that advances in international coordination of technical regulation can further reduce trade frictions and enhance trade and real income.
10.1111/ecca.70064.abstract_zh: 摘要 本文结合结构引力估计与一般均衡预测，评估了2012–2017年间标准类非关税措施监管变化对贸易和收入的影响。监管变化的贸易成本效应在国家-行业层面存在异质性。总体而言，2012–2017年间与非关税措施相关的监管变化提高了商品贸易成本，导致全球贸易下降1.2%。这一降幅中，大部分对应商品贸易的减少量，约占同期全球名义商品贸易实际下降幅度的40%。然而，由此导致的实际收入下降幅度较小。我们强调这些效应在国家与行业层面存在显著差异，并表明忽略国家-行业特定贸易摩擦及第三国效应会引入遗漏变量偏误。研究结果表明，技术监管国际协调的进展可进一步减少贸易摩擦，促进贸易与实际收入增长。
10.1111/ecca.70064.title: General equilibrium effects of technical non‐tariff measures: evidence from bilateral trade cost estimates
10.1111/ecca.70064.title_zh: 技术性非关税措施的一般均衡效应：基于双边贸易成本估计的证据

10.1111/ecca.70065.abstract: Abstract This paper examines the implications of the EU–UK Trade and Cooperation Agreement (TCA) using a dynamic spatial general equilibrium model. Unlike previous studies that primarily projected potential impacts of Brexit based on uncertain scenarios, this analysis introduces new estimates of tariffs and non‐tariff measures specified by the TCA. The findings show that while the TCA will necessitate substantial adjustments for some sectors, Brexit will not fundamentally alter the overall structure of the UK economy. However, the main impacts will manifest as significant hits to real wages and productivity, exacerbating the long‐standing economic challenges faced by the UK.
10.1111/ecca.70065.abstract_zh: 摘要 本文运用动态空间一般均衡模型，评估了欧盟-英国贸易与合作协定（TCA）的经济影响。与以往主要基于不确定情景预测英国脱欧潜在影响的研究不同，本文引入了TCA所规定的关税与非关税措施的最新估算。研究结果表明，尽管TCA将迫使部分行业进行重大调整，但英国脱欧并不会从根本上改变英国经济的整体结构。然而，其主要影响将体现为实际工资与生产率的显著下降，从而加剧英国长期面临的经济挑战。
10.1111/ecca.70065.title: Counting the costs: a quantitative assessment of the effects of Brexit on UK regions and sectors
10.1111/ecca.70065.title_zh: 量化成本：英国脱欧对英国各地区和行业影响的定量评估

10.1111/ecca.70066.abstract: <jats:p>We examine the unintended effects of gender‐based hiring quotas on task allocation and organizational performance using a controlled laboratory experiment designed to mirror team formation and delegation decisions. Participants in the role of employers selected workers and assigned them to either simple or challenging tasks, where performance determined firm earnings. In the absence of quotas, high‐ability women were less likely than their male counterparts to be hired or assigned to high‐responsibility tasks. Imposing a 50% gender quota increased overall female representation and their access to complex tasks, but did not improve outcomes for high‐performing women, who remain relatively less likely to be assigned to high‐responsibility tasks compared to comparable men. Moreover, firm performance declined under the quota due to weaker alignment between worker ability and task assignment. These findings suggest that while quotas enhance representational equity, they may unintentionally reduce efficiency when organizational processes fail to support merit‐based allocation—offering important implications for the design of equity‐enhancing labour market policies.</jats:p>
10.1111/ecca.70066.abstract_zh: 我们通过一项受控实验室实验，研究了基于性别的招聘配额对任务分配和组织绩效的非预期影响。该实验旨在模拟团队组建和授权决策。扮演雇主的参与者选择工人，并将其分配到简单或具有挑战性的任务中，任务表现决定企业收益。在没有配额的情况下，高能力女性被雇佣或分配到高责任任务的可能性低于同等能力的男性。实施50%的性别配额提高了女性的整体代表性及其接触复杂任务的机会，但并未改善高绩效女性的结果——与同等能力的男性相比，她们被分配到高责任任务的可能性仍然相对较低。此外，由于工人能力与任务分配之间的匹配度减弱，配额下的企业绩效出现下降。这些发现表明，虽然配额增强了代表性公平，但当组织流程未能支持基于能力的分配时，它们可能无意中降低效率——这对设计促进公平的劳动力市场政策具有重要启示。
10.1111/ecca.70066.title: Unintended effects of gender quotas on task assignment and firm performance
10.1111/ecca.70066.title_zh: 性别配额对任务分配和企业绩效的非预期影响

10.1111/ecin.70065.abstract: This paper provides a theoretical analysis of salary history bans, which prohibit firms from inquiring about applicants' prior wages. When salary histories are banned, firms cannot tailor their wage offers to the applicants' prior wages and thus offer the same wage to each group of workers. While this benefits relatively low earners, the wage gap between groups may widen. Salary history bans also affect (young) workers' behavior in initial negotiations, where they act less aggressively and demand lower wages. Finally, salary history bans are shown to reduce worker turnover, but to increase the hiring of younger workers.
10.1111/ecin.70065.abstract_zh: 本文对薪资历史禁令进行了理论分析，该禁令禁止企业询问求职者过往薪资。当薪资历史被禁止时，企业无法根据求职者的过往薪资定制工资报价，因此向每组工人提供相同的工资。虽然这有利于相对低收入者，但群体间的工资差距可能会扩大。薪资历史禁令还会影响（年轻）工人在初始谈判中的行为，使其表现得不那么激进，要求的工资也更低。最后，研究表明薪资历史禁令会降低工人流动率，但会增加年轻工人的雇佣。
10.1111/ecin.70065.title: The effects of salary history bans on wages, hiring, and wage gaps
10.1111/ecin.70065.title_zh: 薪资历史禁令对工资、招聘及工资差距的影响

10.1111/ecin.70066.abstract: We examine whether providing free school meals to all students causes changes in out‐of‐school suspensions for schools adopting those policies in the United States. Using updated data and modern difference‐in‐differences methods that account for staggered adoption, we show suspensions fall by approximately 10% in elementary schools and 6% in middle and high schools, with larger effects in schools that previously served fewer students eligible for free and reduced‐price meals in preadoption periods. These findings contrast with earlier null results, primarily due to better methods that account for staggered program adoption as opposed to the updated dataset.
10.1111/ecin.70066.abstract_zh: 本文考察了美国实施免费校餐政策后，该政策是否导致学校校外停学处分的变化。采用更新后的数据及考虑交错采纳的现代双重差分方法，我们发现小学停学率下降约10%，初中和高中下降约6%，且在政策实施前享受免费或减价餐食资格学生较少的学校中效果更为显著。这些发现与早期零结果形成对比，主要归因于采用更优方法处理交错采纳效应，而非数据更新本身。
10.1111/ecin.70066.title: Universal free meals and school suspensions
10.1111/ecin.70066.title_zh: 全民免费校餐与停学处分

10.1111/ecin.70067.abstract: This study systematically evaluates forecasting performance of 11 Dynamic Stochastic General Equilibrium (DSGE) and 2 Bayesian Vector Autoregression (BVAR) models during recessions and expansions in the US and the euro area. Results show that no single model dominates: parsimonious models perform well in stable periods and at short horizons, while richer DSGE specifications with financial frictions, flexible inflation targeting, or labor market dynamics improve forecasts during recessions. BVARs excel in interest rate forecasting, especially in expansions. Crisis‐specific extensions, such as COVID‐related shocks, yield temporary gains. Forecast accuracy depends on the economic state, variable, horizon, and evaluation metric, underscoring the need for a diversified, context‐dependent modeling toolkit.
10.1111/ecin.70067.abstract_zh: 本研究系统评估了11种动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）模型与2种贝叶斯向量自回归（BVAR）模型在美国和欧元区经济衰退与扩张期间的预测表现。结果表明，不存在单一主导模型：简约型模型在稳定时期及短期预测中表现良好，而包含金融摩擦、灵活通胀目标或劳动力市场动态的复杂DSGE模型则能改善衰退期的预测精度。BVAR模型在利率预测方面表现突出，尤其在扩张期。针对特定危机的扩展（如新冠疫情相关冲击）可带来短期预测增益。预测准确性取决于经济状态、变量类型、预测期限及评估指标，这凸显了构建多元化、情境依赖型建模工具集的必要性。
10.1111/ecin.70067.title: Macroeconomic forecasting during recessions and expansions in the US and the euro area
10.1111/ecin.70067.title_zh: 美国与欧元区经济衰退与扩张时期的宏观经济预测

10.1111/ecin.70068.abstract: This mixed‐method study undertakes a comprehensive inquiry of the public discourse on social media surrounding quantitative easing (QE) across the US, the UK, and the European Union. Utilizing a unique tweet dataset, we reveal the sentiment polarity toward QE policy to be strongly negative, at 71.27%, with positive sentiment a mere 4.25%. Distilling the negative QE sentiment, we identify prominent themes of “anti‐government,” “anti‐central bank,” “inequality,” “ineffectiveness,” “inflation,” and “asset inflation,” and demonstrate a longitudinal association between perceived inequality and asset price inflation with an anti‐establishment stance. We conclude with suggested central bank policy recommendations to restore and foster public trust.
10.1111/ecin.70068.abstract_zh: 本混合方法研究对美国、英国及欧盟社交媒体上围绕量化宽松（QE）的公共话语进行了全面探究。利用独特的推文数据集，我们发现公众对QE政策的情绪倾向强烈负面，占比71.27%，而正面情绪仅为4.25%。通过提炼负面QE情绪，我们识别出“反政府”、“反央行”、“不平等”、“无效性”、“通胀”及“资产通胀”等突出主题，并展示了感知不平等与资产价格通胀在纵向维度上与反建制立场之间的关联。最后，我们提出央行政策建议，以恢复并增进公众信任。
10.1111/ecin.70068.title: A qualitative assessment of quantitative easing sentiment
10.1111/ecin.70068.title_zh: 量化宽松情绪的定性评估

10.1111/ecin.70069.abstract: Emerging market and developing economies (EMDEs) can significantly improve their tax‐to‐GDP ratios by expanding the tax base and strengthening institutional quality. This paper develops a neoclassical growth model with heterogeneous agents‐ Ricardian and non‐Ricardian households‐to examine fiscal capacity using a Laffer curve framework. It highlights two key constraints in EMDEs: a large untaxed population‐including exempt and informally employed individuals, and institutional weakness reflected in tax evasion, poor audits, and weak compliance norms. Non‐Ricardians are untaxed; Ricardians may evade or pay taxes. Results show that raising tax rates alone is ineffective; broader compliance, limited exemptions, and institutional reforms are essential.
10.1111/ecin.70069.abstract_zh: 新兴市场和发展中经济体（EMDEs）可以通过扩大税基和加强制度质量显著提高其税收与GDP的比率。本文构建了一个包含异质性主体——李嘉图家庭与非李嘉图家庭的新古典增长模型，并运用拉弗曲线框架分析财政能力。研究重点揭示了EMDEs面临的两大制约因素：一是大量未纳税人口——包括免税群体和非正规就业者；二是制度薄弱问题，表现为逃税、审计不力及合规意识薄弱。非李嘉图家庭无需纳税，而李嘉图家庭可能选择逃税或正常纳税。研究结果表明，单纯提高税率效果有限，扩大税收遵从度、限制税收豁免及推进制度改革至关重要。
10.1111/ecin.70069.title: Improving tax revenues in the emerging markets: A Laffer curve analysis
10.1111/ecin.70069.title_zh: 新兴市场税收收入的提升：拉弗曲线分析

10.1111/ecin.70070.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This paper studies the impact of proxy advisors on shareholder decision‐making. We posit two assumptions: (i) the board is at least as well informed as any individual shareholder; (ii) shareholders can condition their information acquisition on the proxy advisor's (PA) recommendation. If only (i) holds, shareholders optimally rubber‐stamp the board's proposal and do not invest in private research. If (ii) additionally holds, disagreement between the board and the PA can trigger private information acquisition by some shareholders. We identify the conditions under which this mechanism restores value‐of‐information logic and improves the informational quality of shareholder voting outcomes.</jats:p>
10.1111/ecin.70070.abstract_zh:
<jats:title>摘要</jats:title>
<jats:p>本文研究代理顾问对股东决策的影响。我们提出两个假设：（i）董事会至少与任何单个股东拥有同等信息；（ii）股东可根据代理顾问（PA）的建议调整其信息获取行为。若仅满足假设（i），股东最优策略是盲目批准董事会提案，且不投入私人研究。若同时满足假设（ii），董事会与代理顾问之间的分歧可能触发部分股东获取私人信息。我们识别了该机制恢复信息价值逻辑并提升股东投票结果信息质量的条件。</jats:p>
10.1111/ecin.70070.title: When do proxy advisors improve corporate decisions?
10.1111/ecin.70070.title_zh: 代理顾问何时改善公司决策？

10.1111/ecin.70071.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This paper investigates how supply disruptions and economic slack affect the responsiveness of inflation to changes in aggregate demand. We propose and estimate a nonlinear Phillips curve, whereby the sensitivity of inflation to changes in demand varies with supply conditions and the amount of slack in the economy. We find evidence that supply disruptions and low unemployment both steepen the Phillips curve, thereby amplifying the inflationary effects of increased demand. Our results suggest that the effects of fiscal policy on inflation depend on the prevailing supply conditions and the level of unemployment in the economy.</jats:p>
10.1111/ecin.70071.abstract_zh: 本文研究了供给中断与经济松弛如何影响通胀对总需求变化的响应程度。我们提出并估计了一个非线性菲利普斯曲线，其中通胀对需求变化的敏感度随供给状况和经济中的松弛程度而变化。研究发现，供给中断和低失业率均会使菲利普斯曲线陡峭化，从而放大需求增加带来的通胀效应。结果表明，财政政策对通胀的影响取决于经济中当前的供给状况和失业水平。
10.1111/ecin.70071.title: Supply disruptions, economic slack, and the state‐dependent Phillips curve
10.1111/ecin.70071.title_zh: 供给中断、经济疲软与状态依赖型菲利普斯曲线

10.1111/ecin.70072.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We characterize the spillover effects of helicopter drops and optimal monetary policy in a tractable two‐country overlapping generations model with incomplete markets. As helicopter drops can affect the distribution of income across countries, they create room for redistribution policies which are particularly relevant when agents are heterogeneous and markets are incomplete. Under cooperation, central banks can implement the conditionally Pareto optimal allocation using helicopter drops (and suctions) to “lean against the wind.” In a non‐cooperative setting, helicopter drops exacerbate the incomplete markets' friction by making income more volatile. This paves the way for gains from cooperation.</jats:p>
10.1111/ecin.70072.abstract_zh: 摘要：本文在一个可处理的两国世代交叠模型（含不完全市场）中，刻画了直升机撒钱的溢出效应及最优货币政策。由于直升机撒钱可能影响国家间的收入分配，这为再分配政策创造了空间——当经济主体存在异质性且市场不完全时，此类政策尤为重要。在合作框架下，央行可通过直升机撒钱（及抽钱）实施条件帕累托最优配置，实现“逆风干预”。在非合作框架下，直升机撒钱会加剧收入波动，从而放大不完全市场的摩擦，这为合作收益的产生奠定了基础。
10.1111/ecin.70072.title: Helicopter drops in an open economy when markets are incomplete
10.1111/ecin.70072.title_zh: 不完全市场下开放经济中的直升机撒钱

10.1111/ecin.70073.abstract: This paper examines the economic impact of intellectual property rights in the context of complementary vertical innovation by firms in upstream and downstream industries. Empirical patterns suggest that industry downstreamness is associated with a greater relative importance of patents versus trade secrecy in firm appropriation strategies. Using a novel model of endogenous growth, I show that strengthening patent protection generates downstream‐biased technical change in most cases. The corresponding reallocation of resources creates distributional effects from patent policy that existing analysis do not account for. I examine the impact of these effects on economic growth, welfare, and optimal patent policy.
10.1111/ecin.70073.abstract_zh: 本文研究了上下游产业企业互补性垂直创新背景下知识产权的经济影响。实证模式表明，产业下游度与企业专利相对于商业秘密的运用策略重要性呈正相关。通过构建新型内生增长模型，本文论证了在多数情形下强化专利保护会引发偏向下游的技术变革。这种资源重新配置产生的专利政策分配效应，是现有分析尚未纳入考量的。本文进一步考察了这些效应对经济增长、社会福利及最优专利政策的影响。
10.1111/ecin.70073.title: Intellectual property rights and innovation in vertically related industries
10.1111/ecin.70073.title_zh: 知识产权与垂直相关产业中的创新

10.1111/ecin.70075.abstract: Abstract Zoning reform is increasingly advocated to redress unaffordable housing, but few real‐world examples demonstrate its efficacy. However, Auckland recently upzoned approximately three‐quarters of its residential land, precipitating a housing construction boom. We investigate whether the reform reduced housing costs, adopting a synthetic control method to estimate rental prices in Auckland under the counterfactual of no zoning change. Eight years after the reform, the synthetic control under our preferred empirical specification implies that rents decreased by 23% due to the reform. These findings are robust across a range of specifications and support the proposition that widespread upzoning can enhance housing affordability.
10.1111/ecin.70075.abstract_zh: 摘要  分区改革日益被倡导以解决住房负担能力问题，但很少有现实案例证明其有效性。然而，奥克兰最近对其约四分之三的住宅用地进行了重新分区，引发了住房建设热潮。我们采用合成控制法，在未发生分区变化的反事实情境下估算奥克兰的租金价格，以研究该改革是否降低了住房成本。改革实施八年后，我们偏好的实证设定下的合成控制结果表明，租金因改革下降了23%。这些发现在一系列设定下均保持稳健，并支持了广泛重新分区可提升住房可负担性的论点。
10.1111/ecin.70075.title: Can zoning reform reduce housing costs? Evidence from rents in Auckland
10.1111/ecin.70075.title_zh: 分区改革能否降低住房成本？来自奥克兰租金的证据

10.1111/ecin.70076.abstract: We study the effects of horizontal mergers on product quality in a bilateral bargaining environment. In our model, a competition‐reducing merger reduces equilibrium quality as long as the buyer's marginal rate of substitution of quality for price declines with price, holding quality constant. This condition is closely related to quality being a normal good. This result holds when price and quality are jointly negotiated, and it extends to a sequential setting in which sellers first choose quality and then bargain with buyers over price. We discuss applications to procurement and healthcare markets, as well as several extensions.
10.1111/ecin.70076.abstract_zh: 本文研究双边议价环境下横向并购对产品质量的影响。在我们的模型中，只要在质量不变的情况下，买方对质量与价格的边际替代率随价格下降而降低，那么减少竞争的并购就会降低均衡质量。这一条件与质量属于正常品密切相关。该结论在价格与质量联合谈判时成立，并可扩展至卖方先选择质量、再与买方就价格进行议价的序贯设定中。我们讨论了该结论在采购与医疗健康市场中的应用，并探讨了若干扩展情形。
10.1111/ecin.70076.title: Mergers when price and quality are set by bargaining
10.1111/ecin.70076.title_zh: 价格与质量由谈判决定时的并购

10.1111/ecin.70077.abstract: Exploiting variation in debt‐to‐income ratios across US counties at the onset of the Great Recession, we investigate the impact of debt exposure on suicide. We find that more indebted counties saw a significant rise in suicide rates, with effects double for men and triple among adults ages 40–64. These patterns align with financial responsibilities: men are primary borrowers on mortgages, and middle‐aged adults hold the most secured debt. The impact of debt on suicide behavior, with annual costs of several billion dollars, underscores the welfare implications of inflexible household debt instruments.
10.1111/ecin.70077.abstract_zh: 利用大衰退初期美国各县债务收入比的变化，我们研究了债务暴露对自杀行为的影响。研究发现，债务负担更重的县自杀率显著上升，其中男性自杀率增幅为女性两倍，40-64岁成年人自杀率增幅为其他年龄段三倍。这些模式与财务责任分布高度吻合：男性是抵押贷款的主要借款人，而中年人持有最多担保债务。债务对自杀行为的影响——每年造成数十亿美元的社会成本——凸显了缺乏灵活性的家庭债务工具对福利的深远影响。
10.1111/ecin.70077.title: Financial suicide: Debt and death across US counties during the Great Recession
10.1111/ecin.70077.title_zh: 金融自杀：大衰退期间美国各县的债务与死亡

10.1111/ecin.70078.abstract: This study presents an empirical investigation regarding the role of business dynamism (BD) in driving economic development. The results reveal that BD has an escape‐competition (positive) effect and the Schumpeterian (negative) effect on incumbent firms. Mechanism analysis indicates that market competition, innovation intensity, and knowledge spillover are the channels through which BD affects incumbent firms. Moreover, the impact of reallocation is heterogeneous among city's market entry barriers and enterprise type. A decomposition analysis demonstrates that the contribution of BD to incumbents' aggregate productivity growth exhibits a steady increase over time, and this decomposition result aligns with theoretical predictions.
10.1111/ecin.70078.abstract_zh: 本研究对商业活力（BD）在推动经济发展中的作用进行了实证分析。结果表明，商业活力对在位企业同时存在“逃离竞争”（正向）效应和熊彼特（负向）效应。机制分析表明，市场竞争、创新强度与知识溢出是商业活力影响在位企业的传导渠道。此外，资源再配置效应因城市市场进入壁垒和企业类型的不同而呈现异质性。分解分析显示，商业活力对在位企业全要素生产率增长的贡献随时间推移稳步提升，该分解结果与理论预测一致。
10.1111/ecin.70078.title: Business dynamism, reallocation, and growth: Evidence from China
10.1111/ecin.70078.title_zh: 商业活力、资源再配置与增长：来自中国的证据

10.1111/ecoj.12012.abstract: We build a model with financial imperfections and heterogeneous agents and analyse the effects of two types of fiscal policy: revenue‐neutral, intratemporal redistribution; and debt‐financed tax cuts, which we interpret as intertemporal redistribution. Under flexible prices, the two policies are either neutral or display effects that are at odds with the empirical evidence. With sticky prices, Ricardian equivalence always fails. A Robin Hood, revenue‐neutral redistribution to borrowers is expansionary on aggregate activity. A uniform, debt‐financed tax cut has a positive present‐value multiplier on consumption, stemming from intertemporal substitution by the savers, who hold the public debt.
10.1111/ecoj.12012.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含金融摩擦与异质性主体的模型，并分析了两种财政政策的效果：收入中性的期内再分配政策，以及以债务融资减税为代表的跨期再分配政策。在弹性价格条件下，这两种政策要么呈现中性，要么表现出与实证证据相悖的效应。而在粘性价格条件下，李嘉图等价始终失效。针对借款者的罗宾汉式收入中性再分配政策对总体经济活动具有扩张效应。统一实施的债务融资减税政策对消费产生正向现值乘数，这一效应源于持有公共债务的储蓄者的跨期替代行为。

10.1111/ehr.70119.abstract: Housework is central to feminist calls for recognition of women's work, economic histories explaining the sexual division of labour, and claims regarding the progressive role of scientific knowledge. Yet little is known about the time it actually took. We address this lacuna. We utilize British sources and find a substantial increase in the hours ordinary women spent on domestic labour between the late‐eighteenth and the mid‐twentieth centuries. We note the changing imperatives of state involvement and industrial development and explore how the additional domestic labour served the interests of state and employers as well as those of husbands and children.
10.1111/ehr.70119.abstract_zh: 家务劳动是女性主义呼吁承认女性工作、经济史解释性别劳动分工以及主张科学知识进步作用的核心议题。然而，关于家务劳动实际耗费的时间，我们知之甚少。本文旨在填补这一空白。我们利用英国史料发现，从18世纪末到20世纪中期，普通女性从事家务劳动的时间大幅增加。我们注意到国家干预与工业发展的不断变化的必要性，并探讨了额外家务劳动如何服务于国家、雇主以及丈夫和子女的利益。
10.1111/ehr.70119.title: ‘Elbow grease and yellow soap’: Housework time in working‐class households in late‐nineteenth and early twentieth‐century Britain
10.1111/ehr.70119.title_zh: 费力与黄皂”：19世纪末20世纪初英国工人阶级家庭的家务劳动时间

10.1111/ehr.70120.abstract: This paper investigates how kinship and professional networks shaped labour market outcomes in the guild‐based labour market of early modern Genoa. Using a newly constructed dataset of more than 8,000 apprenticeship contracts (1451–1530), I examine the extent to which family and guild connections influenced apprentices' chances of attaining mastership. Using a probabilistic record‐linkage strategy to reconstruct individual career trajectories, I show that apprentices embedded in kinship or guild networks were substantially more likely to become masters. These advantages operated through multiple channels, including shorter apprenticeship contracts and greater flexibility in training careers, and persisted even during periods of economic contraction, suggesting that apprenticeship in Genoa combined formally open access to training with strong informal mechanisms that structured advancement within skilled trades. The findings contribute to debates on the role of guilds and social networks in pre‐industrial labour markets, highlighting how institutions could simultaneously support skill formation and reproduce inequality.
10.1111/ehr.70120.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在近代早期热那亚的行会劳动力市场中，亲属关系与职业网络如何塑造劳动力市场结果。利用新构建的包含8000余份学徒契约（1451–1530年）的数据集，我考察了家庭与行会关系对学徒获得师傅资格的影响程度。通过采用概率性记录关联策略重建个体职业轨迹，我发现嵌入亲属或行会网络的学徒成为师傅的可能性显著更高。这些优势通过多种渠道发挥作用，包括更短的学徒契约期限和更灵活的职业培训路径，并且即使在经济收缩时期依然持续存在。这表明热那亚的学徒制度将正式开放的培训准入与塑造技能行业晋升路径的强有力非正式机制相结合。研究结论为关于前工业劳动力市场中行会与社会网络作用的讨论提供了新视角，揭示了制度如何同时支持技能形成并再生产不平等。
10.1111/ehr.70120.title: Networks paving the way: Apprenticeship, guilds, and access to mastership in early modern Genoa
10.1111/ehr.70120.title_zh: 网络铺路：近代早期热那亚的学徒制、行会与大师资格获取

10.1111/ehr.70121.abstract: We identify a new organizational form, the Managing Agency Business Group (MABG), demonstrating how agency houses used interlocking directorships to build groups on the basis of commercial and plantation expertise to access finance on London stock markets and local capital markets in the pre‐1914 rubber boom. MABG boards combined managerial and commercial expertise with access to financial resources. Such features, rather than membership of elite groups, effectively signalled new issue quality and explained the composition of board membership in the rubber industry, which represented a substantial proportion of initial public offerings in the decade before the First World War. The MABGs used a serial finance model, through which influential intermediaries embedded in commercial networks created managerial capacity in individual estates, which were then merged with other estates, floated on the stock market, consolidated into groups, and their returns securitized through the creation of investment trusts.
10.1111/ehr.70121.abstract_zh: 我们识别出一种新型组织形式——管理代理商业集团（MABG），揭示了代理行如何通过连锁董事制度，依托商业与种植园专业知识构建集团，从而在1914年前橡胶繁荣时期获取伦敦股票市场及本地资本市场的融资。MABG董事会将管理与商业专业知识与金融资源获取能力相结合。此类特征（而非精英集团成员身份）有效传递了新发行证券的质量信号，并解释了橡胶行业董事会构成的成因——该行业在第一次世界大战前十年间占首次公开募股相当大比例。MABG采用序列融资模式，通过嵌入商业网络的有影响力的中介机构，在单个种植园中创造管理能力，随后将这些种植园与其他种植园合并、在股票市场上市、整合为集团，并通过设立投资信托将其收益证券化。
10.1111/ehr.70121.title: Managing agency business groups, elite directors, and the rubber boom, 1897–1913
10.1111/ehr.70121.title_zh: 管理代理商业集团、精英董事与橡胶繁荣，1897–1913

10.1111/ehr.70122.abstract: In recent years economic inequality has become a major research topic in economic history. However, much remains to be done to complete our knowledge of long‐term distributive dynamics. This article highlights several promising avenues for future research, focusing on the preindustrial period. In particular, it identifies the main gaps that still need to be filled in reconstructions of wealth and income distributions; it argues for a closer interaction between scholars working on economic inequality and those working on historical gross domestic product (GDP); and it highlights socio‐economic mobility as a closely related, but much less explored, research area. Shifting the focus from inequality to mobility, and more generally considering how human agency helped shape the aggregate long‐term dynamics we observe, requires examining individual actors and their specific motivations more closely. This is especially true for the socio‐economic elites who, when faced with a perceived threat of status loss, could attempt to capture political institutions, thus securing their control over valuable public resources, whilst at the same time acting as ‘enemies of mobility’. The article also highlights how this kind of research speaks directly to current societal concerns.
10.1111/ehr.70122.abstract_zh: 近年来，经济不平等已成为经济史领域的重要研究课题。然而，关于长期分配动态的认知仍存在大量空白。本文聚焦前工业化时期，为未来研究指明了若干富有前景的方向。具体而言，本文识别了财富与收入分布重建中仍需填补的主要空白；主张研究经济不平等与历史国内生产总值（GDP）的学者应加强互动；并强调社会经济流动性是一个密切相关但研究尚不充分的领域。将研究重心从不平等转向流动性，并更广泛地思考人类能动性如何塑造我们所观察到的长期宏观动态，需要更深入地审视个体行为者及其特定动机。这一点对社会经济精英尤为关键——当面临地位丧失的威胁时，他们可能试图捕获政治制度以维持对公共资源的控制，同时充当"流动性的敌人"。本文还揭示了此类研究如何直接回应当前的社会关切。
10.1111/ehr.70122.title: Economic inequality and social mobility in preindustrial societies: What we know, what we don't (but should) know
10.1111/ehr.70122.title_zh: 前工业化社会的经济不平等与社会流动性：已知、未知（但应知）

10.1111/ehr.70123.abstract: Limited liability company legislation was introduced to the Cape Colony in 1861. An amendment in 1892 led to wider adoption, expanding and diversifying the capital market. Using novel data from the Cape Joint Stock Archive between 1892 and 1902, this paper examines who invested, where capital flowed, and how these patterns shaped firm outcomes across Southern Africa. We show the geographic breadth of the capital market, revealing how shareholders and company operations were dispersed far beyond the Cape. The depth measures shareholders' occupational diversity using Historical International Standard Classifications of Occupations (HISCO) and paid‐up capital. We find investor participation varied systematically by occupation, industry, and location. These preferences influenced firm survival and spatial organization. Shareholders invested at considerable distances from company operations or registered offices, facilitating early forms of managerial separation. Paid‐up capital, a proxy for shareholder depth, was associated with survival, with smaller firms exhibiting shorter lifespans. Formation and failure were closely tied to both local and external economic shocks, underscoring the integration of the Cape economy into wider business cycles. Finally, the Cape illustrates how early commercial law and the organization of private capital may have shaped longer‐run regional economic structures.
10.1111/ehr.70123.abstract_zh: 1861年，开普殖民地引入了有限责任公司立法。1892年的一项修正案推动了该制度的更广泛采用，从而扩大并丰富了资本市场。本文利用1892年至1902年间开普联合股票档案的新数据，考察了谁在投资、资本流向何处，以及这些模式如何影响南部非洲企业的经营成果。我们展示了资本市场的地理广度，揭示了股东和公司运营如何远远超出开普地区。通过历史国际标准职业分类（HISCO）和实缴资本，我们衡量了股东职业多样性的深度。研究发现，投资者的参与因职业、行业和地理位置而呈现系统性差异。这些偏好影响了企业的生存和空间组织。股东在距离公司运营或注册办事处相当远的地方进行投资，促进了早期形式的管理分离。实缴资本作为股东深度的代理变量，与企业的生存相关，规模较小的公司寿命较短。企业的成立与倒闭与本地及外部经济冲击密切相关，凸显了开普经济与更广泛商业周期的融合。最后，开普的案例表明，早期商业法和私人资本的组织方式可能塑造了长期区域经济结构。
10.1111/ehr.70123.title: The depth and breadth of capitalism at the Cape
10.1111/ehr.70123.title_zh: 开普地区资本主义的深度与广度

10.1111/ehr.70124.abstract: Substantial amounts of British capital flowed to Latin America during the first era of globalization. Companies financed by this capital were typically headquartered in the United Kingdom, but operated thousands of miles away. This paper asks how this geographic separation between governance and business activities affected the valuation of these firms. We show that companies headquartered in London and operating in Latin America did not outperform British companies, but were riskier. We find that the location of the headquarters played a more important role than the location of operations. Stock prices tended to fluctuate in line with other equities based in the United Kingdom, suggesting that they were still regarded as being, at least partially, British companies.
10.1111/ehr.70124.abstract_zh: 在第一次全球化时期，大量英国资本流入拉丁美洲。由这些资本资助的公司通常总部设在英国，但运营地点却在数千英里之外。本文探讨了这种治理与商业活动之间的地理分离如何影响这些公司的估值。我们发现，总部设在伦敦并在拉丁美洲运营的公司并未优于英国本土公司，但风险更高。研究结果表明，总部所在地比运营地点更为重要。这些公司的股价往往与英国其他股票同步波动，表明它们仍被视为至少部分属于英国公司。
10.1111/ehr.70124.title: Remote investing in Latin America, 1869–1929

10.1111/ehr.70125.abstract: This study analyses the records in the Cairo geniza , the distribution of Chinese ceramics, the reports of travellers (this is the best‐known, but least important, dataset), and the discussions of the Portuguese regarding how best to exploit pepper in the sixteenth and early seventeenth centuries. This is then set against what evidence there is from Kerala itself. It emerges that, despite the importance of pepper to the trading systems of the medieval period, the impact of that trade on Kerala was of relatively small importance. The Kerala economy was based on rice, and it remained so. The article therefore contributes to the growing historiography which stresses internal regional economies rather than external trading as the best guide for understanding pre‐modern development, as opposed to world‐systems theories, but it also aims to show in detail why it was that the pepper trade had relatively little impact on its producer region. Kerala was the only source of pepper for the whole Eurasian world until the late Middle Ages. This article argues that, despite the importance of pepper to the trading systems of the medieval period, the impact of that trade on Kerala was of relatively small importance, and discusses why.
10.1111/ehr.70125.abstract_zh: 本研究分析了开罗藏经库文献、中国陶瓷分布、旅行者报告（这是最知名但重要性最低的数据集），以及16至17世纪早期葡萄牙人关于如何最佳利用胡椒的讨论。随后将这些证据与喀拉拉邦本地的史料进行对照。研究发现，尽管胡椒在中世纪贸易体系中具有重要地位，但该贸易对喀拉拉邦的影响相对较小。喀拉拉邦的经济以稻米为基础，且始终如此。因此，本文为强调以区域内部经济而非外部贸易作为理解前现代发展最佳路径的史学新范式提供了佐证——这与世界体系理论形成对比；同时旨在详细阐释为何胡椒贸易对其产地影响甚微。喀拉拉邦直至中世纪末期仍是整个欧亚大陆唯一的胡椒产地。本文论证指出，尽管胡椒在中世纪贸易体系中举足轻重，但该贸易对喀拉拉邦的影响相对有限，并探讨了其成因。
10.1111/ehr.70125.title: The profits of pepper. Indian Ocean trade and the economy of Kerala, 800–1600
10.1111/ehr.70125.title_zh: 胡椒的利润：印度洋贸易与喀拉拉邦经济（800–1600年）

10.1111/ehr.70126.abstract: To persuade creditors to lend, cities in the Low Countries relied on a community responsibility system that made all citizens personally liable for public debt. This exposed itinerant citizens to significant risks: their merchandise could be confiscated by creditors, and they could even be imprisoned for debt. Although it is usually difficult to assess how such sanctions were enforced in practice, this study examines a unique account of a group of creditors actively pursuing repayment. Their principal debt collector was a monk of the Carthusian order who travelled tirelessly throughout the Lower Rhine region in search of inhabitants of the county of Holland. This monk‐turned‐bounty‐hunter primarily targeted merchants and their goods but also sought to seize financial instruments and real estate owned by Hollanders. Whilst existing literature emphasizes reputation‐based mechanisms to explain polities’ access to credit, this evidence suggests that sanction‐based mechanisms were equally important: reprisals proved effective in recovering debts. Considering that the community responsibility system exposed merchants to sanctions, its survival into the early modern period is quite striking. I argue that the creation of public debt secured political and economic privileges that cities valued more highly than the safety of their merchants.
10.1111/ehr.70126.abstract_zh: 为说服债权人放贷，低地国家的城市依赖一种社区责任制度，该制度使所有公民对公共债务承担个人责任。这使流动公民面临重大风险：他们的商品可能被债权人没收，甚至可能因债务而入狱。尽管通常难以评估此类制裁在实践中如何执行，但本研究考察了一组债权人积极追讨债务的独特案例。他们的主要收债人是一位加尔都西会修士，他不知疲倦地在下莱茵地区奔波，寻找荷兰郡的居民。这位转行做赏金猎人的修士主要针对商人及其货物，但也试图没收荷兰人持有的金融工具和不动产。现有文献强调基于声誉的机制来解释政体获得信贷的途径，但这一证据表明，基于制裁的机制同样重要：报复手段在追回债务方面被证明是有效的。考虑到社区责任制度使商人面临制裁，其存续至近代早期相当引人注目。我认为，公共债务的创造保障了城市高度重视的政治和经济特权，其重要性甚至超过商人的安全。
10.1111/ehr.70126.title: Hunting for Hollanders: The community responsibility system, trade sanctions, and public debt in the late‐medieval Low Countries
10.1111/ehr.70126.title_zh: 追寻荷兰人：中世纪晚期低地国家的社区责任体系、贸易制裁与公共债务

10.1111/ehr.70127.abstract: When studying French prices between 1938 and 1949, economists and historians face a paradox: whilst a vast black market shaped daily life, official indices recorded only state‐controlled prices. This article addresses the issue by introducing a new consumer price index that incorporates both official and black market prices. Drawing on extensive new data, it quantifies black market activity and estimates household reliance on it. As a result, the price dynamics have been considerably under‐evaluated between 1940 and 1944, and equally considerably over‐evaluated between 1944 and 1948. The index reshapes our understanding of price dynamics by challenging the common narrative that the Vichy regime successfully tamed wartime inflation whilst the postwar democratic regime failed to control it. Instead, the apparent postwar acceleration of inflation is revealed as a statistical illusion. Consequently, we show that real wages dropped dramatically during the German Occupation of France, which proves much more consistent with contemporary testimonies.
10.1111/ehr.70127.abstract_zh: 在研究1938年至1949年法国价格问题时，经济学家和历史学家面临一个悖论：尽管庞大的黑市塑造了日常生活，官方指数却仅记录国家管控价格。本文通过引入同时包含官方价格与黑市价格的新型消费者价格指数来解决这一问题。基于大量新数据，本文量化了黑市活动规模，并估算了家庭对其的依赖程度。研究结果表明，1940年至1944年间的价格动态被严重低估，而1944年至1948年间的价格动态则被严重高估。该指数通过挑战"维希政权成功抑制战时通胀，而战后民主政权却未能控制通胀"的普遍叙事，重塑了我们对价格动态的理解。事实上，战后通胀的明显加速被揭示为一种统计幻觉。据此，我们证明在德国占领法国期间，实际工资急剧下降，这与同时代证词高度吻合。
10.1111/ehr.70127.title: The many prices of war and occupation: Black markets and the cost‐of‐living index in France, 1938–1949
10.1111/ehr.70127.title_zh: 战争与占领的多重代价：法国黑市与生活成本指数（1938–1949）

10.1111/ehr.70128.abstract: This article provides the first systematic estimates of living standards in Al‐Andalus (the Muslim‐ruled Iberian Peninsula) in 950, 1000, and 1200. Drawing on prices and wages from legal documents and market regulation treatises, it reconstructs real wages and welfare ratios. The results indicate that living standards in Al‐Andalus during the tenth century were high in both absolute and comparative terms. Unskilled workers in Córdoba around 950 and 1000 attained welfare ratios comparable to those observed in Fatimid Egypt and the poorer parts of Europe before the nineteenth century. By 1200, real wages declined, particularly for skilled labour, reflecting rising prices and stagnant nominal wages. These findings are robust to alternative basket assumptions and are consistent with independent qualitative and quantitative evidence on welfare levels, urbanization, monetary capacity, and aggregate output. The article contributes to debates on the timing of the Great Divergence by documenting another episode of high living standards under non‐Western institutions.
10.1111/ehr.70128.abstract_zh: 本文首次系统估算了安达卢斯（穆斯林统治下的伊比利亚半岛）在公元950年、1000年和1200年的生活水平。基于法律文献和市场管理论著中的价格与工资数据，本文重建了实际工资与福利比率。结果表明，10世纪安达卢斯的生活水平在绝对和比较意义上均处于高位。公元950年和1000年前后，科尔多瓦的非熟练工人所获得的福利比率，与法蒂玛王朝时期的埃及以及19世纪前欧洲较贫困地区相当。到1200年，实际工资出现下降，尤其是熟练劳动力，这反映了物价上涨与名义工资停滞。这些发现在替代性消费篮子假设下依然稳健，并与关于福利水平、城市化、货币能力及总产出的独立定性与定量证据一致。本文通过记录非西方制度下另一个高生活水平的案例，为关于“大分流”时间节点的讨论提供了新证据。
10.1111/ehr.70128.title: The Golden Age of Al‐Andalus? Living standards in Muslim Iberia (950–1200)
10.1111/ehr.70128.title_zh: 安达卢斯的黄金时代？穆斯林伊比利亚的生活水平（950–1200）

10.1111/ehr.70129.abstract: This article uses the township‐level data on welfare expenditure and provision gathered by parish officers in England and Wales at three points between 1776 and 1815 to illuminate regional and local differences during the period. These data have been linked to geographic information system (GIS) mapping systems, facilitating the mapping of parish/township level welfare data across a wide range of variables. Appropriate linkage to the 1801 and 1811 census data and the 1815 income tax property valuations also permits new village‐level estimates of the prevalence, affordability, and typology of welfare provision. The results challenge current hypotheses about regional differences in how the Poor Law was administered.
10.1111/ehr.70129.abstract_zh: 本文利用1776年至1815年间英格兰与威尔士教区官员收集的三个时间点的乡镇级福利支出与供给数据，揭示该时期区域与地方差异。这些数据已与地理信息系统（GIS）制图系统关联，从而能够基于广泛变量绘制教区/乡镇级福利数据地图。通过将数据与1801年及1811年人口普查数据、1815年所得税财产估值进行适当关联，还可对福利供给的普及程度、可负担性及类型进行新的村级估算。研究结果对当前关于济贫法实施区域差异的假说提出了挑战。
10.1111/ehr.70129.title: Regional and local divergence in welfare provision in England and Wales, 1776–1815
10.1111/ehr.70129.title_zh: 1776-1815年英格兰与威尔士福利供给的区域与地方分化

10.1111/ehr.70130.abstract: We study the market for common white bread in the city of Toledo through a new 266‐year‐long series of bread prices, obtained from the cash purchases and wholesale bread‐for‐wheat contracts of large institutions. Our data are strongly consistent with fragmentary evidence on retail price regulation, as well as with shorter series from other regional markets, suggesting they can be considered representative of consumer bread costs for a broad area of New Castile. We show that, in different periods, Toledo's bread prices were substantially lower than two common series used in the comparative literature. We also explore the role of urban institutions in stabilizing prices. We econometrically demonstrate that Toledo's wheat price fluctuations were consistent with a 1‐year storage cycle, suggesting that urban supply management systems were effective at smoothing the extreme fluctuations in early modern harvest yields. The amount of bread in a respectability basket was generally within reach of urban wage earners up to 1750. Resurgent inflation and the breakdown in regulatory institutions resulted in a marked deterioration in the affordability of bread in the second half of the eighteenth century.
10.1111/ehr.70130.abstract_zh: 本文通过大型机构现金采购和面包换小麦批发合同，构建了长达266年的托莱多市普通白面包价格序列。该数据与零售价格管制的零散证据及其他区域市场的短序列高度吻合，表明其可代表新卡斯蒂利亚广大地区消费者面包成本。研究发现，在不同时期，托莱多的面包价格显著低于比较文献中常用的两种序列。我们还探讨了城市机构在稳定价格中的作用。计量分析表明，托莱多小麦价格波动符合一年期储存周期规律，说明城市供应管理系统有效平抑了近代早期收成产量的极端波动。直至1750年，城市工薪阶层基本能负担体面生活所需的面包量。但18世纪下半叶，通胀回升与监管体系瓦解导致面包可负担性显著恶化。
10.1111/ehr.70130.title: The bread of Toledo: Prices and political economy, 1535–1800
10.1111/ehr.70130.title_zh: 托莱多的面包：价格与政治经济学，1535–1800

10.1111/ehr.70131.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Using newly collected discount rate data for six Swiss cities from 1846 to 1893, we find no evidence of increasing integration during a 30‐year period of lightly regulated free banking. We attribute this to two structural issues: banks had incentives to ward off competitors by protecting their local monopolies or forming cartels, and there was always a risk (which varied across banks) that banknotes were not accepted or converted at par. We use a novel counterfactual to show that these issues increased discount rate dispersion, and argue that as a result, public regulation of payments infrastructure was necessary for money market integration.</jats:p>
10.1111/ehr.70131.abstract_zh: 摘要：利用1846至1893年间瑞士六座城市新收集的贴现率数据，我们发现在30年轻度监管的自由银行时期，市场一体化程度并未增强。我们将此归因于两个结构性问题：银行有动机通过保护本地垄断或组建卡特尔来抵御竞争对手，且始终存在银行券不被按面值接受或兑换的风险（该风险因银行而异）。我们采用新颖的反事实分析方法表明，这些问题加剧了贴现率离散程度，并据此论证：支付基础设施的公共监管对于货币市场一体化具有必要性。
10.1111/ehr.70131.title: Private money and money market integration: The role of payments infrastructure in nineteenth‐century Switzerland
10.1111/ehr.70131.title_zh: 私人货币与货币市场一体化：19世纪瑞士支付基础设施的作用

10.1111/ehr.70132.abstract: Why do elite families often maintain their social and economic status across generations? This paper examines the role of adoption in sustaining elite persistence in prewar Japan. Under the Japanese inheritance system, families without a biological son could adopt an heir to continue the family lineage and transfer assets and social status. Using novel father–heir linked data constructed from the Personnel Inquiry Records (1903–39), we compare elite outcomes between biological and adopted heirs. We find that adopted heirs were substantially more likely to remain elite and to reach the extreme upper tail of the income distribution than biological heirs. The results are robust to family, regional, occupational, and educational controls. Overall, the findings suggest that adoption functioned as an institutional mechanism that expanded the pool of potential successors beyond biological lineage, thereby strengthening intergenerational elite persistence in prewar Japan.
10.1111/ehr.70132.abstract_zh: 为何精英家族常能代际维持其社会经济地位？本文考察了收养制度在战前日本精英持续性中的作用。在日本继承制度下，无亲生儿子的家族可通过收养继承人延续家族血脉并转移资产与社会地位。利用《人事调查记录》（1903-1939年）构建的新型父子关联数据，我们比较了亲生继承人与收养继承人的精英地位结果。研究发现，收养继承人比亲生继承人更可能维持精英地位并进入收入分配的极端顶端。该结果在控制家庭、区域、职业及教育变量后依然稳健。总体而言，研究结果表明，收养作为一种制度机制，将潜在继承人的范围扩展至血缘关系之外，从而强化了战前日本的代际精英持续性。
10.1111/ehr.70132.title: Elite persistence in family: The role of adoption in prewar Japan
10.1111/ehr.70132.title_zh: 家族中的精英延续：战前日本收养制度的作用

10.1111/ehr.70133.abstract: Abstract Using existing and new price data sets, we provide the first estimates of market integration across England over the entire 200 years of the industrial revolution. We document a significant, though not huge, integration improvement for markets furthest from London. Full integration was achieved by the 1830s. Our price data sets vary in quality (type of average, price rounding, frequency of stale prices). We show that this severely biases some standard statistical tests of market integration, and we develop and implement new techniques to ensure valid inference. We discuss the application of these techniques to other historical data sets.
10.1111/ehr.70133.abstract_zh: 摘要 利用现有及新增的价格数据集，我们首次估算了工业革命整个200年间英格兰市场的整合程度。研究发现，距离伦敦最远的市场在整合方面取得了显著（尽管并非巨大）的改善。到19世纪30年代，市场已实现完全整合。我们的价格数据集在质量上存在差异（包括平均值类型、价格取整、陈旧价格频率）。我们证明，这些差异严重扭曲了某些市场整合的标准统计检验，并开发并实施了新技术以确保推断的有效性。我们还讨论了这些技术在其他历史数据集中的应用。
10.1111/ehr.70133.title: The big impact of small change: Fresh estimates of English wheat market integration, 1693–1893
10.1111/ehr.70133.title_zh: 小变化的巨大影响：英国小麦市场整合的新估计，1693–1893

10.1111/ehr.70134.abstract: Abstract Between 1807 and 1815, US imports of manufactured goods were slashed dramatically by a trade embargo, non‐importation measures, and the War of 1812. These disruptions are commonly believed to have promoted the growth of nascent domestic manufacturers and thereby spurred early US industrialization. This paper uses disaggregated data on US industrial production to investigate how this interruption of foreign competition affected domestic manufacturing. On balance, the trade disruptions did not accelerate US industrialization, as trend growth in industrial output was little changed over this period. However, the disruptions may have played a role in shifting resources, at least temporarily, from trade‐dependent industries (such as shipbuilding) to domestic infant industries (such as cotton textiles).
10.1111/ehr.70134.abstract_zh: 摘要 1807年至1815年间，贸易禁运、非进口措施及1812年战争导致美国制成品进口大幅削减。这些贸易中断通常被认为促进了新兴国内制造业的发展，从而推动了美国早期工业化。本文利用美国工业生产的细分数据，研究外国竞争的中断如何影响国内制造业。总体而言，贸易中断并未加速美国工业化，因为这一时期工业产出的趋势性增长几乎没有变化。然而，这些中断可能至少在短期内促使资源从依赖贸易的行业（如造船业）转向国内新兴行业（如棉纺织业）。
10.1111/ehr.70134.title: Trade disruptions and early US industrialization
10.1111/ehr.70134.title_zh: 贸易中断与美国早期工业化

10.1111/ehr.70138.abstract: Japan's regional convergence of productivity levels throughout the twentieth century can be best described as a cumulative process of ‘catching up, forging ahead, and falling behind’. Using a novel dataset spanning 135 years (1874–2008), this study finds support for a crucial role played by structural transformation in convergence. The pace of productivity catch‐up and convergence accelerated in the mid‐1950s with the help of structural transformation, particularly in the period from 1955 to 1965. Structural transformation explains, on average, about 30 per cent of the aggregate productivity growth, and its effect intensified in prefectures with faster movements of labour across sectors and larger sectoral productivity gaps. However, since the early 1970s, its contribution to the convergence was frequently offset by within‐sector productivity growth, in turn thwarting the pace of convergence. These counter‐balancing effects contributed to the diverse pathways of productivity catch‐up at the prefecture level.
10.1111/ehr.70138.abstract_zh: 20世纪日本各区域生产率水平的收敛过程，可被最恰当地描述为“追赶、领先与落后”的累积性进程。本研究利用覆盖135年（1874-2008年）的新数据集，发现结构转型在收敛过程中发挥了关键作用。20世纪50年代中期，在结构转型的推动下，生产率追赶与收敛速度显著加快，尤其在1955年至1965年期间。结构转型平均解释了约30%的总体生产率增长，且其效应在劳动力跨部门流动更快、部门间生产率差距更大的县级行政区中更为显著。然而自20世纪70年代初以来，结构转型对收敛的贡献常被部门内生产率增长所抵消，进而阻碍了收敛进程。这些相互抵消的效应导致了县级层面生产率追赶路径的多元化。
10.1111/ehr.70138.title: The role of structural transformation in regional convergence in Japan: 1874–2008
10.1111/ehr.70138.title_zh: 日本区域趋同中的结构转型作用：1874–2008

10.1111/iere.70064.abstract: Heterogeneous agent incomplete markets models offer a new perspective on price and inflation determination. In contrast to complete markets, the price level is determined from the asset‐market clearing condition. Fiscal and monetary policy then jointly and uniquely determine the finite steady‐state price level and the inflation rate, including in a steady state in which the nominal interest rate is constant. Fiscal policy can determine the long‐run inflation rate for a fiscal rule which sets the growth rate of nominal government debt, whereas both fiscal and monetary policy determine the long‐run inflation rate under different tax rules.
10.1111/iere.70064.abstract_zh: 异质性主体不完全市场模型为价格与通胀决定提供了新视角。与完全市场不同，价格水平由资产市场出清条件决定。财政与货币政策共同且唯一地决定了有限稳态价格水平与通胀率，包括名义利率保持不变的稳态情形。在设定名义政府债务增长率的财政规则下，财政政策可决定长期通胀率；而在不同税收规则下，财政与货币政策共同决定长期通胀率。
10.1111/iere.70064.title: A Demand Theory of the Price Level

10.1111/iere.70071.abstract: I study a novel two‐way feedback between credit and labor market frictions. Running from credit to labor markets, amplitude in capital demand caused by collateral constraints spills over onto labor demand due to the complementarity of capital and labor; and, furthermore, credit frictions raise effective financial hiring costs, prompting firms to delay hiring in recessions. Running back from labor to credit markets, search frictions imply that wages move less than one‐to‐one with productivity; this induces greater volatility of net worth, via the wage bill, which then spills over onto capital demand. Together, these considerably amplify labor and capital market dynamics.
10.1111/iere.70071.abstract_zh: 本文研究信贷摩擦与劳动力市场摩擦之间一种新颖的双向反馈机制。从信贷市场向劳动力市场的传导路径中，抵押约束引发的资本需求波动会通过资本与劳动的互补性溢出至劳动力需求；此外，信贷摩擦提高了有效金融雇佣成本，促使企业在经济衰退期延迟招聘。从劳动力市场向信贷市场的反向传导路径中，搜寻摩擦导致工资变动幅度小于生产率变动幅度，这通过工资账单渠道加剧了净值的波动性，进而溢出至资本需求。两种机制共同作用，显著放大了劳动力市场与资本市场的动态波动。
10.1111/iere.70071.title: The Interaction Between Credit and Labor Market Frictions
10.1111/iere.70071.title_zh: 信贷与劳动力市场摩擦的相互作用

10.1111/iere.70078.abstract: We investigate whether different criteria are used in evaluating male and female leaders when outcomes are determined by unobservable choices and luck. Evaluators form beliefs about leaders’ choices (perceived intentions) and make discretionary payments. We find that while payments to male leaders are determined by both outcomes and perceived intentions, those to female leaders are determined by outcomes only. We label this new source of gender bias as the gender criteria gap . Our findings imply that high outcomes are necessary for women to get bonuses, but men can receive bonuses for low outcomes if evaluators hold them in high regard.
10.1111/iere.70078.abstract_zh: 我们研究了当结果由不可观测的选择和运气决定时，评价男性与女性领导者是否采用不同标准。评价者会形成对领导者选择（感知意图）的信念，并据此进行酌情支付。研究发现，男性领导者的薪酬由结果和感知意图共同决定，而女性领导者的薪酬仅由结果决定。我们将这种新的性别偏见来源称为"性别标准差异"。研究结果表明，高绩效是女性获得奖金的必要条件，但若评价者对男性评价较高，即使其绩效较低，男性仍可获得奖金。
10.1111/iere.70078.title: Gender Criteria Gap in Evaluation: Role of Perceived Intentions and Outcomes
10.1111/iere.70078.title_zh: 评价中的性别标准差距：感知意图与结果的作用

10.1111/iere.70079.abstract: We analyze market entry efficiency in single‐ and two‐sector closed‐economy Melitz–Ottaviano (MO) models without an outside good. Comparing market and second‐best outcomes, we find that market entry is efficient in the single‐sector model. This efficiency also holds in a symmetric two‐sector setting. When sectors have asymmetric demand and the level of asymmetry is sufficiently small, the market yields excessive entry into the “high‐demand” sector. This inefficiency arises from the presence of an additional aggregator in MO preferences.
10.1111/iere.70079.abstract_zh: 本文分析了无外部商品的单部门与两部门封闭经济Melitz–Ottaviano（MO）模型中的市场进入效率。通过比较市场结果与次优结果，我们发现单部门模型中的市场进入是有效的。这一有效性在对称的两部门设定中同样成立。当部门间存在非对称需求且非对称程度足够小时，市场会导致“高需求”部门出现过度进入。这种无效率源于MO偏好中额外加总因子的存在。
10.1111/iere.70079.title: Entry and Welfare in General Equilibrium With Heterogeneous Firms and Endogenous Markups
10.1111/iere.70079.title_zh: 异质性企业与内生加成定价下的一般均衡进入与福利

10.1111/iere.70080.abstract: College loans facilitate access to education, but the repayment burden may distort posteducation human capital investment. We examine the role of college loans and loan repayment policies through a structural model of individuals' dynamic decisions on borrowing/saving, labor supply, and costly human capital investment. We estimate two versions of the model using data from NLSY79: one with natural borrowing limits and another with parameterized limits. Counterfactual simulations suggest that, relative to the standard fixed repayment plan, income‐driven repayment (IDR) plans modestly increase educational attainment, lifetime earnings, and individual welfare; accounting for lifetime income taxes, they also increase government revenue.
10.1111/iere.70080.abstract_zh: 大学贷款有助于促进教育机会获取，但还款负担可能扭曲毕业后的教育人力资本投资。我们通过构建个体在借贷/储蓄、劳动供给及有成本人力资本投资方面的动态决策结构模型，考察了大学贷款及贷款还款政策的作用机制。基于NLSY79数据，我们估计了两种模型版本：一种采用自然借贷约束，另一种采用参数化约束。反事实模拟表明，相较于标准固定还款计划，收入驱动型还款计划能适度提升教育成就、终身收入及个人福利；在考虑终身所得税后，该计划还能增加政府财政收入。
10.1111/iere.70080.title: College Loans and Human Capital Investment
10.1111/iere.70080.title_zh: 大学贷款与人力资本投资

10.1111/iere.70081.abstract: We develop a structural framework to identify the sources of cross‐state heterogeneity in response to U.S. tariff changes. A unilateral 25‐percentage‐point U.S. tariff increase across sectors induces consumption changes ranging from −0.8% in Oregon to 2.3% in Montana. This variation stems from the interaction between states' internal comparative advantage and the nation's external comparative advantage. Factor mobility lowers aggregate consumption and reshapes the cross‐state impacts by shifting resources toward more distorted states and sectors. Consequently, preferred tariff changes vary systematically across states, necessitating transfers to align regional policy incentives. Foreign retaliation reduces aggregate gains while perpetuating cross‐state variation.
10.1111/iere.70081.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个结构性框架，用以识别美国关税变化中各州异质性反应的来源。若美国对各行业统一加征25个百分点的关税，各州消费变化幅度从俄勒冈州的-0.8%到蒙大拿州的2.3%不等。这种差异源于各州内部比较优势与国家外部比较优势之间的相互作用。要素流动性通过将资源向扭曲程度更高的州和行业转移，降低了总体消费水平并重塑了跨州影响。因此，各州偏好的关税变化呈现系统性差异，需要通过转移支付来协调区域政策激励。外国报复性措施在减少总体收益的同时，进一步加剧了跨州差异。
10.1111/iere.70081.title: What Determines State Heterogeneity in Response to U.S. Tariff Changes?
10.1111/iere.70081.title_zh: 美国关税变化下各州异质性反应的决定因素是什么？

10.1111/iere.70082.abstract: We develop a rational, Walrasian model of speculative bubbles inspired by the Kindleberger–Minsky view, which describes bubbles as wave‐like market processes. Touched off by an initial shock, price booms are initially self‐reinforcing but become self‐destructive later when prices surpass fundamental value. Previous models in this vein have been criticized due to ad hoc features, such as prices driven by behavioral forces or particular trading protocols. Our model allays these concerns by relying only on multidimensional uncertainty to prevent unraveling via backward induction. Standard market clearing, moreover, makes the model more compatible with established macroeconomic and asset pricing frameworks.
10.1111/iere.70082.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个受金德尔伯格-明斯基观点启发的理性瓦尔拉斯投机泡沫模型，该模型将泡沫描述为波浪式的市场过程。在初始冲击触发下，价格繁荣初期呈现自我强化特征，但当价格超越基本面价值后则转向自我毁灭。此前同类模型因依赖行为因素驱动价格或特定交易规则等特设性设定而受到批评。我们的模型仅通过多维不确定性来防止逆向归纳导致的泡沫瓦解，从而缓解了这些担忧。此外，标准市场出清机制使该模型与既有的宏观经济和资产定价框架更具兼容性。
10.1111/iere.70082.title: Rational Expectations Fools' Bubbles
