The findings suggest that immigrant networks are especially relevant for ICT goods trade when cross‐border social and commercial ties connect destination markets to technologically capable home countries.</jats:p>
10.1111/twec.70124.abstract_zh: 信息与通信技术（ICT）产品是数字化转型、技术升级及参与全球生产网络的核心要素。然而，关于移民网络是否影响这类知识密集型产品的国际贸易，学界认知仍相对有限。本研究基于2000—2021年间172个国家的双边面板数据，采用引力模型设定、Tobit模型及线性固定效应模型对ICT产品贸易进行估计。结果显示，移民网络与ICT产品贸易（尤其是出口）之间存在显著正向统计关系。在控制生产能力后，出口关系仍保持正向，而进口关系则有所减弱。交互模型进一步表明，当移民母国具备更强的ICT出口能力时，移民网络与ICT产品贸易的关联性更为显著。边际效应估计显示，该关系通过贸易的扩展边际与集约边际共同发挥作用。研究结论表明，当跨境社会与商业联系将目的地市场与技术能力较强的母国相连接时，移民网络对ICT产品贸易具有特殊重要性。
10.1111/twec.70124.title:
Immigrant Networks, Productive Capacity and Trade in
                    ICT
                    Goods
10.1111/twec.70124.title_zh: 移民网络、生产能力与ICT产品贸易

10.1111/twec.70125.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>As globalization faces headwinds from rising geopolitical tensions, the interaction between international politics and trade has become increasingly complex. Moving beyond static gravity models, this paper examines the dynamic co‐evolution of international political relations and the global trade network. Using a Stochastic Actor‐Oriented Model (SAOM) on a dataset of 139 economies from 1996 to 2023, we model the global trade network as an endogenous and evolving system rather than a set of independent dyads. The results show that diplomatic proximity significantly increases the likelihood of trade‐tie formation, and that this effect strengthens markedly after 2016, approaching the explanatory importance of geographic distance. The estimates also reveal strong reciprocity and triadic closure in the trade network, indicating that trade ties emerge within clustered and path‐dependent structures. Overall, the findings suggest that the contemporary trade system is increasingly shaped by the interaction between geopolitical affinity and network embeddedness.</jats:p>
10.1111/twec.70125.abstract_zh: 随着地缘政治紧张局势加剧，全球化面临阻力，国际政治与贸易之间的互动日益复杂。本文超越静态引力模型，考察国际政治关系与全球贸易网络的动态共同演化。基于1996年至2023年139个经济体的数据集，采用随机行动者导向模型（SAOM），我们将全球贸易网络建模为一个内生且不断演化的系统，而非一组独立的双边关系。结果表明，外交亲近度显著提升了贸易联系形成的可能性，且这一效应在2016年后明显增强，其解释力接近地理距离。估计结果还揭示了贸易网络中强烈的互惠性和三角闭合性，表明贸易联系出现在具有聚类和路径依赖特征的结构中。总体而言，研究结果表明，当代贸易体系日益受到地缘政治亲和性与网络嵌入性之间互动的影响。
10.1111/twec.70125.title: The Dynamic Co‐Evolution of International Politics and the Global Trade Network: Evidence From a Stochastic Actor‐Oriented Model
10.1111/twec.70125.title_zh: 国际政治与全球贸易网络的动态共演化：来自随机行动者导向模型的证据

10.1111/twec.70126.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We study the impact of global value chain (GVC) participation on firms' innovation, productivity, and other indicators of technical change. Our dataset encompasses heterogeneous firms from 144 countries at different income levels over the period 2006–2025. Using difference‐in‐differences and matching strategies, we find that GVC participation leads to increased innovation and other technological improvements, with gains driven primarily at the extensive margin and by importing rather than exporting activities. Among innovation types, product innovation responds more strongly than process innovation. Importantly, the nature of innovation differs systematically across development levels: GVC participants in lower‐income countries benefit from access to foreign technology, while those operating in more advanced economies engage more in formal, R&D‐intensive innovation.</jats:p>
                  <jats:p>
                    <jats:bold>JEL Classification</jats:bold>
                    : C31, F14, F15, O31, O33
                  </jats:p>
10.1111/twec.70126.abstract_zh:
我们研究了全球价值链（GVC）参与对企业创新、生产率及其他技术变革指标的影响。数据集涵盖2006–2025年间来自144个不同收入水平国家的异质性企业。通过双重差分法和匹配策略，我们发现GVC参与促进了创新及其他技术进步，其收益主要源于集约边际，且进口活动的作用强于出口活动。在创新类型中，产品创新的响应程度强于流程创新。重要的是，创新性质在不同发展水平上呈现系统性差异：低收入国家的GVC参与者受益于外国技术获取，而发达经济体的企业则更多从事正式的、研发密集型创新。

JEL分类：C31, F14, F15, O31, O33
10.1111/twec.70126.title: Technical Change Through Global Value Chains: Evidence From Firms Worldwide
10.1111/twec.70126.title_zh: 全球价值链中的技术变革：来自全球企业的证据

10.1111/twec.70127.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Utilising microdata from Chinese A‐share listed firms matched to the China Customs Database over the period 2007–2016, this paper exploits a quasi‐natural experiment based on Google's exit from mainland China and constructs a difference‐in‐differences (DID) model to systematically examine the impact of information access barriers on firms' multi‐dimensional export competitiveness. The results indicate that information access barriers have a significant negative effect on firms' multi‐dimensional export competitiveness, primarily reflected in narrowing export product scope, reducing export technological sophistication and weakening their centrality in the export trade network. Mechanism analyses reveal that information access barriers suppress firms' multi‐dimensional export competitiveness through multiple channels, including increasing transaction costs, constraining technological innovation, weakening capital investment, reducing productivity and aggravating financial constraints. Moreover, heterogeneity tests reveal that the impact of information access barriers on firms' multi‐dimensional export competitiveness varies significantly across regions, industries and firm types. Extending the scope beyond export performance, further analysis shows that restricted information access significantly impairs firms' short‐term profitability and long‐term market valuation. Taken together, this study underscores the critical role of information access barriers in firms' export competitiveness and upgrading, offering important insights for better leveraging information technology to improve export patterns.</jats:p>
10.1111/twec.70127.abstract_zh: 利用2007–2016年中国A股上市公司与海关数据库匹配的微观数据，本文以谷歌退出中国大陆为准自然实验，构建双重差分模型系统考察信息获取壁垒对企业多维出口竞争力的影响。结果表明，信息获取壁垒对企业多维出口竞争力具有显著负向效应，主要表现为缩小出口产品范围、降低出口技术复杂度、削弱其在出口贸易网络中的中心度。机制分析显示，信息获取壁垒通过增加交易成本、抑制技术创新、削弱资本投入、降低生产率及加剧融资约束等多重渠道抑制企业多维出口竞争力。异质性检验表明，信息获取壁垒对不同地区、行业及类型企业的多维出口竞争力影响存在显著差异。将研究范畴拓展至出口绩效之外，进一步分析发现，信息获取受限显著损害企业短期盈利能力和长期市场估值。综上，本研究揭示了信息获取壁垒在企业出口竞争力与升级中的关键作用，为更好利用信息技术优化出口格局提供了重要启示。
10.1111/twec.70127.title: Access Denied, Performance Declined: Information Access Barriers and the Multi‐Dimensional Export Competitiveness in China
10.1111/twec.70127.title_zh: 访问受限，绩效下滑：信息获取壁垒与中国多维出口竞争力

10.1111/twec.70128.title: How to Win a Trade War: An Optimistic Guide to an Anxious Global Economy. By SoumayaKeynes and Chad P.Bown, New York, NY: Simon & Schuster, 2026. 288 pp. $30.00 (hardcover). ISBN: 978‐1‐66‐822131‐0
10.1111/twec.70128.title_zh: 如何赢得贸易战：焦虑全球经济中的乐观指南

10.1111/twec.70130.abstract: ABSTRACT This study aims to explore the relationship between trade sophistication and economic development stages, including in the context of digitalization. We employ nonparametric, semiparametric, and parametric methods, covering the period from 2003 to 2024 across 119 countries, categorized into three income groups. Our findings show that GDP per capita has a positive but diminishing relationship with export and import sophistication, suggesting that trade sophistication grows rapidly at lower levels of economic development but slows down as economies become more economically advanced. The evolution patterns of export and import sophistication are relatively similar throughout the stages of economic development; however, the level of export sophistication consistently exceeds that of import sophistication across all income groups. In the context of digital transformation, digitalization is found to positively affect trade sophistication in high and middle‐income countries, while GDP per capita remains positively associated with trade sophistication, but with diminishing marginal effects. For low‐income countries, GDP per capita is the primary driver of increased trade sophistication, while in high‐income countries, digitalization stands out as the dominant factor. These findings remain robust after controlling for human capital, FDI, and institutional quality, highlighting the importance of formulating stage‐specific economic policies to enhance trade sophistication in the rapidly evolving digital era.
10.1111/twec.70130.abstract_zh: 摘要 本研究旨在探讨贸易复杂度与经济发展阶段之间的关系，并纳入数字化背景进行分析。我们采用非参数、半参数及参数方法，覆盖2003年至2024年间119个国家，并将其划分为三个收入组别。研究结果表明，人均GDP与出口及进口复杂度呈正向但边际递减的关系，即贸易复杂度在经济发展水平较低阶段增长较快，但随着经济体日趋成熟而增速放缓。出口与进口复杂度的演变模式在经济发展各阶段相对相似；然而，在所有收入组别中，出口复杂度水平始终高于进口复杂度。在数字化转型背景下，数字化对高收入及中等收入国家的贸易复杂度具有正向影响，而人均GDP仍与贸易复杂度保持正向关联，但边际效应递减。对于低收入国家，人均GDP是提升贸易复杂度的主要驱动力；而在高收入国家，数字化则成为主导因素。在控制人力资本、外商直接投资及制度质量后，上述结论依然稳健，凸显了在快速演变的数字时代制定分阶段经济政策以提升贸易复杂度的重要性。
10.1111/twec.70130.title: Trade Sophistication and Economic Development Stages in the Context of Global Digitalization
10.1111/twec.70130.title_zh: 全球数字化背景下的贸易复杂度与经济发展阶段

10.1111/twec.70131.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    In the current confrontational geopolitical climate, countries have intensified the use of selective trade restrictions to exert economic coercion. This paper introduces
                    <jats:italic>targeted</jats:italic>
                    trade restrictions between a US‐centric bloc and a China‐centric bloc into a general equilibrium trade model that features nonlinear adjustments and input–output connections. We study how micro‐level restrictions—based on data identifying high‐weaponization‐potential products—affect welfare and the macroeconomic structure of global value chains (GVCs). Our findings reveal that while global economic integration is marginally affected, its topology changes: chains become more regional and rely more on non‐aligned countries acting as connectors between opposing blocs, in ways that may be hard to detect in standard trade data.
                  </jats:p>
10.1111/twec.70131.abstract_zh: 在当前对抗性地缘政治气候下，各国强化了选择性贸易限制手段以实施经济胁迫。本文将美国主导集团与中国主导集团之间的针对性贸易限制引入具有非线性调整特征和投入产出关联的一般均衡贸易模型。基于识别高武器化潜力产品的微观数据，我们研究了微观层面的限制措施如何影响福利与全球价值链的宏观经济结构。研究结果表明，尽管全球经济一体化受到轻微影响，但其拓扑结构发生了改变：价值链呈现区域化趋势，并更依赖不结盟国家作为对立集团之间的连接枢纽——这种变化在标准贸易数据中可能难以察觉。
10.1111/twec.70131.title:
Fragmentation and the Future of
                    <scp>GVCs</scp>
10.1111/twec.70131.title_zh: 碎片化与全球价值链的未来

10.1111/twec.70132.abstract: ABSTRACT Oil is the lifeblood of industry, serving as the core source of power for the operation of industrial machinery. Ensuring its stable supply is crucial for the smooth production process, which in turn is a key determinant in enhancing the quality of export products for enterprises. This study empirically examines the impact of energy supply on the quality of export products and the mechanism of its effect by using a staggered difference‐in‐differences (DID) method with the implementation of China's West‐to‐East Oil Transportation Project as a quasi‐natural experiment. The empirical results show that a dependable energy supply substantially boosts the quality of goods produced for export by various companies. The mechanism analysis shows that energy supply improves export product quality through enterprise performance improvement effects, industry agglomeration effects and supply chain stabilization effects, and it mainly improves export product quality in energy‐importing regions, technology‐intensive industries, private enterprises, and general trade enterprises. Further analysis reveals that a stable supply of energy helps enhance the sustainability of enterprise exports while helping enterprises realize value chain upgrading, helping China get rid of the curse of locking the bottom of the export value chain. The findings of this study help clarify the intrinsic mechanism between energy supply and export product quality and provide an empirical basis for the cross‐regional energy dispatch strategy to help China's export value chain upgrade.
10.1111/twec.70132.abstract_zh: 摘要 石油是工业的血液，是工业机械运转的核心动力来源。确保其稳定供应对于生产过程的顺利进行至关重要，而这又是提升企业出口产品质量的关键决定因素。本研究以中国“西油东送”工程实施为准自然实验，采用交错双重差分法实证检验了能源供应对出口产品质量的影响及其作用机制。实证结果表明，可靠的能源供应显著提升了各类企业的出口产品质量。机制分析显示，能源供应通过企业绩效提升效应、产业集聚效应和供应链稳定效应改善了出口产品质量，并且主要提升了能源输入地区、技术密集型行业、民营企业和一般贸易企业的出口产品质量。进一步分析发现，稳定的能源供应有助于增强企业出口的可持续性，同时帮助企业实现价值链升级，助力中国摆脱出口价值链低端锁定的困境。本研究结论有助于厘清能源供应与出口产品质量之间的内在机理，并为跨区域能源调度策略助力中国出口价值链升级提供经验依据。
10.1111/twec.70132.title: Engine Run, Quality Enhance: Examining the Effects of Energy Steady Supply on Chinese Export Product Quality
10.1111/twec.70132.title_zh: 引擎运转，质量提升：能源稳定供应对中国出口产品质量的影响研究

10.1111/twec.70134.abstract: This paper examines how tariffs and non‐tariff measures (NTMs) imposed by Brazil's major agricultural trading partners affect the country's exports at the country–product level over the period 2000–2017. Using a newly assembled dataset of NTMs from the TRAINS database and a novel methodology for constructing unilateral trade flows in a single‐exporter setting, we estimate a reduced‐form Poisson pseudo‐maximum likelihood (PPML) model. The results show that tariffs exert large and consistently negative effects on export performance, while NTMs have heterogeneous impacts that depend on their economic characteristics and on the treatment of Brazilian products relative to competing exporters. We also introduce a measure of the cumulative trade frictions arising from the joint application of tariffs and NTMs, showing that multilateral NTMs substantially amplify the trade‐reducing effects of tariffs, particularly for price and quantity measures. Finally, an event‐study analysis based on the Local Projections Difference‐in‐Differences (LP‐DiD) estimator indicates that the introduction of a new NTM temporarily reduces the export share of the affected product, with recovery beginning in the third year after implementation.
10.1111/twec.70134.abstract_zh: 本文考察了巴西主要农业贸易伙伴实施的关税与非关税措施（NTMs）如何影响该国在2000年至2017年间国家-产品层面的出口。利用从TRAINS数据库新汇编的非关税措施数据集，以及一种在单一出口国情境下构建单边贸易流的新方法，我们估计了一个简化形式的泊松伪最大似然（PPML）模型。结果表明，关税对出口绩效产生了显著且持续的负面影响，而非关税措施的影响则具有异质性，取决于其经济特征以及巴西产品相对于竞争出口国的待遇。我们还引入了一种衡量关税与非关税措施联合应用所产生的累积贸易摩擦的指标，显示多边非关税措施显著放大了关税的贸易缩减效应，尤其是对价格和数量措施而言。最后，基于局部投影双重差分（LP-DiD）估计量的事件研究分析表明，新非关税措施的引入会暂时降低受影响产品的出口份额，并在实施后第三年开始恢复。
10.1111/twec.70134.title: Modelling the Effects of Tariffs and Non‐Tariff Measures on Agricultural Products: Evidence From a Developing Country
10.1111/twec.70134.title_zh: 关税与非关税措施对农产品影响的建模：来自发展中国家的证据

10.1111/twec.70135.abstract: We empirically investigate the utilization rates of the two existing regional trade agreements (RTAs) in Japan's monthly imports from Vietnam from January 2017 to December 2021. In particular, we explore the changes in these rates before and after the commencement of the Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans‐Pacific Partnership (CPTPP), focusing on the products for which CPTPP offered the lowest tariffs. We did not find significant changes in the utilization rates of either existing RTAs or the most‐favoured nation (MFN) regime before CPTPP's entry in January 2019. However, exporters familiar with the use of preferences (i.e., existing RTA users) appear to have switched to CPTPP first, followed by unfamiliar users (MFN users) who switched to it gradually. Consequently, the introduction of a new RTA was associated with a sustained expansion of trade, unlike the gradual tariff reduction in a single RTA observed in the previous study.
10.1111/twec.70135.abstract_zh: 本文实证研究了2017年1月至2021年12月期间，日本从越南月度进口中两项现有区域贸易协定（RTAs）的利用率。我们特别关注《全面与进步跨太平洋伙伴关系协定》（CPTPP）生效前后这些利用率的变化，重点分析CPTPP提供最低关税的产品。研究发现，在2019年1月CPTPP生效前，现有RTAs或最惠国待遇（MFN）机制的利用率并未出现显著变化。然而，熟悉优惠使用的出口商（即现有RTA用户）似乎率先转向CPTPP，随后不熟悉优惠使用的用户（MFN用户）逐步跟进。因此，新RTAs的引入与贸易的持续扩张相关联，这与先前研究中单一RTA逐步降税所观察到的模式有所不同。
10.1111/twec.70135.title: Switching Between Existing and New Trade Agreements: Evidence From Japan's Imports From Vietnam
10.1111/twec.70135.title_zh: 现有贸易协定与新贸易协定之间的切换：来自日本从越南进口的证据

10.1162/rest.a.1768.abstract: This paper uncovers that input tariff reductions result in less domestic innovation, but standard models of trade ensure a positive correlation between importing and innovation. Hence, the paper develops a dynamic framework with a task-specific laboraugmenting productivity and a non-homothetic import demand system to rationalize this finding. The model implies that input liberalization enables firms to use cheaper intermediate imports as a substitute for self-made inputs, a strategy that decreases marginal production costs but also discourages firms from investing in their own inhouse varieties. Finally, the paper compares the effectiveness of trade and innovation policies in boosting aggregate productivity growth.
10.1162/rest.a.1768.abstract_zh: 本文发现，投入品关税削减导致国内创新减少，而标准贸易模型却认为进口与创新之间存在正相关关系。为此，本文构建了一个包含任务特定劳动增强型生产率与非同质进口需求体系的动态框架，以解释这一发现。模型表明，投入品自由化使企业能够用更便宜的进口中间品替代自制投入品，这一策略虽降低了边际生产成本，但也抑制了企业对自主开发内部品种的投资。最后，本文比较了贸易政策与创新政策在促进全要素生产率增长方面的有效性。
10.1162/rest.a.1768.title: Globalization, Innovation, and Margins of Sourcing
10.1162/rest.a.1768.title_zh: 全球化、创新与采购边际

10.1162/rest.a.1769.abstract: Market power is costly to build and, once established, is typically persistent and difficult to change. This paper investigates the impact of large economic shocks (serious epidemics) on the redistribution of market power in manufacturing industries. Using a model of firms’ dynamic decisions on production, pricing, and inventory holding, we demonstrate the importance of inventory stock and demand uncertainty in understanding market power and propose a new measure of market power. We find that the 2003 SARS shock in China significantly reduced the market power of firms in SARS-impacted areas. This effect is long lasting. SARS also substantially increased the inventory of affected firms, which partially contributed to the redistribution of market power.
10.1162/rest.a.1769.abstract_zh: 市场势力的构建成本高昂，且一旦形成便具有显著的持久性和难以改变的特征。本文探究了重大经济冲击（严重流行病）对制造业市场势力再分配的影响。通过构建企业生产、定价与库存持有动态决策模型，我们论证了库存规模与需求不确定性在理解市场势力中的关键作用，并提出了一种新的市场势力测度方法。研究发现，2003年中国非典疫情冲击显著降低了疫区企业的市场势力，且该效应具有长期持续性。非典疫情还大幅增加了受影响企业的库存水平，这在一定程度上推动了市场势力的再分配。
10.1162/rest.a.1769.title: How Do Large Epidemics Redistribute Market Power? Evidence from the 2003 SARS Shock in China
10.1162/rest.a.1769.title_zh: 大型流行病如何重新分配市场力量？来自2003年中国SARS冲击的证据

10.1162/rest.a.1770.abstract: Since 1970, the share of Black individuals living in suburbs of large cities has risen from 16% to 36%. We first show that Black suburbanization has led to major changes in neighborhoods, accounting for the majority of recent increases in both the average Black individual’s neighborhood quality and income segregation within the Black population. We then use an accounting exercise to show that changes in relative suburban amenities and housing prices explain a large share of Black suburbanization, while regional reallocation, changing educational attainment, and gentrification of Black city neighborhoods play only minor roles.
10.1162/rest.a.1770.abstract_zh: 自1970年以来，居住在大城市郊区的黑人比例已从16%上升至36%。我们首先表明，黑人郊区化导致了社区的重大变化，这解释了近年来黑人个体平均社区质量提升以及黑人群体内部收入隔离加剧的大部分原因。随后，我们通过核算分析表明，郊区相对便利设施和房价的变化解释了黑人郊区化的很大一部分原因，而区域重新分配、教育程度变化以及黑人城市社区的绅士化仅起到次要作用。
10.1162/rest.a.1770.title: Black Suburbanization: Causes and Consequences of a Transformation of American Cities
10.1162/rest.a.1770.title_zh: 黑人郊区化：美国城市转型的原因与后果

10.1162/rest.a.1771.abstract: We study how regional housing market disruptions spill over across US local markets through multimarket firm networks. Using granular barcode-level data linked to producer information, we exploit variation in firms’ exposure to local house price declines. A firm’s local sales respond more strongly to indirect housing price declines in its other markets than to direct local declines. The barcode-level data reveal a novel uniform product replacement mechanism: Firms respond to adverse shocks by replacing higher-value products with lower-value alternatives uniformly across all markets. This propagates regional demand shocks through the supply side, with new implications for regional economics.
10.1162/rest.a.1771.abstract_zh: 本文研究区域住房市场冲击如何通过跨市场企业网络在美国地方市场间传导。利用与生产者信息相关联的细粒度条形码级数据，我们考察了企业对当地房价下跌的暴露程度差异。研究发现，企业在其其他市场面临的间接房价下跌对其本地销售的影响，比直接本地房价下跌更为显著。条形码级数据揭示了一种新颖的统一产品替代机制：企业通过在所有市场中统一用低价值产品替代高价值产品来应对不利冲击。这一机制通过供给侧将区域需求冲击进行传导，为区域经济学提供了新的启示。
10.1162/rest.a.1771.title: Spillovers through Multimarket Firms: The Uniform Product Replacement Channel
10.1162/rest.a.1771.title_zh: 多市场企业的溢出效应：统一产品替代渠道

10.1162/rest.a.1772.abstract: We document that in response to intensified competition from China in the U.S., poor countries reduce their export prices relative to rich countries, consistent with conventional wisdom. Interestingly, however, the opposite is true for export quantities. To reconcile these facts, we develop and estimate a general equilibrium model of trade featuring (i) cross-country heterogeneity in the ability to produce high-quality goods and (ii) a two-dimensional Bertrand competition on price and quality. Our model explains the empirical facts by showing that rich countries have a comparative advantage in quality upgrading, whereas a nested model without quality cannot do so.
10.1162/rest.a.1772.abstract_zh: 我们记录到，面对中国在美国市场竞争加剧的情况，贫困国家相对于富裕国家降低了出口价格，这与传统观点一致。然而有趣的是，出口数量却呈现相反趋势。为调和这些事实，我们构建并估计了一个包含以下特征的贸易一般均衡模型：（i）各国生产高质量产品能力的异质性，以及（ii）价格与质量二维伯特兰竞争。该模型通过揭示富裕国家在质量升级方面具有比较优势来解释实证现象，而嵌套的无质量模型则无法做到这一点。
10.1162/rest.a.1772.title: Cross-Country Heterogeneous Response to Competition: Theory and Evidence from Trade Data
10.1162/rest.a.1772.title_zh: 跨国竞争反应的异质性：理论与贸易数据的证据

10.1162/rest.a.1773.abstract: How do import tariffs affect employment? We develop an empirical strategy to identify the effects of tariffs using a difference-in-differences strategy, comparing antidumping (AD) investigations resulting in AD tariffs to those not resulting in AD tariffs. We find that an AD tariff decreases imports and increases employment in the protected sector. Moreover, employment in downstream firms decreases, while upstream firms are unaffected because the protected sector sources inputs abroad. Using a model to quantify the aggregate effects, we find that the Brazilian AD policy increased employment by 0.06% at a welfare loss of 2.4%.
10.1162/rest.a.1773.abstract_zh: 进口关税如何影响就业？我们采用双重差分策略来识别关税效应，通过比较导致反倾销税的反倾销调查与未导致反倾销税的反倾销调查。研究发现，反倾销税会减少进口并增加受保护部门的就业。此外，下游企业的就业减少，而上游企业未受影响，因为受保护部门从国外采购投入品。通过模型量化总体效应，我们发现巴西的反倾销政策使就业增加0.06%，但福利损失达2.4%。
10.1162/rest.a.1773.title: The Employment Consequences of Anti-Dumping Tariffs: Lessons from Brazil
10.1162/rest.a.1773.title_zh: 反倾销关税的就业后果：来自巴西的教训

10.1162/rest.a.1774.abstract: Against a backdrop of sharply rising inequality, the Tokyo Round of the GATT resulted in a 1.6 percentage point reduction in average US tariffs – larger than CUSFTA, NAFTA, and the liberalization accompanying the granting of PNTR to China. We construct a novel IV based on the so-called “Swiss formula” that governed the Tokyo Round tariff liberalization to provide evidence of its effects on imports and inequality. Instrumented tariff reductions explain approximately 20% of the rise in income inequality between non-production and production workers between 1979 and 1988. This effect is largest among women, workers in routine occupations, and workers in more technology-intensive industries, suggesting a complementarity between trade liberalization and skill-biased technological change.
10.1162/rest.a.1774.abstract_zh: 在收入不平等急剧加剧的背景下，关贸总协定东京回合使美国平均关税降低了1.6个百分点——这一降幅大于美加自由贸易协定、北美自由贸易协定以及给予中国永久正常贸易关系地位时的贸易自由化幅度。我们基于指导东京回合关税自由化的所谓"瑞士公式"构建了一个新的工具变量，以证明其对进口和不平等的影响。工具变量估计的关税削减解释了1979年至1988年间非生产工人与生产工人之间收入不平等上升的约20%。这一效应在女性、从事常规职业的工人以及技术密集型行业的工人中最为显著，表明贸易自由化与技能偏向型技术进步之间存在互补性。
10.1162/rest.a.1774.title: Trade and U.S. Inequality in the Tokyo Round
10.1162/rest.a.1774.title_zh: 东京回合中的贸易与美国不平等

10.1162/rest.a.1775.abstract: We provide the first estimates of intergenerational income mobility using tax data for a large developing country, namely Brazil. We measure formal income from tax and payroll data, and we train machine learning models on census and survey data to predict informal income. We quantify the estimation bias resulting from income imputation and other sources of measurement error, and show that such bias remains negligible in our context. A 10 percentile increase in parental income rank is associated on average with a 5.5 percentile increase in child income rank, with considerable variation across sociodemographic groups and geographical areas.
10.1162/rest.a.1775.abstract_zh: 我们利用巴西这一大型发展中国家的税收数据，首次估算了代际收入流动性。通过税收和工资数据衡量正规收入，并基于人口普查和调查数据训练机器学习模型以预测非正规收入。我们量化了因收入估算及其他测量误差导致的估计偏差，并证明此类偏差在我们的研究中可忽略不计。父母收入排名每提高10个百分位，子女收入排名平均上升5.5个百分位，且不同社会人口群体和地理区域之间存在显著差异。
10.1162/rest.a.1775.title: Intergenerational Mobility in the Land of Inequality
10.1162/rest.a.1775.title_zh: 不平等之地中的代际流动性

10.1162/rest.a.1776.abstract: Urban forests are ubiquitous, yet their impacts and values remain largely unknown. We study a massive urban afforestation policy in Beijing that planted 1/3 of a million acres of greenery in less than a decade. We conduct a remote-sensing audit of the program, finding that it contributes to a substantial greening up of the city. This causes significant downwind air quality improvement, reducing average PM2.5 concentration at city population hubs by 4.2%. Rapid vegetation growth unexpectedly led to a 7.4% increase in pollen exposure. Analysis of medical claims data shows that increased aeroallergens triggered emergency room visits, mirroring pollution effects though much less severe. Monetized net health benefits of the program amount to 1.5% of the city’s GDP. Urban forests are only partially capitalized in housing values, with buyers mainly appreciating proximity to green spaces but not the air quality improvements they bring.
10.1162/rest.a.1776.abstract_zh: 城市森林无处不在，但其影响和价值在很大程度上仍不为人知。我们研究了北京一项大规模的城市造林政策，该政策在不到十年内种植了33万英亩的绿地。通过对该项目的遥感审计，我们发现它显著提升了城市的绿化水平。这带来了显著的下风向空气质量改善，使城市人口聚集区的平均PM2.5浓度降低了4.2%。然而，植被的快速生长意外导致花粉暴露量增加了7.4%。对医疗索赔数据的分析显示，空气过敏原的增加引发了急诊就诊，其影响与污染类似，但严重程度远低于污染。该政策的货币化净健康效益相当于该市GDP的1.5%。城市森林仅部分资本化于住房价值中，购房者主要看重靠近绿地的便利性，而非其带来的空气质量改善。
10.1162/rest.a.1776.title: Urban Forests: Environmental Health Values and Risks
10.1162/rest.a.1776.title_zh: 城市森林：环境健康价值与风险

10.1162/rest.a.1777.abstract: Pharmacy benefit managers dominate the U.S. pharmaceutical market but are controversial and poorly understood. We analyze PBMs as market intermediaries that operate formulary contests in which on-patent brand-drug makers compete for favorable placement by offering rebates off list price. These formulary contests deliver efficiency gains compared to drug makers selling directly to consumers; PBMs capture some of these gains. Our approach answers key questions regarding the determinants of efficiency, rebates, list prices, and PBM market power in the pharmaceutical market. Our analysis also explains how common contracting practices, federal regulations, and incentives within formulary contests can undermine market efficiency.
10.1162/rest.a.1777.abstract_zh: 药品福利管理公司主导着美国药品市场，但颇具争议且认知度较低。我们将PBM视为市场中介机构，其运作处方集竞争机制——专利品牌药制造商通过提供标价折扣来争夺有利的处方集地位。相较于药企直接面向消费者销售的模式，这种处方集竞争机制能带来效率提升；PBM则从中获取部分收益。我们的分析框架解答了关于药品市场效率决定因素、折扣机制、标价形成及PBM市场势力的关键问题。研究同时揭示了处方集竞争中的常见合同实践、联邦监管规定及激励机制如何可能削弱市场效率。
10.1162/rest.a.1777.title: Common Agent or Double Agent? Pharmacy Benefit Managers in the Prescription Drug Market
10.1162/rest.a.1777.title_zh: 共同代理人还是双重代理人？处方药市场中的药品福利管理者

10.1162/rest.a.1778.abstract: Nonprofit organizations rely on donations from large competitive marketplaces to provide key social service goods. Most research focuses on competition in output markets without considering philanthropic markets where nonprofits make decisions about how much effort to put into fundraising. We develop and estimate a model that highlights the strategic nature of fundraising, showing that rival NP’s fundraising responses can be strategic complements or substitutes. We find evidence of strategic substitutes. NPs demonstrate nontrivial strategic responses to rival’s fundraising and, in totality, the across sector impacts are important to consider. Counterfactual exercises show that reducing competition decreases equilibrium fundraising levels.
10.1162/rest.a.1778.abstract_zh: 非营利组织依赖大型竞争性市场的捐赠来提供关键的社会服务产品。现有研究大多关注产出市场的竞争，而未考虑非营利组织在慈善市场中决定投入多少募捐努力的问题。我们构建并估计了一个模型，该模型凸显了募捐的战略性质，表明竞争对手非营利组织的募捐反应可能是战略互补或战略替代的。我们发现了战略替代的证据。非营利组织对竞争对手的募捐表现出不可忽视的战略反应，总体而言，跨部门的影响值得重视。反事实模拟表明，减少竞争会降低均衡募捐水平。
10.1162/rest.a.1778.title: Competition and Nonprofit’s Strategic Responses: Evidence from Fundraising in Donative Markets
10.1162/rest.a.1778.title_zh: 竞争与非营利组织的战略回应：来自捐赠市场筹款的证据

10.1162/rest.a.1779.abstract: We investigate the role financial conditions play in the composition of U.S. growth-at-risk. We document that, by a wide margin, growth-at-risk is investment-at-risk. That is, if financial conditions indicate U.S. real GDP growth will be in the lower tail of its conditional distribution, we know that quantitatively, the main contributor is a decline in investment. Consumption contributes under extreme financial stress. Government spending and net exports do not play a role. We show that leverage plays a key role in determining both consumption- and investment-at-risk, which provides support to the financial accelerator mechanism proposed by Bernanke et al. (1999).
10.1162/rest.a.1779.abstract_zh: 我们研究了金融状况在美国增长风险构成中的作用。实证表明，增长风险在很大程度上即为投资风险。也就是说，若金融状况预示美国实际GDP增长将处于条件分布的下尾端，从量化角度看，其主要贡献因素来自投资下降。消费仅在极端金融压力下有所贡献，而政府支出与净出口则未发挥显著作用。我们进一步发现，杠杆水平在决定消费风险与投资风险中均扮演关键角色，这为Bernanke等（1999）提出的金融加速器机制提供了实证支持。
10.1162/rest.a.1779.title: Growth-at-Risk Is Investment-at-Risk

10.1162/rest.a.1780.abstract: This paper provides novel evidence on how dietary habits – a key health behavior – are transmitted across generations, exploiting unique grocery transaction data linked with administrative records. We document strong intergenerational persistence in dietary habits, exceeding that of income, and consider several channels that might explain this pattern. Specifically, we find that socioeconomic status and geography account for only a small share of the transmission. Combined with the absence of a dietary response following a parent’s unexpected lifestyle-related death, these findings underscore the importance of early-life influences and habit formation.
10.1162/rest.a.1780.abstract_zh: 本文利用与行政记录相关联的独特杂货交易数据，提供了关于饮食习惯——这一关键健康行为——如何代际传递的新证据。我们记录了饮食习惯中显著的代际持续性，其程度超过收入，并考察了可能解释这一模式的若干渠道。具体而言，我们发现社会经济地位和地理因素仅能解释传递中的一小部分。结合父母因生活方式相关意外死亡后饮食行为未发生变化的发现，这些结果强调了早期生活影响和习惯形成的重要性。
10.1162/rest.a.1780.title: The Apple Does Not Fall Far From the Tree: Intergenerational Persistence of Dietary Habits
10.1162/rest.a.1780.title_zh: 苹果不会落在离树太远的地方：饮食习惯的代际持续性

10.1162/rest.a.1781.abstract: This paper investigates the long-term impacts of China’s nationwide public health campaigns targeting malaria, measles, and meningitis between the 1960s and 1980s. Exploiting regional variation in precampaign disease prevalence across birth cohorts, we show that these interventions generated sizable improvements in education, cognition, health, and income. As an illustrative case, individuals from high-malaria regions who were fully exposed to the eradication campaign attained about 0.5 additional years of schooling and earned over 10% higher income in adulthood, with cognitive and schooling gains explaining a substantial share of the income effects. Extending the same approach to measles and meningitis vaccination campaigns reveals comparably large benefits, with internal rates of return ranging from 21% to 34%. Together, these findings highlight the lasting socioeconomic returns to early-life health interventions and underscore the role of public health as a foundation for human capital accumulation and long-run economic growth.
10.1162/rest.a.1781.abstract_zh: 本文研究了20世纪60至80年代中国针对疟疾、麻疹和脑膜炎开展的全国性公共卫生运动的长期影响。利用不同出生队列在运动前疾病流行率的地区差异，我们证明这些干预措施显著改善了教育、认知、健康和收入水平。以疟疾为例，来自高疟疾地区且完全暴露于根除运动的个体，其受教育年限平均增加约0.5年，成年后收入提高超过10%，其中认知能力和教育水平的提升解释了收入效应的很大一部分。将相同方法应用于麻疹和脑膜炎疫苗接种运动后，同样发现了可观的收益，内部收益率介于21%至34%之间。这些发现共同凸显了早期健康干预的持久社会经济回报，并强调了公共卫生作为人力资本积累和长期经济增长基础的关键作用。
10.1162/rest.a.1781.title: Public Health, Human Capital, and Economic Growth: The Lasting Effects of Disease Control in China
10.1162/rest.a.1781.title_zh: 公共卫生、人力资本与经济增长：中国疾病控制的持久影响

10.1162/rest.a.1782.abstract: We examine firm responses to state hiring and investment subsidies. We leverage institutional features of the California Competes Tax Credit (CCTC), a large-scale business incentive program that incorporates best practices from prior job creation policies. The CCTC award selection procedure combines formula-based and discretionary components. Leveraging applicant score eligibility cutoffs in a regression discontinuity design and taking advantage of rich longitudinal microdata on establishments and their parent firms, we find that businesses expand employment in California in response to CCTC awards. There is little evidence that these expansions come at the expense of firms’ operations in other states. Our results suggest that targeted and audited hiring and investment subsidies can be effective in promoting local business expansions without inducing significant cross-state displacement effects.
10.1162/rest.a.1782.abstract_zh: 本文考察了企业对州级雇佣与投资补贴的响应。我们利用加州竞争税收抵免（CCTC）的制度特征——这一大规模商业激励计划整合了以往就业创造政策的最佳实践。CCTC奖项评选程序结合了公式化与自由裁量两种机制。通过运用断点回归设计，基于申请者评分资格临界值，并借助涵盖企业及其母公司的丰富纵向微观数据，我们发现企业因获得CCTC奖项而在加州扩大了就业规模。几乎没有证据表明这种扩张是以牺牲企业在其他州的运营为代价。我们的研究结果表明，经过精准定位与审计的雇佣及投资补贴，能够有效促进本地企业扩张，且不会引发显著的跨州替代效应。
10.1162/rest.a.1782.title: Firm Responses to Hiring and Investment Subsidies: Regression Discontinuity Evidence from the California Competes Tax Credit
10.1162/rest.a.1782.title_zh: 企业应对招聘与投资补贴的反应：来自加州竞争税收抵免的断点回归证据

10.1162/rest.a.1783.abstract: We study the role of war bonds and inflation in post-WWII federal elections. After WWII, major bouts of inflation in 1946-48 and 1950-51 depressed the real returns of the bonds sold to households during the war. In a difference-in-differences framework, we find that counties with higher war bond purchases shifted their votes towards the Republican Party in postwar elections. To address the endogeneity of war bond purchases, we use an instrumental variables design, and obtain similar results. Bond ownership raised the saliency of inflation, and the severe rise in prices after the war triggered a backlash against the incumbent Democrats.
10.1162/rest.a.1783.abstract_zh: 我们研究了二战后的战争债券与通货膨胀在联邦选举中的作用。二战后，1946-48年和1950-51年的两次重大通胀压低了战争期间向家庭出售债券的实际回报。在双重差分框架下，我们发现战争债券购买量更高的县在战后选举中投票转向共和党。为解决战争债券购买的内生性问题，我们采用工具变量设计，并得到类似结果。债券持有提高了通胀的显著性，战后物价的急剧上涨引发了选民对在任民主党人的强烈反对。
10.1162/rest.a.1783.title: Inflation, War Bonds, and Voter Backlash in the 1950s
10.1162/rest.a.1783.title_zh: 20世纪50年代的通胀、战争债券与选民反弹

10.1162/rest.a.1784.abstract: This study explores the relationship between legalized sports gambling, unexpected emotional cues stemming from NFL home team upset losses and reported intimate partner violence (IPV). Using 1995–2022 crime data from NIBRS, replicating and extending Card and Dahl (2011)’s model, we find that legalized gambling increases the impact of upset losses on IPV by 10 percentage points. The e!ect is larger in states with mobile betting, where higher bets were placed, around paydays, and for teams on a winning streak. These results suggest that financial losses from gambling amplify emotional reactions to unexpected team losses.
10.1162/rest.a.1784.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了合法化体育博彩、NFL主队爆冷失利引发的意外情绪线索与亲密伴侣暴力（IPV）报告之间的关系。利用1995-2022年NIBRS犯罪数据，复制并扩展了Card和Dahl（2011）的模型，我们发现合法化博彩使爆冷失利对IPV的影响增加了10个百分点。在允许移动投注的州、投注金额较高的地区、发薪日前后以及处于连胜状态的球队中，这一效应更为显著。这些结果表明，博彩带来的经济损失放大了对球队意外失利的情绪反应。
10.1162/rest.a.1784.title: Sports Betting Legalization Amplifies Emotional Cues and Intimate Partner Violence
10.1162/rest.a.1784.title_zh: 体育博彩合法化加剧情绪线索与亲密伴侣暴力

10.1162/rest.a.1785.abstract: Counterfactuals in quantitative trade and spatial models are functions of the current state of the world and the model parameters. Common practice treats the current state of the world as perfectly observed, but there is good reason to believe that it is measured with error. This paper provides tools for quantifying uncertainty about counterfactuals when the current state of the world is measured with error. I recommend an empirical Bayes approach to uncertainty quantification, and show that it is both practical and theoretically justified.
10.1162/rest.a.1785.abstract_zh: 定量贸易与空间模型中的反事实分析依赖于当前世界状态与模型参数。现有研究通常将当前世界状态视为完全可观测的，但实际测量中很可能存在误差。本文提供了当当前世界状态存在测量误差时，量化反事实分析不确定性的工具。我推荐采用经验贝叶斯方法进行不确定性量化，并证明该方法兼具实用性与理论合理性。
10.1162/rest.a.1785.title: Measurement Error and Counterfactuals in Quantitative Trade and Spatial Models
10.1162/rest.a.1785.title_zh: 定量贸易与空间模型中的测量误差与反事实分析

10.1162/rest.a.1786.abstract: We use administrative data to measure sibling spillovers on academic performance before and after the introduction of Free Secondary Education (FSE) in Tanzania. Prior to FSE, students whose older siblings narrowly passed the secondary school entrance exam were less likely to go to secondary school themselves; with FSE, the effect became positive. A triple-differences analysis, using geographic variation in FSE exposure, shows that FSE caused the reversal. Mechanism analyses suggest that changes in parental investments were a more likely channel for this reversal than direct sibling interactions. By alleviating financial constraints, FSE allowed households to invest in more children.
10.1162/rest.a.1786.abstract_zh: 我们利用行政数据，衡量坦桑尼亚实施免费中等教育（FSE）前后，兄弟姐妹对学业表现的溢出效应。在FSE实施前，其兄姐以微弱优势通过中学入学考试的学生，自身升入中学的可能性反而更低；而FSE实施后，这一效应转为正向。通过利用FSE覆盖范围的地理差异进行三重差分分析，结果表明FSE导致了这一逆转。机制分析表明，相较于直接的兄弟姐妹互动，父母投资的变化更可能是这一逆转的传导渠道。通过缓解经济约束，FSE使家庭能够对更多子女进行教育投资。
10.1162/rest.a.1786.title: Sibling Spillovers and Free Schooling
10.1162/rest.a.1786.title_zh: 兄弟姐妹溢出效应与免费教育

10.1162/rest.a.1787.abstract: This paper connects changes in employer characteristics through job transitions to employee earnings following mergers and acquisitions. Using firm balance sheet data linked to individual earnings data in Canada and a matched difference-in-differences design, we find that earnings of workers at target firms decrease after M&As relative to control workers, largely driven by those who move to other firms. Workers leaving targets move to larger and more profitable firms, but still experience wage declines. These decreased earnings are also concentrated among workers with longer tenure. These results are consistent with workers losing valuable match-specific premia after M&A-induced job transitions.
10.1162/rest.a.1787.abstract_zh: 本文通过工作转换将雇主特征的变化与并购后员工收入联系起来。利用加拿大企业资产负债表数据与个人收入数据的关联，并采用匹配双重差分法，我们发现目标企业员工在并购后的收入相对于对照组员工有所下降，这主要源于那些跳槽至其他企业的员工。离开目标企业的员工虽转向规模更大、盈利能力更强的公司，但仍经历工资下降。这些收入下降现象还集中在任职时间较长的员工群体中。研究结果与员工在并购引发的职业转换中失去有价值的岗位特定溢价这一解释相一致。
10.1162/rest.a.1787.title: Job Transitions and Employee Earnings after Acquisitions: Linking Corporate and Worker Outcomes
10.1162/rest.a.1787.title_zh: 收购后的职位转换与员工收入：企业绩效与员工结果的关联

10.1162/rest.a.1788.abstract: This paper investigates fairness perceptions of extreme income inequality generated in winner-take-all competitions. Two large-scale experiments with more than 7,000 participants from the general population of the U.S. show that extreme earnings inequality is widely accepted, even when the winner only slightly outperforms the runner-up. The effect of the winning margin on inequality acceptance is modest compared to the effect of shifting the source of inequality from luck to winning by the smallest possible margin. The experimental choices are systematically associated with broader fairness attitudes and policy preferences, including support for higher taxation of top earners and redistributive economic policy.
10.1162/rest.a.1788.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在赢家通吃竞争中所产生的极端收入不平等现象的公平感知问题。两项涵盖美国普通民众超过7000名参与者的大规模实验表明，极端收入不平等被广泛接受，即便获胜者仅以微弱优势领先亚军。与将不平等来源从运气转向最小可能获胜差距的影响相比，获胜差距对不平等接受程度的影响相对较小。实验选择与更广泛的公平态度及政策偏好存在系统性关联，包括支持对高收入者征收更高税率及再分配经济政策。
10.1162/rest.a.1788.title: Fairness in Winner-Take-All Competitions
10.1162/rest.a.1788.title_zh: 赢者通吃竞争中的公平性

10.1162/rest.a.1789.abstract: In 2001, Germany abolished public occupational disability insurance (ODI)—the second tier of its public DI system—for cohorts born after 1960. Using administrative data, we first document that, in the long run, overall DI inflows declined by roughly one-third. Second, using representative survey data, we document at best modest ODI insurance take-up responses in the private individual, risk-rated market, which lacks guaranteed issue. Third, an equilibrium model incorporating interactions between the public safety net, the first-tier public DI, and the private market reveals that coverage denials and weak insurance demand, driven by complementary social insurance, can explain the modest private ODI take-up response. Coverage gradients by income and health are thus substantial. Finally, counterfactual simulations highlight the limited scope of incremental reforms.
10.1162/rest.a.1789.abstract_zh: 2001年，德国废除了针对1960年后出生群体的公共职业伤残保险（ODI）——其公共伤残保险体系的第二层级。基于行政数据，我们首先发现，从长期来看，总体伤残保险流入量下降了约三分之一。其次，利用代表性调查数据，我们发现在缺乏保证承保条款的风险评级私人市场中，ODI保险的参保反应充其量仅为温和水平。第三，通过构建包含公共安全网、第一层级公共伤残保险与私人市场之间相互作用的均衡模型，我们发现：由补充性社会保险驱动的承保拒绝与疲弱的保险需求，可以解释私人ODI参保反应的温和特征。由此，按收入与健康水平划分的保障梯度差异显著。最后，反事实模拟凸显了渐进式改革的有限空间。
10.1162/rest.a.1789.title: Fundamentally Reforming the DI System: Evidence from Germany
10.1162/rest.a.1789.title_zh: 从根本上改革伤残保险体系：来自德国的证据

10.1162/rest.a.1790.abstract: After remaining flat for decades, labor productivity at U.S. restaurants surged 15% during the COVID pandemic. The surge has persisted. We explore this using mobile phone data tracking visits and spending at 100,000 limited-service restaurants. It cannot be explained by scale economies, market power, or mechanical consequences of COVID demand fluctuations. However, restaurants’ productivity growth is strongly correlated with the share of their customers visiting for 10 minutes or less, which rose considerably during COVID and persisted. This restaurant-level relationship between labor productivity and customer dwell time is large enough to explain most of the aggregate productivity increase.
10.1162/rest.a.1790.abstract_zh: 美国餐饮业的劳动生产率在数十年间保持平稳，却在新冠疫情期间骤增15%，且这一增长态势持续至今。我们利用追踪10万家有限服务餐厅客流量与消费额的手机数据展开研究。这种增长无法用规模经济、市场势力或疫情需求波动的机械效应来解释。然而，餐厅生产率增长与其顾客停留时间不超过10分钟的占比高度相关——该比例在疫情期间显著上升并持续保持。这种餐厅层面劳动生产率与顾客停留时间的关联强度，足以解释大部分总体生产率增长。
10.1162/rest.a.1790.title: The Curious Surge of Productivity in U.S. Restaurants
10.1162/rest.a.1790.title_zh: 美国餐饮业生产率的神秘激增

10.1162/rest.a.1813.abstract: This paper theoretically and empirically examines the role of information in pharmaceutical detailing (promotional interactions between drug representatives and physicians). We start with a theoretical framework in which pharmaceutical firms target detailing visits to physicians who learn about drug quality and prescribe accordingly. We derive several predictions about the role of information in these visits, which we then test empirically using prescriptions and pharmaceutical detailing visit data. We find limited empirical support of learning as the dominant mechanism, though cannot rule it out completely. We conclude with discussing alternative models that may be more consistent with the observed empirical patterns.
10.1162/rest.a.1813.abstract_zh: 本文从理论与实证角度探讨信息在药品推广拜访（即医药代表与医生之间的促销互动）中的作用。我们首先构建了一个理论框架，其中制药企业针对医生进行定向推广拜访，医生通过此类拜访了解药品质量并据此开具处方。基于此框架，我们推导出关于信息在推广拜访中作用的若干预测，并利用处方数据与药品推广拜访数据进行了实证检验。研究发现，学习机制作为主导解释的实证支持有限，但无法完全排除其可能性。最后，我们讨论了与观察到的实证模式更为一致的替代模型。
10.1162/rest.a.1813.title: The Role of Information in Pharmaceutical Advertising: Theory and Evidence
10.1162/rest.a.1813.title_zh: 信息在药品广告中的作用：理论与证据

10.1162/rest.a.1814.abstract: We examine the effect of investments by large technology firms on innovation by AI startups. Large technology firms have substantial advantages in data, a key non-rival input for developing AI technology. We assemble a unique dataset containing approximately 9,800 AI-inventing startups in China. Using a triple-differences strategy, we find that AI startups receiving investments from large technology firms file more AI patent applications and develop more software products following the investment, relative to their counterparts receiving investments from other firms without data advantages. Finally, we provide novel evidence that the innovation effect works mainly through sharing non-rival data.
10.1162/rest.a.1814.abstract_zh: 我们考察了大型科技企业的投资对人工智能初创企业创新的影响。大型科技企业在数据这一人工智能技术开发的关键非竞争性投入方面具有显著优势。我们构建了一个包含约9800家中国人工智能初创企业的独特数据集。采用三重差分策略，我们发现，相较于接受其他不具备数据优势企业投资的同类初创企业，获得大型科技企业投资的人工智能初创企业在投资后提交了更多人工智能专利申请，并开发了更多软件产品。最后，我们提供了新的证据表明，这种创新效应主要通过共享非竞争性数据实现。
10.1162/rest.a.1814.title: Investments and Innovation with Non-Rival Inputs: Evidence from Chinese Artificial Intelligence Startups
10.1162/rest.a.1814.title_zh: 非竞争性投入下的投资与创新：来自中国人工智能初创企业的证据

10.1162/rest.a.1815.abstract: Abstract Predictive algorithms inform consequential decisions in settings with selective labels: outcomes are observed only for units selected by past decision makers. This creates an identification problem under unobserved confounding — when selected and unselected units differ in unobserved ways that affect outcomes. We propose a framework for robust design and evaluation of predictive algorithms that bounds how much outcomes may differ between selected and unselected units with the same observed characteristics. These bounds formalize common empirical strategies including proxy outcomes and instrumental variables. Our estimators work across bounding strategies and performance measures such as conditional likelihoods, mean squared error, and true/false positive rates. Using administrative data from a large Australian financial institution, we show that varying confounding assumptions substantially affects credit risk predictions and fairness evaluations across income groups.
10.1162/rest.a.1815.abstract_zh: 摘要 预测算法在存在选择性标签的情境中影响关键决策：仅当个体被过往决策者选中时，其结果才可观测。这会在未观测混杂因素存在时引发识别问题——即被选中与未被选中的个体在影响结果的未观测维度上存在差异。我们提出一个预测算法稳健设计与评估框架，通过界定具有相同可观测特征的被选中与未被选中个体之间结果差异的上限，将代理结果与工具变量等常见实证策略形式化。该框架的估计量适用于不同边界策略及条件似然、均方误差、真/假阳性率等性能指标。基于澳大利亚某大型金融机构的行政数据，我们证明混杂假设的差异会显著影响不同收入群体的信用风险预测与公平性评估。
10.1162/rest.a.1815.title: Robust Design and Evaluation of Predictive Algorithms under Unobserved Confounding
10.1162/rest.a.1815.title_zh: 未观测混杂下预测算法的稳健设计与评估

10.1162/rest.a.1816.abstract: As manufacturing firms expand globally, business services such as advertising and legal support become essential for entering new markets. Exploiting exogenous demand shocks, we document that French manufacturers increasingly outsource market-access services as they enter more destinations. We develop a theory of market-access costs in which firms weigh the managerial strain of internal provision against adaptation costs of outsourcing—a mechanism that receives empirical sup-port. Further explorations reveal that outsourcing market-access services helps explain variation in access costs related to gravity and extended gravity, affects both sunk and fixed export costs, and substantially amplifies the variety gains from trade liberalization.
10.1162/rest.a.1816.abstract_zh: 随着制造业企业全球扩张，广告和法律支持等商业服务成为进入新市场的关键。利用外生需求冲击，我们发现法国制造商在进入更多目的地市场时，会越来越多地将市场准入服务外包。我们构建了一个市场准入成本理论，其中企业需权衡内部提供的管理压力与外包的适应成本——这一机制得到了实证支持。进一步研究表明，外包市场准入服务有助于解释与引力模型及扩展引力模型相关的准入成本差异，同时影响出口的沉没成本和固定成本，并显著放大了贸易自由化带来的品种增益。
10.1162/rest.a.1816.title: Managing Export Complexity: The Role of Service Outsourcing
10.1162/rest.a.1816.title_zh: 管理出口复杂性：服务外包的作用

10.1162/rest.a.1817.abstract: Abstract No. Elite institutions offer high salaries because they hire the most valued faculty. Moreover, in contrast to the broader labor market, faculty are equally likely to move up and down the prestige ladder, and they increase their salary either way. We speculate that these facts reflect the visible nature of faculty productivity and the sporadic nature of academic job openings.
10.1162/rest.a.1817.abstract_zh: 摘要编号。精英机构之所以提供高薪，是因为它们聘用了最具价值的教职员工。此外，与更广泛的劳动力市场不同，教职员工在声望阶梯上向上或向下流动的可能性相当，且无论哪种流动方向，他们的薪资都会增加。我们推测，这些事实反映了教职员工生产力的可见性以及学术职位空缺的偶发性。
10.1162/rest.a.1817.title: Do Elite Universities Overpay Their Faculty?
10.1162/rest.a.1817.title_zh: 精英大学是否向其教师支付过高薪酬？

10.1162/rest.a.1818.abstract: We document a series of stylized facts about how firms seek to protect the rents from innovation, using a large nationally representative survey of U.S. businesses over the period 2008-2015. Just 1.4 percent of firms obtain patents, but these patenting firms account for 87 percent of R&D investment. Firms consider utility patents less important than other forms of IP protection, like trade secrets, trademarks, and copyrights. Firm industry and size are strongly correlated with firms’ use of all types of intellectual property, but firm-age is not. Implications for innovation research and policy are discussed.
10.1162/rest.a.1818.abstract_zh: 本文利用2008-2015年间美国企业的大规模全国代表性调查数据，系统记录了企业如何寻求保护创新租金的一系列典型事实。仅有1.4%的企业获得专利，但这些专利企业却占据了研发投资的87%。企业认为实用专利的重要性低于其他形式的知识产权保护，如商业秘密、商标和版权。企业所属行业和规模与其使用各类知识产权的行为高度相关，但企业年龄则不然。本文讨论了这些发现对创新研究与政策制定的启示。
10.1162/rest.a.1818.title: Innovation, Patenting and Appropriability: Survey Evidence from a Nationally Representative Sample of U.S. Firms
10.1162/rest.a.1818.title_zh: 创新、专利与专有性：基于美国企业全国代表性样本的调查证据

10.1162/rest.a.1819.abstract: We examine the impact of firearm violence on newborn health in the U.S. using two approaches. First, we analyze the “beltway sniper” attacks in 2002, leveraging both temporal and spatial variation to compare birth outcomes of exposed children to those unexposed. Second, we investigate in-utero exposure to mass shootings using national data. We find that exposure to these incidents during pregnancy increases the likelihood of very low-birthweight and very premature birth. These events carry a significant economic burden, with the beltway sniper attacks costing at least $155 million and mass shootings resulting in annual costs exceeding $75 million.
10.1162/rest.a.1819.abstract_zh: 本文采用两种方法考察美国枪支暴力对新生儿健康的影响。首先，我们以2002年"环城狙击手"袭击事件为研究对象，利用时间与空间双重变异，比较受暴露儿童与未受暴露儿童的出生结局。其次，我们运用全国数据探究产前接触大规模枪击事件的影响。研究发现，孕期暴露于此类事件会显著增加极低出生体重和极早产的发生概率。这些事件带来沉重的经济负担——"环城狙击手"袭击事件至少造成1.55亿美元损失，而大规模枪击事件每年产生的成本超过7500万美元。
10.1162/rest.a.1819.title: The Hidden Cost of Firearm Violence on Infants in Utero
10.1162/rest.a.1819.title_zh: 枪支暴力对胎儿期婴儿的隐性成本

10.1162/rest.a.1820.abstract: Abstract Court capture in developing countries is pervasive, yet its economic effects remain underexplored. We study a Chinese reform that transferred financial and personnel authority over local courts from local to provincial governments. Exploiting the staggered roll-out, we find a 7.3% decline in local defendants’ win rates against non-local plaintiffs, alongside improved judicial quality. The reform encouraged smaller non-local firms to litigate and attracted non-local investment, potentially raising GDP by 1.9%. Yet favoritism toward politically connected firms and inter-provincial protectionism remain, and centralization itself promotes less qualified judges— revealing both its promise and limits.
10.1162/rest.a.1820.abstract_zh: 发展中国家普遍存在法院被地方俘获的现象，但其经济影响尚未得到充分研究。本文研究了中国将地方法院的财政与人事管理权从地方政府转移至省级政府的改革。利用该改革分阶段推行的特征，我们发现本地被告对非本地原告的胜诉率下降7.3%，同时司法质量得到提升。改革鼓励小型非本地企业提起诉讼并吸引非本地投资，可能使GDP增长1.9%。然而，对政治关联企业的偏袒及省际保护主义依然存在，且集权化本身导致法官资质下降——这揭示了改革的成效与局限。
10.1162/rest.a.1820.title: Court Capture, Local Protectionism, and Economic Integration: Evidence from China
10.1162/rest.a.1820.title_zh: 法院俘获、地方保护主义与经济一体化：来自中国的证据

10.1162/rest.a.1821.abstract: Abstract Televised debates between presidential candidates are often regarded as the exemplar of persuasive communication. Yet, recent evidence from Le Pennec and Pons (2023) indicates that they may not sway voters as strongly as popular belief suggests. We revisit their findings through the lens of the persuasion rate and introduce a robust framework that does not require exogenous treatment, parallel trends, or credible instruments. Instead, we leverage plausible monotonicity assumptions to partially identify the persuasion rate and related parameters. Our results reaffirm that the sharp upper bounds on the persuasive effects of TV debates remain modest.
10.1162/rest.a.1821.abstract_zh: 摘要 总统候选人之间的电视辩论常被视为说服性传播的典范。然而，Le Pennec与Pons（2023）的最新证据表明，其影响选民的程度可能远不及普遍认知。我们通过说服率视角重新审视其研究发现，并引入一个无需外生处理、平行趋势或可信工具变量的稳健框架。相反，我们利用合理的单调性假设对说服率及相关参数进行部分识别。研究结果再次证实，电视辩论说服效应的严格上界仍较为有限。
10.1162/rest.a.1821.title: Bounding the Effect of Persuasion with Monotonicity Assumptions: Reassessing the Impact of TV Debates
10.1162/rest.a.1821.title_zh: 单调性假设下说服效应的边界：重新评估电视辩论的影响

10.1162/rest.a.1822.abstract: This paper develops a semiparametric sieve approach to estimate impulse response functions of nonlinear time series models within a broad class of structural autoregressive specifications. A two-step procedure flexibly captures nonlinearities without imposing fixed parametric forms. We establish uniform estimation guarantees and propose an iterative algorithm that makes impulse response computation straightforward. Simulation results show robustness to misspecification with only modest efficiency losses. In an application to U.S. monetary policy, we find larger GDP responses to interest rate hikes than in linear models. We also examine oil supply news shocks of varying magnitudes to assess limitations when analyzing large shocks.
10.1162/rest.a.1822.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种半参数筛分方法，用于在广泛的结构自回归模型类别中估计非线性时间序列模型的脉冲响应函数。该两步法无需设定固定参数形式，即可灵活捕捉非线性特征。我们建立了均匀估计保证，并提出一种迭代算法，使脉冲响应计算变得简便。模拟结果表明，该方法对模型误设具有稳健性，且仅带来适度的效率损失。在应用于美国货币政策时，我们发现利率上调对GDP的影响大于线性模型的结果。此外，我们考察了不同幅度的石油供给新闻冲击，以评估分析大规模冲击时的局限性。
10.1162/rest.a.1822.title: Impulse Response Analysis of Structural Nonlinear Time Series Models
10.1162/rest.a.1822.title_zh: 结构非线性时间序列模型的脉冲响应分析

10.1162/rest.a.1829.abstract: Developing countries face high pharmaceutical prices despite the presence of multiple generic producers. One key reason is excessive spending on sales and marketing by drug firms. This paper examines how centralized drug procurement can curb such marketing efforts and reduce prices, using a policy experiment in China where certain generics are procured through centralized auctions in pilot cities. Winning firms gain large market shares directly without high marketing costs. We find that the centralized auction significantly reduces both sales costs and prices, with winning firms experiencing notable decreases in marketing-related labor demand.
10.1162/rest.a.1829.abstract_zh: 发展中国家尽管存在多家仿制药生产商，却仍面临高昂的药品价格。其中一个关键原因是制药企业在销售和营销上的过度支出。本文利用中国在试点城市对特定仿制药实施集中采购拍卖的政策实验，考察集中采购如何抑制此类营销行为并降低价格。中标企业无需承担高额营销成本即可直接获得较大市场份额。研究发现，集中采购拍卖显著降低了销售成本与药品价格，中标企业的营销相关劳动力需求出现明显下降。
10.1162/rest.a.1829.title: Excessive Pharmaceutical Marketing Expenditure: Policy Remedies from China
10.1162/rest.a.1829.title_zh: 过高的药品营销支出：来自中国的政策应对

10.1162/rest.a.1830.abstract: We study the effect of the MeToo movement on reports of sex crimes to the police. Using multiple empirical strategies, including a triple-difference design comparing crime types across countries and over time, we find that the movement increased reported sex crimes by approximately 10%. Analyzing incident-level US data, we find that the movement also increased arrests and had similar effects across racial and socioeconomic groups. The evidence suggests that the increase reflects a higher propensity to report sex crimes rather than an increase in their incidence. Our results demonstrate that social movements can rapidly and persistently change high-stakes personal decisions.
10.1162/rest.a.1830.abstract_zh: 我们研究了MeToo运动对向警方报告性犯罪的影响。通过多种实证策略（包括比较不同国家、不同时期犯罪类型的三重差分设计），我们发现该运动使报告的性犯罪数量增加了约10%。对美国事件层面数据的分析表明，该运动还提高了逮捕率，且对不同种族和社会经济群体产生了相似的影响。证据显示，这一增长反映的是性犯罪报告倾向的提高，而非性犯罪发生率的上升。我们的结果表明，社会运动能够迅速且持续地改变高风险的个体决策。
10.1162/rest.a.1830.title: The Effects of Social Movements: Evidence from #MeToo
10.1162/rest.a.1830.title_zh: 社会运动的影响：来自#MeToo运动的证据

10.1162/rest.a.1831.abstract: We study how employer concentration affects job design, focusing on schedule flexibility as a non-wage job attribute. Using the full text of 46 million UK job vacancies from 2014–2019, we construct new measures of flexible work arrangements using supervised machine learning and large-language-model—assisted annotations. Adopting an instrumental variable strategy using a Bartik-style prediction of the change in employer concentration based on nationwide hiring trends, we show that higher concentration reduces the value of worker compensation partly through shifts toward “risky” flexibility that exposes workers to earnings volatility.
10.1162/rest.a.1831.abstract_zh: 我们研究了雇主集中度如何影响工作设计，重点关注作为非工资性工作属性的排班灵活性。利用2014-2019年间4600万条英国职位空缺的全文数据，我们通过监督式机器学习与大语言模型辅助标注，构建了灵活工作安排的新测度。采用工具变量策略——基于全国招聘趋势对雇主集中度变化进行巴蒂克式预测——我们发现，更高的集中度会通过转向使工人面临收入波动的“风险型”灵活性，部分降低工人薪酬价值。
10.1162/rest.a.1831.title: Firm Concentration and Job Design: The Case of Schedule Flexible Work Arrangements
10.1162/rest.a.1831.title_zh: 企业集中度与工作设计：以弹性工时安排为例

10.1162/rest.a.1832.abstract: A recent literature studies fiscal policy with realistic intertemporal marginal propensities to consume and the absence of Ricardian equivalence. This literature shows that fiscal policy boosts consumption and is effective: (i) Cumulative fiscal multipliers are above one, and (ii) fiscal policy is fully self-financing. I show this does not extend to small open economies by providing conditions where (i) the cumulative fiscal multiplier is exactly one, and (ii) fiscal deficits are not fully self-financing. This is because the initial debt-fueled rise in consumption is offset by a drop to repay foreign debt. Finally, I provide conditions to overturn this result.
10.1162/rest.a.1832.abstract_zh: 近期文献在考虑现实跨期边际消费倾向且不存在李嘉图等价的前提下，研究了财政政策效应。该文献表明，财政政策能够促进消费且具有有效性：（i）累积财政乘数大于1，（ii）财政政策可实现完全自我融资。本文通过设定条件证明，这一结论并不适用于小型开放经济体：在这些条件下，（i）累积财政乘数恰好等于1，（ii）财政赤字无法实现完全自我融资。其根本原因在于，由债务驱动的初始消费增长将被偿还外债所导致的消费下降所抵消。最后，本文提出了可推翻该结论的条件。
10.1162/rest.a.1832.title: Fiscal Policy in Small Open Economies: The International Intertemporal Keynesian Cross
10.1162/rest.a.1832.title_zh: 小型开放经济体中的财政政策：国际跨期凯恩斯交叉

10.1162/rest.a.1833.abstract: This paper reevaluates the longstanding debate on capital-labor substitution by examining the role of external inputs: raw materials, intermediate goods and services, imports, offshoring. Both a meta-analysis (analyzing existing estimates of substitution) and direct estimation (using U.S. data for 1963-2016) indicate that external inputs disproportionately displace labor. These findings imply (1) that the capital-labor ratio responds 40-80% more strongly to the price of labor than to the price of capital, (2) that value added cannot be modeled separably from gross output, and (3) that historical disagreements regarding substitution can be recast as an omitted variable bias involving external inputs.
10.1162/rest.a.1833.abstract_zh: 本文通过考察外部投入（原材料、中间品与服务、进口、离岸外包）的作用，重新审视了关于资本-劳动替代的长期争论。元分析（对现有替代弹性估计值的系统性分析）与直接估计（基于1963-2016年美国数据）均表明，外部投入对劳动的替代效应尤为显著。这些发现意味着：（1）资本-劳动比对劳动价格的反应强度比对资本价格的反应强度高出40-80%；（2）增加值无法与总产出进行可分离建模；（3）历史上关于替代弹性的分歧可被重新解释为涉及外部投入的遗漏变量偏误。
10.1162/rest.a.1833.title: The Factor Bias of External Inputs: Implications for Substitution between Capital and Labor
10.1162/rest.a.1833.title_zh: 外部投入的要素偏向：对资本与劳动替代关系的启示

10.1162/rest.a.1834.abstract: We study how public disclosure of politicians’ outside income affects their behavior. We exploit a disclosure reform targeting German federal MPs and tax-return data in a difference-indifferences setup using unaffected state MPs as controls. MPs increase their outside income by 24%, driven by likely right-leaning MPs. A representative survey experiment uncovers that right-leaning voters interpret outside income as a signal of competence and hard work, while left-leaning voters associate it with weaker representation. Consistent with this, we show that newspapers cover right-leaning MPs’ outside activities more favorably. Our findings suggest that politicians strategically use public disclosure as a signaling tool.
10.1162/rest.a.1834.abstract_zh: 我们研究了政治家外部收入的公开披露如何影响其行为。利用一项针对德国联邦议会议员的披露改革及纳税申报数据，在双重差分框架下以未受影响的州议会议员作为对照组进行分析。研究发现，议员的院外收入增加了24%，这一增长主要由倾向右翼的议员驱动。一项代表性调查实验揭示，右翼选民将外部收入视为能力与勤奋的信号，而左翼选民则将其与代表性不足相关联。与此一致的是，我们发现报纸对右翼议员外部活动的报道更为正面。研究结果表明，政治家会策略性地将公开披露作为信号传递工具。
10.1162/rest.a.1834.title: Outside Income as a Signal: Evidence from Politicians and Voters
10.1162/rest.a.1834.title_zh: 外部收入作为信号：来自政治家与选民的证据

10.1162/rest.a.1835.abstract: We study the unintended effects of Fair Access to Insurance Requirements (FAIR) plans developed by 26 states in the 1960s to address insurance redlining in urban neighborhoods. FAIR plans’ problematic features included prohibitions on considering environmental hazards in underwriting, mandatory insurer participation in pools that diluted underwriting incentives, and payouts exceeding market values in declining areas. Using a triple-difference design comparing pre/post-FAIR periods, neighborhoods with/without likely FAIR access, and participating/non-participating states, we find that FAIR inadvertently led to significant housing disinvestment and accelerated declines in neighborhood population, with simultaneous increases in the Black population share.
10.1162/rest.a.1835.abstract_zh: 本文研究了20世纪60年代美国26个州为应对城市社区保险红线歧视而制定的《公平保险准入要求》（FAIR）计划所产生的非预期效应。FAIR计划的问题特征包括：禁止在承保中考虑环境危害、强制保险公司参与稀释承保激励的共保池，以及赔付金额超过衰退区域的市场价值。通过采用三重差分设计——比较FAIR实施前后时期、可能获得FAIR准入的社区与未获得社区、参与州与非参与州——我们发现FAIR计划意外导致了显著的住房投资减少，加速了社区人口下降，同时黑人人口占比同步上升。
10.1162/rest.a.1835.title: The Bronx Is Burning: Urban Disinvestment Effects of Fair Access to Insurance Requirements Plans
10.1162/rest.a.1835.title_zh: 布朗克斯在燃烧：公平保险准入计划的城市撤资效应

10.1162/rest.a.1836.abstract: We identify the distributional and quantile marginal treatment effect functions when the outcome is right-censored. Our method requires a conditionally exogenous instrument and random censoring. We propose asymptotically consistent semi-parametric estimators and valid inferential procedures for the target functions . To illustrate, we evaluate the effect of alternative sentences (fines and community service vs. no punishment) on recidivism in Brazil. Our results highlight substantial treatment effect heterogeneity: we find that people whom most judges would punish take longer to recidivate, while people who would be punished only by strict judges recidivate at an earlier date than if they were not punished.
10.1162/rest.a.1836.abstract_zh: 我们识别了当结果存在右删失时的分布和分位数边际处理效应函数。该方法要求工具变量条件外生且删失随机。我们提出了目标函数的渐近一致半参数估计量及有效推断程序。为进行说明，我们评估了巴西替代性刑罚（罚金与社区服务 vs. 无惩罚）对再犯率的影响。研究结果凸显了显著的处理效应异质性：多数法官倾向于施以惩罚的个体再犯间隔时间更长，而仅被严厉法官判处惩罚的个体，其再犯时间反而早于未受惩罚的情况。
10.1162/rest.a.1836.title: Was Javert Right to Be Suspicious? Marginal Treatment Effects with Duration Outcomes
10.1162/rest.a.1836.title_zh: 贾维特的怀疑是对的吗？持续期结果下的边际处理效应

10.1162/rest.a.1837.abstract: This paper studies how to design experiments when the experimental units are large aggregate entities (e.g., markets), and only one or a small number of units can be treated. We propose a class of non-randomized experimental designs using the synthetic control method, which jointly selects treated units and untreated units to serve as a comparison group. We analyze the properties of estimators under these synthetic control designs and develop new inferential techniques. We show that, in experiments with aggregate units, synthetic control designs can substantially reduce estimation bias relative to randomized experiments.
10.1162/rest.a.1837.abstract_zh: 本文研究当实验单元为大型聚合实体（如市场）且仅能对一个或少量单元进行干预时，如何设计实验。我们提出一类基于合成控制法的非随机化实验设计，该方法联合选择处理组单元与对照组单元作为比较组。我们分析了此类合成控制设计下估计量的性质，并开发了新的推断技术。研究表明，在聚合单元实验中，相较于随机化实验，合成控制设计能显著降低估计偏差。
10.1162/rest.a.1837.title: Synthetic Controls for Experimental Design
10.1162/rest.a.1837.title_zh: 实验设计的合成控制法

10.1162/rest.a.1838.abstract: While the relationship between health insurance coverage and health outcomes has been extensively studied, there is limited evidence on which specific features of insurance matter. We address this gap by leveraging the abrupt termination of Colombia’s largest health insurer and examining the spillover effects on patients who were not enrolled with the terminated insurer. The termination caused a 10% decrease in the breadth of provider networks among incumbent insurers and a 20% increase in mortality rates. We show two mechanisms drove the change in mortality: increased congestion stemming from the surge of enrollees at incumbent insurers and reduced provider network breadth. Insurers narrowed their networks by excluding higher-quality providers that served sicker, more expensive patients, whoin turn died at much higher rates than their counterparts. Findings suggest insurers play a key role in patient health through their provider networks.
10.1162/rest.a.1838.abstract_zh: 尽管健康保险覆盖与健康结果之间的关系已被广泛研究，但关于保险具体特征如何影响健康结果的证据仍然有限。我们利用哥伦比亚最大健康保险公司的突然终止，考察其对未参保于该终止保险公司的患者产生的溢出效应，从而填补这一研究空白。该保险公司的终止导致现有保险公司的医疗服务提供者网络广度下降10%，死亡率上升20%。我们揭示了驱动死亡率变化的两种机制：因参保者涌入现有保险公司而导致的拥堵加剧，以及医疗服务提供者网络广度的缩减。保险公司通过排除那些服务于病情更重、医疗费用更高患者的优质医疗服务提供者来收窄其网络，而这些患者的死亡率远高于其他患者。研究结果表明，保险公司通过其医疗服务提供者网络在患者健康中发挥着关键作用。
10.1162/rest.a.1838.title: Do Health Insurers Matter for Health Outcomes? Evidence from a Large Natural Experiment in Colombia
10.1162/rest.a.1838.title_zh: 健康保险公司对健康结果有影响吗？来自哥伦比亚一项大型自然实验的证据

10.1162/rest.a.1839.abstract: Globally, one-third of food is discarded, generating lifecycle greenhouse gas emissions comparable to those from road transport. Further, waste management is among the largest municipal budget items worldwide. Exploiting plausibly exogenous unit-based food waste tax expansions in South Korea, I find that the tax substantially reduces food waste by discouraging excessive grocery purchases. Households sustain food intake despite buying less, but at the cost of additional time spent on meal production. Nonpecuniary motivations appear central to the policy’s e!ectiveness, and the tax is likely welfare-improving because more e"cient food use not only reduces externalities but also offsets time costs.
10.1162/rest.a.1839.abstract_zh: 全球范围内，三分之一的食物被丢弃，其产生的生命周期温室气体排放量与公路运输相当。此外，废弃物管理是全球市政预算中最大的支出项目之一。利用韩国基于单位计量的食品废弃物税扩大的准外生性变化，本研究发现该税种通过抑制过度购买行为显著减少了食品浪费。尽管家庭购买量减少，但食物摄入量得以维持，代价是增加了膳食制作的时间投入。非金钱动机对该政策的有效性至关重要，而该税种很可能提升社会福利，因为更高效的食物利用不仅减少了外部性，还抵消了时间成本。
10.1162/rest.a.1839.title: Does a Food Waste Tax Work? Evidence from Quasi-Experiments in South Korea
10.1162/rest.a.1839.title_zh: 食品浪费税有效吗？来自韩国准实验的证据

10.1162/rest.a.271.abstract: Migrant workers and employers rely on intermediaries to facilitate labor market placements. If information frictions obscure their reputation, however, intermediaries may underinvest in placement quality. Using data on more than 1.5 million Sri Lankan migrants to the Gulf region, we examine the effects of a government-run intermediary rating program that publicly revealed ratings two years after it was announced. Prior to the ratings’ public release, underperforming intermediaries invest in the rating criteria and place migrants in less abusive and more remunerative employment. Our results suggest the government’s threat of quality revelation induced intermediaries to prospectively screen employers and improve placement quality.
10.1162/rest.a.271.abstract_zh: 移民工人与雇主依赖中介机构促进劳动力市场匹配。然而，若信息摩擦掩盖了中介机构的声誉，其可能会在安置质量上投资不足。基于超过150万斯里兰卡移民至海湾地区的数据，我们考察了一项政府主导的中介评级计划的效果——该计划在公布两年后公开披露评级结果。在评级结果公开发布前，表现不佳的中介机构已针对评级标准进行投入，并将移民安置到虐待程度更低、薪酬更优的岗位。研究结果表明，政府以质量信息透明化为威慑手段，促使中介机构前瞻性地筛选雇主并提升安置质量。
10.1162/rest.a.271.title: Regulation by Reputation? Intermediaries, Labor Abuses, and International Migration
10.1162/rest.a.271.title_zh: 声誉监管？中介、劳工虐待与国际移民

10.1162/rest.e.1731.title: Review of Economics and Statistics 2026 Annual Report

10.1162/rest_a_00269.abstract: A key input to inventive activity is human capital. Hence, it is important to understand the monetary incentives of inventors. We estimate the effect of patented inventions on individual earnings by linking data on U.S. patents and their inventors to Finnish employer-employee data. Returns are heterogeneous: inventors get a temporary reward of 3% of annual earnings for a patent grant and for highly cited patents a longer-lasting premium of 30% in earnings three years later. Similar medium-term premium's accrue to inventors who initially hold the patent rights, although they forgo earnings at the time of the grant.
10.1162/rest_a_00269.abstract_zh: 发明活动的关键投入是人力资本。因此，理解发明者的货币激励至关重要。我们通过将美国专利及其发明者数据与芬兰雇主-雇员数据相关联，估算了专利发明对个人收入的影响。回报呈现异质性：发明者因获得专利授权可获得相当于年收入3%的临时奖励，而对于高被引专利，三年后其收入可获得30%的长期溢价。类似的中期溢价也适用于最初持有专利权的发明者，尽管他们在专利授权时放弃了部分收入。
10.1162/rest_a_00269.title: Returns to Inventors

10.1162/rest_a_01405.abstract: This paper explores whether and why a maternal child penalty to earnings would emerge even without changes in employment and hours worked. Using a matched event study design, we trace monthly changes in determinants of wages (job performance, human capital accumulation, and promotions). Data come from a usefully unusual setting with required multiyear employment and detailed personnel data: the US Marine Corps. Mothers’ job performance initially declines, and gaps in promotion grow through 24 months postbirth. Fathers’ physical fitness performance drops somewhat but recovers. These patterns lead mothers to earn relatively lower wages, even absent changes in employment postbirth.
10.1162/rest_a_01405.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了即使在就业和工作时长不变的情况下，母亲因育儿导致的收入惩罚是否会出现及其成因。通过匹配事件研究设计，我们追踪了工资决定因素（工作表现、人力资本积累和晋升）的月度变化。数据来源于一个具有特殊研究价值的场景——美国海军陆战队，该场景要求多年连续就业并提供详细人事数据。研究发现，母亲的工作表现最初出现下降，且晋升差距在产后24个月内持续扩大。父亲的身体素质表现虽有短暂下滑但随后恢复。这些模式导致母亲在产后即使就业状态未变，其相对工资水平仍有所降低。
10.1162/rest_a_01405.title: Baby Bumps in the Road: The Impact of Parenthood on Job Performance, Human Capital, and Career Advancement
10.1162/rest_a_01405.title_zh: 育儿路上的坎坷：为人父母对工作绩效、人力资本及职业晋升的影响

10.1162/rest_a_01414.abstract: We study treatment-effect estimation using panel data. The treatment may be nonbinary, nonabsorbing, and the outcome may be affected by treatment lags. We make a parallel-trends assumption and propose event-study estimators of the effect of being exposed to a weakly higher treatment dose for ℓ periods. We also propose normalized estimators that estimate a weighted average of the effects of the current treatment and its lags. We also analyze commonly used two-way, fixed-effects regressions. Unlike our estimators, they can be biased in the presence of heterogeneous treatment effects. A local-projection version of those regressions is biased even with homogeneous effects.
10.1162/rest_a_01414.abstract_zh: 本文利用面板数据研究处理效应估计。处理变量可能为非二元、非吸收性，且结果可能受到处理滞后期的影响。我们基于平行趋势假设，提出事件研究估计量，用于估计暴露于弱更高处理剂量持续ℓ期的效应。同时，我们提出标准化估计量，以估计当前处理效应及其滞后效应的加权平均值。此外，我们分析了常用的双向固定效应回归模型。与我们的估计量不同，这些模型在存在异质性处理效应时可能产生偏误。即使处理效应具有同质性，这些回归的局部投影版本仍存在偏误。
10.1162/rest_a_01414.title: Difference-in-Differences Estimators of Intertemporal Treatment Effects
10.1162/rest_a_01414.title_zh: 跨期处理效应的双重差分估计量

10.1162/rest_a_01426.abstract: We study the influence of workplace peers on a high-stakes, irreversible retirement plan choice. Midcareer U.S. military personnel choose between higher future pension payouts or an immediate bonus plus lower future payouts. With peers defined as those who have locked in their choices and personnel assignment rules ensuring that peer groups are exogenously formed, we capture the causal impact of peers. Greater peer take-up of the bonus, which is difficult to compare to the alternative plan but often extremely costly over one’s lifetime, discourages choosers from selecting the bonus. Peers have special impact within professional, race, and gender groups.
10.1162/rest_a_01426.abstract_zh: 我们研究了工作场所同伴对一项高风险的、不可逆的退休计划选择的影响。美国军队中的职业生涯中期人员需要在更高的未来养老金支付与即时奖金加较低的未来支付之间做出选择。我们将同伴定义为那些已经锁定自己选择的人员，并且由于人员分配规则确保了同伴群体是外生形成的，我们捕捉到了同伴的因果影响。同伴对奖金的接受率更高——尽管这种奖金与替代计划难以比较，且通常在一生中代价极高——会抑制选择者选择奖金。同伴在职业、种族和性别群体内具有特殊影响。
10.1162/rest_a_01426.title: Information Transmission in Groups: Peer Influence in High-Stakes, Irreversible Financial Decisions
10.1162/rest_a_01426.title_zh: 群体中的信息传递：高风险不可逆财务决策中的同伴影响

10.1162/rest_a_01427.abstract: The US tax system allows taxpayers to deduct local taxes from their taxable incomes. Using school district referendum results, we employ a continuous treatment two-way fixed-effects framework to provide causal evidence of a positive relation between the demand for local public goods and the share of residents deducting local taxes. We find that a 1 percentage point decrease in the share of residents deducting property taxes reduces tax and bond referendum approval rates by approximately 0.97 percentage points. Because these federal tax deductions disproportionately benefit higher-income individuals, they potentially widen disparities in public service provision across jurisdictions.
10.1162/rest_a_01427.abstract_zh: 美国税收制度允许纳税人从其应税收入中扣除地方税。利用学区公投结果，我们采用连续处理双向固定效应框架，为地方公共产品需求与居民地方税扣除比例之间的正相关关系提供了因果证据。研究发现，居民房产税扣除比例每下降1个百分点，税收和债券公投的通过率将降低约0.97个百分点。由于这些联邦税收扣除对高收入群体的惠及程度不成比例，它们可能加剧不同辖区之间公共服务供给的差距。
10.1162/rest_a_01427.title: Federal Tax Deductions and the Demand for Local Public Goods
10.1162/rest_a_01427.title_zh: 联邦税收减免与地方公共物品需求

10.1162/rest_a_01428.abstract: This paper reports causal evidence on how the extent of hybrid work—the number of days worked from home relative to days worked from office—affects employee attitudes and performance. Workers who spent around two days in the office each week on average self-reported greater work-life balance, more job satisfaction, and lower isolation from colleagues compared to workers who spent more or fewer days in the office. Employees in the intermediate hybrid condition received no different performance ratings compared to peers who spent more or fewer days in the office.
10.1162/rest_a_01428.abstract_zh: 本文报告了关于混合办公程度（即居家办公天数与办公室办公天数的比例）如何影响员工态度与绩效的因果证据。与每周在办公室工作天数更多或更少的员工相比，平均每周在办公室工作约两天的员工自我报告的工作与生活平衡度更高、工作满意度更高，且与同事的隔离感更低。处于中等混合办公条件下的员工，其绩效评级与每周在办公室工作天数更多或更少的同事相比并无显著差异。
10.1162/rest_a_01428.title: Is Hybrid Work the Best of Both Worlds? Evidence from a Field Experiment
10.1162/rest_a_01428.title_zh: 混合办公模式是否两全其美？来自田野实验的证据

10.1162/rest_a_01436.abstract: We examine how the 1993 Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) impacts the gender composition at U.S. firms experiencing a negative demand shock. Combining changes in Chinese imports across industries between 2000 and 2003 and a sharp regression discontinuity to identify FMLA status, we find that an increase in import competition decreases the share of female employment, earnings, and promotions at FMLA relative to non-FMLA firms. This effect is driven by women in prime child-bearing ages and without college degrees and is pronounced at firms with all male managers. These results suggest that job-protected leave mandates may exacerbate gender inequalities in response to adverse shocks.
10.1162/rest_a_01436.abstract_zh: 本文研究了1993年《家庭与医疗休假法案》（FMLA）如何影响遭受负面需求冲击的美国企业的性别构成。通过结合2000年至2003年间各行业中国进口变化，并利用断点回归方法识别FMLA适用状态，我们发现：相较于非FMLA企业，进口竞争加剧导致FMLA企业中女性就业比例、收入及晋升机会下降。这一效应主要由处于生育黄金年龄且未获得大学学位的女性群体驱动，并在管理层全为男性的企业中尤为显著。研究结果表明，带薪休假保障政策可能加剧企业在应对负面冲击时的性别不平等现象。
10.1162/rest_a_01436.title: Family-Leave Mandates and Female Labor at U.S. Firms: Evidence from a Trade Shock
10.1162/rest_a_01436.title_zh: 美国家庭休假强制令与企业女性劳动力：来自贸易冲击的证据

10.1162/rest_a_01437.abstract: This paper presents an alternative perspective to a longstanding empirical puzzle: that most entrepreneurs persevere despite persistently low earnings. Because entrepreneurial earnings are notoriously difficult to measure, I approach the question from an expenditure angle. I look at how switching into self-employment corresponds to changes in reported earnings versus expenditure. Using 45 years of longitudinal data, I find that individuals report earning 27.7% less in self-employment, while spending 3.8% more. This household expenditure premium accrues with entrepreneurial experience and is not offset by lower savings or longer work hours. The results hold in highly educated and incorporated business owner subsamples.
10.1162/rest_a_01437.abstract_zh: 本文为长期存在的实证谜题——多数企业家在持续低收益下仍坚持创业——提供了新的解释视角。鉴于创业收益难以精确衡量，本文从支出角度切入研究，考察转向自雇就业如何影响报告收入与支出的变化。基于45年纵向数据研究发现：个体在自雇状态下报告收入降低27.7%，但支出反而增加3.8%。这种家庭支出溢价随创业经验积累而递增，且未被储蓄减少或工时延长所抵消。该结论在高等教育群体及注册企业主子样本中依然稳健成立。
10.1162/rest_a_01437.title: The Unobserved Returns to Entrepreneurship

10.1162/rest_a_01438.abstract: This study examines the impact of school choice on academic achievement. I use differences in the number of schools across similar Romanian towns, generating variation in school choice for local students, who compete for seats via test scores. I find that more school choice results in increased sorting of students by admission scores across different schools. Sorting widens achievement gaps between high- and low-admission score students. High-scorers having access to better teachers and peer effects are the primary factors explaining these widening gaps. Last, between-school competition via school choice does not increase average achievement levels.
10.1162/rest_a_01438.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨学校选择对学业成就的影响。利用罗马尼亚相似城镇间学校数量的差异，当地学生通过考试成绩竞争入学名额，由此产生学校选择的变化。研究发现，更多学校选择导致学生按录取分数在不同学校间的分层加剧。这种分层扩大了高、低录取分数学生之间的成就差距。高分数学生能够获得更优质的教师资源和同伴效应，这是解释差距扩大的主要因素。最后，学校间通过择校机制形成的竞争并未提升平均学业成就水平。
10.1162/rest_a_01438.title: School Choice, Student Sorting, and Academic Performance
10.1162/rest_a_01438.title_zh: 学校选择、学生分类与学业表现

10.1162/rest_a_01441.abstract: This paper describes how to reparametrize low-dimensional factor models with one or two factors to fit weak identification theory developed for generalized method of moments models. Some identification-robust tests, here called “plug-in” tests, require a reparametrization to distinguish weakly identified parameters from strongly identified parameters. The reparametrizations in this paper make plug-in tests available for subvector hypotheses in low-dimensional factor models with one or two factors. Simulations show that the plug-in tests are less conservative than identification-robust tests that use the original parametrization. An empirical application to a factor model of parental investments in children is included.
10.1162/rest_a_01441.abstract_zh: 本文阐述了如何对含有一个或两个因子的低维因子模型进行重新参数化，以适配为广义矩估计模型开发的弱识别理论。部分识别稳健性检验（此处称为"插件式"检验）需要通过重新参数化来区分弱识别参数与强识别参数。本文提出的重新参数化方法使得插件式检验能够应用于含有一个或两个因子的低维因子模型中的子向量假设。模拟结果表明，相较于使用原始参数化的识别稳健性检验，插件式检验的保守性更低。文中还包含一个关于父母对子女投资因子模型的实证应用案例。
10.1162/rest_a_01441.title: Weak Identification in Low-Dimensional Factor Models with One or Two Factors
10.1162/rest_a_01441.title_zh: 一或两个因子低维因子模型中的弱识别问题

10.1162/rest_a_01442.abstract: We propose a quantitative spatial model featuring heterogeneous worker groups and their travel to consume nontradable goods and services. We consider the opening of the Downtown Line in Singapore, which connected regions where high-income households have residential amenities to where nontraded sectors are productive. Leveraging transit farecard data, we show that high-income workers saw large welfare gains but low-income workers gained little. Everyone enjoyed improved access to consumption opportunities, but low-income jobs in nontradables moved to less attractive workplaces. Abstracting from consumption travel understates the disparate impact across worker groups threefold.
10.1162/rest_a_01442.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含异质性工人群体及其通勤消费非贸易商品与服务的定量空间模型。以新加坡市区线的开通为研究对象，该线路将高收入家庭享有居住便利性的区域与非贸易部门具有生产优势的区域相连接。基于交通票务数据，我们发现高收入工人获得了显著的福利提升，而低收入工人获益甚微。所有群体均享受到消费机会改善，但非贸易部门的低收入岗位转移至吸引力较低的工作场所。若忽略消费通勤因素，不同工人群体间的差异化影响将被低估三倍。
10.1162/rest_a_01442.title: Urban Transit Infrastructure and Inequality
10.1162/rest_a_01442.title_zh: 城市交通基础设施与不平等

10.1162/rest_a_01443.abstract: Exponential regressions are frequently used when outcomes are non-negative. They are attractive because they are easy to interpret and to estimate, using pseudomaximum likelihood (PML). However, the validity of these methods depends on the correct specification of the conditional expectation, and little is known regarding their properties when the conditional expectation is misspecified.
