We show that PML estimators of misspecified exponential models provide optimal approximations to the conditional expectation, in a weighted mean squared error sense, and we give conditions under which their Poisson PML estimator identifies average marginal effects.
10.1162/rest_a_01443.abstract_zh: 当结果变量为非负值时，指数回归模型被广泛使用。这类模型因易于解释且可通过伪最大似然估计（PML）进行估计而备受青睐。然而，这些方法的有效性取决于条件期望的正确设定，而关于条件期望设定错误时模型性质的研究尚不充分。本文证明，在加权均方误差意义下，设定错误的指数模型的PML估计量能够为条件期望提供最优近似，并给出了泊松PML估计量识别平均边际效应的条件。
10.1162/rest_a_01443.title: Misspecified Exponential Regressions: Estimation, Interpretation, and Average Marginal Effects
10.1162/rest_a_01443.title_zh: 误设指数回归：估计、解释与平均边际效应

10.1162/rest_a_01444.abstract: Addressing climate change requires individual behavior change and voter support for pro-climate policies, yet surprisingly little is known about how to achieve these outcomes. In this paper, we estimate causal effects of additional education on pro-climate outcomes using new compulsory schooling law data across 20 European countries. We analyze effects on pro-climate beliefs and behaviors, as well as novel data on policy preferences and voting for green parties. Results show that a year of education substantially increases pro-climate beliefs, behaviors, and policy preferences.
10.1162/rest_a_01444.abstract_zh: 应对气候变化需要个体行为改变以及选民对亲气候政策的支持，然而令人惊讶的是，关于如何实现这些目标的研究甚少。本文利用20个欧洲国家的新义务教育法数据，估算了额外教育对亲气候结果的因果效应。我们分析了教育对亲气候信念和行为的影响，并纳入了关于政策偏好和投票支持绿党的新数据。结果表明，每增加一年教育会显著提升亲气候信念、行为和政策偏好。
10.1162/rest_a_01444.title: Human Capital and Climate Change

10.1162/rest_a_01445.abstract: Does monetary policy influence who becomes a homeowner? Lower-income home buyers may be more sensitive to interest rates, at least in part because they more frequently come up against binding payment-to-income ratio constraints in credit decisions. Exploiting the timing of high-frequency observations of individual mortgage rate locks around monetary policy shocks, I find that a 1 percentage point policy-induced increase in mortgage rates lowers the presence of lower-income households in the population of home buyers by 1 to 2 percentage points immediately following the shock. Effects are substantially stronger among first-time home buyers and persist for approximately one year.
10.1162/rest_a_01445.abstract_zh: 货币政策是否影响谁会成为房主？低收入购房者可能对利率更为敏感，至少部分原因在于他们在信贷决策中更频繁地面临严格的偿债收入比约束。利用货币政策冲击前后个人抵押贷款利率锁定的高频观测时机，我发现政策导致的抵押贷款利率每上升1个百分点，在冲击发生后立即会使购房者群体中低收入家庭的比例下降1至2个百分点。这一效应在首次购房者中尤为显著，并持续约一年时间。
10.1162/rest_a_01445.title: Monetary Policy and Home Buying Inequality
10.1162/rest_a_01445.title_zh: 货币政策与购房不平等

10.1162/rest_a_01446.abstract: Between 1883 and 1919, Andrew Carnegie funded the construction of more than 1,500 public libraries across the United States, reducing the costs of accessing knowledge for millions. We study the effect of these libraries on innovation. Patenting in recipient places increased on average by 10%–12% in the 20 years following library construction relative to a novel control group of cities that applied for but did not build libraries. We show that access to scientific knowledge and increased collaboration opportunities are possible mechanisms.
10.1162/rest_a_01446.abstract_zh: 1883年至1919年间，安德鲁·卡内基在美国资助建造了超过1500座公共图书馆，降低了数百万人获取知识的成本。我们研究了这些图书馆对创新的影响。与一组申请建造但未建成图书馆的新颖对照组城市相比，受资助地区在图书馆建成后的20年间，专利数量平均增长了10%–12%。研究表明，获取科学知识的机会增加以及合作机会的增多是可能的机制。
10.1162/rest_a_01446.title: Knowledge Access: The Effects of Carnegie Libraries on Innovation
10.1162/rest_a_01446.title_zh: 知识获取：卡内基图书馆对创新的影响

10.1162/rest_a_01447.abstract: Women are underrepresented in patenting. In this study, we consider differential responsiveness to rejection as a contributor to the gender gap in invention. Leveraging the prosecution histories of almost one million U.S. patent applications and the quasirandom assignment of applications to examiners, we show that women are 3.6–6.9 percentage points less likely to continue in the application process following an early-stage rejection. Conditional on applying for a patent, male-female disparities in the propensity to abandon applications account for more than half of the overall gender gap in issued patents. We provide suggestive evidence that institutional support can help reduce the attrition gap.
10.1162/rest_a_01447.abstract_zh: 女性在专利申请中的代表性不足。本研究将差异化的拒绝应对机制视为发明领域性别差距的一个促成因素。利用近百万份美国专利申请的审查历史以及申请案件准随机分配给审查员的机制，我们发现，在早期阶段遭遇驳回后，女性继续申请流程的可能性低3.6至6.9个百分点。在已提交专利申请的条件下，放弃申请倾向的性别差异解释了已授权专利总体性别差距的一半以上。我们提供的初步证据表明，制度性支持有助于缩小这一退出差距。
10.1162/rest_a_01447.title: Attrition and the Gender Patenting Gap
10.1162/rest_a_01447.title_zh: 流失率与性别专利差距

10.1162/rest_a_01448.abstract: We study how a market uses temporary workers to accommodate extraordinary demand shocks. When COVID-19 surges, hospitals need additional nurses—especially in specialties central to COVID-19 care. By comparing markets for COVID-relevant and other specialties, we show that the market for travel nurses expands dramatically, and we estimate travel nurse labor supply across space. Supply is quite elastic, as workers can choose to travel where they are needed. Workers travel longer distances to temporary jobs when payment increases, suggesting that an integrated national market facilitates reallocation when demand spikes. But when national cases peak, travel distance is less responsive to local demand.
10.1162/rest_a_01448.abstract_zh: 我们研究市场如何利用临时工来应对异常需求冲击。当新冠疫情加剧时，医院需要额外护士——尤其是在与新冠护理密切相关的专科领域。通过比较新冠相关专科与其他专科的市场，我们发现旅行护士市场急剧扩张，并估算了旅行护士在空间上的劳动力供给。由于工人可以选择前往需要他们的地方工作，供给弹性相当大。当报酬增加时，工人会前往更远距离的临时工作岗位，这表明整合的全国市场在需求激增时促进了劳动力重新配置。但当全国病例达到峰值时，旅行距离对本地需求的响应程度降低。
10.1162/rest_a_01448.title: When Nurses Travel: Labor Supply Responses to Peak Demand for Nurses
10.1162/rest_a_01448.title_zh: 护士流动时：劳动力供给对护士需求高峰的响应

10.1162/rest_a_01449.abstract: We use variational inference (VI), a technique from the machine learning literature, to estimate a mortality-based Bayesian model of nursing home quality accounting for selection. We demonstrate how one can use VI to quickly and flexibly estimate a high-dimensional economic model with large datasets. Using our facility quality estimates, we examine the correlates of quality and find that public report cards have near-zero correlation. We then show that in contrast to prior literature, higher-quality nursing homes fared better during the pandemic: a one standard deviation increase in quality corresponds to 2.5% fewer COVID-19 cases.
10.1162/rest_a_01449.abstract_zh: 我们采用变分推断（VI）这一机器学习领域的技术，对考虑选择效应的养老院质量死亡率贝叶斯模型进行估计。我们展示了如何利用VI快速且灵活地估计基于大数据集的高维经济模型。基于设施质量估计结果，我们考察了质量的相关因素，发现公开报告卡与质量之间的相关性近乎为零。进一步研究表明，与既往文献结论相反，高质量养老院在疫情期间表现更优：质量每提高一个标准差，新冠肺炎病例数减少2.5%。
10.1162/rest_a_01449.title: Estimating Nursing Home Quality with Selection
10.1162/rest_a_01449.title_zh: 基于选择效应的养老院质量评估

10.1162/rest_a_01451.abstract: In markets with asymmetric information between sellers and buyers, feedback mechanisms are important to increase market efficiency and reduce the informational disadvantage of buyers. Feedback mechanisms might work because of self-selection of more trustworthy sellers into markets with such mechanisms or because of reputational concerns of sellers. We show in a field experiment how to disentangle self-selection from reputation effects. Based on 476 taxi rides with four different types of taxis, we find strong evidence for reputation effects but little support for self-selection effects. We discuss policy implications of our findings.
10.1162/rest_a_01451.abstract_zh: 在卖方与买方信息不对称的市场中，反馈机制对于提升市场效率、减少买方信息劣势至关重要。反馈机制的有效性可能源于更值得信赖的卖方主动选择进入具备此类机制的市场（自选择效应），也可能源于卖方对声誉的考量（声誉效应）。我们通过一项实地实验，展示了如何区分自选择效应与声誉效应。基于对四种不同类型出租车进行的476次乘车实验，我们发现了支持声誉效应的有力证据，但几乎没有证据支持自选择效应。我们进一步讨论了研究结论的政策启示。
10.1162/rest_a_01451.title: Disentangling Reputation from Selection Effects in Markets with Informational Asymmetries: A Field Experiment
10.1162/rest_a_01451.title_zh: 信息不对称市场中声誉效应与选择效应的分离：一项田野实验

10.1162/rest_a_01453.abstract: In 2001 a large and sustained supply shock halted a heroin epidemic in Australia. We use drug offenses to identify individual opioid users and examine how the shock affected their mortality risks and criminal activity over the next eight years. Initially, gains from fewer overdoses are offset by drug substitution and more crime, including homicides. Most adverse effects dissipate over time, whereas persistent mortality reductions save the lives of around one in 48 individuals in our sample. Our results demonstrate that reducing the supply of illicit opioids can lead to meaningful longer-term improvements, even when the short-term effects are ambiguous.
10.1162/rest_a_01453.abstract_zh: 2001年，一场大规模且持续的供给冲击终结了澳大利亚的海洛因流行。我们利用毒品犯罪数据识别个体阿片类药物使用者，并考察了该冲击如何影响他们在随后八年间的死亡风险与犯罪活动。最初，过量用药减少带来的收益被药物替代及更多犯罪（包括凶杀案）所抵消。大多数不利影响随时间消散，而持续性的死亡率降低则挽救了样本中约每48人中的1条生命。我们的结果表明，即使短期效果尚不明确，减少非法阿片类药物的供给仍能带来有意义的长期改善。
10.1162/rest_a_01453.title: Opioid Use, Mortality Risks and Crime: Insights from a Rapid Reduction in Heroin Supply
10.1162/rest_a_01453.title_zh: 阿片类药物使用、死亡风险与犯罪：海洛因供应快速减少的启示

10.1162/rest_a_01454.abstract: Using panel data on a 20% random sample of Canadian taxpayers, we study behavioral responses to the cancellation of a lifetime capital gains exemption that resulted in increased capital gains taxation for some individuals. We show that the exemption did not change the number of taxpayers reporting positive capital gains, and thus unlikely resulted in increased participation in capital markets. Furthermore, our results suggest that the cancellation increased the long-run capital gains realizations of tax filers with more unused exemption room but had a small, statistically insignificant impact on the capital gains realizations of those with little unused exemption room.
10.1162/rest_a_01454.abstract_zh: 利用加拿大纳税人20%随机样本的面板数据，我们研究了终身资本利得豁免取消对行为的影响，该取消导致部分个人的资本利得税负增加。研究表明，豁免并未改变申报正资本利得的纳税人数量，因此不太可能促进资本市场参与度的提升。此外，我们的结果表明，豁免取消增加了未使用豁免额度较多的纳税人的长期资本利得实现，但对未使用豁免额度较少的纳税人的资本利得实现影响较小且统计上不显著。
10.1162/rest_a_01454.title: Permanent and Transitory Responses to Capital Gains Taxes: Evidence from a Lifetime Exemption in Canada
10.1162/rest_a_01454.title_zh: 资本利得税的永久性与暂时性反应：来自加拿大终身豁免的证据

10.1162/rest_a_01455.abstract: We study the aftermath of the 1968 Washington, D.C. civil disturbance to illuminate the mechanisms that drive urban redevelopment in the presence of low demand and racial tension. Using a within-block identification strategy, we show that destruction caused lots to remain vacant for the next thirty years and only recently converge in terms of structure value. The city acted to preclude for-profit land owners from leaving land vacant until demand conditions improved by purchasing nearly half of all properties in damaged neighborhoods. Despite this and other steps, the city had limited success in speeding up redevelopment.
10.1162/rest_a_01455.abstract_zh: 本文研究1968年华盛顿特区民事骚乱的后续影响，以揭示在低需求与种族紧张背景下驱动城市再开发的机制。通过采用街区内识别策略，我们证明破坏导致地块在此后三十年间持续空置，直至近期才在建筑价值上趋于收敛。市政府通过收购受损街区近半数房产，阻止营利性土地所有者在地产需求改善前闲置土地。尽管采取了这一措施及其他举措，市政府在加速再开发方面成效有限。
10.1162/rest_a_01455.title: Destruction, Policy, and the Evolving Consequences of Washington, DC’s 1968 Civil Disturbance
10.1162/rest_a_01455.title_zh: 华盛顿特区1968年民乱：破坏、政策与不断演变的后果

10.1162/rest_a_01456.abstract: P-hacking is prevalent in reality but absent from classical hypothesis-testing theory. We therefore build a model of hypothesis testing that accounts for p-hacking. From the model, we derive critical values such that, if they are used to determine significance, and if p-hacking adjusts to the new significance standards, then spurious significant results do not occur more often than intended. Because of p-hacking, such robust critical values are larger than classical critical values. In the model calibrated to medical science, the robust critical value is the classical critical value for the same test statistic but with one-fifth of the significance level.
10.1162/rest_a_01456.abstract_zh: P-hacking在现实中普遍存在，但经典假设检验理论却未将其纳入考量。为此，我们构建了一个考虑P-hacking的假设检验模型。基于该模型，我们推导出临界值：若以此临界值判定统计显著性，且P-hacking行为随新的显著性标准调整，则虚假显著结果的出现频率不会超过预期水平。由于P-hacking的存在，此类稳健临界值大于经典临界值。在基于医学科学校准的模型中，稳健临界值相当于同一检验统计量在显著性水平降至五分之一时的经典临界值。
10.1162/rest_a_01456.title: Critical Values Robust to P-hacking

10.1162/rest_a_01457.abstract: Changes in the minimum wage may impact college enrollment and educational attainment. Using institutional data on college enrollment and program completion, we find that enrollment falls markedly among students at public two-year institutions in response to increases in the minimum wage. The largest enrollment effects are seen for those students who are enrolled part-time at community colleges. We find little evidence of negative effects on the attainment of certificates or degrees, suggesting that increases in the minimum wage are unlikely to divert students from degree attainment.
10.1162/rest_a_01457.abstract_zh: 最低工资的变化可能会影响大学入学率和教育成就。利用大学入学和课程完成的机构数据，我们发现，最低工资上涨导致公立两年制院校的学生入学率显著下降。入学率影响最大的是社区学院的非全日制学生。我们几乎没有发现证据表明最低工资上涨对证书或学位的获得产生负面影响，这表明最低工资上涨不太可能使学生偏离学位获取的轨道。
10.1162/rest_a_01457.title: Raising State Minimum Wages, Lowering Community College Enrollment
10.1162/rest_a_01457.title_zh: 提高州最低工资，降低社区大学入学率

10.1162/rest_a_01459.abstract: This paper provides a method to study quantile effects in discrete choice with social interactions. The method is based on a behavioral social interactions model from quantile preference in decision making and demonstrates peer effects on different quantiles of discrete outcomes. The peer effects parameters are estimated by a nested pseudoscore (NPS) approach, which is developed to tackle the computational burden pertaining to the social interactions model. Consistency and asymptotic normality are established for the proposed NPS estimator. We illustrate the finite sample performance of the model and the estimator by Monte Carlo experiments and an application of peer effects among students on exercise decisions, using the National Longitudinal Study of Adolescent Health dataset.
10.1162/rest_a_01459.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种研究存在社会互动时离散选择中分位数效应的方法。该方法基于决策过程中分位数偏好的行为社会互动模型，揭示了同伴效应对离散结果不同分位数的影响。为应对社会互动模型带来的计算负担，我们开发了嵌套伪得分（NPS）方法对同伴效应参数进行估计，并建立了该NPS估计量的一致性和渐近正态性。通过蒙特卡洛实验以及基于美国青少年健康纵向研究数据集的学生运动决策中同伴效应的应用分析，我们验证了模型与估计量的有限样本表现。
10.1162/rest_a_01459.title: Quantile Effects in Discrete Choice with Social Interactions
10.1162/rest_a_01459.title_zh: 社会互动下离散选择的分位数效应

10.1162/rest_a_01464.abstract: The paper studies nonstationary high-dimensional vector autoregressions of order k, VAR(k). Additional deterministic terms such as trend or seasonality are allowed. The number of time periods, T, and the number of coordinates, N, are assumed to be large and of the same order. Under this regime the first-order asymptotics of the Johansen likelihood ratio (LR), Pillai-Bartlett, and Hotelling-Lawley tests for cointegration are derived: The test statistics converge to nonrandom integrals. For more refined analysis, the paper proposes and analyzes a modification of the Johansen test. The new test for the absence of cointegration converges to the partial sum of the Airy1 point process. Supporting Monte Carlo simulations indicate that the same behavior persists universally in many situations beyond those considered in our theorems. The paper presents empirical implementations of the approach for the analysis of S&P100 stocks and of cryptocurrencies. The latter example has a strong presence of multiple cointegrating relationships, while the results for the former are consistent with the null of no cointegration.
10.1162/rest_a_01464.abstract_zh: 本文研究了非平稳高维向量自回归模型（阶数为k，记为VAR(k)），允许包含趋势或季节性等确定性项。假设时间期数T与坐标数N均较大且量级相同。在此框架下，推导了Johansen似然比（LR）、Pillai-Bartlett和Hotelling-Lawley协整检验的一阶渐近性质：检验统计量收敛于非随机积分。为进行更精细的分析，本文提出并分析了一种Johansen检验的修正形式。该新检验对无协整原假设的检验统计量收敛于Airy1点过程的部分和。蒙特卡洛模拟结果支持该行为在超出定理假设的多种情境下具有普遍性。本文将该方法应用于标普100指数股票和加密货币的实证分析。后者案例中多重协整关系显著存在，而前者结果与无协整原假设一致。
10.1162/rest_a_01464.title: Asymptotics of Cointegration Tests for High-Dimensional Var(k)
10.1162/rest_a_01464.title_zh: 高维VAR(k)模型协整检验的渐近性质

10.1162/rest_a_01466.abstract: We present a new data set we built based on Swiss rich lists going back to 1989. We show, among other things, that 60% of the super-rich are heirs—a fraction twice as large as in the United States—and that wealth mobility at the very top has declined significantly. We find that top 0.01% wealth shares are higher than what previous estimates based on wealth tax statistics suggest. At the same time, we argue that rich list data lead to overestimating wealth inequality. Although rich lists are valuable to study the super-rich, we recommend using reported wealth figures with caution.
10.1162/rest_a_01466.abstract_zh: 我们基于1989年以来的瑞士富豪榜单构建了一个全新数据集。研究发现，60%的超级富豪为继承财富者——这一比例是美国的两倍——且顶层财富流动性显著下降。我们发现，最富有的0.01%人群的财富份额高于此前基于财富税统计数据的估算结果。同时，我们认为富豪榜单数据会导致财富不平等程度被高估。尽管富豪榜单对研究超级富豪群体具有重要价值，但我们建议谨慎使用所报告的财富数据。
10.1162/rest_a_01466.title: Using Rich Lists to Study the Super-Rich and Top Wealth Inequality: Insights from Switzerland
10.1162/rest_a_01466.title_zh: 利用富豪榜研究超级富豪与顶层财富不平等：来自瑞士的启示

10.1162/rest_a_01467.abstract: In 1966, Southern hospitals were barred from participating in Medicare unless they discontinued their longstanding practice of racial segregation. Using data from five Deep South states and exploiting county-level variation in Medicare certification dates, we find that gaining access to an ostensibly integrated hospital had no effect on Black postneonatal mortality. Similarly, there is little evidence that the campaign contributed to the trend toward in-hospital births among Southern Black mothers. These results are consistent with descriptions of the hospital desegregation campaign as producing only cosmetic changes and illustrate the limits of antidiscrimination policies imposed on reluctant actors.
10.1162/rest_a_01467.abstract_zh: 1966年，美国南方医院被禁止参与联邦医疗保险计划，除非其终止长期实行的种族隔离做法。利用五个深南部州的数据，并借助县级层面联邦医疗保险认证时间的差异，我们发现，获得表面整合的医院对黑人新生儿后期死亡率并无影响。同样，几乎没有证据表明这场运动促进了南方黑人母亲在医院分娩的趋势。这些结果与将医院废除种族隔离运动描述为仅带来表面变化的说法一致，并揭示了强加于不情愿行为者的反歧视政策的局限性。
10.1162/rest_a_01467.title: The Hospital Desegregation Campaign and Black Postneonatal Mortality in the Deep South
10.1162/rest_a_01467.title_zh: 南方医院废除种族隔离运动与黑人新生儿后期死亡率

10.1162/rest_a_01468.abstract: We document the individual willingness to act against climate change and study the role of social norms in a large sample of U.S. adults. Individual beliefs about social norms positively predict pro-climate donations, comparable in strength to universal moral values and economic preferences. However, we document systematic misperceptions of social norms. Respondents vastly underestimate the prevalence of climate-friendly behaviors and norms. Correcting these misperceptions in an experiment causally raises individual willingness to act against climate change and individual support for climate policies. The effects are strongest for individuals who are skeptical about the existence and threat of global warming.
10.1162/rest_a_01468.abstract_zh: 本文记录了个体应对气候变化的意愿，并在美国成年人大型样本中研究了社会规范的作用。个体对社会规范的信念正向预测亲气候捐赠行为，其预测强度与普遍道德价值观和经济偏好相当。然而，我们发现了对社会规范的系统性认知偏差。受访者严重低估了气候友好行为及规范的普遍性。通过实验纠正这些认知偏差，能因果性地提升个体应对气候变化的意愿及对气候政策的支持。该效应在质疑全球变暖存在及其威胁的个体中最为显著。
10.1162/rest_a_01468.title: Misperceived Social Norms and Willingness to Act Against Climate Change
10.1162/rest_a_01468.title_zh: 误解的社会规范与应对气候变化的意愿

10.1162/rest_a_01469.abstract: We provide the first systematic account of summer declines in women’s labor market activity. From May to July, U.S. women’s employment-to-population ratio declines 1.1 p.p., whereas men’s rises; women’s hours worked fall 9.8%, twice the decline among men. School closures for summer break provide a unifying explanation. The summer drop aligns with cross-state differences in school closure timing, is concentrated among mothers with young school-aged children, and coincides with increased time spent on child care. Gender differences both within and across jobs explain gender gaps in summer exits from employment. Women’s summer work interruptions contribute to gender gaps in pay.
10.1162/rest_a_01469.abstract_zh: 我们首次系统性地揭示了夏季女性劳动力市场活跃度下降的现象。从5月到7月，美国女性就业人口比率下降1.1个百分点，而男性则有所上升；女性工作时长下降9.8%，降幅是男性的两倍。学校暑期放假提供了一个统一的解释。夏季就业下降与各州学校放假时间的差异一致，主要集中在有学龄儿童的母亲群体中，并与育儿时间增加相吻合。职业内部及跨职业的性别差异解释了夏季退出就业的性别差距。女性夏季工作中断进一步加剧了性别薪酬差距。
10.1162/rest_a_01469.title: The Summer Drop in Female Employment

10.1162/rest_a_01470.abstract: This paper shows that the bunching of wages at round numbers is partly driven by firm coarse wage setting. Using data from more than 200 million new hires in Brazil, I first establish that contracted salaries tend to cluster at round numbers. Then, I show that firms that tend to hire workers at round-numbered salaries have worse market outcomes. Next, I develop a wage-posting model in which optimization costs lead to the adoption of coarse rounded wages and provide evidence supporting two model predictions using two research designs. Finally, I examine some consequences of coarse wage setting for relevant economic outcomes.
10.1162/rest_a_01470.abstract_zh: 本文表明，工资在整数处的聚集现象部分源于企业的粗放式工资设定。基于巴西超过2亿新雇员工的数据，我首先证实合同工资倾向于集中在整数数值上。接着，我发现倾向于以整数工资雇佣员工的企业市场表现更差。随后，我构建了一个工资报价模型，其中优化成本导致企业采用粗放的整数工资，并通过两种研究设计为模型的两个预测提供了实证支持。最后，我考察了粗放式工资设定对相关经济结果的一些影响。
10.1162/rest_a_01470.title: Coarse Wage Setting and Behavioral Firms
10.1162/rest_a_01470.title_zh: 粗放式工资设定与行为企业

10.1162/rest_a_01474.abstract: We examine the mechanisms driving the aggregate and distributional impacts of Universal Basic Income (UBI) through model analysis of various UBI programs and financing schemes. The main adverse effect is the distortionary tax increase to fund UBI, reducing labor force participation. Secondary channels are a decline in demand for self-insurance, depressing aggregate capital, and a positive income effect that further deters labor force participation. Due to these channels, introducing UBI alongside existing social programs reduces output and average welfare. Partially substituting existing programs with UBI mitigates the adverse effects, increases average welfare, but does not deliver a Pareto improvement.
10.1162/rest_a_01474.abstract_zh: 我们通过模型分析各类全民基本收入（UBI）方案及其融资机制，探究驱动UBI总体影响与分配效应的内在机制。主要负面效应在于为资助UBI而增加的扭曲性税收，导致劳动力参与率下降。次要传导渠道包括：自我保险需求降低抑制总资本积累，以及正向收入效应进一步削弱劳动供给意愿。由于这些传导机制，在现有社会计划基础上引入UBI会降低产出与平均福利水平。若以UBI部分替代现有计划，虽能缓解负面效应并提升平均福利，但无法实现帕累托改进。
10.1162/rest_a_01474.title: Universal Basic Income: Inspecting the Mechanisms
10.1162/rest_a_01474.title_zh: 全民基本收入：机制探析

10.1162/rest_a_01476.abstract: Positive assortative matching increases both the wages of more productive workers and wage dispersion. We study the effect of immigration on positive assortative matching using French employer-employee data from 1995 to 2005. We find that increases in the share of immigrants, driven by historical networks across local labor markets, generated stronger positive assortative matching between workers and firms. We present evidence suggesting that this effect was associated with higher wages for more productive workers and that the findings are consistent with increased workers’ screening by firms.
10.1162/rest_a_01476.abstract_zh: 正向分类匹配提高了高生产率工人的工资水平，同时也加剧了工资离散程度。我们利用1995年至2005年法国雇主-雇员数据，研究了移民对正向分类匹配的影响。研究发现，由地方劳动力市场历史移民网络驱动的移民占比上升，增强了工人与企业之间的正向分类匹配。证据表明，这一效应与高生产率工人工资上涨相关，且研究结果与企业在招聘中加强工人筛选的机制一致。
10.1162/rest_a_01476.title: Immigration and Worker-Firm Matching

10.1162/rest_a_01482.abstract: Do more educated workers earn higher wages partly because they have access to high-paying firms and occupations? We rely on linked employer-employee data to combine the estimation of AKM (Abowd-Kramarz-Margolis) models with the decomposition of the returns to schooling. We exploit exogenous variation in education driven by changes in compulsory education. We show that education provides access to better-paying workplaces and occupations: 30% of the overall return to education operates through the workplace channel and 12% through the occupation channel. The remainder is associated exclusively with the individual. Match quality plays a modest role in the returns to education.
10.1162/rest_a_01482.abstract_zh: 受教育程度更高的工人获得更高工资，是否部分源于他们能进入高薪企业和职业？我们利用关联雇主-雇员数据，将AKM（Abowd-Kramarz-Margolis）模型的估计与教育回报的分解相结合，并利用义务教育改革带来的教育外生变化进行分析。研究表明，教育为个体提供了进入薪酬更优的工作场所和职业的途径：教育总回报中，30%通过工作场所渠道实现，12%通过职业渠道实现，其余部分则完全与个体特征相关。匹配质量在教育回报中仅发挥有限作用。
10.1162/rest_a_01482.title: What Lies Behind the Returns to Schooling: The Role of Labor Market Sorting and Worker Heterogeneity
10.1162/rest_a_01482.title_zh: 教育回报背后的真相：劳动力市场分类与工人异质性的作用

10.1162/rest_a_01487.abstract: We study communication frictions within multinationals (MNCs), hypothesizing that language barriers reduce management knowledge transfers within the organization. A distinct feature of such MNCs is a three-tier hierarchy: foreign managers (FMs) supervise domestic managers (DMs) who supervise production workers. Tailored surveys from our setting—MNCs in Myanmar—reveal that language barriers impede interactions between FMs and DMs. A first experimental protocol offers DMs free English courses and confirms that lowering communications costs increases their interactions with FMs. A second experimental protocol that asks human-resource managers at domestic firms to rate hypothetical resumes reveals that multinational experience and, specifically, DM-FM interactions are valued in the domestic labor market. Together, these results suggest that reducing language barriers can improve transfers of management knowledge, an interpretation supported by improvements in soft skills among treatment DMs in the first experiment. A model in which communication within MNCs is noncontractible—a realistic feature of workplace life—reveals that the experimental results are consistent with underinvestment in language training and provide a rationale for policy intervention.
10.1162/rest_a_01487.abstract_zh: 本文研究了跨国公司内部的沟通摩擦，假设语言障碍会减少组织内部管理知识的转移。这类跨国公司的一个显著特征是三级层级结构：外籍经理（FMs）监督本地经理（DMs），而本地经理则监督生产工人。基于缅甸跨国公司的定制调查显示，语言障碍阻碍了外籍经理与本地经理之间的互动。第一项实验方案为本地经理提供免费英语课程，并证实降低沟通成本能增加他们与外籍经理的互动。第二项实验方案要求国内企业的人力资源经理对假设简历进行评分，结果表明跨国经验，特别是本地经理与外籍经理的互动，在国内劳动力市场中受到重视。综合来看，这些结果表明减少语言障碍可以改善管理知识的转移，这一解释得到了第一项实验中接受培训的本地经理软技能提升的支持。一个将跨国公司内部沟通视为不可契约化的模型——这是职场生活的现实特征——揭示了实验结果与语言培训投资不足的一致性，并为政策干预提供了理论依据。
10.1162/rest_a_01487.title: Language Barriers in Multinationals and Knowledge Transfers
10.1162/rest_a_01487.title_zh: 跨国公司中的语言障碍与知识转移

10.1162/rest_a_01490.abstract: We study the effects of uncertainty on time use and their macroeconomic implications. Employing data from the American Time Use Survey and the Bureau of Labor Statistics, we document that heightened uncertainty increases housework and reduces market hours, mildly impacting leisure. We then propose a model that quantitatively accounts for these estimates. We show that substitution between market and housework provides self-insurance to households, weakening precautionary motives. However, it also reduces aggregate demand, ultimately amplifying uncertainty’s recessionary impact. Time reallocation can lead to higher inflation, particularly when uncertainty is coupled with policies redirecting time use towards housework (e.g., lockdown restrictions).
10.1162/rest_a_01490.abstract_zh: 我们研究了不确定性对时间配置的影响及其宏观经济含义。利用美国时间使用调查和劳工统计局的数据，我们证实不确定性加剧会增加家务劳动时间、减少市场工作时间，而对休闲时间影响较小。随后我们构建了一个能够定量解释这些估计结果的模型。研究表明，市场劳动与家务劳动之间的替代效应为家庭提供了自我保险机制，削弱了预防性储蓄动机。但这种替代同时会降低总需求，最终放大不确定性的衰退效应。时间再配置可能引发通胀上升，尤其当不确定性叠加引导时间向家务劳动倾斜的政策时（如封锁限制措施）。
10.1162/rest_a_01490.title: Time Use and Macroeconomic Uncertainty
10.1162/rest_a_01490.title_zh: 时间利用与宏观经济不确定性

10.1162/rest_a_01498.abstract: This paper estimates the relationship between the U.S. tariff increases of 2018–2019 and outcomes in domestic manufacturing. Despite being intended to boost manufacturing activity, we find U.S. industries more exposed to tariff increases experience relative reductions in employment, as a small positive effect from import protection is offset by larger negative effects from rising input costs and retaliatory tariffs. Higher tariffs are also associated with relative increases in producer prices due to rising input costs. Last, we document broader labor market impacts, as counties more exposed to rising tariffs exhibit relative increases in unemployment and declines in labor force participation.
10.1162/rest_a_01498.abstract_zh: 本文估算了2018-2019年美国关税上调与国内制造业产出之间的关系。尽管关税上调旨在促进制造业活动，但我们发现，受关税上调影响更大的美国行业反而经历了相对就业减少，这是因为进口保护带来的微弱正面效应被投入成本上升和报复性关税带来的更大负面效应所抵消。由于投入成本上升，更高的关税还与生产者价格相对上涨相关。最后，我们记录了更广泛的劳动力市场影响：受关税上调影响更大的县出现了失业率相对上升和劳动参与率下降的现象。
10.1162/rest_a_01498.title: Disentangling the Effects of the 2018–2019 Tariffs on a Globally Connected U.S. Manufacturing Sector
10.1162/rest_a_01498.title_zh: 解析2018-2019年关税对全球关联的美国制造业的影响

10.1162/rest_a_01511.abstract: We study the link between social preferences and a behaviorally validated measure of support for redistribution. We uncover three fundamentally distinct social preference types: predominantly selfish, inequality averse, and altruistic individuals. Inequality averse and altruistic individuals display a much stronger support for redistribution, particularly if they are more affluent. Beliefs about the role of effort and luck for success play no role for selfish individuals but are highly relevant for other-regarding individuals. Finally, while inequality averse individuals display strong support for policies aimed at reducing the incomes of the rich, altruistic individuals are considerably less supportive of these policies.
10.1162/rest_a_01511.abstract_zh: 我们研究了社会偏好与行为验证的再分配支持度之间的关联。研究发现三种根本不同的社会偏好类型：主要自私型、不平等厌恶型和利他型个体。不平等厌恶型和利他型个体对再分配表现出显著更强的支持，尤其是当这些个体本身较为富裕时。关于努力与运气在成功中作用的信念对自私型个体毫无影响，但对关注他人型个体高度相关。最后，尽管不平等厌恶型个体强烈支持旨在削减富人收入的政策，利他型个体对这些政策的支持度则明显较低。
10.1162/rest_a_01511.title: Social Preferences and Redistributive Politics
10.1162/rest_a_01511.title_zh: 社会偏好与再分配政治

10.1162/rest_a_01516.abstract: We leverage the high degree of worker mobility across production lines in a large Indian manufacturer to estimate the sorting of workers to managers, using data on daily worker productivity. We find negative assortative matching (NAM): better workers tend to be matched with worse managers. Estimates of the production technology, however, reveal that productivity would increase by up to 4% under positive sorting. Exploiting a survey of managers and data on orders from multinational brands, we document that NAM arises, at least partly, because maintaining valuable relationships with buyers provides strong incentives to avoid delays on any given production line.
10.1162/rest_a_01516.abstract_zh: 我们利用印度一家大型制造商生产线上工人高度流动的特点，结合工人日生产率数据，估算了工人与管理者的匹配模式。研究发现存在负向分类匹配（NAM）：表现更优的工人往往与能力较弱的管理者配对。然而，对生产技术的估算表明，若实现正向分类匹配，生产率最高可提升4%。通过分析管理者调查数据及跨国品牌订单信息，我们证实负向分类匹配的产生至少部分源于以下机制：维护与买方的价值关系会形成强烈激励，促使管理者避免任何生产线出现延误。
10.1162/rest_a_01516.title: No Line Left Behind: Assortative Matching Inside the Firm
10.1162/rest_a_01516.title_zh: 不遗漏任何一条线：企业内部的选择性匹配

10.1162/rest_a_01519.abstract: Using Chicago police data, we train a machine learning model to predict the risk of being shot in the next 18 months. Out-of-sample accuracy is strikingly high. A central concern with using police data is “baking in” bias, or overestimating risk for groups likelier to interact with police conditional on behavior. Our predictions, however, accurately recover risk across demographic groups. Legal, ethical, and practical barriers should prevent using victimization predictions to target law enforcement. But using them to target social services could increase both the potential for interventions to reduce shootings and the available statistical power to detect those reductions.
10.1162/rest_a_01519.abstract_zh: 利用芝加哥警方数据，我们训练了一个机器学习模型，用于预测未来18个月内被枪击的风险。样本外预测准确度惊人地高。使用警方数据的一个核心担忧是“固化”偏见，即在行为条件相同的情况下，高估更可能与警方互动的群体的风险。然而，我们的预测准确还原了不同人口群体的风险水平。法律、伦理及实践障碍应阻止将受害风险预测用于执法目标锁定。但将其用于社会服务目标锁定，既能提升干预措施减少枪击事件的潜力，也能增强检测此类减少效果的统计效能。
10.1162/rest_a_01519.title: Machine Learning Can Predict Shooting Victimization Well Enough to Help Prevent It
10.1162/rest_a_01519.title_zh: 机器学习能够足够准确地预测枪击受害风险以助预防

10.1162/rest_a_01520.abstract: We disprove the exchange rate macroeconomic disconnect puzzle by showing that macroeconomic news can explain most variation in exchange rates at monthly and quarterly frequencies, accounting for up to 91% of the quarterly exchange rate variation during U.S. recessions and 65% over all periods. The main driver of the reconnect is exchange rates responding to past news—a result inconsistent with the theory of uncovered interest rate parity under full information rational expectations (UIP-FIRE). We discuss theoretical models that can explain this surprising result, including models featuring currency risk premia, regulatory or institutional frictions, or deviation from FIRE.
10.1162/rest_a_01520.abstract_zh: 我们通过证明宏观经济新闻能够解释月度与季度频率下汇率的大部分变动，从而否定了汇率宏观经济脱节之谜。在美国经济衰退期间，这些新闻可解释高达91%的季度汇率变动，而在所有时期则能解释65%。这一重新关联的主要驱动力在于汇率对过往新闻的反应——该结果与完全信息理性预期下的无抛补利率平价理论（UIP-FIRE）不一致。我们探讨了能够解释这一意外结果的理论模型，包括包含货币风险溢价、监管或制度摩擦，以及偏离FIRE假设的模型。
10.1162/rest_a_01520.title: A Fundamental Connection: Exchange Rates and Macroeconomic Expectations
10.1162/rest_a_01520.title_zh: 基本联系：汇率与宏观经济预期

10.1162/rest_a_01527.abstract: We document that the real effects of monetary shocks last for over a decade. Our approach relies on identification of exogenous and nonsystematic monetary shocks using the trilemma of international finance; merged data from two new international historical cross-country databases; and econometric methods robust to long-horizon inconsistent estimates. Notably, the capital stock and total factor productivity exhibit greater hysteresis than labor. When we allow for asymmetry, we find these effects with tightening shocks but not with loosening shocks. When extending the horizon of the responses reported in several recent studies that use alternative monetary shocks, we find similarly persistent real effects, thus supporting our main findings.
10.1162/rest_a_01527.abstract_zh: 我们证明，货币冲击的实际效应持续超过十年。我们的研究方法依赖于利用国际金融三难困境识别外生且非系统性的货币冲击；整合自两个新型国际历史跨国数据库的合并数据；以及能够应对长期估计不一致性的计量经济学方法。值得注意的是，资本存量与全要素生产率比劳动力表现出更强的滞后效应。在考虑非对称性时，我们发现紧缩性冲击会产生这些效应，而宽松性冲击则不会。当将近期多项采用替代性货币冲击的研究所报告的反应期限延长后，我们同样观察到持续的实际效应，从而佐证了我们的核心发现。
10.1162/rest_a_01527.title: The Long-Run Effects of Monetary Policy

10.1257/aer.116.7.2299.title: Nobel Lecture: The Past and Future of Innovation: Can Progress Be Sustained?
10.1257/aer.116.7.2299.title_zh: 诺贝尔演讲：创新的过去与未来——进步能否持续？

10.1257/aer.116.7.2324.title: Nobel Lecture: The Economics of Creative Destruction
10.1257/aer.116.7.2324.title_zh: 诺贝尔演讲：创造性破坏的经济学

10.1257/aer.116.7.2357.title: Nobel Lecture: Creative Destruction and Economic Growth
10.1257/aer.116.7.2357.title_zh: 诺贝尔演讲：创造性破坏与经济增长

10.1257/aer.20220264.abstract: Most organizations rely on managers to identify talented workers. However, managers who are evaluated on team performance have an incentive to hoard workers. This study provides the first empirical evidence of talent hoarding using personnel records and survey evidence from a large firm. Talent hoarding is self-reported by three-fourths of managers, is detectable in manager ratings of worker talent, and occurs more frequently under stronger hoarding incentives, proxied by performance-related pay, team size, and talent visibility. Using quasi-random exposure to talent hoarding, I show that hoarding deters internal job applications, inhibiting career progression and altering talent allocation in the firm.
10.1257/aer.20220264.abstract_zh: 大多数组织依赖管理者识别有才能的员工。然而，那些以团队绩效为考核标准的管理者，有动机囤积人才。本研究首次利用一家大型企业的人事档案和调查证据，提供了人才囤积的实证依据。四分之三的管理者自报存在人才囤积行为，这一现象在管理者对员工才能的评分中可被察觉，并且在囤积动机更强时（以绩效薪酬、团队规模和人才可见度为衡量指标）更为频繁。通过准随机暴露于人才囤积情境，本研究表明，囤积行为会抑制内部工作申请，阻碍职业发展，并改变企业内的人才配置。
10.1257/aer.20220264.title: Talent Hoarding in Organizations
10.1257/aer.20220264.title_zh: 组织中的人才囤积现象

10.1257/aer.20221351.abstract: This paper develops an asset market-based test for preference for the timing of resolution of uncertainty. Our main theorem provides a characterization of preference for early resolution of uncertainty in terms of the risk premium realized during the period when the informativeness of macroeconomic announcements is resolved. Empirically, we find support for preference for early resolution of uncertainty based on evidence on the dynamics of the implied volatility of S&P 500 index options before Federal Open Market Committee announcements. (JEL D81, D83, G13, G14, G41)
10.1257/aer.20221351.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一种基于资产市场的检验方法，用于评估不确定性解决时机偏好。核心定理表明，偏好不确定性尽早解决的特征可通过宏观经济公告信息释放期间所实现的风险溢价来刻画。基于联邦公开市场委员会公告发布前后标普500指数期权隐含波动率的动态证据，实证结果支持市场参与者存在偏好不确定性尽早解决的倾向。（JEL分类号：D81, D83, G13, G14, G41）
10.1257/aer.20221351.title: Identifying Preference for Early Resolution from Asset Prices
10.1257/aer.20221351.title_zh: 从资产价格中识别对早期解决的偏好

10.1257/aer.20230017.abstract: Policy choices often create trade-offs between workers and consumers. I examine how foreign competition alters the consumer welfare and domestic employment effects of mergers. I construct a model incorporating consumer demand, endogenous product portfolios, and employment decisions. Applying the model to Whirlpool’s acquisition of Maytag in the appliance industry, I compare the observed merger to a counterfactual acquisition by a foreign buyer. Although Whirlpool’s acquisition decreased consumer welfare by $271 million annually, it preserved 797 domestic jobs. These jobs must therefore be valued at more than $344, 000 per year for the domestic employment benefits to offset the consumer harm. (JEL E24, F23, G34, J30, L13, L68, R23)
10.1257/aer.20230017.abstract_zh: 政策选择往往在工人与消费者之间产生权衡。本文考察了外国竞争如何改变并购对消费者福利和国内就业的影响。我构建了一个包含消费者需求、内生产品组合和就业决策的模型。将该模型应用于家电行业惠而浦对美泰克的收购案例，我将实际发生的并购与外国买家收购的反事实情景进行了比较。尽管惠而浦的收购每年使消费者福利减少2.71亿美元，但保留了797个国内就业岗位。因此，要使国内就业收益抵消消费者损失，这些岗位的年价值必须超过34.4万美元。(JEL E24, F23, G34, J30, L13, L68, R23)
10.1257/aer.20230017.title: Mergers, Foreign Competition, and Jobs: Evidence from the US Appliance Industry
10.1257/aer.20230017.title_zh: 并购、外国竞争与就业：来自美国家电行业的证据

10.1257/aer.20230242.abstract: <jats:p>We show that, depending on how the impact of omitted variables is measured, it can be substantially easier for omitted variables to flip coefficient signs than to drive them to zero. This behavior occurs with “Oster's delta” (Oster 2019a), a widely reported robustness measure. Consequently, any time this measure is large—suggesting omitted variables may be unimportant—a much smaller value reverses the sign of the parameter of interest. We propose a modified measure of robustness to address this concern. We illustrate our results in four empirical applications and two meta-analyses. We implement our methods in the companion Stata module “regsensitivity.” (JEL C18, C21, C52)</jats:p>
10.1257/aer.20230242.abstract_zh: 我们证明，根据遗漏变量影响的衡量方式不同，遗漏变量翻转系数符号的难度可能远低于将其驱至零值的难度。这一现象出现在广泛使用的稳健性指标“奥斯特德尔塔”（Oster 2019a）中。因此，每当该指标数值较大（表明遗漏变量可能不重要）时，一个更小的数值即可使关注参数的符号发生反转。我们提出了一种修正的稳健性度量方法以解决此问题。我们在四项实证应用和两项元分析中展示了研究结果，并在配套的Stata模块“regsensitivity”中实现了相关方法。（JEL C18, C21, C52）
10.1257/aer.20230242.title: The Effect of Omitted Variables on the Sign of Regression Coefficients
10.1257/aer.20230242.title_zh: 遗漏变量对回归系数符号的影响

10.1257/aer.20230344.abstract: <jats:p>I study how firm market power and worker bargaining power shape wages and welfare. Using French micro-data, I document patterns linking wages and firm market power that existing models cannot explain. A model in which firms produce vertically differentiated goods and share profits with workers explains those patterns. The model (i) reveals new challenges in estimating monopsony and bargaining power, proposing an alternative approach; (ii) shows that the passthrough of firm-specific shocks to wages depends on the type of shock; (iii) explains how markups shape firm wage premia; and (iv) formalizes how strengthening worker bargaining power affects wages and welfare. (JEL D22, J31, J42, J52, L12, L22)</jats:p>
10.1257/aer.20230344.abstract_zh: 本文研究了企业市场势力与工人议价能力如何共同决定工资与福利。基于法国微观数据，我发现了现有模型无法解释的工资与企业市场势力之间的关联模式。通过构建一个企业生产垂直差异化产品并与工人分享利润的模型，这些模式得以解释。该模型：（i）揭示了估算买方垄断势力与议价能力面临的新挑战，并提出替代性方法；（ii）表明企业特定冲击向工资的传导效应取决于冲击类型；（iii）解释了加成率如何塑造企业工资溢价；（iv）形式化分析了增强工人议价能力对工资与福利的影响。（JEL D22, J31, J42, J52, L12, L22）
10.1257/aer.20230344.title: Understanding High-Wage Firms: Monopoly, Monopsony, and Bargaining Power
10.1257/aer.20230344.title_zh: 理解高工资企业：垄断、买方垄断与议价能力

10.1257/aer.20230376.abstract: We evaluate equity-efficiency trade-offs from admissions quotas by examining effects on output once beneficiaries start producing in the relevant industry. We estimate the impact of abolishing a 40 percent quota for male primary school teachers on their pupils’ long-run outcomes. We combine this reform with the timing of union-bargained teacher retirements to isolate quasi-random variation in male quota teachers. Pupils exposed to male quota teachers transition more smoothly to postcompulsory education and have higher educational attainment and labor force attachment at age 25. Evidence suggests the quota improved the allocation of talent by mending imperfections in the unconstrained selection process. (JEL I21, I23, I28, J16, J24, J45)
10.1257/aer.20230376.abstract_zh: 我们通过考察招生配额受益者在相关行业开始生产后的产出效应，评估了配额政策带来的公平与效率权衡。我们估算了废除小学男教师40%配额制度对学生长期发展的影响。通过将这项改革与工会协商的教师退休时间相结合，我们分离出配额制男教师的准随机变动。接触配额制男教师的学生在义务教育后阶段的过渡更为顺畅，且在25岁时拥有更高的教育成就和劳动力市场参与度。证据表明，该配额通过弥补无约束选拔过程中的缺陷，改善了人才配置效率。（JEL I21, I23, I28, J16, J24, J45）
10.1257/aer.20230376.title: Quota versus Quality? Long-Term Gains from an Unusual Gender Quota
10.1257/aer.20230376.title_zh: 配额还是质量？一项特殊性别配额的长期收益

10.1257/aer.20230448.abstract: This paper studies the economic impacts of carbon pricing. Exploiting institutional features of the European carbon market and high-frequency data, I identify carbon policy shocks and trace their dynamic effects. A restrictive carbon policy shock raises energy prices, reduces emissions, spurs green innovation, but decreases economic activity—disproportionately burdening poorer households. Not only are the poor more affected because of their higher energy spending, but they also experience larger income losses. These indirect, general-equilibrium effects via income and employment play an important role in the transmission of carbon pricing policies, accounting for about two-thirds of the aggregate consumption response.
10.1257/aer.20230448.abstract_zh: 本文研究碳定价的经济影响。利用欧洲碳市场的制度特征与高频数据，我识别出碳政策冲击并追踪其动态效应。限制性碳政策冲击推高能源价格、减少排放、刺激绿色创新，但会抑制经济活动——且对贫困家庭造成不成比例的负担。贫困家庭不仅因能源支出占比更高而受到更大影响，其收入损失也更为显著。这些通过收入与就业渠道传导的间接一般均衡效应，在碳定价政策的传导机制中发挥重要作用，约占总体消费反应的三分之二。
10.1257/aer.20230448.title: The Unequal Economic Consequences of Carbon Pricing
10.1257/aer.20230448.title_zh: 碳定价的不平等经济后果

10.1257/aer.20230541.abstract: This paper examines the effects of privatizing social health insurance. We exploit a natural experiment in Medicaid, wherein nearly 100,000 enrollees were randomly assigned between a publicly operated fee-for-service system and private managed care. Managed care reduced costs by 5.6 percent via cost-effective substitutions among prescription drugs and via lower prices for outpatient services. We present evidence that pharmacy utilization management was the key mechanism reducing overuse and encouraging substitution to lower-cost drugs without decreasing observed quality. In contrast, privatizing medical benefits led to only modest savings and was associated with decreased health care quality and consumer satisfaction. (JEL G22, H41, I13, I18, I38)
10.1257/aer.20230541.abstract_zh: 本文研究了社会医疗保险私有化的影响。我们利用医疗补助计划中的一项自然实验，将近10万名参保者随机分配至公共运营的按服务收费体系与私人管理式医疗体系中。管理式医疗通过处方药的成本效益替代以及降低门诊服务价格，使成本降低了5.6%。我们提供的证据表明，药房利用管理是减少过度用药、鼓励替代为低成本药物且不降低可观测质量的关键机制。相比之下，医疗福利的私有化仅带来适度节约，且与医疗质量下降及消费者满意度降低相关。（JEL分类号：G22, H41, I13, I18, I38）
10.1257/aer.20230541.title: The Private Provision of Public Services: Evidence from Random Assignment in Medicaid
10.1257/aer.20230541.title_zh: 公共服务的私人提供：来自医疗补助随机分配的证据

10.1257/aer.20230586.abstract: Many lower-income countries know little about their citizens and their tax bases, which hinders effective taxation. This paper studies the impact of making the tax base more “legible” to the state and signaling this legibility to taxpayers. Leveraging a new digitized property database, a randomized experiment in Liberia finds that including identifying information (owners’ names and property photographs) in tax notices quadruples the likelihood of payment from 2 percent to over 8 percent, but only when the notice also details noncompliance penalties. The effects of the intervention persist to the 4th year. These results underscore that both legibility and enforcement are essential for taxation.
10.1257/aer.20230586.abstract_zh: 许多低收入国家对其公民及税基知之甚少，这阻碍了有效征税。本文研究了使税基对政府更"可读"并向纳税人传递这一可读性信号的影响。借助利比里亚一项新的数字化财产数据库，随机实验发现：在纳税通知中包含识别信息（业主姓名和房产照片）可使缴税概率从2%提升至8%以上，但这一效果仅在通知同时列明违规处罚条款时成立。该干预措施的效果持续至第四年。这些结果凸显了可读性与执法力度对税收征管同等重要。
10.1257/aer.20230586.title: Becoming Legible to the State: The Necessary but Not Sufficient Role of Identification in Taxation
10.1257/aer.20230586.title_zh: 变得对政府可见：身份识别在税收中的必要但非充分作用

10.1257/aer.20230714.abstract: Exposure to better peers in the workplace can influence career trajectories through two opposing channels: positively, via knowledge spillovers, and negatively, through competition for advancement. We disentangle these effects by studying untrained labor market entrants and distinguishing between coworkers in the same occupation with whom they are likely to compete versus those with whom they are unlikely to compete. We find robust evidence of persistent knowledge spillovers but also identify countervailing competition effects of comparable magnitude. Both effects are more pronounced for men than for women.
10.1257/aer.20230714.abstract_zh: 接触更优秀的同事会通过两种相反的渠道影响职业发展轨迹：正向的知识溢出效应与负向的晋升竞争效应。通过研究未受训的劳动力市场新进入者，并区分同一职业中可能与之竞争的同事与不太可能与之竞争的同事，我们分离了这两种效应。研究发现了知识溢出效应的稳健持续性证据，同时也识别出规模相当的竞争抵消效应。这两种效应在男性群体中均比女性群体更为显著。
10.1257/aer.20230714.title: Knowledge Spillovers, Competition, and Individual Careers
10.1257/aer.20230714.title_zh: 知识溢出、竞争与个人职业生涯

10.1257/aer.20230766.abstract: Item-level transactions data yield cost-of-living indices that can account for quality change and consumer substitution. Transactions data require confronting the rapid turnover of items because prices of new and existing products are interrelated in equilibrium. This paper evaluates multiple approaches to measuring quality change at scale. It shows that a hedonic superlative approach—using econometrics or machine learning for hedonic estimation combined with index formulas that require simultaneous observation of item-level price and expenditure—yields improved measures of the cost of living. Accounting for ubiquitous quality change and for consumer substitution yields lower measures of inflation than traditional, official methods. (JEL C43, C45, E31, L15, L81)
10.1257/aer.20230766.abstract_zh: 基于项目级交易数据编制的居民消费价格指数，能够反映质量变化与消费者替代行为。由于均衡状态下新旧产品价格相互关联，交易数据需应对项目快速更替的挑战。本文评估了多种大规模质量变化测算方法，研究表明：采用计量经济学或机器学习进行特征价格估计，并结合需同步观测项目级价格与支出的指数公式，所构建的特征价格超优指数能更精准地衡量生活成本。相较于传统官方统计方法，将普遍存在的质量变化与消费者替代行为纳入考量后，通胀测算结果显著降低。（JEL分类号：C43, C45, E31, L15, L81）
10.1257/aer.20230766.title: Quality Adjustment at Scale: Hedonic versus Exact Demand-Based Price Indices
10.1257/aer.20230766.title_zh: 大规模质量调整：享乐指数与精确需求价格指数

10.1257/aer.20230768.abstract: Designing public transport networks involves trade-offs between coverage, service frequency, and direct service. We use the expansion of the bus system in Jakarta, Indonesia, to study these trade-offs. We analyze how new direct connections, changes in bus travel time, and wait time reductions affect bus ridership and aggregate flows, and estimate a transit network demand model by matching the route launch events. Commuters in Jakarta are 2-3 times more sensitive to wait time than bus time, and inattentive to long routes. We develop a flexible framework to characterize optimal networks. A less concentrated network would increase ridership and commuter welfare.
10.1257/aer.20230768.abstract_zh: 设计公共交通网络需要在覆盖范围、服务频率与直达服务之间进行权衡。我们以印度尼西亚雅加达公交系统的扩张为例，研究这些权衡关系。通过分析新增直达线路、公交出行时间变化以及等待时间缩短对公交客流量和总体客流的影响，并利用线路开通事件匹配数据估算交通网络需求模型。研究发现：雅加达通勤者对等待时间的敏感度是公交行驶时间的2-3倍，且对长距离线路关注度较低。我们构建了一个灵活的分析框架来刻画最优网络特征，结果表明：降低网络集中度将有助于提升客流量与通勤者福利。
10.1257/aer.20230768.title: Optimal Public Transportation Networks: Evidence from the World’s Largest Bus Rapid Transit System in Jakarta
10.1257/aer.20230768.title_zh: 最优公共交通网络：来自雅加达全球最大快速公交系统的证据

10.1257/aer.20230802.abstract: Do elite colleges help talented students join the social elite or help incumbent elites retain their positions? We combine intergenerationally linked data from Chile with a regression discontinuity design to show that, looking across generations, elite colleges do both. Lower-status individuals who gain admission to elite college programs transform their children’s social environment. Children become more likely to attend high-status private schools and colleges and to live near and befriend high-status peers. In contrast, academic achievement is unaffected. Simulations combining descriptive and quasi-experimental findings show that elite colleges tighten the link between social and human capital while decreasing intergenerational social mobility. (JEL I23, I26, J24, J62, O15, Z13)
10.1257/aer.20230802.abstract_zh: 精英大学是帮助有才华的学生跻身社会精英阶层，还是帮助现有精英维持其地位？我们结合智利的代际关联数据与断点回归设计发现，从代际视角来看，精英大学同时发挥了这两种作用。获得精英大学项目录取资格的低社会地位个体，其子女的社会环境发生了转变：子女更有可能进入高地位私立学校与大学，并与高地位同龄人居住相邻或建立友谊。相比之下，学业成绩并未受到影响。结合描述性与准实验研究结果的模拟分析表明，精英大学在降低代际社会流动性的同时，强化了社会资本与人力资本之间的关联。（JEL I23, I26, J24, J62, O15, Z13）
10.1257/aer.20230802.title: Elite Universities and the Intergenerational Transmission of Human and Social Capital
10.1257/aer.20230802.title_zh: 精英大学与人力资本和社会资本的代际传递

10.1257/aer.20230849.abstract: <jats:p>We use firm-level data to document that private businesses experience large fluctuations in their profit shares. These are due to large, fat-tailed, and transitory changes in output that are not fully accompanied by changes in their inputs. We interpret this evidence using a model of entrepreneurial dynamics. Because firms can limit their exposure to risk by operating at a smaller scale, our model predicts large macroeconomic losses from uninsurable business risk, much larger than those stemming from credit constraints. While self-financing allows entrepreneurs to quickly overcome credit constraints, even wealthy entrepreneurs remain considerably exposed to risk. (JEL D33, E02, E44, G32, L25, L26)</jats:p>
10.1257/aer.20230849.abstract_zh: 我们利用企业层面数据证明，私营企业的利润份额存在大幅波动。这种波动源于产出的大规模、厚尾且暂时性的变化，而这些变化并未完全伴随投入要素的同步调整。我们通过构建企业家动态模型来解释这一现象。由于企业可通过缩小经营规模来限制风险敞口，模型预测不可保商业风险将导致巨大的宏观经济损失——其规模远超信贷约束造成的损失。虽然自我融资能使企业家快速克服信贷约束，但即便是富裕的企业家仍面临显著的风险敞口。（JEL分类号：D33, E02, E44, G32, L25, L26）
10.1257/aer.20230849.title: The Aggregate Costs of Uninsurable Business Risk
10.1257/aer.20230849.title_zh: 不可保险商业风险的总体成本

10.1257/aer.20231344.abstract: We examine how social interactions and friendships shape students’ political opinions in a natural experiment at Sciences Po, a leading French university specializing in social and political sciences. The quasi-random assignment of students into short-term integration groups before their academic curriculum reduces political opinion gaps and fosters friendship formation. Using same-group membership as an instrumental variable for friendship, we find that friendship reduces opinion differences by 44 percent of the mean opinion gap. Our evidence supports a homophily-enforced mechanism: Friendships form among initially politically similar students, leading them to join political associations together, reinforcing their similarity. (JEL C93, D72, Z13)
10.1257/aer.20231344.abstract_zh: 我们通过法国顶尖社会科学与政治学府——巴黎政治学院的一项自然实验，考察社会互动与友谊如何塑造学生的政治观点。学生在学术课程开始前被准随机分配至短期融合小组，这一机制缩小了政治观点差距并促进了友谊形成。以同组归属作为友谊的工具变量，我们发现友谊使观点差异缩小了平均差距的44%。研究证据支持一种同质性强化机制：友谊最初在政治立场相近的学生间形成，促使他们共同加入政治社团，从而进一步强化其观点相似性。（JEL C93, D72, Z13）
10.1257/aer.20231344.title: Friendship Networks and Political Opinions

10.1257/aer.20231368.abstract: We study racial disparities in promotions in a setting in which promotions are formulaic: the US patent office. Using detailed administrative data that allow us to observe who is eligible for promotion when, we document that Black patent examiners experience delays in promotions they are entitled to, slowing their climb to the top of the career ladder by a year and reducing career earnings by 2.9%. Institutional features rule out statistical discrimination with accurate priors. Slow promotions even under Black supervisors argue against taste-based animus. Instead, the patterns fit models of belief-based discrimination.
10.1257/aer.20231368.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在晋升流程高度程式化的情境——美国专利局——中存在的种族晋升差异。利用详尽的行政数据，我们得以观察特定时间点符合晋升条件的群体，发现黑人专利审查员在应得晋升中遭遇延迟，导致其职业阶梯顶端晋升速度放缓一年，职业生涯收入减少2.9%。制度特征排除了基于准确先验信息的统计性歧视。即使在黑人主管领导下仍存在晋升缓慢现象，这否定了基于偏好的歧视解释。相反，这些模式符合基于信念的歧视模型。
10.1257/aer.20231368.title: Racial Promotion Gaps

10.1257/aer.20231414.abstract: Relative to remote work, working downtown facilitates valuable interactions with other in-office workers, but entails commuting costs. The resulting coordination mechanism can lead to multiple stationary equilibria with varying levels of remote work. Temporary reductions in commuters, as in the COVID-19 pandemic, can then lead to persistently large fractions of remote workers. Cellphone- based mobility data for the U.S. shows that commuting trips in the largest cities, which are more likely to exhibit multiplicity, have stabilized at only 60% of pre-pandemic levels, while they are fully back in smaller cities. Cities with permanently low commuting experience average welfare losses of 2.3%.
10.1257/aer.20231414.abstract_zh: 相较于远程办公，市中心工作虽能促进与其他在岗员工的有价值互动，但需承担通勤成本。由此产生的协调机制可能导致远程办公比例不同的多重稳态均衡。如同新冠疫情期间出现的通勤者暂时性减少，可能引发远程工作者比例持续高企的现象。基于美国手机信令数据的流动性研究表明，更易呈现多重均衡特征的大型城市通勤出行量仅恢复至疫情前水平的60%，而小型城市已完全恢复。通勤量持续低迷的城市平均福利损失达2.3%。
10.1257/aer.20231414.title: Remote Work and City Structure

10.1257/aer.20231415.abstract: <jats:p>Moretti (2021) reports a positive elasticity between technology cluster size and patenting, and uses an event study and instrumental variables regressions to justify a causal interpretation. The event study does not use the variation generated by inventors moving across cities, and the instrument is constructed incorrectly due to a coding error. I run a corrected event study and fix the coding error, and find null effects. The reported elasticity may not be causal. (JEL J24, L60, O31, O34, R32)</jats:p>
10.1257/aer.20231415.abstract_zh: Moretti（2021）报告了技术集群规模与专利产出之间的正向弹性，并通过事件研究和工具变量回归论证了因果解释。然而，该事件研究未利用发明人在城市间流动产生的变异，且由于编码错误导致工具变量构建有误。我重新进行了修正的事件研究并纠正了编码错误，发现效应为零。因此，所报告的弹性可能并非因果关系。（JEL J24, L60, O31, O34, R32）
10.1257/aer.20231415.title: The Effect of High-Tech Clusters on the Productivity of Top Inventors: Comment
10.1257/aer.20231415.title_zh: 高科技集群对顶尖发明者生产率的影响：评论

10.1257/aer.20231417.abstract: What are the implications of unequal access to innovation careers for the direction of innovation and inequality? Leveraging novel linked datasets in the United States and Finland, we document that innovators create products more likely to be purchased by consumers like them in terms of gender, socioeconomic status, and age. Homophily exists both within narrow product categories and across industries, and has been stable in recent decades. Incorporating this “social push” channel into a growth model, we estimate that unequal access to innovation careers has a large effect on cost-of-living inequality and long-run growth.
10.1257/aer.20231417.abstract_zh: 创新职业机会的不平等对创新方向与不平等有何影响？利用美国和芬兰的新型关联数据集，我们证实创新者更倾向于开发与其自身在性别、社会经济地位及年龄方面相似的消费者更可能购买的产品。这种同质性既存在于细分产品类别内部，也跨越不同行业，且近几十年来保持稳定。通过将这一"社会推动"渠道纳入增长模型，我们估算出创新职业机会的不平等对生活成本不平等及长期增长具有显著影响。
10.1257/aer.20231417.title: Social Push and the Direction of Innovation

10.1257/aer.20231486.abstract: In general, finding the optimal combination among N items requires evaluating all 2^N possibilities. We develop a method applicable whenever items are complements or substitutes that uses this structure to discard suboptimal combinations without evaluation and extends to heterogeneous-agent environments. In a calibrated general equilibrium model of multinational firms choosing interdependent production locations, we show the method is orders of magnitude faster than incumbent approaches and avoids error from discretizing firm heterogeneity. Quantitatively, whether production locations are complements or substitutes determines whether welfare gains from multinational production concentrate in the most productive countries or accrue more broadly.
10.1257/aer.20231486.abstract_zh: 一般而言，从N个选项中寻找最优组合需要评估全部2^N种可能性。我们提出了一种适用于互补品或替代品情形的方法，该方法利用这种结构在不进行评估的情况下剔除次优组合，并可推广至异质性主体环境。在跨国企业选择相互依赖的生产地点的校准一般均衡模型中，我们证明该方法比现有方法快数个数量级，且避免了因离散化企业异质性而产生的误差。从定量角度看，生产地点是互补品还是替代品，决定了跨国生产带来的福利收益是集中于最具生产力的国家，还是更广泛地惠及各国。
10.1257/aer.20231486.title: Combinatorial Discrete Choice: Theory and Application to Multinational Production
10.1257/aer.20231486.title_zh: 组合离散选择：理论与跨国生产中的应用

10.1257/aer.20231521.abstract: <jats:p>Preschool-aged children get sick frequently and spread disease to other family members. Despite the universality of this experience, there is limited causal evidence on the magnitudes and consequences of these externalities, especially for infant siblings with developing immune systems and brains. We show in Danish administrative data that during infancy, younger siblings have two to three times higher hospitalization rates for respiratory conditions than older siblings. We combine birth order and within-municipality variation in respiratory disease prevalence among young children, finding lasting differential impacts of early-life respiratory disease exposure on younger siblings' earnings, educational attainment, chronic respiratory health, and mental health-related outcomes. (JEL D13, D62, I12, J12, J13, J24, J31)</jats:p>
10.1257/aer.20231521.abstract_zh: 学龄前儿童易患疾病，并会将疾病传播给其他家庭成员。尽管这一经历具有普遍性，但关于这些外部性的程度和后果的因果证据仍然有限，尤其是对于免疫系统和大脑正在发育的婴儿兄弟姐妹而言。我们利用丹麦行政数据发现，在婴儿期，弟弟妹妹因呼吸系统疾病的住院率是哥哥姐姐的两到三倍。我们结合出生顺序以及学龄前儿童呼吸系统疾病患病率的市内差异，发现早期呼吸系统疾病暴露对弟弟妹妹的收入、教育程度、慢性呼吸系统健康以及心理健康相关结果产生了持久的差异化影响。（JEL D13, D62, I12, J12, J13, J24, J31）
10.1257/aer.20231521.title: Germs in the Family: The Short- and Long-Term Consequences of Intrahousehold Disease Spread
10.1257/aer.20231521.title_zh: 家庭中的病菌：家庭内部疾病传播的短期与长期后果

10.1257/aer.20231613.abstract: <jats:p>Lack of market transparency can impair the liquidity provision of nonstandard liquidity suppliers and make liquidity demand increasing in illiquidity. This can yield strategic complementarities and induce multiple equilibria. Then an initial dearth of liquidity may degenerate into a liquidity rout (as in a “flash crash”), and traders faced with the largest cost of trading are those trading more intensely at equilibrium. An increase in order flow transparency and/or in the mass of dealers who are in the market at all times has a positive impact on total welfare. (JEL G12, G14, G41)</jats:p>
10.1257/aer.20231613.abstract_zh: 市场透明度不足会削弱非标准化流动性供应商的流动性供给能力，并导致流动性需求随非流动性程度上升而增加。这可能产生策略互补性并引发多重均衡。此时，初始流动性匮乏可能恶化为流动性崩溃（如"闪崩"现象），而均衡状态下交易最频繁的交易者反而面临最高的交易成本。提高订单流透明度和/或增加始终活跃于市场的交易商数量，将对总福利产生积极影响。（JEL分类号：G12, G14, G41）
10.1257/aer.20231613.title: Market Opacity and Fragility: Why Liquidity Evaporates When It Is Most Needed
10.1257/aer.20231613.title_zh: 市场不透明性与脆弱性：为何流动性在最需要时消失

10.1257/aer.20231684.abstract: Based on a narrative classification of all significant postwar changes in R&D appropriations for five major federal agencies, we find that an increase in nondefense R&D appropriations leads to increases in various measures of innovative activity and higher business-sector productivity in the long run. We structurally estimate the production function elasticity of nondefense government R&D capital using the SP-IV methodology of Lewis and Mertens (2024) and obtain implied returns of 140 to 210 percent over the postwar period. The estimates indicate that government-funded R&D accounts for one-fifth of business-sector TFP growth since WWII, and imply substantial underfunding of nondefense R&D.
10.1257/aer.20231684.abstract_zh: 基于对五大联邦机构战后研发拨款重大变动的叙事分类，我们发现非国防研发拨款的增加长期内会提升各类创新活动指标及商业部门生产率。我们采用Lewis与Mertens（2024）提出的SP-IV方法，对非国防政府研发资本的生产函数弹性进行结构估计，得出战后时期隐含回报率为140%至210%。估算结果表明，二战以来政府资助的研发贡献了商业部门全要素生产率增长的五分之一，并暗示非国防研发存在显著的资金不足问题。
10.1257/aer.20231684.title: The Returns to Government R&D: Evidence from US Appropriations Shocks
10.1257/aer.20231684.title_zh: 政府研发投入的回报：来自美国拨款冲击的证据

10.1257/aer.20231696.abstract: We study how public sector workers balance their professional motivations with private economic concerns, focusing on police arrests. Arrests made near the end of an officer's shift typically require overtime work, and officers respond by reducing arrest frequency but increasing arrest quality. Days in which an officer works a second job after their police shift have higher opportunity cost, also reducing late-shift arrests. Combining our estimates in a dynamic model identifies officer preferences over workplace activity and overtime work. Our results indicate that officers' private costs of arrests have a first-order impact on the quantity and quality of enforcement.
10.1257/aer.20231696.abstract_zh: 我们研究公共部门工作人员如何在职业动机与个人经济考量之间取得平衡，重点关注警察逮捕行为。在警官轮班临近结束时进行的逮捕通常需要加班，而警官对此的应对方式是降低逮捕频率但提高逮捕质量。当警官在警察轮班后还需从事第二份工作的日子里，机会成本更高，这同样减少了轮班末段的逮捕数量。通过将我们的估计结果纳入动态模型，可以识别出警官对工作场所活动及加班工作的偏好。研究结果表明，警官的私人逮捕成本对执法的数量与质量具有首要影响。
10.1257/aer.20231696.title: Professional Motivations in the Public Sector: Evidence from Police Officers
10.1257/aer.20231696.title_zh: 公共部门的职业动机：来自警察的证据

10.1257/aer.20231699.abstract: Conflict along transportation routes during Somalia’s al-Shabaab insurgency significantly increases maize prices at distant locations, decreasing food security, health, and education. Estimated conflict risk has strong price effects independently of realized conflict, highlighting the importance of safety concerns. A model of least-cost route choice in the presence of conflict reveals that more and shorter alternative routes to circumvent conflict can lower prices but their effectiveness diminishes as violence becomes more correlated across routes. Alternatively, securing key transportation routes would alleviate price increases. A market access approach suggests spatial spillovers of conflict also matter for prices of more general baskets of food and nonfood items. (JEL D74, I15, I25, O15, O17, Q11, R41)
10.1257/aer.20231699.abstract_zh: 索马里青年党叛乱期间，运输路线上的冲突显著抬高了偏远地区的玉米价格，进而削弱了粮食安全、健康与教育水平。冲突风险的估计值独立于已发生的冲突本身，对价格产生强烈影响，凸显了安全关切的重要性。基于冲突环境下最低成本路线选择模型的分析表明：增加更多且更短的替代路线以规避冲突可降低价格，但随着暴力事件在路线间的相关性增强，其效果逐渐减弱。另一种方案是保障关键运输路线的安全，这将有效缓解价格上涨。市场准入分析进一步揭示，冲突的空间溢出效应同样影响更广泛的食品与非食品类商品价格。（JEL分类号：D74, I15, I25, O15, O17, Q11, R41）
10.1257/aer.20231699.title: Spatial Spillovers of Conflict in Somalia
10.1257/aer.20231699.title_zh: 索马里冲突的空间溢出效应

10.1257/aer.20240056.abstract: This paper studies how managers plan under uncertainty. In a new panel survey of German manufacturing firms, we observe both forecasts of sales growth and a quantitative measure of subjective uncertainty. We show that subjective uncertainty reflects change experienced by firms: it is high when growth is either unusually low or unusually high. Subjective uncertainty is more than conditional volatility: while more volatile firms are typically more uncertain, experienced change alone increases uncertainty, consistent with a model of learning. Uncertainty over our sample is mostly idiosyncratic but varies substantially over time and leads managers to plan lower employment and prices.
10.1257/aer.20240056.abstract_zh: 本文研究管理者如何在不确定性下进行规划。基于一项针对德国制造业企业的新面板调查，我们同时观测到销售增长预测与主观不确定性的量化指标。研究表明，主观不确定性反映了企业经历的变化：当增长率异常低或异常高时，不确定性均会上升。主观不确定性不仅体现为条件波动性：尽管波动性较高的企业通常面临更大不确定性，但仅凭经历的变化本身就会加剧不确定性，这与学习模型的理论预测一致。样本期间的不确定性主要呈现异质性特征，但随时间显著波动，并促使管理者制定更低的就业与价格计划。
10.1257/aer.20240056.title: Uncertainty and Change: Survey Evidence of Firms’ Subjective Beliefs
10.1257/aer.20240056.title_zh: 不确定性与变化：企业主观信念的调查证据

10.1257/aer.20240094.abstract: Natural gas has replaced coal as the dominant fuel for U.S. electricity generation. However, utilities in regulated U.S. states have retired coal more slowly than others. We build a structural model of rate-of-return regulation during an energy transition where utilities face tradeoffs between lowering costs and maintaining and using legacy capacity. A regulated utility facing carbon taxes lowers short-run coal generation 48% as much as a cost minimizer would. Thirty years after a sudden energy transition, a cost minimizer has retired 71% more coal capacity than the regulated utility. Alternative regulations may jeopardize affordability and reliability goals during energy transitions.
10.1257/aer.20240094.abstract_zh: 天然气已取代煤炭成为美国发电的主要燃料。然而，受监管的美国各州公用事业公司淘汰煤炭的速度慢于其他地区。我们构建了一个能源转型期间回报率监管的结构模型，其中公用事业公司在降低成本与维持及使用遗留产能之间面临权衡。面对碳税的受监管公用事业公司，其短期煤炭发电量降幅仅为成本最小化公司的48%。在突发能源转型30年后，成本最小化公司淘汰的煤炭产能比受监管公用事业公司多71%。替代性监管措施可能在能源转型期间危及可负担性与可靠性目标。
10.1257/aer.20240094.title: Energy Transitions in Regulated Markets
10.1257/aer.20240094.title_zh: 监管市场中的能源转型

10.1257/aer.20240179.abstract: We study residential segregation and access to public services across 1.5 million urban and rural neighborhoods in India. Muslim and Scheduled Caste segregation in India is high by global standards, and only slightly lower than Black-White segregation in the United States. Within cities, public facilities and infrastructure are systematically less available in Muslim and Scheduled Caste neighborhoods. Nearly all regressive allocation is across neighborhoods within cities—at the most informal and least studied form of government. These inequalities are not visible in the aggregate data typically used for research and policy.
10.1257/aer.20240179.abstract_zh: 本研究考察了印度150万个城乡社区中的居住隔离与公共服务获取情况。按全球标准衡量，印度穆斯林与表列种姓的居住隔离程度较高，仅略低于美国的黑白种族隔离。在城市内部，穆斯林与表列种姓社区的公共设施和基础设施系统性匮乏。几乎所有倒退性资源分配都发生在城市内部的社区之间——这属于最非正式且研究最少的政府层级。这些不平等现象在通常用于研究与政策制定的汇总数据中无法显现。
10.1257/aer.20240179.title: Residential Segregation and Unequal Access to Local Public Services in India: Evidence from 1.5 Million Neighborhoods
10.1257/aer.20240179.title_zh: 印度居住隔离与地方公共服务获取不平等：来自150万邻里的证据

10.1257/aer.20240393.abstract: We establish a link between labor scarcity and the adoption of labor-saving technology in industrializing England. During the Napoleonic Wars, more than 10 percent of the male population served in the armed forces. Where recruitment was heavy, more machines economizing on labor were adopted. Naval recruitment, instrumented by warships’ coastal access, provides exogenous variation in labor scarcity and suggests that the link between labor shortages and adoption is causal. Where mechanical skills were abundant, the impact of labor scarcity on adoption appears to be larger.
10.1257/aer.20240393.abstract_zh: 我们建立了劳动力稀缺性与工业化英格兰采用节省劳动力技术之间的联系。在拿破仑战争期间，超过10%的男性人口在武装部队服役。在征兵力度较大的地区，更多节省劳动力的机器被采用。以军舰沿海通道为工具变量的海军征兵，提供了劳动力稀缺性的外生变化，表明劳动力短缺与采用之间存在因果关系。在机械技能丰富的地区，劳动力稀缺性对技术采用的影响似乎更大。
10.1257/aer.20240393.title: Fighting for Growth: Labor Scarcity and Technological Progress During the British Industrial Revolution
10.1257/aer.20240393.title_zh: 为增长而战：英国工业革命时期的劳动力稀缺与技术进步

10.1257/aer.20240404.abstract: We study the effects of the largest corporate income tax cut in U.S. history on firms and workers. To identify causal effects, we use employer-employee matched tax records and event studies comparing similarly sized firms in the same industry that faced divergent tax changes due to their pre-existing legal status. Tax cuts cause increases in firms’ investment, sales, profits, employment, and payrolls, with earnings gains concentrated among highly paid workers. In the short-run, 87% of private income gains flow to the top 10% of the income distribution.
10.1257/aer.20240404.abstract_zh: 我们研究了美国历史上最大规模的企业所得税削减对企业和工人的影响。为识别因果效应，我们使用了雇主-雇员匹配的税务记录，并通过事件研究法比较同一行业中规模相近但因既有法律地位不同而面临不同税收变化的企业。减税导致企业投资、销售额、利润、就业和工资总额增加，但收入增长主要集中在高薪工人群体。短期内，私人收入增长的87%流向了收入分布前10%的人群。
10.1257/aer.20240404.title: Corporate Tax Cuts, Firm Growth, and Workers’ Earnings
10.1257/aer.20240404.title_zh: 企业减税、企业增长与工人收入

10.1257/aer.20240497.abstract: We document the effects of a comprehensive set of mergers of US consumer packaged goods manufacturers on prices, quantities, and product assortment. Across specifications, we find a small average price effect of mergers (-0.5% to 1.1%) but substantial heterogeneity in effects, with a standard deviation between 3.9–7.6 pp. Through a model of enforcement, we find that agencies act as if they challenge mergers they expect would increase prices more than 4.8–6.3%. Increases in stringency would reduce prices and the prevalence of completed price-increasing mergers, with minimal impacts on blocked price-decreasing mergers, at a significantly greater agency burden.
10.1257/aer.20240497.abstract_zh: 本文记录了一组美国消费品制造商全面并购对价格、数量及产品组合的影响。在多种实证设定下，我们发现并购的平均价格效应较小（-0.5%至1.1%），但效应存在显著异质性，标准差介于3.9至7.6个百分点之间。通过执法模型分析，我们发现监管机构的行为模式表明，它们倾向于挑战预期价格涨幅超过4.8%至6.3%的并购。提高执法严格程度将降低价格水平及已完成的价格上涨型并购的普遍性，同时对被阻止的价格下降型并购影响甚微，但会显著增加监管机构的负担。
10.1257/aer.20240497.title: Merger Effects and Antitrust Enforcement: Evidence from US Consumer Packaged Goods
10.1257/aer.20240497.title_zh: 并购效应与反垄断执法：来自美国包装消费品行业的证据

10.1257/aer.20240576.abstract: A designer employs a dynamic protocol to elicit private information. Protocols produce a set of contextual privacy violations— information learned that may be superfluous given the context. A protocol is maximally contextually private if there is no protocol that produces a proper subset of the violations it produces, while implementing the choice rule. Contextual privacy violations arise when a choice rule makes some agents collectively, but not individually, pivotal. In auctions, designing for contextual privacy requires choosing an initial question posed to each agent and the order for querying agents. Ascending-join protocols are maximally contextually private for k-item Vickrey auctions.
10.1257/aer.20240576.abstract_zh: 设计者采用动态协议来获取私人信息。协议会产生一系列情境性隐私侵犯——即在特定情境下可能属于多余的信息被获知。若不存在其他协议能在实现选择规则的同时，产生该协议所引发侵犯行为的真子集，则该协议具有最大情境隐私性。当选择规则使某些代理人集体成为关键角色（而非个体关键角色）时，便会产生情境性隐私侵犯。在拍卖中，实现情境隐私性设计需要确定向每位代理人提出的初始问题及询问代理人的顺序。对于k物品维克里拍卖而言，升序接入协议具有最大情境隐私性。
10.1257/aer.20240576.title: Contextually Private Mechanisms

10.1257/aer.20240617.abstract: We study the problem of designing a dynamic reassignment mechanism when agents’ preferences over objects change over time. In the context of Norway’s system for (re)assigning patients to general practitioners (GPs), we provide direct evidence of misallocation under the current mechanism—patients waiting for each others’ GPs, but who cannot trade—and estimate a structural model of GP switching behavior to evaluate alternatives. Introducing Top Trading Cycles (TTC) would, on average, reduce waiting times and increase patient welfare. However, patients endowed with less desirable GPs would be harmed. Prioritizing these patients can avoid these harms while preserving most of the gains from TTC.
10.1257/aer.20240617.abstract_zh: 本文研究当主体对对象的偏好随时间变化时，如何设计动态再分配机制。以挪威全科医生（GP）患者（重新）分配系统为背景，我们提供了当前机制下资源错配的直接证据——患者相互等待对方的全科医生却无法进行交换——并估计了全科医生转换行为的结构模型以评估替代方案。引入顶级交易循环（TTC）机制平均而言将缩短等待时间并提高患者福利。然而，被分配到较不理想全科医生的患者将受到损害。优先考虑这些患者可以避免此类损害，同时保留TTC机制的大部分收益。
10.1257/aer.20240617.title: Designing Dynamic Reassignment Mechanisms: Evidence from GP Allocation
10.1257/aer.20240617.title_zh: 设计动态再分配机制：来自全科医生分配的实证证据

10.1257/aer.20240642.abstract: <jats:p>We show that in heterogeneous agent New Keynesian (HANK) economies with countercyclical risk, the natural interest rate is endogenous and co-moves with output, leaving the economy susceptible to self-fulfilling fluctuations. Unlike in representative agent New Keynesian models, the Taylor principle is not sufficient to guarantee uniqueness of equilibrium in HANK if risk is even mildly countercyclical: Multiple bounded equilibria exist, no matter how strongly monetary policy responds to changes in inflation. For an active monetary policy to eliminate self-fulfilling fluctuations, it must stabilize the endogenous natural rate fluctuations. Alternatively, a passive monetary and active fiscal regime can also eliminate equilibrium multiplicity. (JEL E12, E23, E31, E32, E43, E52, E62)</jats:p>
10.1257/aer.20240642.abstract_zh: 我们证明，在具有逆周期风险的异质性代理人新凯恩斯（HANK）经济体中，自然利率是内生的，并与产出共同变动，从而使经济容易受到自我实现的波动影响。与代表性代理人新凯恩斯模型不同，如果风险即使只是轻微逆周期，泰勒原理不足以保证HANK中均衡的唯一性：无论货币政策对通胀变化的反应有多强烈，都存在多个有界均衡。要使积极的货币政策消除自我实现的波动，必须稳定内生的自然利率波动。或者，被动的货币政策和积极的财政政策体制也能消除均衡的多重性。（JEL E12, E23, E31, E32, E43, E52, E62）
10.1257/aer.20240642.title: Self-Fulfilling Fluctuations in HANK Economies
10.1257/aer.20240642.title_zh: HANK经济中的自我实现波动

10.1257/aer.20240651.abstract: This paper develops a dynamic model of the attention economy featuring two interlinked markets: a product market, where consumers have limited awareness of firms, and an attention market, where platforms attract attention by investing in free services (e.g., social media, streaming, podcasts) and sell targeted ads using data on consumer preferences. The model provides a tractable framework in which platform investment, ad-driven discovery, product demand, and ad revenue are jointly determined. The effects of data and interoperability policies can reverse over time, platform quality may be inefficiently high or low, and the rise of data-rich digital advertising can coincide with a declining ad revenue-to-GDP ratio.
10.1257/aer.20240651.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个注意力经济的动态模型，该模型包含两个相互关联的市场：产品市场（消费者对企业的认知有限）和注意力市场（平台通过投资免费服务（如社交媒体、流媒体、播客）吸引注意力，并利用消费者偏好数据销售定向广告）。该模型提供了一个易于处理的框架，其中平台投资、广告驱动的发现、产品需求和广告收入是共同决定的。数据与互操作性政策的效果可能随时间逆转，平台质量可能处于低效的高或低水平，而数据丰富的数字广告的兴起可能与广告收入占GDP比重的下降同时发生。
10.1257/aer.20240651.title: A Model of the Attention Economy: Data, Platforms, and Discovery
10.1257/aer.20240651.title_zh: 注意力经济模型：数据、平台与发现

10.1257/aer.20240664.abstract: Efficient risk-sharing implies a simple factor structure for marginal utilities of expenditure (MUEs): Pareto weights divided by a common price. The standard approach infers MUEs from total expenditures, implicitly assuming homothetic preferences, unitary income elasticities, and identical price elasticities. Risk-sharing tests using total expenditures work for idiosyncratic shocks (budgets change, but not prices), but not “covariate” shocks (prices change). We describe all preferences which permit one to infer MUEs from expenditures, and estimate nonhomothetic MUEs to test whether covariate shocks are shared efficiently in Uganda. This delivers sensible results; the standard approach suggests that droughts, floods, and pests are beneficial.
10.1257/aer.20240664.abstract_zh: 有效风险分担意味着支出边际效用（MUEs）存在一个简单的因子结构：帕累托权重除以共同价格。标准方法通过总支出推断MUEs，隐含假设了同质性偏好、单位收入弹性以及相同的价格弹性。基于总支出的风险分担检验适用于异质性冲击（预算变化，但价格不变），但不适用于“协变量”冲击（价格变化）。我们描述了所有允许从支出推断MUEs的偏好类型，并估计了非同质性MUEs，以检验乌干达的协变量冲击是否得到有效分担。这一方法得出了合理的结果；而标准方法则暗示干旱、洪水和虫害是有益的。
10.1257/aer.20240664.title: Risk Sharing Tests and Covariate Shocks: Drought, Floods, and Pests in Uganda
10.1257/aer.20240664.title_zh: 风险分担检验与协变量冲击：乌干达的干旱、洪涝与虫害

10.1257/aer.20240666.abstract: Durables represent a large share of households’ marginal propensity to spend (MPX). We develop a quantitative model of spending that takes durables into account and matches a rich set of empirical regularities simultaneously. Scaling the response of non-durables provides a poor approximation of the MPX on durables when it comes to its distribution in the population, its persistence over time, and its cyclicality. As an application, we study how the MPX varies with the size of stimulus checks and find that it declines more slowly compared to a model of purely non-durable spending.
10.1257/aer.20240666.abstract_zh: 耐用品在家庭边际消费倾向（MPX）中占据较大份额。我们构建了一个考虑耐用品的定量支出模型，该模型同时匹配了丰富的经验规律。在人口分布、时间持续性及周期性方面，仅通过非耐用品反应的缩放来近似耐用品的MPX效果不佳。作为应用，我们研究了MPX如何随刺激支票金额变化，发现其下降速度比纯非耐用品支出模型更慢。
10.1257/aer.20240666.title: Durables and the Marginal Propensity to Spend
10.1257/aer.20240666.title_zh: 耐用品与边际消费倾向

10.1257/aer.20240673.abstract: <jats:p>The implementation of evidence-based policies hinges on the dissemination of evidence to policymakers, a process influenced by the attributes of the sender. We conducted a nationwide RCT with ideologically opposite think tanks, major newspapers, and a research institution with nonsalient ideology to communicate a nonideological, cost-effective policy to local policymakers. Results show a 65 percent increase in policy adoption when informing institutions align ideologically with policymakers. We compare the impact of think tanks versus media outlets on implementation, finding both equally effective when ideologically aligned. We explore three actions where ideology may influence adoption: information exposure, belief updating and implementation. (JEL C93, D72, D78, D83, I23)</jats:p>
10.1257/aer.20240673.abstract_zh: 循证政策的实施依赖于将证据传递给政策制定者，这一过程受到信息发送方特征的影响。我们开展了一项全国性随机对照试验，由意识形态对立的智库、主流报纸以及一家意识形态不显著的研究机构，向地方政策制定者传达一项非意识形态、具有成本效益的政策。结果显示，当信息传递机构与政策制定者的意识形态一致时，政策采纳率提高了65%。我们比较了智库与媒体机构对政策实施的影响，发现两者在意识形态一致时效果相当。我们探讨了意识形态可能影响政策采纳的三个环节：信息暴露、信念更新与实施。（JEL C93, D72, D78, D83, I23）
10.1257/aer.20240673.title: Ideological Alignment and Evidence-Based Policy Adoption
10.1257/aer.20240673.title_zh: 意识形态一致性对循证政策采纳的影响

10.1257/aer.20240701.abstract: We document how deepening resource scarcity results in rationing on the basis of race in a highstakes setting: health care. Using detailed, time-stamped data on 107,000 inpatient admissions to a large health system, we find that in-hospital mortality increases for Black, but not White, patients as hospitals reach capacity. These findings are not explained by differential patient selection. We identify rationing by wait times as a mechanism, documenting that sicker Black patients wait longer for care than healthier White patients at almost all capacity levels. Text analysis of unstructured clinical notes reveals rationing of provider effort as another mechanism.
10.1257/aer.20240701.abstract_zh: 我们记录了资源稀缺加剧如何在高风险场景——医疗保健中——导致基于种族的配给。利用涵盖某大型医疗系统107,000例住院患者的详细时间戳数据，我们发现当医院达到容量上限时，黑人患者的院内死亡率上升，而白人患者则未出现此现象。这些发现无法通过患者选择的差异来解释。我们识别出等待时间配给机制，并记录到在几乎所有容量水平下，病情更重的黑人患者比病情较轻的白人患者等待更长时间。对非结构化临床记录的文本分析揭示了医护人员努力程度的配给是另一机制。
10.1257/aer.20240701.title: Rationing by Race

10.1257/aer.20240712.abstract: The random utility model (RUM), a cornerstone in economics, is typically studied under the assumption that choice frequencies of all alternatives are observable. In practice, however, some alternatives have unobservable choice frequencies and are commonly aggregated into a single category called an outside option. We study RUM in such environments and derive a finite, nonredundant system of inequality constraints on observed choice frequencies that characterizes RU-rationalizability. We show that the conventional practice of aggregating unobserved alternatives can miss key information leading to incorrect conclusions such as that observed choices are rationalizable, even when no RUM is consistent with them.
10.1257/aer.20240712.abstract_zh: 随机效用模型（RUM）作为经济学的重要基石，通常在假设所有备选方案的选择频率均可观测的条件下进行研究。然而在实践中，部分备选方案的选择频率无法观测，通常被合并为单一类别，即外部选项。我们在此类环境下研究RUM，推导出关于可观测选择频率的有限且无冗余的不等式约束系统，该系统刻画了RU可理性化的特征。研究表明，将不可观测备选方案进行合并的传统做法可能遗漏关键信息，导致即使不存在任何RUM与观测数据一致时，仍会得出观测选择具有可理性化的错误结论。
10.1257/aer.20240712.title: Random Utility with Unobservable Alternatives
10.1257/aer.20240712.title_zh: 不可观测选项下的随机效用

10.1257/aer.20240756.abstract: Digital platforms reduce geographic frictions, enabling better matching between service providers and users. I quantify reallocation gains in Swedish online healthcare, using nationwide time-conditional random assignment between patients and physicians. Matching high-risk patients with doctors effective at reducing Emergency Room visits lowers such visits by 4.4% (s.e. 1.3); reallocations also reduce counter-guideline antibiotics by 3.1% (1.4). I find limited trade-offs in matching: horizontal differentiation among doctors and varied patient needs allow improvement in multiple outcomes simultaneously. Efficiency-enhancing reallocations also affect equity. The findings highlight the potential for care reorganization aligning provider heterogeneity with patient needs when geographic constraints are lifted.
