Using a randomized evaluation of an exercise incentive program among diabetics in India, we find that time-bundled contracts generate equiv- alent e ort to time-separable contracts at 15% lower cost. Moreover, they perform 30% better among individuals with above-median effort impatience. Pooled across contracts, incentives increase steps by 20% and improve blood sugar relative to a control group.
10.1257/app.20240564.abstract_zh: 许多人缺乏耐心。我们将领域特定贴现引入契约模型，并检验一项关于如何在人们对努力缺乏耐心时有效设计激励措施的预测：实施时间捆绑契约，使未来努力的报酬随当前努力增加而递增。通过对印度糖尿病患者运动激励项目的随机评估，我们发现时间捆绑契约能以比时间可分离契约低15%的成本产生同等努力水平。此外，在努力耐心程度高于中位数的个体中，其效果提升30%。综合各类契约来看，与对照组相比，激励措施使步数增加20%，并改善血糖水平。
10.1257/app.20240564.title: Designing Incentives for Impatient People: An RCT Promoting Exercise to Manage Diabetes
10.1257/app.20240564.title_zh: 为缺乏耐心者设计激励措施：一项促进运动管理糖尿病的随机对照试验

10.1257/app.20240586.abstract: We study contemporaneous and post-program impacts of a public works program, which provides urban youth seven months of employment at the formal minimum wage with complementary training on entrepreneurship or job search. During the program, we find limited impacts on employment, but a shift toward wage jobs, higher earnings and savings, as well as positive changes in work habits, behaviors, and well-being. After the program, we find no lasting impact on employment or behaviors, with only limited gains in earnings stemming from independent activities. Using machine learning to analyze heterogeneity, we show that alternative targeting approaches can substantially improve welfare.
10.1257/app.20240586.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一项公共工程项目在实施期间及结束后的影响。该项目为城市青年提供为期七个月的正式最低工资就业，并辅以创业或求职培训。在项目实施期间，我们发现其对就业的影响有限，但促使就业向工资性工作转移，提高了收入和储蓄，并在工作习惯、行为及福祉方面产生了积极变化。项目结束后，就业或行为方面未发现持久影响，仅从独立活动中获得有限的收入增长。通过机器学习分析异质性，我们表明替代性的目标定位方法可以显著改善福利。
10.1257/app.20240586.title: Do Workfare Programs Live Up to Their Promises? Experimental Evidence from Côte d’Ivoire
10.1257/app.20240586.title_zh: 工作福利计划是否兑现了承诺？来自科特迪瓦的实验证据

10.1257/app.20240589.abstract: <jats:p>Firms often exploit weaknesses in government contracts to boost revenues, yet little is known about how they allocate these funds. We study how hospitals allocated $3 billion obtained from gaming a Medicare loophole. The average gaming hospital increased Medicare and total revenue by around 10 percent, implying large spillovers on other payers. Nonprofit hospitals deployed most funds toward operating costs. For-profits—driven by a large chain—deducted funds off their balance sheets, distributing them to executives and shareholders. Accordingly, we detect reductions in mortality only at nonprofits. Our results imply that the consequences of engineered windfalls vary substantially by hospital ownership. (JEL D86, H51, I11, I12, I18, L31)</jats:p>
10.1257/app.20240589.abstract_zh: 企业常利用政府合同漏洞增加收入，但关于这些资金如何分配的研究甚少。本文研究了医院如何分配通过利用医疗保险制度漏洞获得的30亿美元。平均而言，利用漏洞的医院将医疗保险收入和总收入提高了约10%，这意味着对其他支付方产生了巨大的溢出效应。非营利性医院将大部分资金用于运营成本。营利性医院——由大型连锁医院驱动——则将资金从资产负债表中扣除，分配给高管和股东。相应地，我们仅在非营利性医院中观察到死亡率下降。研究结果表明，意外收益的后果因医院所有权性质而显著不同。（JEL D86, H51, I11, I12, I18, L31）
10.1257/app.20240589.title: Turbocharging Profits? Contract Gaming and Revenue Allocation in Healthcare
10.1257/app.20240589.title_zh: 涡轮增压利润？医疗保健中的合同博弈与收入分配

10.1257/app.20240737.abstract: We study a Force-down/Shoot-down intervention in Brazil that led cocaine traffickers to shift from air to river routes. Using data on cocaine production, homicides, and the network of rivers in the Amazon, we provide evidence that violence increased in municipalities along river routes originating from Andean producing countries after the policy. We also show that, during the same period, violence in these municipalities became more responsive to cocaine production in origin countries. We document an instance of crime displacement over the three-dimensional space, involving sophisticated adaptations from criminals regarding transportation technologies, with dramatic side-effects for local populations.
10.1257/app.20240737.abstract_zh: 我们研究了巴西的“迫降/击落”干预政策，该政策导致可卡因贩运者从空中路线转向河流路线。利用可卡因产量、凶杀案数据以及亚马逊河流网络，我们提供了证据表明，在该政策实施后，源自安第斯生产国的河流沿线城市的暴力事件有所增加。我们还发现，在同一时期，这些城市的暴力事件对原产国可卡因产量的反应变得更加敏感。我们记录了一个三维空间内犯罪转移的案例，涉及犯罪分子在运输技术上的复杂适应，并对当地居民产生了严重的副作用。
10.1257/app.20240737.title: Landing on Water: Air Interdiction, Drug-Trafficking Displacement, and Violence in the Brazilian Amazon
10.1257/app.20240737.title_zh: 水上着陆：空中拦截、毒品贩运转移与巴西亚马逊地区的暴力问题

10.1257/app.20240746.abstract: This paper builds and analyzes a new global macro-historical database of effective tax rates on capital and labor in 154 countries. We establish a new stylized fact: while effective capital tax rates fell in developed countries between 1965 and 2018, they rose in developing countries since 1990. Multiple research designs at the country, sector and firm-level suggest that trade openness contributed to this rise, by increasing the share of output produced in corporations and larger firms, where effective capital taxation is higher. In contrast to a common view, globalization appears in many countries to have supported governments’ ability to tax capital.
10.1257/app.20240746.abstract_zh: 本文构建并分析了涵盖154个国家资本与劳动有效税率的新型全球宏观历史数据库。我们揭示了一个新的典型事实：1965年至2018年间，发达国家的有效资本税率呈下降趋势，而发展中国家自1990年以来却呈现上升态势。基于国家、行业和企业层面的多重研究设计表明，贸易开放通过提升公司制企业及大型企业的产出占比（这些企业的有效资本税率更高）推动了这一上升趋势。与普遍认知相反，全球化在许多国家反而增强了政府对资本征税的能力。
10.1257/app.20240746.title: Globalization, Capital Taxation, and Development: Evidence from a Macro-Historical Database
10.1257/app.20240746.title_zh: 全球化、资本税与发展：基于宏观历史数据库的证据

10.1257/app.20240759.abstract: Natural disasters displace millions of people a year, but their economic impacts are difficult to study when the affected population becomes dispersed. This paper estimates the longrun impacts of six landslides in Uganda on nearly the full affected population. The analysis exploits the sharp boundaries between households residing in a landslide path and those on the same slopes but outside the path. Years after the landslides, affected households earn 50% less income and are 18 percentage points less likely to report being satisfied with their lives. Further analysis points to social capital as a determinant of successful post-disaster recovery.
10.1257/app.20240759.abstract_zh: 自然灾害每年导致数百万人流离失所，但当受灾人口分散时，其经济影响难以研究。本文估算了乌干达六次山体滑坡对几乎全部受灾人口的长期影响。分析利用了滑坡路径内住户与同处同一山坡但位于路径外住户之间的清晰边界。滑坡发生数年后，受灾家庭收入减少50%，对生活表示满意的可能性降低18个百分点。进一步分析表明，社会资本是灾后成功恢复的决定性因素。
10.1257/app.20240759.title: Disastrous Displacement: The Long-Run Impacts of Landslides
10.1257/app.20240759.title_zh: 灾难性迁移：山体滑坡的长期影响

10.1257/app.20240791.abstract: We update the results of Lipscomb et al 2013 to improve the stability of the instrument, to reconcile differences in definitions of the Amazon used in controls, and to update the standard errors based on the Lee et al 2022 tF procedure. We show that the instrument remains strong in the revised specification. The impact of electricity access is positive and important in magnitude though smaller and less precisely estimated than originally estimated in Lipscomb et al 2013.
10.1257/app.20240791.abstract_zh: 我们更新了Lipscomb等人（2013）的研究结果，以提升工具变量的稳定性，协调控制变量中亚马逊定义差异，并基于Lee等人（2022）的tF程序更新标准误。研究表明，在修订后的设定中，工具变量依然有效。电力接入的影响在量级上显著为正，但相较于Lipscomb等人（2013）的原始估计，其影响更小且估计精度较低。
10.1257/app.20240791.title: Reply to “Comment on “Development Effects of Electrification: Evidence from the Topographic Placement of Hydropower Plants in Brazil”
10.1257/app.20240791.title_zh: 回复“关于《电气化的发展效应：来自巴西水电站地形选址的证据》的评论

10.1257/app.20240804.abstract: Proponents of labor mobility restrictions argue that innovation incentives more than offset harm to workers. Yet the causal effect of such policies on innovation is an open empirical question. Leveraging plausibly exogenous state-level changes in the enforceability of noncompete agreements, we find a significant negative effect on innovation. This effect is even larger for the most novel and innovative patents and firms. Further analysis shows that these negative effects on innovation cannot be explained by entry alone and instead likely result from reduced knowledge flows. Our findings suggest that labor mobility plays a crucial role in spreading knowledge across firms.
10.1257/app.20240804.abstract_zh: 劳动力流动限制的支持者认为，创新激励足以抵消对工人的损害。然而，此类政策对创新的因果效应仍是一个悬而未决的实证问题。利用各州竞业禁止协议可执行性看似外生的变化，我们发现其对创新产生了显著的负面影响。对于最具新颖性和创新性的专利及企业而言，这种负面效应甚至更大。进一步分析表明，这些对创新的负面影响无法仅用市场进入来解释，而更可能源于知识流动的减少。我们的研究结果表明，劳动力流动在跨企业知识传播中发挥着关键作用。
10.1257/app.20240804.title: Innovation through Inventor Mobility: Evidence from Non-Compete Agreements
10.1257/app.20240804.title_zh: 发明人流动性与创新：基于竞业禁止协议的证据

10.1257/app.20240816.abstract: We examine long-run differences in intergenerational occupational mobility between Black and White Americans using linked censuses and survey data from 1850 to 2021. We document two main results. First, shifts in mobility dynamics, most notably for the 1940–1950 cohort, reshaped occupational structures and reduced racial segregation. Second, new measures of intergenerational persistence reveal both bottlenecks and the enduring memory in the mobility system, offering new perspectives on the role of mobility in explaining the lack of convergence in Black-White occupational outcomes.
10.1257/app.20240816.abstract_zh: 我们利用1850年至2021年的关联人口普查与调查数据，考察了美国黑人与白人在代际职业流动性方面的长期差异。研究得出两个主要结论：第一，流动性动态的变化（尤以1940-1950年出生队列最为显著）重塑了职业结构并降低了种族隔离程度；第二，代际持续性的新测度揭示了流动性体系中的瓶颈效应与持久记忆，为理解流动性在解释黑人与白人职业结果缺乏趋同现象中的作用提供了新视角。
10.1257/app.20240816.title: The Evolution of Black-White Differences in Occupational Mobility Across Post-Civil War America
10.1257/app.20240816.title_zh: 美国内战后黑人与白人在职业流动性差异上的演变

10.1257/app.20240822.abstract: We provide new evidence of forward-looking labor supply responses to changes in pension wealth. We exploit a 2014 German reform that increased pension wealth for mothers by an average of 4.4% per child born before January 1, 1992. Using administrative data on the universe of working histories, we implement a difference-in-differences design comparing women who had their first child before versus after January 1, 1992. We document significant reductions in labor earnings, driven by intensive margin responses. Our estimates imply that, on average, an extra euro of pension wealth reduces unconditional labor earnings by 54 cents.
10.1257/app.20240822.abstract_zh: 我们提供了关于养老金财富变化对前瞻性劳动供给影响的新证据。利用2014年德国一项改革，该改革使1992年1月1日前生育子女的母亲人均养老金财富增加4.4%。基于涵盖全体工作历史的行政数据，我们采用双重差分法，比较首次生育时间在1992年1月1日前后女性的差异。研究发现劳动收入显著下降，主要源于集约边际调整。估算结果表明，平均每增加1欧元养老金财富，无条件劳动收入将减少54欧分。
10.1257/app.20240822.title: Forward-Looking Labor Supply Responses to Changes in Pension Wealth: Evidence from Germany
10.1257/app.20240822.title_zh: 前瞻性劳动供给对养老金财富变化的反应：来自德国的证据

10.1257/app.20250044.abstract: Zoning regulations drive rising regional housing costs and residential segregation in the United States. In response, governments are passing laws to override local regulations that limit housing density, despite entrenched opposition from incumbent residents. We study how residents living near housing permitted under one such law, Massachusetts’ Chapter 40B, are affected by and respond to this new, denser housing. Exploiting hyperlocal variation in proximity to 40B developments, we find that the average development does not affect these residents’ property values (95% CI: [–0.4%, 2.4%]). For larger developments that do decrease values, outmigration and political responses are small or non-existent.
10.1257/app.20250044.abstract_zh: 美国的分区法规推高了地区住房成本并加剧了居住隔离。为此，各州政府正通过立法来推翻限制住房密度的地方法规，尽管面临现有居民的强烈反对。我们研究了在马萨诸塞州《第40B章》这类法律许可下，居住在新建高密度住房附近的居民如何受到这些住房的影响并作出反应。通过利用与40B开发项目邻近程度的超本地化差异，我们发现平均而言，这些开发项目并未影响周边居民的房产价值（95%置信区间：[–0.4%, 2.4%]）。对于确实导致价值下降的大型开发项目，居民的迁出和政治回应微乎其微甚至不存在。
10.1257/app.20250044.title: There Goes the Neighborhood? The Local Impacts of State Policies that Override Municipal Zoning
10.1257/app.20250044.title_zh: 邻里何去何从？州政策超越市镇区划的地方影响

10.1257/app.20250049.abstract: <jats:p>US firms hiring foreign workers in low-skill nonfarm jobs face a binding quota on the “H-2B” visa, allocated in part through a randomized lottery. We evaluate the quota’s marginal impact using the lottery, a novel firm survey, and a pre-analysis plan. Firms exogenously employing more H-2B workers in low-skill jobs increase production (elasticity 0.20–0.22), investment (1.5–2.1), and profits (0.15). The elasticity of substitution between H-2B and US workers is very low (0.8–2.2). Thus, the effect on US employment is zero or positive overall, and positive in rural areas. Forensic analysis suggests similarly low substitutability of black-market labor. (JEL J15, J24, J46, J61, J82, K37)</jats:p>
10.1257/app.20250049.abstract_zh: 美国企业在低技能非农岗位雇佣外籍工人时，面临“H-2B”签证的约束性配额，该配额部分通过随机抽签分配。我们利用抽签机制、一项新颖的企业调查以及预分析计划，评估了该配额的边际影响。在低技能岗位中因外生因素雇佣更多H-2B工人的企业，其产量（弹性0.20–0.22）、投资（1.5–2.1）和利润（0.15）均有所提升。H-2B工人与美国工人之间的替代弹性极低（0.8–2.2）。因此，该配额对美国就业的整体影响为零或为正，且在乡村地区呈现正向效应。法证分析表明，黑市劳动力的可替代性同样较低。（JEL J15, J24, J46, J61, J82, K37）
10.1257/app.20250049.title: The Effect of Low-Skill Immigration Restrictions on US Firms and Workers: Evidence from a Randomized Lottery
10.1257/app.20250049.title_zh: 低技能移民限制对美国企业与工人的影响：来自随机抽签的证据

10.1257/app.20250070.abstract: We study how the legacy of WWI deaths affected British communities and the next generation of soldiers. Our instrumental-variable estimates show that servicemen from localities that suffered heavier losses in WWI were considerably more likely to die or win gallantry medals in WW2. To contextualise these findings, we show that the mortality shock increased communities’ inter-war civic capital as demonstrated by the creation of war memorials, veterans’ associations and charities, and increases in pro-social participation. Our results highlight the importance of past conflicts in fostering pro-social behaviours which, in turn, can shape the motivation of soldiers in future wars.
10.1257/app.20250070.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一战死亡遗留问题如何影响英国社区及下一代士兵。工具变量估计表明，来自一战损失更惨重地区的军人在二战中阵亡或获得英勇勋章的可能性显著更高。为阐释这些发现，我们证明死亡率冲击通过战争纪念碑、退伍军人协会和慈善机构的建立，以及亲社会参与度的提升，增强了社区在两次世界大战间的公民资本。研究结果凸显了过往冲突在培育亲社会行为中的重要性，而这种行为反过来可能塑造未来战争中士兵的动机。
10.1257/app.20250070.title: Scars of War: The Legacy of WWI Deaths on Civic Capital and Combat Motivation
10.1257/app.20250070.title_zh: 战争伤痕：一战死亡对公民资本与战斗动机的遗留影响

10.1257/app.20250146.abstract: We develop a revealed preference approach to measure the value of workplace amenities by analyzing how variation in non-wage job attributes affects excess mass in the earnings distribution at budget discontinuities. The approach formalizes the idea that workers respond less to monetary incentives when amenities constitute a larger share of total compensation. Applying this method to workplace safety during COVID-19 waves, we find that workers are willing to sacrifice 9% of their earnings to reduce weekly fatality risks by one in 100,000. The findings suggest that conventional hedonic regressions substantially underestimate the value of workplace safety.
10.1257/app.20250146.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种揭示性偏好方法，通过分析非工资性工作属性变化如何影响预算断点处收入分布的超额聚集程度，来测算工作场所福利的价值。该方法将以下理念形式化：当福利在总薪酬中占比更大时，劳动者对货币激励的反应会减弱。将该方法应用于新冠疫情浪潮期间的工作场所安全研究，我们发现劳动者愿意牺牲9%的收入，以将每周十万分之一的死亡风险降低一个单位。研究结果表明，传统特征回归方法会显著低估工作场所安全的价值。
10.1257/app.20250146.title: Willingness to Pay for Workplace Amenities
10.1257/app.20250146.title_zh: 工作场所便利设施的支付意愿

10.1257/app.20250329.abstract: This paper provides the first evidence on the impact of exposure to international students on the long-term outcomes of native students. I combine unique survey and administrative data from the Netherlands covering one million students across three decades and employ an across-cohort design. I find that exposure to international students leads natives to (i) form social ties with non-natives, (ii) hold more positive attitudes towards migration and learning about other cultures, and (iii) seek opportunities abroad. Notably, I find precisely estimated zero effects on employment, income, entrepreneurship, and the share of international co-workers up to 25 years after university entry.
10.1257/app.20250329.abstract_zh: 本文首次提供了接触国际学生对本土学生长期结果影响的证据。我结合了荷兰覆盖三十年、涉及一百万学生的独特调查与行政数据，并采用跨队列设计。研究发现，接触国际学生使本土学生：（i）与非本土学生建立社会联系，（ii）对移民及了解其他文化持有更积极的态度，以及（iii）寻求海外机会。值得注意的是，在进入大学后的25年内，我发现对就业、收入、创业以及国际同事比例的影响精确估计为零。
10.1257/app.20250329.title: University as a Melting Pot: Long-term Effects of Internationalization
10.1257/app.20250329.title_zh: 大学作为大熔炉：国际化的长期效应

10.1257/app.20250342.abstract: We propose a simple model of the evolution of institutional strength, where leaders' actions have a persistent effect by shaping the norms of the institutions they lead. This leads to different long-run behaviors even for institutions with the same formal rules. The early history of leaders plays a crucial role in determining which outcome prevails. Every period, a leader decides to respect or abuse their position. Respect strengthens the institutions; abuse weakens them. Leader's type and institutional strength determine both the benefit/cost of abusing the position and the replacement probability. We elucidate democratic backsliding and corporate-board capturing.
10.1257/app.20250342.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个关于制度强度演化的简单模型，其中领导者的行为通过塑造其领导机构的规范而产生持久影响。即使正式规则相同的制度，也会因此产生不同的长期行为。领导者的早期经历在决定最终结果中起着关键作用。每个时期，领导者都会决定是尊重还是滥用其职位。尊重会强化制度，滥用则会削弱制度。领导者的类型和制度强度共同决定了滥用职位的收益/成本以及被替换的概率。我们阐释了民主倒退和公司董事会俘获现象。
10.1257/app.20250342.title: Shaping Institutions

10.1257/app.20250397.abstract: We study class disparities in highway patrol traffic stops. Low-income motorists are more likely to be searched for contraband, less likely to be found with contraband when searched, and more likely to be stopped for infractions associated with pretext stops. To measure class-based discrimination, we leverage motorists stopped in multiple vehicles conveying different class signals. Motorists are more likely to be searched when stopped in a low-status vehicle, and evidence suggests that they are also more likely to be stopped when driving one. Marginal searches triggered by vehicle status are less likely to yield contraband when the motorist is low-income.
10.1257/app.20250397.abstract_zh: 我们研究了高速公路巡警交通拦截中的阶层差异。低收入驾驶者更可能因违禁品被搜查，搜查时被发现携带违禁品的概率更低，且更可能因与借口性拦截相关的违规行为被拦停。为衡量基于阶层的歧视，我们利用了驾驶不同阶层信号车辆的驾驶者被拦截的数据。驾驶低地位车辆时，驾驶者更可能被搜查，且有证据表明他们驾驶此类车辆时也更可能被拦停。由车辆地位引发的边际搜查中，若驾驶者为低收入群体，查获违禁品的可能性更低。
10.1257/app.20250397.title: Class Disparities and Discrimination in Traffic Stops and Searches
10.1257/app.20250397.title_zh: 交通拦截与搜查中的阶级差异与歧视

10.1257/app.20250414.abstract: We analyze mandatory retirement in Sweden which eliminates entirely employment protection at age 67. Employment falls by about 10 percent and total average earnings by about 20 percent immediately at age 67. 8 percent of jobs separate immediately due to loss of protection, with effects stemming from jobs with stronger initial employment protection (long tenure, firms subject to “last in, first out” rules), and those in the public sector. We examine effects on continuing jobs. While wages appear rigid, we uncover novel, sizable intensive-margin hours reductions, resulting in an 8 percent drop in earnings conditional on staying on the job.
10.1257/app.20250414.abstract_zh: 本文分析了瑞典的强制退休制度，该制度在67岁时完全取消就业保护。67岁后，就业率立即下降约10%，平均总收入下降约20%。由于保护措施失效，8%的工作岗位立即终止，这一影响主要源于初始就业保护较强的岗位（如长期任职、受“后进先出”规则约束的企业）以及公共部门岗位。我们进一步考察了持续就业岗位的影响。尽管工资水平看似刚性，但我们发现了新颖且显著的集约边际工时缩减现象，导致在职人员收入下降8%。
10.1257/app.20250414.title: Deadwood Labor? The Effects of Eliminating Employment Protection for Older Workers
10.1257/app.20250414.title_zh: 枯木劳动力？取消老年工人就业保护的影响

10.1257/jel.20251766.abstract: Intermediary asset pricing posits that financial institutions play a central role in financial markets, and that their decisions shape asset prices beyond simply reflecting the preferences of the average household. This perspective helps make sense of key empirical patterns: the excess volatility of asset prices, differences in price movements across asset classes, the cross-section of expected returns within asset classes, and specific arbitrage opportunities and price dislocations. We also review the implications of intermediary asset pricing for macroeconomic dynamics, international economics, and policy. In this approach, a primary channel of financial regulation and monetary policy is through alleviating constraints or removing risk from intermediary balance sheets during periods of stress. We highlight both existing progress and gaps for future research.
10.1257/jel.20251766.abstract_zh: 中介资产定价理论认为，金融机构在金融市场中扮演核心角色，其决策不仅反映普通家庭的平均偏好，更直接塑造资产价格。这一视角有助于解释关键实证现象：资产价格的过度波动、不同资产类别间的价格差异、同类资产预期收益率的截面特征，以及特定套利机会与价格错位。本文还梳理了中介资产定价对宏观经济动态、国际经济学及政策制定的启示。在该理论框架下，金融监管与货币政策的主要传导渠道，是在压力时期缓解中介机构面临的约束或消除其资产负债表风险。我们既总结了现有研究进展，也指出了未来需要填补的空白。
10.1257/jel.20251766.title: Intermediaries and Asset Prices

10.1257/jel.20251774.abstract: Refugees are international migrants escaping persecution and crises, whose economic success in their countries of destination is threatened by lack of access to labor and credit markets, limited information on employment opportunities, and loss of human capital and assets. In this paper, we review the economic literature that analyzes and evaluates interventions designed to address these hurdles and facilitate refugees’ economic integration. We also draw important general lessons from a wide variety of these interventions and identify areas for further research.
10.1257/jel.20251774.abstract_zh: 难民是因逃避迫害和危机而跨国迁移的人群，其在目的地国的经济成功面临劳动力与信贷市场准入受限、就业机会信息匮乏、人力资本与资产流失等多重威胁。本文系统梳理了旨在破解上述障碍、促进难民经济融入的经济学干预措施相关文献，通过提炼各类干预方案中的普适性经验，为后续研究指明方向。
10.1257/jel.20251774.title: Refugees’ Economic Integration

10.1257/jel.20251775.abstract: Something is amiss in empirical economics. Despite the advances of the credibility revolution, published estimates tend to be inflated and overconfident. We argue that this stems from a weakness in the dominant econometric framework: treating the researcher like a calculator that mechanically implements the econometric method. We use several examples to show how properties of estimators change dramatically with humans-in-the-loop. Under plausible assumptions on researcher behavior, low-power estimators such as instrumental variables exhibit high degrees of bias, even with a first-stage F -statistic of 200. Threshold testing on the first-stage F -statistic can reduce bias, contrary to Angrist and Kolesár (2024). And standard errors understate uncertainty, since they ignore variation due to researchers’ subjective choices. Ignoring the role of humans “in the research loop” can lead to highly biased and unreliable findings. Modifying econometric practices to address the human factor is a critical frontier of the credibility revolution.
10.1257/jel.20251775.abstract_zh: 实证经济学中存在某种偏差。尽管可信性革命取得了进展，但已发表的估计结果往往存在膨胀和过度自信的问题。我们认为，这源于主流计量经济学框架的一个缺陷：将研究者视为机械执行计量方法的计算器。我们通过多个案例展示了当人类介入研究过程时，估计量的性质会发生显著变化。在关于研究者行为的合理假设下，即使第一阶段F统计量达到200，工具变量等低功效估计量仍会表现出高度偏误。与Angrist和Kolesár（2024）的结论相反，对第一阶段F统计量进行阈值检验可以降低偏误。而标准误低估了不确定性，因为它忽略了研究者主观选择带来的变异。忽视"研究循环"中人类角色的作用，可能导致高度偏误且不可靠的研究结论。调整计量实践以应对人为因素，是可信性革命的关键前沿。
10.1257/jel.20251775.title: Humans in the Loop: The Next Frontier in the Credibility Revolution
10.1257/jel.20251775.title_zh: 人类在循环中：可信度革命的下一个前沿

10.1257/jel.20251792.abstract: We review the flourishing literature on the automobile industry since the seminal work of Berry, Levinsohn, and Pakes (1995), or briefly BLP. Their work provides a structural equilibrium framework that forms a basis for conducting policy counterfactuals in several key areas of interest: competition policy and antitrust, trade policy, and taxation and environmental policy. The demand side of the ‘BLP framework’ is micro-founded and allows for rich consumer heterogeneity to generate flexible substitution patterns between products. The supply side specifies marginal costs and accounts for imperfect competition. Our analysis focuses on two main questions. First, how has the framework been tailored to specific situations and how convincingly has it been evaluated to generate trust in the empirical findings and policy conclusions? Second, what has been learned about policy issues relevant in the automotive industry using the BLP equilibrium framework?
10.1257/jel.20251792.abstract_zh: 本文回顾了自Berry、Levinsohn与Pakes（1995，简称BLP）开创性研究以来蓬勃发展的汽车产业文献。其构建的结构性均衡框架为竞争政策与反垄断、贸易政策、税收与环境政策等关键领域的政策反事实分析奠定了基础。BLP框架的需求侧具有微观基础，通过丰富的消费者异质性刻画产品间的灵活替代模式；供给侧则明确边际成本设定并纳入不完全竞争因素。我们的分析聚焦两大核心问题：第一，该框架如何针对特定情境进行适应性调整，其评估过程在多大程度上能令人信服地支撑实证发现与政策结论？第二，借助BLP均衡框架，我们对汽车产业相关政策议题获得了哪些认知？
10.1257/jel.20251792.title: Demand, Competition, and Public Policy in the Automobile Industry
10.1257/jel.20251792.title_zh: 汽车行业的需求、竞争与公共政策

10.1257/jel.20251826.abstract: In Unforgiving Places , Jens Ludwig makes a strong claim for the behavioral economics of crime, scoring it a knockout when pitted against conventional wisdom. Focusing on gun violence, he proposes a unifying explanation that draws on disciplines beyond economics, especially sociology, criminology, and psychology. Although the intended audience is mainly policymakers and the general public, scholars will benefit from reading Ludwig’s thought-provoking book. In this essay, I evaluate the book’s evidence and elaborate on the research needed to resolve unsettled hypotheses. I focus on several key issues, including linking self-control theory to cognitive processes; informal neighborhood social control; legitimacy in community policing; toxic environmental effects on cognition; the limits of administrative data; age-specific pathways of gun carrying; and the impact of social change. In the spirit of consilience that Unforgiving Places calls for, I argue that further engagement of the book’s framework with these issues yields a promising research agenda.
10.1257/jel.20251826.abstract_zh: 在《无情之地》一书中，延斯·路德维希对犯罪的行为经济学提出了有力主张，认为相较于传统观念，该理论具有压倒性优势。他聚焦枪支暴力问题，提出了一种融合经济学之外多学科（尤其是社会学、犯罪学与心理学）的统一解释框架。尽管本书主要面向政策制定者与普通公众，但学者们亦能从路德维希发人深省的论述中获益。本文评估了该书的证据基础，并详细阐述了解决未决假说所需的研究方向。我重点关注若干关键议题，包括：将自我控制理论与认知过程相联结；非正式邻里社会控制机制；社区警务中的合法性；有毒环境对认知的影响；行政数据的局限性；携带枪支的年龄特异性路径；以及社会变革的影响。秉承《无情之地》所倡导的“知识融通”精神，我认为将该书框架进一步延伸至这些议题，将催生富有前景的研究议程。

10.1257/jel.20260011.title_zh: 沉没成本：谁该为国家破碎的学生贷款体系负责及如何修复——吉莉安·伯曼

10.1257/jel.20261582.abstract: The literature on imperfect competition in labor markets has expanded rapidly in recent years. This article provides a guide to the field, focusing on the firm-specific (“residual”) labor supply elasticity as the definition of a firm’s labor market power. We present a general framework showing how this elasticity nests the three widely studied sources of monopsony power: search frictions, preference heterogeneity, and employer concentration. We summarize the empirical estimates of the elasticity of labor supply, highlighting sources of possible heterogeneity. We emphasize that it is difficult to infer elasticities from markdowns (and vice versa) due to the diversity of firm wage-setting practices, illustrating this point using the interaction between monopsony and efficiency wages. We discuss how policy issues in antitrust, labor market regulation, immigration, and macroeconomics interact with monopsony and conclude by listing several areas for future research.
10.1257/jel.20261582.abstract_zh: 近年来，关于劳动力市场不完全竞争的文献迅速增长。本文为该领域提供指南，聚焦于企业特定（“剩余”）劳动力供给弹性作为企业劳动力市场势力的定义。我们提出一个通用框架，展示该弹性如何涵盖三种被广泛研究的买方垄断势力来源：搜索摩擦、偏好异质性和雇主集中度。我们总结了劳动力供给弹性的实证估计，强调可能存在的异质性来源。我们指出，由于企业工资制定实践的多样性，难以从工资加价中推断弹性（反之亦然），并通过买方垄断与效率工资的相互作用阐明这一观点。我们讨论了反垄断、劳动力市场监管、移民和宏观经济学中的政策问题如何与买方垄断相互影响，最后列出未来研究的若干方向。
10.1257/jel.20261582.title: Monopsony Makes It Big

10.1257/jel.20261604.abstract: Rapid progress has been made in identifying links between human genetic variation and social and behavioral phenotypes. Applications in mainstream economics are beginning to emerge. This review aims to provide the background needed to bring the interested economist to the frontier of social-science genomics. Our review is structured around a statistical framework that nests many of the key methods, concepts and tools found in the literature. We clarify key assumptions and appropriate interpretations. After critically reviewing several significant applications, we conclude by outlining future advances in genetics that will enable more and improved applications, and we discuss the ethical and communication challenges that arise in this area of research.
10.1257/jel.20261604.abstract_zh: 人类遗传变异与社会及行为表型之间的关联研究已取得快速进展，其在主流经济学中的应用也初现端倪。本综述旨在为感兴趣的经济学家提供必要背景知识，助其了解社会科学基因组学的前沿领域。我们围绕一个统计框架展开综述，该框架整合了文献中的诸多关键方法、概念与工具，并阐明核心假设与恰当解读方式。在批判性评述若干重要应用后，我们最后展望了遗传学领域的未来进展——这些进展将推动更多、更优的应用实践，同时探讨该研究领域所引发的伦理与沟通挑战。
10.1257/jel.20261604.title: Social-Science Genomics: Progress, Challenges, and Future Directions
10.1257/jel.20261604.title_zh: 社会科学基因组学：进展、挑战与未来方向

10.1257/jel.20261758.abstract: This paper provides an introduction to Double/Debiased Machine Learning (DML). DML is a general approach to performing inference about a target parameter in the presence of nuisance functions: objects that are needed to identify the target parameter but are not of primary interest. Nuisance functions arise naturally in many settings, such as when controlling for confounding variables or leveraging instruments. The paper describes two biases that arise from nuisance function estimation and explains how DML alleviates these biases. Consequently, DML allows the use of flexible methods, including machine learning tools, for estimating nuisance functions, reducing the dependence on auxiliary functional form assumptions and enabling the use of complex non-tabular data, such as text or images. We illustrate the application of DML through simulations and empirical examples. We conclude with a discussion of recommended practices. A companion website includes additional examples and references to other resources.
10.1257/jel.20261758.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了双重/去偏机器学习（DML）。DML是一种在存在干扰函数（即识别目标参数所需但非主要关注对象的函数）的情况下对目标参数进行推断的通用方法。干扰函数在诸多场景中自然出现，例如在控制混杂变量或利用工具变量时。本文阐述了由干扰函数估计产生的两种偏差，并解释了DML如何缓解这些偏差。因此，DML允许使用包括机器学习工具在内的灵活方法估计干扰函数，从而减少对辅助函数形式假设的依赖，并能够利用复杂的非表格数据（如文本或图像）。我们通过模拟和实证案例展示了DML的应用，并在结论部分讨论了推荐实践。配套网站提供了更多示例及其他资源参考。
10.1257/jel.20261758.title: An Introduction to Double/Debiased Machine Learning
10.1257/jel.20261758.title_zh: 双重/去偏机器学习导论

10.1257/jel.20261768.abstract: The Head Start program, launched in 1965 and targeted to children from disadvantaged backgrounds, remains the largest early childhood care and education (ECE) program in the United States and the only one deployed at the federal level. As such, the Head Start literature spans several decades and now allows for synthesis of findings from different contexts, time periods, and research designs. This paper provides a comprehensive assessment of the rigorous evidence measuring Head Start’s effects on children, their families, and society. The focus is on how (1) the contrast between program and counterfactual conditions, (2) takeup of the program among eligible populations, and (3) treatment–effect heterogeneity inform interpretation and applicability of key findings. The paper presents implications of the evidence for the modern-day Head Start program and an adjacent, policy-relevant research agenda.
10.1257/jel.20261768.abstract_zh: 启智计划”始于1965年，面向弱势背景儿童，至今仍是美国规模最大的早期儿童保育与教育项目，也是唯一由联邦层面部署的项目。因此，关于“启智计划”的研究文献跨越数十年，如今已能综合不同情境、时期和研究设计的发现。本文对衡量“启智计划”对儿童、家庭及社会影响的严谨证据进行了全面评估，重点探讨以下三点如何影响关键发现的解读与适用性：（1）项目条件与反事实条件之间的对比；（2）合格人群的项目参与率；（3）处理效应的异质性。本文还阐述了这些证据对当代“启智计划”的启示，并提出了与之相关的政策研究方向。
10.1257/jel.20261768.title: Early Learning across Decades: Advances in Measuring Head Start Effectiveness
10.1257/jel.20261768.title_zh: 跨越数十年的早期学习：衡量开端计划有效性的进展

10.1257/jel.20261773.abstract: Multiple lines of research aim to quantify the economic impacts of climate change. We show that the effects of climate change on economic activity depend on how climate change alters weather across time and space. Changes in contemporary weather have direct effects on output; changes in past weather and in expectations of future weather induce adaptation; and changes in weather elsewhere around the globe introduce a general equilibrium effect. Using this framework, we argue that estimation of climate impacts faces a trilemma. A methodology can have at most two of: (i) robustness to a particular economic model’s structure, (ii) interpretation as effects of persistent, widespread, anticipated climate change, and (iii) quasi-experimental identification. We summarize the literature on climate damages in light of the trilemma. A solid body of knowledge has developed around direct effects, and recent work has made substantial progress towards understanding adaptation and spatial spillovers.
10.1257/jel.20261773.abstract_zh: 多项研究旨在量化气候变化的经济影响。我们表明，气候变化对经济活动的影响取决于气候变化如何改变不同时间和空间上的天气状况。当代天气的变化对产出产生直接影响；过去天气的变化以及对未来天气的预期会引发适应性调整；而全球其他地区天气的变化则引入了一般均衡效应。基于这一框架，我们认为气候影响的估计面临一个三难困境。一种方法论最多只能满足以下三个条件中的两个：（i）对特定经济模型结构的稳健性，（ii）能够解释为持续性、广泛性、可预期的气候变化的影响，以及（iii）准实验识别。我们根据这一三难困境对气候损害相关文献进行了总结。围绕直接影响已形成了较为扎实的知识体系，而近期研究在理解适应性调整和空间溢出效应方面取得了实质性进展。
10.1257/jel.20261773.title: Navigating the "Problem from Hell": A Guide to Climate Damages
10.1257/jel.20261773.title_zh: 驾驭“地狱难题”：气候损害指南

10.1257/jel.20261783.abstract: This article examines how machine learning and other computational techniques can contribute to the development of economic models. First, comparing economic models to flexible algorithms can help clarify the strengths and limitations of existing models, for instance how far they are from the predictive limit. Second, algorithms can adversarially probe economic models to identify cases in which the theoretical predictions fail. Third, “hybrid” models can combine interpretable economic structure with flexible learning methods to leverage the strengths of both. Finally, large language models introduce qualitatively new possibilities, from simulating human responses to generating novel hypotheses. Throughout, I emphasize both promise and limits: while machine learning can uncover patterns that standard models miss, translating these algorithmic insights into interpretable and portable economic understanding typically still requires human judgment.
10.1257/jel.20261783.abstract_zh: 本文探讨机器学习及其他计算技术如何推动经济模型的发展。首先，将经济模型与灵活算法进行比较，有助于厘清现有模型的优势与局限，例如其与预测极限之间的差距。其次，算法可通过对抗性方式检验经济模型，识别理论预测失效的案例。第三，“混合”模型能够将可解释的经济结构与灵活的学习方法相结合，从而发挥两者的优势。最后，大语言模型带来了质的新可能性，从模拟人类反应到生成新颖假设。全文始终强调前景与局限并存：尽管机器学习能发现标准模型遗漏的模式，但将这些算法洞见转化为可解释且可迁移的经济学理解，通常仍需依赖人类判断。
10.1257/jel.20261783.title: Using Machine Learning to Generate, Clarify, and Improve Economic Models
10.1257/jel.20261783.title_zh: 使用机器学习生成、澄清和改进经济模型

10.1257/jel.20261786.abstract: We consider why fertility has fallen in recent decades in almost all high-income countries. We begin by documenting declining total fertility and rising childlessness across cohorts, highlighting the need to focus on cohort versus period-specific fertility rates. With this motivation, we propose a conceptual model of fertility determination that augments the standard Becker model with an explicit role for social norms and cohort-specific contextual factors, including broad social and economic influences and an expanded set of consumption and lifestyle options. We posit that these forces have led to “shifting priorities,” reducing the centrality of parenthood. We then review existing empirical evidence –and conclude that the decline in fertility likely reflects a complex mix of changing norms around work, parenting, gender roles, and leisure consistent with our cohort-based conceptual framework. We conclude with suggestions for future research and a brief discussion of policy implications.
10.1257/jel.20261786.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了近几十年来几乎所有高收入国家生育率下降的原因。我们首先记录了不同世代群体中总和生育率的下降及无子女现象的上升，强调需关注世代特定生育率而非时期特定生育率。基于此，我们提出一个生育决定的概念模型，该模型在标准贝克尔模型基础上，引入社会规范与世代特定情境因素（包括广泛的社会经济影响及扩大的消费与生活方式选择）的显性作用。我们假设这些力量导致了“优先事项的转变”，削弱了为人父母的核心地位。随后，我们回顾现有实证证据，并得出结论：生育率下降可能反映了围绕工作、育儿、性别角色及休闲的规范变迁的复杂组合，这与我们基于世代的概念框架一致。最后，我们提出未来研究建议并简要讨论政策启示。
10.1257/jel.20261786.title: Why Is Fertility So Low in High-Income Countries?
10.1257/jel.20261786.title_zh: 为什么高收入国家生育率如此之低？

10.1257/jel.20261794.abstract: The ongoing revolution in deep learning is reshaping research across many fields, including economics. Its effects are especially clear in solving dynamic economic models. These models often lack closed-form solutions, so economists have long relied on numerical methods such as value function iteration, perturbation, and projection techniques. Unfortunately, these approaches suffer from the curse of dimensionality, which makes global solutions computationally infeasible as the number of state variables increases. Deep learning offers a different approach: flexible tools that solve dynamic economic models by minimizing residuals in equilibrium conditions, and that can handle high-dimensional problems. This development promises to broaden the scope of quantitative economics. I illustrate the approach using the neoclassical growth model.
10.1257/jel.20261794.abstract_zh: 深度学习的持续革命正在重塑包括经济学在内的众多领域的研究格局。其在动态经济模型求解方面的作用尤为显著。由于这类模型通常缺乏闭式解，经济学家长期以来依赖数值方法，如值函数迭代、摄动法和投影技术。遗憾的是，这些方法受困于维度灾难——随着状态变量数量的增加，全局解在计算上变得不可行。深度学习提供了一种不同的路径：通过最小化均衡条件残差来求解动态经济模型的灵活工具，能够处理高维问题。这一发展有望拓宽定量经济学的应用范围。本文以新古典增长模型为例阐释该方法。
10.1257/jel.20261794.title: Deep Learning for Solving Economic Models
10.1257/jel.20261794.title_zh: 深度学习求解经济模型

10.1257/jel.20261798.abstract: We provide a guide to the macroeconomic literature on retail central bank digital currency (CBDC), organizing the discussion around a CBDC-irrelevance result. We identify both fundamental and policy-related sources of relevance, or departures from neutrality. Bank disintermediation—the crowding out of deposits—does not, by itself, constitute such a source. We argue that the literature has primarily focused on policy-related sources of non-neutrality, often without making this focus explicit. From a macroeconomic perspective, CBDC is, at its core, a matter of monetary architecture, and political economy considerations are central to understanding CBDC policy design.
10.1257/jel.20261798.abstract_zh: 本文围绕零售型央行数字货币（CBDC）的宏观经济文献提供指南，并以CBDC无关性结论为核心组织讨论。我们识别了相关性的根本来源与政策相关来源，即对中性状态的偏离。银行去中介化——存款被挤出——本身并不构成此类来源。我们认为，现有文献主要聚焦于非中性的政策相关来源，但往往未明确这一侧重点。从宏观经济视角看，CBDC本质上属于货币架构问题，而政治经济学考量对于理解CBDC政策设计至关重要。
10.1257/jel.20261798.title: Central Bank Digital Currency and Monetary Architecture
10.1257/jel.20261798.title_zh: 中央银行数字货币与货币架构

10.1257/jel.20261805.abstract: This paper reviews recent research in the economics of human development, focusing on the early years of life as a critical period for shaping long-term outcomes. Early childhood development is inherently multidimensional: cognitive and socioemotional skills evolve dynamically and interact with health, nutritional, and environmental influences. Economists have contributed to this field by providing a conceptual and unifying framework that highlights how key drivers of development reflect the choices of individuals operating under both incentives and constraints. The paper emphasizes two central challenges: understanding the interactions among multiple dimensions of development and identifying causal links, particularly the effects of different inputs at different ages. Measurement issues are a recurring theme, given the difficulty of assessing young children and the need for comparability across contexts. By discussing early childhood interventions in both developed and developing countries, the paper also stresses these issues’ policy relevance for poverty reduction and social mobility.
10.1257/jel.20261805.abstract_zh: 本文综述了人类发展经济学领域的最新研究，重点关注生命早期阶段作为塑造长期结果的关键时期。儿童早期发展本质上是多维的：认知与社会情感技能动态演进，并与健康、营养及环境影响相互作用。经济学家通过提供概念性与统一性框架为该领域作出贡献，该框架强调发展的关键驱动因素如何反映个体在激励与约束条件下的选择。本文着重探讨两大核心挑战：理解发展各维度间的相互作用，以及识别因果关联——特别是不同年龄阶段不同投入要素的影响效应。鉴于低龄儿童评估的困难性及跨情境可比性的需求，测量问题成为贯穿全文的反复议题。通过讨论发达国家与发展中国家的早期儿童干预措施，本文亦强调这些议题对减贫与社会流动性的政策相关性。
10.1257/jel.20261805.title: The First 1,000 Days and Beyond: The Process of Child Development
10.1257/jel.20261805.title_zh: 最初的1000天及以后：儿童发展的过程

10.1257/jel.20261808.abstract: Enslavement: Past and Present by Orlando Patterson should be required reading for any economist or economic historian interested in long-run development and growth, race, inequality, political economy, or institutional development. Patterson synthesizes decades of his cross-disciplinary scholarship into an ambitious comparative framework to understand slavery, built on two main pillars: (i) slavery as “social death”, defined as a condition of total domination, natal alienation and dishonor, and (ii) a “bundle of rights” approach that permits systematic comparison across societies and periods. This review, after summarizing the book’s central arguments, offers three critiques—the limited applicability of social death to West and Central African slavery, insufficient attention to the Transatlantic Slave Trade, and the problematic extension to “modern slavery”—and proposes a research agenda focused on agency and resilience, diasporic identity, and reparations.
10.1257/jel.20261808.abstract_zh: 奥兰多·帕特森的《奴役：过去与现在》应成为任何关注长期发展与增长、种族、不平等、政治经济学或制度发展的经济学家或经济史学家的必读书目。帕特森将其数十年的跨学科学术研究整合为一个宏大的比较框架来理解奴隶制，该框架建立在两大支柱之上：（一）奴隶制作为“社会性死亡”，即一种完全支配、出生疏离与耻辱的状态；（二）一套“权利束”方法，允许跨社会与跨时期的系统性比较。本文在总结该书核心论点后提出三点批评——社会性死亡对西非与中非奴隶制的适用性有限、对大西洋奴隶贸易的关注不足，以及将其延伸至“现代奴隶制”的问题——并提出了一个聚焦于能动性与韧性、散居身份认同及赔偿问题的研究议程。
10.1257/jel.20261808.title: Beyond Social Death: A Review Essay of Enslavement: Past and Present by Orlando Patterson
10.1257/jel.20261808.title_zh: 超越社会性死亡：奥兰多·帕特森《奴役：过去与现在》书评

10.1257/jel.20261809.abstract: This article reviews the growing literature on age at school entry and its effects over the life course. Age at school entry affects a broad range of outcomes, including education, labor-market performance, health, social relationships, and family formation. We synthesize the evidence using a conceptual framework that distinguishes four empirically intertwined components of age at school entry: starting age, age at outcome, relative age, and time in school. Within this framework, we highlight six key channels through which age at school entry operates. While the effects of age at school entry are often substantial and persistent, many studies estimate bundled impacts without isolating specific components or directly measuring underlying mechanisms. We explain how different research designs capture distinct combinations of these components. We also highlight how institutional heterogeneity and behavioral responses can complicate the interpretation of results. We conclude by outlining directions for future research and policy design.
10.1257/jel.20261809.abstract_zh: 本文综述了关于入学年龄及其对生命历程影响的日益增长的文献。入学年龄影响广泛的结果，包括教育、劳动力市场表现、健康、社会关系及家庭形成。我们通过一个概念框架综合现有证据，该框架区分了入学年龄的四个经验上相互交织的组成部分：起始年龄、结果测量时的年龄、相对年龄及在校时间。在此框架内，我们重点阐述了入学年龄发挥作用的六个关键渠道。尽管入学年龄的影响通常显著且持久，但许多研究估计的是捆绑效应，而未分离具体组成部分或直接测量潜在机制。我们解释了不同研究设计如何捕捉这些组成部分的不同组合，并强调了制度异质性与行为反应如何使结果解读复杂化。最后，我们概述了未来研究与政策设计的方向。
10.1257/jel.20261809.title: The Economics of Age at School Entry: Insights from Evidence and Methods
10.1257/jel.20261809.title_zh: 入学年龄的经济学：来自证据与方法的洞见

10.1257/jel.20261827.abstract: John Cassidy's Capitalism and Its Critics surveys 250 years of capitalism's history through the eyes of roughly thirty critics, from the Luddites, early utopians and Marx to modern communitarians, antigrowth proponents, free trade opponents, and scholars of inequality. The result is a vivid, sympathetic reconstruction of left-of-center dissent. We argue, however, that the book reproduces two analytical weaknesses shared by the critics it profiles. First, it commits Harold Demsetz's Nirvana Fallacy, evaluating imperfect real-world markets against idealized regulatory alternatives rather than against equally imperfect real-world governments. Second, it underestimates capitalism's most distinctive self-correcting mechanisms: endogenous technological change and entrepreneurial creative destruction, all coordinated by the price system. The result is a catalogue of capitalism's failures unaccompanied by any comparable accounting of the alternatives.
10.1257/jel.20261827.abstract_zh: 约翰·卡西迪的《资本主义及其批评者》通过约三十位批评者的视角——从卢德分子、早期乌托邦主义者、马克思，到现代社群主义者、反增长倡导者、自由贸易反对者及不平等问题学者——审视了资本主义250年的历史。其结果是对中左翼异议的生动而富有同情心的重构。然而，我们认为该书重现了其所述批评者共有的两个分析缺陷。其一，它陷入了哈罗德·德姆塞茨的"涅槃谬误"，将不完美的现实市场与理想化的监管替代方案进行比较，而非与同样不完美的现实政府进行对比。其二，它低估了资本主义最独特的自我修正机制：由价格体系协调的内生技术变革与企业家创造性破坏。最终呈现的是一份资本主义失败的清单，却未对替代方案进行任何同等程度的评估。

10.1257/jep.20251468.abstract: The dollar shortage debate—Paul Samuelson called it “the big open question of our time”—dominated international macroeconomics in the 15 years following the end of World War II. There were two main views regarding its cause: financial frictions that limited capital flows to Western Europe (Kindleberger); and overvalued fixed exchange rates versus the US dollar (Friedman). According to Kindleberger the dollar shortage was attenuated by two real factors that contributed to current account deficits: a large technological gap between the United States and Europe; and European impatience to improve living standards. Kindleberger believed that the current account deficit would prove chronic because of the persistence of the productivity gap, a view that was challenged by Bloomfield who argued that it would dissipate through income growth in Europe. We argue that Kindelberger’s analytical framework is closely connected to the modern intertemporal approach to current account determination; and, also, that the international reserve function of the US dollar—the Triffin dilemma—did not play a role in the dollar shortage.
10.1257/jep.20251468.abstract_zh: 美元短缺的争论——保罗·萨缪尔森称之为“我们时代悬而未决的重大问题”——在二战结束后的15年间主导了国际宏观经济学领域。关于其成因存在两种主要观点：一是限制资本流向西欧的金融摩擦（金德尔伯格）；二是相对于美元被高估的固定汇率（弗里德曼）。金德尔伯格认为，美元短缺因两个导致经常账户赤字的实际因素而减弱：美国与欧洲之间巨大的技术差距；以及欧洲改善生活水平的迫切需求。金德尔伯格认为，由于生产率差距的持续性，经常账户赤字将被证明是长期性的，这一观点遭到布卢姆菲尔德的质疑，后者认为该赤字将随着欧洲收入增长而消散。我们论证：金德尔伯格的分析框架与现代跨期经常账户决定理论密切相关；同时，美元的国际储备功能——特里芬难题——在美元短缺中并未发挥作用。
10.1257/jep.20251468.title: Retrospectives: The Great Dollar-Shortage Debate

10.1257/mac.20210220.abstract: <jats:p>Using a new survey, we document high dispersion of marginal revenue products across firms in the European Union. To interpret this dispersion, we develop a highly portable framework to quantify gains from better allocation of resources. We demonstrate that apart from direct measures of distortions, firm characteristics, such as demographics, quality of inputs, utilization of resources, and dynamic adjustment of inputs, are predictors of the marginal revenue products of capital and labor. We emphasize that some firm characteristics may reflect compensating differentials rather than constraints and the effect of constraints on the dispersion of marginal products may be smaller. (JEL D22, D24, D25, E23, G31, L25)</jats:p>

10.1257/mac.20210258.abstract: Do changes in aggregate volatility alter the impulse response of output to monetary policy? I use plausibly exogenous oil price volatility shocks and exploit heterogene- ity in oil usage across industries to show that PPI item level price changes become less frequent and more disperse when volatility is high. This implies aggregate price flexibility does not increase when aggregate volatility is high. I construct a state- dependent pricing model with random menu costs to interpret the findings. Match- ing the new empirical facts, the model shows that increases in aggregate volatility do not substantially reduce monetary policy effectiveness.
10.1257/mac.20210258.abstract_zh: 总体波动性的变化是否会改变产出对货币政策的脉冲响应？本文利用外生性较强的石油价格波动冲击，并借助各行业石油使用量的异质性，发现当波动性较高时，生产者价格指数（PPI）分项价格变动频率降低且离散程度增大。这意味着总体波动性较高时，总体价格灵活性并未提升。为解释这一发现，本文构建了一个包含随机菜单成本的状态依存定价模型。在匹配新经验事实的基础上，该模型表明，总体波动性的上升并不会显著削弱货币政策的有效性。
10.1257/mac.20210258.title: Price Setting and Volatility: Evidence from Oil Price Volatility Shocks
10.1257/mac.20210258.title_zh: 价格设定与波动性：来自油价波动冲击的证据

10.1257/mac.20220139.abstract: Capital resale frictions, by increasing liquidity risk and decreasing collateral values, can depress investment and amplify capital misallocation in the entrepreneur sector. I provide qualitative evidence using investment data from startups, and quantify these channels using a calibrated entrepreneurial choice model with production risk, financial frictions, and capital resale frictions. I decompose the effects coming from production risk, financial frictions, and resale frictions. I find that resale frictions increase average excess returns by 2.13 pp, and reduce aggregate productivity by 12.7%. The impact of resale frictions are substantially larger than financial frictions or production risk.
10.1257/mac.20220139.abstract_zh: 资本转售摩擦通过增加流动性风险和降低抵押品价值，可能抑制企业家部门的投资并加剧资本错配。本文利用初创企业的投资数据提供了定性证据，并通过一个包含生产风险、金融摩擦和资本转售摩擦的校准化企业家选择模型对这些渠道进行了量化分析。我将生产风险、金融摩擦和转售摩擦的影响进行了分解。研究发现，转售摩擦使平均超额回报率提高2.13个百分点，并使全要素生产率降低12.7%。转售摩擦的影响显著大于金融摩擦或生产风险。
10.1257/mac.20220139.title: Entrepreneurial Investment Dynamics and the Wealth Distribution
10.1257/mac.20220139.title_zh: 创业投资动态与财富分配

10.1257/mac.20220264.abstract: <jats:p>This paper studies the dispersion and cyclicality of TFPR. Recent business cycle models assume countercyclical dispersion in TFPQ based on evidence of countercyclical dispersion in TFPR, though TFPR reflects endogenous prices. An overlapping generations model with monopolistic competition and state-dependent pricing is constructed to match three key data patterns: (i) countercyclical dispersion of TFPR, (ii) countercyclical dispersion of price changes, and (iii) countercyclical frequency of price adjustment. These patterns are matched either if shocks to the dispersion of TFPQ are negatively correlated with the mean of TFPQ, or if the monetary authority responds to them by “leaning against the wind.” (JEL D24, E23, E24, E32, E51, E52)</jats:p>
10.1257/mac.20220264.abstract_zh: 本文研究了TFPR的离散性与周期性。近期商业周期模型基于TFPR呈现反周期离散的证据，假设TFPQ存在反周期离散，尽管TFPR反映的是内生价格。本文构建了一个包含垄断竞争和状态依赖定价的代际交叠模型，以匹配三个关键数据特征：（i）TFPR的反周期离散性，（ii）价格变动的反周期离散性，以及（iii）价格调整频率的反周期特征。这些特征得以匹配的条件是：要么TFPQ离散性的冲击与TFPQ均值呈负相关，要么货币当局通过“逆风干预”对此类冲击做出响应。（JEL D24, E23, E24, E32, E51, E52）
10.1257/mac.20220264.title: TFPR: Dispersion and Cyclicality

10.1257/mac.20220304.abstract: We study why government spending and tax policy are procyclical in emerging and developing economies. We develop a model of optimal fiscal policy over the business cycle with financial frictions, captured by asset market incompleteness and debt-elastic interest rate spreads. In a simple static setting, incomplete markets can generate procyclical government spending, but not necessarily procyclical tax policy. Procyclical taxation also requires the ratio of private to public consumption to rise in booms, amplifying tax-base fluctuations. We show that this mechanism carries over to a DSGE model calibrated to emerging markets, implies sizable welfare costs, and is robust to distortionary labor income taxation, downward wage rigidities, and fiscal transfer shocks.
10.1257/mac.20220304.abstract_zh: 本文研究为何新兴经济体和发展中经济体的政府支出与税收政策呈现顺周期性。我们构建了一个包含金融摩擦（以资产市场不完全性和债务弹性利率利差为特征）的经济周期最优财政政策模型。在简单静态设定下，不完全市场可产生顺周期的政府支出，但未必导致顺周期的税收政策。顺周期税收还需满足私人消费与公共消费之比在经济繁荣期上升的条件，这会放大税基波动。我们证明该机制可延伸至校准至新兴市场的DSGE模型，并产生显著的福利成本，且对扭曲性劳动收入税、工资下行刚性及财政转移支付冲击具有稳健性。
10.1257/mac.20220304.title: Procyclical Fiscal Policy and Asset Market Incompleteness
10.1257/mac.20220304.title_zh: 顺周期财政政策与资产市场不完全性

10.1257/mac.20220312.abstract: <jats:p>We propose a text-based measure of monetary policy stance that models FOMC statements as convex combinations of dovish and hawkish alternatives, providing a tractable representation of the Committee's position along the policy spectrum. Leveraging staff-drafted alternative statements, we fine-tune a pretrained language model to capture both quantitative precision and semantic tone. Stance is defined as the product of tone and novelty, and decomposed into expected and surprise components using high-frequency financial data. Surprises arise from shifts in tone relative to expectations or from statement novelty. Our framework enables counterfactuals showing how alternative communication could have moved markets. (JEL D83, D84, E31, E32, E43, E52, E58)</jats:p>
10.1257/mac.20220312.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种基于文本的货币政策立场衡量方法，将联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）的声明建模为鸽派与鹰派选项的凸组合，从而为委员会在政策谱系中的位置提供易于处理的表征。利用工作人员起草的备选声明，我们对预训练语言模型进行微调，以捕捉定量精度与语义基调。立场被定义为基调与新颖性的乘积，并利用高频金融数据分解为预期成分与意外成分。意外成分源于相对于预期的基调变化或声明的新颖性。我们的框架能够实现反事实分析，展示替代性沟通方式如何影响市场。（JEL D83, D84, E31, E32, E43, E52, E58）
10.1257/mac.20220312.title: Deciphering Federal Reserve Communication via Text Analysis of Alternative FOMC Statements
10.1257/mac.20220312.title_zh: 通过替代性FOMC声明的文本分析解读美联储沟通

10.1257/mac.20220316.abstract: <jats:p>Technological lock-in has been a standard explanation for the slow take-off of clean innovation, but is hard to reconcile with forward-looking investors who anticipate the eventual switch to clean technologies. We provide an alternative explanation: strategic investment complementarities shape innovation and self-fulfilling prophecies can lead to delayed low-carbon transition. We analyze a standard directed technical change model with clean and dirty inputs. Under good input substitutability, two stable steady states co-exist, each allowing multiple transitional paths. Optimal low-carbon transition requires a Pigouvian tax rule combined with a coordination device; commitment to a Pigouvian tax trajectory cannot solve a coordination failure. (JEL H23, O31, O33, O44, Q54, Q55)</jats:p>
10.1257/mac.20220316.abstract_zh: 技术锁定一直是解释清洁创新起步缓慢的标准理论，但这一理论难以与预期最终将转向清洁技术的前瞻性投资者相协调。我们提出另一种解释：战略性投资互补性塑造了创新过程，而自我实现的预言可能导致低碳转型延迟。我们分析了包含清洁与污染投入的标准定向技术变革模型。在投入品良好替代性的条件下，存在两个稳定的稳态共存状态，每个稳态均允许多种转型路径。最优低碳转型需要将庇古税规则与协调机制相结合；而承诺实施庇古税轨迹无法解决协调失灵问题。(JEL H23, O31, O33, O44, Q54, Q55)
10.1257/mac.20220316.title: Self-Fulfilling Prophecies in the Transition to Clean Technology
10.1257/mac.20220316.title_zh: 清洁技术转型中的自我实现预言

10.1257/mac.20220388.abstract: We investigate the impact of institutional quality on shielding emerging economies from the Global Financial Cycle. Our findings indicate that countries with a higher rule of law, characterized by superior contract enforcement and more robust protection of property rights, experience a less severe tightening of domestic financial and macroeconomic conditions when faced with adverse global financial shocks. We explain this outcome through a simplified model that incorporates financial frictions, showing how strong institutions and effective governance alleviate collateral constraints and mitigate the effects of global financial pressures on the domestic economy.
10.1257/mac.20220388.abstract_zh: 我们研究了制度质量在保护新兴经济体免受全球金融周期影响中的作用。研究结果表明，法治水平较高、合同执行更优且产权保护更完善的国家，在面对不利的全球金融冲击时，其国内金融和宏观经济状况的紧缩程度较轻。我们通过一个包含金融摩擦的简化模型解释了这一结果，展示了强有力的制度和有效治理如何缓解抵押品约束，并减轻全球金融压力对国内经济的影响。
10.1257/mac.20220388.title: Leaning Against the Global Financial Cycle

10.1257/mac.20230017.abstract: Do changes in the location of trading opportunities cause changes in the location of economic activity? I explore this question using a lifting of restrictions on trade across the Spanish Empire in the 18th century. I combine a difference-in-differences approach with a dynamic spatial model to examine this issue. I find that the reform improved market integration and induced urban growth, but had a smaller effect in locations with larger internal markets. The findings suggest that the location of economic activity adapts to changes in the location of trading opportunities, but persists when these changes are preceded by urban growth.
10.1257/mac.20230017.abstract_zh: 贸易机会地点的变化是否会导致经济活动地点的变化？我利用18世纪西班牙帝国贸易限制的解除来探究这一问题。我将双重差分法与动态空间模型相结合进行分析。研究发现，改革改善了市场一体化并促进了城市增长，但在内部市场规模较大的地区影响较小。结果表明，经济活动地点会适应贸易机会地点的变化，但当这些变化发生在城市增长之后时，则表现出持续性。
10.1257/mac.20230017.title: Long-Distance Trade and Long-Term Persistence
10.1257/mac.20230017.title_zh: 长途贸易与长期持续性

10.1257/mac.20230031.abstract: We examine the general-equilibrium effect of the China shock on US regions. We demonstrate that spatial linkages intensify the shock’s negative impact on employment across regions, leading to differential effects that are substantially larger than predictions from existing quantitative models. To address this disconnect, we develop a reduced-form representation of the impact of trade shocks in spatial models. Regional responses combine the direct effect of local shock exposure and its indirect spatial effects. Our approach extends shift-share empirical strategies and indicates that employment losses were amplified by strong agglomeration forces, large employment sensitivity to wages, and spatial and production linkages.
10.1257/mac.20230031.abstract_zh: 我们考察了中国冲击对美国各区域的一般均衡效应。研究表明，空间关联加剧了该冲击对各区域就业的负面影响，导致差异化效应显著大于现有量化模型的预测结果。为解释这一偏差，我们构建了空间模型中贸易冲击影响的简化形式表征。区域响应融合了本地冲击暴露的直接效应及其间接空间效应。本方法拓展了偏移份额实证策略，并揭示出就业损失因强集聚效应、就业对工资的高敏感性以及空间与生产关联而被放大。
10.1257/mac.20230031.title: General Equilibrium Effects in Space: Theory and Measurement
10.1257/mac.20230031.title_zh: 空间中的一般均衡效应：理论与测度

10.1257/mac.20230033.abstract: We study how firm heterogeneity and market power affect macroeconomic fragility, defined as the probability of long slumps. We propose a theory where the positive interaction between firm entry, competition, and factor supply can give rise to multiple steady-states. We show that when firms are highly heterogeneous in terms of productivities, even small temporary shocks can trigger firm exit and make the economy spiral into a competition-driven poverty trap. We calibrate our model to incorporate the well-documented trends on rising firm heterogeneity in the US economy, and show that they significantly increase the likelihood and length of slow recoveries.
10.1257/mac.20230033.abstract_zh: 本文研究企业异质性与市场势力如何影响宏观经济脆弱性，即长期衰退的概率。我们提出一个理论，其中企业进入、竞争与要素供给之间的正向互动可能导致多重稳态。研究表明，当企业在生产率方面高度异质时，即使是微小的暂时性冲击也可能引发企业退出，并使经济陷入竞争驱动的贫困陷阱。我们通过校准模型纳入美国经济中企业异质性上升的已有趋势，并证明这些趋势显著增加了缓慢复苏的可能性与持续时间。
10.1257/mac.20230033.title: Firm Heterogeneity, Market Power and Macroeconomic Fragility
10.1257/mac.20230033.title_zh: 企业异质性、市场势力与宏观经济脆弱性

10.1257/mac.20230055.abstract: Trade credit is a key source of short-term finance. This paper develops a model where trade credit reduces borrowing from banks. This reduction gives rise to a financing cost advantage of trade credit that increases in the product of markups and borrowing costs. Chilean export data confirm this prediction. A one-standard-deviation rise in upstream markups increases trade credit by 9 days. The intensive margin is responsible for about 60 percent of this effect, which strengthens with destination-country borrowing costs. We estimate that trade credit allows U.S. firms to reduce formal borrowing by $1.4 trillion, generating annual savings of $39 billion.
10.1257/mac.20230055.abstract_zh: 贸易信贷是短期融资的关键来源。本文构建了一个模型，其中贸易信贷减少了企业从银行的借款。这种减少使得贸易信贷产生融资成本优势，该优势随加成率与借款成本的乘积递增。智利出口数据证实了这一预测：上游加成率每上升一个标准差，贸易信贷期限将增加9天。集约边际对此效应的贡献约为60%，且该效应随目的地国借款成本的上升而增强。我们估算，贸易信贷使美国企业减少1.4万亿美元的正规借款，每年节省390亿美元。
10.1257/mac.20230055.title: Diversion Risk, Markups, and the Financing Cost Advantage of Trade Credit
10.1257/mac.20230055.title_zh: 转移风险、加成率与贸易信贷的融资成本优势

10.1257/mac.20230083.abstract: <jats:p>This paper studies the sectoral and macroeconomic consequences of carbon taxes in four Nordic countries using a novel monthly measure of effective carbon tax rates. The suggested measure accounts for the time-varying emission coverage of taxes that are both explicitly and implicitly levied on greenhouse gas-emitting goods, thereby solving several issues of existing carbon tax measures currently used by the literature. Employing the new measure in a local projection setting, I find that carbon taxes reduce emissions as expected but also impair macroeconomic activity—though there is some heterogeneity in the effects across sectors and countries. (JEL H23, O44, Q54, Q58)</jats:p>
10.1257/mac.20230083.abstract_zh: 本文利用一种新颖的月度有效碳税率指标，研究了碳税在四个北欧国家的部门及宏观经济影响。该指标考虑了针对温室气体排放商品征收的显性和隐性税收的时变排放覆盖率，从而解决了现有文献中碳税指标存在的若干问题。在局部投影框架下应用这一新指标，我发现碳税如预期般减少了排放，但也削弱了宏观经济活动——尽管不同部门和国家的效应存在一定异质性。（JEL H23, O44, Q54, Q58）
10.1257/mac.20230083.title: The Economic Consequences of Effective Carbon Taxes

10.1257/mac.20230213.abstract: <jats:p>In trade models with scale economies, import liberalization reduces exports within industries by shrinking real market potential. We find this export destruction mechanism reduced US export growth following the permanent normalization of trade relations with China (PNTR). There was also an offsetting boost to exports from lower input costs. We use our estimates to calibrate a quantitative model and show that scale economies are economically important for trade policy analysis. Although PNTR increased aggregate US exports relative to GDP, exports declined in the most exposed industries. US gains from PNTR are positive but 30 percent smaller than under constant returns. (JEL D24, E23, F13, F14, O19, P33)</jats:p>
10.1257/mac.20230213.abstract_zh: 在具有规模经济的贸易模型中，进口自由化通过缩小实际市场潜力减少了行业内的出口。我们发现，这种出口破坏机制在美国与中国永久正常贸易关系（PNTR）实施后抑制了其出口增长。同时，较低的投入成本对出口产生了抵消性提振。我们利用估计结果校准了一个量化模型，并表明规模经济对贸易政策分析具有重要的经济意义。尽管PNTR增加了美国相对于GDP的总出口，但在受影响最大的行业中，出口出现下降。美国从PNTR中获得的收益为正，但比规模报酬不变情况下低30%。（JEL D24, E23, F13, F14, O19, P33）
10.1257/mac.20230213.title: Import Liberalization as Export Destruction? Evidence from the United States
10.1257/mac.20230213.title_zh: 进口自由化是出口破坏吗？来自美国的证据

10.1257/mac.20230241.abstract: <jats:p>Labor productivity growth in the service sector may be mismeasured if workers with heterogeneous skills self-select into sectors. I document with US data that workers reallocated from manufacturing earn more than incumbent workers in professional services but less than incumbent workers in education, health, and public services. A generalized quantitative Roy model predicts a selection effect on labor productivity growth in professional services that is 10 percentage points higher than what a conventional selection model predicts. Overall, the selection effect contributes little to the cost disease of services, which contrasts sharply with the hypothesis in the literature. (JEL E24, J24, J31, J44, J45, L60, L80)</jats:p>
10.1257/mac.20230241.abstract_zh: 若技能异质性的工人自我选择进入不同行业，服务业劳动生产率增长可能被误测。基于美国数据，我发现从制造业重新配置的工人在专业服务业的收入高于该行业原有工人，但在教育、卫生和公共服务业的收入低于原有工人。一个广义定量Roy模型预测，专业服务业中由选择效应导致的劳动生产率增长比传统选择模型高出10个百分点。总体而言，选择效应对服务业成本病的贡献甚微，这与文献中的假设形成鲜明对比。（JEL E24, J24, J31, J44, J45, L60, L80）
10.1257/mac.20230241.title: Selection, Structural Transformation, and the Cost Disease of Services
10.1257/mac.20230241.title_zh: 选择、结构转型与服务业成本病

10.1257/mac.20230278.abstract: We present a model in which efficient long-term employment relationships are sustained by wage adjustments prompted by productivity shocks and outside job offers. These wage adjustments occur only sporadically, due to the presence of renegotiation costs. The model is amenable to analytical solution, yielding new insights for several labor market phenomena, including: (1) key features of empirical distributions of changes in pay among job stayers; (2) a near-“memorylessness” property in wage dynamics whereby hiring wages have only limited influence on later wages and allocation decisions; and (3) a crucial role for recruitment and retention bonuses in sustaining efficient employment relationships.
10.1257/mac.20230278.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个模型，其中高效的长期雇佣关系通过生产率冲击和外部工作机会引发的工资调整得以维持。由于存在重新谈判成本，这些工资调整仅偶尔发生。该模型可进行解析求解，为若干劳动力市场现象提供了新见解，包括：（1）在职者薪酬变动的经验分布的关键特征；（2）工资动态中近乎“无记忆性”的特性，即入职工资对后续工资及配置决策的影响有限；（3）招聘奖金和留任奖金在维持高效雇佣关系中的关键作用。
10.1257/mac.20230278.title: Wage Adjustment in Efficient Long-Term Employment Relationships
10.1257/mac.20230278.title_zh: 高效长期雇佣关系中的工资调整

10.1257/mac.20230299.abstract: <jats:p>This paper examines the behavior of individuals susceptible to a deadly disease in a tractable equilibrium setting. We analytically characterize individually optimal mitigation behavior and the resulting equilibrium trajectory. Analysis is facilitated by a phase diagram. A key insight is that individually optimal behavior of those susceptible to the disease results in excessive caution. This behavior flattens the epidemic curve and prolongs the epidemic. In contrast, socially optimal behavior results in a higher infection rate, with a focus on minimizing cumulative deaths at minimum cost. The paper offers novel technical contributions and an improved understanding of externalities in econ-epi models. (JEL D62, D91, I12, I18)</jats:p>
10.1257/mac.20230299.abstract_zh: 本文在一个可处理的均衡框架下，研究了易感致命疾病的个体行为。我们通过解析方法刻画了个体最优的缓解行为及其导致的均衡轨迹，并借助相图进行分析。核心发现是：易感个体的最优行为会导致过度谨慎，这种平缓了流行病曲线，却延长了疫情持续时间。相比之下，社会最优行为则追求以最小成本最小化累计死亡人数，从而产生更高的感染率。本文在技术层面做出创新贡献，并深化了对经济-流行病模型中外部性的理解。（JEL D62, D91, I12, I18）
10.1257/mac.20230299.title: An Analytical Model of Behavior and Policy in an Epidemic
10.1257/mac.20230299.title_zh: 流行病中行为与政策的分析模型

10.1257/mac.20230301.abstract: Using a unique matched bank-employer-employee administrative dataset for Italy, we construct an exogenous firm-level measure of exposure to the credit shock during the Global Financial Crisis, based on pre-crisis firm-bank relationships. We track outcomes for firms and workers up to 11 years after the shock. More exposed firms experience persistently lower growth in bank credit, which in turn leads to weaker investment and employment dynamics due to capital-labor complementarity. More capital-intensive firms and their workers suffer the most. Displaced workers reallocate primarily to less capital-intensive firms, incurring persistent losses in labor earnings.
10.1257/mac.20230301.abstract_zh: 利用意大利独特的银行-雇主-雇员匹配行政数据集，我们基于危机前的企业-银行关系，构建了全球金融危机期间企业层面信贷冲击暴露度的外生衡量指标。我们追踪了冲击发生后长达11年的企业与工人结果。信贷暴露度更高的企业持续面临更低的银行信贷增长，进而因资本-劳动互补性导致投资与就业动态疲弱。资本密集度更高的企业及其工人遭受的损失最为严重。被解雇的工人主要重新配置到资本密集度较低的企业，并承受持久的劳动收入损失。
10.1257/mac.20230301.title: The Long-Term Earnings' Effects of a Credit Market Disruption
10.1257/mac.20230301.title_zh: 信贷市场中断对长期收入的影响

10.1257/mac.20230323.abstract: Cross-country disparities in collateral technologies alone can account for large capital flows among mature economies, and allow the most advanced country to run a permanent trade deficit. When the collateral technology advantage is in creating negative beta (super safe) financial assets backed by positive beta assets, a Global Collateral Cycle emerges, with pro-cyclical gross and net flows and increased global asset price volatility. The supply of super safe assets is necessarily curtailed in downturns, providing a complementary (supply) channel to the flight to safety (demand) channel for explaining why US safe asset prices rise during crises.
10.1257/mac.20230323.abstract_zh: 仅凭抵押品技术的跨国差异，就能解释成熟经济体之间大规模资本流动的原因，并使最先进的国家能够维持永久性贸易逆差。当抵押品技术优势体现在以正贝塔资产为支撑、创造负贝塔（超级安全）金融资产时，全球抵押品周期便会形成，伴随顺周期的总流量与净流量，以及全球资产价格波动性的加剧。在经济下行期，超级安全资产的供给必然收缩，这为解释为何美国安全资产价格在危机期间上涨提供了与"避险"（需求）渠道互补的（供给）渠道。
10.1257/mac.20230323.title: Capital Flows and the Global Collateral Cycle
10.1257/mac.20230323.title_zh: 资本流动与全球抵押品周期

10.1257/mac.20230356.abstract: <jats:p>Using county-level and zip-code-level data from the United States during the period 1998–2018, we document: (i) Increased flood risk has a large negative impact on firm entry, employment, and output in the long run; (ii) Flood events reduce output in the short run while impact on firm entry and employment is limited. We then develop a quantitative spatial model to characterize how flood risk shapes firms’ location choices and employment. We find flood risk reduced US aggregate output by 0.53 percent in 2018, 23 percent of which stemmed from direct damages and 77 percent from long-run adjustments of firms and workers. (JEL D22, E23, E24, L11, Q54, R23, R32)</jats:p>
10.1257/mac.20230356.abstract_zh: 利用1998–2018年美国县级和邮政编码级数据，我们证实：（i）长期来看，洪水风险增加对企业进入、就业和产出具有显著的负面影响；（ii）短期来看，洪水事件会降低产出，但对企业进入和就业的影响有限。随后，我们构建了一个量化空间模型，以刻画洪水风险如何塑造企业的区位选择和就业。研究发现，2018年洪水风险使美国总产出下降0.53%，其中23%源于直接损失，77%源于企业与工人的长期调整。（JEL D22, E23, E24, L11, Q54, R23, R32）
10.1257/mac.20230356.title: Expecting Floods: Firm Entry, Employment, and Aggregate Implications
10.1257/mac.20230356.title_zh: 预期洪水：企业进入、就业与总体影响

10.1257/mac.20230357.abstract: <jats:p>This paper examines the effects of primary budget surpluses, surprise inflation, and pegged interest rates before the Fed-Treasury Accord of 1951 on the US public debt/GDP ratio. We find that with the primary budget balance and without distortions in real interest rates caused by surprise inflation and the pre-Accord peg, debt/GDP would have declined only from 106 percent in 1946 to 74 percent in 1974, not to 23 percent as in actual history. Our findings imply that, over the last 76 years, only a small amount of debt reduction has been achieved through growth rates that exceed undistorted interest rates. (JEL E23, E31, E43, E65, H61, H63, N12)</jats:p>
10.1257/mac.20230357.abstract_zh: 本文研究了1951年《美联储-财政部协议》之前，基本预算盈余、意外通胀及钉住利率对美国公共债务/GDP比率的影响。我们发现，若保持基本预算平衡，且不存在由意外通胀及协议前钉住利率导致的实际利率扭曲，债务/GDP比率仅会从1946年的106%降至1974年的74%，而非实际历史中的23%。我们的研究结果表明，在过去76年间，仅有少量债务削减是通过增长率超过未扭曲利率实现的。(JEL E23, E31, E43, E65, H61, H63, N12)
10.1257/mac.20230357.title: Did the United States Really Grow Out of Its World War II Debt?
10.1257/mac.20230357.title_zh: 美国真的通过经济增长摆脱了二战债务吗？

10.1257/mac.20230376.abstract: <jats:p>Employment protections often create two-tiered labor markets with substantial differences in job security. I estimate the effects of removing these protections using a quantitative life cycle model, where younger workers are more likely to select into precarious jobs. Workers accumulate human capital when employed and face the possibility of human capital losses in unemployment. Because workers with greater job security experience fewer unemployment spells, they tend to accumulate more human capital over their careers. I show that reducing employment protections boosts younger workers’ job-finding rates but lowers human capital, GDP, and employment. Impacts of these policies differ significantly by age. (JEL D15, E23, E24, J22, J24, J41, J42)</jats:p>
10.1257/mac.20230376.abstract_zh: 就业保护往往导致劳动力市场出现两级分化，不同岗位的就业保障程度差异显著。本文通过构建量化生命周期模型，评估了取消这些保护措施的经济效应。在该模型中，年轻劳动者更倾向于选择不稳定的工作岗位。劳动者在职期间积累人力资本，而失业则面临人力资本贬损的风险。由于就业保障程度较高的劳动者经历失业的次数更少，其职业生涯中积累的人力资本往往更多。研究表明：降低就业保护虽能提升年轻劳动者的求职成功率，但会降低人力资本存量、国内生产总值及就业水平。这些政策对不同年龄段劳动者的影响存在显著差异。(JEL D15, E23, E24, J22, J24, J41, J42)
10.1257/mac.20230376.title: The Life Cycle Implications of Temporary Employment Contracts
10.1257/mac.20230376.title_zh: 临时雇佣合同的生命周期影响

10.1257/mac.20240013.abstract: The U.S. health-services sector has grown both in terms of its expenditure share and relative price. Using a two-sector general equilibrium model with monopolistic competition and endogenous population, we find that relative price growth is almost entirely attributable to increasing relative sectoral markups. Demand effects from aging play only a minor role driving up prices and expenditure shares. Controlling for GE effects and rising relative markups, we estimate that health-sector TFP has grown since the 1980s at a rate greater than 1% annually, dampening relative price growth, while leading to higher health-sector output, partially driving up aggregate expenditure shares.
10.1257/mac.20240013.abstract_zh: 美国健康服务部门的支出份额和相对价格均有所增长。通过构建一个包含垄断竞争和内生人口的两部门一般均衡模型，我们发现相对价格增长几乎完全归因于部门间相对加成率的上升。老龄化带来的需求效应对价格上涨和支出份额增加的推动作用微乎其微。在控制一般均衡效应和相对加成率上升的条件下，我们估算自20世纪80年代以来，健康部门的全要素生产率年均增长率超过1%，这抑制了相对价格增长，同时促进了健康部门产出提升，并部分推高了总支出份额。
10.1257/mac.20240013.title: Health Sector Structural Change
10.1257/mac.20240013.title_zh: 卫生部门的结构性变革

10.1257/mac.20240018.abstract: We incorporate banks into a DSGE framework to study how interest rate hikes affect the macroeconomy. The procyclical bank balance sheets and long-term bond prices amplify adverse shocks, which can trigger a bank run. We introduce a macroprudential policy that can mitigate or prevent banking crises: an ex-ante permanent tax on bank holdings of long-term government bonds and reducing the tax rate in response to interest rate hikes. By contrast, subsidizing bank holdings of long-term investment bonds improves welfare when capital producers face loan-in-advance constraints.
10.1257/mac.20240018.abstract_zh: 我们将银行纳入DSGE框架，研究加息如何影响宏观经济。顺周期的银行资产负债表和长期债券价格会放大负面冲击，从而可能引发银行挤兑。我们引入一项宏观审慎政策，该政策能够缓解或预防银行业危机：对银行持有的长期政府债券征收事前永久性税收，并在加息时降低税率。相比之下，当资本生产者面临贷款预付约束时，补贴银行持有的长期投资债券能够提升社会福利。
10.1257/mac.20240018.title: Long-Term Securities and Banking Crises

10.1257/mac.20240025.abstract: How worker productivity evolves with tenure and experience shapes life-cycle earnings and losses from job separation. Yet, worker-level productivity is hard to identify from observational data. This paper introduces a firm survey designed to separate effects of on-the-job tenure from sector-specific experience on the trajectory of on-the-job productivity. Several findings emerge. (i) On-the-job productivity growth initially exceeds wage growth, consistent with wages not being allocative period-by-period. (ii) Previous sector-specific experience reduces on-the-job tenure needed, though not by one-to-one, to reach a maximal productivity. (iii) There is substantial heterogeneity across jobs in the extent that previous sector-specific experience reduces tenure needed.
10.1257/mac.20240025.abstract_zh: 工人生产率随任期与经验的演变，决定了生命周期内的收入水平及失业造成的损失。然而，从观测数据中识别工人层面的生产率存在困难。本文引入一项企业调查，旨在分离在职任期与行业特定经验对在职生产率轨迹的影响。研究得出以下发现：（i）在职生产率的初始增长超过工资增长，这与工资并非逐期配置性调整的结论一致；（ii）先前的行业特定经验可缩短达到最大生产率所需的在职任期，但并非完全替代关系；（iii）不同岗位中，先前行业特定经验对缩短所需任期的影响存在显著异质性。
10.1257/mac.20240025.title: How Worker Productivity and Wages Grow with Tenure and Experience: The Firm Perspective
10.1257/mac.20240025.title_zh: 任期与经验如何促进工人生产率与工资增长：企业视角

10.1257/mac.20240030.abstract: This paper studies entrepreneurship and firm creation through the lens of serial entrepreneurs – entrepreneurs who establish more than one firm. Using data covering the universe of Chinese firms, we document key facts about serial and non-serial entrepreneurs and develop a theory rationalizing how their behavior is shaped by ability, endowments, and capital market frictions. Serial entrepreneurs have higher average productivity and lower return on capital than non-serial entrepreneurs. However, this premium conceals significant heterogeneity, with a majority of serial entrepreneurs underperforming relative to non-serial entrepreneurs. We link these differences to capital market frictions favoring some, but not all, entrepreneurs.
10.1257/mac.20240030.abstract_zh: 本文通过连续创业者——即创立多家企业的创业者——的视角研究创业与企业创建。利用覆盖中国全部企业的数据，我们记录了连续创业者与非连续创业者的关键特征，并构建理论阐释能力、禀赋及资本市场摩擦如何塑造其行为。连续创业者的平均生产率高于非连续创业者，但资本回报率却更低。然而，这一优势掩盖了显著的异质性：多数连续创业者的表现不及非连续创业者。我们将这些差异归因于资本市场摩擦对部分创业者（而非全部）的偏向性影响。
10.1257/mac.20240030.title: Serial Entrepreneurship in China
10.1257/mac.20240030.title_zh: 中国连续创业现象研究

10.1257/mac.20240046.abstract: Imperfect competition within the pollution abatement equipment sector may hinder the Paris Agreement’s goals. We show that carbon tax–funded environmental subsidies can stimulate firm entry, enhance competition, and lower abatement costs for businesses. Using a quantitative macro-climate model with an endogenous market structure for abatement equipment, we estimate that optimally allocating subsidies (60% to startups and 40% to existing companies) could enhance efficiency, generating annual global GDP savings of $2.5 to $3.1 trillion by 2060.
10.1257/mac.20240046.abstract_zh: 污染减排设备行业的不完全竞争可能阻碍《巴黎协定》目标的实现。我们证明，由碳税资助的环境补贴能够刺激企业进入、增强竞争并降低企业的减排成本。通过构建一个包含减排设备内生市场结构的定量宏观气候模型，我们估算出最优补贴分配（60%给予初创企业，40%给予现有企业）能够提升效率，到2060年每年可为全球GDP节省2.5至3.1万亿美元。
10.1257/mac.20240046.title: Environmental Subsidies to Mitigate Net-Zero Transition Costs
10.1257/mac.20240046.title_zh: 环境补贴以缓解净零转型成本

10.1257/mac.20240057.abstract: <jats:p>This paper develops a framework in which university research depends endogenously on competition for tuition and talented students in the market for higher education. When students are highly stratified across colleges, or when tuition rises sharply with school rank, universities spend on R&D even if the direct contribution of research to teaching is small. The model is consistent with causal evidence and matches new features of the microdata. It explains why universities internally fund research with tuition, despite negligible returns to patenting. Calibrated simulations suggest that existing tuition policies boost university research while research subsidies crowd it out. (JEL I22, I23, L24, O31, O34)</jats:p>
10.1257/mac.20240057.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个分析框架，其中大学研究内生地取决于高等教育市场中学费与优秀学生的竞争。当学生高度分层于不同院校，或学费随学校排名急剧上升时，即使研究对教学的直接贡献很小，大学也会投入研发。该模型与因果证据一致，并匹配了微观数据的新特征。它解释了为何大学会利用学费内部资助研究，尽管专利化回报微乎其微。校准模拟表明，现行学费政策促进了大学研究，而研究补贴则对其产生挤出效应。（JEL I22, I23, L24, O31, O34）
10.1257/mac.20240057.title: University Research and the Market for Higher Education
10.1257/mac.20240057.title_zh: 大学研究与高等教育市场

10.1257/mac.20240063.abstract: We use the functional autoregressive framework of Chang, Chen, and Schorfheide (2024) to examine the effects of monetary policy shocks on the cross-sectional distributions of U.S. earnings, consumption, and financial income. An expansionary shock reduces earnings inequality, primarily by moving individuals out of unemployment, increases consumption inequality, mainly through spending on durable goods, and raises financial income inequality. We further show how an internal instrument can be used to identify the central bank’s reaction function within a VAR framework.
10.1257/mac.20240063.abstract_zh: 我们采用Chang、Chen与Schorfheide（2024）的函数自回归框架，考察货币政策冲击对美国收入、消费及金融收入截面分布的影响。扩张性冲击通过推动个体脱离失业状态降低收入不平等，主要通过耐用品消费支出加剧消费不平等，并提升金融收入不平等。我们进一步论证了如何在VAR框架内利用内部工具变量识别中央银行的反应函数。
10.1257/mac.20240063.title: On the Effects of Monetary Policy Shocks on Income and Consumption Heterogeneity
10.1257/mac.20240063.title_zh: 货币政策冲击对收入与消费异质性影响的研究

10.1257/mac.20240087.abstract: We study the cost of cartels in an oligopoly model with het- erogeneous firms, endogenous markups, and collusion. Cartels can amplify or dampen misallocation, by charging supracompetitive markups and reallocating demand towards non-colluding firms. Using French micro data, our calibrated model suggests that cartels operating in the most productive industries may decrease aggregate productivity by up to 0.4% and welfare by up to 0.7%. We also find that standard competitive oligopoly models may understate the cost of markups by about 20%.
10.1257/mac.20240087.abstract_zh: 本文研究异质性企业、内生加成率与合谋行为并存寡头模型中的卡特尔成本。卡特尔通过收取超竞争加成率并将需求重新分配给非合谋企业，可能加剧或缓解资源错配。基于法国微观数据的校准模型表明，在最具生产率的行业中运营的卡特尔可能导致全要素生产率下降0.4%，福利损失高达0.7%。我们还发现，标准竞争性寡头模型可能低估加成率成本约20%。
10.1257/mac.20240087.title: How Costly Are Cartels?

10.1257/mac.20240107.abstract: <jats:p>We explore how foreign central banks behave when firms engage in currency mismatch, borrowing heavily in dollars. A central bank can deal with risky private-sector mismatch in two ways: (i) with financial regulation or (ii) by accumulating reserves to better serve as a dollar lender of last resort. We highlight a novel externality: Individual central banks may overaccumulate dollar reserves, as this exacerbates a global scarcity of dollar-denominated assets, lowering dollar interest rates and encouraging firms to further increase their currency mismatch. Relative to the decentralized outcome, a global planner may prefer tighter financial regulation and reduced holdings of dollar reserves. (JEL E43, E44, E58, F31, F41, G21, G28)</jats:p>
10.1257/mac.20240107.abstract_zh: 本文探讨当企业存在货币错配、大量借入美元时，外国中央银行的行为模式。央行应对私营部门风险性货币错配有两种方式：（i）实施金融监管，或（ii）积累外汇储备以更好地充当美元最后贷款人。我们揭示了一种新颖的外部性：单个央行可能过度积累美元储备，因为这会加剧全球美元计价资产的稀缺性，压低美元利率，并鼓励企业进一步扩大其货币错配。相较于分散决策的结果，全球规划者可能更倾向于实施更严格的金融监管并减少美元储备持有量。（JEL E43, E44, E58, F31, F41, G21, G28）
10.1257/mac.20240107.title: Central Banks as Dollar Lenders of Last Resort: Implications for Regulation and Reserve Holdings
10.1257/mac.20240107.title_zh: 中央银行作为美元最后贷款人：对监管与储备持有的影响

10.1257/mac.20240125.abstract: How do sovereign debt restructurings affect debt-to-GDP ratios? We explore this empirically using a comprehensive dataset covering 115 countries over 1950–2021. After addressing selection bias through an Augmented Inverse Probability Weighted estimator, we show that restructurings significantly reduce debt-to-GDP ratios over 1-5 years, with the effects working primarily through debt levels.
