10.1257/mic.20250251.title: Rational Misspecification: Framework and Applications

10.1257/mic.20250260.abstract: A profit-maximizing monopolist curates a database for users seek- ing to learn a parameter. There are two user types: "Nowcasters" wish to learn the parameter's current value, while "forecasters" target its long-run value. Data storage involves a constant marginal cost. The monopolist designs a menu of contracts described by fees and data-access levels. The profit-maximizing menu o¤ers full access to historical data, while current data is fully provided to nowcasters but may be withheld from forecasters. Compared to the social optimum, the monopolist keeps too much historical data, too little current data, and may store too much data overall.
10.1257/mic.20250260.abstract_zh: 一个追求利润最大化的垄断者为试图学习某个参数的用户构建数据库。用户分为两类："即时预测者"希望了解该参数的当前值，而"长期预测者"则关注其长期值。数据存储涉及恒定的边际成本。垄断者设计了一套由费用和数据访问权限组成的合同菜单。利润最大化的菜单提供对历史数据的完全访问，同时当前数据被完全提供给即时预测者，但可能对长期预测者有所保留。与社会最优相比，垄断者保留了过多的历史数据、过少的当前数据，并且整体上可能存储了过多的数据。
10.1257/mic.20250260.title: Monopolistic Data Dumping

10.1257/mic.20250285.abstract: In many strategic environments with asymmetric information, systematic decision mistakes can arise from two sources: failures in probabilistic reasoning when updating beliefs and incorrect strategic inference about opponents’ private information or choices. Using a sequential belief elicitation design in persuasion games, we experimentally disentangle and quantify these two reasoning errors. We find that probabilistic and strategic reasoning errors are comparable in magnitude, largely orthogonal, and their patterns and overall degree are stable across various settings. These results suggest that an improved behavioral theory should account for both strategic naivete and non-Bayesian updating, without significant concern for their interaction.
10.1257/mic.20250285.abstract_zh: 在许多存在信息不对称的战略环境中，系统性决策失误可能源于两个因素：更新信念时的概率推理失误，以及对对手私人信息或选择的错误战略推断。通过在说服博弈中采用序贯信念诱导设计，我们通过实验分离并量化了这两种推理错误。研究发现，概率推理错误与战略推理错误在量级上相当，且基本相互独立，其模式与总体程度在不同情境下保持稳定。这些结果表明，改进的行为理论应同时考虑战略天真与非贝叶斯更新，而无需过度关注二者的交互作用。
10.1257/mic.20250285.title: Disentangling Probabilistic and Strategic Errors
10.1257/mic.20250285.title_zh: 区分概率性错误与策略性错误

10.1257/mic.20250318.abstract: I study how the ability to erase records affects patient players’ returns from building reputations. In my model, a patient seller interacts with a sequence of myopic consumers. The seller is either an honest type who always exerts effort and never erases any records, or an opportunistic type who may shirk and can also erase his past actions at a low cost. I show that the seller has an incentive to exert effort until he has a long enough good record, after which his continuation value exceeds his commitment payoff. However, once the seller is sufficiently long-lived, his equilibrium payoff must be close to his minmax value.
10.1257/mic.20250318.abstract_zh: 本文研究记录删除能力如何影响耐心玩家通过建立声誉获得的回报。在模型中，一位耐心卖家与一系列短视消费者进行互动。卖家分为两种类型：一种是始终付出努力且从不删除任何记录的诚实型，另一种是可能偷懒且能以低成本删除过往行为的投机型。研究表明，卖家有动力持续付出努力，直至其积累足够长的良好记录，此时其延续价值将超过承诺收益。然而，一旦卖家存续时间足够长，其均衡收益必然趋近于最小最大值。
10.1257/mic.20250318.title: Reputation Effects with Endogenous Records
10.1257/mic.20250318.title_zh: 内生记录下的声誉效应

10.1257/mic.20250372.abstract: We provide an axiomatic foundation for the classical problem of compensating workers when effort is unobserved. The employer holds Bayesian beliefs about workers’ effort, observes output precisely or imprecisely, and seeks fairness. We introduce axioms tailored to this asymmetric-information environment and show that they determine a unique closed-form reward rule, the informational Bayesian value (IBV). The IBV can be interpreted as a contract between an uninformed employer and workers. We then analyze worker disappointment under this rule and show that average disappointment is zero, whether evaluated ex-post, interim, or ex-ante. Consequently, fair compensation prevents worker disappointment in the long run.
10.1257/mic.20250372.abstract_zh: 我们为努力不可观测时工人补偿的经典问题提供了公理化基础。雇主对工人的努力持有贝叶斯信念，能够精确或非精确地观测产出，并追求公平性。我们针对这一信息不对称环境引入了特定公理，并证明这些公理唯一确定了一个闭式奖励规则——信息贝叶斯价值（IBV）。IBV可被解释为不知情雇主与工人之间的契约。随后我们分析了该规则下的工人失望程度，结果表明无论是事后、中期还是事前评估，平均失望度均为零。因此，公平补偿能够在长期中防止工人产生失望情绪。
10.1257/mic.20250372.title: Bayesian Fairness: Reward Rule and Disappointment under Information Asymmetry
10.1257/mic.20250372.title_zh: 贝叶斯公平：信息不对称下的奖励规则与失望

10.1257/pandp.20261071.abstract: Our paper simulates a model of trade, diplomacy, and wars, calibrated to be relevant for analyzing the conflict between Russia and Ukraine. The quantitative results show that Ukraine’s decoupling from Russia after the 2014 annexation of Crimea reduced its economic exposure to war but also increased the likelihood of conflict by lowering its opportunity cost of war. We then simulate sanction scenarios and find that the 2024 package, if credibly announced in 2021 and made contingent on further aggression, would have significantly raised Russia’s cost of war and could have deterred the 2022 invasion.
10.1257/pandp.20261071.abstract_zh: 本文模拟了一个贸易、外交与战争模型，并针对俄罗斯与乌克兰冲突的分析进行了校准。量化结果表明，乌克兰在2014年克里米亚被吞并后与俄罗斯脱钩，虽然降低了其经济对战争的暴露程度，但也因减少了战争的机会成本而增加了冲突发生的可能性。随后，我们模拟了制裁情景，发现若2024年的制裁方案在2021年可信地宣布，并设定为针对进一步侵略行为的条件性措施，将显著提高俄罗斯的战争成本，并可能阻止2022年的入侵。

10.1257/pol.20200892.abstract: We examine whether vertical integration of hospitals and skilled nursing facilities (SNFs) could lessen competition by foreclosing rival SNFs’ access to lucrative referrals. We find that it could: Among integrated providers, a 1 percent increase in SNF reimbursement for a given patient discharged from the upstream hospital increases the self-referral rate to the hospital’s downstream SNF(s) by 1.8 percent. We find no evidence of offsetting benefits for patients and payers: These increased self-referrals have an imprecisely estimated zero effect on patient outcomes and Medicare spending. (JEL G34, I11, I13, J14, L14, L22)
10.1257/pol.20200892.abstract_zh: 本文考察了医院与专业护理机构（SNFs）的纵向整合是否可能通过阻断竞争性SNFs获取高利润转诊渠道而削弱市场竞争。研究发现确实存在此效应：在整合型医疗服务提供者中，上游医院出院患者的SNF报销比例每增加1%，该医院向下游自有SNF的自我转诊率将提升1.8%。未发现对患者及支付方存在补偿性收益的证据：这些增加的自我转诊对患者预后及医保支出的影响呈现不精确的零效应。（JEL分类号：G34, I11, I13, J14, L14, L22）
10.1257/pol.20200892.title: Vertical Integration and Cream Skimming of Profitable Referrals: The Case of Hospital-Owned Skilled Nursing Facilities
10.1257/pol.20200892.title_zh: 纵向整合与盈利转诊的“撇脂”行为：以医院自营专业护理机构为例

10.1257/pol.20220332.abstract: I investigate the intrahousehold labor and resource allocation consequences of an employment guarantee targeting rural households in India. The guarantee insures household earnings, replacing women as added workers and shutting down a motive for saving. Despite sizable program-job take-up, the guarantee decreases participation in other working activities and, thus, labor force participation of married women and total time worked by their husbands. The guarantee accounts for up to 30 percent of a recent countrywide decrease in rural female labor force participation. Though it increases household consumption, the guarantee reduces the command of women’s household earnings and, thereby, their well-being. (JEL D13, G51, I32, J16, J22, J68, O12)
10.1257/pol.20220332.abstract_zh: 本文研究了印度农村家庭就业保障计划对家庭内部劳动与资源配置的影响。该保障计划为家庭收入提供保险，替代了女性作为补充劳动力的角色，并消除了储蓄动机。尽管该计划下的项目就业参与率较高，但它减少了其他工作活动的参与，从而降低了已婚女性的劳动参与率及其丈夫的总工作时间。该计划可解释近期全国农村女性劳动参与率下降的30%。虽然该计划增加了家庭消费，但它削弱了女性对家庭收入的支配权，进而降低了其福利水平。（JEL分类号：D13, G51, I32, J16, J22, J68, O12）
10.1257/pol.20220332.title: Guaranteed Employment in Rural India: Intrahousehold Labor and Resource Allocation Consequences
10.1257/pol.20220332.title_zh: 印度农村的就业保障：家庭内劳动力与资源配置效应

10.1257/pol.20220738.abstract: The Welfare Effects of Eligibility Expansions: Theory and Evidence from SNAP by Jenna Anders and Charlie Rafkin. Published in volume 18, issue 3, pages 61-100 of American Economic Journal: Economic Policy, August 2026, Abstract: We study how eligibility expansions in the US Supplemental Nutrition As...
10.1257/pol.20220738.abstract_zh: 《资格扩展的福利效应：来自SNAP的理论与证据》作者：Jenna Anders、Charlie Rafkin。发表于《美国经济期刊：经济政策》第18卷第3期第61-100页，2026年8月。摘要：本文研究美国补充营养援助计划（SNAP）资格扩展的福利效应。
10.1257/pol.20220738.title: The Welfare Effects of Eligibility Expansions: Theory and Evidence from SNAP
10.1257/pol.20220738.title_zh: 资格扩展的福利效应：来自SNAP的理论与证据

10.1257/pol.20220777.abstract: Do informational interventions work because they lead subjects to merely update beliefs in the right direction or, to a large extent, because they increase the salience of the decision they target? We randomly assign parents to either an information group, who receives text messages with weekly data on their child’s attendance and school effort, or a salience group, who receives messages that try to redirect their attention without child-specific information. While information has large impacts on attendance, test scores and grade promotion relative to the control group, outcomes in the salience group improve by at least as much.
10.1257/pol.20220777.abstract_zh: 信息干预之所以有效，是因为它们仅仅引导受试者朝正确方向更新信念，还是很大程度上因为它们提高了所针对决策的显著性？我们将家长随机分为两组：信息组每周收到关于孩子出勤和学习努力程度的短信数据，而显著性组则收到旨在引导其注意力但不包含孩子具体信息的短信。与对照组相比，信息组在出勤率、考试成绩和年级晋升方面产生了显著影响，而显著性组的结果改善幅度至少与之相当。
10.1257/pol.20220777.title: When the Effects of Informational Interventions Are Driven by Salience – Evidence from School Parents in Brazil
10.1257/pol.20220777.title_zh: 当信息干预的效果由显著性驱动——来自巴西学生家长的证据

10.1257/pol.20220801.abstract: We study the role of international financial integration in buffering natural disaster shocks, using a large sample of advanced and emerging economies. Natural disasters are largely unpredictable and unrelated to the state of financial integration. We document that integration improves the absorption of such shocks: Output, consumption, and investment are significantly higher after a natural disaster in states with high than in states with low integration. The benefits are most clear for advanced economies. Emerging markets tend to profit from financial integration, too, but the estimates are less precise unless we condition on institutional quality or consider only debt assets. (JEL E21, E22, E23, F32, F33, F34, Q54)
10.1257/pol.20220801.abstract_zh: 本文利用发达经济体与新兴经济体的广泛样本，研究国际金融一体化在缓冲自然灾害冲击中的作用。自然灾害在很大程度上具有不可预测性，且与金融一体化程度无关。我们证实，金融一体化能够改善此类冲击的吸收效果：在自然灾害发生后，金融一体化程度较高的经济体，其产出、消费和投资水平显著高于一体化程度较低的经济体。这种效益在发达经济体中最为明显。新兴市场同样能从金融一体化中获益，但除非我们以制度质量作为条件或仅考虑债务资产，否则相关估计结果的精确度较低。（JEL分类号：E21, E22, E23, F32, F33, F34, Q54）
10.1257/pol.20220801.title: Integrating Out Natural Disaster Shocks

10.1257/pol.20230070.abstract: This paper studies the conditions under which legislators promote policies that may be unpopular in the short term but yield long-term benefits. Using data on the universe of federal disaster declarations from 1989 to 2020, we document that representatives from congressional districts impacted by hurricanes are more inclined to support environmental legislation addressing climate change. However, this response depends on political circumstances: only those in safe seats can change their political agenda towards policies that involve short-term costs for long-term gains. These results highlight the role of electoral incentives in shaping politicians’ attitudes towards far-sighted policy making.
10.1257/pol.20230070.abstract_zh: 本文研究了立法者在何种条件下会推动短期内可能不受欢迎但能带来长期利益的政策。利用1989年至2020年联邦灾害声明的全样本数据，我们发现，受飓风影响的国会选区代表更倾向于支持应对气候变化的环境立法。然而，这种反应取决于政治环境：只有处于安全席位的代表才能将政治议程转向涉及短期成本但带来长期收益的政策。这些结果凸显了选举激励在塑造政治家对远见政策制定态度中的作用。
10.1257/pol.20230070.title: Hurricanes, Climate Change Policies and Electoral Accountability
10.1257/pol.20230070.title_zh: 飓风、气候变化政策与选举问责

10.1257/pol.20230136.abstract: I study how publicly released school social climate information is capitalized into housing markets and affects household sorting. Using the initial release of school climate ratings in Chicago as a plausibly exogenous information shock, I combine a border discontinuity design with event-study and difference-in-differences analyses. I find that homes assigned to higher climate ratings experience price increases and find suggestive evidence that higher-income families sort into these homes. These effects dissipate within a year as information salience declines. A subsequent ratings release generated muted capitalization, but higher-income households continued to react, consistent with unequal access to information.
10.1257/pol.20230136.abstract_zh: 本文研究公开的学校社会氛围信息如何被资本化至住房市场，并影响家庭分类。利用芝加哥首次发布学校氛围评级作为准外生信息冲击，我将边界断点设计与事件研究法和双重差分分析相结合。研究发现，被分配到较高氛围评级的房屋价格出现上涨，并发现高收入家庭倾向于选择这些房屋的初步证据。随着信息显著性的下降，这些效应在一年内消散。后续评级发布产生的资本化效应减弱，但高收入家庭仍持续反应，这与信息获取不平等的情况一致。
10.1257/pol.20230136.title: The Value of School Social Climate Information: Evidence from Chicago Housing Transactions
10.1257/pol.20230136.title_zh: 学校社会氛围信息的价值：来自芝加哥住房交易的证据

10.1257/pol.20230294.abstract: This paper develops a structural model of endogenous product attribute choice in the presence of indirect network effects to study electric vehicle (EV) subsidies. Using data on the German EV market, I find that a support scheme almost doubled EV sales but substantially affected EVs’ price and driving range. These adjustments create a trade-off between optimizing different policy objectives when designing subsidies. Large purchase subsidies maximize EV sales, whereas large charging station subsidies maximize consumer and total surplus. The results suggest that maximizing EV sales can lead to unintended consequences in the form of price and range adjustments. (JEL D12, D22, D85, H25, L14, L62, R41)
10.1257/pol.20230294.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个存在间接网络效应时内生产品属性选择的结构模型，用以研究电动汽车补贴政策。基于德国电动汽车市场数据，我发现补贴计划使电动汽车销量几乎翻倍，但显著影响了其价格与续航里程。这些调整在设计补贴时形成了不同政策目标之间的权衡：高额购车补贴能最大化电动汽车销量，而高额充电站补贴则能最大化消费者剩余与总剩余。研究结果表明，追求销量最大化可能导致价格与续航里程调整等非预期后果。（JEL分类号：D12, D22, D85, H25, L14, L62, R41）
10.1257/pol.20230294.title: Adjustable Product Attributes, Indirect Network Effects, and Subsidy Design: The Case of Electric Vehicles
10.1257/pol.20230294.title_zh: 可调整产品属性、间接网络效应与补贴设计：以电动汽车为例

10.1257/pol.20230365.abstract: We evaluate a tax reform in Ecuador that introduced generous deductions from personal income taxes (PIT), encouraging consumers to request receipts. The reform addresses tax evasion by targeting small self-employed businesses that mainly sell goods or services not subject to value-added taxes (VAT) but that often evade income taxes. Exploiting plausibly exogenous variation in receipt demand due to the distribution of taxpayers across regions and professions, we find significant increases in reported profits among self-employed businesses exposed to the reform. We document spillover effects on VAT. Our net-revenue impact analysis suggests the additional tax payments outweigh the foregone tax revenue. (JEL H24, H25, H26, J23, K34, O17)
10.1257/pol.20230365.abstract_zh: 我们评估了厄瓜多尔的一项税制改革，该改革引入了慷慨的个人所得税（PIT）扣除项，鼓励消费者索取收据。这项改革通过针对主要销售不征收增值税（VAT）的商品或服务、但常逃避所得税的小型个体经营企业，来应对逃税问题。利用纳税人跨地区和职业分布带来的收据需求外生性变化，我们发现受改革影响的个体经营企业报告利润显著增加。我们记录了改革对增值税的溢出效应。净收入影响分析表明，额外税收收入超过了放弃的税收收入。（JEL H24, H25, H26, J23, K34, O17）
10.1257/pol.20230365.title: Harnessing Deductions to Increase Tax Compliance and Formalization
10.1257/pol.20230365.title_zh: 利用扣除额提高税收合规性与正规化

10.1257/pol.20230384.abstract_zh: 《集体谈判权、警务与平民死亡》作者：Jamein P. Cunningham 与 Rob Gillezeau。发表于《美国经济期刊：经济政策》第18卷第3期，2026年8月，第197-234页。摘要：采用事件研究设计，本文考察了各州引入强制谈判义务...
10.1257/pol.20230384.title: Collective Bargaining Rights, Policing, and Civilian Deaths
10.1257/pol.20230384.title_zh: 集体谈判权、警务与平民死亡

10.1257/pol.20230414.abstract: We study rental income tax compliance using novel third-party information and a large-scale randomized field experiment. The third-party information combines register data on the ownership and occupancy of apartments. The RCT used this new third-party information in the targeting and design of experimental treatments, and increased the propensity to report rental income and the amount of reported rental income net of expenses. Our research design also allows us to identify members of ownership networks and analyze spillover effects in tax enforcement between them. We find positive reporting spillovers. We do not find evidence of real effects on asset market transactions. (JEL C93, D83, H26, K34, R31)
10.1257/pol.20230414.abstract_zh: 我们利用新颖的第三方信息和大规模随机实地实验，对租金收入纳税遵从度展开研究。该第三方信息整合了公寓所有权与居住情况的登记数据。随机对照实验将这一新型第三方信息应用于实验干预的目标定位与设计，显著提升了租金收入的申报倾向及扣除费用后的申报金额。研究设计还使我们能够识别所有权网络成员，并分析税收执法在成员间的溢出效应。研究发现存在正向的申报溢出效应，但未发现对资产市场交易产生实质性影响的证据。（JEL分类号：C93, D83, H26, K34, R31）
10.1257/pol.20230414.title: Tax Compliance in the Rental Housing Market: Evidence from a Field Experiment
10.1257/pol.20230414.title_zh: 租赁住房市场中的税收遵从：来自实地实验的证据

10.1257/pol.20230447.abstract: We show that exposure to extreme temperatures significantly increases international migration from El Salvador, where nearly a quarter of the population lives in the United States. Extreme temperatures reduce corn yields, leading producers to decrease their use of postharvest inputs and demand for agricultural workers. These income losses, combined with established US migration networks, increase emigration. Our findings highlight how international migration serves as a response to extreme temperatures when destination networks are strong and migration remains financially feasible. This pattern is not unique to El Salvador: Roughly 30 million farms globally are in low-income settings with access to remittances. (JEL F24, J15, J23, J43, O15, Q12, Q54)
10.1257/pol.20230447.abstract_zh: 研究表明，极端气温显著增加了萨尔瓦多的国际移民——该国近四分之一人口居住在美国。极端气温导致玉米减产，促使生产者减少收获后投入品的使用并降低对农业劳动力的需求。这些收入损失，加上已建立的美国移民网络，进一步推动了移民潮。我们的发现凸显了当目的地移民网络强大且移民在经济上仍可行时，国际移民如何成为应对极端气温的一种手段。这一现象并非萨尔瓦多独有：全球约有3000万个农场位于低收入地区，且这些地区能够获得汇款。（JEL分类号：F24, J15, J23, J43, O15, Q12, Q54）
10.1257/pol.20230447.title: Responses to Extreme Temperatures: Migrant Networks and International Migration from El Salvador
10.1257/pol.20230447.title_zh: 极端温度的反应：移民网络与萨尔瓦多的国际移民

10.1257/pol.20230539.abstract: I study the effects of charters on student racial segregation, identifying a novel mechanism: the assignment of White and non-White students to regular classrooms within their school-grade. Exploiting almost 100 entries of elementary charters in North Carolina from 1997 to 2015, I show that the announcement of an opening significantly increases classroom segregation within public schools nearby, relative to schools farther away, especially within non-majority-White schools and for charter openings that enroll a relatively large share of White students. Accounting for classrooms is unlikely to reverse the literature’s conclusion that the charter effects on student segregation are modest in magnitude. (JEL H75, I21, I24, I28, J15)
10.1257/pol.20230539.abstract_zh: 本文研究了特许学校对学生种族隔离的影响，并识别出一种新机制：白人和非白人学生在其所在年级的常规班级中的分配。利用1997年至2015年间北卡罗来纳州近100所小学特许学校的设立数据，我表明，与距离较远的学校相比，特许学校开学的公告显著增加了附近公立学校内部的班级隔离，尤其是在非白人占多数的学校以及招收白人学生比例相对较高的特许学校中。考虑班级层面的因素不太可能推翻文献中关于特许学校对学生隔离影响程度较小的结论。（JEL H75, I21, I24, I28, J15）
10.1257/pol.20230539.title: The Segregative Effects of Charter Schools

10.1257/pol.20230542.abstract: Estimating the Economic Value of Zoning Reform by Santosh Anagol, Fernando Ferreira and Jonah Rexer. Published in volume 18, issue 3, pages 235-74 of American Economic Journal: Economic Policy, August 2026, Abstract: We estimate the economic value of zoning reform in São Paulo, which altered maximu...
10.1257/pol.20230542.abstract_zh: 桑托什·阿纳戈尔、费尔南多·费雷拉与乔纳·雷克瑟合著《区划改革的经济价值评估》，发表于《美国经济期刊：经济政策》2026年8月第18卷第3期第235-74页。摘要：我们评估了圣保罗市区划改革的经济价值，该改革调整了最大...
10.1257/pol.20230542.title: Estimating the Economic Value of Zoning Reform
10.1257/pol.20230542.title_zh: 估算区划改革的经济价值

10.1257/pol.20230547.abstract: We study the effect of stricter enforcement of the dividend-withholding tax (DWT). We focus on a 2016 Danish enforcement reform and compare Denmark to its Nordic neighbors. Throughout the Nordic stock markets, shares on loan spike sharply around dividend dates. These spikes are consistent with abuse of the DWT system. Postreform, spikes in Denmark disappear, and annual DWT revenue increases by 130 percent. Enforcement does not harm the investment climate as measured by Danish stock returns, investment rate, and dividend yield. (JEL G18, G35, G38, H26, K22, K34)
10.1257/pol.20230547.abstract_zh: 我们研究了股息预扣税（DWT）执行力度加强的影响。重点关注2016年丹麦的一项执法改革，并将丹麦与其北欧邻国进行比较。在整个北欧股票市场中，股票借贷量在股息发放日前后急剧飙升。这些飙升现象与DWT制度的滥用行为相符。改革后，丹麦的此类飙升现象消失，年度DWT收入增长130%。以丹麦股票回报率、投资率和股息收益率衡量，执法并未损害投资环境。（JEL分类号：G18, G35, G38, H26, K22, K34）
10.1257/pol.20230547.title: The Big Short (Interest): Closing the Loopholes in the Dividend-Withholding Tax
10.1257/pol.20230547.title_zh: 大空头（空头利息）：堵塞股息预扣税漏洞

10.1257/pol.20230552.abstract: This paper examines the provision of official flood risk information in the United States and its distributional impacts on residential flood insurance take-up. Assembling all flood maps produced after Hurricane Katrina, I document that updated maps decreased the number of properties zoned in high-risk floodplains and incorrectly omitted five million properties, primarily in neighborhoods with more Black and Hispanic residents. Leveraging the staggered timing of map updates, I estimate that updated maps decreased flood insurance take-up and exacerbated racial disparities in insurance coverage. While past map updates distorted risk and price signals, correcting flood maps would yield substantial welfare gains.
10.1257/pol.20230552.abstract_zh: 本文研究了美国官方洪水风险信息的提供及其对住宅洪水保险参保率的分配效应。通过整合卡特里娜飓风后发布的所有洪水地图，我发现更新后的地图减少了划入高风险洪泛区的房产数量，并错误地遗漏了500万处房产，这些房产主要位于黑人和西班牙裔居民较多的社区。利用地图更新的交错时间安排，我估计更新后的地图降低了洪水保险的参保率，并加剧了保险覆盖中的种族差异。尽管过去的地图更新扭曲了风险与价格信号，但修正洪水地图将带来显著的福利收益。
10.1257/pol.20230552.title: Flood Risk Mapping and the Distributional Impacts of Climate Information
10.1257/pol.20230552.title_zh: 洪水风险图绘制与气候信息的分配效应

10.1257/pol.20230617.abstract: What happens when a country’s electorate suddenly expands by hundreds of thousands of new voters? This study examines the political impact of the mass arrival of repatriates from Algeria to France. Using this quasi-experiment, I demonstrate that their arrival caused significant changes in the French electoral landscape. In areas of exposure to their arrival, they increased the French electorate and reshaped the vote for right-wing parties. Furthermore, their presence influenced candidates’ electoral strategies, causing all candidates to shift their electoral manifestos towards pro-repatriate stances. This significant historical event influenced French political life, reshaping electoral dynamics and political strategies in France.
10.1257/pol.20230617.abstract_zh: 当一个国家的选民突然增加数十万新选民时，会发生什么？本研究考察了阿尔及利亚归国者大规模抵达法国所产生的政治影响。利用这一准实验，我证明他们的到来导致了法国选举格局的重大变化。在受其抵达影响的地区，他们扩大了法国选民规模，并重塑了右翼政党的选票分布。此外，他们的存在影响了候选人的选举策略，促使所有候选人将选举宣言转向支持归国者的立场。这一重大历史事件影响了法国的政治生活，重塑了法国的选举动态和政治策略。
10.1257/pol.20230617.title: The Political Consequences of Mass Repatriation
10.1257/pol.20230617.title_zh: 大规模遣返的政治后果

10.1257/pol.20230644.abstract: The vast majority of Americans become eligible for Medicare at age 65. This results in 7 percent of the near elderly transitioning from uninsurance to insurance and 60 percent switching from some source of insurance to Medicare. We develop an extension of two-sample IV to estimate the effect of uninsurance on access to care while accounting for the effects of the other transitions. We find that not having insurance results in much lower probabilities of having a medical provider or receiving inpatient care. The foregone hospitalizations are for life-threatening emergent conditions and elective surgeries that increase quality of life.
10.1257/pol.20230644.abstract_zh: 绝大多数美国人在65岁时获得Medicare资格。这导致7%的临近老年人群从无保险状态转为有保险，60%的人群从其他保险来源转向Medicare。我们开发了双样本工具变量法的扩展方法，在考虑其他保险转换影响的同时，估计无保险状态对医疗服务可及性的影响。研究发现，缺乏保险会显著降低拥有医疗服务提供者或接受住院治疗的概率。被放弃的住院治疗涉及危及生命的紧急病症以及提升生活质量的择期手术。
10.1257/pol.20230644.title: Health Insurance and Access to Care for the Near Elderly
10.1257/pol.20230644.title_zh: 健康保险与准老年人医疗可及性

10.1257/pol.20230668.abstract: A large literature has documented that fiscal policy is procyclical in emerging markets/developing countries and acyclical/countercyclical in advanced economies. This paper analyzes fiscal procyclicality in commodity-exporting countries. The paper makes two novel contributions. First, based on the “when it rains, it pours” phenomenon (that is, contractionary fiscal policy amplifies the business cycle), the paper shows that, on average, government spending magnifies the business cycle by 21 percent of the initial drop in output following a fall in commodity prices. Second, the paper estimates the welfare costs of fiscal procyclicality at 36 percent of the commodity business cycle. (JEL E32, E62, F14, H50, O19, Q02)
10.1257/pol.20230668.abstract_zh: 大量文献表明，财政政策在新兴市场/发展中国家呈现顺周期性，而在发达经济体中则为非周期性/逆周期性。本文分析了大宗商品出口国的财政顺周期性，并做出两项创新性贡献。首先，基于"祸不单行"现象（即紧缩性财政政策放大经济周期），本文证明：在大宗商品价格下跌后，政府支出平均会使初始产出下降的幅度放大21%。其次，本文估算出财政顺周期性的福利成本相当于大宗商品经济周期的36%。（JEL分类号：E32, E62, F14, H50, O19, Q02）
10.1257/pol.20230668.title: Fiscal Procyclicality in Commodity Exporting Countries: How Much Does It Pour and Why?
10.1257/pol.20230668.title_zh: 大宗商品出口国的财政顺周期性：程度与成因

10.1257/pol.20230670.abstract: We estimate the direct and spillover effects of cannabis legalization on longstanding racial disparities in criminal justice outcomes. We find that legalization reduces cannabis possession and sales arrests for White and Black populations, narrowing but not eliminating disparities. We also find spillover increases in hospitalizations involving cannabis and other illegal drugs. However, spillovers on arrests, incarcerations, and crimes involving serious violent or property offenses are insignificant or even decrease. Other illegal drug sales arrests decrease across populations, while illegal drug incarcerations decrease only among White populations. Spillovers on other low-level offenses are insignificant for White but mixed for Black populations. (JEL I12, J15, K14, K41, K42)
10.1257/pol.20230670.abstract_zh: 我们估算了大麻合法化对刑事司法结果中长期存在的种族差异的直接效应与溢出效应。研究发现，合法化减少了白人和黑人群体中因持有和销售大麻而被逮捕的数量，缩小了差异但并未完全消除。同时，溢出效应导致涉及大麻及其他非法药物的住院人数增加。然而，对涉及严重暴力或财产犯罪的逮捕、监禁及犯罪行为的溢出效应并不显著，甚至有所下降。其他非法药物销售逮捕人数在各群体中均减少，但非法药物监禁人数仅在白人群体中下降。对白人群体而言，其他轻微犯罪的溢出效应不显著，而对黑人群体则呈现混合结果。（JEL I12, J15, K14, K41, K42）
10.1257/pol.20230670.title: State Recreational Cannabis Laws and Racial Disparities in the Criminal Legal System
10.1257/pol.20230670.title_zh: 州娱乐性大麻法律与刑事司法系统中的种族差异

10.1257/pol.20230812.abstract: Incarceration is often justified by a defendant’s risk of future crime. To what extent do biased beliefs about predictors of crime distort incarceration decisions? We survey prosecutors about how violent rearrest rates vary by defendant age and criminal history. Surveyed prosecutors make systematic errors: They underestimate the decline in rearrest with age and overestimate the increase with criminal history. By linking prosecutors’ beliefs to their quasi-randomly assigned cases, we show that prosecutors’ beliefs predict incarceration patterns by defendant age and criminal history in their cases. Finally, we find that prosecutors with more accurate beliefs simultaneously reduce violent rearrest and incarceration. (JEL D83, K14, K41, K42)
10.1257/pol.20230812.abstract_zh: 监禁通常以被告未来犯罪风险为正当理由。关于犯罪预测因素的偏见性认知在多大程度上扭曲了监禁判决？我们调查了检察官对暴力犯罪再逮捕率如何随被告年龄和犯罪记录变化的看法。受访检察官存在系统性错误：他们低估了再逮捕率随年龄下降的趋势，高估了其随犯罪记录增加的趋势。通过将检察官的认知与其准随机分配的案件相关联，我们证明检察官的认知能够预测其案件中按被告年龄和犯罪记录划分的监禁模式。最后，我们发现认知更准确的检察官能够同时降低暴力再逮捕率和监禁率。（JEL D83, K14, K41, K42）
10.1257/pol.20230812.title: Prediction Errors, Incarceration, and Violent Crime: Evidence from Linking Prosecutor Surveys to Court Records
10.1257/pol.20230812.title_zh: 预测错误、监禁与暴力犯罪：来自检察官调查与法庭记录匹配的证据

10.1257/pol.20240044.abstract: We estimate the causal impacts of universal preschool by leveraging a quasi-experimental design based on Israel’s implementation of free public preschool for children ages 3 and 4 beginning in September 1999. We focus on the Arab population, who were the main beneficiaries of the first phase of the law’s implementation. Using a difference-in-differences (DID) research design, we find that universal preschool enhanced individuals’ academic performance from elementary school through high school, improved the learning environment, and increased postsecondary enrollment. Additional benefits include reduced juvenile delinquency among males and decreased early marriage among females. (JEL I21, I24, I28, J15, J16)
10.1257/pol.20240044.abstract_zh: 我们利用以色列自1999年9月起对3至4岁儿童实施免费公立学前教育的准实验设计，评估了普及型学前教育的因果影响。研究聚焦于该法律第一阶段的主要受益群体——阿拉伯人口。通过双重差分（DID）研究设计，我们发现普及型学前教育提升了个人从小学到高中的学业表现，改善了学习环境，并提高了高等教育入学率。其他益处包括降低男性青少年犯罪率和减少女性早婚现象。（JEL I21, I24, I28, J15, J16）
10.1257/pol.20240044.title: Short- and Long-Term Effects of Universal Preschool: Evidence from the Arab Population in Israel
10.1257/pol.20240044.title_zh: 以色列阿拉伯人口中普及学前教育的短期与长期效应

10.1257/pol.20240087.abstract: We examine the impact of the free supply of diphtheria antitoxin, the first effective medical treatment for an infectious disease, on the historical health transition in Massachusetts. Using newly collected municipality-level data on the distribution of antitoxin and information from over 1.5 million death certificates from 1880 to 1914, we find that the rapid availability of antitoxin treatment significantly increased life expectancy at young ages. Our findings suggest that medicine, combined with an effective public health policy, played a more important role in improving life expectancy in the early twentieth century than previously thought. (JEL H75, I12, I18, J13, N31)
10.1257/pol.20240087.abstract_zh: 本文考察了白喉抗毒素（第一种针对传染病的有效医疗手段）的免费供应对马萨诸塞州历史健康转型的影响。利用新收集的市级抗毒素分配数据以及1880年至1914年间超过150万份死亡证明信息，我们发现抗毒素治疗的快速普及显著提高了低龄人群的预期寿命。研究结果表明，在20世纪初期，医学与有效的公共卫生政策相结合，对预期寿命提升的作用比以往认知更为重要。（JEL H75, I12, I18, J13, N31）
10.1257/pol.20240087.title: Medical Technology and Life Expectancy: Evidence from the Antitoxin Treatment of Diphtheria
10.1257/pol.20240087.title_zh: 医疗技术与预期寿命：白喉抗毒素治疗的证据

10.1257/pol.20240121.abstract: Financial crimes are costly to society but less severely punished than other nonviolent crimes. We investigate whether prison sentences reduce financial crimes. Using random assignment of judges in Finland to identify causal impacts, we find a prison sentence reduces defendant reoffending by 42.9 percentage points three years postsentencing. Given prior evidence of financial misconduct “contagion,” we also explore spillovers on colleagues. A prison sentence reduces the likelihood that a financial crime defendant’s colleagues commit crimes by 27 percentage points, suggesting broader deterrent effects of harsher punishments, but only for fraud cases. Last, we show financial crimes are not victimless crimes. (JEL K14, K22, K41, K42)
10.1257/pol.20240121.abstract_zh: 金融犯罪对社会造成高昂代价，但相较于其他非暴力犯罪，其惩罚力度较轻。本文探究监禁刑罚能否减少金融犯罪。利用芬兰法官随机分配机制识别因果效应，我们发现，判决监禁使被告在判决后三年内的再犯率降低42.9个百分点。鉴于已有证据表明金融不当行为具有"传染性"，我们进一步考察了对同事的溢出效应。监禁判决使金融犯罪被告同事的犯罪概率降低27个百分点，这表明更严厉的惩罚具有更广泛的威慑效应，但该效应仅存在于欺诈案件中。最后，我们证明金融犯罪并非无受害者的犯罪。（JEL K14, K22, K41, K42）
10.1257/pol.20240121.title: Punishing Financial Crimes: The Impact of Prison Sentences on Defendants and Their Colleagues
10.1257/pol.20240121.title_zh: 惩罚金融犯罪：监禁刑期对被告及其同事的影响

10.1257/pol.20240147.abstract: This paper examines the effects of a corporate tax cut aimed at incentivizing domestic production on the within-firm distribution of worker earnings, firm employment, and firm capital investment. We use employee-employer-matched U.S. tax filings and find that after implementation of the Domestic Production Activities Deduction, earnings increased modestly in the middle of the within-firm earnings distribution, but increased sharply at the 99th percentile, especially for small firms. Firms also increased investment and employment. Our results demonstrate the importance of allowing for worker and firm heterogeneity when estimating the wage incidence of corporate taxes.
10.1257/pol.20240147.abstract_zh: 本文研究了旨在激励国内生产的企业减税政策对企业内部员工收入分布、企业就业及资本投资的影响。我们利用美国员工-雇主匹配的税务申报数据发现，在实施国内生产活动扣除政策后，企业内部收入分布中位水平的收入温和增长，但第99百分位的高收入群体收入显著上升，尤其是小型企业。同时，企业投资和就业也有所增加。研究结果表明，在估算企业所得税的工资归宿时，考虑员工与企业的异质性至关重要。
10.1257/pol.20240147.title: Effects of Domestic Production Tax Incentives on Workers and Firms: Evidence from US Employee-Employer-Matched Tax Filings
10.1257/pol.20240147.title_zh: 国内生产税收激励对工人和企业的影响：来自美国员工-雇主匹配税务申报的证据

10.1257/pol.20240197.abstract: States and localities are relied upon to implement macroeconomic stabilization policies and ensure service delivery in times of crisis. In April 2020, the introduction of the Municipal Liquidity Facility (MLF) added an emergency lending instrument to the policy arsenal guaranteeing liquidity but at a price. Using a regression discontinuity design that exploits MLF lending eligibility population cutoffs, we find that the MLF contributed to the easing of liquidity pressures and reduced perceived credit risk for municipal borrowers. Low-rated issuers experienced yields reductions of at least 26 bps. We also provide suggestive evidence that these liquidity effects translated into employment gains.
10.1257/pol.20240197.abstract_zh: 各州及地方政府被寄予厚望，需在危机时期实施宏观经济稳定政策并确保公共服务供给。2020年4月推出的市政流动性便利（MLF）为政策工具箱新增了一项应急贷款工具，该工具虽能保障流动性，但需付出相应代价。通过利用MLF贷款资格的人口阈值进行断点回归设计，我们发现MLF有助于缓解流动性压力，并降低了市政借款人的感知信用风险。低评级发行人的收益率至少下降了26个基点。我们还提供了初步证据表明，这些流动性效应已转化为就业增长。
10.1257/pol.20240197.title: The Option Value of Municipal Liquidity
10.1257/pol.20240197.title_zh: 市政流动性的期权价值

文书之困：信息与申请协助对印度社会福利申领的影响  
作者：Sarika Gupta  
发表于《美国经济期刊：经济政策》2026年8月第18卷第3期，第342-371页  
摘要：全球各国政府通过行政程序管理社会项目，旨在为符合条件的公民提供福利。然而，繁琐的文书工作往往成为申领障碍。本文利用印度一项大规模社会福利项目的随机实验，评估了信息提供与申请协助对福利申领率的影响。研究发现，仅提供信息对申领率无显著改善，而结合申请协助则显著提升了申领率，尤其对弱势群体效果更为明显。这一结果表明，程序性障碍而非信息缺失是福利申领的主要瓶颈，简化申请流程或提供针对性协助可有效提升社会项目的覆盖效果。

10.1257/pol.20240290.abstract: Many routine daily activities—such as cooking and commuting—cause large recurring pollution spikes that may impact health without significantly affecting average exposure. We study pollution spikes by combining experimental variation in cooking technology with high-frequency data on individual pollution exposure and time-use in Kenya. Improved cookstoves reduce PM2.5 spikes while cooking by 51.3 μg/m 3 (41 percent) and cause a 0.24 standard deviation reduction in self-reported respiratory symptoms. However, even after more than three years of daily use, we find no clinical health improvements, possibly because we detect no impact on average exposure. Clinical health improvements may require reductions in ambient concentrations. (JEL I12, O12, O13, Q51, Q53)
10.1257/pol.20240290.abstract_zh: 许多日常活动（如烹饪和通勤）会引发频繁且严重的污染峰值，这些峰值可能影响健康，却不会显著改变平均暴露水平。我们通过结合烹饪技术的实验性变化与肯尼亚个体污染暴露及时间利用的高频数据，对污染峰值展开研究。改良炉灶使烹饪期间的PM2.5峰值降低51.3微克/立方米（降幅达41%），并导致自报呼吸道症状减少0.24个标准差。然而，即便经过三年以上的日常使用，我们仍未发现临床健康指标的改善，这可能是因为我们未检测到对平均暴露水平的影响。临床健康的改善或许需要降低环境本底浓度。（JEL I12, O12, O13, Q51, Q53）
10.1257/pol.20240290.title: Cooking, Health, and Daily Exposure to Pollution Spikes
10.1257/pol.20240290.title_zh: 烹饪、健康与日常污染峰值暴露

10.1257/pol.20240356.abstract: Attracting and retaining effective teachers in high-poverty schools remains a persistent challenge. We evaluate the impact of an initiative that offered substantial performance-based compensation to highly effective teachers in the lowest-achieving schools. We find that the program led to dramatic improvements in achievement, nearly closing the gap between the targeted schools and the district average. When the program was later reversed for some campuses, effective teachers departed at high rates, resulting in an immediate decline in student achievement. The results underscore the potential for effectiveness-based compensating differentials to attract and retain effective teachers in disadvantaged schools.
10.1257/pol.20240356.abstract_zh: 在贫困率较高的学校中吸引并留住高效教师仍是一项长期挑战。我们评估了一项针对成绩最差学校中高效教师提供高额绩效薪酬的举措。研究发现，该项目显著提升了学生学业成绩，几乎弥合了目标学校与学区平均水平之间的差距。当该项目后来在部分学校被取消时，高效教师大量流失，导致学生成绩立即下滑。研究结果凸显了基于教学效能的薪酬差异在吸引和留住弱势学校高效教师方面的潜力。
10.1257/pol.20240356.title: Attracting and Retaining Highly Effective Educators in Hard-to-Staff Schools
10.1257/pol.20240356.title_zh: 吸引并留住难以配备师资学校中的高效教育工作者

10.1257/pol.20240393.abstract: This paper examines the impacts of health care provider exits on patient outcomes and displacement. Leveraging data on the universe of long-stay nursing home patients, I estimate the mortality effects of 1,104 nursing home closures using a difference-in-differences approach. Displaced residents face a substantial short-run increase in mortality, with this disruption effect strongest among older and frailer patients. However, surviving patients tend to transfer to higher-quality providers. I find suggestive evidence that for certain subgroups this reallocation may lead to improved long-term survival, net of the initial disruption effect. The findings highlight the immediate health risks of displacement and the potential for quality-driven reallocation to mitigate them. *
10.1257/pol.20240393.abstract_zh: 本文研究了医疗服务提供者退出对患者结局与转移的影响。利用长期护理机构住院患者的全样本数据，我采用双重差分法估算了1104家养老院关闭对死亡率的影响。被转移的居民在短期内面临显著的死亡率上升，这种中断效应在年长及体弱患者中最为强烈。然而，幸存患者倾向于转入更高质量的护理机构。我发现了提示性证据：对于某些亚群体而言，这种重新配置可能带来长期生存率的改善，抵消了初始中断效应的影响。研究结果凸显了患者转移的即时健康风险，以及以质量为导向的重新配置在缓解这些风险方面的潜力。
10.1257/pol.20240393.title: Disruption and Displacement in Health Care: Evidence from Nursing Home Closures
10.1257/pol.20240393.title_zh: 医疗保健中的中断与替代：来自养老院关闭的证据

10.1257/pol.20240403.abstract: This paper studies taxpayer responses to an increase in the top marginal tax rate in South Africa, drawing on rich administrative data and a transparent identification strategy. We show that treated taxpayers strongly reduced their reported taxable income in response to the reform, with adjustments along a broad range of taxable income components. While tax evasion and avoidance explain a sizable share of this response, there is also indication for reduced work effort and business performance of South African corporations led by treated taxpayers—suggesting that raising taxes on top incomes may entail broader economic repercussions.
10.1257/pol.20240403.abstract_zh: 本文利用丰富的行政数据和透明的识别策略，研究了南非最高边际税率上调后纳税人的反应。我们发现，受影响的纳税人显著减少了其申报的应税收入，调整涉及应税收入的多个组成部分。尽管逃税和避税行为在很大程度上解释了这一反应，但也有迹象表明，受影响的纳税人所领导的南非企业的工作努力程度和经营业绩有所下降——这表明对高收入群体增税可能带来更广泛的经济影响。
10.1257/pol.20240403.title: Taxing Top Incomes in the Emerging World—Fiscal and Economic Impact under the Microscope
10.1257/pol.20240403.title_zh: 新兴世界中的高收入征税——财政与经济影响的微观审视

10.1257/pol.20240429.abstract: In 1916, Margaret Sanger established the first birth control clinic in US history. From the mid-1920s, “Sanger clinics” spread over the entire US These clinics advised women on contraception, mainly by fitting diaphragms and explicitly instructing women how to use them effectively. Combining newly digitized data on the roll-out of these clinics, full-count Census data, and historical vital statistics, we find that the clinics accounted for 5.4–6.5 percent of the overall fertility decline across the US until 1940. By increasing the spacing between births and reducing fertility, the clinics generated important health effects and reduced stillbirths and infant mortality.
10.1257/pol.20240429.abstract_zh: 1916年，玛格丽特·桑格在美国历史上建立了第一家节育诊所。自20世纪20年代中期起，“桑格诊所”遍布全美。这些诊所为女性提供避孕指导，主要通过安装子宫托并明确指导女性如何有效使用。结合新近数字化的诊所推广数据、全量人口普查数据及历史生命统计资料，我们发现，截至1940年，这些诊所对美国整体生育率下降的贡献率为5.4%至6.5%。通过延长生育间隔并降低生育率，诊所产生了重要的健康效应，减少了死产和婴儿死亡率。
10.1257/pol.20240429.title: The Impact of Margaret Sanger’s Birth Control Clinics on Early 20th Century US Fertility and Mortality
10.1257/pol.20240429.title_zh: 玛格丽特·桑格避孕诊所在20世纪初美国生育率与死亡率中的影响

10.1257/pol.20240436.abstract: We provide novel evidence on the incidence of business taxes using comprehensive survey and experimental data from German firms. Managers respond asymmetrically to randomized hypothetical tax changes of opposite signs, consistent with asymmetric profit tax incidence. They indicate that tax cuts would be primarily passed on to workers and used for investment projects, while tax increases would be shifted to consumers via higher prices and absorbed by firm owners via lower profit distributions. We further show that the stated incidence on workers rises with the absolute size of the tax change, partially offsetting the burden borne by firm owners.
10.1257/pol.20240436.abstract_zh: 我们利用德国企业的综合调查与实验数据，提供了关于商业税归宿的新证据。管理者对随机设定的正负向税收变化表现出非对称反应，这与利润税的非对称归宿特征一致。他们指出，减税将主要转嫁给劳动者并用于投资项目，而增税则会通过提高价格转嫁给消费者，并通过降低利润分配由企业主承担。我们进一步发现，税收变化绝对规模越大，劳动者承担的税负比例越高，这在一定程度上抵消了企业主所承受的负担。
10.1257/pol.20240436.title: The Asymmetric Incidence of Business Taxes: Survey Evidence from German Firms
10.1257/pol.20240436.title_zh: 企业税负的非对称影响：来自德国企业的调查证据

10.1257/pol.20240478.abstract: Minority workers tend to be disproportionately harmed by negative economic shocks. Indeed, we show that Hispanic populations experienced worse employment losses due to import competition from China, relative to whites, largely due to lower education levels. In contrast, Black-white employment and wage gaps actually narrowed due to relative growth in non-manufacturing sectors. We show that Black workers were less attached to manufacturing by 2000, compared to whites, and were therefore more poised to take advantage of China shock induced reallocation to services. The lasting negative impacts of the China shock on exposed communities were primarily driven by white workers.
10.1257/pol.20240478.abstract_zh: 少数族裔工人往往在经济负面冲击中遭受不成比例的损害。事实上，我们表明，相较于白人，西班牙裔人口因中国进口竞争而面临更严重的就业损失，这主要归因于其较低的教育水平。相比之下，由于非制造业部门的相对增长，黑人与白人之间的就业和工资差距实际上有所缩小。我们指出，到2000年，黑人工人对制造业的依赖程度低于白人，因此他们更有能力利用中国冲击所引发的服务业重新配置。中国冲击对受影响社区造成的持久负面影响主要由白人工人驱动。
10.1257/pol.20240478.title: Racial and Ethnic Inequality and the China Shock
10.1257/pol.20240478.title_zh: 种族与民族不平等及中国冲击

10.1257/pol.20240544.abstract: Are Building Codes an Effective Adaptation to Wind Risk? Evidence from Remotely Detected Blue Tarps by David Wolf and Kenji Takeuchi. Published in volume 18, issue 3, pages 509-40 of American Economic Journal: Economic Policy, August 2026, Abstract: Hurricanes cause significant wind and water damage...
10.1257/pol.20240544.abstract_zh:
建筑规范能否有效应对风灾风险？基于遥感蓝色防水布数据的证据  
作者：David Wolf, Kenji Takeuchi  
发表于《美国经济杂志：经济政策》第18卷第3期，第509-540页，2026年8月  

摘要：飓风会造成严重的风灾和水灾……
10.1257/pol.20240544.title: Are Building Codes an Effective Adaptation to Wind Risk? Evidence from Remotely Detected Blue Tarps
10.1257/pol.20240544.title_zh: 建筑规范能否有效适应风灾风险？基于遥感检测蓝色防水布的证据

10.1257/pol.20240586.abstract: This paper documents a socioeconomic gradient in adult labor market penalties stemming from a single chronic and treatable childhood health shock in a country with universal access to healthcare. Using childhood onset Type 1 Diabetes, Danish administrative registry data, and causal forests, we estimate substantial variation in the employment and earnings penalties at age 30. These penalties vary systematically with parental income and maternal educational attainment. Our findings help explain the income-health gradient and have important implications for policy discussions related to the design of healthcare systems.
10.1257/pol.20240586.abstract_zh: 本文记录了在全民医保国家中，单一慢性且可治疗的儿童期健康冲击对成年劳动力市场惩罚的社会经济梯度。利用儿童期发病的1型糖尿病、丹麦行政登记数据及因果森林方法，我们估计出30岁时就业与收入惩罚存在显著差异。这些惩罚随父母收入及母亲教育程度呈现系统性变化。研究结果有助于解释收入-健康梯度现象，并对医疗体系设计相关的政策讨论具有重要启示。
10.1257/pol.20240586.title: Childhood Health Shocks and the Intergenerational Transmission of Inequality
10.1257/pol.20240586.title_zh: 儿童健康冲击与不平等的代际传递

10.1257/pol.20240611.abstract: This paper explores the labor market returns to working for a victorious political campaign. Using unique administrative data from Brazil, we track campaign workers’ employment and earnings before and after close mayoral elections over nearly 20 years. We find sizable returns to working for a winning campaign, especially in areas with large informal sectors and for workers connected to challengers. Returns are concentrated in the public sector, where connected hires are more educationally qualified, including at higher levels of the bureaucracy. Our findings suggest that personal connections, not simply party ties, facilitate the hiring of capable, though inexperienced, civil servants.
10.1257/pol.20240611.abstract_zh: 本文探究了为获胜政治竞选工作所带来的劳动力市场回报。利用巴西独特的行政数据，我们追踪了近20年市长选举前后竞选工作人员的就业与收入情况。研究发现，为获胜竞选工作能带来可观的回报，尤其是在非正规部门规模较大的地区，以及与挑战者存在关联的工人群体中。这些回报主要集中在公共部门，其中通过关系入职的人员在学历资质上更为优秀，甚至包括更高层级的官僚机构。我们的研究结果表明，个人关系（而非单纯的党派联系）促进了有能力但缺乏经验的公务员的聘用。
10.1257/pol.20240611.title: Campaign Connections

10.1257/pol.20240794.abstract: Climate policies often increase electricity prices by more than they increase prices of fossil fuels. Using administrative data on German manufacturing plants from 2009 to 2017, we provide evidence that these price changes induce plants to generate electricity onsite using fossil fuels. Not all manufacturing plants are subject to emissions pricing under the EU’s Emissions Trading System, and we find evidence of emissions leakage: Electricity generation shifts from regulated power plants to unregulated manufacturing plants.
10.1257/pol.20240794.abstract_zh: 气候政策往往导致电价涨幅超过化石燃料价格涨幅。基于2009年至2017年德国制造业工厂的行政数据，我们证实此类价格变化会促使工厂利用化石燃料进行现场发电。并非所有制造业工厂都受欧盟排放交易体系的排放定价约束，我们发现了排放泄漏的证据：发电活动从受监管的发电厂转移至未受监管的制造业工厂。
10.1257/pol.20240794.title: Climate Policies and Electricity Prices: Why Abate When You Can Generate?
10.1257/pol.20240794.title_zh: 气候政策与电价：为何不减排而选择发电？

10.1257/pol.20240808.abstract: What is the impact and value of hurricane forecasts? We study this question using the universe of landfalling US hurricanes between 2005–2022. We find that forecasts drive adaptive protective expenditures, and that erroneous underforecasts result in a significant increase in total hurricane damage. Using a theoreticallygrounded approach for estimating the marginal value of forecast improvements, we find that improvements since 2007, after the implementation of a national policy to improve hurricane forecasts, have reduced total costs by 19%, averaging $2 billion per hurricane. These benefits far exceed the annual budget of the policy and of all federal weather forecasting.
10.1257/pol.20240808.abstract_zh: 飓风预报的影响与价值何在？我们以2005年至2022年间登陆美国的所有飓风为研究对象，发现预报能够驱动适应性防护支出，而错误的低估预报会导致飓风总损失显著增加。通过基于理论的方法估算预报改进的边际价值，我们发现自2007年实施国家飓风预报改进政策以来，预报质量的提升使总成本降低了19%，平均每次飓风减少20亿美元损失。这些收益远超该政策年度预算及联邦所有气象预报的年度总投入。
10.1257/pol.20240808.title: The Social Value of Hurricane Forecasts

10.1257/pol.20240812.abstract: Governments increasingly use changes in tax rules to combat evasion. We develop a general approach to point-identify tax compliance along with supply and demand elasticities. Identification requires data on prices and quantities, variation in tax policy, and a demand or supply shifter. We illustrate our approach using data on Airbnb collection agreements, where taxes are enforced by shifting the statutory burden away from hosts and onto renters via the platform. We find that taxes are paid on roughly zero to 1.6 percent of Airbnb transactions prior to enforcement.
10.1257/pol.20240812.abstract_zh: 政府越来越多地通过调整税收规则来打击逃税行为。我们提出了一种通用方法，用于点识别税收合规性以及供需弹性。识别过程需要价格和数量数据、税收政策的变化以及需求或供给的变动因素。我们利用Airbnb代收协议的数据来展示这一方法，在该协议中，税收通过将法定负担从房东转移至租客（经由平台）得以强制执行。研究发现，在强制执行前，Airbnb交易中约有0%至1.6%的税款被缴纳。
10.1257/pol.20240812.title: Identifying Tax Compliance from Variation in Tax Policy: Theory and Empirics
10.1257/pol.20240812.title_zh: 从税收政策变化中识别税收遵从：理论与实证

10.1257/pol.20240813.abstract: This paper assesses the effects of corporate tax cuts on small firms and their workers. Following a reform in Quebec, Canada, firms receiving tax cuts expand and their workers' earnings increase com- pared to workers and firms without tax cuts. We estimate that overall workers bear 35 percent of the tax burden, with larger inci- dence falling on those with ownership in the companies they work through increased profits. Additionally, workers across each ter- cile of the within-firm earnings distribution beneffit from tax cuts, possibly because fair-wage concerns matter when after-tax profits rise due to close interactions among workers in small corporate environments.
10.1257/pol.20240813.abstract_zh: 本文评估了企业减税对小企业及其员工的影响。基于加拿大魁北克省的一项改革，享受减税政策的企业规模扩大，其员工收入相较于未受减税政策影响的企业及员工有所增长。我们估算，员工整体承担了35%的税负，其中更大比例的税负通过利润增长落到了持有所在企业股权的员工身上。此外，在企业内部收入分布的各三分位组中，员工均从减税中获益，这可能是因为在小企业环境中员工间的密切互动使得公平工资关切在税后利润上升时发挥了作用。
10.1257/pol.20240813.title: Impacts of Corporate Tax Cuts on Firms and Workers: Evidence from Small Businesses
10.1257/pol.20240813.title_zh: 企业减税对企业与工人的影响：来自小企业的证据

10.1257/pol.20240814.abstract: This paper measures how cost-sharing impacts older low-income patients, exploiting a disconti-nuity in eligibility for a prescription drug subsidy for those who lose access to the Medicaid-linked program. Higher drug prices resulting from subsidy loss lead to a 40% reduction in prescription expenditures, driven by a 16% quantity reduction of prescriptions filled. Patients economize on purchases of higher-priced drugs, irrespective of their health benefits. For example, patients re-duce insulin purchases by 35%. There is no evidence that cost-sharing prompts switching from branded drugs to generics. This behavior suggests that cost-sharing reduces prescription accessibility without enhancing cost-effectiveness.
10.1257/pol.20240814.abstract_zh: 本文利用与医疗补助计划挂钩的处方药补贴资格中断现象，测度成本分摊对老年低收入患者的影响。补贴资格丧失导致药价上涨，使处方药支出减少40%，其中处方药配药量下降16%是主要驱动因素。患者会减少高价药品的购买，而不考虑其健康效益。例如，患者将胰岛素购买量减少35%。没有证据表明成本分摊会促使患者从品牌药转向仿制药。这一行为表明，成本分摊在未提升成本效益的情况下，反而降低了处方药的可及性。
10.1257/pol.20240814.title: Prioritizing Benefit? How Low-Income Patients Respond to Prescription Cost-Sharing
10.1257/pol.20240814.title_zh: 优先考虑收益？低收入患者如何应对处方费用分摊

10.1257/pol.20240815.abstract: Each year, about a thousand public schools in the US close, displacing hundreds of thousands of students. I examine the impact of public school closures on displaced students using linked schooling and labor market data from Texas. Using within-school acrosstime/ cohort variation in exposure to school closures, I implement difference-in-differences strategies to identify causal effects. I find that school closures decrease test scores, increase absenteeism, and lead to more disciplinary actions. Furthermore, school closures decrease high school completion, college attainment, employment, and earnings at ages 25–27. These impacts are larger for secondary school students and those from economically disadvantaged backgrounds.
10.1257/pol.20240815.abstract_zh: 美国每年约有上千所公立学校关闭，导致数十万学生被迫转学。本文利用德克萨斯州关联的学校教育与劳动力市场数据，考察公立学校关闭对受影响学生的影响。通过利用同一学校内不同时期/年级群体受学校关闭影响程度的差异，我采用双重差分策略识别因果效应。研究发现：学校关闭导致学生考试成绩下降、缺勤率上升，并引发更多纪律处分。此外，学校关闭还降低了学生在25-27岁期间的高中毕业率、大学入学率、就业率及收入水平。这些影响对中学生及经济弱势背景学生更为显著。
10.1257/pol.20240815.title: The Long Shadow of School Closures: Impacts on Students’ Educational and Labor Market Outcomes
10.1257/pol.20240815.title_zh: 学校关闭的长期阴影：对学生教育与劳动力市场结果的影响

10.1257/pol.20240830.abstract: We investigate whether removing a previously-obtained criminal record improves employment outcomes. We estimate the causal impact of criminal record remediation laws that have been widely enacted with the goal of improving employment opportunities for millions of individuals with records. We find consistent evidence that removing an existing record does not improve labor market outcomes, on average. A notable exception is participation in gig work through online platforms, which often screen workers based on their records but not their employment histories. The evidence is consistent with records initially scarring labor market trajectories in a way that is difficult to undo later.
10.1257/pol.20240830.abstract_zh: 我们研究了消除先前犯罪记录是否能改善就业结果。我们评估了旨在改善数百万有犯罪记录者就业机会而广泛实施的犯罪记录补救法的因果影响。研究发现，一致证据表明，消除现有记录平均而言并未改善劳动力市场结果。一个显著的例外是通过在线平台参与零工工作，这些平台通常根据犯罪记录而非就业历史筛选工作者。证据表明，犯罪记录最初会以难以事后弥补的方式损害劳动力市场轨迹。
10.1257/pol.20240830.title: Can You Erase the Mark of a Criminal Record? Labor Market Impacts of Criminal Record Remediation
10.1257/pol.20240830.title_zh: 能否抹去犯罪记录的印记？犯罪记录修复对劳动力市场的影响

10.1257/pol.20240883.abstract: Recent firm-level studies find R&D tax incentives to be much more effective at stimulating firms’ R&D investment than aggregate analyses suggest. Based on a distributed analysis of official R&D survey and administrative tax relief microdata for 19 OECD countries, we show that two factors can reconcile these contrasting results. Firstly, the limited uptake of R&D tax incentives in most countries makes aggregate studies underestimate the effectiveness of R&D tax incentives. Secondly, R&D tax incentives are (much) less effective for large and R&D-intensive firms, which account for a small share of R&D-performing firms but most aggregate R&D tax relief.
10.1257/pol.20240883.abstract_zh: 近期基于企业层面的研究发现，研发税收激励对刺激企业研发投资的效力远高于宏观分析所显示的水平。通过对19个OECD国家官方研发调查数据与行政税收减免微观数据的分布式分析，我们揭示两个因素可调和上述矛盾结论：其一，多数国家研发税收激励的有限采用率导致宏观研究低估其有效性；其二，研发税收激励对大型及高研发密集型企业（虽仅占研发企业的小部分，却集中了大部分宏观研发税收减免）的效力显著偏低。
10.1257/pol.20240883.title: How Effective Are R&D Tax Incentives? Reconciling the Micro and Macro Evidence
10.1257/pol.20240883.title_zh: 研发税收激励的有效性如何？调和微观与宏观证据

10.1257/pol.20240889.abstract: This paper shows that retailers increase prices in response to organized retail crime. We match store-level crime data to scanner data from the universe of transactions for cannabis retailers in Washington state. Using quasi-experimental variation from robberies and burglaries, we find a 1.7-1.8% price increase at victimized stores and nearby competitors. This rise is not driven by short-to-medium-term demand changes but is consistent with crime-related cost shocks. Effects are larger for independent stores and less concentrated markets. We estimate that crime imposes a 1% ‘hidden’ unit tax on affected stores, implying $30.7 million additional social costs, primarily borne by consumers.
10.1257/pol.20240889.abstract_zh: 本文表明，零售商在应对有组织零售犯罪时会提高价格。我们将门店层面的犯罪数据与华盛顿州大麻零售商的全量交易扫描数据相匹配。利用抢劫和入室盗窃带来的准实验性变化，我们发现受害门店及其附近竞争对手的价格上涨了1.7%-1.8%。这一价格上涨并非由短期至中期的需求变化驱动，而是与犯罪相关的成本冲击相一致。独立门店及市场集中度较低的区域受影响更大。我们估算，犯罪对受影响门店施加了1%的“隐性”单位税，这意味着额外社会成本达3070万美元，主要由消费者承担。
10.1257/pol.20240889.title: The Pass-Through of Retail Crime

10.1257/pol.20240893.abstract: We combine detailed information on US temporary trade barriers during 1989-2020 with input-output data to study the effects of trade protection along supply chains. We focus on measures imposed against China, which has been the main target of trade protection during the last decades. To deal with endogeneity concerns, we use an instrumental variable strategy, exploiting changes in the identity of swing states across presidential terms and heterogeneous exposure to these political shocks across industries. We find that politically motivated trade protection generates winners and losers: it fosters employment growth in protected industries, but hampers employment growth in downstream industries.
10.1257/pol.20240893.abstract_zh: 我们结合1989-2020年美国临时贸易壁垒的详细信息与投入产出数据，研究贸易保护在供应链中的影响。重点关注针对中国的措施——过去几十年间，中国一直是贸易保护的主要目标。为应对内生性问题，我们采用工具变量策略，利用总统任期更迭中摇摆州身份的变化以及各行业对这些政治冲击的异质性暴露程度。研究发现，政治驱动的贸易保护产生了赢家与输家：它促进了受保护行业的就业增长，但抑制了下游行业的就业增长。
10.1257/pol.20240893.title: Trade Protection Along Supply Chains

10.1257/pol.20240899.abstract: This paper investigates how federal oversight not precipitated by a major scandal influences policing behavior and public safety. The high-profile events triggering such scandals can independently affect policing and crime, confounding estimates of oversight effects. I examine a 2011 federal investigation into the Seattle Police Department. In response to the heightened scrutiny from the investigation, officers immediately and significantly reduced stops, particularly suspicious-activity and traffic stops in minority neighborhoods. These reductions had no detectable effect on public safety. I conclude that federal oversight implemented in the absence of scandals may lower the social cost of policing.
10.1257/pol.20240899.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了并非由重大丑闻引发的联邦监督如何影响警务行为与公共安全。触发此类丑闻的高关注度事件可能独立影响警务与犯罪，从而混淆监督效应的估计。我研究了2011年对西雅图警察局的联邦调查。为应对调查带来的高度关注，警员立即显著减少了拦截行为，尤其是在少数族裔社区的嫌疑活动拦截和交通拦截。这些减少对公共安全未产生可察觉的影响。我得出结论：在无丑闻背景下实施的联邦监督可能降低警务的社会成本。
10.1257/pol.20240899.title: What Does Federal Oversight Do to Policing and Public Safety? Evidence from Seattle
10.1257/pol.20240899.title_zh: 联邦监督对警务与公共安全有何影响？来自西雅图的证据

10.1257/pol.20240903.abstract: We study the economic effects of transfers to local governments using a reform of the Finnish municipal grant system as a source of exogenous variation. We find that higher grants lead to lower municipal taxes and fees, higher public spending and improved budget balance. These changes in local fiscal policy lead to an increase in private sector jobs. Our estimates imply a cost per job of e33,000. The increase in jobs is paired with a reduction in commuting to other municipalities. The effect on migration seems small, suggesting grants bring local benefits without drastically affecting where households choose to live.
10.1257/pol.20240903.abstract_zh: 我们利用芬兰市政拨款制度改革作为外生变动的来源，研究了对地方政府转移支付的经济效应。研究发现，更高的拨款导致市政税费降低、公共支出增加以及预算平衡改善。这些地方财政政策的变化带来了私营部门就业岗位的增加。我们的估算显示，每个就业岗位的成本为33,000欧元。就业增长的同时，通勤至其他市镇的人数有所减少。对迁移的影响似乎较小，这表明拨款在带来地方利益的同时，并未显著改变家庭居住地的选择。
10.1257/pol.20240903.title: Fiscal Transfers to Local Governments and the Distribution of Economic Activity
10.1257/pol.20240903.title_zh: 财政转移支付与地方经济活动分布

10.1257/pol.20250007.abstract: To reduce Russia’s funding for its Ukraine invasion, Western governments imposed, after a delay, a price ceiling on Russian seaborne oil exports utilizing Western services. To evade that ceiling, Russia developed a “shadow fleet” using no such services. We simulate a calibrated model driven by this fleet’s expansion to assess various sanctions. Mainly, sanctions—from a price ceiling to its extreme service ban version—significantly reduce the present value of Russia’s profits. However, tighter price caps will not necessarily harm Russia if they raise the world price. Shortening the delay between sanctions announcement and implementation can harm Russia more.
10.1257/pol.20250007.abstract_zh: 为削减俄罗斯对乌克兰战争的资金支持，西方政府经延迟后对依赖西方服务的俄罗斯海运石油出口实施价格上限。为规避该上限，俄罗斯组建了不使用此类服务的"影子船队"。我们通过校准模型模拟该船队扩张情景，评估各类制裁措施的效果。主要发现：从价格上限到其极端版本的服务禁令，各类制裁均显著降低俄罗斯利润现值。然而，若更严格的价格上限推高全球油价，则未必对俄罗斯造成损害。缩短制裁宣布与实施之间的延迟期，可对俄罗斯造成更大打击。
10.1257/pol.20250007.title: The Dynamics of Evasion: The Price Cap on Russian Oil Exports and the Amassing of the Shadow Fleet
10.1257/pol.20250007.title_zh: 逃避的动态：俄罗斯石油出口价格上限与影子舰队扩张

10.1257/pol.20250265.abstract: Public programs that provide benefits through private markets contend with strategic firm behavior. We study this dynamic in Medicare Part D. The Affordable Care Act closed a coverage gap in Part D by mandating drug manufacturers cover 50% of branded drug costs in the gap. Beneficiaries became 5 percentage points less likely to forgo prescriptions upon reaching the gap. However, manufacturers' response led to 21% higher drug prices, partially offsetting the insurance expansion. The closure was intended to be a $100 transfer to beneficiaries financed by manufacturers, but instead resulted in a $55 transfer to beneficiaries financed by the government.
10.1257/pol.20250265.abstract_zh: 通过私人市场提供福利的公共项目需应对企业的策略性行为。我们以联邦医疗保险D部分为研究对象，分析这一动态机制。《平价医疗法案》通过强制要求药品制造商承担覆盖缺口内品牌药50%的成本，填补了D部分的保障缺口。受益人在进入覆盖缺口后放弃处方的概率降低了5个百分点。然而，制造商的应对措施导致药品价格上涨21%，部分抵消了保险覆盖扩大的效果。该缺口填补政策本意是由制造商出资向受益人转移100美元，但最终演变为由政府出资向受益人转移55美元。
10.1257/pol.20250265.title: The Effect of Public Insurance Design on Pharmaceutical Prices: Evidence from Medicare Part D
10.1257/pol.20250265.title_zh: 公共保险设计对药品价格的影响：来自医疗保险D部分的证据

10.1257/pol.20250309.abstract: This paper studies the impacts of administrative burdens across multiple welfare programs and application stages via an increasingly widespread phenomenon: the automation of caseworker assistance. Leveraging a natural experiment phased in across Indiana’s counties and administrative records for 3 million recipients, we find that SNAP, TANF, and Medicaid enrollments fell by 15%, 24%, and 4% after automation. Heterogeneous declines are attributable to cross-program differences in recertification costs. Needier individuals exited while less needy individuals were screened out at entry, potentially reconciling some conflicting results in the literature and best understood through a dynamic selection model of certification and recertification.
10.1257/pol.20250309.abstract_zh: 本文通过日益普遍的行政自动化现象，研究跨多个福利项目及申请阶段的行政负担影响。利用印第安纳州各县分阶段实施的自然实验及300万受助者的行政记录，我们发现自动化后，SNAP、TANF和Medicaid的注册人数分别下降了15%、24%和4%。异质性下降可归因于不同项目在重新认证成本上的差异。需求更迫切的个体退出，而需求较低的个体在进入阶段被筛选排除，这一发现可能调和了文献中部分相互矛盾的结果，并通过认证与重新认证的动态选择模型得以最佳解释。
10.1257/pol.20250309.title: Certification and Recertification in Welfare Programs: What Happens When Automation Goes Wrong?
10.1257/pol.20250309.title_zh: 福利项目中的认证与再认证：自动化出错时会发生什么？

10.1257/pol.20250324.abstract: Given labor informality in developing countries, addressing employment shocks is challenging. We study Indonesia’s new approach for on-demand online applications for temporary cash assistance and online job training. Through 20 lotteries over two years, 11 million beneficiaries were selected. In nationwide, representative surveys matched with administrative data, most beneficiaries report not receiving the assistance, with no detectable impacts on employment or consumption. In contrast, survey data from applicants with working phones reveal high reported take-up and higher incomes. The results suggest that while flexible, on-demand assistance has potential, design features that allow for flexibility could hinder receipt and, thus, impact.
10.1257/pol.20250324.abstract_zh: 鉴于发展中国家普遍存在的非正规就业现象，应对就业冲击颇具挑战性。我们研究了印度尼西亚针对临时现金援助和在线职业培训的新型按需在线申请模式。通过两年间20轮抽签，共筛选出1100万受益人。在匹配行政数据的全国代表性调查中，多数受益人报告未收到援助，且未发现对就业或消费产生可检测的影响。相比之下，对拥有可用电话的申请者进行的调查数据显示，其报告领取率较高且收入水平更高。研究结果表明，尽管灵活的按需援助具有潜力，但允许灵活性的设计特征可能阻碍实际领取，进而影响政策效果。
10.1257/pol.20250324.title: On-Demand Assistance: Experimental Evidence from Indonesia
10.1257/pol.20250324.title_zh: 按需援助：来自印度尼西亚的实验证据

10.1257/pol.20250505.title: Index-Based Price Adjustment in US Strategic Petroleum Reserve Drawdowns
10.1257/pol.20250505.title_zh: 美国战略石油储备释放中基于指数的价格调整

10.1257/pol.20250543.abstract: We evaluate a guaranteed job program in Austria in 2020–2024. Our evaluation is based on three approaches, pairwise matched randomization, a pre-registered synthetic control at the municipality level, and a comparison to individuals in control municipalities. This allows us to estimate direct effects, anticipation effects, and spillover effects. We find positive impacts on economic and non-economic wellbeing. At the municipality level, we find a reduction of long-term unemployment and no negative employment spillovers. There are positive anticipation effects on well-being, status, and social inclusion. We estimate program costs of 237 Euro per participant and month. Participant income increased by 102 Euro.
10.1257/pol.20250543.abstract_zh: 我们评估了奥地利2020-2024年的一项保障就业项目。该评估基于三种方法：配对匹配随机化、预先注册的市级合成控制法，以及与对照市镇个体的比较。这使我们能够估计直接效应、预期效应和溢出效应。研究发现，该项目对经济和非经济福祉均产生了积极影响。在市级层面，长期失业率有所下降，且未发现负面的就业溢出效应。预期效应对福祉、社会地位和社会融入产生了积极影响。我们估算的项目成本为每位参与者每月237欧元，参与者收入增加了102欧元。
10.1257/pol.20250543.title: Employing the Unemployed of Marienthal: Evaluation of a Guaranteed Job Program
10.1257/pol.20250543.title_zh: 利用马里恩塔尔的失业者：一项保障就业计划的评估

10.1257/pol.20250583.abstract: This paper characterizes the optimal taxation of top earners in a world with externalities. It develops a reduced-form approach that allows for a flexible relationship between top earnings and the distribution of earnings capacities in the population. The optimal top tax rate is expressed in terms of simple sufficient statistics formulas that depend on the magnitude and distribution of net externalities. In general, externalities that run from top earners to bottom earners have much stronger policy implications than externalities within top earners. The theory is linked to evidence on the externalities of top entrepreneurs and a calibration analysis is provided.
10.1257/pol.20250583.abstract_zh: 本文刻画了存在外部性时对高收入者的最优税收政策。研究提出了一种简化形式方法，允许高收入群体收入与人群收入能力分布之间存在灵活关系。最优高收入税率通过简单的充分统计量公式表达，该公式取决于净外部性的规模与分布。一般而言，从高收入者流向低收入者的外部性比高收入群体内部的外部性具有更强的政策含义。本文将理论与顶级企业家外部性的实证证据相联系，并提供了校准分析。
10.1257/pol.20250583.title: Externalities and the Taxation of Top Earners
10.1257/pol.20250583.title_zh: 外部性与高收入者税收

10.1257/pol.20250610.abstract: Preparing young people for citizenship is a foundational purpose of public education, yet little is known about whether or how K-12 schools impact civic engagement. Using education, birth, and voting records for nine cohorts of students in Indiana, I estimate and assess the validity of high school e!ects on voting. School e!ects on voting are significant and practically meaningful: a one standard deviation increase in school civic e!ects increases the probability of voting by 2.1 percentage points (5.3 percent) and also predicts increases in voter registration and times voting. School civic e!ects are positively associated with peer parental civic norms.
10.1257/pol.20250610.abstract_zh: 培养年轻人的公民意识是公共教育的基本目标，但关于K-12学校是否以及如何影响公民参与的研究仍十分有限。本研究利用印第安纳州九届学生的教育、出生及投票记录数据，对高中教育对投票行为的影响效应进行估计与效度评估。研究发现，学校对投票行为的影响具有显著的实际意义：学校公民教育效应每提升一个标准差，学生投票概率将提高2.1个百分点（增幅达5.3%），同时选民登记率与投票次数也呈现增长趋势。学校公民教育效应与同伴家长的公民规范呈正相关关系。
10.1257/pol.20250610.title: High School Effects on Civic Engagement
10.1257/pol.20250610.title_zh: 高中教育对公民参与的影响

10.1257/pol.20250924.abstract: Can African countries deter industrial fishing vessels from near-shore waters reserved for artisanal fishers? Using radar data released in 2024, this paper provides the first causal evaluation of these Inshore Exclusion Zones (IEZs). Regression discontinuity estimates reveal deterrence in 6 of 20 African countries. Next, we apply bunching estimators to obtain counterfactual vessel distributions uncontaminated by spillovers outside IEZ boundaries. We capture extensive-margin effects by calibrating a discrete choice vessel location model to our bunching estimates. Bioeconomic calculations indicate that IEZs increase artisanal fisher catch by enough to meet key micronutrient requirements for 7 million people.
10.1257/pol.20250924.abstract_zh: 非洲国家能否阻止工业渔船进入为手工渔民保留的近岸水域？本文利用2024年发布的雷达数据，首次对这些近岸禁渔区（IEZs）进行了因果效应评估。断点回归估计结果显示，在20个非洲国家中有6个国家产生了威慑效应。随后，我们应用聚束估计量获取了不受禁渔区边界外溢出效应污染的反事实船舶分布。通过将离散选择船舶定位模型校准至聚束估计结果，我们捕捉了集约边际效应。生物经济核算表明，近岸禁渔区使手工渔民的渔获量增加幅度足以满足700万人的关键微量营养素需求。
10.1257/pol.20250924.title: Deterring Industrial Vessels from African Coastal Fisheries
10.1257/pol.20250924.title_zh: 阻止工业渔船进入非洲沿海渔业

10.1596/1813-9450-11196.abstract: This paper provides insights into human capital investments during wartime by presenting evidence from 3 experiments of an online tutoring program for Ukrainian students amid Russia's invasion. Conducted between 2023 and 2024, the experiments reached 10,000 students across Ukraine. The program offered 3 hours per week of small-group tutoring in math and Ukrainian language over 6 weeks, and used academic and psychosocial tools to address student challenges at different intensities of disruption. Results show that the program led to substantial improvements in learning—0.49 standard deviations in math and 0.40 standard deviations in Ukrainian language—and consistent reductions in stress—0.12 standard deviations. High take-up and engagement rates were observed, and 4 mechanisms were identified as drivers of impact: structured peer interactions, improved attitudes toward learning, enhanced socio-emotional skills, and increased student investments. A complementary experiment using information nudges highlights challenges in promoting parental investments in a conflict setting. The program was cost-effective, with benefit-to-cost ratios ranging from 31-56, and scalable given its reliance on existing infrastructure and capacity.
10.1596/1813-9450-11196.abstract_zh: 本文通过介绍俄罗斯入侵期间针对乌克兰学生的在线辅导项目的三项实验证据，揭示了战时人力资本投资的深层机制。实验于2023至2024年间开展，覆盖乌克兰各地10,000名学生。该项目每周提供3小时、为期6周的小组辅导（数学与乌克兰语），并运用学术与心理社会工具应对不同强度干扰下的学生困境。结果显示：项目显著提升了学业表现——数学成绩提高0.49个标准差，乌克兰语成绩提高0.40个标准差——同时持续降低压力水平（0.12个标准差）。研究观察到较高的参与率与投入度，并识别出四种驱动机制：结构化同伴互动、学习态度改善、社会情感技能提升及学生投资增加。一项采用信息助推的补充实验揭示了冲突情境下促进家长投资的挑战。该项目具有成本效益，收益成本比介于31至56之间，且依托现有基础设施与能力具备可扩展性。
10.1596/1813-9450-11196.title: Investing in Human Capital During Wartime: Experimental Evidence from Ukraine
10.1596/1813-9450-11196.title_zh: 战时人力资本投资：来自乌克兰的实验证据

10.1596/1813-9450-11384.title_zh: 社会情感技能是否有回报以及能否通过培训发展？一项元分析

10.1596/1813-9450-11385.abstract: This paper studies the interaction of the contribution-benefit link with tax evasion in the context of parental benefits in Hungary and Latvia. Across the two countries, institutional settings, and time periods, earnings and employment patterns suggest substantial pre-pregnancy underreporting, followed by partial formalization during pregnancy to increase benefits. Using policy reforms, the paper shows that the reporting response tracks changing incentives. The results indicate that even with third-party reporting, income underreporting can be common. Linking benefits to contributions when earnings are underreported may reduce evasion temporarily but can impose net fiscal costs depending on program design.
10.1596/1813-9450-11385.abstract_zh: 本文研究了匈牙利和拉脱维亚育儿福利背景下，缴费-福利关联与逃税行为的相互作用。在两国的制度环境与时间跨度中，收入与就业模式显示，孕前存在大量低报收入现象，而孕期则出现部分正规化以增加福利。通过政策改革分析，本文证明申报行为随激励变化而调整。结果表明，即便存在第三方报告机制，收入低报仍可能普遍存在。当收入被低报时，将福利与缴费挂钩虽能暂时减少逃税，但根据项目设计不同，可能产生净财政成本。

10.1596/1813-9450-11408.abstract: This study analyzes the impact of the Romania Secondary Education Project, which was designed to improve student retention, graduation rates and pass rates on a national end-of-high-school exam for low-achievement high schools in Romania. The program was implemented in three waves, September 2017, September 2018, and September 2020, with eligible high schools randomly assigned to each. The study exploits this staggered implementation to measure the project’s causal impacts on students. The estimates indicate that the Romania Secondary Education Project had no significant impact on (i) student preferences for attending a program high school, (ii) student retention rates, (iii) high school graduation rates, (iv) enrollment in the post-high school baccalaureate exam, (v) baccalaureate exam pass rates, or (vi) baccalaureate exam scores. There was a small increase in girls’ passing rates (3 percentage points). However, there was little heterogeneity in the null effects by grant size, urban-rural status, student achievement levels, town income levels, and type of curriculum taught.
10.1596/1813-9450-11408.abstract_zh: 本研究分析了罗马尼亚中等教育项目的影响，该项目旨在提高罗马尼亚低学业表现高中的学生保留率、毕业率及全国高中毕业会考的通过率。该项目分三批实施（2017年9月、2018年9月和2020年9月），符合条件的高中被随机分配到各批次。研究利用这种分阶段实施机制来测量项目对学生的因果效应。估计结果表明，罗马尼亚中等教育项目对以下指标均无显著影响：（i）学生对就读项目高中的偏好，（ii）学生保留率，（iii）高中毕业率，（iv）高中后学士学位考试注册率，（v）学士学位考试通过率，以及（vi）学士学位考试成绩。女生通过率略有提升（3个百分点）。然而，按补助金额、城乡状况、学生学业水平、城镇收入水平及课程类型划分的零效应异质性极小。
10.1596/1813-9450-11408.title: The Impact of School Grants on Disadvantaged Students: Experimental Evidence from Romania
