10.1596/1813-9450-11409.abstract: This study investigates taxpayer responses to tax compliance interventions undertaken in collaboration with Ethiopia’s revenue authority, focusing on gender differences among business owners. The research targeted a sample of 5,408 business owners, and the interventions—letters highlighting tax obligations and civic responsibilities—were successfully implemented with 3,551 participants. The interventions involved letters emphasizing tax obligations and civic duties and were evaluated through a randomized controlled trial across diverse economic sectors and sub-city locations. Data from quantitative surveys and administrative records provided information about reported tax declarations and compliance behaviors. The findings indicate a balance in key variables before the intervention, with notable impacts of the intervention on reported profit tax declarations. While examining gender differences in tax compliance, the study found no differential effects of the intervention based on business owners’ gender. Specifically, the result shows that the difference in tax compliance between male and female business owners is not statistically significant at both intensive and extensive margins. This indicates that gender did not play a meaningful role in influencing tax compliance as a result of the intervention.
10.1596/1813-9450-11409.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了与埃塞俄比亚税务机关合作实施的税收合规干预措施中纳税人的反应，重点关注企业主的性别差异。研究以5,408名企业主为样本，成功对3,551名参与者实施了干预措施——即强调纳税义务和公民责任的信函。这些干预措施通过随机对照试验在多个经济部门和城区进行效果评估，信函内容着重强调纳税义务与公民责任。定量调查数据与行政记录提供了关于申报纳税额和合规行为的信息。研究结果显示，干预前关键变量保持均衡，且干预措施对申报利润税产生了显著影响。在考察税收合规的性别差异时，研究发现干预措施对企业主性别未产生差异化效应。具体而言，结果显示男性与女性企业主在税收合规方面的差异在集约边际和广延边际上均不具有统计显著性。这表明性别并未因干预措施而对税收合规产生实质性影响。
10.1596/1813-9450-11409.title: Do Information-Based Interventions Influence Tax Compliance Differently across Men and Women? Experimental Evidence from Ethiopia
10.1596/1813-9450-11409.title_zh: 信息干预对男性和女性纳税遵从度的影响是否不同？来自埃塞俄比亚的实验证据

10.1596/1813-9450-11410.abstract: Climate change is increasing the frequency and intensity of extreme weather events. When these events occur, they threaten lives and livelihoods. This paper estimates the global population at high risk of climate-related hazards by combining household-level vulnerability data with local exposure to four types of events: agricultural droughts in rural areas, floods, heatwaves, and cyclones. Under current climate conditions, 4.5 billion people are expected to experience these hazards at intensities exceeding hazard-specific thresholds chosen to capture the likely occurrence of systemic impacts within a lifetime. One-third of this population is considered highly vulnerable, based on seven dimensions that influence ability to cope and recover: income, education, access to finance, social protection, drinking water, electricity, and access to services and markets. Overall, one in five people globally are considered at high risk, meaning they are both likely to experience at least one of these hazards and face severely limited capacity to recover from their impacts. Although the share of the global population at high risk has nearly halved since 2010 due to decreased vulnerability, the number of people exposed has increased, and progress has been uneven across regions. This study introduces a new global population headcount indicator based on household survey data and high-resolution spatial data to monitor climate risks across countries and over time.
10.1596/1813-9450-11410.abstract_zh: 气候变化正加剧极端天气事件的频率与强度。当这些事件发生时，它们威胁着生命与生计。本文通过将家庭层面的脆弱性数据与四种类型事件（农村地区的农业干旱、洪水、热浪和热带气旋）的局部暴露度相结合，估算了全球面临气候相关灾害高风险的人口规模。在当前气候条件下，预计有45亿人将经历超过特定灾害阈值的极端事件——这些阈值旨在捕捉一生中可能发生的系统性影响。其中三分之一的人口被视为高度脆弱，这一判断基于影响其应对与恢复能力的七个维度：收入、教育、金融可及性、社会保障、饮用水、电力以及服务与市场可及性。总体而言，全球每五人中有一人被认为处于高风险状态，即他们既可能经历至少一种此类灾害，又面临严重受限的灾后恢复能力。尽管自2010年以来，由于脆弱性降低，全球高风险人口比例已近乎减半，但暴露于灾害的人口数量有所增加，且各区域的进展并不均衡。本研究基于家庭调查数据和高分辨率空间数据，引入了一项新的全球人口计数指标，用于跨国家、跨时间地监测气候风险。
10.1596/1813-9450-11410.title: Transportation Infrastructure and Total Factor Productivity: Development Heterogeneity and Resilience under Adverse Shocks
10.1596/1813-9450-11410.title_zh: 交通基础设施与全要素生产率：不利冲击下的发展异质性与韧性

10.1596/1813-9450-11411.abstract: This paper examines how federal science and engineering research funding—although intended to advance research—affects degree production and programs offered in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM). Using data from 1971–2016, the study implements a triple-difference design that exploits variation across colleges, time, and fields of study. The findings show that federal grants generate 27.4 percent of doctorates and 14.7 percent of undergraduate science, technology, engineering, and mathematics degrees, as well as 6.3 percent of doctoral programs and 3.7 percent of undergraduate programs in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics annually across 200 U.S. research universities. The impacts are concentrated in biology and engineering, aligning with the priorities of major funders such as the Department of Health and Human Services, the National Science Foundation, and the Department of Defense. These findings suggest that research grants to universities may generate a “double dividend,” simultaneously expanding the supply of skilled labor in targeted fields while also advancing scientific discovery.
10.1596/1813-9450-11411.abstract_zh: 本文考察了联邦科学与工程研究资助——尽管其初衷是推动研究——如何影响科学、技术、工程和数学领域的学位产出与项目设置。基于1971年至2016年的数据，本研究采用三重差分设计，利用学院、时间和学科领域的差异进行分析。结果显示，在美国200所研究型大学中，联邦资助每年贡献了27.4%的博士学位、14.7%的本科STEM学位，以及6.3%的博士项目和3.7%的本科STEM项目。这些影响主要集中在生物学和工程学领域，与卫生与公众服务部、国家科学基金会和国防部等主要资助方的优先方向一致。研究结果表明，对大学的研究资助可能产生“双重红利”，在推动科学发现的同时，也扩大了目标领域熟练劳动力的供给。
10.1596/1813-9450-11411.title: Federal Research Funding and STEM Education

10.1596/1813-9450-11412.abstract: This paper reexamines aid effectiveness using ex-post economic rates of return from 2,500 World Bank–financed infrastructure projects over six decades. Three facts emerge. First, average value creation is high: the mean economic rate of return is 24 percent (median 18.5 percent). Second, returns rise over time: after relative stability through the mid‑1980s, economic rates of return increased from the late 1980s onward, consistent with improved selection, design, and delivery. Third, economic rates of return are systematically higher in countries with weak institutions. In such countries, high-quality World Bank performance is associated with about a 12‑point increase in the average economic rate of return. A plausible mechanism is talent deployment. Higher‑quality task team leaders are disproportionately assigned to the most challenging contexts and linked to faster time‑to‑effectiveness and higher economic rates of return, despite longer, more intensive implementation. Overall, alongside country fundamentals, World Bank performance and talent deployment materially raise returns to scarce capital—especially where governance is weak.
10.1596/1813-9450-11412.abstract_zh: 本文利用世界银行60年间2500个基础设施项目的事后经济回报率，重新审视援助有效性。研究发现三个事实：第一，平均价值创造水平较高——经济回报率均值为24%（中位数为18.5%）；第二，回报率随时间递增——在20世纪80年代中期前保持相对稳定后，自80年代末起经济回报率持续上升，这与项目筛选、设计及交付质量的改善相吻合；第三，制度薄弱国家的经济回报率系统性更高。在此类国家中，世界银行的高质量绩效可使平均经济回报率提升约12个百分点。其潜在机制在于人才配置：更优质的项目团队负责人被不成比例地分配到最具挑战性的环境中，尽管面临更长周期、更高强度的实施过程，却能显著缩短项目见效时间并提升经济回报率。总体而言，除国家基本面因素外，世界银行的绩效表现与人才配置能实质性提升稀缺资本的回报率——尤其在治理薄弱地区效果更为显著。
10.1596/1813-9450-11412.title: Learning at Scale: Infrastructure, Aid Effectiveness, and World Bank Performance
10.1596/1813-9450-11412.title_zh: 大规模学习：基础设施、援助有效性与世界银行绩效

10.1596/1813-9450-11413.abstract: In fragile, conflict-affected, and violent contexts, decentralization is widely promoted to improve service delivery and strengthen the social contract by shifting power closer to citizens. However, empirical evidence on whether these reforms deliver in environments marked by weak state capacity and low institutional trust remains limited. This paper evaluates Mali’s Project for the Deployment of State Resources for the Improvement of Services program, which implemented performance-based conditional grants across 102 communes between 2021 and 2024. Drawing on administrative budget data and georeferenced Afrobarometer survey data, the study assesses the impacts of performance-based conditional grants on local fiscal performance, service delivery, and institutional legitimacy. The results show that a 1 percent increase in performance-based conditional grant allocations is associated with a 1.2 percent increase in investment expenditures and measurable improvements in budget balances. Expenditures were reallocated toward social sectors (education, health, water, and agriculture), consistent with program objectives. A difference-in-differences analysis points to statistically significant increases in citizen satisfaction with public services, particularly health (+2.6 percentage points), water and sanitation (+1.4), and education (+1.0), as well as an 18.4-point rise in trust in municipal councils. Institutional “spillover” effects extended to the national level, with trust in the presidency and parliament increasing by 9.1 and 7.3 points, respectively. A scenario-based cost-effectiveness analysis points to potentially substantial returns under the stated assumptions. Illustrative estimates suggest that observed trust gains could be associated with USD 57 million to USD 141 million in additional annual tax revenues, equivalent to 1.1 to 2.8 times the program’s total cost, through enhanced voluntary compliance—assuming a transmission of trust into compliance broadly consistent with parameters in the literature. These findings are consistent with the view that well-designed performance-based transfers may improve service outcomes and contribute to rebuilding public trust in fragile, conflict-affected, and violent contexts, with effects that appear to extend beyond the local level. Policy implications include considering institutionalization of the performance-based conditional grants within Mali’s fiscal architecture and the design of a medium-term roadmap for sustainability and possible scale-up.
10.1596/1813-9450-11413.abstract_zh: 在脆弱、受冲突影响及暴力频发的环境中，分权改革被广泛推广，旨在通过将权力下放至公民层面来改善公共服务供给并强化社会契约。然而，关于此类改革在政府能力薄弱、制度信任度低的环境中能否取得成效，现有实证证据仍然有限。本文评估了马里2021至2024年间在102个市镇实施的"国家资源部署以改善服务项目"中的绩效挂钩有条件拨款计划。基于行政预算数据与地理参照的非洲晴雨表调查数据，本研究评估了绩效挂钩有条件拨款对地方财政绩效、公共服务供给及制度合法性的影响。结果显示：绩效挂钩有条件拨款每增加1%，投资支出相应增长1.2%，预算平衡状况出现可测度的改善。支出向教育、卫生、水利和农业等社会领域重新配置，这与项目目标一致。双重差分分析表明，公民对公共服务的满意度出现统计显著的提升——卫生服务满意度提高2.6个百分点，供水和卫生设施满意度提高1.4个百分点，教育满意度提高1.0个百分点；同时，对市镇议会的信任度上升18.4个百分点。制度"溢出效应"延伸至国家层面，对总统和议会的信任度分别提升9.1和7.3个百分点。基于情景的成本效益分析显示，在既定假设条件下可能产生可观回报。估算表明，通过增强自愿纳税遵从度，观察到的信任增益可能带来每年5700万至1.41亿美元的额外税收收入，相当于项目总成本的1.1至2.8倍——这一估算假设信任向遵从度的传导机制与文献参数基本一致。这些发现支持以下观点：设计良好的绩效挂钩转移支付能够改善服务成效，并有助于在脆弱、受冲突影响及暴力频发的环境中重建公众信任，其影响似乎超越地方层面。政策启示包括：考虑将绩效挂钩有条件拨款纳入马里财政架构的制度化设计，并制定中期路线图以保障可持续性及可能的推广。
10.1596/1813-9450-11413.title: Decentralization, Service Delivery, and Legitimacy: The Case of Mali
10.1596/1813-9450-11413.title_zh: 分权、服务提供与合法性：以马里为例

10.1596/1813-9450-11414.abstract: This paper synthesizes country-level decomposition evidence on the gender gap in agricultural productivity across Sub-Saharan Africa, identifying its major drivers and reviewing what works to close it. Gender productivity gaps range between 7 percent and 77 percent across twelve African countries, with male-managed plots yielding higher outputs than those managed by women. Although controlling for the characteristics of farmers, households and plots tends to shrink this gap, a conditional gap of 4 percent to 62 percent persists. The literature also documents an overall gender gap in agricultural production in the range of 18 percent to 61 percent. The largest driver of these gaps is women’s concentration in lower-value crops, followed by their lower use of and returns from labor. Social norms and access to land and financial resources play a crucial role in sustaining and exacerbating these gender disparities. Evidence suggests that targeted programmatic approaches to increasing women’s adoption of cash crops, enhancing their use of labor and other inputs and providing them with tailored skills and information can help close the gender gap in agricultural productivity.
10.1596/1813-9450-11414.abstract_zh: 本文综合了撒哈拉以南非洲地区农业生产力性别差距的国家层面分解证据，识别其主要驱动因素，并回顾了缩小该差距的有效措施。在十二个非洲国家中，性别生产力差距介于7%至77%之间，男性管理的地块产出高于女性管理的地块。尽管控制农户、家庭和地块特征后，这一差距有所缩小，但条件性差距仍维持在4%至62%之间。文献还记录了农业生产中18%至61%的总体性别差距。这些差距的最大驱动因素是女性集中于低价值作物，其次是她们对劳动力的使用较少且回报较低。社会规范以及土地和金融资源的获取在维持和加剧这些性别差异中起着关键作用。证据表明，通过有针对性的项目方法提高女性对经济作物的采用、增强其劳动力及其他投入的使用，并提供量身定制的技能和信息，有助于缩小农业生产力中的性别差距。
10.1596/1813-9450-11414.title: The Agricultural Gender Gap in Sub-Saharan Africa: Magnitude, Drivers, and Policy Directions
10.1596/1813-9450-11414.title_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲的农业性别差距：规模、驱动因素与政策方向

10.1596/1813-9450-11415.abstract: This paper provides the first firm-level assessment of agglomeration economies in Mongolia, focusing on Ulaanbaatar, the country’s dominant urban center. Using data from the 2021 Enterprise Census, the paper estimates total factor productivity for a large sample of enter-prises and examines its relationship with localization, urban diversity, and peer productivity. The results indicate robust positive agglomeration effects, alongside suggestive evidence of diminishing returns to localization consistent with an inverted U-shaped pattern. These non-linearities are most apparent in Ulaanbaatar and in manufacturing, although they prove sensitive to alternative agglomeration and productivity measures. Although the cross-sectional nature of the data limits causal inference, the analysis offers new micro-level evidence on how spatial concentration interacts with congestion, infrastructure strain, and potential spatial misallocation. The findings underscore the importance of urban planning, infrastructure investment, and the development of regional hubs to sustain productivity growth in Mongolia’s highly concentrated urban system, with implications for diversification beyond mining in resource-dependent economies.
10.1596/1813-9450-11415.abstract_zh: 本文首次从企业层面评估蒙古国的集聚经济效应，重点关注该国主导城市中心乌兰巴托。利用2021年企业普查数据，本文估算了大量样本企业的全要素生产率，并考察其与本地化经济、城市多样性及同行生产率之间的关系。结果表明，存在稳健的正向集聚效应，同时有迹象显示本地化经济存在递减收益，符合倒U型模式。这些非线性特征在乌兰巴托及制造业中最为显著，但对替代性集聚指标与生产率指标的敏感性较高。尽管数据的横截面性质限制了因果推断，但分析为空间集中如何与拥挤效应、基础设施压力及潜在的空间错配相互作用提供了新的微观证据。研究结果凸显了城市规划、基础设施投资及区域中心建设对维持蒙古国高度集中城市体系中生产率增长的重要性，并对资源依赖型经济体实现矿业以外的多元化发展具有启示意义。
10.1596/1813-9450-11415.title: Beyond the Urban Sweet Spot: Firm-Level Evidence of Over-Agglomeration in Mongolia’s Capital
10.1596/1813-9450-11415.title_zh: 超越城市甜点：蒙古首都过度集聚的企业层面证据

10.1596/1813-9450-11416.abstract: Recognizing that macroeconomic conditions determine aggregate trade imbalances, can tariffs eliminate bilateral trade deficits? The Balanced Trade Tariff Index (BTTI) is introduced as the uniform tariff that closes bilateral deficits while holding macroeconomic conditions fixed. The BTTI depends on bilateral, product-level import demand elasticities estimated using a translog GDP function applied to data from seven major economies. The novel elasticity estimates vary widely across importers, exporters, products, and trade directions. This heterogeneity lowers average implied tariffs relative to homogeneous-elasticity benchmarks, yet implies substantially higher tariffs are required for exporters of inelastic products, underscoring the limits of tariffs for balancing trade.
10.1596/1813-9450-11416.abstract_zh: 认识到宏观经济状况决定总体贸易失衡，关税能否消除双边贸易逆差？本文提出平衡贸易关税指数（BTTI），将其定义为在保持宏观经济条件不变的前提下消除双边逆差的统一关税。该指数依赖于基于超越对数GDP函数估算的双边产品层面进口需求弹性，数据涵盖七大主要经济体。新型弹性估计值在进口国、出口国、产品及贸易方向上呈现显著异质性。相较于同质性弹性基准，这种异质性降低了平均隐含关税水平，但意味着对非弹性产品出口国需征收更高关税，凸显了关税在平衡贸易方面的局限性。
10.1596/1813-9450-11416.title: Bilateral Import Demand Elasticities and Balanced Trade Protection
10.1596/1813-9450-11416.title_zh: 双边进口需求弹性与平衡贸易保护

10.1596/1813-9450-11417.abstract: Markets and public institutions must anticipate evolving care demand driven by East Asia and the Pacific’s exceptionally rapid demographic transition. To this end, this paper develops the Care Simulation Model, a demographic model that estimates gaps in childcare and eldercare needs. By integrating publicly available demographic data, the model captures both care needs and the availability of family caregivers across life cycles and cohorts, allowing the assessment of how demographic shifts may change reliance on family-based care. The paper quantifies unmet family care needs and translates them into estimates of potential market size, defined as the share of households likely to require care services outside the family and the corresponding potential employment creation in childcare and eldercare. By 2030, the childcare needs of an estimated 25 percent of households and the eldercare needs of 7 percent of households in ASEAN-5 countries may not be met within the family. After accounting for family availability and current care employment, the unmet need across 21 countries in East Asia and the Pacific translates into a potential gap of 19.9 million jobs in childcare and 34.1 million jobs in eldercare. The model offers a transparent, cross-country framework to inform care policy, workforce planning, and investment strategies.
10.1596/1813-9450-11417.abstract_zh: 市场和公共机构必须应对东亚及太平洋地区异常快速的人口转型所驱动的不断变化的照护需求。为此，本文开发了照护模拟模型，这是一种估算儿童照护和老年人照护需求缺口的人口模型。通过整合公开可得的人口数据，该模型捕捉了生命周期和队列中的照护需求及家庭照护者的可得性，从而评估人口结构变化如何改变对家庭照护的依赖。本文量化了未满足的家庭照护需求，并将其转化为潜在市场规模估计，定义为可能需要家庭外照护服务的家庭比例，以及儿童照护和老年人照护中相应的潜在就业创造。到2030年，东盟五国中约25%家庭的儿童照护需求和7%家庭的老年人照护需求可能无法在家庭内部得到满足。在考虑家庭可得性和当前照护就业后，东亚及太平洋地区21个国家的未满足需求转化为儿童照护领域1990万个潜在就业缺口和老年人照护领域3410万个潜在就业缺口。该模型提供了一个透明的跨国框架，为照护政策、劳动力规划和投资策略提供信息。
10.1596/1813-9450-11417.title: The Potential Market for Care in East Asia and Pacific
10.1596/1813-9450-11417.title_zh: 东亚及太平洋地区照护服务的潜在市场

10.1596/1813-9450-11418.abstract: Most students in developing countries receive grade-level instruction despite lacking prerequisite skills, a mismatch that widens learning gaps as students progress. This paper reports evidence from a randomized controlled trial across 38 classrooms and 1,333 ninth-grade students in the Dominican Republic, in which classrooms were randomly assigned to one of three arms: computer-adaptive learning (CAL) software replacing two of seven weekly mathematics hours, CAL combined with small-group tutoring, or a business-as-usual control. CAL improved test scores by 0.29–0.31 standard deviations over six months, among the larger effects documented for education technology interventions in developing countries. Adding small-group tutoring yielded no detectable improvement over CAL alone; if anything, classrooms assigned to both interventions showed smaller gains than those receiving CAL alone, though this difference is not statistically significant. Evidence on mechanisms indicates that tutoring classrooms exhibited reduced engagement with the CAL platform. These results suggest that computer-adaptive learning software can be effectively integrated into classroom instruction to improve learning at scale, but that combining multiple interventions is not guaranteed to produce additive benefits and may instead generate unintended behavioral responses that offset their effectiveness.
10.1596/1813-9450-11418.abstract_zh: 发展中国家多数学生虽缺乏必要先修技能，却仍接受年级水平教学，这种不匹配随着学业推进加剧了学习差距。本文基于多米尼加共和国38个班级、1333名九年级学生的随机对照试验证据，将班级随机分配至三组：每周七小时数学课时中两小时替换为计算机自适应学习（CAL）软件、CAL结合小组辅导、或常规教学对照组。六个月后，CAL使测试成绩提升0.29–0.31个标准差，这一效果在发展中国家教育技术干预研究中属于较大效应。相较于单独使用CAL，增加小组辅导未带来可检测的改善；相反，接受双重干预的班级成绩提升幅度甚至低于仅使用CAL的班级，尽管该差异未达统计显著性。机制证据表明，辅导班级学生对CAL平台的参与度有所降低。这些结果表明，计算机自适应学习软件可有效融入课堂教学以实现规模化学习改善，但多重干预的组合未必产生叠加效益，反而可能引发非预期的行为反应，抵消其有效性。
10.1596/1813-9450-11418.title: Improving Student Outcomes through Adaptive Learning Platforms: Experimental Evidence from the Dominican Republic
10.1596/1813-9450-11418.title_zh: 通过自适应学习平台提升学生成绩：来自多米尼加共和国的实验证据

10.1596/1813-9450-11419.abstract: This paper examines the local effects of the 2018–19 U.S.-China trade disruptions on Mexico. Combining detailed municipal-level customs data with U.S. tariff schedules, it estimates that municipalities with greater export concentration in products targeted by U.S. tariffs on China (hereafter, tariff exposure) experienced significantly larger nearshoring dividends. An increase of 1 percent in tariff exposure led to a 4.3 percent increase in municipality-level exports to the United States, with gains concentrated in northern and south-central states. These export gains translated into broad labor market improvements: total labor income rose by 5.6 percent for each 1 percent increase in tariff exposure, driven by job creation rather than wage growth as average earnings remained unchanged. The effects were heterogeneous across skill levels, with the largest employment rate gains among semi-skilled workers. Beyond job quantity, the shock improved job quality: each 1 percent increase in tariff exposure reduced labor informality by 0.25 percentage points, with newly created jobs disproportionately being formal. Effects were driven primarily by manufacturing but extended to services through local spillovers. The findings indicate that trade policy changes between major economies can significantly reshape the spatial distribution of economic activity and the quantity and quality of jobs in third-party countries.
10.1596/1813-9450-11419.abstract_zh: 本文研究了2018-2019年中美贸易摩擦对墨西哥的本地影响。通过将市级海关数据与美国关税清单相结合，本文估算发现，在美国对华加征关税所针对的产品中（以下简称关税暴露度），出口集中度越高的城市，其获得的近岸外包红利显著更大。关税暴露度每增加1%，城市对美出口额增长4.3%，且增长集中在北部和中南部各州。这些出口增长转化为广泛的劳动力市场改善：关税暴露度每增加1%，劳动总收入增长5.6%，这一增长由就业创造驱动而非工资上涨，因为平均收入保持不变。不同技能水平的影响存在异质性，半熟练工人的就业率增幅最大。除就业数量外，冲击还提升了就业质量：关税暴露度每增加1%，非正规就业比例下降0.25个百分点，且新增就业岗位中正规就业占比显著更高。影响主要来自制造业，但通过本地溢出效应延伸至服务业。研究结果表明，主要经济体之间的贸易政策变化能够显著重塑第三方国家的经济活动空间分布以及就业数量与质量。
10.1596/1813-9450-11419.title: Trade Diversion and Jobs: Evidence from Mexican Municipalities
10.1596/1813-9450-11419.title_zh: 贸易转移与就业：来自墨西哥城市的证据

10.1596/1813-9450-11420.abstract: This paper investigates the impact of informal competition—defined as competition faced by formal firms from informal enterprises—on the firm-provided worker training among formal manufacturing small and medium-sized enterprises. Using a representative dataset of small and medium-sized manufacturing firms in 23 Sub-Saharan African countries, a sizable negative impact is found. A one-standard-deviation increase in informal competition reduces the probability that a firm offers training to its workers by 8.7 to 12.9 percentage points, relative to the sample mean of firms that offer training of approximately 25 percent. Comparable declines are observed in the share of workers receiving training. To address potential endogeneity, the paper employs several complementary strategies. First, an instrumental-variables strategy leverages variation in the number of children aged 0–4 and 5–9 years per working-age woman to generate exogenous shifts in informal competition. Second, heterogeneity is examined through tests derived from the “legalist” view of informality, which predicts bigger adverse effects of informal competition in environments characterized by a weaker rule of law and more stringent business regulations. Third, information about firms in other world regions is used to construct out-of-sample predictions of informal competition at the sector level. The findings suggest that informal competition is a substantial constraint on the training investments of formal firms, underscoring the need for policy responses that mitigate its adverse consequences.
10.1596/1813-9450-11420.abstract_zh: 本文研究了非正规竞争——即正规企业面临的来自非正规企业的竞争——对正规制造业中小企业提供的员工培训的影响。基于23个撒哈拉以南非洲国家中小型制造企业的代表性数据集，发现非正规竞争对员工培训存在显著的负面影响。非正规竞争每增加一个标准差，企业为员工提供培训的概率将下降8.7至12.9个百分点，而样本中提供培训的企业均值约为25%。员工接受培训的比例也出现了类似的下降。为解决潜在的内生性问题，本文采用了多种互补策略。首先，利用工具变量法，通过每名育龄妇女对应的0-4岁和5-9岁儿童数量的变化，生成非正规竞争的外生变动。其次，基于非正规经济的“合法主义”观点进行异质性检验，该观点预测在法治较弱、商业监管更严格的环境中，非正规竞争的负面影响更大。第三，利用其他地区企业的信息，构建行业层面非正规竞争的样本外预测。研究结果表明，非正规竞争严重制约了正规企业的培训投资，凸显了制定政策以减轻其负面影响的必要性。
10.1596/1813-9450-11420.title: Does Informal Competition Reduce Firm-Provided Worker Training among Formal Manufacturing SMEs in Sub-Saharan Africa?
10.1596/1813-9450-11420.title_zh: 非正式竞争是否减少了撒哈拉以南非洲正规制造业中小企业提供的员工培训？

10.1596/1813-9450-11421.abstract: Insecure land rights and limited access to modern inputs are often seen as key constraints on smallholder investment in Sub-Saharan Africa. This paper studies both in a three-year field experiment with women farmers in Mozambique, cross-randomizing a statutory land registration intervention with a subsidized package of agricultural inputs and climate-smart agriculture training, and eliciting willingness to pay for the package at randomized prices. Demand for registration was high, but its effects were limited: it produced only a temporary gain in perceived tenure security and did not raise willingness to pay for inputs or down-stream investment. Despite gender-targeted titling, it also did not improve women’s intra-household security or decision-making power. The input-and-training package raised input use but reduced harvests, with exploratory evidence of a shift toward a more shock-prone crop; the losses persisted even after households fully reverted to pre-program practices. Consistent with negative social learning, non-recipients with more treated network connections also reduced their adoption of climate-smart practices over time. Relaxing both constraints together produced no effects beyond either intervention alone.
10.1596/1813-9450-11421.abstract_zh: 不稳定的土地权利和现代投入品的有限获取常被视为撒哈拉以南非洲小农投资的关键制约因素。本文通过对莫桑比克女性农民开展为期三年的实地实验，将法定土地登记干预与补贴性农业投入品及气候智慧型农业培训进行交叉随机化处理，并在随机定价条件下测度农户对投入品组合的支付意愿。土地登记需求虽高，但其效果有限：仅带来感知土地权属保障的暂时性提升，既未提高对投入品的支付意愿，也未促进后续投资。尽管实施性别定向的土地确权，该干预仍未能改善女性在家庭内部的保障状况或决策权。投入品与培训组合虽提高了投入品使用量，却导致收成下降——探索性证据表明农户转向更易受冲击的作物品种；即便家庭完全恢复至项目前耕作模式，损失仍持续存在。与非受益者中拥有更多受干预社交网络联系的农户随时间推移减少气候智慧型实践采用的现象一致，这印证了负面社会学习效应。同时放松两类约束并未产生超越单一干预的叠加效果。
10.1596/1813-9450-11421.title: Property Rights, Agricultural Technology Adoption, and Investment: Experimental Evidence from Mozambique
10.1596/1813-9450-11421.title_zh: 产权、农业技术采纳与投资：来自莫桑比克的实验证据

10.1596/1813-9450-11422.abstract: This study makes a significant contribution to the expanding body of literature on the energy-growth nexus, distinguishing itself in two important ways. First, this is the first meta-analysis that systematically compares the economic growth impacts of renewable versus nonrenewable energy sources, instead of relying on aggregate energy indicators. Second, it explicitly explores the heterogeneity of these effects in the context of developing countries. These elasticities exhibit notable nonlinearity, following a U-shaped pattern across stages of development. In low-income countries, the relatively higher elasticity for both energy types likely reflects the critical need to expand access, regardless of the source. As countries move up the income ladder, the elasticity of renewables tends to decline, potentially reflecting short-term frictions and adjustments associated with the integration of intermittent sources, and comes to a plateau for high-income countries. In contrast, fossil fuels may remain essential in higher-income contexts for supporting grid stability and storage as renewable energy becomes more integrated. The findings underscore the need for customized energy policies that correspond to each country's economic development stage. In low-income countries, policies should focus on expanding access to affordable and reliable energy sources. In developed economies, policies should aim to encourage innovations in clean energy technologies and support technology transfer to developing countries, assisting them in sustainably meeting their energy requirements for economic growth.
10.1596/1813-9450-11422.abstract_zh: 本研究对能源与经济增长关系的文献体系做出了重要贡献，其独特性体现在两个方面。首先，这是首项系统比较可再生能源与不可再生能源对经济增长影响的元分析研究，而非依赖总体能源指标。其次，本研究明确探讨了发展中国家情境下这些影响的异质性特征。这些弹性系数呈现显著的非线性特征，在经济发展阶段中呈U型分布。在低收入国家，两种能源类型均表现出相对较高的弹性，这很可能反映了无论能源来源如何，扩大能源可及性的迫切需求。随着国家收入水平提升，可再生能源弹性趋于下降，这或许反映了间歇性能源整合过程中的短期摩擦与调整，并在高收入国家趋于平稳。相比之下，在可再生能源整合程度加深的背景下，化石燃料在高收入经济体中对维持电网稳定性和储能仍具关键作用。研究结果强调，能源政策需根据各国经济发展阶段进行定制化设计。在低收入国家，政策应聚焦于扩大可负担且可靠能源的可及性；在发达经济体，政策应着力于激励清洁能源技术创新，并支持向发展中国家进行技术转移，协助其以可持续方式满足经济增长所需的能源需求。
10.1596/1813-9450-11422.title: Assessing the Impact of Renewable versus Fossil Fuels Energy on Economic Growth: A Meta-Analysis of the Elasticity across Development Stages
10.1596/1813-9450-11422.title_zh: 可再生能源与化石燃料能源对经济增长影响的评估：基于发展阶段弹性的元分析

10.1596/1813-9450-11423.abstract: This paper studies a randomized controlled trial in which undocumented Venezuelan migrants in Colombia were assigned to receive informational videos via WhatsApp encouraging registration in a regularization program. The intervention backfired. Receiving a video reduced take-up by 8 percentage points, a 15 percent decline relative to the control mean. The negative effect operated through two channels. Among individuals who watched, exposure to procedural content discouraged registration. Among those who did not engage, unsolicited contact itself reduced take-up. Both effects were concentrated among individuals at the margin of the decision to participate. These findings challenge the assumption that well-designed informational nudges are, at worst, neutral.
10.1596/1813-9450-11423.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一项随机对照试验，其中哥伦比亚境内的无证委内瑞拉移民被随机分配接收通过WhatsApp发送的鼓励其参与正规化计划注册的信息视频。该干预措施产生了反效果。接收视频使参与率降低了8个百分点，相较于对照组均值下降了15%。这一负面效应通过两个渠道发挥作用：在观看视频的个体中，接触程序性内容抑制了注册行为；在未观看视频的个体中，未经请求的接触本身降低了参与率。两种效应均集中于处于参与决策边缘的群体。这些发现挑战了"精心设计的信息助推措施至多仅具中性效果"的假设。
10.1596/1813-9450-11423.title: When Digital Nudges Nag: Evidence on Program Take-up from a WhatsApp Intervention
10.1596/1813-9450-11423.title_zh: 当数字助推变成唠叨：来自WhatsApp干预的项目参与证据

10.1596/1813-9450-11424.abstract: Multidimensional poverty metrics offer a more complete picture of poverty than monetary poverty, yet their adoption has been limited by data constraints. Often not all dimensions in a multidimensional measure are observed in the same survey, leading to countries being excluded from global measures. This study introduces a novel data fusion approach to estimate multidimensional poverty metrics by combining summary statistics from multiple data sources. The proposed method is validated by simulating typical missing data scenarios using 571 household surveys from 112 countries (1989–2024) to estimate the World Bank’s Multidimensional Poverty Measure. The fusion method accurately predicts various multidimensional poverty metrics across these scenarios, even in the presence of simulated sample bias reflecting differences in survey design. It enables estimates of multidimensional poverty for a greater number of countries, gap-filling in time series, and the inclusion of previously unavailable indicators and dimensions in global multidimensional poverty measures.
10.1596/1813-9450-11424.abstract_zh: 多维贫困指标相比货币贫困能更全面地反映贫困状况，但其应用受限于数据约束。由于多维贫困指标中的各个维度往往无法在同一项调查中完整观测，导致许多国家被排除在全球性贫困测度之外。本研究提出一种创新的数据融合方法，通过整合多个数据源的汇总统计量来估算多维贫困指标。该方法利用112个国家（1989-2024年）的571项家庭调查数据，通过模拟典型数据缺失场景对世界银行多维贫困测度进行验证。结果表明，即便在存在反映调查设计差异的模拟样本偏差时，该融合方法仍能准确预测各类多维贫困指标。该方法不仅能够为更多国家提供多维贫困估算，填补时间序列数据缺口，还能将此前无法获取的指标和维度纳入全球多维贫困测度体系。
10.1596/1813-9450-11424.title: Fusing Data Sources to Measure Multidimensional Poverty
10.1596/1813-9450-11424.title_zh: 融合数据源以衡量多维贫困

10.1596/1813-9450-11425.abstract: This paper uses artificial intelligence-enhanced agent computing to determine how to allocate budgetary resources within a large set of heterogeneous government programs targeting human capital. The approach considers essential features of the budget allocation process: multidimensionality, interdependencies between policy issues, and the political economy of public officials' collective action. The analysis uses highly disaggregated Mexican data covering the 2016-2022 period across 49 federal government human capital programs. It focuses on how expenditure affects program coverage, defined as the share of the population with a public problem and that has access to various government benefits to mitigate those problems, in the short run. The paper answers three research questions. First, how sensitive is program coverage to changes in public expenditure? Second, what are the structural bottlenecks behind poor coverage response? Third, what are the optimal budgetary allocations that could boost the performance of a multidimensional objective function?
10.1596/1813-9450-11425.abstract_zh: 本文运用人工智能增强型智能体计算方法，探讨如何在针对人力资本的大量异质性政府项目中分配预算资源。该方法考虑了预算分配过程的核心特征：多维性、政策议题间的相互依存性，以及公共官员集体行动的政治经济学因素。分析采用2016-2022年期间墨西哥49个联邦政府人力资本项目的高度细化数据，重点研究支出如何影响项目覆盖率——即存在公共问题且能获得各类政府福利以缓解问题的人口比例——的短期效应。本文回答三个研究问题：第一，项目覆盖率对公共支出变化的敏感度如何？第二，导致覆盖率响应不足的结构性瓶颈是什么？第三，能够提升多维目标函数绩效的最优预算分配方案是什么？
10.1596/1813-9450-11425.title: Human Capital Expenditure and Its Effectiveness on Multi-Program Coverage: A Policy Prioritization Investigation
10.1596/1813-9450-11425.title_zh: 人力资本支出及其对多项目覆盖率的有效性：一项政策优先序研究

10.17016/feds.2006.20.abstract: this paper, we reexamine the role of key elements of the inflation targeting framework towards this end, in the context of an economy where economic agents have an imperfect understanding of the macroeconomic landscape within which the public forms expectations and policymakers must formulate and implement monetary policy. Using an estimated model of the U.S. economy, we show that monetary policy rules that would perform well under the assumption of rational expectations can perform very poorly when we introduce imperfect knowledge. We then examine the performance of an easily implemented policy rule that incorporates three key characteristics of inflation targeting: transparency, commitment to maintaining price stability, and close monitoring of inflation expectations, and find that all three play an important role in assuring its success. Our analysis suggests that simple difference rules in the spirit of Knut Wicksell excel at tethering inflation expectations to the central bank?s goal and in so doing achieve superior stabilization of inflation and economic activity in an environment of imperfect knowledge.
10.17016/feds.2006.20.abstract_zh: 本文重新审视了通胀目标框架中关键要素的作用，研究对象设定为经济主体对宏观经济环境存在不完全认知的经济体——在此环境中，公众形成预期，政策制定者必须制定并实施货币政策。通过使用美国经济估计模型，我们证明：在理性预期假设下表现良好的货币政策规则，在引入不完全知识后可能表现极差。随后，我们检验了一种易于实施的政策规则的表现，该规则包含通胀目标的三个核心特征：透明度、维持价格稳定的承诺以及对通胀预期的密切监测。研究发现，这三个特征对其成功实施均具有重要作用。我们的分析表明，遵循克努特·维克塞尔精神的简单差分规则，在将通胀预期锚定至央行目标方面表现卓越，从而在不完全知识环境下实现了通胀与经济活动的更优稳定。

10.17016/feds.2026.009.abstract: We examine prospective classification of crypto currencies risks within the ISDA Standardized Initial Margin Model (SIMM) framework for calculation of initial margin on trades sensitive to cryptocurrencies’ risk factors in the uncleared market. Consistent with the view that cryptocurrencies are digital assets that fundamentally rely on distributed ledger technology (DLT) and induce financial risks that are significantly different from those in traditional risk classes like commodities or FX, we find that cryptocurrencies are best classified into a distinct risk class within SIMM that is split into two buckets – pegged and floating (unpegged) crypto currencies as risk factors - and suggest risk weights’ calibration methodology within the cryptocurrencies risk class that is consistent with the existing approaches adopted in SIMM.
10.17016/feds.2026.009.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在ISDA标准化初始保证金模型（SIMM）框架下，对未清算市场中受加密货币风险因子影响的交易进行初始保证金计算时，加密货币风险的预期分类问题。基于加密货币本质上是依赖分布式账本技术（DLT）的数字资产，且其引发的金融风险与商品或外汇等传统风险类别存在显著差异这一观点，我们发现加密货币在SIMM中最适合归入一个独立的风险类别，该类别进一步划分为两个子类——锚定型与浮动型（非锚定型）加密货币作为风险因子——并提出了加密货币风险类别内的风险权重校准方法，该方法与SIMM现有方法保持一致。
10.17016/feds.2026.009.title: Initial Margin for Crypto Currencies Risks in Uncleared Markets
10.17016/feds.2026.009.title_zh: 未清算市场中加密货币风险的初始保证金

10.17016/feds.2026.010.abstract: Prediction markets offer a new market-based approach to measuring macroeconomic expectations in real-time. We evaluate the accuracy of prediction market-implied forecasts from Kalshi, the largest federally regulated prediction market overseen by the CFTC. We compare Kalshi with more traditional survey and market-implied forecasts, examine how expectations respond to macroeconomic and financial news, and how policy signals are interpreted by market participants. Our results suggest that Kalshi markets provide a high-frequency, continuously updated, distributionally rich benchmark that is valuable to both researchers and policymakers.
10.17016/feds.2026.010.abstract_zh: 预测市场提供了一种基于市场的新方法，用于实时衡量宏观经济预期。我们评估了由CFTC监管的、美国最大的联邦监管预测市场Kalshi所隐含预测的准确性。我们将Kalshi与传统调查及市场隐含预测进行比较，考察预期如何对宏观经济和金融新闻做出反应，以及市场参与者如何解读政策信号。研究结果表明，Kalshi市场提供了一个高频、持续更新、分布信息丰富的基准，对研究人员和政策制定者均具有重要价值。
10.17016/feds.2026.010.title: Kalshi and the Rise of Macro Markets

10.17016/feds.2026.011.abstract: This paper describes the current U.S. dollar interbank payments landscape and identifies its key characteristics. It then discusses major considerations and potential tradeoffs that various conceptual alternatives might raise.
10.17016/feds.2026.011.abstract_zh: 本文描述了当前美元银行间支付格局，并指出了其主要特征。随后，本文探讨了各种概念性替代方案可能引发的主要考量因素及潜在权衡。
10.17016/feds.2026.011.title: Contrasting Ledgers: Considerations for U.S. Dollar Interbank Payment Systems
10.17016/feds.2026.011.title_zh: 对比账本：对美元银行间支付系统的思考

10.17016/feds.2026.012.abstract: Does fair lending litigation impact mortgage lender decisions? Using a novel dataset of all fair lending legal actions from 1991 to 2023, we find that it does. In the wake of legal settlements for discrimination against Black borrowers, lenders significantly reduced denial rates for Black applicants. The reductions offset pre-litigation racial disparities in denial rates by litigated banks, relative to those banks' competitors. Origination rates for Black applicants also increased post-litigation. We further observe evidence of a spillover effect on the approval decisions of non-litigated banks operating in the same city as a litigated bank. Altogether, the evidence suggests that the enforcement of fair lending laws is an effective tool to reduce racial discrimination in credit markets.
10.17016/feds.2026.012.abstract_zh: 公平贷款诉讼是否影响抵押贷款机构的决策？利用1991年至2023年所有公平贷款法律诉讼的新数据集，我们发现确实存在影响。在针对黑人借款人的歧视性法律和解后，贷款机构显著降低了黑人申请人的拒绝率。与诉讼银行的竞争对手相比，这些拒绝率的下降抵消了诉讼银行在诉讼前存在的种族差异。诉讼后，黑人申请人的贷款发放率也有所上升。我们进一步观察到，在同一城市运营的非诉讼银行的审批决策存在溢出效应。总体而言，证据表明，公平贷款法律的执行是减少信贷市场种族歧视的有效工具。
10.17016/feds.2026.012.title: Enforcing Fair Lending: Evidence from Mortgage Market Litigation
10.17016/feds.2026.012.title_zh: 执行公平贷款：来自抵押贷款市场诉讼的证据

10.17016/feds.2026.021.abstract: We revisit the credit channel of monetary policy when firms face multiple financing constraints. Our theory shows that the multiplicity of constraints dampens the transmission of expansionary policy to firm borrowing and investment notably but amplifies the transmission of policy tightening. This asymmetry arises because, when policy tightens (eases), the most (least) responsive constraint binds. Using U.S. firm-level data and exploiting a quasi-natural experiment, we find strong support for these predictions. Embedding the mechanism into a New Keynesian framework, we find that the drop in investment after contractionary shocks is twice as large as its increase following equally-sized expansionary shocks.
10.17016/feds.2026.021.abstract_zh: 我们重新审视了当企业面临多重融资约束时货币政策的信贷渠道。我们的理论表明，约束的多重性显著削弱了扩张性政策向企业借贷和投资的传导，但放大了政策收紧的传导效应。这种不对称性源于，当政策收紧（放松）时，最（不）敏感的约束起主导作用。利用美国企业层面数据并借助准自然实验，我们为这些预测找到了有力支持。将该机制嵌入新凯恩斯框架后，我们发现，紧缩性冲击后投资的下降幅度是同等规模扩张性冲击后投资上升幅度的两倍。
10.17016/feds.2026.021.title: Monetary Policy under Multiple Financing Constraints
10.17016/feds.2026.021.title_zh: 多重融资约束下的货币政策

10.17016/feds.2026.028.abstract: In an ample-reserves framework, administered rates anchor money markets but suppress information from unsecured interbank trading. We recover that information by isolating the small interbank segment of the federal funds market. Using high-frequency bank-level data, we employ deposit shocks as an instrument for bank borrowing demand. Our analysis reveals that non-bank lenders, such as Federal Home Loan Banks, supply funds elastically, whereas bank lenders exhibit price inelasticity, which intensifies as their reserve balances decline, particularly for bankers’ banks. This interbank segment highlights distributional frictions in the federal funds market that emerge well before aggregate reserves become scarce and provides new evidence on monetary policy transmission in an ample-reserves regime.
10.17016/feds.2026.028.abstract_zh: 在充裕准备金框架下，管理利率锚定货币市场，但抑制了无担保银行间交易的信息。我们通过隔离联邦基金市场中规模较小的银行间部分来恢复这些信息。利用高频银行层面数据，我们将存款冲击作为银行借款需求的工具变量。分析揭示，非银行贷方（如联邦住房贷款银行）弹性供应资金，而银行贷方则表现出价格非弹性，且随着其准备金余额下降而加剧，尤其是对银行家的银行而言。这一银行间部分凸显了联邦基金市场中在总准备金变得稀缺之前就已出现的分配摩擦，并为充裕准备金制度下的货币政策传导提供了新证据。
10.17016/feds.2026.028.title: A Tale of Demand and Supply for Central Bank Reserves
10.17016/feds.2026.028.title_zh: 中央银行准备金需求与供给的故事

10.17016/feds.2026.030.abstract: We study the rise of nonbank financial intermediation and its implications for systemic risk. We develop a structural network model of banks and nonbank financial institutions (NBFIs) that decomposes intermediation into a capacity channel, driven by bank balance-sheet constraints, and a reliance channel, reflecting NBFI funding reliance. Using U.S. banking confidential supervisory data, we estimate key structural parameters and quantify both channels. We find that fluctuations in bank-NBFI intermediation are primarily explained by the reliance channel, with variation in NBFI fragility emerging as the dominant driver. We show that NBFI intermediation can amplify shocks through funding interconnectedness.
10.17016/feds.2026.030.abstract_zh: 我们研究了非银行金融中介的兴起及其对系统性风险的影响。我们构建了一个包含银行和非银行金融机构（NBFIs）的结构性网络模型，将中介活动分解为容量渠道（由银行资产负债表约束驱动）和依赖渠道（反映NBFI融资依赖）。利用美国银行保密监管数据，我们估计了关键结构性参数，并量化了这两个渠道。我们发现，银行-NBFI中介活动的波动主要由依赖渠道解释，其中NBFI脆弱性的变化成为主导驱动因素。我们表明，NBFI中介通过融资互联性可能放大冲击。
10.17016/feds.2026.030.title: Bank Regulation and the Rise of Nonbank Intermediation
10.17016/feds.2026.030.title_zh: 银行监管与非银行中介的兴起

10.17016/ifdp.2010.1013.abstract: It is customary to suggest that the asymmetry in the transmission of oil price shocks to real output is well established. Much of the empirical work cited as being in support of asymmetries, however, has not directly tested the hypothesis of an asymmetric transmission of oil price innovations. Moreover, many of the papers quantifying these asymmetric responses are based on censored oil price VAR models which recently have been shown to be invalid. Other studies are based on dynamic correlations in the data that do not shed light on the central question of whether the structural responses of real output triggered by positive and negative oil price innovations are asymmetric. Recently, a number of new methodologies have been introduced and applied to the problem of testing and quantifying asymmetric responses of U.S. real economic activity to positive and negative oil price innovations. Our objective is to put this literature in perspective, to contrast it with more traditional approaches, to highlight directions for further research, and to reconcile some seemingly conflicting results reported in the literature.
10.17016/ifdp.2010.1013.abstract_zh: 通常认为，石油价格冲击对实际产出影响的非对称传导已得到充分证实。然而，多数被引证支持非对称性的实证研究并未直接检验石油价格创新非对称传导的假设。此外，许多量化这些非对称响应的论文基于经审查的石油价格VAR模型，而近期研究表明此类模型存在缺陷。另一些研究则依赖数据中的动态相关性，未能阐明核心问题——正向与负向石油价格创新所引发的实际产出结构性响应是否具有非对称性。近年来，一系列新方法被引入并应用于检验与量化美国实际经济活动对正负石油价格创新的非对称响应。本文旨在系统梳理该领域文献，对比传统研究路径，指明未来研究方向，并调和文献中看似矛盾的若干结论。

10.1787/b4860378-en.title: Fiscal and macroeconomic impacts of defence spending
10.1787/b4860378-en.title_zh: 国防支出的财政与宏观经济影响

10.1787/f5c8c874-en.title: Quantifying the impact of a personal income tax reform on tax revenues, growth and inequality in Hungary
10.1787/f5c8c874-en.title_zh: 量化匈牙利个人所得税改革对税收收入、经济增长与不平等的影响

10.2139/ssrn.242364.abstract: Summary.Recent anti-trust cases exacerbated the concerns of investors regarding the effects of a firm’s monopoly power on its production choice, shareholder value, and the overall economy. We address this issue within a dynamic equilibrium model featuring a large monopolistic firm whose actions not only affect the price of its output, but also effectively influence the valuation of its stock. The latter renders time-inconsistency to the firm’s dynamic production choice. When the firm is required to pre-commit to its strategy, the ensuing equilibrium is largely in line with the predictions of the textbook monopoly model. When the firm behaves in a time-consistent manner, however, the predictions are strikingly at odds. The trade-off between current profits and the valuation of future profits induces the firm to increase production beyond the competitive benchmark and cut prices. This policy may result in destroying shareholder value, and does indeed fully wipe out the firm’s profit in the limit of the decision-making interval shrinking to zero, in line with the Coase conjecture.
10.2139/ssrn.242364.abstract_zh: 摘要。近期反垄断案件加剧了投资者对企业垄断势力在生产选择、股东价值及整体经济层面影响的担忧。本文通过构建一个包含大型垄断企业的动态均衡模型来探讨该问题——该企业的行为不仅影响其产出价格，还会实质性地影响其股票估值。后者导致企业动态生产选择出现时间不一致性。当企业被要求预先承诺其策略时，由此产生的均衡基本符合教科书垄断模型的预测。然而，当企业以时间一致的方式行事时，预测结果则截然不同。当前利润与未来利润估值之间的权衡促使企业将产量提升至竞争性基准水平以上并降低价格。这种策略可能导致股东价值受损，并且在决策间隔趋近于零的极限情况下，确实会完全消除企业利润——这一结论与科斯猜想相吻合。
10.2139/ssrn.242364.title: Monopoly Power and the Firm's Valuation: A Dynamic Analysis of Short versus Long-Term Policies
10.2139/ssrn.242364.title_zh: 垄断势力与企业估值：短期与长期政策的动态分析

10.2139/ssrn.2491279.abstract: this paper is a general framework in which alternative priors for the half-life of deviations from PPP can be examined. We show how to incorporate formally the prior views of economists about the half-life. In our empirical analysis we provide two examples of such priors. One example is a consensus prior consistent with widely held views among economists with a professional interest in the PPP debate. The other example is a relatively diffuse prior designed to capture a large degree of uncertainty about the half-life. Our methodology allows us to make explicit probability statements about the half-life and to assess the likelihood that the half-life exceeds a given number of years, without taking a stand on whether the data have a unit root or not. We find only very limited support for the common view in the PPP literature that the half-life is between three and five years.
10.2139/ssrn.2491279.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个通用框架，用于检验购买力平价偏离半衰期的不同先验设定。我们展示了如何将经济学家关于半衰期的先验观点进行形式化整合。在实证分析中，我们提供了两种此类先验的示例：其一是共识先验，与专业关注购买力平价争论的经济学家的普遍观点一致；其二是相对分散的先验，旨在捕捉半衰期的高度不确定性。我们的方法能够在不预设数据是否存在单位根的前提下，对半衰期做出明确的概率陈述，并评估半衰期超过给定年数的可能性。研究发现，购买力平价文献中关于半衰期介于三至五年之间的普遍观点仅获得极为有限的支持。

10.2139/ssrn.273642.abstract: This paper offers a new explanation for the prevalent use of convertible securities in venture capital finance. Convertible securities can be used to endogenously allocate cash flow rights as a function of the realized quality of the project. This property can be used to mitigate the double moral hazard problem between the entrepreneur and the venture capitalist. It is shown that an optimally designed convertible security outperforms any mixture of debt and equity and that it can induce both parties to invest efficiently. The result is robust to renegotiation and to changes in the timing of investments and information flows.
10.2139/ssrn.273642.abstract_zh: 本文为风险资本融资中可转换证券的普遍使用提供了一种新的解释。可转换证券能够根据项目实现质量内生地分配现金流权，这一特性可用于缓解企业家与风险资本家之间的双重道德风险问题。研究表明，最优设计的可转换证券优于任何债务与股权的组合，并能激励双方进行有效投资。该结论在重新谈判、投资时机及信息流变化的情况下均保持稳健。
10.2139/ssrn.273642.title: Convertible Securities and Venture Capital Finance
10.2139/ssrn.273642.title_zh: 可转换证券与风险资本融资

10.2139/ssrn.290901.abstract: We examine wage bargaining in a two-sector economy when the employers and labour unions in each sector are not always aware of all the general equilibrium feedback effects. We show analytically that if agents only consider labour demand effects, low real wages and low unemployment are the result. With an intermediate view, i.e. when partial equilibrium effects within a sector are taken into account, high real wages and unemployment result. If all general equilibrium effects are simultaneously considered, we once again obtain a situation of low wages and unemployment. The assumption that unions and employers' federations are unable to incorporate all feedback effects from other sectors may explain why unemployment in Europe is high.
10.2139/ssrn.290901.abstract_zh: 本文考察了两部门经济中的工资谈判问题，假设各部门的雇主和工会并非总能意识到所有一般均衡反馈效应。分析表明，若经济主体仅考虑劳动力需求效应，将导致实际工资偏低且失业率较低；若采用中间视角（即考虑部门内的局部均衡效应），则会出现实际工资偏高且失业率较高的情况；而当所有一般均衡效应被同时纳入考量时，低工资与低失业率的局面将再次出现。工会与雇主联合会无法完全纳入其他部门的反馈效应这一假设，或可解释欧洲高失业率的原因。
10.2139/ssrn.290901.title: Awareness of General Equilibrium Effects and Unemployment
10.2139/ssrn.290901.title_zh: 一般均衡效应与失业的认知

10.2139/ssrn.322764.abstract: We develop democratic mechanisms where individual utilities are not observable by other people at the legislative stage. We show that an appropriate combination of three rules can yield efficient provision of public projects: first, flexible and double majority rules where the size of the majority depends on the proposal and verifiable parameters and taxed and non-taxed individuals need to support the proposal; second, flexible agenda costs where the agenda-setter has to pay a certain amount of money if his proposal does not generate enough supporting votes; third, a ban on subsidies. We provide a rationale why double majority rules are used in practice. We also show that higher degrees of uncertainty about project parameters can make it easier to achieve first-best allocations and that universal equal treatment with regard to taxation is undesirable.
10.2139/ssrn.322764.abstract_zh: 我们构建了立法阶段个体效用不可被他人观测的民主机制。研究表明，三项规则的恰当组合能够实现公共项目的有效供给：其一，灵活双重多数规则——多数规模取决于提案内容与可验证参数，且纳税人与非纳税人均需支持该提案；其二，灵活议程成本规则——若议程设定者的提案未获得足够支持票数，则需支付特定金额；其三，禁止补贴规则。本文为实践中采用双重多数规则提供了理论依据，同时证明项目参数不确定性程度的提高反而更易实现最优配置，并指出税收领域的普遍平等对待并不可取。
10.2139/ssrn.322764.title: Democratic Mechanisms: Double Majority Rules and Flexible Agenda Costs
10.2139/ssrn.322764.title_zh: 民主机制：双重多数规则与灵活议程成本

10.2139/ssrn.3502964.abstract: We propose an analysis of platform competition based on the academic literature with a view toward competition policy. First, we discuss to which extent competition can emerge in digital markets and show which forms it can take. In particular, we underline the role of dynamics, but also of platform differentiation, consumers multihoming and beliefs to allow competition in platform markets. Second, we analyze competition policy issues and discuss how rules designed for standard markets can perform in two-sided markets. We show that multi-sided externalities create new opportunities for anti-competitive conducts, often related to pricing and contractual imperfections.
10.2139/ssrn.3502964.abstract_zh: 我们基于学术文献提出平台竞争分析，旨在为竞争政策提供参考。首先，探讨数字市场中竞争产生的可能性及其表现形式，特别强调动态因素、平台差异化、消费者多归属行为及市场预期在促进平台市场竞争中的作用。其次，分析竞争政策议题，讨论为标准市场设计的规则如何适用于双边市场。研究表明，多边外部性为反竞争行为创造了新机会，这些行为通常与定价和合同缺陷相关。

10.2139/ssrn.4364830.abstract: We study a model of popular demand for anti-elite populist reforms that drain the swamp: replace experienced public servants with novices that will only acquire experience with time. Voters benefit from experienced public servants because they are more effective at delivering public goods and more competent at detecting emergency threats. However, public servants’ policy preferences do not always align with those of voters. This tradeoff produces two key forces in our model: public servants’ incompetence spurs disagreement between them and voters, and their effectiveness grants them more power to dictate policy. Both of these effects fuel mistrust between voters and public servants, sometimes inducing voters to drain the swamp in cycles of anti-elite populism. We study which factors can sustain a responsive democracy or induce a technocracy. When instead populism arises, we discuss which reforms may reduce the frequency of populist cycles, including recruiting of public servants and isolating them from politics. Our results support the view that a more inclusive and representative bureaucracy protects against anti-elite populism. We provide empirical evidence that lack of trust in public servants is a key force behind support for anti-elite populist parties and argue that our model helps explain the rise of anti-elite populism in large robust democracies.
10.2139/ssrn.4364830.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一种反精英民粹主义改革的大众需求模型，该改革旨在“排干沼泽”：用缺乏经验的新人替换经验丰富的公务员，而这些新人将随时间积累经验。选民受益于经验丰富的公务员，因为他们能更有效地提供公共产品，并更胜任识别紧急威胁。然而，公务员的政策偏好并不总是与选民一致。这种权衡在我们的模型中产生了两种关键力量：公务员的无能加剧了他们与选民之间的分歧，而他们的有效性则赋予他们更多主导政策的权力。这两种效应都加剧了选民与公务员之间的不信任，有时会诱使选民以反精英民粹主义的周期循环“排干沼泽”。我们研究了哪些因素能够维持回应型民主或催生技术官僚体制。当民粹主义出现时，我们讨论了哪些改革可能减少民粹主义周期的频率，包括公务员的招募以及使其与政治隔离。我们的结果支持以下观点：更具包容性和代表性的官僚体系能够抵御反精英民粹主义。我们提供了实证证据，表明对公务员缺乏信任是支持反精英民粹主义政党的关键力量，并论证我们的模型有助于解释大型稳健民主国家中反精英民粹主义的兴起。
10.2139/ssrn.4364830.title: Drain the Swamp: A Theory of Anti-Elite Populism

10.2139/ssrn.4428283.abstract: Under collusion, firms deviate from current profit maximization in anticipation of future rewards. As current profit maximization places little restrictions on firms' pricing behaviour, collusive conduct is hard to infer. Under collusion -- however -- firms' behaviour should instantaneously respond to the anticipation of future changes in their ability to sustain it. We show that bids from certain firms in the Colombian wholesale electricity market collapsed immediately after the announcement, and before the implementation, of a reform that potentially made collusion harder to sustain. A forensic analysis uncovers a type of coordinated behaviour among cartel members that likely required explicit communication and provides suggestive evidence that such communication might have occurred. A quantification exercise supports the reduced-form evidence on collusion and quantifies its costs. Dynamic enforcement constraints should be taken seriously by policy-makers fighting collusion.
10.2139/ssrn.4428283.abstract_zh: 在合谋状态下，企业会为预期未来收益而偏离当前利润最大化行为。由于当前利润最大化对企业定价行为的约束极小，合谋行为难以被推断。然而，在合谋状态下，企业行为应当会即时响应其对未来维持合谋能力变化的预期。我们研究发现，哥伦比亚批发电力市场中某些企业的报价，在一项可能削弱合谋可持续性的改革方案宣布后、实施前，便立即出现暴跌。法证分析揭示了卡特尔成员间一种很可能需要显性沟通的协调行为，并提供了此类沟通可能存在的暗示性证据。量化分析支持了关于合谋的简约形式证据，并估算了其成本。反合谋政策制定者应严肃对待动态执行约束问题。
10.2139/ssrn.4428283.title: Relational Collusion in the Colombian Electricity Market
10.2139/ssrn.4428283.title_zh: 哥伦比亚电力市场中的关系性合谋

10.2139/ssrn.4541374.abstract: We show that during the period of the Public Sector Purchase Program (PSPP) implemented by the Eurosystem, the prices of German sovereign bonds targeted by the PSPP increase predictably towards month-end and drop subsequently. We propose a sequential search-bargaining model that captures salient features of the implementation of the PSPP such as the commitment to buy within an explicit time horizon. The model can explain the predictable pattern as a result of imperfect competition between dealers that are counterparties to the Eurosystem. Motivated by the model’s predictions, we show that the price pattern is more pronounced (a) for bonds that are targeted by the PSPP, (b) for monthly windows where the Eurosystem has fewer counterparties, and (c) for monthly windows where the Eurosystem targets a larger amount of purchases. We discuss the implications of our analysis for future purchase programs. *We thank ECB and Bundesbank market operations and risk management colleagues and seminar participants at the European Central Bank for helpful comments. The views expressed are those of the authors and do not necessarily reflect those of the Eurosystem.
10.2139/ssrn.4541374.abstract_zh: 我们证明，在欧洲系统实施的公共部门购买计划（PSPP）期间，PSPP目标德国主权债券的价格会在月末可预测地上涨，随后下跌。我们提出了一个序贯搜索-议价模型，该模型捕捉了PSPP实施的关键特征，例如在明确时间范围内承诺购买。该模型能够解释这一可预测模式，其根源在于作为欧洲系统交易对手的交易商之间的不完全竞争。基于模型预测，我们进一步证明，价格模式在以下情况下更为显著：（a）针对PSPP目标债券，（b）在欧洲系统交易对手较少的月度窗口期，以及（c）在欧洲系统目标购买量较大的月度窗口期。我们讨论了分析对未来购买计划的启示。*感谢欧洲央行和德国央行市场操作与风险管理部门的同事，以及欧洲央行研讨会的参与者提供的宝贵意见。本文观点仅代表作者本人，并不必然反映欧洲系统的立场。
10.2139/ssrn.4541374.title: Is the Bond Market Competitive? Evidence from the ECB's Asset Purchase Program
10.2139/ssrn.4541374.title_zh: 债券市场是竞争性的吗？来自欧洲央行资产购买计划的证据

10.2139/ssrn.4647828.abstract: We develop a two-country business-cycle model of the US and the rest of the world with dollar dominance in trade invoicing, in cross-border credit, and in safe assets. The interplay between these elements---dollar trinity---rationalizes salient features of the Global Financial Cycle in the data: When its tide subsides, the dollar appreciates, financial conditions tighten, the world business cycle slows down, and emerging-market central banks face a trade-off between mitigating the recession and dampening price pressures. We find the dollar is no sideshow in this, but central for the transmission of the Global Financial Cycle to the world economy.
10.2139/ssrn.4647828.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含美国与世界其他地区的两国商业周期模型，其中美元在贸易计价、跨境信贷和安全资产领域占据主导地位。这些要素之间的相互作用——美元三位一体——合理化了数据中全球金融周期的显著特征：当美元潮汐退去时，美元升值，金融状况收紧，全球商业周期放缓，新兴市场央行面临缓解经济衰退与抑制价格压力之间的权衡。我们发现，美元在此过程中并非次要因素，而是全球金融周期向世界经济传导的核心环节。
10.2139/ssrn.4647828.title: Dollar Trinity and the Global Financial Cycle
10.2139/ssrn.4647828.title_zh: 美元三位一体与全球金融周期

10.2139/ssrn.4787392.abstract: We estimate that investors systematically overreact to perceptions about multiple fundamental shocks in a macro-dynamic system, generating asymmetric compositional effects when real-world events produce conflicting signals with counteracting market implications. We show that such events can lead the market to underreact to news, even when investors overreact to all shocks.
10.2139/ssrn.4787392.abstract_zh: 我们估计，投资者在宏观动态系统中系统性地过度反应于对多重基本面冲击的感知，当现实事件产生相互冲突的信号并带来抵消性的市场影响时，会引发非对称的构成效应。我们证明，此类事件可能导致市场对新闻反应不足，即便投资者对所有冲击均表现出过度反应。

10.2139/ssrn.4835079.abstract: This paper proposes a novel mechanism linking common ownership to anticompetitive outcomes. Common owners promote shareholder-friendly governance policies in their portfolio firms, empowering interventions by activist hedge funds that discourage managers from investing. The cumulative impact of hedge fund activism contributes to anticompetitive outcomes, without collusion between managers. Effectively, and possibly unintentionally, common owners exert monopsonistic power over labor by reducing aggregate investment. Subsequently, the artificially depressed wages result in transfer of wealth to shareholders. While hedge fund activism generally improves social welfare in a competitive equilibrium, it may reduce social welfare under common ownership. The symbiotic relationship between common owners and activist hedge funds can be detrimental to society. The paper establishes a new connection between the rise of institutional ownership, adoption of shareholder-friendly policies, increased hedge fund activism, reduced investment and labor share, and heightened capital market returns.
10.2139/ssrn.4835079.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新的机制，将共同所有权与反竞争结果联系起来。共同所有者在投资组合公司中推行有利于股东的公司治理政策，从而增强了激进对冲基金的干预能力，这些干预会抑制管理层的投资意愿。对冲基金激进主义的累积效应导致了反竞争结果，而无需管理层之间的合谋。实际上，共同所有者可能无意中通过减少总投资的途径，对劳动力施加了买方垄断力量。随后，人为压低的工资导致财富向股东转移。尽管在竞争均衡中，对冲基金激进主义通常能改善社会福利，但在共同所有权下，它可能反而降低社会福利。共同所有者与激进对冲基金之间的共生关系可能对社会造成损害。本文建立了机构所有权上升、股东友好型政策采纳、对冲基金激进主义增加、投资与劳动份额下降以及资本市场回报率提高之间的新联系。

10.2139/ssrn.486084.abstract: Many international treaties come into force only after a minimum number of countries have signed and ratified the treaty. Why do countries agree to introduce a minimum participation constraint among the rules characterising an international treaty? This question is particularly relevant in the case of environmental treaties dealing with global commons, where free-riding incentives are strong. Is a minimum participation rule a way to offset these free-riding incentives? Why do countries that know they have an incentive to free-ride accept to tie their hands through the introduction of a minimum participation constraint? This paper addresses the above questions by analysing a three-stage non-cooperative coalition formation game. In the first stage, countries set the minimum coalition size that is necessary for the treaty to come into force. In the second stage, countries decide whether to sign the treaty. In the third stage, the equilibrium values of the decision variables are set. At the equilibrium, both the minimum participation constraint and the number of signatories - the coalition size - are determined. This paper shows that a non-trivial partial coalition, sustained by a binding minimum participation constraint, forms at the equilibrium. This paper thus explains why in international negotiations all countries often agree on a minimum participation rule even when some of them do not intend to sign the treaty. The paper also analyses the optimal size of the minimum participation constraint.
10.2139/ssrn.486084.abstract_zh: 许多国际条约只有在达到最低签署与批准国家数量后方可生效。为何各国同意在界定国际条约的规则中引入最低参与约束？这一问题在处理全球公共品环境条约时尤为突出——此类条约中"搭便车"动机极为强烈。最低参与规则能否抵消这种搭便车倾向？明知自身存在搭便车动机的国家，为何甘愿通过引入最低参与约束来束缚自身行动？本文通过构建三阶段非合作联盟形成博弈模型，对上述问题展开分析。第一阶段，各国设定条约生效所需的最低联盟规模；第二阶段，各国决定是否签署条约；第三阶段，确定决策变量的均衡值。在均衡状态下，最低参与约束与签署国数量（即联盟规模）同时内生决定。研究表明，均衡中会形成由具有约束力的最低参与约束所支撑的非平凡部分联盟。由此，本文解释了为何在国际谈判中，即便部分国家无意签署条约，所有国家仍常就最低参与规则达成共识。本文还进一步分析了最低参与约束的最优规模。
10.2139/ssrn.486084.title: Endogenous Minimum Participation in International Environmental Treaties
10.2139/ssrn.486084.title_zh: 国际环境条约中的内生最低参与度

10.2139/ssrn.4997456.abstract: We develop and estimate a structural model of firms’ card demand, utilization, and default choice, accounting for imperfect competition and the correlation between utilization and default. We find that while the correlation between utilization and delinquency leads to modestly higher rates, they are primarily explained by markups rather than lender costs, making business card provision highly profitable. In counterfactual analyses we show that under systematic stress scenarios, absent large shocks to lender funding costs, lender profits tend to rise in times of borrower stress, as higher revenue from utilization more than offsets increases in delinquency. Finally, we evaluate proposed capital regulations that add a portion of undrawn credit limits to bank risk-weighted assets. Such rules reduce bank credit provision and push some lending outside the regulated banking sector, while modestly reducing firm surplus. Because credit card lending tends to be more profitable in times of stress, such regulations may be counterproductive for bank stability.
10.2139/ssrn.4997456.abstract_zh: 我们构建并估计了一个关于企业信用卡需求、使用及违约选择的结构模型，该模型考虑了不完全竞争以及使用率与违约之间的相关性。研究发现，尽管使用率与逾期之间的相关性会导致违约率略有上升，但这一现象主要源于加价而非贷款成本，这使得企业信用卡业务具有极高的盈利性。反事实分析表明，在系统性压力情景下，若贷款机构融资成本未遭受重大冲击，贷款机构利润往往在借款人承压时期上升，因为使用率带来的更高收入足以抵消逾期率的增加。最后，我们评估了拟议的资本监管规则——该规则将未提取信用额度的一部分纳入银行风险加权资产。此类规则会减少银行信贷供给，并将部分贷款业务推向受监管银行体系之外，同时适度降低企业剩余。由于信用卡贷款在压力时期往往更具盈利性，此类监管可能对银行稳定性产生反效果。

10.2139/ssrn.5515874.abstract: We develop a theoretical framework where debt issuance decisions take into account heterogenous demand of investors in terms of their response to changes in the price of currency risk.
10.2139/ssrn.5515874.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个理论框架，其中债务发行决策考虑了投资者对货币风险价格变化反应的异质性需求。

10.2139/ssrn.5560383.abstract: We study how firms’ investment responds to interest rate changes based on a German firm survey, combining hypothetical vignettes, open-ended questions, and rich firm data. We estimate a 7 percent semi-elasticity of investment to loan rates—about half the total corporate investment response to monetary policy shocks. Adjustment is heterogeneous: many firms do not react, citing cash buffers or a lack of opportunities, while adjusters revise sharply. Managers’ narratives about monetary policy transmission to investment emphasize direct borrowing-cost effects and rarely mention general-equilibrium channels. Local projections show this direct channel is central to output dynamics after monetary policy shocks.
10.2139/ssrn.5560383.abstract_zh: 基于德国企业调查数据，结合假设情景模拟、开放式问题及丰富的企业微观数据，我们研究了企业投资如何响应利率变化。研究发现，投资对贷款利率的半弹性约为7%——约占企业总投资对货币政策冲击总响应幅度的一半。调整行为呈现异质性：许多企业因持有现金缓冲或缺乏投资机会而未作出反应，而进行调整的企业则显著修正投资计划。管理者关于货币政策传导至投资渠道的叙述强调直接借贷成本效应，极少提及一般均衡渠道。局部投影法分析表明，该直接渠道是货币政策冲击后产出动态的核心驱动因素。
10.2139/ssrn.5560383.title: The Impact of Interest: Firms' Investment Sensitivity to Interest Rates
10.2139/ssrn.5560383.title_zh: 利率的影响：企业投资对利率的敏感度

10.2139/ssrn.6030467.title_zh: 加价之战：冲突性通胀与货币政策传导的期望渠道

10.2139/ssrn.6326703.abstract: A central insight from neoclassical economics is that international trade operates like an improvement in production technology. It generates mutual aggregate welfare gains for countries as a whole, but creates winners and losers within countries. Tariffs are a tax on this trading technology and distort the prices faced by domestic consumers and producers. Large countries can use tariffs to improve their terms of trade on world markets. But if all countries try to do so, they can end up with lower welfare than if they cooperated to liberalize trade. Tariffs can be used to redistribute income between the winners and losers from trade within countries. But there can be other more efficient ways to achieve redistribution. Policies to promote economic activity in critical industries can be rationalized based on externalities or national security. But these arguments typically rationalize targeted policies towards those industries and tariffs can be dominated by other policy interventions. Empirical findings from the recent waves of U.S. tariffs suggest that most of the incidence of these tariffs has been borne by U.S. importers, wholesalers, retailers and consumers rather than by foreign exporters. These tariffs have led to a large-scale reorganization of U.S. supply chains away from China to third countries. Although this reorganization has substantially reduced China’s share of U.S. imports, the U.S. remains indirectly exposed to China through the imports of these third countries.
10.2139/ssrn.6326703.abstract_zh: 新古典经济学的核心观点认为，国际贸易如同生产技术的改进，能为各国整体带来相互的福利增益，但也会在国家内部产生赢家和输家。关税是对这种贸易技术征收的税收，会扭曲国内消费者和生产者面临的价格。大国可以利用关税改善其在世界市场上的贸易条件。但如果所有国家都试图这样做，最终可能比合作实现贸易自由化时的福利水平更低。关税可用于在国家内部贸易赢家和输家之间进行收入再分配，但可能存在其他更有效的再分配方式。基于外部性或国家安全理由，可以合理化对关键产业的经济活动促进政策，但这些论点通常支持对这些产业实施针对性政策，而关税可能被其他政策干预手段所取代。近期美国关税浪潮的实证结果表明，这些关税的负担主要由美国进口商、批发商、零售商和消费者承担，而非外国出口商。这些关税导致美国供应链大规模重组，从中国转向第三国。尽管这种重组大幅降低了中国在美国进口中的份额，但美国仍通过从这些第三国的进口间接暴露于中国的影响之下。
10.2139/ssrn.6326703.title: The Economics of Tariffs

10.2139/ssrn.6458138.abstract: We study how institutional constraints on executive selection shape redistributive policy using a 1919 Danish reform that allowed town councils to democratically elect mayors. Although the reform applied uniformly, it made left-wing executive control feasible, especially where prior Social Democratic support was strong. Using 1917 vote shares interacted with the post-reform period, we identify the causal effect of Social Democratic mayors on local public finance. Social Democratic rule led to substantial increases in social spending, particularly poor relief and public assistance, financed mainly through higher direct taxes, with no robust evidence of adverse effects on local economic activity
10.2139/ssrn.6458138.abstract_zh: 我们利用1919年丹麦的一项改革——该改革允许市议会民主选举市长——研究了行政长官选拔的制度约束如何影响再分配政策。尽管改革统一实施，但它使左翼行政控制成为可能，尤其是在先前社会民主党支持率较高的地区。通过将1917年得票率与改革后时期进行交互分析，我们识别出社会民主党市长对地方公共财政的因果效应。社会民主党执政导致社会支出大幅增加，尤其是贫困救济和公共援助，这些支出主要通过提高直接税来融资，且没有稳健证据表明其对地方经济活动产生不利影响。
10.2139/ssrn.6458138.title: Left in Charge: Political Rule and the Rise of Local Welfare
10.2139/ssrn.6458138.title_zh: 留守掌权：政治统治与地方福利的兴起

10.2139/ssrn.6596700.abstract: We study the interconnection between the productivity and pricing effects of financial shocks. Combining administrative records on firm-level output prices and quantities with quasi-experimental variation in credit supply, we show that a tightening of credit conditions has a persistent, yet delayed, negative effect on firms' long-run physical productivity growth (TFPQ) but also induces firms to change their pricing policies. Commonly used revenue-based productivity measures (TFPR)-which conflate price and productivity-offer biased predictions regarding the consequences of financial shocks for firms' productivity growth, underestimating the long-run elasticity of physical productivity to credit supply by half. We also show that the pricing adjustments themselves have productivity implications. Firms use low pricing as a source of internal financing, allowing them to avoid cutting expenditures on productivityenhancing activities, thereby softening the impact of financial shocks. We incorporate these forces into a quantitative model of firm dynamics to quantify the importance of productivity and pricing dynamics (and their interplay) in driving the scarring effects of financial crises on aggregate productivity and welfare.
10.2139/ssrn.6596700.abstract_zh: 本文研究了金融冲击对生产率与定价效应之间的内在关联。通过将企业层面产出价格与数量的行政记录数据与信贷供给的准实验性变化相结合，我们发现：信贷条件收紧对企业长期实物生产率增长（TFPQ）具有持续但滞后的负面影响，同时也会促使企业调整其定价策略。常用的基于收入的生产率指标（TFPR）——该指标混淆了价格与生产率——对金融冲击影响企业生产率增长的预测存在偏差，导致对实物生产率相对于信贷供给的长期弹性低估了约50%。我们还发现，定价调整本身具有生产率效应。企业将低价策略作为内部融资来源，从而避免削减生产率提升活动的支出，进而缓解金融冲击的影响。我们将这些机制纳入企业动态定量模型，以量化生产率与定价动态（及其相互作用）在驱动金融危机对总生产率和福利造成疤痕效应中的重要性。

10.2139/ssrn.898570.abstract: This paper presents new evidence on the child-quantity/child-quality trade-off. Our empirical strategy exploits exogenous variation in family size due to twin births and preferences for a mixed sibling-sex composition, as well as ethnic differences in the effects of these variables and preferences for male births in some ethnic groups. We use these sources of variation to look at the causal effect of family size on completed educational attainment, fertility, and earnings. For the purposes of this analysis, we constructed a unique matched data set linking Israeli Census data with information on the demographic structure of families drawn from a population registry. Our results show no evidence of a quantity-quality trade-off, though some estimates from one sub-sample suggest that first-born girls from large families marry sooner.
10.2139/ssrn.898570.abstract_zh: 本文提供了关于子女数量与子女质量之间权衡关系的新证据。我们的实证策略利用了因双胞胎出生和子女性别混合偏好所导致的家庭规模外生变异，以及这些变量在不同族群中的效应差异和某些族群对男性子女生育的偏好。我们利用这些变异来源，考察家庭规模对最终受教育程度、生育率和收入水平的因果效应。为此，我们构建了一个独特的匹配数据集，将以色列人口普查数据与来自人口登记系统的家庭人口结构信息相链接。研究结果显示，未发现数量-质量权衡的证据，尽管来自某个子样本的估计表明，大家庭中的头胎女孩会较早结婚。

10.2307/2297461.abstract: Thin equity markets cannot accommodate temporary bulges of buy or sell orders without large price movements. The resulting volatility can induce risk-averse transactors who face transaction costs to desert these markets. Thus thinness and the related price volatility may become joint self-perpetuating features of an equity market, irrespective of the volatility of asset fundamentals. If, however, appropriate incentive schemes are adopted to encourage entry by additional investors, this vicious circle can be broken, eventually shifting the market to a self-sustaining, superior equilibrium characterized by a higher number of transactors, lower price volatility and larger supply of the asset.
10.2307/2297461.abstract_zh: 薄弱的股票市场无法在不引发大幅价格波动的情况下容纳临时性的买卖订单激增。由此产生的波动性可能导致面临交易成本的风险规避型交易者退出这些市场。因此，市场薄弱性及其相关的价格波动可能成为股票市场的自我强化特征，无论资产基本面波动性如何。然而，如果采用适当的激励机制鼓励更多投资者进入市场，这种恶性循环可以被打破，最终使市场转向一个自我维持的、更优的均衡状态，其特征是交易者数量更多、价格波动性更低以及资产供给量更大。

10.2307/2601112.title_zh: 价格水平目标与通胀目标：免费午餐？

10.2307/3038229.abstract: This paper is an attempt to gauge how much the conclusions derived from the standard analysis of labour supply may have to be altered when we allow for such 'unemployed' workers. For the sample of married women in the UK which we investigate, the standard model appears to exaggerate the positive impact which reductions in marginal wages may have on participation and reduces the possibilities for a backward-bending supply curve of labour. The probability of being in a state of unemployment, as defined above, is found to depend on certain demand-side factors, age and a number of other demographic characteristics.
10.2307/3038229.abstract_zh: 本文旨在评估，当我们将此类“失业”工人纳入考量时，标准劳动供给分析所得结论可能需要做出多大程度的修正。基于我们所研究的英国已婚女性样本，标准模型似乎夸大了边际工资下降对劳动参与率的正向影响，并降低了劳动供给曲线向后弯曲的可能性。研究发现，处于上述定义的失业状态的概率取决于某些需求侧因素、年龄以及其他若干人口特征。

10.2307/3968363.title: DP21631 Anchors aweigh? The effect of communicating forecast uncertainty
10.2307/3968363.title_zh: DP21631 锚定效应？传达预测不确定性的影响

10.31235/osf.io/em3js.abstract: This paper examines the impact of ethnic fractionalization on public service use by exploiting a major constitutional reform in Kenya. Following an important period of inter-ethnic conflict, responsibility for local health services was decentralized to 47 newly created county governments. Using an event-study design, we find that use of public clinics for births increased significantly after the reform, but only in counties that were relatively ethnically homogeneous. We also find a significant increase in the correlation between county ethnic fractionalization and a range of other measures of public health service use. Services in these counties are also less likely to require payments after decentralization. Using within-county variation to investigate mechanisms, we find healthcare use increases were concentrated among areas and individuals of the same ethnicity as members of the new county government executives. Overall, the results suggest that more ethnically homogeneous sub-national jurisdictions can rapidly increase public service use.
10.31235/osf.io/em3js.abstract_zh: 本文利用肯尼亚一次重大宪法改革，考察了民族分裂程度对公共服务使用的影响。在经历了一段重要的民族间冲突时期后，地方卫生服务责任被下放至47个新成立的县级政府。通过事件研究设计，我们发现改革后公立诊所用于分娩的使用率显著增加，但仅出现在民族相对同质的县。我们还发现，县级民族分裂程度与一系列其他公共卫生服务使用指标之间的相关性显著增强。权力下放后，这些县的服务也更少需要付费。利用县内差异探究机制，我们发现医疗保健使用率的增长集中在与新任县级政府行政人员同属一个民族的地区和个人中。总体而言，研究结果表明，民族更为同质的地方行政辖区能够迅速提高公共服务使用率。
10.31235/osf.io/em3js.title: Decentralization, Ethnic Fractionalization, and Public Services: Evidence from Kenyan Healthcare
10.31235/osf.io/em3js.title_zh: 分权、民族分裂与公共服务：来自肯尼亚医疗保健的证据

10.3368/le.102.3.intro.abstract: There is a long tradition in environmental economics of using visits to outdoor recreation sites to value environmental goods. Recreation demand (or travel cost) models combine data on trips individuals make to recreation destinations with imputed travel costs and attributes of recreation sites to
