Such a constraint would lower the profit gains of targeting by about half. These findings highlight the importance of quantifying tradeoffs and complementarities when deciding what to maximize.
10.3386/w35521.abstract_zh: 公司治理的经典理论认为，股东利润最大化与股东福利（如社会影响）最大化之间存在权衡。机器学习技术的进步增强了企业精准定位特定客户的能力，这可能加剧或缓解这一权衡。我们利用南非、菲律宾和波斯尼亚随机小额信贷审批数据，从两个维度评估社会影响：信贷可及性（即覆盖通常难以进入金融市场的弱势群体）和实际影响（即对家庭收入的处理效应）。三家贷款机构中有两家可通过基于机器学习的精准定位将平均贷款利润率提高7-9个百分点。然而，这种精准定位会与信贷可及性方面的社会目标产生冲突：具体而言，女性和低收入家庭将被更严重地排斥在外（对借款人收入的影响——这一社会影响双重目标的核心要素——因估计精度不足而无法得出明确结论）。为衡量第一种权衡的规模，我们考察了若贷款机构在基准借款人收入的每个五分位区间内调整放贷对象（即保持收入分布大致相似但优化收入区间内的精准定位），利润将如何变化。这种约束会使精准定位带来的利润增益降低约一半。这些发现凸显了在决策最大化目标时量化权衡与互补关系的重要性。
10.3386/w35521.title: Profits and Social Impacts: Complements vs. Tradeoffs for Lenders in Three Countries
10.3386/w35521.title_zh: 利润与社会影响：三国贷款机构中的互补与权衡

10.3386/w35523.abstract: OECD countries experienced declining native population growth and rising net immigration over 1990-2024. We compile a new dataset of net immigration rates to OECD countries from all origins and show that most of the increase came from non-OECD countries and was predominantly high-skilled. Push factors, network effects, and policy indices explain little of the large cross-country heterogeneity in immigration dynamics; unexpected shocks and surges were common. Using local projections and several sources of identifying variation, we then estimate the relationship between immigration and growth in GDP per capita, labor productivity, capital investment, and total factor productivity (TFP). Immigration from non-OECD countries was a significant predictor of GDP per worker growth, primarily through higher investment. High-skilled immigration, in particular, was associated with stronger human capital accumulation, faster TFP growth, and greater capital deepening. Native population growth, by contrast, had no or weakly negative effects on GDP per capita and productivity. These results are consistent with a large literature documenting the positive productivity and growth effects of immigration, especially high-skilled immigration.
10.3386/w35523.abstract_zh: 1990-2024年间，OECD国家经历了本土人口增长放缓与净移民持续上升的双重趋势。我们构建了涵盖所有来源国对OECD国家净移民率的新数据集，发现移民增长主要来自非OECD国家，且以高技能移民为主。推力因素、网络效应和政策指数难以解释各国移民动态的巨大异质性，突发性冲击与激增现象普遍存在。通过局部投影法结合多种识别变异来源，我们估算了移民与人均GDP、劳动生产率、资本投资及全要素生产率（TFP）增长之间的关系。非OECD国家移民对人均GDP增长具有显著预测作用，主要通过促进投资实现。高技能移民尤其与更强的人力资本积累、更快的TFP增长及更深的资本深化相关联。相比之下，本土人口增长对人均GDP和生产率无显著影响甚至呈现微弱负效应。这些结论与大量文献中关于移民（特别是高技能移民）对生产率和经济增长具有积极效应的研究结果一致。
10.3386/w35523.title: Immigration and Macroeconomic Outcomes in OECD Countries
10.3386/w35523.title_zh: OECD国家移民与宏观经济结果

10.3386/w35524.abstract: Most unemployment insurance (UI) systems condition the potential duration of benefits on claimants' work history, yet little evidence exists on whether doing so is socially optimal. We study this question using 25 regression discontinuities in Canada's UI system, where benefit duration increases discretely when prior hours worked crosses various thresholds. Using administrative records covering the universe of UI claims from 1997 to 2018, we estimate the fiscal effects of extending potential duration across the work-history distribution. On average, an additional week lengthens unemployment by 0.30 weeks and costs the government $96. However, this average effect masks significant heterogeneity: the mechanical cost falls steeply with prior hours, while the behavioral cost increases modestly. Consequently, the fiscal externality of extending UI rises with labor market attachment. Embedding these estimates in a sufficient statistics framework, we find that the fiscal externality of a uniform extension is 76% larger than that of an extension targeted at claimants with short histories. Moreover, aggregate welfare can be raised at zero fiscal cost by redistributing benefits from high to low hour claimants.
10.3386/w35524.abstract_zh: 大多数失业保险（UI）制度将福利的潜在领取期限与申请人的工作历史挂钩，但关于这种做法是否具有社会最优性的证据却很少。我们利用加拿大失业保险制度中的25个断点回归设计来研究这一问题——在该制度中，当申请人此前的工作时长跨越不同阈值时，福利领取期限会呈阶梯式增加。基于覆盖1997年至2018年所有失业保险申请的行政记录，我们估算了在工作历史分布的不同节点延长潜在领取期限的财政效应。平均而言，每延长一周福利期限会使失业期延长0.30周，并给政府带来96美元的成本。然而，这一平均效应掩盖了显著的异质性：机械性成本随此前工作时长的增加而急剧下降，而行为性成本则温和上升。因此，延长失业保险的财政外部性随劳动力市场依附程度的增强而增大。将这些估计值嵌入充分统计量框架后，我们发现：统一延长福利期限的财政外部性比针对短期工作历史申请人的定向延长高出76%。此外，通过将福利从高工时申请人重新分配给低工时申请人，可以在零财政成本下提高总体社会福利。
10.3386/w35524.title: The Welfare Effects of Conditioning the Potential Duration of UI Benefits on Prior Work History
10.3386/w35524.title_zh: 将失业保险金潜在领取时长与先前工作经历挂钩的福利效应

10.3386/w35525.abstract: We investigate whether, by providing better and more timely information, the first mandatory online reporting and auditing program for wastewater discharge releases in the U.S. improved facility compliance and environmental performance, while also allowing state regulators to more effectively monitor and enforce regulations. Examining reporting programs with automated feedback features can also offer insights into the potential for artificial intelligence-based tools to improve compliance and environmental performance. Difference-in-difference results suggest that the program resulted in significant increases in the completeness of reporting and reductions in discharges but also greater reported violations. We find that effects are larger for minor dischargers and publicly owned facilities. We also find evidence consistent with the more efficient targeting of inspections by state authorities towards plants with a history of recent noncompliance, which could be a potential mechanism driving these results.
10.3386/w35525.abstract_zh: 本文探究美国首个针对废水排放的强制性在线报告与审计制度，是否通过提供更优质、更及时的信息，提升了设施合规性与环境绩效，同时使州监管机构能够更有效地监督和执行法规。研究具有自动反馈功能的报告制度，也可为基于人工智能的工具在改善合规性与环境绩效方面的潜力提供启示。双重差分结果表明，该制度显著提高了报告的完整性，减少了污染物排放量，但同时也增加了报告的违规事件。我们发现，对小型排放者及公有设施的影响更为显著。此外，证据表明州监管机构更高效地将检查资源集中于近期存在违规历史的工厂，这可能是驱动上述结果的潜在机制。
10.3386/w35525.title: Evidence of How Electronic Reporting and Automated Auditing Affects Regulatory Compliance and Environmental Performance
10.3386/w35525.title_zh: 电子报告与自动审计对监管合规及环境绩效影响的实证证据

10.3386/w35526.abstract: Using rich data on Chinese schoolchildren, we study the relationships of IQ and personality traits with children’s risk preferences and how they affect the precision with which those preferences are measured. Our structural model separates preferences from deliberation noise and guessing, and relates guessing to deliberation noise. Psychological measures have weak direct influences on preferences but strongly affect deliberation noise and guessing behavior. Shocks to choice have persistent individual-specific components and are not independent. Socioeconomic background has little direct influence on preferences or deliberation noise once traits are accounted for. Background variables affect psychological traits, however. Risk preferences differ across and within genders. For small gambles, girls are less risk averse than boys, but the opposite holds for larger gambles.
10.3386/w35526.abstract_zh: 基于中国学龄儿童的丰富数据，本研究探讨了智商与人格特质与儿童风险偏好之间的关系，以及这些因素如何影响风险偏好测量的精确度。我们的结构模型将偏好与决策噪声及猜测行为区分开来，并将猜测行为与决策噪声相关联。心理测量指标对偏好的直接影响较弱，但显著影响决策噪声与猜测行为。选择中的冲击具有持久的个体特异性成分，且并非相互独立。在控制心理特质后，社会经济背景对偏好或决策噪声的直接作用微乎其微。然而，背景变量会影响心理特质。风险偏好存在性别间及性别内的差异。对于小额赌博，女孩的风险厌恶程度低于男孩；但对于大额赌博，情况则相反。
10.3386/w35526.title: Relating Cognitive Skills and Personality Traits to Economic Preferences: Decision-Making under Cognitive Shocks and Guessing
10.3386/w35526.title_zh: 认知技能与人格特质对经济偏好的影响：认知冲击与猜测情境下的决策行为

10.3386/w35527.abstract: This paper examines how networks formed through college athletics influence the early-career trajectories of Ivy League graduates. Tracking professional histories of 120,306 Ivy League graduates, we compare each graduate's actual first job against other potential jobs that the graduate could reasonably have taken. Athletics-based networks, especially team-based connections, materially influence initial job choice. Employing one additional alum from a specific Ivy League collegiate sports team increases the probability that a same-team athlete joins the firm by 193.70% relative to the baseline match probability. Likewise, employing one more Ivy League alum who played a specific Varsity sport increases the probability that any Ivy League athlete who plays the same sport joins the firm by 16.40%, while employing one more alum who played any sport at a specific Ivy League university raises the probability that any Ivy League athlete from the same university joins the firm by 4.60%. For team-based connections, these effects persist whether the alum and the college athlete were direct peers whose college years overlapped or older “network” affiliates whose college years were completely disjoint. Our results demonstrate that college athletics-based social networks materially influence initial job placement and early-career trajectories for top college graduates. More generally, they clarify how non-academic social capital shapes the job searching and matching process within labor markets.
10.3386/w35527.abstract_zh: 本文考察了通过大学体育形成的社交网络如何影响常春藤盟校毕业生的早期职业轨迹。通过追踪120,306名常春藤盟校毕业生的职业历程，我们将每位毕业生的实际首份工作与其可能合理获得的其他潜在工作进行了比较。基于体育运动的社交网络，尤其是团队型联系，对初始职业选择产生了实质性影响。在特定常春藤盟校运动队中每多雇佣一名校友，会使同队运动员加入该企业的概率较基准匹配概率提高193.70%。同样，每多雇佣一名参与过特定校队运动的常春藤盟校校友，会使从事相同运动的任何常春藤盟校运动员加入该企业的概率提高16.40%；而每多雇佣一名在特定常春藤盟校参与过任何运动的校友，会使来自同一大学的任何常春藤盟校运动员加入该企业的概率提高4.60%。对于团队型联系而言，无论校友与大学运动员是大学时期重叠的直接同窗，还是大学时期完全错位的年长"网络"关联者，这种效应均持续存在。我们的研究结果表明，基于大学体育的社交网络对顶尖大学毕业生的初始职业选择和早期职业轨迹具有实质性影响。更广泛而言，这些发现阐明了非学术性社会资本如何在劳动力市场中塑造求职与匹配过程。
10.3386/w35527.title: From Field to Firm: College Sports and Early-Stage Career Choice
10.3386/w35527.title_zh: 从赛场到职场：大学体育与早期职业选择

10.3386/w35528.abstract: Using mandatory Outlook reports from Chinese mutual funds, we decompose each fund’s equity-market beliefs into macro fundamentals, government policy, and residual sentiment. Policy beliefs, rather than macro beliefs, predict subsequent market returns and help explain the positive alphas observed in China’s mutual fund industry. By contrast, residual sentiment strongly shapes equity allocations and attracts investor flows, even though it does not predict returns. Using maturing wealth management products as an instrument for future aggregate fund flows, we show that funds strategically position their stated beliefs to cater to investors. Overall, our analysis reveals a core tension in active asset management: skilled managers generate performance through policy insights while attracting flows through sentiment alignment.
10.3386/w35528.abstract_zh: 利用中国共同基金的强制性Outlook报告，我们将每只基金的股票市场信念分解为宏观基本面、政府政策和残余情绪。政策信念（而非宏观信念）能够预测后续市场回报，并有助于解释中国共同基金行业观察到的正Alpha。相比之下，残余情绪虽无法预测回报，却显著影响股票配置并吸引投资者资金流入。以即将到期的理财产品作为未来基金总资金流的工具变量，我们发现基金会策略性地调整其陈述的信念以迎合投资者。总体而言，我们的分析揭示了主动资产管理中的核心矛盾：具备技能的基金经理通过政策洞察创造业绩，却需通过情绪迎合来吸引资金流入。
10.3386/w35528.title: Beliefs That Predict Returns and Beliefs That Attract Flows: Policy Insights and Sentiment Catering in Mutual Funds
10.3386/w35528.title_zh: 预测回报的信念与吸引资金的信念：共同基金中的政策洞察与情绪迎合

10.3386/w35529.abstract: We study how temperature fluctuations affect U.S. state-level economic conditions using high frequency, weekly data from 1987 to 2024. The impulse response to a temperature shock from a panel local projection framework reveals a modest short-run increase in economic conditions followed by a delayed and persistent medium-run decline. Nonlinearities show that the medium-run decline is larger and more persistent at higher base temperatures. A decomposition of the economic conditions index points to the labor market as the primary channel. To interpret these findings, we develop a weekly labor search and matching model featuring a labor disutility channel, a heat damage stock, and a slow-moving adaptation mechanism.
10.3386/w35529.abstract_zh: 本文利用1987年至2024年的高频周度数据，研究温度波动如何影响美国各州经济状况。基于面板局部投影框架的温度冲击脉冲响应显示，经济状况在短期内温和上升，随后出现延迟且持续的中期下降。非线性分析表明，在较高基准温度下，中期下降幅度更大且更持久。对经济状况指数的分解表明，劳动力市场是主要传导渠道。为解释这些发现，我们构建了一个包含劳动负效用渠道、热损害存量以及缓慢调整适应机制的周度劳动力搜索与匹配模型。
10.3386/w35529.title: Temperature Fluctuations and Economic Conditions: Evidence from Weekly U.S. Data
10.3386/w35529.title_zh: 温度波动与经济状况：来自美国周度数据的证据

10.3386/w35530.abstract: As renewable generation plays a growing role in the energy system, periods of negative wholesale electricity prices are becoming increasingly common and are expected to grow dramatically over the next ten years. Traditionally, system operators respond by paying generators, especially renewables, to curtail production, or mandating that they do so without compensation. In this study, we propose and test a novel alternative: exposing consumers to free and negative prices to stimulate demand when supply is abundant. We implemented large-scale nationwide natural field experiments simultaneously in Great Britain and Spain, with roughly 60,000 residential customers in each country randomized to receive varying financial incentives to “turn up” their electricity. We found that demand increased substantially as prices fell to zero, but paying customers to consume beyond zero price yielded little additional response. Households with electric vehicles and rooftop solar had a larger elasticity than households without such technologies, suggesting demand turn-up becomes more effective as households adopt low-carbon technologies. In Great Britain, consumption was largely shifted from adjacent hours, while in Spain the increase appeared to represent net new demand. We develop a welfare framework showing conditions under which demand turn-up improves on curtailment; we find that by inducing additional consumption in periods and locations where the marginal cost of supply is low, demand turn-up generates welfare gains that curtailment leaves uncaptured.
10.3386/w35530.abstract_zh: 随着可再生能源在能源系统中扮演日益重要的角色，负批发电价现象正变得愈发普遍，预计未来十年将大幅增长。传统上，系统运营商会通过向发电商（尤其是可再生能源发电商）支付费用要求其削减产量，或强制其无偿减产来应对这一情况。本研究提出并检验了一种创新替代方案：在供应充裕时，通过向消费者提供零电价甚至负电价来刺激需求。我们在英国和西班牙同步开展了大规模全国性自然现场实验，每个国家约有6万户居民被随机分配接受不同力度的经济激励，以"提升"其用电量。研究发现，当电价降至零时，需求显著增长；但通过付费激励消费者在零电价基础上进一步增加用电，收效甚微。拥有电动汽车和屋顶太阳能的家庭需求弹性显著高于未配备此类技术的家庭，这表明随着家庭采用低碳技术，"需求提升"策略将更为有效。在英国，用电增量主要来自相邻时段的用电转移；而在西班牙，用电增长则表现为净新增需求。我们构建了一个福利分析框架，揭示了"需求提升"优于"削减产量"的条件：通过在供应边际成本较低的时段和区域诱导额外消费，"需求提升"能够产生"削减产量"策略无法实现的福利增益。
10.3386/w35530.title: A Demand-Side Alternative to Renewable Curtailment: Natural Field Experimental Evidence from Two Countries
10.3386/w35530.title_zh: 可再生能源弃电的需求侧替代方案：来自两国的自然实地实验证据

10.3386/w35531.abstract: This paper examines reforms in China’s imperial examination system during the Northern Song dynasty that anonymized exam submissions and ended local officials’ discretion to recommend candidates. Using prefecture-level data from 960–1127 and a difference-in-differences design, we compare areas with and without prominent elite families, where corruption and elite capture were more likely. The reforms increased the share of successful candidates from commoner backgrounds and narrowed their performance gaps with elites in scholarship and political achievement, indicating better selection of commoner talent. Treated prefectures also saw less social unrest. Overall, the reforms strengthened meritocracy, broadened political access, and promoted stability.
10.3386/w35531.abstract_zh: 本文考察了北宋时期科举制度的改革，该改革对考卷进行匿名处理，并终止了地方官员推荐考生的自由裁量权。利用960年至1127年的府级数据，并采用双重差分法，我们比较了存在显著精英家族的地区（这些地区更易发生腐败和精英俘获）与其他地区的情况。改革提高了来自平民背景的考生中举比例，并缩小了他们与精英阶层在学术造诣和政治成就上的表现差距，表明对平民人才的选拔更为有效。受改革影响的府级地区社会动荡也有所减少。总体而言，改革强化了贤能政治，拓宽了政治参与渠道，并促进了社会稳定。
10.3386/w35531.title: Elite Capture, Meritocracy and Social Stability: Evidence from the Chinese Imperial Examinations
10.3386/w35531.title_zh: 精英俘获、精英统治与社会稳定：来自中国科举制度的证据

10.3386/w35532.abstract: Total fertility rates in East Asia have fallen to levels without historical precedent, even though the region’s Confucian heritage long placed extraordinary emphasis on family continuity and large families. We argue that this “Confucian Fertility Paradox” dissolves once we separate two strands of the tradition and recognize that modernization affected them very differently. The pro-natal strand, built on lineage continuity, ancestor worship, and reliance on sons for old-age support, was gradually switched off as child mortality fell, incomes rose, women entered the labor force, and state pensions replaced the family as the main source of security in old age. What survived was the second strand: the veneration of education and of status won through examination success, rooted in the imperial examination tradition. Under modern conditions this surviving strand reverses sign with respect to its effect on fertility. Where the historical examination system rewarded having many sons so that one might succeed, the modern single-ranking tournament rewards concentrating resources on one or two intensively educated children, and the quantity–quality tradeoff turns a once pro-natal culture into a powerful engine of low fertility. Drawing on recent empirical evidence from China and Korea, we show how education competition becomes the channel through which traditional values now suppress childbearing. We explain why standard pro-natalist policies, such as removing birth restrictions or offering cash subsidies, accomplish little when the underlying problem is a competitive equilibrium in parental investment, and we argue that policies aimed at the source of the distortion, such as structural reform of educational pathways, hold more promise.
10.3386/w35532.abstract_zh: 东亚地区的总和生育率已降至史无前例的低水平，尽管该地区悠久的儒家传统历来极度重视家族延续与多子多福。本文认为，一旦我们将这一传统中的两条脉络加以区分，并认识到现代化对它们产生了截然不同的影响，所谓的"儒家生育悖论"便迎刃而解。第一条鼓励生育的脉络——建立在宗族延续、祖先崇拜以及养儿防老基础之上——随着儿童死亡率下降、收入增长、女性进入劳动力市场以及国家养老金取代家庭成为老年保障的主要来源而逐渐消退。留存下来的是第二条脉络：对教育的尊崇以及通过科举成功获得社会地位的追求，这一传统根植于帝国科举制度。在现代条件下，这条留存下来的脉络对生育的影响发生了逆转。历史上的科举制度奖励多生儿子以增加中举概率，而现代单一排名的锦标赛式竞争则鼓励将资源集中投入于一两个接受精英教育的子女身上。数量与质量的权衡使曾经鼓励生育的文化转变为低生育率的强大引擎。基于来自中国和韩国的最新实证证据，我们揭示了教育竞争如何成为传统价值观抑制生育的传导渠道。我们解释了为何当根本问题在于父母投资中的竞争均衡时，诸如取消生育限制或提供现金补贴等标准鼓励生育政策收效甚微，并论证了针对扭曲根源的政策——例如教育路径的结构性改革——更具前景。
10.3386/w35532.title: The Confucian Fertility Paradox: Education Competition and Ultra-Low Fertility in East Asia
10.3386/w35532.title_zh: 儒家生育悖论：教育竞争与东亚超低生育率

10.3386/w35533.abstract: This paper examines the long-term effects of early-life exposure to county health departments (CHDs), a public health initiative aimed at providing affordable healthcare access to disadvantaged and underserved areas during the early decades of the 20th century, on later-life longevity. We employ Social Security Administration death records linked with the 1940 census and implement a difference-in-differences estimation strategy to compare the longevity of individuals exposed at different ages to the county-specific year of CHD establishment. We find that exposure to a CHD opening in the county of birth during fetal development and early years of life is associated with a 1-4-month increase in longevity. We observe considerable heterogeneity in the results, such that the effects are more concentrated among non-white individuals and individuals with lower-educated parents. Contemporaneous fertility and infant mortality data suggest reductions in infant mortality rates and increases in birth rates following CHD openings. Additionally, we find significant improvements in educational attainment, socioeconomic status, and income in early adulthood. We argue that enhancements in the fetal environment, improved fetal survival, and better early life health capital resulting from CHD exposure contribute to improvements in human capital during adulthood, with potential implications for later-life longevity.
10.3386/w35533.abstract_zh: 本文考察了早期接触县级卫生部门（CHDs）对晚年寿命的长期影响。CHDs是20世纪早期旨在为弱势和医疗服务不足地区提供可负担医疗服务的公共卫生举措。我们利用与1940年人口普查相关联的社会保障管理局死亡记录，并采用双重差分估计策略，比较不同年龄接触县级卫生部门设立年份的个体的寿命差异。研究发现，在胎儿发育期和生命早期接触出生县CHD的设立与寿命延长1-4个月相关。结果存在显著异质性，非白人个体及父母教育水平较低的个体受影响更为集中。同期生育率和婴儿死亡率数据显示，CHD设立后婴儿死亡率下降、出生率上升。此外，我们发现早期成年期的教育程度、社会经济地位和收入均有显著改善。我们认为，CHD接触带来的胎儿环境改善、胎儿存活率提升及早期健康资本积累，促进了成年期人力资本提升，并对晚年寿命产生潜在影响。
10.3386/w35533.title: Early Life Healthcare Access and Later-life Mortality: Evidence Using Openings of County Health Departments
10.3386/w35533.title_zh: 早期医疗保健可及性与晚年死亡率：基于县级卫生部门设立的证据

10.3386/w35534.abstract: Tax avoidance through personal holding companies has long been viewed as a key challenge for progressive income taxation. We exploit twenty years of administrative micro-data linking firms to owners in Sweden and Norway to analyze how the use of personal holding companies varies across the income distribution and to quantify its implications in a quasi-experimental setting. About half of the income of the top 0.1% is retained in personal holding companies defined, as in US tax law, as firms for which five or fewer owners own more than 50% of the stock and that derive more than 60% of income from investment income. Event studies of shocks to operational firms’ value-added show that holding companies shield around half of dividend distributions from individual income taxation. Profits tend to remain in holding companies for long periods of time, with cumulative payout rates of 15%–20% over two decades for the highest income groups. Wealth taxes do not provide an effective backstop due to the low valuation (or exemption) of shares in private businesses. As a result, effective tax rates, all taxes included, fall from about 50% for the upper middle class to about 15%–20% among the highest-net-worth individuals. Accounting for income in holding companies erases half of the difference in the 1980–2020 rise of the top 1% fiscal income share between Nordic countries and the United States, where rules penalizing the use of holding companies have been in place since the 1930s.
10.3386/w35534.abstract_zh: 通过个人控股公司避税长期以来被视为累进所得税制面临的关键挑战。我们利用瑞典和挪威二十年来将企业与所有者关联的行政微观数据，分析个人控股公司的使用如何随收入分配变化，并在准实验环境中量化其影响。根据美国税法定义，个人控股公司指由不超过五名所有者持有超过50%股份、且超过60%收入来源于投资收入的企业。在最高收入前0.1%群体中，约半数收入留存于此类公司。对运营企业增加值冲击的事件研究表明，控股公司约将半数股息分配从个人所得税中屏蔽。利润往往长期留存于控股公司，最高收入群体二十年累计派息率仅为15%-20%。由于私人企业股份估值偏低（或享受豁免），财富税无法提供有效补充。因此，包含所有税种在内的实际税率，从中上阶层的约50%降至最高净值人群的约15%-20%。若将控股公司收入纳入统计，1980-2020年间北欧国家与美国的顶层1%财政性收入份额增长差异将缩小一半——美国自1930年代起便实施限制控股公司使用的规则。
10.3386/w35534.title: Personal Holding Companies, Tax Progressivity, and Inequality
10.3386/w35534.title_zh: 个人控股公司、税收累进性与不平等

10.3386/w35535.abstract: We document arguably unintended returns of biodiversity conservation to science discovery, exploiting the 2002 fishing ban in China—an ecosystem restoration policy without explicit science-related objectives, which allows us to implement a difference-in-differences design across fish species. We find that the ban substantially increased research on affected species: funded programs rose by 21.5%, total funding by 22.8%, publications per program by 97.0%, and citations per paper by 106.7%. The effect is concentrated among researchers with geographic access to the river, and is stronger for non-extinct species and non-farmed fish species, suggesting that conservation expanded the supply of biological materials available for research. The ban also increased related public influence and patents. These results reveal that biodiversity conservation generates a significant scientific dividend through the restoration of natural research inputs, with implications for evaluating the broader benefits of ecosystem protections in an underdiscussed dimension for the science of science.
10.3386/w35535.abstract_zh: 我们记录了生物多样性保护对科学发现的意外回报，利用2002年中国实施的禁渔令——一项没有明确科学相关目标的生态系统恢复政策，这使得我们能够对鱼类物种进行双重差分设计。研究发现，禁渔令显著增加了受影响物种的研究：资助项目数量上升21.5%，总资助金额增加22.8%，每个项目的论文产出提高97.0%，每篇论文的引用量增长106.7%。这一效应集中在具有河流地理接近性的研究人员中，且对非灭绝物种和非养殖鱼类更为显著，表明保护措施扩大了可供研究的生物材料供给。禁渔令还提升了相关的公众影响力及专利数量。这些结果揭示，生物多样性保护通过恢复自然研究投入产生了显著的科学红利，对在科学学中尚未充分讨论的维度上评估生态系统保护的更广泛效益具有启示意义。
10.3386/w35535.title: The Scientific Return of Biodiversity Conservation: Evidence from Fishing Bans Along the Yangtze River
10.3386/w35535.title_zh: 生物多样性保护的科学回报：来自长江禁渔政策的证据

10.3386/w35536.abstract: Progressive taxation is central to high-income countries' tax systems, but developing countries typically rely on less progressive instruments. We study the introduction of progressive property taxation in a large Congolese city through a citywide field experiment conducted in partnership with the provincial government. Neighborhoods were randomly assigned to a progressive or a proportional schedule. The progressive schedule increased revenue by 56% relative to the proportional one. Gains occurred throughout the property value distribution: at the top, higher statutory rates mechanically raised revenue despite modest compliance losses; at the bottom, lower rates induced compliance gains large enough to offset lower liabilities. Cross-randomized information treatments show that taxpayers responded primarily to their own rates, not to others' rates or to the perceived fairness of the overall schedule. Effective tax rates – taxes paid as a share of property value – declined with property value and were most regressive under the progressive schedule. However, after a progressive schedule was scaled up citywide in subsequent years, targeted enforcement among high-value properties reversed this pattern, aligning statutory and effective rates. Together, the results suggest that progressive property taxation can raise fiscal capacity in low-income settings and, when paired with targeted enforcement, further shift the tax burden onto wealthier property owners.
10.3386/w35536.abstract_zh: 累进税制是高收入国家税收体系的核心，但发展中国家通常采用累进性较弱的税制。我们与省政府合作，在刚果某大城市开展了一项全市范围的实地实验，研究累进财产税的引入效果。社区被随机分配至累进税率或比例税率方案。相较于比例税率，累进税率使税收收入增加56%。这一增长覆盖了全部房产价值区间：在高端房产中，尽管存在适度的合规损失，但更高的法定税率机械性地提升了收入；在低端房产中，较低的税率带来的合规收益足以抵消税负减少的影响。交叉随机信息干预实验表明，纳税人主要对自身税率做出反应，而非他人税率或整体税制的公平性感知。有效税率（即实际缴纳的税款占房产价值的比例）随房产价值递减，且在累进税制下呈现最强的累退性。然而，当累进税制在后续年份推广至全市范围后，针对高价值房产的定向执法扭转了这一趋势，使法定税率与有效税率趋于一致。综合来看，研究结果表明：累进财产税能够提升低收入地区的财政汲取能力，若配合定向执法，可进一步将税负转移至更富裕的房产所有者。
10.3386/w35536.title: Does Progressivity Raise Tax Capacity? Experimental Evidence from the D.R. Congo
10.3386/w35536.title_zh: 累进性是否提升税收能力？来自刚果（金）的实验证据

10.3386/w35537.abstract: Financial incentives may encourage vaccination, but their cost-effectiveness depends on targeting patients who are most responsive. We conducted a randomized controlled trial with 57,579 adult patients in an integrated health system during the 2021–2022 influenza season. Patients with an upcoming appointment were randomized to a no-contact control, a simple reminder, a $1 cash incentive, or a scratch-off lottery ticket incentive worth up to $5,000. Any active intervention increased vaccination at the scheduled appointment by 2 percentage points (an 8% increase over the control mean) and by 1.5 percentage points over the full influenza season. The three active arms did not differ significantly, indicating that small financial incentives provided no additional benefit beyond a reminder. Using electronic health records and area-level characteristics, we used causal forests to estimate conditional average treatment effects. Predicted responsiveness varied substantially: patients in the top quartile were 3–4 times more likely to respond to incentives than those in the bottom quartile, whereas reminder effects were relatively homogeneous. These findings suggest that low-cost reminders can increase influenza vaccination, while machine-learning methods can help identify patients most responsive to small financial incentives.
10.3386/w35537.abstract_zh: 经济激励可能促进疫苗接种，但其成本效益取决于能否精准锁定最易响应的患者群体。我们在2021-2022年流感季期间，对某整合医疗系统中57,579名成年患者开展随机对照试验。将近期有预约的患者随机分为四组：无接触对照组、简单提醒组、1美元现金激励组、最高价值5000美元的刮刮乐彩票激励组。任何主动干预措施均使预约接种率提升2个百分点（较对照组均值增长8%），整个流感季接种率提升1.5个百分点。三个干预组间无显著差异，表明小额经济激励相较于单纯提醒并未产生额外效益。我们利用电子健康档案与区域特征数据，通过因果森林模型估计条件平均处理效应。预测响应度呈现显著异质性：响应度最高四分位患者对激励措施的反应概率是低四分位患者的3-4倍，而提醒效应的异质性相对较小。研究结果表明，低成本提醒可提升流感疫苗接种率，机器学习方法则有助于识别对小额经济激励最敏感的患者群体。
10.3386/w35537.title: Effects of Lottery Incentives for Influenza Vaccination: Evidence from a Large-Scale Randomized Trial and Causal Forest Analysis
10.3386/w35537.title_zh: 彩票激励对流感疫苗接种的影响：来自大规模随机试验与因果森林分析的证据

10.3386/w3554.abstract: The current debate in Western Europe centers on the relationship between economic and political integration. To address this problem, we construct a simple general equilibrium model in which the returns to trading are directly affected by the availability of a public good. In our model, heterogeneous agents choose both a club and a market to belong to. In the club, agents vote over the public good, are taxed to finance this good, and receive access to it when they trade. In the market, they are randomly matched with a partner. If a match occurs between traders of different clubs, they both suffer a transactions cost.
10.3386/w3554.abstract_zh: 当前西欧的辩论焦点在于经济一体化与政治一体化之间的关系。为解决这一问题，我们构建了一个简单的一般均衡模型，其中贸易收益直接受到公共品可得性的影响。在该模型中，异质性主体需同时选择加入某个俱乐部和某个市场。在俱乐部内部，成员通过投票决定公共品供给，缴纳相应税收以资助该公共品，并在贸易时获得其使用权；而在市场中，主体则随机匹配交易伙伴。若交易双方来自不同俱乐部，则需承担交易成本。
10.3386/w3554.title: DP511 Public Goods in Trade: On the Formation of Markets and Political Jurisdictions
10.3386/w3554.title_zh: DP511 贸易中的公共品：论市场与政治管辖区的形成

10.3386/w3576.abstract: This paper proposes a tractable and realistic nonlinear model of exchange rate dynamics, and argues that its predictions are consistent with available empirical evidence on exchange rate and interest differential behavior in real-life target zones. In our model, the exchange rate fluctuates between given boundaries for random lengths of time and jumps discretely when devaluations occur. We allow for stochastic variability in the likelihood and size of devaluations, and we provide explicit solutions for the stochastic processes followed by the exchange rate and by the expected rate of depreciation. The model produces realistic patterns of covariation between exchange rates and interest rate differentials, and provides interesting interpretations of available empirical evidence. We also specify how to infer devaluation risk from target zone data.
10.3386/w3576.abstract_zh: 本文提出一个易于处理且贴近现实的汇率动态非线性模型，并论证其预测结果与真实目标汇率区中汇率与利差行为的现有实证证据一致。在该模型中，汇率在给定边界内随机时长波动，并在发生贬值时发生离散跳跃。我们允许贬值概率与幅度存在随机变化性，同时为汇率及预期贬值率所遵循的随机过程提供显式解。该模型生成了汇率与利差之间符合现实的协动模式，并对现有实证证据提供了有趣的解释。我们还阐明了如何从目标汇率区数据中推断贬值风险。
10.3386/w3576.title: DP513 Stochastic Devaluation Risk and the Empirical Fit of Target Zone Models
10.3386/w3576.title_zh: DP513 随机贬值风险与目标区间模型的经验拟合

10.3386/w5797.abstract: Inflation targeting is shown to imply inflation forecast targeting; the central bank’s inflation forecast becomes an explicit intermediate target. Inflation forecast targeting simplifies both implementation and monitoring of monetary policy. The weight on output stabilization determines how quickly the inflation forecast is adjusted towards the inflation target. Money growth or exchange rate targeting is generally inferior than inflation targeting and leads to higher inflation variability. Commitment to ‘target rules’ may be better than commitment to ‘instrument rules’.
10.3386/w5797.abstract_zh: 研究表明，通胀目标制实质上意味着通胀预测目标制；央行的通胀预测成为明确的中介目标。通胀预测目标制简化了货币政策的实施与监控。产出稳定权重决定了通胀预测向通胀目标调整的速度。货币增长目标制或汇率目标制通常劣于通胀目标制，并会导致更高的通胀波动性。对"目标规则"的承诺可能优于对"工具规则"的承诺。
10.3386/w5797.title: Inflation Forecast Targeting: Implementing and Monitoring Inflation Targets
10.3386/w5797.title_zh: 通胀预测目标制：通胀目标的实施与监控

10.3386/w5930.title: To Each According To...? Markets, Tournaments, and the Matching Problem with Borrowing Constraints
10.3386/w5930.title_zh: 各尽所能，按需分配？市场、锦标赛与借贷约束下的匹配问题

10.3386/w5960.abstract: This paper surveys the evolution of international capital mobility since the late-nineteenth century. It begins with an overview of empirical evidence on the fall and rise of integration in the global capital market. A discussion of institutional developments focuses on the use of capital controls and the pursuit of domestic macroeconomic policy objectives in the context of changing monetary regimes. A fundamental macroeconomic policy trilemma has forced policy-makers to trade off conflicting goals. The natural implication of the trilemma is that capital mobility has prevailed and expanded under circumstances of widespread political support either for an exchange rate subordinated monetary policy regime (e.g. the gold standard), or for a monetary regime geared mainly towards domestic objectives at the expense of exchange rate stability (e.g. the recent float). Through its effect on popular attitudes towards both the gold standard and the legitimate scope for government macroeconomic intervention, the Great Depression emerges as the key turning point in the recent history of international capital markets.
10.3386/w5960.abstract_zh: 本文梳理了自19世纪末以来国际资本流动性的演变历程。首先概述了全球资本市场一体化兴衰的实证证据。在制度发展讨论中，重点分析了资本管制手段的运用，以及不同货币制度背景下各国追求国内宏观经济政策目标的行为。一个根本性的宏观经济政策三难困境迫使决策者在相互冲突的目标间进行权衡。该三难困境的自然推论是：当汇率从属于货币政策（如金本位制）或货币政策主要服务于国内目标而牺牲汇率稳定（如近期浮动汇率制）获得广泛政治支持时，资本流动性便得以盛行并扩张。通过影响民众对金本位制及政府宏观经济干预合理范围的认知，大萧条成为国际资本市场近代史中的关键转折点。
10.3386/w5960.title: The Great Depression as a Watershed: International Capital Mobility over the Long Run
10.3386/w5960.title_zh: 大萧条作为分水岭：长期国际资本流动

10.3386/w6211.abstract: We investigate whether a welfare-maximizing government ought to pursue a programme of strategic trade intervention or instead commit itself to free trade when, in the former case, domestic firms will have an opportunity to manipulate the government’s choice of the level of intervention. Domestic firms may over-invest in physical and knowledge capital in a regime of strategic intervention in order to influence the government’s choice of subsidy. In the event, a commitment to free trade may be desirable even in settings where profit-shifting would be possible. We analyse the desirability of such a commitment when the government is well informed about firms’ types and actions, and when it suffers from an informational disadvantage.
10.3386/w6211.abstract_zh: 本文探讨在以下情境中，追求社会福利最大化的政府是否应实施战略性贸易干预政策，抑或应承诺自由贸易：在前一种情形下，国内企业将有机会操纵政府对干预水平的选择。在战略性干预体制下，国内企业可能过度投资于物质资本和知识资本，以影响政府对补贴水平的决策。因此，即便存在利润转移的可能性，承诺自由贸易仍可能是可取的选择。我们分析了政府在充分了解企业类型与行为，以及面临信息劣势时，此类承诺的合意性。

10.3982/ecta20506.abstract: <jats:p>Customs data reveal the heterogeneity and granularity of relationships among buyers and sellers, showing how more exports to a destination break down into more firms selling there and more buyers per exporter. We develop a quantitative general equilibrium model of firm‐to‐firm matching that builds on this insight to separate the roles of iceberg costs and matching frictions in gravity. In the cross section, we find matching frictions as important as iceberg costs in impeding trade, and more sensitive to distance. Because domestic and imported intermediates compete directly with labor in performing production tasks, our model also fits the heterogeneity of labor shares across French producers. Applying the framework to the 2004 expansion of the European Union, reduced iceberg costs and reduced matching frictions contributed equally to the increase in French exports to the new members. While workers benefited overall, those competing most directly with imports gained less, even losing in some countries entering the EU.</jats:p>
10.3982/ecta20506.abstract_zh: 海关数据揭示了买卖双方关系的异质性和颗粒度，显示对某一目的地的出口增长如何分解为更多企业在该地销售以及每个出口商拥有更多买家。我们构建了一个企业间匹配的量化一般均衡模型，基于这一洞察，将冰山成本与匹配摩擦在引力模型中的作用分离开来。在横截面分析中，我们发现匹配摩擦在阻碍贸易方面与冰山成本同等重要，且对距离更为敏感。由于国内和进口中间品在生产任务中直接与劳动力竞争，我们的模型也拟合了法国各企业劳动份额的异质性。将该框架应用于2004年欧盟扩张，冰山成本的降低与匹配摩擦的减少对法国向新成员国出口增长的贡献相当。尽管工人整体受益，但与进口竞争最直接的工人获益较少，甚至在部分加入欧盟的国家中遭受损失。
10.3982/ecta20506.title: Firm‐to‐Firm Trade: Imports, Exports, and the Labor Market
10.3982/ecta20506.title_zh: 企业间贸易：进口、出口与劳动力市场

10.3982/ecta21839.abstract: <jats:p>This paper explores the impact of information design on the auctioneer's revenue in the U.S. offshore oil/gas lease auctions where, post‐auction, the winner decides whether to explore the auctioned tract and must pay the government a royalty on its production value. I first document that there is a positive correlation between the exploration rate and publicly observed losing bids. This suggests that the winning bidder uses the rivals' bids to infer their private information about the tract's potential. I then characterize the equilibrium bidding strategy when the auctioneer designs and commits to how to reveal information on losing bids to the winning bidder. Counterfactual exercises reveal that alternative bid disclosure policies significantly improve auctioneer revenue.</jats:p>
10.3982/ecta21839.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了信息设计对美国海上油气租赁拍卖中拍卖方收益的影响。在拍卖结束后，中标者需决定是否对拍卖地块进行勘探，并须按其生产价值向政府支付特许权使用费。我首先发现，勘探率与公开观察到的未中标报价之间存在正相关关系。这表明，中标者利用竞争对手的报价来推断其关于地块潜力的私人信息。随后，我刻画了当拍卖方设计并承诺如何向中标者披露未中标报价信息时的均衡投标策略。反事实分析表明，替代性的报价披露政策能够显著提高拍卖方收益。
10.3982/ecta21839.title: Information Design in Common Value Auction With Moral Hazard: Application to OCS Leasing Auctions
10.3982/ecta21839.title_zh: 道德风险下的共同价值拍卖信息设计：在OCS租赁拍卖中的应用

10.3982/ecta21926.abstract: <jats:p>Personalizing policies can theoretically increase their effectiveness. However, personalization is difficult when individual types are unobservable and the preferences of policymakers and individuals are not aligned, which could cause individuals to misreport their type. Mechanism design offers a strategy to overcome this issue: offer an “incentive‐compatible” menu of policy choices designed to induce participants to select the variant intended for their type. Using a field experiment that personalized incentives for exercise among 6,800 adults with diabetes and hypertension in urban India, we show that personalizing with an incentive‐compatible choice menu substantially improves program performance, increasing the treatment effect of incentives on exercise by 80% without increasing incentive costs relative to a one‐size‐fits‐all benchmark. Offering choice achieves similar performance to personalizing with an extensive set of observable variables, but without the same data requirements.</jats:p>
10.3982/ecta21926.abstract_zh: 个性化政策在理论上可以提升其有效性。然而，当个体类型不可观测，且政策制定者与个体的偏好不一致时，个性化难以实现，因为这可能导致个体虚报其类型。机制设计提供了一种解决该问题的策略：提供一份“激励相容”的政策选择菜单，旨在引导参与者选择针对其类型设计的方案。通过在印度城市地区对6800名患有糖尿病和高血压的成年人进行一项实地实验，我们证明，采用激励相容的选择菜单进行个性化激励，能显著提升项目绩效：与一刀切的基准方案相比，在不增加激励成本的情况下，将激励对锻炼的处理效应提高了80%。提供选择菜单所达到的效果，与利用大量可观测变量进行个性化处理的效果相当，但无需相同的数据要求。
10.3982/ecta21926.title: Mechanism Design for Personalized Policy: A Field Experiment Incentivizing Exercise
10.3982/ecta21926.title_zh: 个性化政策的机制设计：一项激励运动的实地实验

10.3982/ecta22110.abstract: <jats:p>I document that the right tail of the firm size distribution systematically thickens with economic development. To rationalize this fact, I develop a parsimonious idea search model in which both aggregate growth and the firm size distribution are endogenously determined. The model features an asymptotic balanced growth path along which Gibrat's law holds at each date, and the right tail of the firm size distribution thickens monotonically toward Zipf's law. The model also implies that policies favoring large firms can improve welfare by better utilizing the diffusion externalities arising from idea search.</jats:p>
10.3982/ecta22110.abstract_zh: 本文发现，企业规模分布的右尾随经济发展系统性增厚。为解释这一事实，我构建了一个简约的思想搜寻模型，其中总量增长与企业规模分布均为内生决定。该模型具有渐进平衡增长路径特征，在此路径上各期均满足吉布拉定律，且企业规模分布的右尾单调增厚直至趋近齐普夫定律。模型还表明，偏好大企业的政策可通过更充分利用思想搜寻产生的扩散外部性来提升社会福利。
10.3982/ecta22110.title: Economic Growth and the Rise of Large Firms
10.3982/ecta22110.title_zh: 经济增长与大型企业的崛起

10.3982/ecta22451.abstract: <jats:p>We construct a dynamic integrated assessment model of climate and the economy with very high geographic resolution. Migration is free within, but not allowed across, countries. The model parameterization uses a wealth of data, including the distribution of output, population, energy sources and use, and estimates of the local damages from climate change. It implies very large geographic dispersion in damages from warming. We conduct three kinds of policy experiments. In one, we note that a modest, uniform carbon tax limits global warming and damages around the world substantially. In a second experiment, we let the poorest countries not tax carbon, while the rest compensate by setting higher taxes; the efficiency losses are large. In a final experiment, we find that fast green technology growth alone is a poor substitute for carbon taxes, whether globally available or not.</jats:p>
10.3982/ecta22451.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个具有极高地理分辨率的动态气候与经济综合评估模型。模型设定中，人口可在国家内部自由迁移，但禁止跨国流动。模型参数化过程运用了丰富的数据集，包括产出分布、人口分布、能源来源与使用情况，以及气候变化对各地造成的损失估算。该模型揭示了全球变暖损失在地理分布上的巨大差异性。我们开展了三类政策实验：其一，适度的统一碳税能够显著抑制全球变暖并大幅降低全球损失；其二，若允许最贫困国家免征碳税，而其他国家通过提高税率进行补偿，则会产生巨大的效率损失；其三，我们发现，无论绿色技术是否实现全球普及，仅靠其快速增长都无法有效替代碳税政策。
10.3982/ecta22451.title: Walras–Bowley Lecture: Climate Policy in the Wide World
10.3982/ecta22451.title_zh: 瓦尔拉斯-鲍利讲座：广阔世界中的气候政策

10.3982/ecta22542.abstract: <jats:p>This paper develops a macroeconomic model that combines an incomplete‐markets overlapping‐generations economy with a job ladder featuring sequential wage bargaining, endogenous search effort of employed and non‐employed workers, and differences in match quality. With these ingredients, our model provides a joint microfoundation for the three main inputs in aggregate production: capital, employment, and labor efficiency. The calibrated model offers a good fit to the empirical age profiles of search activity, job‐finding rates, wages, and savings. We use the model to analyze the impact of tax and transfer policies for labor market dynamics and aggregate economic activity via capital, employment, and labor efficiency channels. Lower unemployment benefits and a less progressive tax schedule bring about welfare losses for a newborn worker which are mainly driven by higher consumption risk and costlier search effort; both policies have differential effects along the age, income, and wealth dimensions.</jats:p>
10.3982/ecta22542.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个宏观经济学模型，该模型将不完全市场的世代交叠经济与包含序贯工资谈判、就业与非就业工人内生搜寻努力以及匹配质量差异的工作阶梯相结合。基于这些要素，我们的模型为总生产中的三个主要投入——资本、就业和劳动效率——提供了统一的微观基础。校准后的模型较好地拟合了搜寻活动、工作找到率、工资和储蓄的年龄分布经验特征。我们利用该模型分析税收与转移支付政策通过资本、就业和劳动效率渠道对劳动力市场动态及总体经济活动的影响。降低失业救济金和减少税收累进性会给新生工人带来福利损失，这主要源于更高的消费风险和更昂贵的搜寻努力；这两种政策在年龄、收入和财富维度上具有差异化效应。
10.3982/ecta22542.title: Job Ladder and Wealth Dynamics in General Equilibrium
10.3982/ecta22542.title_zh: 一般均衡中的职业阶梯与财富动态

10.3982/ecta22979.abstract:
<jats:p>
                    The U.S. Supreme Court's 2010 decision in
                    <jats:italic>Citizens United v. Federal Election Commission</jats:italic>
                    deregulated campaign finance, enabling the rise of a new political action committee (the Super PAC) with broad freedom to raise and spend money. This led to an unprecedented surge in spending in primary and general elections. To evaluate the impact of Super PACs, I estimate a multistage model of political competition using data from U.S. Congressional elections between 2010 and 2020. I find that Super PAC spending by both sides prompts offsetting responses, resulting in limited net equilibrium effects. However, by amplifying the role of donors, Super PACs still have the potential to reshape the electoral landscape.
                  </jats:p>
10.3982/ecta22979.abstract_zh: 美国最高法院2010年就"联合公民诉联邦选举委员会案"作出的裁决放松了对竞选资金的监管，催生了一种新型政治行动委员会（超级政治行动委员会），使其在筹款和支出方面拥有广泛自由。这导致初选和大选中的支出出现前所未有的激增。为评估超级政治行动委员会的影响，我利用2010年至2020年美国国会选举数据，估计了一个多阶段政治竞争模型。研究发现，双方超级政治行动委员会的支出会引发对冲性反应，导致均衡效应有限。然而，通过放大捐赠者的作用，超级政治行动委员会仍有可能重塑选举格局。
10.3982/ecta22979.title: The Equilibrium Effects of Campaign Finance Deregulation on U.S. Elections
10.3982/ecta22979.title_zh: 竞选财务放松管制对美国选举的均衡效应

10.3982/ecta23049.abstract: <jats:p>We consider a dynamic buyer–seller interaction. Instead of the buyer's valuation, it is the frequency with which he needs to trade that is the buyer's private information. The difference matters. With commitment, full surplus extraction is possible, for instance via limited‐time offers. Without commitment, ratcheting is mitigated, as not buying is not necessarily a sign of strength. Because time is informative, the seller learns and may adjust her behavior over time. When finding a suitable alternative seller is easy, she starts with a pooling offer before permanently switching to a screening offer. When finding a suitable alternative seller takes time, she starts with a pooling offer before occasionally experimenting with separating offers.</jats:p>
10.3982/ecta23049.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一种动态的买卖双方互动关系。与买方估值不同，买方需要交易的频率才是其私人信息。这一差异至关重要。在有承诺的情况下，完全剩余提取是可能的，例如通过限时报价。在没有承诺的情况下，棘轮效应得到缓解，因为不购买并不一定意味着买方处于强势地位。由于时间具有信息价值，卖方会随着时间推移学习并可能调整其行为。当寻找合适的替代卖方较为容易时，她会先提出混合报价，然后永久转向筛选报价。当寻找合适的替代卖方需要时间时，她会先提出混合报价，然后偶尔尝试分离报价。
10.3982/ecta23049.title: Dynamic Screening of Buyers With Heterogeneous Purchase Frequency
10.3982/ecta23049.title_zh: 异质性购买频率下买家的动态筛选

10.3982/ecta23174.abstract: <jats:p>We study instrumental variables models characterized by: (i) Unobserved heterogeneity consisting of potential outcomes and response types that describe how the instrument determines treatment choice; (ii) Conditional independence of the instrument and the unobserved heterogeneity; and (iii) Convex restrictions on the distribution of unobserved heterogeneity. We show certain causal parameters are identified in these models if and only if a version of the kappa of Abadie (2003) exists. Our identification results are constructive in yielding estimating moment conditions. Focusing on a leading special case, we develop asymptotically normal estimators based on a doubly robust version of these moment conditions.</jats:p>
10.3982/ecta23174.abstract_zh: 我们研究具有以下特征的工具变量模型：（i）未观测异质性由潜在结果和描述工具如何决定处理选择的响应类型构成；（ii）工具与未观测异质性条件独立；（iii）未观测异质性分布满足凸性约束。我们证明，当且仅当Abadie（2003）的kappa统计量存在时，这些模型中的某些因果参数可被识别。我们的识别结果是建设性的，能够导出估计矩条件。聚焦于一个主要特例，我们基于这些矩条件的双重稳健版本开发了渐近正态估计量。
10.3982/ecta23174.title: Identification in Instrumental Variables Models: The Central Role of Abadie's Kappa
10.3982/ecta23174.title_zh: 工具变量模型中的识别：Abadie's Kappa的核心作用

10.3982/ecta23334.abstract:
<jats:p>
                    Evidence from the laboratory and the field has uncovered both underreaction and overreaction to new information. We provide new experimental evidence on the underlying mechanisms of under‐ and overreaction by comparing how people make inferences
                    <jats:italic>and</jats:italic>
                    revise forecasts in the same information environment. Participants underreact to signals when inferring about underlying states, but overreact to the same signals when revising forecasts about future outcomes—a phenomenon we term “the inference‐forecast gap.” We show that this gap is largely driven by different simplifying heuristics used in the two tasks. Additional treatments suggest that the choice of heuristics is affected by the similarity between statistics in the information environment and the statistic elicited by the belief‐updating problem.
                  </jats:p>
10.3982/ecta23334.abstract_zh: 来自实验室和现场的证据揭示了人们对新信息既存在反应不足也存在反应过度。我们通过比较人们在相同信息环境下如何进行推断和修正预测，提供了关于反应不足与反应过度内在机制的新实验证据。参与者在推断潜在状态时对信号反应不足，但在修正对未来结果的预测时却对相同信号反应过度——我们将这一现象称为“推断-预测差距”。研究表明，这一差距主要由两项任务中使用的不同简化启发式策略驱动。额外实验处理表明，启发式策略的选择受到信息环境中的统计量与信念更新问题所引发的统计量之间相似性的影响。
10.3982/ecta23334.title: The Inference‐Forecast Gap in Belief Updating
10.3982/ecta23334.title_zh: 信念更新中的推断-预测差距

10.3982/ecta23345.abstract: <jats:p>We consider impulse response inference in a locally misspecified vector autoregression (VAR) model. The conventional local projection (LP) confidence interval has correct coverage even when the misspecification is so large that it can be detected with probability approaching 1. This result follows from a “double robustness” property analogous to that of popular partially linear regression estimators. By contrast, the conventional VAR confidence interval with short‐to‐moderate lag length can severely undercover for misspecification that is small, difficult to detect statistically, and cannot be ruled out based on economic theory. The VAR confidence interval has robust coverage if, and only if, the lag length is so large that the interval is as wide as the LP interval.</jats:p>
10.3982/ecta23345.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在局部误设定的向量自回归（VAR）模型中脉冲响应推断的问题。传统的局部投影（LP）置信区间即使在误设定程度大到能以趋近于1的概率被检测到时，仍能保持正确的覆盖率。这一结果源于一种与流行的部分线性回归估计量相似的“双重稳健性”性质。相比之下，采用短至中等滞后长度的传统VAR置信区间，在面对较小、难以从统计上检测且无法基于经济理论排除的误设定时，可能严重低估覆盖率。VAR置信区间只有在滞后长度足够大，使其区间宽度与LP区间相当时，才具有稳健的覆盖率。
10.3982/ecta23345.title: Double Robustness of Local Projections and Some Unpleasant VARithmetic
10.3982/ecta23345.title_zh: 局部投影的双重稳健性与一些令人不快的VAR算术

10.3982/ecta23358.abstract: <jats:p>Unlike gender or race, class background is rarely a focus of research on career progression, or of DEI efforts in elite occupations. Should it be? In this paper, we document a large class gap in career progression in one occupation—U.S. tenure‐track academia—using parental education to proxy for class background. First‐generation college graduates are 10% less likely to be tenured at an R1, are tenured at institutions ranked 11% lower, earn 3% less, and report 5% lower job satisfaction, than their former PhD classmates (from the same institution and field) with a parent with a non‐PhD graduate degree. Neither selection out of academia nor different preferences explain this gap; differential research productivity also plays little role. Instead, likely drivers are differences in cultural and social capital. We also find a class gap in career progression for PhDs who work in industry, suggesting this phenomenon generalizes outside academia.</jats:p>
10.3982/ecta23358.abstract_zh: 与性别或种族不同，阶级背景很少成为职业发展研究或精英职业领域多元化、公平与包容（DEI）举措的关注焦点。那么，它是否应该被重视？本文以美国终身教职制学术界这一职业为例，利用父母教育程度作为阶级背景的代理变量，揭示了职业发展中的显著阶级差距。与父母拥有非博士研究生学位的同届博士同学（来自同一院校和领域）相比，第一代大学毕业生在R1研究型大学获得终身教职的可能性低10%，其任职院校排名低11%，收入少3%，且工作满意度低5%。这一差距既非源于学术界的选择性退出，也非偏好差异所致；研究生产力的差异同样作用甚微。相反，文化资本和社会资本的差异是可能的驱动因素。此外，我们发现在产业界工作的博士群体中也存在职业发展的阶级差距，这表明该现象具有超越学术界的普遍性。
10.3982/ecta23358.title: The Class Gap in Career Progression: Evidence From U.S. Academia
10.3982/ecta23358.title_zh: 职业晋升中的阶级差距：来自美国学术界的证据

10.3982/ecta944sum.title_zh: 向计量经济学会专著系列投稿

10.3982/qe173bm.title_zh: 数量经济学第17卷第3期附录
