url:464b3c16c318c634.abstract: Asia-Pacific has undergone a profound transformation over the past few decades, increasing its share in global trade and GDP. This paper assesses to what extent Asia-Pacific’s role in global finance has expanded commensurately and whether it has become more integrated by systematically analyzing crossborder financial data. We combine descriptive analyses of past trends in financial positions with network analysis to understand how inter- and intra- regional financial linkages have evolved for economies in the region. We find that Asia-Pacific’s role in global finance still significantly lags its role in global trade and that there is considerable heterogeneity within the region. Advanced economies in the region are well integrated into global financial markets, whereas most emerging markets exhibit more limited integration. Financial integration within the region is also low but diverges significantly by instrument. Intra-regional financial integration is advancing in foreign direct investment (FDI) and cross-border banking (the latter from low levels), but has remained limited in foreign portfolio investment (FPI). Gravity model analysis indicates a significant association between trade and FDI, but not between trade and FPI. We conclude the paper with policy recommendations to promote resilient financial integration in Asia-Pacific.
url:464b3c16c318c634.abstract_zh: 过去数十年间，亚太地区经历了深刻变革，其在全球贸易与GDP中的份额持续攀升。本文通过系统分析跨境金融数据，评估亚太地区在全球金融体系中的角色是否同步扩大，以及区域金融一体化程度是否有所提升。我们结合金融头寸历史趋势的描述性分析与网络分析方法，探究区域内及区域间金融关联的演变路径。研究发现：亚太地区在全球金融体系中的地位仍显著滞后于其在全球贸易中的角色，且区域内部存在显著异质性。区域内发达经济体已深度融入全球金融市场，而多数新兴市场的金融一体化程度相对有限。区域内部金融一体化水平整体偏低，但不同金融工具呈现显著分化——外商直接投资与跨境银行业务（后者虽基数较低）的区域内一体化程度有所提升，而证券投资组合的区域内一体化仍显不足。引力模型分析表明，贸易与外商直接投资之间存在显著关联，但贸易与证券投资组合之间未呈现类似关系。本文最后提出促进亚太地区韧性金融一体化的政策建议。
url:464b3c16c318c634.title: The Changing Landscape of Financial Integration in Asia-Pacific
url:464b3c16c318c634.title_zh: 亚太金融一体化格局的变迁

url:465f9355664512dd.abstract: Populist leaders often campaign against bureaucratic constraints, yet their economic performance may depend on the very institutional environment they inherit. We examine whether bureaucracy moderates the economic costs of populism using two complementary settings: cross-country synthetic-control evidence and a U.S. state-year panel spanning 1929–2023. The cross-country analysis offers suggestive evidence that the output decline following populist takeovers is attenuated in countries with stronger pre-existing bureaucratic institutions, particularly where bureaucracies are more independent. The U.S. state analysis provides sharper, within-country evidence. Leveraging LLM estimates of guberna-torial populism derived from State of the State speeches, we find that populist governors are associated with significantly lower per-capita income in states lacking an independent civil service, while no comparable penalty emerges—and the association is more than off-set—where such protections are in force. Heterogeneity-robust event-study estimates point in the same direction, with the post-entry income decline concentrated in states without civil-service reform. Together, the evidence is consistent with independent bureaucracies acting as a partial buffer against the economic costs of populist governance: the ”swamp” appears to dampen the damage populism would otherwise cause.
url:465f9355664512dd.abstract_zh: 民粹主义领导人常以反对官僚体制束缚为竞选纲领，但其经济表现可能取决于所继承的制度环境。本文通过两个互补性研究设计——跨国合成控制证据与覆盖1929-2023年的美国州级面板数据——考察官僚体制是否调节了民粹主义的经济成本。跨国分析提供初步证据表明，在既有官僚制度更健全的国家（尤其是官僚机构独立性更强的国家），民粹主义执政后的产出下降幅度有所缓和。美国州级分析则提供了更精确的国内证据。通过利用大语言模型对州情咨文中州长民粹主义倾向的估算，本研究发现：在缺乏独立公务员制度的州，民粹主义州长与人均收入显著下降相关；而在实施公务员保护制度的州，不仅未出现类似的经济惩罚效应，其关联性甚至被完全抵消。异质性稳健的事件研究估计指向相同结论——民粹主义执政后的收入下降集中在未实施公务员制度改革的州。综合证据表明，独立官僚机构可作为缓冲机制部分抵消民粹主义治理的经济成本：所谓"沼泽"反而抑制了民粹主义本可能造成的损害。
url:465f9355664512dd.title: Do Not Drain The Swamp! Populism, Bureaucracy and Economic Performance
url:465f9355664512dd.title_zh: 不要抽干沼泽！民粹主义、官僚主义与经济绩效

url:4668a0691a8fcf22.abstract: This essay presents a rigorous theory of involuntary unemployment in less developed countries based on the observation that at low consumption levels a person's overall ability to work is impaired. The theory links the incidence of involuntary unemployment in a market economy to the incidence of malnutrition and this in turn to inequality in the distribution of physical assets. The theory is a classical one and attention is deliberately concentrated on situations where there is no aggregate demand deficiency. It is shown that certain patterns of inequality-reducing asset redistribution reduce the incidence of mal-nourishment and the volume of employment and thus increase the aggregate level of output in a market economy. In particular, this means that in such economies there is no necessary conflict between the goal of equality (in the distribution of assets and consumption) and the goal of increasing the aggregate level of output and employment.
url:4668a0691a8fcf22.abstract_zh: 本文基于低消费水平会损害个人整体工作能力的观察，提出了一个关于欠发达国家非自愿失业的严谨理论。该理论将市场经济中非自愿失业的发生率与营养不良的发生率联系起来，进而与物质资产分配的不平等联系起来。这一理论属于古典经济学范畴，并特意聚焦于不存在总需求不足的情形。研究表明，某些减少不平等的资产再分配模式能够降低营养不良的发生率与就业规模，从而提升市场经济的总产出水平。这意味着，在此类经济体中，平等（资产与消费分配方面）目标与提高总产出及就业水平的目标之间并不必然存在冲突。
url:4668a0691a8fcf22.title: DP50 Inequality, Malnutrition and Unemployment
url:4668a0691a8fcf22.title_zh: DP50 不平等、营养不良与失业

url:467bd8738bfd1e11.title: Occupational affiliation and the incidence of environmental regulation
url:467bd8738bfd1e11.title_zh: 职业归属与环境规制的发生率

url:4687e2b0cf2e6eb8.abstract: Fathers’ parental leave uptake remains low in many advanced economies despite substantial policy efforts. We study a setting where financial and eligibility barriers are minimal: employed, native-born first-time fathers entitled to generous, non-transferable leave benefits. Using Swedish population register data for 1995–2015, we document three key facts: (i) low uptake follows a persistent U-shaped income gradient, (ii) its determinants vary across the distribution—economic constraints at the bottom and top, workplace norms in the middle—and (iii) these constraints have grown more salient over time. Quota reforms increased uptake on average but did not narrow differences in low uptake between constrained and unconstrained fathers. Using quasi-random sibling-sex composition, we show that exposure to traditional gender-role environments increases the likelihood of low uptake in recent cohorts. The results highlight the limits of financial incentives and point to workplace and household norms as central barriers to equal parental leave participation.
url:4687e2b0cf2e6eb8.abstract_zh: 尽管许多发达经济体出台了大量政策，父亲休育儿假的比例仍然较低。我们研究了一个经济和资格门槛极低的环境：享有优厚且不可转移育儿假福利的受雇本土初为人父者。利用1995-2015年瑞典人口登记数据，我们揭示了三个关键事实：（i）低休假率呈现持续性的U型收入梯度；（ii）其决定因素在不同收入分布区间存在差异——底层和顶层受经济约束，中间层受职场规范影响；（iii）这些约束随时间推移愈发显著。配额改革虽平均提高了休假率，但未能缩小受约束与不受约束父亲之间低休假率的差异。利用准随机兄弟姐妹性别构成，我们发现接触传统性别角色环境会增加近期队列中低休假率的可能性。研究结果凸显了经济激励的局限性，并指出职场和家庭规范是阻碍育儿假平等参与的核心障碍。
url:4687e2b0cf2e6eb8.title: Fathers but not caregivers

url:4689301a24671ba8.title_zh: 谷物产量的温度敏感性与适应性：来自意大利的经验证据

url:46ae050258128d84.title_zh: 数字信贷平台如何影响企业融资能力

url:46af05976942b9b5.title: A Joint Test of Unconfoundedness and Common Trends
url:46af05976942b9b5.title_zh: 无混淆性与共同趋势的联合检验

url:46ce545f2493a029.abstract: When do labor-market shocks become lasting health inequality? We develop and estimate a continuous-time lifecycle model of wealth, health, and skill in which medical care combines smooth maintenance with threshold-crossing repair. Adverse wage shocks push financially fragile households toward subsistence, increase toxic labor effort, delay repair, and convert temporary earnings losses into persistent biological damage. Estimated with PSID, MEPS, and RAND HRS data, the model shows that skill-biased technical change generates concentrated lower-tail losses in health, survival, and welfare. A meaningful share of this damage reflects endogenous repair failure, and the mechanism remains visible in a parsimonious general-equilibrium environment.
url:46ce545f2493a029.abstract_zh: 劳动力市场冲击何时会演变为持久的健康不平等？我们构建并估计了一个涵盖财富、健康与技能的连续时间生命周期模型，其中医疗护理兼具平滑维护与阈值修复的双重特征。不利的工资冲击使财务脆弱的家庭陷入生存困境，增加有害的劳动投入，延迟修复行为，并将暂时性收入损失转化为持续性生理损伤。基于PSID、MEPS和RAND HRS数据的估计结果显示，技能偏向型技术进步在健康、生存和福利方面产生了集中的低端损失。这种损害中有相当一部分源于内生的修复失败机制，且该机制在简约的一般均衡环境中依然清晰可辨。

url:46d37636cd2f2e30.abstract: The paper examines the possible motivations behind the plea for fiscal rules in the Delors Report. We argue that coordination problems arising from aggregate demand spillovers cannot be solved by means of budget rules and that in any case they are not important in Europe. We then discuss the notion of structural fiscal imbalances and show that potential solvency is a problem for some European countries, probably made more severe by EMU. Membership of countries with unsustainable positions may represent a risk for the stability of the union because of financial spillovers. Neither monetary discipline enforced by a `conservative' European Central Bank nor market discipline will by themselves prevent fiscal indiscipline or insulate the union from its consequences. Specific sanctions are needed to affect political choices by creating a trade-off between debt and monetary stability. The most effective sanction in our view would be a no-entry clause, such that membership is made contingent upon specifically defined changes in the fiscal positions of the countries concerned.
url:46d37636cd2f2e30.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了《德洛尔报告》中倡导财政规则的可能动机。我们认为，由总需求溢出效应引发的协调问题无法通过预算规则解决，且此类问题在欧洲并不显著。随后，我们讨论了结构性财政失衡的概念，并指出部分欧洲国家存在潜在偿付能力问题，而经济货币联盟可能加剧这一困境。由于金融溢出效应，财政不可持续的国家加入联盟可能对联盟稳定性构成风险。无论是通过“保守型”欧洲中央银行实施的货币纪律，还是市场纪律，都无法单独遏制财政失范行为，或使联盟免受其后果影响。需要制定具体制裁措施，通过建立债务与货币稳定之间的权衡关系来影响政治决策。我们认为，最有效的制裁措施是设置准入条款，即成员国资格需以相关国家财政状况的特定变革为前提条件。
url:46d37636cd2f2e30.title: DP516 Fiscal Rules in the European Monetary Union: A No-Entry Clause
url:46d37636cd2f2e30.title_zh: DP516 欧洲货币联盟中的财政规则：一项禁止进入条款

url:4724bcc4ea67e8cf.abstract: This paper investigates the relationship between intergenerational social mobility, migration aspirations, and participation in political demonstrations. Using individual-level data from the Latinobarómetro between 2002 and 2023, we show that individuals experiencing negative intergenerational educational mobility are more likely to express a desire to migrate and to participate into peaceful protests, whereas those with positive mobility exhibit the opposite pattern. Our analysis further suggests that the decision to migrate and to protest may be shaped by a common underlying decision process. Finally, we find that confidence in political institutions and positive economic expectations substantially mitigate expressions of social discontent in the form of migration aspirations and protest participation. Overall, the results indicate that unequal opportunities across generations are an important determinant of both migration intentions and political engagement.
url:4724bcc4ea67e8cf.abstract_zh: 本文研究了代际社会流动、移民意愿与参与政治示威之间的关系。利用2002年至2023年间拉丁美洲晴雨表的个体层面数据，我们发现，经历负向代际教育流动的个体更可能表达移民意愿并参与和平抗议，而经历正向代际教育流动的个体则呈现相反模式。进一步分析表明，移民与抗议决策可能受共同潜在决策过程的影响。最后，我们发现对政治体制的信心与积极的经济预期能显著缓解以移民意愿和抗议参与形式表现的社会不满情绪。总体而言，研究结果表明代际机会不平等是移民意向与政治参与的重要决定因素。
url:4724bcc4ea67e8cf.title: Social mobility, Protests, and Migration: Evidence from Latin American Countries
url:4724bcc4ea67e8cf.title_zh: 社会流动、抗议与移民：来自拉丁美洲国家的证据

url:474e6ebb8ac02a87.abstract: Using employer-employee Italian data over the period 1998-2018 we analyze the impact of the largest regularization of undocumented immigrant workers in Italy on wage, employment and mobility outcomes of natives. Our empirical strategy takes advantage of the 2002 Bossi-Fini law that unexpectedly regularized 634,000 undocumented non-EU immigrants, with variation across firms and provinces that was not correlated with previous economic performance. We find that the policy had a small effect on the average wage of native workers and positive effects on their employment at the local labor market level. Additionally, native co-workers in firms more affected by the policy were more likely to change employers in the post-policy period. Such higher mobility resulted in a heterogeneous wage effect across switchers: workers that managed to transition towards better firms experienced wage gains in the medium- and long-run, while other workers experienced wage losses. This implied an increase in wage dispersion for natives and some losers among Italian workers.
url:474e6ebb8ac02a87.abstract_zh: 基于1998-2018年意大利雇主-雇员匹配数据，本文分析了意大利最大规模非法移民合法化政策对本土劳动者工资、就业及流动性的影响。实证策略利用2002年《博西-菲尼法》意外合法化63.4万非欧盟非法移民这一准自然实验，通过企业与省份层面的变异识别政策效应，且该变异与地区前期经济表现无关。研究发现：该政策对本土劳动者平均工资影响较小，但在地方劳动力市场层面产生了正向就业效应；此外，受政策冲击较大的企业中，本土同事在政策实施后更可能更换雇主。这种高流动性导致流动者面临异质性工资效应：成功转向优质企业的劳动者在中长期获得工资增长，而其他流动者则遭受工资损失。这最终加剧了本土劳动者的工资离散度，并导致部分意大利劳动者成为政策受损方。
url:474e6ebb8ac02a87.title: DP21781 Immigrants' Regularization and Native Workers' Response
url:474e6ebb8ac02a87.title_zh: DP21781 移民身份合法化与本土工人的反应

url:4758917d4db997c6.title_zh: 变化世界中的欧洲：韧性、产业政策与碎片化的政治经济学

url:477596927ba5e54b.abstract: We develop and empirically support a theory showing that when firms patent enhancements to incumbent, non-disruptive technologies, they can cooperate more easily on these technologies, increasing their profitability. The downside of cooperating on non-disruptive technologies is that the investment in and commitment to disruptive technologies decline. To improve their commitment to disruptive technologies, some firms rely more on trade secrecy. We provide empirical support for these predictions. We document that after a patent reform that made information about patent applications widely accessible, firms cooperate more and charge higher markups. Furthermore, the nature of patented innovation has changed, with the proportion of non-disruptive patents increasing substantially. Finally, while some firms start patenting more, others patent less and rely more on trade secrecy, with the response depending on the attractiveness of firms' innovation prospects.
url:477596927ba5e54b.abstract_zh: 我们构建并实证支持了一个理论，表明当企业为现有非颠覆性技术的改进申请专利时，它们在这些技术上更容易合作，从而提高盈利能力。然而，合作于非颠覆性技术的弊端在于，对颠覆性技术的投资和承诺会减少。为了增强对颠覆性技术的承诺，一些企业更加依赖商业秘密保护。我们为这些预测提供了实证支持。我们记录到，在专利改革使得专利申请信息广泛可获取之后，企业合作增多并收取更高的加成率。此外，专利创新的性质发生了变化，非颠覆性专利的比例大幅增加。最后，虽然一些企业开始增加专利申请，但另一些企业则减少专利申请并更多依赖商业秘密，其反应取决于企业创新前景的吸引力。
url:477596927ba5e54b.title: Disclosure, Patenting, and Trade Secrecy

url:4790bd356db8a9ec.abstract: An organization is autonomous if it has the right or power of self-government. Self-government implies that autonomous organizations cannot rely on outside parties for contract enforcement; all contracts must be relational or self-executing. We present a model in which an autonomous organization commits to a governance structure that allocates managerial power to some members. We show that the organization faces a trilemma: the goals of autonomy, decentralization, and efficiency conflict with one another. Thus, the optimal governance structure of an autonomous organization is centralized. Centralization implies inequality in power and payoffs among members of autonomous organizations.
url:4790bd356db8a9ec.abstract_zh: 如果一个组织拥有自治权或自我治理的能力，则该组织具有自主性。自我治理意味着自主组织不能依赖外部主体执行契约；所有契约必须是关系型或自我执行的。我们构建了一个模型，其中自主组织承诺采用一种将管理权力分配给部分成员的治理结构。研究表明，该组织面临一个三难困境：自主性、去中心化与效率这三个目标相互冲突。因此，自主组织的最优治理结构是集权化的。集权化意味着自主组织成员之间在权力和收益分配上存在不平等。
url:4790bd356db8a9ec.title: Governance and Management of Autonomous Organizations
url:4790bd356db8a9ec.title_zh: 自治组织的治理与管理

url:47aec80c44f228d7.abstract: According to administrative data, as many as 25 million children between the ages of 5 and 16 are out-of-school in Pakistan. However, little is known about where these children are in relation to available public and private schooling options. This paper brings together novel data from satellite imagery, the population census, government school censuses of public schools, and publicly available location data on private schools to understand the out-of-school phenomenon at the community level. The paper uses satellite imagery analysis and machine learning methods to present estimates of the accessibility of schools and to describe the whitespace between schools. The paper relies on administrative data from more than 137, 000 public schools and documents the existence of more than 72, 700 private schools using publicly available location data. The approach suggests that 21.7 million children (49 percent of the total) are enrolled in private schools, higher than previously reported official estimates. The paper also presents detailed data on how the out-of-school population, accessibility, and whitespace are distributed geo-spatially across Pakistan. As an application of the strength of using satellite imagery, it analyzes the effect of a major flood event in 2022 on accessibility, whitespace, and catchment areas. Doing so suggests that the 2022 floods affected the schooling of approximately 3.5 million children in Pakistan. Lastly, an in-person ground-truthing survey conducted about 18 months after the floods is used to corroborate the findings. Together, the data sets and methods presented in this paper have applications for both day-to-day monitoring of school infrastructure as well as pre- and post-disaster planning efforts in Pakistan and elsewhere.
url:47aec80c44f228d7.abstract_zh: 根据行政数据，巴基斯坦有多达2500万5至16岁儿童失学。然而，关于这些儿童与现有公立及私立教育资源的空间分布关系，目前知之甚少。本文整合了卫星影像、人口普查、公立学校行政普查及私立学校公开位置数据等新型数据集，从社区层面解析失学现象。通过卫星影像分析与机器学习方法，本文估算了学校的可达性，并描述了学校之间的"空白区域"。研究基于超过13.7万所公立学校的行政数据，并利用公开位置数据确认了超过7.27万所私立学校的存在。分析表明，2170万儿童（占总数的49%）就读于私立学校，这一比例高于此前官方报告的估计值。本文还详细呈现了失学人口、可达性及空白区域在巴基斯坦地理空间上的分布情况。作为卫星影像应用优势的例证，本文分析了2022年特大洪水事件对学校可达性、空白区域及学区范围的影响，结果显示该洪水影响了巴基斯坦约350万儿童的学业。最后，通过洪水发生约18个月后开展的实地验证调查，进一步佐证了研究结论。本文提出的数据集与方法体系，不仅适用于巴基斯坦及其他地区学校基础设施的日常监测，也可服务于灾前预防与灾后重建规划工作。
url:47aec80c44f228d7.title: Where Are Pakistan’s Out-of-School Children ? Mapping Accessibility of Schooling Using Satellite Data and Machine Learning Methods with an Application to the 2022 Floods
url:47aec80c44f228d7.title_zh: 巴基斯坦失学儿童在哪里？利用卫星数据和机器学习方法绘制学校可及性地图——以2022年洪水为例

url:47d975c881a66b94.title_zh: 未选择之路：社会情感学习与学术严谨性

url:4803f27a10f71a85.title_zh: 人工智能采纳的证据：技能短缺的作用

url:4814ec1ea93cdc6d.abstract: We use an algorithm audit of China's four largest job boards to measure the causal effect of a job seeker's gender on the jobs that are recommended to them, and to identify the algorithmic processes that generate those recommendations. Focusing on identical male and female worker profiles seeking jobs in the same industry-occupation cell, we find precisely estimated but modest amounts of gender bias: Jobs recommended to women pay 0.2 percent less, request 0.9 percent less experience, come from smaller firms, and contain .07 standard deviations more stereotypically female content such as requests for patience, carefulness, and beauty. The dominant driver of these gender gaps is content-based matching between posted job ads and the declared gender in new workers' resumes. 'Action-based' mechanisms -based on a worker's own actions or recruiters' reactions to their resume- contribute relatively little to the gaps we measure.
url:4814ec1ea93cdc6d.abstract_zh: 我们通过对中国四大招聘平台的算法审计，测量求职者性别对推荐岗位的因果效应，并识别产生这些推荐的算法过程。聚焦于在同一行业-职业单元中求职的男女工人档案（特征完全相同），我们发现了精确估计但程度适中的性别偏差：推荐给女性的岗位薪资低0.2%，经验要求低0.9%，来自规模较小的企业，且包含多0.07个标准差的刻板女性化内容（如要求耐心、细心、美貌）。这些性别差距的主要驱动因素是招聘广告与新人简历中声明的性别之间的基于内容的匹配。基于工人自身行为或招聘方对其简历反应的"行动型"机制，对我们所测量的差距贡献相对较小。
url:4814ec1ea93cdc6d.title: Measuring Bias in Job Recommender Systems: Auditing the Algorithms

url:485d0086cbef4117.abstract: This paper studies the role of private supplemental health insurance (SHI) in universal healthcare systems. Linking novel microdata on SHI contracts to rich administrative data from Sweden, we document a steep income gradient in take-up: higher-income individuals are substantially more likely to enroll in SHI despite a greater healthcare need among lower-income individuals. Exploiting variation in the timing of employer-sponsored SHI, we find large and persistent increases in healthcare utilization (23 percent). The effects are even larger for low-income individuals and extend beyond specialist consultations to high-value treatments, consistent with binding rationing in public care. Focusing on cancer as a high-stakes condition, we find that SHI increases screening and diagnoses and reduces mortality. Although SHI is privately contracted, its effects materialize largely within the public healthcare system: coverage increases publicly financed utilization and reduces waiting times, generating negative fiscal and congestion externalities.
url:485d0086cbef4117.abstract_zh: 本文研究私人补充医疗保险（SHI）在全民医疗体系中的作用。通过将瑞典新型SHI合同微观数据与丰富的行政数据相关联，我们发现参保率存在显著的收入梯度：尽管低收入群体医疗需求更大，但高收入个体参保SHI的可能性显著更高。利用雇主提供SHI的时间差异，我们发现医疗利用率出现大幅且持续的增长（23%）。这种效应在低收入群体中更为显著，且影响范围从专科门诊延伸至高价值治疗，这与公共医疗中的刚性配给机制一致。以癌症这一高风险疾病为例，我们发现SHI提高了筛查率和诊断率，并降低了死亡率。尽管SHI属于私人合同，但其效应主要显现在公共医疗体系内：参保增加了公共医疗资源的使用并缩短了等待时间，从而产生负面的财政和拥堵外部性。
url:485d0086cbef4117.title: The Impact and Incidence of Supplemental Health Insurance: Evidence from Sweden
url:485d0086cbef4117.title_zh: 补充健康保险的影响与发生率：来自瑞典的证据

url:4867458f774f4f27.abstract: This paper studies the impact of a selective extension of unemployment benefit duration on the incidence of unemployment in Austria. As the new law applies only to elderly workers in certain regions of the country after June 1988, a quasi-experimental situation is created. Unemployment entry is found to rise by between four and eleven percentage points due to the new law. The findings are explained by a breach of an implicit contract; elderly workers receive wages above their marginal product in order to elicit higher effort. Dismissal of elderly workers is now easier because more generous unemployment insurance makes reputation loss for the firm less severe.
url:4867458f774f4f27.abstract_zh: 本文研究了奥地利失业救济金期限选择性延长对失业发生率的影响。由于新法律仅适用于1988年6月后该国特定地区的老年工人，由此形成了准实验情境。研究发现，新法律导致失业率上升了4至11个百分点。这一结果可通过隐性契约的破裂来解释：老年工人获得高于其边际产出的工资以激励其付出更高努力。如今解雇老年工人变得更为容易，因为更慷慨的失业保险降低了企业声誉损失的严重程度。
url:4867458f774f4f27.title: Benefit Duration and Unemployment Entry: Quasi-experimental Evidence for Austria
url:4867458f774f4f27.title_zh: 津贴期限与失业进入：奥地利的准实验证据

url:4878e9d18b3d7fa4.abstract: This Paper documents four basic facts about investment goods and investment prices. First, investment has a very significant non-tradable component in the form of construction services. Second, distributions services (wholesaling, retailing, and transportation) are much less important for investment than for consumption. Third, the import content of investment is much larger than that of consumption. Finally, in the aftermath of three large devaluations, the rate of exchange rate pass-through is, perhaps not surprisingly, highest for imported equipment and lowest for construction services.
url:4878e9d18b3d7fa4.abstract_zh: 本文记录了关于投资品与投资价格的四个基本事实。第一，投资中包含了以建筑服务形式存在的、非常显著的非贸易成分。第二，分销服务（批发、零售和运输）对投资的重要性远低于对消费的重要性。第三，投资的进口含量远高于消费的进口含量。最后，在三次大规模货币贬值之后，汇率传递程度——或许并不令人意外——在进口设备中最高，在建筑服务中最低。
url:4878e9d18b3d7fa4.title: Investment Prices and Exchange Rates: Some Basic Facts
url:4878e9d18b3d7fa4.title_zh: 投资价格与汇率：一些基本事实

url:48aaf0d8a4d2d978.abstract: This paper estimates the effects of the 2025 U.S. tariffs on household spending using transaction-level data linked to tariff exposure and a tariff sentiment survey. Comparing high versus low tariff-exposed categories, we find 15 to 20 percent price pass-through. At the mean increase in tariff exposure, prices rise by 1 to 2 percent while spending falls by roughly 4 percent. Survey evidence linking stated intentions to revealed behavior identifies a mechanism for the large spending response: reallocation toward essentials and trade-down within categories, concentrated among middle-income households with discretionary slack who express tariff concerns. Low-income households bear a disproportionate welfare burden through regressive pass-through.
url:48aaf0d8a4d2d978.abstract_zh: 本文利用与关税暴露度相关联的交易级数据及关税情绪调查，估算了2025年美国关税对家庭支出的影响。通过比较高关税暴露度与低关税暴露度的商品类别，我们发现价格传导率为15%至20%。在关税暴露度平均增幅下，价格上涨1%至2%，而支出下降约4%。将调查中陈述的意图与揭示的行为相联系的证据，识别出了支出大幅变动的机制：向必需品重新配置以及类别内的降级消费，这一现象集中在拥有可自由支配空间且表达关税担忧的中等收入家庭。低收入家庭则通过累退性传导承担了不成比例的福利负担。
url:48aaf0d8a4d2d978.title: Paying More and Buying Less: 2025 Tariffs and U.S. Household Spending
url:48aaf0d8a4d2d978.title_zh: 多付少买：2025年关税与美国居民消费

url:48bf1acb10018ffe.abstract: Primary healthcare systems in many developed countries are under strain, partly due to unrestricted patient demand. In response, policymakers have introduced measures to curb unnecessary GP visits, including (i) instituting a small upfront fee for GP visits, (ii) implementing a self-report based triage system, and (iii) providing more information to patients about their condition before they make an appointment with their GP. We evaluate the effectiveness of these approaches using two online experiments with a representative sample of UK adults. The first experiment involves induced monetary incentives in a laboratory-style study while the second is a health-framed vignette study. We find that while all three interventions are effective in the laboratory study, only the intervention that provides patients with more information about their condition reduces low-priority demand in the vignette study. We discuss implications for policy and for the study of health-related decision-making.
url:48bf1acb10018ffe.abstract_zh: 许多发达国家的初级医疗体系正面临压力，部分原因在于患者不受限制的就诊需求。为此，政策制定者引入了多项措施以减少不必要的全科医生就诊，包括：（i）对全科医生就诊收取小额预付费用；（ii）实施基于自我报告的分诊系统；（iii）在患者预约全科医生前，为其提供更多关于自身病情的相关信息。我们通过两项针对英国成年人群体的代表性样本在线实验，评估了这些方法的有效性。第一项实验采用实验室式研究中的诱导性货币激励，第二项实验则是以健康情境为框架的案例研究。研究发现，在实验室研究中，三种干预措施均有效；但在案例研究中，只有为患者提供更多病情信息的干预措施能减少低优先级就诊需求。我们讨论了这些发现对政策制定及健康相关决策研究的启示。
url:48bf1acb10018ffe.title: Managing Excess Demand for Primary Care: Evidence from Online Experiments
url:48bf1acb10018ffe.title_zh: 管理初级医疗超额需求：来自在线实验的证据

url:49098222ad0be562.abstract: this paper is to see how far developments in the labour market can help to explain the fluctuations in births which have been experienced over the period 1952-1980 in England and Wales. We examine separately the period rate of childless women proceeding to the first birth, mothers of one child proceeding to a second birth, mothers of two proceeding to a third birth, and mothers of three proceeding to a fourth birth. Our analysis shows that different birth orders respond differently to economic variables, and different age groups within a parity also exhibit varying responses. We have found that growing real wages for both men and women tend to deter older parents from adding to existing families. In the early stages of family building, births are inhibited by labour markets favourable to women. But conditions in the male labour market have the reverse effect on early breeding.
url:49098222ad0be562.abstract_zh: 本文旨在探讨1952-1980年间英格兰和威尔士劳动力市场的发展在多大程度上能够解释生育率的波动。我们分别考察了无子女女性生育第一胎、一孩母亲生育第二胎、二孩母亲生育第三胎以及三孩母亲生育第四胎的时期生育率。分析表明，不同生育顺序对经济变量的反应存在差异，且同一胎次内的不同年龄组也表现出不同的反应。研究发现，男女实际工资的增长往往会抑制年长父母扩大家庭规模。在家庭组建初期，有利于女性的劳动力市场会抑制生育行为。然而，男性劳动力市场的状况对早期生育则产生相反的影响。
url:49098222ad0be562.title: DP37 The Next Birth and the Labour Market: A Dynamic Model of Births in England and Wales

url:4976863c4331deb2.abstract: Focus Historically, banks' holdings of sovereign debt have been key drivers of the co-movement between sovereign and bank risks. Recent years have seen an increase in banks' links with non-bank financial institutions (NBFIs) as well as a greater presence of NBFIs in sovereign debt markets. These developments have the potential to broaden the classical sovereign-bank nexus into a sovereign-bank-NBFI nexus. We examine the degree to which this has taken place, using European bank-level data along with global country-level data.
url:4976863c4331deb2.abstract_zh: 历史上，银行持有的主权债务一直是主权风险与银行风险联动的主要驱动因素。近年来，银行与非银行金融机构（NBFIs）的联系日益紧密，同时NBFIs在主权债务市场中的参与度显著提升。这些发展可能将传统的主权-银行关联扩展为主权-银行-NBFI三重关联。我们利用欧洲银行层面的数据及全球国家层面的数据，考察了这一转变的实现程度。
url:4976863c4331deb2.title: The evolving nexus: sovereigns, banks and NBFIs
url:4976863c4331deb2.title_zh: 演变中的关联：主权、银行与非银行金融机构

url:49ad4cd8e4bf2f0f.abstract: Entrants are typically found to be more innovative than incumbent firms. Furthermore, these innovative ideas often originate with established firms in the industry. Therefore, the established firm and the start-up firm seem to select different types of projects. We claim that this is the consequence of their optimal project allocation mechanism, which depends on their comparative advantage. The start-up firm may seem more ?innovative? than the established firm may because the comparative advantage of the start-up firm is to commercialize ?innovative? projects, i.e. projects that do not fit with the established firms? existing assets. Our model integrates various facts found in the industrial organization literature about the entry rate, firm focus, firm growth, industry growth and innovation. We also obtain some counter-intuitive results such that a reduction in the cost of start-ups may actually slow down start-ups and that the firm may voluntarily give away the property rights to the inventions discovered within the firm.
url:49ad4cd8e4bf2f0f.abstract_zh: 通常发现，新进入企业比在位企业更具创新性。此外，这些创新想法往往源自行业内的成熟企业。因此，成熟企业与初创企业似乎选择了不同类型的项目。我们认为，这是其最优项目分配机制的结果，该机制取决于各自的比较优势。初创企业可能比成熟企业显得更具"创新性"，原因在于初创企业的比较优势在于将"创新性"项目商业化，即那些与成熟企业现有资产不匹配的项目。我们的模型整合了产业组织文献中关于进入率、企业专注度、企业成长、行业增长及创新的多种事实。我们还得出了一些反直觉的结论，例如降低初创企业的成本实际上可能减缓其发展速度，以及企业可能自愿放弃内部发明的产权。
url:49ad4cd8e4bf2f0f.title: DP3429 Optimal Project Rejection and New Firm Start-Ups

url:49d3c4e7e45d0b21.abstract: Why might persuaders favor anecdotes over aggregate statistics? We study a policy advocate choosing between them to persuade a diverse, skeptical citizenry with demographically correlated outcomes. Two forces compete: an umbrella effect, by which everyone responds more strongly to the statistic, and a wild-card effect, by which the anecdote's higher variance makes favorable realizations likelier. The anecdote prevails under sufficiently narrow consensus, so its appeal has a rational, informational basis. When breadth of aggregation is flexible, the optimal evidence is a local statistic that aggregates over a broader subpopulation than the minimal winning coalition, though almost anecdotal as consensus narrows.
url:49d3c4e7e45d0b21.abstract_zh: 为何说服者更偏爱轶事而非总体统计数据？我们研究了一位政策倡导者在两者间的选择，其目标是说服一个具有人口统计相关结果的多元化、持怀疑态度的公民群体。两种效应相互竞争：一是“伞效应”，即每个人对统计数据的反应更为强烈；二是“野牌效应”，即轶事的高方差使得有利结果更可能出现。当共识足够狭窄时，轶事占据上风，因此其吸引力具有理性的信息基础。当聚合范围灵活时，最优证据是一种局部统计量，它聚合了比最小获胜联盟更广泛的子群体，但随着共识变窄，这种统计量几乎接近于轶事。
url:49d3c4e7e45d0b21.title: Anecdotes or Statistics?

url:49db88f2eca966df.title_zh: 全球供应链中地方法律的局限性：切断联系还是“教育贸易”采购伙伴？

url:4a02df8cf156eb87.abstract: We study the evolution of digital and artificial intelligence (AI) skill demand across six economies in Asia and the Pacific between 2019 and 2024 using millions of online job postings from Indeed and a large language model to classify them by their required level of digital and AI proficiency. Digital skill requirements are widespread across the occupational distribution and have expanded most rapidly in traditionally low and mid digital jobs, pointing to broad technological diffusion. Jobs requiring higher digital proficiency command substantially higher pay, even when comparing job postings within the same job title and controlling for cognitive, interpersonal, organizational, and technical skill requirements. We estimate wage premia of approximately 4%, 11%, and 26% for basic, intermediate, and advanced digital skills, respectively, with intermediate and advanced digital skills commanding larger premia than many other highly rewarded skills. We also document a sharp increase in demand for AI-related competencies, particularly those related to the use of AI tools.
url:4a02df8cf156eb87.abstract_zh: 我们利用Indeed平台数百万条在线招聘信息，结合大语言模型按所需数字与人工智能（AI）技能水平进行分类，研究了2019至2024年间亚太地区六个经济体的数字与AI技能需求的演变。数字技能要求广泛分布于各职业层级，且在传统低数字与中数字岗位中增长最为迅速，表明技术正在广泛扩散。要求较高数字技能水平的岗位薪酬显著更高——即便在控制认知、人际、组织及技术技能要求后，对同一职位名称的招聘信息进行比较时亦是如此。我们估算出基础、中级与高级数字技能的工资溢价分别约为4%、11%和26%，其中中级与高级数字技能的溢价幅度超过许多其他高回报技能。此外，我们还发现对AI相关能力（尤其是AI工具使用能力）的需求急剧增长。
url:4a02df8cf156eb87.title: Skills That Pay: Digital Skills Demand and Wage Premia in Asia and the Pacific
url:4a02df8cf156eb87.title_zh: 技能即报酬：亚太地区的数字技能需求与工资溢价

url:4a5977d42c0d0c6f.abstract: High-debt euro area economies face fiscal consolidation in a low-growth environment. We use a Heterogeneous Agent New Keynesian model to assess how consolidation composition shapes aggregate and distributional outcomes in a representative high-debt economy. The status quo is not neutral: delay generates its own costs through lower investment, higher debt service, and damage to constrained households. For a given fiscal effort, expenditure-based consolidation achieves faster debt reduction with lower growth and distributional costs than revenue-based consolidation. As a complementary exercise, pairing the expenditurebased path with growth-enhancing structural reforms further improves outcomes by lifting real wages, a channel that disproportionately benefits hand-to-mouth households. Across both strategies, modest well targeted transfers to low-income households can substantially mitigate distributional costs at minimal fiscal expense while supporting aggregate demand.
url:4a5977d42c0d0c6f.abstract_zh: 高负债欧元区经济体在低增长环境中面临财政整固挑战。我们采用异质性主体新凯恩斯模型，评估不同整固方案对典型高负债经济体的总量与分配效应。现状并非中性：延迟整固将通过抑制投资、增加偿债负担及损害受约束家庭产生额外成本。在既定财政努力下，相较于收入端整固，支出端整固能以更低的经济增长与分配成本实现更快的债务削减。作为补充方案，将支出端路径与促进增长的结构性改革相结合，可通过提升实际工资进一步改善经济表现——这一渠道对月光族家庭的惠及程度尤为显著。两种策略中，针对低收入家庭的适度定向转移支付能以最小财政代价显著缓解分配成本，同时支撑总需求。

url:4ae9a1c9f589e9c6.abstract: Firm heterogeneity in financial constraints is a quantitatively important driver of how monetary policy transmits to inflation. Using detailed microdata on Swedish public and private firms, and high-frequency monetary policy surprises around Riksbank announcements, we document that smaller, financially constrained firms adjust prices significantly less than larger firms in response to changes in monetary policy. This heterogeneous price response materially dampens the aggregate PPI inflation response to monetary policy. Models of customer markets and financial frictions can explain our findings: because the external finance premium rises after a monetary contraction, constrained firms cut prices less to preserve cash flows, sacrificing future market share. Additional evidence on heterogeneous sales, debt, marginal cost, and markup responses further supports this channel. We consider several alternative explanations, including differences in price adjustments, working capital, market share, and export share, but these cannot explain our main heterogeneity result.
url:4ae9a1c9f589e9c6.abstract_zh: 企业融资约束的异质性在货币政策向通胀传导过程中具有重要的定量意义。基于瑞典上市与非上市企业的微观数据，结合瑞典央行公告前后高频货币政策意外冲击，我们发现：相较于大型企业，规模较小且面临融资约束的企业在应对货币政策变化时，其价格调整幅度显著更低。这种异质性价格响应实质上削弱了货币政策对总体生产者价格指数（PPI）通胀的影响。客户市场模型与金融摩擦理论可解释这一发现：由于货币紧缩后外部融资溢价上升，受约束企业为维持现金流而减少降价幅度，从而牺牲未来市场份额。关于销售额、债务、边际成本及加成率异质性的额外证据进一步支持该传导渠道。我们考察了包括价格调整成本、营运资本、市场份额及出口份额在内的多种替代性解释，但这些因素均无法解释核心异质性结论。

url:4afc7245352156c2.abstract: This paper presents a novel app-based survey designed to elicit beliefs about the impact of parental time investments from parents of preschoolers that allows to differentiate the intrinsic value of the activity from the significance of parental engagement. The resulting parental belief indicators exhibit strong internal validity and consistency and correlate with engagement and the quality of daily parent-child interactions, as measured by 24-hour parental time diaries: a one standard-deviation increase in beliefs regarding the importance of engagement is associated with an additional 5 hours spent with the child, 6 hours of engaged time (about 30% in time-use standard deviations).
url:4afc7245352156c2.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了一项基于应用程序的新型调查，旨在从学龄前儿童家长中获取关于父母时间投入影响的信念，从而能够区分活动的内在价值与父母参与的重要性。由此得出的父母信念指标表现出较强的内部效度和一致性，并与通过24小时父母时间日记测量的参与度及日常亲子互动质量相关：父母对参与重要性的信念每增加一个标准差，与孩子相处的时间将增加5小时，其中投入时间增加6小时（约占时间使用标准差的30%）。

url:4b1806829f24334a.abstract: A prominent explanation for declining labor shares is automation. We test this mechanism directly at the firm level, drawing on a central prediction of the task-based model of production: firms that automate more should see larger declines in routine employment and labor share. Using administrative data from France between 1994 and 2019, we find no support for this prediction. Changes in routine employment share are either uncorrelated or even negatively correlated with changes in labor share within firms. Our evidence shows that automation is not driving labor share dynamics in France.
url:4b1806829f24334a.abstract_zh: 关于劳动份额下降的一个主要解释是自动化。我们基于任务型生产模型的核心预测，在企业层面直接检验了这一机制：自动化程度更高的企业，其常规就业份额和劳动份额应出现更大幅度的下降。利用1994年至2019年法国的行政数据，我们发现这一预测未得到支持。在企业内部，常规就业份额的变化与劳动份额的变化要么不相关，甚至呈负相关。我们的证据表明，自动化并非法国劳动份额动态变化的驱动因素。
url:4b1806829f24334a.title: Does Automation Lower the Labor Share?

url:4b8e040457711778.abstract: We evaluate whether LLMs have had any discernible impact on the aggregate labor market so far. We focus on occupations that are computer programming-intensive, motivated by data showing that coding is one of the most LLM-exposed tasks. Linking O*NET to CPS we find that aggregate employment of coders has decelerated sharply since the introduction of ChatGPT. Using a novel control variable for industry-level shocks we show that the deceleration is not attributable to the exposure of coders to slowing industries, suggesting instead that coders experienced an occupation-specific shock around the introduction of ChatGPT. Coder employment has continued to grow in recent years, though much more slowly than it did pre-2022. We validate the industry-level control variable by examining historical examples of occupations that experienced either occupation-specific or industry-level shocks. We also provide statistics on the agreement rates between different measures of AI exposure.
url:4b8e040457711778.abstract_zh: 我们评估了大型语言模型（LLMs）是否对当前总体劳动力市场产生了可识别的影响。基于编码是最受LLM影响的任务之一的数据驱动，我们重点关注计算机编程密集型职业。通过将O*NET与当前人口调查（CPS）数据关联，我们发现自ChatGPT推出以来，编程人员的总体就业增速显著放缓。利用行业层面冲击的新型控制变量，我们证明这种放缓并非源于编程人员所在行业的衰退冲击，而是表明编程人员在ChatGPT推出前后经历了职业特异性冲击。近年来编程人员就业虽持续增长，但增速远低于2022年前的水平。我们通过考察历史上经历职业特异性冲击或行业层面冲击的职业案例，验证了行业层面控制变量的有效性，并提供了不同人工智能暴露度测量指标间的一致率统计。
url:4b8e040457711778.title: AI and Coder Employment: Compiling the Evidence
url:4b8e040457711778.title_zh: 人工智能与程序员就业：证据汇编

url:4b96305aa6f85540.abstract: How does terrorism affect labor markets in developing countries? We combine georeferenced data on terrorist incidents with nationally representative employment data from Nigeria to examine this question. Exploiting within-location variation in exposure to terrorist attacks over time, we show that terrorism reduces employment. A one standard deviation increase in exposure lowers the probability of employment by 0.7 percentage points, or roughly 1 percent of average employment, with substantially larger effects for women. Beyond reducing employment, terrorism shifts workers away from regular and cash-paying jobs and lowers employment in sales, services, and unskilled manual occupations. The findings identify labor market disruption as an important economic cost of insecurity in developing countries.
url:4b96305aa6f85540.abstract_zh: 恐怖主义如何影响发展中国家的劳动力市场？我们将恐怖袭击的地理参照数据与尼日利亚具有全国代表性的就业数据相结合来研究这一问题。通过利用同一地区在不同时期遭受恐怖袭击暴露程度的差异，我们发现恐怖主义会降低就业水平。暴露程度每增加一个标准差，就业概率将下降0.7个百分点，约占平均就业率的1%，且对女性的影响显著更大。除减少就业外，恐怖主义还促使劳动者远离正规及现金支付岗位，并导致销售、服务业及非熟练体力劳动职业的就业率下降。研究结果表明，劳动力市场紊乱是发展中国家不安全状况的重要经济成本。

url:4bf6f0bee1ebc164.abstract: This paper studies the aggregate implications of the geography of financial frictions faced by firms in Europe. Using proprietary data from the European Central Bank's Survey on the Access to Finance of Enterprises, we document three new facts. First, there is substantial regional heterogeneity in the access to external finance. Second, this heterogeneity is persistent, with only gradual convergence over time. Third, countries with tighter financial frictions are less responsive to monetary shocks. To formalize these empirical findings, we develop and calibrate a tractable New~Keynesian model of a monetary union with 22 countries that are heterogeneous in financial frictions, productivity, and size. High-friction countries are less responsive to monetary shocks because firms face a steeper marginal cost curve and a lower capital elasticity. The heterogeneity in financial frictions also shapes the output-inflation trade-off, as in high-friction countries the same output gain comes at the cost of more inflation. Convergence experiments show that financial market integration in the spirit of a European Savings and Investments Union raises the power of monetary policy, but at a potential cost to financial stability.
url:4bf6f0bee1ebc164.abstract_zh: 本文研究了欧洲企业面临的金融摩擦地理分布对宏观经济的影响。利用欧洲央行《企业融资渠道调查》的专有数据，我们揭示了三个新事实：第一，外部融资渠道存在显著的区域异质性；第二，这种异质性具有持续性，仅随时间呈现渐进式收敛；第三，金融摩擦更严重的国家对货币冲击的反应更弱。为将这些实证发现形式化，我们构建并校准了一个包含22个国家、在金融摩擦、生产率和规模方面存在异质性的可处理新凯恩斯货币联盟模型。高摩擦国家因企业面临更陡峭的边际成本曲线和更低的资本弹性，对货币冲击的反应更弱。金融摩擦的异质性还塑造了产出-通胀权衡关系——在高摩擦国家，同等产出增长需以更高通胀为代价。收敛实验表明，以欧洲储蓄与投资联盟为蓝本的金融市场一体化将增强货币政策效力，但可能以金融稳定为潜在代价。
url:4bf6f0bee1ebc164.title: The Geography of Financial Frictions

url:4bf9d8153491e2c6.abstract: This paper examines the effectiveness of Covid-related financial support in Spain and Italy, focusing on its impact on firm recovery. Using a difference-in-differences (DiD) approach combined with propensity score weighting, it compares outcomes of similar firms receiving aid to those without. The results show significant benefits for micro-firms, including mitigated turnover declines and increased investments in both tangible and intangible assets. The findings highlight the critical role of government support in business survival and recovery, especially for SMEs, during the pandemic.
url:4bf9d8153491e2c6.abstract_zh: 本文评估了西班牙与意大利新冠疫情相关金融支持政策的有效性，重点关注其对企业复苏的影响。采用双重差分法结合倾向得分加权，比较了获得援助的相似企业与未获援助企业的结果差异。研究结果表明，微型企业获益显著，具体表现为营业额降幅收窄，且对有形资产与无形资产的投入均有所增加。这些发现凸显了疫情期间政府支持对企业生存与复苏的关键作用，尤其对中小企业而言。

url:4c75d693fcfc4bd5.abstract: This article revives and enhances the factor-supply approach to estimate the effects of changes in immigrant supply on wages and employment of US natives. We introduce and validate a skill-based shift-share IV for immigrants’ labor supply. We find a positive impact of immigration on natives' employment and significant imperfect substitutability between natives and immigrants. Consistent with these estimates, we find significant task complementarity and occupational upgrading of native workers in response to immigrants. Finally, we calculate that immigration over 2000-2023 increased wages of non-college-educated natives by 2.6 to 3.4%, with small effects on other groups.
url:4c75d693fcfc4bd5.abstract_zh: 本文重新激活并完善了要素供给方法，用以估算移民供给变化对美国本土劳动者工资与就业的影响。我们提出并验证了一种基于技能的偏移份额工具变量，用于衡量移民劳动力供给。研究发现，移民对本土劳动者的就业具有正向影响，且本土劳动者与移民之间存在显著的不完全替代性。与这些估计结果一致，我们还发现本土劳动者在应对移民时表现出显著的任务互补性与职业升级。最后，我们测算得出，2000年至2023年间的移民使未受过大学教育的本土劳动者工资提高了2.6%至3.4%，而对其他群体的影响较小。

url:4cf951f2f9750333.abstract: Connections appear to be helpful in many contexts such as obtaining a job, a promotion, a grant, a loan, or publishing a paper. This may be due to favoritism or to information conveyed by connections. Building on earlier work on discrimination, we propose a new method that identifies these channels using data observed at the time of promotion. The method exploits distinct implications of the two effects on the relationship between observables and success. We show that extra information on connected candidates generates excess variance in latent errors while favors yield different promotion thresholds. We characterize the conditions under which both effects are identified and operationalize these ideas econometrically within a semiparametric framework. We also derive testable restrictions of the model and show how to account for connection endogeneity. We reanalyze data on academic promotions in Spain and Italy and political promotions in China. We detect evidence of favoritism for all types of candidates and of information effects for candidates applying to junior positions. We find strong support for the model’s testable restrictions.
url:4cf951f2f9750333.abstract_zh: 人脉关系在求职、晋升、获取资助、贷款或发表论文等多种情境中似乎都大有裨益。这既可能源于偏袒行为，也可能归因于人脉所传递的信息。基于早期关于歧视问题的研究，我们提出了一种新方法，利用晋升时观测到的数据来识别上述两种渠道。该方法利用了两种效应在可观测变量与成功结果之间关系上的不同含义。我们证明，关于人脉候选人的额外信息会引发潜在误差的过度方差，而偏袒则会导致不同的晋升门槛。我们刻画了两种效应均能被识别的条件，并在半参数框架内以计量经济学方法实现了这些思想。我们还推导出模型的可检验约束条件，并展示了如何处理人脉关系的内生性问题。我们重新分析了西班牙和意大利的学术晋升数据以及中国的政治晋升数据。研究发现，所有类型的候选人均存在偏袒效应的证据，而申请初级职位的候选人则存在信息效应的证据。模型的可检验约束条件得到了强有力的支持。
url:4cf951f2f9750333.title: Promotion through Connections: Favors or Information?

url:4d47b206bb4565ed.abstract: The U.S. general fertility rate has fallen by 22% since 2007, a sustained decline not readily explained by economic conditions, contraceptive use, housing or childcare costs, or other commonly cited factors. We assess the potential role of a different shock: the diffusion of the smartphone. The U.S. rollout of the iPhone, the first modern smartphone, provides a natural experiment: from June 2007 through February 2011, the device was sold only on AT&T, allowing us to identify its effect from variation in AT&T’s mobile broadband coverage. Entropy-balanced Poisson and synthetic difference-in-differences event studies imply that access to the iPhone reduced births by 4.5–8.0% at ages 15–19 and 3.2–6.6% at ages 20–24, with statistically significant but smaller declines among older cohorts. Placebo analyses applied to Verizon and Sprint’s pre-2011 coverage footprint are null. Taken together, these cohort effects imply that the diffusion of the iPhone deepened the decline in births among women under 30 while suppressing the rise in births among older women. Overall, the diffusion of the iPhone explains 33–52% of the decline in the general fertility rate among women aged 15–44. National-survey evidence on time use and sexual behavior is consistent with the iPhone reducing in-person interactions, increasing pornography use, and reducing sexual frequency.
url:4d47b206bb4565ed.abstract_zh: 自2007年以来，美国总和生育率下降了22%，这一持续下降趋势难以用经济状况、避孕措施使用、住房或育儿成本等常见因素解释。我们评估了另一种冲击的潜在作用：智能手机的普及。美国首款现代智能手机iPhone的推广提供了一个自然实验：从2007年6月至2011年2月，该设备仅由AT&T独家销售，这使我们能够通过AT&T移动宽带覆盖范围的差异识别其影响。基于熵平衡泊松模型和合成双重差分事件研究的结果表明，iPhone的接入使15-19岁年龄段生育率下降4.5%-8.0%，20-24岁年龄段下降3.2%-6.6%，而较高年龄段虽呈现统计显著但降幅较小。针对Verizon和Sprint在2011年前覆盖范围的安慰剂分析未发现显著效应。综合来看，这些队列效应表明iPhone的普及加剧了30岁以下女性生育率的下降，同时抑制了高龄女性生育率的上升。总体而言，iPhone的普及解释了15-44岁女性总和生育率下降幅度的33%-52%。基于全国调查的时间使用与性行为证据显示，iPhone减少了面对面互动，增加了色情内容使用，并降低了性行为频率。

url:4d53e598faba0b61.abstract: This paper examines how Russian imports were reoriented after the 2022 sanctions. Using annual bilateral trade data at the product level, it asks whether direct Chinese export gains to Russia were concentrated in the same product lines in which EU exports to Russia declined. It also studies rerouting through Hong Kong, Armenia, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, and Türkiye. The results point to substantial post-2022 import reorientation in Russia. Direct Chinese export gains are larger in product lines where Russia had depended more heavily on EU suppliers before the sanctions. Including transit-linked flows strengthens this relationship and points to broader rerouting through intermediary economies in those same product lines. In sanction-relevant goods, direct Chinese gains offset only part of the EU shortfall, while intermediary-country channels account for a substantial additional share. On the EU side, product-level evidence also suggests that some of the lost Russian market was absorbed through higher exports of the same products to other non-transit destinations. The evidence is therefore consistent with partial direct substitution by China, broader rerouting through intermediary economies, and partial outward redirection by EU exporters, not full replacement of lost EU exports.
url:4d53e598faba0b61.abstract_zh: 本文考察了2022年制裁后俄罗斯进口如何实现重新定向。利用产品层面的年度双边贸易数据，研究聚焦于中国对俄直接出口增长是否集中于欧盟对俄出口下降的同一产品类别，并分析了经香港、亚美尼亚、哈萨克斯坦、吉尔吉斯斯坦和土耳其的转运路径。结果表明，2022年后俄罗斯进口出现了显著的重新定向。在制裁前俄罗斯更依赖欧盟供应商的产品类别中，中国直接出口增长更为显著。纳入转运相关贸易流后，这一关系得到强化，表明同一产品类别中通过中间经济体的转运范围更为广泛。在制裁相关商品领域，中国直接出口增长仅部分弥补了欧盟的供应缺口，而中间经济体渠道则贡献了相当可观的额外份额。从欧盟方面看，产品层面证据亦表明，部分失去的俄罗斯市场份额通过向其他非转运目的地增加同类产品出口得以吸收。因此，证据支持以下结论：中国部分直接替代、通过中间经济体的广泛转运、以及欧盟出口商的局部市场转向，共同构成了对欧盟出口损失的补偿，而非完全替代。
url:4d53e598faba0b61.title: Chinese Export Gains, EU Export Losses, and Russian Import Reorientation after the 2022 Sanctions

url:4e0fa8934f6223c9.abstract: We use administrative security-level data from the U.S. and Euro Area (EA) portfolios to estimate asset demand and supply elasticities by exploiting exogenous variation in bond-specific currency wedges. Employing a Bartik-style shift-share identification approach, we document extensive heterogeneity in investor demand responsiveness to exogenous changes in the price of currency risk, conditional on the issuer characteristics. Demand for AE-bonds is always inelastic, whereas for EM-bonds, elasticity depends on investor type and currency: insurance/pension, nonbanks and banks have finite-elastic demand for EM-bonds that are issued in their own (investor) currency. For EM-issuer-currency bonds, only EA non-bank investors increase the share of these bonds in their portfolio when currency wedges widen, suggesting they accept higher currency risk for higher returns. In response, issuers adjust their supply endogenously: an exogenous increase of 8 basis point in currency wedges leads to a 0.26% decline in local currency bond issuance relative to GDP. We develop a theoretical framework where debt issuance decisions take into account heterogenous demand of investors in terms of their response to changes in the price of currency risk.
url:4e0fa8934f6223c9.abstract_zh: 我们利用美国和欧元区投资组合的行政安全级数据，通过挖掘债券特定货币楔子的外生变动，估计资产需求与供给弹性。采用巴蒂克式转移份额识别方法，我们发现，在给定发行人特征条件下，投资者需求对货币风险价格外生变化的响应存在显著的异质性。对发达经济体债券的需求始终缺乏弹性，而对新兴市场债券而言，弹性取决于投资者类型和货币：保险公司/养老基金、非银行机构和银行对以其自身（投资者）货币发行的新兴市场债券具有有限弹性需求。对于以新兴市场发行人货币计价的债券，当货币楔子扩大时，只有欧元区非银行投资者会增加此类债券在其投资组合中的占比，表明他们为获取更高回报而接受更高的货币风险。作为回应，发行人内生调整其供给：货币楔子每外生增加8个基点，本币债券发行量相对于GDP下降0.26%。我们构建了一个理论框架，其中债务发行决策需考虑投资者对货币风险价格变化响应的异质性需求。

url:4e3ccb39b2333f99.abstract: We examine exchange rate dynamics in cases where the authorities promise (i) to confine a floating rate within a predetermined range, (ii) to peg the currency once it reaches a predetermined future level, and (iii) to unify a system of dual exchange rates. Similarities between these and several related examples of regime switching are stressed. We also discuss how stochastic regime changes can affect some standard statistical tests of hypotheses about exchange rates.
url:4e3ccb39b2333f99.abstract_zh: 本文考察了当局承诺以下三种情形下的汇率动态：(i) 将浮动汇率限制在预定区间内，(ii) 一旦汇率达到预定的未来水平即实施钉住汇率制度，以及(iii) 统一双重汇率体系。我们强调了这些情形与若干相关制度转换案例之间的相似性。此外，还探讨了随机性制度转换如何影响关于汇率的某些标准统计假设检验。

url:4e5280c49ff97fef.abstract: This paper examines the association between the quality of hospitals to which residents of a US county are exposed and deaths from COVID-19. We derive a measure of the hospitals accessible to county residents based on ambulance travel patterns. We estimate hospital quality from measures of performance used in a flagship national pay-for-performance program. We find that a standard deviation in local quality- exposure is associated with a roughly 9% lower death rate. The preventive effects of access to high quality hospitals vary sharply by minority composition of the local population.
url:4e5280c49ff97fef.abstract_zh: 本文考察了美国某县居民可接触到的医院质量与COVID-19死亡人数之间的关联。我们基于救护车出行模式，推导出县居民可及医院的度量指标。我们利用一项国家级旗舰按绩效付费项目中的绩效衡量标准来评估医院质量。研究发现，当地质量暴露的一个标准差与死亡率降低约9%相关。高质量医院的可及性对预防效果的影响，因当地人口的少数族裔构成不同而存在显著差异。

url:4e556411fa1b49c9.abstract: Can monetary incentives improve health behaviors in the long run, and do commonly used surrogate outcomes capture these effects? We study these questions in the context of vaccination using a large-scale eld experiment. The experiment combines commonly used surrogates|vaccination intentions, intermediate behavioral proxies, and short-run vaccination|with long-run administrative vaccination records. We first document that incentives increase vaccination rates in the long run: guaranteed $20 incentives raise COVID-19 booster uptake by 9 percentage points. Lottery-based incentives also increase long-run uptake, while prosocial incentives primarily accelerate vaccination. Second, using surrogacy methods, we study whether surrogates can predict long-run impacts. Although the surrogates are strongly correlated with eventual vaccination, the assumptions required for surrogacy methods are often violated, and they do not accurately predict long-run impacts. Our ndings highlight both the ability of incentives to change behavior and the importance of measuring long-run outcomes rather than relying solely on surrogates.
url:4e556411fa1b49c9.abstract_zh: 货币激励能否长期改善健康行为，而常用的替代结果指标能否捕捉这些效应？我们通过一项大规模实地实验，以疫苗接种为背景研究这些问题。该实验将常用替代指标（疫苗接种意愿、中间行为代理变量及短期疫苗接种）与长期行政疫苗接种记录相结合。首先，我们证实激励措施能长期提高疫苗接种率：保证提供20美元激励使新冠加强针接种率提升9个百分点。基于抽奖的激励措施同样能提高长期接种率，而亲社会激励主要加速疫苗接种进程。其次，通过替代指标方法，我们检验替代指标能否预测长期影响。尽管替代指标与最终疫苗接种存在强相关性，但替代指标方法所需假设常被违反，且无法准确预测长期影响。我们的发现既凸显了激励措施改变行为的能力，也揭示了测量长期结果而非仅依赖替代指标的重要性。

url:4f2fff1153a37519.abstract: Natural disasters are a growing global threat, yet their consequences for gender-based violence (GBV) in high-income countries with strong institutional protections remain largely unknown. We address this gap using administrative crime records linked to disaster declarations at the Local Government Area level in Australia. Applying staggered difference-in-differences estimation techniques, we find that disasters cause short-run increase family, domestic and sexual violence with effects concentrated in the first one to three months following a disaster. Strikingly, these effects are larger in urban and affluent areas, an outcome that is difficult to reconcile with a pure economic-stress mechanism, and is more consistent with institutional strain and differential reporting environments. To probe the underlying pathway, we draw on complementary household survey evidence, which points to mental health deterioration and increased intra-household conflict as individual-level mechanisms. Together, our findings suggest that even well-resourced institutional settings offer only incomplete protection against disaster-induced violence against women
url:4f2fff1153a37519.abstract_zh: 自然灾害正成为日益严峻的全球性威胁，然而在制度保障完善的高收入国家中，此类灾害对基于性别的暴力行为（GBV）的影响仍鲜为人知。本研究利用澳大利亚地方政府辖区层面与灾害声明相关联的行政犯罪记录，填补了这一研究空白。通过采用交错双重差分估计方法，我们发现灾害会导致家庭暴力、亲密伴侣暴力及性暴力在短期内增加，其影响主要集中在灾害发生后的1至3个月内。值得注意的是，这种影响在城市和富裕地区更为显著——这一结果难以用纯粹的经济压力机制解释，而更符合制度性压力与差异化举报环境的理论。为探究潜在作用路径，我们补充分析了家庭调查证据，发现心理健康恶化与家庭内部冲突加剧是关键的个体层面机制。综合来看，我们的研究结果表明，即使资源充足的制度环境也无法完全保护女性免受灾害引发的暴力侵害。

url:4f5fd2d1c5b23c8a.abstract: This paper shows that separating persistent (permanent) temperature changes from transitory weather fluctuations can reshape our understanding of the macroeconomic costs of warming. Using a Kalman filter state-space decomposition, it separates temperature into a permanent component and transitory weather fluctuations, and links the permanent component to trend output using a panel cointegration and error-correction framework. A one-degree Celsius higher permanent temperature is associated with a significant decline in the long-run level of output, with full adjustment unfolding over multiple decades to a century. Decomposing aggregate output into population and output per capita reveals that the long-run output losses operate primarily through demographic adjustment in the full sample, while in advanced economies, both long-run output per capita and population decline as the climate warms. Economies with higher capital intensity and more durable capital stocks experience larger long-run per capita output losses. These findings suggest that long-run economic vulnerability to persistent warming is more broadly distributed across rich and poor countries than the short-run weather literature implies, reflecting differences in capital structure. They complement rather than contradict the well-established finding that developing countries are more exposed to short-run weather shocks.
url:4f5fd2d1c5b23c8a.abstract_zh: 本文表明，将持续性（永久性）气温变化与暂时性天气波动区分开来，可以重塑我们对气候变暖宏观经济成本的理解。通过使用卡尔曼滤波状态空间分解方法，本文将气温分解为永久性成分和暂时性天气波动，并利用面板协整与误差修正框架将永久性成分与趋势产出联系起来。永久性气温每升高1摄氏度，产出的长期水平将显著下降，且完全调整过程需跨越数十年至一个世纪。将总产出分解为人口与人均产出后发现，在全样本中，长期产出损失主要通过人口结构调整实现；而在发达经济体中，随着气候变暖，长期人均产出与人口均出现下降。资本密集度更高、资本存量更耐用的经济体，其长期人均产出损失更大。这些发现表明，相较于短期天气波动文献的结论，持久性气候变暖对长期经济的脆弱性在富国与穷国之间分布更为广泛，这反映了资本结构的差异。该结论并非否定发展中国家更易受短期天气冲击的既有发现，而是对其形成补充。

url:4f8f62046b63f596.abstract: We develop a simple growth model with imperfect competition in which demand conditions can affect the dynamics of capital accumulation, hindering or enhancing growth. In our model the elasticity of the demand schedule faced by a typical firm depends on the aggregate savings rate. The latter feature results from a wedge between the elasticity of substitution across inputs in productive activities and the elasticity of substitution across goods in consumption. When the demand elasticity is constant or inversely related to the savings rate the equilibrium dynamics are shown to be qualitatively identical to those found in the perfectly competitive one-sector growth model: there is a unique stationary equilibrium which is saddle-point stable. In contrast, when the demand elasticity is positively related to the savings rate, multiple stationary equilibria (as well as multiple non-stationary equilibrium paths converging to them) emerge for some parameter values. In the latter case, the model can account for permanent differences in per capita income across homogeneous economies (even when the initial conditions are identical), as well as the absence of capital flows from rich to poor countries.
url:4f8f62046b63f596.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含不完全竞争的简单增长模型，其中需求条件能够影响资本积累的动态过程，从而阻碍或促进经济增长。在该模型中，典型企业面临的需求曲线弹性取决于总储蓄率。这一特征源于生产活动中投入品替代弹性与消费中商品替代弹性之间的差异。当需求弹性为常数或与储蓄率呈负相关时，均衡动态在性质上与完全竞争的单部门增长模型相同：存在唯一的稳态均衡且满足鞍点稳定性。相反，当需求弹性与储蓄率呈正相关时，某些参数取值下会出现多重稳态均衡（以及收敛于这些均衡的多重非稳态均衡路径）。在后一种情况下，该模型可以解释同质经济体之间人均收入的持久差异（即使初始条件完全相同），以及资本无法从富国流向穷国的现象。

url:4fcd83c75e87bd57.abstract: Potential output growth around the world slowed over the past two decades. This slowdown is expected to continue in the remainder of the 2020s: global potential growth is projected to average 2.2 percent per year in 2022-30, 0.4 percentage point below its 2011-21 average. Emerging market and developing economies (EMDEs) will face an even steeper slowdown, of about 1.0 percentage point to 4.0 percent per year on average during 2022-30. The slowdown will be widespread, affecting most EMDEs and countries accounting for 70 percent of global GDP. Global potential growth over the remainder of this decade could be even slower than projected in the baseline scenario—by another 0.2-0.9 percentage point a year—if investment growth, improvements in health and education outcomes, or developments in labor markets disappoint, or if adverse events materialize. A menu of policy options is available to help reverse the trend of weakening economic growth, including policies to enhance physical and human capital accumulation; to encourage labor force participation by women and older adults; to improve the efficiency of public spending; and to mitigate and adapt to climate change, including infrastructure investment to facilitate the green transition.
url:4fcd83c75e87bd57.abstract_zh: 过去二十年，全球潜在产出增速持续放缓。这一趋势预计将在2020年代余下年份延续：2022-2030年全球潜在增长率预计年均2.2%，较2011-2021年均值低0.4个百分点。新兴市场与发展中经济体（EMDEs）将面临更剧烈的减速——2022-2030年间年均增速将下降约1.0个百分点至4.0%。此次放缓具有广泛性，将影响大多数EMDEs及占全球GDP七成的经济体。若投资增长、健康与教育成果改善、劳动力市场表现不及预期，或出现不利事件冲击，本十年剩余年份的全球潜在增速可能较基准情景进一步放缓0.2-0.9个百分点/年。现有政策工具箱可助力扭转经济增长疲软趋势，具体包括：强化物质资本与人力资本积累、鼓励女性和老年群体参与劳动力市场、提升公共支出效率、通过基础设施投资推动绿色转型以减缓和适应气候变化。

url:4fe408000d29ba5a.abstract: With India facing highest US reciprocal tariff of 50%, this paper estimates the Direct and Indirect effects of the tariff shock on Indian Textile industry. Using a CES demand model, we estimate the counterfactual demand under 50% and 25% tariff scenarios, structured into two stages. In the first stage, we quantify the tariff induced import changes of 656 textile products at HS 6-digit level and decompose into Direct Tariff effect and Third country tariff effect (Indirect). In the second stage, we quantify the transmission effect along the supply chain using I-O tables. Our analysis shows that US textile imports from India would decline by over US$ 6.6 billion under 50% tariff. Apparel and Made ups face the largest losses. Given the inter-industry linkages, first-order indirect effects are US$ 4.6 billion, including US$ 1.4 billion within the textile sector. Chemicals, agriculture, and trade services account for roughly 40% of these upstream losses. The alternative 25% tariff scenario results in a decline of US$ 2.1 billion in US textile imports, implying that the punitive tariff accounts for the additional US$ 4.5 billion. We conclude that India should negotiate for 25% or lower tariff and focus on alternate markets.
url:4fe408000d29ba5a.abstract_zh: 面对美国对印度征收50%的最高互惠关税，本文估算了关税冲击对印度纺织业的直接与间接影响。通过采用CES需求模型，我们模拟了50%和25%两种关税情景下的反事实需求，并分两个阶段进行分析。第一阶段，我们量化了关税对656种HS六位码纺织产品进口变化的影响，并将其分解为直接关税效应和第三国关税效应（间接效应）。第二阶段，我们利用投入产出表量化了供应链上的传导效应。分析表明，在50%关税下，美国从印度进口的纺织品将减少超过66亿美元，其中服装和制成品损失最大。考虑到行业间关联，一阶间接效应达46亿美元，其中纺织业内部占14亿美元。化学品、农业和贸易服务约占这些上游损失的40%。在25%关税的替代情景下，美国纺织品进口将减少21亿美元，这意味着惩罚性关税导致了额外的45亿美元损失。我们得出结论：印度应争取25%或更低的关税，并聚焦于替代市场。

url:4ff51ea72dff322b.abstract: This study analyzes the fresh produce market in Papua New Guinea (PNG) using unique market flow and price data collected by the Fresh Produce Development Agency (FPDA) over the past 15 years across multiple markets. We document substantial flows of fresh produce from diverse production zones to major urban centers, with Port Moresby emerging as the primary terminal market. Hard fresh produce and sweet potato supplied there largely originate from the Highlands, while other staples and soft fresh produce are mostly sourced from other regions. Price analysis reveals four key patterns: (i) fresh produce prices have risen significantly relative to non-food products, particularly for items less supplied by the Highlands; (ii) prices exhibit strong seasonality—lowest at year-end and highest mid-year (June–August)—reflecting major cultivation periods and possibly seasonality in household labor availability; (iii) marketing margins have increased substantially, especially for soft fresh produce, creating new opportunities for Highland producers to compete in Port Moresby markets; and (iv) in 2023–2025, marketing and wastage costs accounted for the largest share of retail prices in Port Moresby—up to 85 percent for cabbage—while producer shares ranged from 15 percent for cabbage to 61 percent for Irish potatoes. These findings underscore evolving market dynamics and the critical role of supply chain efficiency in PNG’s fresh produce sector.
url:4ff51ea72dff322b.abstract_zh: 本研究利用巴布亚新几内亚（PNG）新鲜农产品发展局（FPDA）过去15年间在多个市场收集的独特市场流量与价格数据，对该国新鲜农产品市场进行了分析。我们记录了从不同生产区域流向主要城市中心的大量新鲜农产品流动，其中莫尔兹比港成为主要的终端市场。该地供应的硬质新鲜农产品和甘薯主要来自高地地区，而其他主食和软质新鲜农产品则大多源自其他区域。价格分析揭示了四个关键特征：（i）新鲜农产品价格相对于非食品类商品显著上涨，尤其是高地地区供应较少的品种；（ii）价格呈现强烈的季节性波动——年末最低，年中（6月至8月）最高——这反映了主要种植周期，并可能与家庭劳动力可用性的季节性变化有关；（iii）营销利润率大幅上升，尤其是软质新鲜农产品，为高地生产者在莫尔兹比港市场竞争创造了新机遇；（iv）在2023至2025年间，营销与损耗成本占莫尔兹比港零售价格的最大份额——卷心菜高达85%——而生产者份额则从卷心菜的15%到爱尔兰土豆的61%不等。这些发现凸显了市场动态的演变以及供应链效率在PNG新鲜农产品行业中的关键作用。

url:50b8124dd6494b5a.abstract: Do central banks decide systematically how much to communicate when explaining their policy decisions? Using all U.S. Federal Open Market Committee policy statements since 1994, we measure communication effort through the change in Shannon entropy and estimate a forward-looking communication rule. We find that communication is systematic: the Federal Reserve communicates more when inflation is expected to exceed target and output is expected to fall below potential. This finding is robust across a variety of sensitivity exercises. We then develop a New Keynesian model with imperfect information showing that systematic communication acts as a second policy instrument, stabilizing expectations and complementing interest-rate policy, especially at the zero lower bound.
url:50b8124dd6494b5a.abstract_zh: 中央银行在解释其政策决策时，是否会系统性地决定沟通程度？我们利用1994年以来美国联邦公开市场委员会的所有政策声明，通过香农熵的变化衡量沟通努力程度，并估算前瞻性沟通规则。研究发现沟通具有系统性：当预期通胀将超过目标值、产出将低于潜在水平时，美联储会加强沟通。这一结论在多种敏感性检验中保持稳健。我们进一步构建包含不完全信息的新凯恩斯模型，证明系统性沟通作为第二政策工具，能够稳定预期并补充利率政策效力，尤其在零利率下限环境下效果显著。

url:50ec18f631111f58.abstract: This paper uses a multi-recipient dictator game to examine whether in-group favoritism increases donations to in-group institutions but decreases donations to out-group institutions. By comparing individual donations to in-group institutions, out-group institutions, and total donations in different treatments, I find that the total donations are similar in different treatments, but the donations each institution receives are different. Individuals donate equally when they encounter two out-group institutions, but, they tend to donate a larger amount to the in-group institution and a smaller amount to the out-group institution. These results demonstrate that donations to the in-group institution due to the effect of in-group favoritism increase at the expense of donations to the out-group institution.
url:50ec18f631111f58.abstract_zh: 本文采用多接受者独裁者博弈实验，考察内群体偏袒是否会增加对内群体机构的捐赠，同时减少对外群体机构的捐赠。通过比较不同实验处理中个体对内群体机构、外群体机构及总捐赠额的差异，本研究发现：不同处理下的总捐赠额相近，但各机构获得的捐赠额存在差异。当个体面对两个外群体机构时，其捐赠行为呈现均等化特征；然而，当面对内群体机构与外群体机构时，个体倾向于向内群体机构捐赠更多金额，而向外群体机构捐赠更少金额。这些结果表明，内群体偏袒效应导致对内群体机构的捐赠增加，是以牺牲对外群体机构的捐赠为代价的。

url:51170667734579ec.abstract: Using a novel dataset covering the complete history of individual-level web traffic and digital subscriptions from a major metropolitan newspaper in the United States between 2020 and 2024, we investigate consumers' willingness to pay for different categories of news content, with particular focus on the kinds of coverage believed to generate civic externalities. Our identification strategy relies on the quasi-random arrival of paywall events which force consumers to subscribe if they wish to continue reading. Using this variation, we estimate a model of consumer demand and construct the optimal staff allocation for the paper under different counterfactual revenue models: a fully subscription-based model and a fully ad-supported model. Our results suggest that readers are willing to pay for local reporting, and that measures of demand based only on time-use substantially underestimate the value of “hard” news coverage on topics like local politics and public health. However, digital subscription revenues alone are insufficient to cover staff costs even at the highest revenue-generating sections of the paper. We use our model to estimate the subsidy required to expand the newspaper's production of investigative coverage.
url:51170667734579ec.abstract_zh: 利用一项涵盖2020至2024年间美国某大都市报纸个体层面网页浏览与数字订阅完整历史的新数据集，我们研究了消费者对不同类别新闻内容的支付意愿，尤其聚焦于被认为能产生公民外部性的报道类型。我们的识别策略依赖于付费墙事件的准随机出现——这些事件迫使消费者若想继续阅读则必须订阅。借助这一变化，我们估计了消费者需求模型，并在两种反事实收入模式下构建了报纸的最优人员配置：完全订阅制模式与完全广告支持模式。研究结果表明，读者愿意为本地报道付费，而仅基于时间使用量的需求测度会显著低估本地政治与公共卫生等“硬新闻”报道的价值。然而，即便在报纸收入最高的板块，仅凭数字订阅收入也不足以覆盖人员成本。我们利用模型估算了扩大报纸调查性报道生产所需的补贴额度。

url:515953a8c537e4d1.abstract: We study the effects of broadband internet use on the investment decisions of individual investors. A public program in Norway provides plausibly exogenous variation in internet use. Our instrumental variables estimates show that internet use causes a substantial increase in stock market participation, driven primarily by increased fund ownership. Existing investors tilt their portfolios towards funds, thereby obtaining more diversified portfolios and higher Sharpe ratios, and do not increase their trading activity in stocks. Overall, access to high-speed internet seems to spur a "Democratization of finance", with individuals making investment decisions that are more in line with the advice from portfolio theory.
url:515953a8c537e4d1.abstract_zh: 本文研究宽带互联网使用对个人投资者投资决策的影响。挪威的一项公共项目为互联网使用提供了合理的外生性变化。工具变量估计结果显示，互联网使用显著提高了股市参与率，这一增长主要由基金持有量的增加驱动。现有投资者将投资组合向基金倾斜，从而获得更分散的投资组合和更高的夏普比率，且并未增加股票交易活跃度。总体而言，高速互联网的接入似乎推动了“金融民主化”，使个人投资者做出的投资决策更符合投资组合理论的建议。

url:51b57d84cd58e44d.abstract: this paper we reconsider the transmission of shocks to government spending across these regimes within a standard new-Keynesian model of a small open economy. Because of the stronger emphasis on intertemporal optimization, the new-Keynesian framework requires a precise specification of fiscal and monetary policies, and their interaction, at both short and long horizons. We derive an analytical characterization of the transmission mechanism of expansionary spending policies under a peg, showing that the long-term real interest rate necessarily rises if inflation rises on impact, in response to an increase in government spending. This drives down private demand even though short-term real rates fall. As this need not be the case under floating exchange rates, the conventional wisdom needs to be qualified. Under plausible medium-term fiscal policies, government spending is not necessarily less expansionary under floating exchange rates.
url:51b57d84cd58e44d.abstract_zh: 本文在标准的新凯恩斯小型开放经济模型中重新审视了不同汇率制度下政府支出冲击的传导机制。由于新凯恩斯框架更强调跨期优化，因此需要精确界定财政与货币政策及其在短期与长期内的相互作用。我们推导了钉住汇率制度下扩张性支出政策传导机制的分析特征，表明若政府支出增加导致通胀即时上升，长期实际利率必然随之攀升。尽管短期实际利率下降，这一效应仍会抑制私人需求。由于浮动汇率制度下未必出现此情形，传统观点需加以修正。在合理的中期财政政策条件下，浮动汇率制度下的政府支出未必具有更弱的扩张效应。

url:51e9d556d45ce811.abstract: US dollar appreciations can inflict sizable negative cross-border spillovers. We investigate such spillovers from flight-to-safety shocks and the accompanying "global dollar cycleâ€ . Our results show that negative real sector spillovers from US dollar appreciations fall disproportionately on emerging markets. In contrast, effects on advanced economies are small and short-lived. Emerging market commodity exporters historically experienced larger negative spillovers than commodity importers, reflecting a strong negative link between the US dollar and commodity prices. In terms of policies, more anchored inflation expectations can mitigate the initial negative spillovers, while more flexible exchange rates can speed up the subsequent economic recovery.
url:51e9d556d45ce811.abstract_zh: 美元升值可能引发显著的负面跨境溢出效应。本文研究了避险冲击及其伴随的"全球美元周期"所产生的此类溢出效应。研究结果表明，美元升值对实体经济的负面溢出效应不成比例地集中于新兴市场。相比之下，对发达经济体的影响则较小且短暂。历史上，新兴市场中的大宗商品出口国比进口国承受了更大的负面溢出效应，这反映了美元与大宗商品价格之间存在强烈的负相关关系。在政策层面，更稳固的通胀预期能够缓解初始阶段的负面溢出效应，而更灵活的汇率制度则有助于加速后续的经济复苏。

url:520441403fd3b2a1.abstract: One of the aims of government policy has been to speed up the diffusion of new technologies. This aim has been pursued largely by policies aimed at improving information about the technology or by subsidising the purchase of new technology. In this paper we construct a simple diffusion model that integrates the two dominant themes in the literature, one stressing learning and the other stressing differences between potential adopters. We investigate the impact of learning and subsidy policies on the diffusion path and the welfare implications of these policies. It is argued that the market structure of the industry supplying the new technology is a key factor determining the impacts of the policies. It should therefore be considered when choosing whether government should intervene and if so, what instruments should be used.
url:520441403fd3b2a1.abstract_zh: 政府政策的目标之一是加速新技术的扩散。这一目标主要通过改善技术信息或补贴新技术购买的政策来实现。本文构建了一个简单的扩散模型，整合了文献中的两大主流主题：一个强调学习，另一个强调潜在采用者之间的差异。我们研究了学习政策和补贴政策对扩散路径的影响，以及这些政策的福利含义。研究表明，供应新技术的行业市场结构是决定政策影响的关键因素。因此，在选择政府是否干预以及采用何种工具时，应充分考虑这一因素。

url:5274f0c447e81a9d.abstract: Using matched employer–employee data on more than 62, 000 master’s graduates, this paper examines how gender differences in wage returns to fields of study vary by migration background and how educational specialisation contributes to the gender wage gap. We estimate wage regressions and apply a decomposition approach to separate sorting across fields from differences in pay within fields. Returns vary widely, with law, economics and management, and science yielding the highest returns, and women earning less than men within all fields, especially in high-paying ones. First-generation immigrants from developing countries obtain the lowest returns regardless of field of study, while second-generation immigrants approach but do not fully match natives. Fields of study explain a substantial share of gender wage inequality among natives and second-generation immigrants, whereas among first-generation immigrants broader wage disadvantages dominate. Results further vary with the number of parents originating from developing countries and with age at arrival.
url:5274f0c447e81a9d.abstract_zh: 本文利用超过62,000名硕士毕业生的匹配雇主-雇员数据，考察了不同专业领域的工资回报如何因移民背景而呈现性别差异，以及教育专业化如何影响性别工资差距。我们通过估计工资回归方程并采用分解方法，将不同专业领域的筛选效应与同一专业领域内的薪酬差异区分开来。各专业领域的回报差异显著，其中法律、经济与管理以及科学领域的回报最高，且在所有专业领域内女性收入均低于男性，尤其是在高薪领域。无论专业领域如何，来自发展中国家的第一代移民获得的回报最低，而第二代移民虽接近但未能完全达到本土出生者的水平。专业领域解释了本土出生者和第二代移民中性别工资不平等的相当大一部分，但在第一代移民中，更广泛的工资劣势占据主导地位。研究结果还因父母来自发展中国家的数量以及移民抵达时的年龄而呈现差异。

url:52822d2299026bc7.abstract: We examine the relationship between allomaternal care (i.e., care for children by individuals other than the mother) and prosociality (reciprocity and altruism). Motivated by ethnographic evidence of a positive association between allomaternal care and societal trust across cultures, we design an economic experiment to measure the relationship between allomaternal care and cooperative behavior among 820 participants in small scale societies of the Solomon Islands. Our results show that receiving help with child care predicts higher levels of reciprocity towards the helper. This relationship remains robust for mothers even after accounting for participant fixed effects, for the nature of the relationship between mother and helper, and for other forms of mutual assistance. Moreover, help from non-relatives is associated with altruism toward strangers, suggesting a novel channel for the development of impersonal prosociality. Strengthening the case for the importance of allomaternal care for human development, we report suggestive evidence of potential socio-cognitive benefits to children who receive care from non-relatives (based on daylong recordings of 197 children analyzed using a multilingually-trained neural network), as well as societal-level benefits in terms of economic growth. url:52822d2299026bc7.abstract_zh: 我们考察了异母照料（即非母亲个体对儿童的照料）与亲社会性（互惠与利他）之间的关系。受跨文化民族志证据表明异母照料与社会信任呈正相关的启发，我们设计了一项经济实验，以测量所罗门群岛小型社会中820名参与者的异母照料与合作行为之间的关系。研究结果显示，获得育儿帮助预示着对帮助者具有更高水平的互惠行为。即使在控制参与者固定效应、母亲与帮助者之间的关系性质以及其他形式的互助后，这一关系对母亲而言依然稳健。此外，来自非亲属的帮助与对陌生人的利他行为相关，这揭示了非人格化亲社会性发展的新渠道。为强化异母照料对人类发展重要性的论证，我们报告了提示性证据：接受非亲属照料的儿童可能获得社会认知方面的益处（基于对197名儿童全天录音的分析，采用多语言训练的神经网络），以及在社会层面促进经济增长的潜在效益。类似内容被其他人浏览。

url:52a22a9bc9147b63.abstract: This paper presents a critical survey of theories of migration, their welfare and policy implications and their empirical relevance. We also develop some extensions to the theory beginning with a general encompassing model of migration which treats the Harris and Todaro (HT) model as a special case. In particular, we show how standard policy, a reduction of the wage gap between an advanced and a backward region to reduce the rate of migration, follows from the standard model, but ceases to be valid if borrowing constraints on the potential migrant are introduced. The HT model is extended to examine risk-averse behaviour within families where the migration of members of families serves to diversify risk. The welfare implications of the individual migration decision and government intervention in the form of employment subsidies are also examined.
url:52a22a9bc9147b63.abstract_zh: 本文对迁移理论、其福利与政策含义及实证相关性进行了批判性综述。我们首先构建了一个涵盖性迁移模型，将哈里斯-托达罗（HT）模型作为特例纳入其中，并在此基础上对理论进行了若干拓展。具体而言，我们展示了标准政策——即通过缩小发达地区与欠发达地区之间的工资差距来降低迁移率——如何从标准模型中推导得出，但若引入潜在迁移者的借贷约束，该政策便不再有效。此外，我们对HT模型进行了扩展，以考察家庭内部的风险规避行为，其中家庭成员迁移旨在分散风险。本文还探讨了个人迁移决策的福利含义，以及政府以就业补贴形式进行干预的影响。

url:52e71b839b416c7e.abstract: Standard macroeconomic data do not cleanly separate the systematic and non-systematic components of monetary policy. We show that incorporating unstructured text data into the structural estimation of a DSGE model can sharpen this distinction. We augment a standard state-space model with a non-core measurement block that links structural shocks to time series derived from FOMC transcripts, using a spike-and-slab prior to let the data select which series are informative. In a medium-scale New Keynesian model for the U.S., incorporating text improves predictive performance and materially alters structural inference: the new model estimates a lower response of the policy rate to inflation, higher price stickiness and lower price indexation, implying a flatter and less backward-looking price Phillips curve.
url:52e71b839b416c7e.abstract_zh: 标准宏观经济数据无法清晰区分货币政策的系统性与非系统性成分。我们证明，将非结构化文本数据纳入DSGE模型的结构估计能够强化这一区分。我们通过一个非核心测量模块对标准状态空间模型进行扩展，该模块将结构性冲击与源自联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）会议记录的时序数据相关联，并采用尖峰-板状先验让数据自行选择具有信息量的序列。在美国中等规模新凯恩斯模型中，引入文本数据不仅提升了预测表现，还显著改变了结构性推断：新模型估计的政策利率对通胀的响应更低，价格粘性更高且价格指数化程度更低，这意味着更平坦且更少后顾性的价格菲利普斯曲线。
