url:538bb47d9592c433.abstract: This paper examines how global greenfield foreign direct investment (FDI) flows are evolving amid rising geoeconomic fragmentation. We use difference-in-differences and event study approaches to analyze changes in FDI around key bilateral inflection points. We find a decline in FDI from the US and broader Group of Seven Plus (G7+) into the PRC, concentrated in trade-exposed, efficiency-seeking sectors. Investment diversion—particularly from the PRC to Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) members and Latin America—is evident, but this growth was concentrated in less global value chain (GVC)-integrated activities, suggesting that GVC links may act as a constraint on investment relocation. These findings suggest that while tensions may be reshaping global investment, GVC dependencies are likely limiting firms’ ability to reallocate production at scale, making the “great reallocation” least evident where it was most expected.
url:538bb47d9592c433.abstract_zh: 本文考察了在地缘经济碎片化加剧的背景下，全球绿地外商直接投资（FDI）流动的演变趋势。我们采用双重差分法和事件研究法，分析关键双边关系转折点前后FDI的变化。研究发现，美国及更广泛的七国集团+（G7+）对中国的FDI出现下降，且主要集中在贸易敏感、效率寻求型行业。投资转移现象明显——尤其是从中国流向东南亚国家联盟（ASEAN）成员国和拉丁美洲——但这种增长集中于全球价值链（GVC）整合程度较低的活动，表明GVC联系可能对投资重新布局构成制约。这些发现表明，尽管地缘紧张局势可能正在重塑全球投资格局，但GVC依赖关系很可能限制了企业大规模重新配置生产能力，使得“大转移”在最被预期发生的领域反而最不明显。

url:539de14a289c2f19.abstract: Urban overheating is increasingly recognised as a major public health challenge under climate change, yet existing frameworks remain heavily focused on acute medical risk and clinically vulnerable populations. This paper introduces \textit{hidden vulnerability} to describe a broader population who remain socially and economically active under ordinary conditions but experience progressive destabilisation during sustained indoor heat exposure. Drawing on a sensor-enhanced longitudinal housing survey in Southwark, London during the summer of 2023, combining indoor environmental monitoring with weekly health and wellbeing questionnaires, the study examines how overheating affects everyday urban life. The findings reveal that impacts extended well beyond thermal discomfort. Participants described cascading disruptions across physical, functional, and psychological domains, sleep loss, exhaustion, impaired self-care, reduced concentration, emotional strain, and increased caring burdens, that interacted and reinforced one another, progressively eroding the capacity to maintain ordinary routines. Critically, these processes were observed not only among participants with chronic conditions but also among those without formally recognised health vulnerabilities, suggesting that the threshold for destabilisation is lower, and more widely distributed, than existing frameworks assume. The paper argues that hidden vulnerability is an urban condition, produced by the intersection of housing quality, social infrastructure, and accumulated disadvantage. The response calls for a conceptual framework for redefining heat vulnerability beyond demographic and clinical categories, and an empirical foundation for a social cure approach to urban heat governance.
url:539de14a289c2f19.abstract_zh: 城市过热日益被视为气候变化下的一项重大公共健康挑战，然而现有研究框架仍高度聚焦于急性医疗风险及临床意义上的脆弱人群。本文提出"隐性脆弱性"概念，用以描述在常规条件下保持社会与经济活跃、但持续暴露于室内高温时经历渐进式失稳的广泛人群。基于2023年夏季在伦敦南华克区开展的传感器增强型纵向住房调查，结合室内环境监测与每周健康福祉问卷，本研究考察了过热对日常城市生活的影响。研究结果表明，其影响远超热不适范畴。参与者描述了身体、功能及心理层面的级联式干扰——睡眠剥夺、疲惫、自我照护能力受损、注意力下降、情绪压力及照护负担加重——这些因素相互交织、彼此强化，逐步侵蚀维持日常活动的能力。关键的是，这些过程不仅出现在患有慢性疾病的参与者中，也出现在无正式认定的健康脆弱性的参与者中，表明失稳阈值低于现有框架假设，且分布更为广泛。本文认为，隐性脆弱性是一种城市状态，由住房质量、社会基础设施与累积劣势的交织作用所产生。应对策略要求构建超越人口统计与临床分类的热脆弱性概念框架，并为城市热治理的社会疗愈路径提供实证基础。

url:5548f04cb377eac0.abstract: This paper presents theoretical arguments and empirical evidence from British manufacturing for the view that the first of these is the most serious with important dimensions in the measurement of capital and output as well as that of utilization. New light is shed on two classic questions. One was first raised by Feldstein (1967) who observed in a cross-section context that the elasticity of output w. r. t. average observed hours of work significantly exceeded the elasticity w. r. t. employment. Craine (1973) observed a similar result for time-series data. The other question is one with which most researchers on productivity have struggled: how to correct productivity for cyclical variations in the utlization of inputs. A novel answer based on the use of overtime hours data is found to give excellent empirical results.
url:5548f04cb377eac0.abstract_zh: 本文从理论论证和英国制造业的经验证据出发，认为上述第一个问题最为严重，且在资本与产出的测度以及利用率维度上均具有重要影响。研究为两个经典问题提供了新视角。其一是由Feldstein（1967）首次提出，他在横截面分析中发现，产出相对于平均观测工时弹性显著高于相对于就业弹性；Craine（1973）在时间序列数据中也观察到类似结果。另一个问题是大多数生产率研究者长期面临的挑战：如何校正投入要素利用率周期性波动对生产率的影响。本文基于加班工时数据提出创新性解决方案，实证结果表现优异。

url:557baced4b843cdb.abstract: Voters in multiparty systems often fail to coordinate on majority-preferred parties. Using constituency-level election data linked to party-ideology measures across 96 countries, we show that in 20–30% of multiparty elections since 1940 the Condorcet winner does not win, and in roughly 10% the winner is the Condorcet loser. Failures are most common under plurality rule and in fragmented, volatile party systems, and systematically disadvantage opposition and culturally liberal parties while benefiting organizationally strong ones. Can information fix this? In four pre-registered experiments around Indian elections (N > 4,000), constituency-level polls shift voting intentions by at most 2 percentage points, a precisely estimated null, despite modest belief updating, though undecided voters become 7 points more likely to support a viable party. A model with expressive motives rationalizes both results: polls refine beliefs but lack the leverage to overcome entrenched attachments, identifying boundary conditions on polls as coordination devices.
url:557baced4b843cdb.abstract_zh: 在多党制中，选民往往难以协调支持多数偏好的政党。通过将96个国家的选区级选举数据与政党意识形态指标相关联，我们发现自1940年以来，20%至30%的多党选举中孔多塞胜者未能获胜，约10%的选举中胜者实为孔多塞败者。此类失败在单一选区制、碎片化且不稳定的政党体系中最为常见，并系统性地不利于反对党及文化自由主义政党，而有利于组织力量强大的政党。信息能否解决这一问题？在围绕印度选举开展的四项预注册实验中（样本量>4000），选区级民调对投票意向的影响至多为2个百分点——这一精确估计的零效应，尽管存在适度的信念更新，但未决选民支持可行政党的概率提升了7个百分点。一个包含表达性动机的模型可同时解释这两项结果：民调虽能修正信念，却缺乏克服根深蒂固依附关系的杠杆作用，从而界定了民调作为协调机制的条件边界。
url:557baced4b843cdb.title: DP21790 Majority Lost: Global Evidence and Field Experiments on Electoral Miscoordination
url:557baced4b843cdb.title_zh: DP21790 多数派失利：选举协调失灵的全球证据与实地实验

url:5583fbd81d8a1cb8.abstract: The macroeconomic theory that is taught in graduate schools, and used in the conduct of monetary and fiscal policy around the world today, emerged from a revolution in economics that was led by Ned Phelps. This column discusses Phelps’s theoretical contributions and how they created a micro foundation for macroeconomics.
url:5583fbd81d8a1cb8.abstract_zh: 如今研究生院教授并被全球用于货币与财政政策制定的宏观经济理论，源于由内德·菲尔普斯引领的经济学革命。本文探讨了菲尔普斯的理论贡献，以及这些贡献如何为宏观经济学奠定了微观基础。
url:5583fbd81d8a1cb8.title: Ned Phelps and modern macroeconomics
url:5583fbd81d8a1cb8.title_zh: 内德·菲尔普斯与现代宏观经济学

url:55907d5000df2527.abstract: Accurate stock price forecasting has consistently remained a pivotal yet challenging FinTech task that underpins quantitative trading and investment decision making. Recent efforts have been dedicated to modeling various complex relationships among stocks in the stock market toward more reliable stock price forecasting.These methods depend heavily on strong static prior assumptions by modeling either temporal dependencies within individual stocks or spatial dependencies across different stocks based on predefined structures, while the complex market dynamics that drive stock price movements remain unexplored. To alleviate this issue, we propose a novel game-theoretic modeling method that captures heterogeneous investor interactions for stock price forecasting. The core idea is to embed game-theoretic mechanisms into the heterogeneous graph structure to finely model the dynamic strategic interactions among heterogeneous investors with respect to target stocks. Additionally, temporal positional encoding is adopted to reflect the differentiated influences of each game event at different time steps within the time window on future stock price movements. Leveraging heterogeneous graph networks, we proxy the intricate dynamics of the stock market through investor games and enable real-time information propagation and node updates among all nodes. Extensive experiments conducted on two real-world benchmark dataset demonstrate that our method effectively outperforms state-of-the-art stock price forecasting methods.
url:55907d5000df2527.abstract_zh: 准确的股票价格预测一直是支撑量化交易与投资决策的关键且具有挑战性的金融科技任务。近期研究致力于建模股票市场中各类复杂关系，以实现更可靠的股价预测。这些方法高度依赖强静态先验假设，要么基于预定义结构建模单只股票的时间依赖性，要么建模不同股票间的空间依赖性，但驱动股价波动的复杂市场动态仍未被充分探索。为解决这一问题，我们提出一种新颖的博弈论建模方法，通过捕捉异质投资者互动来实现股价预测。其核心思想是将博弈论机制嵌入异质图结构，精细建模目标股票相关异质投资者间的动态策略互动。此外，采用时间位置编码来反映时间窗口内不同时间步的博弈事件对未来股价波动的差异化影响。借助异质图网络，我们通过投资者博弈代理股票市场的复杂动态，实现所有节点间的实时信息传播与节点更新。在两个真实世界基准数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法有效超越了现有最优的股价预测方法。

url:55a5d3028a7d40f5.abstract: This paper examines whether regulatory liquidity buffers enable banks to support corporate borrowers during financial stress. Using confidential bank-firm credit data and handcollected Liquidity Coverage Ratio regulation (LCR) disclosures during COVID-19, we find that banks with higher LCR buffers above the regulatory minimum provided significantly more credit to firms with large undrawn credit lines in March 2020. Critically, only buffers, not overall LCR levels, matter, revealing that the regulatory minimum operates as a binding constraint during stress. The effect is concentrated among high-quality borrowers with clean credit profiles and disappears by mid-2020, confirming that LCR buffers provide selective, temporary liquidity insurance during acute stress.
url:55a5d3028a7d40f5.abstract_zh: 本文考察了监管流动性缓冲是否能使银行在金融压力时期为企业借款人提供支持。利用新冠疫情期间的机密银行-企业信贷数据及手工收集的流动性覆盖率（LCR）监管披露信息，我们发现，在2020年3月，LCR缓冲高于监管最低要求的银行，向拥有大量未提取信贷额度的企业提供了显著更多的信贷。关键在于，只有缓冲水平而非整体LCR水平产生影响，这表明监管最低要求在压力时期构成了具有约束力的限制。这一效应集中于信用记录良好的高质量借款人，并在2020年年中消失，证实了LCR缓冲在严重压力时期提供了选择性、临时性的流动性保险。
url:55a5d3028a7d40f5.title: The Last Taxi: LCR Buffers and Bank Liquidity Provision
url:55a5d3028a7d40f5.title_zh: 最后的出租车：流动性覆盖率缓冲与银行流动性供给

url:55bc1fb36be56faa.abstract: In response to rising urban air pollution, European cities have adopted Low Emission Zones (LEZs), restricting the most polluting vehicles. While effective in improving air quality, these policies remain controversial due to concerns over fairness and acceptability. This paper examines the impact of London’s 2021 and 2023 Ultra Low Emission Zone (ULEZ) expansions on Subjective Well-Being (SWB). Using panel data from the UK Household Longitudinal Study and a staggered difference-in-differences design with individual and year fixed effects, we compare changes in life satisfaction among residents inside and outside the affected areas. We find that the 2021 expansion led to a decline in life satisfaction by approximately 0.4 points. We explore the mechanisms driving this decline and find that the well-being loss is mediated by car dependency and transport mode availability. While the policy increased reliance on public transport, we show that a better accessibility to public transport mitigates the decline in life satisfaction among London residents. Furthermore, we show that the well-being costs of the policy are regressive, disproportionately affecting lower-income households. These findings suggest that LEZs can generate short-term and unequal well-being costs despite achieving modest behavioural change, highlighting the need for complementary measures to enhance social acceptability.
url:55bc1fb36be56faa.abstract_zh: 针对城市空气污染日益加剧的问题，欧洲城市采取了低排放区（LEZs）措施，限制高污染车辆的使用。尽管这些政策在改善空气质量方面成效显著，但因其公平性与可接受性方面的担忧而备受争议。本文考察了伦敦2021年及2023年超低排放区（ULEZ）扩展对主观幸福感（SWB）的影响。利用英国家庭纵向研究的面板数据，并采用包含个体及年份固定效应的交错双重差分设计，我们比较了受影响区域内外居民生活满意度的变化。研究发现，2021年的扩展导致生活满意度下降约0.4个百分点。我们进一步探究了这一下降背后的机制，发现幸福感损失受汽车依赖度及交通方式可用性的中介作用影响。尽管政策增加了对公共交通的依赖，但研究表明，更好的公共交通可达性能够缓解伦敦居民生活满意度的下降。此外，我们还发现该政策的幸福感成本具有累退性，对低收入家庭的影响尤为显著。这些发现表明，低排放区在实现适度行为改变的同时，可能产生短期且不平等的幸福感成本，凸显了采取补充措施以增强社会可接受性的必要性。
url:55bc1fb36be56faa.title: The Well-Being Costs of Low Emission Zones: Evidence from London's ULEZ Expansions
url:55bc1fb36be56faa.title_zh: 低排放区的福利成本：来自伦敦ULEZ扩展的证据

url:55c5b03346c60c24.title_zh: 联邦财政结构中的收入分配、税收与转移

url:55c9307c9f7c952c.abstract: Conventional demographic models systematically overestimate fertility decline in sub-Saharan Africa. This paper proposes a complementary explanation grounded in a prevalent but understudied belief system: ancestors influence the living and seek the continuation of their lineage, into which they may be reincarnated. In this worldview, having children becomes a moral and collective duty, rooted in the spiritual responsibility to ensure the survival of the lineage. Drawing on first-hand data, novel ethnographic information, and historical and contemporary surveys, I document a strong and quantitatively large positive relationship between ancestral beliefs and fertility across contexts and time periods. A simple model in which children are a public good for the lineage rationalizes the patterns observed in the data: the fertility effect of ancestral beliefs is concentrated in patrilineal societies, and a specific form of free-riding emerges among siblings whose children continue the same family line. These findings suggest that high fertility in sub-Saharan Africa rests on moral foundations that standard, externally designed interventions tend to overlook.
url:55c9307c9f7c952c.abstract_zh: 传统人口模型系统性地高估了撒哈拉以南非洲地区的生育率下降趋势。本文提出一种基于普遍存在但研究不足的信仰体系的补充性解释：祖先会影响生者，并寻求其血脉的延续，而祖先可能通过转世回归这一血脉。在这种世界观中，生育子女成为一项道德与集体义务，根植于确保血脉存续的精神责任。通过利用一手数据、新颖的民族志信息以及历史与当代调查，我记录了祖先信仰与生育率之间在不同情境与时间跨度中呈现的强烈且数量显著的正向关联。一个将子女视为血脉公共品的简单模型，合理化了数据中观察到的模式：祖先信仰对生育率的影响集中于父系社会，且兄弟姐妹之间出现一种特定形式的搭便车行为——其子女延续同一家族血脉。这些发现表明，撒哈拉以南非洲的高生育率建立在道德基础之上，而标准的外部干预设计往往忽视了这一点。

url:55f406cc6b906572.title: Strategic Submissions: An Analysis of Supplemental Drug Approvals
url:55f406cc6b906572.title_zh: 策略性提交：补充药物批准的分析

url:55fcfa08b82db855.abstract: Much of the controversy about labour migration concerns an aspect which is not easily measured, the 'quality' of the flow. The first part of the paper applies logit analysis to a sample of emigrants from an Irish border county for some insight on the issue. The results suggest that while those who leave are relatively better educated than their neighbours, kinship variables such as parental attitudes and emigrant sponsors, are also important. The second part of the paper weighs 'life-cycle' losses from post-war Irish migration against receipts from emigrant tourism and remittances. It turns out that these items make a big dent in the losses.
url:55fcfa08b82db855.abstract_zh: 关于劳动力迁移的诸多争议集中于一个难以衡量的方面，即迁移流的“质量”。论文第一部分运用逻辑回归分析，对来自爱尔兰边境郡的移民样本进行考察，以探究该问题。结果表明，尽管离境者相较于其邻人受教育程度更高，但亲属关系变量（如父母态度与移民担保人）同样具有重要影响。第二部分则权衡了战后爱尔兰移民的“生命周期”损失与移民旅游及汇款收入。结果显示，这些收入显著抵消了部分损失。
url:55fcfa08b82db855.title: DP52 On Two Aspects of Post-War Irish Emigration
url:55fcfa08b82db855.title_zh: DP52 论战后爱尔兰移民的两个方面

url:560bf8c5f1b72ed6.abstract: Digital platforms allocate buyer attention across sellers that differ in quality and breadth of appeal. We study a monopoly platform that sets meeting rates between buyers and two seller types --- niche sellers whose high-quality good is valued by a fraction of buyers and mass-market sellers whose good is valued by all. Sellers compete by posting prices à la Burdett and Judd (1983), so buyer surplus requires competition, while platform revenue requires seller rents. This difference creates a systematic distortion: as search capacity grows, the platform keeps high-quality niche attention just past the point where extra exposure stops creating rents and starts eroding them — its saturation point — and diverts the rest to mass-market sellers. The resulting buyer-surplus loss converges to a finite limit proportional to the quality gap between the two goods, split equally between an allocative loss from too little high-quality exposure and excess rent extracted by sellers. Applying the model to Amazon product search and Google passage-ranking data indicates that, for captive buyers, both platforms operate past the saturation point, with buyer-surplus losses of 63 and 44 percent of the planner's benchmark, respectively. Allowing buyer participation to respond to the platform's recommendation strategy disciplines the platform and shrinks this loss.
url:560bf8c5f1b72ed6.abstract_zh: 数字平台在质量与吸引力广度各异的卖家之间分配买家注意力。我们研究了一个垄断平台，该平台设定买家与两类卖家之间的匹配率——利基卖家（其高质量商品仅被部分买家青睐）与大众市场卖家（其商品被所有买家青睐）。卖家按照Burdett和Judd（1983）的模型进行价格竞争，因此买家剩余依赖于竞争，而平台收入则依赖于卖家租金。这一差异造成了系统性扭曲：随着搜索能力的增长，平台将高质量利基卖家的注意力维持在刚好超过额外曝光不再创造租金、反而开始侵蚀租金的临界点——即其饱和点——并将剩余注意力转移给大众市场卖家。由此导致的买家剩余损失收敛于一个有限极限，该极限与两种商品的质量差距成正比，并均分为两部分：高质量曝光不足造成的配置损失，以及卖家攫取的超额租金。将该模型应用于亚马逊产品搜索与谷歌段落排名数据后发现，对于被锁定的买家而言，两个平台的运营均已超过饱和点，买家剩余损失分别达到规划者基准水平的63%和44%。允许买家参与度对平台推荐策略做出反应，能够约束平台行为并缩小这一损失。
url:560bf8c5f1b72ed6.title: DP21637 Platform-Controlled Search and Distortions in Attention Allocation
url:560bf8c5f1b72ed6.title_zh: DP21637 平台控制的搜索与注意力分配中的扭曲

url:5617c7fb0be9e0ac.abstract: Large cities worldwide have adopted congestion pricing to reduce urban traffic, with well-documented benefits for travel speeds, accident rates, and air quality. This paper identifies a novel external benefit: faster emergency medical service (EMS) response times. We provide the first evidence on how the congestion pricing program in New York City – the first comprehensive cordon-based congestion pricing system in the U.S. that was implemented on January 5th, 2025 – affects EMS performance. Exploiting the sharp geographic boundary of New York City’s congestion relief zone at 60th Street and a difference-in-discontinuities design, we first document substantial changes in traffic and mobility near the boundary: vehicular traffic declines by roughly 18 to 21 percent, accompanied by increases in pedestrian and bicycle activity. Consistent with these first-stage mechanisms, we find that congestion pricing improves EMS performance, reducing total travel times by 63–70 seconds (approximately 5–6 percent). Effects emerged quickly and show little evidence of displacement to adjacent areas. A concurrent FDNY directive requiring transport to the nearest hospital confounds standard difference-in-differences estimates but not our boundary-based design. These findings suggest that cost-benefit analyses of congestion pricing systematically understate net social benefits by omitting emergency response improvements.
url:5617c7fb0be9e0ac.abstract_zh: 全球各大城市已普遍采用拥堵收费政策以减少城市交通拥堵，其在提升通行速度、降低事故率及改善空气质量方面的效益已有充分文献佐证。本文识别出一项新型外部效益：急救医疗服务响应时间的缩短。我们首次提供了关于纽约市拥堵收费计划——美国首个于2025年1月5日实施的综合性区域拥堵收费系统——如何影响急救医疗服务绩效的证据。利用纽约市拥堵缓解区在第60街的清晰地理边界及断点回归设计，我们首先记录了边界附近交通与出行模式的显著变化：机动车流量下降约18%至21%，同时伴随步行与自行车活动的增加。与这些第一阶段机制相一致，我们发现拥堵收费改善了急救医疗服务绩效，将总行程时间缩短63至70秒（约5%至6%）。该效应迅速显现，且几乎没有证据表明其向邻近区域转移。纽约市消防局同时实施的将患者送往最近医院的指令混淆了传统双重差分估计结果，但未影响基于边界的识别设计。这些发现表明，拥堵收费的成本效益分析因忽略应急响应改善而系统性低估了净社会效益。
url:5617c7fb0be9e0ac.title: Congestion Pricing and Emergency Medical Service Response: Evidence from New York City
url:5617c7fb0be9e0ac.title_zh: 拥堵收费与紧急医疗服务响应：来自纽约市的证据

url:5628ca71dbe91b82.abstract: The paper proposes an intertemporal equilibrium model with monopolistic competition and start-up investment with variable capacity to explain the nexus between business formation and medium-run growth. An investment externality is identified that results in under-accumulation of capital in the decentralized market equilibrium and, thus, creates investment multipliers. Some form of investment promotion is called for. The paper compares the effectiveness of policies to promote small business formation with a general investment tax credit.
url:5628ca71dbe91b82.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个包含垄断竞争与可变产能初创投资的跨期均衡模型，用以解释企业形成与中期增长之间的关联。研究发现存在一种投资外部性，导致分散市场均衡中的资本积累不足，进而产生投资乘数效应。因此需要采取某种形式的投资促进政策。本文比较了促进小企业形成的政策与一般性投资税收抵免的有效性。
url:5628ca71dbe91b82.title: Business Formation and Aggregate Investment

url:563c8ee2762ce798.abstract: Data centers now account for 4.4% of United States electricity demand, yet the grid-level effectiveness of the renewable energy certificates (RECs) and power purchase agreements (PPAs) hyperscalers use to claim carbon neutrality remains unclear. We develop a game-theoretic model in which a data center operator chooses among RECs, PPAs, and behind-the-meter colocation while generators make entry decisions under endogenous financing costs. The model identifies a timing wedge -- the mismatch between consumption and credited renewable generation -- as a central mechanism through which AI demand degrades reliability, raises prices, and increases emissions even when RECs cover 100% of annual consumption. Colocation with storage addresses this wedge directly and induces the greatest renewable entry by eliminating generator revenue risk. We test these predictions by exploiting the staggered release of large language models as a natural experiment, using difference-in-differences on a novel dataset linking AI activity to local grid outcomes. AI demand significantly increases fossil generation, wholesale prices (up to 25% in treated PJM zones), and outage frequency (0.5--1 additional outages per year) near data centers, with impacts scaling in model size. Data centers with on-site generation exhibit a sign reversal in power-quality effects, consistent with the model's prediction that behind-the-meter capacity absorbs demand spikes. Counterfactual analyses show that edge inference, spatial reallocation, and colocated storage each substantially mitigate grid impacts, while REC-only strategies do not. Together, our results demonstrate that the externalities of AI to the grid are tightly coupled to procurement design and the spatial organization of data center infrastructure.
url:563c8ee2762ce798.abstract_zh: 数据中心目前占美国电力需求的4.4%，然而，超大规模企业用于宣称碳中和的可再生能源证书（RECs）和购电协议（PPAs）在电网层面的有效性仍不明确。我们构建了一个博弈论模型，其中数据中心运营商在RECs、PPAs和表后共置方案之间进行选择，而发电商则在内生融资成本下做出进入决策。该模型识别出一个时间错配——即电力消费与可归因的可再生能源发电之间的时间差——作为核心机制，通过这一机制，即使RECs覆盖100%的年度消费，人工智能需求仍会降低电网可靠性、推高电价并增加碳排放。与储能设施共置直接解决了这一时间错配问题，并通过消除发电商的收入风险，最大程度地促进了可再生能源的进入。我们利用大语言模型的分阶段发布作为自然实验，通过双重差分法对连接人工智能活动与地方电网结果的新数据集进行检验，以验证这些预测。人工智能需求显著增加了数据中心附近化石燃料发电量、批发电价（在受影响的PJM区域最高上涨25%）以及停电频率（每年额外增加0.5至1次停电），且影响程度随模型规模扩大而增强。配备自备发电设施的数据中心在电能质量效应上表现出符号反转，这与模型预测一致，即表后容量能够吸收需求尖峰。反事实分析表明，边缘推理、空间重新布局以及共置储能均能显著缓解电网影响，而仅依赖RECs的策略则无法实现。综合来看，我们的研究结果表明，人工智能对电网的外部性与采购设计及数据中心基础设施的空间组织紧密相关。

url:5644c08f5396f681.abstract: How does informality shape the impact of minimum wage policy? We study this question using evidence from Mexico’s 145% real increase in the minimum wage since 2016, together with a general equilibrium model featuring endogenous informality and household heterogeneity. Reduced-form estimates of the implemented increases indicate limited effects on employment and formalization, alongside modest wage gains at the bottom of the formal wage distribution that arguably reflect incomplete enforcement. The calibrated model reproduces these patterns but predicts that, under full enforcement, higher wage floors generate nonlinear effects: the share of firms reallocating toward informality rises sharply, lowering productivity and aggregate welfare. These losses fall disproportionately on low-skill households, who bear the brunt of the reduction in transfers caused by lower tax revenue yet, as predominantly informal workers, gain little directly from the minimum wage. The minimum wage’s effectiveness as a redistributive tool is therefore limited.
url:5644c08f5396f681.abstract_zh: 非正规性如何影响最低工资政策的效果？我们利用墨西哥自2016年以来最低工资实际增长145%的证据，结合包含内生非正规性与家庭异质性的一般均衡模型来研究这一问题。对已实施最低工资上调的简化形式估计表明，其对就业和正规化的影响有限，同时正规工资分布底端出现温和的工资增长——这在一定程度上反映了执法不完善。校准后的模型复现了这些特征，但预测在完全执法条件下，更高的工资下限会产生非线性效应：转向非正规部门的企业比例急剧上升，从而降低生产率和总体福利。这些损失不成比例地由低技能家庭承担——他们因税收减少导致的转移支付下降而首当其冲，但作为以非正规就业为主的劳动者，却几乎无法直接从最低工资中获益。因此，最低工资作为再分配工具的有效性十分有限。
url:5644c08f5396f681.title: Minimum Wages and the Informality Constraint
url:5644c08f5396f681.title_zh: 最低工资与非正规约束

url:56540dfd6a5119f6.abstract: We develop a multi-country, multi-sector New Keynesian model with incomplete markets, input-output linkages, and heterogeneous sectoral price rigidities to study the macroeconomic effects of tariffs. Tariffs act simultaneously as demand and supply shocks. A risk-sharing wedge, driven by terms-of-trade effects and revalued net foreign assets, summarizes the wealth transfer in general equilibrium and determines whether the tariff-imposing country gains or loses. This wedge interacts with a propagation matrix encoding network structure, sectoral rigidity, and cross-country monetary policy heterogeneity, which governs how inherited real marginal-cost distortions feed into inflation and consumption. Through input-output linkages, transitory tariffs generate persistent distortions, unlike standard New Keynesian benchmarks. These distortions exceed what N-country monetary policy can offset, even under flexible exchange rates. Quantitatively, the 2025-2026 tariffs are stagflationary for the U.S. and yield inflation or deflation abroad depending on trade diversion and monetary policy heterogeneity. Tariff threats alone generate inflation shaped by retaliation expectations.
url:56540dfd6a5119f6.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个包含不完全市场、投入产出关联及异质性部门价格粘性的多国多部门新凯恩斯模型，用以研究关税的宏观经济效应。关税同时发挥需求冲击与供给冲击的作用。由贸易条件效应与重估后的净外国资产驱动的风险分担楔子，概括了一般均衡中的财富转移，并决定了征收关税国家的损益状况。该楔子与一个编码了网络结构、部门粘性及跨国货币政策异质性的传播矩阵相互作用，后者决定了继承的实际边际成本扭曲如何传导至通胀与消费。通过投入产出关联，临时性关税会产生持续性扭曲，这与标准新凯恩斯基准模型不同。即便在浮动汇率制度下，这些扭曲也超出了N国货币政策所能抵消的范围。定量分析表明，2025-2026年关税对美国具有滞胀效应，并根据贸易转移与货币政策异质性导致国外通胀或通缩。仅关税威胁本身就会产生由报复预期塑造的通胀。
url:56540dfd6a5119f6.title: Global Networks, Monetary Policy, Trade
url:56540dfd6a5119f6.title_zh: 全球网络、货币政策与贸易

url:5691160609b1a2db.abstract: We develop two proposals to enhance the prospects for both liberalization of services trade and regulatory reform. The first is for governments to create mechanisms ('services knowledge platforms') to bring together regulators, trade officials and stakeholders to discuss services regulatory reform. Such mechanisms could identify reform priorities and opportunities for utilization of 'aid for trade' resources, thereby putting in place the preconditions for future market opening. The second proposal is for a new approach to negotiations in the WTO, with a critical mass of countries that account for the bulk of services production agreeing to lock-in applied levels of protection and pre-committing to reform of policies affecting FDI and international movement for individual service providers--two areas where current policy is most restrictive and potential benefits from liberalization are greatest. If these proposals cannot be fully implemented in the Doha time frame, then any Doha agreement could at least lay the basis for a forward-looking program of international cooperation along the proposed lines.
url:5691160609b1a2db.abstract_zh: 我们提出两项建议，以提升服务贸易自由化与监管改革的前景。第一项建议是，各国政府应建立机制（“服务知识平台”），将监管机构、贸易官员和利益相关方聚集在一起，讨论服务监管改革。此类机制可确定改革优先事项及利用“贸易援助”资源的机会，从而为未来的市场开放奠定前提条件。第二项建议是针对世贸组织谈判采取新方法，由占服务生产绝大部分的关键国家群体同意锁定现行保护水平，并预先承诺改革影响外国直接投资和个体服务提供者国际流动的政策——这两个领域当前政策限制最为严格，而自由化的潜在收益也最大。如果这些建议无法在多哈回合时间框架内完全实施，那么任何多哈协议至少可为按照上述方向开展前瞻性国际合作计划奠定基础。
url:5691160609b1a2db.title: Services Trade Liberalization and Regulatory Reform: Re-invigorating International Cooperation
url:5691160609b1a2db.title_zh: 服务贸易自由化与监管改革：重振国际合作

url:569bbbfb16f09d0c.abstract: This paper tests the insiders? dilemma hypothesis in a laboratory experiment. The insiders? dilemma means that a profitable merger does not occur, because it is even more profitable for each firm to unilaterally stand as an outsider (Stigler, 1950; Kamien and Zang, 1990 and 1993). The experimental data provides support for the insiders? dilemma, and thereby for endogenous rather than exogenous merger theory. More surprisingly, our data suggests that fairness (or relative performance) considerations also make profitable mergers difficult. Mergers that should occur in equilibrium do not, since they require an unequal split of surplus.
url:569bbbfb16f09d0c.abstract_zh: 本文通过实验室实验检验了内部人困境假说。内部人困境是指一项有利可图的合并未能发生，因为每个企业单方面作为局外人反而能获得更高利润（Stigler, 1950; Kamien and Zang, 1990, 1993）。实验数据支持内部人困境的存在，从而验证了内生性合并理论而非外生性合并理论。更令人意外的是，我们的数据表明，公平性（或相对绩效）考量同样阻碍了有利可图的合并。本应在均衡状态下发生的合并未能实现，原因在于这些合并要求对剩余进行不平等分配。
url:569bbbfb16f09d0c.title: DP5016 The Insiders' Dilemma: An Experiment on Merger Formation
url:569bbbfb16f09d0c.title_zh: DP5016 内部人的困境：合并形成的实验研究

url:56b0d483755e9251.abstract: This paper uses five rounds of Mexican and Brazilian census extracts to evaluate the accuracy of different model specifications and estimation methods that use survey and census data to generate small area estimates of poverty. Models that utilize more granular data for prediction (household- and/or village-level predictors) tend to produce more accurate estimates of poverty than models estimated only using area-level predictors. Differences in accuracy across models and methods that utilize household or village level predictors are minor. Models that omit household-level predictors tend to be more robust than unit-level models to the use of old census data and classical measurement error in survey predictors. The performance of the Fay-Herriot area-level model falls in the presence of sample selection bias and small sample sizes. Rescaling sample weights is important in Mexico, where the sample is informative within areas. Applying raw sample weights without rescaling in this case greatly reduces the accuracy of estimates from linear models and distorts methodological comparisons. Overall, no one approach dominates across all contexts, but when sample weights are rescaled there is no downside to using more granular data for prediction.
url:56b0d483755e9251.abstract_zh: 本文利用墨西哥和巴西五轮人口普查数据，评估了不同模型设定及估计方法（结合调查与普查数据生成贫困小区域估计值）的准确性。相较于仅使用区域层面预测变量的模型，采用更细粒度数据（家庭层面和/或村庄层面预测变量）进行预测的模型往往能生成更准确的贫困估计值。在利用家庭或村庄层面预测变量的模型与方法之间，其准确性差异较小。省略家庭层面预测变量的模型在使用旧普查数据及调查预测变量存在经典测量误差时，通常比单元层面模型更具稳健性。Fay-Herriot区域层面模型在样本选择偏差和小样本量情况下表现下降。在墨西哥，由于样本在区域内具有信息性，重新调整样本权重至关重要。若在此情况下直接使用未经调整的原始样本权重，将大幅降低线性模型估计值的准确性，并扭曲方法比较结果。总体而言，没有任何一种方法在所有情境下均占优，但当样本权重经过重新调整后，使用更细粒度数据进行预测不会产生负面影响。
url:56b0d483755e9251.title: Evaluating Alternative Approaches to Small Area Estimation of Poverty with Survey and Census Data
url:56b0d483755e9251.title_zh: 贫困小区域估计中调查与普查数据替代方法的评估

url:56e04a110d3742cd.abstract: This paper examines the credit supply effects of sale-of-business (SoB) bank resolutions under the post-Global Financial Crisis regulatory framework, focusing on the resolution of a major Spanish bank. We provide the first micro-level evidence of how an SoB resolution reshapes credit allocation. The acquiring bank preserved lending relationships, prioritizing support for riskier inherited borrowers most exposed to competing banks' retrenchment. This stabilization was achieved despite tighter capital conditions, as the acquiring bank strategically reallocated credit within its broader portfolio, shifting away from more capital-intensive exposures.
url:56e04a110d3742cd.abstract_zh: 本文研究了后全球金融危机监管框架下业务出售型银行处置的信贷供给效应，重点关注一家西班牙大型银行的处置案例。我们首次提供了微观层面证据，揭示业务出售型处置如何重塑信贷配置。收购方银行保留了借贷关系，优先支持那些面临其他银行收缩信贷时风险敞口最大的继承借款人。尽管资本条件趋紧，收购方银行仍通过在其更广泛的资产组合中战略性重新配置信贷（减少资本密集型敞口）实现了这一稳定效应。

url:56f44912ef05ce36.abstract: We construct and estimate a small open economy DSGE model featuring a regime-switching reserve requirement (RR) ratio rule within a banking sector that has access to foreign assets. The model incorporates key financial characteristics of the Chinese economy and examines the implications of changes in the RR-ratio. Estimation results reveal that the RR-ratio follows a feedback rule with a regime-dependent coefficient on net foreign lending during two distinct phases between 2006 and 2017. The state-contingent rule is temporarily suspended during the Global Financial Crisis, but is reactivated in the post-crisis period amid recovered capital inflows. On the one hand, the RR-ratio has almost negligible real effects on output and inflation; but on the other hand, it proves effective as a macroprudential instrument by mitigating financial instability through a reduced risk of self-fulfilling bank runs by about 25%.
url:56f44912ef05ce36.abstract_zh: 我们构建并估计了一个小型开放经济DSGE模型，该模型在拥有外国资产的银行部门中引入了带有体制转换特征的法定存款准备金率规则。模型纳入了中国经济的核心金融特征，并考察了法定存款准备金率变动的影响。估计结果显示，在2006年至2017年间的两个不同阶段，法定存款准备金率遵循一个反馈规则，该规则对净外国贷款具有体制依赖系数。这一状态依存的规则在全球金融危机期间被暂时中止，但在危机后随着资本流入恢复而重新激活。一方面，法定存款准备金率对产出和通胀的实际影响几乎可以忽略不计；但另一方面，它作为宏观审慎工具被证明是有效的，通过将自我实现的银行挤兑风险降低约25%，从而缓解了金融不稳定。

url:570e5a60fbce256b.abstract: We find that whether US import tariffs have supply-side effects or demand-side effects on US manufacturing sectors depends on where the affected sectors are located in the US production network. Using local projections in a panel of US manufacturing sectors, we find that US import tariffs —including the 2018-19 tariff hikes— led to sectoral output contractions via two different channels: (1) Tariff increases act as negative supply shifters for sectors that use goods from tariff-facing sectors as input in production and thus face rising input costs. (2) Tariff increases act as negative demand shifters for sectors whose customer sectors suffer negative supply side effects due to tariffs and reduce their production. We show that these results are consistent with a stylized production network model featuring complementarities in production. Overall, our finding suggests that tariffs markedly reduce US manufacturing production and that the role of input–output linkages is key for understanding the transmission of import tariff shocks to output and producer prices. JEL Classification: E23, E32, F13
url:570e5a60fbce256b.abstract_zh: 我们发现，美国进口关税对美国制造业部门的影响究竟是供给侧效应还是需求侧效应，取决于受影响部门在美国生产网络中的位置。基于美国制造业部门面板数据的局部投影法分析表明，美国进口关税（包括2018-2019年的关税上调）通过两种不同渠道导致部门产出收缩：（1）关税上调对使用受关税影响部门产品作为生产投入的部门构成负向供给冲击，使其面临投入成本上升；（2）关税上调对客户部门因关税遭受负向供给冲击而缩减生产的部门构成负向需求冲击。我们证明，这些结果与一个包含生产互补性的简化生产网络模型一致。总体而言，我们的发现表明关税显著抑制了美国制造业产出，而投入产出关联在理解进口关税冲击向产出和生产者价格传导的过程中起着关键作用。JEL分类号：E23, E32, F13

url:5760386a48924f2c.abstract: Standard economic rationale suggests that an enhancement of conflict-effort efficiency or sabotage efficiency in contests, benefits the player who is experiencing the improvement. This paper presents a model of sabotage in the context of attacker-defender contest with ‘gun’ and ‘butter’ (as posited by Chowdhury and Topolyan in 2026). We observe a strikingly counter-intuitive outcome – any increase in sabotage efficiency is counter-productive (even for the player experiencing the increase) in terms of equilibrium payoffs. The channel through which the result holds for both players (the attacker and the defender) is the shrinking size of the defender’s ‘butter’ when sabotage efficiency (of either player) increases. The paper also contradicts the findings of Chung in 2024 and Glökler, Pull and Stadler in 2022 who claim that endogenization of the prize alleviates or eliminates sabotage.
url:5760386a48924f2c.abstract_zh: 标准经济理论认为，在竞赛中提升冲突努力效率或破坏效率，将使效率提升的一方获益。本文基于Chowdhury与Topolyan（2026）提出的"枪炮与黄油"攻防竞赛框架，构建了破坏行为模型。我们观察到一种显著反直觉的结果——任何破坏效率的提升（即使对效率提升方而言）在均衡收益层面都会适得其反。该结论对攻防双方均成立的作用机制在于：当任意一方的破坏效率提升时，防御方的"黄油"规模会相应缩减。本文同时反驳了Chung（2024）以及Glökler、Pull与Stadler（2022）的研究结论——后者主张将奖品内生化可缓解或消除破坏行为。

url:5784e5a3bc7b1387.abstract: In sub-Saharan Africa, women constitute the majority of new Christian membership (including Evangelical and Pentecostal denominations), and this gender gap exceeds that of any other religion. Existing explanations for conversion to these churches emphasize demand for mutual help or informal insurance. We instead show that emancipation is central: these churches provide services that support women's economic advancement and help them challenge patriarchal norms. Using experimental data from Benin, we find that women randomly offered an economic opportunity become more likely to convert, partly because these churches help counter witchcraft threats, a risk that disproportionately targets economically successful women. To assess external validity, we combine large African datasets with local variation in exposure to positive economic shocks - using exogenous changes in cash crop prices and the implementation of world bank projects with a gender focus. Women are more likely to join new Christian churches following such shocks, especially where witchcraft beliefs are widespread. There, women work more, have fewer children, and exercise greater decisionâ€‘making power, while both women and men reject traditional beliefs, rituals, and authorities.
url:5784e5a3bc7b1387.abstract_zh: 在撒哈拉以南非洲，女性构成了新兴基督教教会（包括福音派和五旬节派）新信徒的主体，这一性别差距超过任何其他宗教。现有对改信这些教会的解释强调对互助或非正式保险的需求。然而，我们证明解放是核心因素：这些教会提供支持女性经济进步并帮助她们挑战父权规范的服务。利用贝宁的实验数据，我们发现，随机获得经济机会的女性更可能改信，部分原因在于这些教会帮助对抗巫术威胁——这种风险不成比例地针对经济成功的女性。为评估外部有效性，我们将大型非洲数据集与正向经济冲击的局部暴露变化相结合——利用经济作物价格的外生变化以及以性别为重点的世界银行项目的实施。女性在经历此类冲击后更可能加入新兴基督教教会，尤其是在巫术信仰普遍的地区。在那里，女性工作更多、生育更少、拥有更大的决策权，同时女性和男性都摒弃传统信仰、仪式和权威。

url:57b20585e5b53a70.abstract: We study the role of heterogenous preferences at the spousal level and that of spousal mutual insurance against wage shocks for couples’ labor supply in a time-use model. We estimate the model for couples in the German Time-Use Survey with Bayesian techniques and generate gender-specific wage-elasticities of market hours in the cross-section and for all couples. Missing mutual insurance ignores males’ behavior which we find to be substantial. Together with preference heterogeneity it shapes the elasticities’ size and distribution, especially for high and low hours worked and wage groups. Our setting is suitable to analyze nonlinear and distributional economic policy.
url:57b20585e5b53a70.abstract_zh: 本文在时间利用模型中研究了配偶层面异质性偏好以及配偶间工资冲击相互保险对夫妻劳动供给的作用。我们采用贝叶斯方法，基于德国时间利用调查数据对模型进行估计，并生成了截面层面及所有夫妻的性别特异性市场工时工资弹性。缺失相互保险会忽略男性的行为，而我们的研究发现这种行为影响显著。与偏好异质性共同作用，这种缺失塑造了弹性的大小与分布，尤其在高、低工时及工资群体中表现突出。我们的研究框架适用于分析非线性及分布性经济政策。

url:58892f9ed223df29.abstract: This paper evaluates the unintended consequences of China's 2021 "Double Reduction" policy, which aimed to ease students' academic burden by limiting homework and private tutoring. Using a tailored household survey, a constructed policy enforcement index, and a difference-in-differences design, we find that the policy increased private tutoring enrollment, household tutoring expenditures, and parental time spent on helping children with schoolwork. These effects disproportionately harmed low-income families, resulting in worse academic outcomes. Our findings suggest that the policy's effects run counter to its intended goals and may exacerbate educational inequality.
url:58892f9ed223df29.abstract_zh: 本文评估了中国2021年“双减”政策的非预期后果，该政策旨在通过限制作业和校外培训来减轻学生学业负担。利用定制化家庭调查、构建的政策执行指数以及双重差分设计，我们发现该政策增加了校外培训参与率、家庭培训支出以及家长辅导孩子功课的时间投入。这些效应不成比例地损害了低收入家庭，导致其学业表现恶化。研究结果表明，该政策的实际效果与其预期目标背道而驰，并可能加剧教育不平等。

url:591c961f03875574.abstract: This paper examines how forced displacement shapes child development beyond socioeconomic disadvantage. The paper uses original data on roughly 1,600 Venezuelan refugees, Colombian internally displaced individuals, and nondisplaced children in Medellín, Colombia. The analysis adapts rank-rank regressions from the intergenerational mobility literature to a forced displacement setting, ranking each child’s developmental outcomes against household wealth. The paper documents substantial gaps that persist after holding wealth and parental background fixed. It also shows that the cause of displacement shapes the nature of the gaps. Venezuelan refugees displaced by acute material deprivation fall 19 and 13 rank points behind in cognitive and physical development, respectively. Colombian children displaced by armed conflict fall 12 rank points behind in depression and exhibit elevated trauma. Access to regularization and social services is associated with narrower gaps.
url:591c961f03875574.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了被迫流离失所如何超越社会经济劣势影响儿童发展。研究基于哥伦比亚麦德林约1600名委内瑞拉难民、哥伦比亚国内流离失所者及非流离失所儿童的一手数据。分析将代际流动性文献中的排名-排名回归方法适配至被迫流离失所情境，依据家庭财富对每位儿童的发展成果进行排序。研究发现，在控制财富与父母背景后，发展差距依然显著存在。同时，流离失所的成因决定了差距的性质：因严重物质匮乏而流离失所的委内瑞拉难民儿童，其认知与身体发展分别落后19个和13个排名位次；因武装冲突而流离失所的哥伦比亚儿童，其抑郁指标落后12个排名位次，并表现出更高的创伤水平。获得合法身份与社会服务与缩小发展差距存在关联。

url:5956ee12f4322842.abstract: 미·중 간 기술 패권 경쟁이 지속되면서 미국 등 주요국은 핵심 과학기술 분야에서 자국 기술과 산업을 보호·육성하기 위한 전략을 강화하고 있다. 각국 정부는 연구개발 투자를 확대하는 동시에 기술 보호 및 육성을 위한 법·제도적 기반을 정비하고 있으며, 기술 경쟁력 확보뿐만 아니라 국가 안보와 산업 생태계 강화를 목표로 하고 있다. 주요 선진국들은 핵심 기술 분야의 발전을 지원하면서 불필요한 규제를 완화하고, 기술 보호를 위한 새로운 규제를 도입하는 등 정교한 정책 설계를 시도하고 있다. 이러한 규제 혁신 전략을 분석함으로써 선진국의 과학기술 발전 전략과 혁신 생태계 조성 방식, 산업 발전을 위한 정책적 접근법을 비교·분석할 필요가 있다. 본 연구에서는 기존 연구에서 다루지 않았던 과학기술 분야별 규제 혁신 전략들에 대한 다면적 분석을 통해 빠른 속도로 변하고 있는 과학기술 분야 미래 규제 환경에 대한 우리의 효과적 대응 전략을 제시한다. As the competition for technological hegemony intensifies between the U.S. and China, major advanced countries around the world, including the U.S., are increasingly strengthening their strategies to protect and foster their technologies and industries in core science and technology fields. The governments of individual countries are expanding R&D investment, reorganizing legal and institutional foundations for technology protection and fostering, and aiming to strengthen national security and industrial ecosystems as well as securing technological competitiveness.
url:5956ee12f4322842.abstract_zh: 随着美中之间技术霸权竞争的持续，美国等主要国家正加强在核心科学技术领域保护和培育本国技术与产业的战略。各国政府在扩大研发投资的同时，也在完善技术保护与培育的法律制度基础，其目标不仅在于确保技术竞争力，还在于强化国家安全与产业生态系统。主要发达国家在支持核心技术领域发展的同时，正尝试通过放宽不必要的监管、引入新的技术保护监管等精细化的政策设计。通过分析这些监管创新战略，有必要对发达国家的科技发展战略、创新生态构建方式以及促进产业发展的政策路径进行比较分析。本研究通过对现有研究尚未涉及的科技领域监管创新战略进行多维度分析，为快速变化的科技领域未来监管环境提出有效的应对策略。

url:59cc7ebc9f2bd4ab.abstract: This paper investigates the relationship between intergenerational social mobility, migration aspirations, and participation in political demonstrations. Using individual-level data from the Latinobarómetro between 2002 and 2023, we show that individuals experiencing negative intergenerational educational mobility are more likely to express a desire to migrate and to participate into peaceful protests, whereas those with positive mobility exhibit the opposite pattern. Our analysis further suggests that the decision to migrate and to protest may be shaped by a common underlying decision process. Finally, we find that confidence in political institutions and positive economic expectations substantially mitigate expressions of social discontent in the form of migration aspirations and protest participation. Overall, the results indicate that unequal opportunities across generations are an important determinant of both migration intentions and political engagement.
url:59cc7ebc9f2bd4ab.abstract_zh: 本文研究了代际社会流动、移民意愿与政治示威参与之间的关系。利用2002年至2023年间拉丁美洲晴雨表的个体层面数据，我们发现，经历负向代际教育流动的个体更可能表达移民意愿并参与和平抗议，而经历正向代际教育流动的个体则呈现相反模式。进一步分析表明，移民与抗议决策可能受共同潜在决策过程的影响。最后，研究发现对政治体制的信心与积极的经济预期能够显著缓解以移民意愿和抗议参与形式表现的社会不满情绪。总体而言，研究结果表明代际机会不平等是移民意向与政治参与的重要决定因素。

url:5a36856a1d075019.abstract: Food loss is a significant source of economic inefficiency in value chains. In many developing countries, including Nigeria, a majority of fruits, vegetables, and other perishable foods are lost after harvest, due in large part to inadequate postharvest handling or low adoption of post-harvest management technologies, particularly cooling technologies such as temperature-controlled transportation and cold storage. To examine the economic impacts of cool transportation connecting vegetable-producing states in northeast Nigeria to large demand centers in Nigeria’s southern regions, we introduced a randomized controlled trial. Cool transportation was found to have a large and statistically significant impact: sales price, revenues, and profits increased substantially for the origin-state marketers. A larger portion of sales price increase at the destination market is attributed to refrigeration, that is, quality preservation through cooling. About 66 percent of this increase comes from cooling, with an additional 34 percent from transportation. An information experiment further showed that improved quality information through labelling that identifies the origin of the produce creates price premiums at the destination market. This implies that significant economic gains can be generated not only from narrowing supply–demand gaps in different markets but also, potentially, through mitigating spatial asymmetric information.
url:5a36856a1d075019.abstract_zh: 食物损失是价值链中经济效率低下的重要来源。在包括尼日利亚在内的许多发展中国家，大部分水果、蔬菜及其他易腐食品在收获后发生损失，其主要原因在于采后处理不当或采后管理技术（尤其是温控运输和冷藏等冷却技术）的采用率较低。为考察连接尼日利亚东北部蔬菜生产州与南部地区大型需求中心的冷链运输的经济影响，我们开展了一项随机对照试验。研究发现，冷链运输具有显著且统计意义重大的影响：原产地销售商的销售价格、收入和利润均大幅提升。目的地市场销售价格的上涨中，更大比例归因于冷藏（即通过冷却保持品质），其中约66%的涨幅来自冷却，另外34%来自运输。一项信息实验进一步表明，通过标注产地信息的标签传递品质改善信号，可在目的地市场产生价格溢价。这意味着，不仅缩小不同市场的供需缺口能带来显著经济收益，缓解空间信息不对称同样具有潜在的经济效益。
url:5a36856a1d075019.title: Spatial disparity, information, and the economics of cool transportation: Insights from a randomized controlled trial in Nigeria
url:5a36856a1d075019.title_zh: 空间差异、信息与酷交通经济学：来自尼日利亚随机对照试验的启示

url:5a45cbc0b84c1773.abstract: Egypt's demographic trajectory has shifted markedly over recent decades, with fertility declines in the 1980s and 1990s followed by a reversal that peaked at 3.5 children per woman in 2014. While previous research has examined determinants such as women's employment, contraceptive use, and migration, the role of housing policy remains largely unexplored. This study investigates the impact of Egypt's 1996 rental market liberalization on fertility. Using four waves of the Egypt Labor Market Panel Survey (ELMPS) combined with district-level housing data from the 2006 Census, we exploit geographic and temporal variation in exposure to the reform. We examine whether women of marriageable age in 1996 living in districts with greater availability of liberalized rental units experienced different fertility outcomes. Results show that exposure to the reform increased the likelihood of childbearing and positively affected other fertility measures, including age at first birth and parity at ages 25, 30, and 35. Evidence suggests that earlier marriage is the main mechanism, consistent with the reform lowering housing constraints for young couples.
url:5a45cbc0b84c1773.abstract_zh: 近几十年来，埃及的人口结构轨迹发生了显著变化：20世纪80年代至90年代生育率下降后出现逆转，于2014年达到每名妇女生育3.5个子女的峰值。尽管已有研究探讨了女性就业、避孕措施使用及人口迁移等影响因素，但住房政策的作用仍鲜有涉及。本研究考察了埃及1996年租赁市场自由化对生育率的影响。通过运用四轮埃及劳动力市场面板调查数据，结合2006年人口普查中的地区级住房数据，我们利用改革暴露程度的地理与时间差异进行分析。研究检验了1996年处于婚育年龄的女性中，居住在自由化租赁住房供应更充足地区的群体是否呈现不同的生育结果。结果表明，改革暴露程度提高了生育可能性，并对其他生育指标产生正向影响，包括初育年龄及25岁、30岁、35岁时的生育数量。证据表明，早婚是主要作用机制，这与改革降低了年轻夫妇住房约束的结论一致。
url:5a45cbc0b84c1773.title: Housing Policy and Fertility Behavior in Egypt: Evidence from the 1996 Rental Liberalization

url:5b561b132f832db9.abstract: Focus The extent to which exchange rate changes affect consumer prices typically varies a lot between countries and time periods. url:5b56eafd861bc3e2.abstract: This study analyzes the fresh produce market in Papua New Guinea (PNG) using unique market flow and price data collected by the Fresh Produce Development Agency (FPDA) over the past 15 years across multiple markets. We document substantial flows of fresh produce from diverse production zones to major urban centers, with Port Moresby emerging as the primary terminal market. Hard fresh produce and sweet potato supplied there largely originate from the Highlands, while other staples and soft fresh produce are mostly sourced from other regions. Price analysis reveals four key patterns: (i) fresh produce prices have risen significantly relative to non-food products, particularly for items less supplied by the Highlands; (ii) prices exhibit strong seasonality—lowest at year-end and highest mid-year (June–August)—reflecting major cultivation periods and possibly seasonality in household labor availability; (iii) marketing margins have increased substantially, especially for soft fresh produce, creating new opportunities for Highland producers to compete in Port Moresby markets; and (iv) in 2023–2025, marketing and wastage costs accounted for the largest share of retail prices in Port Moresby—up to 85 percent for cabbage—while producer shares ranged from 15 percent for cabbage to 61 percent for Irish potatoes. These findings underscore evolving market dynamics and the critical role of supply chain efficiency in PNG’s fresh produce sector.
url:5b56eafd861bc3e2.abstract_zh: 本研究利用巴布亚新几内亚（PNG）新鲜农产品发展局（FPDA）过去15年间在多个市场收集的独特市场流量与价格数据，对该国新鲜农产品市场进行了分析。我们记录了从不同生产区域流向主要城市中心的大量新鲜农产品流动情况，其中莫尔兹比港成为主要的终端市场。该市场供应的硬质新鲜农产品和甘薯主要来自高地地区，而其他主食和软质新鲜农产品则大多来自其他区域。价格分析揭示了四个关键特征：（i）新鲜农产品价格相对于非食品产品显著上涨，尤其是高地地区供应较少的品种；（ii）价格呈现强烈的季节性波动——年末最低，年中（6月至8月）最高——这反映了主要种植周期，并可能与家庭劳动力可用性的季节性变化有关；（iii）营销利润率大幅上升，尤其是软质新鲜农产品，为高地生产者在莫尔兹比港市场竞争创造了新机遇；（iv）在2023至2025年间，营销与损耗成本占莫尔兹比港零售价格的最大份额——卷心菜高达85%——而生产者份额则从卷心菜的15%到爱尔兰土豆的61%不等。这些发现凸显了市场动态的演变以及供应链效率在巴布亚新几内亚新鲜农产品行业中的关键作用。

url:5bb0a09f27398abc.abstract: The United States and China put parts of the global economy at risk in 2025 through their trade war over critical minerals and technology. A series of escalatory tariffs and export restrictions led to shortages of essential inputs, nearly forcing automakers worldwide to shut down production. The costly policies reflected uncoordinated and uncommunicated efforts by both countries to reduce their mutual economic dependence. This paper explores a novel path for the United States and China to "cooperate" over how they reduce their dependence on each other in technology and critical minerals, with the aim of limiting future escalation risks and avoiding unnecessary costs. The proposal draws on a version of the reciprocal approach to negotiations developed under the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade, modified to accommodate a mutual reduction in each country's market dominance in key sectors.
url:5bb0a09f27398abc.abstract_zh: 2025年，美国与中国围绕关键矿产和技术的贸易战使全球经济面临风险。一系列不断升级的关税和出口限制导致关键投入品短缺，几乎迫使全球汽车制造商停产。这些代价高昂的政策反映了两国在减少相互经济依赖方面缺乏协调与沟通的努力。本文探索了一条美中两国在技术和关键矿产领域“合作”减少相互依赖的新路径，旨在限制未来升级风险并避免不必要的成本。该提议借鉴了《关税与贸易总协定》框架下发展出的互惠谈判方式，并加以调整，以适应两国在关键领域市场主导地位的共同削减。

url:5bc5d3dbaee8161b.abstract: Moral regulation is widespread across societies, yet its consequences have seldom been examined empirically. We study the Hays Code (July 1934-1960s), which imposed systematic moral guidelines on American cinema. Using a regression-discontinuity design, with non-U.S. films providing a comparison group, we find that the moral compliance of U.S. films rose sharply after 1935 and remained high for two decades. The Code also reshaped protagonists and political tone: protagonists became less likely to be women or working class, and political tones grew more conservative. Filmmakers adapted both by increasing compliance within genres and by shifting across them: less-compliant Drama declined while more-compliant Western and Action rose. Companies with a larger market size and immigrant film directors exhibited stronger responses. These findings reveal how moral constraint, market, and identity jointly shape cultural production and how well-intentioned moral regulation can produce broad and often unintended spillovers.
url:5bc5d3dbaee8161b.abstract_zh: 道德规范在社会中普遍存在，但其后果鲜少得到实证研究。本文以《海斯法典》（1934年7月至20世纪60年代）为研究对象，该法典对美国电影施加了系统性的道德准则。通过采用断点回归设计，并以非美国电影作为对照组，我们发现美国电影的道德合规性在1935年后急剧上升，并持续保持高位长达二十年。该法典还重塑了主角形象与政治基调：主角中女性及工人阶级的比例显著下降，政治基调趋于保守。电影制作人通过两种方式适应这一变化：既在类型片内部提升合规性，又进行类型片之间的转移——合规性较低的剧情片产量下降，而合规性较高的西部片与动作片产量上升。市场份额较大的电影公司及移民导演表现出更强的应对反应。这些发现揭示了道德约束、市场与身份认同如何共同塑造文化生产，以及出于善意的道德规范如何产生广泛且往往非预期的溢出效应。
url:5bc5d3dbaee8161b.title: Moral Regulation and Cultural Production: Evidence from Hollywood
url:5bc5d3dbaee8161b.title_zh: 道德规制与文化生产：来自好莱坞的证据

url:5bc8e90fe69a7711.abstract: Can monetary incentives improve health behaviors in the long run, and do commonly used surrogate outcomes capture these effects? We study these questions in the context of vaccination using a large-scale eld experiment. The experiment combines commonly used surrogates|vaccination intentions, intermediate behavioral proxies, and short-run vaccination|with long-run administrative vaccination records. We first document that incentives increase vaccination rates in the long run: guaranteed $20 incentives raise COVID-19 booster uptake by 9 percentage points. Lottery-based incentives also increase long-run uptake, while prosocial incentives primarily accelerate vaccination. Second, using surrogacy methods, we study whether surrogates can predict long-run impacts. Although the surrogates are strongly correlated with eventual vaccination, the assumptions required for surrogacy methods are often violated, and they do not accurately predict long-run impacts. Our ndings highlight both the ability of incentives to change behavior and the importance of measuring long-run outcomes rather than relying solely on surrogates.
url:5bc8e90fe69a7711.abstract_zh: 货币激励能否长期改善健康行为？常用的替代指标能否捕捉这些效应？我们通过一项大规模实地实验，以疫苗接种为背景研究上述问题。该实验将常用替代指标（疫苗接种意愿、中间行为代理变量及短期疫苗接种）与长期行政疫苗接种记录相结合。首先，我们证实激励措施能长期提升疫苗接种率：20美元保证性激励使新冠加强针接种率提高9个百分点。基于抽奖的激励同样能提升长期接种率，而亲社会激励主要加速疫苗接种进程。其次，通过替代指标方法，我们检验替代指标能否预测长期影响。尽管替代指标与最终疫苗接种存在强相关性，但替代指标方法所需假设常被违反，且无法准确预测长期影响。研究结果既凸显了激励措施改变行为的能力，也揭示了测量长期结果而非仅依赖替代指标的重要性。
url:5bc8e90fe69a7711.title: Incentives, Surrogates, and Long-run Vaccination
url:5bc8e90fe69a7711.title_zh: 激励、替代指标与长期疫苗接种

url:5bd5b3391be2b64e.abstract: We document how foreign firms, inputs, and subsidies have shaped the development of Viet Nam's solar panel industry. We use firm-to-firm transaction data from Panjiva as well as firm-level data from the Vietnamese Enterprise Survey to trace solar panel value chains. We uncover three key findings: First, parts and components from subsidizing countries are 30% cheaper than alternatives. Those from China, which provides the majority of solar inputs to Vietnamese producers, are cheapest. Foreign subsidies may thus spill over across countries via value chains. Second, Chinese FDI firms dominate Viet Nam's solar industry, accounting for 75% of exports and 50% of jobs, while exporting solar panels that are 38% cheaper than those of other producers in Viet Nam. Third, local firms supplying parts and components to these Chinese FDI firms experience positive productivity gains. Our findings show how Viet Nam's solar boom emerged through deep integration into China's subsidized supply chains.
url:5bd5b3391be2b64e.abstract_zh: 本文揭示了外资企业、中间投入品及补贴如何塑造了越南太阳能光伏产业的发展格局。我们利用Panjiva的企业间交易数据以及越南企业调查的企业层面数据，追溯了太阳能光伏价值链的演变。研究得出三项核心发现：第一，来自补贴国的零部件价格比替代品低30%，而来自中国（越南太阳能投入品的主要供应国）的零部件价格最低。这表明外国补贴可能通过价值链产生跨国溢出效应。第二，中国外商直接投资企业在越南太阳能产业中占据主导地位，贡献了75%的出口额和50%的就业岗位，其出口的太阳能电池板价格比越南其他生产商低38%。第三，向这些中国外商直接投资企业供应零部件的本土企业实现了正向生产率提升。研究结论表明，越南太阳能产业的繁荣是通过深度融入中国补贴供应链实现的。

url:5c268c9b96d623d2.abstract: Evaluating optimized AI systems for asset pricing is fundamentally difficult for two reasons. First, models are trained on all data, implying that any backtest or analysis using historical data suffers from look-ahead bias. In addition, markets are reflexive — as investors adopt AI, prices adjust — which may erode the very patterns the AI system was trained to exploit. We introduce a real-time, out-of-sample benchmark designed to sidestep both problems. The benchmark measures how well AI systems can explain contemporaneous stock returns around earnings announcements using only information available at announcement time, including the text of the announcement itself. Applying this benchmark to a range of agentic AI systems — which extract structured signals from earnings call transcripts and optimize over those signals — we find that the best-optimized systems more than double the explained variation in returns relative to standard benchmarks (R2 increasing from 8% to close to 20%). We show that AI-based optimization can deliver efficiency gains relative to traditional machine learning methods while also improving interpretability as our approach produces human-readable economic mechanisms that explain price movements. These learned rules can be compared to the drivers of realized returns in existing asset pricing models to identify missing sources of variation in a data-driven, self-evolving way that integrates empirical learning with economic structure. We release an SDK for researchers to improve on our results. Saturating this benchmark would represent fundamental progress in understanding how capital markets process firm-level information.
url:5c268c9b96d623d2.abstract_zh: 评估针对资产定价优化的AI系统存在两个根本性困难。首先，模型基于全部数据训练，这意味着任何使用历史数据的回测或分析都存在前瞻性偏差。其次，市场具有反身性——随着投资者采用AI技术，价格会相应调整——这可能导致AI系统原本训练利用的模式逐渐消失。我们引入了一个实时、样本外的基准测试，旨在规避这两个问题。该基准测试衡量AI系统仅利用公告发布时可获取的信息（包括公告文本本身）来解释盈余公告期间同期股票收益的能力。将该基准应用于一系列智能体AI系统（这些系统从财报电话会议记录中提取结构化信号并对其进行优化），我们发现最优化的系统相较于标准基准，其解释的收益变异程度提升了一倍以上（R²从8%提升至接近20%）。研究表明，基于AI的优化相较于传统机器学习方法能带来效率提升，同时增强可解释性——我们的方法可生成解释价格变动的人类可读经济机制。这些学习到的规则可与现有资产定价模型中实际收益的驱动因素进行对比，以数据驱动、自我演进的方式识别缺失的变异来源，实现经验学习与经济结构的融合。我们发布了SDK供研究者改进我们的结果。饱和该基准测试将标志着理解资本市场如何处理公司层面信息的根本性进展。

url:5c3950b814268286.abstract: This paper shows that expected capital gains in several MSAs were higher for relatively lower-priced, rather than higher-priced, houses during the U.S. boom of the 2000s. Because buyers of lower-priced houses tend to be more sensitive to credit conditions than buyers of higher-priced houses, this paper documents patterns that are consistent with an interaction of beliefs and credit conditions in a time period where direct evidence on house price beliefs is scarce. Documenting this interaction is important for unifying beliefs and credit conditions as joint, instead of competing, explanations for the U.S. housing boom of the 2000s.
url:5c3950b814268286.abstract_zh: 本文表明，在2000年代美国房地产繁荣期间，多个大都市统计区（MSAs）中，相对低价房屋的预期资本收益高于高价房屋。由于低价房屋的购房者往往比高价房屋的购房者对信贷条件更为敏感，本文记录的模式与信念和信贷条件在房价信念直接证据稀缺时期的相互作用一致。记录这种相互作用对于将信念和信贷条件作为共同而非竞争性解释因素来统一说明2000年代美国房地产繁荣具有重要意义。

url:5c48ceab98af2ef2.abstract: We find consistent evidence across ratings and regions that delta-hedged credit index options have large negative Sharpe ratios and much more so than their equity index counterparts. Risk-factors extracted from equity index options have only moderate explanatory power for the time-series and cross-sectional variation in credit option returns, while a single credit-specific factor explains much of the remaining variation. We link this factor to credit option order flow in a manner that is consistent with the predictions of a demand-based option pricing model, where order-flow risk is priced in equilibrium.
url:5c48ceab98af2ef2.abstract_zh: 我们通过评级和地区的一致证据发现，Delta对冲的信用指数期权具有较大的负夏普比率，且其负值程度远超股票指数期权。从股票指数期权中提取的风险因子对信用期权收益的时间序列和截面变化的解释力有限，而一个单一的信用特定因子则解释了剩余的大部分变化。我们将该因子与信用期权订单流联系起来，这一关联符合基于需求的期权定价模型的预测，在该模型中，订单流风险在均衡状态下被定价。

url:5c97f8dd3cf61e07.abstract: This paper examines whether mobile money reduces gender gaps in financial autonomy across six Sahelian countries using Afrobarometer Round 9 data (2021-2023, N=6, 540). Instrumenting adoption with distance to traditional financial services, we find pronounced heterogeneity: mobile money increases women's autonomy by 11 percentage points in Senegal (26% gap reduction) and 16 points in Sudan (38% reduction), with no detectable effects in four other countries. This variation correlates with ecosystem maturity, agent density, and regulatory quality. Mechanisms include transactional discretion, informal credit access, and enhanced security. Transformative impacts require 10-14 years ecosystem maturation and agent density above 1 per 2, 000 inhabitants. Digital finance advances women's empowerment only under specific institutional conditions.
url:5c97f8dd3cf61e07.abstract_zh: 本文利用非洲晴雨表第9轮数据（2021-2023年，样本量N=6,540），考察移动货币是否缩小了萨赫勒地区六国女性金融自主权的性别差距。通过以距离传统金融服务的远近作为移动货币采纳的工具变量，我们发现显著的异质性：移动货币使塞内加尔女性金融自主权提升11个百分点（性别差距缩小26%），苏丹提升16个百分点（性别差距缩小38%），而在其他四个国家未观察到显著影响。这种差异与生态系统成熟度、代理网点密度及监管质量相关。其作用机制包括交易自主权、非正规信贷获取及安全性提升。变革性影响需10-14年生态系统成熟期，且代理网点密度需达到每2000名居民至少1个。数字金融仅在特定制度条件下才能促进女性赋权。

url:5cc28f4442e6fa98.abstract: Investors reward reform progress. Econometric results suggest that holistic reforms, fiscal spending discipline, and monetary policy credibility are associated with a tightening of Qatar’s external sovereign credit spreads. In particular, investors may view fiscal spending discipline as an integral part of Qatar’s holistic reform and economic diversification. Greater broad-based reform progress also boosts the resilience of sovereign credit spreads to external shocks. The findings support fiscal and monetary policy reforms as part of the broader reform agenda in a holistic manner, as planned under the Third National Development Strategy.
url:5cc28f4442e6fa98.abstract_zh: 投资者对改革进展给予回报。计量经济学结果表明，整体性改革、财政支出纪律和货币政策可信度与卡塔尔外部主权信用利差的收紧相关。特别是，投资者可能将财政支出纪律视为卡塔尔整体改革和经济多元化不可或缺的一部分。更广泛的全面改革进展也增强了主权信用利差抵御外部冲击的韧性。这些发现支持将财政和货币政策改革作为更广泛改革议程的一部分，以整体方式推进，正如第三国家发展战略所规划的那样。

url:5ccbecd72d645250.abstract: This paper studies the environmental effects of the large-scale deployment of AI-driven monitoring systems across French wastewater treatment plants operated by a global leader in water supply services. Exploiting quasi-experimental variation in both the timing of adoption and outages thanks to high-frequency data, we estimate the causal impact of AI on energy use and carbon emissions. We find that AI has allowed treated plants to reduce their electricity consumption and carbon emissions by 5.4% and 6% respectively, and electricity costs by 8.2%, resulting in negative abatement costs, and still improved water effluent quality. The additional electricity demand generated by AI servers represents less than 1% of these savings. Beyond average effects, AI-equipped plants exhibit greater resilience to high operational stress, including extreme meteorological events and chemical pollutant peaks. They also improve load management by reallocating consumption from peak toward off-peak hours. Finally, we assess the aggregate implications of our findings for global climate and welfare using the DICE model. We find large estimated global welfare gains associated with our estimate of AI-induced CO2 reductions.
url:5ccbecd72d645250.abstract_zh: 本文研究了由全球水务服务领导者运营的法国污水处理厂大规模部署人工智能驱动监控系统的环境效应。利用高频数据中采纳时机与系统故障的准实验变异，我们估计了人工智能对能源使用和碳排放的因果影响。研究发现，人工智能使受处理工厂的电力消耗和碳排放分别降低了5.4%和6%，电力成本下降了8.2%，实现了负减排成本，同时改善了出水水质。人工智能服务器产生的额外电力需求仅占这些节约量的不到1%。除平均效应外，配备人工智能的工厂在极端气象事件和化学污染物峰值等高运营压力下展现出更强的韧性，并通过将用电从高峰时段重新分配至非高峰时段改善了负荷管理。最后，我们利用DICE模型评估了研究结果对全球气候和福利的总体影响，发现人工智能带来的二氧化碳减排估计值对应着巨大的全球福利增益。

url:5d3b933f2e416eeb.abstract: Free trade in audio-visual services has faced opposition on the grounds that foreign media undermine domestic culture, and ultimately, global diversity. We assess the media-culture link using name frequencies as a measure of tastes. Using a 47-year panel of French birth registries, we first show that names appearing on television shows, movies, or in songs are about five times more popular than other names. Most, but not all, of this relationship arises from endogeneity: song and script writers, as well as performers and their parents, select names that would be popular anyways. Using name attributes, fixed effects, and lagged popularity as controls, our regression results suggest that media affect choices by informing parents of unfamiliar names.
url:5d3b933f2e416eeb.abstract_zh: 视听服务自由贸易面临反对，理由在于外国媒体会侵蚀本土文化，并最终损害全球文化多样性。我们以名字使用频率作为文化品味的衡量指标，评估媒体与文化之间的关联。基于法国出生登记系统47年的面板数据，我们首先发现：出现在电视节目、电影或歌曲中的名字，其流行度约为其他名字的五倍。这种关联大部分（但非全部）源于内生性：歌曲和剧本作者、表演者及其父母会优先选择本就可能流行的名字。通过控制名字属性、固定效应及滞后流行度变量，回归结果表明：媒体通过向父母传递不熟悉的名字信息，从而影响其选择。

url:5d596bcb0673cda5.abstract: Standard welfare evaluations of means-tested transfers typically treat eligibility enforcement as affecting only households directly exposed to the rule. We show that this direct-only approach is incomplete when enforcement events transmit information through workplace networks, inducing other beneficiaries to adjust formal employment and reported earnings. We study Uruguay's AFAM-PE conditional cash transfer, in which household income eligibility is verified monthly using administrative records of formal earnings and households exceeding the threshold may lose benefits, while most beneficiaries are largely unaware of the income rule. Linking program records, social security employment histories, and firm identifiers, we build workplace networks defined six months before each peer's exposure to enforcement and identify spillovers using a fuzzy regression discontinuity design that exploits quasi-random variation in whether a peer crosses the income threshold. Coworkers of peers just above the cutoff reduce registered labor earnings by 20%, and the corresponding fuzzy-RD estimate implies a decline of about one-third of baseline earnings in response to a peer's suspension. These effects emerge within two months and persist for at least 12 months. The response operates almost entirely on the extensive margin of formal employment, and most of the decline reflects transitions to informal work rather than exit from the labor force. Spillovers are concentrated in small firms and among similar coworkers, are nearly three times larger when the suspended peer actively contacted the program's support service, and are absent among non-beneficiary coworkers. This pattern is consistent with information transmission as the main channel. Incorporating these indirect responses lowers the estimated MVPF of the program as implemented with enforcement from 0.53 to 0.36. Because the same information channel operates wherever means-tested programs are enforced through records of formal earnings, evaluations that count only directly exposed households systematically understate the cost of enforcement.
url:5d596bcb0673cda5.abstract_zh: 对家计调查型转移支付的福利评估通常将资格核查视为仅影响直接受规则约束的家庭。我们证明，当核查事件通过工作场所网络传递信息，促使其他受益人调整正规就业和申报收入时，这种仅关注直接影响的评估方法是不完整的。本研究以乌拉圭AFAM-PE有条件现金转移项目为对象，该项目每月通过行政记录核实家庭收入资格，超出阈值的家庭可能失去福利，但多数受益人对收入规则知之甚少。通过关联项目记录、社保就业历史及企业标识，我们构建了每位同伴接受核查前六个月的工作场所网络，并利用同伴是否跨越收入阈值的准随机变化，采用模糊断点回归设计识别溢出效应。结果显示，略高于收入阈值的同伴的同事，其登记劳动收入下降20%；对应的模糊断点回归估计表明，同伴被暂停资格后，其同事基线收入下降约三分之一。这些影响在两个月内显现并持续至少12个月。反应几乎完全体现在正规就业的集约边际上，收入下降主要源于向非正规工作的转移而非退出劳动力市场。溢出效应集中于小型企业和相似同事群体中；当被暂停资格的同伴主动联系项目支持服务时，溢出效应扩大近三倍，而非受益同事中则无此现象。这一模式与信息传递作为主要渠道的假设一致。将间接反应纳入评估后，该项目在核查机制下的估计边际价值公共资金（MVPF）从0.53降至0.36。由于凡是通过正规收入记录执行家计调查的项目均存在相同的信息传递渠道，仅统计直接受影响家庭的评估方法会系统性低估核查成本。
url:5d596bcb0673cda5.title: Enforcement Spillovers and the Efficiency Costs of Means-Tested Transfers: Evidence from Workplace Networks

Greater exposure to flexible work substantially reduces mothers

url:5db458811c2f6fef.abstract: Exploiting three decades of detailed regional data for Germany, we find that when the Green Party is successful at the polls, local hazardous emissions decline. The level of political representation matters, too. Green politicians’ gaining influence at county level is followed largely by a decline in air pollutants that have an immediate adverse health effect. In contrast, when the Green party joins the state government, only greenhouse gas emissions that affect the welfare of future generations via climate change decline. The primary mechanism to achieve lower emissions appears to be a reduction in output, rather than more efficient energy use.
url:5db458811c2f6fef.abstract_zh: 利用德国三十年来详尽的区域数据，我们发现当绿党在选举中获胜时，当地有害排放物会减少。政治代表程度同样重要。绿党政客在县级层面获得影响力后，主要伴随的是对健康有直接不利影响的空气污染物减少。相比之下，当绿党加入州政府时，只有通过气候变化影响后代福利的温室气体排放会减少。实现较低排放的主要机制似乎是产出减少，而非能源利用效率提升。

url:5db9c212ef4b2ea3.abstract: We study monopolistic certification in markets where sellers possess partial private information about product quality. A certifier can provide information through two channels: screening sellers’ private information (soft information) and acquiring new quality data (hard information). We prove that any certification menu achieving less than maximal screening is Pareto dominated by one with full screening.
url:5db9c212ef4b2ea3.abstract_zh: 我们研究在卖方拥有产品质量部分私人信息的市场中垄断性认证问题。认证机构可通过两种渠道提供信息：筛选卖方的私人信息（软信息）以及获取新的质量数据（硬信息）。我们证明，任何未能实现最大程度筛选的认证菜单，均会被完全筛选的认证菜单帕累托占优。

url:5e064ad80fedba53.abstract: Amid public skepticism toward trade, we investigate whether evidence-based information - concise statements of research findings - can shape trade policy preferences. In survey experiments conducted on U.S. general population samples from 2018-2022, we consistently uncover a “backfire effect”: information highlighting the benefits of trade, such as job gains in productive sectors or lower prices for consumers, induces protectionist preferences. We interpret this effect as stemming from prior-biased belief updating, whereby the information activates pre-existing concerns about competition for jobs and trade relations with China. These associations are evoked particularly among limited-attention respondents, as well as politically-engaged Republicans.
url:5e064ad80fedba53.abstract_zh: 在公众对贸易持怀疑态度的背景下，我们探究了基于证据的信息——即研究结论的简明陈述——能否影响贸易政策偏好。基于2018-2022年间对美国普通人群样本开展的调查实验，我们持续发现一种"反火效应"：强调贸易益处（如生产部门就业增长或消费者价格降低）的信息反而会诱发保护主义偏好。我们将这一效应解释为源于先验偏差信念更新机制——信息激活了公众对就业竞争及中美贸易关系的既有担忧。这种关联效应在注意力有限的受访者以及政治参与度高的共和党人中尤为显著。
url:5e064ad80fedba53.title: Can Evidence-Based Information Shift Preferences Towards Trade Policy?
url:5e064ad80fedba53.title_zh: 基于证据的信息能否改变人们对贸易政策的偏好？

url:5e1979b2ebe6775a.abstract: Using linked survey and administrative wage records, we measure workers’ financial monitoring through the accuracy of their self-reported earnings. An unsupervised latent-class model distinguishes transitory reporting errors from rounding behavior and persistent reporting biases, allowing us to interpret lower reporting uncertainty as more precise knowledge of one’s wages. Among low-wage workers, reporting precision exhibits a pronounced pay-cycle pattern: it increases by approximately 12 percent in the days leading up to payday and declines immediately afterward. No comparable pattern emerges among higher-wage workers. These findings suggest that predictable liquidity constraints lead low-wage workers to monitor their personal finances more closely as payday approaches.
url:5e1979b2ebe6775a.abstract_zh: 利用关联的调查数据与行政工资记录，我们通过工人自报收入的准确性来衡量其财务监控程度。采用无监督潜类别模型，将暂时性报告误差与四舍五入行为及持续性报告偏差区分开来，从而将较低的报告不确定性解释为对自身工资更精确的认知。在低收入工人群体中，报告精确性呈现出显著的薪酬周期模式：发薪日前数天精确性提升约12%，发薪日后立即下降。而高收入工人中未发现类似模式。这些发现表明，可预测的流动性约束导致低收入工人在发薪日临近时更密切地监控个人财务状况。
url:5e1979b2ebe6775a.title: DP21775 Payday and the Monthly Attention Cycle of Low-Wage Workers

url:5e50b47c6eebf8d0.abstract: This paper empirically reassesses monetary policy transmission in emerging and frontier market economies in Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA EFMs). Using the identification approach of Romer and Romer (2004), we construct measures of monetary policy shocks and provide evidence on transmission mechanisms in the region. We show that monetary policy shocks pass through quickly to short-term market interest rates and lead to persistent increases in bank deposit and lending rates in most economies, indicating an operative bank-based interest rate channel. By contrast, exchange rates generally do not appreciate and, in many cases, depreciate following monetary tightening, consistent with the exchange rate puzzle—suggesting that interest rate hikes alone may be insufficient to systematically influence exchange rate movements. We also find that contractionary monetary policy reduces both output and inflation, with effects that are modest and notably weaker than in more developed economies. In addition, we find that transmission is stronger in economies that have adopted, or are transitioning toward, inflation-targeting regimes. Finally, we show that cross-country heterogeneity in transmission largely reflects differences in monetary policy transparency, financial development, and, to a lesser extent, fiscal dominance.
url:5e50b47c6eebf8d0.abstract_zh: 本文对撒哈拉以南非洲新兴及前沿市场经济体（SSA EFMs）的货币政策传导机制进行了实证再评估。采用Romer与Romer（2004）的识别方法，我们构建了货币政策冲击的度量指标，并提供了该区域传导机制的证据。研究表明，货币政策冲击能迅速传导至短期市场利率，并在多数经济体中导致银行存款利率与贷款利率持续上升，表明银行主导的利率渠道具有有效性。相比之下，汇率在货币紧缩后通常不会升值，反而在多数情况下出现贬值，这与"汇率之谜"现象一致——暗示单纯加息可能不足以系统性影响汇率变动。我们还发现，紧缩性货币政策会同时降低产出与通胀，但其影响幅度温和且显著弱于发达经济体。此外，在已采用或正转向通胀目标制的经济体中，货币政策传导效应更强。最后，研究表明跨国传导异质性主要源于货币政策透明度、金融发展水平的差异，而财政主导地位的影响相对较小。
url:5e50b47c6eebf8d0.title: Monetary Policy Transmission in Sub-Saharan Africa: Evidence from Emerging and Frontier Markets
url:5e50b47c6eebf8d0.title_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲的货币政策传导：来自新兴与前沿市场的证据

url:5e79499a6f925eb0.abstract: We use a randomized controlled trial to examine how out-of-pocket costs affect contraceptive method choice, pregnancy, abortion, and childbirth among uninsured U.S. women. The study recruited women seeking care through Title X—a national family planning program subsidizing reproductive health services for low-income Americans—and randomized vouchers, making the full spectrum of contraception highly discounted or free. We find that subsidizing contraception has large and persistent effects on the choice of con- traceptive method, resulting in significantly fewer pregnancies and abortions at 26 months. The effects on births are inconclusive.
url:5e79499a6f925eb0.abstract_zh: 我们通过一项随机对照试验，考察自付费用如何影响美国无保险女性的避孕方法选择、怀孕、堕胎及分娩。研究招募了通过Title X（一项为低收入美国人提供生殖健康服务补贴的国家计划生育项目）寻求医疗服务的女性，并随机发放代金券，使各类避孕措施大幅降价或免费。我们发现，补贴避孕措施对避孕方法的选择产生了显著且持续的影响，在26个月时导致怀孕和堕胎数量显著减少。对分娩的影响尚无定论。
url:5e79499a6f925eb0.title: Does Increasing Financial Access to Contraception in the U.S. Reduce Unintended Pregnancies? Evidence from the M-CARES Randomized Control Trial at Two Years

url:5e861f576bf82c84.abstract: This study investigates how the interaction of political accountability and local officials' career incentives shapes the market for Municipal Corporate Bonds (MCBs) in China, taking the 2017 local government debt personal responsibility rule as a quasi-natural experiment. We develop a stylized incomplete-information bargaining model to analyze how the rule reshapes the bargaining equilibrium by rendering officials' observable characteristics credible signals of bailout incentives. Using a dataset of prefecture-level MCBs from 2008 to 2020, we empirically test the model's predictions and focus on separating officials' incentive effects from their inherent ability. Our core findings show that post-announcement of the rule, each additional year of a local party secretary's remaining time to retirement, a proxy for bailout incentives, reduces MCB spreads by approximately 2.5 basis points and increases issuance volume by about 2.0%. These effects are significantly amplified in fiscally stressed cities. Notably, under the 2017 rule, cities led by party secretaries with stronger bailout incentives can expand MCB issuance, which is contrary to the rule's original intent to rein in local borrowing.
url:5e861f576bf82c84.abstract_zh: 本研究以2017年地方政府债务终身问责制为准自然实验，探究政治问责与地方官员职业激励的交互作用如何塑造中国市政企业债券市场。我们构建了一个简约的不完全信息讨价还价模型，分析该制度如何通过使官员可观测特征成为纾困激励的可信信号，重塑讨价还价均衡。基于2008-2020年地级市市政企业债券数据集，我们实证检验模型预测，并重点分离官员激励效应与内在能力差异。核心发现表明：该制度实施后，地方党委书记退休剩余年限（纾困激励代理变量）每增加一年，市政企业债券利差下降约2.5个基点，发行规模增长约2.0%。上述效应在财政压力较大的城市显著增强。值得注意的是，在2017年问责制下，由纾困激励更强的党委书记领导的城市反而能够扩大市政企业债券发行规模，这与该制度抑制地方举债的初始意图相悖。
url:5e861f576bf82c84.title: Political Accountability and Local Government Debt: Evidence from China
url:5e861f576bf82c84.title_zh: 政治问责与地方政府债务：来自中国的证据

url:5e9913d34d5df0db.abstract: This paper develops a simple time-series model of emigration and applies it to data for emigration from the UK between 1870 and 1913. The model is derived from a microeconomic analysis of the migration decision and provides a specific functional form and dynamic structure. It encompasses many of the features of models used in earlier research in which the specifications have been essentially ad hoc. The results support the model strongly in most respects. Both wage rates and employment rates in the sending and the receiving countries influenced fluctuations in emigration. The short-run fluctuations were driven largely by variations in employment rates while the long-run level of emigration was determined largely by the relative wage.
url:5e9913d34d5df0db.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个简洁的移民时间序列模型，并将其应用于1870年至1913年间英国移民数据的实证分析。该模型基于移民决策的微观经济学分析，提供了具体的函数形式与动态结构，涵盖了早期研究中诸多本质上具有临时性特征的模型规范。实证结果在多数维度上显著支持该模型：迁出地与迁入地的工资率与就业率共同影响移民波动。短期波动主要由就业率变化驱动，而长期移民水平则主要由相对工资水平决定。
url:5e9913d34d5df0db.title: DP771 A Model of UK Emigration, 1870-1913
