url:7d36a7fe5751c0b8.abstract: Digital platforms allocate buyer attention across sellers that differ in quality and breadth of appeal. We study a monopoly platform that sets meeting rates between buyers and two seller types --- niche sellers whose high-quality good is valued by a fraction of buyers and mass-market sellers whose good is valued by all. Sellers compete by posting prices Ã la Burdett and Judd (1983), so buyer surplus requires competition, while platform revenue requires seller rents. This difference creates a systematic distortion: as search capacity grows, the platform keeps high-quality niche attention just past the point where extra exposure stops creating rents and starts eroding them – its saturation point – and diverts the rest to mass-market sellers. Applying the model to Amazon product search and Google passage-ranking data indicates that, for captive buyers, both platforms operate past the saturation point.. Allowing buyer participation to respond to the platform's recommendation strategy disciplines the platform and shrinks this loss.
url:7d36a7fe5751c0b8.abstract_zh: 数字平台在质量与吸引力广度各异的卖家之间分配买家注意力。我们研究了一个垄断平台，该平台设定买家与两类卖家之间的匹配率——一类是利基卖家，其高质量商品仅被部分买家青睐；另一类是大众市场卖家，其商品受所有买家青睐。卖家按照Burdett和Judd（1983）的模型进行价格竞争，因此买家剩余依赖于竞争，而平台收入则依赖于卖家租金。这一差异导致了系统性扭曲：随着搜索能力的增长，平台将高质量利基卖家的注意力维持在略超过额外曝光不再创造租金、反而开始侵蚀租金的临界点（即饱和点）之上，并将剩余注意力转移给大众市场卖家。将该模型应用于亚马逊产品搜索与谷歌段落排名数据后发现，对于受限制的买家而言，两个平台的运营均超过了饱和点。允许买家参与度对平台推荐策略做出反应，能够约束平台行为并缩小这一损失。

url:7d645f1a4f9e38e9.abstract: Price regulation may have unintended consequences, such as facilitating collusion or softening actual price competition by causing a reduction in the number of active firms. Observing different firms hav- ing a monopoly position in parts of a market may be the result of either intense post-entry competition and non-cooperative entry decisions, or collusive entry. This phenomenon and large price differences per pill within a market are widespread in the Swedish generic pharmaceutical market where price regulation through monthly auctions for each active ingredient–dosage form–strength–package size combination channels a large part of demand to the winner within each such substitution group. 22% of the markets are potentially collusive in having at least two firms as monopolies for different substi- tution groups at least some of the time and prices per pill in such markets are on average significantly higher. We take a structural model tailored to the Swedish circumstances to data on two markets. In one market, the entry patterns (monopoly package sizes) are suggestive of actual, in the other of attempted, collusion. Our counterfactual analysis where we induce substitution across package sizes yield savings of >50% in the first market, but lead to a modest expenditure increase in the other because intensified post-entry competition induces exit.
url:7d645f1a4f9e38e9.abstract_zh: 价格管制可能产生非预期后果，例如通过减少活跃企业数量来促进合谋或弱化实际价格竞争。观察到不同企业在市场不同部分拥有垄断地位，既可能是激烈进入后竞争与非合作进入决策的结果，也可能是合谋性进入所致。这一现象及市场内每片药物价格差异巨大的情况，在瑞典仿制药市场中普遍存在——该市场通过每月针对每种活性成分-剂型-规格-包装规格组合的拍卖实施价格管制，将大部分需求引导至各替代组内的中标企业。22%的市场存在潜在合谋特征：至少有两家企业在不同替代组中至少部分时段形成垄断，此类市场的每片药物价格平均显著更高。我们针对瑞典市场特征构建结构模型，并将其应用于两个市场的数据。其中一个市场的进入模式（垄断包装规格）暗示实际合谋，另一个市场则显示合谋企图。反事实分析表明，通过诱导跨包装规格替代，第一个市场可节省超过50%的费用，但第二个市场因进入后竞争加剧导致企业退出，反而使支出小幅增加。

url:7e3c53c7d6aace74.abstract: Inflationary shocks do not affect all workers equally. Comparing men and women, we document two facts. First, both demand- and supply-driven inflationary shocks widen the gender wage gap within industries and occupations. Because these shocks imply opposite business-cycle conditions, their common effect points to inflation as the relevant force. Second, women and men perceive the same inflationary shocks as having different labor-market consequences: women expect conditions to worsen, while men expect them to improve. This asymmetry creates an expectations channel linking inflation to unequal wage growth. We formalize this channel in a New Keynesian search-and-matching model with male and female workers, imperfect information, and gender-specific ambiguity attitudes. Common macroeconomic signals lead ambiguity-averse women to place greater weight on adverse supply-driven states. For inflationary signals, this lowers their perceived outside options and wage demands relative to men
url:7e3c53c7d6aace74.abstract_zh: 通胀冲击对不同劳动者的影响并不均等。通过对比男性和女性，我们揭示了两项事实。其一，无论是需求驱动型还是供给驱动型的通胀冲击，都会在行业和职业内部扩大性别工资差距。由于这两类冲击对应截然不同的商业周期条件，其共同效应表明通胀本身才是关键作用力。其二，面对相同的通胀冲击，女性和男性对其劳动力市场后果的感知存在差异：女性预期就业状况将恶化，而男性则预期改善。这种认知不对称形成了一种将通胀与工资不平等增长联系起来的预期传导渠道。我们通过构建包含男女劳动者、不完全信息以及性别特异性模糊态度的新凯恩斯搜寻匹配模型，对这一渠道进行了形式化分析。共同的宏观经济信号使厌恶模糊性的女性更倾向于赋予不利供给驱动状态更高权重。对于通胀信号而言，这导致她们相较于男性降低了对外部选择权与工资诉求的预期值。

url:7e94a83cff39b2da.abstract: We examine the impact of U.S. sanctions on food security using a panel of 185 economies over 1990-2017, linking the World Food Programme (WFP) multidimensional food security indicator system to sanction episodes. Using difference-in-differences identification strategy and an event-study design, we show that sanctions significantly reduce food security in target countries, widening the gap with non-sanctioned countries by about 30 percent. Effects are concentrated in food access and stability-key dimensions of household food affordability and resilience-and are primarily driven by trade and financial restrictions. Mechanism analysis indicates that sanctions operate through both supply and demand channels. On the supply side, they reduce food imports and domestic production. On the demand side, they lower income, raise inflation and unemployment, and weaken political stability. Notably, the sanction impacts are strongest in low- and lower-middle-income countries, where food systems are more vulnerable to external shocks. These results highlight substantial and uneven humanitarian costs of sanctions for food security.
url:7e94a83cff39b2da.abstract_zh: 我们利用1990-2017年间185个经济体的面板数据，将世界粮食计划署（WFP）多维粮食安全指标系统与制裁事件相关联，考察美国制裁对粮食安全的影响。采用双重差分识别策略和事件研究设计，我们发现制裁显著降低了目标国的粮食安全水平，使其与未受制裁国家的差距扩大约30%。影响主要集中在粮食获取与稳定性——即家庭粮食可负担性与韧性的关键维度——且主要由贸易和金融限制驱动。机制分析表明，制裁通过供给和需求双重渠道发挥作用：在供给端，制裁减少了粮食进口和国内生产；在需求端，制裁降低了收入水平、推高了通胀和失业率，并削弱了政治稳定性。值得注意的是，制裁对低收入和中低收入国家的影响最为显著，这些国家的粮食体系更易受到外部冲击。这些结果揭示了制裁对粮食安全造成的巨大且不均衡的人道主义代价。

url:7efa2a75c8b45edd.abstract: this paper, we report econometric evidence suggesting that the market attaches too high a weight to current dividends relative to future dividends. This is consistent with the widely-held belief that the market is myopic. The main reason that we obtain a different result is that we estimate a model that is more general than the standard approach. However, we find no evidence to link this myopic behaviour with increased institutional ownership of equity. Our evidence can also be interpreted as a rejection of the standard efficient markets model, even when we allow for a time-varying discount rate. In addition our test does not depend on the time-series properties of dividends (e.g. we do not require stationarity).
url:7efa2a75c8b45edd.abstract_zh: 本文报告了计量经济学证据，表明市场对当前股息的权重过高，而对未来股息的权重过低。这与市场普遍存在的短视行为观点一致。我们得出不同结果的主要原因在于，我们估计的模型比标准方法更为一般化。然而，我们未发现证据表明这种短视行为与机构持股比例上升有关。我们的证据也可被解读为对标准有效市场模型的否定，即使我们允许贴现率随时间变化。此外，我们的检验不依赖于股息的时间序列特性（例如，我们不需要平稳性假设）。

url:7f6ade916a72e5b1.abstract: We study on-platform tying by a dominant platform that controls a primary access point and operates an adjacent specialised service. A rival service can reach users both through the dominant platform and through a direct channel. In a two-sided market where platforms charge sellers and seller participation affects consumer demand, tying improves the integrated service, but also shifts demand away from the rival. We show that lower mediated demand reduces seller participation on the rival platform, weakening the rival also for users who access it directly. As a result, tying can reduce consumer surplus and welfare once the direct channel is sufficiently large. We also compare tying with demotion and with a common-access policy, and show that our main insights carry over to a one-sided model in which network effects operate among consumers who pay directly for the specialised service.
url:7f6ade916a72e5b1.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一家主导平台在控制主要接入点并运营相邻专业化服务时的平台内捆绑行为。竞争性服务既可通过主导平台触达用户，也可通过直接渠道触达用户。在平台向卖家收费且卖家参与影响消费者需求的双边市场中，捆绑行为虽能提升整合服务的质量，但也会导致需求从竞争平台转移。研究表明，中介需求的降低会减少竞争平台上的卖家参与，从而削弱该平台对直接访问用户的吸引力。因此，当直接渠道规模足够大时，捆绑行为可能降低消费者剩余和社会福利。我们还将捆绑行为与降级处理及公共接入政策进行了比较，并证明主要结论可延伸至网络效应作用于直接为专业化服务付费的消费者之间的单边模型。

url:7f74cce02eee8949.abstract: Experiments from psychology show that people associate northern locations on arbitrary maps with positive value, raising the possibility that this cognitive bias shapes real housing markets. Using parcel-level data on 1.1 million residential properties across 285 cities in the northeastern United States, we find that houses in the northern parts of cities indeed sell at higher market prices. This premium disappears once lot size is controlled for, the only housing characteristic with this property. We argue that a small psychological preference for northness, too small to register as a direct price premium yet large enough to act as a Schelling focal point, could lead to neighborhood sorting and generate these differences in housing quality between the northern and southern parts of cities.
url:7f74cce02eee8949.abstract_zh: 心理学实验表明，人们会将任意地图上的北方位置与正向价值相关联，这引发了一种可能性：这种认知偏差可能影响真实的住房市场。基于美国东北部285个城市110万套住宅的地块级数据，我们发现城市北部地区的房屋确实以更高的市场价格成交。一旦控制地块面积这一唯一具有此特性的住房属性，该溢价便消失。我们认为，一种微小的对北方的心理偏好——小到不足以直接体现为价格溢价，却足以作为谢林焦点——可能引发社区分层，并导致城市南北部之间住房质量的差异。

url:7f9cc854f330a652.abstract: We develop a flexible model of confirmation bias, in which individuals misinterpret signals as stronger evidence for the state favored by their prior than they actually are. The bias varies with the agent's current belief, nesting Rabin and Schrag (1999) as a special case. In an individual learning setting, incorrect learning arises with positive probability when the bias is severe, generalizing existing work. By contrast, in a social learning setting, correct learning obtains almost surely regardless of the severity of bias. Whereas social information typically introduces inefficiencies, here it mitigates them: social interaction overcomes bias that would otherwise generate incorrect learning.
url:7f9cc854f330a652.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个灵活的确认偏误模型，在该模型中，个体将信号错误地解读为比实际更强的证据，以支持其先验信念所偏好的状态。该偏误随行为主体当前信念的变化而变化，并将Rabin和Schrag（1999）的研究作为特例。在个体学习情境下，当偏误严重时，错误学习会以正概率发生，这扩展了现有研究。相比之下，在社会学习情境下，无论偏误严重程度如何，正确学习几乎必然实现。尽管社会信息通常会引发效率损失，但在此情境下它反而缓解了效率损失：社会互动克服了原本会导致错误学习的偏误。
url:7f9cc854f330a652.title: How Social Learning Overcomes Confirmation Bias
url:7f9cc854f330a652.title_zh: 社会学习如何克服确认偏误

url:7fd657b4da63e85c.abstract: Air pollution from natural sources is often subject to less regulatory oversight, but can still be caused by human activities. Understanding the role for policy requires quantifying the source's pollution contribution, for which there is currently no standard methodological approach. This paper uses the context of the shrinking Great Salt Lake in Utah to model air quality impacts of the highly erodible and growing area of exposed lakebed. Using four common identification strategies in the air pollution literature, and three alternative pollution measurement technologies, we find consistent evidence of meaningful pollution increases attributable to the shrinking lake in non-winter months. Estimates are relatively invariant to measurement technology but vary across identification strategies. Marginal annual costs range from $81 to $175 million per 100 km² of exposed lakebed. Scaling to the area of total exposed lakebed, annual desiccation-related health cost estimates range from $1.1 billion to $2.3 billion. Given the direct relationship between human water use in the basin and exposed lakebed, these results provide evidence for the cost-effectiveness of policies aimed at reducing consumptive water use.
url:7fd657b4da63e85c.abstract_zh: 自然来源的空气污染通常受到的监管较少，但仍可能由人类活动引发。理解政策的作用需要量化该来源的污染贡献，而目前尚无标准方法论。本文以美国犹他州大盐湖萎缩为背景，对高度易蚀且不断扩大的裸露湖床区域的空气质量影响进行建模。利用空气污染文献中四种常见的识别策略及三种替代性污染测量技术，我们发现一致证据表明，在非冬季月份，湖泊萎缩导致了显著的污染增加。估计值对测量技术相对不敏感，但不同识别策略间存在差异。每100平方公里裸露湖床的边际年成本介于8100万至1.75亿美元之间。按总裸露湖床面积推算，与干涸相关的年度健康成本估计值在11亿至23亿美元之间。鉴于流域内人类用水与裸露湖床之间的直接关系，这些结果为旨在减少消耗性用水的政策提供了成本效益证据。
url:7fd657b4da63e85c.title: Dust in the Wind: The Health Costs of Great Salt Lake Desiccation
url:7fd657b4da63e85c.title_zh: 风中之尘：大盐湖干涸的健康代价

url:7fff64dbb524b6f3.abstract: The effects of the bank levy in Poland on the broadly defined credit market (including on loan rates and volumes) appear to be well documented, with the use of the standard difference-in-differences (DID) method. However, as, for example, Borusyak et al. (2024) note, in a setting with staggered treatment (as in the case of the bank levy in Poland), and different effects of the treatment in time and between cross-sections, the method might provide biased estimates. None of the studies to date used the heterogenous DID method that addresses this drawback. In this research note I use the heterogenous DID method to estimate the consequences of the bank levy. I also discuss other methodological choices. Among other things, I find that the bank levy has lowered deposit rates, raised rates on loans for house purchases, and changed the composition and the level of bank assets. However, I find no longer-term crowding out of credit by government bond securities (while the latter did increase, the former did not increase) or effects on bank profitability. The use of a more advised method did not lead to results in stark contrast with the earlier literature applying methods for causal inference.
url:7fff64dbb524b6f3.abstract_zh: 波兰银行税对广义信贷市场（包括贷款利率和规模）的影响，已有研究通过标准双重差分法进行了充分论证。然而，正如Borusyak等人（2024）所指出的，在交错处理设定下（如波兰银行税案例），若处理效应在时间维度和截面维度存在异质性，该方法可能产生有偏估计。现有研究均未采用能解决此缺陷的异质性双重差分法。本研究采用异质性双重差分法评估银行税的经济后果，并探讨其他方法论选择。研究发现：银行税降低了存款利率，提高了购房贷款利率，并改变了银行资产的构成与规模。但未发现政府债券对信贷的长期挤出效应（尽管债券规模上升，信贷规模并未下降），也未发现银行税对盈利能力的影响。采用更优方法所得结论与早期运用因果推断方法的研究并无显著差异。
url:7fff64dbb524b6f3.title: Yet another estimate of the consequences of the bank levy for the credit market in Poland

url:8036bf2f7378ca90.abstract: Across much of the Middle East and Central Asia (ME&CA), market competition remains weaker than in other emerging markets, holding back productivity and income growth. Using firm-level data from Orbis for 2002–2021, this paper studies the evolution of market competition in ME&CA economies and examines how trade policy and institutions shape competitive dynamics. We find that market power remains substantial and uneven across ME&CA, with particularly high markups in resource-intensive activities, selected service sectors, and—more recently—manufacturing in the Caucasus and Central Asia (CCA). Higher tariff protection is systematically associated with faster growth in markups, indicating that trade barriers weaken competitive pressure, while improvements in competition policy, anti-corruption frameworks, and property rights are linked to declining market power and hence increasing competition. Although productivity gaps remain large and persistent, stronger competition is associated with faster firm-level productivity growth and higher GDP per capita growth, with these effects particularly pronounced in CCA economies. Overall, the findings highlight the importance of policies aimed at reducing trade barriers and strengthening institutional and competition policy frameworks to foster competition, raise productivity, and support long-term income growth in the ME&CA region.
url:8036bf2f7378ca90.abstract_zh: 在中东和中亚大部分地区，市场竞争仍弱于其他新兴市场，这抑制了生产率和收入增长。本文利用Orbis数据库2002-2021年的企业层面数据，研究中东和中亚经济体的市场竞争演变，并考察贸易政策和制度如何塑造竞争动态。我们发现，中东和中亚地区的市场势力依然显著且分布不均，资源密集型活动、部分服务业以及近期高加索和中亚地区的制造业中，加成率尤其偏高。更高的关税保护与加成率的更快增长系统性相关，表明贸易壁垒削弱了竞争压力；而竞争政策、反腐败框架和产权制度的改善则与市场势力下降（即竞争增强）相关联。尽管生产率差距依然巨大且持续存在，但更强的竞争与企业层面生产率的更快增长以及更高的人均GDP增长相关，这些效应在高加索和中亚经济体中尤为显著。总体而言，研究结果强调了旨在降低贸易壁垒、加强制度和竞争政策框架的政策重要性，以促进竞争、提高生产率并支持中东和中亚地区的长期收入增长。
url:8036bf2f7378ca90.title: Competition and Productivity in Middle East and Central Asia: What Role Do Tariffs Play?

url:80910c858a5b6961.abstract: Governments often intervene to prevent firm closures during crises, fearing that financially constrained but viable firms may fail. We develop a firm dynamics model with incomplete financial markets and show how financial frictions generate excessive firm exit. A key statistic governing this dynamic inefficiency is the marginal propensity to exit with debt. Using confidential U.S. Census data, we estimate the relationship between debt and exit and use it to discipline the model. The calibrated model implies that eliminating financial frictions reduces firm exit from 9.3\% to 5.0\% and generates welfare gains of 3.6\% in consumption-equivalent terms. We show that the welfare costs of financial frictions rise sharply during financial crises but change little during standard productivity recessions. Finally, we compare government-guaranteed loans and grants, quantifying the trade-off between fiscal cost and effectiveness in preventing excessive exit.
url:80910c858a5b6961.abstract_zh: 政府常会在危机期间干预以防止企业倒闭，担心那些面临财务约束但具有生存能力的企业可能失败。我们构建了一个包含不完全金融市场的企业动态模型，并展示了金融摩擦如何导致企业过度退出。衡量这种动态低效率的关键统计指标是债务驱动的边际退出倾向。利用保密的美国人口普查数据，我们估算了债务与退出之间的关系，并以此校准模型。校准后的模型表明，消除金融摩擦可使企业退出率从9.3%降至5.0%，并以消费等价形式带来3.6%的福利收益。我们进一步发现，金融摩擦的福利成本在金融危机期间急剧上升，但在标准的生产率衰退期间变化甚微。最后，我们比较了政府担保贷款与直接拨款，量化了财政成本与防止过度退出有效性之间的权衡关系。
url:80910c858a5b6961.title: Firm Exit and Financial Frictions

url:80c5341723828ecf.abstract: This paper studies spatial rents in markets where firm location determines competitive advantage. Using the London bus market—where operators maintain proprietary garage networks and bid for route contracts—we develop a structural model linking garage value to procurement profits through transportation (dead-mile) costs, local monopoly rents, and economies of density. Exploiting the exclusive use of garages, we recast the location prob- lem as one where garages choose operators, yielding a tractable discrete choice estimator. Model estimates and simulations reveal a clear tension between minimising dead-mile costs and maintaining spatial isolation from competitors to protect local monopoly rents. A so- cial planner reassigning garage ownership can recover up to 24.3% in welfare gains through reduced spatial isolation alone. In addition, adding a Pigouvian correction for dead-mile ex- ternalities contributes 2.0% through a channel that does not require displacing incumbents. Sizeable gains remain un- der short-run fleet constraints and under conservative assumptions about the social cost of disrupting incumbent-specific investments.
url:80c5341723828ecf.abstract_zh: 本文研究了企业区位决定竞争优势的市场中的空间租金。以伦敦公交市场为背景——该市场中运营商拥有专属车库网络并竞标线路合同——我们构建了一个结构模型，通过运输（空驶）成本、本地垄断租金和密度经济将车库价值与采购利润联系起来。利用车库的排他性使用特征，我们将区位问题重新表述为车库选择运营商的问题，从而得到一个易于处理的离散选择估计量。模型估计与模拟揭示了在最小化空驶成本与保持与竞争对手的空间隔离以保护本地垄断租金之间的明显张力。若由社会规划者重新分配车库所有权，仅通过减少空间隔离即可实现高达24.3%的福利改善。此外，针对空驶外部性引入庇古校正，通过不涉及替代在位运营商的渠道额外贡献2.0%的福利提升。在短期车队约束条件下，以及关于破坏在位运营商特定投资的社会成本的保守假设下，仍存在可观的福利改进空间。

url:80d22994197249d7.abstract: This paper studies formal employment dynamics using linked employer–employee data from eight countries spanning a wide income range from Kenya to Chile. First, we show that formality rates increase with development, both between and within countries, because more workers enter the formal sector, not because they spend more time in formal jobs. Second, formal labor market fluidity increases with development, as workers hold more formal jobs, spend less time in each job, and less time between jobs. Third, greater fluidity is associated with higher life-cycle wage growth, which is largely accounted for by within- rather than between-firm wage gains.
url:80d22994197249d7.abstract_zh: 本文利用涵盖从肯尼亚到智利等八个收入水平差异显著国家的关联雇主-雇员数据，研究正规就业的动态变化。首先，我们发现正规就业率随经济发展而上升，这一趋势既存在于国家之间也存在于国家内部，其原因是更多工人进入正规部门，而非他们在正规岗位上的工作时间延长。其次，正规劳动力市场的流动性随经济发展而增强，表现为工人从事更多正规工作、每份工作持续时间缩短、以及工作间隔时间减少。第三，更高的流动性与更大的生命周期工资增长相关，而这主要归因于企业内部而非企业间的工资提升。
url:80d22994197249d7.title: Formal Labor Market Dynamics and Development

url:8115c0e359129d33.abstract: The asset management industry is increasingly shifting toward tailored portfolios, fund proliferation, and decentralization of stewardship—trends partly driven by growing heterogeneity in investor preferences. While these developments better align investment products with investor demands, they also reshape ownership structures, potentially leading to more fragmented ownership and weaker managerial oversight. We develop a framework to evaluate these trade-offs and show that fund proliferation does not necessarily weaken governance: Stronger incentives for asset managers and concentrated portfolios of specialized funds can offset these effects, especially when investor preferences are intense. However, strong investor preferences can also induce asset managers to compete on a new margin—granting investors control by decentralizing stewardship and adopting pass-through voting—without internalizing the associated governance costs.
url:8115c0e359129d33.abstract_zh: 资产管理行业正日益转向定制化投资组合、基金数量激增以及管理权分散化——这些趋势部分源于投资者偏好的日益多样化。尽管这些发展使投资产品与投资者需求更加契合，但也重塑了所有权结构，可能导致所有权更加分散、管理层监督弱化。我们构建了一个评估这些权衡关系的分析框架，并发现基金数量激增并不必然削弱公司治理：资产管理人更强的激励机制以及专业基金集中化的投资组合能够抵消上述影响，尤其在投资者偏好强烈时更为显著。然而，强烈的投资者偏好也可能促使资产管理人在新维度展开竞争——通过分散管理权并采用传递投票机制将控制权让渡给投资者——却未将相应的治理成本内部化。

url:81e896c54e79b50b.abstract: This paper uses rich, administrative-quality data on earnings in the UK from the Annual Survey of Hours and Earnings (ASHE) to provide a detailed analysis of income risk and its patterns across individuals and over time. We develop a model of income dynamics that accounts for the broader state of the economy and successfully captures key features of the UK earnings growth distribution, including: a cyclical variance, procyclical skewness (more frequent negative earnings shocks during recessions), and a distribution that combines sharp peaks with long, heavy tails. The model is simple enough to be integrated into broader macroeconomic frameworks, such as heterogeneous agent models, and could be used to support policy scenario analysis.
url:81e896c54e79b50b.abstract_zh: 本文利用英国《工时与收入年度调查》（ASHE）中具有行政质量的高精度收入数据，对收入风险及其在个体间与时间维度上的分布模式进行了详细分析。我们构建了一个考虑宏观经济整体状态的收入动态模型，该模型成功捕捉了英国收入增长分布的关键特征，包括：周期性方差、顺周期偏度（经济衰退期间负向收入冲击更为频繁），以及兼具尖峰与长厚尾特征的分布形态。该模型结构简洁，可整合至更广泛的宏观经济框架（如异质性主体模型）中，并可用于支持政策情景分析。

url:8253cce7ce84db7c.abstract: The secular decline in birth rates across the globe over the past seven decades has slowed population growth, raised average ages, and reshaped labor markets and the macroeconomy. Contrary to the widespread expectation that these trends hamper economic growth, we find lower birth rates are associated with higher growth in GDP per working-age adult across countries and higher wage growth across US commuting zones, with no negative impact on aggregate GDP or earnings. These patterns are not explained by educational upgrading, rising female labor force participation, the declining importance of agriculture, or neoclassical-Solow mechanisms. We argue that they reflect the endogenous, labor-saving response of technology to the scarcity of younger workers. Consistent with this interpretation, countries and regions with lower birth rates exhibit more labor-saving patents and growing high-tech activity. There is also higher TFP growth across countries and industries. Exploiting cross-country variation in WWII military and civilian deaths, we find that declines in younger population, rather than population size per se, drive our results.
url:8253cce7ce84db7c.abstract_zh: 过去七十年间全球生育率的长期下降，减缓了人口增长，提高了平均年龄，并重塑了劳动力市场与宏观经济。与普遍认为这些趋势会阻碍经济增长的预期相反，我们发现较低的生育率与各国劳动年龄人口人均GDP的更高增长以及美国通勤区工资的更高增长相关，且对总体GDP或收入无负面影响。这些模式无法通过教育水平提升、女性劳动参与率上升、农业重要性下降或新古典索洛机制来解释。我们认为，这反映了技术对年轻劳动力稀缺性的内生性、节约劳动力的响应。与这一解释一致的是，生育率较低的国家和地区拥有更多节约劳动力的专利，且高科技活动日益活跃。各国及各行业也呈现出更高的全要素生产率增长。利用二战期间各国军事与平民死亡人数的跨国差异，我们发现驱动结果的是年轻人口减少，而非人口规模本身。
url:8253cce7ce84db7c.title: Baby Busts and Growth Booms : Demographic Change and the Macroeconomy

url:825d3542d272eaae.abstract: TThis paper provides econometric evidence on how exchange rates respond to tariffs. We construct a new tariff-shock database, which captures tariff-related announcements, threats and implementations by the U.S., China, the Euro Area and Canada between 2018 and 2020, and in 2025. Our shock measure accounts for both the size of tariff rates and their economic relevance. Over the 2018-2020 period, we show that exchange rates reacted to U.S. tariff shocks in systematically different ways depending on retaliation: the U.S. dollar (USD) appreciated if the tariff was imposed unilaterally, but depreciated if other countries threatened to retaliate. In 2025, when nearly all U.S. tariff actions were met with retaliatory threats, the USD again depreciated. In contrast to 2018-2020, however, long-maturity U.S. Treasury yields rose in 2025, instead of fell-consistent with an interpretation of â€˜Liberation Day' as a reserve-currency shock. This may reflect that U.S. tariff actions in 2025 were significantly larger, more frequent and targeted a broader set of countries.
url:825d3542d272eaae.abstract_zh: 本文提供了关于汇率如何对关税做出反应的计量经济学证据。我们构建了一个新的关税冲击数据库，涵盖了2018年至2020年以及2025年间美国、中国、欧元区和加拿大与关税相关的公告、威胁和实施措施。我们的冲击度量既考虑了关税税率的大小，也考虑了其经济相关性。在2018-2020年期间，我们发现汇率对美国关税冲击的反应因报复行为而呈现系统性差异：若关税为单方面实施，美元（USD）升值；若其他国家威胁报复，则美元贬值。2025年，当几乎所有美国关税行动都遭遇报复威胁时，美元再次贬值。然而，与2018-2020年不同的是，2025年美国长期国债收益率上升而非下降——这与将“解放日”解读为储备货币冲击的解释一致。这可能反映出2025年美国关税行动的规模显著更大、频率更高，且针对的国家范围更广。
url:825d3542d272eaae.title: Trading Blows: The Exchange-Rate Response to Tariffs and Retaliations

url:82c9f057fdb97858.abstract: A vocabulary is a list of words designating subsets from a grand set X . We model a vocabulary as a partition of X and study the aggregation of individual vocabularies into a collective one. We characterize aggregation rules when X is linearly ordered and each word of the vocabulary spans an order interval. We allow for individual vocabularies to differ both in the number and in the span of their words. Under a suitable restriction on agents’ preferences, we show that our aggregation rules are strategy-proof. This is a preview of subscription content, log in via an institution to check access.
url:82c9f057fdb97858.abstract_zh: 词汇表是从一个全集X中指定子集的词语列表。我们将词汇表建模为X的一个划分，并研究如何将个体词汇表聚合为集体词汇表。当X具有线性顺序且词汇表中的每个词语覆盖一个序区间时，我们对聚合规则进行了刻画。我们允许个体词汇表在词语数量和覆盖范围上存在差异。在对个体偏好施加适当限制的条件下，我们证明这些聚合规则是防策略性的。这是订阅内容的预览，请通过机构登录以检查访问权限。

url:82d75bbd8574bd1c.abstract: In a competitive constant-returns small open economy world prices are the appropriate shadow prices for traded goods in public sector cost-benefit analysis. If there are at least as many factors of production as there are goods produced and traded, it is straightforward to derive 'foreign-exchange-equivalent' factor shadow prices. Bertrand (American Economic Review, 1979) has argued that the case of more goods being produced and traded than there are factors (referred to as 'diversification' below) is of greater empirical relevance, and that in this case it is impossible to define factor shadow prices. In this paper, I argue that this view is incorrect, in the sense that if the economic forces which bring about the diversification of production are consistently and explicitly modelled, just enough information is available to define the factor shadow prices. The cases considered are: (i) a small open economy in which the government's objective is to influence the distribution of income, in which case diversification could only result from an irrational use of the policy tools available to the government; (ii) a small open economy in which there are political constraints on production levels in some activities, in which case world prices are not the correct shadow prices for the constrained activities; and (iii) a closed economy (which can be thought of as a model in which world prices are endogenous) in which the shadow prices of goods are not world prices.
url:82d75bbd8574bd1c.abstract_zh: 在一个竞争性、规模报酬不变的小型开放经济中，世界价格是公共部门成本-收益分析中贸易品恰当的影子价格。如果生产要素的数量至少与生产和贸易的商品数量相等，则可以直接推导出“外汇等价”要素影子价格。伯特兰（《美国经济评论》，1979年）认为，生产和贸易的商品数量超过要素数量的情况（下文称为“多样化”）具有更大的经验相关性，且在此情况下无法定义要素影子价格。本文认为，这一观点并不正确——若导致生产多样化的经济力量被一致且明确地建模，则恰好有足够的信息来定义要素影子价格。本文考虑的情形包括：（i）政府目标为影响收入分配的小型开放经济，此时多样化只能源于政府对其可用政策工具的非理性使用；（ii）某些活动的生产水平受到政治约束的小型开放经济，此时世界价格并非受约束活动的正确影子价格；（iii）封闭经济（可视为世界价格内生化的模型），其中商品的影子价格并非世界价格。
url:82d75bbd8574bd1c.title: DP42 Factor Shadow Prices in Distorted Open Economies

url:832196ef5fbcc126.abstract: Official Spanish birth registry data report sex ratios well above expected levels between 1975 and 2000, peaking at 109 boys per 100 girls in the early 1980s, the highest in the world at that time. Prior research has attributed these elevated ratios to factors such as maternal age, birth order, and differential prenatal care. We show that they instead reflect systematic coding errors by the Spanish Statistical Office. Census data reveal normal sex ratios for the same cohorts. The birth registry also exhibits implausible monthly volatility and asymmetrically distributed outliers, consistent with one-directional miscoding of females as males. Additional corroborating evidence comes from provisional birth statistics, which show significantly lower sex ratios than the finalised records, and from anomalous patterns in adjacent fields on the birth registration form. Our findings underscore the responsibility of statistical agencies to validate administrative records and cross-check them against alternative sources.
url:832196ef5fbcc126.abstract_zh: 西班牙官方出生登记数据显示，1975年至2000年间性别比显著高于预期水平，1980年代初达到峰值——每100名女婴对应109名男婴，为当时全球最高。此前研究将这一异常性别比归因于母亲年龄、出生顺序及差异化产前护理等因素。我们证明，这实际上反映了西班牙国家统计局的系统性编码错误。人口普查数据显示，同一出生队列的性别比正常。出生登记数据还呈现出不合常理的月度波动及非对称分布的异常值，这与将女性单向误编码为男性的模式相符。临时出生统计数据显示的性别比显著低于最终记录，且出生登记表相邻字段存在异常模式，这些均为佐证。我们的研究凸显了统计机构验证行政记录并与其他数据源交叉核验的责任。

url:83bae391f6125fa4.abstract: Maritime transport remains the backbone of global trade, yet the port and shipping network that carries it has been transformed by containerization and related technological advances. Drawing on newly available granular data—digitized historical shipping records, georeferenced ship movements, and shipment-level routing information—we present five stylized facts on the structure and evolution of the maritime network. Global shipping activity is highly concentrated among a changing lineup of dominant top ports even as lower-ranked ports disperse, while state-owned Chinese port terminal operators increasingly account for these global volumes, boosting overall port operations while delivering efficiency gains mostly to Chinese vessels. We use these facts to organize a synthesis of a fast-growing literature: containerization reshaped which port cities could expand, reinforced hub-and-spoke concentration that yields large but localized welfare gains, embedded ports in multimodal networks that amplify the returns to infrastructure, and generated market power, congestion, and environmental costs. Together, this evidence shows how evolving maritime technologies simultaneously deepen global integration and heighten the economic and geopolitical importance of critical nodes in the transport network—and of who controls them.
url:83bae391f6125fa4.abstract_zh: 海上运输仍是全球贸易的支柱，但承载这一运输体系的港口与航运网络已因集装箱化及相关技术进步而发生深刻变革。基于新获取的颗粒化数据——数字化历史航运记录、地理参照船舶轨迹及单次货运路径信息——我们归纳出关于海运网络结构与演进的五个典型事实：全球航运活动高度集中于排名动态变化的头部港口，而低排名港口则呈现分散化趋势；同时，中国国有港口码头运营商在全球吞吐量中的占比持续攀升，在提升整体港口运营效率的同时，其效率增益主要惠及中国籍船舶。我们以这些事实为框架，系统梳理了快速发展的相关文献：集装箱化重塑了港口城市的扩张空间，强化了枢纽-辐射式集中格局（虽带来巨大但局部化的福利增益），将港口嵌入多式联运网络（放大基础设施投资回报），并催生了市场势力、拥堵与环境成本问题。这些证据共同表明，不断演进的海运技术在深化全球一体化的同时，也加剧了运输网络关键节点及其控制者的经济与地缘政治重要性。

url:83dab6695cd1465c.abstract: In the first part of the paper we outline a method for estimating a class of models in which news or surprises appear and expectations are formed rationally. The method is an extension of the errors-in-variables method of McCallum and Wickens. As a by-product some of Pagan's results on the circumstances under which the commonly use two-step method of estimating surprise models is efficient are shown to be a consequence of well-known theorems on the efficiency of sub-system estimation when a subset of equations is exactly identified. In the second part of the paper the method is applied to Hall's random-walk model of consumption, which is extended to allow for stochastic interest rates and for leisure and government spending to be substitutes for private spending. The extended formulation is a great deal more successful at capturing the salient features of the data. We also derive approximate restrictions across the parameters of the model due to the rational expectations hypothesis but find that they are marginally rejected by the data. Finally, we evaluate the ability of the life-cycle with rational expectations model to encompass alternative models.
url:83dab6695cd1465c.abstract_zh: 本文第一部分概述了一种估计包含新闻或意外冲击且预期理性形成的模型类别的方法。该方法是对McCallum与Wickens变量误差法的扩展。作为副产品，本文证明了Pagan关于常用两步法估计意外模型有效性的部分结论，实为子方程组恰好识别时子系统估计效率经典定理的推论。第二部分将该方法应用于Hall的消费随机游走模型，通过引入随机利率、休闲与政府支出对私人支出的替代效应进行扩展。扩展后的模型在捕捉数据关键特征方面显著提升。我们进一步推导了理性预期假设下模型参数的近似约束条件，但发现这些约束被数据轻微拒绝。最后，本文评估了理性预期生命周期模型对其他竞争性模型的涵盖能力。

url:83f3c721e72a9a30.abstract: he Voluntary Carbon Market (VCM) rests on the premise that one carbon credit compensates for one tonne of emissions. While a growing body of evidence questions the integrity of many credits, much less is known about whether the ability to offset affects firms’ incentives to reduce their own emissions. Using a buyer-linked dataset covering the near-universe of offset retirements, we exploit the 2023 carbon-market scandals as a quasi-natural experiment. Firms that stop offsetting after the shock reduce their operational (Scope 1) emissions substantially more than firms that continue to purchase offsets. This finding is consistent with moral licensing: access to offsets weakens firms’ incentives to undertake internal abatement. We also document persistent oversupply, opaque intermediation, and sharp price and volume responses to the scandals. Our results identify a demand-side problem in the VCM that is distinct from concerns about credit quality: even when credits represent genuine emissions reductions, the option to offset may slow decarbonization within purchasing firms.
url:83f3c721e72a9a30.abstract_zh: 自愿碳市场（VCM）建立在“一个碳信用抵消一吨排放”的前提之上。尽管越来越多的证据对许多碳信用的真实性提出质疑，但关于抵消能力是否会影响企业减排动机的研究仍十分有限。利用覆盖近乎全部碳信用注销的买方关联数据集，我们将2023年碳市场丑闻作为准自然实验。研究发现，在冲击发生后停止碳抵消的企业，其运营排放（范围一）的减少幅度显著高于继续购买碳抵消的企业。这一发现与道德许可效应一致：碳抵消的可获得性削弱了企业开展内部减排的动机。我们还发现市场存在持续供应过剩、中介环节不透明，以及丑闻引发的价格与交易量剧烈波动。我们的研究揭示了VCM中一个区别于碳信用质量问题的需求侧困境：即使碳信用代表真实的减排量，抵消选项也可能减缓购买企业的脱碳进程。

url:84485f9e6b5dce9d.abstract: This study uses an entropy balancing model to show that coups d’état can reduce GDP growth by around 2.3 percentage points in the same year. This is a larger effect than some previous estimates, and is found to be persistent over time, reducing cumulative GDP growth by around five percentage points over the following five years. This study goes deeper than previous research into the drivers of that impact, finding that economic sanctions are an an important reason for the observed lower growth in many cases and that the principal channel is via private consumption and investment.
url:84485f9e6b5dce9d.abstract_zh: 本研究采用熵平衡模型表明，政变可使当年GDP增长率降低约2.3个百分点。这一影响幅度大于部分既有研究估计值，且呈现持续性特征——在随后五年内累计减少约五个百分点的GDP增长。相较于既有研究，本研究更深入探究该影响的驱动因素，发现经济制裁是多数案例中增长放缓的重要成因，而其主要传导渠道为私人消费与投资。

url:8448c2186d66f501.abstract: We study the behavior of Covered Interest Parity (CIP) deviations - aka the CIP basis - in Emerging Markets (EM). A major challenge in computing the CIP basis in EM's lies in measuring local currency interest rates which are free of local credit risk. To do so, we construct a â€˜purified' CIP basis for eight major EM currencies using supranational bonds issued in EM local currencies and US dollar going back twenty years. We show that this â€˜purified' CIP basis aligns well with theory-implied predictions. In the cross-section and the time-series, the basis correlates with fundamental forces driving supply and demand for dollar forwards. Shocks to global dollar funding costs, global intermediary's balance sheet capacity, and the demand for dollar safe assets interact with currency-specific dollar hedging and funding needs in moving the CIP basis in EM's.
url:8448c2186d66f501.abstract_zh: 我们研究了新兴市场（EM）中抛补利率平价（CIP）偏离——即CIP基差——的行为。计算新兴市场CIP基差的主要挑战在于衡量无本地信用风险的本地货币利率。为此，我们利用过去二十年新兴市场本地货币和美元计价的主权超国家债券，为八种主要新兴市场货币构建了“净化版”CIP基差。研究表明，这一“净化版”CIP基差与理论隐含预测高度吻合。在横截面和时间序列维度上，该基差与驱动美元远期供需的基本力量相关。全球美元融资成本冲击、全球中介机构资产负债表容量冲击以及美元安全资产需求冲击，会与货币特定的美元对冲和融资需求相互作用，共同影响新兴市场的CIP基差变动。

url:8468b2d352820c70.abstract: We develop a unified approach to studying cost-price dynamics in the cross-section of firms in order to explain the time series of aggregate inflation, both during normal times and inflation surges. A key novelty is the use of microdata on firms’ prices and production costs to construct an empirical measure of price gaps — the deviation between a firm’s listed and optimal price. We characterize the mapping between price gaps and the size and frequency of price adjustments and take them to the data to test nonparametrically how firms’ pricing strategies align with the predictions of different pricing models, conditional on shocks of different magnitudes. The microdata provide strong evidence of state dependence: the passthrough of costs into inflation increases more than proportionately when the economy is hit by large aggregate shocks. In contrast, in normal times, the frequency of price adjustment is approximately constant, and the microdata conform to the predictions of time-dependent models (e.g., Calvo 1983). Conditional on the path of aggregate cost shocks extracted from the data, a generalized state-dependent pricing model accounts well for both the low and stable inflation of the pre-pandemic period and the nonlinear surge that followed.
url:8468b2d352820c70.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种统一的分析框架，研究企业截面中的成本-价格动态，以解释总体通胀的时间序列特征，既涵盖正常时期也涵盖通胀激增时期。一个关键创新在于利用企业价格与生产成本的微观数据，构建价格缺口（即企业标价与最优价格之间的偏离）的实证度量指标。我们刻画了价格缺口与价格调整幅度及频率之间的映射关系，并将其应用于数据中，以非参数方式检验企业在不同冲击强度下定价策略与各类定价模型预测的一致性。微观数据为状态依赖性提供了有力证据：当经济遭受大规模总体冲击时，成本向通胀的传导效应会以超比例方式增强。相比之下，在正常时期，价格调整频率大致保持恒定，微观数据符合时间依赖模型（如Calvo 1983）的预测。基于从数据中提取的总体成本冲击路径，一个广义的状态依赖定价模型能够很好地解释疫情前通胀的低位稳定特征以及随后出现的非线性激增现象。
url:8468b2d352820c70.title: Micro and Macro Cost-Price Dynamics in Normal Times and during Inflation Surges

url:84c505ecb2234071.abstract: This paper examines the short- and medium-term effects of the 2018–19 China-U.S. tariff increases on the trade and investment flows of ASEAN member economies. Using granular trade data, we demonstrate that several ASEAN countries experienced a disproportionate growth in exports of products that were targeted by these tariffs. To further explore the dynamic and often immediate responses of international capital flows to these trade policy shifts, we leverage a novel firm-level FDI database that allows us to identify surges in sectoral investment inflows. Among ASEAN countries, Vietnam stands out as the one where FDI in targeted sectors grew notably faster during 2018–19, likely contributing to its observed export gains over the medium term. At the same time, our analysis reveals that trade gains in targeted products have not universally translated into stronger overall export performance across ASEAN. More generally, while trade reallocation may yield short- and medium-term gains, these gains can be offset over time by the higher long-term aggregate losses associated with trade fragmentation.
url:84c505ecb2234071.abstract_zh: 本文考察了2018-2019年中美关税上调对东盟成员国贸易与投资流动的短期及中期影响。基于细粒度贸易数据，我们证实部分东盟国家在受关税影响产品上的出口呈现非对称增长。为深入探究国际资本流动对此类贸易政策变动的动态即时反应，我们利用新型企业层面外商直接投资数据库，识别出特定行业投资流入的激增现象。在东盟国家中，越南在2018-2019年间受关税影响行业的外商直接投资增速尤为显著，这很可能促成了其中期出口增长。与此同时，我们的分析表明，受关税影响产品的贸易收益并未普遍转化为东盟整体出口绩效的提升。更广泛而言，尽管贸易转移可能带来短期与中期收益，但这些收益会随时间推移被贸易碎片化导致的更高长期总体损失所抵消。
url:84c505ecb2234071.title: ASEAN’s Trade and Investment in a Fragmented World
url:84c505ecb2234071.title_zh: 碎片化世界中的东盟贸易与投资

url:84d4ed0ea1f363f1.title: Monetary Policy Shocks and Exchange Rate Dynamics in Small Open Economies
url:84d4ed0ea1f363f1.title_zh: 小型开放经济体中的货币政策冲击与汇率动态

url:84e19a5fb45d4eaa.abstract: This paper, based on the Stanley Fischer Memorial Lecture that the author delivered at the Annual Bank Conference on Development Economics (ABCDE) 2026, examines two structural impediments to broad-based economic development: dysfunctional central bank currency systems and inadequately resolved sovereign debt burdens. On currency, the paper argues that floating exchange rate regimes and multiple exchange rate systems—as practiced in countries such as Ethiopia, Nigeria, and Egypt—systematically transfer wealth from low-income wage earners to a narrow-privileged class, deepening poverty rather than alleviating it. Using Ethiopia as a central case study, the paper documents how successive devaluations have raised the national poverty rate from 33 percent in 2016 to a projected 43 percent by 2025, while eroding the real value of development assistance disbursed in local currency. The paper proposes that currency stabilization, low-cost digital payment infrastructure, and unsterilized central bank intervention offer a more direct path to rising median incomes than current IMF-endorsed exchange rate flexibility. On sovereign debt, the paper evaluates the performance of the G20 Common Framework and the Global Sovereign Debt Roundtable against the benchmark of the 1989 Brady Plan, finding that contemporary frameworks have generated intensive creditor engagement but minimal net present value reduction for debtor countries. Key failures identified include the absence of a single comparable discount rate for measuring debt relief, incomplete participation by China and commercial creditors, growing opacity in collateralized sovereign transactions, and the risks posed by value recovery instruments to the durability of restructuring agreements. The paper concludes that neither the Common Framework nor the Global Sovereign Debt Roundtable, in their current forms, are fit for purpose, and calls for replacement frameworks that prioritize measurable median income gains over creditor accommodation. Absent reforms on both fronts, per capita income growth in low-income developing economies is projected to remain at approximately 2 percent annually, leaving 5.6 billion people with incomes less than one-tenth of those in advanced economies and widening the global development gap.
url:84e19a5fb45d4eaa.abstract_zh: 本文基于作者在2026年发展经济学年度银行会议（ABCDE）上发表的斯坦利·费希尔纪念演讲，探讨了阻碍广泛经济发展的两大结构性障碍：功能失调的央行货币体系与未充分解决的主权债务负担。在货币方面，本文指出，浮动汇率制度及多重汇率体系——如埃塞俄比亚、尼日利亚和埃及等国所实行的制度——系统性地将财富从低收入工薪阶层转移至少数特权阶层，加剧而非缓解贫困。以埃塞俄比亚为核心案例，本文记录了连续贬值如何使全国贫困率从2016年的33%上升至2025年预计的43%，同时侵蚀了以本币拨付的发展援助的实际价值。本文提出，相较于当前国际货币基金组织认可的汇率弹性政策，货币稳定、低成本数字支付基础设施及未冲销的央行干预措施，为提升中位收入提供了更直接的路径。在主权债务方面，本文以1989年布雷迪计划为基准，评估了二十国集团共同框架与全球主权债务圆桌会议的表现，发现当代框架虽促成了密集的债权人参与，但对债务国而言净现值削减微乎其微。识别出的关键失败包括：缺乏衡量债务减免的统一可比贴现率、中国及商业债权人参与不完整、抵押主权交易日益不透明，以及价值回收工具对重组协议持久性构成的威胁。本文结论认为，共同框架与全球主权债务圆桌会议目前的形式均不适用，并呼吁建立以可衡量的中位收入增长而非债权人妥协为核心的替代框架。若这两方面改革缺失，低收入发展中经济体的人均收入增长预计将维持在每年约2%的水平，导致56亿人口的收入不足发达经济体的十分之一，从而扩大全球发展差距。
url:84e19a5fb45d4eaa.title: Stanley Fischer Memorial Lecture: Public Debt and Central Banks — The World Bank Group ABCDE Conference

url:84eec7de39661652.abstract: Third-party litigation financing involves an external party funding a legal claim, taking on the risk of loss in exchange for a share of any potential recovery. As European regulators prepare to establish a common regulatory framework for third-party litigation financing, this article draws on existing law and economics literature to examine the unique characteristics of third-party litigation financing, vis-a-vis other forms of financial support of litigation. Our findings highlight the strengths and weaknesses of different litigation-financing mechanisms in promoting socially desirable levels of litigation, adding a political economy perspective to the ongoing debates on the issue.
url:84eec7de39661652.abstract_zh: 第三方诉讼融资是指由外部方资助法律索赔，承担败诉风险，以换取潜在赔偿金的一部分。在欧洲监管机构准备为第三方诉讼融资建立统一监管框架之际，本文借鉴现有法律与经济学文献，探讨第三方诉讼融资相较于其他诉讼资助形式的独特特征。研究结果凸显了不同诉讼融资机制在促进社会合意诉讼水平方面的优势与不足，并为当前相关争论增添了政治经济学视角。

url:858c646a170a003e.abstract: This paper provides a simple unified discrete-choice framework for analyzing differentiated duopolies. This framework nests models of horizontal and vertical differentiation, including standard textbook models (Hotelling and Shaked-Sutton). Contrary to these models, it also applies to economic environments where horizontal differentiation coincides with positive correlation of product valuations across consumers, and environments where vertical differentiation coincides with negative correlation. The paper provides an equilibrium characterization that is applicable independently of the type of differentiation and the sign of the valuation correlation.
url:858c646a170a003e.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个简单统一的离散选择框架，用于分析差异化双寡头市场。该框架涵盖了横向与纵向差异化模型，包括标准教科书模型（霍特林模型与谢克德-萨顿模型）。与这些模型不同，该框架同样适用于横向差异化与消费者产品估值正相关并存的经济环境，以及纵向差异化与估值负相关并存的经济环境。本文给出了一个独立于差异化类型及估值相关符号的均衡特征刻画。

url:85ca440452310fc2.abstract: With the rise of new industries, often new jobs emerge. Evolutionary Economic Geography and in particular Industry Life Cycle perspectives predict that these activities first emerge in a limited number of cities to then diffuse to other locations as job descriptions become more standardized. Here, we focus on a particularly important new industry: software development, an activity that is economically important, quickly changing, and has a pronounced spatial concentration in a small number of global IT hubs. We use an online database of over 60 million questions and answers about problems in software development that yields a longitudinal dataset of 237 software skills. By geo-locating 3 million posting users at regular intervals, we link these skills to cities worldwide. We find that, in spite of its digital nature, the software industry exhibits similar spatial regularities as previously observed in more traditional sectors. First, cities diversify into skills that are related to their existing ones. Second, new skills first emerge in cities with large and diversified software sectors, and later diffuse -- mostly unhindered by geographical distance -- to smaller cities specialized in closely related skills. We find suggestive but limited support for a windows of locational opportunity account: although even brand-new skills still emerge first in cities with strong prior specialization in related skills, concentrations of related activities impact less the emergence of new skills than the diffusion of existing ones.
url:85ca440452310fc2.abstract_zh: 随着新兴产业的崛起，新职业往往随之涌现。演化经济地理学，特别是产业生命周期理论预测，这些活动最初会在少数城市出现，随后随着职位描述逐渐标准化而扩散至其他地区。本文聚焦于一个尤为重要的新兴产业——软件开发。这一经济活动具有重要经济价值、快速迭代特征，且高度集中于少数全球IT枢纽城市。我们利用一个包含超过6000万个软件开发问题与答案的在线数据库，构建了涵盖237项软件技能的纵向数据集。通过对300万用户进行定期地理定位，我们将这些技能与全球城市建立关联。研究发现，尽管软件开发具有数字属性，但其空间分布规律与传统行业存在相似性：首先，城市会向与其现有技能相关的领域进行多元化拓展；其次，新技能首先在拥有大规模、多元化软件产业的城市出现，随后——基本不受地理距离阻碍——扩散至专注于紧密关联技能的小型城市。我们发现了支持区位机会窗口理论的有限证据：尽管全新技能仍优先出现在相关技能基础雄厚的城市，但相关活动的集聚程度对新技能涌现的影响，要弱于对现有技能扩散的影响。
url:85ca440452310fc2.title: The Changing Global Division of Labor in Software: Emergence and Diffusion of New Programming Skills across IT Hubs

url:85d70c4ba9d45c12.abstract: We study the aggregation of individuals’ beliefs into their collective judgment on a certain proposition, called the conclusion , which is logically related to other preliminary propositions. While the literature has highlighted the crucial dependency of voting outcomes on the selection of an agenda —i.e., the set of propositions voted on—the structure of this dependency is not well understood. We introduce two novel premise-based rules, defined through the conjunctive normal form and disjunctive normal form of the conclusion. Our theorem shows that for any profile of voters’ beliefs, these rules respectively yield the highest and lowest voting outcomes, with respect to a given total order over the set of truth values, within the class of all premise-based rules. This result clarifies the extent to which a voting outcome can be manipulated through the selection of an agenda. Similar content being viewed by others
url:85d70c4ba9d45c12.abstract_zh: 本文研究个体信念如何聚合为对某一命题（称为“结论”）的集体判断，该结论与其他前提性命题存在逻辑关联。现有文献虽已强调投票结果对议程（即被投票的命题集合）选择的关键依赖性，但这一依赖关系的结构尚未得到充分理解。我们引入两种基于前提的新规则，分别通过结论的合取范式与析取范式进行定义。定理表明：对于任意选民信念分布，在给定真值集合的全序关系下，这两类规则分别在所有基于前提的规则中产生最高与最低的投票结果。该结论揭示了通过议程选择操纵投票结果的可能边界。

url:85eecf6d04ca0b94.abstract: We study whether workplace flexibility is a key driver of the motherhood penalty. Exploiting the sharp and heterogeneous diffusion of work-from-home (WFH) contracts after COVID-19 in a difference-in-differences framework, we combine administrative data on the universe of Italian WFH contracts with matched employer--employee records, mother--father links, fertility records, and firm balance sheets. Greater exposure to flexible work substantially reduces mothers
url:85eecf6d04ca0b94.abstract_zh: 我们研究工作场所灵活性是否为“母职惩罚”的关键驱动因素。利用新冠疫情后居家办公合同在双重差分框架下的急剧且异质性扩散，我们将意大利所有居家办公合同的行政数据与匹配的雇主-雇员记录、母亲-父亲关联数据、生育记录及企业资产负债表相结合。对灵活工作的更高接触显著降低了母亲

url:85f1683c1f854121.abstract: This paper exploits the division of Germany after the Second World War and the reunification of East and West Germany in 1990 as a natural experiment to provide evidence of the importance of market access for economic development. In line with a standard new economic geography model, we find that following division cities in West Germany that were close to the new border between East and West Germany experienced a substantial decline in population growth relative to other West German cities. We provide several pieces of evidence that the decline of the border cities can be entirely accounted for by their loss in market access and is neither driven by differences in industrial structure nor differences in the degree of war related destruction. Finally, we also find some first evidence of a recovery of the border cities after the reunification of East and West Germany.
url:85f1683c1f854121.abstract_zh: 本文利用二战后德国分裂及1990年东西德统一作为自然实验，为市场准入对经济发展的重要性提供了证据。与标准的新经济地理模型一致，我们发现，分裂后，西德靠近东西德新边界的城市相对于其他西德城市经历了人口增长的显著下降。我们提供了多项证据表明，边境城市的衰退完全可归因于其市场准入的丧失，既非产业结构差异所致，也非战争破坏程度差异造成。最后，我们还发现了东西德统一后边境城市复苏的初步证据。
url:85f1683c1f854121.title: The Costs of Remoteness: Evidence from German Division and Reunification

url:861dff724d80274e.abstract: When governments face fiscal stress, they frequently manage consolidation by delaying cash payments on legally incurred obligations rather than cutting explicit appropriations. This "execution wedge" reduces the real resources available for public production while leaving formal appropriations unchanged. We identify the causal effect of this adjustment margin using monthly administrative data from Ecuadors public health system, exploiting institutional features that make the cash execution pipeline observable and its frictions plausibly exogenous. A one-standard-deviation increase in the execution wedge reduces hospital discharges by 19.9 percent and increases the conditional inpatient mortality rate after 48 hours by 59 percent. Conversely, mortality within 48 hours an indicator of patient severity at arrival, is unaffected. These findings demonstrate that payment timing operates as an active fiscal policy variable with first-order welfare costs that are unmeasured in standard fiscal policy analysis.
url:861dff724d80274e.abstract_zh: 当政府面临财政压力时，它们常常通过延迟支付合法产生的债务现金，而非削减明确的拨款，来实施财政整顿。这种“执行缺口”减少了可用于公共生产的实际资源，同时正式拨款保持不变。我们利用厄瓜多尔公共卫生系统的月度行政数据，识别了这一调整边际的因果效应，利用制度特征使现金执行流程可观察，且其摩擦具有合理的外生性。执行缺口每增加一个标准差，医院出院人数减少19.9%，48小时后的条件住院死亡率增加59%。相反，48小时内的死亡率——作为入院时患者严重程度的指标——则不受影响。这些发现表明，支付时点作为一种活跃的财政政策变量，其福利成本的一阶效应在标准财政政策分析中未被计量。
url:861dff724d80274e.title: The Unmeasured Cost of Fiscal Execution: Payment Timing and Public Service Delivery

url:86295fa6a087189a.abstract: We show that credit constraints significantly increase the risk that firms are infiltrated by organized crime, defined as the covert involvement of criminal organizations in corporate decision-making. Using confidential data on criminal investigations, credit ratings, and loan histories for the universe of Italian firms, we find that a downgrade to substandard credit status reduces credit availability by 30% over five years and increases the probability of infiltration by 5%, relative to comparable firms. A local randomization design comparing firms just above and below the downgrade threshold confirms this result. The effect is pervasive across sectors and regions, but particularly strong in real estate, where the probability of infiltration rises by 10% following a downgrade. Infiltrated firms also display higher survival rates than other downgraded firms, despite similar declines in employment and revenues. These findings suggest that organized crime can serve as a financial backstop — sustaining non-viable businesses and potentially redirecting their strategies to serve criminal interests.
url:86295fa6a087189a.abstract_zh: 我们证明，信贷约束显著增加了企业被有组织犯罪渗透的风险——即犯罪组织秘密介入企业决策。基于意大利全体企业的刑事调查、信用评级及贷款历史机密数据，我们发现：相较于可比企业，信用评级降至次级标准的企业五年内信贷可得性下降30%，被渗透概率上升5%。采用降级阈值附近企业的局部随机化设计验证了这一结果。该效应普遍存在于各行业与地区，但在房地产领域尤为显著——降级后该行业企业被渗透概率上升10%。尽管被渗透企业与其它降级企业同样面临就业与收入下滑，但其存活率更高。这些发现表明，有组织犯罪可充当财务后盾——维持无生存能力的企业运营，并可能引导其战略转向服务于犯罪利益。

url:8652b3f4c89965fa.abstract: We document the macroeconomic patterns that characterize labor market recovery from financial crises. Using a sample of postwar recession episodes from around the world, we show that financial crises are typically followed by jobless recoveries, with a sluggish recovery in employment relative to output. A departure from this empirical regularity occurs in emerging-market crises with high inflation, which feature strong employment recoveries but persistent declines in real wages and result in “wageless recoveries.” Our findings highlight the central role of financial components in labor input costs and nominal wage rigidities in shaping labor market dynamics following economic crises.
url:8652b3f4c89965fa.abstract_zh: 本文记录了金融危机后劳动力市场复苏的宏观经济特征。基于全球战后经济衰退案例样本，我们发现金融危机通常伴随无就业复苏，即就业相对于产出的恢复较为缓慢。这一经验规律在新兴市场高通胀危机中出现例外——此类危机呈现强劲的就业复苏，但实际工资持续下降，形成"无工资复苏"现象。研究结果凸显了劳动力投入成本中的金融成分与名义工资刚性在塑造经济危机后劳动力市场动态中的核心作用。

url:868cbbcd2c461f72.abstract: Startup accelerators are a leading gateway to venture capital, but top programs often require founders to relocate to a venture hub. From a hand-collected census of U.S. accelerator startups (2008-2011) followed for five years, we estimate a two-sided matching model that separates two channels behind the gender funding gap, geographic mobility and sorting across accelerator tiers. Women raise about 60% less than men over five years; the gap concentrates among non-relocating women, is largest at active-childrearing ages, and vanishes for relocators, while the mobility cost is near zero for men. Removing mobility frictions raises women's match quality but not their tier; reaching the high-funding top tier also requires removing the sorting disadvantage that women face. The 2012 JOBS Act eased the legal barrier and capacity grew tenfold, yet the U.S. VC dollar gap still tripled (2011-2020): closing it needs mobility, sorting, and capacity together.
url:868cbbcd2c461f72.abstract_zh: 创业加速器是通往风险资本的主要门户，但顶级项目通常要求创始人迁至创业中心。基于一项手工收集的美国加速器初创企业普查数据（2008-2011年，并追踪五年），我们估计了一个双边匹配模型，以分离性别融资差距背后的两个渠道：地理流动性和加速器层级的分类效应。五年间，女性融资额比男性低约60%；这一差距集中在未迁居的女性群体中，在育儿活跃年龄段最为显著，而迁居者的差距则消失，同时男性的流动性成本几乎为零。消除流动性摩擦可提高女性的匹配质量，但无法提升其所在层级；要进入高融资的顶级层级，还需消除女性面临的分类劣势。2012年《创业企业扶助法》降低了法律障碍，加速器容量增长了十倍，但美国风险资本美元差距仍扩大了三倍（2011-2020年）：缩小这一差距需要同时解决流动性、分类和容量问题。

url:87172b609c9b92e5.abstract: Firm organizations are designed to compress unit costs in general, and wage costs in particular. We build on this intuition to study how minimum wages affect firms' organizations, production costs and, ultimately, productivity. To this end, we construct a general equilibrium model in which firms rely on optimal hierarchies to optimize the use of labor and associated knowledge (training). The introduction of a minimum wage constraint in such an environment alters firms' optimal strategies when knowledge acquisition costs are large relative to management costs. We calibrate this model on French data to quantify the impact of the large increases in the minimum wage (up to 8.5% in real terms) that occurred for some firms between 2003 and 2006. We find that the endogenous contraction and flattening responses of firms' organizations strongly contributes to mitigating the overall loss in output (simulated at about 2%). This is driven by gains in revenue productivity (by about 4%) and wages (6.8%), while the impact on quantity-based productivity indices is not monotonic across firm types. These results are confirmed in the French data, both qualitatively and quantitatively, by regression analyses combining difference-in-differences and instrumental variable strategies. Further simulations show that the relative cost of minimum wage constraints tends to be amplified in economies with more efficient communication technologies, and mitigated in economies with more efficient information or problem-solving technologies. However, this last result does not hold for large technological shocks, which suggests that the current waves of new AI-based technologies, as well as the massive investments in communication technologies during the recent Covid-19 pandemic, are likely to necessitate a thorough re-examination of cost-benefit analyses of labor market institutions and regulations.
url:87172b609c9b92e5.abstract_zh: 企业组织设计的核心目标在于压缩单位成本，尤其是工资成本。基于这一直觉，我们研究最低工资如何影响企业组织、生产成本，并最终影响生产率。为此，我们构建了一个一般均衡模型，其中企业通过最优层级结构来优化劳动力使用及其相关知识（培训）的配置。当知识获取成本相对于管理成本较高时，最低工资约束的引入会改变企业的最优策略。我们利用法国数据对该模型进行校准，以量化2003年至2006年间部分企业面临的最低工资大幅上涨（实际涨幅高达8.5%）的影响。研究发现，企业组织的内生性收缩与扁平化调整显著缓解了总产出损失（模拟结果约为2%）。这一调整通过收入生产率提升（约4%）和工资增长（6.8%）实现，但基于数量的生产率指数在不同类型企业间呈现非单调变化。通过结合双重差分法与工具变量策略的回归分析，这些结果在法国数据中得到了定性与定量层面的验证。进一步模拟表明，在通信技术更高效的经济体中，最低工资约束的相对成本会被放大；而在信息或问题解决技术更高效的经济体中，该成本则被缓解。然而，这一结论在面临重大技术冲击时不再成立，这意味着当前基于人工智能的新技术浪潮，以及近期新冠疫情期间对通信技术的大规模投资，可能需要对劳动力市场制度与监管的成本效益分析进行彻底重新审视。

url:8755dc5ee4fb63fb.abstract: We test whether a conditional cash lottery targets prevention on those doing too little because of inverse-S probability distortion that also causes overvaluation of a lottery. Consistent with theory, Filipinos perceiving their cardiovascular disease (CVD) risk in a wide intermediate interval (10%, 85%] are 3 percentage points (60%) less likely to have a check-up before baseline if they exhibit inverse- S distortion. A random lottery offer conditional on going for a check-up (CVD screening) increases the probability by 47 points overall. Estimates of compliance and lottery-induced CVD preventive care are larger (not significantly) for inverse- S (but also S) types perceiving intermediate risk.
url:8755dc5ee4fb63fb.abstract_zh: 我们检验了条件现金彩票是否针对那些因逆S型概率扭曲而预防行为不足的个体，这种扭曲同时导致对彩票的高估。与理论一致，感知自身心血管疾病风险处于宽泛中间区间（10%，85%]的菲律宾人，若表现出逆S型扭曲，则在基线前接受体检的可能性低3个百分点（60%）。一项以接受体检（心血管疾病筛查）为条件的随机彩票提供，总体上将这一概率提高了47个百分点。对逆S型（也包括S型）且感知中等风险的个体，其依从性和彩票诱导的心血管疾病预防护理的估计值更大（虽不显著）。

url:87589d3680e35d55.abstract: We construct standardized climate anomalies from daily observations and carefully calibrate physical thresholds to identify storms, floods, droughts, heatwaves, and cold snaps across 196 countries over the period 1970–2023. Using a local projections framework, we estimate the contemporaneous and 2-year effects of each disaster type and collectively on real GDP growth. We find that storms, floods, droughts, and heatwaves significantly reduce growth on impact (by roughly 0.1–0.2 percentage points on average), with the largest effects observed in emerging markets and developing economies. Cold spells have no statistically significant impacts. Our estimations also indicate that the initial drop in GDP growth is often not fully offset by a quick rebound, leaving GDP below the pre-disaster trend in the subsequent two years. Severe disasters impose far larger costs. Catastrophic floods can lower growth by up to 3 percentage points (with once-in-100-year storms or heatwaves reducing growth by ~0.5pp and extreme droughts by ~1pp). By combining the estimated global coefficients with each country’s own disaster intensity, we translate the aggregate results into localized growth effects and cross-check them against estimates from a dynamic heterogenous panel model. Finally, rolling-window estimates indicate that the contemporaneous growth impact of storms and heatwaves has attenuated in recent decades, whereas droughts have become increasingly damaging, reflecting divergent adaptation or even maladaptation and vulnerability trends over time.
url:87589d3680e35d55.abstract_zh: 我们基于每日观测数据构建了标准化的气候异常指标，并仔细校准了物理阈值，以识别1970-2023年间196个国家的风暴、洪水、干旱、热浪和寒潮事件。通过局部投影框架，我们估算了每种灾害类型及其综合对实际GDP增长的当期影响和两年期效应。研究发现，风暴、洪水、干旱和热浪在冲击当期显著抑制经济增长（平均约0.1-0.2个百分点），其中新兴市场和发展中经济体的影响最为显著。寒潮则未呈现统计显著影响。我们的估算还表明，GDP增长的初始下降通常无法通过快速反弹完全弥补，导致后续两年GDP仍低于灾前趋势水平。严重灾害造成的成本远高于平均水平：灾难性洪水可使增长率下降高达3个百分点（百年一遇的风暴或热浪约降低0.5个百分点，极端干旱约降低1个百分点）。通过将全球估计系数与各国自身灾害强度相结合，我们将汇总结果转化为局部增长效应，并与动态异质性面板模型的估计结果进行交叉验证。最后，滚动窗口估计表明，近几十年来风暴和热浪的当期增长冲击有所减弱，而干旱的破坏性持续增强，这反映了随时间推移出现的适应性分化乃至适应不良与脆弱性趋势的演变。
url:87589d3680e35d55.title: The Growth Effects of Natural Disasters: Evidence From A Novel Global Dataset Over 1970-2023

url:877faa026b931d69.abstract: How do households respond when deposit rates drop below zero? Using administrative micro data and exploiting cross-bank variation in interest rate policies, we study a major episode of negative deposit rates in Denmark affecting two thirds of household deposits. We find that households strongly reduced deposit balances when exposed to negative deposit rates, allocating funds to stock portfolios and consumption. In a large-scale survey, we document important roles for loss aversion, perceived unfairness, intertemporal substitution and return considerations in driving these responses. Our findings suggest that monetary policy can have strong consumption effects in negative territory.
url:877faa026b931d69.abstract_zh: 当存款利率降至负值时，家庭会如何应对？利用行政微观数据并借助银行间利率政策的差异，我们研究了丹麦一次影响三分之二家庭存款的重大负存款利率事件。研究发现，当家庭面临负存款利率时，会大幅减少存款余额，将资金配置至股票投资组合和消费领域。通过大规模调查，我们证实损失厌恶、感知不公、跨期替代及收益考量在驱动这些行为中发挥重要作用。研究结果表明，货币政策在负利率区间可能对消费产生显著影响。

url:87afb75323a06a97.abstract: The alpha male, associated with traditional masculinity features such as competitiveness, assertiveness, and risk tolerance, embodies a biologically grounded dimension of personality. We construct a novel dataset of political leaders' masculinity---measured by facial width-to-height ratio, an established biological marker for traditional masculine behavior driven by testosterone---for more than 2,000 national leaders across 184 countries over 150 years. Leaders’ masculinity has increased over the past 70 years in both democracies and autocracies, across rich and poor countries, and across all regions. Benchmarking against Olympic athletes, Wikipedia-notable individuals, and U.S.\ population data, we document that political leaders exhibit systematically higher masculinity than other groups, in both democracies and autocracies. Leaders' masculinity surges during periods of geopolitical uncertainty, such as the World Wars, the Cold War, and recent decades. Two empirical applications show that masculine leaders are related to democratic change and international war, and these links depend on the institutional environment.
url:87afb75323a06a97.abstract_zh: 阿尔法男性特质，如竞争性、自信和风险承受力，与传统男性气质相关，体现了一种基于生物基础的人格维度。我们构建了一个涵盖150年间184个国家2000多位国家领导人的新型数据集，以面部宽高比（一种由睾酮驱动的传统男性行为的既定生物标志）衡量其男性气质。过去70年间，无论是民主国家还是专制国家、富裕国家还是贫穷国家、以及所有地区，领导人的男性气质均有所上升。通过与奥运运动员、维基百科知名人士及美国人口数据对比，我们发现政治领导人的男性气质在民主和专制国家中均系统性高于其他群体。在地缘政治不确定时期（如两次世界大战、冷战及近几十年），领导人的男性气质显著激增。两项实证研究表明，男性气质与民主变革及国际战争存在关联，且这种关联取决于制度环境。
url:87afb75323a06a97.title: Tha Alpha Politocal Male

url:87b34f87c61cced2.abstract: Discrete policy thresholds are pervasive in tax and regulatory systems and can substantially distort behavior. We show that notches acting as barriers to mobility within a distribution generate distortions extending far beyond the threshold. The same mechanism biases conventional difference-in-differences estimators, and we propose a new methodology to recover causal effects. Applying the method to the abolition of a size-based payroll tax notch, we find that the notch reduced the number of firms above the threshold by 18 percent and lowered treated firms’ employment, capital stock, and value added by 10 percent, whereas conventional difference-in-differences estimates imply negligible effects.
url:87b34f87c61cced2.abstract_zh: 离散政策阈值在税收和监管体系中普遍存在，并可能显著扭曲行为。我们证明，作为分布内流动性障碍的阈值缺口会引发远超阈值本身的扭曲效应。这一机制导致传统双重差分估计量产生偏差，为此我们提出一种恢复因果效应的新方法。将该方法应用于基于企业规模的工资税缺口废除案例，我们发现该缺口使阈值以上企业数量减少18%，并导致受处理企业的就业、资本存量和增加值下降10%，而传统双重差分估计显示的影响可忽略不计。

url:87b73fb1a4f18817.abstract: In his work “A System of Logic”, John Stuart Mill presented four methods of experimental inquiry, structured into five canons, aimed at determining the circumstances that relate to the considered phenomenon by an invariable law. This study delves into Mill’s methods through the lens of social choice theory and discovers the synchronicity between these theories. Our primary finding is that Approval Voting and the Leximax rule are characterized by consistently (and neutrally) extending Mill’s first canon (the method of agreement) and his second canon (the method of difference). Furthermore, we explore the interplay among the five canons. Our findings demonstrate that the Leximax rule successfully adheres to the first four canons while maintaining consistency and neutrality. These results underscore the intricate connection between causal inference and social choice theory, establishing a foundational link for the application of preference aggregation theory to data aggregation in causal inference and vice versa. Similar content being viewed by others
url:87b73fb1a4f18817.abstract_zh: 约翰·斯图尔特·密尔在其著作《逻辑体系》中提出了四种实验探究方法，并将其归纳为五条准则，旨在通过不变法则确定与所考察现象相关的条件。本研究从社会选择理论的视角深入剖析密尔的方法，发现这些理论之间存在同步性。我们的主要发现是：批准投票规则和Leximax规则能够一致且中立地扩展密尔的第一准则（求同法）和第二准则（求异法）。此外，我们探讨了五条准则之间的相互作用。研究结果表明，Leximax规则在保持一致性和中立性的前提下，成功遵循了前四条准则。这些发现凸显了因果推断与社会选择理论之间的复杂联系，为偏好聚合理论在因果推断中的数据聚合应用以及反向应用奠定了基础性关联。

url:881f5b0bd814c764.abstract: This paper estimates Korea's long-run real neutral interest rate and quantifies the structural forces behind its decline since 1990. Using semiannual data for 12 advanced economies over 1990-2024, we estimate a cross-country panel state-space model that separates country-specific productivity and demographic trends from common global components. Korea's neutral rate falls from about 1.6% in 1990 to roughly 0.7% in 2024. The model attributes this decline mainly to slower trend productivity growth, the post-2014 reversal in the working-age population share, and spillovers from major advanced economies. Safe-asset market forces also contribute, but supply and demand effects partly offset each other. Counterfactual simulations suggest that removing global spillovers would raise the 2024 estimate by about 0.6 percentage points, while holding the working-age share at its 2014 level would raise it by about 0.5 percentage points. Conditional demographic scenarios imply continued downward pressure absent offsetting structural changes, highlighting implications for monetary policy space.
url:881f5b0bd814c764.abstract_zh: 本文估算了韩国的长期实际中性利率，并量化了1990年以来其下降背后的结构性因素。利用1990-2024年间12个发达经济体的半年度数据，我们估计了一个跨国面板状态空间模型，该模型将国家特定的生产率和人口趋势与共同的全球成分分离开来。韩国的中性利率从1990年的约1.6%下降至2024年的约0.7%。模型将这一下降主要归因于趋势生产率增长放缓、2014年后劳动年龄人口占比的逆转以及主要发达经济体的溢出效应。安全资产市场力量也起到一定作用，但供给和需求效应部分相互抵消。反事实模拟表明，消除全球溢出效应将使2024年的估计值提高约0.6个百分点，而将劳动年龄人口占比维持在2014年水平则会使估计值提高约0.5个百分点。条件性人口情景表明，若无抵消性结构变化，下行压力将持续存在，这对货币政策空间具有重要启示。

url:883d7e3105a1401a.abstract: How Western donors respond to China’s expanding development finance remains contested, with competing hypotheses and limited systematic evidence. This study estimates the effect of Chinese aid on bilateral official development assistance (ODA) provided by donors in the OECD Development Assistance Committee (OECD-DAC). Using a Poisson pseudo-maximum likelihood estimator on a four-dimensional panel covering 31 donors, 130 recipients, and 13 sectors from 2001 to 2019, the analysis exploits within-recipient-sector-year variation in Chinese aid shocks and incorporates an extensive set of multi-way fixed effects to address endogeneity concerns. While no average competitive response is detected across all donors, we find consistent evidence that Japan systematically increased its ODA commitments in reaction to Chinese engagement—amounting to an estimated US$ 49.2â€¯billion, or 22% of Japan’s total ODA commitments during the study period. Japan’s competitive responses are concentrated in geographically proximate and more democratic recipients, consistent with its geopolitical and normative priorities. No comparable response is detected for other major OECD-DAC donors, including the United States, Germany, France, and the United Kingdom. Taken together, the results show that Japan’s behaviour illustrates how a traditional donor can strategically deploy ODA as part of a broader foreign policy and industrial strategy, while the muted responses of other donors suggest that the OECD-DAC system remains more resilient than often assumed.
url:883d7e3105a1401a.abstract_zh: 西方捐助者如何应对中国不断扩大的发展融资仍存在争议，相关假设相互竞争且缺乏系统性证据。本研究评估了中国援助对经合组织发展援助委员会（OECD-DAC）捐助者提供的双边官方发展援助（ODA）的影响。采用泊松伪极大似然估计法，基于涵盖2001年至2019年31个捐助者、130个受援国及13个行业的四维面板数据，利用受援国-行业-年份层面的中国援助冲击变异，并纳入广泛的多维固定效应以处理内生性问题。尽管未发现所有捐助者存在平均竞争性反应，但研究一致表明日本系统性地增加了其ODA承诺以应对中国的参与——估计金额达492亿美元，占研究期间日本ODA承诺总额的22%。日本的竞争性反应集中于地理邻近且民主程度较高的受援国，这与其地缘政治和规范性优先事项相符。其他主要OECD-DAC捐助者（包括美国、德国、法国和英国）未发现类似反应。综合来看，结果表明日本的行为展示了传统捐助者如何将ODA作为更广泛外交政策和产业战略的一部分进行战略性部署，而其他捐助者的温和反应则表明OECD-DAC体系比通常假设的更具韧性。
url:883d7e3105a1401a.title: Compete or Retreat? Evidence from aid competition between China and Western donor countries

url:886045a17e6357a7.abstract: This paper investigates a unique policy designed to maintain employment during the privatization of East German firms after the fall of the Iron Curtain. The policy required new owners of the firms to commit to employment targets, with penalties for non-compliance. Using a dynamic model, we highlight three channels through which employment targets impact firms: distorted employment decisions, increased productivity, and higher exit rates. Our empirical analysis, using a novel dataset and instrumental variable approach, confirms these findings. We estimate a 22% points higher annual employment growth rate, a 14% points higher annual productivity growth, and a 3.6% points higher probability of exit for firms with binding employment targets. Our calibrated model further demonstrates that without these targets, aggregate employment would have been 15% lower after 10 years. Additionally, an alternative policy of productivity investment subsidies proved costly and less effective in the short term.
url:886045a17e6357a7.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一项旨在铁幕倒塌后东德企业私有化过程中维持就业的特殊政策。该政策要求企业新所有者承诺就业目标，并对未达标者实施处罚。通过构建动态模型，我们揭示了就业目标影响企业的三个渠道：扭曲的雇佣决策、生产率提升以及退出率上升。基于新颖数据集与工具变量法的实证分析证实了上述发现。我们估算出，受约束就业目标的企业年就业增长率高出22个百分点，年生产率增长率高出14个百分点，退出概率高出3.6个百分点。校准模型进一步表明，若无此类目标，十年后总就业量将降低15%。此外，替代性的生产率投资补贴政策在短期内成本高昂且效果欠佳。
url:886045a17e6357a7.title: Committing to Grow: Privatizations and Firm Dynamics in East Germany
url:886045a17e6357a7.title_zh: 承诺增长：东德的私有化与企业动态

url:8861e83bfece8154.abstract: This paper provides causal evidence on how pension income affects labor supply after retirement. We exploit the introduction of the German Earned Income Pension Credit (Grundrente), which permanently increased pension income for retirees with long contribution histories and comparatively low lifetime earnings. The reform generates exogenous variation in non-labor income without creating additional labor supply distortions, allowing us to isolate pure income effects. Using administrative data covering the universe of German retirees and a difference-in-differences design, we find that a 1,200 euro increase in annual pension income reduces unconditional labor earnings by approximately 122 euros, implying a marginal propensity to earn out of unearned income of -0.1. Two thirds of this response reflects extensive margin adjustments, which operate through both increased exit and reduced re-entry, with the remainder driven by intensive margin reductions. Effects are stronger for younger, more labor-market-attached cohorts.
url:8861e83bfece8154.abstract_zh: 本文提供了关于养老金收入如何影响退休后劳动供给的因果证据。我们利用德国劳动收入养老金补贴（Grundrente）的引入，该政策永久性地提高了缴费年限长且终身收入相对较低的退休人员的养老金收入。这项改革在非劳动收入中产生了外生变化，且未造成额外的劳动供给扭曲，从而使我们能够分离出纯粹的收入效应。基于覆盖德国全体退休人员的行政数据及双重差分设计，我们发现年度养老金收入增加1200欧元会使无条件劳动收入减少约122欧元，这意味着非劳动收入的边际劳动收入倾向为-0.1。其中三分之二的效应来自劳动参与边际调整，既通过增加退出也通过减少重新进入实现，其余部分则由劳动强度边际调整驱动。对于更年轻、劳动市场依附性更强的群体，该效应更为显著。
url:8861e83bfece8154.title: DP21645 Pension Income and Post-Retirement Labor Supply
url:8861e83bfece8154.title_zh: DP21645 养老金收入与退休后劳动供给

url:8863600505f057f3.abstract: We study the intergenerational distributional effects of carbon pricing during the green transition in an overlapping-generations New Keynesian model calibrated to euro-area household micro data. Climate policy generates systematic redistribution across cohorts through two channels: a labor-income channel, driven by wage compression and lower labor demand, and a financial-wealth channel, driven by asset revaluation and higher real returns. The labor- income channel dominates quantitatively , generating persistent welfare losses of up to 6 percent in permanent-consumption equivalents for working-age households, while retirees experience comparable gains. Revenue recycling can mitigate these asymmetries, requiring 40 to 68 per- cent of carbon-tax revenues to be directed toward financial-income tax relief. Monetary policy has limited influence on the overall redistributive pattern.
url:8863600505f057f3.abstract_zh: 我们研究了绿色转型过程中碳定价的代际分配效应，基于一个以欧元区家庭微观数据校准的世代交叠新凯恩斯模型。气候政策通过两个渠道在代际间产生系统性再分配：一是劳动收入渠道，由工资压缩和劳动力需求下降驱动；二是金融财富渠道，由资产重估和实际回报率上升驱动。劳动收入渠道在数量上占主导地位，导致劳动年龄家庭的永久消费等价福利损失高达6%，而退休群体则获得相应收益。收入循环利用可缓解这种不对称性，需将40%至68%的碳税收入用于金融收入税减免。货币政策对整体再分配格局的影响有限。
url:8863600505f057f3.title: Intergenerational Redistribution in the Green Transition
url:8863600505f057f3.title_zh: 绿色转型中的代际再分配

url:88992722fb3fc6f9.abstract: We study central bank asset purchases (APs) in bond markets where rational investors face position limits and learn from private signals and market prices. APs affect information aggregation, altering the informativeness of prices and their sensitivity to fundamentals through an information channel distinct from risk-premium effects. Consistent with this mechanism, we find that U.S. Federal Reserve APs strengthened the pass-through of labor market news to Treasury yields. Dispersed beliefs and position limits also provide a microfoundation for the optimality of APs.
url:88992722fb3fc6f9.abstract_zh: 我们研究理性投资者面临头寸限制并从私人信号和市场价格中学习的债券市场中，央行资产购买（APs）的影响。资产购买通过一个区别于风险溢价效应的信息渠道，影响信息聚合，改变价格的信息含量及其对基本面的敏感度。与这一机制一致，我们发现美联储资产购买增强了劳动力市场消息对国债收益率的传导效应。信念分散与头寸限制也为资产购买的最优性提供了微观基础。
url:88992722fb3fc6f9.title: The Information Channel of Asset Purchases

url:889df9ae4be1ab3a.abstract: We propose a data-based approximation of the effects of trade sanctions. We validate the approximation by comparing it with exact responses simulated from a canonical multi-country multi-sector model. The approximation is palatable for a broad range of elasticities of substitution, except for extremely low ones. It is based on a decomposition of high order trade according to destination or inputs markets and can readily be computed on the basis of international input-output data. As such it provides a practical shortcut to evaluating the consequences of trade sanctions without having to make difficult calibration choices. We implement our approximation to evaluate the consequences of trade sanctions between Europe and Russia. Our approximated effects are within the range of existing estimates, but they mask vast asymmetries. First, the effects of sanctions are about fifteen times larger on Russia than on Europe. Second, the effects within Europe are enormously asymmetric, with much larger consequences on ex-“satellite” countries of the Soviet Union than on large Western European economies. We then adapt our approach to show that the most affected European countries do not typically have access to substitute markets and are in fact highly dependent on Russia. We show that this extreme dependence on Russia is at least partly explained by the existence of specific energy transporting infrastructure (pipelines) that appear to constrain tightly the production of electricity in those heavily affected East European economies. These findings illustrate the practical potentiality of our approximation in a variety of different contexts.
url:889df9ae4be1ab3a.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种基于数据的贸易制裁效应近似方法。通过将其与经典多国多部门模型模拟的精确响应进行对比，验证了该近似的有效性。除极低替代弹性情形外，该近似在广泛的替代弹性范围内均具有适用性。其原理基于按目的地或投入品市场分解的高阶贸易结构，可直接利用国际投入产出数据计算。因此，该方法为评估贸易制裁后果提供了实用捷径，无需进行复杂的校准参数选择。我们将该近似方法应用于评估欧俄贸易制裁的后果，所得效应估计值处于现有研究区间内，但揭示了巨大的非对称性：首先，制裁对俄罗斯的影响约为对欧洲影响的十五倍；其次，欧洲内部效应呈现极端非对称性，前苏联"卫星国"遭受的冲击远大于西欧主要经济体。进一步调整方法后发现，受影响最严重的欧洲国家通常缺乏替代市场，且对俄罗斯存在高度依赖。研究表明，这种极端依赖至少部分源于特定能源运输基础设施（管道）的存在——这些设施严重制约了受冲击严重的东欧经济体的电力生产。上述发现充分展示了该近似方法在不同情境下的实践潜力。
url:889df9ae4be1ab3a.title: An Empirical Approximation of the Effects of Trade Sanctions with an Application to Russia
url:889df9ae4be1ab3a.title_zh: 贸易制裁效果的实证近似：以俄罗斯为例
