url:88ee82b55925acee.abstract: We study the liquidity choice of a bank subject to rollover risk and support from a lender of last resort (LLR) and study the consequences for bank stability, funding costs, and liquidity regulation. The liquidity choice balances forgoing profitable yet illiquid investment with fewer panic runs and cheaper debt. A higher LLR penalty rate increases bank liquidity and has a V-shaped effect on ex-ante bank stability. Turning to normative implications, the availability of the LLR reduces welfare for a large social cost of bank failure. The anticipation of ex-post support mitigates panic runs but induces lower bank liquidity ex ante, which increases funding costs and the frequency of bank failure. Liquidity regulation aligns private with social incentives and increases the social value of LLR support.
url:88ee82b55925acee.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一家面临展期风险并接受最后贷款人（LLR）支持的银行的流动性选择，并探讨了其对银行稳定性、融资成本及流动性监管的影响。流动性选择需要在放弃盈利但缺乏流动性的投资与减少恐慌性挤兑及降低债务成本之间进行权衡。更高的LLR惩罚利率会提升银行流动性，并对事前银行稳定性产生V形效应。从规范意义上看，LLR的可得性在银行破产社会成本较高时会降低社会福利。对事后支持的预期虽能缓解恐慌性挤兑，但会降低银行事前流动性，从而增加融资成本及银行破产频率。流动性监管能够协调私人激励与社会激励，并提升LLR支持的社会价值。
url:88ee82b55925acee.title: Bank Runs, Lender of Last Resort, and Liquidity Regulation
url:88ee82b55925acee.title_zh: 银行挤兑、最后贷款人与流动性监管

url:88f0b1426175d348.abstract: Why do political campaigns so often yield unexpected results? We address this question by separately estimating the direct effect of a campaign on targeted voters and the indirect effect on others in the same social environment. Partnering with a local NGO during Argentina’s 2023 presidential election, we randomized the distribution of leaflets providing an expert assessment of the consequences of the potentially dangerous proposals by the outsider candidate Javier Milei. Exploiting Argentina’s unique sub-precinct election reporting system, we show that the campaign reduced Milei’s support among directly treated voters, as expected, but increased his support among untreated voters in treated precincts, producing a backfiring, net-positive effect for Milei. A pre-registered replication confirmed these opposite-signed effects. Using theory and a survey experiment, we show that the minority of voters who disbelieved the campaign were more motivated to discuss it with peers, convincing them to support Milei. This mobilization effect appears especially likely when campaigns criticize outsider candidates. Our results highlight how campaigns aimed at anti-elite candidates can unintentionally mobilize support for them.
url:88f0b1426175d348.abstract_zh: 为何政治竞选活动常常产生出人意料的结果？我们通过分别估算竞选活动对目标选民的直接影响，以及对同一社会环境中其他选民的间接影响来探讨这一问题。在阿根廷2023年总统大选期间，我们与一家当地非政府组织合作，随机分发传单，内容为专家对局外人候选人哈维尔·米莱提出的潜在危险提案后果的评估。利用阿根廷独特的次选区选举报告系统，我们发现，该竞选活动如预期般降低了直接受干预选民对米莱的支持率，但反而提高了受干预选区中未受干预选民对他的支持率，从而对米莱产生了适得其反的净正面效应。一项预先注册的复制实验证实了这些符号相反的效应。通过理论分析和调查实验，我们证明，少数不相信该竞选活动的选民更有动力与同伴讨论此事，从而说服他们支持米莱。这种动员效应在竞选活动批评局外人候选人时尤为显著。我们的研究结果凸显了针对反精英候选人的竞选活动如何可能无意中为其动员支持。

url:89753faae5705b13.abstract: Market thinness can be an important determinant of the riskiness of stock returns, because it reduces the reliability of stock prices as predictors of future dividends. This paper analyses the relationship between market size and risk as the outcome of rational expectations equilibrium in a multiasset model with transaction costs, and shows that: (i) the conditional and measured variance of stock returns should be higher for thin issues ceteris paribus, and (ii) this thinness-variability relationship should arise only from the unsystematic component of the variance. These predictions are tested on data from the Milan Stock Exchange and appear to be supported by the evidence.
url:89753faae5705b13.abstract_zh: 市场流动性不足可能是股票收益风险性的重要决定因素，因为它降低了股票价格作为未来股息预测指标的可靠性。本文通过构建包含交易成本的多资产模型，将市场规模与风险的关系分析为理性预期均衡的结果，并表明：（i）在其他条件相同的情况下，流动性较差的股票其条件方差与已实现方差应更高；（ii）这种流动性-波动性关系应仅源于方差的非系统性成分。这些预测在米兰证券交易所的数据中得到检验，且实证结果支持上述结论。

url:89a0d60462012034.abstract: This study investigates the effect of the large shock to energy prices following the Russian invasion of Ukraine on bank credit to firms. To isolate the causal effect of the shock, it compares bank lending to high-energy-intensive firms to that of similar low-energy-intensive firms. Following the shock, bank credit to high-energy-intensive firms persistently declined, while their interest rates on new loans rose and other loan terms tightened. Across the distribution, safer firms reduced outstanding credit lines and paid unchanged interest rates on new bank loans, while riskier firms borrowed at higher interest rates. JEL Classification: G21, G32, Q43
url:89a0d60462012034.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了俄乌冲突后能源价格大幅冲击对企业银行信贷的影响。为隔离该冲击的因果效应，本文对比了银行对高能耗企业与类似低能耗企业的贷款情况。冲击发生后，银行对高能耗企业的信贷持续下降，同时其新增贷款利率上升，其他贷款条件收紧。从分布特征来看，风险较低的企业减少了未偿信贷额度，且新增银行贷款利率保持不变；而风险较高的企业则以更高利率借款。JEL分类号：G21, G32, Q43

url:89c59dd2b67c8109.abstract: Informal commercialisation of agricultural products is widespread in Colombian food systems. It plays a central role in supporting rural livelihoods and affordable food access, but may limit value creation, create fiscal pressures, and undermine the evidence base for policymaking. This paper examines why small-scale farmers in Colombia rely on informal markets, with particular attention to Afro-Colombian and Indigenous communities. It situates informality within the broader context of rural areas and the structure of the agri-food supply chain. It proposes a characterisation of the main barriers that hinder small-scale farmers’ engagement with formal buyers, drawing on desk research and interviews with government officials, industry stakeholders, community representatives, and academics. It suggests that formal market participation could be facilitated by prioritising the provision of rural public goods, improving data and evidence on informality in food systems, better aligning agricultural policies with producer-financed parafiscal funds, and adopting a demand-driven approach to agricultural policy.
url:89c59dd2b67c8109.abstract_zh: 农产品非正规商业化在哥伦比亚食品体系中普遍存在。它在支撑农村生计和保障食品可负担性方面发挥着核心作用，但可能限制价值创造、造成财政压力，并削弱政策制定的证据基础。本文探讨了哥伦比亚小农户依赖非正规市场的原因，特别关注非裔哥伦比亚人和原住民社区。研究将非正规性置于农村地区及农业食品供应链结构的更广泛背景下，通过案头研究及对政府官员、行业利益相关者、社区代表和学者的访谈，提出了阻碍小农户与正规买家合作的主要障碍特征。研究表明，通过优先提供农村公共产品、改善食品体系中非正规性的数据与证据、更好地协调农业政策与生产者资助的准财政基金，以及采取需求导向的农业政策方法，可促进正规市场参与。

url:89d27642a6b06576.abstract: Using genealogical records of Chinese families from 1300 to 1920, this paper examines how the fundamental wheels of change identified by Unified Growth Theory operated within the Ming–Qing context. It finds that families with moderate fertility were more likely to attain higher levels of education and to experience greater reproductive success across generations, revealing a trade-off between high fertility and long-term lineage outcomes. Employing negative binomial regression and instrumental variable methods, the study shows that a preference for child quality conferred an evolutionary advantage—suggesting that, if this evolutionary pattern was present globally during the epoch of stagnation, it may have been central to the demographic transition and the emergence of modern economic growth.
url:89d27642a6b06576.abstract_zh: 本文利用1300年至1920年间中国家族谱系记录，考察统一增长理论所识别的变革基本动力在明清时期的运作机制。研究发现，适度生育水平的家族更可能获得更高教育成就，并在代际间实现更优的繁衍成功，揭示了高生育率与长期宗族发展之间的权衡关系。通过采用负二项回归与工具变量方法，研究表明对子女质量的偏好赋予了进化优势——这意味着，若该进化模式在停滞时代全球范围内普遍存在，则可能对人口转型与现代经济增长的出现具有核心作用。

url:89f3883ac768061c.abstract: This paper develops a dynamic model of seigniorage in which economies' equilibrium paths reflect the ongoing strategic interaction between an optimizing government and a rational public. The model extends existing positive models of monetary policy and inflation by explicitly incorporating the intertemporal linkages among budget deficits, debt and inflation. A central finding is that the public's rational responses to government policies may well create incentives for the government to reduce inflation and the public debt over time. A sufficiently myopic government may, however, provoke a rising equilibrium path of inflation and public debt.
url:89f3883ac768061c.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个铸币税的动态模型，其中经济体的均衡路径反映了最优化政府与理性公众之间持续的策略互动。该模型通过明确纳入预算赤字、债务与通胀之间的跨期关联，拓展了现有的货币政策和通胀实证模型。核心发现是：公众对政府政策的理性反应很可能随时间推移为政府创造降低通胀和公共债务的激励。然而，一个足够短视的政府可能引发通胀与公共债务不断攀升的均衡路径。

url:8a4d77e32aaa0e1a.abstract: this paper is to understand the implications for consumption and portfolio choice of the separation of an investor?s risk aversion and elasticity of intertemporal substitution that is made possible by recursive utility, in contrast to expected utility, where the two are governed by the same parameter. In particular, we study exactly how risk aversion and elasticity of intertemporal substitution affect optimal dynamic consumption and portfolio decisions. For a three-date, discrete-time model with a stochastic interest rate, we obtain an exact analytic solution for the optimal consumption and portfolio policies. We find that, in general, the consumption and portfolio decisions depend on both risk aversion and the elasticity of intertemporal substitution. Only in the case where the investment opportunity set is constant, is the optimal portfolio weight independent of the elasticity of intertemporal substitution. We also find that the size of risk aversion relative to unity determines the sign of the intertemporal hedging component in the optimal portfolio, while elasticity of intertemporal substitution affects only the magnitude of the hedging component.
url:8a4d77e32aaa0e1a.abstract_zh: 本文旨在理解递归效用（recursive utility）相较于预期效用（expected utility）所实现的投资者风险厌恶（risk aversion）与跨期替代弹性（elasticity of intertemporal substitution）分离对消费与投资组合选择的影响——在预期效用框架下，两者由同一参数决定。具体而言，我们精确研究了风险厌恶与跨期替代弹性如何影响最优动态消费与投资组合决策。针对一个包含随机利率的三期离散时间模型，我们推导出最优消费与投资组合策略的精确解析解。研究发现，一般而言，消费与投资组合决策同时取决于风险厌恶与跨期替代弹性。仅当投资机会集恒定时，最优投资组合权重才独立于跨期替代弹性。此外，风险厌恶相对于1的大小决定了最优投资组合中跨期对冲成分的符号，而跨期替代弹性仅影响该对冲成分的规模。
url:8a4d77e32aaa0e1a.title: The Role of Risk Aversion and Intertemporal Substitution in Dynamic Consumption-Portfolio Choicewith Recursive Utility

url:8ac0993c13caca97.abstract: Despite documented heterogeneity in volatility dynamics across the option surface, standard implied volatility forecasting models apply homogeneous parameters throughout. We introduce a machine-learning framework that uses regression trees to partition the surface along both moneyness and maturity dimensions, identifying data-driven regions where distinct forecasting models perform best. Extending the Surface Heterogeneous Autoregressive (SHAR) framework of Dufays, Jacobs, and Rombouts (2025), we develop tree-based SHAR specifications that preserve interpretable structure while allowing model parameters to vary across the surface. Empirical analysis using S&P 500 options demonstrates that the boosted tree-based specification achieves the lowest out-of-sample forecast errors across all horizons, reducing one-month-ahead RMSE by 13 percent versus the benchmark SHAR model. The improvements are statistically significant and particularly pronounced during stress periods. The estimated tree presents economically interpretable segmentation: short-dated options exhibit higher daily persistence but lower monthly persistence than long-dated options, while deep out-of-the-money calls or puts display distinct dynamics from near-the-money contracts.
url:8ac0993c13caca97.abstract_zh: 尽管期权曲面上的波动率动态存在显著异质性，但标准隐含波动率预测模型在整个曲面上均采用同质参数。我们引入一种基于回归树的机器学习框架，沿期限与执行价两个维度对曲面进行划分，识别出不同预测模型表现最优的数据驱动区域。通过扩展Dufays、Jacobs与Rombouts（2025）提出的曲面异质自回归（SHAR）框架，我们开发了基于树的SHAR模型，在保持可解释结构的同时允许模型参数随曲面位置变化。基于标普500期权的实证分析表明，增强型树模型在所有预测期限上均实现最低的样本外预测误差，将一个月前瞻均方根误差较基准SHAR模型降低13%。该改进具有统计显著性，且在压力时期尤为突出。估计树呈现经济可解释的分段特征：短期期权较长期期权具有更高的日度持续性但更低的月度持续性，而深度虚值看涨/看跌期权则展现出与平值期权截然不同的动态特征。
url:8ac0993c13caca97.title: Capturing Heterogeneity: Machine Learning Approaches to Implied Volatility Forecasting

url:8ae2d3fbc9fed20c.abstract: We study how sovereign risk fluctuations propagate to the real economy when banks hold long-term public debt. Using Italian data, we decompose spread-implied default probabilities into a systematic debt-driven component and an exogenous component capturing shifts in perceived sovereign risk. We embed this decomposition in a quantitative New-Keynesian model with constrained financial intermediaries and endogenous default risk, solved to a third order and estimated by simulated method of moments. Higher perceived default risk lowers sovereign bond prices, weakens bank net worth, tightens intermediary constraints, and depresses investment and output. Because default risk also responds to debt dynamics, the downturn amplifies sovereign risk through a sovereign-bank loop. We find that sovereign risk shocks account for about one fifth of output fluctuations and roughly one third of welfare costs at the business cycle frequency. Fiscal policy can mitigate this loop, but only by moving distortionary taxes. Consumption-tax rules deliver the largest welfare gains, whereas deficit-based rules can generate excessive tax volatility and large welfare losses.
url:8ae2d3fbc9fed20c.abstract_zh: 我们研究了当银行持有长期公共债务时，主权风险波动如何传导至实体经济。利用意大利数据，我们将利差隐含的违约概率分解为系统性债务驱动成分和捕捉主权风险认知变化的外生成分。我们将这一分解嵌入一个包含受约束金融中介机构和内生违约风险的定量新凯恩斯模型中，该模型求解至三阶，并通过模拟矩估计法进行估计。更高的感知违约风险会降低主权债券价格，削弱银行净值，收紧中介约束，并抑制投资和产出。由于违约风险也会对债务动态做出反应，经济衰退通过主权-银行循环放大了主权风险。我们发现，主权风险冲击解释了约五分之一的产出波动以及商业周期频率下约三分之一的福利成本。财政政策可以缓解这一循环，但只能通过调整扭曲性税收来实现。消费税规则带来最大的福利收益，而基于赤字规则可能引发过度的税收波动和巨大的福利损失。
url:8ae2d3fbc9fed20c.title: DP21800 Sovereign Risk Shocks and Fiscal Rules
url:8ae2d3fbc9fed20c.title_zh: DP21800 主权风险冲击与财政规则

url:8b03cbbeec8ea602.abstract: This paper examines long-run unconditional convergence of labour productivity in manufacturing across 48 contiguous U.S. states. For that purpose, we construct a detailed panel data set of state-industry pairs with over 120 industries covering the period 1880-2007. We find that unconditional β-convergence in manufacturing productivity was pervasive and rapid – 7.6% per year in 1880-2007 – and that manufacturing accounts for most of the unconditional convergence contribution to overall productivity growth over the long run: 61% in 1880-1940 and 91% in 1958-2007. We also examined broad U.S. regions and found that in the South the contribution of unconditional β-convergence in manufacturing to aggregate productivity growth before World War II was weak not because of a slower convergence rate but a much smaller manufacturing sector.
url:8b03cbbeec8ea602.abstract_zh: 本文考察了美国本土48个州制造业劳动生产率的长期无条件收敛性。为此，我们构建了一个涵盖1880-2007年、包含120多个行业的州-行业配对面板数据集。研究发现，制造业生产率的无条件β收敛具有普遍性与快速性——1880-2007年间年均收敛率为7.6%——且制造业对长期总体生产率增长中无条件收敛的贡献占比最大：1880-1940年间为61%，1958-2007年间为91%。我们还考察了美国主要区域，发现二战前美国南部地区制造业无条件β收敛对总体生产率增长的贡献较弱，其原因并非收敛速度较慢，而是制造业部门规模过小。
url:8b03cbbeec8ea602.title: DP18065 Unconditional Convergence in Manufacturing Productivity across U.S. States: What the Long-Run Data Show
url:8b03cbbeec8ea602.title_zh: DP18065 美国各州制造业生产率的无条件收敛：长期数据的启示

url:8b0748b8741bba19.abstract: Through a cluster randomised field trial, we evaluate the impact of an evidence-based, soft skills curriculum aimed at adolescents, referred to as Healthy Minds, that ran in 35 high schools in England over four years (2013/14 – 2017/18). We find supportive evidence that Healthy Minds positively augments the primary outcome of self-reported physical health in the treated adolescents. Treated pupils have global health attainment that is 0.235 standard deviations higher than children in the control group, resulting in a 10-percentile increase in their measured health status. We also find evidence of positive impacts on behaviour. There is no evidence of impacts on improved emotional wellbeing. We note significant gender differences in the effects found, strongly favouring boys. Overall, we provide strong evidence that a designed, taught life skills curriculum can improve related outcomes during the adolescent years, and that differential learning styles across visible aspects of diversity are worthy of consideration Healthy Minds.
url:8b0748b8741bba19.abstract_zh: 通过一项整群随机实地试验，我们评估了一项名为“健康心智”的循证软技能课程对青少年的影响。该课程在英国35所高中开展了四年（2013/14至2017/18学年）。研究发现支持性证据表明，“健康心智”课程显著提升了受试青少年自我报告的身体健康这一主要结果。接受干预的学生整体健康水平比对照组儿童高出0.235个标准差，相当于其测量健康状态提升了10个百分点。我们还发现了该课程对行为产生积极影响的证据，但未发现其对情绪健康改善有显著作用。值得注意的是，干预效果存在显著的性别差异，且明显更有利于男生。总体而言，我们提供了有力证据，表明设计并教授的生活技能课程能够改善青少年时期的相关结果，同时，在可见的多样性维度上，差异化的学习风格值得在“健康心智”课程中加以考量。
url:8b0748b8741bba19.title: The impact on adolescent health and wellbeing from adding evidence-based soft skill lessons to the high school curriculum
url:8b0748b8741bba19.title_zh: 在高中课程中加入循证软技能课程对青少年健康与福祉的影响

url:8b08cb643d8c842d.abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic has caused major disruptions in international trade and has raised concerns about adverse effects on international supply chains. Using a unique establishment survey matched with administrative data from Germany, we provide novel evidence on how establishments have adjusted their supply chains in response to pandemic-induced disruptions. We find that establishments that experienced difficulties in obtaining intermediate inputs as a result of the pandemic are significantly more likely to change their network of suppliers than establishments without such problems, especially if disruptions affected imports from abroad. Establishments experiencing supply chain difficulties are more likely to replace a distant with a closer supplier. However, these adjustments in response to the pandemic appear to be temporary.
url:8b08cb643d8c842d.abstract_zh: COVID-19疫情对国际贸易造成了重大冲击，并引发了对国际供应链负面影响的担忧。通过将德国独特的机构调查数据与行政数据相匹配，我们提供了关于机构如何应对疫情引发的供应链中断而进行调整的新证据。研究发现，因疫情而面临中间投入品获取困难的机构，其调整供应商网络的可能性显著高于未遭遇此类问题的机构，尤其是当供应链中断影响到海外进口时。遭遇供应链困难的机构更倾向于用距离更近的供应商替代距离较远的供应商。然而，这些针对疫情的调整似乎是暂时性的。
url:8b08cb643d8c842d.title: The COVID-19 Pandemic and International Supply Chains
url:8b08cb643d8c842d.title_zh: 新冠疫情与国际供应链

url:8b180724a8c9ec03.abstract: This paper argues that domestic social conflicts are a key to understanding why growth rates lack persistence and why so many countries have experienced a growth collapse after the mid-1970s. It emphasizes, in particular, the manner in which social conflicts interact with external shocks on the one hand, and the domestic institutions of conflict-management on the other. Econometric evidence provides support for this hypothesis. Countries that experienced the sharpest drops in growth after 1975 were those with divided societies (as measured by indicators of inequality, ethnic fragmentation etc) and with weak institutions of conflict management (proxied by indicators of the quality of governmental institutions, rule of law, democratic rights, and social safety nets).
url:8b180724a8c9ec03.abstract_zh: 本文认为，国内社会冲突是理解经济增长率缺乏持续性以及20世纪70年代中期后众多国家经历增长崩溃的关键因素。研究特别强调社会冲突如何一方面与外部冲击相互作用，另一方面与国内冲突管理机制相互影响。计量经济学证据支持这一假说：1975年后增长降幅最大的国家，正是那些社会分裂程度较高（以不平等程度、族群碎片化等指标衡量）且冲突管理机制薄弱（以政府机构质量、法治水平、民主权利及社会安全网等指标为代理变量）的国家。
url:8b180724a8c9ec03.title: DP1789 Where Did all the Growth Go? External Shocks, Social Conflict and Growth Collapses

url:8b62a429d9ac577d.abstract: This paper addresses the lack of official data on Indian poverty between 2011-12 and 2022-23, a period known as the "missing decade". It critiques two major attempts to estimate poverty during this time: one using national account growth rates and the other using a private survey. These methods are criticised for their assumptions and data limitations. The paper proposes a new method, imputing consumption from official labour force surveys using a wage-based model. The authors find that poverty reduction was not as dramatic as previously suggested, with about 20% of Indians living in poverty on the eve of the pandemic. The paper's analysis aligns with the fact that India's structural economic transformation was limited, with agriculture output stagnant and regional convergence lacking. The paper concludes that while poverty may have gone down, but its rate of decline has been slow in the decade after 2011-12.
url:8b62a429d9ac577d.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了2011-12年至2022-23年间印度贫困数据缺失的问题，这一时期被称为“缺失的十年”。文章批判了在此期间估算贫困的两种主要方法：一种基于国民账户增长率，另一种依赖私人调查数据。这两种方法因其假设条件和数据局限性而受到质疑。本文提出了一种新方法，即利用基于工资的模型，从官方劳动力调查中推算消费数据。作者发现，贫困减少的幅度并不像此前所暗示的那样显著，疫情前夕约有20%的印度人生活在贫困中。本文的分析与印度结构性经济转型有限的事实相符，表现为农业产出停滞且缺乏区域趋同。文章得出结论：尽管贫困可能有所减少，但2011-12年后的十年间，其下降速度一直较为缓慢。
url:8b62a429d9ac577d.title: Reassessing India’s Poverty Decline over the Missing Decade: 2011-12 to 2022-23
url:8b62a429d9ac577d.title_zh: 重新评估印度“缺失十年”（2011-12至2022-23）的贫困下降

url:8b62b5a261bd8e66.abstract: We examine whether research systems reallocate scientific effort as health needs change. We assemble a global disease--location panel for 204 countries and territories (1990--2021) by linking disease-specific publication output to disease burden in the same place and year. Using large language models, we extract diseases from article text, map them into a standardized disease classification, and classify research funders by type. Empirically, we estimate how publication output co-moves with disease burden within countries and diseases over time, and we use event-study difference-in-differences designs that exploit plausibly exogenous variation from the timing of outbreak alerts. We find that responsiveness to endemic burden has increased over time but remains highly uneven across locations; outbreak alerts trigger rapid, statistically significant research surges that have strengthened in recent years; and funding composition is strongly associated with adjustment dynamics, with philanthropic and government-supported research contributing disproportionately to responsiveness growth in lower-income settings.
url:8b62b5a261bd8e66.abstract_zh: 我们考察研究体系是否随着健康需求的变化而重新配置科研力量。通过将特定疾病的出版产出与同一地点和年份的疾病负担相关联，我们构建了一个覆盖204个国家和地区（1990-2021年）的全球疾病-地点面板数据。利用大型语言模型，我们从文章文本中提取疾病信息，将其映射到标准化的疾病分类中，并按类型对研究资助者进行分类。在实证分析中，我们估计了出版产出如何随国家内部和疾病随时间变化的疾病负担而共同变动，并采用事件研究双重差分设计，利用疫情警报时间点带来的看似外生的变异。我们发现，对地方性流行负担的响应性随时间增强，但在不同地点间仍高度不均；疫情警报会引发快速且统计上显著的研究激增，且近年来这种激增有所加强；资助构成与调整动态密切相关，其中慈善和政府支持的研究在低收入环境中的响应性增长中贡献尤为突出。
url:8b62b5a261bd8e66.title: (How) Do Health Shocks Reallocate Research Direction?
url:8b62b5a261bd8e66.title_zh: 健康冲击如何（以及是否）重新配置研究方向？

url:8b90432a1460038b.abstract: This paper examines life-cycle patterns of earnings and consumption inequality in a developing economy, focusing on employment informality, risk sharing, and the impacts of the COVID-19 pandemic. Using household survey data from Thailand, with robustness checks for Indonesia and Vietnam, we find that in Thailand both earnings and consumption inequality rise with age during prime working years, and earnings inequality continues to increase after retirement. Inequality patterns differ by employment status: formalworker- headed households show limited risk sharing at younger ages, while informal-worker-headed households display flatter consumption-inequality profiles, with consumption inequality generally below earnings inequality. During the COVID-19 period, overall inequality declined, but consumption inequality increased among younger households. Finally, a standard life-cycle model calibrated to match earnings inequality fails to replicate the observed age profile of consumption inequality, suggesting that key developing-economy features, such as informal insurance mechanisms, are not fully captured.
url:8b90432a1460038b.abstract_zh: 本文考察了发展中经济体中收入与消费不平等在生命周期中的模式，重点关注就业非正规性、风险分担以及新冠疫情的影响。利用泰国家庭调查数据，并以印度尼西亚和越南进行稳健性检验，我们发现：在泰国，收入不平等和消费不平等在主要工作年龄阶段均随年龄增长而上升，且收入不平等在退休后继续加剧。不平等模式因就业状态而异：以正规工人为户主的家庭在年轻时风险分担有限，而以非正规工人为户主的家庭则呈现更平缓的消费不平等曲线，且消费不平等通常低于收入不平等。新冠疫情期间，总体不平等有所下降，但年轻家庭的消费不平等却有所上升。最后，一个为匹配收入不平等而校准的标准生命周期模型未能复现观测到的消费不平等年龄分布，这表明发展中经济体的关键特征（如非正式保险机制）未被充分捕捉。
url:8b90432a1460038b.title: Consumption Inequality, Life-Cycle Risk Sharing and the COVID-19 Crisis in a Developing Economy: Evidence from Thailand, Indonesia and Vietnam
url:8b90432a1460038b.title_zh: 消费不平等、生命周期风险分担与发展中经济体的新冠疫情危机：来自泰国、印度尼西亚和越南的证据

url:8ba7532a37fbf5fc.abstract: At the COVID-19 pandemic's onset, the federal government enacted substantial changes impacting both the revenues and expenditures connected to states' Medicaid programs through a pair of provisions in the March 2020 Families First Coronavirus Response Act. These included a 6.2 percentage point increase in states' Federal Medical Assistance Percentages (FMAP), which raised states' revenues, contingent on adherence to a continuous coverage requirement. The latter provision raised expenditures by preventing the disenrollment of individuals whose eligibility would otherwise have lapsed due to changes in income or other eligibility-relevant circumstances. While these provisions were ex-ante expected to result in expenditures and costs of similar magnitudes, the ex-post realizations remain unquantified. Nationwide, we estimate that states’ share of the continuous coverage provision's costs was $139.2 billion, which is roughly $11.0 billion less than the revenues states received, in aggregate, through increased FMAPs. Revenues and costs varied substantially across states, however, with costs exceeding revenues by as much as $594 per capita, and revenues exceeding costs by as much as $838 per capita. The baseline parameters governing the federal government's share of states' Medicaid expenditures emerge as a key driver of the extent to which the continuous coverage requirement can be viewed as an unfunded federal mandate.
url:8ba7532a37fbf5fc.abstract_zh: 在新冠疫情初期，联邦政府通过2020年3月《家庭优先新冠病毒应对法案》中的两项条款，对各州医疗补助计划的收入和支出实施了重大调整。这些条款包括将各州的联邦医疗援助比例（FMAP）提高6.2个百分点，从而增加各州收入，但前提是各州必须遵守持续参保要求。后者通过阻止因收入或其他资格相关情况变化而本应失去资格的参保者退出计划，增加了支出。尽管这些条款在事前预期将产生规模相近的支出和成本，但事后实际结果尚未量化。在全美范围内，我们估计各州承担的持续参保条款成本为1392亿美元，这比各州通过提高FMAP获得的收入总额少约110亿美元。然而，各州的收入和成本差异显著，成本超过收入的情况最高达人均594美元，而收入超过成本的情况最高达人均838美元。决定联邦政府承担各州医疗补助支出份额的基准参数，成为衡量持续参保要求是否可被视为无资金支持的联邦指令的关键因素。

url:8c61dc9b6fd4aa55.abstract: We consider strategy-proof social choice correspondences (SCCs) –mappings from preference profiles to sets of alternatives– when individuals are endowed with single-peaked preferences over alternatives. We interpret the selected sets of alternatives as the basis for lotteries that determine the final social choice, and consider that agents’ preferences over sets are consistent with Expected Utility Theory and Bayesian updating from an initial probability assessment over the full set of alternatives. We exploit the relation between SCCs and probabilistic decision schemes –mappings from preference profiles to lotteries over alternatives–, to characterize the family of SCCs that satisfy strategy-proofness and unanimity for arbitrary initial probability assessments. We extend the analysis to multi-dimensional convex spaces of alternatives under the uniform initial probability assessment.
url:8c61dc9b6fd4aa55.abstract_zh: 本文考虑策略性防策略的社会选择对应（SCCs）——即从偏好分布到备选方案集合的映射——当个体对备选方案具有单峰偏好时。我们将所选的备选方案集合视为决定最终社会选择的抽签基础，并假设个体对集合的偏好与期望效用理论一致，且基于对全部备选方案的初始概率评估进行贝叶斯更新。通过利用SCCs与概率决策方案（即从偏好分布到备选方案抽签的映射）之间的关系，我们刻画了在任意初始概率评估下满足策略防策略性和一致性的SCCs族。在均匀初始概率评估假设下，我们将分析扩展至多维凸空间中的备选方案。
url:8c61dc9b6fd4aa55.title: Strategy-Proof social choice correspondences and single-peaked preferences

url:8ca3ae8ac169349f.abstract: With soaring domestic demand, Ghana has become highly dependent on imported rice, thereby tying domestic rice prices more closely to international prices. This study aims to analyze how international and domestic rice prices interact, as well as how imported prices affect domestic prices across regions. This study applies the Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL) model to analyze the long-run relationships and short-run dynamics of imported prices, domestic prices, world prices, and overall inflation. The data used are monthly data from ten major rice markets in Ghana for the period 2012 to 2024. The results indicate a long-run relationship between imported and domestic rice prices, and some degree of integration with the global market. Price transmission is faster in coastal markets but slower in the north, where shocks can take more than a year to be reflected in local prices. Ineffective policies, poor infrastructure, and macroeconomic instability explain why Ghana is largely a price taker. This study clarifies region-specific cross-market price transmission, identifying a clear south-north transmission gradient and slower adjustment speeds compared to those found in previous studies.
url:8ca3ae8ac169349f.abstract_zh: 随着国内需求激增，加纳对进口大米的依赖程度显著提高，国内大米价格与国际价格的关联性也随之增强。本研究旨在分析国际与国内大米价格之间的互动机制，以及进口价格如何影响各地区国内价格。研究采用自回归分布滞后（ARDL）模型，分析进口价格、国内价格、世界价格及整体通胀之间的长期关系与短期动态。数据涵盖2012年至2024年加纳十大主要大米市场的月度数据。结果表明，进口大米价格与国内大米价格存在长期关系，且与全球市场存在一定程度的整合。沿海市场的价格传导速度较快，而北部地区则较慢，冲击可能需要一年以上才能反映在当地价格中。政策失效、基础设施薄弱及宏观经济不稳定解释了加纳为何在很大程度上是价格接受者。本研究厘清了特定区域的跨市场价格传导机制，识别出明显的南-北传导梯度，且调整速度较以往研究更慢。
url:8ca3ae8ac169349f.title: Price Transmission Dynamics in Ghana fs Rice Market: Spatial and Macroeconomic Analysis
url:8ca3ae8ac169349f.title_zh: 加纳大米市场价格传导动态：空间与宏观经济分析

url:8cc6aca8d7dd155f.title: Does strategic cooperation between banks and fintech companies increase bank risk-taking? Evidence from China
url:8cc6aca8d7dd155f.title_zh: 银行与金融科技公司的战略合作是否增加了银行风险承担？来自中国的证据

url:8ccb3c32bd1dba6c.abstract: Accurate stock price forecasting has consistently remained a pivotal yet challenging FinTech task that underpins quantitative trading and investment decision making. Recent efforts have been dedicated to modeling various complex relationships among stocks in the stock market toward more reliable stock price forecasting.These methods depend heavily on strong static prior assumptions by modeling either temporal dependencies within individual stocks or spatial dependencies across different stocks based on predefined structures, while the complex market dynamics that drive stock price movements remain unexplored. To alleviate this issue, we propose a novel game-theoretic modeling method that captures heterogeneous investor interactions for stock price forecasting. The core idea is to embed game-theoretic mechanisms into the heterogeneous graph structure to finely model the dynamic strategic interactions among heterogeneous investors with respect to target stocks. Additionally, temporal positional encoding is adopted to reflect the differentiated influences of each game event at different time steps within the time window on future stock price movements. Leveraging heterogeneous graph networks, we proxy the intricate dynamics of the stock market through investor games and enable real-time information propagation and node updates among all nodes. Extensive experiments conducted on two real-world benchmark dataset demonstrate that our method effectively outperforms state-of-the-art stock price forecasting methods.
url:8ccb3c32bd1dba6c.abstract_zh: 准确的股票价格预测一直是支撑量化交易与投资决策的关键且具有挑战性的金融科技任务。近期研究致力于建模股票市场中各类复杂关系，以实现更可靠的股价预测。这些方法高度依赖强静态先验假设，要么基于预定义结构建模单只股票的时间依赖性，要么建模不同股票间的空间依赖性，但驱动股价波动的复杂市场动态仍未得到探索。为解决这一问题，我们提出一种新颖的博弈论建模方法，通过捕捉异质投资者互动来实现股价预测。其核心思想是将博弈论机制嵌入异质图结构，精细建模目标股票相关异质投资者间的动态策略互动。此外，采用时间位置编码来反映时间窗口内各博弈事件在不同时间步对未来股价波动的差异化影响。借助异质图网络，我们通过投资者博弈代理股票市场的复杂动态，实现所有节点间的实时信息传播与节点更新。在两个真实世界基准数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的方法有效超越了当前最先进的股价预测方法。
url:8ccb3c32bd1dba6c.title: Game-Theoretic Modeling of Heterogeneous Investor Interactions for Stock Price Forecasting
url:8ccb3c32bd1dba6c.title_zh: 基于博弈论的异质投资者互动建模用于股票价格预测

url:8cff3eaa441d2c74.abstract: This paper takes stock of the Recovery and Resilience Facility (RRF)’s economic impact as implementation enters its final phase and draws lessons for the design of the next EU Multiannual Financial Framework (MFF). Using sectoral and cross-country data, the paper finds that the RRF provided a short term demand boost, supporting employment and output growth—especially in countries with large allocations—while a substantial share of its growth impact is expected to materialize as absorption accelerates. Unprecedented joint EU level borrowing is found to have contributed to stabilizing sovereign debt markets and improving prospects for EU bonds as safe assets. Finally, the RRF’s performance based conditionality through improved national ownership has supported reform implementation in some member states. At the same time, challenges around the pace of funds absorption remain as implementation is still ramping up and the overall macroeconomic impact will ultimately depend on how effectively the RRF funds are utilized. Plan overambition and complexity, administrative capacity limits, and absorption bottlenecks have slowed disbursement in several member states, while the predominance of output based milestones and targets has limited the framework’s focus on results.
url:8cff3eaa441d2c74.abstract_zh: 本文评估了复苏与韧性基金（RRF）在经济影响方面的成效，随着其实施进入最后阶段，并为下一轮欧盟多年期财政框架（MFF）的设计总结经验教训。基于行业和跨国数据，本文发现RRF提供了短期需求刺激，支撑了就业和产出增长——尤其是在获得大额拨款的成员国——而随着资金吸收加速，其增长影响的相当一部分预计将逐步显现。史无前例的欧盟层面联合借贷有助于稳定主权债务市场，并提升欧盟债券作为安全资产的前景。最后，RRF通过增强国家自主权实施的基于绩效的附加条件，支持了部分成员国的改革落实。与此同时，资金吸收速度方面的挑战依然存在，因为实施仍在推进中，整体宏观经济影响最终将取决于RRF资金的有效利用程度。计划过于雄心勃勃且复杂、行政能力限制以及吸收瓶颈，导致多个成员国的资金拨付放缓，而以产出为基础的里程碑和目标占主导地位，则限制了该框架对结果的关注。
url:8cff3eaa441d2c74.title: The EU’s Recovery and Resilience Facility: Experience and Lessons for the Next Multiannual Financial Framework
url:8cff3eaa441d2c74.title_zh: 欧盟复苏与韧性基金：对下一个多年期财政框架的经验与启示

url:8dc6ab78cd34a909.abstract: Education is widely associated with better health outcomes, but whether this relationship is causal remains unclear, especially in low-income countries. This study examines the causal effect of maternal education on child nutrition and dietary diversity in Kenya. Using a fuzzy regression discontinuity design, with exposure to the 2003 school reform as an instrument for educational attainment, the analysis finds that an additional year of maternal schooling significantly improves children's nutritional status and dietary diversity. Positive effects are observed for both boys and girls, although they are slightly stronger for boys. The results are robust to a range of sensitivity tests. Further analysis suggests that maternal education improves child health through several channels, including delayed first birth, fewer children under age five, higher paternal education, greater use of prenatal care, increased access to information through newspapers and television, improved literacy, and higher employment rates among mothers. These findings indicate that expanding educational opportunities for girls can be an effective policy tool for improving child nutrition and feeding practices in developing countries such as Kenya.
url:8dc6ab78cd34a909.abstract_zh: 教育通常与更好的健康结果相关联，但这种关系是否具有因果性仍不明确，尤其是在低收入国家。本研究探讨了肯尼亚母亲教育对儿童营养和膳食多样性的因果效应。采用模糊断点回归设计，以2003年学校改革作为教育程度的工具变量，分析发现母亲每多接受一年教育，能显著改善儿童的营养状况和膳食多样性。对男孩和女孩均观察到积极影响，但对男孩的影响略强。结果在一系列敏感性检验中保持稳健。进一步分析表明，母亲教育通过多个渠道改善儿童健康，包括推迟首次生育、减少五岁以下子女数量、提高父亲教育水平、增加产前护理使用、通过报纸和电视获取更多信息、提升识字率以及提高母亲就业率。这些发现表明，扩大女孩教育机会可以成为改善肯尼亚等发展中国家儿童营养和喂养实践的有效政策工具。
url:8dc6ab78cd34a909.title: Can Maternal Education Improve Children's Dietary Diversity and Nutritional Outcomes? Evidence from the 2003 Education Reform in Kenya
url:8dc6ab78cd34a909.title_zh: 母亲教育能否改善儿童的膳食多样性和营养结果？来自肯尼亚2003年教育改革的证据

url:8de38f32de26b12c.abstract: This study uses whole-of-population linked census-administrative data to examine gender gaps in educational outcomes from early primary school through early adulthood in Australia and to assess the contribution of socioeconomic factors to these gaps either at the mean and along the distribution of educational outcomes. Leveraging the richness and large size of the linked data and employing some of the most rigorous empirical approaches in the literature, including mother and twin fixed-effects models, we find that females outperform males as early as ages 5–6 across multiple developmental domains, and that this advantage persists through university. The gender gap in favour of females is larger among lower-performing students. We also find that boys benefit more than girls from growing up in more advantaged families, particularly among academically lower-performing boys. However, this advantage is observed only for outcomes measured in the early years of primary school. By contrast, for outcomes measured at the tertiary level, most indicators of socioeconomic advantage confer stronger benefits to females, especially among individuals at the lower end of the educational attainment distribution. Finally, having ruled out gender differences in birth weight—which favour males—we identify gender differences across siblings in school sector choice and early childhood health conditions, both favouring females, as potential mechanisms underlying these patterns.
url:8de38f32de26b12c.abstract_zh: 本研究利用全人口关联的普查与行政数据，考察澳大利亚从小学早期至成年早期的教育成果性别差距，并评估社会经济因素在均值及教育成果分布上对这些差距的贡献。借助关联数据的丰富性与大规模样本，并采用文献中最严谨的实证方法（包括母亲固定效应模型和双胞胎固定效应模型），我们发现：早在5-6岁阶段，女性在多个发展领域已优于男性，且这一优势持续至大学阶段。女性优势的性别差距在学业表现较低的学生中更为显著。同时，成长于更优越家庭环境的男孩比女孩获益更多，尤其在学业表现较低的男孩群体中——但这一优势仅体现在小学早期阶段的教育成果指标上。相比之下，在高等教育阶段，大多数社会经济优势指标对女性更有利，尤其对教育成就分布底端的个体而言。最后，在排除出生体重（男性占优）的性别差异后，我们识别出兄弟姐妹间在学校类型选择及儿童早期健康状况上的性别差异（两者均有利于女性），这些差异构成了上述模式的潜在机制。

url:8df8c22d164f6cb3.abstract: We study the formation of risk perceptions— subjective probability beliefs— of three adverse events—COVID-19 contagion, influenza contagion, and food poisoning—at the onset and outset of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States, using survey data. We show that perceived risk levels for COVID-19 are similar to those for influenza but are not significantly influenced by proximity to infection and are shaped instead by an individual's gender, education, and employment status. Using an instrumental variable strategy, we assess whether these perceptions influence a number of protective behaviors. Although risk perceptions are associated with various protective behaviors, we only find a causal impact in increasing the likelihood of phone or online medical consultations by only about a percentage point
url:8df8c22d164f6cb3.abstract_zh: 我们利用调查数据，研究了美国新冠疫情初期与暴发阶段，民众对三种不良事件——新冠病毒感染、流感感染及食物中毒——的风险感知（即主观概率信念）的形成机制。研究表明，民众对新冠病毒的风险感知水平与流感相似，但并未显著受到感染邻近性的影响，而是由个体的性别、教育程度及就业状况所塑造。通过工具变量策略，我们评估了这些风险感知是否影响多种防护行为。尽管风险感知与各类防护行为存在关联，但我们仅发现其对增加电话或在线医疗咨询概率具有因果效应，且该效应仅约一个百分点。

url:8e82fcfcea8b1fbf.abstract: This paper explores how demographic shifts, particularly population aging, are reshaping banking in Asia-Pacific’s bank-dominated financial systems. Using household surveys as well as bank-level and country-level panel data, we show that aging populations are associated, with shifts in bank portfolios away from traditional loans (with lower loan-to-deposit and loan-to-asset ratios), driven by changes in households’ financial behavior. These changes affect banks’ funding structures, profitability, and risk profiles, with implications for financial stability. We also provide new evidence on cross-border dynamics, showing that demographic divergence spurs asset reallocation toward younger economies. Our findings highlight evolving risks and supervisory challenges as demographic transitions unfold unevenly across economies.
url:8e82fcfcea8b1fbf.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了人口结构变化，特别是人口老龄化，如何重塑亚太地区以银行为主导的金融体系。利用家庭调查数据以及银行层面和国家层面的面板数据，我们表明，人口老龄化与银行资产组合从传统贷款（表现为较低的贷存比和贷资比）的转移相关，这种转移由家庭金融行为的变化驱动。这些变化影响了银行的融资结构、盈利能力和风险状况，并对金融稳定产生影响。我们还提供了关于跨境动态的新证据，表明人口结构差异促使资产重新配置向更年轻的经济体转移。我们的研究结果突显了随着人口转型在各经济体间不均衡推进，不断演化的风险与监管挑战。

url:8ed57284623d7f2e.abstract: Canada’s innovation performance has been strong but shows limited upward momentum despite generous research and development (R&D) subsidies. This paper develops an endogenous innovation, multisector, heterogeneous-agent model calibrated to the Canadian economy to evaluate fiscal policies that promote innovation and growth. The impact of R&D subsidies depends critically on the supply of high-skilled labor. When the supply of scientists is inelastic, subsidies raise research wages, crowd out private R&D, and can reduce long-run growth. When labor supply is more elastic, subsidies generate substantial gains in innovation and output. The analysis also compares alternative policy instruments. Investment tax reductions and education spending foster innovation through capital deepening and an expanded supply of highskilled labor, delivering more robust gains when talent constraints bind, while personal income tax changes have more limited effects. R&D subsidies also increase inequality by disproportionately benefiting high-skilled workers, although these effects are mitigated when labor supply responds. Overall, effective innovation policy requires combining R&D incentives with policies that expand human capital and reduce distortions to investment.
url:8ed57284623d7f2e.abstract_zh: 尽管加拿大提供了慷慨的研发补贴，其创新表现强劲，但增长动力有限。本文构建了一个以内生创新、多部门、异质性主体为特征的模型，并基于加拿大经济进行校准，以评估促进创新与增长的财政政策。研发补贴的效果关键取决于高技能劳动力的供给。当科学家供给缺乏弹性时，补贴会推高研发工资，挤出私人研发投入，甚至可能降低长期增长率。而当劳动力供给弹性较大时，补贴则能显著提升创新与产出。本文还比较了其他政策工具：投资税收减免与教育支出通过资本深化和扩大高技能劳动力供给来促进创新，在人才约束趋紧时能带来更稳健的收益；而个人所得税调整的效果则较为有限。此外，研发补贴会通过使高技能劳动者不成比例地受益而加剧不平等，但当劳动力供给具有弹性时，这一效应会有所缓解。总体而言，有效的创新政策需要将研发激励与扩大人力资本、减少投资扭曲的政策相结合。
url:8ed57284623d7f2e.title: Innovation, Human Capital, and Taxation: Evidence from a Structural Model of the Canadian Economy
url:8ed57284623d7f2e.title_zh: 创新、人力资本与税收：基于加拿大经济结构模型的证据

url:8ee18e2580afc53a.abstract: Researchers are faced with the choice of which of the many recently developed difference-in-differences methods to use in practice. To assess these estimators' relative performance for single-unit event studies, we conduct 134,000+ state-level placebo event studies across 13 estimators. We find that no single method dominates. Performance is context-dependent, with synthetic-control-like methods sometimes outperforming and sometimes underperforming two-way-fixed-effect-like and matching methods. Performance also varies across states at least as much as it does across estimators. Our results highlight the need for practitioners to conduct placebo tests to understand the performance of methods in their research context.
url:8ee18e2580afc53a.abstract_zh: 研究者面临如何在众多新近发展的双重差分方法中做出实际选择的难题。为评估这些估计量在单单位事件研究中的相对表现，我们基于13种估计量开展了超过13.4万次州级安慰剂事件研究。研究发现，没有任何单一方法具有绝对优势。方法表现具有情境依赖性，合成控制类方法有时优于、有时劣于双向固定效应类方法和匹配方法。各州之间的表现差异至少与不同估计量之间的差异相当。研究结果强调，实践者需开展安慰剂检验以理解其研究情境下各方法的实际表现。

url:8f04e89f84ef248c.abstract: This paper develops high frequency trade estimates at the country level by applying nowcasting methodologies to satellite-based big data on vessel movements sourced from IMF PortWatch. The approach provides a timely estimate of monthly trade at the country level that can be produced and released within 7 working days. The paper validates the nowcasting trade estimates against official data for an initial wave of countries representing advanced economies, emerging markets and small island developing states: Brazil, Jamaica, Japan, Samoa, and the United States. The nowcasting methodology produces trade estimates that perform well compared to the official statistics, with the best fit for advanced economies and large emerging markets. The paper identifies key complementary information to improve the presented nowcasting methodology to develop country trade estimates. The paper also considers an application to estimates of U.S. imports during a period of elevated trade tensions.
url:8f04e89f84ef248c.abstract_zh: 本文通过将即时预测方法应用于国际货币基金组织港口观察（IMF PortWatch）提供的基于卫星的船舶移动大数据，开发了国家层面的高频贸易估算。该方法可在7个工作日内生成并发布国家层面的月度贸易及时估算。本文以首批涵盖发达经济体、新兴市场和小岛屿发展中国家的国家（巴西、牙买加、日本、萨摩亚和美国）为对象，将即时预测贸易估算与官方数据进行验证。结果表明，该即时预测方法生成的贸易估算与官方统计数据拟合良好，其中对发达经济体和大型新兴市场的拟合效果最佳。本文识别了改进现有即时预测方法以完善国家贸易估算的关键补充信息，并进一步探讨了该方法在贸易紧张局势加剧时期对美国进口估算的应用。

url:8f11d91a842ca71a.abstract: How does carbon pricing affect investment in brown firms? During the period 2000–2019, the effective cost of emitting carbon rose by about 400 percent for Swedish manufacturing firms. Despite lower operating margins, high-emission firms significantly increased both total capital investment and the share of investment dedicated to abatement. The response is concentrated among firms with strong internal financial capacity. We find no comparable investment increase in lower-emitting firms or in high-emission industries outside of Sweden. Our results show that pricing CO2 emissions at a sufficiently high level can incentivize brown firms to make green investments.
url:8f11d91a842ca71a.abstract_zh: 碳定价如何影响棕色企业的投资？在2000年至2019年间，瑞典制造业企业的有效碳排放成本上升了约400%。尽管运营利润率下降，高排放企业仍显著增加了总资本投资以及用于减排的投资份额。这一反应集中在内部财务能力较强的企业中。我们在低排放企业或瑞典以外的高排放行业中未发现类似的投资增长。研究结果表明，将二氧化碳排放定价在足够高的水平，能够激励棕色企业进行绿色投资。

url:8f4bf76b72a269c3.abstract: This paper examines the impact of voluntary and involuntary excess liquidity on monetary policy effectiveness and inflation in Kazakhstan. Consistent with first-principles predictions, we find that voluntary liquidity held for precautionary motives is (i) negatively related to the opportunity cost of holding liquid assets and to the level of mandatory reserve requirements; (ii) positively related to average liquidity outflows, proxied by transactional demand for cash; and (iii) ambiguously affected by the magnitude and volatility of the business cycle. We further show that higher voluntary liquidity weakens monetary policy transmission and increases exchange rate pass-through to inflation. In contrast, involuntary liquidity hampers monetary policy effectiveness no matter its level and it increases average inflation primarily through its influence on the formation of inflation expectations. Overall, the results suggest that reforms aimed at reducing both forms of liquidity would enhance monetary policy effectiveness and, ceteris paribus, reduce inflation.
url:8f4bf76b72a269c3.abstract_zh: 本文研究了哈萨克斯坦自愿性与非自愿性超额流动性对货币政策有效性和通货膨胀的影响。与基本原理预测一致，我们发现：出于预防性动机持有的自愿性流动性（i）与持有流动性资产的机会成本及法定准备金要求水平呈负相关；（ii）与以现金交易需求为代理变量的平均流动性流出呈正相关；（iii）受经济周期幅度和波动性的影响具有模糊性。我们进一步证明，较高的自愿性流动性会削弱货币政策传导机制，并增强汇率传递对通货膨胀的影响。相比之下，无论非自愿性流动性水平高低，其均会阻碍货币政策有效性，并主要通过影响通胀预期形成机制推高平均通胀水平。总体而言，研究结果表明，旨在减少两种形式流动性的改革将提升货币政策有效性，并在其他条件不变的情况下降低通货膨胀。
url:8f4bf76b72a269c3.title: There Will Be Liquidity! But Will There Be Transmission?

url:8f978ca5af28e4fc.abstract: Air pollution from natural sources is often subject to less regulatory oversight, but can still be caused by human activities. Understanding the role for policy requires quantifying the source's pollution contribution, for which there is currently no standard methodological approach. This paper uses the context of the shrinking Great Salt Lake in Utah to model air quality impacts of the highly erodible and growing area of exposed lakebed. Using four common identification strategies in the air pollution literature, and three alternative pollution measurement technologies, we find consistent evidence of meaningful pollution increases attributable to the shrinking lake in non-winter months. Estimates are relatively invariant to measurement technology but vary across identification strategies. Marginal annual costs range from $81 to $175 million per 100 km² of exposed lakebed. Scaling to the area of total exposed lakebed, annual desiccation-related health cost estimates range from $1.1 billion to $2.3 billion. Given the direct relationship between human water use in the basin and exposed lakebed, these results provide evidence for the cost-effectiveness of policies aimed at reducing consumptive water use.
url:8f978ca5af28e4fc.abstract_zh: 自然来源的空气污染通常受到的监管较少，但仍可能由人类活动引发。理解政策的作用需要量化该来源的污染贡献，但目前尚无标准方法论。本文以美国犹他州大盐湖萎缩为背景，对高度可侵蚀且不断扩大的裸露湖床区域的空气质量影响进行建模。利用空气污染文献中四种常见的识别策略及三种替代性污染测量技术，我们发现在非冬季月份，湖泊萎缩导致显著的污染增加，且证据一致。估计值对测量技术相对不敏感，但随识别策略不同而变化。每100平方公里裸露湖床的边际年成本介于8100万至1.75亿美元之间。按总裸露湖床面积推算，与干涸相关的年度健康成本估计值介于11亿至23亿美元之间。鉴于流域内人类用水与裸露湖床之间的直接关系，这些结果为旨在减少消耗性用水的政策提供了成本效益证据。

url:8f9cea081790cf48.title: The impact of post-harvest training interventions on adoption and production behavior: evidence from black pepper farmers in Sri Lanka
url:8f9cea081790cf48.title_zh: 产后培训干预对采纳与生产行为的影响：来自斯里兰卡黑胡椒种植户的证据

url:8fe52bb6f761cb5b.abstract: Can imputed poverty estimates be reliably disaggregated by population groups, especially when the interest is monitoring poverty levels for smaller, vulnerable groups that may not be represented as well in large-scale household surveys? The study tackles this question through a comprehensive literature review and empirical analysis that leverages 18 household surveys across four different low- and middle-income countries. The results suggest that the imputation accuracy widely varies by population group, with differences being as high as 10 percentage points in pairwise comparisons of groups. The imputation accuracy for the population groups of interest increases, on average, by 1.3 percentage points in response to increasing the sample size by 1,000 observations for the target survey that is used for sourcing the predictors for the imputation model. The results are robust to extensive sensitivity analyses and also suggest that incorporating geospatial predictors into the imputation model can help increase imputation accuracy. The discussion provides useful inputs for future survey design.
url:8fe52bb6f761cb5b.abstract_zh: 估算贫困数据能否按人口群体可靠分解，尤其是在关注大规模住户调查中可能代表性不足的较小弱势群体贫困监测水平时？本研究通过系统性文献综述和实证分析，利用四个中低收入国家的18项住户调查数据探讨该问题。结果表明，不同人口群体的估算精度差异显著，群体间成对比较的差异最高可达10个百分点。当用于获取估算模型预测变量的目标调查样本量每增加1000个观测值时，关注人口群体的估算精度平均提升1.3个百分点。该结果在广泛的敏感性分析中保持稳健，同时表明将地理空间预测变量纳入估算模型有助于提高估算精度。相关讨论为未来调查设计提供了有益参考。
url:8fe52bb6f761cb5b.title: Disaggregating Imputed Poverty Estimates by Population Groups: New Evidence from a Multi-country Analysis
url:8fe52bb6f761cb5b.title_zh: 按人口群体分解估算贫困数据：基于多国分析的新证据

url:8fe6b82aad1d1e47.abstract: This paper investigates the impact of informal competition—defined as competition faced by formal firms from informal enterprises—on the firm-provided worker training among formal manufacturing small and medium-sized enterprises. Using a representative dataset of small and medium-sized manufacturing firms in 23 Sub-Saharan African countries, a sizable negative impact is found. A one-standard-deviation increase in informal competition reduces the probability that a firm offers training to its workers by 8.7 to 12.9 percentage points, relative to the sample mean of firms that offer training of approximately 25 percent. Comparable declines are observed in the share of workers receiving training. To address potential endogeneity, the paper employs several complementary strategies. First, an instrumental-variables strategy leverages variation in the number of children aged 0–4 and 5–9 years per working-age woman to generate exogenous shifts in informal competition. Second, heterogeneity is examined through tests derived from the “legalist” view of informality, which predicts bigger adverse effects of informal competition in environments characterized by a weaker rule of law and more stringent business regulations. Third, information about firms in other world regions is used to construct out-of-sample predictions of informal competition at the sector level. The findings sugge st that informal competition is a substantial constraint on the training investments of formal firms, underscoring the need for policy responses that mitigate its adverse consequences.
url:8fe6b82aad1d1e47.abstract_zh: 本文研究了非正规竞争——即正规企业面临的来自非正规企业的竞争——对正规制造业中小企业提供的员工培训的影响。基于23个撒哈拉以南非洲国家中小型制造企业的代表性数据集，发现非正规竞争对员工培训存在显著的负面影响。非正规竞争每增加一个标准差，企业提供员工培训的概率将下降8.7至12.9个百分点，而样本中提供培训的企业均值约为25%。员工接受培训的比例也出现了类似的下降。为解决潜在的内生性问题，本文采用了多种互补策略。首先，利用工具变量策略，通过每名育龄妇女对应的0-4岁和5-9岁儿童数量的变化，生成非正规竞争的外生变动。其次，基于非正规经济的“合法主义”观点进行异质性检验，该观点预测在法治较弱、商业监管更严格的环境中，非正规竞争的负面影响更大。第三，利用其他地区企业的信息，构建行业层面非正规竞争的样本外预测。研究结果表明，非正规竞争严重制约了正规企业的培训投资，凸显了制定政策以减轻其负面影响的必要性。

url:8fe6b82aad1d1e47.title_zh: 非正式竞争是否减少了撒哈拉以南非洲正规制造业中小企业提供的员工培训？

url:8ff0d5b98985d48e.abstract: Using a recent and comprehensive data set covering nine of the most actively traded currencies on a monthly basis from 1995 to 2024, this paper explores the presence and potential drivers of herding behaviour in foreign exchange rate forecasts. The dataset features an average of 40–50 forecasters per currency, representing a broader range of currencies, a longer time frame, and a larger cross section of forecasters than is commonly found in the FX herding literature. Our results provide mixed evidence on herding, where the balance tends towards anti-herding conclusions.While some revision-based tests suggest herding when current consensus forecasts are used, this evidence weakens considerably when lagged information is employed. In contrast, forecast-error based tests, Bernhardt et al. statistics, and over-reaction regressions more often point to anti-herding, particularly at longer horizons. Overall, we interpret the findings as suggesting thatdifferences among forecasters are largely attributable to heterogeneous views, noise, or idiosyncratic error rather than systematic convergence toward the consensus. When alternative explanations for expectation formation or revisions are considered, the main findings remain unchanged across a wide range of measures, including different types of uncertainty and FX predictors such as the forward premium, the real exchange rate, and the depreciation rate. JEL Classification: C10, C22, F31, F47, G17
url:8ff0d5b98985d48e.abstract_zh: 本文利用1995年至2024年涵盖九种最活跃交易货币的月度高频综合数据集，探究外汇汇率预测中羊群行为的存在性及其潜在驱动因素。该数据集平均每种货币包含40-50位预测者，相较于外汇羊群行为研究文献，其覆盖货币范围更广、时间跨度更长、预测者截面规模更大。研究结果为羊群行为提供了混合证据，整体结论更倾向于反羊群行为。当采用当前共识预测时，部分基于修正的检验显示存在羊群行为，但使用滞后信息后该证据显著减弱。相比之下，基于预测误差的检验、Bernhardt等人统计量及过度反应回归更常指向反羊群行为，尤其在较长预测期限中。总体而言，我们认为预测者间的差异主要源于异质性观点、噪声或特质性误差，而非系统性趋同于共识。在考虑预期形成或修正的替代性解释后，主要结论在涵盖不同类型不确定性及远期升水、实际汇率、贬值率等外汇预测因子的广泛指标体系中保持稳健。JEL分类号：C10, C22, F31, F47, G17

url:9015c5c626e1ae49.abstract: Were cash benefits and welfare services available to the unemployed sufficient to protect them from ill-health? Recent reappraisals have tended to magnify the influence of welfare provision. The present review draws on hitherto unexploited, confidential reports of the Ministry of Health and Board of Education, to point out that expert witnesses were increasingly concerned that unemployment relief and social services were inadequate to meet the needs of the community in 'Special Areas'. It is argued that the value of cash benefits was undermined by operation of the means test, and that welfare services were most inadequate where the need was greatest.
url:9015c5c626e1ae49.abstract_zh: 失业者获得的现金补助和福利服务是否足以保护他们免受健康损害？近期重新评估倾向于夸大福利供给的影响。本文基于此前未被利用的卫生部与教育部机密报告指出，专家证人日益担忧失业救济与社会服务不足以满足"特别地区"社区的需求。研究表明，现金补助的价值因经济状况调查的实施而遭到削弱，而福利服务在最需要的地方却最为匮乏。

url:9062c7fe855a9e7c.abstract: The central trade-off for designing Disability Insurance (DI) is between providing insurance to those in need while maintaining incentives to work. This paper develops a novel revealed-preference approach to identify the insurance value of DI benefits. We show that comparing the DI take-up response to a change in benefits versus a change in wages identifies the insurance value. Implementing our framework in Canada, we estimate that increasing DI benefits by $1 creates an additional disincentive cost of $0.60 but creates an insurance value of $2.20. Thus, our approach suggests that DI benefits are not overly generous in the Canadian context.
url:9062c7fe855a9e7c.abstract_zh: 设计残疾保险（DI）的核心权衡在于，既要为有需要者提供保障，又要维持工作激励。本文提出了一种新颖的揭示偏好方法，用以识别DI福利的保险价值。我们证明，通过比较福利变化与工资变化对DI参保率的影响，可以识别出保险价值。在加拿大实施我们的框架后，估计每增加1美元DI福利，会产生0.60美元的额外抑制成本，但创造2.20美元的保险价值。因此，我们的方法表明，在加拿大背景下，DI福利并未过度慷慨。

url:909357ceb6aebc8e.abstract: In a model with endogenous risk-taking, deposit insurance and limited liability may lead banks to make risky loans that are socially inefficient. Capital requirements can prevent excessive risk-taking at the cost of reducing liquidity-producing bank deposits. A policy that sets capital requirements just high enough to prevent excessive risktaking will move capital requirements pro-, counter-, or a-cyclically depending on the shock source. However, such a policy requires full knowledge of all the shocks hitting the economy and is not implementable. Simple rules that respond to cyclical conditions—in line with Basel III guidance—perform poorly, whereas a small static capital buffer can do much better.
url:909357ceb6aebc8e.abstract_zh: 在内生风险承担模型中，存款保险与有限责任可能导致银行发放社会效率低下的高风险贷款。资本充足要求能够以降低流动性创造型银行存款为代价，防止过度风险承担。若将资本充足要求设定为恰好足以遏制过度风险承担的水平，该政策将根据冲击来源呈现顺周期、逆周期或非周期特征。然而，此类政策要求完全掌握冲击经济的全部因素，实际中并不可行。符合《巴塞尔协议III》指引的周期性调节型简单规则表现欠佳，而小规模静态资本缓冲却能取得显著更优效果。

url:90af40fe59d0d4bf.abstract: This paper examines several possible benefits that RTAs may confer on their partners, including credibility, signalling, bargaining power, insurance, and coordination. It assesses the necessary conditions for each of these candidates to work; gives stylized examples of specific types of policy where it might be applicable; examines real cases where the explanation might be relevant; and discusses their overall plausibility. It concludes by examining NAFTA and the Europe Agreements viewed in this light.
url:90af40fe59d0d4bf.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了区域贸易协定（RTAs）可能为其伙伴带来的若干潜在益处，包括可信度、信号传递、议价能力、保险机制及协调功能。研究评估了每种候选机制生效的必要条件；列举了可能适用的特定政策类型的典型范例；分析了相关解释可能适用的现实案例；并讨论了其整体合理性。最后，本文从这一视角审视了北美自由贸易协定（NAFTA）与欧洲协定。

url:90d491eb9308661a.abstract: This paper examines whether increasing individuals’ awareness of their own confidence can influence financial behaviour. In a pre-registered online experiment with nearly 3,000 U.S. adults, we test the effects of a novel metacognitive intervention: personalised feedback on implicit confidence about one’s financial abilities, as measured by a custom Implicit Association Test (IAT), paired with an explanation of the importance of self-confidence in financial abilities. Treated participants show a significant reduction in “don’t know” responses on financial literacy tests and their performance in an incentivised investment task significantly improves: treated participants are less likely to make clearly dominated choices, more likely to select efficient allocations, and choose portfolios closer to the efficient frontier. These effects persist two weeks later in a follow-up survey with obfuscated framing. Heterogeneity analyses show stronger effects for females and for participants who understate their confidence (i.e. whose reported confidence is lower than what their IAT suggests). Keywords: Confidence, Confidence awareness, Personal finance, Financial literacy, Survey experiment.
url:90d491eb9308661a.abstract_zh: 本文探究提升个体对自身信心的认知是否会影响其金融行为。在一项针对近3000名美国成年人的预注册在线实验中，我们测试了一种新型元认知干预措施的效果：通过定制化内隐联想测验（IAT）测量个体对自身金融能力的内隐信心，并辅以关于金融能力自信心重要性的解释，向参与者提供个性化反馈。接受干预的参与者在金融素养测试中回答“不知道”的比例显著降低，且其在激励性投资任务中的表现显著改善：他们更少做出明显被支配的选择，更倾向于选择有效配置方案，并选择更接近有效前沿的投资组合。这些效应在两周后以模糊化框架进行的追踪调查中依然持续存在。异质性分析显示，该效应在女性参与者以及低估自身信心（即自我报告信心低于IAT测量结果）的参与者中更为显著。关键词：信心，信心认知，个人理财，金融素养，调查实验。

url:911271cf5e254565.abstract: A growing literature documents racial hierarchy in international institutions. I test whether formally equal rules eliminate that hierarchy in practice. The Schengen visa regime offers a hard case because member states process applications under identical law. I show that ancestral distance, a measure of perceived racial difference, predicts visa refusals. Contemporary ancestral distance drives the result. A pre-1500 measure does not, consistent with the social construction of race. A consulate-level analysis isolates the discretionary channel. Busier consulates discriminate more against ancestrally distant applicants, even though a nationality's risk profile does not change with consular workload. Routine operational pressures activate the categorical shortcuts that institutional design was supposed to prevent. A further test shows the effect is stronger where national populations hold more restrictive racial attitudes, not where institutional capacity is weakest. Harmonized rules do not eliminate international institutional racism. They push it into discretionary gaps that formal law cannot close.
url:911271cf5e254565.abstract_zh: 越来越多的文献揭示了国际机构中的种族等级现象。本文检验了形式上平等的规则是否能在实践中消除这种等级。申根签证制度提供了一个典型案例，因为成员国依据相同的法律处理签证申请。研究表明，祖先距离（一种感知种族差异的衡量指标）能够预测签证拒签率。当代祖先距离是驱动这一结果的关键因素，而1500年之前的祖先距离则无显著影响，这与种族的社会建构属性一致。领事馆层面的分析揭示了自由裁量渠道的作用。工作更繁忙的领事馆对祖先距离较远的申请人歧视更严重，尽管国籍的风险特征并不随领事馆工作量变化。常规操作压力激活了制度设计本应防止的类别化捷径。进一步检验表明，这种效应在国民种族态度更保守的地区更为显著，而非在制度能力最弱的地区。统一规则并未消除国际制度中的种族主义，而是将其推向了正式法律无法填补的自由裁量空间。
url:911271cf5e254565.title: The Discretionary Color Line in International Institutions

url:915e89dc3db50c87.abstract: Housing affordability is high on the economic, social, and political agenda in Europe. While the economic literature has mostly analyzed the drivers of housing unaffordability, this paper focuses on its consequences, quantifying, at the EU level, its impact on individuals’ well-being as well as its economic and demographic impact. We find that the impact of an increase in housing cost burden is large on housing adequacy as well as on poverty and health. It is somewhat smaller on fertility and labor force participation.
url:915e89dc3db50c87.abstract_zh: 住房可负担性在欧洲的经济、社会和政治议程中占据重要地位。尽管经济学文献主要分析了住房不可负担性的驱动因素，本文则聚焦于其后果，在欧盟层面量化其对个人福祉的影响，以及其经济和人口层面的影响。研究发现，住房成本负担增加对住房适足性、贫困和健康的影响较大，而对生育率和劳动力参与率的影响相对较小。
url:915e89dc3db50c87.title: The (Many) Consequences of the Housing Affordability Problem in the EU: A Machine-Learning Empirical Analysis

url:916f09b4b8aeedda.abstract: We investigate integration by parts (IBP) formulae for stochastic Volterra equations and we establish the smoothing effect of the expectation. Due to the inherent path-dependent dynamics of this class of processes, standard Bismut--Elworthy--Li (BEL) formulae and lifting procedures fail to produce representations for directional derivatives with respect to the initial curve. We exhibit a new type of fractional IBP for these derivatives which, by means of the Riemann--Liouville fractional derivative, interpolates between the standard chain rule and a pure BEL formula with Cameron--Martin path directions. Our assumptions describe precisely the trade-off between the direction's and the test function's regularities. Crucially, we reveal that more roughness leads to more smoothing: for a power-law kernel with Hurst parameter $H\in(0, 1/2)$, we show that the expectation is differentiable along constant directions provided that the test function has H\"older continuity $\beta>2H$. The proof of the formula relies on a careful analysis of the conditional expectation's temporal regularity and on the well-posedness of its Riemann--Liouville derivative. We complement these results with a BEL formula along all square integrable directions whenever the noise is additive, a second order BEL formula and an application to forward and rough volatility models. In the latter case, the derivative is interpreted as the sensitivity with respect to the whole initial forward variance curve.
url:916f09b4b8aeedda.abstract_zh: 我们研究了随机Volterra方程的分部积分公式，并建立了期望的平滑效应。由于这类过程固有的路径依赖动力学特性，标准的Bismut--Elworthy--Li (BEL)公式和提升方法无法生成关于初始曲线的方向导数表示。我们针对这些导数提出了一种新型分数阶分部积分公式，该公式通过Riemann--Liouville分数阶导数，在标准链式法则与包含Cameron--Martin路径方向的纯BEL公式之间进行插值。我们的假设精确描述了方向正则性与测试函数正则性之间的权衡关系。关键的是，我们发现更粗糙的路径会导致更强的平滑效应：对于Hurst参数$H\in(0, 1/2)$的幂律核，我们证明只要测试函数具有Hölder连续性$\beta>2H$，期望沿恒定方向是可微的。该公式的证明依赖于对条件期望时间正则性的细致分析及其Riemann--Liouville导数的适定性。我们进一步补充了以下结果：当噪声为加性时，沿所有平方可积方向的BEL公式、二阶BEL公式，以及在远期和粗糙波动率模型中的应用。在后一种情况下，导数被解释为对整条初始远期方差曲线的敏感性。
url:916f09b4b8aeedda.title: Functional integration by parts formulae for stochastic Volterra processes
url:916f09b4b8aeedda.title_zh: 随机Volterra过程的泛函分部积分公式

url:9180c1400bb2aa81.abstract: This study examines how soft skills education performatively shapes business realities across cultural boundaries. While prior research has treated soft skills as static capabilities, we demonstrate their role as performative forces actively reshaping organizational practices. Through in-depth interviews with Chinese graduates of UK universities working in China, our findings reveal an inverted U-shaped relationship between structural performativity and organizational transformation, moderated by collective orientation (weakening effect) and absorptive capacity (strengthening effect) and pinpoint six key domains through which soft skills education acts as a performative mechanism. Our findings suggest that successful organizational transformation through soft skills education requires balancing international connections, cultural values, and knowledge integration capabilities. The study advances performativity theory in management education by demonstrating how educational practices actively construct organizational realities rather than merely describing them and provides insights for business schools on effectively harnessing performativity to create desirable organizational outcomes in cross-cultural contexts.
url:9180c1400bb2aa81.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨软技能教育如何以表演性方式跨越文化边界塑造商业现实。既有研究将软技能视为静态能力，而本文揭示其作为表演性力量主动重塑组织实践的机制。通过对在华工作的英国高校中国毕业生进行深度访谈，研究发现结构性表演性与组织转型呈倒U型关系，集体主义导向（弱化效应）与吸收能力（强化效应）对该关系起调节作用，并识别出软技能教育发挥表演性机制的六大关键领域。研究结果表明，通过软技能教育实现成功的组织转型需要平衡国际联结、文化价值观与知识整合能力。本研究通过论证教育实践如何主动构建而非简单描述组织现实，推进了管理教育领域的表演性理论发展，并为商学院在跨文化情境中有效利用表演性创造理想组织成果提供实践启示。
url:9180c1400bb2aa81.title: The Performative Role of Soft Skills Education: Reshaping Business Realities through Cross-Cultural Learning in Chinese Organizations

url:91a6b3eb7cf08e5d.abstract: This Paper studies a stylized model of dynamic labour market interactions where labour reallocation costs are partly financed by uninsured workers? consumption flows. In the resulting second-best equilibrium, provisions that shift labour reallocation costs to risk-neutral employers can increase productive efficiency if their administrative deadweight costs are not too large, and increase workers? welfare as long as employers? firing costs at least partly finance workers? mobility.
url:91a6b3eb7cf08e5d.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一个动态劳动力市场互动的典型模型，其中劳动力重新配置成本部分由未参保工人的消费流承担。在由此产生的次优均衡中，若将劳动力重新配置成本转移至风险中性雇主的政策安排，其行政无谓成本不过高，则可提升生产效率；且只要雇主的解雇成本至少部分用于资助工人的流动性，就能增加工人福利。

url:91bd9e43f00ef88c.abstract: We show that incorporating uninsurable countercyclical income risk into a standard international RBC model can qualitatively and quantitatively account for the quantity puzzles in open-economy macro, namely (i) the Backus-Smith puzzle, (ii) the Backus-Kehoe-Kydland puzzle and (iii) the weak correlation between the trade balance and the exchange rate. We also show that our model can simultaneously account for the Fama puzzle and the evidence that high interest rate countries have stronger currencies---which representative-agents models that rely only on financial or demand shocks cannot jointly account for. Crucially, our model resolves all these puzzles while relying solely on productivity shocks, and thus generates the observed domestic and cross-country macroeconomic comovement.
url:91bd9e43f00ef88c.abstract_zh: 我们证明，将不可保险的反周期收入风险纳入标准国际实际经济周期模型，能够从定性和定量角度解释开放经济宏观经济学中的数量谜题，即：（i）巴克斯-史密斯谜题、（ii）巴克斯-基欧-基德兰德谜题以及（iii）贸易余额与汇率之间的弱相关性。我们还证明，该模型能够同时解释法玛谜题以及高利率国家拥有更强货币的证据——而仅依赖金融或需求冲击的代表性主体模型无法共同解释这些现象。关键在于，我们的模型仅依靠生产率冲击就解决了所有这些谜题，从而生成了观察到的国内及跨国宏观经济协同波动。

url:921951d101ce08a9.abstract: In high-inequality states the opportunity cost of delayed fertility do not resonate with youth, undermining the effectiveness of sex education. Teen fertility remains high despite widespread mandates for school-based sex education, perhaps due to heterogeneous topic coverage and variation in classroom implementation. Social inequality affects teens’ need for school-based education and response to the content. Using staggered difference-indifferences estimation that is reversal-robust, we find that teen fertility rises in highinequality states when sex education is required in schools. We conclude that policy design and implementation are distinct dimensions of sex education, and they must be tailored to local social conditions.
url:921951d101ce08a9.abstract_zh: 在高不平等州，延迟生育的机会成本难以引起年轻人的共鸣，从而削弱了性教育的有效性。尽管学校性教育被广泛强制推行，青少年生育率仍然居高不下，这可能是由于话题覆盖的异质性和课堂实施的差异所致。社会不平等影响了青少年对学校性教育的需求及其对教育内容的反应。通过使用对反转稳健的渐进双重差分估计，我们发现，在要求学校开展性教育的高不平等州，青少年生育率反而上升。我们得出结论：政策设计与实施是性教育的两个不同维度，必须根据当地社会条件进行定制。

url:92983980aa3babf9.abstract: We study how fatal and nonfatal health shocks affect households’ ability to meet their financial obligations. We find that fatal shocks substantially increase the likelihood of default and that housing wealth plays a key role as a self-insurance mechanism. Surviving spouses who experience the largest income losses are more likely to sell their homes, and those without housing wealth face a sharply higher risk of debt collection. In the most financially vulnerable families, these shocks even generate intergenerational spillovers. In contrast, nonfatal health shocks lead to only modest increases in default risk. Taken together, our findings suggest that strengthening survivors’ benefits for households with limited resources could improve welfare across generations.
url:92983980aa3babf9.abstract_zh: 我们研究了致命与非致命健康冲击对家庭履行财务义务能力的影响。研究发现，致命冲击显著增加了违约可能性，而住房财富作为自我保险机制发挥着关键作用。遭受最大收入损失的丧偶者更可能出售房屋，且无住房财富的家庭面临债务催收的风险急剧上升。在最脆弱的家庭中，这些冲击甚至会产生代际溢出效应。相比之下，非致命健康冲击仅导致违约风险小幅上升。综合来看，我们的研究结果表明，为资源有限的家庭加强遗属福利可改善跨代福利水平。
url:92983980aa3babf9.title: When loss strikes twice: severe health shocks and financial well-being

url:929cc919b2e82cd6.abstract: Although continuous genetic improvement of crops cultivated by smallholder farmers is a well-known route to increasing agricultural productivity, our understanding of varietal adoption, turnover, and concentration in farmers’ fields is limited. Often, the greatest challenge to our understanding lies in the measurement approach (farmer self-reports versus DNA fingerprinting), as well as in the analysis and interpretation of the available data. To address this issue, we explore variety-level data on four main crops (wheat, maize, teff, and common bean) in Ethiopia. We estimate the area-weighted average varietal age (AWAVA) of each crop using data from a nationally representative sample survey of farm households and a unique genotyping dataset based on seed samples collected from the fields of sampled farm households. We also calculate indices to explore the concentration of varieties in farmers’ fields, which serves to substantiate the varietal age analysis. Overall, results show considerable variation in average varietal age across crops, ranging from 12.5 years for wheat to 28.2 years for common bean. Analysis of area shares of individual varieties for each crop indicates that slower varietal turnover (i.e., higher varietal age) is driven by the continued dominance of older varieties, despite the presence of newer varieties in the market. Slow varietal turnover in the presence of new varieties suggests the need for greater investment in the systems and markets through which seed is distributed to farmers. This includes stronger coordination of research and extension activities, improvement of variety-specific popularization and marketing efforts, and continued experimentation in seed sector development in Ethiopia.
url:929cc919b2e82cd6.abstract_zh: 尽管小农户种植作物的持续遗传改良是提高农业生产率的公认途径，但我们对农民田间品种采用、更替和集中度的理解仍然有限。通常，理解的最大挑战在于测量方法（农民自我报告与DNA指纹识别），以及现有数据的分析和解读。为解决这一问题，我们研究了埃塞俄比亚四种主要作物（小麦、玉米、苔麸和普通菜豆）的品种层面数据。我们利用全国代表性农户调查数据和基于样本农户田间采集种子样本的独特基因分型数据集，估算了每种作物的面积加权平均品种年龄（AWAVA）。同时，我们计算了相关指数以探究农民田间品种的集中度，从而佐证品种年龄分析。总体而言，结果显示不同作物的平均品种年龄存在显著差异，从小麦的12.5年到普通菜豆的28.2年不等。对每种作物单个品种面积份额的分析表明，尽管市场上有新品种存在，但老品种持续占据主导地位，导致品种更替缓慢（即品种年龄较高）。新品种存在下的缓慢品种更替表明，需要加大对种子分发至农民的系统与市场的投资。这包括加强研究与推广活动的协调、改进品种特定推广和营销工作，以及在埃塞俄比亚种子部门发展中持续进行试验。
url:929cc919b2e82cd6.title: Varietal adoption, turnover, and concentration for major crops in Ethiopia: Evidence from household surveys and field sample genotyping
url:929cc919b2e82cd6.title_zh: 埃塞俄比亚主要作物的品种采用、更替与集中度：基于家庭调查与田间样本基因分型的证据

url:92bfd17498c25801.abstract: We study how expatriates cope when conflict breaks out in their homeland. Using Russia’s 2022 invasion of Ukraine as a natural experiment, we identify causal effects using a matched difference-in-differences design, comparing incumbent Ukrainian migrants in Sweden to matched migrants from other countries. We show that Ukrainian expatriates experience immediate and persistent mental health deterioration—a 30 percent increase in psychiatric prescription use that remains elevated three years later—while simultaneously increasing employment and earnings. A simple framework rationalizes this pattern through two channels operating in opposite directions: concern for family safety worsens mental health and raises the disutility of work, while heightened financial responsibilities raise the return to earning income. Consistent with reduced reservation wages, Ukrainians take on secondary jobs, exit unemployment faster into lower-quality jobs, and earn less than comparable coworkers. Earnings effects concentrate among migrants from more war-exposed regions, while mental health effects attenuate in Swedish municipalities with more Ukrainian refugee arrivals. Results replicate in European and US survey data. As global migration and armed conflict both reach historic highs, the findings show that the welfare costs of war extend across borders, shaping the well-being and economic behavior of expatriates worldwide.
url:92bfd17498c25801.abstract_zh: 我们研究了外籍人士在祖国爆发冲突时的应对机制。以2022年俄罗斯入侵乌克兰作为自然实验，采用匹配双重差分法，将瑞典境内的乌克兰移民与来自其他国家的匹配移民进行对比，识别出因果效应。研究表明，乌克兰外籍人士的心理健康立即且持续恶化——精神类药物处方量增加30%，三年后仍维持高位——同时其就业率和收入同步上升。一个简单框架通过两个反向作用渠道解释了这一模式：对家人安全的担忧加剧心理健康问题并提高工作负效用，而经济责任加重则提升了收入回报。与保留工资下降一致，乌克兰移民从事副业、更快脱离失业状态但进入低质量岗位，且收入低于可比同事。来自战争更激烈地区的移民收入效应更为显著，而乌克兰难民接收量较多的瑞典市镇中，心理健康效应有所减弱。该结果在欧洲及美国调查数据中均得到验证。在全球移民与武装冲突均达历史高位的背景下，研究显示战争福利成本跨越国界，深刻影响着全球外籍人士的福祉与经济行为。
url:92bfd17498c25801.title: Beyond the Battlefield: The Impact of War on Expatriates’ Health and Livelihoods
url:92bfd17498c25801.title_zh: 超越战场：战争对外籍人士健康与生计的影响

url:9307b19f9a21dd81.abstract: Liquidity is central to modern fixed-income markets, yet it is often treated too simply. Bonds are commonly described as liquid or illiquid, as though liquidity were a fixed quality built into the security itself. This book challenges that view. It argues that liquidity is not a permanent feature of a bond, but a fragile condition created by market structure, financing arrangements, collateral rules, dealer capacity, valuation practices, regulation, and investor behaviour. The Endogeneity of Liquidity Risk in Leveraged Fixed-Income Systems develops a clear theory of how liquidity is created inside the financial system and how it can disappear under stress. A bond may appear easy to sell in calm markets, financeable through repo, acceptable as collateral, and stable in daily valuation. Yet those qualities may depend on conditions that change quickly when volatility rises, funding tightens, or many investors try to exit at the same time.
url:9307b19f9a21dd81.abstract_zh: 流动性是现代固定收益市场的核心，但往往被过于简单地对待。债券通常被描述为具有流动性或缺乏流动性，仿佛流动性是证券本身固有的固定属性。本书挑战了这一观点，认为流动性并非债券的永久特征，而是一种由市场结构、融资安排、抵押品规则、交易商能力、估值实践、监管和投资者行为共同创造的脆弱状态。《杠杆固定收益系统中流动性风险的内生性》构建了一套清晰的理论，阐释流动性如何在金融体系内部被创造出来，又如何在压力下消失。一只债券在平静市场中可能看似易于出售、可通过回购融资、可被接受为抵押品且日常估值稳定，但这些特质可能依赖于某些条件——当波动性上升、资金收紧或大量投资者同时试图退出时，这些条件会迅速改变。

url:935e602f08cfce80.abstract: We reappraise the Arrow problem by studying the aggregation of choice functions. We do so in the general framework of judgment aggregation, in which choice functions are naturally representable by specifying, for each menu A and each alternative x in A , whether x is choosable from A , or not. Our framework suggests a natural strengthening of Arrow’s independence condition positing that the collective choosability of an alternative from a menu depends on the individual views on that issue, and that issue alone. Our analysis reveals that Arrovian impossibility results crucially hinge on what internal consistency requirements we impose on choice functions. While the aggregation of ‘binary’ choice functions, i.e.those satisfying both contraction (\(\alpha \)) and expansion (\(\gamma \)) consistency, is necessarily dictatorial, possibilities in the form of oligarchic rules emerge for path-independent choice functions, that is, when the expansion property \(\gamma \) is replaced by the so-called Aizerman condition. Remarkably, the Arrovian aggregation of choice functions is shown to be almost dictatorial already under property \(\gamma \) alone. When giving up expansion consistency, specific quota rules become possible.
url:935e602f08cfce80.abstract_zh: 我们通过研究选择函数的加总问题，重新审视了阿罗悖论。在判断加总的通用框架下，选择函数可自然地表示为：针对每个菜单A及其中的每个备选项x，明确x是否可从A中被选出。该框架提出了对阿罗独立性条件的自然强化，即集体对某备选项从某菜单中的可选择性，仅取决于个体对该议题的判断，且仅取决于该议题本身。分析表明，阿罗式不可能性结果的关键在于我们对选择函数施加何种内部一致性要求。当加总满足收缩一致性（\(\alpha\)）与扩张一致性（\(\gamma\)）的"二元"选择函数时，结果必然具有独裁性；而对于路径独立型选择函数（即用所谓的艾泽曼条件替代扩张性质\(\gamma\)），则可能出现寡头规则形式的可能性。值得注意的是，仅凭性质\(\gamma\)，阿罗式选择函数加总已近乎呈现独裁特征。若放弃扩张一致性，则特定配额规则成为可能。

url:937dcb91bf2acc41.abstract: This paper examines how global greenfield foreign direct investment (FDI) flows are evolving amid rising geoeconomic fragmentation. We use difference-in-differences and event study approaches to analyze changes in FDI around key bilateral inflection points. We find a decline in FDI from the US and broader Group of Seven Plus (G7+) into the PRC, concentrated in trade-exposed, efficiency-seeking sectors. Investment diversion—particularly from the PRC to Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) members and Latin America—is evident, but this growth was concentrated in less global value chain (GVC)-integrated activities, suggesting that GVC links may act as a constraint on investment relocation. These findings suggest that while tensions may be reshaping global investment, GVC dependencies are likely limiting firms’ ability to reallocate production at scale, making the “great reallocation” least evident where it was most expected.
url:937dcb91bf2acc41.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在地缘经济碎片化加剧的背景下，全球绿地外商直接投资（FDI）流动的演变趋势。我们采用双重差分法和事件研究法，分析关键双边关系转折点前后FDI的变化。研究发现，来自美国及更广泛的七国集团+（G7+）经济体对中国的FDI有所下降，且主要集中在贸易敏感型、效率寻求型行业。投资转移现象明显——尤其是从中国流向东南亚国家联盟（ASEAN）成员国和拉丁美洲——但这种增长集中于全球价值链（GVC）整合程度较低的活动，表明GVC联系可能对投资重新布局构成制约。这些发现表明，尽管地缘紧张局势可能正在重塑全球投资格局，但GVC依赖关系很可能限制了企业大规模重新配置生产能力，使得“大转移”在最被预期的领域反而最不明显。

url:94227a97b0b8e1e8.abstract: This paper provides a general review of recent developments in the application of control theory to macroeconomic policy design. It starts by highlighting the crucial difference between the engineering and economic control problem, in that the latter, unlike the former, is concerned with the control of intelligent systems. It examines the problems that this creates for macroeconomic policy formulation, and considers the usefulness of the rational expectations assumption in this context. Policy formulation is then analysed in the context of an interdependent world, and the dangers of single country policy optimisation are highlighted. It is argued that the most pressing issue is that of formulating appropriate rules, supported by penalty strategies, for the orderly conduct of macroeconomic policy in an international setting. The paper concludes by examining the conduct of United Kingdom macropolicy over the past five years, arguing that greater attention to issues of macropolicy design would have avoided some serious deficiencies in the conduct of policy.
url:94227a97b0b8e1e8.abstract_zh: 本文综述了控制理论在宏观经济政策设计中的最新应用进展。首先，文章强调了工程控制问题与经济控制问题的关键区别：后者与前者不同，涉及对智能系统的控制。文章探讨了这种区别对宏观经济政策制定带来的问题，并评估了理性预期假设在此背景下的适用性。随后，在相互依存的世界背景下分析了政策制定，并指出了单一国家政策优化的风险。文章认为，最紧迫的问题是在国际环境中制定适当的规则，并辅以惩罚策略，以有序实施宏观经济政策。最后，文章通过考察过去五年英国宏观政策的实施情况，指出若更关注宏观政策设计问题，本可避免政策实施中的若干严重缺陷。
