url:a3c6529b9a6fd88e.abstract: I develop a method that uses the language surrounding places, people, and other entities in dated text to measure their attributes over time, and use it to ask whether a local orientation toward useful knowledge predicts innovation and growth. Patterns of word use form a numerical map, or word embedding, in which fixed word lists define attribute scales for scoring each entity. Neither scales nor scores use outcomes, and publication dates restrict scores to prior text. Applied to 38.6 billion context-word occurrences in nearly 2.7 million English-language works from 1500-1899, the method recovers independently measured elevation and agricultural dependence and combines learning, science, practical improvement, and print in a useful-knowledge index. Within countries, a one-standard-deviation increase in the index is associated with 0.105 standard deviations higher log(1+patents) during 1980-2014 and a 3.4 percentage-point increase in the probability of any patent. The association remains 0.062 standard deviations in 7,011 cells without a recorded birthplace of a notable intellectual. An index reconstructed from pre-1750 contexts predicts 1980-2014 log patenting within countries at 0.053 standard deviations after controlling for textual coverage, with positive estimates in Europe, Asia, and Latin America. Training the embedding solely on pre-1750 text leaves the full-sample association positive. Within countries, the 1500-1899 index also predicts average nighttime light over 1992-2024 and regional GDP per capita in each region's latest available year, 2016-2020. In European cities, the pre-1750 index predicts faster post-1750 growth near coal, a complementarity concentrated in Britain. The findings support Mokyr's view of useful knowledge as a local innovative capacity and an Allen-Mokyr synthesis for Britain's coal-and-steam take-off.
url:a3c6529b9a6fd88e.abstract_zh: 我提出一种方法，利用文本中围绕地点、人物及其他实体的语言，测量其随时间变化的属性，并以此探究对实用知识的地方性取向能否预测创新与增长。词汇使用模式构成数值化地图（即词嵌入），其中固定词表定义属性标尺，用于对每个实体进行评分。标尺与评分均不依赖结果变量，且出版日期将评分限定于历史文本。将该方法应用于1500-1899年间近270万部英文著作中的386亿个上下文词汇实例后，该方法成功还原了独立测量的海拔高度与农业依赖度，并将学习、科学、实践改进与印刷术整合为实用知识指数。在国家层面，该指数每增加一个标准差，1980-2014年间log(1+专利数)提高0.105个标准差，且产生任何专利的概率上升3.4个百分点。在7011个未记录著名知识分子出生地的单元格中，该关联仍保持0.062个标准差。基于1750年前文本重建的指数，在控制文本覆盖范围后，可预测1980-2014年国家内log专利数达0.053个标准差，且欧洲、亚洲与拉丁美洲均呈现正向估计值。仅以1750年前文本训练词嵌入后，全样本关联仍保持正向。在国家层面，1500-1899年指数还可预测1992-2024年平均夜间灯光强度，以及各地区最新可用年份（2016-2020年）的区域人均GDP。在欧洲城市中，1750年前指数可预测1750年后煤炭资源附近更快的增长，这种互补性集中体现在英国。研究结果支持Mokyr关于实用知识作为地方创新能力的观点，以及英国煤炭与蒸汽腾飞的Allen-Mokyr综合解释。

url:a3dba51012d079a6.abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic has caused major disruptions in international trade and has raised concerns about adverse effects on international supply chains. Using a unique establishment survey matched with administrative data from Germany, we provide novel evidence on how establishments have adjusted their supply chains in response to pandemic-induced disruptions. We find that establishments that experienced difficulties in obtaining intermediate inputs as a result of the pandemic are significantly more likely to change their network of suppliers than establishments without such problems, especially if disruptions affected imports from abroad. Establishments experiencing supply chain difficulties are more likely to replace a distant with a closer supplier. However, these adjustments in response to the pandemic appear to be temporary.
url:a3dba51012d079a6.abstract_zh: COVID-19疫情对国际贸易造成了重大冲击，并引发了对国际供应链负面影响的担忧。通过将德国独特的机构调查数据与行政数据相匹配，我们提供了关于机构如何应对疫情引发的供应链中断而进行调整的新证据。研究发现，因疫情而面临中间投入品获取困难的机构，其调整供应商网络的可能性显著高于未遭遇此类问题的机构，尤其是当供应链中断影响到海外进口时。遭遇供应链困难的机构更倾向于用距离更近的供应商替代距离较远的供应商。然而，这些针对疫情的调整似乎是暂时性的。

url:a3f07b633d100d4c.abstract: We study the rise of nonbank financial intermediation and its implications for systemic risk. We develop a structural network model of banks and nonbank financial institutions (NBFIs) that decomposes intermediation into a capacity channel, driven by bank balance-sheet constraints, and a reliance channel, reflecting NBFI funding reliance. Using U.S. banking confidential supervisory data, we estimate key structural parameters and quantify both channels. We find that fluctuations in bank-NBFI intermediation are primarily explained by the reliance channel, with variation in NBFI fragility emerging as the dominant driver. We show that NBFI intermediation can amplify shocks through funding interconnectedness.
url:a3f07b633d100d4c.abstract_zh: 我们研究了非银行金融中介的兴起及其对系统性风险的影响。我们构建了一个包含银行与非银行金融机构（NBFIs）的结构性网络模型，将中介活动分解为两个渠道：由银行资产负债表约束驱动的能力渠道，以及反映非银行金融机构融资依赖性的依赖渠道。利用美国银行保密监管数据，我们估计了关键结构性参数并量化了这两个渠道。研究发现，银行与非银行金融机构之间中介活动的波动主要由依赖渠道解释，其中非银行金融机构脆弱性的变化成为主导驱动因素。我们证明，非银行金融中介可能通过融资互联性放大冲击。

url:a40399225084883e.abstract: We develop a simple overlapping generations model in which the young have a choice in investing in equities and index-linked bonds. Projections of share price uncertainty over a 30-year period show that the risk associated with such a long-term investment predicts an equity premium that matches historical values.

url:a4132ea8063134b2.abstract: we examine how SDB can distort treatment effects in experiments and discuss mitigation strategies. Translation created by Artificial Intelligence (LLM) #### Share Twitter Facebook LinkedIn is a pervasive threat to the validity of survey and experimental data. Respondents might often misreport sensitive attitudes and behaviors to appear more socially acceptable. We begin by synthesizing empirical evidence on the prevalence and magnitude of SDB across various domains, focusing on studies with individual-level benchmarks. We then critically assess commonly used strategies to mitigate SDB, highlighting how they can sometimes fail by creating confusion or inadvertently increasing perceived sensitivity. url:a4132ea8063134b2.abstract_zh: 我们考察了社会期望偏差（SDB）如何扭曲实验中的处理效应，并讨论了缓解策略。由人工智能（LLM）生成的翻译 #### 分享 Twitter Facebook LinkedIn 社会期望偏差（SDB）是调查与实验数据有效性的普遍威胁。受访者可能经常误报敏感态度和行为，以显得更符合社会期望。我们首先综合了各领域关于SDB普遍性与严重程度的实证证据，重点关注具有个体层面基准的研究。随后，我们批判性地评估了常用的SDB缓解策略，指出这些策略有时可能因造成混淆或无意中增加感知敏感性而失效。为帮助研究者应对这些挑战，我们提供了针对不同研究情境选择最合适工具的实际指导。最后，我们考察了SDB如何扭曲实验中的处理效应，并讨论了缓解策略。

url:a45bd82a9de5d37d.abstract: We study the effects of taxi market deregulation in Finland, which removed price controls and lowered barriers to entry. The reform led to a surge in firm entry and a modest increase in exit, indicating substantial changes in market structure. Average taxi prices increased slightly according to price indices, while monthly firm-level reported sales and VAT declined by over 10 percent. Operating costs and mileage remained largely unchanged, suggesting limited demand responses. These findings point to increased tax evasion following deregulation. Consistent with this interpretation, we document a small rise in property crime, with no effects on other criminal offenses.
url:a45bd82a9de5d37d.abstract_zh: 本文研究了芬兰出租车市场放松管制的影响，该改革取消了价格控制并降低了市场准入门槛。改革导致企业大量进入市场，退出数量略有增加，表明市场结构发生了显著变化。根据价格指数，出租车平均价格小幅上涨，而企业月度报告销售额和增值税下降了超过10%。运营成本和行驶里程基本保持不变，表明需求反应有限。这些发现表明放松管制后逃税行为有所增加。与这一解释一致，我们记录了财产犯罪的小幅上升，而对其他刑事犯罪没有影响。

url:a48c624c552ae10e.abstract: After substantial growth in the 1990s and 2000s, enrollment in the U.S. Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) program has been declining since 2013. We use detailed administrative data to quantify the contributions of various factors to trends in SSDI enrollment, focusing especially on the decline in the 2010s. A statistical decomposition suggests that the vast majority of the decline in SSDI enrollment since 2013 is attributable to declines in application rates—and, to a lesser extent, award rates—within demographic groups. There is very little contribution from changes over time in demographic characteristics, eligibility, or exit from SSDI. The decline in SSDI enrollment rates is disproportionately driven by low-to-middle-skilled men who, over time, have become less likely to apply for SSDI and more likely to work. Consistent with this descriptive evidence, we present results from a causal analysis suggesting that improved labor market opportunity for less-skilled men is a key explanation for the decline in SSDI enrollment. We also investigate several other popular hypotheses for the decline in SSDI applications, including lower award rates at the appeals level, and find evidence at odds with them.
url:a48c624c552ae10e.abstract_zh: 在1990年代和2000年代经历了显著增长后，美国社会保障残疾保险（SSDI）项目的参保人数自2013年起持续下降。我们利用详细的行政数据量化了各因素对SSDI参保趋势的贡献，重点关注2010年代的下降趋势。统计分解表明，2013年以来SSDI参保人数的下降绝大部分可归因于各人口群体内申请率的下降（以及较小程度上的批准率下降）。人口特征、资格条件或退出SSDI的时序变化对下降趋势的贡献微乎其微。SSDI参保率的下降主要由中低技能男性群体驱动——随着时间的推移，该群体申请SSDI的可能性降低，而就业可能性上升。与这一描述性证据一致，我们通过因果分析发现，低技能男性劳动力市场机会的改善是解释SSDI参保率下降的关键因素。我们还检验了其他几种关于SSDI申请下降的流行假说（包括上诉阶段批准率降低），但发现证据与之相悖。

url:a52e0d8f8d6751d2.abstract: This paper analyses the impact of introducing progressivity into the Hungarian personal income tax (PIT) system on tax revenues, growth and inequality. This reform would strengthen labour market participation by reducing the labour tax wedge for low-income earners and improve the responsiveness of tax revenues to economic growth. Using a framework combining static effects and behavioural responses along both the extensive margin (employment effects) and the intensive margin (substitution and income effects), and accounting for tax buoyancy, the analysis shows that the reform becomes revenue-enhancing once these dynamic effects are considered. Aligning capital income taxation more closely with labour taxation further strengthens tax revenues. The comprehensive reform would raise the tax-to-GDP ratio by 0.4–0.8pp by 2040, depending on the specific reform scenario and assumed parameters. By stimulating employment among low- and middle-income workers and despite moderate disincentives for higher-income earners, the reform would boost potential GDP in all scenarios. The reform would also significantly reduce income inequality and strengthen redistribution.
url:a52e0d8f8d6751d2.abstract_zh: 本文分析了在匈牙利个人所得税体系中引入累进性对税收收入、经济增长及不平等的影响。这一改革将通过降低低收入者的劳动税楔来增强劳动力市场参与度，并提高税收收入对经济增长的响应能力。通过采用结合静态效应与行为反应（涵盖广延边际的就业效应和集约边际的替代效应与收入效应）的分析框架，并考虑税收弹性，研究表明一旦纳入这些动态效应，该改革将提升税收收入。将资本收入税与劳动税进一步协调，可进一步强化税收收入。根据具体改革方案和假设参数，到2040年，全面改革将使税收占GDP比重提高0.4至0.8个百分点。通过刺激中低收入者的就业（尽管对高收入者产生适度抑制效应），该改革在所有情景下均能提升潜在GDP。此外，改革还将显著降低收入不平等并强化再分配效应。

url:a5ad5132cb354fcd.abstract: We document that China’s 2018 domestic regulations, which suppressed the future growth potential of its game app market, unintentionally triggered an immediate and significant export expansion in this sector. This expansion was largely accounted for by apps already established in foreign markets, and was significantly stronger among high-quality firms. To rationalize these patterns, we develop and calibrate a dynamic model featuring customer accumulation under capacity constraints. In response to the regulatory shocks, firms proactively reallocate resources toward foreign markets, with higher-quality firms exhibiting a stronger reallocation response. This proactive behavior further amplifies the welfare losses borne by domestic consumers.
url:a5ad5132cb354fcd.abstract_zh: 本文揭示了中国2018年实施的国内监管政策，在抑制其游戏应用市场未来增长潜力的同时，意外地引发了该行业即时且显著的出口扩张。这一扩张主要源于已在海外市场立足的应用产品，且在高品质企业中表现尤为突出。为解释上述现象，我们构建并校准了一个包含产能约束下客户积累特征的动态模型。面对监管冲击，企业主动将资源重新配置至海外市场，其中高品质企业展现出更强的资源再配置响应。这种主动行为进一步加剧了国内消费者承担的福利损失。
url:a5ad5132cb354fcd.title: Big push to export: Unintended consequences of China’s domestic regulations in digital game sector
url:a5ad5132cb354fcd.title_zh: 出口大推动：中国数字游戏行业国内规制的非预期后果

url:a5b448995d656cc1.abstract: This study analyzes the impact of the Romania Secondary Education Project, which was designed to improve student retention, graduation rates and pass rates on a national end-of-high-school exam for low-achievement high schools in Romania. The program was implemented in three waves, September 2017, September 2018, and September 2020, with eligible high schools randomly assigned to each. The study exploits this staggered implementation to measure the project’s causal impacts on students. The estimates indicate that the Romania Secondary Education Project had no significant impact on (i) student preferences for attending a program high school, (ii) student retention rates, (iii) high school graduation rates, (iv) enrollment in the post-high school baccalaureate exam, (v) baccalaureate exam pass rates, or (vi) baccalaureate exam scores. There was a small increase in girls’ passing rates (3 percentage points). However, there was little heterogeneity in the null effects by grant size, urban-rural status, student achievement levels, town income levels, and type of curriculum taught.
url:a5b448995d656cc1.abstract_zh: 本研究分析了罗马尼亚中等教育项目的影响，该项目旨在提高罗马尼亚低成就高中的学生保留率、毕业率及全国高中毕业会考的通过率。该项目分三批实施（2017年9月、2018年9月和2020年9月），符合条件的学校被随机分配至各批次。研究利用这一分阶段实施机制，衡量项目对学生产生的因果效应。估计结果表明，罗马尼亚中等教育项目对以下指标均无显著影响：（i）学生就读项目高中的偏好；（ii）学生保留率；（iii）高中毕业率；（iv）高中后会考注册率；（v）会考通过率；（vi）会考成绩。仅女生通过率出现小幅提升（3个百分点）。然而，按补助金额、城乡状况、学生学业水平、城镇收入水平及课程类型划分的异质性分析显示，零效应在各子样本中均未呈现显著差异。

url:a6d07e24bf9b82c1.abstract: Models of electoral accountability typically assume a politician provides a public good. Yet in many contexts, elected officials distribute private goods among voters with conflicting interests. We present a formal model to analyze this situation. An elected official allocates a rivalrous good to a number of voters, who each observe their own allocation but neither others’ allocations nor the official’s action. Each voter’s challenge is to determine whether the incumbent stole from other voters when deciding to sack or retain the incumbent. This problem can be resolved if voters retain the incumbent probabilistically, so that the vote of any voter from whom the incumbent steals is effectively up-weighted. However, this benefit of probabilistic voting also comes with a cost, since the fact that the incumbent may be sacked by mistake diminishes the allocation they are willing to provide to voters.
url:a6d07e24bf9b82c1.abstract_zh: 选举问责模型通常假设政治家提供公共产品。然而在许多情境中，民选官员会在利益冲突的选民之间分配私人产品。我们构建了一个正式模型来分析这种情况。一位民选官员将竞争性物品分配给若干选民，每位选民仅能观察到自身所得分配，既无法获知他人分配情况，也无法了解官员的具体行为。当决定是否罢免现任官员时，每位选民面临的挑战在于判断该官员是否侵占了其他选民的应得利益。若选民以概率化方式决定是否留任现任官员，这一问题便可得到解决——因为当官员侵占某位选民利益时，该选民的投票权重实际上会被提升。然而，这种概率化投票机制也伴随着代价：由于官员可能因误判而被罢免，这会降低其愿意向选民提供的分配额度。
url:a6d07e24bf9b82c1.title: Electoral accountability, distributive conflict, and probabilistic voting

url:a6e3431391e7aa58.abstract: Europe is converging on a definition of economic security as reduced dependence – de-risking, reshoring, buying European. This column argues that the definition is mistaken. Three decades of evidence on financial and production networks shows that resilience is a property of a node’s position in the network – the depth, diversity, and quality of its connections – not of the number of connections it has severed for self-sufficiency. Applying this test to critical input supply chains such as energy and defence – with Turkey, the EU’s largest customs union partner, as the defining case – the author argues that Europe passes the initiative’s ‘Singapore test’ only if it treats integration depth, rather than self-sufficiency, as the union’s security variable.
url:a6e3431391e7aa58.abstract_zh: 欧洲正在就经济安全的定义达成共识，即减少依赖——去风险、回流、购买欧洲产品。本文认为这一定义存在谬误。三十年来关于金融与生产网络的证据表明，韧性取决于节点在网络中的位置属性——其连接的深度、多样性和质量——而非为追求自给自足而切断的连接数量。作者以欧盟最大关税同盟伙伴土耳其作为典型案例，将这一检验标准应用于能源和国防等关键投入供应链，论证指出：只有当欧盟将一体化深度而非自给自足视为联盟的安全变量时，欧洲才能通过该倡议的"新加坡测试"。

url:a71129682c99dd32.abstract: This paper provides a nationally representative assessment of changes in women’s work in livestock rearing in rural India using unit-level data from the Time Use Surveys (TUS) 2019 and 2024. By situating the analysis within debates on the feminization of agriculture, the study examines shifts in participation and time allocation in livestock rearing among rural working-age individuals (15–59 years). While women’s participation in economic work increased modestly between 2019 and 2024, this expansion continues to coexist with a persistently high burden of unpaid domestic and caregiving services. Within agriculture, livestock emerges as a relatively more dynamic and gendered domain of work. Using the 2016 International Classification of Activities for Time-Use Statistics (ICATUS), livestock activities are disaggregated into own use and market-oriented livestock activities. Descriptive evidence shows that women’s participation in livestock activities increased from 11 percent in 2019 to 15 percent in 2024, with a particularly notable rise in market-oriented livestock activities across several states and agroecological zones. Although crop husbandry continues to dominate agricultural employment, both incidence and intensity of participation of women in livestock rearing has visibly increased. Regression results indicate a positive and significant year effect for total livestock and livestock activities, but not for livestock own-use activities, suggesting that the observed increase is primarily associated with market-oriented engagement rather than subsistence expansion. Education exhibits a strong negative association with livestock time use, especially for women, indicating that livestock remains a fallback activity under constrained employment options. Gelbach decomposition further shows that changes in age composition and educational attainment account for a substantial share of the explained variation, while monthly per capita consumption expenditure has a stronger and more consistently significant association with women’s livestock time use than men’s. Overall, the findings point to incremental change within a persistently gendered structure of rural time allocation.
url:a71129682c99dd32.abstract_zh: 本文利用2019年和2024年时间使用调查（TUS）的单元级数据，对印度农村女性在牲畜饲养领域工作的变化进行了全国代表性评估。通过将分析置于农业女性化议题的讨论中，本研究考察了农村劳动年龄人口（15-59岁）在牲畜饲养中的参与率及时间分配变化。尽管2019年至2024年间女性经济工作参与率略有上升，但这种增长仍与持续高负荷的无偿家务和照料服务并存。在农业领域，牲畜饲养成为相对更具动态性和性别差异的工作领域。基于2016年《时间使用统计国际分类》（ICATUS），本文将牲畜活动细分为自用型和市场导向型两类。描述性证据显示，女性参与牲畜活动的比例从2019年的11%增至2024年的15%，其中多个邦和农业生态区的市场导向型牲畜活动增长尤为显著。尽管作物种植仍主导农业就业，但女性参与牲畜饲养的广度和强度均明显提升。回归结果表明，总牲畜活动和市场导向型活动存在显著正向年份效应，但自用型活动不显著，说明观察到的增长主要与市场导向型参与相关，而非自给型扩张。教育水平与牲畜时间使用呈强负相关，尤其对女性而言，表明在就业选择受限时，牲畜饲养仍是替代性活动。Gelbach分解进一步显示，年龄结构和教育程度的变化解释了大部分可解释变异，而月人均消费支出对女性牲畜时间使用的影响比男性更强且更持续显著。总体而言，研究结果揭示了农村时间分配在持续性别化结构中的渐进式变化。
url:a71129682c99dd32.title: Intensification without empowerment? Gendered time burdens in India's livestock sector

url:a759498fb0a58b73.abstract: this Paper, we review recent empirical evidence regarding the special role of banks for the corporate governance of German firms. We differentiate between large exchange-listed firms and small and medium sized companies throughout. With respect to the role of banks as monitoring investors, the evidence does not unanimously support a special role of banks for large firms. Only one study finds that banks? control of management goes beyond what non-bank shareholders achieve. Proxy-voting rights apparently do not provide a significant means for banks to exert management control. Most of the recent evidence regarding small firms suggests that a Hausbank relationship can indeed be beneficial. Hausbanks are more willing to sustain financing when borrower quality deteriorates, and they invest more often than arm?s-length banks in workouts if borrowers face financial distress.
url:a759498fb0a58b73.abstract_zh: 本文回顾了关于银行在德国公司治理中特殊作用的最新实证证据。我们始终区分大型上市企业与中小型企业。就银行作为监督投资者的角色而言，证据并未一致支持银行对大型企业具有特殊作用。仅有一项研究发现，银行对管理层的控制超越了非银行股东所能实现的程度。代理投票权显然并未为银行提供显著的管理控制手段。关于小型企业的大多数最新证据表明，主银行关系确实可能带来益处。当借款人质量恶化时，主银行更愿意维持融资；若借款人面临财务困境，主银行比保持距离型银行更频繁地参与债务重组。

url:a77a00279c5dc2f8.abstract: There has been a dramatic rise in disability employment since the pandemic. At the same time, work from home (WFH) has risen four-fold. This paper asks whether the two are causally related. Controlling for compositional changes and labor market tightness, a 1 percentage point increase in WFH increases full-time employment by 1.0% for individuals with a physical disability. The postpandemic increase in working from home explains 68%-85% of the rise in full-time employment. Wage data suggests that WFH increased the supply of workers with a physical disability, likely by reducing commuting costs and enabling better control of working conditions.
url:a77a00279c5dc2f8.abstract_zh: 自疫情以来，残障人士就业率显著上升。与此同时，居家办公比例增长了四倍。本文旨在探究二者是否存在因果关系。在控制人口结构变化与劳动力市场紧张程度后，居家办公比例每上升1个百分点，身体残障人士的全职就业率将提高1.0%。疫情后居家办公的普及可解释全职就业率增长的68%-85%。工资数据表明，居家办公通过降低通勤成本并改善工作条件自主性，有效扩大了身体残障人士的劳动力供给。
url:a77a00279c5dc2f8.title: Work from Home and Disability Employment

url:a7deb09680fd82c4.abstract: This paper proposes corrected forecast combinations when the original combined forecast errors are serially dependent. Motivated by the classic Bates and Granger (1969) example, we show that combined forecast errors can be strongly autocorrelated and that a simple correction - adding a fraction of the previous combined error to the next-period combined forecast - can deliver sizable improvements in forecast accuracy, often exceeding the original gains from combining. We formalize the approach within the conditional-risk framework of Gibbs and Vasnev (2024), in which the combined error decomposes into a predictable component (measurable at the forecast origin) and an innovation. We then link this correction to efficient estimation of combination weights under time-series dependence via GLS, allowing joint estimation of weights and an error-covariance structure. Using the U.S. Survey of Professional Forecasters for major macroeconomic indices across various subsamples (including pre/post-2000, GFC, and COVID), we find that a parsimonious correction of the mean forecast with a coefficient around 0.5 is a robust starting point and often yields material improvements in forecast accuracy. For optimal-weight forecasts, the correction substantially mitigates the forecast combination puzzle by turning poorly performing out-of-sample optimal-weight combinations into competitive forecasts.
url:a7deb09680fd82c4.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种修正的组合预测方法，适用于原始组合预测误差存在序列相关性的情形。受Bates和Granger（1969）经典案例的启发，我们证明组合预测误差可能呈现强自相关性，而一个简单的修正——将上一期组合误差的一部分加入下一期组合预测——能够显著提升预测精度，其改进幅度往往超过组合本身带来的原始收益。我们在Gibbs和Vasnev（2024）的条件风险框架内对该方法进行了形式化处理，在该框架中，组合误差可分解为可预测成分（在预测起点可测）和创新项。随后，我们将该修正与时间序列依赖条件下通过广义最小二乘法对组合权重的高效估计联系起来，从而实现对权重与误差协方差结构的联合估计。基于美国专业预测者调查中主要宏观经济指标在不同子样本（包括2000年前后、全球金融危机及新冠疫情期间）的数据，我们发现，对均值预测采用系数约为0.5的简约修正是一个稳健的起点，且通常能带来预测精度的实质性提升。对于最优权重预测而言，该修正通过将表现不佳的样本外最优权重组合转化为具有竞争力的预测，显著缓解了预测组合难题。
url:a7deb09680fd82c4.title: Corrected Forecast Combinations

url:a80d28ffbfbf29ab.abstract: this paper we specify and estimate a structural model which accounts for competition in two variables: capacity and prices. The model has a two-stage set-up. In the first stage firms make capacity decisions followed by a product-differentiated, price-setting game in the second stage. Since costs are endogenized through the first stage, this has important implications for the measurement of market power in the product market. In particular, simpler one-stage specifications would result in a bias in the measurement of market power, which can be linked to the taxonomy for two-stage games given in Fudenberg and Tirole (1984). We then estimate this model ? demand, cost (short- and long-run), and conduct ? for the European airline industry using data for the period 1976?90. We perform a number of specification tests and reject a simple one-stage specification in favour of our two-stage set-up. In particular, we find that empirically the game is consistent with a fat-cat strategy. In other words, European airlines over-invest in capacities in order to be less aggressive. Moreover, we find that some degree of market power in the product market exists. Market power in the two-stage set-up is significantly lower than in the more widely employed one-stage specification, however, which is consistent with the direction of bias in fat-cat games. This illustrates that firms? market power in the product market is significantly overestimated whenever capacity competition is not accounted for.
url:a80d28ffbfbf29ab.abstract_zh: 本文构建并估计了一个考虑产能与价格双重竞争的结构性模型。该模型采用两阶段设定：第一阶段企业进行产能决策，随后在第二阶段展开产品差异化定价博弈。由于第一阶段内生化成本，这对产品市场市场势力的测度产生重要影响。具体而言，更简化的单阶段模型会导致市场势力测度出现偏差，这种偏差可关联至Fudenberg和Tirole（1984）提出的两阶段博弈分类体系。我们利用1976-1990年欧洲航空业数据，对模型的需求、成本（短期与长期）及市场行为进行估计。通过一系列设定检验，我们拒绝了单阶段模型，支持两阶段设定。实证结果表明，该博弈符合"肥猫策略"特征——欧洲航空公司通过过度投资产能来降低竞争强度。此外，产品市场存在一定程度的市场势力，但两阶段设定下的市场势力显著低于广泛使用的单阶段模型，这与肥猫博弈的偏差方向一致。这揭示出：若未考虑产能竞争，产品市场中的企业市场势力将被显著高估。
url:a80d28ffbfbf29ab.title: Capacity and Product Market Competition: Measuring Market Power in a 'Fat-Cat' Industry
url:a80d28ffbfbf29ab.title_zh: 产能与产品市场竞争：衡量“肥猫”行业的市场势力

url:a850550db25b69b1.abstract: We investigate the short- and long-run impacts of unexpected mortality on psychosocial health in the context of a large-scale high-mortality natural disaster, the 2004 Indian Ocean earthquake and tsunami. The effects of the tsunami-related mortality measured at the community level are contrasted with the effects of individual-specific loss of close kin using population-representative longitudinal survey data from the Study of the Tsunami Aftermath and Recovery. In the short-run, two years post-tsunami, both community and individual-level mortality exposures are significant predictors of elevated depression and post-traumatic stress symtoms. In the longer-run, ten years post-tsunami, individual-level exposures are slightly attenuated but remain significant predictors of both psychosocial health measures; in contrast, community-level mortality predicts post-traumatic stress but not depression symptoms. Mortality is linked to smaller household sizes in the short- and long-run and to less social support in the long-run, although the latter effect differs substantially for males and females. The estimates adjust for other tsunami exposure measures and, in the individual-level analyses, we compare people living in the same community at the time of the tsunami who were exposed to the same community-level mortality rate.
url:a850550db25b69b1.abstract_zh: 本文以2004年印度洋地震海啸这一大规模高死亡率自然灾害为背景，探究意外死亡对心理社会健康的短期与长期影响。通过使用"海啸后果与恢复研究"中具有人口代表性的纵向调查数据，我们将社区层面测量的海啸相关死亡率影响与个体层面近亲丧失的影响进行对比。在短期（海啸后两年）内，社区与个体层面的死亡暴露均是抑郁症状与创伤后应激症状加剧的显著预测因子。在长期（海啸后十年）内，个体层面暴露的影响虽略有减弱，但仍对两项心理健康指标具有显著预测作用；相比之下，社区层面死亡率仅能预测创伤后应激症状，而非抑郁症状。死亡率与短期及长期家庭规模缩小相关，并与长期社会支持减少相关，但后者效应在男女性别间存在显著差异。本研究在估计中调整了其他海啸暴露指标，并在个体层面分析中，对比了海啸发生时居住于同一社区且面临相同社区死亡率的人群。

url:a866cce03ce948f1.abstract: China’s unprecedented expansion of higher education in 1999, increased annual college enrollment from 1 million to 9.6 million by 2020. We trace the global ripple effects of that expansion by examining its impact on US graduate education and local economies surrounding college towns. Combining administrative data from China’s college admissions system and US visa data, we leverage the centralized quota system governing Chinese college admissions for identification and present three key findings. First, the expansion of Chinese undergraduate education drove graduate student flows to the US: every additional 100 college graduates in China led to 3.6 Chinese graduate students in the US. Second, Chinese master’s students generated positive spillovers, driving the birth of new master’s programs, and increasing the number of other international and American master's students, particularly in STEM fields. And third, the influx of international students supported local economies around college towns, raising job creation rates outside the universities, as well. Our findings highlight how domestic education policy in one country can reshape the academic and economic landscape of another through student migration and its broader spillovers.
url:a866cce03ce948f1.abstract_zh: 中国1999年启动的高等教育史无前例的扩招，使年度大学招生人数从100万增至2020年的960万。我们通过考察该扩招对美国研究生教育及大学城周边地方经济的影响，追溯其全球涟漪效应。结合中国高考录取系统的行政数据与美国签证数据，我们利用中国大学招生的集中配额制度进行识别，得出三项核心发现：第一，中国本科教育的扩张推动了赴美研究生流动——中国每增加100名大学毕业生，美国便新增3.6名中国研究生；第二，中国硕士生产生正向溢出效应，催生新硕士项目设立，并带动其他国际学生及美国本土硕士生数量增长，尤其在STEM领域表现显著；第三，国际学生涌入为大学城周边地方经济提供支撑，同时提升了大学以外的就业岗位创造率。研究揭示了一国国内教育政策如何通过学生迁移及其广泛溢出效应，重塑另一国的学术与经济格局。

url:a9435521c9b77d7d.abstract: We develop a market-based measure of firms' and industries' exposure to foreign trade disruptions. Combining this approach with detailed supervisory data, we quantify large U.S. banks' exposure to such disruptions and propose a novel bank-level vulnerability index. We show that banks with greater exposure experienced significantly larger stock price declines following the April 2025 tariff announcements. Our vulnerability index explains 18% of the cross-sectional variation in bank returns during this episode.
url:a9435521c9b77d7d.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一种基于市场的企业及行业对外贸易中断风险敞口度量方法。结合详尽的监管数据，我们量化了美国大型银行对此类风险的敞口程度，并提出了一种新颖的银行层面脆弱性指数。研究表明，在2025年4月关税政策宣布后，风险敞口较大的银行股价跌幅显著更大。该脆弱性指数可解释此轮银行股收益率截面差异的18%。

url:a9c92048da28cbe2.abstract: This paper studies how short-term variations in fine particulate matter (PM2.5) pollution affects cognitive performance across tasks of varying complexity. While prior work shows that pollution impairs performance in highly demanding cognitive settings, it remains unclear whether these effects extend to simpler tasks. We examine this question using data from official Rubik's Cube tournaments in the United States and India. Solving different cube sizes provides a natural proxy for task complexity, while solving time measures cognitive performance. To identify causal effects, we exploit exogenous variation in local PM2.5 generated by wind direction. We find that PM2.5 pollution has negligible effects on simple tasks but significantly slows performance on complex ones for tournaments in the United States. In India, where baseline PM2.5 levels are substantially higher, we find similar effect patterns but none of the effects are statistically significant. We show that this pattern is explained by diminishing marginal sensitivity to short-term PM2.5 shocks as baseline PM2.5 pollution levels increase. Our findings provide causal evidence that the cognitive costs of PM2.5 pollution depend critically on task complexity.
url:a9c92048da28cbe2.abstract_zh: 本文研究了细颗粒物（PM2.5）污染的短期波动如何影响不同复杂度任务中的认知表现。尽管已有研究表明污染会损害高认知需求环境下的表现，但尚不清楚这些影响是否延伸至简单任务。我们利用美国和印度官方魔方锦标赛的数据来探究这一问题。不同尺寸魔方的解法可作为任务复杂度的自然代理变量，而解题时间则衡量认知表现。为识别因果效应，我们利用风向引起的当地PM2.5外生变化。研究发现，PM2.5污染对美国锦标赛中简单任务的影响微乎其微，但显著降低了复杂任务的表现速度。在基线PM2.5水平显著更高的印度，我们观察到相似的影响模式，但所有效应均未达到统计显著性。我们证明，这一模式可通过短期PM2.5冲击的边际敏感性随基线PM2.5污染水平升高而递减来解释。研究结果提供了因果证据，表明PM2.5污染的认知成本关键取决于任务复杂度。

url:aa1578de8b803667.abstract: We study participation in sponsored-search auctions when sellers can also appear as organic results. Under the platform’s ex post revenue-maximizing display rule, organic placement acts as an endogenous outside option: the best-matched sellers shade their bids and entry into bidding remains incomplete. The platform gains by committing to show more sponsored results than is ex post optimal, degrading match quality. Empirically, using Amazon search data and a Gini-based measure of query breadth, we confirm the model’s predictions: narrower queries receive fewer sponsored results, and sponsored results are worse matched than organic ones, especially for narrow queries.
url:aa1578de8b803667.abstract_zh: 我们研究了当卖家也能以自然搜索结果出现时，其参与赞助搜索拍卖的行为。在平台事后收益最大化的展示规则下，自然排名充当了内生外部选择：匹配度最高的卖家会压低出价，且竞价参与仍不充分。平台通过承诺展示比事后最优更多的赞助结果来获益，但这会降低匹配质量。基于亚马逊搜索数据及基尼系数衡量的查询广度，我们实证验证了模型预测：窄查询获得的赞助结果更少，且赞助结果的匹配质量低于自然结果，尤其在窄查询中更为显著。

url:aa35bd51d0916c81.abstract: Trust in official economic statistics has become an increasingly salient policy issue, including in the US where the Commissioner of the Bureau of Labor Statistics was dismissed in August 2025 amid allegations that agency data had been manipulated. This column shows that the events produced a sharp increase in economic policy uncertainty, with existing estimates linking uncertainty to macroeconomic outcomes implying that the resulting loss of confidence may have reduced US GDP by roughly $20 billion. While some economic activity postponed during periods of uncertainty may eventually occur later, there are reasons to believe that at least part of the effect could be lasting.
url:aa35bd51d0916c81.abstract_zh: 对官方经济统计数据的信任已成为日益突出的政策问题，包括在美国，劳工统计局局长于2025年8月因机构数据被操纵的指控而被解雇。本专栏显示，这些事件导致经济政策不确定性急剧上升，现有估计将不确定性与宏观经济结果联系起来，表明由此产生的信心丧失可能使美国GDP减少约200亿美元。尽管在不确定性期间推迟的部分经济活动最终可能发生，但有理由相信至少部分影响可能是持久的。

url:aaf460f1aaba7f91.abstract: this paper contributes to this literature by investigating factors determining the demand for hospitalization in Germany. While most previous studies have found a significant impact of social insurance on the demand for hospital trips, the empirical results presented here cast doubts on the propelling role of those economic incentives in the German case. There are also important differences in the hospitalization behaviour of men and women and between the full sample and those who are chronically ill, which have been neglected by the literature. The analysis relies on various count data models including Poisson, NEGBIN, ZIP (/), hurdle Poisson and NEGBIN panel models, and the findings are rather robust.
url:aaf460f1aaba7f91.abstract_zh: 本文通过探究德国住院需求的决定因素，为该领域文献做出贡献。尽管以往多数研究发现社会保险对住院需求具有显著影响，但本文的实证结果对经济激励在德国案例中的推动作用提出了质疑。此外，男性和女性在住院行为上存在显著差异，全样本与慢性病患者群体之间也存在重要差异，而这些差异此前被文献所忽视。本研究采用多种计数数据模型进行分析，包括泊松模型、负二项模型、零膨胀泊松模型、障碍泊松模型及负二项面板模型，研究结果具有较高的稳健性。

url:aaf8dedde1d72b15.abstract: The rise of generative AI has raised hopes that high-quality, personalised financial advice might finally become cheap and universally accessible. This column develops a method to quantify the impact of following AI financial advice over a lifetime. The authors find that on the decisions that matter most for long-run wealth, such as investing in diversified equity or building a savings buffer, today’s leading models give advice broadly consistent with what economists would prescribe. But what people get from AI depends as much on the model's ability as on how they write their prompts, with the advice varying by gender, financial literacy, and prior AI experience.
url:aaf8dedde1d72b15.abstract_zh: 生成式人工智能的兴起引发了人们的期待：高质量、个性化的财务建议或许终于能够变得廉价且普及。本文提出了一种方法，用以量化遵循人工智能财务建议对一生财富的影响。作者发现，在影响长期财富的关键决策上，例如投资多元化股票或建立储蓄缓冲，当前领先的模型给出的建议与经济学家通常推荐的内容基本一致。然而，人们从人工智能中获得的建议不仅取决于模型的能力，还取决于他们如何编写提示词，且建议内容因性别、金融素养和先前的人工智能使用经验而异。

url:ab155538ea744998.abstract: This paper develops an analytical structure for assessing the process of international trade negotiations that includes interest groups and self-interested negotiators as fundamental elements. The central conclusion of the analysis is that it is likely to be very difficult for a government that wishes to promote national welfare to do so. The political economy analysis suggests there are strong incentives facing politicians to produce agreements whose profile appears distinctly liberalizing while significant protectionist character flaws tend to be buried in the esoterica. The primary need is to design institutions that will help to introduce much greater transparency in both regional and multilateral agreements and thereby encourage the mobilization of diffuse consumer interests. Only then will significant progress towards liberalization - whether regional or multilateral - become more likely.
url:ab155538ea744998.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个分析国际贸易谈判进程的分析框架，将利益集团与自利型谈判者作为核心要素。分析的核心结论是：试图提升国民福利的政府很可能难以实现这一目标。政治经济学分析表明，政治家面临强烈激励去达成表面呈现显著自由化特征、而重大保护主义缺陷往往深藏于晦涩条款中的协议。当务之急是设计有助于提升区域及多边协议透明度的制度安排，从而激励分散的消费者利益群体形成合力。唯有如此，无论是区域还是多边层面的自由化进程才更有可能取得实质性突破。

url:ab3a9a5ddf1b985e.abstract: We study the anatomy of the international portfolio finance network. As global financial linkages have become denser over time, cross-border portfolio equity positions have grown in importance relative to debt for Emerging markets and Advanced economies. Using the framework developed by Stavrakeva and Rey (2024), we construct a novel proxy of daily foreign investor holdings in both equity and long-term sovereign debt markets across 32 currency areas. Leveraging an instrumental variable strategy, we identify an effect of foreign equity ETF inflows on exchange rates and local stock market prices. Our high-frequency proxy enables us to interpret episodes of turbulence in international finance. It should prove useful to assess how persistent the current shocks to the international financial system are likely to be.
url:ab3a9a5ddf1b985e.abstract_zh: 本文研究了国际组合金融网络的结构。随着全球金融联系日益紧密，跨境组合股权头寸在新兴市场和发达经济体中的重要性相对于债务持续上升。基于Stavrakeva与Rey（2024）构建的分析框架，我们创新性地构建了涵盖32个货币区域的股票及长期主权债券市场每日外国投资者持有量的代理指标。通过工具变量策略，我们识别出外国股权ETF资金流入对汇率及本地股票市场价格存在显著影响。这一高频代理指标使我们能够解读国际金融市场的动荡时期，并为评估当前国际金融体系冲击的持续性提供分析工具。

url:ab408d99af2514d5.abstract: Marriage payments are transfers made in connection with marriage and are among the most widespread and enduring institutions in human history. They can be categorized into three forms: bride price, paid by the groom or his family to the bride’s parents; dowry, transferred from the bride’s family to the groom or his kin; and dower, paid by the groom directly to the bride and retained as her property. Although their prevalence has declined in many industrialized societies, marriage payments remain common across large parts of Asia, Africa, the Middle East, and Oceania. Their persistence reflects the fact that they serve multiple economic and social functions simultaneously. Marriage payments can facilitate matching in marriage markets, redistribute marital surplus, transfer wealth across generations, provide insurance within marriage, and signal status, prestige, and adherence to social norms. Marriage payments influence a wide range of outcomes, including household savings, fertility decisions, child marriage, educational investments, migration, bargaining power within marriage, and marital stability. Their effects often extend beyond the married couple themselves, shaping intergenerational patterns of wealth transmission and human capital formation. As such, the consequences of marriage payments are far-reaching. Their welfare implications depend critically on the direction of transfers, who retains control over them after marriage, and the broader legal and social institutions in which they are embedded. In some settings, marital transfers can enhance women’s economic security and bargaining power. In others, they may contribute to gender inequality, violence, coercion, son preference, and constraints on women’s autonomy. The significance of these welfare consequences warrants the attention of policymakers. Accordingly, marriage payments have generated considerable debate and ongoing efforts toward legal reform. At the same time, the diversity of marriage payment systems suggests caution in the design of public policy. Blanket prohibitions or externally imposed reforms may overlook the multiple functions these institutions perform and may generate unintended consequences. More promising approaches may focus on mitigating specific harmful features while preserving functions that families value, particularly where marriage payments remain deeply embedded in local social, economic, and legal systems.
url:ab408d99af2514d5.abstract_zh: 婚姻支付是与婚姻相关的财产转移，是人类历史上最普遍且最持久的制度之一。其形式可分为三类：聘礼，由新郎或其家庭支付给新娘父母；嫁妆，从新娘家庭转移给新郎或其亲属；以及聘金，由新郎直接支付给新娘并作为其个人财产保留。尽管在众多工业化社会中婚姻支付的盛行程度有所下降，但在亚洲、非洲、中东和大洋洲的大部分地区，婚姻支付仍然普遍存在。其持续性反映了这些支付同时服务于多种经济和社会功能。婚姻支付可以促进婚姻市场中的匹配、重新分配婚姻剩余、实现代际财富转移、在婚姻内部提供保险，并传递地位、声望及对社会规范的遵从。婚姻支付影响广泛的结果，包括家庭储蓄、生育决策、童婚、教育投资、迁移、婚姻内部议价能力以及婚姻稳定性。其影响往往超越夫妻本身，塑造代际财富传递模式和人力资本形成。因此，婚姻支付的后果具有深远影响。其福利效应关键取决于转移的方向、婚后谁保留对转移财产的控制权，以及这些支付所嵌入的更广泛的法律和社会制度。在某些情境下，婚姻转移可以增强女性的经济安全和议价能力；在其他情境下，则可能加剧性别不平等、暴力、胁迫、男孩偏好以及对女性自主权的限制。这些福利后果的重要性值得政策制定者关注。相应地，婚姻支付引发了大量争论和持续的法律改革努力。同时，婚姻支付体系的多样性提示公共政策设计需谨慎。全面禁止或外部强加的改革可能忽视这些制度所履行的多重功能，并可能产生意外后果。更有前景的方法可能是聚焦于减轻特定有害特征，同时保留家庭所珍视的功能，尤其是在婚姻支付仍深深嵌入当地社会、经济和法律体系的地区。

url:ab408d99af2514d5.title_zh: 婚姻支付的经济学：聘礼、嫁妆与寡妇产

url:ab5675ceea837849.abstract: We develop a framework to compare the relative effectiveness of subsidizing alternative emission-reducing technologies. We show that an intermediate technology may reduce emissions more effectively than the cleanest technology if it induces sufficiently greater substitution away from the prevailing high-emission technology. We apply the framework to the South Korean passenger vehicle market using a demand model that incorporates mileage heterogeneity, an important determinant of fuel-type choice. First, reallocating existing subsidies from battery electric vehicles (BEVs), the cleanest technology, to hybrid electric vehicles (HEVs), an intermediate technology, would reduce total greenhouse gas emissions by an additional 47\%. Second, for a BEV-focused subsidy policy to outperform an HEV-focused policy, the carbon intensity of electricity generation would need to fall by approximately 45\%. Our findings suggest that HEV subsidies remain more effective than BEV subsidies until consumers become sufficiently willing to switch to BEVs or electricity generation becomes sufficiently decarbonized.
url:ab5675ceea837849.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个分析框架，用于比较补贴不同减排技术的相对有效性。研究表明，若中间技术能显著促使消费者从当前高排放技术转向该技术，其减排效果可能优于最清洁技术。我们将该框架应用于韩国乘用车市场，采用了一个考虑里程异质性（影响燃料类型选择的关键因素）的需求模型。研究发现：第一，将现有补贴从最清洁的纯电动汽车（BEV）重新分配至中间技术的混合动力汽车（HEV），可使温室气体总排放量额外降低47%；第二，若要使以BEV为核心的补贴政策效果优于以HEV为核心的政策，电力生产的碳强度需下降约45%。结论表明，在消费者对BEV的转换意愿足够强烈或电力生产实现充分脱碳之前，HEV补贴始终比BEV补贴更有效。

url:ac1306993af194fb.abstract: We study how entrepreneurs respond to investment opportunities created by new technologies. Using the staggered rollout of broadband internet in Norway as a natural experiment, we find that access to the new technology increases startup rates by about 25% without reducing their quality. The effects are strongest in ICT-intensive industries, and treated entrepreneurs are more likely to invest in complementary assets such as computers. Consistent with existing literature, established firms show a more muted response to the new technology. Our findings suggest that entrepreneurs play a key role in adapting the economy to technological change.
url:ac1306993af194fb.abstract_zh: 我们研究了企业家如何应对新技术带来的投资机会。利用挪威宽带互联网分阶段推广作为自然实验，我们发现新技术的接入使创业率提高了约25%，且并未降低创业质量。这一效应在ICT密集型行业最为显著，受技术影响的企业家更倾向于投资计算机等互补性资产。与现有文献一致，现有企业对新技术反应较为平缓。研究结果表明，企业家在推动经济适应技术变革中发挥着关键作用。
url:ac1306993af194fb.title: New Technology and Entrepreneurship

url:ac13bae7a2377a3e.abstract: Quantitative easing has faced recent criticism for causing large central bank losses and contributing to the post-COVID inflation, raising the question of under what conditions it may be warranted as a tool to fight recessions. This column employs a model that allows for an empirically realistic account of the key transmission mechanisms of quantitative easing and finds significant macroeconomic and fiscal benefits of using it to fight recessions when inflation is expected to remain well below the central bank’s target for a protracted period. However, there is reason for caution when deploying it in shallow recessions where it runs more risk of causing the economy to overheat.
url:ac13bae7a2377a3e.abstract_zh: 量化宽松政策近期因导致央行巨额亏损及助长疫情后通胀而受到批评，这引发了一个问题：在何种条件下，该政策可作为应对衰退的合理工具。本文采用了一个能够对量化宽松关键传导机制进行符合实证现实的建模分析，发现当通胀预期将在较长时间内持续远低于央行目标时，运用量化宽松应对衰退可带来显著的宏观经济与财政效益。然而，在浅度衰退中部署该政策需保持谨慎，因其更易引发经济过热风险。

url:ac1ebc53fd0b9937.abstract: this paper we solve a particular type of stochastic process switching problem where the terminal date is fixed but the terminal price may depend on past prices. The conclusions from our analysis may provide guidelines not only for the initial EMU members, but also for the countries that join at a later stage.

url:ac264e205a20758d.abstract: This paper shows that sovereign bond spreads are shaped not only by absolute debt levels but also by a country’s relative debt position within its peer group. Using panel fixed effects for over 80 emerging and developing economies over 1993-2024, we find that relative debt—especially benchmarked by income and commodity status—has greater explanatory power for spreads than gross debt alone. A one–standard deviation increase in relative debt raises spreads by roughly 0.2–0.3 standard deviations, comparable in magnitude to global risk indicators. Similarly, a 10 percent increase in relative debt is associated with a 3.8 percent increase in sovereign spreads, all else equal. The effect of relative debt is state-dependent, being stronger in countries with better institutions, access to concessional lending, and during periods of low risk aversion and ample global liquidity. These results hold across alternative specifications, sample periods, methodologies, and controls, which underscores the comparative nature of investor assessments and the importance of benchmarking for fiscal policy, debt management, and international surveillance.
url:ac264e205a20758d.abstract_zh: 本文表明，主权债券利差不仅受绝对债务水平影响，还取决于一国在其同类国家中的相对债务位置。基于1993-2024年间80多个新兴经济体和发展中经济体的面板固定效应模型，我们发现相对债务——尤其是以收入和商品类别为基准衡量的相对债务——对利差的解释力强于总债务。相对债务每增加一个标准差，利差约上升0.2-0.3个标准差，其影响幅度与全球风险指标相当。类似地，在其他条件不变的情况下，相对债务每增加10%，主权利差将上升3.8%。相对债务的影响具有状态依赖性：在制度质量较高、可获得优惠贷款的国家，以及全球风险规避程度较低、流动性充裕的时期，其效应更为显著。上述结论在替代设定、样本区间、方法论及控制变量下均保持稳健，凸显了投资者评估的比较属性，以及基准化分析对财政政策、债务管理和国际监督的重要性。

url:ac7bdc2c53350c0c.abstract: We consider a medium-scale macroeconomic model where the zero lower bound on interest rates remains binding permanently. We estimate the model for the Japanese economy, encompassing both active and passive fiscal policy scenarios. Our findings reveal a predominantly passive fiscal policy stance during the period spanning from 1995 to 2023. We compute fiscal multipliers for various policy instruments, showing that under the backdrop of passive fiscal policy: i) multipliers are lower than in an active fiscal policy regime; ii) government spending multipliers remain below one; iii) tax reductions can be associated with a decrease in output and inflation. A counterfactual analysis suggests that a more active fiscal policy would have resulted in a higher price level without increasing output volatility.
url:ac7bdc2c53350c0c.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个中等规模的宏观经济模型，其中利率零下限永久性具有约束力。我们利用日本经济数据对该模型进行估计，涵盖了积极与消极财政政策两种情景。研究结果表明，在1995年至2023年期间，日本主要采取消极财政政策立场。我们计算了不同政策工具的财政乘数，发现在消极财政政策背景下：（i）乘数低于积极财政政策体制；（ii）政府支出乘数始终小于1；（iii）减税可能导致产出与通胀下降。反事实分析表明，若采取更积极的财政政策，将实现更高的价格水平，且不会增加产出波动性。

url:acaaa81fdf83bda9.abstract: We compare the informativeness of order statistics in a sample of conditionally independent draws from a distribution F(x|θ) as the sample size n increases. The k-th highest of n+1 draws is more accurate than the k-th highest of n if and only if the cumulative reverse hazard − log F(x|θ) is log-supermodular. Symmetrically, the k-th lowest is more accurate if and only if the cumulative hazard − log (1−F(x|θ)) is log-supermodular. Reversals are exceptional, occurring only for experiments that are, up to increasing transformations, exponential location experiments. In large samples, middle order statistics are asymptotically fully informative, while bounded lower and upper ranks require unbounded informativeness tail conditions. When full learning fails, bounded ranks converge to location experiments, and more central ranks are Blackwell more informative. Extending the analysis from scalar order statistics to blocks of selected data, we obtain multidimensional comparisons under log-supermodularity of hazard rates. The results unify and extend information-aggregation results in auctions and provide a new order-statistic approach to strategic voting.
url:acaaa81fdf83bda9.abstract_zh: 我们比较了在条件独立抽样分布F(x|θ)中，随着样本量n增大，顺序统计量的信息含量。当且仅当累积逆风险函数−log F(x|θ)为对数超模时，n+1次抽样中的第k高顺序统计量比n次抽样中的第k高顺序统计量更精确。对称地，当且仅当累积风险函数−log (1−F(x|θ))为对数超模时，第k低顺序统计量更精确。反转情况极为罕见，仅出现在经过递增变换后等价于指数位置实验的实验中。在大样本条件下，中间顺序统计量渐近地具有完全信息含量，而有限的下界和上界秩次则需要无界信息含量尾部条件。当完全学习失效时，有界秩次收敛于位置实验，且更中心的秩次在Blackwell意义上具有更高信息含量。将分析从标量顺序统计量扩展至选定数据块后，我们在风险率对数超模条件下获得了多维比较结果。这些结论统一并拓展了拍卖中的信息聚合结果，并为策略性投票提供了新的顺序统计量分析方法。

url:ace73f7d6b9939f3.abstract: We study the effect of ambiguity on timing decisions. An agent faces a stopping problem with an uncertain stopping payoff and a stochastic time limit. The agent is unsure about the correct model quantifying the uncertainty and seeks to maximize her payoff guarantee over a set of plausible models. As time passes and the agent updates, the worst-case model used to evaluate a given strategy can change, creating a problem of dynamic inconsistency. We characterize the stopping behavior in this environment and show that, while the agent's myopic incentives are fragile to small changes in the set of considered models, the best consistent plan from which no future self has incentives to deviate is robust.
url:ace73f7d6b9939f3.abstract_zh: 我们研究了模糊性对时机决策的影响。代理人面临一个具有不确定终止收益和随机时间限制的停止问题。代理人不确定量化不确定性的正确模型，并试图在一组合理模型中最大化其收益保障。随着时间推移和代理人更新信息，用于评估给定策略的最坏情况模型可能发生变化，从而产生动态不一致性问题。我们刻画了这种环境下的停止行为，并表明：尽管代理人的短视激励对考虑模型集的微小变化较为脆弱，但未来自我没有动机偏离的最佳一致计划具有稳健性。

url:ad19e6b09ce70879.abstract: We study whether AI methods applied to large-scale portfolio holdings data can improve macroprudential financial regulation. We build a graph-based deep learning model tailored to security-level data on the holdings of financial intermediaries. The architecture incorporates economic priors and learns latent representations of both assets and investors from the network structure of portfolio positions. Applied to the universe of non-bank financial intermediaries, covering nearly $40 trillion in wealth, the model substantially outperforms existing approaches in out-of-sample forecasts of intermediary trading behavior, including in crisis episodes. The model has more than ten times the explanatory power for the cross-sectional variation in asset returns during stress events compared to traditional approaches, and it outperforms existing systemic risk metrics at the institution level. Its learned representations show that the holdings network encodes rich, economically interpretable information about fire- sale vulnerability. The architecture is fully inductive, producing informative estimates even when entire asset classes or investors are withheld from training. We embed our empirical approach into a macroprudential optimal policy framework to formalize why these objects matter for policy and welfare. We show that even in an equilibrium environment subject to the Lucas critique, the predictive information from the model improves welfare by sharpening the cross-sectional targeting of policy interventions, and we demonstrate a complementarity between prediction and structural knowledge.
url:ad19e6b09ce70879.abstract_zh: 本文研究人工智能方法应用于大规模投资组合持仓数据能否改善宏观审慎金融监管。我们构建了一个基于图的深度学习模型，专门针对金融中介机构持有的证券级数据。该模型架构融合了经济先验知识，通过投资组合持仓的网络结构学习资产与投资者的潜在表征。将该模型应用于覆盖近40万亿美元财富的非银行金融中介机构全样本后，其在预测中介交易行为（包括危机时期）的样本外表现显著优于现有方法。在压力事件期间，该模型对资产收益率截面变异的解释力是传统方法的十倍以上，且在机构层面优于现有系统性风险指标。模型习得的表征表明，持仓网络编码了关于抛售脆弱性的丰富且具有经济可解释性的信息。该架构具有完全归纳能力，即便在训练数据中完全剔除某类资产或投资者时，仍能产生具有信息量的估计结果。我们将实证方法嵌入宏观审慎最优政策框架，以形式化论证这些变量对政策与福利的重要性。研究表明，即使在面临卢卡斯批判的均衡环境中，该模型的预测信息通过强化政策干预的截面精准度提升了社会福利，并揭示了预测能力与结构性知识之间的互补关系。

url:ad65984ec9349235.abstract: This paper examines the relationship between borderlands and political violence in Africa. Do African conflicts relocate or expand across borders? Using spatiotemporal data on conflict events from 1997 to 2024 alongside the innovative OECD/SWAC Spatial Conflict Dynamics indicator (SCDi), the paper suggests that borderlands experience more conflict than non-borderlands. Approximately half of all violent events occur within 100 km of a border. In Africa, political violence also tends to decrease very rapidly with distance from borders. The proportion of violent events recorded in borderlands varies over time and mirrors the cycles of violence that affect specific regions. This share was very high in the early 2000s due to the wars in the Gulf of Guinea and the Great Lakes region. It then declined for less than a decade before increasing substantially in the 2010s. Finally, the paper demonstrates that when conflicts diffuse across borders, they tend to occupy a greater spatial extent rather than simply moving from one side of the border to the other. These findings suggest that more policy efforts should be devoted to monitor the circulation of armed groups across West African borders.
url:ad65984ec9349235.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了非洲边境地区与政治暴力之间的关系。非洲冲突是否会跨境转移或扩散？利用1997年至2024年冲突事件的时空数据，并结合创新的OECD/SWAC空间冲突动态指标（SCDi），本文发现边境地区比非边境地区经历更多冲突。约半数暴力事件发生在距边境100公里范围内。在非洲，政治暴力随距边境距离增加而急剧减少。边境地区记录的暴力事件比例随时间变化，并反映了影响特定区域的暴力周期。由于几内亚湾和大湖地区的战争，这一比例在21世纪初非常高；随后下降不到十年，在2010年代又大幅上升。最后，本文证明，当冲突跨境扩散时，它们往往占据更大的空间范围，而非简单地从边境一侧转移到另一侧。这些发现表明，应投入更多政策努力来监测西非边境地区武装团体的流动。
url:ad65984ec9349235.title: Political violence in African borderlands

url:ad862a2e72f4711e.abstract: As populations in rich countries age and fewer youngsters enter the labour force, employers and politicians bemoan labour ‘shortages’. This column turns to historical evidence to highlight why governments should learn to love labour shortages. Between 1792 and 1815, as Britain and France fought each other for global dominance, more than one out of every ten British men ended up in the army or navy, resulting in acute labour shortages and upward pressure on wages. The authors show how this labour scarcity and a skill abundance complemented each other in driving technology diffusion, boosting British productivity in the long run.
url:ad862a2e72f4711e.abstract_zh: 随着富裕国家人口老龄化及年轻劳动力减少，雇主和政界人士纷纷抱怨劳动力"短缺"。本文通过历史证据揭示政府为何应学会拥抱劳动力短缺。1792年至1815年间，当英法为争夺全球霸权而战时，超过十分之一的英国男性最终服役于陆军或海军，导致严重劳动力短缺并推高工资水平。作者论证了这种劳动力稀缺与技能充裕如何相互促进，推动技术扩散，最终在长期内提升了英国的生产率。
url:ad862a2e72f4711e.title: Technology adoption and labour shortages: Evidence from Britain’s Industrial Revolution

url:addb1e675df9f6f0.abstract: This paper introduces the African Debt Database (ADD) - a new, comprehensive dataset that traces both domestic and external debt instruments at a granular level. The main innovation is a detailed mapping of Africa's domestic debt markets, drawing on rich, new data extracted from government auction reports and bond prospectuses. The database covers over 50,000 individual government loans and securities issued by 54 African countries between 2000 and 2024, amounting to a total of USD 6.3 trillion in debt. For each instrument, it provides harmonized micro-level information on currency, maturity, interest rates, instrument type, and creditor. The data reveal the growing dominance of domestic debt in Africa - albeit with substantial cross-country variation. Four stylized facts stand out: (i) the rapid expansion of domestic debt markets, especially in middle-income countries; (ii) the wide dispersion in borrowing costs and real interest rates; (iii) large cross-country differences in maturity structures and associated rollover risks; and (iv) a rising debt-service burden, particularly due to international bonds. Generally, this project shows that debt transparency is both feasible and valuable, even in data-scarce environments.
url:addb1e675df9f6f0.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了非洲债务数据库（ADD）——一个全新的、全面的数据集，该数据集以微观层面追踪了国内外债务工具。其主要创新在于，基于从政府拍卖报告和债券募集说明书中提取的丰富新数据，对非洲国内债务市场进行了详细映射。该数据库涵盖了2000年至2024年间54个非洲国家发行的超过5万笔政府贷款和证券，债务总额达6.3万亿美元。针对每项工具，它提供了关于货币、期限、利率、工具类型和债权人的统一微观层面信息。数据显示，非洲国内债务的主导地位日益增强——尽管各国之间存在显著差异。四个典型事实尤为突出：（i）国内债务市场快速扩张，尤其是在中等收入国家；（ii）借贷成本和实际利率存在广泛差异；（iii）期限结构及相关展期风险存在巨大的跨国差异；以及（iv）偿债负担不断上升，尤其是国际债券带来的负担。总体而言，本项目表明，即使在数据稀缺的环境中，债务透明度既可行又具有重要价值。

url:adecc320ecd2f0f4.abstract: Episode recorded on 19 June 2026 at the PSE-CEPR Policy Forum in Paris. Twice before, the world's savings and debts have piled up in the wrong places, and twice the imbalance broke something. The first time it took the Plaza Accord to fix it. The second time it took a global financial crisis. Now we are in a third wave. Gita Gopinath (Harvard, former IMF Chief Economist and First Deputy Managing Director) and Philip Lane (European Central Bank, CEPR) join Tim Phillips to ask what is different this time. Household and bank balance sheets are stronger than before 2008. But the fragility has moved to governments carrying much higher debt, and to non-bank financial institutions whose exposures and links to banks are only partly visible. Foreign investors hold US$40.7 trillion of US equities, 44% of world GDP outside the US, much of it riding on the AI boom. Lane's overriding principle: central banks can calm bond markets under stress, but they must be just as clear about what they will not do if debt is unsustainable.
url:adecc320ecd2f0f4.abstract_zh: 2026年6月19日，在巴黎举行的PSE-CEPR政策论坛上录制了本期节目。此前，全球储蓄与债务曾两次堆积于错误之处，两次失衡均引发危机。第一次靠《广场协议》化解，第二次则酿成全球金融危机。如今我们正经历第三次浪潮。哈佛大学、前国际货币基金组织首席经济学家兼第一副总裁吉塔·戈皮纳特与欧洲央行、CEPR的菲利普·莱恩共同探讨本次有何不同。家庭与银行资产负债表较2008年前更为稳健，但脆弱性已转移至背负更高债务的政府，以及风险敞口与银行关联仅部分可见的非银行金融机构。外国投资者持有40.7万亿美元美国股票，占美国以外全球GDP的44%，其中大量资金依托于人工智能热潮。莱恩的核心原则是：央行能够稳定承压的债券市场，但若债务不可持续，它们必须同样明确表明不会采取何种行动。
url:adecc320ecd2f0f4.title: Addressing Global Imbalances

url:adf92d76279e8dd4.abstract: We study productivity shocks in a New Keynesian model with endogenous entry, selection, and nominal rigidities. Adjustment along the extensive margin fundamentally alters the transmission of TFP shocks. Under sticky prices, productivity disturbances generate a large “entry multiplier”: firm entry-exit responds much more strongly than under flexible prices, even when output is allocatively efficient to first order. Introducing wage stickiness breaks this neutrality. Adverse TFP shocks reduce profits, trigger exit, and generate a negative output gap while remaining inflationary. Productivity shocks therefore behave as true supply shocks, without resorting to ad hoc cost-push or markup disturbances. Unlike standard markup shocks, TFP shocks in our framework imply procyclical profits and entry, consistent with the data. When wages are sufficiently sticky, expansionary monetary policy raises entry, closes the negative output gap, and improves welfare. The model remains analytically tractable and isomorphic to the standard New Keynesian framework, with entry and selection appearing as simple wedges.
url:adf92d76279e8dd4.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个包含内生进入、选择效应和名义刚性的新凯恩斯模型中的生产率冲击。沿扩展边际的调整从根本上改变了全要素生产率冲击的传导机制。在价格粘性条件下，生产率扰动会产生巨大的"进入乘数"效应：即使产出在一阶条件下达到配置效率，企业进入与退出对生产率冲击的反应仍远强于灵活价格情形。引入工资粘性会打破这种中性效应。不利的全要素生产率冲击会降低利润、引发企业退出，并在保持通胀压力的同时产生负向产出缺口。因此，生产率冲击无需借助特设的成本推动或加成率扰动，即可表现为真正的供给冲击。与标准加成率冲击不同，我们框架中的全要素生产率冲击意味着顺周期的利润与进入行为，这与数据特征一致。当工资粘性足够强时，扩张性货币政策能够促进企业进入、缩小负向产出缺口并提升社会福利。该模型保持解析可处理性，且与标准新凯恩斯框架同构，其中进入与选择效应以简单楔子形式呈现。

url:ae3390a643b9b3f5.abstract: This paper studies how geopolitical risk shapes financial fragmentation and international risk-sharing, using bilateral official lending data from 1910 to 2024. We document that when geopolitical risk is high, bilateral lending increasingly follows geopolitical alignment. Because geopolitically aligned countries experience more synchronized shocks, this fragmentation limits the effectiveness of international risk-sharing. To rationalize these patterns, we introduce geopolitical considerations into a limited-commitment model of sovereign borrowing. The model shows that, even with non-discriminatory default, higher geopolitical tensions redirect international lending toward allied countries and weaken risk-sharing.
url:ae3390a643b9b3f5.abstract_zh: 本文利用1910年至2024年的双边官方贷款数据，研究地缘政治风险如何塑造金融碎片化与国际风险分担。我们发现，当地缘政治风险较高时，双边贷款日益遵循地缘政治结盟。由于地缘政治结盟国家经历更为同步的冲击，这种碎片化限制了国际风险分担的有效性。为合理化这些模式，我们将地缘政治考量引入主权借款的有限承诺模型。模型表明，即使存在非歧视性违约，更高的地缘政治紧张局势也会将国际贷款引向盟国，并削弱风险分担。
url:ae3390a643b9b3f5.title: International Risk-Sharing in a Fragmented World
url:ae3390a643b9b3f5.title_zh: 碎片化世界中的国际风险分担

url:ae3b10a89da1b7b9.abstract: We estimate the causal effect of exclusionary citizenship policies on communicable disease transmission. In 2013, the Dominican Republic's Constitutional Court Ruling 168-13 retroactively revoked citizenship from roughly 10 percent of the population—primarily individuals of Haitian descent—thereby restricting their access to healthcare. Leveraging municipality-level variation in exposure within a difference-in-differences framework as well as individual administrative data, we identify a two-stage dynamic in dengue incidence. In the short run, reported cases decline by 13.5 percent in high-exposure municipalities, consistent with healthcare avoidance among affected populations. This decline reverses after six months, as untreated infections generate spillover transmission to non-Haitian populations, increasing cases by 16.7 percent. Overall, the findings demonstrate that restricting healthcare access through citizenship policy imposes substantial public health costs that extend beyond the targeted population.
url:ae3b10a89da1b7b9.abstract_zh: 我们估计了排他性公民身份政策对传染病传播的因果效应。2013年，多米尼加共和国宪法法院第168-13号裁决追溯性地剥夺了约10%人口（主要是海地裔）的公民身份，从而限制了他们获得医疗服务的权利。利用市级层面暴露程度的差异，结合双重差分框架及个体行政数据，我们识别出登革热发病率的两个阶段动态变化。短期内，高暴露地区的报告病例下降13.5%，这与受影响人群回避就医的行为一致。六个月后，这一下降趋势发生逆转，未治疗的感染引发向非海地人群的溢出传播，导致病例增加16.7%。总体而言，研究结果表明，通过公民身份政策限制医疗获取权会带来巨大的公共卫生成本，且其影响超出了目标人群本身。

url:aef8bc9b0a7eb5bf.abstract: The Covid pandemic dramatically altered patterns of daily life, particularly through widespread declines in mobility due to lockdowns and social distancing measures. While the economic and epidemiological effects of these restrictions have been widely studied, their broader health implications remain underexplored. This paper investigates the relationship between mobility decline during the Covid pandemic and hypertension outcomes in India. Leveraging district-level variation in mobility from Google Community Mobility Reports and health data from the 2019–2021 Indian Demographic and Health Survey (DHS), we find that a 1 percentage point reduction in mobility over the 30 days prior to interview is associated with a 0.3 percentage point decrease in the likelihood of having normal blood pressure. The effect is driven by increases in pre-hypertensive and mildly elevated blood pressure, with no significant changes in more severe hypertension. We examine potential mechanisms—healthcare access, stress (proxied by alcohol use), and reduced physical activity—and find limited explanatory power for the former two. These findings suggest that reduced physical mobility likely played a key role in worsening cardiovascular risk profiles. The results underscore the importance of integrating chronic disease considerations into the design of mobility-restricting public health interventions.
url:aef8bc9b0a7eb5bf.abstract_zh: 新冠疫情深刻改变了日常生活模式，尤其通过封锁和社交距离措施导致人口流动性普遍下降。尽管这些限制措施的经济和流行病学影响已被广泛研究，但其对健康的更广泛影响仍待深入探讨。本文研究了新冠疫情期间印度人口流动性下降与高血压结果之间的关系。利用谷歌社区流动性报告中地区层面的流动性变化数据，以及2019-2021年印度人口与健康调查（DHS）的健康数据，我们发现：受访前30天内流动性每降低1个百分点，血压正常的概率将下降0.3个百分点。这一效应主要源于高血压前期和轻度血压升高病例的增加，而重度高血压未见显著变化。我们考察了潜在机制——医疗可及性、压力（以酒精使用为代理变量）和体力活动减少——发现前两者的解释力有限。这些结果表明，身体活动减少可能在心血管风险恶化中发挥了关键作用。研究结果强调，在设计限制流动性的公共卫生干预措施时，必须将慢性病防控纳入考量。
url:aef8bc9b0a7eb5bf.title: Public Health Trade-Offs During a Pandemic: Mobility Decline and Hypertension Risk in Indialoven
url:aef8bc9b0a7eb5bf.title_zh: 疫情期间的公共卫生权衡：印度流动性下降与高血压风险

url:aef9915c7dd89f62.abstract: This paper examines the effect of digital connectivity on income of women-headed households in Viet Nam. Using the Viet Nam Digital Economy Access Index and the Viet Nam Household Living Standards Survey, empirical evidence shows that increased digital connectivity significantly improves the income of women headed households. Disadvantaged groups, such as those with limited educational attainment and lower income levels, and living in rural areas, benefit more from having digital connectivity. We explore the mechanisms behind this relationship and find that digital connectivity is related to increased participation in the labor market, particularly in the services sector. This paper offers new insights into the inclusive effects of digital connectivity and provides policy recommendations for advancing digital infrastructure development.
url:aef9915c7dd89f62.abstract_zh: 本文考察了数字连接对越南女性户主家庭收入的影响。基于越南数字经济接入指数与越南家庭生活水平调查数据，实证结果表明：数字连接的增强显著提升了女性户主家庭的收入水平。教育程度有限、收入水平较低及居住在农村地区的弱势群体，从数字连接中获益更多。我们进一步探究了该影响的作用机制，发现数字连接与劳动力市场参与度的提升密切相关，尤其在服务业领域。本研究为数字连接的包容性效应提供了新见解，并为推进数字基础设施建设提出了政策建议。
url:aef9915c7dd89f62.title: Digital Connectivity and Household Income: Evidence from Women-Headed Households in Viet Nam

url:af58c2579f415d6a.abstract: Consider an analyst interested in predicting the size of an effect. She has identified a set of prior published studies of similar effects. We provide a toolkit for (i) summarizing the prior literature, (ii) making predictions of effects in new contexts, and (iii) correcting for the bias from selectivity in the prior literature. We illustrate these methods with empirical examples from labor, public, behavioral, environmental, and development economics. Some of the tools are relevant even when only three prior studies are available. We show how it is possible to use covariates to transparently make predictions for a new context by reweighting prior estimates. The mean effect---after correcting for selectivity---is between 12% and 21% of the simple mean in our empirical examples. We conclude with a cookbook for practitioners producing meta-analyses.
url:af58c2579f415d6a.abstract_zh: 考虑一位分析师，其目标是预测某一效应的大小。她已确定一组关于类似效应的先前已发表研究。我们提供了一套工具包，用于：(i) 总结先前文献，(ii) 预测新情境下的效应，以及 (iii) 纠正先前文献中选择性偏差带来的偏误。我们通过来自劳动经济学、公共经济学、行为经济学、环境经济学和发展经济学的实证案例来展示这些方法。即便仅有三项先前研究可用，部分工具仍具适用性。我们展示了如何通过重新加权先前估计值，利用协变量透明地预测新情境下的效应。在我们的实证案例中，经选择性偏差校正后的平均效应，仅为简单均值的12%至21%。最后，我们为从事元分析的研究者提供了一份操作指南。

url:af6ce807167923c8.abstract: What role does wealth play in shaping educational choices? While theoretical frameworks generate elaborate, testable predictions, there are significant hurdles in empirically assessing this relationship. In modern societies, compulsory education laws conceal the impact of wealth on educational decisions. To address this challenge, we draw on a unique dataset from 1858 that records municipal-level wealth shares alongside primary school enrollment across Sicily, an ideal historical setting in which schools were present in nearly every municipality, yet attendance was voluntary. Leveraging the long-term effects of historical earthquakes on land and property distribution-effects that reshaped the wealth structure of Sicilian municipalities in the mid-19th century, we examine the impact of wealth on schooling decisions. Our analysis shows that wealth played a significant role in educational outcomes even in a largely agrarian context: a 10% increase in the share of wealthy households was associated with a 0.6% increase in primary school enrollment.
url:af6ce807167923c8.abstract_zh: 财富在塑造教育选择中扮演何种角色？尽管理论框架能够产生详尽且可检验的预测，但在实证评估这一关系时仍面临重大障碍。在现代社会中，义务教育法掩盖了财富对教育决策的影响。为应对这一挑战，我们利用1858年一项独特的数据集，该数据集记录了西西里各市镇的财富份额与小学入学率。这一历史背景具有理想的研究条件：几乎每个市镇都设有学校，但入学完全自愿。借助历史地震对土地与财产分配的长期影响——这些影响在19世纪中期重塑了西西里各市镇的财富结构，我们考察了财富对教育决策的作用。分析表明，即便在高度农业化的背景下，财富对教育成果仍具有显著影响：富裕家庭比例每增加10%，小学入学率相应提高0.6%。
url:af6ce807167923c8.title: Wealth and the origins of the education take-off
url:af6ce807167923c8.title_zh: 财富与教育起飞的起源

url:afb503cbb8118a06.abstract: We investigate how information frictions affect the efficacy of contraception provision programs. We study a Costa Rican initiative that combined free access to long-acting reversible contraceptives and a tailored information campaign to correct for baseline misinformation. Using administrative data and geographic variation in the initiative, we find a 16% decrease in the teen birth rate. We show information complements access – an extra year of exposure to the information campaign is equivalent to the effect of contraception access alone. Using surveys on sexual behavior, we show the policy changed the information source from personal networks to healthcare professionals, amending misinformation on sexual health.
url:afb503cbb8118a06.abstract_zh: 我们研究了信息摩擦如何影响避孕措施提供项目的有效性。我们聚焦于哥斯达黎加的一项举措，该举措结合了长效可逆避孕药的免费获取与针对性的信息宣传，以纠正基线信息偏差。利用行政数据及该举措的地理差异，我们发现青少年生育率下降了16%。研究表明，信息与获取渠道具有互补效应——额外一年的信息宣传接触所产生的效果，等同于仅提供避孕措施的效果。通过性行为调查数据，我们发现该政策将信息源从个人社交网络转向医疗专业人员，从而修正了关于性健康的信息偏差。
url:afb503cbb8118a06.title: The Complementary Role of Information and Contraceptive Access in Teen Pregnancy
url:afb503cbb8118a06.title_zh: 信息与避孕措施可及性在青少年怀孕中的互补作用

url:afc3ceb3c3bedda3.abstract: Business plan competitions aim to identify and spur high-growth entrepreneurs. Two experiments were embedded into in a Kenyan competition to test how intensity of selection and of capital determine entrepreneurial outcomes. Applicants received a US$9,000 grant after a streamlined process or went through multiple selection stages and were randomly assigned US$9,000 or US$36,000. All grants initially generated jobs, but the impacts only persisted over three years under multi-stage selection. The larger grants did not yield greater long-term impacts than the multi-stage US$9,000 grant, suggesting diminishing returns to capital and limited lumpy investment opportunities. Selection, rather than grant size, determines long-run firm growth.
url:afc3ceb3c3bedda3.abstract_zh: 商业计划竞赛旨在识别并激励高成长型企业家。通过在肯尼亚的一场竞赛中嵌入两项实验，本研究检验了筛选强度与资本规模如何决定创业成果。申请者经简化流程后获得9000美元资助，或需通过多阶段筛选并随机分配9000美元或36000美元。所有资助最初均创造了就业岗位，但只有经过多阶段筛选的资助在三年后仍持续产生效应。更大规模的资助并未比多阶段筛选下的9000美元资助带来更显著的长期影响，这表明资本存在边际收益递减效应，且大规模投资机会有限。决定企业长期增长的关键因素是筛选机制，而非资助金额。
url:afc3ceb3c3bedda3.title: Selection or More Capital? Experimental Evidence on High-Growth Entrepreneurs in Kenya
url:afc3ceb3c3bedda3.title_zh: 选择还是更多资本？肯尼亚高增长企业家的实验证据

url:afe13de44cd9e2cf.abstract: Using matched employer–employee data on more than 62,000 master’s graduates, this paper examines how gender differences in wage returns to fields of study vary by migration background and how educational specialisation contributes to the gender wage gap. We estimate wage regressions and apply a decomposition approach to separate sorting across fields from differences in pay within fields. Returns vary widely, with law, economics and management, and science yielding the highest returns, and women earning less than men within all fields, especially in high-paying ones. First-generation immigrants from developing countries obtain the lowest returns regardless of field of study, while second-generation immigrants approach but do not fully match natives. Fields of study explain a substantial share of gender wage inequality among natives and second-generation immigrants, whereas among first-generation immigrants broader wage disadvantages dominate. Results further vary with the number of parents originating from developing countries and with age at arrival.
url:afe13de44cd9e2cf.abstract_zh: 本文利用超过6.2万名硕士毕业生的匹配雇主-雇员数据，考察了不同学科领域工资回报的性别差异如何随移民背景变化，以及教育专业化如何影响性别工资差距。我们估计了工资回归模型，并采用分解方法将跨领域的选择效应与领域内的工资差异分离开来。研究结果显示，各领域的回报差异显著，其中法律、经济与管理以及科学领域的回报最高，而在所有领域中，女性的收入均低于男性，尤其是在高薪领域。来自发展中国家的第一代移民无论学习何种领域，其回报均最低，而第二代移民虽接近但未能完全达到本土居民的水平。学科领域解释了本土居民和第二代移民中性别工资不平等的主要部分，但在第一代移民中，更广泛的工资劣势占据主导地位。此外，结果还因父母来自发展中国家的数量以及移民到达时的年龄而异。

url:afedb4873a6bc914.abstract: This paper measures and analyzes management practices in the Kenyan health care sector, drawing on a nationally representative survey and linked administrative data. The paper adapts the World Management Survey to measure management quality in primary health care facilities and hospitals, surveying 429 primary health care facilities and 73 hospitals. Primary health care facilities are the primary point of contact for most patients, providing treatment for common infectious diseases and chronic conditions, as well as services related to maternal and child health. Management quality is low on average, and the distribution is highly compressed. The analysis uses administrative data to test the association between the management quality and performance of primary health care facilities, measured by outpatient attendance, during a period of disruption that included the COVID-19 pandemic and a public health workers
url:afedb4873a6bc914.abstract_zh: 本文基于全国代表性调查及关联行政数据，对肯尼亚医疗部门的管理实践进行了测度与分析。研究采用世界管理调查法，对429家初级卫生保健机构和73家医院的管理质量进行评估。初级卫生保健机构作为多数患者的首要接触点，承担常见传染病、慢性病治疗及母婴健康相关服务。结果显示，管理质量整体偏低且分布高度集中。通过行政数据检验管理质量与初级卫生保健机构绩效（以门诊就诊量为衡量指标）之间的关联性，研究时段涵盖新冠疫情及公共卫生工作者罢工等干扰事件。
url:afedb4873a6bc914.title: Management of Health Care Facilities and Patient Attendance during Major Disruptions : Evidence from Kenya
url:afedb4873a6bc914.title_zh: 重大干扰期间医疗设施管理与患者就诊率：来自肯尼亚的证据

url:aff376bb44cd2090.abstract: European countries paved the way for modern economic growth in the 19th century with large-scale reforms facilitating human capital accumulation. The literature has looked at the role of elites in broad education investments, but less attention has been devoted to reforms promoting workers' health, a key component of human capital. This paper studies the impact of the 1866 cholera outbreak on modern waterworks construction in the German Empire to test the hypothesis whether concerns about workers' health may have compelled elites to invest in health-enhancing public goods. We find that the epidemic raised the annual probability of building waterworks by about 35%. Exogenous variation relying on the cholera-spreading effect of military movements during the Austro-Prussian War in 1866 further underpins this result. Quantitative and qualitative evidence indicates that non-agricultural elites employing more productive capital and better-skilled workers pushed for reform to avoid the costly prospect of future labour shocks. Long-term analyses show sizeable and persisting effects of the epidemic on public health and development outcomes shortly before the First World War.
url:aff376bb44cd2090.abstract_zh: 欧洲国家在19世纪通过大规模改革促进人力资本积累，为现代经济增长奠定了基础。现有文献关注了精英阶层在广泛教育投资中的作用，但较少关注促进工人健康（人力资本的关键组成部分）的改革。本文以1866年霍乱疫情对德意志帝国现代供水系统建设的影响为研究对象，检验以下假设：对工人健康的担忧是否可能促使精英阶层投资于增进健康的公共品。研究发现，疫情使供水系统建设的年概率提高了约35%。利用1866年普奥战争期间军事调动对霍乱传播的外生性影响，进一步验证了这一结果。定量与定性证据表明，雇佣更多生产性资本和技能更熟练工人的非农业精英阶层推动改革，以避免未来劳动力冲击带来的高昂成本。长期分析显示，疫情对第一次世界大战前夕的公共卫生与发展成果产生了显著且持续的影响。
url:aff376bb44cd2090.title: Private Interest in the Public Good: Cholera and the Origins of Sanitary Reform
url:aff376bb44cd2090.title_zh: 公共利益中的私人利益：霍乱与卫生改革的起源

url:b025c7f2e45105e6.abstract: This paper explains why these policies were the most popular savings vehicle of their day. Ordinary life policies were well suited to the early twentieth-century economic environment. They had good returns; low risks; tax advantages; and little correlation with returns of competing investments, like bank deposits, building and loan shares, postal savings deposits, real estate, or stocks. The policies protected households from poverty in old age, from the premature death of their breadwinner, and from other risks including disability and deflation. Understanding how households saved in the past has implications for a wide range of literatures in the social sciences.
url:b025c7f2e45105e6.abstract_zh: 本文解释了为何这些保单成为当时最受欢迎的储蓄工具。普通寿险保单完美契合了20世纪初的经济环境：其收益可观、风险较低、享有税收优惠，且与银行存款、建房贷款股份、邮政储蓄存款、房地产或股票等竞争性投资工具的收益率相关性极低。这类保单既能防止家庭因年老陷入贫困，又能抵御家庭经济支柱早逝、残疾及通货紧缩等风险。理解历史上的家庭储蓄方式，对社会科学领域的诸多研究具有启示意义。
url:b025c7f2e45105e6.title: Ordinary Life Insurance: The Best-Performing Financial Asset of the 1930s
url:b025c7f2e45105e6.title_zh: 普通人寿保险：20世纪30年代表现最佳的金融资产

url:b03c00718609d630.abstract: Models to explain the chances of economic activity, employment and full-time work in a national cross-section of British women in 1980 in terms of a number of demographic and economic variables are estimated by OLS. Marital status differentials are minor once the presence of dependent children and the level of alternative income are controlled. Earning power is also an important factor; it is imputed on the basis of work history information at the level of pay associated with the best paying occupation, not necessarily that current or most recent, on the grounds that mature women workers are often over-qualified for the jobs with which they combine domestic responsibilities. Regional variations, remote childbearing and marital history, and fertility intentions have little or no explanatory power. Participation rates among women who are neither students nor permanently sick are also reduced by responsibility for adult dependents, being married to a non-earning husband and living in an area of high unemployment. Through the last two factors adverse demand conditions reduce both the chances of women having jobs, and to a smaller extent, of married women describing themselves as economically active.
url:b03c00718609d630.abstract_zh: 本文利用1980年英国全国横截面数据，通过普通最小二乘法（OLS）估计了若干人口与经济变量对女性经济活动、就业及全职工作概率的解释模型。在控制受抚养子女存在及替代收入水平后，婚姻状况差异的影响微乎其微。收入能力同样是重要因素——基于工作历史信息，以与最高薪酬职业（而非当前或最近职业）对应的薪资水平进行归因，理由是成熟女性劳动者往往因兼顾家庭责任而从事与其资质不符的工作。区域差异、生育间隔与婚姻史、生育意愿的解释力较弱或可忽略。既非学生亦非长期病患的女性，其劳动参与率还会因以下因素降低：需照料成年受抚养人、配偶无收入、居住在高失业率地区。通过后两个因素，不利需求条件既降低了女性获得工作的概率，也在较小程度上降低了已婚女性自评为经济活动人口的概率。
url:b03c00718609d630.title: DP40 Participation in Paid Work: Multiple Regression Analysis of the Women and Employment Survey

url:b07399d8774f7292.abstract: We study frictionless matching models in large production economies with and without market imperfections and/or incentive problems. We provide necessary and sufficient distribution-free conditions for monotone matching which depend on the relationship between what we call the segregation payoff - a generalization of the individually rational payoff - and the feasible set for a pair of types. Imperfections have two distinct effects that are relevant for equilibrium matching patterns: they can overwhelm the complementarity properties of the production technology and they can introduce nontransferabilities that make equilibrium matching inefficient. We also use our framework to reveal the source of differences in the comparative static properties of some models in the literature and to explore the effects of distribution on the equilibrium matching pattern.
url:b07399d8774f7292.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在存在或不存在市场缺陷及/或激励问题的大型生产经济中的无摩擦匹配模型。我们提出了单调匹配的充分必要条件（无需分布假设），这些条件取决于我们称之为“隔离收益”（个体理性收益的推广）与一对类型的可行集之间的关系。市场缺陷对均衡匹配模式产生两种不同的影响：它们可能压倒生产技术的互补性特征，也可能引入非可转移性，导致均衡匹配效率低下。此外，我们利用该框架揭示了文献中某些模型比较静态性质差异的根源，并探讨了分布对均衡匹配模式的影响。
url:b07399d8774f7292.title: Monotone Matching In Perfect And Imperfect Worlds

url:b13ad996e5b266d6.abstract: Using large-scale high-granularity data from a food delivery platform and granular pollution and weather information, we study how PM 2.5 fluctuations affect riders' absenteeism, productivity, and accidents. Exploiting exogenous pollution variation from inverse boundary layer height, we find that higher pollution increases absenteeism for all workers and raises delivery times and accident rates only among (e-)bike riders, who must exert physical effort while working. Affected workers compensate productivity losses by working longer hours. Monetary incentives mitigate the effects on absenteeism but do not offset the decline in productivity and appear to exacerbate accident risk.
url:b13ad996e5b266d6.abstract_zh: 利用某外卖平台的大规模高粒度数据以及细颗粒物污染与天气信息，我们研究了PM2.5波动如何影响骑手的缺勤、生产率及事故发生率。借助逆边界层高度带来的外生污染变化，我们发现污染加剧会增加所有工人的缺勤率，并仅提高（电动）自行车骑手的配送时间和事故率，这些骑手在工作中需付出体力劳动。受影响的工人通过延长工作时间来弥补生产率损失。金钱激励缓解了缺勤效应，但并未抵消生产率下降，反而似乎加剧了事故风险。
