url:b1495b1a35845384.abstract: This paper examines how model uncertainty affects the price of catastrophe risk insurance. We use unique data on expected loss rate projections from seven hurricane risk models approved by regulators for use in Florida property insurance rate setting to quantify model uncertainty. By combining these data with newly published information on local property insurance markets, we are able to empirically test the relationship between model uncertainty and insurance premiums across Florida ZIP codes and over time. Controlling for confounding variables and time-invariant latent factors that may be correlated with observed variables, we find strong empirical support for the hypothesis that greater dispersion among model forecasts leads to higher homeowners insurance premiums. Our findings suggest that, had model dispersion been ten percent lower than that observed in 2021, a typical Florida homeowner would have saved $50 to $90 on her annual homeowners insurance premium.
url:b1495b1a35845384.abstract_zh: 本文研究了模型不确定性如何影响巨灾风险保险的定价。我们利用佛罗里达州监管机构批准的七个飓风风险模型所生成的预期损失率预测数据，对模型不确定性进行量化。通过将这些数据与新发布的当地财产保险市场信息相结合，我们能够从实证角度检验佛罗里达州各邮政编码区域及不同时间维度上模型不确定性与保险保费之间的关系。在控制混杂变量及可能与观测变量相关的时不变潜在因素后，我们发现了强有力的实证证据支持以下假设：模型预测结果的离散程度越大，房主保险保费越高。研究结果表明，若2021年模型离散程度比实际观测值低10%，则典型佛罗里达房主每年可节省50至90美元的房主保险保费。

url:b1cbdebfdda02b4f.abstract: We investigate how individuals interpret corporate sustainability disclosures in a pre-registered survey experiment. We provide novel evidence that participants can meaningfully distinguish greener from browner firms, yet their assessments exhibit a central tendency bias. Interestingly, this bias is asymmetric: respondents overestimate the greenness of browner firms while underestimating the greenness of greener firms more strongly. The same pattern persists among finance professionals and sustainability experts, suggesting that expertise alone does not eliminate interpretation errors. Consequently, firms’ incentives to invest in emissions reductions may be attenuated. We further identify disclosure design features that enhance individuals’ ability to differentiate firms’ emissions performance.
url:b1cbdebfdda02b4f.abstract_zh: 我们通过一项预注册的问卷调查实验，探究个体如何解读企业可持续发展披露信息。我们提供了新颖的证据，表明参与者能够有意义地区分更环保与更不环保的企业，然而其评估存在中心趋势偏差。有趣的是，这种偏差具有不对称性：受访者高估了较不环保企业的绿色程度，同时更显著地低估了更环保企业的绿色程度。这一模式在金融专业人士和可持续发展专家中同样存在，表明专业知识本身并不能消除解读错误。因此，企业投资于减排的激励可能被削弱。我们进一步识别出能够增强个体区分企业排放绩效能力的披露设计特征。
url:b1cbdebfdda02b4f.title: DP21803 Objective vs. Perceived Corporate Greenness: Do Individuals Understand Corporate Sustainability Information?
url:b1cbdebfdda02b4f.title_zh: 客观绿色度与感知绿色度：个体能否理解企业可持续信息？

url:b1d1e8f36aeae60c.abstract: This paper analyses four costs which may be associated with monetary union. First it (obviously) allows no `relative' monetary accommodation of the kind which may assist when dealing with asymmetric shocks. This can impose significant adjustment costs. Second it does not of itself prevent `absolute' accommodation to an inflation shock originating in all members, or even one member, of the union. Third, the distribution of benefits of membership of the union may be skewed. Finally, a union may require significant fiscal flexibility to mitigate against the adjustment costs. We investigate the form of fiscal flexibility which may be required, and we also propose a form of Soft Monetary Union which might alleviate the first problem.
url:b1d1e8f36aeae60c.abstract_zh: 本文分析了与货币联盟可能相关的四种成本。首先，（显然）货币联盟不允许那种有助于应对非对称冲击的“相对”货币调节，这可能带来显著的调整成本。其次，货币联盟本身并不阻止对源于所有成员国甚至单一成员国的通胀冲击进行“绝对”调节。第三，联盟成员国的收益分配可能不均衡。最后，货币联盟可能需要显著的财政灵活性以缓解调整成本。我们探讨了可能需要的财政灵活性形式，并提出了一种可能缓解第一个问题的“软性货币联盟”模式。
url:b1d1e8f36aeae60c.title: DP517 Adjustment Difficulties within a European Monetary Union: Can They be Reduced?
url:b1d1e8f36aeae60c.title_zh: DP517 欧洲货币联盟内部的调整困难：能否缓解？

url:b1d5e38d87881b41.abstract: This paper constructs a real business cycle model in which real money balances yield utility. We calibrate the model to fit the first moments of US data and simulate a set of impulse response functions that are generated by the model for GDP, the rate of interest, money growth and real balances. These theoretical impulse responses are compared with actual impulse responses from US data. The model does a reasonably good job of capturing the dynamic interactions of money and real variables in US data. It differs from most existing approaches by choosing a parameterization of utility for which the model admits the existence of indeterminate equilibria. It is argued that this fact is critical in explaining the monetary propagation mechanism.
url:b1d5e38d87881b41.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个真实货币余额产生效用的实际经济周期模型。我们通过校准模型使其拟合美国数据的一阶矩，并模拟了模型生成的GDP、利率、货币增长及实际余额的一组脉冲响应函数。将这些理论脉冲响应与美国数据的实际脉冲响应进行比较，发现该模型较好地捕捉了美国数据中货币与实际变量的动态交互关系。与现有大多数方法不同，本文选择了允许模型存在不确定均衡的效用参数化设定。研究认为，这一特性对于解释货币传导机制至关重要。
url:b1d5e38d87881b41.title: Money in a Real Business Cycle Model
url:b1d5e38d87881b41.title_zh: 真实商业周期模型中的货币

url:b1e6e1795d45001d.abstract: Europe has devoted substantial resources to fostering innovation and AI diffusion, through both centralised EU initiatives and national programmes. This column combines an experiment on 3,316 euro area firms with data from a large firm survey to demonstrate that that the decision to adopt AI is primarily driven by competition pressures rather than informational spillovers. If firms systematically underestimate their competitors’ AI investment – especially those abroad – informational gaps could be driving underinvestment. Reducing invisible barriers to knowledge sharing across regions may be just as vital as financial support for closing gaps in AI investment and innovation across Europe.
url:b1e6e1795d45001d.abstract_zh: 欧洲通过欧盟集中倡议和国家计划投入了大量资源，以促进创新和人工智能的扩散。本专栏结合一项针对3316家欧元区企业的实验以及大型企业调查数据，表明企业采用人工智能的决策主要受竞争压力驱动，而非信息溢出效应。如果企业系统性地低估其竞争对手（尤其是海外竞争对手）的人工智能投资，信息差距可能导致投资不足。减少跨区域知识共享的隐形障碍，对于缩小欧洲人工智能投资与创新差距而言，可能与财政支持同等重要。
url:b1e6e1795d45001d.title: Innovation without borders

url:b20400d378167e08.abstract: We develop a dynamic multi-country trade model with trade-related technology diffusion and endogenous R&D to quantify the impacts of trade policies and trade wars on innovation, technology rivalry, and welfare. We estimate the model using data on trade and patent citations and validate it in the context of U.S. export controls on China. Counterfactual analysis yields three main results. First, U.S. export controls on China reduce technological progress in both countries: China experiences a sharp contraction in knowledge inflows, while the U.S. faces a decline in R&D. Second, trade-driven diffusion and endogenous innovation substantially amplify the technological and welfare gains in the U.S. and losses in other major economies from the 2025 Liberation Day tariffs. Third, U.S. optimal tariffs on China, under varying geopolitical concerns, reflect a trade-off between curbing technology diffusion to China and sustaining U.S. innovation.
url:b20400d378167e08.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含贸易驱动技术扩散与内生研发的动态多国贸易模型，用以量化贸易政策及贸易战对创新、技术竞争和福利的影响。基于贸易与专利引用数据对模型进行估计，并以美国对华出口管制为背景验证模型有效性。反事实分析得出三项主要结论：第一，美国对华出口管制将抑制两国技术进步——中国面临知识流入急剧收缩，而美国则遭遇研发活动衰退；第二，贸易驱动的技术扩散与内生创新机制显著放大了2025年解放日关税对美国的技术与福利增益，同时加剧其他主要经济体的损失；第三，在不同地缘政治关切下，美国对华最优关税体现了遏制技术向中国扩散与维持美国创新活力之间的权衡。
url:b20400d378167e08.title: Trade War and Technology Rivalry

url:b20d0984d548e186.abstract: The EU's fiscal rules in force since 2024 are often criticised for their complexity. The official implementation requires thousands of lines of code and a sophisticated debt sustainability analysis. This column argues that the central result can be approximated by a remarkably simple formula: the required primary balance equals the largest debt-stabilising primary balance in a ten-year period plus roughly 1% of the debt ratio. While this simplification cannot replace the full calculations, it helps demystify the debt rules and provides a shortcut for assessing the impact of policies on debt sustainability.
url:b20d0984d548e186.abstract_zh: 自2024年起生效的欧盟财政规则常因其复杂性而受到批评。官方实施需要数千行代码和复杂的债务可持续性分析。本文认为，其核心结果可通过一个极为简单的公式近似得出：所需的基本财政余额等于十年期内最大的债务稳定基本余额加上约1%的债务比率。尽管这一简化无法替代完整计算，但它有助于揭开债务规则的神秘面纱，并为评估政策对债务可持续性的影响提供了一条捷径。
url:b20d0984d548e186.title: Opening the black box of Europe’s new fiscal rules
url:b20d0984d548e186.title_zh: 揭开欧洲新财政规则的黑箱

url:b213d6adee8878d4.abstract: Using a novel indicator for the People's Bank of China monetary policy stance, we estimate a policy rule that accounts for the dual nature of its price stability mandate-encompassing domestic inflation and the exchange rate-and for the evolution of its operational framework. The Ins: The domestic transmission follows textbook patterns, with exceptions due to the active management of the renminbi and the financial account. The Outs: International spillovers are powerful and affect commodity markets, global production and trade. The pass-through to foreign (US) prices is substantial. Financial spillovers are second-order, and mostly derivative from trade spillovers.
url:b213d6adee8878d4.abstract_zh: 我们采用一项衡量中国人民银行货币政策立场的新指标，估算了一条政策规则，该规则既考虑了其价格稳定目标的双重属性——涵盖国内通胀与汇率——也考虑了其操作框架的演变。内部传导方面：遵循教科书模式，但由于人民币和金融账户的积极管理而存在例外。外部溢出方面：国际溢出效应显著，影响大宗商品市场、全球生产与贸易。对国外（美国）价格的传导效应相当大。金融溢出效应属于次要层面，主要源于贸易溢出效应。

url:b22e95475ef5aeed.abstract: Loan modifications can either amplify or mitigate credit losses depending on the strategy lenders employ. Using detailed supervisory data and a model incorporating various frictions that could encourage modifications (liquidity constraints, foreclosure costs, and loss recognition costs), I assess why banks extend CRE loans. I find that extensions predominantly address temporary payment frictions, both in normal times and following the Spring 2023 bank stress episode. Contrary to concerns about banks “extending-and-pretending” following that episode, banks increased income and principal paydown requirements for extensions, contributing to strong ex-post performance for extended loans.
url:b22e95475ef5aeed.abstract_zh: 贷款修改可能放大或减轻信用损失，具体取决于贷款机构采用的策略。利用详细的监管数据以及一个纳入可能促使修改的各种摩擦因素（流动性约束、止赎成本和损失确认成本）的模型，我评估了银行发放商业房地产贷款的原因。我发现，无论是在正常时期还是在2023年春季银行压力事件之后，展期主要都是为了解决临时性支付摩擦。与对该事件后银行“展期并假装”的担忧相反，银行提高了展期贷款的收入和本金偿还要求，从而使得展期贷款在事后表现出强劲的业绩。

url:b2a07fd3658fccca.abstract: Startup accelerators are a leading gateway to venture capital, but top programs often require founders to relocate to a venture hub. From a hand-collected census of U.S. accelerator startups (2008-2011) followed for five years, we estimate a two-sided matching model that separates two channels behind the gender funding gap, geographic mobility and sorting across accelerator tiers. Women raise about 60% less than men over five years; the gap concentrates among non-relocating women, is largest at active-childrearing ages, and vanishes for relocators, while the mobility cost is near zero for men. Removing mobility frictions raises women's match quality but not their tier; reaching the high-funding top tier also requires removing the sorting disadvantage that women face. The 2012 JOBS Act eased the legal barrier and capacity grew tenfold, yet the U.S. VC dollar gap still tripled (2011-2020): closing it needs mobility, sorting, and capacity together.
url:b2a07fd3658fccca.abstract_zh: 创业加速器是通往风险资本的主要门户，但顶级项目通常要求创始人迁至创业中心。基于一项手工收集的美国加速器初创企业普查数据（2008-2011年，追踪五年），我们估计了一个双边匹配模型，以分离性别融资差距背后的两个渠道：地理流动性和加速器层级的分类效应。五年间，女性融资额比男性低约60%；这一差距集中在未迁址的女性群体中，在育儿活跃年龄段最大，而迁址女性的差距消失，同时男性的流动性成本几乎为零。消除流动性摩擦可提高女性的匹配质量，但无法提升其层级；要进入高融资的顶级层级，还需消除女性面临的分类劣势。2012年《创业企业扶助法》降低了法律障碍，加速器容量增长了十倍，但美国风险资本美元差距仍扩大了两倍（2011-2020年）：缩小这一差距需要同时解决流动性、分类和容量问题。
url:b2a07fd3658fccca.title: Getting There and Getting In: How Mobility and Sorting Keep Women out of Top Startup Accelerators
url:b2a07fd3658fccca.title_zh: 到达与进入：流动性与分类如何将女性排除在顶级创业加速器之外

url:b2e99733b806ecc7.abstract: This paper develops a long-run theory of labor effort, defined as the product of hours worked times work intensity. Under empirically plausible parameter values, the model predicts that intensity rises with income as hours decline. The theory provides a unified interpretation of several empirical regularities: cross-country disparities in hourly productivity among workers with comparable skills and technologies; higher workplace stress in richer economies; limited effectiveness of work-organization reforms in poor regions; patterns of non-work at work. The model is calibrated to match the large joint shift in hours and work intensity in the United States during the first half of the twentieth century. It shows that cross-country differences in intensity matter for welfare as much as differences in hours and suggests that accounting for intensity would significantly narrow measured welfare differences between rich and poor countries. The analysis identifies a key mechanism underlying the reorganization of work and leisure during the transition from poor traditional economies to affluent industrial ones.
url:b2e99733b806ecc7.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个关于劳动努力的长期理论，将劳动努力定义为工作时间与工作强度的乘积。在经验上合理的参数取值下，模型预测工作强度随收入上升而增加，而工作时间则随之下降。该理论为若干经验规律提供了统一解释：技能与技术条件相似的劳动者在小时生产率上存在的跨国差异；富裕经济体中更高的工作场所压力；贫困地区工作组织改革的有限成效；以及“在职非工作”的行为模式。模型经过校准，以匹配20世纪上半叶美国工作时间和工作强度的大幅联合变动。研究表明，跨国工作强度差异对福利的影响与工作时间差异同等重要，并指出若将工作强度纳入考量，将显著缩小富国与穷国之间测度上的福利差距。分析揭示了从贫困传统经济向富裕工业经济转型过程中，工作与休闲重组背后的关键机制。
url:b2e99733b806ecc7.title: Work Intensity and Welfare Across Countries and Over Time
url:b2e99733b806ecc7.title_zh: 跨国与跨时期的工作强度与福利

url:b32d4df69a1b41c6.abstract: We survey and extend work on the Federal Reserve’s effect on the stock market, focusing on three empirical findings: The effect of monetary policy surprises in a narrow window around announcements from the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC), the pre-FOMC announcement drift, and the FOMC cycle in stock returns. We discuss the magnitude of the Fed’s impact (directional effects or effects on average stock returns), the types of shocks coming from the Fed (pure monetary policy shocks, reaction function news, or information about the Fed’s view of the economy), and the asset pricing channels through which effects emerge (an equity premia for news from the Fed, or changes to yields, equity premia, or expected dividends). We also consider the information transmission (communication) channels. The Fed’s effect on the stock market is large, even for average stock returns earned over periods of several decades. Fed-induced changes to both yields and equity premia play substantial roles, with less direct evidence available regarding cash flows. For stocks, reaction function news appears to be more important than Fed information effects. Communication flows outside announcements windows are important.
url:b32d4df69a1b41c6.abstract_zh: 本文综述并拓展了关于美联储对股票市场影响的研究，重点关注三项实证发现：联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）公告前后窄窗口期内货币政策冲击的影响、FOMC公告前的漂移现象，以及股票收益中的FOMC周期。我们探讨了美联储影响的程度（方向性效应或对平均股票收益的影响）、来自美联储的冲击类型（纯货币政策冲击、反应函数信息或美联储对经济看法的信息），以及效应产生的资产定价渠道（美联储消息的股权溢价，或收益率、股权溢价、预期股息的变化）。我们还考虑了信息传递（沟通）渠道。美联储对股票市场的影响是巨大的，即使是在数十年期间获得的平均股票收益方面也是如此。美联储引发的收益率和股权溢价变化均发挥了重要作用，而关于现金流的直接证据较少。对于股票而言，反应函数信息似乎比美联储信息效应更为重要。公告窗口外的沟通流动具有重要影响。

url:b33d2f025dbb0944.abstract: This paper uses own built historical register tracing the evolution of Italian higher education from the High Middle Ages to 2010 to analyse the economic effects of the rise of modern universities. The registry data prompts the creation of a panel dataset measuring higher education supply across 110 Italian provinces from 1870 to 2010, which corresponds to the transition from elite to mass higher education in Italy. Our econometric approach combines a fixed effects estimator with Bartik-style instruments that exploit the historical cross-province distribution of higher education institutions in Italy. We find significant economic returns of universities, particularly in synergy with industrialisation, contributing to Italy’s transition to sustained growth. Our estimates predict that a province exposed to an average supply (equivalent to 7 universities, approximately) experiences an annual 2% increase in real gross value added per capita compared to a province with a zero supply. We show that about two thirds of these returns arise locally, while the remaining third originates from externalities. We argue that such high local concentration of economic returns contribute to fostering inequalities between small peripheral areas and large university hubs. Similar content being viewed by others
url:b33d2f025dbb0944.abstract_zh: 本文利用自建的历史登记册，追溯意大利高等教育从中世纪盛期至2010年的演变历程，分析现代大学兴起的经济效应。该登记册数据构建了一个面板数据集，用于衡量1870年至2010年间意大利110个省份的高等教育供给，这一时期对应意大利从精英教育向大众教育的转型。我们的计量方法结合了固定效应估计量与巴蒂克式工具变量，后者利用了意大利各省份高等教育机构的历史分布差异。研究发现，大学具有显著的经济回报，尤其在与工业化协同作用时，推动了意大利向持续增长的转型。我们的估计预测，与零供给的省份相比，面临平均供给（约相当于7所大学）的省份，其人均实际总增加值每年增长2%。我们表明，这些回报中约三分之二产生于本地，其余三分之一源于外部性。我们认为，这种经济回报的高度本地集中加剧了小型边缘地区与大型大学中心之间的不平等。类似内容被其他读者阅读。
url:b33d2f025dbb0944.title: Keeping up with the Joneses? The rise of modern universities and local economic development in Italy
url:b33d2f025dbb0944.title_zh: 追赶琼斯？现代大学的兴起与意大利地方经济发展

url:b34f8c43513f289c.abstract: We develop a dynamic theory of large shareholders and firm policies, where a blockholder engages with the firm to improve asset productivity and influence decisions on investment, financing, and executive compensation. In equilibrium, the blockholder’s ownership stake may grow or shrink over time driven by gains from trade that result from the relationship between ownership, corporate policies, and control. A feedback loop emerges: as the blockholder increases their ownership, it boosts investment and the firm's debt capacity, while higher returns from debt and investment incentivize the blockholder to increase their stake. While firm policies need not maximize dispersed shareholder value when the blockholder is in control, limiting blockholder influence ultimately reduces blockholder ownership and firm value.
url:b34f8c43513f289c.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个关于大股东与企业政策动态关系的理论模型。在该模型中，大宗持股者通过参与公司治理提升资产生产率，并影响投资、融资及高管薪酬等决策。在均衡状态下，大宗持股者的所有权份额会随时间推移而增减，这种变化源于所有权结构、企业政策与控制权之间的交易收益关系。由此形成反馈循环：当大宗持股者增持股份时，会促进投资并提升企业债务容量，而债务与投资带来的更高回报又激励其进一步增持。尽管在大宗持股者控制下，企业政策未必能最大化分散股东价值，但限制其影响力最终将导致持股比例下降与企业价值受损。
url:b34f8c43513f289c.title: Ownership Dynamics and Firm Policies with a Large Shareholder
url:b34f8c43513f289c.title_zh: 大股东持股下的所有权动态与企业政策

url:b39a739f42a394c3.abstract: This paper introduces a labour force participation choice into a standard labour market matching model embedded in a dynamic stochastic general equilibrium set-up. The participation choice is modelled as a trade-off between forgoing the expected benefits of being search active and engaging in costly labour market search. In contrast to models with constant labour force participation, the model that we analyse induces a symmetry in firms' and workers' search decision since both sides of the labour market vary search effort at the extensive margins. We show that this set-up is (a) of considerable analytical convenience, and (b) that the introduction of a participation choice leads to a strong tendency for procyclical unemployment, very low volatility of labour market tightness, and for a positively sloped Beveridge curve. These implications are summarized by a linear relationship between the vu-ratio and the marginal utility of consumption that we refer to as the consumption-tightness puzzle given its counterfacutal implications. Moreover, we show that this relationship survives a number of extentions of the standard model and that it derives from the allowance for an endogeneous labour market participation choice.
url:b39a739f42a394c3.abstract_zh: 本文将劳动力参与选择引入嵌入动态随机一般均衡框架的标准劳动力市场匹配模型。参与选择被建模为放弃参与搜索活动的预期收益与承担高成本劳动力市场搜索之间的权衡。与劳动力参与率恒定的模型不同，本文分析的模型在企业和工人的搜索决策中引入了对称性，因为劳动力市场的双方都在集约边际上调整搜索努力。研究表明，这一设定（a）具有显著的分析便利性，且（b）引入参与选择会导致失业呈现强顺周期性、劳动力市场紧度波动性极低，以及贝弗里奇曲线呈正斜率。这些特征通过失业-职位空缺比率与消费边际效用之间的线性关系得以概括，鉴于其反事实含义，我们将其称为“消费-紧度之谜”。此外，我们证明这一关系在标准模型的多种扩展中依然成立，且其根源在于允许内生化的劳动力市场参与选择。
url:b39a739f42a394c3.title: The Consumption-Tightness Puzzle

url:b3a58253cdb46b23.abstract: The relationship between unemployment and the rate of change of money wages in interwar Britain is re-examined. It is argued that improved estimates of the wage equation can be obtained by taking account explicitly of factors which change the level of excess demand associated with the measured unemployment rate. In particular, the evidence suggests that long-term unemployment did not act as a restraint on the growth of money wages. New estimates of the wage equation imply that the NAIRU rose during the 1930s as the proportion of unemployment that was long term was higher than in the late 1920s.
url:b3a58253cdb46b23.abstract_zh: 本文重新审视了两次世界大战期间英国失业率与货币工资变动率之间的关系。研究表明，通过明确考虑那些改变与实测失业率相关的超额需求水平的因素，可以获得对工资方程的更优估计。具体而言，证据表明长期失业并未对货币工资增长起到抑制作用。工资方程的新估计表明，由于20世纪30年代长期失业占比高于20年代末，该时期的非加速通货膨胀失业率有所上升。
url:b3a58253cdb46b23.title: DP147 Long-Term Unemployment, Excess Demand and the Wage Equation in Britain, 1925-39

url:b3b47a8f54e0dde7.abstract: Policymakers frequently implement environmental policies that are less ambitious than what voters would prefer. We document this gap using findings from previous research as well as evidence from climate policy in Austria
url:b3b47a8f54e0dde7.abstract_zh: 政策制定者经常实施的环境政策，其力度往往低于选民所期望的水平。我们通过先前研究的发现以及奥地利气候政策的证据，记录了这一差距。

url:b3db9d93caa088c1.abstract: Using administrative data on the largest group of German labor market entrants - graduates from an apprenticeship in a specific occupation - this paper studies the effect of entry conditions on occupational mismatch. Higher entry unemployment entails persistent earnings losses driven by full-time wage effects. Concurrently, occupational matching falls, accounting for 20% of the wage effect. A framework shows that mismatch can arise from cyclical training firm retention or occupation-specific shocks, which I confirm empirically using novel data on occupation-specific unemployment. The findings highlight that specific skills protect graduates from unemployment but may expose them to costly occupational mismatch.
url:b3db9d93caa088c1.abstract_zh: 本文利用德国最大规模劳动力市场新进入群体（特定职业学徒毕业生）的行政数据，研究进入条件对职业错配的影响。更高的进入期失业率会通过全职工资效应导致持续的收入损失。与此同时，职业匹配度下降，占工资效应的20%。一个分析框架表明，错配可能源于周期性培训企业留用或职业特定冲击，本文利用职业特定失业率的新数据对此进行了实证验证。研究结果强调，特定技能虽能保护毕业生免于失业，但可能使其面临代价高昂的职业错配。
url:b3db9d93caa088c1.title: DP21784 When Skills Are Specific: Labor Market Entry and Occupational Mismatch for Apprenticeship Graduates

url:b48ade223b318072.abstract: Fiscal multipliers are larger during natural disasters. Using aggregate and state-level U.S. data, we show that the government-spending multiplier is significantly magnified when natural disasters occur. To rationalize this finding, we develop a New-Keynesian model augmented with disaster risk, in which higher public spending generates a larger output expansion through a strengthened investment channel. Two mechanisms are at work. First, by destroying productive capacity, a disaster raises the marginal productivity of capital, which further crowds in private investment. Second, wealth destruction leads households to draw down less of their savings in response to the fiscal shock, which boosts capital supply.
url:b48ade223b318072.abstract_zh: 自然灾害期间财政乘数显著增大。基于美国全国及州级数据，我们发现当自然灾害发生时，政府支出乘数会显著放大。为解释这一现象，我们构建了纳入灾害风险的新凯恩斯模型，其中公共支出通过强化投资渠道产生更大的产出扩张效应。两种机制在发挥作用：其一，灾害破坏生产能力后，资本边际生产率提升，进而挤出私人投资；其二，财富损失导致家庭在面临财政冲击时减少储蓄消耗，从而增加资本供给。
url:b48ade223b318072.title: Fiscal Multipliers during Natural Disasters

url:b4f3ac3aeb18128c.abstract: This paper examines the limitations of spot markets in providing adequate investment incentives to support zero-carbon investments in electricity markets. In contrast, properly designed long-term contracts have the potential to mitigate price volatility and facilitate the funding of the investments. A theoretical model is developed to analyze contract design under conditions of moral hazard and adverse selection, emphasizing the trade-offs that arise when exposing firms to price and quantity risk. The findings inform optimal contract design for nuclear and renewable energy projects, offering policy recommendations to enhance investment incentives while minimizing productive inefficiencies and excessive rents.
url:b4f3ac3aeb18128c.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了现货市场在提供充足投资激励以支持电力市场零碳投资方面的局限性。相比之下，设计得当的长期合同具有缓解价格波动并促进投资融资的潜力。本文构建了一个理论模型，用于分析道德风险和逆向选择条件下的合同设计，重点揭示了企业在面临价格与数量风险时所产生的权衡关系。研究结论为核能与可再生能源项目的最优合同设计提供了依据，并提出了相关政策建议，以在增强投资激励的同时，减少生产效率损失与超额租金。
url:b4f3ac3aeb18128c.title: Designing Contracts for the Energy Transition

url:b4f4bdc4f724b837.abstract: Banking Union (BU) membership comes with costs, such as foregoing the ability to tailor domestic banking regulation to the country’s needs and preferences; and benefits, such as a more efficient provision of deposit insurance. We use a general equilibrium model that features a rich financial sector, risk shocks, optimal bank capital regulation and government-provided deposit insurance to evaluate the implications of BU membership for welfare, macroeconomic activity and financial stability. BU participation is favored by a riskier and more consequential --for economic activity-- banking sector. Nevertheless, there are cases of welfare improving membership that are not associated with higher and more stable macroeconomic performance and financial stability.
url:b4f4bdc4f724b837.abstract_zh: 银行联盟（BU）成员身份既带来成本，例如放弃根据本国需求和偏好调整国内银行监管的能力；也带来收益，例如更高效的存款保险供给。我们采用包含复杂金融部门、风险冲击、最优银行资本监管及政府提供存款保险的一般均衡模型，评估BU成员身份对福利、宏观经济活动及金融稳定的影响。风险更高且对经济活动影响更显著的银行部门更倾向于加入BU。然而，存在福利改善型成员身份案例，其并未伴随更高且更稳定的宏观经济表现与金融稳定。
url:b4f4bdc4f724b837.title: DP21762 To be or not to be in Banking Union

url:b544ab1445a567c8.abstract: This study examines financial challenges faced by justice-involved individuals using 2023-2024 Survey of Household Economics and Decisionmaking data. Individuals with justice system contact experience substantially worse financial outcomes than those without criminal records, with disparities widening by severity of involvement. Compared to individuals with no prior records, those arrested but not convicted are 4 percentage points less likely to report doing at least okay financially, while formerly convicted as well as incarcerated adults are 15 percentage points less likely. Formerly incarcerated individuals are also 21 percentage points less likely to have credit scores above 660 and 13 percentage points less likely to have credit cards. These disparities mirror patterns observed across education levels, where adults with lower educational attainment experience lower financial well-being and inclusion. Our findings document substantial barriers to financial stability among justice-involved populations and may inform policies promoting financial inclusion and improving economic outcomes for this group.
url:b544ab1445a567c8.abstract_zh: 本研究利用2023-2024年美国家庭经济与决策调查数据，考察了涉法个体面临的金融挑战。与无犯罪记录者相比，有司法系统接触经历的个体在财务结果上显著更差，且差距随涉法程度加深而扩大。相较于无前科者，曾被逮捕但未被定罪者报告财务状况至少尚可的概率低4个百分点，而曾被定罪及监禁的成年人则低15个百分点。曾被监禁者信用评分超过660分的概率低21个百分点，持有信用卡的概率低13个百分点。这些差异与不同教育水平群体中观察到的模式一致——受教育程度较低的成年人财务福祉与金融包容性更低。研究结果揭示了涉法群体在金融稳定性方面面临的重大障碍，可为促进该群体金融包容性、改善其经济状况的政策制定提供参考。
url:b544ab1445a567c8.title: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

url:b559dceb1e691290.abstract: 본 연구는 새로운 지식(혁신)의 창출 현황을 ‘국가-산업 간 네트워크’ 관점에서 살펴보고 ‘혁신 네트워크’ 참여의 경제적 함의에 대해 분석하였다. 지금까지 정책 입안자들은 기술을 발전시키고 혁신 역량을 강화하면서 의례히 자국의 R&D 투자 총액을 늘리는 데 집중해 왔다. 하지만 현대 사회에서 혁신은 한 국가, 산업 또는 기업의 자체적인 R&D만으로는 달성이 불가능하다. 한 국가 내에서뿐만 아니라 국경을 넘어 다른 나라에서의, 다른 산업에서의 혁신은 또 다른 국가로, 또 다른 산업으로 여러 경로를 통해 공유되고 전파되므로 이 점을 충분히 고려하여 정책을 만들어 나가야 한다. 특히 한국의 경우 네트워크의 중요성은 다시 한번 강조될 필요가 있다. This research project examines the current state of new knowledge creation from the perspective of global knowledge networks and analyzes the economic implications of participating in the so-called ‘innovation network.’ Policymakers have as a matter of course prioritized increasing their own country’s total R&D investment to advance technology and strengthen innovation. This research, however, asserts that in our current economic environment innovation cannot be achieved solely through the R&D of a single country, industry, or company. Policies must be formulated with the full understanding that innovation is shared and disseminated across borders—flowing from other countries and industries to new ones through various channels. For Korea, in particular, participating in these networks are critical.
url:b559dceb1e691290.abstract_zh: 本研究从“国家-产业间网络”视角审视新知识（创新）的创造现状，并分析了参与“创新网络”的经济含义。迄今为止，政策制定者在推动技术发展、强化创新能力时，通常侧重于增加本国研发投资总额。然而，在现代社会中，创新无法仅凭单一国家、产业或企业自身的研发实现。创新不仅在一国内部，更跨越国界，从其他国家、其他产业通过多种渠道共享与传播至另一国家或产业，因此政策制定必须充分考虑这一点。尤其对韩国而言，网络的重要性需要再次强调。
url:b559dceb1e691290.title: 글로벌 혁신 네트워크 참여의 경제적 함의와 통상 정책방향 연구(A Study on the Economic Implications of Participation in the Global Innovation Network and Trade Policy Directions)

url:b58a1bd920b566f9.abstract: The paper investigates whether the Japanese monetary authorities use post-retirement employment of Ministry of Finance (MoF) and Bank of Japan (BoJ) officials as a policy instrument. The authors also investigate whether industrial groupings (keiretsu) and main banks have monitoring functions. They find that MoF and BoJ retirees do move into banks that perform badly in terms of profitability. Furthermore, the paper concludes that the movement of these retirees into the boards of private banks is positively related to specific main bank relationships. The hypothesis of monitoring by keiretsu is rejected, however. Finally, the paper finds that MoF/BoJ amakudari appointments have a positive impact on the development of lending to risky industries. In particular, this latter finding casts doubts on the credibility of the hypothesis that amakudari is used as an instrument of prudential policy.
url:b58a1bd920b566f9.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了日本货币当局是否将财务省和日本银行官员的退休后任职作为一种政策工具。作者还研究了企业集团和主银行是否具有监督功能。他们发现，财务省和日本银行的退休人员确实会进入那些盈利能力较差的银行。此外，本文得出结论，这些退休人员进入私人银行董事会的流动与特定的主银行关系呈正相关。然而，企业集团监督的假设被否定。最后，本文发现，财务省或日本银行的“空降”任命对向高风险行业发放贷款具有积极影响。特别是，这一发现对“空降”被用作审慎政策工具的假设的可信度提出了质疑。
url:b58a1bd920b566f9.title: Monitoring the Monitors: Amakudari and the Ex-Post Monitoring of Private Banks
url:b58a1bd920b566f9.title_zh: 监督监督者：官员下凡与私营银行的事后监督

url:b598b840d43d4b0e.abstract: Globalisation has changed economic research profoundly, making it more comparable, more competitive, and thoroughly quantitative. This column argues that AI may unsettle this new order as thoroughly as globalisation unsettled the old one and discusses the technical and geopolitical mechanisms at work. One prediction can be made with high confidence: someone who wakes up thirty years from now is likely to recognise economics as little as someone who fell asleep thirty years ago and just woke up today.
url:b598b840d43d4b0e.abstract_zh: 全球化深刻改变了经济学研究，使其更具可比性、竞争性，并彻底走向定量化。本专栏认为，人工智能可能像当年全球化颠覆旧秩序一样，彻底动摇这一新格局，并探讨了其中涉及的技术与地缘政治机制。一个高度可信的预测是：三十年后醒来的人，很可能像三十年前入睡、今天才醒来的人一样，几乎认不出经济学这门学科。
url:b598b840d43d4b0e.title: AI, the future of economic research and of the many-handed economist
url:b598b840d43d4b0e.title_zh: 人工智能：经济研究与多面手经济学家的未来

url:b5b456a5925bdabb.abstract: Fiscal policy has re-emerged as a central tool of macroeconomic stabilization, yet the way governments communicate fiscal choices remains poorly understood. This paper provides the first systematic analysis of fiscal communication across the G7 from 2000–2024. Using a new dataset of budget documents, ministerial speeches, and press communiqués, we examine the clarity, thematic content, and rhetorical tone of official fiscal statements through computational text-analysis methods. We uncover a structured but fragmented communication architecture. Technical documents emphasize sustainability and constraints; speeches underscore growth, fairness, and investment; and press releases distill policy packages into succinct signals. Despite rising expectations of transparency, fiscal language remains complex and often optimistically framed. These patterns reflect institutional design, political incentives, and macroeconomic conditions. Our findings highlight fiscal communication as an underappreciated dimension of economic governance, one that shapes expectations, conditions credibility, and warrants deeper integration into fiscal policy analysis.
url:b5b456a5925bdabb.abstract_zh: 财政政策已重新成为宏观经济稳定的核心工具，然而政府沟通财政选择的方式仍鲜为人知。本文首次对2000-2024年间七国集团的财政沟通进行了系统性分析。通过运用预算文件、部长演讲和新闻公报的新数据集，我们采用计算文本分析方法，考察了官方财政声明的清晰度、主题内容和修辞语气。研究发现了一种结构化但碎片化的沟通架构：技术文件强调可持续性与约束条件；演讲侧重增长、公平与投资；新闻公报则将政策方案提炼为简洁信号。尽管透明度预期不断提升，财政语言仍保持复杂且常带有乐观倾向。这些模式反映了制度设计、政治激励和宏观经济状况的影响。我们的研究凸显了财政沟通作为经济治理中未被充分重视的维度——它塑造预期、影响可信度，并值得更深入地融入财政政策分析。
url:b5b456a5925bdabb.title: Decoding Fiscal Messaging: How G7 Finance Ministries Communicate
url:b5b456a5925bdabb.title_zh: 解码财政信息：七国集团财政部如何沟通

url:b5ce9f3cdbae5504.abstract: Oil price shocks do not simply make conflict more likely everywhere; they change where violence happens. Using monthly georeferenced data for 131 low- and middle-income countries from 1989 to 2021, this column shows that higher oil prices pull organised conflict towards petroleum fields, while protests and attacks rise around refineries and pipelines. Aggregate conflict statistics can therefore look calm while the local map of violence is being redrawn.
url:b5ce9f3cdbae5504.abstract_zh: 油价冲击并非简单地使冲突在全球范围内更易发生，而是改变了暴力事件的发生地点。本文利用1989年至2021年间131个低收入和中等收入国家的月度地理参考数据表明，油价上涨会将有组织冲突引向油田区域，同时炼油厂和管道周边的抗议与袭击事件也会增加。因此，当局部暴力地图正在被重新绘制时，总体冲突统计数据可能看似平静。
url:b5ce9f3cdbae5504.title: How oil price shocks redraw the map of conflict
url:b5ce9f3cdbae5504.title_zh: 油价冲击如何重塑冲突版图

url:b5ebb60846dc4b93.abstract: This paper analyzes credit developments in the Caucasus and Central Asia (CCA) using several complementary approaches. First, it estimates long-run equilibrium credit levels based on economic fundamentals, providing benchmarks to assess whether observed credit levels are broadly aligned with country characteristics. Second, it applies statistical “gap” measures to identify periods of unusually rapid credit expansion that may signal emerging financial vulnerabilities. Third, it uses the Kalman filter to decompose credit into trend and cyclical elements conditional on macro variables. The results suggest there is scope for further financial deepening in all CCA economies, but the speed of household credit expansion warrants close monitoring. A comparative “horse race” of alternative indicators suggests that no single measure consistently outperforms others across countries, implying that combining various credit gap measures enhances the robustness of risk assessments.
url:b5ebb60846dc4b93.abstract_zh: 本文采用多种互补方法分析高加索和中亚地区的信贷发展。首先，基于经济基本面估算长期均衡信贷水平，为评估实际信贷水平是否与各国特征基本一致提供基准。其次，运用统计"缺口"指标识别可能预示金融脆弱性出现的异常快速信贷扩张期。第三，利用卡尔曼滤波法将信贷分解为趋势成分与周期成分，并使其以宏观变量为条件。研究结果表明，所有高加索和中亚经济体均存在进一步深化金融的空间，但家庭信贷扩张速度需密切监测。通过比较不同指标的"赛马"分析发现，没有任何单一指标能在各国间持续优于其他指标，这意味着综合运用多种信贷缺口指标可增强风险评估的稳健性。
url:b5ebb60846dc4b93.title: Credit Expansion in the Caucasus and Central Asia
url:b5ebb60846dc4b93.title_zh: 高加索和中亚地区的信贷扩张

url:b61cef581261634d.abstract: This paper studies how financial conditions affect research and development (R&D) by firms specialized in green innovation. Using U.S. patent data matched with Compustat, we identify “green innovators” as firms with a high cumulative share of green patents. Although they account for a small share of total green patenting, these firms occupy central positions in the green-innovation ecosystem. Estimating firm-level impulse responses to exogenous changes in broad financial conditions, we find that tightening has a disproportionately large and persistent negative effect on the R&D of specialized green innovators. In contrast, R&D by diversified innovators and non-innovators responds only weakly. Green innovators are younger, smaller, and more dependent on external finance, suggesting that financial tightening introduces a systematic bias against upstream green technological development.
url:b61cef581261634d.abstract_zh: 本文研究金融状况如何影响专注于绿色创新的企业的研发活动。通过将美国专利数据与Compustat数据库匹配，我们将“绿色创新者”定义为绿色专利累计占比高的企业。尽管这些企业在绿色专利总量中占比很小，但它们处于绿色创新生态系统的核心位置。通过估计企业对外生广义金融状况变化的脉冲响应，我们发现金融紧缩对专业化绿色创新企业的研发产生了不成比例的大幅且持续的负面影响。相比之下，多元化创新者和非创新者的研发反应较弱。绿色创新者通常更年轻、规模更小且更依赖外部融资，这表明金融紧缩对上游绿色技术发展引入了系统性偏差。

url:b669772287310d79.abstract: The energy transition is essential for combating climate change and achieving sustainability. Artificial intelligence, as a ‘double-edged sword’ technology, not only provides new momentum for the energy transition but also poses risks of uneven development. This paper investigates the impact of AI on the energy transition using data from 261 cities in China. The findings indicate AI can reduce energy consumption, enhance energy efficiency, and optimize the energy structure, thereby promoting the energy transition across three dimensions: quantity, quality, and structure. The mechanism analysis confirms that AI can indirectly promote the energy transition by improving human-machine alignment and fostering economic agglomeration. Moderation results indicate that the quality of digital infrastructure, technological absorptive capacity, and production factor structure significantly influence the effectiveness of AI. Threshold effects reveal that the impact of AI on the energy transition exhibits an increasing marginal effect under different levels of energy equity. Spatial spillover analysis reveals a significant spatial dependence in the energy transition. However, due to the predominance of the siphoning effect over the trickle-down effect, the impact of AI on neighbouring areas temporarily exhibits a dampening effect. This study enhances the understanding of opportunities presented by AI, providing important references for promoting energy transition and ecological civilization construction. KEYWORDS: Artificial intelligence energy transition spatial spillover China JEL CLASSIFICATION: Q42 Q55
url:b669772287310d79.abstract_zh: 能源转型对于应对气候变化和实现可持续发展至关重要。人工智能作为一把“双刃剑”技术，既为能源转型提供了新动力，也带来了发展不均衡的风险。本文利用中国261个城市的数据，研究了人工智能对能源转型的影响。研究结果表明，人工智能能够降低能源消耗、提升能源效率并优化能源结构，从而在数量、质量和结构三个维度上促进能源转型。机制分析证实，人工智能通过改善人机协同和促进经济集聚，间接推动能源转型。调节效应结果显示，数字基础设施质量、技术吸收能力以及生产要素结构显著影响人工智能的有效性。门槛效应揭示，在不同能源公平水平下，人工智能对能源转型的影响呈现边际效应递增的特征。空间溢出分析表明，能源转型存在显著的空间依赖性。然而，由于虹吸效应主导了涓滴效应，人工智能对邻近地区的影响暂时表现为抑制效应。本研究深化了对人工智能所带来机遇的理解，为促进能源转型和生态文明建设提供了重要参考。关键词：人工智能；能源转型；空间溢出；中国 JEL分类：Q42 Q55
url:b669772287310d79.title: Blessing or peril? The impact of Artificial Intelligence on the energy transition—evidence from China
url:b669772287310d79.title_zh: 福兮祸兮？人工智能对中国能源转型的影响——来自中国的证据

url:b6978a9199f0908d.abstract: Can governments raise pensions for low-income retirees without discouraging them from working? Drawing on Germany's Earned Income Pension Credit, this column finds that higher pension income reduces post-retirement labour supply, but the effect is modest and concentrated among retirees still close to the participation margin. Two-thirds of the response runs through whether retirees work at all, including the often-overlooked decision to return to work after an earlier exit.
url:b6978a9199f0908d.abstract_zh: 政府能否在不抑制低收入退休者工作意愿的前提下提高其养老金？基于德国劳动收入养老金抵免政策的研究发现，养老金收入增加会降低退休后的劳动供给，但影响幅度有限，且主要集中在仍处于劳动参与边缘的退休群体中。三分之二的劳动供给反应体现在退休者是否继续工作这一决策上，包括常被忽视的提前退出后重返工作岗位的选择。
url:b6978a9199f0908d.title: How higher pensions shape work after retirement: Lessons from Germany's Earned Income Pension Credit
url:b6978a9199f0908d.title_zh: 更高养老金如何影响退休后工作：德国劳动收入养老金抵免的启示

url:b6986667948ec8be.abstract: This paper develops a stochastic multi-sector climate-economy model to study how temperature targets, endogenous carbon pricing, and long-run macroeconomic risk shape sectoral asset prices. The model combines a reduced-form integrated assessment block with Epstein-Zin asset pricing. Sectors differ in productivity, carbon intensity, abatement costs, pass-through, and exposure to physical damages. For each temperature target, the policymaker commits to a target-consistent emissions path, and the carbon tax is determined endogenously, date by date and state by state, to implement it. The analysis delivers three main insights. First, stringent temperature targets are dominated by transition costs, whereas looser targets imply weaker transition pressure but larger long-run physical damages. Second, carbon intensity alone does not determine expected returns: endogenous carbon pricing can make brown sectors partly hedge-like, while stringent targets can generate substantial downside risk for high emitters. Third, once transition-cost and damage-exposure shifters are stochastic, the model generates both low- and high-premium brown-sector outcomes. The sign of the brown premium depends on the cyclicality of transition costs, pass-through, and the stochastic discount factor. The framework therefore connects climate targets to the cross section of sectoral risk premia in a tractable, scenario-consistent way.
url:b6986667948ec8be.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个随机多部门气候-经济模型，旨在研究温度目标、内生碳定价及长期宏观经济风险如何影响部门资产价格。该模型将简化形式的气候综合评估模块与Epstein-Zin资产定价框架相结合。不同部门在生产率、碳强度、减排成本、成本传导率及物理损害暴露度方面存在差异。针对每个温度目标，政策制定者承诺遵循与目标一致的排放路径，并通过逐期、逐状态内生确定的碳税来实现该路径。分析得出三个核心结论：第一，严格的温度目标以转型成本为主导，而宽松目标虽转型压力较小，但长期物理损害更大；第二，碳强度本身并非预期收益的决定因素：内生碳定价可能使高碳部门具备部分对冲属性，而严格目标则可能为高排放部门带来显著下行风险；第三，当转型成本与损害暴露度冲击因子具有随机性时，模型既能生成低碳溢价也能生成高碳溢价的高碳部门结果。碳溢价的符号取决于转型成本周期波动性、成本传导率及随机贴现因子的交互作用。该框架以可操作且情景一致的方式，将气候目标与部门风险溢价的截面差异联系起来。
url:b6986667948ec8be.title: Climate Targets and Sectoral Risk Premia
url:b6986667948ec8be.title_zh: 气候目标与行业风险溢价

url:b70459c783cc95fb.abstract: We study the evolution of digital and artificial intelligence (AI) skill demand across six economies in Asia and the Pacific between 2019 and 2024 using millions of online job postings from Indeed and a large language model to classify them by their required level of digital and AI proficiency. Digital skill requirements are widespread across the occupational distribution and have expanded most rapidly in traditionally low and mid digital jobs, pointing to broad technological diffusion. Jobs requiring higher digital proficiency command substantially higher pay, even when comparing job postings within the same job title and controlling for cognitive, interpersonal, organizational, and technical skill requirements. We estimate wage premia of approximately 4%, 11%, and 26% for basic, intermediate, and advanced digital skills, respectively, with intermediate and advanced digital skills commanding larger premia than many other highly rewarded skills. We also document a sharp increase in demand for AI-related competencies, particularly those related to the use of AI tools.
url:b70459c783cc95fb.abstract_zh: 我们利用Indeed平台数百万条在线招聘信息，结合大语言模型按所需数字与人工智能（AI）技能水平进行分类，研究了2019至2024年间亚太地区六个经济体中数字与AI技能需求的演变。数字技能要求广泛分布于各职业层级，且在传统低数字与中数字岗位中增长最为迅速，这表明技术正在广泛扩散。要求更高数字技能水平的岗位薪资显著更高——即便在相同职位名称内进行比较，并控制认知、人际、组织及技术技能要求后，这一结论依然成立。我们估算出基础、中级与高级数字技能的工资溢价分别约为4%、11%和26%，其中中级与高级数字技能的溢价高于许多其他高回报技能。同时，我们还发现对AI相关能力的需求急剧上升，尤其是涉及AI工具使用的能力。

url:b71ea7e09e13b7e8.abstract: Protected areas cover 17% of the world’s land surface, yet credible evidence on their long-run economic and ecological impacts remains scarce. This paper estimates the effects of South Africa’s protected areas on household income, bird biodiversity, and tourism consumer surplus. For the income and biodiversity analyses, it develops a machine-learning counterfactual approach that recovers the present-day impacts of protected areas created up to 100 years ago. Short-run impacts of newer protected areas are small and statistically insignificant, while older protected areas generate large gains. Prior research may have severely underestimated the benefits of protected areas by only estimating the short-run effects of newly established protected areas. In aggregate, this paper estimates that protected areas increase annual household income by approximately R300 billion (roughly 10% of 2011 GDP). This yields approximately 7.6 million job-equivalents attributable to South Africa’s protected areas. Different types of protected areas play complementary roles in conserving different categories of threatened birds, demonstrating the value of South Africa’s entire protected area network. A structural travel cost model estimates that South Africa’s national parks generate R7.7 billion per year (2023 rand) in recreational value for domestic and international tourists. These results suggest that in South Africa there is little tradeoff between wildlife conservation and economic development. Realizing the economic and ecological benefits of protected areas, however, requires patience: returns to conservation accumulate over decades, not years.
url:b71ea7e09e13b7e8.abstract_zh: 保护区覆盖了全球17%的陆地面积，但关于其长期经济与生态影响的可信证据仍然匮乏。本文估算了南非保护区对家庭收入、鸟类生物多样性及旅游消费者剩余的影响。在收入与生物多样性分析中，本文开发了一种机器学习反事实方法，用以还原创建于100年前的保护区在当下的影响。较新保护区的短期影响较小且统计上不显著，而较老保护区则产生了巨大收益。此前研究可能因仅估算新设保护区的短期效应而严重低估了保护区的效益。总体而言，本文估算保护区每年使家庭收入增加约3000亿兰特（约占2011年GDP的10%），这相当于南非保护区创造了约760万个就业等效岗位。不同类型的保护区在保护不同类别受威胁鸟类方面发挥着互补作用，彰显了南非整个保护区网络的价值。结构性旅行成本模型估算显示，南非国家公园每年为国内外游客产生77亿兰特（2023年兰特币值）的游憩价值。这些结果表明，在南非，野生动物保护与经济发展之间几乎不存在权衡取舍。然而，实现保护区的经济与生态效益需要耐心：保护的回报需要数十年而非数年才能积累显现。
url:b71ea7e09e13b7e8.title: The Long-Run Impacts of Protected Areas on Income, Birds, and Tourism in South Africa
url:b71ea7e09e13b7e8.title_zh: 保护区对南非收入、鸟类及旅游业的长期影响

url:b76689d9b22fe21d.abstract: This paper examines the catalysis of an epochal institutional change by the contributions of a foreign-educated elite, effectively ending dynastic China. We show how the Qing government’s attempt to build a modern nation-state by sending the country’s best talent to study in Japan inadvertently heightened the students’ nationalist desire for social and political changes, culminating in the fall of the Qing dynasty. Specifically, each additional overseas student in a county led to significantly greater participation in political parties by the people of that county (41.5%), greater representation of its elite in the provincial assembly (11.4%), and a greater likelihood of that county declaring independence (11.5%) during the 1911 Revolution. To identify causality, we leverage the influence of the network of Zhang Zhidong – the father of overseas study – on the spatial variation of overseas students from each county. To ensure that the networks thus formed are plausibly exogenous, we exploit pre-existing connections – specifically those that Zhang formed with local officials before their randomized (re-)appointment to a (different) county – and the instrumented results hold. Last, we show that schools and newspapers were the primary channels through which the people were mobilized.
url:b76689d9b22fe21d.abstract_zh: 本文考察了海外留学精英的贡献如何催化了一场划时代的制度变革，并最终终结了帝制中国。研究表明，清政府试图通过派遣国内顶尖人才赴日留学来构建现代民族国家，却无意中强化了学生的民族主义诉求，推动社会与政治变革，最终导致清朝覆灭。具体而言，每增加一名海外留学生，该县民众参与政党的比例显著提升41.5%，精英在省议会中的代表比例增加11.4%，且在1911年辛亥革命期间该县宣布独立的可能性提高11.5%。为识别因果关系，我们利用张之洞（海外留学之父）的人际网络对各县留学生空间分布的影响。为确保由此形成的网络具有外生性，我们借助张之洞与地方官员在随机（重新）任命至（不同）县之前已存在的联系，工具变量结果保持稳健。最后，研究表明学校和报纸是动员民众的主要渠道。
url:b76689d9b22fe21d.title: Overseas students, ideology, and the fall of dynastic China
url:b76689d9b22fe21d.title_zh: 海外留学生、意识形态与中华帝制的崩溃

url:b779179eb28dc504.abstract: In n -person games with compact strategy spaces and continuous payoff functions, the expected payoff functions of the mixed extension are continuous with respect to the product of the weak topologies. We provide an elementary proof of this fact. The analysis reveals that the Hausdorff separation axiom, commonly imposed on the topology of players’ strategy spaces, is not needed. We also show that the definition of expected payoffs as an iterated integral does not depend on the ordering of the players.
url:b779179eb28dc504.abstract_zh: 在具有紧策略空间和连续支付函数的n人博弈中，混合扩展的期望支付函数关于弱拓扑的乘积是连续的。我们给出了这一事实的初等证明。分析表明，通常施加于参与者策略空间拓扑的豪斯多夫分离公理并非必要。我们还证明了将期望支付定义为迭代积分的结果不依赖于参与者的顺序。

url:b7a917680f4913fa.abstract: We review the evidence on the impact of private equity (PE) ownership on firms, stakeholders, and the economy. We organize this literature using a framework that emphasizes the costs and benefits of PE as an ownership form and implies five main predictions: (i) only some firms are natural PE targets; (ii) PE ownership is optimally temporary; (iii) debt is typically a cheaper source of capital than PE equity; (iv) PE activity is strongly cyclical; and (v) the PE model is a second-best response to underlying agency and contracting frictions. We use this framework to interpret existing evidence and to clarify when, and for whom, PE ownership creates value.
url:b7a917680f4913fa.abstract_zh: 本文综述了私募股权（PE）所有权对企业、利益相关者及经济影响的实证证据。我们通过一个强调PE作为所有权形式的成本与收益的分析框架来组织相关文献，该框架隐含五个主要预测：（i）仅部分企业是天然的PE收购目标；（ii）PE所有权具有最优的暂时性特征；（iii）债务通常比PE股权更具成本优势；（iv）PE活动呈现强周期性；（v）PE模式是对潜在代理问题与契约摩擦的次优应对方案。我们运用该框架解释现有证据，并阐明PE所有权在何种情境下、为哪些主体创造价值。

url:b8a15abac516f300.abstract: Under collusion, firms deviate from current profit maximization in anticipation of future rewards. As current profit maximization places little restrictions on firms' pricing behaviour, collusive conduct is hard to infer. Under collusion -- however -- firms' behaviour should instantaneously respond to the anticipation of future changes in their ability to sustain it. We show that bids from certain firms in the Colombian wholesale electricity market collapsed immediately after the announcement, and before the implementation, of a reform that potentially made collusion harder to sustain. A forensic analysis uncovers a type of coordinated behaviour among cartel members that likely required explicit communication and provides suggestive evidence that such communication might have occurred. A quantification exercise supports the reduced-form evidence on collusion and quantifies its costs. Dynamic enforcement constraints should be taken seriously by policy-makers fighting collusion.
url:b8a15abac516f300.abstract_zh: 在合谋行为下，企业为预期未来收益而偏离当前利润最大化目标。由于当前利润最大化对企业定价行为的约束极小，合谋行为难以被推断。然而，在合谋状态下，企业的行为应当会立即响应其对未来维持合谋能力变化的预期。我们研究发现，在哥伦比亚批发电力市场中，一项可能削弱合谋可持续性的改革宣布后、实施前，部分特定企业的报价立即暴跌。法证分析揭示了卡特尔成员间一种可能依赖明确沟通的协调行为，并提供了此类沟通可能存在的暗示性证据。量化分析支持了关于合谋的简化形式证据，并估算了其成本。反合谋政策制定者应严肃对待动态执行约束问题。
url:b8a15abac516f300.title: Relational Collusion in the Colombian Electricity Market
url:b8a15abac516f300.title_zh: 哥伦比亚电力市场中的关系性合谋

url:b8b5f1d728a0a7c4.abstract: Governmental information manipulation has been hard to measure and study systematically. This paper provides comparable country-level estimates of the extent of misinformation in official data, in a large and diverse set of countries. We hand-collect data from a variety of sources in 134 countries to estimate misreporting of Covid mortality in 2020-2021. We find that information manipulation by governments during this period was remarkably widespread: between 45%–55% of governments misreport the number of deaths. Misreporting is large in magnitude: together, the countries we study reported 5.08 million Covid deaths during 2020-2021, whereas actual Covid mortality was more than double, at 12.47 million. The lion’s share of misreporting cannot be attributed to a country’s capacity to accurately diagnose and report deaths. Contrary to some theoretical expectations, information manipulation takes the form of downplaying rather than exaggerating the severity of the crisis. What characterizes governments that manipulate information? We examine the role of macroeconomic incentives, culture, audience sophistication, and institutions. The evidence strongly suggests that misreporting is higher where governments face fewer social and institutional constraints; in countries holding elections during this period; and in countries with a communist legacy. url:b8b5f1d728a0a7c4.abstract_zh: 政府信息操纵一直难以被系统性地衡量和研究。本文在大量且多样化的国家中，提供了关于官方数据中错误信息程度的可比国家层面估计。我们手工收集了134个国家多种来源的数据，以估算2020-2021年新冠死亡人数的误报情况。研究发现，在此期间政府的信息操纵行为异常普遍：45%至55%的政府误报了死亡人数。误报规模巨大：我们研究的国家在2020-2021年期间报告了508万新冠死亡病例，而实际新冠死亡率超过这一数字的两倍，达到1247万。绝大多数误报不能归因于国家准确诊断和报告死亡的能力。与某些理论预期相反，信息操纵表现为淡化而非夸大危机的严重性。那么，操纵信息的政府有何特征？我们考察了宏观经济激励、文化、受众成熟度以及制度的作用。证据强烈表明，在面临较少社会与制度约束的政府中、在选举期间的国家中、以及具有共产主义遗产的国家中，误报率更高。类似内容被其他人浏览。

url:b8d80aa52da9ab2e.abstract: Equal pay for equal work has been a core EU principle since 1957, yet women across Europe continue to earn less than men, even in very similar jobs. As EU countries begin implementing the new Pay Transparency Directive, greater wage transparency is expected to narrow these gaps. This column explores the potential effects on the 27 EU countries. Equal pay could substantially narrow gender disparities, but the gains are greater where unequal pay among comparable workers is a key driver of the gender pay gap.
url:b8d80aa52da9ab2e.abstract_zh: 同工同酬自1957年起便是欧盟的核心原则，然而即便在高度相似的岗位上，欧洲女性收入仍普遍低于男性。随着欧盟各国开始实施新的《薪酬透明指令》，更高的薪酬透明度有望缩小这些差距。本文探讨了该指令对27个欧盟国家的潜在影响。同工同酬可显著缩小性别差异，但在可比劳动者薪酬不平等是性别薪酬差距主要驱动因素的国家，其收益更为显著。

url:b8e53cc5cbfa84c1.abstract: This paper introduces the most comprehensive database to date, covering the nine most commonly used measures of potential growth for up to 173 countries over 1981-2021. Based on this database, the paper presents three findings. First, all measures of global potential growth show a steady and widespread decline over the past decade, with all the fundamental drivers of growth losing momentum over time. In 2011-21, potential growth was below its 2000-10 average in nearly all advanced economies and roughly 60 percent of emerging market and developing economies. Second, adverse events, such as the global financial crisis and the COVID-19 pandemic, contributed to the decline. At the country-level also, national recessions lowered potential growth even five years after their onset. Third, the persistent impact of recessions on potential growth operated through weaker growth of investment, employment, and productivity.
url:b8e53cc5cbfa84c1.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了迄今为止最全面的数据库，涵盖1981年至2021年间多达173个国家的九种最常用的潜在增长率衡量指标。基于该数据库，本文提出三项发现。第一，过去十年间，全球潜在增长率的各项指标均呈现持续且广泛的下降趋势，所有增长的基本驱动力随时间推移逐渐减弱。在2011-2021年间，几乎所有发达经济体的潜在增长率均低于其2000-2010年的平均水平，而约60%的新兴市场和发展中经济体亦呈现相同趋势。第二，全球金融危机和新冠疫情等不利事件加剧了这一下降。在国家层面，国内经济衰退甚至在爆发五年后仍持续压低潜在增长率。第三，衰退对潜在增长率的持续影响通过投资、就业和生产率增长的疲弱传导机制实现。
url:b8e53cc5cbfa84c1.title: Potential Growth: A Global Database

url:ba49e458b859155b.abstract: This paper explores a possible link between job security and multiple job-holding in the United Kingdom. It is argued that an individual may hold a second job if they believe that their primary job has a high risk of termination. The reason is that holding a second job may cushion the financial impact of losing the main source of earnings, especially if there is scope for increasing the number of hours worked in the second job. Data from four waves of the British Household Panel Study are used to test this hypothesis. The empirical analysis provides (at best) very weak evidence in support of hedging behaviour of this type.
url:ba49e458b859155b.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了英国就业保障与多重兼职之间的潜在关联。研究认为，当个体感知到其主要工作面临较高失业风险时，可能会选择从事第二份工作。其逻辑在于：兼职工作能够缓冲主要收入来源丧失带来的经济冲击，尤其是当第二份工作存在增加工作时长的空间时。基于英国住户追踪调查四轮数据，本研究对该假说进行了实证检验。分析结果（至多）仅提供了极弱的证据支持此类对冲行为。
url:ba49e458b859155b.title: Multiple Job Holding as a 'Hedge' Against Unemployment

url:ba5197cf5aff920b.abstract: The paper shows that the conversion from national currency bank notes to hard-ECU notes is promoted by the provision of an implicit and free currency call option. This wealth effect is caused by the devaluation-proof definition of this currency. Nevertheless, additional transactions and information costs would keep the demand for hard-ECUs very limited. Because of such externalities the market does not lead to a Pareto-efficient arrangement for the European monetary order. At best the hard-ECU would out-compete currencies of EC countries with above-average inflation rates, while national currencies would remain in use in the other EC countries. In addition, the competition process is distorted by the subsidy character of the implicit option. The scheme is intended to enhance monetary stability in Europe, but the need for such an additional nominal anchor is not clear, nor is any reason why the Hard-ECU Bank should have an an extremely strong stability orientation. Moreover, a deliberate interest rate policy of the HEB, which would be required to discipline national central banks, conflicts with the main target of using the market as an exploratory device for identifying an optimum European monetary order.
url:ba5197cf5aff920b.abstract_zh: 本文表明，通过提供一种隐性且免费的货币看涨期权，可促进从国家货币纸币向硬埃居纸币的转换。这种财富效应源于该货币的抗贬值定义。然而，额外的交易成本与信息成本将使硬埃居的需求极为有限。由于此类外部性，市场无法为欧洲货币秩序带来帕累托有效的安排。在最理想的情况下，硬埃居仅能击败通胀率高于平均水平的欧共体国家货币，而其他欧共体国家仍将保留本国货币。此外，隐性期权的补贴性质扭曲了竞争过程。该方案旨在增强欧洲的货币稳定性，但引入这一额外名义锚的必要性尚不明确，亦无理由认为硬埃居银行应具备极强的稳定性导向。此外，为约束各国央行而需实施的刻意利率政策，与利用市场作为探索工具以识别最优欧洲货币秩序的主要目标相冲突。

url:ba7d4add288320fa.abstract: Addressing the massive test score gaps between rich and poor countries will require programs that are both high-impact and scalable. This study uses the results of a randomized controlled trial in low-fee private schools in Ghana to study a program that meets both needs. The Tools for Foundational Learning Improvement program increased test scores by 0.5 standard deviation after just nine months of intervention. A machine learning method decomposes the effects by predicted test scores if the students did not receive the treatment, and the findings show that the gains were larger for weaker students. Moreover, the program’s impacts scale roughly linearly with time compared to a shorter-term, smaller-scale pilot randomized controlled trial. The program’s developers used generative artificial intelligence to accelerate lesson plan development and adaptation to new settings. An observational pilot test of this adaptation in Uganda yielded comparable results to those of this study’s randomized controlled trial. The study developed a model in which basic skills constrain the development of advanced skills, which predicts the pattern of effects observed across early reading capabilities, and it makes forecasts about the future impacts of the program as it continues into second grade.
url:ba7d4add288320fa.abstract_zh: 解决富国与穷国之间巨大的考试成绩差距，需要兼具高影响力和可扩展性的项目。本研究利用加纳低收费私立学校的一项随机对照试验结果，考察了一个同时满足这两项需求的项目。基础学习提升工具项目在仅九个月的干预后，将考试成绩提高了0.5个标准差。通过机器学习方法，根据学生未接受干预时的预测考试成绩分解项目效果，结果显示较弱学生的收益更大。此外，与一项短期、小规模的试点随机对照试验相比，该项目的影响大致随时间线性扩展。项目开发者利用生成式人工智能加速教案开发及对新环境的适应。在乌干达进行的该适应性调整的观察性试点测试，得出了与本研究随机对照试验相当的结果。本研究构建了一个模型，其中基础技能制约高级技能的发展，该模型预测了早期阅读能力中观察到的效果模式，并对项目持续至二年级时的未来影响进行了预测。

url:bad26bc885068542.abstract: Countries borrow in dollars because dollar debt markets are deep and liquid. This paper develops a theory of when that dominance becomes fragile because countries have inherited dollar liabilities but increasingly earn yuan-linked revenues. In the model, countries begin with dollar-denominated sovereign debt. Geopolitical fragmentation raises their yuan revenue share through two channels: higher trade barriers with dollar-linked markets shift exports toward yuan-linked markets, and higher costs of using dollars in that trade make yuan settlement more attractive. Governments then face a choice: repay dollar debt using revenues that are less dollar-linked, default, or restructure into yuan. The paper identifies a liquidity spillover from restructuring: dollar-to-yuan restructurings deepen yuan debt markets, lowering refinancing costs and encouraging additional restructurings. The model shows when fragmentation produces limited restructuring and when it triggers a self-reinforcing shift from dollar debt to yuan debt. A cascade requires the liquidity feedback from yuan restructuring to be stronger than the dispersion in countries’ yuan revenue exposure.
url:bad26bc885068542.abstract_zh: 各国以美元借贷，是因为美元债务市场深度大、流动性强。本文构建了一个理论，探讨当各国继承美元负债但收入日益与人民币挂钩时，这种主导地位何时会变得脆弱。在模型中，各国最初持有以美元计价的主权债务。地缘政治碎片化通过两个渠道提高其人民币收入份额：与美元挂钩市场的贸易壁垒提高，促使出口转向人民币挂钩市场；以及在该贸易中使用美元的成本上升，使人民币结算更具吸引力。政府随后面临选择：用与美元关联度较低的收入偿还美元债务、违约，或重组为人民币债务。本文识别出重组带来的流动性溢出效应：美元转人民币的重组深化了人民币债务市场，降低了再融资成本，并鼓励更多重组。模型展示了碎片化何时导致有限的重组，以及何时触发从美元债务向人民币债务的自我强化转变。这种级联效应需要人民币重组的流动性反馈强于各国人民币收入敞口的分散程度。
url:bad26bc885068542.title: Geopolitical Fragmentation, Sovereign Debt, and Dollar Dominance
url:bad26bc885068542.title_zh: 地缘政治碎片化、主权债务与美元主导地位

url:bade340534323f6c.abstract: Evidence is mixed on whether central banks can influence exchange rates simply by talking about them. This column explores this question by analysing more than two decades of ECB communications. The authors find that exchange rate communication has only limited effects on the euro exchange rate, and any effects that do emerge tend to disappear quickly. This stands in contrast with monetary policy communication, which is a major driver of exchange rate movements. Financial markets seem to pay much more attention to what central banks do or say about monetary policy than to what they say about exchange rates.
url:bade340534323f6c.abstract_zh: 关于央行能否仅通过口头干预影响汇率，现有证据结论不一。本文通过分析欧洲央行二十余年的沟通记录探讨这一问题。作者发现，汇率沟通对欧元汇率的影响十分有限，且任何显现出的效应往往迅速消退。这与货币政策沟通形成鲜明对比——后者才是汇率波动的主要驱动因素。金融市场似乎更关注央行在货币政策上的行动或言论，而非其对汇率的表态。
url:bade340534323f6c.title: Exchange rate communication in practice: Evidence from two decades of ECB press conferences
url:bade340534323f6c.title_zh: 实践中的汇率沟通：来自欧洲央行二十年新闻发布会的证据

url:baece5ca76e1759b.abstract: The CHIPS and Science Act, enacted in August 2022, is a key element of the revival of U.S. industrial policy. We examine the short-term employment effects of the act. Drawing on quarterly industry-by-county data from the Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages (QCEW), we implement two county-level difference-in-difference designs, the first comparing counties with pre-existing semiconductor facilities to other counties with high-tech industries and the second comparing counties with semiconductor fabrication facilities (which were targeted for the bulk of the CHIPS funding) to counties with non-fabrication semiconductor facilities. Using both approaches, we find robust, positive employment impacts in affected counties. The effects began at the time of the passage in the Senate of a precursor bill, in anticipation of the signing of the CHIPS Act. Our preferred estimates suggest an increase of 110 jobs per affected county in the first design and 180 jobs per affected county in the second design. We also find robust positive impacts on local construction employment. Evidence on total employment and GDP at the county level, as well as on employment in upstream input sectors, is mixed. Simple back-of-the-envelope calculations (which come with caveats) suggest national direct employment effects of approximately 15, 000-16, 000 jobs in the core semiconductor sector and indirect effects of 28, 000-35, 000 jobs in related sectors.
url:baece5ca76e1759b.abstract_zh: 2022年8月颁布的《芯片与科学法案》是美国产业政策复兴的关键举措。本文考察该法案的短期就业效应。基于《季度就业与工资普查》（QCEW）提供的行业-县季度数据，我们采用两种县级双重差分设计：第一种比较拥有现有半导体设施的县与其他拥有高科技产业的县；第二种比较拥有半导体制造设施（《芯片法案》资金主要投向对象）的县与拥有非制造类半导体设施的县。两种方法均发现受影响县出现稳健的正向就业效应。该效应始于参议院通过预算法案之时，早于《芯片法案》正式签署。我们的首选估计显示，第一种设计中每个受影响县新增110个就业岗位，第二种设计中每个受影响县新增180个就业岗位。我们还发现对当地建筑业就业产生稳健的正向影响。县级总就业与GDP数据，以及上游投入部门就业数据的证据则呈现混合特征。基于简单粗略估算（需注意局限性）表明，核心半导体部门全国直接就业效应约为15,000-16,000个岗位，相关行业间接就业效应为28,000-35,000个岗位。
url:baece5ca76e1759b.title: Employment Impacts of the CHIPS Act

url:baefbc89037d37e0.abstract: This paper develops and estimates a dynamic life-cycle model to quantify why households save and work. The model incorporates multiple sources of risk—health, marital status, wages, medical expenses, and mortality—as well as endogenous labor supply and human capital accumulation, retirement, and bequest motives at the death of the first and last household member. We estimate it using PSID and HRS data for the 1941–1945 cohort via the Method of Simulated Moments. Eliminating bequest motives reduces aggregate wealth by 23.8% and labor earnings by 1.2%; removing medical expenses lowers them by 13.1% and 0.7%. Wage risk is crucial for early-life saving: its removal reduces wealth by 10.4% but raises earnings by 2.3%. Eliminating marriage and divorce dynamics leads couples—numerous and wealthier—to save and work slightly less, and singles—fewer and poorer—to save and work considerably more. These effects largely offset in the aggregate. Removing all saving motives beyond retirement needs and lifespan uncertainty lowers wealth by 56.9% and earnings by 2.7%. These findings show that capturing multiple risks and behavioral margins jointly is essential to understanding household saving and labor supply.
url:baefbc89037d37e0.abstract_zh: 本文构建并估计了一个动态生命周期模型，旨在量化家庭储蓄与劳动供给的动因。该模型纳入了多重风险来源——健康状况、婚姻状态、工资水平、医疗支出及死亡率——同时涵盖内生劳动供给、人力资本积累、退休决策以及首位与末位家庭成员去世时的遗赠动机。我们利用PSID和HRS数据库中1941-1945年出生队列的数据，通过模拟矩估计法进行参数估计。消除遗赠动机会使总财富减少23.8%，劳动收入下降1.2%；剔除医疗支出则使两者分别降低13.1%和0.7%。工资风险对早期储蓄至关重要：消除该风险使财富减少10.4%，但劳动收入增加2.3%。取消婚姻与离婚动态机制后，数量较多且更富裕的夫妻群体储蓄与劳动供给略有减少，而数量较少且更贫困的单身群体储蓄与劳动供给显著增加，这些效应在总体上大致相互抵消。若移除退休需求与寿命不确定性之外的所有储蓄动机，财富将下降56.9%，劳动收入减少2.7%。上述发现表明，同时捕捉多重风险与行为边际对于理解家庭储蓄与劳动供给至关重要。
url:baefbc89037d37e0.title: Why Do Households Save and Work?

url:bb25e29cf91ed0d1.abstract: Central bank communications, particularly FOMC statements and press conferences, play a crucial role in shaping financial market expectations. Using large language models to quantify central bank content, this paper demonstrates how sentiment aligns with traditional market-based monetary policy measures. We show that press conferences correlate with future policy to a greater extent than other communications. While FOMC statements coarsely signal the current stance of policy, press conferences fine-tune the message, which helps market participants revise their expectations about future policy.
url:bb25e29cf91ed0d1.abstract_zh: 央行沟通，尤其是联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）声明与新闻发布会，在塑造金融市场预期中发挥着关键作用。本文利用大语言模型量化央行内容，揭示了情绪如何与传统市场型货币政策指标保持一致。研究表明，新闻发布会相较于其他沟通形式，与未来政策的关联度更高。尽管FOMC声明粗略传递了当前政策立场，但新闻发布会通过精细调整信息，帮助市场参与者修正对未来政策的预期。
url:bb25e29cf91ed0d1.title: The Fed's Fine-Tune: Coarse Statements and Predictive Pressers
url:bb25e29cf91ed0d1.title_zh: 美联储的微调：笼统声明与预测性新闻发布会

url:bb3837a2ecd5ca57.abstract: Credit constraints often hinder investment in unincorporated enterprises, limiting innovation and overall performance, including reduced productivity and output, and slower growth. In this paper, we assess credit constraints on unincorporated enterprises using NSSO’s unit-level data from the Annual Survey of Unincorporated Enterprises 2022-23. Identifying the factors and determinants of credit constraints is crucial for informing policy recommendations. Based on sources of outstanding loans and survey responses, we classify enterprises into three categories: fully constrained, partially constrained, and not constrained. We find that manufacturing enterprises face more credit constraints than those engaged in trading and services. Furthermore, the study indicates that female entrepreneurs and those belonging to SC/ST or OBC castes face comparatively greater credit constraints than others. Other factors, such as region (rural vs. urban), size (annual turnover and asset value), GST registration status, price-cost margin, etc., are strong determinants of credit constraints or access to credit.
url:bb3837a2ecd5ca57.abstract_zh: 信贷约束常常阻碍非公司制企业的投资，限制其创新和整体绩效，导致生产率与产出下降、增长放缓。本文利用印度国家抽样调查局（NSSO）2022-23年度非公司制企业调查的单位级数据，评估了非公司制企业面临的信贷约束。识别信贷约束的影响因素及决定机制，对于制定政策建议至关重要。基于未偿贷款来源和调查反馈，我们将企业分为三类：完全受约束、部分受约束和不受约束。研究发现，制造业企业比贸易和服务业企业面临更严重的信贷约束。此外，女性企业家以及表列种姓/表列部落（SC/ST）或其他落后阶级（OBC）群体面临相对更大的信贷约束。其他因素如地区（农村与城市）、规模（年营业额和资产价值）、商品与服务税（GST）注册状态、价格-成本利润率等，均是信贷约束或信贷获取能力的强决定因素。
url:bb3837a2ecd5ca57.title: Credit Constraints among Unincorporated Enterprises in India: An Empirical Investigation Using Unit-Level ASUSE Data
url:bb3837a2ecd5ca57.title_zh: 印度非公司制企业的信贷约束：基于ASUSE单位层面数据的实证研究

url:bb44b079c8567b94.abstract: We construct postwar U.S. patent time series by funding source and ownership. In local projections with rich macroeconomic controls, disciplined by external instruments and information-set tests, unanticipated filings serve as source-specific technology-shock proxies. Government-funded but privately owned patents are two percent of filings, yet explain about one-fifth of medium-run fluctuations in TFP and GDP. Responses propagate through private R&D and investment, with model-implied social returns to public R&D about twice those to private R&D. Effects concentrate in science-based patents supported by NIH and NSF or assigned to universities, research institutes, and start-ups. Government-owned patents have weak average effects but a consequential upper tail.
url:bb44b079c8567b94.abstract_zh: 我们按资金来源和所有权构建了战后美国专利时间序列。在包含丰富宏观经济控制变量的局部投影中，通过外部工具变量和信息集检验的约束，未预期的专利申请被用作特定来源的技术冲击代理变量。政府资助但私人拥有的专利仅占专利申请量的2%，却解释了全要素生产率（TFP）和GDP中期波动的约五分之一。其影响通过私人研发和投资传导，模型隐含的公共研发社会回报率约为私人研发的两倍。效应集中于由美国国立卫生研究院（NIH）和国家科学基金会（NSF）支持、或分配给大学、研究机构和初创企业的科学型专利。政府拥有的专利平均效应较弱，但存在显著的上尾分布。
url:bb44b079c8567b94.title: Where Do Technology Shocks Come From? Public Funding and Private Ownership
url:bb44b079c8567b94.title_zh: 技术冲击从何而来？公共资助与私人所有权

url:bb8db59c6fa54375.abstract: Between 1880 and 1920, more than 20 million immigrants settled in the United States. We study how this migration wave affected innovation and growth. Using a newly constructed dataset linking individual census records to historical immigration records and the universe of US patents, we highlight a new channel through which immigrants contributed to growth: they disproportionately settled in urban innovation hubs. To quantify the aggregate and regional effects of this mass migration episode, we develop a new spatial growth model in which skilled workers have a comparative advantage in innovation and sort endogenously across space. We find that international arrivals after 1880 raised US income per capita by 8.2\% by 1940. Removing the subsequent immigration restrictions of the 1920s would have raised income per capita by a further 1.7\% by 2000. Immigrants' skill composition and their concentration in urban hubs are key drivers of these effects.
url:bb8db59c6fa54375.abstract_zh: 1880年至1920年间，超过2000万移民定居美国。本研究考察了此次移民浪潮对创新与经济增长的影响。通过构建将个人人口普查记录、历史移民记录及美国全部专利数据相关联的新数据集，我们揭示了移民促进经济增长的新渠道：移民不成比例地聚集于城市创新中心。为量化此次大规模移民事件的总体与区域效应，我们构建了新型空间增长模型，其中技能型劳动者在创新领域具有比较优势，并在空间上实现内生性分类。研究发现，1880年后的国际移民使1940年美国人均收入提升8.2%。若取消1920年代后续实施的移民限制，2000年人均收入将额外增长1.7%。移民的技能构成及其在城市创新中心的集聚效应是这些影响的关键驱动因素。
url:bb8db59c6fa54375.title: Immigration, Innovation, and the Geography of Growth
url:bb8db59c6fa54375.title_zh: 移民、创新与增长的地理分布

url:bbbcaaf51f2382c5.abstract: Proxy advisors play a central and controversial role in modern corporate governance. Institutional investors rely on advisory firms such as Institutional Shareholder Services and Glass Lewis to provide shareholder voting recommendations, research, and execution infrastructure across thousands of portfolio companies each year, enabling voting at scale. Critics argue that proxy advisors induce “robo-voting,” exercise excessive influence, operate with conflicts of interest, and dominate a concentrated market with limited accountability. In response, federal and state actors have launched an escalating series of investigations, executive actions, and novel statutory and regulatory regimes. Many existing reform proposals misdiagnose the economic foundations of proxy advice and risk degrading voting quality or driving proxy advisors from the market altogether. Because institutional investors have limited attention budgets, weakening proxy advisory services would likely increase deference to corporate management rather than enhance shareholder oversight. This Article offers an economic framework for evaluating proxy advice and the reforms proposed to regulate it. We develop a three-stage theory of shareholder voting in which investors (1) select proxy advisors, (2) specify customized voting policies ex ante, and (3) allocate scarce attention across proposals ex post. We complement this framework with empirical evidence on voting patterns that reassesses claims of “robo-voting” and advisor dominance. Together, our analysis situates proxy advice within the collective-action problem inherent in shareholder voting: investors bear the concentrated costs of informed voting while capturing only a fraction of its benefits. Building on this analysis, we propose a targeted reform agenda. First, we recommend requiring proxy advisors to provide “attention flags” identifying recommendations that involve material trade-offs, firm-specific context, or high-stakes decisions, thereby directing investor attention to where it is most valuable. Second, we propose strengthening fiduciary obligations governing proxy voting to ensure meaningful engagement where warranted. We also address firm-specific conflicts of interest and evaluate prominent regulatory approaches, including federal solicitation-based regulation and recent state legislation. Our regulatory framework improves the targeting of investor attention while preserving economies of scale, offering a more promising path forward.
url:bbbcaaf51f2382c5.abstract_zh: 代理顾问在现代公司治理中扮演着核心且备受争议的角色。机构投资者依赖诸如机构股东服务公司和格拉斯·刘易斯等咨询公司，每年为数千家投资组合公司提供股东投票建议、研究及执行基础设施，从而实现规模化投票。批评者认为，代理顾问诱导“机器人投票”，施加过度影响，存在利益冲突，并在一个集中度高且问责有限的市场中占据主导地位。作为回应，联邦和州层面的行动者已发起一系列不断升级的调查、行政措施以及新的法规和监管制度。许多现有改革方案误判了代理建议的经济基础，可能降低投票质量，甚至将代理顾问完全逐出市场。由于机构投资者的注意力预算有限，削弱代理咨询服务可能会增加对管理层决策的顺从，而非增强股东监督。本文提供了一个评估代理建议及其监管改革的经济学框架。我们构建了一个股东投票的三阶段理论：投资者（1）选择代理顾问，（2）事先制定定制化投票政策，以及（3）事后在提案之间分配稀缺注意力。我们通过投票模式的实证证据补充这一框架，重新评估了关于“机器人投票”和顾问主导地位的论断。综合来看，我们的分析将代理建议置于股东投票中固有的集体行动问题中：投资者承担知情投票的集中成本，却仅获得其收益的一小部分。基于此分析，我们提出了一项有针对性的改革议程。首先，我们建议要求代理顾问提供“注意力标记”，识别涉及重大权衡、公司特定背景或高风险决策的建议，从而将投资者注意力引导至最有价值的领域。其次，我们提议加强管理代理投票的受托责任，以确保在必要时进行有意义的参与。我们还处理了公司特定的利益冲突，并评估了主要的监管方法，包括联邦基于招股说明书的监管和近期的州立法。我们的监管框架在保留规模经济的同时，改善了投资者注意力的针对性，提供了一条更有前景的前进道路。
url:bbbcaaf51f2382c5.title: Other people’s votes: The law and economics of proxy advice
url:bbbcaaf51f2382c5.title_zh: 他人之票：代理投票建议的法律与经济学

url:bbe71b7a421904b7.abstract: Why do some currencies systematically appreciate when global risk rises? This paper argues that safe-haven status reflects a macro-financial transmission mechanism. Higher global uncertainty raises precautionary savings and reallocates portfolios toward assets that provide a better hedge, raising their relative prices, directing capital flows toward them, and appreciating the currency in which they are denominated. We document these dynamics in Swiss data and develop a simple open-economy New Keynesian model with internationally active intermediaries and balance-sheet constraints that reproduces them. The mechanism is that financial frictions make uncertainty-induced portfolio reallocation asymmetric across countries, so that some assets absorb more demand and command lower expected returns. In the Swiss calibration, higher relative productivity triggers the mechanism. We provide suggestive empirical evidence of a positive correlation between safe-haven strength and relative productivity. Japan is a boundary case. A Japanese calibration with lower relative productivity reverses the mechanism under symmetric leverage, but safe-haven dynamics are restored when the calibration incorporates higher Japanese intermediary leverage. Finally, we show that the same underlying mechanism implies a persistent low-rate bias in safe-haven economies.
url:bbe71b7a421904b7.abstract_zh: 为何某些货币在全球风险上升时系统性升值？本文认为，避险属性反映了一种宏观金融传导机制。全球不确定性上升会提高预防性储蓄，促使投资组合向对冲效果更优的资产倾斜，推升其相对价格，引导资本流向这些资产，并使其计价货币升值。我们利用瑞士数据验证了这些动态特征，并构建了一个包含国际活跃金融中介与资产负债表约束的开放经济新凯恩斯模型，成功复现了上述现象。其核心机制在于：金融摩擦导致不确定性引发的投资组合再配置在国家间呈现非对称性，使得部分资产吸收更多需求并获取更低预期收益。在瑞士参数校准中，相对生产率提升触发了该机制。我们提供了避险强度与相对生产率正相关的初步经验证据。日本作为边界案例：在对称杠杆条件下，较低相对生产率的日本参数校准会逆转该机制，但若校准中纳入日本金融中介更高的杠杆率，避险动态特征得以恢复。最后，我们证明同一基础机制意味着避险经济体存在持续的低利率偏差。
url:bbe71b7a421904b7.title: DP21763 What Makes a Safe-Haven Currency Safe?
url:bbe71b7a421904b7.title_zh: DP21763 什么使避险货币安全？

url:bbfabadb3e6dd291.abstract: This Paper evaluates alternative designs of indicator regimes for monetary policy in a small stochastic macromodel of the small open economy with rational expectations. The paper first derives methods for deriving optimal control rules and optimal simple feedback rules in rational expectations models, taking account of the Lucas critique. Use of the money supply, exchange rate, nominal income and price level as alternative indicators for monetary policy are then considered, with the objective of minimising a linear combination of price and output fluctuations. The price level indicator regime is found to be robust in the face of different types of disturbance and parameter changes. Moreover, this regime generally dominates the other regimes, and exhibits only a slight increase in loss relative to the full optimal rule.
url:bbfabadb3e6dd291.abstract_zh: 本文在一个具有理性预期的小型开放经济随机宏观模型中，评估了货币政策指标机制的不同设计方案。首先，本文推导了在理性预期模型中考虑卢卡斯批判后，如何得出最优控制规则和最优简单反馈规则的方法。随后，以最小化价格与产出波动的线性组合为目标，考察了将货币供应量、汇率、名义收入及价格水平作为货币政策替代指标的情形。研究发现，价格水平指标机制在面对不同类型的冲击和参数变化时具有稳健性。此外，该机制通常优于其他机制，且相较于完全最优规则，其损失仅略有增加。
url:bbfabadb3e6dd291.title: DP4 An Evaluation of Alternative Indicator Regimes for Monetary Policy

url:bc26a0beb5fd1cb9.abstract: In this paper we focus on the analysis of ranking methods based on a lexicographic comparison of individual evaluations. Notable examples of ranking methods in this family are the majority judgement , the lexicographic excellence and its dual version. Making a bridge with the theory of lexicographic preferences on elements with multiple factors, we provide an axiomatic characterization of the family of lexicographic methods using three well-studied properties in social choice: Anonymity , Neutrality and Independence of Irrelevant Alternatives . These assumptions allow restricting the study to the set of individual evaluations rearranged in a non increasing way. Two further assumptions of Ordinal Invariance and Dominance (restricted to this domain) allow for the requested characterization. Some operational indications on how to establish the order used by the lexicographic procedure is also discussed.
url:bc26a0beb5fd1cb9.abstract_zh: 本文聚焦于基于个体评价词典序比较的排序方法分析。该排序方法家族中的典型代表包括多数判断法、词典序卓越法及其对偶版本。通过建立与多因素要素词典序偏好理论的关联，我们运用社会选择理论中三个经过充分研究的性质——匿名性、中立性与无关选项独立性——对词典序方法家族进行了公理化刻画。这些假设将研究范围限定在按非递增方式重新排列的个体评价集合。在此基础上，两个附加假设（序数不变性与支配性，且限定于该领域）实现了所需的公理化表征。此外，本文还探讨了如何建立词典序程序所用排序顺序的操作性建议。
url:bc26a0beb5fd1cb9.title: Lexicographic social ranking

url:bce681b008e1a398.abstract: Fiscal dominance refers to situations in which fiscal policy imposes restrictions on monetary policy. Large shifts in the dynamics of sovereign debts, surpluses, and central bank's balance sheets since the Great Financial Crisis have created the perception of a heightened risk of such fiscal dominance in major jurisdictions. This paper reviews the theoretical and empirical literature on fiscal dominance. We offer a simple theory in which fiscal dominance arises as the outcome of strategic interactions between the government, the central bank and the bond markets.
url:bce681b008e1a398.abstract_zh: 财政主导是指财政政策对货币政策施加约束的情形。自全球金融危机以来，主权债务、财政盈余及央行资产负债表的动态变化显著，导致主要经济体面临财政主导风险上升的认知。本文系统梳理了关于财政主导的理论与实证文献，并提出一个简约理论框架：财政主导是政府、央行与债券市场三方战略互动的结果。
