url:f48e58888a1e51e0.abstract: Sovereigns self-insure via reserve accumulation, prioritizing liquidity over yield. This practice imposes opportunity costs and can amplify the convenience premium on traditional reserve assets. This paper evaluates Synthetic Reserve Deposits (SRDs), a pooling mechanism designed to improve the return-liquidity trade-off. Participants would hold floating-value claims on a vehicle comprising a settlement buffer, an investment portfolio, and, in some designs, an optional collateralized liquidity window. The architecture separates the allocation of portfolio risk from the provision of short-term foreign-currency liquidity: market risk remains with SRD holders, while liquidity is provided through redemption at contemporaneous executable value or through secured advances. Simulations illustrate that the structure can shift the return-liquidity frontier outward under explicit downside-risk constraints. General equilibrium modeling suggests that, if implemented at sufficient scale and under appropriate conditions, reallocating reserve demand through this mechanism could increase the effective supply of reserve claims and affect the global financial cycle, creating aggregate welfare gains and possibly Pareto improvements depending on initial global asset positions.
url:f48e58888a1e51e0.abstract_zh: 主权国家通过积累外汇储备进行自我保险，优先考虑流动性而非收益。这种做法会产生机会成本，并可能放大传统储备资产的便利溢价。本文评估了合成储备存款（SRDs）这一旨在改善收益-流动性权衡的集合机制。参与者将持有对某一工具的可变价值债权，该工具包含结算缓冲池、投资组合，以及在某些设计中增设的可选抵押流动性窗口。该架构将组合风险配置与短期外币流动性供给相分离：市场风险由SRD持有者承担，流动性则通过按当前可执行价值赎回或通过担保垫款提供。模拟分析表明，在明确的下行风险约束下，该结构可将收益-流动性边界向外推移。一般均衡模型显示，若在适当条件下以足够规模实施，通过该机制重新配置储备需求可增加储备债权的有效供给，影响全球金融周期，产生总体福利收益，并可能根据初始全球资产头寸实现帕累托改进。

url:f4b497ce2aff5822.abstract: Using survey data from U.S. firms, we study the primitive beliefs for pricesetting: firms’ forecasts of their own marginal costs. These forecasts are disconnected from CPI expectations, (over)react to current and past costs systematically, and underreact to aggregate shocks until costs move. We show that under empirically realistic cost beliefs the New Keynesian Phillips curve is steeper and less forward-looking. Supply shocks are more inflationary because they hit costs quickly. Demand shocks are less inflationary because firms fail to anticipate future wage pressure. Forward guidance weakens at long horizons but strengthens in the near term.
url:f4b497ce2aff5822.abstract_zh: 利用美国企业的调查数据，我们研究了价格设定中的原始信念：企业对其自身边际成本的预测。这些预测与CPI预期脱节，系统性地对当前及过去的成本作出（过度）反应，并且对总体冲击反应不足，直至成本变动发生。我们表明，在经验上现实可行的成本信念下，新凯恩斯菲利普斯曲线更为陡峭且前瞻性较弱。供给冲击更具通胀效应，因为它们迅速影响成本。需求冲击的通胀效应较弱，因为企业未能预见到未来的工资压力。前瞻指引在长期内效果减弱，但在短期内则增强。

url:f578060ee3f7a916.abstract: Between 2025 and 2035, the largest-ever cohort of young people in emerging market and developing economies will reach working age. Slowing growth, overlapping crises, tight fiscal conditions, and weak job-creation capacity in many countries make creating enough good jobs for this generation one of the defining development challenges of the next decade. This column argues that, with determined policy action, this demographic wave can become a powerful engine of growth, poverty reduction, and development progress.
url:f578060ee3f7a916.abstract_zh: 2025年至2035年间，新兴市场和发展中经济体将迎来史上规模最大的青年群体进入劳动年龄。然而，多国面临增长放缓、危机叠加、财政紧缩及就业创造能力疲软等困境，如何为这一代人创造充足的优质就业岗位，将成为未来十年最具标志性的发展挑战。本文认为，若采取果断的政策行动，这一人口浪潮有望转化为推动经济增长、减贫与发展进程的强大引擎。

url:f585f70cf36bf1a1.abstract: Over the past century, the United States has provided dollar liquidity abroad through both the US Treasury and the Federal Reserve, but the appropriate mode of liquidity injection depends on the economic, financial, and geopolitical contexts. The Treasury is the more appropriate lending conduit when geopolitical concerns dominate, while Fed dollar provision should primarily be targeted toward global stability objectives and be more insulated from short-term foreign policy motives. Up to now, political abuses of these foreign lending channels have been constrained to some degree by laws, norms, and intergovernmental understandings, but adherence can no longer be assumed, so more formal guardrails are needed.
url:f585f70cf36bf1a1.abstract_zh: 过去一个世纪以来，美国通过财政部和美联储向海外提供美元流动性，但适当的流动性注入模式取决于经济、金融和地缘政治背景。当地缘政治关切占主导地位时，财政部是更合适的贷款渠道，而美联储的美元供给应主要针对全球稳定目标，并更少受短期外交政策动机的影响。迄今为止，法律、规范和政府间谅解在一定程度上约束了这些对外贷款渠道的政治滥用，但已无法假定各方会继续遵守，因此需要更正式的防护措施。

url:f59bb14fe5cd0416.abstract: On 28 January 2025 the second Trump administration issued a blanket stop-work order on the United States Agency for International Development (USAID), terminating the largest national bilateral aid programme worldwide. We use this natural experiment to estimate the impact of the aid cut on two outcomes in Africa: local economic activity, measured through nighttime light radiance around USAID project sites; and acute food insecurity, measured through the Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) at the subnational level. First, the cessation of USAID activities produced a sharp and significant decline in nighttime light radiance within 500 m to 10 km of project sites, attenuating monotonically and undetectable at 25 km. Second, areas more exposed to USAID humanitarian assistance saw relative increases in population in IPC Phase 3 (Crisis) or worse and Phase 4 (Emergency), with effects building over the first post-shock year, amplified in higher-vulnerability regions and approximately fourteen times larger in less democratic countries. Third, both effects are driven by humanitarian-aid cuts; the nightlight effect is also driven by productive-sector cuts.
url:f59bb14fe5cd0416.abstract_zh: 2025年1月28日，第二届特朗普政府发布全面停工令，叫停美国国际开发署（USAID）业务，终止了全球规模最大的双边援助项目。我们利用这一自然实验，评估援助削减对非洲两项结果的影响：一是以USAID项目点周边夜间灯光亮度衡量的地方经济活动；二是以次国家级综合粮食安全阶段分类（IPC）衡量的严重粮食不安全状况。首先，USAID活动停止导致项目点周边500米至10公里范围内夜间灯光亮度急剧且显著下降，该效应随距离单调衰减，至25公里处已无法检测。其次，更依赖USAID人道主义援助的地区，其IPC第3阶段（危机）及以上、第4阶段（紧急）人口占比相对上升，该效应在冲击后第一年内持续累积，在高脆弱性地区被放大，且在民主程度较低的国家中约扩大十四倍。第三，上述两种效应均由人道主义援助削减驱动；夜间灯光效应还受到生产部门援助削减的影响。

url:f5ad55fc8f5ede63.abstract: we develop a simple theoretical framework showing how parent–child gaps can arise from information frictions and differences in reporting styles. We complement the model with a novel survey design that elicits both parental beliefs about children’s latent socio-emotional wellbeing and parental beliefs about children’s self-reports, allowing us to disentangle the different sources of the discrepancy. Using a new survey from Luxembourg, we estimate that approximately 70% of the observed gap is attributable to information frictions. Consistent with a Bayesian model of signal extraction, belief accuracy declines when children experience high levels of distress. The precision of second-order beliefs is negatively correlated with parental education, income, and employment, and—paradoxically—with more accurate priors about aggregate parental under-reporting, a pattern we refer to as the Capacity Paradox. As predicted by the model, a randomized information intervention shifts both first- and second-order beliefs only among parents with weak priors and generates heterogeneous effects on intended parental investments. These findings highlight the central role of second-order beliefs in understanding parental misperceptions and the potential for targeted information policies to improve parental awareness of children’s socio-emotional wellbeing.
url:f5ad55fc8f5ede63.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个简洁的理论框架，揭示了信息摩擦与报告风格差异如何导致亲子认知差距。为补充该模型，我们设计了一项新颖的问卷调查，同时获取父母对子女潜在社会情感福祉的信念，以及父母对子女自我报告的信念，从而能够区分认知偏差的不同来源。基于卢森堡的一项新调查数据，我们估计约70%的观测差距可归因于信息摩擦。与贝叶斯信号提取模型一致，当儿童经历高度痛苦时，父母信念的准确性会下降。二阶信念的精确度与父母教育水平、收入及就业状况呈负相关，且与父母对总体低报现象的准确先验信念呈负相关——这种矛盾模式被称为“能力悖论”。正如模型所预测，一项随机信息干预仅对先验信念较弱的父母群体产生一阶与二阶信念的同步偏移，并对预期养育投入产生异质性影响。这些发现凸显了二阶信念在理解父母认知偏差中的核心作用，以及定向信息政策在提升父母对子女社会情感福祉认知方面的潜在价值。

url:f5be212f48d7ba4e.abstract: This paper investigates the relationship between AI adoption and carbon emission intensity. Using micro-level data from Chinese firms, we find that carbon intensity decreases following the adoption of AI. The effect is particularly pronounced among large firms, those headquartered in AI hubs, and those in high-carbon intensity sectors. We investigate several mechanisms and find that AI adoption is also associated with increases in energy management processes, green innovation, inventory efficiency, overall productivity, and the share of specialized labor. We find that AI-induced carbon reductions are subject to a large rebound effect of approximately 70%.
url:f5be212f48d7ba4e.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了人工智能应用与碳排放强度之间的关系。基于中国企业层面的微观数据，我们发现企业在采用人工智能后，其碳排放强度有所下降。这一效应在大型企业、总部位于人工智能枢纽的企业以及高碳排放强度行业的企业中尤为显著。我们研究了若干机制，发现人工智能应用还与能源管理流程、绿色创新、库存效率、整体生产率以及专业劳动力占比的提升相关。此外，我们发现人工智能带来的碳减排效应存在约70%的大幅反弹效应。
url:f5be212f48d7ba4e.title: AI Adoption, Carbon Intensity, and Rebound Effect: Evidence from China

url:f5c0e8c4350042d4.abstract: Global non-US banks have significant dollar exposure both on and off their balance sheet. We develop a model to analyze their adjustment to dollar funding shocks, whether from reduced direct lending or external dollar shortages. The model provides insight into banks' responses through borrowing, lending, and FX swap positions, as well as the impact on their net worth, their probability of default and CIP deviations. Implications of the model are confronted with data on the response of non-US global banks to major dollar funding shocks. We examine the benefits from buffering these shocks through central bank dollar swap lines or local currency lending by the central bank.
url:f5c0e8c4350042d4.abstract_zh: 全球非美国银行在表内和表外均持有大量美元敞口。我们构建了一个模型，分析这些银行如何应对美元融资冲击——无论是来自直接贷款减少还是外部美元短缺。该模型揭示了银行通过借款、贷款及外汇掉期头寸的调整机制，以及这些调整对其净资产、违约概率和抛补利率平价（CIP）偏离的影响。我们将模型推论与全球非美国银行应对重大美元融资冲击的实际数据进行了对比验证。此外，我们评估了通过央行美元互换额度或央行本币贷款缓冲此类冲击的潜在收益。

url:f5ebf61c056a7642.abstract: While extensive empirical research documents discrimination in labour and housing markets, comparative insights between these markets remain limited. We address this gap by juxtaposing levels of discrimination across five legally protected grounds - race and ethnicity, sex and gender, health and disability, sexual orientation, and social origin - in both markets. We apply hierarchical Bayesian meta-regressions to global data from correspondence audit studies conducted from 2000 to 2024. In doing so, we account for the metadata's multilevel structure, including study, group, location and time components. Our meta-analysis uncovers structural differences in discrimination, with racial and ethnic discrimination being greatest in the labour market and discrimination based on social origin being highest in the housing market. Frequentist robustness checks that address publication bias yield comparable findings.
url:f5ebf61c056a7642.abstract_zh: 尽管大量实证研究记录了劳动力和住房市场中的歧视现象，但这两个市场之间的比较性见解仍然有限。我们通过对比五个受法律保护领域——种族与民族、性别与性别认同、健康与残疾、性取向以及社会出身——在两个市场中的歧视程度来填补这一空白。我们采用分层贝叶斯元回归方法，对2000年至2024年间全球通信审计研究的数据进行分析。在此过程中，我们考虑了元数据的多层次结构，包括研究、群体、地点和时间等组成部分。我们的元分析揭示了歧视的结构性差异：种族与民族歧视在劳动力市场中最为严重，而基于社会出身的歧视则在住房市场中最为突出。针对发表偏倚的频率学稳健性检验也得出了类似的结果。

url:f618f5b4f4c172c5.abstract: We study how fluctuations in investor attention affect stock return synchronicity. For a sample of 734 stocks from 19 countries, we document that synchronicity increases when international soccer matches distract investors, suggesting that investors pay less attention to firm-specific news. Next, we show that synchronicity increases even more as matches become more important and when the national team is (closely) trailing rather than when it is leading during a match. These results are in line with Kahneman’s (1973) capacity model of attention, with loss aversion and with a role for suspense and underscore how fluctuations in investor attention affect price formation.
url:f618f5b4f4c172c5.abstract_zh: 我们研究了投资者注意力波动如何影响股票收益同步性。基于19个国家734只股票的样本，我们发现当国际足球比赛分散投资者注意力时，股票收益同步性会上升，这表明投资者对公司特定新闻的关注度降低。进一步研究表明，随着比赛重要性增加，以及当国家队在比赛中处于（微弱）落后而非领先状态时，同步性上升幅度更大。这些结果与卡尼曼（1973）的注意力容量模型、损失厌恶理论以及悬念的作用机制相吻合，并凸显了投资者注意力波动如何影响价格形成过程。

url:f62c757c0ccb5217.abstract: The Credit Surface along the leverage dimension gives the bond spread as a function of the loan-to-value ratio. Empirically, we show that uncertainty shocks typically increase spreads and steepen the credit surface, profoundly affecting the supply of credit. Theoretically, we derive necessary and sufficient conditions for the convexity of the credit surface, and for changes in the anticipated distribution of collateral prices that lead to steepening of the credit surface. Finally, we show that the credit surface itself fully reveals the entire distribution of collateral prices, thus providing a new and vivid language with which to describe uncertainty and stochastic orders. Credit surface steepening itself is a new stochastic order that may better capture our intuitive notion of more uncertainty.
url:f62c757c0ccb5217.abstract_zh: 沿杠杆维度的信用曲面将债券利差表示为贷款价值比的函数。实证上，我们表明不确定性冲击通常会提高利差并使信用曲面变得更加陡峭，深刻影响信贷供给。理论上，我们推导出信用曲面凸性的充分必要条件，以及预期抵押品价格分布变化导致信用曲面陡峭化的条件。最后，我们证明信用曲面本身完全揭示了抵押品价格的整个分布，从而为描述不确定性和随机序提供了一种新颖而生动的语言。信用曲面陡峭化本身是一种新的随机序，可能更好地捕捉我们对更多不确定性的直觉概念。
url:f62c757c0ccb5217.title: Credit Surfaces and Economic Uncertainty

url:f6a6c2e0902b90b0.abstract: We study a platform that interacts with a major content provider, a long tail of independent providers, and consumers who allocate attention across competing content. By designing independent-provider compensation, the platform endogenously shapes its outside option and disciplines the major. This strategic use of long-tail compensation distorts entry relative to the first best. Allowing the platform to steer consumer attention improves entry incentives conditional on compensation, but affects bargaining incentives, and may thus increase or decrease welfare. We then consider regulation, showing that conservative minimum-compensation floors robustly improve welfare, while non-discrimination policies have ambiguous welfare effects.
url:f6a6c2e0902b90b0.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个平台，该平台与一个主要内容提供商、众多独立提供商（长尾）以及在不同竞争内容间分配注意力的消费者进行互动。通过设计对独立提供商的补偿机制，平台内生地塑造了其外部选择，并对主要提供商形成约束。这种对长尾补偿的策略性运用，相对于最优状态扭曲了市场进入。允许平台引导消费者注意力，在给定补偿条件下改善了进入激励，但会影响议价激励，从而可能增加或减少社会福利。随后我们考虑监管问题，发现保守的最低补偿下限能稳健地提升社会福利，而非歧视性政策则具有模糊的福利效应。

url:f6b0fc1c2b817b17.abstract: How do international investors adjust portfolios in response to biodiversity risk? Using monthly data on investment fund portfolios, we show that the 2021 Kunming Declaration led fund managers to reallocate portfolios from high-biodiversity risk countries to less risky ones, while ultimate fund investors remained unresponsive. Fund managers reduced exposures to extremely high biodiversity risk without seizing low biodiversity risk as an opportunity for profit, characterizing biodiversity as downside risk factor. Investment funds drive cross-country spillovers as the reallocation triggers significant capital flows beneï¬ ting countries in the same geographic region, but outside of a fund
url:f6b0fc1c2b817b17.abstract_zh: 国际投资者如何根据生物多样性风险调整投资组合？利用投资基金的月度组合数据，我们发现2021年《昆明宣言》促使基金经理将投资组合从高生物多样性风险国家重新配置至风险较低的国家，而最终基金投资者对此并无反应。基金经理在未将低生物多样性风险视为盈利机会的情况下，减少了对极高生物多样性风险的敞口，从而将生物多样性界定为下行风险因素。投资基金通过这种重新配置引发显著的资本流动，使同一地理区域内但非基金所在国受益，从而驱动了跨国溢出效应。

url:f6c4c3e1f42ff2ec.abstract: The 2025 US university endowment tax hike, together with other financial pressures, is pushing the wealthiest universities to shrink their doctoral cohorts. This column exploits a novel sample of MIT Economics PhD applicants to shed light on the research value-added of elite doctoral programmes and the possible consequences of programme cutbacks. Holding applicant ability fixed, graduates of high-tax and other elite schools produce 60-75% more impact-weighted publications than comparable applicants. Neither peer effects nor home-journal favouritism explains this advantage. If elite PhD programmes add similar value in other disciplines, the endowment tax may well slow the pace of scientific progress.
url:f6c4c3e1f42ff2ec.abstract_zh: 2025年美国大学捐赠税上调，叠加其他财务压力，正迫使最富有的大学缩减博士生招生规模。本文利用麻省理工学院经济学博士申请者的新颖样本，揭示了精英博士项目的研究附加值以及项目缩减可能带来的后果。在控制申请者能力不变的情况下，高税负及其他精英学校的毕业生所产出的影响力加权论文数量，比同类申请者高出60%至75%。这种优势既不能用同伴效应解释，也不能用本校期刊偏好解释。如果精英博士项目在其他学科也能带来类似的附加值，那么捐赠税很可能会减缓科学进步的步伐。
url:f6c4c3e1f42ff2ec.title: Research value-added in elite economics PhD programmes
url:f6c4c3e1f42ff2ec.title_zh: 精英经济学博士项目的研究附加值

url:f6c6beb80ff2d273.abstract: Firms and policy makers are increasingly looking at friend-shoring to make supply chains less vulnerable to geopolitical tensions. We test whether these considerations are shaping FDI flows, using investment-level data on almost 300,000 instances of greenfield FDI between 2003 and 2022. Estimates from a gravity model, which controls for standard push and pull factors, show an economically significant role for geopolitical alignment in driving the geographical footprint of bilateral investments. This result is robust to the inclusion of standard bilateral drivers of FDI—such as geographic distance and trade flows—and the strength of the effect has increased since 2018, with the resurgence of trade tensions between the U.S. and China. Moreover, our results are not limited to greenfield FDI, but hold also for M&As.
url:f6c6beb80ff2d273.abstract_zh: 企业和政策制定者日益关注"友岸外包"，以降低供应链受地缘政治紧张局势影响的风险。我们利用2003年至2022年间近30万例绿地外商直接投资的项目层面数据，检验这些考量是否正在影响外商直接投资的流动。基于引力模型的估计（该模型控制了标准的推拉因素）表明，地缘政治一致性在驱动双边投资的地理布局中发挥着具有经济显著性的作用。这一结果在纳入标准双边外商直接投资驱动因素（如地理距离和贸易流动）后依然稳健，且自2018年美中贸易紧张局势再度升级以来，该效应的强度有所增强。此外，我们的结论不仅适用于绿地外商直接投资，对并购活动同样成立。

Instrumenting adoption with distance to traditional financial services, we find pronounced heterogeneity: mobile money increases women
url:f6dd35de7ac77d72.abstract_zh: 本文利用Afrobarometer第9轮数据（2021-2023年，N=6,540），考察移动货币是否缩小了萨赫勒六国在金融自主权方面的性别差距。以距离传统金融服务的距离作为移动货币采纳的工具变量，我们发现显著的异质性：移动货币提升了女性

url:f6ef7bcf336135d2.abstract: This paper investigates the impact of free primary education (FPE) on parents' fertility decisions in sub-Saharan Africa and how these effects depend on prevailing gender norms. Leveraging the staggered rollout of FPE across 17 countries and a within-ethnicity design, we find that the reform reduced completed fertility by 0.25 births per woman. Reduced fertility coincides with both improved child survival and school enrollment. Linking these data with ethnic-level cultural norms of male dominance, we show that these effects arise exclusively among groups with low male dominance. Consistent with fertility reductions increasing women's autonomy, FPE also strengthens women's outside options and intra-household bargaining power. In low male-dominance settings, this is reflected in higher divorce probabilities, lower acceptance of intimate partner violence, greater participation in household decisions, and increased media engagement - changes absent in high male-dominance cultures. A simple model embedding the quantity - quality tradeoff within a limited-commitment household bargaining framework, where gender norms determine women's veto power over fertility, rationalizes these findings. Overall, the results underscore the central role of gender norms in shaping the effects of policy interventions on fertility and broader development outcomes.
url:f6ef7bcf336135d2.abstract_zh: 本文研究了撒哈拉以南非洲地区免费初等教育（FPE）对父母生育决策的影响，以及这些效应如何受主流性别规范的调节。利用17个国家分阶段推行FPE的政策差异及族群内部设计，我们发现该改革使每位女性的完成生育数减少0.25个。生育率下降与儿童存活率提升及入学率提高同步发生。通过将数据与反映男性主导地位的族群文化规范相关联，我们发现这些效应仅出现在男性主导程度较低的群体中。与生育率下降增强女性自主权相一致，FPE还提升了女性的外部选择权和家庭内部议价能力。在低男性主导环境中，这体现为离婚概率上升、对亲密伴侣暴力的接受度降低、家庭决策参与度提高以及媒体接触增加——而在高男性主导文化中则未观察到这些变化。一个嵌入数量-质量权衡且受有限承诺家庭议价框架约束的简单模型（其中性别规范决定女性对生育的否决权）可合理解释上述发现。总体而言，研究结果凸显了性别规范在塑造政策干预对生育及更广泛发展成果影响中的核心作用。
url:f6ef7bcf336135d2.title: Gender Norms and the Quantity-Quality Tradeoff: Evidence from Free Primary Education in Africa
url:f6ef7bcf336135d2.title_zh: 性别规范与数量-质量权衡：来自非洲免费初等教育的证据

url:f77b1f8a13af29f2.abstract: This paper examines the employment effects of multinational enterprises (MNEs) in Mexico, focusing on the labor market impacts of foreign tariff increases during 2018-2019. Using data from Mexicos National Survey of Occupations and Employment (ENOE) for 2014-2023 combined with sector-level tariff exposure measures based on Fajgelbaum et al. (2024), we construct a quarterly city-sector panel distinguishing employment in MNEs and domestic firms. We analyze employment outcomes across worker characteristics (education, age, gender) and firm attributes (size and location). Results indicate a positive employment effect in MNEs within the sectors most affected by the tariff increases, particularly for highly educated workers and small establishments. In contrast, there is no clear evidence of significant effects on wages.
url:f77b1f8a13af29f2.abstract_zh: 本文考察了墨西哥跨国企业的就业效应，重点关注2018-2019年外国关税上调对劳动力市场的影响。基于2014-2023年墨西哥国家职业与就业调查（ENOE）数据，结合Fajgelbaum等人（2024）提出的行业层面关税暴露指标，我们构建了区分跨国企业与本土企业就业的季度城市-行业面板数据。通过分析不同劳动者特征（教育程度、年龄、性别）及企业属性（规模与区位）的就业结果，研究发现：在受关税上调影响最严重的行业中，跨国企业呈现正向就业效应，尤其体现在高学历劳动者和小规模企业中。相比之下，工资水平未出现显著变化的明确证据。

url:f7c7b3e6bbaa2e48.abstract: We investigate the role of industrial relations for working from home during and after the COVID- 19 pandemic in Germany. Using data from the German Socio-Economic Panel (SOEP) for the years 2020 to 2023 and a special COVID sample (SOEP-CoV) for 2020 and 2021, we examine how collec- tive bargaining and plant-level co-determination are associated with the incidence and frequency of working from home. Controlling for worker, firm, occupation, and industry characteristics, we find that employees covered by a collective bargaining agreement are less likely to work from home and do so less frequently than uncovered employees. In contrast, the incidence and frequency of working from home are positively associated with the presence of a works council.
url:f7c7b3e6bbaa2e48.abstract_zh: 本文探究了新冠疫情期间及之后德国劳资关系对居家办公的影响。基于2020至2023年德国社会经济面板数据（SOEP）及2020至2021年新冠专项样本（SOEP-CoV），我们分析了集体谈判与工厂层面共同决策机制如何影响居家办公的发生率与频率。在控制劳动者、企业、职业及行业特征后，研究发现：受集体谈判协议覆盖的员工居家办公可能性更低且频率更少；相反，企业职工委员会的存在与居家办公的发生率及频率呈正相关。

url:f843e28f2bf83fc0.abstract: When do labor-market shocks become lasting health inequality? We develop and estimate a continuous-time lifecycle model of wealth, health, and skill in which medical care combines smooth maintenance with threshold-crossing repair. Adverse wage shocks push financially fragile households toward subsistence, increase toxic labor effort, delay repair, and convert temporary earnings losses into persistent biological damage. Estimated with PSID, MEPS, and RAND HRS data, the model shows that skill-biased technical change generates concentrated lower-tail losses in health, survival, and welfare. A meaningful share of this damage reflects endogenous repair failure, and the mechanism remains visible in a parsimonious general-equilibrium environment.
url:f843e28f2bf83fc0.abstract_zh: 劳动力市场冲击何时会演变为持续的健康不平等？我们构建并估计了一个涵盖财富、健康与技能的连续时间生命周期模型，其中医疗护理结合了平滑维护与阈值跨越修复两种模式。不利的工资冲击使财务脆弱的家庭陷入生存困境，增加有害的劳动投入，延迟修复行为，并将暂时的收入损失转化为持久的生理损伤。基于PSID、MEPS和RAND HRS数据的估计结果显示，技能偏向型技术进步在健康、生存和福利方面产生了集中的低端损失。这种损伤中有相当一部分源于内生的修复失败，且该机制在简约的一般均衡环境中依然清晰可辨。

url:f863f507d77b7243.abstract: In fragile, conflict-affected, and violent contexts, decentralization is widely promoted to improve service delivery and strengthen the social contract by shifting power closer to citizens. However, empirical evidence on whether these reforms deliver in environments marked by weak state capacity and low institutional trust remains limited. This paper evaluates Mali’s Project for the Deployment of State Resources for the Improvement of Services program, which implemented performance-based conditional grants across 102 communes between 2021 and 2024. Drawing on administrative budget data and georeferenced Afrobarometer survey data, the study assesses the impacts of performance-based conditional grants on local fiscal performance, service delivery, and institutional legitimacy. The results show that a 1 percent increase in performance-based conditional grant allocations is associated with a 1.2 percent increase in investment expenditures and measurable improvements in budget balances. Expenditures were reallocated toward social sectors (education, health, water, and agriculture), consistent with program objectives. A difference-in-differences analysis points to statistically significant increases in citizen satisfaction with public services, particularly health (+2.6 percentage points), water and sanitation (+1.4), and education (+1.0), as well as an 18.4-point rise in trust in municipal counc ils. Institutional “spillover” effects extended to the national level, with trust in the presidency and parliament increasing by 9.1 and 7.3 points, respectively. A scenario-based cost-effectiveness analysis points to potentially substantial returns under the stated assumptions. Illustrative estimates suggest that observed trust gains could be associated with USD 57 million to USD 141 million in additional annual tax revenues, equivalent to 1.1 to 2.8 times the program’s total cost, through enhanced voluntary compliance—assuming a transmission of trust into compliance broadly consistent with parameters in the literature. These findings are consistent with the view that well-designed performance-based transfers may improve service outcomes and contribute to rebuilding public trust in fragile, conflict-affected, and violent contexts, with effects that appear to extend beyond the local level. Policy implications include considering institutionalization of the performance-based conditional grants within Mali’s fiscal architecture and the design of a medium-term roadmap for sustainability and possible scale-up.
url:f863f507d77b7243.abstract_zh: 在脆弱、受冲突影响和暴力环境中，权力下放被广泛推广，旨在通过将权力下放至公民层面来改善公共服务并强化社会契约。然而，关于此类改革在政府能力薄弱、制度信任度低的环境中是否有效的实证证据仍然有限。本文评估了马里2021至2024年间在102个市镇实施的"国家资源部署以改善服务项目"中的绩效导向有条件拨款计划。基于行政预算数据和地理参照的非洲晴雨表调查数据，本研究评估了绩效导向有条件拨款对地方财政绩效、公共服务供给及制度合法性的影响。结果显示：绩效导向有条件拨款每增加1%，投资支出相应增长1.2%，预算平衡状况出现可量化改善。支出向教育、卫生、水利和农业等社会领域重新配置，这与项目目标一致。双重差分分析表明，公民对公共服务的满意度出现统计显著提升，其中卫生服务满意度提高2.6个百分点、供水和卫生设施满意度提高1.4个百分点、教育满意度提高1.0个百分点，同时市镇议会信任度上升18.4个百分点。制度"溢出效应"延伸至国家层面，总统和议会信任度分别提升9.1和7.3个百分点。基于情景的成本效益分析显示，在既定假设条件下可能产生显著回报。估算表明，假设信任向税收遵从的传导效应与文献参数基本一致，观察到的信任提升可能通过增强自愿纳税遵从带来每年5700万至1.41亿美元的额外税收收入，相当于项目总成本的1.1至2.8倍。这些发现与以下观点一致：设计良好的绩效导向转移支付能够改善服务成效，并有助于在脆弱、受冲突影响和暴力环境中重建公众信任，其影响似乎超越地方层面。政策启示包括：考虑将绩效导向有条件拨款制度化纳入马里财政架构，并制定中期路线图以实现可持续发展和可能的规模扩展。
url:f863f507d77b7243.title: Decentralization, Service Delivery, and Legitimacy: The Case of Mali

url:f8665e09e1953427.abstract: Crises such as rapid population and demand growth, droughts, resource availability fluctuations, and supply-chain disruptions increasingly expose hidden fragilities in socio-technical systems. At the same time, they generate political momentum and practical urgency for institutional and governance innovation, as emergency measures often become prototypes for routine practice. This paper develops a national-scale, multi-sector water-energy-emissions (W-E-E) scenario model for Rwanda and uses it to test how demand growth, hydrological stress, and supply-side choices jointly shape future energy security and emissions trajectories through 2050. The analysis shows that, under SSP2 and especially SSP5 growth conditions, emissions remain strongly demand-driven; therefore, even ambitious demand-side and supply-side measures are best interpreted as pathways that moderate, rather than fully reverse, emissions growth. The contribution of the study is to identify which combinations of efficiency, electrification, renewable deployment, thermal retirement, and hydrological risk management most effectively reduce system stress and improve resilience under compound crises.
url:f8665e09e1953427.abstract_zh: 人口快速增长、需求激增、干旱、资源供应波动以及供应链中断等危机，日益暴露社会技术系统中隐藏的脆弱性。与此同时，这些危机催生了制度与治理创新的政治动力和现实紧迫性，因为应急措施往往成为常规实践的雏形。本文为卢旺达构建了一个国家尺度的多部门水-能源-排放（W-E-E）情景模型，并利用该模型检验需求增长、水文压力以及供给侧选择如何共同影响2050年前的能源安全与排放轨迹。分析表明，在SSP2尤其是SSP5增长条件下，排放仍主要由需求驱动；因此，即使是最为雄心勃勃的需求侧与供给侧措施，也最好被理解为减缓而非完全逆转排放增长的路径。本研究的贡献在于识别出哪些效率提升、电气化、可再生能源部署、火电退役以及水文风险管理组合，能在复合危机下最有效地降低系统压力并提升韧性。

url:f8824af545782535.abstract: We study the impact of large, successful manufacturing plants on other local producers in China, focusing on “Million-Rouble Plants” built in the 1950s during a brief alliance with the U.S.S.R. The ephemeral geopolitical situation and the locations of allied and enemy airbases provide exogenous variation in plant siting. We find a boom-and-bust pattern: Counties hosting these plants were 80% more productive than control counties in 1982 but 20% less productive by 2010. This decline reflects the performance of local establishments, which exhibit low productivity, limited innovation, and high markup. Specialization hindered spillovers, preventing the emergence of new clusters and local entrepreneurship.
url:f8824af545782535.abstract_zh: 本文研究了中国大型成功制造工厂对其他本地生产者的影响，重点关注20世纪50年代中苏短暂结盟期间建设的“百万卢布工厂”。短暂的地缘政治局势以及盟军与敌军空军基地的位置为工厂选址提供了外生变异。我们发现了一种“繁荣-萧条”模式：1982年，拥有这些工厂的县的生产率比对照组县高出80%，但到2010年却低了20%。这一下降反映了本地企业的表现，这些企业呈现出低生产率、有限创新和高加价的特点。专业化阻碍了溢出效应，阻止了新集群的形成和本地创业精神的发展。

url:f8e7a6a39c60ce72.abstract: We study the long-run effects of a large public expansion of pre-primary education in Argentina. Between 1993 and 1999, the federal government financed the construction of new preschool classrooms targeted to departments with low baseline enrollment and high poverty, creating roughly 186,000 additional places. We link administrative records on classroom construction to four population censuses and estimate difference-in-differences models that compare treated and untreated cohorts across high- and low-construction departments. An additional preschool seat per child increases post-kindergarten schooling by about 0.5 years, raising the probability of completing secondary school by 11.9 percentage points and of attaining any post-secondary education by 7.1 percentage points. For women, access to the program also reduces fertility: an additional seat lowers the number of live births per woman by 0.20. Across several checks using cohort sizes, household composition, province-of-birth restrictions, and direct migration measures, we find little evidence consistent with systematic selective migration, suggesting that migration is unlikely to be a major source of bias in our estimates. Our results show little impact on labor-market outcomes at the census date, consistent with beneficiaries still being in school or in the early stages of their careers. A benefit-cost analysis based on the estimated schooling gains, standard Mincer returns, and observed construction and operating costs yields a benefit-cost ratio of about 11 and an internal rate of return of 13\%. Our findings show that universal at-scale pre-primary expansions in middle-income countries can generate sizable improvements in human capital and demographic outcomes at relatively low fiscal cost.
url:f8e7a6a39c60ce72.abstract_zh: 本文研究了阿根廷大规模公立学前教育扩张的长期效应。1993年至1999年间，联邦政府资助新建了针对基线入学率低且贫困程度高的地区的学前教育教室，新增约18.6万个学位。我们将教室建设的行政记录与四次人口普查数据相关联，采用双重差分模型比较高建设密度与低建设密度地区中受政策影响与未受影响的群体。每增加一个儿童学前教育学位，可使幼儿园后的受教育年限提高约0.5年，高中毕业概率提升11.9个百分点，接受高等教育的概率提升7.1个百分点。对女性而言，该政策还降低了生育率：每增加一个学位可使每位女性的活产数减少0.20。通过使用队列规模、家庭构成、出生省份限制及直接迁移指标等多项检验，我们未发现系统性选择性迁移的显著证据，表明迁移不太可能成为估计偏差的主要来源。结果显示，该政策在普查时点对劳动力市场影响甚微，这与受益者仍处于在校或职业生涯早期阶段的情况相符。基于估算的教育收益、标准明瑟回报率以及实际建设与运营成本进行的成本收益分析表明，收益成本比约为11，内部收益率为13%。本研究表明，中等收入国家大规模普及学前教育能以相对较低的财政成本显著提升人力资本与人口结构指标。

url:f9c0df46dc70f51c.abstract: No, in the mortgage market. Using confidential micro-level data combining mortgage contracts with credit and repayment records for 44 million loans spanning 5,000 bank mergers over nearly three decades, we find no changes to mortgage rates, approval rates, or delinquency rates. Local mortgage markets remain remarkably competitive despite consolidation, averaging over 100 active lenders in each county every post-merger quarter. Our findings reveal significant merger selection motives: large acquiring banks target community banks with relationship-intensive, portfoliolending business models, whereas community banks appear to merge together to gain scale and compete. Overall, our study challenges the view that bank mergers increase market concentration and create market power that harms household borrowers.

url:fabfbe16fd61c836.abstract: In dynamic multisector economies, the planner’s optimal capital allocation can serve to minimize the aggregate impact of shocks cascading through nonlinear production networks. We show analytically in a simplified model that, under complementarity and if risk aversion is not too low, (i) optimal capital allocation under uncertainty involves deliberately over-investing, relative to the deterministic optimum, in upstream sectors in order to mitigate severe economic downturns; (ii) this strategy can reduce the average level of consumption and give rise to a high welfare cost of business cycles. Deploying novel deep-learning techniques in a general environment, we show quantitatively that: (iii) the ergodic distribution of the simulated nonlinear economy features higher mean capital levels in key upstream sectors, lower mean levels of macroeconomic aggregates, realistic aggregate volatility, and a welfare cost of business cycles two orders of magnitude larger than in standard one-sector models.
url:fabfbe16fd61c836.abstract_zh: 在动态多部门经济中，规划者的最优资本配置能够最小化通过非线性生产网络级联放大的冲击对总体经济的影响。我们在简化模型中通过解析推导表明，在要素互补性且风险厌恶程度不太低的情况下：（i）不确定性下的最优资本配置策略会相对于确定性最优状态，有意对上游部门进行过度投资，以缓解严重的经济衰退；（ii）该策略可能降低平均消费水平，并导致商业周期产生高昂的福利成本。通过运用新型深度学习技术于一般化环境，我们定量分析发现：（iii）模拟非线性经济的遍历分布呈现关键上游部门平均资本水平更高、宏观经济总量均值更低、总体波动率符合现实特征，且商业周期福利成本比标准单部门模型高出两个数量级。

url:fad8414d243e36fd.abstract: We study the macroeconomic effects of persistent public investment shocks using a local-projection instrumental-variables framework and European data. For identification we exploit European Investment Bank loans for public infrastructure projects and address potential endogeneity in loan approval with an inverse-probability-weighted regression-adjustment estimator. Public investment shocks raise employment and output in the medium term, without crowding out private investment and consumption, or generating inflation and additional debt burden. The cumulative output multiplier reaches 3.38 after five years and is significant and larger when credit conditions are favorable. We report significant positive spillover effects from spending in public infrastructure in both output and employment.
url:fad8414d243e36fd.abstract_zh: 我们利用局部投影工具变量框架和欧洲数据，研究持续性公共投资冲击的宏观经济效应。为识别因果关系，我们采用欧洲投资银行对公共基础设施项目的贷款数据，并通过逆概率加权回归调整估计量解决贷款审批中的潜在内生性问题。公共投资冲击在中期内提升就业与产出，且不会挤出私人投资与消费，亦不会引发通胀或额外债务负担。五年后累计产出乘数达3.38，在信贷条件有利时该乘数显著且更大。我们报告了公共基础设施支出对产出和就业均存在显著的正向溢出效应。

url:fb288c14f239381c.abstract: Using text-as-data methods, we quantify the U.S. discourse on China, place it in historical perspective, and compare its evolution across different sources of public narrative. Our analysis is based on a large corpus of materials drawn from public records (presidential and congressional records, newspaper articles, social media, think tank reports). We develop two measures of narrative discourse: an indicator of the frequency with which China is covered and a proxy for how positively or negatively China is presented. We document a sustained decline in net sentiment towards China in presidential sources since the early 2000s, predating Donald Trump’s first term in office. In contrast to presidential documents, congressional, news media, social media, and think tank sources exhibit persistent negative sentiment towards China even in decades prior to the 2000s. Instead of a deterioration in sentiment across the board, what we find is a convergence in presidential sentiment to other sources of narrative discourse. We find no evidence that presidential leadership has played a significant role in setting the narrative tone for the nation as a whole. Historical and shorter-term evidence both point to a bottom-up process of diffusion of narratives, rather than top-down diffusion.
url:fb288c14f239381c.abstract_zh: 采用文本数据方法，我们量化了美国涉华话语体系，将其置于历史视角下审视，并比较了不同公共叙事来源的演变过程。分析基于涵盖公共记录（总统与国会档案、报刊文章、社交媒体、智库报告）的大型语料库。我们构建了叙事话语的两项指标：中国话题的报道频率指数，以及中国形象呈现的正面/负面倾向代理变量。研究发现，自21世纪初以来，总统文献中对华净情感指数持续走低，这一趋势早于唐纳德·特朗普的首个任期。与总统文献形成对比的是，国会、新闻媒体、社交媒体及智库来源在21世纪前的数十年间已持续呈现对华负面倾向。我们观察到的并非全面情感恶化，而是总统话语与其他叙事来源的趋同现象。未发现总统领导力在塑造全国叙事基调中发挥显著作用的证据。历史与短期证据均指向叙事传播的自下而上模式，而非自上而下扩散。

url:fb71e25b18285653.abstract: This article examines gender differences in early childhood capability deprivation in Algeria, Morocco, Syria, and Yemen. Using nationally representative surveys from the Pan Arab Project for Family Health, we estimate deprivation among children aged 0-4 in three latent dimensions: nutrition, sanitation, and access to information. The empirical strategy combines a capability-deprivation framework with multi-group structural equation modelling, measurement-invariance tests, and multidimensional aggregation. The results show that gendered deprivation is neither uniform nor always to the disadvantage of girls. Female children are more likely to be capability deprived on aggregate in Algeria, Morocco, and Yemen, while male children appear more deprived in Syria. Gender disparities also vary across dimensions: boys are more likely to be nutrition-deprived in Morocco and Syria, while girls are more likely to be sanitation-deprived in Algeria and Morocco and information-deprived in Morocco and Yemen. Rural residence and low household-head education are generally associated with weaker achievements in nutrition, sanitation, and information. The findings contribute to applied research on child poverty measurement and gender inequality by showing that gendered capability deprivation is observable before school age and is patterned by household and public-service conditions.
url:fb71e25b18285653.abstract_zh: 本文考察了阿尔及利亚、摩洛哥、叙利亚和也门四国儿童早期能力剥夺的性别差异。基于泛阿拉伯家庭健康项目的全国代表性调查数据，我们估算了0-4岁儿童在营养、卫生设施和信息获取三个潜在维度上的剥夺状况。实证策略将能力剥夺框架与多组结构方程模型、测量不变性检验及多维聚合方法相结合。研究结果表明：性别化的剥夺既非均匀分布，也并非总是不利于女童。在阿尔及利亚、摩洛哥和也门，女童在综合指标上更易遭受能力剥夺，而叙利亚男童的剥夺程度则更为显著。性别差异在不同维度上呈现异质性：摩洛哥和叙利亚男童更易出现营养剥夺，阿尔及利亚和摩洛哥女童更易面临卫生设施剥夺，摩洛哥和也门女童则在信息获取方面处于劣势。农村居住环境与户主低教育水平通常与营养、卫生设施及信息获取方面的弱势表现相关。本研究通过揭示学龄前阶段已存在性别化的能力剥夺现象，且该现象受家庭与公共服务条件影响，为儿童贫困测量与性别不平等领域的应用研究提供了新证据。

url:fba6f746e8618771.abstract: European banking remains fragmented, leaving billions of euros inefficiently allocated. Reforms to establish a European deposit insurance system have been proposed to allow cross-border banking groups to operate more freely. This column argues that a common deposit insurance system fundamentally changes the link between risk-sharing and risk-taking. In addition to greater integration, it can encourage more risk-taking, with unclear effects on overall welfare. Therefore, greater freedom to move capital and liquidity across borders should be accompanied by sufficiently strict supervision to address the risk-taking incentives created by such reforms.
url:fba6f746e8618771.abstract_zh: 欧洲银行业仍处于碎片化状态，导致数十亿欧元资金配置效率低下。为建立欧洲存款保险体系而提出的改革方案，旨在允许跨境银行集团更自由地运营。本专栏认为，共同存款保险体系从根本上改变了风险分担与风险承担之间的关联。除了促进一体化外，它还可能鼓励更多风险承担行为，但对整体福利的影响尚不明确。因此，在赋予资本和流动性跨境流动更大自由度的同时，必须辅以足够严格的监管，以应对此类改革所催生的风险承担激励。

url:fc0217269728fd16.abstract: President Donald Trump's Global Tariff War has discarded US commitments to the postwar international trading order established under the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT) and the World Trade Organization (WTO). It replaces the Most Favored Nation (MFN) principle with an "Every Nation Different" principle under the false premise that any economy with a trade surplus against the United States must be cheating on its trade obligations and imposes a "reciprocal" tariff increase based on the ratio of bilateral US imports to exports. It fails to recognize the role of US fiscal deficits in boosting demand for imports, and of the attractiveness of the US capital market to inflows of foreign capital in strengthening the dollar and contributing to a persistent trade deficit. The Trump Global Tariff War promises revival of US manufacturing jobs under the false premise that trade deficits rather than technological change and Engel curve shifts in demand toward services have driven the decline in the share of manufacturing in employment and GDP. It shows no recognition that higher tariffs are a self-inflicted wound to the economy because of large static welfare triangle costs and loss in dynamic efficiency growth. This study estimates that the 18 percent rise in tariffs so far in the Trump Global Tariff War imposes an ongoing future static welfare cost of 0.28 percent of GDP. The medium-term dynamic efficiency loss brings the total welfare loss reaching a range of 1.1 to 2.3 percent of baseline GDP by 2035. Congressional Budget Office budget estimates of increased tariff revenues of 1 percent of GDP over the next decade (including interest savings) may be understated on an implied premise of sharp import reductions but overstated because President Trump has suggested giving them away in "tariff dividend" checks to all but high-income households. Moreover, a possible Supreme Court ruling against application of the "emergency" legislation on which the main tariff increases are based further reduces the reliability of revenue estimates. The Trump Global Tariff War has usefully revealed a vulnerability of the US economy to a future cutoff in the supply of rare earth minerals, metals, and magnets imported from China that requires urgent action.
url:fc0217269728fd16.abstract_zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统的全球关税战抛弃了美国在《关税与贸易总协定》（GATT）和世界贸易组织（WTO）框架下对战后国际贸易秩序的承诺。它以"每个国家都不同"原则取代最惠国待遇（MFN）原则，其错误前提是任何对美贸易顺差经济体必然违反贸易义务，并基于双边美进口与出口比率实施"对等"关税加征。该政策未能认识到美国财政赤字对进口需求的拉动作用，以及美国资本市场对外资流入的吸引力如何强化美元并导致持续贸易逆差。特朗普全球关税战承诺重振美国制造业就业，其错误前提是贸易逆差而非技术变革及恩格尔曲线向服务需求转移导致了制造业在就业与GDP中占比下降。该政策完全无视更高关税因巨大的静态福利三角形成本与动态效率增长损失而对经济造成的自伤效应。本研究估算，特朗普全球关税战迄今18%的关税加征将产生持续的未来静态福利成本，占GDP的0.28%。中期动态效率损失使总福利损失在2035年达到基准GDP的1.1%至2.3%区间。美国国会预算办公室关于未来十年关税收入增加GDP的1%（含利息节省）的预算估算，可能因隐含进口大幅减少的前提而被低估，但亦因特朗普总统提议向除高收入家庭外的所有群体发放"关税红利"支票而被高估。此外，最高法院可能裁定主要关税加征所依据的"紧急状态"立法不适用，进一步降低了收入估算的可靠性。特朗普全球关税战有效揭示了美国经济未来面临从中国进口的稀土矿物、金属及磁材供应中断的脆弱性，亟需采取紧急行动。

url:fc68f02d16d0051f.abstract: This paper concentrates on the effects of increased competition on fare behaviour. It uses an unpublished 1990 dataset on eight fare categories adopted by Alitalia on medium-range international routes (Europe, North Africa, Middle East). Using an index of competitive pressure on Alitalia, we find that competition is stronger in the EC than elsewhere in the medium-range markets. Moreover, increases in the degree of competition cause average fares to fall, and fare variability to increase, as new lower fares are introduced, or passengers are allowed easier access to low fares which already exist. In non-EC medium-range (still regulated) markets, the determination of fares does not seem to depend on the number of carriers serving each route, as the presence of many `competitors' -- who in fact collude -- may even suggest the existence of a market where prices can actually increase.
url:fc68f02d16d0051f.abstract_zh: 本文聚焦于竞争加剧对票价行为的影响。研究采用意大利航空1990年未公开的八类票价数据集，涵盖其中程国际航线（欧洲、北非、中东）。通过构建意大利航空面临的竞争压力指数，我们发现中程市场中欧盟地区的竞争强度高于其他区域。此外，竞争程度的提升导致平均票价下降，而票价波动性增加——这源于新低价票种的引入，或乘客更易获取既有低价票种。在非欧盟中程（仍受管制）市场，票价决定似乎不取决于每条航线的承运商数量，因为众多"竞争者"（实际存在合谋行为）的存在甚至可能暗示市场存在票价上涨空间。

url:fc7e5966874a438d.abstract: Unique global data on 47,000 consumers across 47 countries representing 90% of world GDP reveal universal patterns in macroeconomic belief formation. Most consumers form beliefs based on local information sources (utility bills, shopping, and acquaintances) that provide signals not representative for the overall consumption bundle, so that seeking information leads to forming biased macroeconomic expectations. Distrust in governments and central banks, the producers of aggregate economic information, helps explain reliance on local sources and the lack of learning from aggregate realizations. Observed macroeconomic volatility fuels distrust. In the cross-section, we confirm that certain demographics correlate with expectation biases but mostly due to different sorting into information sources, rather than different processing of the same economic information. These globally established facts inform advances of theories of belief formation and the design of communication strategies as a macroeconomic policy tool.
url:fc7e5966874a438d.abstract_zh: 覆盖全球47个国家、代表全球90%GDP的47,000名消费者的独特全球数据揭示了宏观经济信念形成的普遍模式。大多数消费者基于本地信息源（水电账单、购物经历及熟人）形成信念，这些信息源提供的信号无法代表整体消费组合，因此信息寻求反而导致形成有偏的宏观经济预期。对生产总体经济信息的政府与中央银行的不信任，有助于解释消费者依赖本地信息源以及未能从总体经济实现中学习的原因。观测到的宏观经济波动加剧了这种不信任。在横截面分析中，我们证实某些人口统计特征与预期偏差相关，但这主要源于不同群体对信息源的选择差异，而非对相同经济信息处理方式的差异。这些全球性实证发现为信念形成理论的发展以及作为宏观经济政策工具的沟通策略设计提供了依据。

url:fd12977fdc44fbd6.abstract: Is the top of the economics profession becoming more insular? We study the placement of top PhD graduates over the past quarter-century, matching them to their advisors. Three trends point towards greater openness: graduates increasingly place outside academia, outside the US, and into a tech sector recruiting broadly across gender, ethnicity, and program prestige. The disaggregated picture is less reassuring: the Emerging South is largely sidelined in the global job market, East Asians face persistent gaps in top academic placement, and elite advisors continue to confer substantial advantages within academia. Tech placement, meanwhile, is dominated by a single employer.
url:fd12977fdc44fbd6.abstract_zh: 经济学界顶尖群体是否正变得愈发封闭？我们研究了近25年来顶尖博士毕业生的就业去向，并将其与导师进行匹配。三项趋势表明开放性增强：毕业生越来越多地进入学术界以外、美国以外以及科技行业就业，且科技行业的招聘在性别、种族和院校声望方面具有广泛包容性。然而细分数据却令人担忧：新兴南方国家在全球就业市场中基本被边缘化，东亚裔在顶尖学术岗位中持续面临差距，精英导师在学术界仍能赋予显著优势。与此同时，科技行业的就业高度集中于单一雇主。

url:fd2d2a726ddc4404.abstract: This systematic review, meta-analysis and meta-regression evaluates twenty years of literature on data-driven identification of common PTSD symptom trajectories following potentially traumatic events. Traditional, machine learning- and large language model–assisted systematic search approaches were combined to identify eligible articles applying statistical Growth Mixture Modeling to longitudinally assessed PTSD symptom severity. Ninety-nine studies representing 113 independent samples and 215, 136 participants from 21 countries were included. We identified five prototypical PTSD symptom trajectories that commonly occurred across samples. We determined pooled relative trajectory prevalence estimates across samples observing these specific trajectories with the low symptoms trajectory being the most and the increasing symptoms trajectory the least prevalent. Using meta-regression, various socio-demographic, exposure-related and methodological moderators of sample-level relative trajectory prevalences were identified. Our findings provide empirical support and further refinements of leading theoretical PTSD conceptualizations. Furthermore, the obtained relative prevalence estimates and sample-level moderators may inform population-tailored trauma-related mental health care.
url:fd2d2a726ddc4404.abstract_zh: 本系统综述、荟萃分析及荟萃回归评估了二十年来关于创伤后应激障碍症状轨迹数据驱动识别的研究文献。结合传统、机器学习及大型语言模型辅助的系统检索方法，识别出符合条件的研究，这些研究应用统计增长混合模型对纵向评估的PTSD症状严重程度进行分析。共纳入来自21个国家的99项研究，涵盖113个独立样本及215,136名参与者。我们识别出五种典型的PTSD症状轨迹，这些轨迹在样本中普遍出现。我们确定了观察这些特定轨迹的样本中，轨迹相对患病率的汇总估计，其中低症状轨迹最为普遍，而症状递增轨迹最为罕见。通过荟萃回归分析，我们识别出多种社会人口学、暴露相关及方法论层面的调节变量，这些变量影响样本层面的相对轨迹患病率。我们的研究结果为领先的PTSD理论概念化提供了实证支持，并进一步加以完善。此外，所获得的相对患病率估计及样本层面调节变量可为针对人群定制的创伤相关心理健康护理提供参考。

url:fd4efcaff83f1319.abstract: In the last two decades European policy makers have sought to increase the use of market mechanisms in the delivery of healthcare. These reforms introduce competition and choice into previously heavily constrained environments. This leads to a set of interesting economic issues that have been addressed in a range of papers, both theoretical and empirical. This paper examines whether this popular reform model has resulted in improvements in outcomes for patients and/or taxpayers. It synthesises the existing economic analyses, highlights what is known and what is not, and signals potential next steps for economic research.
url:fd4efcaff83f1319.abstract_zh: 过去二十年中，欧洲政策制定者致力于在医疗服务供给中扩大市场机制的应用。这些改革将竞争与选择引入此前受到严格约束的环境，由此引发了一系列有趣的经济学议题，相关理论与实证论文已对此展开探讨。本文旨在考察这一流行改革模式是否改善了患者和/或纳税人的福利。通过综合现有经济分析，本文厘清了已知与未知领域，并指出了经济学研究的潜在未来方向。

url:fe47366ae7920832.abstract: We examine the effects of a criminal record on labor market outcomes and the mediating role of job sorting using Swedish register data. Prime-age adults with criminal records earn about 30% less than observably similar adults without records and are concentrated in specific employers and occupations. To estimate the causal effect of a criminal record, we use an event study design that compares outcomes for adults charged with an offense for the first time to matched adults who were suspected of a similar offense but not charged. Acquiring a criminal record reduces months employed by 2% and annual earnings by 5%. These negative effects are: twice as large for more serious or subsequent charges, not driven by job displacement or incapacitation, and not mitigated by automatic record expungement, which typically occurs 5 or 10 years after case disposition. We classify firms by their propensity to hire workers with criminal records, holding suspected offense history fixed. A criminal record reduces employment at firms classified as less likely to hire workers with criminal records, increases employment at other firms, and decreases monthly wages across all firm types. Firm propensity to hire workers with criminal records varies substantially — even within industries — and is linked to firm size and managers’ prior exposure to people with records. Leveraging manager moves across small firms, we find that when a firm hires a new manager with greater prior exposure to people with criminal records, it hires more people with records, with no detectable effect on productivity.
url:fe47366ae7920832.abstract_zh: 本文利用瑞典登记数据，考察犯罪记录对劳动力市场结果的影响以及工作分类的中介作用。有犯罪记录的壮年成年人收入比观察特征相似的无记录成年人低约30%，且集中于特定雇主和职业。为估计犯罪记录的因果效应，我们采用事件研究设计，将首次被指控犯罪的成年人与匹配的因类似罪行被怀疑但未被指控的成年人进行结果比较。获得犯罪记录会使就业月数减少2%，年收入减少5%。这些负面效应在更严重或后续指控中扩大两倍，并非由工作替代或失能效应驱动，且无法通过通常在案件结案后5年或10年自动执行的记录消除政策缓解。我们根据企业雇佣有犯罪记录劳动者的倾向性对企业进行分类，同时固定被怀疑的犯罪史。犯罪记录会降低在分类为不太可能雇佣有犯罪记录劳动者的企业的就业率，增加在其他企业的就业率，并降低所有类型企业的月工资。企业雇佣有犯罪记录劳动者的倾向性差异显著——即使在行业内部——且与企业规模及管理者此前接触有犯罪记录者的经历相关。利用管理者在小企业间的流动，我们发现当企业雇佣一位此前接触有犯罪记录者经历更丰富的新管理者时，会雇佣更多有犯罪记录者，且对生产率无显著影响。

url:fe57206124ae2eb6.abstract: This paper explores the relationship between the myopia, the solvency and the reputation of a government choosing the optimal financing policy given a particular path of government spending. A central result is the demonstration of a logical link between government myopia and insolvency in the sense that there is a class of models for which a solution to the optimal taxation problem does not exist. Results are shown analytically for a very simple non-monetary economy, for a seigniorage model examined by Obstfeld and, using simulations, for a more developed non-Ricardian model with capital.
url:fe57206124ae2eb6.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在给定政府支出路径下，政府选择最优融资政策时，其短视性、偿付能力与声誉之间的关系。核心结论在于揭示了政府短视与偿付能力之间的逻辑关联——存在一类模型，其中最优税收问题的解不存在。研究通过解析方法分析了一个极为简单的非货币经济体，针对奥布斯菲尔德所研究的铸币税模型进行了探讨，并利用模拟方法对包含资本的更发达的非李嘉图模型进行了分析。

url:fe9df33024b32bc5.abstract: We use Gallup World Poll data from over 150 countries from 2009-2019 at both the individual and country levels to revisit the relationship between income and subjective wellbeing. Our inspiration is the paradox first proposed by Easterlin (1974), where higher incomes are associated with greater happiness in cross-sections, yet rising country GDP per head does not necessarily increase its average wellbeing. In our analysis subjective wellbeing (or happiness) is measured by the Cantril ladder on a 0-10 scale. Across individuals, other things equal, one unit of log income raises subjective wellbeing by 0.4 points. In other words, doubling income raises wellbeing by 0.3 points out of 10. Across countries, a crude regression of wellbeing on log per capita income gives a higher coefficient of 0.6. But, once social variables like health and social support are introduced, the picture changes. In rich countries, income no longer has a significant independent effect, either in country cross-sections or in time series. For low-income countries the result is also clear cut - income raises happiness in both cross-section and time series, whether the social variables are controlled for or not. For middle-income countries the result is mixed.
url:fe9df33024b32bc5.abstract_zh: 我们利用2009-2019年间覆盖150多个国家的盖洛普世界民意调查数据，从个体和国家两个层面重新审视收入与主观幸福感之间的关系。本研究的灵感源于伊斯特林（1974）首次提出的悖论：在横截面数据中，较高收入与更高幸福感相关，但国家人均GDP增长未必能提升其平均幸福感。本分析中，主观幸福感（或幸福感）采用坎特里尔阶梯量表（0-10分制）进行测量。在个体层面，其他条件不变时，对数收入每增加一个单位，主观幸福感提升0.4分。换言之，收入翻倍可使幸福感在10分制中提升0.3分。在国家层面，对幸福感与人均对数收入进行简单回归，得到0.6的更高系数。然而，一旦引入健康与社会支持等社会变量，结果便发生改变。在富裕国家，无论是国家横截面数据还是时间序列数据，收入均不再具有显著的独立效应。对于低收入国家，结果同样明确——无论是否控制社会变量，收入在横截面和时间序列中均能提升幸福感。而对于中等收入国家，结果则呈现混合特征。

url:fed98d6a4c411573.abstract: Environmental regulations often generate environmental improvements at home, yet their consequences may extend far beyond the countries that adopt them. The international incidence of environmental regulation remains poorly understood. We study where the resulting environmental damages emerge and who ultimately bears their costs using China's 2017 ban on waste imports, which triggered a large reallocation of global recycling activity. Combining international trade data, administrative records, direct measures of firms' waste mismanagement, and local pollution data in the main destination for diverted waste, we examine the international incidence of environmental regulation by tracing the rarely observed process linking trade reallocation to firm behavior, pollution exposure, and welfare. The ban increased pollution-intensive plastic waste imports, lowering input costs for downstream firms using recyclable materials. Meanwhile, imported waste displaced domestic recyclables, leading firms to adopt harmful disposal methods. The environmental damages from air pollution exceeded the economic gains from access to lower-cost inputs.
url:fed98d6a4c411573.abstract_zh: 环境法规往往能改善本国环境质量，但其影响可能远超实施国边界。目前学界对跨国环境规制效应的理解仍十分有限。本文以中国2017年实施的废品进口禁令为研究对象——该政策引发了全球回收活动的重大重组——探究由此产生的环境损害发生在何处，以及最终由谁承担其成本。通过整合国际贸易数据、行政记录、企业废弃物管理不当的直接测度指标，以及废弃物转移主要目的地的局部污染数据，我们追踪了从贸易重组到企业行为、污染暴露及福利效应的罕见传导链条，从而考察环境规制的跨国影响。研究发现：该禁令增加了污染密集型塑料废品的进口，降低了使用可回收材料的下游企业的投入成本；与此同时，进口废品挤占了国内可回收物市场，导致企业采用有害处置方式。空气污染造成的环境损害已超过低成本投入带来的经济收益。
url:fed98d6a4c411573.title: Plastic Dumping Grounds: The International Incidence of Environmental Regulation
url:fed98d6a4c411573.title_zh: 塑料倾倒场：环境规制的国际影响

url:fee7fc3c3d5db3fa.abstract: Data centers now account for 4.4% of United States electricity demand, yet the grid-level effectiveness of the renewable energy certificates (RECs) and power purchase agreements (PPAs) hyperscalers use to claim carbon neutrality remains unclear. We develop a game-theoretic model in which a data center operator chooses among RECs, PPAs, and behind-the-meter colocation while generators make entry decisions under endogenous financing costs. The model identifies a timing wedge -- the mismatch between consumption and credited renewable generation -- as a central mechanism through which AI demand degrades reliability, raises prices, and increases emissions even when RECs cover 100% of annual consumption. Colocation with storage addresses this wedge directly and induces the greatest renewable entry by eliminating generator revenue risk. We test these predictions by exploiting the staggered release of large language models as a natural experiment, using difference-in-differences on a novel dataset linking AI activity to local grid outcomes. AI demand significantly increases fossil generation, wholesale prices (up to 25% in treated PJM zones), and outage frequency (0.5--1 additional outages per year) near data centers, with impacts scaling in model size. Data centers with on-site generation exhibit a sign reversal in power-quality effects, consistent with the model
url:fee7fc3c3d5db3fa.abstract_zh: 数据中心目前占美国电力需求的4.4%，然而，超大规模企业用于宣称碳中和的可再生能源证书（RECs）和购电协议（PPAs）在电网层面的有效性仍不明确。我们构建了一个博弈论模型，其中数据中心运营商在RECs、PPAs和表后托管之间进行选择，而发电商则在内生融资成本下做出进入决策。该模型识别出一个时间错配——即电力消费与可归因的可再生能源发电之间的时间差——作为核心机制，通过这一机制，即使RECs覆盖100%的年度消费，AI需求仍会降低可靠性、推高电价并增加排放。结合储能的表后托管直接解决了这一时间错配，并通过消除发电商的收入风险，最大程度地促进了可再生能源的进入。我们利用大语言模型的分阶段发布作为自然实验，通过双重差分法对连接AI活动与地方电网结果的新数据集进行检验，以验证这些预测。AI需求显著增加了数据中心附近化石燃料发电量、批发价格（在受影响的PJM区域最高上涨25%）以及停电频率（每年额外增加0.5至1次停电），其影响随模型规模扩大而增强。配备现场发电的数据中心在电能质量效应上表现出符号反转，这与模型预测一致。
url:fee7fc3c3d5db3fa.title: Certificates without Electrons? Theory and Evidence on Impacts from AI-Driven Power Demand
url:fee7fc3c3d5db3fa.title_zh: 没有电子的证书？人工智能驱动电力需求影响的理论与证据

url:fee872a15ff237c7.abstract: We develop a novel semantic-distance-based algorithm and apply it to job titles data to identify ``new work''---new types of jobs introduced in a labor market. Implementing these measures for the US (1980-2010), we show that the share of college-educated workers across occupations and locations is the strongest predictor of new work, even after controlling for technological change, trade, immigration, population aging, and agglomeration economies. Using pre-1920 land-grant colleges as instruments in matched treatment-control analyses, we find evidence consistent with a strong, positive causal effect of college-educated density on ``new work" creation. Complementary analysis based on Lightcast online vacancy data (2017-2022) confirms this pattern.
url:fee872a15ff237c7.abstract_zh: 我们开发了一种基于语义距离的新算法，并将其应用于职位名称数据，以识别“新工作”——即劳动力市场中引入的新型职业类型。通过在美国（1980-2010年）实施这些度量，我们发现，即使在控制了技术变革、贸易、移民、人口老龄化和集聚经济等因素后，各职业和地区中受过大学教育的劳动者占比仍是新工作出现的最强预测因子。利用1920年前赠地学院作为工具变量，在匹配处理-对照分析中，我们发现了与大学教育密度对新工作创造具有强烈正向因果效应相一致的证据。基于Lightcast在线职位空缺数据（2017-2022年）的补充分析进一步证实了这一模式。
url:fee872a15ff237c7.title: The Role of College Education in the Rise of ``New Work": Measurement and Evidence
url:fee872a15ff237c7.title_zh: 大学教育在“新工作”兴起中的作用：测度与证据

url:fefdf80821c26243.title: Standard Errors when a Regressor is Randomly Assigned

url:ff23a34c0d6a2742.abstract: Governments increasingly look to capital income for both revenue and redistribution. This column compares two dividend tax reforms in Israel – a permanent rate increase and a temporary one-year cut – to examine how high-income taxpayers can adjust the timing and labelling of dividends in ways that undermine reform. Both produced immediate surges of more than 100% in reported dividends and tax revenue. But only the temporary reform left a lasting mark: payouts fell sharply once the relief expired, as firms retained earnings in anticipation of future cuts. Because undistributed profits are not recorded as personal income, the resulting rise in retained earnings also made top-income inequality appear to fall.
url:ff23a34c0d6a2742.abstract_zh: 各国政府日益依赖资本收入来增加财政收入和实现再分配。本文比较了以色列两项股息税改革——一项是永久性税率上调，另一项是临时性一年期减税——以考察高收入纳税人如何通过调整股息申报时间和分类来削弱改革效果。两项改革均导致申报股息和税收收入立即激增超过100%。但只有临时性改革留下了持久影响：当税收优惠到期后，股息支付大幅下降，因为企业为预期中的未来减税而留存收益。由于未分配利润不计入个人收入，由此产生的留存收益增加也使得顶层收入不平等程度看似有所下降。
url:ff23a34c0d6a2742.title: Dividend tax reforms: Why design shapes revenue and measured inequality
url:ff23a34c0d6a2742.title_zh: 股息税改革：为何设计影响财政收入与测度不平等

url:ff31d782b57b0042.abstract: This paper analyzes trade patterns across the Caribbean Community (CARICOM)—15 Caribbean countries—and makes three main contributions. First, it provides a unified empirical assessment of Caribbean external connectivity by jointly analyzing goods trade, tourism flows, and cross-border banking linkages within a consistent gravity-model framework. Second, it presents new evidence on the role of physical connectivity—shipping and air transport—in shaping both import source concentration and tourism inflows, drawing on granular bilateral trade, tourism, and flight capacity data. Third, it shows that, while financial connectivity matters in a global context, it is not the primary binding constraint for Caribbean economies; instead, limited physical connectivity emerges as the more decisive factor shaping trade patterns and external vulnerabilities.
url:ff31d782b57b0042.abstract_zh: 本文分析了加勒比共同体（CARICOM）——15个加勒比国家——的贸易模式，并作出三项主要贡献。首先，通过在一个一致的引力模型框架内联合分析商品贸易、旅游流和跨境银行联系，对加勒比地区的外部连通性进行了统一的实证评估。其次，利用细粒度的双边贸易、旅游和航班运力数据，揭示了物理连通性（航运和航空运输）在塑造进口来源集中度和旅游流入方面的作用。第三，研究表明，尽管金融连通性在全球背景下具有重要意义，但它并非加勒比经济体的主要约束因素；相反，有限的物理连通性成为塑造贸易模式和外部脆弱性的更具决定性的因素。
url:ff31d782b57b0042.title: Mind the Gaps: Caribbean Trade Patterns and the Connectivity Constraint
url:ff31d782b57b0042.title_zh: 关注差距：加勒比贸易模式与连通性约束

url:ff3d9ce7f4dae3b5.abstract: This paper asks whether macroeconomic policy can affect fertility and education by documenting a slow-down of long-term improvements in these two outcomes in the wake of a major protectionist shock that shielded low-skilled individuals from the adverse consequences of the first wave of globalisation. We build a novel dataset for 19th-century France where, following decades of rising grain imports at low prices, high tariffs on cereal were introduced in 1892, shifting relative prices in favour of agriculture and away from industry. We exploit regional data that allow us to measure differences in the intensity of the protectionist shock and find that the tariff halted the long-term increase in schooling and slowed-down the decline in fertility that were already well underway.
url:ff3d9ce7f4dae3b5.abstract_zh: 本文通过记录一次重大保护主义冲击后生育率与教育水平长期改善进程的放缓，探讨宏观经济政策能否影响这两项指标。该保护主义政策使低技能劳动者免受第一波全球化浪潮的不利影响。我们构建了19世纪法国的新数据集：在经历数十年低价谷物进口增长后，1892年对谷物征收高额关税，导致相对价格向农业倾斜而偏离工业。通过利用可衡量保护主义冲击强度的区域数据，我们发现该关税政策终止了已持续多年的教育普及化进程，并减缓了生育率的下降趋势。
url:ff3d9ce7f4dae3b5.title: The toll of tariffs: The impact of protectionism on education and fertility in late 19th century France
url:ff3d9ce7f4dae3b5.title_zh: 关税的代价：19世纪末法国保护主义对教育与生育率的影响

url:ff65e945168c2ed6.abstract: We characterize the optimal renegotiation-proof contract in a dynamic Principal-Agent model in which the type of the agent may change stochastically over time. Contrary to the case with constant types, the ex ante optimal contract may be renegotiation-proof even if types are highly correlated. The marginal benefit of having some pooling of types in the first period is not monotonic in their persistence level, but the equilibrium level of pooling is non-decreasing in persistence; and, for any level persistence, it is always optimal to partially screen the types by offering a menu of choices to the agent. Despite the non-linearity of the problem, the optimal equilibrium allocation is unique.
url:ff65e945168c2ed6.abstract_zh: 本文刻画了在代理人类型可能随时间随机变化的动态委托-代理模型中，最优的防再谈判契约特征。与类型恒定情形相反，即使类型高度相关，事前最优契约也可能具有防再谈判性质。第一期对部分类型进行混同的边际收益并非随其持续性水平单调变化，但均衡混同程度随持续性递增；且对于任意持续性水平，通过向代理人提供选择菜单进行部分甄别始终是最优策略。尽管该问题具有非线性特征，但最优均衡配置具有唯一性。
url:ff65e945168c2ed6.title: Optimality and Renegotiation in Dynamic Contracting
url:ff65e945168c2ed6.title_zh: 动态合同中的最优性与再谈判

url:ff9caea18320d1a3.title_zh: 一般均衡中的生存风险、实际利率与永久收入假说

url:ff9f009486580c1e.abstract: States are major international financiers, but their role is poorly understood. We study state-driven cross-border lending over two centuries using a new database covering 1.2 million official loans and grants by 134 governments and 70 multilateral institutions since 1790. We document a dual, state-contingent structure of international credit. In normal times, private creditors dominate cross-border lending. In adverse states of the world, such as wars and financial crises, official creditors step in, at times on a massive scale. These official flows are driven by great powers, are highly subsidized, and are largely absent from canonical models in international macroeconomics.
url:ff9f009486580c1e.abstract_zh: 国家是主要的国际融资方，但其作用尚不明确。我们利用涵盖1790年以来134个政府和70个多边机构120万笔官方贷款与赠款的新数据库，研究两个世纪以来国家驱动的跨境贷款。我们揭示了国际信贷的双重国家依存结构：在正常时期，私人债权人主导跨境贷款；而在战争、金融危机等不利状态下，官方债权人会介入，有时规模巨大。这些官方资金流动由大国驱动，享有高额补贴，且在国际宏观经济学的经典模型中基本缺失。
url:ff9f009486580c1e.title: States as Financiers: International Lending in War and Peace
url:ff9f009486580c1e.title_zh: 国家作为金融家：战争与和平中的国际借贷

url:ffa22d5ef9e48dee.abstract: Big Boss Games represent a specific class of cooperative games where a single veto player, known as the Big Boss, plays a central role in determining resource allocation and maintaining coalition stability. In this paper, we introduce a novel allocation scheme for Big Boss games, based on two classical solution concepts: the Shapley value and the \(\tau \)-value. This scheme generates a coalitionally stable allocation that effectively accounts for the contributions of weaker players. Specifically, we consider a diagonal of the core that includes the Big Boss’s maximum aspirations, the \(\tau \)-value, and those of the weaker players. From these allocations, we select the one that is closest to the Shapley value, referred to as the Projected Shapley Value allocation (PSV allocation). Through our analysis, we identify a new property of Big Boss games, particularly the relationship between the allocation discrepancies assigned by the \(\tau \)-value and the Shapley value, with a particular focus on the Big Boss and the other players. Additionally, we provide a new characterization of convexity within this context. Finally, we conduct a statistical analysis to assess the position of the PSV allocation within the core, especially in cases where computing the Shapley value is computationally challenging. url:ffa22d5ef9e48dee.abstract_zh: 大老板博弈是一类特殊的合作博弈，其中被称为"大老板"的单一否决权玩家在决定资源分配和维护联盟稳定性方面发挥着核心作用。本文基于两个经典解概念——沙普利值和τ值——为大老板博弈提出了一种新的分配方案。该方案能够产生联盟稳定的分配结果，有效体现弱势玩家的贡献。具体而言，我们考虑核心的对角线，该对角线包含大老板的最大期望值、τ值以及弱势玩家的期望值。从这些分配方案中，我们选取最接近沙普利值的分配方案，称为投影沙普利值分配（PSV分配）。通过分析，我们发现了大老板博弈的一个新性质，特别是τ值与沙普利值所分配的差异之间的关系，重点关注大老板与其他玩家之间的差异。此外，我们还在该背景下给出了凸性的新刻画。最后，我们通过统计分析评估PSV分配在核心中的位置，特别是在计算沙普利值存在计算困难的情况下。
url:ffa22d5ef9e48dee.title: The Shapley value and the strength of weak players in big boss games
url:ffa22d5ef9e48dee.title_zh: 大老板博弈中的沙普利值与弱参与者力量

url:ffa810b70df15025.abstract: We test for evidence that US trade policy depends on the degree of government discretion. We do this by studying US tariff choices under two distinct environments. One is that of tariffs set under the Escape Clause (section 201 of the US Trade Act of 1974). The other is the Tokyo Round of GATT negotiations and the determination of the set of exclusions from the general formula cuts. We argue that the second environment provides much more capacity to commit than the first one. Comparing decisions made in these two environments allows us to ask whether the degree of policy commitment has a measurable impact on trade policy. Our findings suggest that it does.
url:ffa810b70df15025.abstract_zh: 我们检验了美国贸易政策是否取决于政府自由裁量权的程度。为此，我们研究了两种不同环境下的美国关税选择：其一是根据《1974年贸易法》第201条“逃避条款”设定的关税；其二是GATT东京回合谈判中，从通用公式减让中确定排除清单的过程。我们认为，第二种环境比第一种环境提供了更强的承诺能力。通过比较这两种环境下的决策，我们得以探究政策承诺程度是否对贸易政策产生可衡量的影响。研究结果表明，这种影响确实存在。
url:ffa810b70df15025.title: DP514 Does Commitment Matter in Trade Policy?
url:ffa810b70df15025.title_zh: DP514 贸易政策中的承诺重要吗？

url:ffc4a5352afc1b82.abstract: this paper that the inference of a comparable time series of female economic activity rates from these data is not at all straightforward as the way in which economic activity was recorded altered on each occasion. We document these changes in reliability and likely direction of errors in Census evidence. Finally we adjust the Census information in the light of our activity rates by age group "less inconsistent" with the definition of economic activity as adopted by the EEC Labour Survey which is the most regular source likely to be available in the future. Since the 1971 Census seems to have been exceptionally extensive in its coverage of the economically active, the revised series makes the longer run upward trend seem to have been smoother than the crude data suggest.
url:ffc4a5352afc1b82.abstract_zh: 本文指出，从这些数据推断出具有可比性的女性经济活动率时间序列并非易事，因为每次记录经济活动的方式都有所不同。我们记录了这些变化在可靠性方面的影响，以及普查证据中可能存在的误差方向。最后，我们根据各年龄组的经济活动率对普查信息进行了调整，使其与欧共体劳动力调查所采用的经济活动定义“更少不一致”，而该调查是未来最可能定期获取的数据来源。由于1971年普查对经济活动人口的覆盖范围似乎异常广泛，修订后的序列使得长期上升趋势显得比原始数据所显示的更为平滑。
